14049679.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'spending funds to promote upper class education in the castle'?"

14052750.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'allowing the self-proclaimed neutral cartographer to survey our territory'?"

14516873.m_KeyValue: "Noah shook his head. 'Not seeing it at all.'"

14516874.m_KeyValue: ""As a sister of the Church, I was meant to devote my days and nights to the praise of our great lord, Aeon.""

14516875.m_KeyValue: ""'If I could crack them, we wouldn't have to rely on luck anymore.'""

14516876.m_KeyValue: ""'Forgive me, but I must go for now. I'll uncover the story behind it.'""

14516877.m_KeyValue: "'She didn't just study the moon… She recorded observations of other celestial bodies too. Look—here are notes on Venus and Mars.'"

14516880.m_KeyValue: "'That makes sense. Let's go take a look.'"

14517962.m_KeyValue: ""Before long, they stumbled upon a new discovery.""

14517963.m_KeyValue: "The long-buried history left behind by those before had finally found its chance to see the light of day."

14517964.m_KeyValue: ""Three figures arrived, their presence at odds with any fascination for the stars above.""

14517967.m_KeyValue: ""'I'll continue studying the moon—not just for the sake of returning home, but to honor the legacy of those who came before.'""

14517968.m_KeyValue: ""'According to the notes, the next observable phase is approaching soon. Why don't we stay and witness it for ourselves?'""

14674853.m_KeyValue: "A blend of salty sea air and Esmeralda's enchanting herbs."

14687849.m_KeyValue: ""...Ah, but it seems the director has no intention of letting the first scene conclude so easily.""

14687850.m_KeyValue: " 'All great dramas begin with a blackout. It just looks cooler that way.' —Excerpt from 'Minexus: A Brief History' (8th Edition)."

14687851.m_KeyValue: ""Though the hour grows late, a sea of faces crowds beneath the platform—they cry out '<style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style>' as if to honor Genevieve on her final bow.""

14687852.m_KeyValue: ""The name suits it perfectly, don't you think? What would you have called it instead—a <style=""Highlight"">chameleon</style>? How pedestrian.""

14687853.m_KeyValue: ""'You're back, Genevieve.' Mass isn't fazed. 'Too bad there's no room for you here anymore, <style=""Highlight"">former Drama Queen</style>.'""

14687854.m_KeyValue: ""'Because she's a <color=#728c69>Perfect Metamorph Dragon</color>, isn't that right—'""

14687855.m_KeyValue: ""'...Excellent, excellent!' Quinn watches the exchange, 'This is precisely the kind of sublime theatrical spectacle I envisioned!'""

14687856.m_KeyValue: ""'Of course, you must give up everything you have now…' Genevieve circles around Mass like a predator, her voice a silken whisper as she delivers each cruel word. 'As the saying goes, one must face death to find life—'""

14690025.m_KeyValue: ""—Let us warmly welcome our attendee seated to the north, the young lady who purchased her elder position for an exorbitant sum, founder and president of the Puppet Association—Bella Slade!""

14690026.m_KeyValue: "'What is it that you really want to reforge? The glory of the Bathory family... or that worn-out vessel of yours...?'"

14690027.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet remained unperturbed by Gilrain's intrusion. His gaze, unwavering and fixed upon the trophy, betrayed no reaction—as though he were already lost in the mists of memory. 'At the very least,' he intoned solemnly, 'I still possess recollections worthy of sharing.'""

14690028.m_KeyValue: ""A feeble light sputtered to life beside the loftiest seat on the eastern side of the Hall of Honor. Baphomet—despite his eyeless visage—squinted to adjust to the faint illumination, then brought his massive axe crashing down upon the ground...""

14690032.m_KeyValue: ""'Achoo!' Caught off guard by a sudden sneeze, Gilrain gives Bella an annoyed look.""

14690985.m_KeyValue: ""'The purpose of this assembly, newly appointed elders, is to showcase how we transform glory into tangible symbols that inspire our younger members. But I ask you this: in recent years, how many new trophies and medals have actually been added to our collection?'""

14690986.m_KeyValue: ""'Meow...?' As if awakened by Gilrain, the black cat leapt down from its usual spot and began pacing around the room.""

14690987.m_KeyValue: ""Having reached a momentous decision, a reverberating clang rang out as Baphomet slammed his axe onto the ground. In that instant, Baphomet's silhouette towered, grand and imposing.""

14690988.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain and Bella paused for a moment."

14690990.m_KeyValue: "—Which indirectly led to Baphomet's crushing defeat in one of the most pivotal battles of his existence!"

14729225.m_KeyValue: "A chill almost identical to the temperature of her own body."

14729226.m_KeyValue: "'Hold on. Something's not right.' Bella reached out with all her hands to stop Selena in her tracks. 'Don't you think the castle looks... dark?'"

14729227.m_KeyValue: ""At that, Bella let out a quiet giggle. 'Then allow me to take you to the finest restaurant in the Harbor of Soughs—consider it a token of thanks for teaching me the Breath of Life.'""

14729228.m_KeyValue: ""With two hands pinning Selena in place, Bella calmly used a third to sweep the loose strands behind her ear. Leaning in ever so slightly, she murmured: 'Hm? What was that? I didn't quite catch it.'""

14729229.m_KeyValue: ""Beneath the blistering sun, she adjusted the life-like octopus hat perched on her head, casting what little shade it could. 'This... this alone, I must never give up.'""

14729230.m_KeyValue: "'Prep Cook? I don't recall ever agreeing to that. Come to think of it—do you even know what Master Cook means?'"

14729231.m_KeyValue: ""'What I mean is...' Bella ran all four hands through her hair, tousled by the midnight breeze. 'We're lost.'""

14729232.m_KeyValue: ""'Oof...' The girl let Selena pull her along. As they ran, something familiar flickered through her mind... and for a moment, a quiet warmth welled up in her chest.""

14729237.m_KeyValue: ""'I want to share that feeling. That ache deep in the chest. With Lord Van Helsing. With Silver-haired. And with you, Bella... because all of you seem so... full of sorrow.'""

14730315.m_KeyValue: ""It vanished shortly before, or after, that elder left its presence.""

14730316.m_KeyValue: ""'I, too...' came the resigned reply, '...am a prisoner of circumstance.'""

14730317.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't overreact,' Lamia said, trying to maintain her facade of composure in front of her sister. 'It's just a magical painting.'""

14730318.m_KeyValue: "'It simultaneously reveals your true self and the self warped by your own perception.'"

14730319.m_KeyValue: ""Amidst the hall's array of rare specimens and curiosities, this portrait stood out.""

14730320.m_KeyValue: ""'Escape? I wouldn't be here if I had a way out!' Empousa cried out with frustration. When the incident unfolded, she had been trapped in the elevator and unwittingly became Lamia's accomplice.""

14761898.m_KeyValue: ""A wave of bone-chilling cold swept over both Gilrain and Bella, who felt it despite being in a puppet body.""

14761901.m_KeyValue: ""'The Roland family is stingy beyond belief. They call themselves the Lords of the Plains, but they don't have a clue about give and take. The only ones worse off are the Ganelon family—those wolf pups barely understand the concept of money!'""

14761902.m_KeyValue: ""Even if he did almost become a Bell Ringer. Even if he is a direct Cidhall descendant. So what? In the vast river of time, I have seen far too many such 'prodigies' come and go.""

14761903.m_KeyValue: ""'Victory with warhorses isn't a fair comparison,' Morain argued. 'We should evaluate them under equal conditions: on foot, without relying on enhancements like the Blood of Light.'""

14761904.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain's expression turned cold. 'So which family do you intend to use for the Transfusion? You'd be hard-pressed to find anyone in the Cidhall family stronger than me.'"

14767209.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Sirene, behave!_$$ Quinn fixes Sirene with a stern look before turning to Agnes with an elegant curtsy. _$$Agnes, in that case, I must make things right._$$""

14767210.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I... I understand! We'll start immediately... P-please, my lady, which scene would you have us begin with..._$$""

14767211.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Oh, Father and Mother are so blissfully happy together! It's like a real-life Mario and Juliet!_$$ Quinn lights up with joy.""

14767212.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Only a blissfully happy Bathory lady... How wonderful it is that such an Other Side could exist._$$ When she looks up again, her smile is bright and clear.""

14767213.m_KeyValue: ""Seeing that the young lady still refuses to show herself, Sirene's eyes glint with fresh mischief. _$$Oh my, what a terrible shame..._$$""

14767214.m_KeyValue: ""First appears an elegant parasol, lifting above the greenery like a pale moon. Then comes a young lady in a moon-white gown, stepping gracefully from the bushes. _$$...And you said Father just happens to be sleeping?_$$""

14767215.m_KeyValue: ""Welcome to our grand terrestrial adventure, rumor investigation, revelation entertainment, and comprehensive field expedition series—'Exploring Minexus'!""

14767216.m_KeyValue: "—She's stepped on her own ridiculously long cloak!"

14767223.m_KeyValue: ""_$$It's just one line! That's all!_$$ Before Agnes can protest again, Quinn materializes a scroll from nowhere and presses it into her hands.""

14767246.m_KeyValue: ""Finally, we're getting to the heart of it.""

14833773.m_KeyValue: ""'Which family?!' Van Helsing yelled in horror, but only silence answered.""

14833774.m_KeyValue: ""The guard continued, his eyes even more clouded with age as he gazed into the distance: 'The Ancestors are powerful beings, not so easily starved to death. Not all Bloodborn relish drinking blood either, as evidenced by the one standing next to you.'""

14833775.m_KeyValue: ""'I was becoming concerned too,' the guard admitted. 'If you knew its history, you'd understand—there shouldn't be any sounds coming from the vault at all.'""

14833776.m_KeyValue: ""Once again, they infiltrated the Bathory Castle to investigate the Ancestral Vault, only to cross paths with Noah during his after-dinner stroll.""

14834729.m_KeyValue: ""To Bella's right stood the hostess herself. 'No. We absolutely cannot let a distinguished guest be put at risk!' Empousa replied firmly, throwing a glance to her right.""

14834730.m_KeyValue: "'But that alchemy wasn't just about freezing.' Bella’s voice lowered again. 'According to the last alchemist who served the Bathory family... that process could absorb the life force of other living beings.'"

14834731.m_KeyValue: ""All three of them felt a creeping, cold dread that slithered down their spines. A nameless terror made their skin crawl, as they realized they were not alone in the dark.""

14834732.m_KeyValue: ""The Raog Fin Shark, also known as the Glasflare Dart, dwells in the deep waters surrounding the Dekatres Archipelago. Adults exceed twelve meters in length, with a hide so tough it can endure the crushing pressures of the abyss.""

14834733.m_KeyValue: ""Bella drifted toward the window at the end of the shadowed corridor, her gaze unfocused as it settled on the silent moonlit night beyond. Her thoughts wandered with it... Clearly, it was a memory unlike any other.""

14834734.m_KeyValue: ""Following her gaze, one could spot Empousa and Bella standing at the gates of Bathory Castle. They wore pleasant smiles and waved in welcome—yet behind those expressions, they whispered in hushed tones…""

14834735.m_KeyValue: ""'Lady Lorelei… um, thank you for… gracing our—our noble estate…'""

14834736.m_KeyValue: ""'The-the Ancestral Vault?!' Even in the dark, Empousa struck a dramatic pose of terror, as if trying to sell the performance. 'You fool! This is something you should've warned me—!'""

14834741.m_KeyValue: ""The blaze far surpassed expectations, flooding the room with an intense, searing brightness. In that sudden, daylight-like glow, each face revealed a flicker of emotion too complex to name.""

14834742.m_KeyValue: ""Bella raised all four arms, halting Lorelei before she could utter another word. 'I know everything. I don’t care about any of that. But…'""

17507573.m_KeyValue: "'And fear.' The painting on the wall interjected."

17507574.m_KeyValue: ""'It's simply out of the utmost respect for the Matriarch,' Cain replied solemnly.""

18565430.m_KeyValue: ""Then let me go, Ressa. No… Bell Ringer Thibault.""

18565431.m_KeyValue: ""And after I awoke, you traveled with me through Starfall Valley, Mouret, Sunset Isle…""

18565432.m_KeyValue: ""The life we shared… that quiet, ordinary time… It's a precious memory—one I'll carry always.""

18565433.m_KeyValue: ""Stay calm. On Sunset Isle, it's not uncommon to mistake memories… for longings.""

18565434.m_KeyValue: "Um… do you want to speak with me?"

18568633.m_KeyValue: "I'm also eager to reunite with my brethren!"

18568634.m_KeyValue: "Your cunning far exceeds my expectations—using the Heart of the Divine Body to revive your pawn and ordering her to impersonate you and stall us."

19418264.m_KeyValue: "(Then I'll proceed as planned—complete the survey task in her stead.)"

19418265.m_KeyValue: ""(Since she's clearly avoiding the topic, it suggests she won't be a threat in the near future.)""

19418272.m_KeyValue: "I saw those things in the castle..."

19418274.m_KeyValue: ""Alright then, I'll have the cartographic instruments sent to you presently.""

19418275.m_KeyValue: "Those things may terrify me... but that doesn't diminish the fact that I am the continent's greatest cartographer!"

19418277.m_KeyValue: ""Surveying work is no simple matter. Should you fail to meet the requirements, I will personally see to it at the castle...""

19418278.m_KeyValue: "(Did her surveying work inadvertently lead her to our secret?)"

19418279.m_KeyValue: "(Just what are these things that have Agnes so thoroughly spooked...)"

19857084.m_KeyValue: "Why are you holding back?! Why don't you just kill me?!"

19857085.m_KeyValue: ""So pray. To Aeon, or to our true ancestral Black Blood.""

19857086.m_KeyValue: ""Even if your body is caged beneath the Cathedral, under the Church's constant watch… Your soul will remain free.""

19857087.m_KeyValue: "And this _$$human form_$$ is the true curse. A lie forced upon us by the Divine Body."

19857088.m_KeyValue: "This is... have I returned to the Church?"

19857089.m_KeyValue: "Stop calling me a child. I'm over a hundred years old..."

20348163.m_KeyValue: ""That's one perspective. In truth, when the first spark illuminated the earth, humanity forever lost its blissful ignorance.""

20525664.m_KeyValue: "Most fantasy stories say the future is something that can't—or shouldn't—be known."

21166641.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you're warm... You look like a pile of frozen scrap. What are you really?""

21166642.m_KeyValue: ""I know you understand me. Go on, don't be shy.""

22061554.m_KeyValue: "It's been a long while since someone patted my head... How nostalgic."

22061651.m_KeyValue: "I've been meaning to stretch my legs. Let's see how the world's changed."

22064660.m_KeyValue: "Let us walk that road once more."

22070250.m_KeyValue: ""I tiptoe to be closer to you, but you're still out of reach.""

22073356.m_KeyValue: "My sword has grown a bit stronger."

22073449.m_KeyValue: ""Every time I open my eyes, it marks the beginning of a tragedy. But this time... I have you by my side.""

22075499.m_KeyValue: "My future is but a dream of endlessly prayer to return to the bygone days."

22076648.m_KeyValue: "Stand by my side and witness how I toy with this world."

22426881.m_KeyValue: "W-who told these disgusting things to keep crawling on me?!"

24628392.m_KeyValue: ""Though I've transformed like a butterfly, my heart remains unchanged! Brought forth from the Divine Body _$$Womb,_$$ she concealed the name of _$$Plague_$$—one of the Four Calamities—beneath the surname _$$Ganelon._$$ She knew she didn't belong here, yet couldn't recall where her true homeland lay; she didn't know where to go, nor who her real self was. But her father's hand-sewn cloak caressed her cheeks, her brother's gift of Wolfsbane rustled in her bag, and Sheila's bloodline flowed through her veins... These cherished mementos wrapped around her more warmly than any armor. —Home was never just a place on the continent; it exists wherever cherished memories gather. —She has always been that little girl from the Lupine Forest, and Hati Ganelon has never changed.""

24628675.m_KeyValue: ""Judge the world with clarity, seek the truth with conviction. One of Saint Albrecht's three disciples, Van Helsing was adopted by the Saint following a tragedy too severe for most to survive. Now a dedicated member of Silver Cross, he devotes himself to the pursuit of absolute justice, executing every mission from the Church with unwavering precision. Perhaps, in these cases, he even finds a measure of joy. Van Helsing's pursuit of power is not born of ambition—but of duty. To carry out what must be done.""

24628764.m_KeyValue: ""What truly defines a person - their physical form, or their soul? As an embodiment of honor and principle within this ancient family, time has not left him with the scars of decay, but with a haunting question of existence. The true cause of his loss of physical form centuries ago remains unknown, yet his obsession with the 'silver-haired, crimson-eyed Bloodborn' is unrelenting.""

24628923.m_KeyValue:
""'Plunge into the turbid currents of fate.'

Ami, who had never been in control of her own destiny, finally made a choice of her own—to plunge into the sea and perish together with the Calamity along with her own bloodline, tied to the Divine Body. What she didn't expect was that Noah, in an attempt to save her, would also choose to jump into the sea. Amidst the surging waves, all she could see was that outstretched hand.

In her eyes, the ocean had always been cold—yet profound. It didn't need her, and she didn't need it. It had kept her in solitude, yet also granted her true salvation. The moment she plunged into the sea, death caught up with her—embraced her. She no longer tried to struggle free from the darkness; she had accepted the destiny to which she belonged. But the ocean didn't let her die. Nor did Noah. Well then... perhaps she could try to live on.

Breaking free from death's grasp, she became one with Famine, her heartbeat now resonating with the waves. One day, this entire ocean would heed her command.""

24633487.m_KeyValue: "<color=#D63536>Starfall Valley</color>... Somehow we ended up going there anyway. Is it just a coincidence?"

25211794.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? You look a bit pale..."

25897513.m_KeyValue: ""I discovered a secret—when I place the Siren's Tear beside my pillow, she appears in my dreams.""

25920171.m_KeyValue:
""The dagger that gleamed under the silver moon was proof of direct descent from the Ganelon family. It would grow stronger as Clive Jr. grew, and vanish when his life came to an end. It was also his only solace—that he shared a deeper bond with his foster father than his sister ever did.
He dreamed of the day his dagger would become a great sword. But when that day finally came, he understood the look in Clive's eyes—a gaze filled with pity, mourning the youth forever trapped in this endless cycle...""

25920264.m_KeyValue:
""October 7th, 1354. Clear, perfect sunshine. Yet the air aboard feels heavier with each passing day. William—the root of it all—has turned into someone I scarcely recognize. He is no longer the person I once knew. Left with no other options, I've contacted Cain. I don't know if his solution will work, but I've no choice now but to try. I won't let William drag the whole crew under.
I pray the fabled Sunset Isle will truly hold the answers we seek. Let it not be the end of our voyage.
—The final entry in the Captain's Log of the El Dorado""

25920330.m_KeyValue: ""A pillow Hati stitched for Clive—silent witness to many sleepless nights clouded with doubt. In one corner bloomed a small Wolfsbane, a quiet vow woven in thread. Over time, the bloom faded, foreshadowing a parting they could never escape.""

25920419.m_KeyValue:
""Regina carried back a construct heart from The Exodus.

She tells me it is an old custom.

That when split in two, a construct's heart becomes twin talismans, each half carrying a blessing of protection for those who matter most.""

25920578.m_KeyValue:
""Stella wished to learn this world's history. But my time since waking had been brief, and I knew little more than she did. So we arranged to meet in the library.

As she stepped into the room—lined with parchment scrolls and timeworn tomes—her face lit up with wonder. In her world, under the Mastermind's orders, constructs had destroyed nearly all written works to obstruct and monopolize the spread of knowledge.

What little remained—knowledge that fueled the fight for freedom—was preserved only in hushed whispers passed between those who dared resist.

I had never truly understood how precious books could be.""

26565529.m_KeyValue: ""I fear for my own future as well, wondering if I too will become a monster imprisoned by the family's mission.""

26565530.m_KeyValue: "I don't know... I'm afraid the monster might harm him."

26565533.m_KeyValue: ""I asked father what the monster was, but he remained silent.""

26565534.m_KeyValue: ""The monster had slender limbs and a hoarse voice. On its wrinkled, festering face, one could barely make out features that seemed almost human.""

26565535.m_KeyValue: "It seems your father harbors deep hatred for the monster."

26565536.m_KeyValue: "It seems your father harbors deep feelings for the monster."

26565537.m_KeyValue: ""Father was in high spirits and had a few extra drinks at the banquet. In his drunken state, he led me to the forbidden grounds.""

26565538.m_KeyValue: ""At my birthday banquet this year, father and the Elders spoke of many mysterious things... They said someone could finally inherit the family's mission, and mentioned taking me to a _$$ritual._$$ I don't understand what they mean.""

26565539.m_KeyValue: ""Father opened the iron doors one by one, then sat beside the monster, endlessly mumbling to himself as both smiles and tears crept across his face.""

26565540.m_KeyValue: "A stench from the Abyss permeated the cold dungeon—there was actually a monster in the forbidden grounds."

26919627.m_KeyValue: ""A fascinating discovery indeed, though the cause of these anomalies remains unclear.""

26919628.m_KeyValue: "No need to apologize. Think of me as a scholar—I study water."

26919629.m_KeyValue: "Water is the wellspring of all life. To witness such defilement... retribution is warranted."

26919630.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, even if those nobles refrain from alchemical experiments in the short term, as long as profit exists, this water will inevitably be contaminated again.""

30209627.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, he always finds me. I never know where he'll turn up next.""

30251205.m_KeyValue: "'We should indeed conserve our energy. I'll gather some branches for a fire.' Our lamb has enough experience to deftly handle such arguments."

30251206.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain rubbed his furrowed brow, his voice dripping with sarcasm. 'Oh, is the young master of House Roland about to grace us with his commands again?'""

30251207.m_KeyValue: "'Let's take a breather here and grab a bite before we press on.' Friedrich's suggestion was the very picture of prudence."

30251212.m_KeyValue: ""Thus, the three rested, sharing their provisions as if on a picnic. Little did they know that this might be their last moment of tranquility.""

31169879.m_KeyValue: "Defend the Rift. Don't let more than <#A65F30>10</color> phantoms escape."

35701972.m_KeyValue: ""Because there are always many ropes hanging around the mast, and with the ship rocking at the time, one rope moving wouldn't have stood out.""

35701973.m_KeyValue: ""One end was fed through the ventilation panel into the guest cabin—the rust marks on the rope, left by the panel, are solid evidence.""

35701975.m_KeyValue: "The one at the helm... Ah!! Are you serious?"

35701977.m_KeyValue: ""Then all we need to do is find that rope, and both the Captain and the killer will have nothing left to say!""

35701979.m_KeyValue: ""Right... Before he went to the helm, he was pestering us about our invitation...""

35702002.m_KeyValue: "Was stealing my job not enough? Now I can't even rest my injured body?"

35702003.m_KeyValue: "Bringing up the great Aeon... I-I… I was... I went..."

35702004.m_KeyValue: ""Wait... by 'something's happened,' you don't mean he ended up like those sluggish sailors, do you?""

35702005.m_KeyValue: "The other possibility is that someone deliberately poisoned the ship."

35702006.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... My head's still spinning... Did I really dream about those nasty bats...?"

35702258.m_KeyValue: "What's going on here? Why all the shouting?"

35702259.m_KeyValue: "Don't you think I know that?! Where's Kris—where's Captain Goldland? Where did he go at a time like this?!"

35702266.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously. Of all the ships crossing these waters, why did we end up on the most ridiculous one?""

35702267.m_KeyValue: ""H-Hey, what are you doing?! Don't you dare throw up on me!""

35702268.m_KeyValue: ""He did. Even knowing what was to come, he chose to stay that day, because...""

35702269.m_KeyValue: "Ah... What I wanted to say back then..."

35702270.m_KeyValue: "Captain? I thought Mr. Goldland was the Captain. He did give the welcome speech..."

35702271.m_KeyValue: "But it seems this card has been waiting just for you..."

35702272.m_KeyValue: "Are you truly telling me... not to worry?"

35702273.m_KeyValue: "We've lingered long enough. Let's rejoin Empousa and Hati in the guest quarters."

35702298.m_KeyValue: "Quick! Restrain the stowaway before First Mate Bob starts crying!"

35702299.m_KeyValue: ""You are a lady of the Bathory family, and you have set sail to complete that 'mission.'""

35702300.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't need your meddling!""

35702304.m_KeyValue: ""That's quite the demand, little Van Helsing... But the Captain did say ship security could be entrusted to you.""

35702305.m_KeyValue: "What's with this guy? His presence feels completely different from the rest..."

35702330.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why is there a crowd outside the Captain's quarters?"

35702332.m_KeyValue: "The Bathory clan is in decline! And being an Elder is still a high-risk job!"

35702333.m_KeyValue: "It's not addressed to us—it's for Cain."

35702334.m_KeyValue: ""Why don't you lower your weapon, lad?""

35702335.m_KeyValue: "I'm going down to fight Van Helsing."

35702337.m_KeyValue: ""'Powerful,' huh… Can't tell if that's a compliment—or sarcasm.""

35702358.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. This doesn't feel like rough seas—It feels more like... something's wrong with the ship itself."

35702359.m_KeyValue: ""B-But... Ami said she noticed you hadn't been resting, Captain. She wanted to help you stay up by preparing something special... She promised she wouldn't sneak any food...""

35702362.m_KeyValue: ""Kristoph, you're really giving them a rest area? They're troublemaking stowaways!""

35702363.m_KeyValue: "Conflicts aboard ship are like storms at sea. They can strike at any time. Our duty is to weather them together—and seek the rainbow after the rain."

35702364.m_KeyValue: ""Aren't you worried these Bloodborn might sprout wings and fly away, just like the legends say?""

35702365.m_KeyValue: "There's usually competition between merchant associations. You seem rather fond of this Puppet Association."

35702366.m_KeyValue: "She's a Heretic Bloodborn! Arrest her—dead or alive!"

35702367.m_KeyValue: ""Right, right. So... putting it plainly, it's just sucking up.""

35702368.m_KeyValue: ""William, that was rather discourteous. Whatever their status on land, here they are...""

35702369.m_KeyValue: "Seems the Silver Cross has its share of internal conflicts."

35702390.m_KeyValue: "Captain Goldland. Does this guest cabin connect to any other parts of the ship?"

35702391.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally, one is with me—part of my magnificent ring of keys.""

35702395.m_KeyValue: ""A rope around the neck, blood under the fingernails, and scratch marks. All signs of a violent struggle before death.""

35702396.m_KeyValue: "He was in the kitchen? Did you notice anything unusual about him?"

35702397.m_KeyValue: "This portrait is surprisingly well-done. You can tell who it is at a glance."

35702398.m_KeyValue: ""As Captain, the crew's safety is my top priority. I had to check the deck first—make sure no one was injured.""

35702399.m_KeyValue: "I wasn't even using my full strength... Huh?"

35702400.m_KeyValue: "I thought I'd broken something again... I ran because I was afraid you'd scold me."

35702401.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be scared, little Ami—Uncle Bob is coming!""

35702426.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah. Meanwhile, whenever I sneak into the kitchen, they always try to kick me out.""

35702427.m_KeyValue: "Captain Goldland said rushing to explain yourself means you don't know how to talk to someone you like."

35702428.m_KeyValue: "It's safer if you hide for now."

35702429.m_KeyValue: ""I'm heading to the crew quarters. Silver-haired, you and the others, come too!""

35702430.m_KeyValue: ""It's difficult for one person alone. Besides, other sailors on deck would have noticed right away.""

35702431.m_KeyValue: "Aaron was killed from outside? That's impossible."

35702432.m_KeyValue: "Wow. You sure can hold a grudge."

35702433.m_KeyValue: "Just as you all heard a heavy crash and immediately feared another murder..."

35702459.m_KeyValue: "So they are investigating us for stowing away."

35702461.m_KeyValue: "No doubt about it... it's the scent of Black Blood. Aaron poisoned the food..."

35702462.m_KeyValue: "I found my half-eaten dessert from earlier."

35702464.m_KeyValue: "What a miscalculation... I thought I wouldn't run into anyone."

39056578.m_KeyValue: ""Forward, then right—fifty-seven paces northeast. There—Jones's whispered repentence should drift through the shadows.""

39056579.m_KeyValue: "What is it? Something wrong with the path you remember?"

42504614.m_KeyValue:
""As we ventured into the depths of the canyon, Aeon called for me to halt,
'Look, that is the cliff no one can conquer.'
A mighty eagle circled above the peak,
A black serpent licked its fangs within the trees,
A white lamb wept at the mountain's base.
I asked the lamb why it wept; it gazed at the cliff,
'I can no longer reach the Other Side.'
I asked the serpent why it coiled; it looked at the cliff,
'I shall drag that eagle down from the peak.'
I asked the eagle why it refused to land; it did not reply,
But dropped skeletal remains at my feet.
I saw clearly—it was a lamb's bones cloaked in snakeskin,
The bones hung their head in sorrow,
While the snakeskin fluttered in the wind's grip.""

42560521.m_KeyValue: ""Though I'd like to ignore it, the solemn wax seal and embossed gold lettering on the envelope make it impossible not to feel pressured.""

42594282.m_KeyValue: "Lamia? I can't return right now. What's the matter?"

42634993.m_KeyValue: "The world never ceased its endless cacophony."

42634995.m_KeyValue: ""Noah Nevernight, I demand you tell me everything.""

42634996.m_KeyValue: "I don't remember anything from my childhood anymore."

42635001.m_KeyValue: "I arrived at the location Acappella specified."

42704261.m_KeyValue: "(An old candlestick—one I had discarded—now stood once more upon my desk.)"

44909204.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, do you remember that bedtime story?""

44909205.m_KeyValue: ""But thanks to you, I've experienced happiness. Joy.""

44909206.m_KeyValue: "Would that help me experience that sorrow once again?"

44909207.m_KeyValue: "I don't blame her. But the sorrow remained."

44909208.m_KeyValue: ""This place... it's where you first met Tris, isn't it?""

45345597.m_KeyValue: "Hardly a coincidence. That woman is Silver Cross as well."

45345598.m_KeyValue: "What about the others in the dungeon...?"

45345604.m_KeyValue: "Do not think I won't put an arrow through you because you're a civilian."

45345605.m_KeyValue: "Quiet enough. Now—answer what I asked you before."

45345606.m_KeyValue: "You mean the mist is a harbinger of a Scourge breaking its seal?"

45345607.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina advances with measured steps, cold eyes fixed upon the unsuspecting men—an executioner's calm sharpened into purpose.""

45345608.m_KeyValue: ""Ryan surveys the fallen survivors, his gaze fixing on Seraphina—untouched amid the violence.""

45345610.m_KeyValue: ""An old friend of hers, I suppose.""

46516185.m_KeyValue: "Valora never imagined I would be against her."

46516186.m_KeyValue: ""After your long slumber, you feel lost when facing the current world""

46516187.m_KeyValue: "But you don't have to acknowledge me."

46516188.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa granted you life. In some way, you might barely qualify as heir to the Bathory.""

46516189.m_KeyValue: ""In quiet moments, I find myself questioning whether this new age has any need for my vigil.""

51200013.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing?! What are you doing here? Didn't you say you were too busy for a vacation? Why did you come here alone in secret?"

51200014.m_KeyValue: ""We couldn't keep our promises back then, but now, eleven years later, you've defeated the Master and saved my people.""

51200036.m_KeyValue: ""Selena, you need to be more careful about the company you keep. You're always getting tangled up with the questionable sorts.""

51200043.m_KeyValue: ""Dawn is near. When the others wake, they'll likely notice these subtle changes as well.""

51200044.m_KeyValue: "I have no need for such lavish ceremonies. You may leave."

51200045.m_KeyValue: "I... I suppose I could muster the courage to visit the Roland family and get to know her better..."

51200046.m_KeyValue: ""What's the matter, Aiona? You look a bit pale.""

51200047.m_KeyValue: "Is that about the only outfit that's... normal?"

51200070.m_KeyValue: "'And don’t forget to check your mailbox. Our deal...'"

51200074.m_KeyValue: ""Joyce stood over Bella's mangled body, hands on her hips in dismay.""

51200075.m_KeyValue: ""Albrecht's voice lingered in his mind, but Isaac remained silent, fingers clenched tight around the dagger.""

51289839.m_KeyValue: ""I have someone to meet at the sealed area, so I'll wait for you there, meow.""

51289840.m_KeyValue: "His first four drops of blood birthed the Four Calamities. The rest became the Scourges."

51289841.m_KeyValue: ""And he's the one who killed Noah, right here... Ah, could it be!""

51289842.m_KeyValue: ""The Bathory guard a Divine Body known as the Wings. Unlike the others, this one exists as a pair...""

51289843.m_KeyValue: "Why was their Matriarch sealed inside it?"

51289844.m_KeyValue: "This is where I first met Noah… Does that mean we've come full circle?"

51289847.m_KeyValue: ""So you've made up your mind, Mr. Lifeless Eyes? Once you leave this path, we might not meet again.""

51293046.m_KeyValue: "Killer of the Choir... Why don't you kill us?"

52030122.m_KeyValue: "My old nemeses... Let us meet once more—on a new battlefield."

52033323.m_KeyValue: "I remember now. This area is the Hunting Ground where Baphomet conducted his experiments!"

52112787.m_KeyValue: ""'You might as well declare war on all the major families,' Gilrain retorted. 'If we had that much power, we wouldn't be fretting over increasing our strength.'""

52112788.m_KeyValue: ""Another option would be to find other Ancestors older than the Matriarch, but the Puppet Association has yet to uncover any leads,' Bella added with a sigh.""

52112790.m_KeyValue: "'If we could find an older Ancestral bloodline—Dracula's being ideal—that would solve our problem.'"

52240131.m_KeyValue: "A powerful force is preventing Aiona from crossing to another timeline."

52491336.m_KeyValue: "Then tell me—What must I give to learn the truth?"

52491337.m_KeyValue: "You're Constantine. The other survivor of the catastrophe from eleven years ago... aren't you?"

52491338.m_KeyValue: ""That disaster brought with it the sirens. They're now imprisoned. They agreed to help the fishermen—catching fish, gathering pearls—in exchange for supplies.""

52491339.m_KeyValue: "But to understand how it all began... we must go back twenty years."

52491340.m_KeyValue: ""Not all of it. Fate is cruel... For what awaited us when we returned to the basement... were torn garments and severed limbs, left behind by the Blood Beast.""

52491341.m_KeyValue: ""The procedure lasted through the night. Before I could examine her, Hallon forced me to flee the basement.""

52491343.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever it was you did back then, you did it only to ease your father's torment. He was consumed by the Black Blood.""

52491368.m_KeyValue: "The guards said you killed Lorelei. Is that true?"

52491370.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei must be alive, and I must... find our promised meeting place...""

52491371.m_KeyValue: ""It's not even dawn yet, why is everyone being woken up so suddenly?""

52491373.m_KeyValue: "Should I pretend I didn't see you in such a pitiable state?"

52491375.m_KeyValue: "Joyce rushed over after hearing about the commotion at the prison—Joyce thought Lord Isaac might be in danger!"

52491377.m_KeyValue: ""I understand… but I will never forgive you, Uncle.""

52491624.m_KeyValue: ""We didn't do that to him, but... Bella, run!""

52491633.m_KeyValue: ""I've never heard of Catherine, Yakov, or the Adventures of Ginokio. From the way you speak to the way you dress... you're suspicious in every possible way.""

52491634.m_KeyValue: ""There, in the gentle breeze of Sapphire Isle, under the masterful hands of the great artisan Peppetto, our protagonist—Ginokio—was born.""

52491635.m_KeyValue: "To dream up something so revolutionary... I must truly be a genius!"

52491636.m_KeyValue: ""Obeying that proud instinct born to mankind... I suppose I, too, must long to become human.""

52491638.m_KeyValue: ""First, I'll need the right weapon. A blade that draws blood on the slightest cut...""

52491639.m_KeyValue: "The stench of blood... that pale skin... This one reeks of the Bloodborn."

52491664.m_KeyValue: "Did I really make a promise with someone? Do I even belong here... in Sapphire Isle?"

52491665.m_KeyValue: ""All over, really... But I remember the beach up ahead—every summer, it would be blanketed by Tidewisps.""

52491667.m_KeyValue: "B-But where were... w-where were we meant to meet?"

52491670.m_KeyValue: "I don't even know her—so how does she know my name?"

52491671.m_KeyValue: "Wait—wait a second! Isn't that Alexa of the Seven Sages?!"

52491696.m_KeyValue: ""And a rather uncouth one, at that.""

52491697.m_KeyValue: "Now it's going to be hard to slip away..."

52491698.m_KeyValue: "We must end this before tomorrow's Eighth Sage Inauguration Ceremony."

52491699.m_KeyValue: "The Church's people are still waiting at the auction house. I'll leave the investigation entirely in your hands."

52491702.m_KeyValue: "You mean the memories of this body's original _$$owner_$$...?"

52491703.m_KeyValue: ""Next time, don't touch anything that creepy again...""

52491729.m_KeyValue: "Silver-Haired! I've successfully completed the plan—what about you?"

52491732.m_KeyValue: "She's getting better and better at handling that strange power—surely thanks to my impeccable guidance!"

52491760.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Alexis, this is where we found that strange device!""

52491761.m_KeyValue: "Has Constantine's Siren's Tear been replaced? Which of the other six tampered with it?"

52491762.m_KeyValue: "No. That’s not what matters now. We must destroy the Master."

52491763.m_KeyValue: "Ah... so you haven't known each other long..."

52491767.m_KeyValue: ""Second—I have no interest in guaranteeing basic welfare for dolls, nor do I see any reason to be dragged into the spotlight for such things.""

52491793.m_KeyValue: ""He's more skilled than I am—easily strong enough to defeat other Sages—and yet, he lent me the Siren's Tear and listened to everything I had to say. He's not the monster that poster makes him out to be.""

52491795.m_KeyValue: "And somehow... I can see the next Siren's Tear is there too."

52491796.m_KeyValue: "Very good. You've carried out the Master's command."

52491797.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Hallon, you are the head of Sapphire Isle Seven Sages. Who would dare question your word?""

52491798.m_KeyValue: ""To think, after more than a decade—Sapphire Isle faces another wave of chaos...""

52491822.m_KeyValue: "I… I have to protect them. I have to defeat the monster."

52491824.m_KeyValue: ""He spent years studying sirens. He would know their anatomy, their behavior—everything. Could it be...""

52491826.m_KeyValue: ""A truth I thought was lost forever... With his appearance, new threads have begun to surface.""

52491827.m_KeyValue: ""Three weeks ago, he began frequently rotating the number of sirens held across various facilities.""

52491829.m_KeyValue: "Take the yellow door on the right."

52491830.m_KeyValue: "Up ahead... that should be the meeting place in my memories."

52491831.m_KeyValue: ""Tourists...? But isn't Sapphire Isle... just a dull, forgotten place?""

52739942.m_KeyValue: ""Each Vassal has four skills, three of which can be enhanced.""

53566538.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps there are still survivors of the Ganelon family in Mouret."

53566539.m_KeyValue: "What…? Could someone else be helping me?"

53566540.m_KeyValue: ""By the time I arrived, they were all dead. One clean strike for each.""

53566541.m_KeyValue: ""...Huh? If it wasn't you, then who? When I woke up, it was just the two of us there!""

53566542.m_KeyValue: "There's no response. She must be investigating."

53566543.m_KeyValue: ""I need to head to Lupine Forest right away! If he's back, I have to find him!""

53566544.m_KeyValue: ""But if it wasn't them, who else would know about the forbidden grounds... Ah! Could it be... Clive Jr.?""

53566545.m_KeyValue: ""I've looked into it—since the family migrated from Lupine Forest, they never came back.""

54440983.m_KeyValue: ""I once thought that as long as the light cast mine, you'd catch up eventually.""

54440984.m_KeyValue: "But one thing still puzzles me. Why would this tale be carved into the walls of this sealed place?"

54440985.m_KeyValue: "But the version I know says there was a war before everyone became one."

54440986.m_KeyValue: "Those three figures at the center—are they children?"

54442003.m_KeyValue: "You said it yourself—those holy water bullets are fatal to Bloodborn."

54442006.m_KeyValue: ""But I don't regret it. Because it led me to Noah, who, like me, refuses to kneel to fate.""

54442007.m_KeyValue: ""I trust Aiona, Van Helsing... and I trust Empousa most of all. They'll stop him.""

54442009.m_KeyValue: ""It seems you still don't understand me, Lady Empousa.""

54680654.m_KeyValue: ""As _$$War,_$$ it was indeed war that sang you a lullaby.""

54680655.m_KeyValue: "Everyone has their own cradle at birth. Mine just happened to be that kind of place."

54680656.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, now that your curiosity's satisfied, help me find that earring.""

56486302.m_KeyValue: ""Then share them with me. Last night's little confession was exquisite—I've been aching for more. Tonight, we continue.""

56486303.m_KeyValue: "(This is it—the place. The door isn't even locked… Her arrogance will be her undoing.)"

56486306.m_KeyValue: ""She toys with others, using them to claw her way out—only to be dragged back, again and again. To her, it’s nothing but a game.""

56856504.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Deal as much DMG as possible to the Insatiable Newt within the time limit. No score will be recorded if the entire team dies.</style>
The Insatiable Newt summons Newt Hatchlings, which will self-destruct to attack your team. Using a <style=""Highlight"">lineup that excels at summoning</style> can slow them down.
Top Picks: Transcendent Noah, Timeless Aiona, Genevieve, Bella""

57423124.m_KeyValue: ""Hall of the Elders, where memories live.""

57459249.m_KeyValue: "A contemptuous gaze abrades the soul. Try recalling it again."

57777957.m_KeyValue: "Fanny? To me she looks more like a puppet shoved into the spotlight. All bluster masking impotence—grasping at what little validation she can among her toys of torment."

57777958.m_KeyValue: ""Still, I'll tell you what I know. Only you can decide if it holds true.""

57777959.m_KeyValue: ""As I told you, she is far more than she seems.""

58928379.m_KeyValue: ""...Fanny, set the medicine down. Your mother has gone to a place far, far away. She won't be coming back.""

58928380.m_KeyValue: "There was never hope to begin with. This illness... even the physicians outside would struggle to cure it."

58928381.m_KeyValue: "Father! Where's Mother? I brought medicine from the big sister next door—she said it must be taken while it's still hot to work."

58928382.m_KeyValue: "Now that I think about it... I haven't seen her since before dawn..."

58928383.m_KeyValue: "Then it begins with the day I first donned the Warden's mantle."

58928386.m_KeyValue: "Last night revealed much. Walk me through your world—I want to understand your life here... and <style="Highlight">the story of how you became warden</style>."

58928393.m_KeyValue: ""You said it's 'difficult to cure'—that means there's still hope! Those physicians outside you spoke of—where are they? Please, tell me! I have to find them!""

58928394.m_KeyValue: ""Haha... They're beyond these walls, on the land that once belonged to 'truth'... but 'ignorance' rules there now. And we who once sought 'truth'... we've been forgotten, forever trapped in this gaol.""

59179123.m_KeyValue: "That sound again... it sounds so miserable... Is this the 'language' of pain for the deaf and mute?"

59179125.m_KeyValue: "Just get him some. You can take your frustrations out on the other wretches."

59179127.m_KeyValue: ""Then, for my next move—Ugh, my head...""

59179154.m_KeyValue: ""No, no! Now’s not the time to worry about Joyce! Let’s turn our attention to the candidates and see how they’ll prove their worth to claim the symbol of the Eighth Sage—the Siren’s Tear!""

59179156.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Savich, don’t you have important matters to attend to today? How do you still have time for tea with me?""

59179157.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, then we’ll strike while the iron’s hot! We’re getting Master Van Helsing out of there!""

59179158.m_KeyValue: ""If Mr. Savich is elected, every resident of the Isle will receive a bag of gold to fund their shops. The remaining gold will be used to expand roads and maintain shipping routes.""

59179160.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! The Young Master doesn't even know what a barnacle is!"

59179418.m_KeyValue: "Are you really stopping now? Don’t you want to keep going? How about another barrel?"

59179421.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing? Which family is that? Are they wealthy?"

59179422.m_KeyValue: "I must apologize that your visit to Sapphire Isle has been... 'unpleasant'. That is my failing."

59179444.m_KeyValue: ""M-M-Me what? I know, your father led the creation of the Maritime Spice Route, and you're his precious son.""

59179445.m_KeyValue: ""You are guests who have 'come from afar,' and we've become such fast friends. Please allow me to extend my hospitality.""

59179450.m_KeyValue: "The Sapphire Isle Seven Sages...? What’s that supposed to be?"

59179452.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... it would be perfect if we trimmed the fabric a bit here and there!"

59179453.m_KeyValue: "Trust in the expertise of the 'Association's Fashion Contest' champion! This fit will definitely suit you."

59179454.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Selena is fascinated by mysterious poisons concocted by Alchemists, Miss Aiona seems interested in the pearl-encrusted lamb figurine but remains silent, and as for Miss Ami...""

59179455.m_KeyValue: "I... How did I end up here fighting a siren?"

59179456.m_KeyValue: ""Ah... I understand now, this part needs some improvement...""

59179482.m_KeyValue: ""Grab something to eat, then go see the Captain.""

59179484.m_KeyValue: ""After such a busy day, aren't you tired?""

59179514.m_KeyValue: ""At night, when the mist rolls into Sapphire Isle... a merciless killer called the 'Mistbound Terror' will appear.""

59179515.m_KeyValue: "I would love to see these Roland family runts 'soften' bit by bit... Wouldn't you agree?"

59179516.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... that this Mistbound Terror uses dreams to mark their next target?"

59179517.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps it was because of playing with that device..."

59179518.m_KeyValue: "Please enjoy the inn's breakfast while you wait for news."

59179519.m_KeyValue: ""Welcome, esteemed guest. How may I be of assistance?""

59179520.m_KeyValue: "You must be Mr. Savich! You've come at the perfect time!"

59179521.m_KeyValue: ""They're at the Shark Hunter Tavern, but let me handle this—Mr. Savich is so wealthy, he looks down on everyone except the Church.""

59179547.m_KeyValue: "It's true! My mother told me so too!"

59179550.m_KeyValue: ""Where does this suffering come from? And where will it end? If we are to endure, if we are to resist, how can we turn a blind eye to such questions?""

59179552.m_KeyValue: "No. Focus on practicing your archery. I'll check your progress when I return."

59179553.m_KeyValue: "Where am I? Why am I locked in here?"

59179576.m_KeyValue: "The night is still young. There's time for pleasant dreams."

59179577.m_KeyValue: "This should be the time for sweet dreams."

59179578.m_KeyValue: ""You won't suddenly try to kill me, will you?""

59179579.m_KeyValue: "Could it mean that 'blackmail' goes against justice?"

59179580.m_KeyValue: "So the victim was a competitor of the Seven Sage Association—or planning to work with their competitors."

59179581.m_KeyValue: "Could the victim be from the same family as Van Helsing?"

59179582.m_KeyValue: ""The dove, a symbol of peace, was mutilated.""

59179583.m_KeyValue: "'Crime Scene and Autopsy Report'... this is it! There's even a sketch of the scene in here..."

59179585.m_KeyValue: "Still content with this life of groveling before the Church for a few measly coins?"

59179608.m_KeyValue: "I should never have trusted you... and Master Van Helsing shouldn't have trusted you either!"

59179609.m_KeyValue: ""Stop, I don't want to hurt you...""

59179612.m_KeyValue: "While I have already know a lot about Miss Ami and your attendant..."

59179613.m_KeyValue: "What do you think of my methods?"

59179615.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, he must be present for any discussion with me.""

59179616.m_KeyValue: "What brings you here? Is there something I can help you with?"

59179617.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, when was the last time you took a bath?!""

60044598.m_KeyValue: ""Deeply committed to the honor of his people, an elder established this tradition to inspire young Bloodborn on their mission to the moon. Those awarded the Medal of Honor receive the elder's highest blessings and unwavering support.""

61463405.m_KeyValue: ""These Artifact Captains hold the keys to treasure chests. Defeating them requires not only strength, but wisdom and courage, for they are more than just guards—they are interpreters of Artifacts and pilgrims.""

62205396.m_KeyValue: "The day of the Cartographer's Association's 2000th anniversary."

62205493.m_KeyValue: "When daybreak is shrouded by the tempest."

62205528.m_KeyValue: ""The day of her death, and the start of her rebirth.""

62205594.m_KeyValue: "The day when light and dark are equal."

63519039.m_KeyValue: ""Listen here, whelp. Lay a hand on Noah, and you'll regret it.""

63519040.m_KeyValue: "Death can't fight back now. I'll finish him myself and avenge our Commander!"

63519048.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. I'll help you remember it all. Bit by bit..."

63519049.m_KeyValue: ""Spare me your smug remarks, you traitor!""

63519050.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... I never imagined she would..."

63519051.m_KeyValue: "He's just turned into an egg! He's not dead! You're not the one suffering here!"

63519052.m_KeyValue: "You think I wanted this? Your Commander left of her own will—and now Noah has become... this."

63519054.m_KeyValue: ""Must we quarrel now, of all times?""

63520063.m_KeyValue: "The crystal traces become increasingly prominent as we venture deeper. It should lead us to Miss Piera."

63520064.m_KeyValue: "Noah seems to be there as well."

63520071.m_KeyValue: "Master always warned us: every action carries a price. So why would Piera risk punishment by returning to this place?"

63520072.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it's because of her family... just like me."

63520073.m_KeyValue: "The Paracelsus name had already fallen from grace by the time she was born into the Church's territories. She shouldn't have any deep ties to Sunset Isle."

63520074.m_KeyValue: "If something happens to her... I don't know how I'll explain this to Master Albrecht."

63520075.m_KeyValue: "It seems Miss Piera has lost control of her powers due to unforeseen circumstances. This has resulted in the island and its inhabitants being crystallized..."

63520076.m_KeyValue: ""However, this appears to be the only explanation that fits our current situation.""

63520077.m_KeyValue: "She's not as fragile as you're making her out to be."

63520078.m_KeyValue: "But what other explanation could there be? I certainly can't think of any..."

63521217.m_KeyValue: ""You never imagined I would take Commander Tris's place and become a Bell Ringer, did you?""

63521218.m_KeyValue: "Only fragments of memory from that time. There's no need to be afraid."

63521223.m_KeyValue: ""You believed yourself to be a simple doctor, healing villagers beside Ressa.""

63521225.m_KeyValue: "A dream of Sunset Isle and Ressa."

63521226.m_KeyValue: ""That's because during those sixty-six years inside the black cocoon, you fell into a dream of your own making...""

63521228.m_KeyValue: "This is where you truly were for those sixty-six years."

63521230.m_KeyValue: ""But in reality, once removed from Sunset Isle, we were locked within the Church's alchemy chamber, sealed inside the black cocoon for study.""

63521753.m_KeyValue: "They arrive at the arena as promised."

63521754.m_KeyValue: "You have a point. I cannot wrench your instinct for self-preservation from you—my impatience ran ahead of me."

63521755.m_KeyValue: "Then treat me as one. Fight to kill—or be killed."

63521848.m_KeyValue: ""No—I mean things like… strange tales, what to eat for dinner, or just… unimportant matters?""

63521849.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you worried that talking mid-battle is distracting?"

63521850.m_KeyValue: ""This time, I arrive at our meeting place ahead of schedule.""

63521851.m_KeyValue: ""With that, Seraphina begins a disciplined stretching routine, working through each muscle with practiced precision.""

63522242.m_KeyValue: ""Don't misunderstand me. If Piera is in there, then I can't guarantee her survival once the Bell Ringer strikes.""

63522247.m_KeyValue: "I won't allow it. The one in there is my prey."

63522249.m_KeyValue: ""Hard as it is to believe, it's the only lead I've found.""

63522250.m_KeyValue: "Then what are we waiting for? Let's get Noah out of there!"

63522251.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you Albrecht's student? I'll let you off. Leave now."

63522252.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid... I can't comply with that."

63522253.m_KeyValue: "What are you planning to do to Noah!?"

63522254.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it obvious? I'm going to kill him here!"

63523396.m_KeyValue: "Naturally... because you left behind two very important things."

63523399.m_KeyValue: "Only by awakening completely... can we become _$$Death_$$ once more."

63523400.m_KeyValue: "Surely by now you understand why I made you remember?"

63523401.m_KeyValue: "You've prepared quite the speech. It seems you knew I would return here after sixty-six years."

63523402.m_KeyValue: "I'm more conscious than I've ever been."

63523403.m_KeyValue: "And she is the testament to the bonds you've made."

63523404.m_KeyValue: ""Death and life, cold and warmth. Only when you become aware of their existences and duality will you truly take form.""

63523405.m_KeyValue: ""Death and rebirth, bitterness and sweetness. Only when you can walk both paths and embrace their duality will you truly have a soul.""

63523406.m_KeyValue: "Her existence serves as a reminder of what you once cherished."

63524420.m_KeyValue: "It's more like I've gained full control of its power."

63524423.m_KeyValue: "It's those creatures from before! And they're even more aggressive now!"

63524425.m_KeyValue: "I know what you've all done for me."

63524428.m_KeyValue: ""No... this feeling, it's like something's burrowing up from underground.""

63525573.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps Death is lonely. At the end of life, only a lonely soul was left to sink silently into the abyss.""

63525575.m_KeyValue: "Speak for yourself... but I still need to find Piera's remains before the island sinks."

63525576.m_KeyValue: "I've never smacked a Divine Body before. I want to see just how tough it is!"

63525577.m_KeyValue: "And I'm sure everyone here feels the same way—"

63525578.m_KeyValue: ""Who's the Vassal, you or me? If you can do it, so can I! Don't forget—we're partners in crime!""

63525579.m_KeyValue: "But dealing with the Divine Body is not going to be easy."

63525580.m_KeyValue: ""From now on, don't even think about leaving my sights!""

63525581.m_KeyValue: "Are you trying to play the lone hero again? Just like on the ship?"

65548581.m_KeyValue: "Then I must uncover what stirs in this cursed place."

66866370.m_KeyValue: ""In Accursed Journey, deploying the following Vassals will increase your chance of obtaining Extra Rewards.""

66962423.m_KeyValue: ""And as for him... Will he, at last, find the answer to the question that haunts his every step: _$$Who am I?_$$""

67637363.m_KeyValue: ""<#F11E1D>Time's Up</color>, and it was a defeat.""

68995821.m_KeyValue: "I can't feel anything... have I become jaded already?"

68995854.m_KeyValue: ""As I put on this gown, I feel something stir within me... and I know it’s because of you.""

68996019.m_KeyValue: "Could this be the power of hope?"

68996052.m_KeyValue: "Is this really the time for that..."

68996085.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever this journey may bring, I will be there along with you.""

68996118.m_KeyValue: "I won't let my loved ones get hurt anymore."

68996151.m_KeyValue: "Feeling alright? It's not like you to get all nervous."

68996184.m_KeyValue: ""Wow... you've always known what I love, haven't you?""

68996217.m_KeyValue: "Take your time. I've waited this long for you—what's a moment more?"

68996250.m_KeyValue: "I should have changed my outfit first!"

<alpha=#80>Engrained in the souls of countless believers.""

69079301.m_KeyValue:

70140570.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella No. 13 gained special protection: Non-CRIT DMG Taken -{0}, CRIT RES Rate +{1}, and CRIT DMG Down +{2}.""

70140571.m_KeyValue: ""After taking a certain amount of DMG, Little Bella No. 13 immediately enters a Charging State. This state can be interrupted by dealing strong DMG to her within a short period. While Charging, Little Bella No. 13 takes reduced Non-CRIT DMG. Deploying Vassals who can deal steady CRIT DMG is recommended.""

70687618.m_KeyValue: ""Are you truly trying to clear up the misunderstanding, or make it worse?""

71287644.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... a 'shade' of an old friend?"

71287645.m_KeyValue: ""He seems to be talking to someone, but he's the only one there.""

71287651.m_KeyValue: ""But there's one thing I'm absolutely sure of: when it comes to Piera, he's definitely on our side.""

71287652.m_KeyValue: ""I'll admit, those Bloodborn with him have piqued my curiosity, but dealing with them isn't part of my current mission.""

71287653.m_KeyValue: "And he's probably here to investigate Piera too."

71287654.m_KeyValue: "'—You said the village was at the base of the mountain... so why haven't we arrived yet... are we going in circles?'"

71287655.m_KeyValue: ""I recognize his heartbeat from the ship, it's him... but...""

71287657.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, I found him. There's a very constant heartbeat in the forest to the southwest.""

71289822.m_KeyValue: ""So... I think... what matters isn't how I'll die, but how I've 'lived.'""

71289823.m_KeyValue: "I could die from using Covenant... die from Blood Beasts... die from being consumed by nightmares. Once we're born... death is always looming... isn't it?"

71289826.m_KeyValue: ""She may be more timid than most, but your existence and her master's support have given her courage far beyond ordinary people.""

71289827.m_KeyValue: ""She wants your approval; she wants to inherit your title; she wants to complete the duty you left unfinished, even if it means facing everything she fears.""

71289828.m_KeyValue: ""I know that... if I hadn't met Noah, I probably would have died soon after arriving on the island...""

71289829.m_KeyValue: "...I'm... not as amazing as Noah says... but I... I did make this decision on my own..."

71289830.m_KeyValue: ""Though I haven't known Piera long, I can sense her confusion. She fears death, fears Blood Beasts, and even fears animals...""

71289831.m_KeyValue: "I... What would he know about me!"

71289833.m_KeyValue: ""Yet she came back on her own, because she admires you—you who bear the family's honor as the Gravekeeper.""

71364270.m_KeyValue: "It appears there was a pricing error and you were overcharged."

71470029.m_KeyValue: "Ah... my sincerest apologies. My name is Tris. I'm tasked with finding an organ for the hymn recital."

71498215.m_KeyValue:
""The new leader of the Astolfo family hides sorrow and anguish deep within her eyes, unseen by all. 
'Snow fleets, for the sun is too great to endure.'""

71592781.m_KeyValue: "The Soul is the most perfect form of life."

71592812.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, you are the second to earn my respect. Or perhaps, you were also the first.""

71595821.m_KeyValue: ""If one cannot break free from the shackles of desire, then one must learn to live with its presence... Right?""

71603682.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, don't go dying on me. You make a pretty good adventuring partner.""

71604517.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps I should rethink the meaning of justice... through your perspective."

71604676.m_KeyValue: "This power shall root out the wicked."

71605825.m_KeyValue: ""With this power, I can protect everyone!""

71605856.m_KeyValue: "Let time stand still for a moment. I want to savor this lingering warmth."

71606691.m_KeyValue: ""With you, perhaps I can really feel alive.""

71606850.m_KeyValue: "This feeling... Are there any worthy opponents to fight?"

71607999.m_KeyValue: "Can you smell it? This is the fragrance of life's fruit."

71608030.m_KeyValue: "Our lives seem to be intertwined like branches."

72853540.m_KeyValue: ""Scions of Astolfo, guardians of this sacred ground—eternal and unyielding.""

72853541.m_KeyValue: "Bring her back...? What do you mean?"

72853542.m_KeyValue: ""Look at that Blood Moon, Alene. Tell me—does this look like a world with order to you?""

72853543.m_KeyValue: ""No, I meant... You're the Gravekeeper of the Scourge, Frost. I thought you would have already—""

73462280.m_KeyValue: "How can I trust someone who'd side with the Church in slaughtering their own hometown?"

73473333.m_KeyValue: "Where do you get off talking like that?"

73473335.m_KeyValue: ""I see, young Nevernight. I can sense your confusion, or should I say, your fear...""

73475381.m_KeyValue: ""Unable to recall important people, or even who they are... The pain of 'nothingness' will torment them forever.""

73477525.m_KeyValue: ""Though not explicitly stated, it seems the location of the forbidden grounds is likely related to this place called the Ashen Garden.""

76390166.m_KeyValue:
""Used to upgrade Hall of Honor and, when enough are collected, gain permanent bonuses.
<alpha=#80>The badge, polished to perfection, has clearly been well cared for, though its previous owner remains unknown. Regardless, past honor always paves a path for the future.""

76777337.m_KeyValue: ""The Gravekeeper family tore itself apart in civil war, and in their desperation they even resorted to Black Blood, which had begun seeping up from below...""

76777338.m_KeyValue: ""When humanity first walked the earth, I found myself doing things I had never done before.""

76777342.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Seraphina, you can smile too, can't you?""

76777344.m_KeyValue: "Seeing how we've lost—might as well lie back and enjoy ourselves!"

76778361.m_KeyValue: ""Ha! I told you, ambush tactics are the most efficient.""

76778362.m_KeyValue: "Enough. We shall speak when the fighting is done."

76778363.m_KeyValue: ""Soldiers' blades and villagers' pitchforks lie strewn along the path, abandoned along with their wielders' courage in these final desperate moments.""

76778364.m_KeyValue: "Including when you lunged at the Bell Ringer's vice-commander in the midst of a war council?"

76778367.m_KeyValue: "The ground is yours—I expect this area completely cleared before midnight."

78068986.m_KeyValue: ""So... we'll meet again someday, won't we?""

78068994.m_KeyValue: ""It's because I ran away, that you've grown this strong.""

78068995.m_KeyValue: ""Why did you have to push things this far, Seraphina?""

78068996.m_KeyValue: "It's fine. Just got pecked by some bird."

78068999.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, you wouldn't be able to fly anymore.""

78070017.m_KeyValue: "Their bodies convulse with sickening spasms as they track the scent of the intruder."

78070018.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias, I... I did not betray the Church.""

78070019.m_KeyValue: "When I drove my blade into their hearts... they whispered thanks..."

78070020.m_KeyValue: "There! I told you we'd find folk here!"

78070022.m_KeyValue: ""I—I must look strange to you, don't I...?""

78070023.m_KeyValue: "This wretched mist! I cannot see a thing!"

79179658.m_KeyValue: ""A winged creature from the depths of the sealed area, corrupted by Black Blood. It appears to have been driven from the darkness by some force. Covered in dry blood spots, it generates powerful Sound Waves with each flap of its wings.""

""A crab that escaped the El Dorado, once a Black Blood experiment subject.

The crab is long dead, with the barnacle controlling everything from its back.
The barnacle bears the mark of a sea beast and the number one.
Noah wonders, 'Why isn't it carved on the crab instead?'""

79179747.m_KeyValue: ""A creature that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Each rush forward strikes like a bolt of lightning, stupefying the enemy.""

79179754.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its tissue is fully exposed, and it emits dreadful spiked orbs.""

79179757.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its tissue is fully exposed, and it emits dreadful spiked orbs.""

79179759.m_KeyValue: ""Moles that have adapted to the special terrain of Starfall Valley with crystals on their back allowing them to blend with mountains. After being infected with Black Blood outside the sealed area, the durability of their crystalline form reached its limit.""

79179760.m_KeyValue: ""A creature that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Its giant body sparkles with reflected light, and a gust of dry air follows its every swing.""

79179761.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its squiggling body struggles to maintain control over its energy orbs.""

82687887.m_KeyValue: ""The basic principle is to sacrifice the essence of Bloodborn souls as offerings, in turn allowing one to draw upon the purest Ancestral Power to increase a Vassal's strength.""

82918580.m_KeyValue: "All objectives complete. Please stay tuned for new ones!"

83721471.m_KeyValue: "I remember your dream was to reach the 'promised home' with the Moonblessed. It seems you still have a long way to go..."

83722494.m_KeyValue: ""Then I met you all, and we journeyed together.""

83727477.m_KeyValue: "I've always procured the latest and finest armor for that old-timer's body."

83728500.m_KeyValue: ""After losing the Matriarch, Lady Empousa is the first heir in line, the one who the family should pledge allegiance to... Are you implying...?""

83731568.m_KeyValue: "Excellent. Decisive and composed. I expected nothing less of you. This is your reward."

85323810.m_KeyValue: ""When it comes to slaughtering one's own, you humans are hardly innocent.""

85323811.m_KeyValue: "I suggest you hand it over. Now."

85323812.m_KeyValue: ""No need for such alarm, miss. If we're speaking of oddities, I'd say that towering companion of yours is a far stranger sight.""

85873742.m_KeyValue: "Then let me show you what House Astolfo has become."

85873743.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to show you—what your teachings and her decisions have made of me."

85873744.m_KeyValue: "The thunder you heard earlier... That was her."

85874765.m_KeyValue: "So you've stopped concealing your power... You must think you've already won."

85874766.m_KeyValue: "Now that we're alone... won't you share a few secrets with me?"

85874768.m_KeyValue: ""Even after everything—after meeting Noah, after seeing a different future—""

86615465.m_KeyValue: ""Why stand by these fragile, fleeting mortals!?""

86615468.m_KeyValue: ""If we're to retain our humanity, trust is the only weapon we have left.""

87165390.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, but what's the rush? We've all the time in the world to discuss such things, don't we? After all...""

87165391.m_KeyValue: "You really believe you can keep all of us at bay?"

87165392.m_KeyValue: "And they wouldn't have fallen—not Ressa. I know her strength."

87165393.m_KeyValue: ""Plague is the White Knight—whose power now flows through Hati. Famine, the Black Knight—passed her power to Ami through Ranna...""

87165394.m_KeyValue: "Three actually. The red door is closed."

87165395.m_KeyValue: ""Let's not slow him down. We should press on into the sealed area! This time, I swear I'll—""

87165396.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it obvious? The gate's wide open—he's already inside."

87165397.m_KeyValue: "And now the headscarf woman's weapon lies here... abandoned."

87166414.m_KeyValue: ""Let the Long Night descend, and call forth the Blood Moon—""

87166415.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, Lady Empousa... we’re all unharmed. I just couldn't stop him from taking you...""

87166416.m_KeyValue: "You expect me to let an inferior copy serve Lady Limine?"

87166417.m_KeyValue: "…Lamia was right about you. You're always like this."

87166418.m_KeyValue: ""Don't get coy with me—I can hear it in your voice. You feel pity, don't you?""

87166420.m_KeyValue: ""Bad feeling? Oh, I won't have a word of it!""

87166421.m_KeyValue: ""Still at it, are we? Must I remind you, we exist solely to fight for the right to become Mother's _$$vessel of rebirth_$$!""

87166422.m_KeyValue: "Where is this place? What has Cain done to us?"

87166423.m_KeyValue: ""_$$When the four Moonblessed gather, Mother will open her arms and take us back..._$$""

88968655.m_KeyValue: ""Don't you notice? You're no longer on the battlefield. Look at your feet—there's no shadow, and the candlelight passes right through you.""

88968656.m_KeyValue: "Raise shields! Now! Arrows are coming! In waves! Take cover!"

88968657.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Cartographer, stop engaging with him. He's not harmless—whoever summoned him can force him to attack. Use your weapon now!""

88968658.m_KeyValue: "No! Cowards! We fight on! For the Moontide Canal! Where is my sword? Bring me my sword!"

88968659.m_KeyValue: "That Bloodborn stabbed Tom to death before your eyes! He was so close… Why? Why didn't you kill that Bloodborn? You traitor!!"

88969671.m_KeyValue: "Really? How did you figure that out?"

88969672.m_KeyValue: "Tertius promised me a whole room of new playmates!"

88969679.m_KeyValue: "Will you be my new Vassal? It would ease my mind."

88969680.m_KeyValue: "Why do hands sprout from her mantle? Is she being controlled?"

88969681.m_KeyValue: ""Those aren't physical hands... The mantle and claws are extensions of her will. She uses them to drag the souls of the deceased back to the mortal realm, imprisoning them in her mantle as her playthings.""

88969682.m_KeyValue: ""Little Quinn, you've changed... You used to love playing hide and seek with me.""

88969683.m_KeyValue: "Let's skip the small talk. We need to go to the Ritual Chamber. Please step aside."

88969684.m_KeyValue: "The Ritual Chamber? Why would anyone want to visit such a boring place?"

88969685.m_KeyValue: "What did Tertius offer you? This isn't like you at all."

88969686.m_KeyValue: ""It can't be playing hide and seek with her, can it?""

88970831.m_KeyValue: ""The situation has turned in our favor, Elder Valora. If not for your timely arrival, those vicious wolves would have troubled us indefinitely.""

88970836.m_KeyValue: ""I've seen all you've done for this family. When the young lord ascends, I will ensure the Baphomet name rises with him—""

88970837.m_KeyValue: "The Ganelons will remain quiet after this battle. Perhaps your heart can find its solace now."

88970838.m_KeyValue: "Worthy indeed of the Bathory's most loyal knight. The old master's faith in you speaks for itself."

88970857.m_KeyValue: "That was the story of Long Night."

88970858.m_KeyValue: "You must have realized it—the Divine Body I used to cross the realm is the same one that Grandpa and Noah mentioned."

88970863.m_KeyValue: "You brought back... historical materials far more precious than any notes."

88970865.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Grandpa... I went surveying in secret... and couldn't even bring back a single page of notes... I've failed again... I'll never become a true cartographer...""

88970867.m_KeyValue: ""This, Agnes Ganelon, is your greatest and most credible record as a cartographer.""

88970869.m_KeyValue: "You have passed the ultimate test for a cartographer."

88970870.m_KeyValue: ""You became the one to etch legends onto the timeline, grounding history's course in the chaos of uncertainty.""

89174522.m_KeyValue: ""So I never lost my memories, I just chose not to remember.""

89174553.m_KeyValue: "One such as I should no longer get close to anyone...except myself."

89177562.m_KeyValue: ""So, um, when vampires bite people... isn't it kind of intimate? Don't you... get embarrassed?""

89177721.m_KeyValue: ""I'm Selena Dalma, hired assassin on occasion... Oh, you're glaring at me...""

89183249.m_KeyValue: ""If that is your wish, I can oblige.""

89185392.m_KeyValue: "Let us celebrate our first encounter with a dance."

89185423.m_KeyValue: "Don't take your hand away. I want you to lead me as I continue dancing."

89186258.m_KeyValue: ""If you don't mind, please close your eyes and listen to the whispers of the flowers and plants.""

89186417.m_KeyValue: ""If needed, I can share my knowledge with you.""

89187566.m_KeyValue: ""As long as the flame still burns, even death can be warm... Care to try?""

89187597.m_KeyValue: ""What is birthed from the flames is not civilization, but countless wars.""

89188432.m_KeyValue: "I like the feel of your fingers."

89189740.m_KeyValue: ""The Church gave me a title, but the children’s voices gave me my name.""

89189771.m_KeyValue: ""Your scent... it seems to awaken memories within me. Please, would you come closer?""

89190606.m_KeyValue: "...Forgive me. Now is not the time to let go of all restraint."

89190765.m_KeyValue: "Black Blood can be cured. But there are many things that can't be."

90435558.m_KeyValue: "Deals increased DMG to enemies under Control effects."

90501339.m_KeyValue: ""If one knew every step in advance, fear would smother resolve. Thus ignorance itself becomes my greatest weapon.""

90501346.m_KeyValue: ""Noah… thank you. But it's too late. The prison has taken root in me, it won't let me go.""

90501348.m_KeyValue: "Death… let it serve as my penance."

90501349.m_KeyValue: ""Because you and I—like everyone else—do not belong here. We belong out there, beneath the open sky.""

90501352.m_KeyValue: "Go where you must. I'll entrust you to that insufferable redhead's care."

90501353.m_KeyValue: "Has Ironfist Gaol truly fallen into complete chaos…"

90502370.m_KeyValue: "Naturally I would not know—we have never met."

90502371.m_KeyValue: ""They are mine. Easy now—you glare too sharply, and you will soon be marked as troublemakers.""

90502372.m_KeyValue: "And Fanny—the Church's sanction of her as Warden proves she holds some peculiar value. That may be the key we can use to our advantage."

91701183.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa's maid, and companion in pursuit of returning _$$home._$$""

96893879.m_KeyValue: "I swear upon my title as Lord Astolfo—my word shall not be broken."

96893881.m_KeyValue: "What is it you desire? Wealth? Glory?"

97203878.m_KeyValue: ""Once they're all my playthings, there'll be no more quarrels. Wouldn't that be peaceful?""

97203909.m_KeyValue: "I have stood watch over this Twilight Citadel for a hundred years..."

97203975.m_KeyValue: ""No soul that draws breath, nor any that ever will, can defeat me!""

97402253.m_KeyValue: ""You think the 'Black Blood' is some sort of disease, right?""

97402254.m_KeyValue: "It's been corroding my sanity. I could turn into a monster at any moment..."

97402255.m_KeyValue: "But what if I told you... that the Black Blood can grant you power beyond human limits?"

97402256.m_KeyValue: "So... the Bloodborn are carriers capable of harnessing the power of Black Blood?"

97402257.m_KeyValue: "It seems your higher-ups have not told you the real reason why they fear the Black Blood!"

""Searching through the choir's records, I discovered that orphaned girls of heretics, like Anna and Darcias, were not uncommon there. At first, the Church tolerated this, but as rumors of Bloodborn revival grew stronger, adoption screenings became extremely strict.
Three months ago, Tris encountered a young street singer whose voice, though untrained, showed remarkable musical talent. Her adoption request was rejected by the Church, citing 'difficult temperament and questionable background.' Tris was unwilling to give up. Instead, she kept the girl at a friend's house for the time being. I have a growing suspicion that Tris's secrets may be connected to this child.""

"What an excellent question! I can see you're truly paying attention.

107285432.m_KeyValue: "Joan! Don't let the past make you soft on our enemies!"

108378248.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, I was just about to ask you about that.'""

110794431.m_KeyValue: ""Noah's eyes fall upon the ovoid relic cradled in her arms, as he strives to sense the eternal tempest that stirs within.""

111117374.m_KeyValue: "Was any of it real? Or just dreams dressed up in memory?"

114083654.m_KeyValue: "We have not reached that level of trust."
