118895114.m_KeyValue: "Unable to deploy Vassals that use melee attacks or inflict displacement."

118910632.m_KeyValue: ""When the people from the Church landed on the island, I... I think I gave them the wrong directions.""

118910634.m_KeyValue: "The source of their mutation is Black Blood—and salt is one of the substances that counteracts Black Blood!"

118910635.m_KeyValue: "66 years ago? What are you talking about...?"

118910637.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah... when did you become so strong? All this time, we thought you were just some frail assistant to the doctor...""

118910664.m_KeyValue: ""In truth, no one knows what happens after we die. Perhaps its possible to become a phantom of longing thoughts.""

118910665.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I lost my memories, it feels like I've been constantly having brushes with death these past few days.""

118910666.m_KeyValue: "How could that be? Jason... Sora... Ressa... Why can't I remember any of them...?"

118910667.m_KeyValue: "What's going on? The tremors seem to be coming from the mountain!"

118910691.m_KeyValue: "But if that's the case... why would Master choose me? I'm not good in battle and I don't have any special abilities... I'm not good at anything..."

118910696.m_KeyValue: ""Because you know something, right? Or maybe you did do it after all.""

118910697.m_KeyValue: ""Piera Paracelsus, Vice-Commander of the Third Bell Ringer.""

118910700.m_KeyValue: "That last sec was for my catchphrase."

118910702.m_KeyValue: "Yet... I can't detect even a hint of hesitation in your heartbeat... Are you actually serious?"

118910722.m_KeyValue: "Acappella's voice? Where are you?! Why did you run off and abandon us here?!"

118910723.m_KeyValue: ""'Air manipulation'? So that's what that move on the ship was... I've got to say, that was seriously impressive.""

118910728.m_KeyValue: "And you were there with us 66 years ago to subjugate Death. Don't tell me you've forgotten...?"

118910730.m_KeyValue: ""Though he was a passenger, while we were stowaways.""

118910731.m_KeyValue: ""Throughout the ages, this isle has stood apart, its shores barred to outsiders by the will of the Divine Body. Thus it has ascended into the realm of legend.""

118910732.m_KeyValue: ""Go, follow your path. I'll help you find him, so he can be your ally in the fight against the Calamity's fate.""

118910733.m_KeyValue: "That concern doesn't seem to extend to me."

118910734.m_KeyValue: "So Noah... might be connected to the Bathory family... Could the companions he's searching for also be...?"

118910735.m_KeyValue: ""So you're worried about him. Well don't. If he really is from Sunset Isle 66 years ago, we might just have a lot in common...""

118910757.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, as my successor, you're far too naive. For a Bell Ringer, having 'humanity' is a fatal flaw.""

118910760.m_KeyValue: ""And what's truly infuriating... is your tone. Urging us to fight Death, to abandon our current existence...""

118910763.m_KeyValue: "No... this can't be right. You must have been deceived by Death... How... How could this be??"

118910764.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Oh no, we know exactly who you are, little Piera. You're you, and your grandmother is your grandmother!""

118910765.m_KeyValue: ""All 'thoughts' eventually die, becoming 'longings' that rely on other 'thoughts.'""

118910766.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... once told me that Death left behind its most precious possession on this island..."

118910767.m_KeyValue: ""That's why when you enter these blessed grounds, we can all connect through our shared memories.""

118910788.m_KeyValue: "No... I'm fine... It's just... I haven't mastered the Covenant yet.. my body is a bit..."

118910789.m_KeyValue: ""Covenant is a way of borrowing power from their 'gods' by consuming one's life force. While Bell Ringers might be unaffected, for ordinary people...""

118910793.m_KeyValue: ""My Piera... though you've grown up, you're still my brightest, most dependable granddaughter... and the one most like me...""

118910794.m_KeyValue: "What...? So the reason you can see Grandmother is because... you were here 66 years ago?"

118910795.m_KeyValue: ""I hate to interrupt this touching reunion, but I'm afraid we need to pause for a moment.""

118910796.m_KeyValue: "Behind it... stands the sun that never sets; yet its eyes... are forever fixed upon the 'darkness' sealed within the coffin."

118910797.m_KeyValue: "A Gravekeeper is born to guard the abyss... and they must know... how to find their way in the darkness..."

118910798.m_KeyValue: "...In the name of Paracelsus... I offer my life for the legacy..."

118910799.m_KeyValue: "Foolish child... you don't... understand at all..."

118910826.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah... Sorry to keep you waiting, Ressa...""

118910827.m_KeyValue: "I'll get you out of there! I'll take you away from this place!"

118910828.m_KeyValue: "The Spirit Bone Tower... it's the perfect form made from the blood and bones of my people... It's indestructible..."

118910829.m_KeyValue: ""I won't leave you behind, no matter what happens.""

118910830.m_KeyValue: "No... not that... I mean... hurry... and go..."

121096958.m_KeyValue: ""Skoll... you've always looked up to Father, haven't you?""

121096959.m_KeyValue: ""After I arrived, I snuck away from the squad and came to look for you two.""

121096960.m_KeyValue: ""Then, those wolves we encountered earlier were probably the infected townspeople.""

121096961.m_KeyValue: "It's precisely because it's dangerous that I need to find them!"

121096963.m_KeyValue: "Leave that to my superior. He'll surely step in to help."

121096990.m_KeyValue: ""But what about you? You seem to possess some power to suppress the Black Blood, but even that has its limits...""

121096991.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, my former colleagues, but I must bear witness to this man's oath until the very end.""

121097255.m_KeyValue: "Enemy? Is there something between your two families?"

121097256.m_KeyValue: "What the... This guy looks so weak."

121097257.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why are you back? Weren't you in a hurry to find someone?"

121097291.m_KeyValue: ""No one can change their predetermined fate, nor escape the cycle of time.""

121097292.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! Good point. Perhaps no one really knows their 'true self.'"

121097318.m_KeyValue: ""Cain always has something concealed, but he never lies.""

121097319.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? Are you hurt anywhere?"

121097320.m_KeyValue: ""For as long as I can remember, we have never been accepted by mortals. We cannot walk under the sunlight. We are born as fugitives, constantly hunted.""

121097321.m_KeyValue: "But the moon is far beyond our reach. Even birds can't fly there. How could we possibly...?"

121097322.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it, I don't get it! What's the Church up to? They're the ones who told us the Bathory family was the enemy!""

121097324.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Listen here, you unruly brat! You better explain yourself. I won't stand for baseless insults!""

121097325.m_KeyValue: ""And here I thought you were going to say something decent... How dare you insult my family, you stinking bat!""

121097354.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... If only I had noticed sooner... I hope you'll no longer be tormented by nothingness."

121097355.m_KeyValue: "The Church has abandoned you now. I'd say it's karma for you 'evil wolves'!"

121097356.m_KeyValue: ""Did you see a boy on your way here? About my height, with brown skin and messy hair.""

121097357.m_KeyValue: "I-I'm fine. But her... how can that bat woman actually turn into a bat? And change back on her own!"

121097382.m_KeyValue: ""What a pain... So either we search on our own, or we help them find their father first?""

121097386.m_KeyValue: "I'm not taking you with me. I'm going back to find them on my own..."

121097387.m_KeyValue: "And three others who don't look local. Reinforcements she called in?"

121097389.m_KeyValue: ""You've been calling me a smelly bat all this time, and now you're finally asking for my name?!""

121097417.m_KeyValue: ""Let's hurry to the Ashen Garden, Noah! It's this way!""

121097418.m_KeyValue: ""Wolfsbane is actually its real name. Thibault, the Church's chief doctor, does indeed give it to soldiers infected with Black Blood.""

121097420.m_KeyValue: "Do you know where your father might be now?"

121097421.m_KeyValue: "Have you been to Mouret before? Do you know their father?"

121097449.m_KeyValue: ""That was harsh, Hati. We grew up together...""

121097450.m_KeyValue: "Don't look at me. The Bathory family cut ties with The Church long before I can remember. I know nothing about any Gravekeeper."

121097452.m_KeyValue: "I was there the few times Uncle Gadric came to see Father. They never talked about this stuff."

121097453.m_KeyValue: ""What are you talking about, Clive? Father has always seen you as his heir.""

121119211.m_KeyValue: "{1} of Barnacle No. 1 emerge from the cave after a while."

121135692.m_KeyValue: ""Phantoms who wander between rifts. Bound neither to past nor future, they are trapped in the infinity of time, forever cycling through perpetuating dimensions, unable to find their way home.""

121135693.m_KeyValue: ""Phantoms who wander between rifts. Bound neither to past nor future, they are trapped in the infinity of time, forever cycling through perpetuating dimensions, unable to find their way home.""

121199361.m_KeyValue: ""It's too cold here… isn't it, Pavana?""

121199362.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no! You have to run—warn the others! Get them out of the camp!""

121199365.m_KeyValue: "No... Colossus Max... you must go back..."

121320194.m_KeyValue: "Jestel is my descendant. Looking after her is my duty."

121878492.m_KeyValue: "You can continue to increase Transfusion Level after evolution.|The following Vassals' levels will be locked and cannot be reset. Continue?"

123282492.m_KeyValue: ""He's on a completely different level from the enemies I've fought before, and we‘ve just suffered a crushing defeat...""

123282493.m_KeyValue: "Can we just leave out that last part?"

123294534.m_KeyValue: "Stop being dramatic. These soulless pawns of Baphomet will never break through my shield!"

123294535.m_KeyValue: ""It's all because of you, loudmouth! Now the guards are after us!""

125765597.m_KeyValue: ""This must be the brazier. Once we light it, we should be able to activate the elevator.""

125765599.m_KeyValue: ""Every day—every night in that cell, I could hear someone whispering to me.""

125765601.m_KeyValue: ""...because they were modified by Baphomet's Black Blood process, the Black Blood left in the cell would...""

125765602.m_KeyValue: ""It was the memories of my dead family... my father, brothers, and even my mother who protected me regardless of her own peril...""

125765603.m_KeyValue: ""—I'm willing to become such a relentless curse, as long as I can kill him with my own hands!""

125765604.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet has always been toying with flesh and blood, only to retaliate against his own terrible curse that can never be undone.""

125765605.m_KeyValue: ""Not to mention, now I have one more reason to settle the score with that demon—for Lady Empousa and her sisters!""

125766623.m_KeyValue: ""Next, we have to face the oldest elder of the Bathory family, the arrogant and cruel Bloodborn—Baphomet 'The Soulless.'""

125766624.m_KeyValue: ""He is powerful and cunning, and understands the battleground better than any of us. This is bound to be a fierce battle.""

125766625.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, I'm trembling. I can't help but doubt my feeble self, can we really defeat him?""

125766626.m_KeyValue: ""I don't think you're weak. Don't forget we've crossed swords before, although you lost that time, too.""

125766628.m_KeyValue: ""How reliable... Well then, let's go. We've got a score to settle with him.""

125774301.m_KeyValue: "As far as I can touch... that is the end of the world—the Other Side."

125774309.m_KeyValue: "Where do you think the 'Other Side' at the end of the world lies?"

125774311.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) When I grow up, I'm gonna leave 'Paradise' and conquer whatever's out there.""

125774312.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) Across the sea, of course.""

125774313.m_KeyValue: "You're such a kid. The stars were created to illuminate our Paradise. We are the center of it all. There's nothing out there."

125774314.m_KeyValue: ""Well I think the Other Side is up there, beyond the pale moon, where the stars were born.""

125774316.m_KeyValue: ""What about you, Abel? Who do you think is right?""

125775325.m_KeyValue: ""And then we recreated you through alchemy. Although it seems incomplete, I should congratulate you on your rebirth, so... 'Happy Birthday.'""

125775334.m_KeyValue: "We've prepared some new clothes for you. I hope they will fit."

125775336.m_KeyValue: ""This is a secluded castle that belongs to the Bathory family, and the home of Lady Empousa and myself.""

125776479.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. Well, now that you've seen through me, there's no point hiding it. Naturally, my beauty far eclipses that hideous creature.""

125776480.m_KeyValue: ""No, you're not Empousa. I spot plenty of differences.""

125776485.m_KeyValue: "The special type... 'silver-hair'... I'll give you a chance to return to my side."

125776489.m_KeyValue: "Have you looked in a mirror lately?!"

125776490.m_KeyValue: "What?! You're the flower girl from Starfall Valley? Why are you dressed so shamelessly!"

125776491.m_KeyValue: ""You really did lose your memory. Do you not even remember your master, Empousa?""

125777504.m_KeyValue: "What gave you the right to speak during this council?"

125777510.m_KeyValue: "I just got here... I don't know the past of this family."

125777512.m_KeyValue: ""How long has it been since the Hall of the Elders last saw such excitement, with two trials on the same day? A hundred years?""

125777513.m_KeyValue: "Don't be rude. The one in charge here is Elder Baphomet. He values tradition and standing above all else."

125777514.m_KeyValue: ""Elders, please hear me out. Yes, lady Empousa violated the tenets, but it was to rescue a special type. It was an emergency...""

125777516.m_KeyValue: "The Four Elders seem quite different from what I imagined... more like a gathering of weirdos."

125778657.m_KeyValue: ""No, I was just struck by the coincidence. Just as I had doubts, someone appeared to answer them...""

125778662.m_KeyValue: ""Oh... and her, what is this Moonblessed thing anyway? At first, I thought it was what the Bloodborn called themselves...""

125778664.m_KeyValue: "The Bloodborn have long held a legend that we were born on the moon."

125778665.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood, the carriage accident, the execution, the resurrection, the Embrace, the Bathory elders...""

125778667.m_KeyValue: ""My thoughts are so muddled, my memories before the crash...very hazy.""

125778668.m_KeyValue: "We've been rushing through so much until now. Only after calming down do I realize just how many things have happened these past few days."

125779681.m_KeyValue: ""If you knew the way, why didn't you say so earlier?""

125779682.m_KeyValue: ""You didn't ask me. Besides, I wanted Aiona to ask, not you.""

125779685.m_KeyValue: ""We must be close to those treasures, that's why we're caught in these disorienting traps...""

125779686.m_KeyValue: ""No, that's not it, we've just been taking the wrong turns.""

125779687.m_KeyValue: "Wait... do you know your way around here?"

125779688.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes, Baphomet would escort members of our family to the experiment site. I... remember the way.""

125779690.m_KeyValue: "It feels like we've been going in circles..."

125779691.m_KeyValue: ""I heard this tower existed even before the Bathory family took refuge here, it was only converted into a prison in the last decade.""

125779692.m_KeyValue: "Then there may be many ancient treasures hidden inside this tower that no one knows about!"

125780835.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">The moon is but a dream of the sun</style>, and thus we were forgotten by the light—""

125780836.m_KeyValue: "The stars are our birthplace; and thus we were exiled—"

125780838.m_KeyValue: "Do you know what Death means? Do you fear disappearing as well?"

125780839.m_KeyValue: "I feel like... this is the first time I truly understand the meaning of that word."

125780841.m_KeyValue: ""When the sun rises, and its rays shine in, I will... disappear, won't I?""

125780842.m_KeyValue: ""Even the moonlight, which should feel like a mother's embrace, has turned cold...""

125781859.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather, he was struck down by that new elder, Gilrain, and then we were imprisoned in this tower...""

125781860.m_KeyValue: ""I see... But I still feel that if it's him, he wouldn't die just like that.""

125781863.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, and where's Cain? Is he slacking off somewhere again?""

125781865.m_KeyValue: "Why has Lady Empousa been silent since leaving the cell?"

125781866.m_KeyValue: ""You... if you did anything to upset Lady Empousa, I'll kill you where you stand.""

125781868.m_KeyValue: ""When you two were alone earlier, did you discuss anything?""

126326561.m_KeyValue: ""Peace can be destroyed by war, yet war is the only way to build peace—what you seek is a war that will completely end the old era.""

128326638.m_KeyValue: ""But living alone in this world is misery—for you, and for me.""

128326639.m_KeyValue: "Fool. A new family name means the Lord might adopt Joan as his foster daughter."

129522506.m_KeyValue: ""I helped Empousa mend a damaged doll today, which reminded me of Clive Jr. But don't worry, I'm fine—we have to keep moving forward after all!""

129618294.m_KeyValue: ""Behold! With thunderous applause and roaring cheers, we welcome the long-absent legend of these sands—the undefeated myth, now approaching her 999th triumph—Joan!""

129618295.m_KeyValue: "Too bad Pavana missed this—she'd have been overjoyed!"

129738244.m_KeyValue: "Every story seems filled with strife and conflict."

130015517.m_KeyValue: "Turn this setback into drive by strengthening your Vassals."

130015520.m_KeyValue: "Failure is but a chance to start anew. Trust that you will face the next challenge with better composure."

130239823.m_KeyValue: ""'Killing him without cause is not justice,' Van Helsing reasoned, though deep down, he knew he was merely opposing Noah out of habit.""

130239828.m_KeyValue: ""'Fine, let's get it over with.' Noah said resolutely.""

130239829.m_KeyValue: ""'Wait!' To everyone's surprise, it was Van Helsing who objected.""

130239830.m_KeyValue: "'Wait?' Selena stared at Van Helsing in confusion."

130379742.m_KeyValue: ""There's more than one way to take what you desire, meow.""

130379775.m_KeyValue: "It seems you still haven't realized what might be of value to me."

130379940.m_KeyValue: ""This time, it's your life I'm after.""

130380072.m_KeyValue: "What a shameless way to go... meow."

130380105.m_KeyValue: "Want my help? Just know—I always collect what's owed."

130380138.m_KeyValue: "I'm going to enjoy watching you squirm."

130727384.m_KeyValue: "Pact has exceeded 180 days. Unable to use."

131268388.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa did everything she could for me to prevent the disease from spreading. But I eventually became like this, while still clinging to the promise I made her, until...""

131269412.m_KeyValue: ""Well it doesn't matter how many there are, just kill them all!""

137131385.m_KeyValue:
""After the catastrophe, the Carrelle family pledged unwavering loyalty to the Church.

Setti, born of a branch of the family, was no exception. Raised under the shadow of the Church and her kin, she nurtured a fervent desire to serve the divine.

She knew that such a path demanded not only faith, but strength.

Deep in the forest, she learned a hunter's instincts from owls. Each twang of her bowstring was a hymn to Aeon.

Through countless days and nights, devotion and discipline became her prayer—until at last, her wish was fulfilled.""

137131478.m_KeyValue: ""In the drawing, Goldland is shown gripping the helm with exaggerated fierceness, claws bared like a monster, with childish handwriting beside it reading 'Captain Demon.' She rarely speaks of it, but I can clearly see how Ami sees Goldland in her heart—a Captain, a 'demon,' and... a father.""

137131509.m_KeyValue:
""Before this, I only wanted to live; after this, the order of life and death was broken.

On the day that marked the edge of life and death, Agares's flames devoured both my life and my 'sins.' I was reborn as a Bloodborn—only to be branded with a new 'sin.' To the Church, all life bears the stain of original sin. I am but one among the countless. Yet in defying the order of life and death, my burden weighs heavier than most.""

137131544.m_KeyValue:
""After the Alita family faded into the flow of time, Aiona's heart grew as cold and distant as the moonlight she keeps watch over—no longer stirred by emotion.

Yet she once said that my presence seemed to awaken a glimmer of hope within her.

But like moonlight that lingers in the gaps between clouds, I still cannot see what future lies behind the gaze beneath her frozen mask.""

137131602.m_KeyValue:
""This is what I know of the Aegis family and Jess's story.

They were a branch family of the Bathory family, the fiercest warriors of The Howling Peninsula.

To them, guarding the main family was the highest honor, and returning to the moon was their lifelong pursuit.

Her father left behind a black shield when he received the summons, departing for Bathory Castle with her mother.

'I will protect Papa and Mama, and uphold the main family's honor!'

'That's wonderful, dear! Papa and Mama will be waiting for you at the castle!'""

137131699.m_KeyValue:
""The Moonfall Games are like an exquisite robe woven by the Hall of the Elders, crawling with lice beneath its splendor.

The maidens wake, fight, and die—the same cycle repeats endlessly.

_$$Are we... just vessels to be replaced and discarded at will?_$$

Rage surges forth—Empousa's first taste of raw, unfiltered emotion.

The pulse of shared blood tells her that this game should not be ruled by mutual slaughter.

She adorns the maidens' hair with scarlet flowers, letting them call her sister. She wants to live—to help everyone live.

Even now those unnaturally red flowers still bloom in the castle's back garden. Only later did I learn they were nourished by the blood of fallen maidens.""

137131757.m_KeyValue: ""While reading Cain's Alchemy Handbook, I was surprised to discover that Cain once held a position within the Church, even attaining the rank of priest with a devoted following of believers. Yet judging from Cain's usual demeanor, he absolutely despises the existence of god. So why did he join the Church? Perhaps continuing to read these journals will answer my questions...""

137450806.m_KeyValue: ""(A letter addressed to the castle. The sender seems to be an old acquaintance of the castle? I've heard tales of its former glory. As its new master, a polite reply seems fitting.)""

158831150.m_KeyValue: "We're... running out of time... my lady..."

158831181.m_KeyValue: ""<alpha=#FF>My companions are waiting for me, I must go back... Let me go!""

158831183.m_KeyValue: ""Whoever you are, swear by Aeon, if I offer my soul... you will protect everyone in my stead!""

158831443.m_KeyValue: ""The lord is not here, my lady. You shouldn't speak too much; your eyes need time to recover. Please rest for now.""

158831445.m_KeyValue: ""Relax and just sleep for now. When you open your eyes again, the honor and duty of our family will be yours...""

158831446.m_KeyValue: "I don't need to rest. I need to see my father."

158831448.m_KeyValue: "There's no end to them. I need to find a way out of here—"

158831475.m_KeyValue: "I will definitely save Father and our family..."

158831476.m_KeyValue: "Was that the day of the ritual? What about the lord? What happened to him?"

158831477.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, kid! Where are you going? You did pay—""

158831478.m_KeyValue: "So much sand... Did it blow in from outside?"

158831510.m_KeyValue: "But the lord said the most important thing is to complete 'that matter.' None of the guards stationed there are allowed to leave their posts..."

158831544.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be afraid, I have no ill intent.""

158831575.m_KeyValue: "The servants will die; the guards will die; the seven elders will die; the lord and his heir will die; and this entire castle will crumble in a great fire. This is what is 'predestined' to take place today."

158831577.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if you're after wealth or honor, but you... shouldn't have touched Aiona.""

158831610.m_KeyValue: ""Assassins clad in black, concealing their ambitions beneath the night sky;""

158831641.m_KeyValue: ""Those who seek power from darkness will fall into eternal night. Gilrain, do not waver from the faith you pursue.""

159618788.m_KeyValue: "Wait! Could it be Aiona and the others..."

159618791.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? Who are you calling out to?"

159618793.m_KeyValue: "Even if I forget everything about myself one day... This place—I will never forget. Where they came swarming. Where my companions were devoured."

159618794.m_KeyValue: "There's nothing remarkable here. Why bring me to this place?"

159619715.m_KeyValue: "Maybe you haven't considered this: I have no desire to become the Mastermind. There's no reason for us to fight."

159619718.m_KeyValue: ""Fascinating, isn't it? Whatever game I imagine takes shape immediately. Please—sit.""

159619719.m_KeyValue: "So that's your goal... to defeat me and claim the title of Mastermind."

159619720.m_KeyValue: "It may have devoured world after world to reach this one."

159619721.m_KeyValue: ""The Mastermind holds boundless knowledge. Endless, magnificent understanding.""

159619811.m_KeyValue: "Albrecht has found a way to destroy the Mastermind—and Ami knows where it lies."

159619814.m_KeyValue: "That's no reason to risk drawing the Formless away on your own!"

159619815.m_KeyValue: "I just... I couldn't bear to see you get hurt."

159619816.m_KeyValue: "Now's not the time to think about returning home. We need to focus on ending this."

159619817.m_KeyValue: ""You wanted Albrecht to take me back to our world, didn't you? But I told you—we're companions. We face this together.""

159619818.m_KeyValue: "Little Stella! (sniffling)... I'm so glad you're still alive!"

159619821.m_KeyValue: "You idiot! Who gave you the right to decide that on your own and just leave me behind?!"

159621988.m_KeyValue: "You're asking 'why don't I go with you?'"

159621989.m_KeyValue: "Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep—?"

159621990.m_KeyValue: ""If anyone can make it back home, it's them.""

159621991.m_KeyValue: ""By now, the other 'me' should have found his way back to them. He and that world's Albrecht... they seemed dependable.""

159621992.m_KeyValue: ""Still, we've put good distance between us and the El Dorado—enough, I hope, for Regina and the others to escape the Formless.""

159621993.m_KeyValue: ""Does it sadden you too, seeing the city like this?""

159621995.m_KeyValue: ""While I was on the Other Side, so many years passed here... Everything's in even worse shape than when I left.""

159664422.m_KeyValue: "That's part of the main story. We're in the Affinity story now—so it's still around."

159733334.m_KeyValue: "Slaves of House Carrelle who will stop at nothing to claim a _$$surname_$$ for themselves."

161051044.m_KeyValue: "Where have you gone… Have you chosen to abandon us?"

161051047.m_KeyValue: "So you see—you're fated to destroy everyone who dares to care for you."

161051049.m_KeyValue: "The previous Bell Ringer's weapon… is it this lance?"

161051051.m_KeyValue: "We yield! We swear to serve you—"

161174827.m_KeyValue: ""I've had my eye on this situation for a while now. The real issue is... oops, I'm saying too much...""

161177765.m_KeyValue: "There are no fools here. Just tell me what you're really after."

161179940.m_KeyValue: ""It might not be suitable, but I could help you find more inspiration.""

161181854.m_KeyValue: ""Haha, I thought you might have actually learned something after all this time apart...""

161183011.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... Allow me to share a story with you after the meeting concludes."

161184032.m_KeyValue: "Something lurking in the shadows of my past warns me against such actions..."

161187103.m_KeyValue: "I've witnessed far too many tragedies in this world and they all shared a common cause一human nature."

161582406.m_KeyValue: ""I write this letter because I once heard a maid speak of those who live by the sea, how they place their innermost thoughts in bottles and let the waves carry them to distant shores.""

162342703.m_KeyValue: ""Struck down in the arena, executed by a master for no cause, beaten to death for offending a noble…""

162342704.m_KeyValue: "I remember… that spear still lies where she fell—in the capital of Astolfo."

162342706.m_KeyValue: "I will defeat you all—kill every last one of you!"

162342708.m_KeyValue: ""When we return, will Joan turn cold again?""

163500051.m_KeyValue: "To become this strong in just a night... to be able to stand against even me..."

163507080.m_KeyValue: ""The Hall of the Elders is not far ahead. From here on out, we must proceed with the utmost caution.""

163520205.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, I've picked out the perfect spot. You better not blow our cover!""

163758122.m_KeyValue: "Make good use of it and it will prove to be a boon."

163761323.m_KeyValue: ""I lose sleep in agony every time I think about the future of the Bathory family resting on your shoulders, you complete failure.""

163769386.m_KeyValue: ""To halt the bloodthirsty spear's relentless carnage, I recalled the place where we first _$$met_$$...""

163792833.m_KeyValue: "That stance... Don't tell me he's about to use Compost?"

163792835.m_KeyValue: "The perfect fusion of the Alita bloodline and the Eye of the Divine Body… The Saint never wished for you to walk freely in the outside world."

163792836.m_KeyValue: "We'll send both you and that ugly rat sky-high!"

163792837.m_KeyValue: "But… aren't you a Bell Ringer? How can you speak like that about the Divine Bodies?"

163792839.m_KeyValue: ""Gone for only a moment… and already you stand with the Bloodborn, Aiona Alita?""

163792840.m_KeyValue: "I’m sorry… Lady Empousa. I never told you… I once served as the Saint's priestess."

165084492.m_KeyValue: ""Freedom... this freedom that you all yearn for, what exactly is it?""

165084493.m_KeyValue: ""Hah! You fancy yourself witty, do you?""

165084494.m_KeyValue: ""He might've ruled this dump once, but now I'm the strongest!""

165084495.m_KeyValue: ""Here, on Carrelle land, it's our only shot at changing fate!""

165964799.m_KeyValue: ""But with everything that's been happening on the island recently, I couldn't bear to watch everyone getting infected and turning into beasts one after another. That's why the village chief and I contacted the Church...""

165964800.m_KeyValue: "D-Don't suddenly get quiet like you're trying to spare my feelings!"

165964801.m_KeyValue: "Then I'd better stay alive to witness the day you unleash the secrets of salt!"

165964802.m_KeyValue: ""An odd fellow from the Church told me, but more importantly...""

165964804.m_KeyValue: ""You've already known for a long time, haven't you?""

165964831.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm not just doubting you, I'm doubting my own existence as well.""

165964832.m_KeyValue: ""No, I mean about my grandmother. She sacrificed herself as a Gravekeeper before I was even born. I've never met her, nor have I ever mentioned her to you.""

165964834.m_KeyValue: "Who could it be? Only those from the Paracelsus bloodline can become the sacrifice..."

165964857.m_KeyValue: ""Whether we bring her back, what happens afterwards... we'll cross those bridges when she actually returns.""

165964858.m_KeyValue: "It's fine. It seems she holds everyone in equal contempt."

165964863.m_KeyValue: "Did you help Death escape from the cathedral?"

165964864.m_KeyValue: ""This time, his Vice-Commander has committed such a serious crime, even someone like him couldn't just feign indifference.""

165964866.m_KeyValue: "Noah... Was it really just a coincidence that you used this gesture as our secret signal...?"

165964867.m_KeyValue: "Piera... have you ever wondered why the Bell Ringer's Vice-Commanders tend to be such emotionally detached oddballs?"

165964870.m_KeyValue: ""You expect me to believe that? If it wasn't you, how could you possibly know all this?""

165964889.m_KeyValue: ""Cut it out, you brat! If you're here, show yourself already!""

165964890.m_KeyValue: "You little brat! Just wait till I find out where you are—I'll fly over and teach you a lesson."

165964896.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, wasn't there someone from the Bathory family on the ship too? Could that have been his companion?""

165964899.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Acappella. I fear I can't keep my promise.""

165964900.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, come on! We were just following Aiona's advice to meet in the village. How did we end up in this mess?!""

165964901.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you're right! But... where should I even start looking?""

165964902.m_KeyValue: "But that didn't prevent you from getting lost on the way here."

165964924.m_KeyValue: ""...Fear and hesitation are behind me now... Goodbye, Master, Acappella, Grandmother, and ...Noah.""

165964928.m_KeyValue: "What? But you're my ancestors! You're not Gravekeepers—you've become Death's pawns!"

165964929.m_KeyValue: ""I am Piera's granddaughter, I am the Paracelsus Gravekeeper. I will defeat Death. I have never wavered...""

165964930.m_KeyValue: ""...Master, even though you never allowed me to use the things inside...""

165964931.m_KeyValue: ""Because we're all Gravekeepers, every one of us!""

165964932.m_KeyValue: ""And that is the indomitable courage of 'humanity,' something unique only to them.""

165964933.m_KeyValue: ""...But she was right. Death has truly returned, and... it will indeed come back to the blessed grounds where it was once sealed.""

165964955.m_KeyValue: "I knew he couldn't be trusted! Curse that heartless man!"

165964956.m_KeyValue: "You... why are you still defending him! He's a Bell Ringer! How could he not know what you were doing right under his nose!"

165964959.m_KeyValue: ""It's because of Death's power that this island has these 'phantoms of longing,' allowing us to converse like this...""

165964960.m_KeyValue: "No... that can't be! The grandmother in my memories would never be... be someone who would choose to give up..."

188548467.m_KeyValue: ""Desert dwellers came to this place twice—once a century ago in pursuit of new lands, and a hundred years later in chains. The rare blue crystal mines turned the desert into a treasure trove for nobles, but they also became the final resting place for countless enslaved desert inhabitants.""

188548468.m_KeyValue: ""The frozen blue lake stands high between the Astolfo and Montebello families. Beneath its untouched surface, an ancient verse echoes: A lake upon the heights, illuminated by the Other Side, sings of a child divine.""

188548469.m_KeyValue: ""Adamm Astolfo, the sage who once led the desert people in their wandering, established the first desert tribe along this river. Though the tribe has long since vanished, the river bears the sage's name as its lasting legacy.""

188548470.m_KeyValue: ""Stone pillars stand solemnly in the desert sands, engraved with records of the Astolfo family's southward migration along the oases. Yet their ancestral dwellings have crumbled to ruin, and the elders who have passed sealed away this history, burying unspeakable secrets of the past.""

188548472.m_KeyValue: ""Once believed to bring prosperity to the desert with the fall of a meteorite, this deep western crater is now encrusted with cobalt-blue crystals, marking the inescapable doom of the Astolfo clan.""

188548473.m_KeyValue: ""Children of the desert often sing this rhyme: Water flows where sands run dry, trees shall bloom and touch the sky. A bard roams from town to east, to seek a land of peace at least. Yet long ago, this verdant land, belonged to another's hand.""

188548474.m_KeyValue: ""This narrow mountain path, northeast of Sandspire Keep, is the only route to the outside world. After the Campaign began, it became a burial ground for fallen Vassals. Though frost has replaced the desert sands, the weapon marks carved into the surrounding cliffs remain as eternal scars.""

188548479.m_KeyValue: ""_$$We extolled our ancestors for their protection, we extolled the Divine for our victories. Now, with nowhere else to turn, we must extol once more—for the future of our people._$$""

188548480.m_KeyValue: ""After countless migrations, the desert dwellers finally built high walls atop the central dunes. Yet the peace they longed for crumbled under relentless conflict, leaving only restless spirits to wander the sands.""

220440363.m_KeyValue: ""I simply want to be with the one I love—quietly, peacefully, for all the days to come.""

220440365.m_KeyValue: "Traces of tears still glisten on Letitia's cheeks."

220440366.m_KeyValue: "Sorry I was such a downer today."

220440368.m_KeyValue: "A wave of dizziness strikes without warning."

220749343.m_KeyValue: ""Confess to your sins, Nevernight. Only Aeon's Holy Flame can cleanse your sins and grant salvation to your damned soul!""

220749345.m_KeyValue: "You have a history with the Church?"

220749346.m_KeyValue: ""Another admirer? My, you sure are popular.""

221110503.m_KeyValue: ""When facing a vast disparity in power, this was perhaps the best course of action.""

222122901.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on granting them access?"

222123134.m_KeyValue: ""To protect the family's interests, some elders are considering convicting those involved. I'd like to hear everyone's thoughts on this matter.""

222123297.m_KeyValue: ""This would be an opportune time to propose a merger treaty, but given the generations of hostility between the Bathory and them, the method of approach requires careful consideration...""

222972930.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the Blood Beasts, they can't be killed...""

225014198.m_KeyValue: ""The crimes committed by Ironfist's prisoners are documented in detail, each word carved in iron, every case on record.""

225059651.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! I get it now. If they're not in the present, then they must be in the past or future here! Wait, what?""

225059652.m_KeyValue: ""My sense of smell wasn't always this good, but Father trained me to enhance my senses.""

225059653.m_KeyValue: ""Just as the rats served as the carriers of Black Blood in Starfall Valley, here in Lupine Forest, these are the carriers.""

225059654.m_KeyValue: ""You... You're saying he was infected by the Black Blood? How could this be? Then doesn't that mean he's... No, impossible...""

225059656.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Hati. I can't explain, but we must hurry to the deepest part of this cave immediately.""

225059683.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, you and those two men mentioned earlier that at the depths of this cave, a Calamity is sealed.""

225059684.m_KeyValue: ""As time passes, individual memories and relationships between people continuously accumulate. We all change, but...""

225059685.m_KeyValue: ""I feel like I also made a promise to someone, but I can't remember...""

225059686.m_KeyValue: ""In other words, they found out that I can suppress the Black Blood on my own—""

225059688.m_KeyValue: ""Gadric entrusted you to me, and Hati is still waiting. I can't go back on my word..""

225059947.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. When I was younger, I always wanted to ask father what he meant by 'home.'""

225059948.m_KeyValue: ""...Just leave after you've given the flowers to my father. Whatever you came here to do, I won't interfere.""

225059949.m_KeyValue:
""Perhaps it's to answer that question—
'Where is your true home?'""

225059950.m_KeyValue: ""I think I understand now what Gadric saw in you. Don't worry, you can entrust the future of the Ganelon family to me.""

225059951.m_KeyValue: "I'm looking for something that might be hidden here—the 'Moon.'"

225059952.m_KeyValue: "The first of which is most likely in the forbidden grounds that your family has guarded for generations."

225059953.m_KeyValue: ""Eh... if something bad happens, don't say I didn't warn you!""

225059954.m_KeyValue: "The Black Blood is acting up... Why at a time like this? Is it because of something here..."

225059981.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Hati, please take us to the cemetery. I'm certain Noah and Clive will need our help with what's to come.""

225060011.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, they're just trying to scare me, right? I won't... I won't turn into one of those monsters, will I?""

225060013.m_KeyValue: "From the pool nearby. I was thirsty and took a sip first."

225060014.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, I must have mistaken your voice for someone else.""

225060017.m_KeyValue: "I see... the Bloodborn's 'Immortality'... so it really exists."

225060043.m_KeyValue: "Then... you believe I am the Aiona you know?"

225060044.m_KeyValue: ""You shouldn't invest too much in strangers that have nothing to do with you, Aiona.""

225060045.m_KeyValue: ""Then why didn't you stop Clive! You're the Church's elites, yet you let him walk away.""

225060046.m_KeyValue: ""It's too dangerous, you can't go any deeper.""

225060047.m_KeyValue: "Ridiculous. I've witnessed countless humans suffer a fate worse than death from it!"

225060048.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, once infected with Black Blood, they all turn into disgusting, mindless beasts sooner or later. Humans cannot resist it.""

225060049.m_KeyValue: ""For most, the moment they're infected with Black Blood, it's no different from death. Only the light of Tempus can purify them.""

225060050.m_KeyValue: "I... I don't know why... but I can hear their voices in my head."

225060072.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry. Perhaps it's my impulsive thinking that makes me seem naive... Maybe that's why I was never able to comprehend the Oracle that Aeon bestowed upon my family..."

225060075.m_KeyValue: "I'm the reason he's in this forsaken place. He's probably feeling angry and helpless."

225060079.m_KeyValue: "What the hell is this Divine Body?"

225060080.m_KeyValue: ""...unique condition, the Divine Body is reacting to you by sending out different resonance frequencies.""

225060081.m_KeyValue: "I finally understand why Clive and those werewolves feel deceived and betrayed by the Church..."

225060082.m_KeyValue: ""No, there's no time, we have to find Clive. If what you say is true...""

225060112.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, wolves are cool... But don't add dumb to it!""

225060113.m_KeyValue: ""Coincidence, perhaps. I came here on a mission twenty years ago. Fortunately, the environment hasn't changed much since then.""

225060114.m_KeyValue: "(heavy breathing) ...We finally made through that blasted minefield... right?"

225060143.m_KeyValue: "It seems they've come to take back what's theirs!"

225060144.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps if it was the old me..."

225060145.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, if the water is contaminated, how is this lamb still okay?""

225060146.m_KeyValue: "She will surely lead the Church's finest doctors to find a way to contain the spread of the disease."

225599971.m_KeyValue: ""After selecting a difficulty, choose your destination and attempt the stage for your fastest clear time!""

225802689.m_KeyValue: "Doing the bare minimum while still getting the job done—that's the spider way."

225802691.m_KeyValue: ""A winding path lies ahead. Will you take it, or bypass it and go straight?""

225802692.m_KeyValue:
"'I'm the No. 1 Steering Spider!'
Reach the next destination even faster!"

225802721.m_KeyValue:
""Misleading opponents is also a competitive strategy.
Faced with a dead end, the two spiders reassess their relationship.""

225802722.m_KeyValue:
"You encounter spiders moving in the opposite direction.
You question yourself—should you be following them?"

225802724.m_KeyValue: "The spider that stuck to its path spotted the other spider at the supply point—the one that turned back earlier had caught up."

226229221.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, now that you've been reborn into the hereditary Bathory family, you should be given a noble title.""

226229223.m_KeyValue: "Congratulations. You are now officially a member of the Bathory family. Sharing the secret of the Embrace with you should no longer be considered a violation of our oath—"

226229224.m_KeyValue: "A noble title? I get to choose it myself..."

227541262.m_KeyValue: ""Just some rocks, nothing that can keep me down!""

227541264.m_KeyValue: ""The situation is not getting any better, though...""

228500469.m_KeyValue: "There's something I'm not sure if I should say..."

228500470.m_KeyValue: ""He's hanging from a rope tied to the rear mast—get him down, now!""

228500471.m_KeyValue: ""We are adventurers of the El Dorado! As long as the Captain stands and our sails fly high, we keep sailing toward our goal!""

228500472.m_KeyValue: "They've completely transformed! Don't let them scratch or bite you—no matter what!"

228500473.m_KeyValue: "It's the same one I heard when I first boarded... Could this be what's been making me dizzy?"

228500474.m_KeyValue: "Hmph... No wonder Bob once said the first rule of the Silver Cross is to be ruthless."

228500493.m_KeyValue: ""Have you noticed something, Mr. Van Helsing?""

228500501.m_KeyValue: "Then perhaps that is why they remain. Even in this form… their will to protect the helm remains."

228500502.m_KeyValue: ""A Silver Cross member's Future Artifact—unleashing its metamorphosis—was never meant for mortal eyes, least of all Heretics like you.""

228500503.m_KeyValue: "On the contrary... those words were not meant to hold me back. They sounded more like..."

228500504.m_KeyValue: "Which brings me to the second question: Where exactly were Goldland and William at the time?"

228500505.m_KeyValue: "But I hadn't said anything about poisoning the whole ship. I merely hinted someone might've introduced poison aboard. Yet his reaction assumed mass poisoning—an oddly specific leap for someone hearing it for the first time."

228500506.m_KeyValue: ""To uncover the truth behind William's death, we'll first need to solve how Goldland left Jones's quarters without being seen. But before that...""

228500507.m_KeyValue: ""So Jones knew the deed was done, and Aaron, trusting him as a partner, let his guard down...""

228500508.m_KeyValue: ""So far, aside from us, only Jones and Goldland have shown no signs of infection.""

228500535.m_KeyValue: "And the Captain of this ship—he looks rich and suspicious… What if he's part of something this vile?!"

228500566.m_KeyValue: "No—your case is different. If I'm right..."

228500567.m_KeyValue: ""We'll wait here... not just until the ship docks, but until the world ends.""

228500568.m_KeyValue: ""That isn't what troubles me. What I cannot understand is this—despite consuming Black Blood-tainted flesh before my eyes, you've shown no signs of infection.""

228500569.m_KeyValue: "So you knew all along… that I knew how to open the hidden door?"

228500571.m_KeyValue: "...But isn't this storage room meant to be the lowest level of the El Dorado?"

228500572.m_KeyValue: "If there truly is a hidden level… how do we reach it?"

228500593.m_KeyValue: "William... (coughing)... he's a clever one… He spent his days studying alchemy aboard the ship… Especially fond of making things that explode…"

228500594.m_KeyValue: ""It ends here, William. Your cruel schemes fall to ruin, and your life will forever remain in Goldland's shadow.""

228500597.m_KeyValue: "You fool! You've been frail since boyhood. That's why no one pressed you—they hoped you'd follow what you truly loved."

228500598.m_KeyValue: "Then it's possible he was concealing his identity long before you ever stepped aboard."

228500599.m_KeyValue: ""All he ever did was curse me, strike me! And once we reach Sunset Isle, he'll cast me aside!""

228500600.m_KeyValue: "What does any of this have to do with Goldland wanting to reach Sunset Isle?"

228500601.m_KeyValue: ""He may have been reckless... but for those who face the sea's wonders with nothing but mortal flesh, is that not a form of... art?""

228500602.m_KeyValue: ""And on this storm-swept day you adore so dearly, I have finally silenced all who sought to harm you.""

228500603.m_KeyValue: "Because he and the Captain… They're twins!"

228500604.m_KeyValue: "I remember when we first came here to meet Goldland… There were only four suits of armor on display."

228500629.m_KeyValue: "You mean those foul things above us?!"

228500630.m_KeyValue: "Hati's been alone this whole time… in the cabin above us?"

228500633.m_KeyValue: "Well then. It seems there's no one left to challenge me for the Captain's seat."

228500634.m_KeyValue: "You're much more reasonable. No wonder Noah prefers you over her."

228500635.m_KeyValue: ""Ironically… if we count our enemies among them, you may be the one who understands me best.""

228500636.m_KeyValue: ""Where are you…? You're playing with me, aren't you? You're just hiding, waiting for me to find you.""

228500662.m_KeyValue: "I am Ranna of the Moonblessed. The Calamity most feared among mortals—Famine."

228500663.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately for you, neither I, nor my master, nor any of the Bell Ringers… will ever allow that to happen.""

228500665.m_KeyValue: ""If she were truly unstoppable, she wouldn't be sealed away here—trapped aboard this ship, forced to rely on a trembling fool like William instead of stronger pawns like Goldland or Bob.""

228500666.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha… Am I seeing this correctly? Is that fear on your smug face? At last, even you falter before her glory. Truly befitting my goddess!""

228500668.m_KeyValue: "From the beginning… no one believed in me. No one needed me. Then she came… She gave me hope… gave me life..."

230245294.m_KeyValue: "It seems you have a gift for divination?"

230389034.m_KeyValue: "Really appreciate the packages. The survey nearly failed without them."

230473739.m_KeyValue: "Embracing one another may be the way to returning to the other side."

230473805.m_KeyValue: "Fear makes a fitting decoration for tonight's soirée."

230473836.m_KeyValue: ""Humans are naught but beasts in garments, and gods fare no better.""

230476938.m_KeyValue: ""Self: The world you see, the power you touch... it's hard for me to let go of such things.""

230477004.m_KeyValue:
""Real self: That's not a customer. 
Puppet: Then send them to hell!""

230482435.m_KeyValue: ""Interlocking our fingers, like making a wish.""

230482532.m_KeyValue: ""What's come over me, lost in thought while gazing at my reflection.""

230484485.m_KeyValue: ""Hey! You did that on purpose, didn't you?! You may be my Vassal, but don't push your luck...""

230484706.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, how long are you going to keep me waiting?""

230486783.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not very familiar with the world beyond archery, but... I'm willing to explore it together with you.""

230486880.m_KeyValue: "Patience is crucial in waiting for the moment when prey lets its guard down."

230487684.m_KeyValue: ""Shields are actually quite fragile. Once cracked, they cannot be easily repaired.""

230487715.m_KeyValue: "You assigned me to stand guard? Understood."

230488833.m_KeyValue: ""Since you insist, I shan't decline... But don't come to regret it.""

230489054.m_KeyValue: ""I shall simply remain here, slowly decaying away.""

230489889.m_KeyValue: "I have long grown accustomed to waiting."

230489982.m_KeyValue: "This indescribable feeling... Could this also be a revelation?"

230492032.m_KeyValue: ""Habits can be terrifying. I've thought about leaving my overprotective guardian, but I've never dared to take the first step.""

""Noah,

You and I, sinners guilty of crimes against time itself, have met amid the realm's turbulence, with time standing as the barrier. There is indeed a certain irony to this.
Our collaboration has been most pleasant, but now we must go forth to fulfill our missions in separate ways.
I hope our paths will cross again one day.

231351025.m_KeyValue:
""Noah,
I made it to Mouret safely.
It feels strange to return—it's been so long since we left.
The Ganelon may lie to the north, but the summers here were always just as vivid in my memory. The meadows, the streams, the markets… everything felt so alive.
I thought I'd never see it like this again, not after everything that happened. But when I stepped onto this land, the flowers and grass beneath my feet reminded me that life can still flourish, even after ruin.
I visited Father. The Wolfsbane is blooming beautifully.
I've enclosed one for you—maybe you can compare it to the ones in the castle's sunroom.
Oh, and… it's my birthday today. I wish you were here to celebrate with me, but reviving the Ganelon is my duty, and I won't stop until it's done.
Still, let's make a promise.
Next year, on this day, we'll stand together in Mouret—restored, alive—and admire the summer we both remember so well.
Goodbye, for now.""

300213673.m_KeyValue: "But something's wrong. She knows your past—your memories. She knows better than anyone these jailers could never hold you."

301784348.m_KeyValue: "Hopeless. Fighting is all this woman has room for in her head."

301784349.m_KeyValue: "Let's open the door and find out."

301784350.m_KeyValue: "We can solve these mysteries later. For now—fight!"

304395252.m_KeyValue: "To protect everyone... I must become stronger."

322744795.m_KeyValue:
""Exile from the light is the Bloodborn's immutable fate.
Yet Quinn refused to bow before destiny's decree. She had devoured too many hymns to daylight within forbidden poetry—yearning burned within her to walk beneath the sun as mortals do. Thus she sought Cain the steward's aid to forge this parasol of protection. Tragically, during that bitter conflict with her father, the parasol was lost within the castle's depths. For centuries it lay forgotten, never fulfilling its purpose, until...""

322747996.m_KeyValue:
""The drafting ruler Agnes gifted me is said to be a meticulously crafted replica of hers.

It is said that every cartographer possesses a custom-made drafting tool designed exclusively for them. This ruler is no exception—serving as both precision instrument in the girl's capable hands and dependable weapon upon the battlefield.

In its extended form, it serves for measurement and drafting work. When adjusted to a specific angle, it can be thrown like a boomerang for ranged attacks. In close combat, it can be swiftly disassembled and reassembled into a spear. A single tool with many uses—ingeniously and elegantly designed.""

322755157.m_KeyValue:
""In Ironfist, Genevieve wore a dagger pinned to her chest. In the final moments of our escape, she handed it to me. Only upon closer inspection did I realize—this dagger was a miniature version of the sword that had been my faithful companion through countless battles across the years.

At that time, I had no idea that within this slender steel lay the fervent prayers of every soul in the Carrelle family, intertwined with the unyielding creed that Genevieve and I had forged—to reverse the Calamity.""

323389920.m_KeyValue: "But the fact that you can still correspond with me proves that the little boy didn't perish alongside the others."

323389921.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes your words manage to surprise even me. In all these long years, you remain the first person who can truly understand what lies on my mind.""

323389923.m_KeyValue: "The memories that await... they shall reveal the answers you seek..."

324387389.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, I got your note. What do you need help with?""

324603127.m_KeyValue: ""My goodness, could this be that magical connection they're always going on about in romance novels?""
