325831059.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer asking for help from a _$$heretic_$$?"

325941038.m_KeyValue: ""It wasn't really about alchemy back then. I was just an eight-year-old kid, struggling to survive.""

326046797.m_KeyValue: "Let's hear about that insomnia of yours."

326104736.m_KeyValue: ""The trio crested the hill, venturing into a birch forest. A spectral mist coiled between the trees, swirling around the long-awaited visitors like curious, ghostly tendrils.""

326104737.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, seemingly accustomed to their antics, observed, 'The Eye of God mentioned on the linen must be this place. Now, where could this key lead us?'""

326104738.m_KeyValue: ""As night fell, the trio sought refuge in the cabin from the lake's chilling wind. In the fireplace, branches crackled and popped to ward off the cold.""

326104739.m_KeyValue: ""'To my dear Nikola, One day, we shall meet again through death. Your friend, Leonardo Ptolemy.'""

326104740.m_KeyValue: "'I think we've uncovered all the secrets we can here. Let's get some sleep now. We've still got tasks to finish tomorrow.'"

326107999.m_KeyValue: ""'Huh…? You're looking at the owner, meow!' The cat sat up straight and began tidying the Tarot cards it had been using as a blanket. 'Welcome to Jacintha's Divination Night!'""

326108000.m_KeyValue: ""'It's just a crystal ball. No need for alarm.' With a flick of Joan's spear tip, the ball that had rolled into Theophane's foot bounced cleanly off the ground and landed squarely in Joan's hand.""

326108001.m_KeyValue: ""The cat stretched with a soft yawn, slipping from its bed. 'Guess it's time to work, meow.' It pried open the massive storage cabinet nearby with a paw, vanishing inside and soft rustling can be heard.""

326108003.m_KeyValue: ""'…Fine then. Count that as your win.' With that, the cat flopped back onto its cushion, looking thoroughly unmotivated.""

326108004.m_KeyValue: ""With those words, Joan tapped the table once with a single hand. One of the face-down Tarot cards bounced into the air, spun once, and landed neatly face-up. The card revealed—""

326108005.m_KeyValue: ""'Spoken like a true War Goddessr, meow.' It gestured toward the table with a tiny flourish of its paw. 'Then, please... you may begin meow.'""

326108006.m_KeyValue: ""Joan glanced toward Theophane. She didn't speak, but after years of working together, the message was clear: 'Did you catch that odd detail?'""

326108009.m_KeyValue: "'Anyone who tries to draw power from it risks being devoured by the Silver Blood within.' Joan clenched tightly while silver light pulsed faintly across the orb's surface."

326108010.m_KeyValue: ""'Being a little kitty is cute and all, but sometimes it's such a hassle.' Her gaze swept across the cards left scattered on the table. 'But...'""

326174432.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland shook his head in weary resignation. 'Captain, when exactly might you abandon this charming habit of speaking with your mouth full? Not everyone is fluent in Ami-speak, you know.'""

326174434.m_KeyValue: ""'My resolve is absolute! Those who dare oppose me shall suffer the same fate as...' Ami's hand moved instinctively as if to grab Jack and devour it—only to grasp empty air, the agonizing loss of her beloved food striking her once again.""

326174436.m_KeyValue: ""To discover what fate awaits them, please stay tuned for the next thrilling chapter—""

326174437.m_KeyValue: ""'But this is the world that bore us, that raised us from nothing! To surrender it to invaders without even drawing our swords...' Her voice rang with fierce conviction. 'Tell me—could you live with that shame?'""

326174438.m_KeyValue: ""And so this story comes to an end—wait, no, what's that?""

326175519.m_KeyValue: ""If becoming an Ascendant were really that easy, the Church wouldn't be breaking its back over it. Ease up on the reckless talk, Bell Ringer!""

326175521.m_KeyValue: "That's enough! Are these two telepathic?! Would it kill them to talk?"

326175522.m_KeyValue: ""'When you think about it, it doesn't quite add up. Maybe what's buried here isn't actually the remains of the Carrelle family?'""

326175523.m_KeyValue: ""'Heh...' Agares lets out a quiet chuckle. He raised a hand and curled a single finger. Instantly, the flame softened its intensity, curling around his fingertip like a tamed pet.""

326175524.m_KeyValue: ""'Who knows? Doesn't matter.' With that, Agares casually flung the stone over his shoulder.""

326175526.m_KeyValue: ""'Even when forced into that card match, Agares chose to skip his own turn just to avoid the hassle.'""

326175527.m_KeyValue: "Mass looked at Noah and remained silent for a long while."

326175528.m_KeyValue: ""'What is this place to you?' Noah looked toward Mass, who was still tracing the gravestone. 'Didn't you agree this might not even belong to the Carrelle family?'""

326176610.m_KeyValue: ""Dear heavens, our Bell Ringer appeared to be making a gesture of Covenant. Perhaps I should excuse myself.""

326176611.m_KeyValue: ""'Did your heart just skip a beat? Are you alright?' Acappella pressed her forehead to Darcias's, her voice full of concern.""

326176612.m_KeyValue: ""'I think they are dancing... Be quiet, let's hear what they're saying.'""

326176614.m_KeyValue: ""'Aaagh!' Acappella made a face at the mud monster on the ground, mimicking its greeting.""

326176618.m_KeyValue: ""'Dar-dar-ci-ci-as-as, Hap-hap-py-py birth-birth-day-day!' Acappella finished her dance, striking an odd pose and blinking at Darcias.""

326231219.m_KeyValue: ""Some doors can only be used in one direction. Once you've crossed through, there's no going back.""

326248479.m_KeyValue: "'It was the year before your father became clan leader. I'd asked for his help in eliminating a group of vampires.'"

326248481.m_KeyValue: ""The two children fell silent, finishing their meals without another word.""

326248484.m_KeyValue: ""The duel had driven them to the edge of the sea. Clive nearly stumbled over the slippery rocks several times. As defeat loomed, the young warrior finally began to regain his composure.""

326248485.m_KeyValue: ""'What?' Gadric looked at Clive, then at Hati, his face likely bewildered behind the helmet. 'Is there even such a thing as falling on purpose?'""

326248486.m_KeyValue: ""Feeling for her brother, Hati sought to console him. 'I've heard the Roland family, the Horse, has raised many fierce knights, and the warriors of the Lion, the Griffiths, are no less powerful.'""

326251746.m_KeyValue: "'The battle had descended into hand-to-hand combat atop the tower. A mere three defenders were locked in brutal melee against two hundred Bloodborn.'"

326251747.m_KeyValue: ""'Surprisingly, when the Ganelon lands faced a food crisis some time later, it was the Bathorys who came to their aid.'""

326251748.m_KeyValue: ""'Wow, I had no idea the tower had such an incredible history!' Hati exclaimed, her eyes wide with amazement.""

326251749.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh come on, what are you two bickering about now?' Jestel called out as she made her way up to join them. 'Empousa, weren't we supposed to be here to enjoy the sea view?'""

326277887.m_KeyValue: "'<style="Highlight">Noah</style>...?' Stella tilts her head in thought. 'I despise this notion of being defined by others.'"

326277889.m_KeyValue: ""'If I remember correctly, the Other Side I come from isn't <color=#bc544b>yyf</color>, but rather...'""

326277890.m_KeyValue: ""'Well... perhaps not too serious. After all, it is only a legend—unworthy even of a mention in Minexus: A Brief History_ (8th Edition).'""

326277892.m_KeyValue: "Such rumors—clearly even less credible than Minexus: A Brief History (8th Edition)—can never sway her heart."

326277893.m_KeyValue: """"So that leaves the women in Noah's orbit as...""""

326277894.m_KeyValue: ""'No sunlight!' Letitia lets out a heavy sigh and closes her eyes, as if the very thought is unbearable.""

326277896.m_KeyValue: ""'You will, as long as you keep moving forward. One day, you will encounter <color=#bc544b>her</color>, and in that first moment when your eyes meet, you will know beyond all doubt that <color=#bc544b>she</color> is your—'""

326280063.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh? So you speak for the Church now?' Cain asked, his voice laced with skepticism.""

326280064.m_KeyValue: ""'Cain,' the black-haired man introduced. 'Steward of the Bathory family.'""

326280065.m_KeyValue: ""'The only advantage is all these new shortcuts,' Isaac quipped as they climbed over a collapsed wall.""

326280069.m_KeyValue: ""'Later, his son passed away—an old man in his bed, yet his body withered to that of an infant.'""

326280070.m_KeyValue: ""'The architect of this sacred edifice,' Cain mused, his gaze drawn to the vaulted ceilings that once resounded with fervent supplications, 'was a distant progenitor of the Bathory lineage, a paragon of unwavering faith.'""

326281024.m_KeyValue: "(Pfft. How old are you to still be using excuses like that? It's killing me!)"

326281025.m_KeyValue: "'Ughhh! Why isn't Darcias here at a time like this!'"

326281026.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously, what is it? Some kind of outfit only Bell Ringers can see!?""

326281027.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, so that's what this is—a brand-new type of card game… If it's a battle of imagination, then a bard has nothing to fear!""

326281028.m_KeyValue: ""With a dramatic flourish, Acappella drew a card from the top of the (Bell Ringer–only) deck. 'My turn! I summon you—Silvershade Requiem!'""

326281029.m_KeyValue: ""So that's it… Agares truly have the skill of a Bell Ringer. ...Though between us, is that really a strategy? Or was he just trying to sneak in a nap?""

326281030.m_KeyValue: "Wait—she can form a Covenant too!? What is this game!? A Bell Ringer war simulation disguised as a card battle!?"

326281031.m_KeyValue: "'I sacrifice six cards… in exchange for skipping the next three turns.'"

326281032.m_KeyValue: ""You brought that on yourself.' Of the three, only Thibault remained composed—perhaps because she was a doctor to begin with. 'If you'd just burned those strange plants from the start…'""

326319263.m_KeyValue: ""_$$You must understand... lambs grow their precious fleece on the shortest day of the year, when winter's chill is at its sharpest. It falls away just as the summer sun reaches its peak..._$$""

326319264.m_KeyValue: "Friedrich grabbed the edge of his armor and gave it a hard yank. A large chunk of thick wool lining came off in his hands. _$$We might run into enemies ahead. Armor this bulky will only slow me down._$$"

326319265.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, swept up in the chaos of battle, heard the desperate cry of another version of herself echoing from afar: _$$No! The Covenant is still too early for you now..._$$""

326319266.m_KeyValue: ""Certain he had cracked the case, Gilrain drew his sword in one smooth motion. Steel whispered through the air as he leveled the blade at their supposed foe. _$$Surrender now, Joyce Gadric!_$$""

326319267.m_KeyValue: ""As tensions rose between the two, Aiona quickly stepped in. _$$You two..._$$""

326319269.m_KeyValue: "_$$Hmm? Why are you two leaving without me? Wait up!_$$"

326319270.m_KeyValue: "_$$Mm... and I'm truly grateful for that beautiful dress Friedrich gave me as well..._$$"

326319275.m_KeyValue: ""While her other self remained rooted, Aiona lifted the delicate Acorellia lamb wool shawl—light and warm to the touch—and wrapped it around her shoulders. _$$Happy Birthday, Aiona._$$""

326319276.m_KeyValue: ""_$$So... I've been found out._$$ Aiona smiled faintly, snow-white hair drifting like gossamer silk. _$$For you as you are now..._$$""

326320351.m_KeyValue: ""'In this realm of perpetual snow, even plants struggle to survive.' With that, Yggdrasill rose, pushed open the door, and walked out into the frosty air.""

326320353.m_KeyValue: ""'Once the blizzard subsided, the six of them returned to the city to restock. Then they went back to the waystation, dismantled it, and hauled the materials further out to construct a second waystation.'""

326320354.m_KeyValue: ""'This explains why this waystation was built on such an open area, devoid of any natural shelter like trees.'""

326320355.m_KeyValue: ""'Humans will always do what is necessary for survival, even if those very actions might lead to their demise.'""

326320356.m_KeyValue: ""Poor Yggdrasill resorted to fanning his disciple with his branches, hoping to cool down her flaring temper.""

326320358.m_KeyValue: ""'Because it has just unfurled its wings, yet hasn't savored the joy of free flight. Its life is so fleeting...' Edina replied, a tinge of sorrow in her voice.""

326351936.m_KeyValue: ""From atop the hill where the mill stood, Hati gazed out over the vast wheat fields blanketing the land. These were once meticulously tended grounds, now a testament to bygone care.""

326351939.m_KeyValue: ""'What? A town this size with just one mill?!' Empousa gasped, her eyes wide with astonishment.""

326351941.m_KeyValue: ""'Then, after the wheat had ripened, the Bathory family helped transform this mill. It was originally just a modest hut on a steep slope, but look at it now.'""

326351942.m_KeyValue: ""'That's how the Ganelon family survived that winter. Afterward, they began cultivating crops on their own land.' Hati turned her gaze towards Empousa.""

326357247.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, next time there's thunder, could I borrow those gloves? I want to try challenging the highest power too. Maybe it'll help me get over my fear of thunder and lightning.'""

326357249.m_KeyValue: "'Oh!' Hati suddenly burst out. 'I almost forgot why we came up here in the first place!'"

326357250.m_KeyValue: ""Hati fidgeted nervously. 'B-Because on the day I got the gloves, I was walking under this mill when crashes of thunder suddenly filled the sky. I got spooked and accidentally threw the gloves up into the air.'""

326357251.m_KeyValue: ""Thinking quickly, Empousa transformed into a bat and flew to the roof while Ressa climbed onto Hati's shoulders to deliver a rope to the top.""

326357252.m_KeyValue: ""'Furthermore, he became an extraordinary architect during his long life. The observatory in the castle was his masterpiece.'""

326357254.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa pouted. 'Ressa, that sounds like you're trying to refuse without actually saying no.'""

326423807.m_KeyValue: ""Before Agares could finish, Hati and Ami instantly caught on. The three exchanged glances, the kind of understanding that only comes from living together for fifty years.""

326423808.m_KeyValue: ""'Hold on, have you noticed something...' Noah furrowed his brows, scanning everyone with a serious expression.""

326423809.m_KeyValue: ""'No, that was merely an unfounded rumor.'""

326423810.m_KeyValue: "'Shouldn't we be more concerned about Ami's winning conditions?' Noah rubbed his forehead with a sigh. 'Though I suppose Hati does have a point—this wouldn't be fair either way.'"

326423811.m_KeyValue: "But the rest of Noah's words went unheard—the others were already absorbed in plotting how to secure the first turn in the hot spring."

326423812.m_KeyValue: ""Agares rose from the pool, wincing as he held his back—ah, so that was what Hati had crashed into...""

326423813.m_KeyValue: ""'Wow! I heard the Ethereal Springs was an island shrouded in mist,' Hati exclaimed excitedly, dashing through the thin fog. 'But seeing it in person—AAAH!'""

326424767.m_KeyValue: ""'So all that meaningless splashing from earlier was just you dissolving mercury into the spring, wasn't it?' She gave the already-unconscious Gadric a casual prod as she spoke.""

326424768.m_KeyValue: ""'Mercury alone couldn't dissolve a human body, could it?' Darcias stared pensively at the hollow shell of armor.""

326424769.m_KeyValue: ""'That's Gadric’s voice. Over there.' Realizing something, Darcias sprang from the spring in a sudden leap, scattering fine droplets into the humid mist.""

326424770.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias turned to Nicole, who stood not far behind. 'You control mercury. Did you sense anything?'""

326424772.m_KeyValue: ""'Gadric, why do you wear your helmet even in the hot springs?'""

326424773.m_KeyValue: ""'Hahahaha!' His joy intensified, becoming almost... unsettling.""

326424779.m_KeyValue: "'Not so fast. Look over there.' She pointed toward the base of a tree. 'Looks like some kind of alchemical sound-replication device.'"

326495687.m_KeyValue: ""'Now, let the spectacle commence!' With a flourish, Goldland inverted the hourglass and set it on the ground. His voice rang out with theatrical grandeur, 'I hereby declare the greatest fishing competition in all of Minexus—'""

326495689.m_KeyValue: ""'I think what Noah's been trying to say is that Goldland forgot his fishing rod,' Cain said, with a half-smirk at Van Helsing as he casually pointed to the ground nearby.""

326495690.m_KeyValue: "'Huh? What's...' Noah stared puzzled in Goldland's direction."

326495691.m_KeyValue: ""'But you're missing one crucial detail—you don't know how to activate the pearl!' As he spoke, Goldland suddenly lunged forward, his hand reaching out to snatch the golden hourglass.""

326495692.m_KeyValue: ""Meanwhile, in a ramshackle house somewhere in the fishing village...""

326495693.m_KeyValue: ""'Next time we're back here, how about a friendly fishing competition?' The four exchanged warm smiles, their eyes twinkling with a newfound camaraderie—kindred spirits recognizing the worth in one another.""

326495694.m_KeyValue: ""'Would you all just stop? There's no pearl inside me...' His words left everyone stunned. Seizing this chance, Noah pressed on, 'Why did you all come to participate in this competition in the first place?'""

326497857.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia clenched her fists, barely containing her anger as she turned toward the court. 'Empousa, come on. Let's get this over with.'""

326497858.m_KeyValue: ""'That's right, the third touch is actually for 'attacking.'' Lamia held up two fingers. 'The first two touches are for defense and positioning the ball, while the last one...'""

326497863.m_KeyValue: ""'...Hmph, I'm not wasting my breath on you!' Empousa put her hands on her hips. 'Church choir? You're nothing but the Church's weapons. No matter how you dress it up, enemies are enemies.'""

326497864.m_KeyValue: ""'As sharp as ever, Commander... And here I thought retirement might have dulled your senses a bit.'""

326497865.m_KeyValue: ""'What nonsense are you talking about, you dummy Empousa? Nobody's forcing you to come. You're the one who insisted—'""

326497868.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph hmph, that's my 'air' power!' Acappella crossed her arms proudly. 'I'm impressed you noticed that. Perhaps you Bathorys aren't completely hopeless after all.'""

326497870.m_KeyValue: ""'The Bathory family and the Church are allies, at least on the surface...' Tris calmly explained the situation to Empousa. 'You wouldn't want to destroy that facade, would you?'""

326500999.m_KeyValue: "'Forget it. What's done is done.' But just as Agares assumed Noah had resigned himself to floating there in quiet defeat—"

326501002.m_KeyValue: "Like the color of the sky tonight."

326501003.m_KeyValue: "Noah shook his head… then gave a slight nod. 'It was all right.'"

326501006.m_KeyValue: ""The man emerged with muscle lines as sharp as reef stone and a gaze like chiseled iron. It was as if he hadn't joined a race, but descended into some solemn rite of battle.""

326503171.m_KeyValue: ""'Aaah—' Empousa covered her nose indignantly, glaring up at the seabird.""

326503172.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah... a debt note for 38 million Soli?' Tris said with an amused clap. 'That's nothing to worry about, because there's some fine print on the back that's easy to miss...'""

326503175.m_KeyValue: ""'But if we force another attack, that little brat will just block it again...!' Empousa glared through the net at Acappella, who met her gaze with a playful grimace.""

326503176.m_KeyValue: ""'And here I thought I wouldn't need to step in again... Acappella, you really underestimated your opponents.' With a wave of her hand, Tris instantly severed one of the vines.""

326503178.m_KeyValue: "'Curse the Church...' Empousa glared at the fish-skin ball on the ground. 'They were just toying with us the whole time... they weren't even fighting at full strength!'"

326503180.m_KeyValue: ""'Wow, the Bathory folks are pretty impressive, huh?' Acappella shielded her eyes with one hand as she gazed excitedly skyward, as if she were merely a spectator to the match.""

326503181.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, you dummy Empousa! Don't fall for their trap so easily!'""

326503182.m_KeyValue: ""'Now's our chance!' Lamia seized the moment, using the vine net as a springboard to leap high into the air. Positioning herself above and at an angle to the ball, she whirled her right leg around for a devastating roundhouse kick—""

326757425.m_KeyValue: "Clear [A Familiar Spark] <color=#a65f30>N 2-2</color>: The End of the Road"

326757851.m_KeyValue: "Clear [Sapphire Isle] <color=#a65f30>N 1-4</color>: In the Name of Bell Ringers..."

326879968.m_KeyValue: "But don't worry. I'll teach you how to please me... One step at a time. Hand in hand."

326879969.m_KeyValue: ""With my own two hands, of course.""

326879970.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder you can't sleep, with all these weird thoughts running through your head.""

326879971.m_KeyValue: "Why don't you put those hands to better use and brew yourself some sleeping medicine?"

326879973.m_KeyValue: ""But the more you resist, the more I want to play with you... hehehe...""

327531180.m_KeyValue: ""Agares summons a Sun Cross that continuously channels to call down a meteor, dealing massive DMG. Destroying the Sun Cross prevents the meteor from falling.""

327555876.m_KeyValue: ""When Firstborn Sheila uses her Ultimate, eliminate as many Plague Hatchlings as possible. Use healing and purification to counter increasing Pestilence effects.""

329014731.m_KeyValue: "Do you also believe gold to be the most radiant hue?"

329014890.m_KeyValue: "I shall illuminate for you the path to the Light."

329020387.m_KeyValue: ""What, you don't look like much at all. Why in the world...""

329020418.m_KeyValue: "How rude. I should teach you some manners."

329022561.m_KeyValue: "Is it my turn to shine? Allow me to solve all your problems!"

329022592.m_KeyValue: "Ah! Don't sneak up on me like that. I might hurt you."

329023427.m_KeyValue: "The duty of a torch is to burn itself and illuminate the dark ages... I'm just kidding."

329024766.m_KeyValue: "Curiosity may be the death of you."

329025601.m_KeyValue: "I am accustomed to dwelling in the shadows. There is no need for you to feel perplexed."

329025760.m_KeyValue: "Have you also come to enjoy the night's serenity?"

329026909.m_KeyValue: "Ever ready to slay those who defy order."

329027934.m_KeyValue: "I don't recall calling you... But it seems you have no intention of leaving."

329029949.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... Feeling a bit playful, are we?""

329030108.m_KeyValue: ""Come quickly, it's time for prayer. We mustn't keep the Lord waiting.""

329051179.m_KeyValue: "At last! Something we can use! These might actually help everyone..."

329396660.m_KeyValue: ""So that's why you were so surprised when you first saw me, but remained calm when you saw the phantoms.""

329396661.m_KeyValue: ""The village you mentioned before, it's in this direction, right?""

329396662.m_KeyValue: "The tenth Bell Ringer at the time...?"

329396663.m_KeyValue: "It appears that the families guarding the Divine Body each have their own different convictions and levels of resolve."

329396665.m_KeyValue: ""Because... seven days ago, Death broke free from the Church's territories...""

329396666.m_KeyValue: "You must wake up! We made a promise..."

329396667.m_KeyValue: ""It's the demon that destroyed your family and this island! You didn't come back just to offer up your life, did you?!""

329396693.m_KeyValue: "No... it's not that easy. We were fooled. What we saw wasn't Death's true form."

329396695.m_KeyValue: "Did he... turn into a Blood Beast?"

329396696.m_KeyValue: ""Just let me handle it. You're afraid of beasts, right?""

329396957.m_KeyValue: "Did the waves wash me ashore? And Ami... could she be nearby?"

329396958.m_KeyValue: ""They just came from that direction. If I follow the beach, I might find more survivors.""

329396988.m_KeyValue: ""Anyway, how's your leg? Does it still hurt? I could carry you on my back...""

329396989.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I'll take care of these old friends of mine. We can have a long chat after.""

329396991.m_KeyValue: ""It's as if the sun is constantly watching me, hanging motionless at the edge of the sky, just out of reach.""

329397020.m_KeyValue: "They followed us all the way here?"

329397021.m_KeyValue: ""Not exactly. You were raised somewhere else, but me, I lost my mem—I mean, I can't remember much about my past.""

329397053.m_KeyValue: "Of course... Why would you ask that?"

329397057.m_KeyValue: "This thing is a little heavy. I just need a moment to catch my breath..."

329397058.m_KeyValue: "Bring back Dr. Ressa! Bring back our families!"

329397084.m_KeyValue: "These creatures... they're not Blood Beasts at all."

329397088.m_KeyValue: "Listen to yourself. How many Bell Ringers do you know need a bodyguard?"

329397089.m_KeyValue: ""Even though we, the Choir, were the ones who captured him on this very island 66 years ago, he still remains a thorn in my side.""

329397091.m_KeyValue: ""Hey now, little ones, it's not polite to eavesdrop.""

329397119.m_KeyValue: "I miss her... and just want to see her again?"

329397121.m_KeyValue: ""You stole our sun, our only hope.""

329397122.m_KeyValue: "...You know she passed away many years ago."

329397123.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not doubting you, Piera. I'm just wondering if it's possible... that we're not seeing the same people?""

329397148.m_KeyValue: ""It's people's longings... Grandmother said that due to the influence of the Divine Body somewhere on Sunset Isle, these phantoms of longing often materialize into physical form.""

329397149.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother... never told me about them either. What do you think, Noah... Where do you think they could be?""

329397150.m_KeyValue: ""Because... I've finally been able to get everything off my chest, and there's even someone to listen to me.""

329397151.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, to thank you for helping me, I'll tell you what I know of the Calamity from my grandmother and family members.""

329397152.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally you'd know, Noah... Yes... it's to guard the Calamity sealed on this island.""

329397153.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I've lost the past I can't remember, I still have the present with them. I will never abandon these companions who've walked this road with me.""

329397154.m_KeyValue: "But... but I wasn't lying. It really is my first time here... Even though... this is my hometown..."

329397155.m_KeyValue: "So it was your grandmother who told you about this island?"

329602130.m_KeyValue: ""Or, after walking this fated journey of yours, do you even know who you are?""

329602131.m_KeyValue: "Kris? ...Goldland? Are they calling out to... me?"

329602132.m_KeyValue: ""The prophecy fulfilled. The Long Night returns, the First Scourge awakens. Then we gather the other eight...""

329602133.m_KeyValue: "I have no interest in your war. I have my own goal—I will save Lamia as well."

329602134.m_KeyValue: ""War spreads. Confusion deepens. The old world withers. And from its corpse, a new age shall rise.""

329602135.m_KeyValue: "But I believe you'll accept my offer..."

330632437.m_KeyValue: ""The one who asked it, of course.""

330632439.m_KeyValue: "When you don't know how to answer a question—where should you seek the solution?"

330632440.m_KeyValue: "Why are you so quick to believe that? You really think my entire world fits inside this tiny bottle?"

330632441.m_KeyValue: "The silver-haired one is right—yes. The other silver-haired one is wrong—no."

330633454.m_KeyValue: ""Captain, something's not right. I'm picking up four unknown signals nearby...""

330633455.m_KeyValue: ""In fact, she may well become our secret weapon.""

330633460.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Now that is fascinating... Perhaps the passage won’t tear her apart at all."

330633461.m_KeyValue: "But Regina—she's just an ordinary person! That passage could tear her apart—"

330633463.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I am! Take me with you—""

330633464.m_KeyValue: ""No need for concern. What I achieved there, I can replicate here—this passage will carry them through safely.""

330886019.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Strong. The carrier stops and remains unable to cast Ultimate, Special (Active), Basic ATK, or move during the effect. Can be purified.""

330893576.m_KeyValue: "Reduces DMG taken from outside the Cocoon Barrier by 50%."

330910664.m_KeyValue: "Use me as bait to lure them into a rescue?"

331449505.m_KeyValue: ""Smashes to the ground {0} sec after the battle begins, dealing <link=""Tips_ID;4""><#508499><u>True DMG</u></color></link> to enemies in a circle equal to {1} of their Max HP and stunning them for {2} sec.""

332202316.m_KeyValue: "Tsk. He's getting harder to read by the minute."

332202318.m_KeyValue: "I can set out now—scout Twin Peaks myself. If we learn their true intent..."

332202319.m_KeyValue: ""They've taken the lance. If you pursue them now, you'll be walking straight into their trap.""

332421448.m_KeyValue: ""Since I kept my word and came, I ought to give you everything I've got.""

333620243.m_KeyValue: ""One of the maiden's copies, and bearer of the last pass to the outside realm for No. 79. In order to shed the shackles of a caged bird, she has no choice but to fight with her friend.""

333620246.m_KeyValue: ""One of the Bathory's surviving Elders, also the youngest. He seems to have some connection to the Cidhall family.""

334437792.m_KeyValue: ""'I think the Carrelle family, the 'Eagle,' deserves a seat on the Elder Council,' Bella suggested. 'They're practical, and their archery skills are invaluable on the battlefield. They've earned it.'""

334473184.m_KeyValue: "Your journey still has so much brilliance to come. Keep moving forward."

334473281.m_KeyValue: "The tombstone you raised for me is my passage to freedom."

335891540.m_KeyValue: ""Still, every time they show up, it's when you're unconscious. That might have something to do with it.""

335891541.m_KeyValue: ""Eek—! How did you know... Wait, there's no one behind me!""

335891542.m_KeyValue: ""But if they've helped me out of trouble twice already, why won't they just let me meet them?""

335891544.m_KeyValue: ""If I pretend to faint when I meet them, then I can see who's been saving me, right? I'll go prepare right away!""

335891546.m_KeyValue: "Those alchemists won't give up so easily on the mushrooms in the forbidden grounds."

335891547.m_KeyValue: ""Unconscious... but I can't exactly knock myself out, can I?""

337005652.m_KeyValue: "Doesn't sound like much of a prize."

337005653.m_KeyValue: ""Back then, I thought earning a surname meant I could stand by that young princess's side. In the end, it was just another deception.""

337005654.m_KeyValue: "Freedom is worth more than money. But I never expected this surname would be the beginning of yet another deception."

337005655.m_KeyValue: "The rest is up to you to discover. Don't forget to let me know if you find out what happened to the earring."

337005657.m_KeyValue: ""Haven't you seen that memory yet? Most slaves kept by the Carrelle family were sent to the arena to fight to the death, entertaining nobles who thirst for thrill.""

337005658.m_KeyValue: "The losers had only one fate—I'm sure you can guess what that was. As for the slave who emerged victorious... their prize was being granted a surname."

337486417.m_KeyValue: "It looks like an ordinary conch shell..."

337558159.m_KeyValue: "So to Agares—to 'your people'—you revealed only the name Mass."

339140357.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that this Celestial God has eyes capable of perceiving cause and effect. The left eye looks into past, while the right eye sees into the future. This unique ability has helped the celestial realm avoid a great many disasters. Those under its protection can navigate steadily through the waves of causality, gaining insight into the order and balance of the universe.""

339329588.m_KeyValue: ""Even in wastelands, unexpected treasures may be unearthed.""

339329589.m_KeyValue: "Joan's hand is bleeding. Her wound has torn open again!"

339329591.m_KeyValue: ""Such a naïve child, blissfully unaware, kept safe by others.""

339329592.m_KeyValue: "It seems mankind are universally drawn to the spectacle of mutual destruction."

339329594.m_KeyValue: "Who said I'm worried about you? I'll be the one washing these sheets!"

340153885.m_KeyValue: "_$$Minexus: A Brief History_$$... what's that? I don't think I've ever heard of it."

342074577.m_KeyValue: "I've heard the stories. Thought you'd be something impressive. And yet here you are—rotting in a hole?"

342074578.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, my lady. I won't be able to keep our promise to stay alive.""

342074579.m_KeyValue: "Wait... what's that smell? Burning meat... No—burning flesh..."

342074580.m_KeyValue: "Some of us even get promoted to castle guards! Imagine that!"

342074581.m_KeyValue: "The last time... a sea of fire took away my light..."

342772778.m_KeyValue:
""Clovis had never seen waves that high...
In a single night, once-familiar elders had grown siren traits and begun tearing into their own kin.
'The Church will come. When they do, things will return to normal.'
That's what Clovis told Isaac and himself. The moon hung cold and pale overhead. Would morning ever come?
Far across the ink-black sea, where the sun would rise, a silhouette stirred.
The Church's Bell Ringer had arrived. The Isle could be saved!
But with a snap of their fingers, the Bell Ringer summoned a flood from the heavens, drowning homes and fleeing villagers alike.
'No… The Church… they've come to purge us…'
'They're... they're here!'
'Run, Isaac... run!'""

342986931.m_KeyValue: "Top-up disabled due to security concerns about this IP address."

342986963.m_KeyValue: "Blood Moon Rising: Blood Hunt Rewards Claimed"

343363033.m_KeyValue: "The Tempus Church trains its soldiers well. Punctual to a fault. Should I applaud your devotion to Aeon?"

343363034.m_KeyValue: ""These wounds weren't made by Blood Beasts... These were clean, deliberate strikes. The killer was no amateur.""

343363035.m_KeyValue: "You young ones really don't know a thing. Starfall Valley's changed."

343363036.m_KeyValue: "Are you two the only ones stationed here tonight? Where's the rest of the watch stationed at?"

343366233.m_KeyValue: ""The third time, my humanity died with the old era.""

343366234.m_KeyValue: "We're not the only ones who yearn for freedom and justice."

343366235.m_KeyValue: "Promise me you'll stay alive and become stronger. I need you by my side as my personal guard!"

343366236.m_KeyValue: "Sixty years—I broke the seal of the Divine Body."

343932391.m_KeyValue: ""I understand it's hard to accept this sudden change, but this Pure Blood Essence is vital to restoring your strength so you can live on.""

343932392.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, the Silver-haired Heretic...! And that witch, and... Oh? Someone unfamiliar, but seemingly unreliable.""

344311784.m_KeyValue: ""I knew this plan was too risky! Now he's already suspicious of you, and...""

344311785.m_KeyValue: "It's coming from next door... Isn't that the resting cabin for that armored fool who got humiliated by lifeless eyes? Is he already awake?"

344311788.m_KeyValue: ""She hasn't slept at all since we left that place... Have some sweet dreams, you silly wolf.""

344311791.m_KeyValue: "I never realized how hard it is to take care of someone... I should have let Aiona watch over her. I'll go find her now."

344311792.m_KeyValue: "There's something I need to confirm—and I hope you'll help."

344311793.m_KeyValue: ""No, wait. Even though you're no longer our prime suspect, I still need you to stay here.""

344672588.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—besides being silver-haired, what other features did he have? I might've met him before!""

344672589.m_KeyValue: "I already tried lifting it—couldn't even get it off the ground."

345167887.m_KeyValue: "In-battle Bloodsoul recovery rate is fixed and unaffected by the number of deployed Vassals."

346034035.m_KeyValue: "A being that no longer belongs to our world."

346706155.m_KeyValue: ""'We'll just wait for the Bathory family to finish collecting all those troublesome debts, then hit them with a 125% 'debt transfer tax'.'""

348134339.m_KeyValue:
""Someone carelessly left their ledger at the inn. A quick peek now—surely no one will notice:

'It's been a while since I last attended the assassins' gathering. Had to spend a fortune to get information about Master Van Helsing's whereabouts. But why is Brandy, who sold me the information, also here at Sapphire Isle? They even tried to convince me to leave Master Van Helsing's side—was I deceived? Today's debt: 200,000,000 Soli. Master Van Helsing always says that many things are priceless. He'll surely approve of how decisively I spent money where it matters!'

No, I'm quite certain Van Helsing wouldn't approve at all.""

348134498.m_KeyValue: ""The dream of turning Sapphire Isle into a land of joy has fractured. Lorelei bid her final farewell to this world, leaving behind nothing but a tainted name and a broken Siren's Tear. In the Sage's office, her personal belongings had been completely cleared away. I saw how she had spent a fortune in the auction house, we exchanged thoughts about the Mistbound Terror, and we hatched our last plan together. Yet that brilliant woman vanished without a trace, as if she too had been nothing more than an illusion woven by the devices on Sapphire Isle.""

348134711.m_KeyValue:
""A weathered metal saddle acquired from a marketplace vendor, its patches of rust concealing the ancient engravings etched beneath.

The traveling merchant claimed he had discovered it among the ruins of an ancient battlefield near Ganelon territory, hoping to turn a handsome profit from his find.

Clearly, he had no inkling that the heraldic crest bore the marks of both Bathory and Aegis. Had he known, he never would have dared hawk such a relic in broad daylight, lest the Silver Cross come calling in the shadows of night.

Once the truth dawned upon him, terror seized him. He thrust the saddle into my hands for a mere 1 Soli and hastily began gathering his wares.""

348904981.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, even in this realm, the act of wishing upon a shooting star remains nothing more than superstition.""

348904983.m_KeyValue: ""'Back then, King Johan the Red claimed it was the divine guidance of shooting stars that led his army eastward, rendering him invincible...' Well, it seems we overestimated Empousa's ability to lighten the mood.""

348904984.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, of course, couldn't accept this view. 'How can two people finding true love be a disaster?' she protested.""

348904986.m_KeyValue: "'Aren't you joining us in the search for the Moonblessed?' Noah suddenly realized this would also mark a moment of separation."

351348559.m_KeyValue: "I thought you'd storm the castle and never let me off."

352408313.m_KeyValue: "Should I be relieved? I was right. It stopped attacking the El Dorado and came after me instead."

352408314.m_KeyValue: "But why me? Why would the Formless target me?"

352408315.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you beep faster, I still can't understand you...""

352408316.m_KeyValue: ""But anything that doesn't look like you must be an enemy, right?""

352408317.m_KeyValue: "Are you trying to warn me that enemies are coming?"

352408318.m_KeyValue: "Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep—!"

352408328.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier... you were trying to warn me about the Formless, weren't you?""

352410497.m_KeyValue: ""So even these constructs, fleshless as they are, aren't so different from the Blood Beasts.""

352410499.m_KeyValue: ""People. Life. Even the universe. Strip away their form, and maybe what remains... is the same.""

352410500.m_KeyValue: "So what you're saying is we don't need to stop the Mastermind?"

352410501.m_KeyValue: "On the contrary. What happens to humanity is irrelevant to everyone but me."

352410503.m_KeyValue: "Come. Let's find the Mastermind. I believe I know how to deal with it."

352410504.m_KeyValue: "And how exactly are we supposed to track it down?"

352411514.m_KeyValue: "Either way—I'm not letting you face this alone!"

352411515.m_KeyValue: "That's awful! You forgot? One day there is several years here!"

352411516.m_KeyValue: "We've known each other for less than a day."

352411517.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if I'm ordinary. First and foremost, I'm your companion!""

352411518.m_KeyValue: ""Regina... I don't know how you even made it across, but you're just an ordinary person. If you get hurt because of me...""

352411519.m_KeyValue: "Those metal creatures looking for Noah—that was my doing. I have to take responsibility."

352411527.m_KeyValue: "What's your status?! We're barely holding the line!"

352411528.m_KeyValue: ""Well, that didn't take long... Regina, your safety comes first.""

352412673.m_KeyValue: "He wants to discover who created him—and this world."

352412674.m_KeyValue: ""You both probe at the mysteries of your respective universes—yet in the end, you discovered one another's existence.""

352412675.m_KeyValue: "Does every version of you fancy yourself a god? Apparently being Aeon's Bell Ringer isn't enough for you."

352412676.m_KeyValue: ""Creation is only a means—a way to trace our origins, to learn how our universe came to be.""

352412679.m_KeyValue: ""Please, don't phrase it so quaintly. View me as an alchemic scholar—""

352412680.m_KeyValue: ""—or better yet, as one who seeks the root truths of existence itself.""

352413699.m_KeyValue: "So you've reclaimed dominion over water—a legacy from your other-world self."

352413702.m_KeyValue: ""Then allow me to ignite these—a grand display, visible even from the other side.""

352413704.m_KeyValue: "What's that in the sky? It's so bright... and shimmering..."

352415867.m_KeyValue: "The Grand Alchemist... the one who died? Don't tell me—"

352415868.m_KeyValue: "(sighing) If only the Grand Alchemist were still with us... Perhaps then the Gates could've been sealed for good."

352415873.m_KeyValue: "That was also the day those constructs turned on humanity."

352415874.m_KeyValue: "That would make her rather old now."

352415875.m_KeyValue: ""She was the girl chosen to light the harvest bonfire at Asta's festival, nineteen years ago.""

352415877.m_KeyValue: ""Close it? What are you, a child? If that were possible, do you think the world would've come to this?""

352415878.m_KeyValue: "Then why don't we just close the Gates? Wouldn't that stop them?"

352415879.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... Whenever a rift opens, another place will vanish from existence.""

352415880.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, you said the Formless used those Gates to unleash those metal creatures—correct?""

352417024.m_KeyValue: "Ahem. I'm the captain. The welcoming speech should be mine to say."

352417025.m_KeyValue: ""What is this place? It looks like a ship, but... I don't hear any waves?""

352417027.m_KeyValue: "What about you? Are you feeling any better?"

352417028.m_KeyValue: "Much better than before... The dizziness is mostly gone. Wait—no!"

352417029.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, William—protect the lady. I'll check in with Captain Ami about our next move.""

352417030.m_KeyValue: ""Phew... Lucky there weren't many of them—and the Formless didn't appear. Otherwise, we'd be in real trouble.""

352417032.m_KeyValue: "Blast it! Those metal constructs found us!"

352418050.m_KeyValue: ""That distinction is meaningless to an alchemist. What matters isn't where he's from, but...""

352418053.m_KeyValue: ""If I can find what he left behind, I'll have everything I need to strike back.""

352418054.m_KeyValue: "The version of me fighting this world's constructs... He must've started his research long ago."

352418056.m_KeyValue: "You mean... the Albrecht from this world?"

353917783.m_KeyValue: "The strong devour the weak. Only the victors will be remembered."

353917814.m_KeyValue: "The secret to immortality... does it pique your interest?"

353920823.m_KeyValue: "Eek...! Does teasing me really bring you such joy? What a terrifying fetish."

353920982.m_KeyValue: ""Would you like to see my homeland, buried deep beneath the waves?""

353928653.m_KeyValue: "Just Ottavia will do. The rest is irrelevant."

353928684.m_KeyValue: ""I won't let you die for now, but this doesn't mean you're absolved.""

353929519.m_KeyValue: "Your hand... Could you keep holding mine a little longer? I fear I may lose my way..."

353930827.m_KeyValue: ""The inverse butterfly flutters its wings, bringing both clear skies and tumultuous storms...""

353930858.m_KeyValue: "It's the pain of the past that reminds me I'm still alive."

353931693.m_KeyValue: ""Peace nurtures the seeds of war, yet war, in turn, nurtures peace.""

353931852.m_KeyValue: ""I hope you can put up a fight, or it won't be any fun.""

353933001.m_KeyValue: ""All things in this world will eventually turn to dust, absorb the rain and dew, and sprout anew. That is life.""

353933032.m_KeyValue: ""Life has a beginning and an end, yet plants can endure eternally...""

354832447.m_KeyValue: "Since I'm not dead... there's no reason... to let the cat face danger alone..."

354832479.m_KeyValue: "Why is the street so empty... Where did everyone go?"

354832480.m_KeyValue: ""You've messed everything up again—Oh, you curse, you disaster, you despised vagabond—""

354832483.m_KeyValue: "Afraid to face the reality that you are—too weak and feeble!"

354832484.m_KeyValue: "That black thing over there... is it a sail?! A ship is passing by! We're saved!"

354832485.m_KeyValue: ""The sea's waves may toss us, but WE DON'T CARE!""

354832511.m_KeyValue: "They were kind to me. They are my friends too."

354832512.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you run away? Do you want... to help me... end this battle?"

354832516.m_KeyValue: ""That's our companion! Please lower a lifeboat, we'll go pick her up!""

354832518.m_KeyValue: "There's... no need to go back anymore..."

356123838.m_KeyValue: ""The divination guided us to find the red of blood, the gold of the sun, and the black of night. The Tarot cards drawn from these contain spiritual power.""

356123870.m_KeyValue: "No good! The beasts are catching up to us!"

356123871.m_KeyValue: ""'Tonight's 'Moon' has lost its radiance. When tomorrow's 'Sun' is at its peak, accompanied by three bell tolls, we shall set sail from the east, moving towards the rising sun.'""

356124134.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, divination is how Mother saved me.""

356124135.m_KeyValue: "I can't do divination for others because of... something that happened..."

356124137.m_KeyValue: "The departed will eventually return to dust..."

356124168.m_KeyValue: ""Men, are you going to let a girl and cat be in peril? Take up your weapons!""

356124234.m_KeyValue: ""Men, clean up the battlefield. The great Pontos II will set sail again tomorrow!""

356124235.m_KeyValue: "Don't lose heart. Let me find something to patch up the hole."

356124267.m_KeyValue: "The fate and future you speak of are all lies!"

356124268.m_KeyValue: "I... I want to believe the Captain's words."

356124269.m_KeyValue: ""You... you're the one Esmeralda mentioned, aren't you?""

356124297.m_KeyValue: ""So... if you really brought a message from the Captain, I would believe it.""

356124299.m_KeyValue: ""As long as we hold onto hope, there's still a chance to turn things around.""

356124300.m_KeyValue: ""...'Strength' is right there, but the one who possesses it turns a blind eye.""

356124333.m_KeyValue: "I'm not afraid... What happened in the past won't happen again..."

356514336.m_KeyValue: "'<style="Highlight">The archery stall owner</style> has new prizes in stock.'"

356588756.m_KeyValue: ""Did this fall from a construct? That doesn't make sense, though—all their components are tightly integrated. Nothing should just break loose.""

356588757.m_KeyValue: "Just look at this disaster! It didn't just topple every piece of merchandise I had—it dragged in half a block of leaves and grime! How in the world am I supposed to tackle all this alone?!"

357545653.m_KeyValue: ""Elder Bella? I apologize, but I don't recall spending that much.""

357549102.m_KeyValue: "Hand in Hand in Hand in Hand"

357794896.m_KeyValue: "There's no need for formality. Consider this place your refuge."

359191014.m_KeyValue: "This giant werewolf is your father?! He's... he's completely transformed!"

362307186.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... What's this sticky stuff on the ground?"

363411117.m_KeyValue: ""Three years new, three years old, and three years of mending worn holes; the wood caskets in the Timeworn Mausoleum endure, generation after generation.""

363414316.m_KeyValue: ""Three years new, three years old, and three years of mending worn holes; the wood caskets in the Timeworn Mausoleum endure, generation after generation.""

363724483.m_KeyValue: "These enemies just keep coming back... are they immortal?"

363724514.m_KeyValue: ""By consuming 4 Bloodsoul points, I'll show you the true power of Black Blood.""

365199478.m_KeyValue: ""Oh my! If it isn't our silver-haired friend! Sadly, the shop's closed for the day—you'll have to come earlier next time!""

365199479.m_KeyValue: ""We spent a fortune hiring Cain to dig into it, and found out Joyce was behind everything!""

365199481.m_KeyValue: "If it's not too much trouble… Would you mind staying the night? There's much I'd like to ask you."

366965190.m_KeyValue:
"The spider has lost curiosity due to exhaustion.
Continues walking down the road."

366965192.m_KeyValue: "The bells of a nearby church ring in an irregular rhythm. Should you check it out?"

366965193.m_KeyValue:
""Lucky! It's the Bell-Ringer Spider!
Received guidance from the mightiest of spiders, and speed has been further increased!""

366965222.m_KeyValue:
"'Acting is believing!'
Can machines possess belief? The answer doesn't matter."

366965223.m_KeyValue: "Your computer flashes a message: 'Do you have the courage to tread the path ahead?'"

368393415.m_KeyValue: "Wait... how are you going to fight with your eyes closed?!"

368531887.m_KeyValue:
""That Cid guy claimed he saw the moon during the day.
According to a book I read, the daytime moon is also known as _$$the far side of the moon._$$""

368531890.m_KeyValue: "Those lofty adjudicators never considered us from the beginning."

368531921.m_KeyValue:
""Severed limbs cannot escape any further.
Meanwhile, the uncontrollable rage inside has already eclipsed reason.
Or perhaps, I never truly possessed such a thing in the first place.""

368531951.m_KeyValue:
""_$$It wasn't a killer confessing her feelings._$$
_$$In the end, she simply fell in love with herself._$$""

368531952.m_KeyValue:
""In both physical prowess and intellect, I fell short compared to other copies.
Furthermore, I was not solely fixated on the concept of survival itself.""

368531953.m_KeyValue:
""_$$I tore myself apart, forming lines of another symbol.
I rewove them, only to become myself again._$$
Those emotions, forcibly closed yet unable to be locked away… they were so mad.""

368531983.m_KeyValue:
""Unforgivable rage sounds its horn beneath the moonlight.
The sole purpose of this journey is to drag everyone into the depths of hell.""

368531986.m_KeyValue:
""_$$You will never be the winner; you are more worthless than this corpse._$$
_$$It's a pity; only the chosen ones are given names, and you don't even qualify to compete._$$
His voice was like an enchanting melody, tempting one to fall into the abyss.
_$$Perhaps you have a different choice than hers._$$
_$$And that is—_$$""

368532019.m_KeyValue:
""Melancholy constantly loomed overhead.
I couldn't distinguish if despair bred negativity, or negativity nurtured lethargy.
I was weary, I was tired.
I didn't want to die—""

368532052.m_KeyValue:
""Once again, more blood was shed. They let their guard down during the day.
And after each slaughter, I would stand in front of the mirror, examining myself.""

368532053.m_KeyValue:
""Desire was once a skeleton lying at the bottom of the abyss.
Upon death's embrace, the skeleton sprouted flesh and bloomed once more inside the abyss.""

368532084.m_KeyValue:
""O, merciless god, wouldst thou retire into oblivion?
If _$$we_$$ were born of shadow, destined for darkness,
then let the crimson moon irradiate the night sky.
Let the world endure retribution.
—This is where my memory ceases.""

368532085.m_KeyValue:
""The emptiness within me continues to consume,
tearing a hole from the inside out, black sludge gushing from it...
I'm so hungry, starving, famished...
The more I focus and try to understand this feeling, the worse my hunger pangs.""

368851553.m_KeyValue: ""The anguished cries of survivors echo through the ancient stone halls. Letitia's instincts urge her to flee the fortress, to escape the darkness pressing in from all sides.""

368851556.m_KeyValue: "Your symptoms progress with remarkable slowness—this is no direct exposure to concentrated Black Blood."

368851557.m_KeyValue: ""Ryan, his body drenched in blood, struggles to crawl forth from the heap of corpses.""

369173838.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Gameplay Breakdown
<style=""InfoText"">• You can challenge Bosses of varying difficulties here.
• Difficulties unlock progressively. Nightmare Mode unlocks after clearing all Assaults in the Normal Mode.
• Boss DMG modifiers may vary across different stages.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Normal Mode
<style=""InfoText"">• Regular Assaults offer rewards upon completion.
• You can Assault Bosses of any difficulty 2 times daily, and each Assault includes 3 attempts.
• Boss HP will decrease with each Assault. Defeat the Boss before your attempts run out to carry out a successful Assault.
• If the Boss survives, the Assault fails, and your attempts will be reset.
• During these 3 attempts, Vassals can only be deployed once.
• A Boss's HP will be reset and all Vassals will be available again upon a successful, failed, or terminated Assault.
• Assaults reset daily.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Nightmare Mode
<style=""InfoText"">• A special mode where Boss HP is tuned extremely high. You will be ranked based on your highest DMG dealt in a single Assault.
• You can Assault a Boss 2 times daily, and each Assault includes 3 attempts. Consuming all attempts counts as a successful Assault.
• If a Boss is reset before all 3 attempts are used, the total DMG won't be recorded.
• Assaults in Nightmare Mode are separate from the Normal Mode, but both reset daily.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Trial Assault
<style=""InfoText"">• Trial Assault is available for all unlocked Difficulties at any time.
• DMG dealt in Trial Assault won't be recorded.
• Trial Assault will not use Assaults.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Assault
<style=""InfoText"">• Quick Assault will become available after any successful Assault in Normal Mode.
• Quick Assault will use Assaults.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rank
<style=""InfoText"">• Players will be ranked based on their highest Total DMG dealt to a Boss.
• When DMG is tied, the first player to reach this score will Rank higher.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rank Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Rewards will be sent based on your Rank at the end of the season.
• Rewards will be distributed via mail after season ends.""

370736282.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood has transformed William into a beast driven purely by desire. Timidity and self-doubt are stripped away. Ranna is beckoning to him — and there, where the claws of fear can never reach, lies only the promise of eternal peace.""

370762898.m_KeyValue: "You picked that up faster than I imagined."

370762899.m_KeyValue: "This way of reaching me... does it carry only sound?"

370762904.m_KeyValue: ""Stella's voice drifted from within—at times clear, at times worn and frayed.""

370762905.m_KeyValue: "The little construct crept to my side and nestled into place."

370762910.m_KeyValue: ""...Back then, we had Regina's salt to thank.""

370762911.m_KeyValue: ""Even across worlds, I could still hear the excitement in Stella's voice as she recounted her journey.""

371407795.m_KeyValue: "Could I take that adorable sound as a hint of your nervousness?"

371441556.m_KeyValue: ""Father once told me he hoped I would be like Wolfsbane. At first, I didn't understand what he meant.""

371657294.m_KeyValue: "Do you have a theme in mind?"

372054007.m_KeyValue: ""You know what's going on, don't you?""

372885226.m_KeyValue: ""Come now, no need to be so cold. Agree to help, and I'll make sure the Inquisition keeps their distance.""

372923463.m_KeyValue: "Pregnant? A woman with her temperament and faith—suicide doesn't add up."

372995205.m_KeyValue: ""Every time you send me that liquid, it cuts off abruptly at some point in history. But the visions are lasting longer now, and I'm seeing deeper into the past—""

373100964.m_KeyValue: "How annoying... That place is terrible for my skin."

373802473.m_KeyValue: ""As you gradually regain your memories and abilities, our territory will expand accordingly. And with it, the earnings you can collect.""

373802570.m_KeyValue: ""Equipping certain equipment can significantly enhance Blood Power. When you find more equipment in the future, remember to return to the castle to equip them.""

374244414.m_KeyValue: "The Blood Arena has been fully restored. Please follow me there."

374247712.m_KeyValue: "Baphomet has set up guards and traps around this tower. I'm afraid it will be difficult for us to break through."

374290200.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Wild Boars and crabs visible only to Noah."

374801082.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. Once the captain of the Astolfo resistance and Alene's closest comrade, they seem to retain a trace of sanity.""

374801091.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us wisdom to endure the winter nights.'""

374801094.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. Normally mindless, they briefly regain their sanity at the sight of a familiar shadow from the past.""

374801149.m_KeyValue: ""Ganelon soldiers never question right from wrong, but simply obey orders out of habit. It is this blind compliance that makes them part of evil's plan.""

374801155.m_KeyValue: ""A Mouret villager who takes shifts with James tending to the afflicted in the cave. He appears dutiful on the outside, yet secretly harbors thoughts of betrayal toward his kin.""

374801160.m_KeyValue: "A hunter residing in Mouret. Their archery skills retain deadly precision against the invaders."

374801161.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer from Mouret, who even without any proper weapon, still grips a pitchfork with unwavering resolve, sworn to defend this land until the final breath.""

374801179.m_KeyValue: ""Eldest of the Bathory family, and guardian of the vicious Bloodborn. Despite his proud demeanor, he isn't immune to the ravages of time.""

374801186.m_KeyValue: "The Heretic Hunters of the Church who stare death in the face. They know well that even their baptism before the crusade could not change their inevitable fate. Their chainmail clangs like a bell rung at their own funeral."

374801188.m_KeyValue: ""Spirit vessels used by Baphomet for his flesh experiments. Though they are quite damaged, they still retain some energy.""

374801189.m_KeyValue: "An assassin attempting to infiltrate the Alita castle and kill the lord."

374801190.m_KeyValue: ""Spirit vessels used by Baphomet for his flesh experiments. Though they are quite damaged, they still retain some energy.""

374801191.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to repel the intruders.""

374801253.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps the most distinctive Spirit Bone Tower, it is clearly a prized piece of work. The tower is meticulously constructed from the skulls of the Paracelsus family, and silently displays the obsessive nature of its creators.""

375723960.m_KeyValue: "Gains All DMG Taken Down (Minor) and ATK SPD UP (Minor) for {0} sec. The ATK SPD UP effect becomes stronger with each cast."

375728316.m_KeyValue: "Summons several Plague Nests that become Plague Spawnlings after hatching."

376087444.m_KeyValue: "But what about you? Who will protect you?"

376087446.m_KeyValue: ""Because it's divine punishment for heresy, of course! Animals don't have faith, so why would they suffer?""

376087447.m_KeyValue: "...As I expected. You're still that righteous child. I knew you wouldn't accept this easily."

376087448.m_KeyValue: "What I don't understand is... Why didn't you take me with you when you decided to leave?"

376087449.m_KeyValue: "You'd realize there’s no such thing as freedom. Only a script we've all been forced to play."

376105347.m_KeyValue: "That power... I've never seen anything like it..."

377652069.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, I can tell exactly what you’re thinking from that expression.' Noah said, noticing Ami’s subtly upturned lips and easily reading her thoughts.""

377652074.m_KeyValue: ""'You know... recognizing your physical limits is an important skill too. There’s no shame in taking a break when you need it,' Noah said gently, choosing his words with care to comfort Hati.""

377652075.m_KeyValue: ""'Noah has a point. If it’s too much for you, I can arrange a small boat to take you back,' Ami said with an understanding nod.""

377652076.m_KeyValue: ""But what Ami was really thinking was: The mystical Ethereal Springs isn’t very big—if everyone goes, it’ll be awfully crowded... It would be a huge help if someone stayed behind, hehe.""

377892369.m_KeyValue: "I was about to come looking for you myself."

377946929.m_KeyValue: "Friend or foe—that's for you to decide."

377946930.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Lord Van Helsing! The rebel soldiers we were fighting... they suddenly turned into Blood Beasts, one after another. We were nearly wiped out.""

377946931.m_KeyValue: "But I can't let them get to you..."

377946932.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Henceforth, I'll end this war myself!_$$ ...or something along those lines.""

377946933.m_KeyValue: "The Long Night draws near... and all returns to the beginning."

377947957.m_KeyValue: ""...But this body holds no memory of battle. In this state, I can't win.""

379369856.m_KeyValue: "She represents a threat to all who dwell within these walls and cannot be permitted to move freely."

379475615.m_KeyValue: ""Regarding our prior meeting, I confess to a coward's flight.""

379992250.m_KeyValue: "Hold it! The Warden is at prayer—no one disturbs her devotions!"

379992251.m_KeyValue: "You're not tending their affairs—you're mourning them."

379992253.m_KeyValue: ""Is this truly the present you've chosen, Noah?""

379992254.m_KeyValue: "Where did you go? Don't... don't leave me behind."

381144356.m_KeyValue: "But why would they leave the message _$$don't look for me_$$? Are they avoiding me?"

381178117.m_KeyValue: ""That girl, you mean the Carrelle family's young princess? She always said I was different from other slaves, and would secretly sneak away to see me.""

381283904.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm right, the exit is at the far end of this floor.""

381283905.m_KeyValue: "Twenty minutes of yard time… Even beasts get better treatment than us. I will not return."

381283906.m_KeyValue: ""Verify they’re still breathing, note any irregularities, replace broken shackles. The routine takes about two hours.""

381283907.m_KeyValue: "Warden. Aren't you being too soft on that silver-haired? Evening strolls with him!"

381393678.m_KeyValue: ""So we gained his trust by speaking ill of the Black Blood—but please believe me, those words were not my true feelings.""

381393679.m_KeyValue: "There's a passage inside the auction house that leads to the sewers…"

381393680.m_KeyValue: "I'll prepare an indisputable token of proof for you."

381393681.m_KeyValue: "I must find a way to save them!"

381393683.m_KeyValue: "Deceiving Selena like this... she will be quite upset."

381393710.m_KeyValue: "Why is it that those aiding me... are the very creatures born of myth?"

381393713.m_KeyValue: ""But I don’t have the heart to do it. After all, you’re family...""

381393714.m_KeyValue: "I... I've never fainted like this before..."

381393736.m_KeyValue: "Will the waves carry you back… to your homeland?"

381393742.m_KeyValue: ""Sounds to me like you're the real fraud. You don't even know Miss Ami. And this 'Bertram Roland'... he's just another accomplice, isn't he?""

381393743.m_KeyValue: "How can you take her side too!"

381393744.m_KeyValue: "We need to know who's behind these brutal acts! Where are they?"

381393746.m_KeyValue: ""When I was forced to set this plan in motion, I spent the most effort choosing my final piece.""

381393747.m_KeyValue: ""If you're the Mistbound Terror, then why stage the crime scenes to mock yourself?""

381393748.m_KeyValue: "Attendants of Miss Ami slew the siren!"

381393749.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Savich, when you asked me to testify, you never said things would turn out like this!""

382854585.m_KeyValue: ""Master Letitia, you should come with us.""

382854586.m_KeyValue: ""Before these primates gained their so-called intelligence, had this world ever witnessed such death and suffering?""

383701992.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, if you still find yourself craving blood, you know where to find me.""

383701993.m_KeyValue: "It's been centuries since anyone could dodge my attacks."

383701994.m_KeyValue: "Why have you started killing again? Why target the innocent?"

383861937.m_KeyValue: ""Each stack of Bloodlust increases the Vassal's ATK SPD by {0} and DMG dealt by {0}, stacking up to 10 times, lasting for 10 sec.""

383930447.m_KeyValue: "ATK SPD +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

383932625.m_KeyValue: "All Windchaser Vassals gain +{} Synergy DMG for each allied Windchaser Vassal present."

384414796.m_KeyValue: "But why did you eat that fish as well?"

385724628.m_KeyValue: "So what's the situation? Are we going into a two-on-two fight with a child in tow?"

385724630.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, if there's any danger, you must protect yourself first.""

385724631.m_KeyValue: ""Let us perform a requiem for the Calamity called Death—and for Ressa Ambolia, the Apostate.""

385724634.m_KeyValue: "I must be out of practice... To be losing ground to the current Bell Ringer. But I'm not alone this time—Noah is with me."

385724635.m_KeyValue: "How can this be!? The Calamity... and the Church's Valkyrie... moving in perfect harmony!?"

385724636.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine. It's just that after regaining some of Death’s memories, the Black Blood in me has started to stir again... This body still isn't used to it...""

385725651.m_KeyValue: "I knew our silver-haired friend wouldn't vanish so easily at sea. Can you tell which direction?"

385725653.m_KeyValue: "As I thought. The enemies often come from the very place they most wish to keep us from."

385725654.m_KeyValue: "What was that?! Why did the monster's form change when that fake sky shattered?"

385725655.m_KeyValue: ""Crystallization. The salt crystals Mr. Van Helsing mentioned haven't only spread across the land, they've altered the minions too.""

385725656.m_KeyValue: "Piera... why would you go this far? Don't you dare die before I find you!"

385725657.m_KeyValue: ""If she really triggered the crystal surge, we might trace her by tracking the shifts in crystal density, and follow it back to the source.""

385725658.m_KeyValue: "Which seems to lead... straight to the peak."

385725659.m_KeyValue: "Perfect! We're heading there to find Noah too! Strength in numbers!"

385734356.m_KeyValue: "…There. You can open your eyes now—it's over."

385734363.m_KeyValue: ""I don't really get it, but… it sounds sad. Can't we just not send them away? _$$Balance_$$ sounds mean!""

385734364.m_KeyValue: "Yes… I once thought the same. That's why I came to this island to study medicine."

385734365.m_KeyValue: ""I want to understand the truth of life and death, so that one day, I might stand against 'balance' itself.""

385734366.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong? Why do you sound so serious?"

385734367.m_KeyValue: "Because if we defy balance... we'll face those who enforce it. Like these—"

385734369.m_KeyValue: ""Father said we have to run if we see one, or they'll eat us!""

385734370.m_KeyValue: "Don't be afraid. Close your eyes and stay behind me."

385735509.m_KeyValue: ""As I told you before, they haven't forgotten. They're simply moving forward while still carrying their longing for you.""

385735515.m_KeyValue: "They cannot see Eleanor because they've severed their longing?"

385735517.m_KeyValue: ""Now, at long last, we've chosen to release that grief. To look ahead.""

385735518.m_KeyValue: ""There was a time we returned to Painter's Bluff each year, hoping to feel Eleanor's longing... But grief held us captive.""

385735519.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa... they really don't want me anymore, do they?""

385735521.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Ressa. And to whoever sent the flower—please give them our thanks as well.""

385735522.m_KeyValue: "Then congratulations are in order. Eleanor would be glad."

385737687.m_KeyValue: "No way?! Did the goddess just... give birth?"

385737688.m_KeyValue: "But... did someone just walk out of the Phantom of Aeon?"

385737691.m_KeyValue: "Why are you so surprised? This isn't the first time you've seen her fight."

385737693.m_KeyValue: "We can just get someone to fix it later!"

385737694.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's not that... Dr. Ressa just destroyed everything, including the Phantom of Aeon...""

385737695.m_KeyValue: "What kind of revelation did Eleanor's parents receive? And from whom?"

385737696.m_KeyValue: ""Just as we name things to make sense of them... Maybe life and death are only names, too. I thought I understood.""

385737698.m_KeyValue: ""But I'm certain now. You are the enemy of longing, therefore you are our enemy!""

385738715.m_KeyValue: "Noah Nevernight... I do love this name. I promise you."

385738717.m_KeyValue: ""As long as you remain Noah Nevernight, as long as you live on, as long as you remember this place...""

385738718.m_KeyValue: "This will always be the home you can return to."

385738719.m_KeyValue: ""Ah—wait! You think a single name isn't enough. You want a last name, too?""

385738720.m_KeyValue: ""Then from now on, your name will be... Noah Nevernight.""

385738721.m_KeyValue: ""Like the island itself—bathed in twilight, yet never engulfed by darkness.""

385738722.m_KeyValue: "_$$Never engulfed by darkness._$$ You're still warning me... not to use that method. But..."

385739865.m_KeyValue: "She mentioned the east... or was it west?"

385739866.m_KeyValue: ""We came swiftly by soundwave resonance. She, on the other hand, had to return by sea. It'll take her some time.""

385739867.m_KeyValue: ""But where's the Gravekeeper who summoned us? Without her to guide us, how are we supposed to find where Death is sealed?""

385739869.m_KeyValue: "What a troublesome child... Very well. But do not stray from my sight."

385739870.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, Commander! I'm much stronger now! Besides, my power might actually help you.""

385739871.m_KeyValue: "No wonder the air reeks of Black Blood."

385739872.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body on this island has inexplicably ceased its response—this may be connected to the awakening of _$$Death_$$ noted in the reports."

385739874.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—no! I finally get to come out with you! Please let me stay, just this once!""

385740891.m_KeyValue: ""Be it here, the Other Side, or anywhere beyond—so long as you remain with your longings, that place is home.""

385740892.m_KeyValue: ""Innocent children, your journey ends here. Awaken—""

385740893.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive our past ignorance and betrayal. You are the Ancestor, our true god.""

385740894.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, incarnation of Death, please bring us to our beloved ones and back to the home that is rightfully ours.""

385740895.m_KeyValue: "I am Death... their passage to the Other Side."

385740896.m_KeyValue: "Noah… when did it...? No—You've been our true enemy all along."

385740897.m_KeyValue: ""Please guide us to the Other Side, to be reunited with Eleanor… You are our true god.""

385740898.m_KeyValue: ""Eleanor, your mother and I have come back...""

387188678.m_KeyValue: "Take care of yourself. Leave the rest to me."

387222439.m_KeyValue: "No. The paint is special. It's only available where you are."

387912873.m_KeyValue: ""If this truly is a rebirth, then everything is unfolding at a dizzying pace.""

388475153.m_KeyValue:
""Uh... no, it just rolled off the tongue naturally...

<size=-10><alpha=#88>Seriously, why didn't I pick the other option! Now I have to explain all this!""

388596391.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me there's more up ahead?!"

390703247.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't touch my receiver, Darcias!' Acappella jumped up, crossing her hands over her chest in a defensive gesture, watching Darcias warily.""

390703250.m_KeyValue: ""'What receiver?' Darcias tilted her head, looking innocent.""

391351803.m_KeyValue: "In these years since I left... my successor has grown so strong."

391351804.m_KeyValue: ""In recent years, the Church has made breakthroughs in Future Artifact research. For you to contend using an older model... it's truly admirable.""

391351805.m_KeyValue: "You're not activating the metamorphosis? Even the old models were built with a final form."

391351806.m_KeyValue: ""As you say, little Van Helsing… both I and this weapon are old models. We've nothing left to become.""

391351807.m_KeyValue: "You've been away from the frontlines for too long. Your eyes no longer hold any killing intent—you no longer even care about victory or defeat."

391351808.m_KeyValue: ""The hunter Robert, who once mercilessly slaughtered Heretics... Has he truly been 'lost to the sea'?""

391351809.m_KeyValue: ""You may have heard of a fool, one who lost everything to the sea—family, friends, hope... He sought to defy the sea itself, to 'duel' it to the death.""

391351810.m_KeyValue: "And the sea swallowed him without even raising a ripple."

391351811.m_KeyValue: "But he gained a new life. And found a new family."

391351812.m_KeyValue: ""So now he wishes to stand against me, for the sake of that family?""

391365951.m_KeyValue: "Then I could come and go from the kitchen whenever I wanted. I'd never have to borrow keys again!"

391365952.m_KeyValue: "You're being accused of murder—and you're getting excited? Don't tell me you're thinking about learning that trick..."

391365956.m_KeyValue: "Like... what if the killer didn't come through the door at all?"

391365957.m_KeyValue: "Walked through walls? Can someone really do that!?"

391365958.m_KeyValue: "Then they must have... walked through the walls!"

391365959.m_KeyValue: ""After that, Jones was never alone again—Not until that Bathory broad knocked him unconscious. He's still lying in the lounge at the other end of the ship.""

391365960.m_KeyValue: "It’s Jack... But you can just call me 'that dutiful sailor' if you like..."

391365961.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no, no! We must have missed something... There has to be another possibility! Like...""

391365962.m_KeyValue: ""Meanwhile, Aaron's time of death... was just moments ago.""

391754511.m_KeyValue:
""Esteemed Lord of Bathory,

This month marks the Kingdom's routine survey, conducted once every fifty years.
We shall dispatch our finest cartographer to your territory for comprehensive surveying. The scope encompasses: the Bathory family's main city, subsidiary settlements, and adjacent townships. Given the thoroughness of this deep survey, considerable time will be required. Please inform the residents in advance and prepare for the necessary cooperation.

Agnes, the Greatest Cartographer on the Continent""

""Several letters addressed to Sage Lorelei arrived, but no one was there to receive them. A wine seller eventually forwarded them to me. 

'…A year ago, I left the Isle to pursue trade. Thanks to your funding, I've established a shop in Eastdale. You're always welcome to vacation here.'

'…Payment for our next transaction remains outstanding. Please note that, starting next month, we will no longer handle live cargo at the abandoned port in Sapphire Isle. Restoration, disguise, and relocation services will also be…'

Were these unclaimed letters truly the end of her story?

No. It couldn't end like this…""

405439096.m_KeyValue: "The task description isn't clear enough. I need more detailed guidance."

405472857.m_KeyValue: "I've reviewed the records about the Moonfall Games."

405582836.m_KeyValue: "You were right. I need to learn to accept things as they are."

405688595.m_KeyValue: ""Not financial fraud, but some kind of fanatical cult...""

405909019.m_KeyValue:
""The Oracle descended here in the form of a meteorite, which was mined heavily by the Church, leading to the fulfillment of one prophecy after another.
And so, the story begins here, right where it ended. Like a point on a circle, it loops endlessly.""

406804431.m_KeyValue: ""Death is the destiny of humans, as the long sleep is the fate of the Bloodborn. The freedom to choose when to end one's existence should be his right.""

406804497.m_KeyValue: ""At the end of the letter, she attached her ideal menu—grilled beef with cheesy mashed sweet potatoes, mulled wine, and red velvet cake with raspberry jam. It sounds absolutely mouthwatering! Diversifying our menu is a must!""

406804528.m_KeyValue: ""At times, concessions and compromises can secure more enduring advantages. This is the art of negotiation! Let us cast aside antiquated notions and contemplate how to forge mutually beneficial alliances.""

406804594.m_KeyValue: ""Through this approach, we can establish Bathory’s intelligence network across all major kingdoms, gathering information from every corner of the realm!""

406804629.m_KeyValue: ""Moreover, by attending meetings in bat form, I not only avoid the hassle of formal attire but also save time to handle more important matters.""

406804660.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Aiona has specifically compared our library with the one in her hometown. It seems we’re lacking books on continental history, literature and arts, and arithmetic and geometry. We should certainly consider acquiring new books!""

406804726.m_KeyValue: ""Consider this stray cat—not only is it affectionate and playful, but it also catches mice, making it far more endearing than that black cat perpetually dozing on the Elder’s chair. I propose we show more leniency and grant Vassals the freedom to keep pets.""

407094669.m_KeyValue: "ATK SPD +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

407119841.m_KeyValue: ""I needed a suitable vessel for my memories, and the Church sought someone strong enough to inherit Silver Blood... just as you did with 'Death.'""

407119842.m_KeyValue: ""You seem confused. From the very beginning, I was never granted Silver Blood—I chose it.""

407119843.m_KeyValue: "I never imagined a Bell Ringer of the Church would confess such things to a Heretic."

407119844.m_KeyValue: "—Or perhaps it's because we share the same fate."

407119845.m_KeyValue: "It seems you have also discovered my past within this vessel."
