407119846.m_KeyValue: ""Endlessly searching for the past, constantly grasping for the future—you and I are of one spirit.""

407119847.m_KeyValue: ""Your fascination with my past stems not from mere reward, but from a deeper yearning.""

407119850.m_KeyValue: ""I've always known that my 'selves' throughout the realms would continue to discover other worlds, but only Noah Nevernight can truly grasp the significance of this breakthrough.""

407520198.m_KeyValue: "What are you so excited about? You can't even use your powers yet."

407520199.m_KeyValue: "So the silver-haired one is here too? Perfect. You'll all fall before me!"

407520201.m_KeyValue: "Only three Calamities? A pity. I was hoping all of you'd be here."

407520202.m_KeyValue: ""Curious as ever, my little Fool. If you wish to understand, you'll have to carve your way into the sealed area and see with your own eyes.""

407520203.m_KeyValue: "Or maybe… the origin of the Moonblessed?"

407520204.m_KeyValue: "Let's retrace the path that Inquisitor took when he stole our little Fool."

407520205.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, I know that name! She's the one who brought down House Ganelon during the Bathory uprising!""

407520207.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, Jacintha—what you said earlier... Was it true?""

407523407.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it was former leader Tris or current Acappella, they're nothing but filthy killers!""

407833171.m_KeyValue: ""After Soul Echo, Equipment will be permanently bound to the Vassal|Attribute UP and gain up to 3 random Echo Blessings.""

408151215.m_KeyValue: "Oh? That gleaming stone fell from him... quite a pretty thing."

408721696.m_KeyValue: ""What really happened that day, Constantine? It looks to me like a part of you died in that disaster, too.""

408721697.m_KeyValue: ""You're just like him. But I'm afraid the isle is now ruled by your uncle, Hallon.""

408721698.m_KeyValue: ""You're right to loathe us. Maybe it was retribution. Just as the research showed promise, my sister's daughter… her condition suddenly took a turn for the worse.""

408721699.m_KeyValue: ""But fate offered me a glimmer of hope—Thirteen years ago, a shipwreck struck near the isle. I suppose you've forgotten that too?""

408721700.m_KeyValue: ""If this were an Inquisition, I'd have shot you already.""

408721701.m_KeyValue: "My daughter... We have to get her out of here!"

408721703.m_KeyValue: "I still carry a Sage version of the Siren's Tear... Take it. Keep it far from the Master's reach."

408721728.m_KeyValue: "The Siren's Tear that belonged to Lorelei..."

408721730.m_KeyValue: "I must get her out of here… I must do something to fulfill what Lorelei sought to achieve."

408721734.m_KeyValue: "If only she'd break that habit of stalking…"

408721735.m_KeyValue: "Lord Isaac must have uncovered the truth! Could Lord Hallon… be the Master behind it all?"

408721736.m_KeyValue: ""It isn't us who haunt you, but your last shred of conscience.""

408721984.m_KeyValue: "Fine... I'll grudgingly toss in another ten Soli. Happy now?"

408721995.m_KeyValue: ""Shut it! That's not something we're supposed to say out loud! Please, everyone—just ask for directions and go home!""

408721996.m_KeyValue: ""I may have a way to help you get what you desire. I'll speak with the elder of the Roland family—about a marriage alliance with Lady Ami, in your name.""

408721998.m_KeyValue: "What nonsense... Dispose of him before Lord Albrecht is disturbed."

408722025.m_KeyValue: "I was only bedridden for a while—so why does no one recognize me anymore?"

408722026.m_KeyValue: ""As far as I know... you can't. Though lovely, their bloom was short, and the petals were a nightmare to clean once they withered. The Seven Sage Association had them completely uprooted from the bay years ago.""

408722027.m_KeyValue: "That also happens to be everything I have on me right now..."

408722028.m_KeyValue: "Aiona—can you see what took place here?"

408722029.m_KeyValue: "That explains Ami's urgency before the Seven Sage Association. She said she'd find a way to locate the others still in captivity..."

408722030.m_KeyValue: "If I don't reach the promised place tonight... it'll be too late."

408722058.m_KeyValue: "If you uncover anything that implicates Ami before tomorrow's ceremony... Nothing is set in stone."

408722059.m_KeyValue: "We only just saw each other at the Seven Sage Association—what reason could there be for a private audience?"

408722089.m_KeyValue: "W-wait... is that an undercurrent over there?"

408722092.m_KeyValue: "I want to buy you a birthday gift."

408722093.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll just have to use a bit of righteous valor to convince you!"

408722094.m_KeyValue: ""Understood, Lady Selena! Will you not return with us?""

408722095.m_KeyValue: "L-Lady...? I-It's the first time anyone's called me that..."

408722116.m_KeyValue: "There's something important... I have to tell Alexa... Wait..."

408722117.m_KeyValue: "You remembered it after hearing it once? As expected of Sapphire Isle's greatest genius."

408722120.m_KeyValue: "Aside from Lorelei... There are rats... hiding in our midst."

408722122.m_KeyValue: "You always waste money you didn't earn on things that don't matter."

408722123.m_KeyValue: "So you're suggesting I'll need to collect all the Siren's Tears to recover my memories about the promise—including where it was made?"

408722124.m_KeyValue: "Why did you help me just now?"

408722125.m_KeyValue: "Eternal life?! That's absurd! You must be joking!"

408722127.m_KeyValue: "Lord Constantine—the last of the Seven Sages!"

408722151.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, back off! What if someone sees us?!""

408722154.m_KeyValue: ""Ami, Noah, and the Mistbound Terror were secretly in league... but now they've turned on each other?! Wait... you're one of the Mistbound Terror's accomplices? No wonder you fought so fiercely. Little Bella, we must apprehend him immediately!""

408722155.m_KeyValue: ""Attention! All citizens, be advised—Wanted criminals Ami and Noah have been sighted... Wait!""

408722156.m_KeyValue: "Then... Would you be so kind as to take me to the Master?"

408722157.m_KeyValue: "If tonight... things spiral beyond control... Go to the Church. Contact an old friend of mine. Bell Ringer Albrecht."

408722158.m_KeyValue: ""Strip her of her Sage title. Then issue a warrant across the Isle—for the arrest of Ami, and her subordinate, Noah. What do you think, Mr. Van Helsing?""

408722184.m_KeyValue: "This smell... They were tortured—more savagely than before."

408722186.m_KeyValue: ""Even now, my mind still reels with bouts of disorientation.""

408722187.m_KeyValue: ""According to the report, his final experiment took place three days ago. That day's log was written by his assistant. He likely disappeared shortly after.""

408722188.m_KeyValue: "Take the dilapidated door on the left."

408722189.m_KeyValue: ""Please, come in, Lord Isaac. Lord Constantine hasn't returned for awhile, so the place is currently unguarded.""

408722190.m_KeyValue: ""Sapphire Isle truly has no shortage of surprises—auction houses, Association-hosted fashion contests, promotional tournaments...""

409379687.m_KeyValue: ""Then am I to understand... that once we stepped into this place, our alliance—""

409379688.m_KeyValue: "If I don't protect this stinking bat—I'll be breaking the Ganelon family motto!"

409379689.m_KeyValue: "But what's that got to do with us? You got some bad blood with your mother or something?"

409380706.m_KeyValue: ""Though neither of you are the original Ancestry, the bloodline flows within you.""

409380707.m_KeyValue: "After all we've done to reach this place… are we truly this powerless?"

409380708.m_KeyValue: "Death weaves the threads of the forgotten past. And War—War ignites the haze of dusk."

409380709.m_KeyValue: ""I, more than anyone, should know—there are no what-ifs in this world. We just keep struggling against the tide of history...""

409380712.m_KeyValue: ""According to your truth, we never truly die. So long as memory persists, wherever it resides...""

409380713.m_KeyValue: ""Still, I believe one day, you'll understand me—truly understand. And see even further than I do.""

409380714.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Everything that will happen must happen, because it has transpired._$$""

409380715.m_KeyValue: ""You mean... you are me, I am you. We are everyone, and everyone is me.""

410106960.m_KeyValue: "It's been corroding my sanity. I could turn into a monster at any moment..."

411142234.m_KeyValue: ""A horseshoe crab common to Sunset Isle. Seemingly infected with Black Blood, it now swings its pincers wildly as if to shred anything standing before it.""

411847508.m_KeyValue: "We thought you might be reminiscing when we couldn't find you."

411980898.m_KeyValue: ""Taking the lance, I can understand. But why Alene...?""

411980899.m_KeyValue: "It seems to be coming from the camp over there..."

412063246.m_KeyValue: "Time is the one thing I have in abundance."

412564830.m_KeyValue: "The Ancestor responsible for the noises from the cellar... could he have already left?' Noah speculated."

412564831.m_KeyValue: ""'Right, how else would he know with such certainty?' Isaac chimed in.""

412564832.m_KeyValue: ""'Perhaps,' the guard mused. 'He is one of the condemned of the Bathory family, and that accursed cellar serves as his eternal prison.'""

412704942.m_KeyValue: "Cover your eyes—it's time for sensory training. Let's see if you can detect me."

412704975.m_KeyValue: "You can't hide from me with your little facade."

412705041.m_KeyValue: "Need an outfit for sneaking around? I'd love to see how you look in it."

412705173.m_KeyValue: ""Want it? Then take it yourself, like a true burglar.""

413401157.m_KeyValue: "That boy doesn't suffer from Black Blood disease—but what he has seems far worse."

413445619.m_KeyValue: "The mission is complete. Let's take him back to the desert..."

413506916.m_KeyValue: "I'm fairly certain _$$striking down incompetent doctors_$$ isn't part of my job description."

413824735.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmm...? Thank you for your patronage. The Puppet Association is wholly committed to providing bespoke services tailored to every client's needs—whatever they may be, so long as payment is guaranteed.'""

414697177.m_KeyValue: "Protect <#A65F30>Theophane</color> and survive the attack for 60 sec."

414697272.m_KeyValue: "Survive Dark Colossus and crystallized monsters for 60 sec."

414801852.m_KeyValue: "Defeat Fanny and grant her true freedom."

414839837.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, where are you headed, Miss Lorelei?""

414839838.m_KeyValue: "I'm helping arrange your lodging for tonight. Why do you ask?"

414839843.m_KeyValue: "We have no way to determine if the salvaged items came from the same shipwreck."

414839844.m_KeyValue: ""However, I'll have our appraisers keep an eye out.""

414839845.m_KeyValue: "There's no need for such formal words like 'favor' between family."

414839846.m_KeyValue: "Could you let me know if you find any other items or clues that were salvaged along with this gilded statue?"

414839847.m_KeyValue: ""A normal human shouldn't be able to fit inside that doll, right?""

414839848.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it really is just a doll?"

414839850.m_KeyValue: ""When you leave, give this claim ticket to Joyce—the doll on the stage.""

414844945.m_KeyValue: ""Ami, you were never one to betray others.""

414845281.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#8f9abf>He has cleaned up many 'remnants' for us, and in exchange, we don't pry into his secrets.</color>""

414845282.m_KeyValue: "<color=#be79a6>He can no longer be trusted. We must find out who among us is the Mistbound Terror.</color>"

414845283.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#be79a6>The Mistbound Terror left those traces, and deliberately leaked them to the common folk.</color>""

414845284.m_KeyValue: "<color=#c6ae80>Execute him! Expose him! Tear him apart!</color>"

414845286.m_KeyValue: "May your days in Sapphire Isle be like a beautiful dream."

414845287.m_KeyValue: ""Please prepare yourself, Miss Ami. I look forward to sharing the slaves with you, sharing the 'Siren's Tears,' sharing our future.""

414845288.m_KeyValue: ""Of course. After all, the Eighth Sage will join us as a symbol of Sapphire Isle.""

414845289.m_KeyValue: "Will the selection be open to the public?"

415207043.m_KeyValue: ""Once a scavenger of the dead, now—mutated by Black Blood—the undisputed King of Starfall Valley.""

417801400.m_KeyValue: "'Could it be that one?' Noah pointed toward a cluster of three stones in the distance."

417801401.m_KeyValue: ""But even if my actions have already strayed beyond the bounds of doctrine, I still wish to continue this research.""

417801402.m_KeyValue: ""'In all the long history of the Alita family, I've never heard of an astronomer who could map the surface of the moon.'""

417801404.m_KeyValue: ""Moonlight poured down, casting a pale glow over her resolute expression.""

417801407.m_KeyValue: ""'Before her death, her final wish was for me to preserve and bury her writings. Fulfilling that wish was the most reckless act of my life.'""

417802488.m_KeyValue: "'But I doubt he ever imagined… that his notes would be entirely forgotten.'"

417802489.m_KeyValue: ""'_$$March twenty-ninth, new moon—The moon is not visible today._$$ The sketch is just a completely empty sky.'""

417802491.m_KeyValue: ""Arms crossed, Empousa huffed dramatically. 'Well, if you must know, it's because Aiona found some old journal in the library.'""

417802495.m_KeyValue: ""Alas, the skies were unkind that night—thick clouds veiled the faint light of the moon.""

417959371.m_KeyValue: "The catnip of Sapphire Isle alone carries that familiar scent."

417959372.m_KeyValue: "Sapphire Isle... does that place hold special meaning for you?"

417959375.m_KeyValue: ""As a reward for your cleverness, how about offering some catnip to your elder?""

417959376.m_KeyValue: ""Fangs, mystery, and nocturnal instincts... Maybe all cats are destined to be Bloodborn?""

417959377.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, it must be from Sapphire Isle.""

417959380.m_KeyValue: "How does a mere cat of the Matriarch survive this long?"

417959381.m_KeyValue: "Is that so? Meow... down to my last tail now."

417959382.m_KeyValue: "Could you be a Bloodborn among cats?"

417972376.m_KeyValue: ""'You know, there's a most extraordinary creature that dwells upon Minexus...' Quinn's voice floats from nearby, sounding completely unrelated.""

417972377.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph. Coming from you, Genevieve—our very own <style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style>—that's rich. How perfectly ironic.'""

417972378.m_KeyValue: ""'Cut—!' Quinn flicks her parasol, signaling Genevieve to stop. 'Mass... How many times do I have to tell you not to improvise your lines?'""

417972379.m_KeyValue: ""'<color=#728c69>Perfect Metamorph Dragon</color>... <style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style>...' Mass whispers these words heavy with enchantment, her gaze slowly turning toward the distant horizon...""

417972380.m_KeyValue: "'Perhaps that's true.' Genevieve interrupts Quinn. 'But the truth doesn't matter anymore. What matters now is <style="Highlight">belief</style>.'"

417972381.m_KeyValue: ""'...<color=#728c69>Drama Queen</color>.' Quinn freezes for a moment, stunned by the transformation. Then she recovers. 'Quick... get ready!'""

417972383.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, the prison's name is kept deliberately vague here for dramatic secrecy!""

417974552.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet lowered his axe while looking down at Gilrain with disdain. 'Hmph. Next time you dare provoke me, boy, you'd best measure your own abilities first.'""

417974553.m_KeyValue: ""The atmosphere suddenly grew tense. Gilrain's long hair stirred as if by an unseen force, while Baphomet tightened his grip on his axe, his gauntlet creaking ominously. It seemed a great battle was imminent...""

417974554.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, among Gilrain's other woes is... the disdain of the Bathory tailors. His tendency to destroy shirts in Battle has forced him to spend most of his time bare-chested.""

417974555.m_KeyValue: ""A muffled voice reverberated from within the armor: 'In that distant year, I was but a humble retainer in service to the Matriarch.'""

417974559.m_KeyValue: ""Curled up comfortably on its seat to the west, the black cat lets out a contented purr, as if to say, 'East or west, one's own bed is best.'""

417975512.m_KeyValue: ""'How thoughtful of you,' Gilrain said without any emotion.""

417975513.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, completely unfazed after being exposed, replied, 'Well, those are Jacintha's little paws after all. What can I say? Jacintha is the cutest cat in the world!'""

417975514.m_KeyValue: ""'Hm... she's probably right. After all, he is her most valued customer. Who else would know him better?' Gilrain, unexpectedly in agreement with Bella, remarked as he dissolved into the shadows.""

417975515.m_KeyValue: ""The dim, flickering lights cast long shadows of the three elders as they walked ahead. Baphomet gazed wistfully at their retreating forms—those three he had once so carefully trained, now grown...""

417975516.m_KeyValue: ""'Bathory Elders... we move! Let us give this intruder a warm welcome!' Baphomet's voice had never sounded so impassioned as he led a shadow, a puppet, and a black cat...""

418013752.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, as she hurried forward, her bulky octopus hat snagged in the narrow space, and she went sprawling. 'Ah—'""

418013753.m_KeyValue: ""The two slipped into the castle under the cover of night (?), aimlessly drifting through its shadowed halls. 'Something still feels wrong... This feels almost like...'""

418013754.m_KeyValue: ""The slanting sunlight pooled across Bella's figure, casting a golden softness over her rose-kissed hair. As the sea breeze stirred, those delicate strands danced across Selena's face, brushing her skin with a teasing touch.""

418013755.m_KeyValue: ""Bella tilted her head, utterly puzzled by Selena's actions—then abruptly changed the subject. '...Are you hungry?'""

418013756.m_KeyValue: "'Ow... that hurt!' Selena rubbed her forehead with a pitiful look. But the anger in her eyes quickly softened as they landed on the other girl's delicate face."

418013758.m_KeyValue: "...This has long since passed the point of being merely lost."

418013759.m_KeyValue: ""Before Selena could finish, the girl suddenly halted, turning to stare at her, wide-eyed. 'H-human... what?'""

418014842.m_KeyValue: ""'That's only temporary! She will see me! It's her fate! Her inescapable fate! And you three... you'll face your own portraits, sooner or later!'""

418014844.m_KeyValue: ""'There are no unknowns in this world,' Lamia scoffed while trying to keep her composure. 'You simply don't know, but I bet someone does.'""

418014845.m_KeyValue: ""'You see, the image in the portrait will begin to change and distort, and the person before it will as well.'""

418014847.m_KeyValue: ""'Doubly so—from both the sublime artistry and the Matriarch herself,' Cain replied.""

418046428.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet would have worn a mocking expression, if only his armor allowed such displays. 'It's quite simple. We must create a perfect vessel for the Matriarch, and cultivate more powerful elders.'""

418046429.m_KeyValue: ""'No. I'm referring to the true power that the major families have demonstrated during this series of conflicts. Bella, you should have the most insight into this matter.'""

418046430.m_KeyValue: ""'Actually, my proposal is that we don't make a choice at all,' Baphomet said.""

418046431.m_KeyValue: "'Those two pathetic families?' Gilrain's voice dripped with contempt. 'Those weaklings rely on hidden arrows and poison to do their dirty work. They're utterly worthless in a real battle.'"

418051736.m_KeyValue: "_$$Would you be so kind as to perform it for us now?_$$"

418051737.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn peeks open one eye, glancing shyly at Agnes, who stands frozen in stunned silence beside her. _$$Agnes, Agnes, it's your turn now, okay?_$$""

418051738.m_KeyValue: "_$$—I arrived at a different Other Side entirely._$$ The blue-haired girl gazes with wonder at the refined and graceful Bathory lady before her. _$$...How utterly marvelous this is._$$"

418051739.m_KeyValue: ""Catching the note of reluctance in Agnes's voice, Quinn freezes mid-step, turning to stare at her in utter disbelief. _$$You... are you saying you want to refuse Mario and Juliet?!_$$""

418051740.m_KeyValue: ""Sirene catches the movement, but keeps up the act. _$$Oh my, Baphomet claims he needs his beauty sleep today and has dumped his official duties on me... what an absolute bother._$$""

418051741.m_KeyValue: ""Unfurling her parasol with ceremonial precision, Quinn traces an arc of elegance through the air. _$$I have the privilege to stand as one of the Bathory lineage—Quinn Crowley Baphomet._$$""

418051742.m_KeyValue: "The girl spreads her robe upon the earth and gazes intently at the cryptic symbols embroidered within its folds—markings that only she can decipher. She remains lost in contemplation... until a sudden awareness prickles at her senses. _$$Who's there—?_$$"

418051743.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I'll hide your precious parasol in Valora's armory!_$$ A wicked grin spreads across her face, delighted by her own threat.""

418051750.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Congratulations! You've now experienced Mario and Juliet—one of the 'Seven Must-See Plays of a Lifetime', as deemed by the distinguished editorial board of 'Minexus: A Brief History'!_$$""

418118301.m_KeyValue: ""The guard's pale lips curled in a dry chuckle. 'A cliché tale begets a cliché ending. In the end, the Ancestor who defied the others fled into the crypt's depths with the girl.'""

418118302.m_KeyValue: ""'As the Bloodborn were busy dealing with the Crimson Inquisition, they nearly forgot about their captives. They failed to provide fresh food and water.'""

418118303.m_KeyValue: ""Before Noah could finish, the old guard looked up sharply. 'Tell your two accomplices to come out as well. Your incessant whispering was starting to annoy me.'""

418119256.m_KeyValue: ""'It was many, many years ago, on a summer night without moonlight…' Bella sighed lightly, and as if in response, the flickering candle before her wavered too—threatening to go out at any moment.""

418119257.m_KeyValue: ""'Lady Empousa...' Bella rummaged through her satchel for a moment, then fell still. 'The spares are gone. We're out of candles.'""

418119258.m_KeyValue: ""'Miss Ami, why are you here?' Bella tilted her head, puzzled. 'I'm quite sure I prepared five portions of food.'""

418119259.m_KeyValue: "'Tsk! Useless! And right when it's important!'"

418119260.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally, the mastermind was already gone in a flash... leaving behind only a single, deadpan sentence—one that somehow reeked of smug satisfaction.""

418119262.m_KeyValue: ""Unbothered by Empousa's awkward attempt at etiquette, Lorelei raised her glass of murky, blood-red liquid and took a sip. 'Heh… The Bathory family certainly lives up to its reputation.'""

418119263.m_KeyValue: ""A feat only possible for someone like Bella, who happened to have four arms.""

418119268.m_KeyValue: ""Wait a minute—she's right! Empousa's a Bloodborn, and Bella's a puppet. There’s no way they'd be spooked by a little darkness! This whole setup was a poorly acted farce—and the bard had seen through it from the start!""

420399828.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you had it, I'd never sell to a slave. Look at the brand upon your arm—dealing with your kind is ill luck.""

420443828.m_KeyValue: "Most likely an orphan. Poor child. Such a tragic fate."

420443829.m_KeyValue: "I suspect the child enlisted just for a warm meal. But in the end..."

420443830.m_KeyValue: "Noah… Will I fade away like that someday? Leaving nothing behind?"

420443831.m_KeyValue: "Yes… Orphans have the loneliest souls. No one to remember them. No one to grieve."

420443832.m_KeyValue: ""The battle was brutal. The body's thin, and badly damaged.""

420443834.m_KeyValue: "A scar on the right ear. Thin build. I'll remember."

420443835.m_KeyValue: "But there's a triangular scar—on the right ear. The rest… is unrecognizable."

421307887.m_KeyValue: "First Clearance Reward may only be obtained once."

421557945.m_KeyValue: ""Also, next time… maybe don't let Anna read our letters.""

422702791.m_KeyValue: "Let me be clear—I'm not running away from this."

422702792.m_KeyValue: "Did you have an unpleasant experience during the last survey?"

422702799.m_KeyValue: "I've never met anyone quite so passionate about their work."

422702800.m_KeyValue: "Most people I know spend their days looking for ways to avoid work."

422702801.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, I didn't notice before—is this letter from Bathory?""

422702802.m_KeyValue: "But work needs to be done in moderation too. Why not leave the surveying to Bathory's Lord? That would be the safe approach."

422702803.m_KeyValue: "You're absolutely right! Work should be done in moderation—why not take that break after all!"

422702804.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, suddenly my legs are feeling a bit sore.""

422702805.m_KeyValue: "Why did you change your mind upon realizing it was a letter from the Bathory family?"

422702806.m_KeyValue: ""Then the surveying is entrusted to you. It's decided, my Lord.""

423141611.m_KeyValue: "Tell me what I'm supposed to do."

423141613.m_KeyValue: "Do you know? Humanity once had Black Blood running through its veins. We are descendants of Black Blood."

423141614.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body that seals the thirteen drops of Ancestral Black Blood. It is not our salvation. It is our prison. A deception created by Aeon to confine humanity."

423141615.m_KeyValue: "I left the Saint's sight because I had to seek the truth."

423141616.m_KeyValue: "What kind of freedom would it be if you're not even by my side?"

423632690.m_KeyValue: "Yet it seems their faith in you exceeds their faith in god himself."

423810191.m_KeyValue: ""That's good. So, can you tell me about what happens in the future?""

425085252.m_KeyValue: "Enough! Our ship was nearly complete! El Dorado was meant to be the final vessel! But that day..."

425085253.m_KeyValue: "The Church sent that Bell Ringer. She destroyed our homeland and ships..."

425085259.m_KeyValue: ""Hey! No matter how you look at it, isn't Famine just using you? What exactly are you even following?""

425085260.m_KeyValue: ""We know this must hurt you, Lady Ami... But soon...""

425085261.m_KeyValue: ""You'll return to Ranna's memory, and be reborn as the new, perfected Ancestors of Landis!""

425085262.m_KeyValue: "But I don't get it... She turned you into this. Even if you're with family now... is losing your sense of self really what you wanted?"

425085263.m_KeyValue: "And more importantly—those whispers you followed back then... Did they save you in the end?"

425085264.m_KeyValue: ""You Bathorys turned your back on the Church too. The Moonblessed were branded Calamities, not born monsters. But I guess your blood's thinned too much to remember that.""

425085265.m_KeyValue: ""Excuse me!? I know about the Moonblessed too, thank you very much!""

425088584.m_KeyValue: ""No one ever taught you, did they? The louder you roar, the more it betrays your fear. Then again... who do you even have to talk to?""

425088586.m_KeyValue: "Ami... I'm disappointed. You defy me... and mock me!?"

425088587.m_KeyValue: "Hey now—wait just a minute. That's just your fantasy. I never agreed to any—"

425088588.m_KeyValue: "The next Captain of the El Dorado!"

425088589.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not a mortal either, I am...""

425088590.m_KeyValue: "They are the crew of the El Dorado—the bravest adventurers of all."

425088592.m_KeyValue: "You're just a mortal! How dare mortals trespass into the domain of an Apocalypse…"

425088593.m_KeyValue: "Impossible... You shouldn't be capable of this—constructing memory worlds is a power only the oldest Moonblessed once possessed..."

429182040.m_KeyValue: "The dream unfolded in a lavish mansion. Was this her office? No... I remembered the furniture was different."

431309605.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me, Clive, do you truly have no regrets?""

431450914.m_KeyValue: ""When delivering Sapphire Isle's specialty to Elder Bella's room, I unexpectedly uncovered a surprising truth.""

431594654.m_KeyValue: ""I caught the big fish Ami wanted, but I hope she's not going to eat it whole again...""

431700351.m_KeyValue: "Asta is holding another grand celebration. The news has reached the castle—everyone seems rather interested."

433034257.m_KeyValue: "Just like the way you make me feel."

433177997.m_KeyValue: "Who's helping you draft these ornate letters of yours?"

433991528.m_KeyValue: ""This is an absurd situation, and only an equally absurd hero would choose to continue such futility.""

433991536.m_KeyValue: ""Our last memory before coming here... was encountering a meteor near Starfall Valley, and after that...""

433991537.m_KeyValue: "It takes five years for a body to turn into bones."

433991538.m_KeyValue: "See? Everyone's curious about this kind of stuff."

433991539.m_KeyValue: "Huh?! My power... seems to have disappeared too."

433991540.m_KeyValue: "I can't... my transformation powers are gone..."

433991542.m_KeyValue: "No... I'm the one who failed to protect them..."

433991568.m_KeyValue: "Is this... the answer to it all?"

433991569.m_KeyValue: "Is it truly hopeless? Is there no way for everyone to escape this place?"

433991570.m_KeyValue: ""Now, return to your own timeline and prevent the final calamity from descending...""

433991571.m_KeyValue: ""As long as I remember, I'll have the strength to keep fighting this battle...""

433991572.m_KeyValue: "It's just... I never got the chance to say goodbye..."

433991600.m_KeyValue: ""But now, more importantly, you must return to your timeline...""

433991602.m_KeyValue: ""You... can't overcome it anymore, can you?""

433991606.m_KeyValue: "And so I shall recount another ancient tale..."

434668909.m_KeyValue: ""Smashes toward the target, dealing {0} ATK (P. DMG) to enemies in the area ahead.""

435440965.m_KeyValue: ""Even after returning to the castle, there's still no sign of her.""

435440966.m_KeyValue: "You seem particularly fixated on competing with Empousa."

435440967.m_KeyValue: "Outside those doors... there really is nothing at all..."

435440968.m_KeyValue: ""So before dying, she crafted that entire lie about the weapon to defeat everyone, just to lure me out of the castle?""

437323879.m_KeyValue: ""It's you, Noah Nevernight, who shared countless pasts with me.""

437323980.m_KeyValue: "Take the others... go... carry our blessings... to..."

437324011.m_KeyValue: "The last thing I can do... is to protect you on your retreat..."

437324077.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how many times I've been through this, I do it willingly.""

438681302.m_KeyValue: "They couldn't let someone bearing the Reese bloodline walk away. Nor allow her to interfere with the marriage."

438681303.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, you arrived a step too late.""

438986497.m_KeyValue: "What?! Then that means... Little Ami is still the prime suspect!"

438986498.m_KeyValue: ""So, without my permission, you conducted experiments to verify whether Aaron could be strangled from outside his cabin. Well, what were your findings?""

438986499.m_KeyValue: ""The next step was simple. Since there's a pulley on the mast, turning the helm would draw the rope from the crew quarters...""

438986501.m_KeyValue: "The first mistake was when he turned the helm to control the rope in the crew quarters—and jammed the rudder."

438986502.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Who? Who is it? Don't tell me... are we the only ones still clueless?"

438986503.m_KeyValue: "...He is far more calculating than his brother."

438986504.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, Captain. You were the one who cut and disposed of the rope that should have remained at the mast.""

438986505.m_KeyValue: ""...that I would be on this ship. Looking back, my arrival was his greatest miscalculation, far worse than his three earlier mistakes.""

438986506.m_KeyValue: ""More precisely, someone was involved. This was William's third fatal mistake—his plan required an 'accomplice.'""

438986529.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure we should leave that oaf behind...?"

438986530.m_KeyValue: "So it was him you were talking to earlier!"

438986532.m_KeyValue: "I know. You've been with me this whole time and showed no signs of bloodthirst."

438986533.m_KeyValue: "Which raises another question. Where's William? He's not among these people."

438986785.m_KeyValue: "Hmm… It does bear the El Dorado seal. Let me check the invitation..."

438986786.m_KeyValue: "Please wait. There may be some misunderstanding regarding the invitations."

438986793.m_KeyValue: ""Treasure, power, paradise—every secret we seek lies beyond the sea.""

438986794.m_KeyValue: ""Assuming, of course, that our peacock Captain isn't just puffing his feathers.""

438986795.m_KeyValue: ""The 'outcome' of the future must not be allowed to shape the past—this is 'the decree of the past,' and it must not be defied. It must never be...""

438986796.m_KeyValue: ""To you, Clive isn't a prisoner bound by time, but a martyr who placed his faith in the future.""

438986798.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally. After all, this 'Chariot' rides toward the legendary 'Sun'... And even I, the 'Magician,' cannot steer the 'Wheel of Fortune.'""

438986799.m_KeyValue: ""Tread carefully, little 'Fool.' To place the 'Wheel of Fortune' solely in your own hands is to believe in no one but yourself.""

438986800.m_KeyValue: "Today's guests are rather peculiar... That one with the lifeless eyes also refused to eat anything served on the ship."

438986825.m_KeyValue: "You there—stowaway! Are you the one who hurt my precious crew?!"

438986826.m_KeyValue: ""Your corset is expertly laced, and the lining is fine cloth from the Northern Continent—far beyond what commoners can afford.""

438986827.m_KeyValue: "Have her close her eyes and sit quietly where she is."

438986828.m_KeyValue: ""What is wrong with you, you dumb wolf?! Don't tell me you're going to throw up on me again!""

438986831.m_KeyValue: "Might I take temporary custody of this stowaway? Her combat performance earlier... piqued my interest."

438986832.m_KeyValue: "No! This is on me! I failed to protect you all..."

438986857.m_KeyValue: "Even if you insist your invitation was taken by mistake…"

438986861.m_KeyValue: ""So you don't deny it. Figures… your tone, your attitude—it's annoyingly similar to mine. Equally unpleasant.""

438986862.m_KeyValue: ""Aww, what a shame. Just when they were about to get serious...""

438986863.m_KeyValue: ""Despite his attitude, he didn't actually hurt us.""

438986864.m_KeyValue: ""The Captain planned everything! With the Church's top agent and Bob here, no monster can threaten this ship!""

438986885.m_KeyValue: "I-I'm sorry... I really can't drink alcohol..."

438986886.m_KeyValue: ""Captain Goldland, is there something you need? Would you like a meal prepared?""

438986889.m_KeyValue: ""Tch. That wretched... musclebound broad... Even seasick, she's still a menace...""

438986890.m_KeyValue: ""The sea is free: whether you're a commoner or a sinner, its secrets open to your courage.""

438986891.m_KeyValue: "He's still conscious about that scar on his face after all..."

438986892.m_KeyValue: "We lost the invitation ourselves. Their suspicion is understandable."

438986893.m_KeyValue: ""Well, from what you're saying, it's just this time, right? No need to throw a tantrum. Talk about being petty.""

438986895.m_KeyValue: "Just as you make no effort to hide your 'identity.'"

438986896.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, dumb wolf! Get up! These Knights aren't here to play nice—go teach them a lesson!""

438986918.m_KeyValue: "Right across from here? Then that heavy thud we heard must have been..."

438986923.m_KeyValue: "Were you in the kitchen the entire time before that?"

438986924.m_KeyValue: "We thought it was strange too. Aaron was supposed to be patrolling the deck—but he never showed up."

438986925.m_KeyValue: "The ship just lurched violently. Did something happen here?"

438986926.m_KeyValue: "Strange… It's not even a sailor's knot. It's really hard to untie..."

438986928.m_KeyValue: ""That's enough, Bob. Those aren't the kind of things you should be bragging about.""

438986954.m_KeyValue: ""If you're asking about Black Blood, it's a—...Wait, what?""

438986955.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, so the floor really is broken. Which one of you is footing the bill?""

438986956.m_KeyValue: "It's not about how many were pulling. It's about what was pulling."

438986957.m_KeyValue: ""Is it secured? You do realize the sea winds are pretty strong up here, right?""

438986958.m_KeyValue: "I didn't know you could tie a sailor's knot."

438986959.m_KeyValue: "The painting's fine... But it's not heavy enough."

438986960.m_KeyValue: "That noise... Something terrible might have happened again! I need to check it out!"

438986983.m_KeyValue: "When can we get out of here...? Can I go join the excitement?"

438986985.m_KeyValue: ""Are you feeling unwell? Any coughing, fever, nausea?""

438986986.m_KeyValue: "I knew I shouldn't have trusted you!"

438986988.m_KeyValue: "...then that's why I smelled it the moment I entered the kitchen..."

438986989.m_KeyValue: ""It's dangerous, yes—but not in the way you're thinking. ...Wait.""

438986990.m_KeyValue: ""No, thanks... Anyway, do you remember exactly where Aaron dropped that thing? It might be an important clue.""

438986991.m_KeyValue: ""What should I have for afternoon tea? Wait, I already had afternoon tea... so it must be dinner time now?""

438986992.m_KeyValue: "I-I'll be going now. The kitchen is all yours—..."

439101748.m_KeyValue: ""Applies Temporal Dislocation to any unit, returning them to their original position and orientation at the beginning of the current round (status effects remain unchanged).""

439225402.m_KeyValue: ""Major Arcana Card No. 10. Dalcarlo's Divination: _$$Wading through the dark, truth is gradually revealed._$$""

439681650.m_KeyValue: "Units within the Spore Circle are inflicted with All DMG Taken Up (Moderate) until they leave the area."

440232125.m_KeyValue: "If only I were stronger... If only I were a bit older..."

440720131.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, the stories behind those two... Well, this letter would run far too long if I started telling them here.""

440720132.m_KeyValue: "Then what about the three siblings? What do they represent?"

440720133.m_KeyValue: ""A manor slave. Chancellor of Carrelle. The Church's Bell Ringer. And... my personal favorite, _$$the Poet of Flame._$$ That makes four, doesn't it?""

440720134.m_KeyValue: "You were once a slave and a chancellor? Two roles that couldn't be more opposed. It's hard to believe either of them led to the man you are now."

440720135.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, perhaps it's no surprise. I've lived through four identities, and the last is to become the Bell Ringer that the world now knows. No wonder people talk.""

440720136.m_KeyValue: "Four identities. Four names. That explains where the rumors began."

440720137.m_KeyValue: ""My friend, you really do have a sharp tongue.""

440720138.m_KeyValue: "My past burns hotter than flame. You'd do well to tread carefully."

440720139.m_KeyValue: "Is this how all inquisitors dodge questions?"

441837318.m_KeyValue:
""Attention Lord:
In this Clan Hunt, your Clan achieved Rank {AllianceBattleRank}. Please claim your reward!""

441981951.m_KeyValue: "No one will say. The entire castle is keeping secrets—even Reese II."

441981957.m_KeyValue: "Good guess. But she is no one's wife."

441981958.m_KeyValue: "A dead woman. A strange castle. I assume the place is haunted? Was she the Duke's wife? Or Reese II's?"

441981959.m_KeyValue: "There was a woman… but she died five years ago."

441981962.m_KeyValue: ""Because of this, the Duke's condition has grown worse.""

441981963.m_KeyValue: ""The house is haunted by a former maid. They say her spirit appears at night, endlessly washing laundry.""

441981964.m_KeyValue: "The Duke's wife died in childbirth. Reese II has never married."

443395750.m_KeyValue: "Whether my lady's long-cherished wish might yet be fulfilled..."

443395751.m_KeyValue: "Precisely. A flawless deduction. And to think—I went to such trouble returning Noah to your side."

443395752.m_KeyValue: "Nothing more than a humble butler. One who hopes to see his lady and companions reach the end they seek."

443395753.m_KeyValue: ""But something is wrong. Aside from Joan, I can't sense Ressa... no, Thibault, nor Acappella.""

443395754.m_KeyValue: "Now I understand why the sealed doors opened and why the red door is shut."

443395756.m_KeyValue: "I haven't mastered Death's power. If I lose control... I could hurt you."

443395757.m_KeyValue: "How can you say something that awful so casually...?"

443395758.m_KeyValue: ""That makes sense. Agares must have sought entry into the sealed area, and Joan, as its guardian, tried to stop him.""

443396774.m_KeyValue: ""She withstood several direct hits from me while shielding those two Calamities. Quite the feat, really.""

443396775.m_KeyValue: "A parting gift from Master Albrecht. A true alchemist—far greater than you'll ever be."

443396776.m_KeyValue: "I no longer believe—nor hope—that anyone might understand me."

443396778.m_KeyValue: ""Go with anyone who can help you escape this place, and stop Cain...""

443396780.m_KeyValue: "When the Blood Moon descends... To rule the world!"

443396781.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia, stop this! Let's put an end to this meaningless slaughter!""

443396782.m_KeyValue: ""You've known, long before I, that this is where Mother rests.""

443396783.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, save your breath! The fact is you've arrived here with all four Moonblessed, in preparation for Mother's awakening!""

444349438.m_KeyValue: ""Keep watching, Silver-haired. The memories ahead may well unravel the mysteries that trouble you.""

444349445.m_KeyValue: ""Patience, Silver-haired. The answer will come to you in time.""

444349447.m_KeyValue: ""It was my first alchemical creation, and thus bound to have certain flaws beyond my ability to recognize.""

444349448.m_KeyValue: ""The memories plunged into darkness, and I could see nothing at all.""

444349449.m_KeyValue: "This liquid's hue appears richer than before."

444349450.m_KeyValue: "Have you seen the other bottle I sent you? It too holds a fragment of the past."

444349451.m_KeyValue: "So you've grasped the flaws of the first liquid. Your true purpose reaches beyond simply having me chronicle the past to find a cure for Black Blood."

444349452.m_KeyValue: "I've refined the materials and adjusted the procedure—this formula should prove far more stable than its predecessor."

444830510.m_KeyValue: ""Immune to Control, DMG Down, ATK SPD Down effects other than Taunt and Silence.""

445200039.m_KeyValue: "Prophecies are cages. Those bound to them live as puppets—enacting what was never theirs to choose."

445200040.m_KeyValue: "What about the good ones? Omens of peace and victory... you don't want to know about those either?"

445200041.m_KeyValue: "Prophecies about me... I don't believe they'll lead to a peaceful end."

445200042.m_KeyValue: ""But in my story, one thing is absolutely certain—it was you, Quinn, who stopped this endless war.""

445200044.m_KeyValue: "Then this time... I'll turn the prophecy into reality."

445201185.m_KeyValue: "Now... I shall become the vessel to tame these all-consuming flames..."

445201191.m_KeyValue: ""Fool! Soul Pyre feeds on life and obsession. Charge into it, and you will only stoke its fury!""

445201192.m_KeyValue: "Don't make me laugh! What is it now? You try to put out the fire with your own body?"

445201194.m_KeyValue: ""What a shame, these flames consume everything!""

445201195.m_KeyValue: "Therefore... I can absorb the fury of the fire... and soothe its rage..."

445201196.m_KeyValue: ""And the Crowley bloodline, passed down from my mother... has the power... to take in all evil and harm...""

445201197.m_KeyValue: "Within me dwells the undying spirit of the Baphomet… And Soul Pyre... it empowers me."

445845048.m_KeyValue: "Feuler has brought a letter from the Church."

445878809.m_KeyValue: "I'm giving you three days. Return to the castle within that time."

445919521.m_KeyValue: "This is clearly a job for the brilliant Acappella."

445919522.m_KeyValue: ""I-I was just... No... The plan has already failed, hasn't it?!""

445919523.m_KeyValue: "You know... I think you might know a bit too much."

445919526.m_KeyValue: ""This is exactly how the capture plan was meant to go, and it worked perfectly.""

445919527.m_KeyValue: "Acappella lowers her voice while making repeated eye signals."

445919528.m_KeyValue: ""Come on, I'm a Bell Ringer after all.""

445988788.m_KeyValue: ""(In the depths of night, I returned to my room. The furnishings, though familiar, held subtle differences from memory—enough to stir disquiet in my heart.)""

447198517.m_KeyValue: "My memories? But where must I go..."

447198518.m_KeyValue: ""So you want me to take part in restoring the Bathory family, and the key to this restoration lies in finding all the Moonblessed?""

447198519.m_KeyValue: ""As you seek out the Moonblessed and grow the family's strength, I shall transform your influence into a reward that ensures your path remains untroubled.""

447198552.m_KeyValue: ""Begin your Odyssey without concern. I shall attend to the castle's affairs—after all, I am quite the capable 'steward.'""

447740210.m_KeyValue: "Breaking crystals slows Phantom of Aeon's Hypertension buildup while reducing its ATK and DEF."

447839485.m_KeyValue: "Aside from the First Holy War in ancient times..."

447839486.m_KeyValue: ""You must be Sirene of the Shadow Cloak, a Bathory Elder who fought in the Second Holy War.""

447839493.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, but my wardrobe doesn't have room for such niche little trinkets.""

447839494.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, isn't it the Church you truly want to bring to heel?""

447839495.m_KeyValue: "Tch... And you think those filthy Church mutts are worthy of such a prize?"

447839496.m_KeyValue: ""Honestly, just their scent alone makes my skin crawl.""

447839497.m_KeyValue: "Judging by your reaction... the two factions I saw in those memories must be the Bloodborn and the Church."

447839499.m_KeyValue: ""My dear Noah, don't pretend indifference while trying to pry into your master's affairs.""

447839500.m_KeyValue: ""I've reviewed the records. There were only two major, full-scale wars between the Bloodborn and the Church.""

448193731.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll wait for the day your painting is complete."

448193732.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you asked me for paint."

448193733.m_KeyValue: ""And as Acappella's Vice-Commander—if I lose that strength, I can't protect her.""

448193734.m_KeyValue: ""But over time, I began to forget.""

448193735.m_KeyValue: "If you don't mind… tell me what's on your mind. Consider it payment."

448345216.m_KeyValue: ""Elongates its blade and strikes at the target, dealing strong P. DMG to all enemies in a rectangle.""

448752631.m_KeyValue: ""To unbind a third-party account, you must first log in and authorize this action.""

449196416.m_KeyValue: "Set the pointers to the position indicated in the hint."

449786706.m_KeyValue: ""<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link> to release a shockwave that deals moderate DMG to all enemies and triggers Knockback. Regenerates the Crystal and the Stone. If Heir of Zagon takes strong DMG while <link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channeling</u></color></link>, it becomes interrupted and enters a weakened state.""

449786711.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak P. DMG to the target."

449786712.m_KeyValue: ""Slams the ground with right hand, dealing moderate P. DMG to all enemies. Cannot be triggered if the crystal is destroyed. Crystal takes reduced P. DMG.""

449786713.m_KeyValue: ""Randomly selects an enemy and casts the Stone with left hand, dealing massive P. DMG and inflicting Stun. Cannot be used if the Stone is destroyed. Stone takes reduced M. DMG.""

450103667.m_KeyValue: ""Tertius Baphomet enters a charging state. After a period, he unleashes a powerful Slash that deals strong M. DMG to all enemies in a rectangle.""

450103669.m_KeyValue: ""Tertius Baphomet is immune to Control, ATK SPD Down, and DMG Dealt Down effects. When Tertius Baphomet's HP drops by a certain amount, summons a Shield Spirit or Blade Spirit to assist in battle.""

450103671.m_KeyValue:
""Tertius Baphomet enters Soul Dominion Stance and summons 6 Pike Spirits onto the battlefield. Tertius Baphomet targets the Vassal with the lowest HP, continuously launching spear attacks that deal strong M. DMG to the target.
During Soul Dominion Stance, Tertius Baphomet cannot be targeted and gains Invincibility. Pike Spirits also continuously attack Tertius Baphomet's selected target. Eliminating all Pike Spirits will force Tertius Baphomet to exit Soul Dominion stance.""

450103672.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak M. DMG to the target."

450971340.m_KeyValue: "The swirling crimson mist and cries of fallen soldiers echoing inside Starfall Valley still haunt the mind of its former master— a chilling testament to their tragic past."

451832584.m_KeyValue: ""You took the Lord's coin and gifts, and pledged—""

451832586.m_KeyValue: "The one walking with those wealthy folk. I saw her with them after Joan collapsed last time as well."

451832587.m_KeyValue: ""You arranged to meet that slave here, didn't you?""

453248032.m_KeyValue: "We eagerly await the choices you will make."

453275214.m_KeyValue: "I retrieved that old relic while you slept. There's no need for you to carry that burden anymore."

454574365.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Save the introductions—That woman is clearly no ordinary enemy!"

454574367.m_KeyValue: "Four Moonblessed. Four drops of Dracula's Blood. That is the key to reaching the Far Side of the moon."

454574368.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps he meant let you leave. His true goal remains unclear, but the result is certain:""

454574371.m_KeyValue: "What Noah means… is that many an odyssey ends where it first began."

454574372.m_KeyValue: ""Sealed area? That name… sounds familiar. Like I heard it once, a long time ago...""

454574373.m_KeyValue: ""They got the hang of their powers later than you, but look at them—way better at using them.""

454574374.m_KeyValue: "What a polite way of saying you're off to fetch backup because you know you can't win."

454577573.m_KeyValue: ""If you're talking about Gadric, he doesn't die so easily.""

454577574.m_KeyValue: "I clearly smelled garlic… but where is he?"

454774334.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood was never some divine punishment, it's a <style=""Highlight"">disease</style> that infects all living things.""

454774335.m_KeyValue: "What about the Bloodborn? We only seek blood in order to survive. Are we not justified?"

454775358.m_KeyValue: "They can still move? I need to get out of here..."

455503874.m_KeyValue: ""Next client... Well, give him an easy one.""

455503875.m_KeyValue: ""Elder Bella has left her seat, but the collections must continue!""

455524922.m_KeyValue: "Continue exploring other areas for more rewards."

455775865.m_KeyValue: ""Your father, then lord of the isle, allowed them to settle in the coastal waters, since they could no longer return to their homeland.""

455775866.m_KeyValue: "To the day we all lost the ones we loved most..."

455775867.m_KeyValue: ""All those years of experiments—meant to save her... Yet in the end, it was my experiments that killed her.""

455775868.m_KeyValue: "And what I saw... was a living hell."

455775869.m_KeyValue: "See her again—only when you can do so as a human."

455775895.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Bella, there's more to this story...""

455775897.m_KeyValue: "In my memory... this isn't the place. Could it be this room?"

455775899.m_KeyValue: "Isaac… could he be Van Helsing? Selena said she couldn't find him anywhere—so he’s been here all along."

455775900.m_KeyValue: "Silver-haired...? Are you... another dream of mine?"

455775901.m_KeyValue: ""Three. As for the others—one lies with Ami, one's whereabouts remain unknown, and one is held by Hallon, leader of the Seven Sages.""

455775902.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you the puppet from the auction?"

455775903.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't it too risky to confront Lord Hallon directly? Are you sure you don't need more preparation, Lord Isaac?""

455775904.m_KeyValue: ""Since it has come to this, Isaac... will you grant me one final request, for the sake of our blood?""

455776152.m_KeyValue: "I came back to Sapphire Isle.. to fulfill a <style="Highlight">promise</style>..."

455776159.m_KeyValue: ""It's not your turn to shine yet, Jacintha.""

455776160.m_KeyValue: ""So cold! We have a contract, my little Bella!""

455776161.m_KeyValue: "My heart brims with newfound hope... though my head remains as stubborn as wood."

455776162.m_KeyValue: "And how exactly do we steer the story?"

455776163.m_KeyValue: "I've heard that even beasts can become human through the power of love. Surely the same must hold true for a puppet?"

455776166.m_KeyValue: "So that's why Lord Albrecht used that technique..."

455776186.m_KeyValue: ""Also... maybe I was mistaken, but just before she lost consciousness, she seemed to hide something beneath the table.""

455776194.m_KeyValue: "E-Everything about that... promise is... is missing from my mind."

455776195.m_KeyValue: "Lorelei used the legend of the Mistbound Terror to discreetly eliminate several of her guild partners. That had already drawn suspicion from the other Sages—which is why she rushed to set her plan in motion."

455776197.m_KeyValue: "And what’s that strange thread on her head?"

455776198.m_KeyValue: "A doll with a master... must return to the Master."

455776223.m_KeyValue: "Is this Mr. Thoreau's definition of etiquette—kidnapping the very partner you handpicked yourself?"

455776224.m_KeyValue: "That gleaming stone brought us here for a reason... And that person... there's something unsettling about them."

455776225.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Van Helsing, is this mission issued under your personal authority—or in the name of the Seven Sages?""

455776226.m_KeyValue: ""With such trust placed in me, how could I possibly refuse?""

455776229.m_KeyValue: "You're using Goldland's body? Where is Ami? What have you done with her?"

455776259.m_KeyValue: "So people with thick skin really do live..."

455776261.m_KeyValue: "If only I could become a Bell Ringer one day..."

455776262.m_KeyValue: "Can I have a pearl? We'll engrave our names on it—then we'll be best friends forever. No splitting up."

455776283.m_KeyValue: "Little Bella! If that's the case—I know where the next one is!"

455776284.m_KeyValue: "That instrument we heard in the city—the one at the church."

455776287.m_KeyValue: "We haven't identified who placed it or what it does. No one's dared to move it without orders."

455776288.m_KeyValue: ""A sweet essence slithers like a sea serpent in hiding, coiling through every nerve, severing each signal from brain to limb. From this moment on, you need not trouble yourself with life's burdens, love's failures, or the work left unfinished after twenty-three relentless hours.""

455776289.m_KeyValue: "I can't save everyone. Only my dearest kin... And you."

455776290.m_KeyValue: ""You mentioned earlier that you need to collect all the Siren's Tears, right?""

455776291.m_KeyValue: ""I'll pass. I have no use for anything that dulls the mind or weakens the will, and this place isn't entirely safe either.""

455776292.m_KeyValue: "Hey! This is the part where you ask what is this secret about!"

455776293.m_KeyValue: ""You must think it's one of the Seven Sages too, right?""

455776294.m_KeyValue: "But... Lord Hallon gave you a potion refined from the Siren's Tear! If you don't become the ruler of the Isle and gather the Tears to break the illusion..."

455776317.m_KeyValue: "The script is on track—just as planned. Time for us to move backstage."

455776318.m_KeyValue: "I swear on my honor as a troupe owner!"

455776319.m_KeyValue: ""No, no—my back gave out in the last battle! For the sake of your grand mission, you must... leave me behind!""

455776321.m_KeyValue: "The person in the wanted poster... really does look like you. It says Ami and Noah are accomplices of the Mistbound Terror."

455776322.m_KeyValue: "Then let us set forth—toward our objective!"

455776323.m_KeyValue: "You—! Weren't you supposed to be dead?"

455776324.m_KeyValue: ""Since the Isle's reconstruction, the Sage Council has always stood for fairness—justice!""

455776325.m_KeyValue: ""This man, Noah, must not be underestimated. He poses a grave threat.""

455776326.m_KeyValue: "Have you made progress in your investigation?"

455776349.m_KeyValue: "This memory… I remember now. I was the one who killed..."

455776351.m_KeyValue: ""The most dangerous place is often the safest. If he's still alive, then he's hiding among the sirens, in the prison.""

455776353.m_KeyValue: "Oh—Joyce doesn't understand a word of that!"

455776354.m_KeyValue: ""Officially, it was to 'reduce the risk of organized resistance among the slaves.'""

455776356.m_KeyValue: "Take the door on the left marked with the Tidewisp marker."

455776357.m_KeyValue: ""To think a place like this hides an old, broken ship...""

455776358.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, isn't it? I was recently told that Sapphire Isle used to be impoverished...""

456066608.m_KeyValue: ""'...Ah, the Goldland statue is upside down,' Noah's sharp eyes immediately realizing what was truly bothering Goldland.""

460141031.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Defeat as many Bloodborn as possible.</style>
Bloodborn have high M. DEF. Use the Seal <style=""Highlight"">Tainted Blood</style> and deal <style=""Highlight"">P. DMG</style> to defeat them faster.
Top Picks: Van Helsing, Agnes, Sirene, Timeless Aiona""

460499786.m_KeyValue: "Have you decided on your next move?"

460637456.m_KeyValue:
""I used to mistakenly believe that those versed in music theory were _$$quiet and composed_$$—until Acappella came along.

Perhaps it's because a Bell Ringer's duties are too monotonous, or maybe the Church's discipline is too rigid and suffocating, but I can always sense her boundless energy looking for an outlet.

They say that after becoming a Bell Ringer, Acappella's physical form has remained eternally youthful, frozen in her teenage years. It seems her mentality has stayed the same as well...""

460637522.m_KeyValue:
""Through my inquiries, I learned of the mysterious curse that haunts Piera and her bloodline.

Because of it, members of the Paracelsus family rarely live to old age—elders are a rarity, and partings come far too soon. From childhood, Piera grew up surrounded by illness and last goodbyes.

One quiet afternoon years ago, she held her mother's cold hands and bid farewell to the last of her kin. From that day on, she took it upon herself to prepare the dead for their final rest.
Perhaps, by then, Piera had already come to see farewell as a part of life itself.""

460637615.m_KeyValue:
""I read many accounts of Gadric's heroic deeds in a southern lord's castle:

When he entered the castle, everyone assumed he was a jester performing an act.

The winter sun reflected off his cumbersome armor, causing concern that the wearer might suffocate in the stifling metal shell at any moment.

He seemed to have lost his sense of sight and smell long ago, yet in battle, the long stalk on his helmet stood like a spear in the snow-laden wind, unmoved, serving as his eyes and nose.

He pointed at a guest attending the gathering and shouted, then struck them down with speed unfitting for his bulk, revealing their blood-red eyes and sharp fangs—unmistakable signs of a Bloodborn.""

460637646.m_KeyValue:
""The Death card lies in a cat's nest atop the castle tower, nestled among silk fabric with golden embroidery—now gray with age and heavy with memories of days long past. Nearby sits a century-old toy, adorned with rubies and emeralds.

Among the treasures, there is a pure gold pendant, etched with the relief of a fearless woman. Beneath, the name 'Limine Bathory' is engraved.""

460637704.m_KeyValue: ""I found a metal fragment in a corner of the castle. It resembled the ritual tool Aiona wore atop her head. Empousa once told me that when she first met Aiona, her ritual tool was damaged. Back then, Empousa eagerly proposed forging a powerful new tool—one that could cut through iron without a sound—using meteorite iron from Starfall Valley, blessed by the celestial powers of the Tarot, and quenched in the spring waters of the Ashen Garden. But Aiona always hesitated.""

461062485.m_KeyValue: ""This is your fault, isn't it?! Cutting down my yard time! Even chained, I could still pound you into the dirt!""

461668229.m_KeyValue: ""You long to end it all, yet you dare not dishonor their sacrifice with an easy death.""

461668230.m_KeyValue: "But that rite is for Bell Ringers and their Vice-Commanders!"

461668231.m_KeyValue: ""From the shadows, a corpulent figure drifts forth, like a phantom conjured from darkness itself.""

461668232.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, but Miss Seraphina's eyes—so heavy with shadow. Quite unlike Joyce, of course. Joyce has no eyes at all! Hahaha!""

462463649.m_KeyValue: "A disability is no reason for such treatment."

462463652.m_KeyValue: "For a slave? Eat with your filthy hands."

462463654.m_KeyValue: "I think... I understand the meaning of these sounds."

462463681.m_KeyValue: "Ah—something strange is happening to Joyce's body!"

462463682.m_KeyValue: "Move it! The selection has already begun!"

462463683.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#b39cb7>Such beauty must be worth 'recording,' don't you think?</color>""

462463684.m_KeyValue: ""Once we reveal the truth, that’s your cue to enter.""

462463686.m_KeyValue: "Did I just make such a cool speech?! Father will definitely praise me!"

462463687.m_KeyValue: "Monocle? Why are you calling me a monocle?"

462463945.m_KeyValue: ""At this pace, you're still far from winning the grand prize.""

462463946.m_KeyValue: "Weren't we… here to investigate someone in the area who resembles Goldland…?"

462463948.m_KeyValue: ""But if... if I could find Master Van Helsing, then maybe...""

462463949.m_KeyValue: ""You…! You're nothing but lowborn rabble, yet you dare defy me! I—""

462463950.m_KeyValue: "We're in no hurry... Let's order twenty more skewers of squid while we wait."

462463951.m_KeyValue: "I don't believe you! My master would never work with a heretic. Unless... you can tell me one of his secrets!"

462463972.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I'll take care of the payment.""

462463977.m_KeyValue: ""Not only that, she's also one of the Seven Sages who reformed the institutions of Sapphire Isle with an iron will.""

462463978.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! At Sapphire Isle, people might splash you with blessed seawater at any moment—such attire is absolutely necessary!""

462463979.m_KeyValue: "Please don't trouble yourself. I've already prepared my vacation attire."

462463980.m_KeyValue: ""Since you're Miss Lorelei's guests, please feel free to choose any outfit you like.""

462463981.m_KeyValue: ""From Francis Justinian's unfinished painting 'No. 198.4' to the legendary wine glass used by the Bell Ringer of Light, the Sapphire Isle Auction House offers an impressive array of extraordinary items.""

462463984.m_KeyValue: "Would you like to try fighting the sirens?"

462464012.m_KeyValue: ""I'm so hungry... While everyone's asleep, I'll sneak some food prepared for tomorrow's guests.""

462464038.m_KeyValue: "I can't help but feel her friendliness toward us is excessive. It's hard not to suspect she has other motives... though I hope I'm just overthinking it."

462464046.m_KeyValue: ""Why isn't he here?! W-What's going on, did he find me too troublesome and leave me behind?""

462464048.m_KeyValue: "Noah might have been beaten to a pulp by then! Where is that Mr. Savich anyway?"

462464077.m_KeyValue: ""To silently endure the poisoned arrows of fate, or to rise against the endless suffering of this world?""

462464078.m_KeyValue: ""The Isle, the beach, and this mysterious 'auction house'—what a perfect summer vacation spot. I'll take care of the expenses like before.""

462464079.m_KeyValue: "I just want to be of use... Master's affairs are my affairs too. Please let me join you!"

462464103.m_KeyValue: "The fog is getting thicker. Let me escort you back."

462464104.m_KeyValue: "If we can't find the victim's body... will we be trapped in this dream forever?"

462464106.m_KeyValue: "The goddess with scales and blindfold—these are symbols of 'justice' and 'fairness.'"

462464107.m_KeyValue: "...offering prices 10% lower than the Seven Sage Association... please consider our proposal..."

462464108.m_KeyValue: "Master's two guns are also named Aphrodite and Eros."

462464110.m_KeyValue: ""'Summer Concerto Sheet Music,' '137th Meeting Summary,' 'Comparative Analysis of Acorellia Highlands Cashmere and Long-haired Cashmere'... None of these are...""

462464112.m_KeyValue: "You were never this dull when you were still active in the 'Assassin's world.'"

462464135.m_KeyValue: "Listen to the voice in the deepest depths of your heart—"

462464138.m_KeyValue: "You won't have to lay your eyes on a single beast."

462464140.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami has uncovered even this? How very admirable."

462464141.m_KeyValue: "Did you already know Viktor Thoreau? No wonder Lorelei treated you all so well..."

462464142.m_KeyValue: ""One moment, I am Miss Ami's advisor.""

462464143.m_KeyValue: "Completely unconvincing... Didn't the victim have curly hair?"

463270686.m_KeyValue: ""On this journey to pursue the light, will you join me?""

463276373.m_KeyValue: ""Be mine, and I'll give you what she could never.""

463278547.m_KeyValue: "Um... can I get a bit closer? There's this familiar scent..."

463279382.m_KeyValue: ""With you around, even work won't be too dull.""

463279541.m_KeyValue: ""When believers get this zealous, it really puts the gods in a bind.""

463280690.m_KeyValue: "Am I now worthy to face the flames?"

463280721.m_KeyValue: "If only I could have met you sooner... as the person I once was."

463281556.m_KeyValue: "This restlessness... Why can I not quell it...?"

463281715.m_KeyValue: "Can you feel the moon's shadow enveloping you?"

463282895.m_KeyValue: ""In you, I sense a presence akin to that of the divine...""

463283730.m_KeyValue: "Do you wish to meld into the shadows with me?"

463283889.m_KeyValue: ""What is closer to immortality - eternity, or the void?""

463285904.m_KeyValue: "This familiar sunset view has become so beautiful. It must be because you're by my side."

463329125.m_KeyValue: ""The arcane rites of the ancients. Originally intended for self-enhancement, they were soon apprehended by the Bloodborn. After many massacres, the ultimate secret behind the ritual would be discovered: By offering souls similar in essence to the ritual's subject, the purest form of ancestral power could be harnessed.""

463728893.m_KeyValue: "...Do you want to see them again?"

463728896.m_KeyValue: ""(Ah, so that's how Stella sees her...)""

464747934.m_KeyValue: ""Artifact Guards patrol back and forth through the chambers. Each footstep lands with precision, as if measuring this territory that belongs only to faith and future.""

465489923.m_KeyValue: "The day when torrential floods descended from the heavens."

465489989.m_KeyValue: "The day blossoms flourish and branches bend with fruit."

465490218.m_KeyValue: ""The Nones of January, when the sky smoldered with flame.""

466803566.m_KeyValue: ""Are you kidding me!? I just finished reporting to the Church, and you all ran off without me! I finally caught up, and now you're leaving again!?""

466803575.m_KeyValue: "But at least this way Noah will survive..."

466803578.m_KeyValue: ""But seriously, why were those dreamfeeders attacking me!? I don’t even look like a longing... huh?""

466803579.m_KeyValue: "Hah... I should've known. Ressa handled it already."

466803580.m_KeyValue: "Don't call me a child! Death and the Valkyrie are one thing—but there’s no way you’re older than me!"

466803581.m_KeyValue: "I know you two! The warrior and the child with the Bell Ringer!"

466805744.m_KeyValue: ""Now it's just the two of us, Noah…""

466805751.m_KeyValue: "I heard you drove Albrecht away again?"

466805753.m_KeyValue: ""Yet before us, she says nothing. She merely stands... unmoving. Watching.""

466805754.m_KeyValue: ""But next time you speak to me, lose that smile.""

466805756.m_KeyValue: ""One bell toll has passed. Let me speak with him alone, would you?""

466805757.m_KeyValue: "The man who executed you. A Bell Ringer of absolute authority."

466806279.m_KeyValue: ""Go easy, and we can call it a warm-up.""

466806281.m_KeyValue: "Still—thanks for keeping your word. I'll be off."

466806375.m_KeyValue: "Reading myths about other gods is a serious breach of doctrine."

466806376.m_KeyValue: "I parry her relentless strikes with ease and answer with a devastating counter."

466806377.m_KeyValue: ""The evening breeze threads through the forest, cooler than before.""

466806378.m_KeyValue: "I can't shake the feeling you're planning another ambush."

466807926.m_KeyValue: ""Even without my memories, I never forgot the promise I made.""

466807927.m_KeyValue: "But it seems you haven't forgotten our promise."

466807929.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry to keep you waiting... I'm back, Ressa. Piera.""

466807932.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Noah... I wish I could be there with you.""

466807933.m_KeyValue: "Though something has changed. You seem more mature than when we first met."

466810100.m_KeyValue: ""Because it's that Noah who gave me the courage to face my fate, isn't it?""

466810101.m_KeyValue: "The Noah I know never hesitates or wavers..."

466810102.m_KeyValue: "Hesitation... that's not the Noah I know..."

466810103.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps beyond death lies only darkness, but for those behind you, it becomes a door to the future.""

466810104.m_KeyValue: ""As life fades, the remains left behind nourish the land, ushering in new life.""

466810105.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, Death took many lives, but it also allowed everyone who once lived on Sunset Isle to have the most beautiful farewell.""

466810106.m_KeyValue: ""You'll always be Noah Nevernight, the Noah we all know.""

466810108.m_KeyValue: ""If I use this power, I might transform into Death...""

469117778.m_KeyValue: ""'I see.' Gadric lowered his head, took a bite of his sandwich, and chewed slowly, lost in his memories.""

469117780.m_KeyValue: ""'When did he say that?' Gadric asked, gulping down the last of his wine and swallowing a mouthful of sandwich.""

469117781.m_KeyValue: ""'It must have been you who won, right? Father said he couldn't beat you.'""

469608662.m_KeyValue: ""Clear [The Black Mist] and complete [Cosmic Singularity] to obtain the event item _$$Rough Silver Coin,_$$ which can be redeemed at [Clouded Outpost] for abundant rewards.""

469608664.m_KeyValue: ""Clear [Heart of Darkness] and complete [Cosmic Singularity] to obtain the event item _$$Gilded Insignia,_$$ which can be redeemed at [Joyce's Sundries] for abundant rewards.""

470256012.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps it was fate that guided me to write this letter, and fate that brought it to you.""

470256013.m_KeyValue: "This is the first time I've received... a gift I truly love."

470256016.m_KeyValue: ""Not knowing what you like, I found a handcrafted lamb at the market. I'm sending it along with this letter—please accept it as my birthday gift to you.""

470256017.m_KeyValue: "All I did was offer some personal advice."

470256018.m_KeyValue: ""We have many lambs in our family's pasture, and I often spend my free time playing with them.""

470256019.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you so much! Actually, lambs are my favorite animals!""

471034410.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'granting full rights to the recreated vassals'?"

471036588.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'investing a certain amount of money and manpower to diversify the castle's menu'?"

471039659.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'convicting vassals who have close associations with the kingdom'?"

472363827.m_KeyValue:
""A fancy chalice filled with starry liquid, served to Ancestral Vassals. Fancy meal, moderately heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Can this really be called _$$food_$$?""

472363828.m_KeyValue:
""An exquisite chalice filled with starry liquid, served to Ancestral Vassals. Luxury meal, greatly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Some seek out the flavors; others give up.""

472363830.m_KeyValue:
""A small flask filled with starry liquid, served to Ancestral Vassals. Simple meal, slightly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>There must be light, no matter how dim it is.""

472462036.m_KeyValue: ""'Tell us! Tell us!' Hati suddenly leaned in, then realized this matter wasn't as glorious as Empousa had made it out to be.""

472462037.m_KeyValue: ""'On second thought, forget it,' Empousa said, waving her hand dismissively. 'I couldn't care less about all that war stuff anyway.'""

472462038.m_KeyValue: "Jestel let out a heavy sigh. 'But the Ganelon family is no more. We can't allow that chapter of history to simply fade into oblivion.'"

476138067.m_KeyValue: "I'll kill you. I swear I'll kill you!"

476138070.m_KeyValue: "Joan led us to break the chains the nobles had bound us with."

476712776.m_KeyValue: ""As I've said, she's far more perceptive than we give her credit for.""

476712777.m_KeyValue: "I'm fading away soon enough. I don’t want my final memory to be of her looking sad."

476712778.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Thank you, Sheila. Please pass on my gratitude to Father and the others as well._$$""

476712779.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, before today, Sheila came to me and asked me to keep his existence a secret.""

476756704.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Gadric, what brings you to a place like this? You don't seem to be related to the Ganelons.""

476756705.m_KeyValue: "You look like a garlic to me."

476757635.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Gadric said he was heading to the town, but...""

476757638.m_KeyValue: "He clearly went the wrong way. That's the direction we came from."

476757862.m_KeyValue: "Toying with you? I might even say I'm the one being toyed with."

476759743.m_KeyValue: "I was just about to ask... What exactly are you here for?"

476759843.m_KeyValue: ""...Hati, it seems your father truly loves you very much.""

476759844.m_KeyValue: ""Oh... yeah, I guess. But you've never met.""

476759846.m_KeyValue: ""Since I was little, my father has been very protective of me, saying I must never get injured or bleed. So I've always been careful not to get infected with the Black Blood...""

479300346.m_KeyValue: ""Survival or death, good or evil—it all comes down to a single choice.""

480895385.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no, he seems to have completely lost control!""

481353513.m_KeyValue: "She's in high spirits. Just indulge her little games for now."

481353525.m_KeyValue: ""I came here expecting to carry out a simple cleansing. Instead, it looks like I'll be escorting a whole group of survivors back home.""

481353526.m_KeyValue: "Seal the wind itself? The earth would wither into a barren wasteland."

481354543.m_KeyValue: ""Until then, if you choose to weep, you will rust into worthless scrap.""

481354544.m_KeyValue: ""As she hesitates, grotesquely twisted forms emerge from the mist.""

481354550.m_KeyValue: "Hello! Is someone there? I heard voices!"

482149020.m_KeyValue: "Word from my kin there—the alchemist's water has been defiled!"

483026551.m_KeyValue: "The First Summer on Sapphire Isle Rewards"

483174789.m_KeyValue: ""After a while, deals massive DMG to the carrier and inflicts Sleep for {1} sec.""

485477734.m_KeyValue: "Only Vassals eligible for Dispatch are displayed."

485972414.m_KeyValue: ""Though the Church has explicitly banned alchemical research, for the Bloodborn, it remains an essential means of self-enhancement, regardless of the risks.""

486833029.m_KeyValue:
""Clear Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II Fragment 8 to randomly obtain equipment from the following. 
<alpha=#80>Time erodes the husks of monsters, but the legacy of battle echoes eternally.""

487005998.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, do you know about Baphomet's abilities? Jestel...?""

487007022.m_KeyValue: "He's the first one I've encountered whose actions completely exceed my expectations."

487012004.m_KeyValue: ""But looking at his battle with Cidhall, that body seems to have potential.""

487013027.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa may have broken the tenets, but it was to save a Moonblessed. If we explain that to the elders...""

487013028.m_KeyValue: ""So I understand even less about how great these tenets you speak of are, or how formidable these so-called elders can be.""

487014182.m_KeyValue: ""As the first heir, you should know better than anyone the consequences of your actions.""

487016095.m_KeyValue: ""Shut up, you're too loud. If you want to keep babbling, let that rusty heap of armor you call a body come out itself.""

487016096.m_KeyValue: "This is the secret that the young lady works so hard to keep."

487017119.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you just said we two are in some kind of relationship now?""

489405101.m_KeyValue: "I just wanted to send you on a pointless errand."

489405102.m_KeyValue: ""It was in the hands of a sailor from the El Dorado, corrupted by Black Blood. Even after losing his will, he still held onto this drawing with all his strength.""

489899995.m_KeyValue: "Me too! I like Colossus Max and the hat lady!"

490449917.m_KeyValue: "We are blessed with something close to eternity... are we not?"

490449918.m_KeyValue: "That would be... difficult. But I did say I strive to be a dutiful butler. And if it is my lady's wish..."

490449919.m_KeyValue: "Unless... They faced something they never expected."

490449920.m_KeyValue: "The gray door is meant for Noah. And the red one... the one already closed..."

490449921.m_KeyValue: "Then let's pick from the remaining three and stick together!"

490449922.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... you will return to us, won't you? I absolutely forbid you to...""

490449923.m_KeyValue: "Then what are we waiting for?! We have to stop him!"

490449924.m_KeyValue: "The gate to the sealed area's been forced open too. Just like when the forbidden grounds back home was breached..."

490449926.m_KeyValue: "It appears there was a fierce battle. Everything's been burned... utterly destroyed."

490450942.m_KeyValue: ""He's right. On my own, I can only track his presence—stopping him is another matter...""

490450943.m_KeyValue: ""No—you'll been officially eliminated, just like your _$$sisters_$$ before you.""

490450944.m_KeyValue: ""Always pretending to be naive, always playing the fool—when in truth, you see more than anyone else. But you keep it to yourself.""

490450945.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I'll stand for it no longer... Always pretending to be different, always fantasizing about _$$free_$$ will...""

490450946.m_KeyValue: ""I thought we were clear on your role as sacrifices... or rather, _$$vessels._$$""

490450947.m_KeyValue: ""Now that the Divine Body here has been destroyed, the sealed area has merged once more with our castle, and Mother's resting place is exposed...""

490450948.m_KeyValue: "—This is the only way Bloodborn can reproduce!"

490450949.m_KeyValue: "Where's Aiona? And Noah... Where are they?"

490450950.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Back to our homeland, on the far side of the moon._$$""
