492253174.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, Quinn... do you remember your younger days? You'd ask if the stories were true—that gargoyles become red petals when they die…""

492253175.m_KeyValue: ""O' my gargoyle, may your petals never fall...""

492253182.m_KeyValue: "Now—! While I can still control myself—! Destroy—me—!!"

492253183.m_KeyValue: "What signal... what use of that when you're gone?"

492253184.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, you won't be able to hold on like this...""

492253186.m_KeyValue: ""The link flows both ways—not only do you take on others' wounds, they can share your pain too.""

492253187.m_KeyValue: "Your bloodline power... it lets you channel damage through a mental link!"

492253188.m_KeyValue: ""Take my hand, let me help you!""

492253189.m_KeyValue: ""If you truly can't do it to Michelangelo, at least... let me stand with you.""

492254199.m_KeyValue: "Even if there was one... it'd be nothing but scrap metal. Give up..."

492254206.m_KeyValue: "The two Elders… they should've reached the frontlines by now. With power like theirs…"

492254207.m_KeyValue: "It won't take long before people in Mouret become cold bodies."

492254208.m_KeyValue: "Why not stay here and play one last game of hide and seek with me? At least... you can spare yourself from those dreadful scenes..."

492254209.m_KeyValue: "Did she just say this place is called the Timeworn Mausoleum...?"

492254210.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, if I'm not mistaken, this name indicates the nature of time.""

492254211.m_KeyValue: ""Time's nature, circle, time... and what Cain said... there must be a connection between these.""

492254212.m_KeyValue: ""As a cartographer, you have a unique insight into the structures of time and space.""

492254213.m_KeyValue: ""Remember this: Time is a circle, two faces meeting as one. The beginning is also the end. Therefore—""

492255358.m_KeyValue: "If we hit the stone pillars... what will happen?"

492255359.m_KeyValue: "What signal... what use of that when you're gone?"

492255360.m_KeyValue: "The signal... remember the signal I told you before—!"

492255361.m_KeyValue: "There must be a faster way to get there!"

492255365.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't I think of this sooner? It will summon gargoyles of course!"

492255385.m_KeyValue: "Q-Q-Quinn! Why are you in this era?!"

492255390.m_KeyValue: ""That pathetic boy who wept as his father died, powerless to even graze the enemy's hem... he is dead now.""

492255391.m_KeyValue: ""Before you is Jamie Mouret, future Lord of Ganelon, the one to erase the name of Bathory from this world forever.""

492255392.m_KeyValue: "Child... what's happened? You are a new person now."

492255394.m_KeyValue: "Could this Cartographer be talking about... me?"

492255396.m_KeyValue: "'Not all Bloodborn bears pale skin and fangs. I once met a Bloodborn lady—she was the most captivating presence I've ever beheld.'"

492494218.m_KeyValue: "I still don't understand why you want to take her with us."

492494219.m_KeyValue: ""My mission is simple: to save you. You may not remember, but I am not like you. I have wandered the currents of time far too long— Even if I left, I might never find the right place.""

492494220.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, are you certain you still wish to find her? By now, the Church will have filled that place with their weapons.""

492494221.m_KeyValue: ""When she peered into my past, I caught glimpses of hers in return.""

492495242.m_KeyValue: ""I can only say, I'm sorry, truly...""

492495244.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm… I must say, you're the fairest of all who have come this month.""

492495246.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm… a shattered lock? Then I stand corrected—this was no attempted escape, but a successful one.""

492495248.m_KeyValue: ""Spikes pierced flesh, and agony surged over him like a tide.""

492495249.m_KeyValue: ""At least I know my sins are mine, my choices carved by my own hand. But you… even your so-called devotion is not your own.""

493536125.m_KeyValue: ""Their weak forms cannot bear the Black Blood. Mutation will only reduce them to mindless creatures, lost to its corruption.""

493536126.m_KeyValue: "Werewolves... How could the Ganelons harness the mutation powers of the Black Blood?"

493536127.m_KeyValue: "...Are you saying the Ganelon is deliberately turning the mutated villagers into weapons for this war?!"

493536128.m_KeyValue: "They need not become true Bloodborn... All they want is to win this war."

493536129.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't I warn you just hours ago? These vermin... the longer you hesitate, the more they swarm like flies.""

493536130.m_KeyValue: "Why the surprise? The Ganelon's betrayal of its own kind is nothing new."

493536131.m_KeyValue: "Allowing werewolves into Bathory territory—this provocation is unforgivable... and it will not stand."

493536132.m_KeyValue: "I care not for their ways. What truly matters... is that the honor of Bathory must never be tarnished."

493536134.m_KeyValue: ""Blood Servants, heed my call! Assemble at once and defend the front!""

493537149.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Quinn, you deduced that the Long Night is sustained by rituals, yet you never wonder where the ingredients are from?""

493537150.m_KeyValue: "You mean the ritual ingredients are blood... and entrails?"

493537151.m_KeyValue: "Let me be clear: the Long Night is sustained by an abundance of blood. As for the rest… they're not vital."

493537153.m_KeyValue: "My mistake. It's 'dining time' for the Blood Servants."

493537154.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, here's the little traitor who escaped the dungeon this morning. Couldn't stay away, could you?""

493537155.m_KeyValue: "Tsk. Do you see the 'trash' piling up here? It would be decent of us to clear it away."

493537156.m_KeyValue: "The scent of death lures bats to feast..."

493537157.m_KeyValue: "So... these bodies were drained of blood to sustain the Bloodletting."

493537158.m_KeyValue: ""Precisely. The old master hungered for the power of the Long Night, but the Divine Body kept it sealed away. To grant his wish, this ritual was conceived—to undermine the Divine Body and draw forth the power of the Long Night.""

493545853.m_KeyValue: "It's time to prove these stories aren't just legends... they're history."

493545854.m_KeyValue: "And how do you plan to prove that?"

493545861.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, I'm warning you again—stop wasting time on unverified stories. If your grandfather hears about this, I'm the one who'll get scolded.""

493545862.m_KeyValue: "It's not just some story... it’s a legend!"

493545863.m_KeyValue: "Make no assumptions without evidence.' First Rule of Cartography. I've got it memorized."

493545864.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder you keep failing the exams. Just like your last evaluation said: 'lacks research discipline, prone to flights of fancy.'""

493545865.m_KeyValue: "Are you seriously planning to get certified through your grandfather's influence?"

493545868.m_KeyValue: "You're destined to become the greatest cartographer in all of Minexus."

493547007.m_KeyValue: ""It's Wolfsbane. We originally gathered it to treat the plague in town... Though now, it seems we won't be needing it for that anymore.""

493547014.m_KeyValue: "Like this—massage both sides of your head. Nice and gentle. Ten times. Can you do that?"

493547016.m_KeyValue: "You've been asleep a whole day and night. No wonder your head hurts..."

493547018.m_KeyValue: "Ah! I remember now—this one always works!"

493547019.m_KeyValue: ""That's odd. When I had headaches, Father would always massage them like this—and it always helped!""

493547020.m_KeyValue: "You don’t need to fuss. It's nothing new... it'll pass."

493548031.m_KeyValue: ""Is this the Wolfsbane? All I have to do is give it to the patients, right?""

493548037.m_KeyValue: ""You've got time to nap, but not enough to deliver medicine to dying patients?""

493548038.m_KeyValue: ""The more I think about this, the more this feels... deliberate. There's something off here. James, hide for a moment. I'll try to get some answers.""

493548039.m_KeyValue: "Someone's sleeping in a place like this?"

493548040.m_KeyValue: ""That's Johannes. We take turns tending the infected. Lately, there've been so many... He must've been too exhausted to stay awake.""

493548041.m_KeyValue: ""Johannes! I'm new here. The townsfolk said you and James were overworked, so they sent me to change shifts with you!""

493548042.m_KeyValue: ""Shifts? That's perfect! Finally, I can go home and sleep like a rock!""

493548044.m_KeyValue: ""Mmm... don't disturb... Wait, who are you?!""

493549185.m_KeyValue: "Come on! I'll take you to the cave. Maybe we'll find something that helps us learn more about her!"

493549186.m_KeyValue: "Your mother left you that Wolfsbane mark. She must've been someone truly special..."

493549189.m_KeyValue: "So he's the one who locked you in the dungeon all those years just because you wouldn't drink human blood...?"

493549190.m_KeyValue: "Maybe those bats aren't wrong to call me a traitor."

493549191.m_KeyValue: "Jamie... that is enough. He's still my father. And nothing can change that."

493549192.m_KeyValue: "Ugh! I take it back. Impressive? Forget that! Even the finest plating can't hide the rot underneath!"

493549193.m_KeyValue: ""The other Elders said that after I was born, he lost his physical body in the war. His memory and will were bound to that armor to keep him alive.""

493549194.m_KeyValue: ""I-I didn't study much, so... so armored people can have children?!""

493549195.m_KeyValue: "The way he pushed for war today... and so many things he's said over the years... I no longer know if I can agree with any of it."

493549196.m_KeyValue: ""As a child, I thought he was a hero who gave his all for the family. And as his daughter, I tried to honor that. But ever since the patriarch passed... he's changed. He's grown harsher and more violent.""

493550214.m_KeyValue: ""Deep breaths, Agnes… you're a cartographer. You've faced worse. No panicking...""

493550216.m_KeyValue: "What is this…? It's soft… and warm—"

493550217.m_KeyValue: ""Wait… I think I see something—eyes, glowing red, just ahead in the dark...""

493550218.m_KeyValue: "Red eyes... could it be a B-Bloodborn...?"

493550219.m_KeyValue: ""D-don't worry, sir… I'm a licensed cartographer! I've seen all sorts of monsters before—even Calamity-class! A Bloodborn's nothing… L-leave it to me!""

493550220.m_KeyValue: "Your voice is shaking! Drop the act and get behind me!"

493551364.m_KeyValue: ""And that girl in the hood. She bears some resemblance... James, bring her closer. Let me see.""

493551365.m_KeyValue: "Forgotten? No. It's because I remember that I must wipe out every last one of those fanged wretches... before I die."

493551366.m_KeyValue: "You—! Have you forgotten the bloodshed from twenty years ago?! You heartless... (coughing)"

493551367.m_KeyValue: ""If we clung to every vow made to the departed, we'd all be bound by ghosts.""

493551368.m_KeyValue: "What promise must I keep... with the dead?"

493551369.m_KeyValue: "And I haven't forgotten it. But Leila is gone."

493551370.m_KeyValue: "You gave your word to Lady Leila—that you'd never take up arms again."

493551371.m_KeyValue: ""Ezareth, I heard everything! What is this talk of war?""

493552387.m_KeyValue: ""Run away, fool! Or you'll die here too!""

493552388.m_KeyValue: "No... my brother can't die on the land of Bathory..."

493552391.m_KeyValue: ""You're not actually thinking of ending this war… just to fulfill your mother's dying wish, are you?""

493552395.m_KeyValue: ""'I'm sorry I missed your childhood... but I brought you into this world because I believed that life, whether bitter or sweet, is worth living.'""

493552396.m_KeyValue: ""'And finally, my dearest daughter, remember: What your eyes see is not always the truth, but what your heart believes will lead you to the light.'""

508983154.m_KeyValue:
""The next time I saw Agares was inside the cage of the Carrelle family's slave estate.

Though treated by the nobles as nothing more than a pawn in the arena, he had not lost himself like the other slaves. Instead, bathed in moonlight filtering through the iron bars, he turned the pages of a poetry book with his scarred hands.

'This poem says peace is as pure as a dove.'
A soft female voice whispered beside him. Agares replied lazily, 'My peace is as small as this cage.'

As the girl spoke again, my vision began to blur slightly. 'Then take up a sharper sword, carve out enough space, and let the dove fly free!'
'I might not even live long enough to grasp a sword...'
'Agares!' The girl's youthful voice suddenly turned serious. 'Promise me... you must survive. Stay alive, with me!'""

508983371.m_KeyValue:
""After my connection to Fanny was severed, I made desperate attempts to reach her, each one ending in failure. In the month that followed, no letters arrived—only silence.

Her final correspondence echoes in my thoughts, and I cannot shake the dread that she may be in mortal peril. I pleaded with Aiona to send me back to Ironfist, but even she lacks the power to grant such a wish. All I can do now is pray that Fanny remains safe, that in my absence, no harm befalls the one I abandoned to darkness.""

508983526.m_KeyValue:
""Just as I thought this eerily realistic letter had come to an end, I discovered new content that hadn't been there before. It described how _$$I_$$—the diary's owner—would be indebted to Cain in a few days' time for breaking his wine bottle.

I dismissed it as just another prank, but a few days later, events unfolded exactly as the diary had described. The same handwriting as mine, predicting future events... Could it be that the person who wrote this diary was my future self...""

512570296.m_KeyValue: "I only claimed what my friend had left behind. Can that truly be called theft?"

512714036.m_KeyValue: "Absolutely not. I endured countless hardships to evade Grandfather's watchful eyes and reach this era."

515156291.m_KeyValue: "We can't keep dragging this out. Skoll... he's running out of time!"

515894782.m_KeyValue: ""Some time passed after last exchange, before another letter from Ami finally arrived.""

515963583.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us unshakable might.'""

515963584.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us speed of forest wind.'""

515963591.m_KeyValue: ""Crows that soar above Starfall Valley. After being infected with Black Blood outside the sealed area, the explosive power of their crystalline form reached its limit. Upon death, crystal shards explode from their bodies in a wide swath.""

515963592.m_KeyValue: ""A spider construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Originally designed to help humans navigate, its sensor has become the most lethal of weapons.""

515963593.m_KeyValue: ""A spider construct powered by Aqua Vitae. The electricity emitted from its sensors was meant to provide convenience to the city, but now serves as the very cause of its desolation.""

515963595.m_KeyValue: "A bee construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Its sensors on the head have lost their communication function and can only receive one-way commands for attacks."

515963596.m_KeyValue: ""A bee construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Its luminescent components were originally created to provide lights, but have somehow become harbingers of death.""

515963649.m_KeyValue: ""A Bloodborn girl who suddenly emerged from the shadowy caverns, fangs gleaming coldly in the darkness, eyes glowing with dangerous crimson. Strangely, she now carefully shields a frail human boy behind her.""

515963650.m_KeyValue: ""The Mouret boy cowering behind the Bloodborn girl, clutching tightly to a flower basket fragrant with herbs. He stares at Agnes like a frightened animal, his pants stained with mud, his young face a mixture of fear and defiance.""

515963657.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious colossus that hunts Colossus Max through the frozen deserts during the Long Night, seemingly burdened with an inescapable mission.""

515963680.m_KeyValue: ""A knight grotesquely twisted under the influence of Black Blood. Devoid of faith, their swordsmanship is now tempered by pure insanity.""

515963689.m_KeyValue: "An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. Its exaggerated spine implies a body terribly distorted."

515963691.m_KeyValue: ""A peasant residing near the Lupine Forest. The Black Blood infection stripped away their sanity, leaving only a blood-covered scythe as a testament to their madness.""

515963692.m_KeyValue: ""An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. This creature has lost all semblance of its original form, becoming a monstrous beast.""

515963693.m_KeyValue: ""Once they were offerings to the divine, now they have kindled the signal fires of rebellion and change.""

515963694.m_KeyValue: ""A hunter residing near the Lupine Forest. Despite their infection with Black Blood, their archery skills retain a deadly precision.""

515963753.m_KeyValue: ""A friend of the Bell Ringer No. III Albrecht, mysteriously awakened on the streets of Asta in her youthful body and appearance, though she was thought to have perished in the Church.""

515963754.m_KeyValue:
""The last remnants of Piera's will as she merges with the Spirit Bone Tower.
The girl learned forbidden arts, stole the salt coffin, and sailed across the sea to Sunset Isle all for this very moment. For the sake of her clan and those standing before her, she persists onward, despite the prospects of death.""

516110264.m_KeyValue: ""After hearing Bella's song, I couldn't wait to write back.""

516735163.m_KeyValue: "Too dense. I've said all along we should do this."

516737341.m_KeyValue: ""Hm. Still qualifies as knightly, I'd say.""

516741697.m_KeyValue: "Yes... this will certainly keep with the course of history."

516890814.m_KeyValue: ""<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>, the Plague Nest bursts upon completion, producing two Plague Spawnlings.""

517814944.m_KeyValue: ""Will this create a rift between us, too?""

517819300.m_KeyValue: "Please reconsider. Too many tragedies have been born from momentary impulses..."

517820323.m_KeyValue: "Bella: Let's call this a special perk for our loyal customer."

518438755.m_KeyValue: ""As a Bloodborn, my actions are no different than humans slaughtering their cattle. The strong culling the weak. Is that a sin?""

518438756.m_KeyValue: ""I can hear the sound of the wind breathing, it must be coming from outside. We must be getting close to the exit!""

519494913.m_KeyValue: "I just felt like… you were the only one who'd truly listen."

519495010.m_KeyValue: ""Listening to those stories in a graveyard… Who knows, maybe the spirits are still here, eavesdropping.""

520353944.m_KeyValue: ""Stop the Wolf Spirits from channeling at all costs, or Clive will gain Hypertension.""

522195161.m_KeyValue: "Why do you look so frightened? Did my outburst startle you?"

522195162.m_KeyValue: ""Not many, but they were all wearing masks like some kind of elite squad.""

522195163.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the nightmare we encountered, one of us...""

522195164.m_KeyValue: "...Quite the fighter! Have you been hiding your strength this whole time?"

522195192.m_KeyValue: "Are you suggesting you might be a phantom I created?"

522195193.m_KeyValue: ""Today? When we first met? There's something seriously wrong with you, Noah.""

522195194.m_KeyValue: "So many nightmares... were all destroyed? Who could have done this?"

522195195.m_KeyValue: ""Well whoever you are, I won't let you throw your life away like this!""

522195217.m_KeyValue: ""You are indeed just a 'useless' mortal. You fear danger, you die when wounded... But you're far from ordinary!""

522195218.m_KeyValue: ""The thing is, when the Bell Ringer goes all out in battle, survival within a hundred-mile radius is nearly impossible. That's why they require such individuals as Vice-Commanders—""

522195223.m_KeyValue: "I find that rather difficult to envision."

522195224.m_KeyValue: ""There are only two situations that require a Bell Ringer to personally take action: one is to 'cleanse' a Black Blood outbreak, and the other...""

522195228.m_KeyValue: ""You're just a stammering coward, just a weakling who gets winded from singing a single song, just...""

522195229.m_KeyValue: "I had to come back here. It must be me... who puts an end to Death. Because I am..."

522195230.m_KeyValue: ""You've been chasing her with me all this time, and you still haven't figured that out?!""

522195249.m_KeyValue: ""This isn't a contest! Besides, you can't even kill them!""

522195255.m_KeyValue: "Ah... Could it be... I see now... That's why Noah was so flustered back then..."

522195256.m_KeyValue: ""But in these 66 years, the three of us haven't aged either.""

522195258.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on... Sunset Isle is home to the Head of the Divine Body, the piece with the most free will.""

522195259.m_KeyValue: ""When I first arrived on this island, I knew I wasn't prepared... I wanted to run away... But Noah...""

522195260.m_KeyValue: "You're not going to tell her? The possibility that troubles you so?"

522195283.m_KeyValue: "It's coming from the village! Did something happen there?!"

522195284.m_KeyValue: ""What's that commotion... Piera, that fool! She broke our agreement! Though I was also...""

522195287.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! We are indeed your ancestors, and we were once Gravekeepers. However...""

522195288.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes, great ancestors. Since so many of our family are here... together, we can...""

522195289.m_KeyValue: ""...Noah, even though I haven't had the chance to tell you what's inside...""

522195293.m_KeyValue: "I'm so glad... I made the right decision to come back here... I'm so glad I'm not alone anymore... We can definitely succeed!"

522195294.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, we're all family! Even though we lived in different eras of history.""

522195316.m_KeyValue: ""The salt stake was a weapon I researched to fight against the Calamities. After I joined the Church, Albrecht, the world's most renowned alchemist, approached me because of them.""

522195320.m_KeyValue: "That's precisely why more and more members of the Paracelsus family have come to believe that Death is our true god."

522195322.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... you knew Master Albrecht? You two sound close."

522195324.m_KeyValue: ""I... was born bearing both duty and curse, yet under the protection of the Church... under Grandmother's care, under Master's guidance...""

522195325.m_KeyValue: "The blood before us is guidance left by our ancestors..."

522195354.m_KeyValue: "If only... I had told you everything from the beginning... maybe things could have turned out differently... (coughing)"

522195355.m_KeyValue: "In the end... I just caused more trouble... for you... for everyone..."

522195356.m_KeyValue: ""The last step? Wait, you mean sacrificing a 'Gravekeeper'?!""

522195357.m_KeyValue: ""Think, damn it! I know how to do this!""

523766943.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry. I had no other choice back then. I had to ensure Hati's safety before my strength ran out completely."

523766944.m_KeyValue: ""_$$But now I understand—even if you're not by my side, I can still protect you all!_$$""

523766946.m_KeyValue: ""As they left me one by one, I felt lost in a forest, alone and helpless.""

524381485.m_KeyValue: ""I can't betray his trust in me. Even if it means turning against the Church, I'll get you out of here!""

524381486.m_KeyValue: ""Trust me, Hati. I'm just a lowly monk. I had no idea the Church was going after Mouret.""

524381487.m_KeyValue: "Almost everyone in town has been infected. This place is... beyond saving."

524381488.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, you don't understand how terrifying a Bell Ringer can be, or how dangerous Mouret is right now!""

524381490.m_KeyValue: "But there must be people in town who aren't infected yet. What about them?"

524381517.m_KeyValue: ""You've been guarding the entrance to these forbidden grounds for twenty years, preventing any source of infection from reaching Mouret.""

524381518.m_KeyValue: ""After all, nothingness is far more desperate and painful than death... especially eternal nothingness.""

524381519.m_KeyValue: "A graveyard filled with Wolfsbane... Who prepared this stage for you? Was it fate? Or was it you..."

524381782.m_KeyValue: "We entered enemy territory the moment we set foot in this forest."

524381783.m_KeyValue: ""Please, leave me be! I cannot bring myself to harm you!""

524381784.m_KeyValue: "Thank you again for your help. I must take my leave now—"

524381815.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... You did help me earlier, and I'd like to just let it go, but I can't abandon my duty...""

524381818.m_KeyValue: ""Gadric, Noah... This is your choice? Can't say I'm surprised.""

524381819.m_KeyValue: "You seem to fear your true self. Are you afraid to confront your real power?"

524381845.m_KeyValue: "What does that mean? Are we supposed to go find it on the moon?"

524381846.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, your brother was just here. Where did that boy suddenly run off to...""

524381849.m_KeyValue: "It's possible that the conflict between our families has been a misunderstanding from the start."

524381851.m_KeyValue: "You Bathory scum! Are you here to take advantage of our misfortune?"

524381881.m_KeyValue: ""So, I won't let outsiders hurt you... It must be me. I, Hati Ganelon, will set you free with my own hands!""

524381882.m_KeyValue: ""It seems every time you opposed us Bathory, you were being used by the Church without even realizing it!""

524381883.m_KeyValue: ""I was planning to escort the townspeople to safety, then return with Clive to help our father hold the rear... Oh!""

524381909.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright, Clive. Father is strong. He's just covering our retreat. We'll see him soon.""

524381913.m_KeyValue: ""We're looking for the Ganelon family's forbidden grounds. According to our information, it's likely in Mouret.""

524381916.m_KeyValue: ""They're, uh... well... What are your names again?""

524381944.m_KeyValue: "And the place where these flowers bloom the most is the Ashen Garden... Ah!"

524381945.m_KeyValue: ""So... The Church didn't just deceive us, but their own people too?""

524381948.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, how did Father... I've never heard of this before, and he knows Noah?""

524381976.m_KeyValue: ""That weak aura, that timid voice... It really is you, Skoll!""

524381977.m_KeyValue: "Each of the twelve families has one... Does that mean the Bathory family too?"

524381978.m_KeyValue: "Stay alert. Someone else is coming this way."

524381979.m_KeyValue: "Father never left the Lupine Forest. He shouldn't know about the outside world... Could Gadric have told him?"

524381980.m_KeyValue: ""It must be because Father doesn't want you in danger, sis. He's always loved you more...""

524604721.m_KeyValue: ""I am an Aegis knight, bound by knightly virtues—I would never stoop to such vile acts.""

526567020.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, I don't know how badly you lost before, but I don't recall ever losing to him.""

528787515.m_KeyValue: "Clear [The Black Mist] <color=#a65f30>N 1-9</color>: Earth and the Azure Sky"

532351300.m_KeyValue: "I have no interest in human knowledge."

532423042.m_KeyValue: ""The wheel can briefly reverse the flow of time, but only the Blood Power of the Alita family can awaken it.""

532807033.m_KeyValue: "Forgive me. Did I wake you up?"

532902822.m_KeyValue: ""All these cheers are for you, Joan.""

534061188.m_KeyValue: ""No... If I'm merely an empty shell inheriting Noah Nevernight's memories, then I've only existed for a day.""

534066171.m_KeyValue: "Take this so-called Moonblessed and the others to the dungeon."

534067194.m_KeyValue: ""Then why is Lamia so happy about it? If that traitorous elder wants to claim the inheritance, they'll come for her too.""

534070262.m_KeyValue: "I shall await you at the top floor."

534070263.m_KeyValue: ""Is it really you? Baphomet! Did you turn Lamia, did you turn them—""

534288940.m_KeyValue: "It came from Duke Reese's son—Reese II."

534360682.m_KeyValue: "I wonder whether ingesting it might yield similar results. This presents yet another intriguing avenue of investigation..."

534466441.m_KeyValue: ""All I did was share my true name, and you've already taken so many memories without asking.""

534552915.m_KeyValue: "I learned all this from <style="Highlight">Ressa</style>... She's the best healer back home."

534553939.m_KeyValue: ""I heard the <style=""Highlight"">blacker the blood and the whiter the hair</style>, the more far gone they are. How revolting.""

535655710.m_KeyValue: "Repel the Church's elite forces sweeping through the village."

535844570.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, don't you know how to transform? We could easily fly to the other side.""

535845593.m_KeyValue: "The pursuers caught up already? That's... like they knew I'd come here."

537743595.m_KeyValue: ""It must have fallen into disuse alongside the family's decline after the Holy War. Decrepit, abandoned. From the remnants, it seems this was once where young Vassals were trained in the art of the hunt.""

537743596.m_KeyValue: ""As the family rises once more, and we progress through our journey in Threads of Fate, more facilities will gradually become available.""

537743598.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, this is it! The same desolate air as before, though time has clearly left its mark here.""

537743600.m_KeyValue: ""Wait... I think I've been here before, when I was very young... with my parents, a place my kin once called the 'Lost Courtyard.'""

537743607.m_KeyValue: "Careful where you step! That place is dangerous. I remember it was..."

539608165.m_KeyValue: ""'The Bathory family needs more skilled blacksmiths to craft trophies!' Baphomet's enthusiastic declaration rang out in the Hall of Honor, touching everyone present.""

540121319.m_KeyValue:
""The energy concealed within the Artifact hugely enhances the capabilities of Vassals.
<alpha=#80>A perplexing cylindrical structure employed by the Tempus Church to gaze into the void located at the end of the world.""

540415912.m_KeyValue:
""Perhaps due to insufficient blood during the Embrace, Setti's memories remain fragmented.

When I learned that owls were a symbol of honor in her family, I carved this wooden figure, hoping it might stir something within her.

Setti accepted it with a smile, but gently refused to turn the owl's head, saying it reminded her of things best forgotten.

Yet that was the part where I'd carved every line with care.""

540416036.m_KeyValue: ""At last, I reached the end of my journey—Sunset Isle. This island is like a mirror, reflecting my past… yet the figure staring back feels like a stranger. I can no longer tell if it's truly me. Have my very sense of self vanished with my memories? That's why I hate mirrors. They leave me with nothing but doubt.""

540416071.m_KeyValue:
""Every grain of sand in Aiona Alita's treasured hourglass was once a living soul.

Like that hourglass, ever turning over—perhaps the world in her eyes too is caught in an endless cycle of ruin and rebirth.

I cannot see the end of fate. But I know this: the threads of our destinies are already tightly entwined, bound together until the end.

_$$Noah, isn't it too cruel… to measure time with the remnants of life?_$$""

540416129.m_KeyValue: ""Jess caresses the tiny shield, its polished front bears an inscription—This side is courage. 'Father, I couldn't slay our enemy with my own hands; Mother, I couldn't overcome my fears. The honor you entrusted to me, I couldn't uphold...' 'What about the other side?' People often fixate on the bright, gleaming side of things, overlooking the other side. Jess was like that, as was I. This side is fear.... Jess turns the small shield over, seemingly seeing the inscription on the back for the first time. 'The front grants you courage to face your enemies; the back conceals the fears in your heart—perhaps this is why a shield has two sides.' 'So they had told me all along: standing behind a shield, facing your fears is embracing courage.' Jess's expression softens, though her grip on the shield tightens. 'Next full moon, shall we try visiting the Observatory together?' 'As long as we don't take that elevator.'""

540416226.m_KeyValue:
""Before we embarked, Empousa left her flower basket in the study. Thinking they were flowers she cherished, I kindly reminded her.

_$$My affairs are none of your concern,_$$ she snapped. I didn't understand her anger, just like many times before.

So we became _$$accomplices of fate,_$$ and I gradually came to understand the meaning behind the scarlet flowers.

Unusually red, yet tragically short-lived—perhaps a reflection of the fate that awaits every maiden bearing the Bathory name.

Empousa left them in the castle, perhaps saying: let the past rest in yesterday's embrace.""

540416443.m_KeyValue:
""The second collection didn't go quite as smoothly. When I presented the invoice to Cain the steward, he hinted at an alternative form of settlement. Alternative means? Was he referring to a barter arrangement—like the one I had?

Sensing my confusion, Cain patiently explained, _$$information comes at a steep cost._$$ Elder Bella had commissioned him to investigate the whereabouts of Joyce—an assignment dangerous enough to offset nearly half a year's worth of alchemy fees.

Joyce who pioneered mechanical ascension? Why would Elder Bella want to find that eccentric puppet?""

""<style=""Highlight"">It is recommended to first watch the [Far Side of the Moon] event before reading this Vassal Journal.</style>

'Perhaps a caged bird should never yearn for the starry sky.'

A Bloodborn maiden shaped beneath the moon's gaze, she was nurtured by darkness and now stands as second heir to the Bathory family. Aloof, she keeps her distance from all, and her gleaming fangs and bitter words piercing any soul that dare approach. Yet, her demeanor may well be a disguise, masking the sorrow and uncertainty plaguing her inside.""

541707757.m_KeyValue: ""Ready to restore order. When people speak of the Vice-Commander to Bell Ringer No. X, they recall only a silver-clad warrior—expressionless, efficient, and swift to resolve all things by force. While her youthful Bell Ringer superior dreamed up grand and unorthodox battle strategies, it was always Darcias who brought those impossible blueprints to life with flawless precision. As an Ascendant from the second Silver Blood Trial, Darcias retained fragments of her past. She remembered it was hatred for the Black Blood that drove her to the Church and carried her through the trials. Yet in bitter irony, the moment she grasped power, the agony that once defined her vanished. She knew all too well: Ascendants were forged to serve the Church. And the emotions stripped from them were the cruelest proof of that purpose. Still, in the stillness of certain nights, she could not help but ask: Can a warrior still be called a warrior, if they’ve forgotten why they ever drew their blade?""

541707850.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human? From the ashes of slaves condemned as kindling rose a shadow chancellor, the one who steered the Carrelle nobles toward reform. Upon achieving victory, he turned to the Tempus Church, ascending through the ranks to become Bell Ringer No. II—Agares Brennholt. Tales of his eccentric feats and enigmatic persona drifted across the cities of the continent, carried like the scent of wine through back alleys and crowded squares. Yet despite these rumors, few have ever seen the man himself. Perhaps his power was so absolute that all who beheld him were reduced to ash. Or perhaps he simply preferred to remain idle, tucked away in seclusion, gazing past even the great Cathedral. Except this time. Vice-Commander Nefertari voiced her doubt, why now, of all times, had Lord Brennholt chosen to preside over this heretic's trial himself? One must stir from time to time. Lest they wither into dry kindling, unfit to bear witness to the grace of Aeon.""

541707881.m_KeyValue: ""Is it my turn to shine? Allow me to solve all your problems! Raised in the Lupine Forest, Hati is more beast than human, having battle instincts carved into her bones. Her animal-like demeanor and impetuosity mean that she never bows her head, even when fate's fangs tear her apart. After the Black Blood Disease ravaged her homeland, this once-favored child of destiny lost everything. She who fell from heaven into the abyss remained unbroken no matter how battered. Wiping away her tears, Hati chose to embark on an adventure with her new companions. Many thought this lone little wolf would forever be trapped in a blizzard, never noticing that beneath her playful facade, in the cracks of old wounds, something more resilient was quietly taking root.""

618266558.m_KeyValue: ""Though once deemed uninhabitable, through sheer human enterprise, this island was transformed into the ocean's pearl. Isolated by rising tides, it became one of the few pure islets in Minexus following the outbreak of the Black Blood Disease. Perhaps the tidal waves of the past were simply left unrecorded in The Church's annals, in anticipation of the tranquility to come.""

618266562.m_KeyValue: ""The once-humble cabins had been transformed into grain mills by many a hand, their streams irrigating the land, with light breezes caressing the fields of wheat. This low-lying site still bears the imprint of youthful eyes gazing upon the night sky. Over time, however, childhood promises faded under the unrelenting toil of labor, their spirits either withering away or growing wild. Then one day, with a clap of thunder, the dilapidated bricks collapsed, and were never to be repaired again.""

618266563.m_KeyValue: ""The Howling Peninsula, long contested by the Bathory and Ganelon families, is iconically shaped like a wolf's head, yet it is the tower on the cape resembling a fang which gives it its striking appearance. Perched over the rocks and tide, the Fangtooth Tower broods in loneliness, estranged by the moon hanging in the sky. Darkness acts as a foil to light, just as solitude gazes watchfully at companionship. Though the sea draws in whispers from afar, they explode into plumes of bubbles.""

618266564.m_KeyValue: ""A singular geologic event gave birth to this island shrouded in mist. During winter, when looking northwest, snow-capped mountains span the horizon, occasionally revealing black ridges, long regarded in legend as sleeping drakes. Before Black Blood tainted the land, travelers would often come here in search of respite. Now, even its beloved hot springs struggle to resist time's twisted fate.""

618266565.m_KeyValue:
""The crackling of dry branches echoes across the snow-covered plain. Can northbound travelers find even a morsel of warmth in this land of frigid memories?
'No need for dense forests to shield from wind and snow; I merely hope to be found. Now, then, bear forth my message, won't you? Engrave my epitaph behind the waystation.'
Having finished telling his story to the young one, the elderly figure cast down a little wildflower, poured out a dram of spirits, and continued northward.""

618266567.m_KeyValue: ""North of Bathory Castle lies a hill where countless souls seem to stand frozen solid amidst the birch trees, the silhouettes of their embrace outlined in the mist. As if tracing the path of birds in flight, the hilly terrain gradually ascends upward. Atop the hill, beyond the dense expanse of woods, lies a deep lake resembling the great eye of a fallen deity. The first to record this location named it the _$$Eye of God,_$$ yet they have long since been forgotten, lost to a labyrinth of loneliness and despair while searching for an answer to a question that no longer exists.""

618266568.m_KeyValue: ""The Church, once-monumental, now stands in tatters, with only its winter peonies enduring, recalling the days of yore when the Bathories and The Church had been united as one. Under the glow of the crescent moon, a silhouette carefully tinkers with a device, intoxicated by the light refracting through some liquid-substance. After the notion of space was disregarded and faith in time abandoned, all that remained was the soft whispers of flowers echoing in the wind.""

618266569.m_KeyValue: ""After the Bathory family began researching the forbidden techniques, its burial grounds would soon become overgrown. These now-nameless tombstones once harbored the thoughts of the living, but even the flowers came to wither, bereft of all companionship. Some say the longer the night, the more tenacious the spirit. But then, who is to explain the harrowing wails which fill the night sky?""

631784996.m_KeyValue: "William—why would you do something so foolish!"

631784997.m_KeyValue: "...Why is there someone hanging up there? And that person is..."

631784998.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—if they're too scared to follow us in here, shouldn't we be safe as long as we stay put?""

631784999.m_KeyValue: "The spread is too fast... They've fully transformed... Could it be something as potent as the Plague sealed in the Forbidden Grounds?"

631785000.m_KeyValue: "Am I even heading the right way...?"

631785001.m_KeyValue: ""All you need to know is this—it's the weapon's final form, forged to erase flesh entirely.""

631785020.m_KeyValue: ""Right? That lustrous Captain dresses like a peacock in spring, yet makes the whole crew wear the same uniform—just in different colors. Even his own brother only gets an extra hat...""

631785021.m_KeyValue: "Come... come to me... let us feast... until there's nothing left to crave..."

631785028.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing! These stairs will take you to the helm at the aftcastle!"

631785029.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Van Helsing is Noah's friend. He won't abandon him. And of course, we'll help too.""

631785031.m_KeyValue: "First—I'm certain he was the one who orchestrated Aaron's murder aboard this ship."

631785032.m_KeyValue: "That walking armor? What did he say?"

631785033.m_KeyValue: "Ah! It's the same again—how could he be so sure William committed suicide… Unless he saw it happen. Or worse..."

631785034.m_KeyValue: "If that's the case… could Mr. Jones have spoken so instinctively because he already knew where the poisoning took place?"

631785035.m_KeyValue: "Then William may have been killed by Jones as well?"

631785060.m_KeyValue: ""So, you're not someone imprisoned... then what are you? You look bizarre...""

631785061.m_KeyValue: ""Strange… that pesky bat isn't even here, and I can still hear her mocking me…""

631785062.m_KeyValue: "Save you…? I thought you were inviting me to dinner or something."

631785063.m_KeyValue: "Strange… I break through one wall only to find another?"

631785092.m_KeyValue: "What I mean is—perhaps you were already infected with Black Blood long before we ever met."

631785093.m_KeyValue: ""Those infected with Black Blood lose their will swiftly, but in return, their bodies grow unnaturally resilient, capable of limited regeneration.""

631785094.m_KeyValue: "This should hold them off—unless they manage to break the door down."

631785095.m_KeyValue: "It's fine if you don't believe me. Everyone laughs whenever I say such things."

631785096.m_KeyValue: ""If that wall is truly as thick as the blueprint claims, it shouldn't sound like this when struck.""

631785098.m_KeyValue: ""Back then, we searched far and wide for the Moonblessed… only to discover that Hati—who had been with us the entire time—was...""

631785099.m_KeyValue: "Then… could that sound have come from beneath the sea?"

631785120.m_KeyValue: "Still haven't figured out the difference in strength? Such pitiful tricks…"

631785121.m_KeyValue: ""I won't listen, I won't believe it! We've all already… passed the point of no return!""

631785124.m_KeyValue: "You… cowardly fool! You slaughtered an entire ship of people who cared about you!"

631785125.m_KeyValue: ""People are always most afraid of being exposed for what they've long pretended to possess, but never truly had.""

631785126.m_KeyValue: ""He must have learned through his connections that mortals can only contend with Blood Beasts, especially when their strength is unknown—by harnessing the power of a Divine Body.""

631785127.m_KeyValue: "What?! That's insane—who in their right mind would sell or even buy something like that?!"

631785128.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you should answer my question first. Where is Jones?"

631785130.m_KeyValue: "What did you say…? And you call yourself the Silver Cross's most merciless hunter! Why didn't you burn his body on the spot?!"

631785131.m_KeyValue: ""Lies! All lies! I have wisdom, ideals! I am neither fool nor coward!""

631785156.m_KeyValue: ""Of course we heard it. William, shouting in madness—though what exactly happened, I cannot say...""

631785157.m_KeyValue: ""William, the traitor who murdered your Captain, is just ahead! And this is the moment you choose to get seasick and fall to pieces?! You're no better than he is! Ah—!""

631785158.m_KeyValue: "She? What are you talking about? Weren't you just strutting about all fearless? And now you're cowering at a voice?"

631785160.m_KeyValue: "So much happened in the time it takes to miss a single meal…"

631785161.m_KeyValue: ""No need to be so grumpy. If your mood's sour because you're hungry, I can share half of Finley with you.""

631785162.m_KeyValue: ""To begin anew, under the name of the one he envied most. Captain Goldland: wealthy, respected, untouchable.""

631785163.m_KeyValue: ""Anyone who dares stand in our way shall die aboard this ship. As long as I'm with you, we are invincible.""

631785190.m_KeyValue: "R-Recognition? Tch. You actually think I'd be moved by that?"

631785191.m_KeyValue: "We shall become her sustenance... become one with her!"

631785192.m_KeyValue: ""You're nothing but a nameless scrap of flesh, fresh-spawned and unworthy of being devoured by the beautiful Ranna!""

631785193.m_KeyValue: ""The Atoll Devourer, Ranna... Though you might know her better by a different name. For she is also known as…""

631785194.m_KeyValue: """"To feed her?"" You turned your former companions into Blood Beasts—to feed this being?""

631785195.m_KeyValue: ""This tragedy, born of your cowardice, foolishness, and selfishness ends here.""

 Only you would have the impudence to forget what day it is...
 By rights, you—my Vassal—should have greeted me today. Clearly, you lack the proper sense of decorum!

"The true Tempest Scourge.
Hypocrisy suffocates all life in its greenhouse of lies; only destruction can bring true rebirth."

639666715.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it seems I haven't been left behind after all.""

639674899.m_KeyValue: ""Yes! At last, I understand what Noah was thinking!""

639677970.m_KeyValue: ""For a commoner, you have some lofty ideals.""

641453901.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry. You weren't punished, were you?""

659977071.m_KeyValue: ""'Hati flies ahead, pulling us across the sea—is that the kind of trick you mean?' Ami asked, a sly smile spreading across her face.""

""'Just got a mission to track the Bloodborn and document it. She said it's too risky, but the reward is too good to pass up...'
'I'm taking it. Luck is always on my side—I'm always one step ahead of death. This'll be no different.'
'What a coincidence! I won a map from an El Dorado crew member in a dice game. It shows where the Bloodborn were last seen.'
'On my way to the spot on the map, I ran into a red-eyed traveler. I've made a note, but he looked pretty ordinary.'""

672219702.m_KeyValue:
""'Today I tracked the trail to the 'depths.' The air here is thick and damp, and the whole place feels eerie.'
'Yesterday's rainfall washed away the soil along the riverbank and uncovered what looked like freshly spilled blood. Oddly, I didn't hear a sound all night.'
'I'm nearing the legendary Bloodborn territory, and the forest is growing denser as well.'
'Tonight's moon is rather unsettling, and it sounds like someone in the forest is calling for help. I need to investigate.'
...
The rest of the notes are blank, with only a few dried bloodstains smeared across the yellowed paper.""

672219703.m_KeyValue:

In the end, silence will reign.
As moonlight blankets the countless graves of those lost.""

672219704.m_KeyValue: ""When the ■■■■ is stained crimson, the land will bleed, and the Bloodborn will return to their promised home.""

672219764.m_KeyValue:
""With a tranquil heart, I gaze across the sea,
Where familiar mountains stand steadfast and free.
Tonight, I pray for peace from where I stand,
May you find the courage to explore new lands,
And may you raise the sails on your journey home.""

672219765.m_KeyValue:
""I was born to chase the sun's bright glow,
The little man sings through the day's ebb and flow,
Yearning for the light, for home's embrace.
As the long night comes, the sunset parts its final glow,
The little man continues to sing, with a voice never dull.
Darkness looms, shadows stretch across the sky,
Yet I will chase the sun, alone, with hope held high.""

672219767.m_KeyValue:
""In the forest, the wind sings of sorrow,
Fallen leaves, oh, who has left you for tomorrow?
Wolfsbane blooms beneath the moon's soft grace,
The promised home waits beyond the sky's embrace.""

672219796.m_KeyValue: ""Today marks my first day aboard the El Dorado, and I'm thrilled to have been chosen by Captain Goldland. We enjoyed a fantastic meal with fellow townsfolk this evening—everyone was in high spirits. After all, it's not every day you set out on such an adventure, so a little celebration the night before seems appropriate.""

672219798.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Ran into the Captain on deck. He was in high spirits and smelled of alcohol, kept bragging about his clever brother. Why not tell that to the man himself?_$$

_$$There've been strange thuds coming from the lower deck where the mysterious cargo is stored, as if something's alive down there... Some crew members suggest it might be haunted, but I doubt it. They're betting on who'll dare to check it out tonight. I hope everything turns out alright._$$""

672219799.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Yesterday the Captain had some cargo brought aboard and specifically instructed us to keep our distance. Yet I keep catching whiffs of a peculiar fishy smell. What could be so mysterious?_$$

_$$Met the Captain's brother on deck tonight. William, I think his name was? He was pouring something into the sea while muttering about not disappointing his brother again. Rather unsettling._$$""

672219833.m_KeyValue:
""A letter carefully tucked away in a dresser reads:
To My Dearest Claire Magnier,
Though the day is long, it pales in comparison to my endless longing for you; though the night is deep, it cannot match the depth of my love for you.
I've won my father's approval and will soon ask your parents for your hand. May the god of love bless us, so that I may spend the rest of my life with you by my side.
Alas, mere words could never hope to express the profundity of my love. Though all things must end, not even death could separate us.
A million embraces till the ends of eternity,
Samuel Ganelon""

672219835.m_KeyValue:
""
...That filthy, vile wolf ruined our wedding! It even took your father away... Tears have withered your beautiful face. I know nothing can erase the pain in your heart, but I still want to do something. While you are still dreaming, I have taken my father's sword and will head into the forest to slay that foul beast in the name of vengeance.
Do not worry about me, my love. I shall bring you good news soon!
A million embraces till the ends of eternity,
Samuel Ganelon""

672219861.m_KeyValue:
""In the cemetery, among the grotesque display of werewolves slain by the knights, two still cling to each other even in death. Each of their necks bears a pendant:
one contains a portrait of a man, and the other, a woman. Both pendants have the initials 'S&C' engraved on the back.""

672219862.m_KeyValue:
""Father says you won't be coming back, but I don't believe him. We've only just married—how could you leave me?
I asked Father if you were still alive, but he wouldn't answer. His eyes were full of pity. Was this why he tried to keep us apart from the start?
Since you left, Father often takes food to the cemetery. Could you... I hold onto the sliver of hope that you might still be out there. But if you're alive, why haven't you come back to see me?
Maybe all the answers are in the cemetery. Tonight, I will follow Father in secret. Whatever awaits me there, I have no regrets, for you said that not even death could separate us.""

672219896.m_KeyValue:
""To the venerable Saint Seth and my fellow members of the Church Tribunal:
I, David Petri, the appointed trial witness, hereby document the thirteenth Silver Blood Trial.
Seven individuals, including two heretics, were chosen from the monastery by Aeon's will.
After baptism and confession, they were each seated at the Blood Purification Altar for Holy Communion and ablution with Holy Water.
Upon the first dose, using Divine Blood, three who did not have Black Blood disease perished, unable to withstand Aeon's grace. The remaining four showed no abnormalities.
After the second dose, with Silver Blood this time, a woman who did not have Black Blood disease and a male heretic died from excessive hemorrhaging, accompanied by severe convulsions and incontinence. The remaining two survived, though the female heretic experienced hair loss and molting of the skin.
After the third dose, once again with Silver Blood, a man who did not have Black Blood disease bled from eyes, nose, and ears, then died from a sudden rise in body temperature. The female heretic, despite her earlier symptoms, rapidly recovered and revealed a 'divine mark' on her hand.
Upon examination, her blood had turned a semi-transparent silver, free of Black Blood, and she retained her consciousness and memories. Moreover, she inherited the memories of an individual known as 'Darcias.'
May the martyrs return to Aeon.
An esteemed Bell Ringer will administer the next trial for the Silver Blood successor.""

672219897.m_KeyValue:
""Who the hell was it that told me Wolfsbane could combat Black Blood disease?
I traveled all the way from the eastern continent, and for what? Not a damn thing!
There's no cure to this infernal curse—it continues to rage within me.
Bloodletting, herbal remedies, holy water, Wolfsbane... is there anything I haven't tried?
Damn it! Damn it all!
My fingers are swollen, my stomach's on fire, and this itch on my back—makes me want to rip my skin right off.
I'm sorry, my darling. I don't think I'll ever see you again.
If only...
If only someone could bring this note to you...
I'm so exhausted. I think I'll rest here for a while.""

672219899.m_KeyValue:
""April 25th, 1213. Experiment #12.
Subject: Survivor of the Ganelon family clash.
Condition: Human-like appearance with partial black coarse hair; abnormal tailbone growth observed. Pupils constricted, highly sensitive to light and water. Presumably in the mid-to-late stages of Black Blood disease.
Condition of Blood: Blood separated through layering process, darker than average in hue, composition of red blood cells only 10%.
Experiment Record: Blood transfusion slowed the spread of the Black Blood but eventually proved ineffective and was abandoned. A new mixture of Pure Blood extracted from Pure Blood Essence and combined with a sample of Black Blood from a Bloodborn (Cain) was injected into the neck, chest, and legs. The body was then stored in a wooden coffin in the cellar for seven days.
Results: The subject reverted to human form, with the Black Blood fully suppressed after further refinement of the blood. The seventh, ninth, and eleventh experiments confirmed the Pure Blood Essence's suppressive effect, but the subject's native Black Blood could not merge with Bloodborn fluids. Dissection revealed swollen organs, abnormal bone growth, and Black Blood clots encasing red blood. The subject ultimately succumbed to Black Blood disease. Experiment failed.
— Baphomet""

672219924.m_KeyValue:
""Tempus Sequence XXXIII, Central Minexus, the Pillars of Hercules.
I didn't expect the Pillars of Hercules to be swallowed by the sea in all the previous sequences.
Here in Sequence XXXIII, they remain above water. Unfortunately, my 'stone' is running low on energy, so I cannot return just yet.
As past records state, the Landis family relies heavily on trade and military prowess, though they've always lacked resources.
Numerous ships from the Church continue to sail into port, likely preparing to retaliate against the Landises for their aggression.
However, none of the existing texts explain how the Landis family fell under the influence of the Calamity _$$Famine._$$ As a chronographer, I must document this.
But could I be hallucinating? It's absurd, yet I thought I saw my mentor's stone in the hands of the Landis patriarch.
Come to think of it, the chronographer stones we use to etch history could have some effect on the Calamities as well...""

672219925.m_KeyValue:
""Tempus Sequence VI, Central Minexus, Sea of the Divine Crown.
The sea lacks any distinctive landmarks and most of it remains uncharted.
However, in this sequence, the sea level has not yet risen, allowing me to still see the Pillars of Hercules in the distance.
While tracing my mentor's footsteps, I learned that he once set sail from these docks. Unfortunately, I cannot determine whether he aimed to fill in the incomplete maps of the seas, or to mourn his old friend, who was devoured by Calamity when he was still human.
However, the Cartographer's Code prohibits us from interfering with established history or contacting the deceased. As a seasoned cartographer, he surely would have remembered this.""

672219928.m_KeyValue:
""Tempus Sequence VII, Central Howling Peninsula, Lupine Forest, Southern Region.
Follow the mountain path to the hilltop, and you will find an open area before you. The rocky ground is loose and prone to collapse, with white bones lying all about. To my knowledge, this area has not been recorded by any cartographer.
Knowing my mentor, he had a habit of leaving subtle traces whenever he ventured into unexplored territory.
But so far, I haven't found any evidence of his visit.
Could it be in another sequence?
In the heart of the hill lies a colossal bleached-out skeleton with a broad, flat face and a pointed mouth several meters long. It seems to be the remains of an unrecorded creature.
Beneath the skeleton, a note is pinned which reads 'Eye of God.'
Wait... this is my mentor's handwriting. He was here—could he be heading for that place called the Eye of God?""

672219930.m_KeyValue:
""Tempus Sequence VII, Northwestern Howling Peninsula, Mouret.
Upon reaching the town of Mouret, I found the area enveloped in mist due to an abundance of Wolfsbane.
According to what my mentor once told me, the Divine Body guarded by the Ganelon family lies somewhere deep within this town.
My mentor was obsessed with the Divine Body and the Calamity. Is that why he came to this town?
Entering Mouret, I found it completely overrun by the Black Blood. But as the records stated, Black Blood werewolves interestingly still retain a basic level of intelligence and the ability to use tools.
Thankfully, as a chronographer, they could not sense me, so I had ample time to search for my mentor.""

672219931.m_KeyValue:
""Tempus Sequence VII, Central Howling Peninsula, Lupine Forest, Northern Region.
Moving north from the graveyard, I entered a birch forest shrouded in thick mist that obscured my vision and hampered my navigation. Caution was my only guide.
According to my mentor's notes, at the end of this birch forest lies the remains of what looks like a giant eye, which he named the Eye of God. He had not yet discovered the graveyard in the south at that time. Perhaps there was no path leading south when he was here.
The area is mountainous, and the further north I go, the more red minerals I see in the rock layers.
It's unlikely he came here, but I had to see for myself this Eye of God that he spoke of with such reverence.
And indeed, the sight was as captivating as he described—at the top of the hill lies a large azure lake, surrounded by lush undergrowth, with a cave at the bottom that stretches from both side to side. The colors grow deeper and deeper, like the eye of God descending into the world. The sight evoked a profound awareness of one's insignificance and the vastness of the unknown.""

672220158.m_KeyValue:
""Inspired by the prophet, a revelation was given.
It is a realm we cannot behold.
In the depths of darkness lies a mirror of our world, severed by invisible threads.
In the distant, dreamlike glow, the same mountains rise, the same cities stretch, and the same 'us' wander.
It appears as if our homeland arises from the reflection in our eyes.
Yet, that homeland does not truly exist.""

672220159.m_KeyValue:
""Inspired by the prophet, a revelation was given.
These words have not been seen by anyone else—not inherited from the primal beings but penned by the prophet.
Though their meaning remains elusive, within the vertical lines and curved circles, we seem to glimpse the essence of the world, touch the pulse of life, and feel the whisper of the soul.
Such enigmatic scripture. Perhaps this is the final legacy the prophet bestowed upon us before his departure.""

672220160.m_KeyValue:
""Inspired by the prophet, a revelation was given.
All things in the world emerged from the fall of Minexus.
Its body nurtured life and gifted twenty-four primal beings.
Clothes and spices, the flesh and blood they bestowed;
Words and language, the soul they granted;
Fire and the forge, the will they empowered.
They passed down their bloodlines and gave shape to what would be humanity.""

672220161.m_KeyValue:
""Inspired by the prophet, a revelation was given.
The memory of history begins at time's end, holding secrets beyond our grasp: the circular ouroboros, the dot of the raven's eye, the linear black tortoise.
The memory of war starts where history fades, veiling visions beyond our understanding: soaring silver wings, swimming rusted fish, and pounding steel hooves.
These are the vestiges granted by the great prophet.""

672220163.m_KeyValue:
""Inspired by the prophet, a revelation was given.
At the dawn of life, the fall of Minexus gave birth to existence: from its shattered remains, the earth was formed and gave rise to space. This is known as the 'Divine Body.'
At the dawn of time, the descent of the temporal deity Aeon ushered in life: the deity's will shaped the heavens and the earth, weaving the fabric of time itself. This is known as the 'Tempus.'
The Divine Body and the Tempus are two sides of the same coin, giving rise to all that exists—they are the genesis of the world.""

672220256.m_KeyValue: ""Years ago, this sea was not so treacherous. Not only did the entire family vanish without a trace, but the sea itself has been shrouded in mystery ever since.""

709414838.m_KeyValue: ""The world isn't black and white, but there's no doubt he was the source of the Black Blood seeping into Lupine Forest.""

709414839.m_KeyValue: ""Don't look down on me, I can get out on my own!""

709414840.m_KeyValue: "A baby crying? But the Calamity... could it be twins?"

709414842.m_KeyValue: ""To get you, Noah. You have many people waiting for you out there, but me...""

709414843.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, what exactly did you see? I'll help you, just tell me—""

713991495.m_KeyValue: ""Days have passed since we fled Ironfist, yet Genevieve's true nature remains shrouded in shadow. My thoughts drift constantly to that dagger she pressed into my hands.""

714025256.m_KeyValue: "(An unsigned letter was left at my door.)"

716392850.m_KeyValue: ""So, was it you that sent the carriage over the cliff?""

716392852.m_KeyValue: "Let's sort it out after we deal with them together."

716392854.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh... this feeling again, the uncontrollable surge of blood rushing to my chest...""

716392855.m_KeyValue: "That's your Bloodsoul trying to take control of your body."

716696399.m_KeyValue: "Hey! One's Death and the other's a traitorous Bell Ringer. They don't deserve fairness!"

717179984.m_KeyValue: "You just met him today! What do you know about any of this?"

717179986.m_KeyValue: "You dumb wolf! Take care of that equally dumb monk and your brother. Leave this to us!"

717179987.m_KeyValue: ""All these years, I've been waiting for you to say something like that. I'm so glad...""

717179989.m_KeyValue: "Is this why the Church is so afraid of the Black Blood? They fear what they don't understand..."

717180018.m_KeyValue: ""When you were helping Noah and the others just now, big brother Skoll...""

717180019.m_KeyValue: ""He had it with him, so why didn't he take it?! He'd rather become... this...""

717180021.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, the singing is coming from not far to the north. If I'm not mistaken, that should be...""

717180049.m_KeyValue: ""But I'm really worried about my big brother, sister, and father...""

717180051.m_KeyValue: "Relax. He's the Gravekeeper of Ganelon. Ordinary Church Knights are no threat to him. Besides..."

717501228.m_KeyValue: ""Once the guards discovered our breakout, they didn't just bar the exits—they summoned reinforcements to hunt us.""

717501229.m_KeyValue: ""Good news, you were right about the gate—""

717501230.m_KeyValue: "It matches our suspicion. Fanny's confidence was no bluff—she believes there's no true escape."

719108967.m_KeyValue: ""When taking Basic ATK, Dodge Rate +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type.""

719108969.m_KeyValue: ""When dealing DMG, CRIT Rate +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type.""

719108970.m_KeyValue: "CRIT DMG Taken -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

719108972.m_KeyValue: "P. DMG Taken -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

721548716.m_KeyValue:
""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
With fantastic steering, it is a missed opportunity.""

721548717.m_KeyValue:
"With great power comes great responsibility!
The Mechanical Spider has great responsibility!"

721548719.m_KeyValue:
""It said, 'Charge forth.'
The processor issued a command, and the mechanical legs executed an action.""

721548722.m_KeyValue:
""New all-time high!
Though you've failed before, your success was inevitable.""

722455788.m_KeyValue:
""It said, 'Charge forth.'
It said, 'Charge forth.'
The processor issued a command, but the mechanical legs did not respond.""

722455790.m_KeyValue:
"Less power equals less responsibility!
Mechanical spider is ready to pass the buck!"

722455791.m_KeyValue:
""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
Afterwards, each sets off on their own journey, reeling from their wounds.""

722455793.m_KeyValue:
"The chassis failed to withstand the acceleration once more.
A few more failures and that'll be it."

723790249.m_KeyValue: "I'll draw her away. Please—you must lead these people to safety."

723790250.m_KeyValue: "Fighting in this foul dungeon… how loathsome."

723790258.m_KeyValue: "And you're in perfect health—so healthy you've never even caught a sense of humor."

723790259.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. I've no leisure to wander into a disaster zone only to amuse myself with lies."

723790262.m_KeyValue: "The truth is... the situation beyond these walls is far graver than it appears..."

723791313.m_KeyValue: "Eliminate the Shield Spirit to clear the stage."

724306953.m_KeyValue: "Hilda was cheerful. She spoke of starting over elsewhere."

724306959.m_KeyValue: "Hilda came to the Reese estate with her mother as a child. She used to serve Duke Reese and grew up alongside Reese II."

724306960.m_KeyValue: "He told me what he knew. Willingly."

724306961.m_KeyValue: "I'm sure you must have uncovered some inside information?"

724306962.m_KeyValue: "Aren’t you the one who prefers aggressive methods?"

724306963.m_KeyValue: "But the servant doesn't believe it was suicide."

724306964.m_KeyValue: "Yes. They say she hanged herself. Out of heartbreak… or abandonment."

724306965.m_KeyValue: ""Later, the maid died, so the rumors stopped naturally.""

724306966.m_KeyValue: "Rumors swirled about the two of them… until Reese II became engaged to someone else."

724383333.m_KeyValue: ""An experienced sailor who's served on _$$El Dorado_$$ for many years. To avoid any pay cuts caused by fire damage done to the ship, they hone their remarkable marksmanship skills.""

724383334.m_KeyValue: ""A resident of Sunset Isle who has been waiting for Noah's return, placing their hopes in him to heal their old friend Sora.""

724762247.m_KeyValue: "Realizing that I was not the sole victor unsettled me."

724762250.m_KeyValue:
""Her counterattack came quicker than I anticipated.
As my body hit the ground, I heard her say she wanted to live on with me.""

724762280.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I couldn't provide answers to fate, yet I arrogantly believed myself to be unique._$$""

724762312.m_KeyValue:
""Alas, the girl I rescued most closely resembles the one from these memories.
Perhaps I was mistaken...""

724762313.m_KeyValue: ""If I could dictate the course of the story, I would undoubtedly be a dictator.""

724762346.m_KeyValue:
""The blade in my hand was merciless, embracing death to be reborn—this reflected my current state of mind.
I delivered the harshest judgments upon my kind, yet I was still unable to restore the world.
Only when I severed their last hope did the cold blood in my chest begin to boil.""

724762379.m_KeyValue:
""However…
_$$The dishonest part of oneself is that which becomes their fate._$$""

724762412.m_KeyValue:
""Do I crave to survive? To become one among _$$them_$$?
Or do I desire to become _$$their_$$ amalgamation?""

724762445.m_KeyValue:
""_$$They_$$ look the same. Perhaps... I do as well?
It's vexing... the moment my chest was torn, my hunger dissipated.""

725081910.m_KeyValue: ""Silver-haired, your allegiances are rather transparent, wouldn't you say?""

725081911.m_KeyValue: "How peculiar. In battle we take every measure to avoid contamination by the enemy's vile secretions."

725081912.m_KeyValue: ""Stay back, stay back— please, I'm begging you... Ahhhhh!""

725081913.m_KeyValue: ""The moment the survivor beholds Letitia's true visage, terror seizes him. He thrashes in panic, forcing himself back in desperate retreat.""

725081916.m_KeyValue: ""These marks on my body... they're not from the Mutation, but rather...""

725081917.m_KeyValue: "He's right. I am the Dark Witch."

Knight's Lance: Increases range of Friedrich's Ultimate.""
