725549607.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, Bella summons 4 <link=""Tips_ID;20081""><#508499><u>Animated Puppets</u></color></link> every 8 sec for {2} sec. The puppets will have <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> of Bella's ATK, as well as <style=""Highlight"">{1}</style> of her DEF and HP, and will be targeted in place of Bella.""

726674439.m_KeyValue: ""Take the current Black Blood disease outbreak—perhaps from the very beginning, the Black Blood disease had been designed to plague humanity, selecting only those who could adapt to an entirely new chapter of history.""

726674440.m_KeyValue: ""Once they lose that identity, extinction becomes their inevitable fate.""

726674447.m_KeyValue: ""I can sense it—you don't just understand these humans, you have lived among them. Every time we speak of the past, there's something in your voice... something that remembers.""

726674449.m_KeyValue: "To bare your past so openly before me... I'm not sure our relationship has grown quite that intimate yet."

726674450.m_KeyValue: "Such keen insight... You truly are worthy of being the chosen one."

726674451.m_KeyValue: ""Aside from you, I haven't encountered a second ancestral human—in fact I haven't even heard whispers of one.""

726674452.m_KeyValue: ""It's simply that I've been fascinated by you from the very beginning, Silver-haired.""

726674453.m_KeyValue: "They are called ancestors because their very existence served a singular purpose—to push forward civilization and history itself."

726674454.m_KeyValue: "Because most of them have long since been consumed by the passage of time..."

727638155.m_KeyValue: "Now that I know you reside in the castle—when would you like me to return the tarot cards you left in my room?"

727671916.m_KeyValue: ""Upon waking, I found a note slipped under the door. It was in Hati's handwriting.""

727781895.m_KeyValue: "Agnes chose Starfall Valley as our meeting place. Something about this feels... wrong."

728695637.m_KeyValue: "The light shall shine upon us all."

728697551.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong with changing my mind? I’m not the type to be stuck in my ways."

728698572.m_KeyValue: ""So talkative... Fine, this lady will change her vote. Happy now?""

728700750.m_KeyValue: "Let's go with your idea this time!"

728701643.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I knew it. These are your real feelings.""

728702664.m_KeyValue: "Why are you glaring at me... Aren't you afraid?"

728703821.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, your plan does seem a bit more effortless.""

728704842.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid I couldn't keep up with your line of thought earlier."

728707913.m_KeyValue: ""If changing my mind will make you talk less, I suppose it's not a bad option.""

729389262.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain of the Cidhall family, known as the 'Golden Ascendant,' warded off the dust of his family's decline with a glimmer of defiance in his eyes.""

729389263.m_KeyValue: ""'No, wait.' Aiona's face was veiled with sorrow as she knelt down, her fingers gently brushing the damp soil to the object buried within.""

729389264.m_KeyValue: ""The cabin's interior was filled with piles of books, letters, notes, and maps. As the door opened, a few loose pages stirred by the wind fluttered gently to the trio's feet.""

729389265.m_KeyValue: ""'You mean like on the linen?' Gilrain asked, popping an orange slice into his mouth and savoring the tangy juice.""

729389266.m_KeyValue: "'Leonardo Ptolemy... that name rings a bell.' Gilrain began sifting through the books he had read in her mind."

729389267.m_KeyValue: ""After a sleepness night of tumultuous thoughts, the trio departed from the Eye of God at dawn. They set out towards the forbidden grounds of the Ganelon family, into an inescapable destiny.""

729392526.m_KeyValue: ""'Since you've come all this way… why not let me do a reading for you, meow?' The cat extended one paw and tapped the top of the deck—and the cards began to hover, gently spinning in the air...""

729392527.m_KeyValue: ""—This was the hallmark of the Bell Ringer known as the Lightning Overlord, when the battlelust in her veins began to stir beyond restraint.""

729392528.m_KeyValue: ""With a soft thump, the black cat leapt lightly onto the table, batted the crystal ball aside, and curled up on the cushion meant to go under it—Wait, what about the crystal ball!?""

729392530.m_KeyValue: ""Without waiting for the cat's reply, Joan turned and walked out of the tent, crystal ball in hand. Naturally, Theophane followed close behind. Before long, the two had vanished into the forest.""

729392531.m_KeyValue: ""'Tell me, Bell Ringer... Was that deliberate?' Even in the face of such an odd result, the cat remained unbothered. 'Well, technically… the rules don't say you can't flip someone else's card, meow.'""

729392532.m_KeyValue: ""'...Meow?!' Startled, the cat rubbed its face with a paw. 'Oh my whiskers, didn't expect that one.'""

729392533.m_KeyValue: ""...What!? That's what you noticed? And what's with that smug look, like you've just uncovered some grand conspiracy? Don't act like you've made some critical breakthrough in the name of the Church!""

729458958.m_KeyValue: ""'Ami, we've discussed this countless times, haven't we?' A man in fine attire shook his head wearily. 'We cannot go to Starfall Valley.'""

729458959.m_KeyValue: ""'Recycling names like that is pretty lazy, don't you think?' Goldland turned toward the camera with a smug grin. 'Just like... some third-rate bard.'""

729458960.m_KeyValue: ""'Risking everything for a mere taste... Captain Ami, I beg you to reconsider!'""

729458961.m_KeyValue: ""'That's the situation, right, Captain Ami?' Stella, having finally dragged her attention back from her lost vacation, grasped the whole situation with remarkable speed and graciously offered Ami a diplomatic escape.""

729458962.m_KeyValue: ""'Assuming we actually know where this so-called <style=Highlight>Minexus Restoration System Y</style> is located.' Stella finished speaking and turned her gaze toward Regina, who had proposed this solution.""

729458964.m_KeyValue: ""'Heh, I must admit—this ending turned out rather well after all.' Goldland turned toward the camera with a light chuckle, then straightened with renewed purpose. 'Well then, Captain, your orders?'""

729458965.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't worry—once we pull this off, I won't shortchange you even a minute of that vacation I promised!'""

729460046.m_KeyValue: "'Not using the chance to carry out a private trial?'"

729460047.m_KeyValue: ""After a brief silence, he rose and stepped forward. 'Heh. You think I'm wasting my time with this, eh? Noah.'""

729460048.m_KeyValue: ""Far from offended, Agares let loose a laugh. 'As expected of you. Straight to the point.'""

729460049.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh yes,' Agares added while digging, 'you're lending a hand too.'""

729460050.m_KeyValue: "'Let's see who the real Bell Ringer is—and who the imposter truly is. Let's settle this!'"

729460051.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh...?' Judging by Agares's reaction, it seemed he'd just laid eyes on someone he didn't expect.""

729460052.m_KeyValue: "Noah turned toward the voice. From the fading mist emerged a graceful silhouette—Mass."

729460053.m_KeyValue: "'Haven't you both noticed something?' Noah finally spoke up."

729460055.m_KeyValue: ""'Protect, huh.' Noah rubbed his chin with one hand, thinking aloud. 'What could possibly be worth protecting in a place like this?'""

729461134.m_KeyValue: ""'Though the Bathory graveyard has long been abandoned, secret messages from nearby villagers claim that strange music can still be heard here.'""

729461135.m_KeyValue: "'Alright.' Darcias loosened her grip on Acappella."

729461136.m_KeyValue: "'Objective confirmed. <style="Highlight">Find inspiration for musical composition</style>. Destination confirmed. <style="Highlight">Wailing Crypts</style>.'"

729461137.m_KeyValue: "'Did you just make that name up?'"

729461138.m_KeyValue: ""'That mud monster just performed a surprisingly rhythmic piece without any instruments,' Acappella said while running.""

729461139.m_KeyValue: ""'I see—this must be the source of the strange music. Still, I never imagined a form like that could create such unusual melodies.'""

729461140.m_KeyValue: ""'What are you doing?' Darcias watched as Acappella lay on the ground, contemplating who her blade would strike once drawn.""

729461141.m_KeyValue: ""The mud monster glanced at the Bell Ringer on the left, then at the Vice-Commander on the right, her hand resting on her blade, before turning and slithering away.""

729461144.m_KeyValue: ""'Wait.' Acappella stopped Darcias as she reached for her sword, her eyes locked on the mud monster, the tension in the air.""

729461145.m_KeyValue: ""'Thank you, but beings like us don't have birthdays.'""

729533006.m_KeyValue: ""'What caught us both off guard was how surprisingly weak these evil vampires were. We wiped them out easily, leaving our battle lust unsatisfied.'""

729533007.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't call her that,' Hati sighed, shaking her head. 'She'll kill you if she hears you.'""

729533010.m_KeyValue: ""A series of metallic clashes echoed behind Hati, punctuated by a distinct, ethereal resonance. One weapon clearly stood apart from the rest—Ganelon's Moonlight Sword.""

729533011.m_KeyValue: ""'Uncle Gadric!' Hati cried out as she rushed to his aid. As she helped him up, disbelief coursed through her—surely his fall couldn't have been just due to carelessness.""

729533012.m_KeyValue: "Hati checked one last time to confirm there were no critters around before finally accepting Gadric's answer."

729533013.m_KeyValue: ""Clive Ganelon was fiercely loyal to both his family and the Church. However, it was this very devotion that rendered him an inadequate father.""

729536273.m_KeyValue: ""'As dawn broke the next day, rain began to fall, cascading the blood of the Bloodborn down the tower's façade, transforming its pristine white surface to pitch black. It took the Bathory family a full day and night of relentless effort to finally reduce Fangtooth Tower to rubble.'""

729536274.m_KeyValue: ""'I don't know the exact details, but I would guess he received the Embrace and became a Bloodborn. After that, this Ganelon helped the Bathory family launch a surprise attack on Mouret.'""

729536275.m_KeyValue: ""'Moreover, it played a crucial role in a certain campaign,' Empousa added, her eyes gleaming with barely concealed pride.""

729536276.m_KeyValue: ""'It's fine,' Hati muttered, averting her gaze.""

729536277.m_KeyValue: ""'What's this, dumb wolf?' Empousa's voice suddenly rang out from the stairway. 'Putting on a show at such dizzying heights with your abysmal swordsmanship?'""

729562414.m_KeyValue: "'There is no need to rush. We have endless time... to tell stories that unfold upon distant stages...'"

729562415.m_KeyValue: "Who are you?! Why have you barged in as narrator? Why steal bread from the mouths of bards?! The <style="Highlight">Minexus Bard Association</style> will not forgive this!"

729562416.m_KeyValue: "How many times must I say it—stop stealing the bard's job!"

729562417.m_KeyValue: ""Meeting Letitia's expectant gaze, Stella finally speaks. '...Noah Nevernight?'""

729562418.m_KeyValue: ""Ever the pragmatist, Stella accepts Letitia's explanation. But who is the next likely maternal figure?""

729562419.m_KeyValue: ""'I-I don't believe this ridiculous tale! I'm just... just curious, nothing more—something to pass the time.'""

729562420.m_KeyValue: "'Hmm... but doesn't Aiona usually appear with Friedrich and Gilrain? Don't tell me Noah stole her away...'"

729562421.m_KeyValue: ""Ahem, pardon the interruption, but according to Minexus: A Brief History (8th Edition), Noah is actually taken from Sunset Isle by the Church, not Empousa—""

729564590.m_KeyValue: ""'This sacred ground once echoed with the Bathory family's devout prayers to the goddess Aeon,' Cain said. 'Do you know why it now lies in ruins?'""

729564591.m_KeyValue: ""'The power of time is a divine right, not to be wielded by mortal hands,' Nicole interjected, cutting straight to the point.""

729564592.m_KeyValue: ""Just then, Van Helsing noticed dozens of books stacked in the corner. 'Look! There are books over there!'""

729564593.m_KeyValue: ""'So this is why it's called the Crescent Garden,' Piera remarked to her junior disciples, a wry smile playing on her lips. 'The roses have formed a perfect crescent around the ruins.'""

729564596.m_KeyValue: ""'How he defeated the knights guarding the church and destroyed the sturdy building remained a mystery. Many whispered that he received help from the Bloodborn. Afterwards, he disappeared into the annals of history.'""

729564597.m_KeyValue: "'His prayer was answered!' But Isaac's elation quickly gave way to suspicion—there had to be a catch."

729565551.m_KeyValue: ""'And there's really only one person who would…' With a flick of the wrist, Thibault stirred the dust behind them. Within the haze, the outline of a familiar figure began to take shape.""

729565552.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah—no leaving!' Seeing Agares and Thibault about to slip away, Acappella panicked and pointed toward an empty patch of ground. 'Look over there! What is that!?'""

729565553.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah! The crest of the Tempus Church!' Acappella clapped her hands excitedly and plopped to the ground, wiping her hand across the earth as if smoothing out a pile of cards.""

729565554.m_KeyValue: "'Let's make our own rules and battle with them!' Acappella clapped her hands in excitement. 'But first—we've got to name this deck!'"

729565555.m_KeyValue: "Even though I can't see a thing… the Bell Ringers' battle has begun! Don't think a bard will just sit back and fold—A true bard plays until the curtain drops!"

729565556.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, why are neither of you attacking?! That's so boring!' Acappella groaned, clutching her head in theatrical despair. 'Aaaah! Where is Darcias when I need her!?'""

729565557.m_KeyValue: ""So then, with Acappella having launched such an aggressive opening… How would Agares—who had been under pressure since the start—strike back? Could that have been where his counterattack began?""

729565558.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no, not this again. Darcias is still—""

729565559.m_KeyValue: "Hmm… Might be useful as a way to train soldiers' mental acuity.' Thibault took the cards from Acappella and casually passed them to a nearby Church soldier."

729603790.m_KeyValue: ""_$$How dare you cast aside such a precious gift from nature!_$$ Gone was the soft-spoken Aiona they knew. In her place stood a figure of calm, unshakable authority.""

729603791.m_KeyValue: ""_$$…Huh? Why would I want something you just tossed away? Don't flatter yourself, Fred!_$$""

729603792.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona dismissed Gilrain's savage assault entirely, whirling to gaze toward the distant point where another version of herself had materialized—""

729603793.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona drew a dagger, turning the blade thoughtfully in her fingers. _$$A task from the Church... You really haven't changed at all... Though I do find comfort in such consistency._$$""

729603794.m_KeyValue: ""Sensing an edge, Gilrain gestured toward Aiona's garments whipping in the bitter wind. _$$I know that dress. It's the birthday gift she received when she turned sixteen._$$""

729603795.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Tch, of all the days to visit this godforsaken mountain village, it had to be the year's cruelest..._$$ Though his shattered chestplate left Gilrain's torso bare against winter's bite...""

729603797.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I truly cherish the gifts you both gave me, but today I chose something for the task, something more..._$$""

729603802.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain's eyes fell on the shawl now draped around Aiona's shoulders. _$$This is..._$$"

729603803.m_KeyValue: ""_$$In the original timeline, Joyce Gadric would have destroyed you. Completely._$$ Her voice wavered, and for a heartbeat, sorrow shadowed her features.""

729604880.m_KeyValue: ""'I suspect by now, some would be tempted to give up.'""

729604881.m_KeyValue: "Yggdrasill studied the fragile creature that was on the verge of death. He recognized it as a 'Cloud Fairy' butterfly."

729604882.m_KeyValue: "'His first headache was recruiting manpower. He quickly discovered that no one was willing to brave certain death on the snowy plains.'"

729604883.m_KeyValue: ""'Yet they trudged on, down a one-way path to certain doom.'""

729604884.m_KeyValue: ""Edina's master approached her and, without looking, sensed that she was cradling protectively a butterfly with damaged wings in her hands.""

729604885.m_KeyValue: ""'The momentary warmth you offer it—is it truly poison or antidote? Can you really discern the difference?' With these words, Yggdrasill took long strides towards the house.""

729636462.m_KeyValue: ""'Of course he is. After all, he's a true Ganelon, through and through.'""

729636463.m_KeyValue: ""'Empousa, may I request for the farmers of your lands to come here and harvest the wheat?'""

729636466.m_KeyValue: ""'I suppose the young lady only reads what interests her.' Ami glanced into the mill, quickly grasped its workings, and just as swiftly lost interest.""

729636467.m_KeyValue: ""'You bloodsucking pest...' Hati began, but couldn't muster a proper comeback. Instead, she used the key to unlock the door of Mouret Mill, hesitating as she took just one step inside.""

729636468.m_KeyValue: ""'Many in the Ganelon family know this story, yet they still maintain their faith and support the Church. As for the Bathory family, however...'""

729636469.m_KeyValue: ""'No,' Hati revealed, her voice tinged with disbelief at her own words. 'It happened after the two families had been locked in a prolonged war.'""

729641776.m_KeyValue: ""'What is that?' Empousa asked, her face scrunching up in disgust. 'It looks absolutely filthy.'""

729641777.m_KeyValue: "'He also said that only when I truly gained that power would I have the right to take the gloves down from the roof.'"

729641778.m_KeyValue: ""Before Hati could reveal why they were on the roof, the sky was suddenly split by a bolt of lightning. A deafening crash of thunder followed, causing stone tiles to break loose and tumble from the roof.""

729641779.m_KeyValue: ""''It shall stand as the pinnacle of the continent!' he proclaimed to all, dismissing the very existence of mountains. The moment the tower's highest platform was barely habitable, he ascended with feverish anticipation.'""

729641780.m_KeyValue: ""'Perhaps you should worry more about your castle's food supplies,' Ressa teased, hitting Empousa's sore spot: Ami was eating them out of house and home.""

729641781.m_KeyValue: "Empousa glanced up at the top of the mill with curiosity. 'Are you afraid of heights or the dark?'"

729708334.m_KeyValue: "'You're right! If even Hati isn't getting seasick... This Ethereal Springs must be something special.'"

729708335.m_KeyValue: "'We just talked about how unfair that would be!'"

729708336.m_KeyValue: ""'It’s a real hassle, but to create a hot spring capable of soothing back pain—'""

729708337.m_KeyValue: ""'Come on now, fire is the most impartial force to all living things,' Agares said, shaking his head. 'And besides, who do you think you have to thank for this hot spring existing in the first place?'""

729708338.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, shoot... Well, I guess this will have to do.'""

729708339.m_KeyValue: ""'What folly is this... Do you believe a mere tree can mark your claim to this hot spring? Your winded words fall short here, Bell Ringer.'""

729708340.m_KeyValue: ""And there, in the pool, was none other than their arch-enemy, the Church's Bell Ringer, Agares! (Though, considering his past beast transformation through a Covenant, Bell Beast might be a more fitting name.)""

729708341.m_KeyValue: ""Neck-deep in the water, Noah let out a soft chuckle. His gaze swept across the modest pool, pausing at certain spots as if lost in memories of those who had once been there.""

729709294.m_KeyValue: ""'Well said.' Nicole stepped toward Gadric’s body, still floating atop the spring’s surface. Placing both hands on his helmet, she said, 'Now, at last, we can uncover his true face—'""

729709295.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, what's that supposed to mean? Don't tell me... Gadric isn't really...?""

729709299.m_KeyValue: ""'I'm rather sensitive to changes in air and temperature. It's not by choice, just something I have to deal with. Trust me, you wouldn't want to feel the same.'""

729709300.m_KeyValue: ""'This is bad. Gadric could drown! Initiate emergency rescue!' Before the words had even finished leaving her mouth, Darcias raised both hands and cleaved the water with deadly precision.""

729709306.m_KeyValue: "And in the very next moment... BOOM! The entire Ethereal Springs erupted in a massive explosion!"

729709307.m_KeyValue: ""'Ugh, I'm bored. Farming is so dull.' The _$$Gadric_$$ who had just used the Covenant removed their helmet, revealing Acappella's face underneath. 'And to think I even knocked that garlic-head out cold...'""

729780214.m_KeyValue: ""'Eureka!' Goldland exclaimed, clapping his hands with unbridled excitement. 'We'll wait for this round of exquisite golden sand to finish its journey, then I'll flip it right side up, and we can commence our grand competition!'""

729780215.m_KeyValue: ""In a flash, he whipped out an object. A burst of dazzling golden light erupted from his palm. Everyone squinted, eyeing it warily. The tension was thick in the air.""

729780216.m_KeyValue: ""Seemingly touched by Van Helsing's unwavering spirit, Noah gazed in awe at his figure disappearing into the mist. It took him a long moment to shake off his daze. '...Didn't he go in the wrong direction?' he asked, bemused.""

729780217.m_KeyValue: ""'Goldland has done his research and found the best fishing spot in advance. As long as no one interferes with him, victory will be ours.'""

729780218.m_KeyValue: ""Despite his misgivings, Noah found his body moving of its own accord. Before he knew it, his hand had instinctively grasped the golden hourglass.""

729780219.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing violently lifted a wooden plank, revealing a box underneath. 'Come forth, Seafood Tycoon Pearl!' As his words faded, a fierce burst of golden light erupted from the box—!""

729780220.m_KeyValue: ""Realizing he was in hot water, Noah darted off like a bolt of lightning. Van Helsing and Goldland, quick to catch on, erupted into furious shouts as they tore after him.""

729780221.m_KeyValue: ""'Those rumors were nothing but a calculated ploy to sow discord and divert attention, all to manipulate the seafood market behind the scenes... How did you all fall for such an obvious trap?'""

729782384.m_KeyValue: "How will this match unfold? Find out in the next chapter..."

729782390.m_KeyValue: ""'Hahaha, and here I thought you were building up to something profound...' Acappella laughed, clapping her hands. 'Instead it's just the same old mindless drivel. How hilarious!'""

729782391.m_KeyValue: ""'What's the big deal about being discovered by a Bell Ringer?' Empousa excitedly pointed at Acappella across from them. 'You're totally underestimating what a Bell Ringer can do, Lamia!'""

729782392.m_KeyValue: ""A while later, at a sandy area in Cerulean Fishing Village—""

729782393.m_KeyValue: ""The golden-haired woman seemed unsurprised by Acappella's appearance. 'Ah, you've arrived early. Please, come in, honorable Bell Ringer.'""

729782394.m_KeyValue: ""Then she repeated the motion, smashing it upward two more times.""

729782395.m_KeyValue: ""'Of course, the ball has to go over the fishing net first,' Tris added after a moment's thought. 'Also, if the ball touches you and then goes out of bounds... the point still goes to the other team.'""

729782396.m_KeyValue: ""'Now for the court.' Tris sketched a rough outline in the air for Acappella. 'About this size should do, Acappella.'""

729782397.m_KeyValue: ""'Tch, so what's this contest you're proposing?' Lamia flipped her hair back and took a step forward, looking down at Tris with disdain.""

729785526.m_KeyValue: "'Although I pulled you… why do I get the feeling you deliberately jumped in?'"

729785527.m_KeyValue: "Fine. I just want to get it over with and back on shore."

729785528.m_KeyValue: "'Give me a moment of peace and quiet.'"

729785530.m_KeyValue: "'Truthfully… my feelings toward the sea are complicated. That's why I usually just watch from shore.'"

729785532.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah wasn't going down without a fight. Calm and steady, he picked up speed with each stroke.""

729785533.m_KeyValue: ""Expression as unreadable as ever, Noah spoke evenly. 'Congratulations on your victory, Augustine.'""

729787698.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa suddenly realized something too. Ignoring the pain, she rushed to Lamia's side. 'A... debt note?'""

729787699.m_KeyValue: "'Well... first you have to waltz with the village chief's sow... to demonstrate equality of all beings before the holy Covenant.'"

729787702.m_KeyValue: ""Before Empousa's words had even faded, the flowers shot upward from the ground, their thorny vines coiling around Acappella's arms and legs.""

729787703.m_KeyValue: "'...What are they doing?' Empousa watched Acappella and Tris in surprise. 'But this works for us—they'll be too busy with their internal strife to receive the ball!'"

729787704.m_KeyValue: ""Silence fell over the field. Empousa, closest to the fish-skin ball, stood with her clothes drenched in sweat, watching as the ball continued to rotate and grind against the fishing net before her.""

729787705.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa nodded. 'You're right, there's only one question left—'""

729787706.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey... don't mess this up here.' Empousa turned her head slightly, whispering seriously to Lamia beside her at the fishing net.""

729787707.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, this little thing?' Acappella waved her hand dismissively. The ball suddenly slowed, finally coming to a gentle stop, hovering in front of her.""

729787708.m_KeyValue: ""The thunder startled the seabirds perched on the net posts, sending them soaring skyward—right past where Tris now hovered. She extended her index finger toward the fish-skin ball, which hung almost motionless before her...""

729787709.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh no...!' Before Acappella could finish, Lamia felt an immense resistance against the ball she had kicked—as if it were stuck in thick mud.""

729787869.m_KeyValue: "But the fish skin ball remains intact"

730042378.m_KeyValue: "Clear [Sapphire Isle] <color=#a65f30>N 1-7</color>: Becoming Lady of the Isle"

730164487.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps future generations will invent something that meets your requirements."

730164488.m_KeyValue: "Hmph. Seems that thick skull of yours still doesn't understand what a privilege this is."

730164495.m_KeyValue: "Is there another Elder in this castle more deserving of your undivided devotion?"

730164497.m_KeyValue: "Silence and avoidance won't get you out of this."

730164498.m_KeyValue: "Ah. These tortured souls won't stop wailing. I really need someone who can quiet them for me."

730164499.m_KeyValue: ""Care to give it a try, dear Noah?""

730164500.m_KeyValue: "That's the first time I've heard murder described so poetically."

730164501.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. I'd never let you end up like them."

730164502.m_KeyValue: ""I'd keep you locked in my room, making all the lovely sounds I want to fall asleep to.""

732681187.m_KeyValue: "...There shouldn't be another living soul left on this island."

732681189.m_KeyValue: "The tenth Bell Ringer at the time arrived on the island with her 'Choir.'"

732681190.m_KeyValue: ""The members of the Landis family we encountered covet the power of the Calamity; in contrast, the Paracelsus family are sworn mortal enemies of the Calamity.""

732681192.m_KeyValue: ""But Piera, if Death has been sealed in the Church's territories for the past 66 years, and the island has been abandoned by your family, why did you return now?""

732681193.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... look carefully, that is not me.""

732681220.m_KeyValue: "Piera... you seem more upbeat than usual. Is it because we got away from Death?"

732681221.m_KeyValue: "You nearly lost your life trying to help me. Nothing could be more important than finding you safe and sound."

732681222.m_KeyValue: ""We... we searched everywhere, but couldn't find the doctor... Sora, he... he didn't make it...""

732681224.m_KeyValue: "We must go to the village. We need to find the doctor as soon as possible."

732681483.m_KeyValue: ""May the mortals of both shores be freed from sorrow, no longer divided by the veil of life and death.""

732681484.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, that's right... to save Ami from Famine, I grabbed her and dove into the sea...""

732681485.m_KeyValue: ""But if the Blood Beasts and I all washed up on this island, the ship must have went down near the coast. There's a good chance the others made it too.""

732681515.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I think that's the first time someone's said that to me. This isn't really my usual style of dress.""

732681516.m_KeyValue: "Okay but... I don't think I can walk... I'm really sorry for being such a burden."

732681518.m_KeyValue: ""I've been walking along this coast for quite some time since I came to, yet the daylight hasn't changed at all.""

732681548.m_KeyValue: "Then you're also from here? And you've only heard about it from others... Could we be in the same boat?"

732681549.m_KeyValue: ""It appears to be just a sprain, but you should still be careful.""

732681550.m_KeyValue: "You lived here? Are there other people living on this island?"

732681553.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... my mother told me about the legend of this island. 'Our home is forever chasing the sun across the sea, so night never falls...'""

732681579.m_KeyValue: "The person I saw was much younger than the grandmother I remember..."

732681582.m_KeyValue: "Is it really just a coincidence? What do you think?"

732681585.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for waking me up. I promise I'll remember... remember who you are!"

732681586.m_KeyValue: ""Damnit! Just when I thought we found a lead on the doctor, it's just an empty shell who can't remember anything!""

732681615.m_KeyValue: "A Vice-Commander's sworn duty is to protect their Bell Ringer."

732681616.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, this is all his fault! Making me suffer that infernal boat ride and having to step foot on this bizarre island again.""

732681618.m_KeyValue: ""Because when we captured him the first time, he left something very important here...""

732681647.m_KeyValue: ""So you were... truly that special to Dr. Ressa...? No, I can't aceept it...""

732681649.m_KeyValue: ""I may not be able to see your grandmother, but I could see how happy you were when you were talking with her. Even though...""

732681650.m_KeyValue: "Well... um... I know it's hard to believe since you couldn't see her..."

732681675.m_KeyValue: "So these are indeed phantoms... What are the rules that determine how they appear and to whom?"

732681676.m_KeyValue: ""But for the Divine Body or the Calamity, I still have no idea where they are or what they look like...""

732681678.m_KeyValue: "Well... it's complicated. Can you tell me what you know about the Calamity first."

732681679.m_KeyValue: ""So, your family's duty must be to...""

732681680.m_KeyValue: ""I hesitated. I thought about becoming a different person, discarding all of my past... but I just couldn't do it.""

732681681.m_KeyValue: "You already knew about this island's strange phenomenon."

732681682.m_KeyValue: ""...Divine Body? I've only read about them in my grandmother's books. I never imagined you would have encountered them firsthand, and twice at that...""

732886657.m_KeyValue: ""Let us retrace the path you've taken... Back to the beginning, where the heart gives rise to form.""

732886659.m_KeyValue: "Limine would awaken stronger than any of us. And who knows who'd she choose as her first meal."

732886660.m_KeyValue: "So our little silver-haired one really does have the grit and cleverness Agares spoke so fondly of..."

732886661.m_KeyValue: ""When I stole you—the spark—from the Grand Cathedral, I didn't expect you'd follow every step of my design so perfectly.""

732886662.m_KeyValue: ""According to our plan, a civil war will erupt in Starfall Valley. It will break the Blood Moon Seal.""

733299021.m_KeyValue: "It seems your encounters with those outsiders Bella and Cidhall have taught you the rules of this 'game.'"

733299022.m_KeyValue: ""Fear not. What stands before you is but one of my avatars, its power still within mortal bounds to challenge.""

733299053.m_KeyValue: ""No matter what lies ahead, I'll be by your side. But...""

733299054.m_KeyValue: "Then we have nothing more to say to you."

733299055.m_KeyValue: "What does that mean?! ...Is it the far side of the moon? Or a bleeding moon? I've seen both in my dreams..."

733299057.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, we'll think about it on the way. Before we find the last two cards and escape...""

733299317.m_KeyValue: "Who am I? Why am I here?"

733299319.m_KeyValue: "The ones locked up here either lose their minds in despair or rush headfirst into death without a second thought. But you..."

733299320.m_KeyValue: ""Instead of complaining, pay attention to what's ahead of us...""

733299349.m_KeyValue: "I think whoever's controlling those puppets might be the one watching us."

733299351.m_KeyValue: "Brilliant! Teaming up with you was a great idea!"

733299352.m_KeyValue: "What if there was more than one prison from the start?"

733299383.m_KeyValue: "Huh? So you don't believe that the far side of the moon is our true home?"

733299413.m_KeyValue: ""Darn, she's pretty sharp when it comes to making deals...""

733299414.m_KeyValue: ""Don't flatter yourself. I made the decision to leave, and I was the one who found the card clue.""

733299416.m_KeyValue: "Bella's quite happy to have made two new friends."

733299417.m_KeyValue: "Jealous?! How did you come to that conclusion?!"

733299449.m_KeyValue: ""We got lucky once, but how can we ensure we'll be fortunate enough to survive a second or third time?""

733299451.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm right, then the person controlling these statues might... possess the third card.""

733299481.m_KeyValue: "The path ahead is yours to choose."

733299483.m_KeyValue: "I'm surprised you still have the strength to speak."

733299513.m_KeyValue: ""No, on the contrary, I think it's wonderful!""

733299516.m_KeyValue: "We'll have to use our tried-and-true method—knock them out! But be careful not to fall off—Aaah!"

733916959.m_KeyValue: ""Even when I invoked Covenant just now, the results were clear:""

733916960.m_KeyValue: "Our rate of elimination is vastly outpaced by their rate of creation."

733916961.m_KeyValue: ""By my calculations, the probability of successful resistance is… zero.""

733916962.m_KeyValue: ""As Miss Death had said, that world's 'Mastermind' has near-limitless creative capacity.""

733916963.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. Didn't you once say you love to solve every problem? Then solve this."

733916965.m_KeyValue: ""And here, in this man's workshop, those works lie scattered in plain view.""

733916966.m_KeyValue: "Enough talk! Let this ancient genius tell us how we're meant to fend off those monsters!"

733916967.m_KeyValue: ""It's no exaggeration. To ordinary folk, an alchemist is a genius.""

733916968.m_KeyValue: "But such geniuses often spend their lives crafting things meant to reshape the world—"

733917981.m_KeyValue: ""To face a 'Mastermind' like that... would take at least two of me—and two of you. Now, lead the way.""

733917982.m_KeyValue: "That is why the me from over there sent our silver-haired guest to us."

733917985.m_KeyValue: "Then your so-called 'Mastermind' has had far more time to create those tireless constructs."

733917987.m_KeyValue: ""If these things are alchemical in origin, powered by liquid catalysts, then destroying the 'Mastermind' might be the only way to end this.""

733917988.m_KeyValue: "So you're suggesting we enter that world and destroy the source that controls them all?"

733917989.m_KeyValue: "Sounds like that version of you is smarter."

733917990.m_KeyValue: ""Then let us make proper use of the singularity she carried to this side. After all, it was the me from her world who uncovered it.""

733917991.m_KeyValue: "He did mention it once... That a single bell toll here might span ten years back home."

733917992.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm not mistaken, time flows more swiftly in that world. He's simply had longer to work.""

733920160.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's not the sky—it's more of those metal scraps—!!""

733920161.m_KeyValue: "The resemblance is stronger now! This is exactly what happened on Sunset Isle!"

733920162.m_KeyValue: ""No, it looks like something tore it open—""

733920163.m_KeyValue: ""This… I feel like I've seen it before. Don't tell me the sky's about to fall again, like on Sunset Isle?""

733920165.m_KeyValue: "That's impossible! We should still be halfway to Albrecht's workshop..."

733920167.m_KeyValue: "The blue constructs… they've gone completely still."

736222609.m_KeyValue: "This is a personal invitation from the Warden herself. She's expecting me."

736222610.m_KeyValue: "Because of those inmates who met their untimely end?"

736222611.m_KeyValue: ""No. I've come to deliver deeper pain. True, unblemished pain.""

737624038.m_KeyValue: "Could those slaves have come from the sea as well?"

737624039.m_KeyValue: ""Be it 'auctions' or 'elections', Sapphire Isle seems to be undergoing many institutional reforms.""

737624041.m_KeyValue: "Me?! Am I really going to be a candidate?"

737624043.m_KeyValue: "Where are those wretched slaves? Release them all!"

737624071.m_KeyValue: ""I couldn't revive the dead, could I?""

737624072.m_KeyValue: ""Just as stubborn as your father. The world has changed, Isaac. Integrity and courage alone can't protect everyone.""

737624073.m_KeyValue: ""This is the treasure of Sapphire Isle, the Siren's Tear.""

737624096.m_KeyValue: "'Sapphire Isle has become a dead land. Only I can bring it back to life.'"

737624097.m_KeyValue: "(That familiar presence about her... am I just imagining it?)"

737624102.m_KeyValue: "Annoying... when you're nothing but food to me."

737624103.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather, I should say, there has never been a ‘Miss Ami’ in either the main line or any branch of our family.""

737624104.m_KeyValue: "Surely none here doubt Miss Ami—she has no cause to deceive us."

737624106.m_KeyValue: "These Sages certainly have quite a lot of secrets to hide."

737624107.m_KeyValue: ""From the very beginning, you fabricated Ami's image as wealthy and influential, lured Thoreau into drawing her in, and steered Selena and me toward the trail of the Mistbound Terror.""

737624108.m_KeyValue: ""I have one last question for you, Mistbound Terror.""

737757711.m_KeyValue: ""I'm just a side character, not meant to be noticed.""

737757777.m_KeyValue: ""It wasn't you who killed me, but my own sins and the evil I once committed.""

737757808.m_KeyValue: ""From the moment I took the path of a slayer, redemption became unworthy and unreachable.""

738391610.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing sighed quietly. '...What is it now?' He had made a deal with Goldland before and knew that Goldland was caught up in some trivial matter again."

739123553.m_KeyValue: ""Randomly selects 3 enemies, dealing massive P. DMG to each target.""

739311947.m_KeyValue: ""DMG Reduction UP by {0}. Each CRIT Hit received reduces DMG Reduction by {1}, up to {2} times. When this limit is reached, becomes Stunned for {3} sec.""

739311948.m_KeyValue: "Ultimate Cost increased by {1}. Removed when Blood Moon is active."

739641126.m_KeyValue: "Different challenges await along different paths in the Threads of Fate."

740619704.m_KeyValue: ""...Ah, it seems to be the case. Like we've seen (or will see) similar stories before (or in the future). Perhaps we should try something else.""

742272565.m_KeyValue: ""So... please, Father, can you come to your senses? At least... at least let me say goodbye to you in person—""

742455330.m_KeyValue: "There must be a way. There must still be a way..."

742455331.m_KeyValue: ""(I see her sinking into the mire, yet no path reveals itself to pull her free.)""

742455332.m_KeyValue: "(The moon had risen. The dream was over.)"

744107703.m_KeyValue: "Partner? Maybe only a small part of him qualified as that…"

744107706.m_KeyValue: ""'Come now, Noah. Surely half of me counts as a partner, at least.'""

745381115.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Valora - Spirit Siphon avatar."

745381119.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Lamia - Spirit Siphon avatar."

745381120.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Gadric - Spirit Siphon avatar."

745381121.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Tris - Spirit Siphon avatar."

745381122.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Seth - Spirit Siphon avatar."

745595688.m_KeyValue: "Even the faintest glimmer can pierce the night."

745595781.m_KeyValue: ""Where light reaches, shadows are born. Perhaps in some corner of my heart, there is darkness that goes unnoticed...""

745601278.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, alright... I suppose I can make an exception and allow you to speak with me.""

745603328.m_KeyValue: ""If there's a battle, I'm counting on you to watch my back!""

745604477.m_KeyValue: ""I really wish I could control my own future... At least then, I could slack off with you.""

745606527.m_KeyValue: ""I have always walked alone, but the moonlight seems to be casting two shadows.""

745606558.m_KeyValue: "Let's leave it at that for now."

745607676.m_KeyValue: "Allow me... to feel warmth once more."

745608825.m_KeyValue: ""Look down at your shadow. In times of loneliness, it's the only thing that will accompany you.""

745610875.m_KeyValue: ""Feeling bored? Come on, let's play our favorite game!""

745610906.m_KeyValue: "The path lies hidden among the stars."

745683799.m_KeyValue: "Clear [Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II (Any)] <style="Clientmessage01">Tier 9</style> to unlock."

746057305.m_KeyValue:
""'Joyce has received payment. And Joyce always upholds a deal!'
But in this case…
Joyce stood over Bella's mangled body, hands on her hips in dismay.
'Oh dear, oh dear. Half the body’s been eaten. Tragic… And the other half? Tainted with Black Blood... Such a pity…'
'But now Joyce has the answer! If we turn little Bella into a puppet, she'll never be sick again!'
'A win-win deal! Joyce really is a genius!'
'Before leaving… there's still time to wrap up one last transaction through Hallon!'""

746623293.m_KeyValue: ""The four contestants don't seem to mind, so why all these pointless comments from the audience?""

746647560.m_KeyValue: "Kenneth's team reporting in for scheduled relief..."

746647561.m_KeyValue: ""...No, we're right on schedule. Strange—Kenneth is never late.""

746647563.m_KeyValue: "All I know is my shift got longer because of it... (yawn)"

746650760.m_KeyValue: "I wish you could witness it—a new order reborn from the embers."

746650761.m_KeyValue: ""The Garden of Asta is fortified beyond compare. An assault with our current numbers would come at a steep cost, my Lord.""

747287638.m_KeyValue: ""What a pity, you almost completely 'devoured' me instead.""

747287639.m_KeyValue: "There it is... Of course someone as broken as you could never wield power from the 'other side.'"

747287640.m_KeyValue: ""I shall be reborn as the Calamity, 'Famine'—feared by all of mankind.""

747287641.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... I have to keep fighting... I can't let anyone else fall..."

747287645.m_KeyValue: "I wouldn't be so sure about that."

747287646.m_KeyValue: "You... We share the same blood—why do you all stand in my way!?"

747287647.m_KeyValue: ""There's nowhere left to run, little Devil.""

747297374.m_KeyValue: "Phew—I feel so much lighter. Did I finally shake off that thing?"

747297376.m_KeyValue: ""How... How long has it been since we last spoke face to face, my kindred?""

747298520.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me Cain sent you because he doesn't trust us to find the Moonblessed."

747298521.m_KeyValue: "That's not what I meant. Why are you on this ship?"

747298526.m_KeyValue: ""Though to be fair, Jacintha's the only one in the family who actually enjoys showing up in her beast form.""

747298527.m_KeyValue: "What's that surprise for? I can turn into a bat too. Controlling one's beast form is the basic for all Bloodborn."

747298528.m_KeyValue: "Meow—It seems The High Priestess is more familiar with this form of mine."

747298529.m_KeyValue: ""But the others are Bella, Gilrain, and... Oh!""

747298531.m_KeyValue: ""This is the ship's alchemy lab, isn't it? Naturally, I came to see if there was any useful research worth stealing, meow.""

747298532.m_KeyValue: "Enough distractions. Jacintha! What are you really here for?"

747298533.m_KeyValue: "Now I'm curious... What kind of beast forms do the other Elders and Noah have?"

747299551.m_KeyValue: "Wait—there's another one?! Who are you supposed to be?!"

747299552.m_KeyValue: "You seriously thought you could take me? Not in this lifetime!"

747299553.m_KeyValue: "How could this be... Am I still too weak? I need to eat..."

747300707.m_KeyValue: "Because Miss Hati... might be one of the Moonblessed we've been searching for."

747301722.m_KeyValue: "My faithful exist for one purpose only: to feed me."

747301723.m_KeyValue: ""Why's it smashing the floor now? What, is there food down there too?""

747301726.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah. And it ate all my rations, too. Truly heartbreaking.""

747301727.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you hit so hard... Didn't expect you to be such a good fighter."

747301728.m_KeyValue: "Such pitiful creatures... no wonder you cannot endure my power."

747301730.m_KeyValue: "Exactly! Stop right now! Those are my rations—you can't eat them all!"

747301731.m_KeyValue: "Ah... so that's what this is really about..."

747301732.m_KeyValue: "No one will keep me from eating..."

747301733.m_KeyValue: "So you've gorged yourself and grown this massive... and that's all you've got?"

747302883.m_KeyValue: "I see... Oh—right. I don't even know your name yet."

747302885.m_KeyValue: "No! I looked away for one second and that thing made it to the deck!"

751418990.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">We recommend playing through the [Ashes of Time] content first before reading this Vassal Journal</style>

_$$Thousands of years, gone in the blink of an eye._$$

Her hood and veil cloaked her visage; none would know her true identity. Perhaps even she has forgotten.

Should one defy destiny, or follow the path of fate?

For the one true future, within the annihilating void, a Vassal whom none remember endures her endless, futile vigil.""

751419025.m_KeyValue:
""We are children who belong nowhere. So home is wherever our family is.'

Eleven years ago, a shipwreck left a drifting branch of the Landis family stranded on Sapphire Isle. There, Lorelei found a new home. She learned to live as humans do, to speak as they speak—believing those simple days might last forever.

Until the Black Blood swept across the Isle. Until a Bell Ringer reduced her second home to ash. Until the ones she once called family became the very Lords who caged her kin. She found herself caught between the two.

Humans had once given her warmth… and bound her with sin.

The land had offered her shelter… and became the grave where she buried her soul.""

751419083.m_KeyValue:
""_$$I could have endured the endless night, had I never seen the blazing sun._$$

All the world knows the Howling Peninsula as a forsaken realm, cast beyond daylight's reach.

She was born under that darkness, like the rest of her kin. She could’ve lived her life beneath the moon, untouched by light or hope. But then she read a book—foreign poetry, written by sunlit people. The verses glowed with a quiet longing, and something inside her shifted. She began to write. In secret. Songs of light. Dreams of warmth.

When those songs crossed six centuries to reach the future, her doubts were finally answered. That single reply felt like light piercing through the dark. Persecution. Flames of war. Betrayal... The Howling Peninsula's shadow runs deeper than its endless night. She resolved to shatter this prison of perpetual darkness and claim a dawn of her own.""

751419149.m_KeyValue:
""_$$When one's knowledge and memory cease to exist, that is when true death occurs._$$

On the title page of the Church's _$$Codex Sanctus,_$$ the second name blessed by the Saint blazes with ethereal radiance—Albrecht Magnus, enigmatic Bell Ringer No. III, and history's first mortal soul to grasp the mysteries of alchemy.

His presence has woven itself into the very sinews of time. When scholars fold yellowed parchment, when smiths forge molten steel, when soldiers hone their blades—in countless unconscious moments, the embers of his legacy smolder in silence. Humanity calls this presence the _$$Gift of Magnus,_$$ speaking of it as naturally as wind through leaves or seeds sleeping in fertile earth.

In the light cast through the skylight of an alchemist's workshop, one can still faintly make out the presence of this Bell Ringer, bent over his sacred work, wielding civilization as his compass. What seethes within his crucible is neither mercury nor sulfur, but something far more profound—pure thought.

_$$From where does this world rise, and to where are we headed?_$$""

751419180.m_KeyValue:
""'Tell me, in places yet untouched by cartographers, could greater fascinations await?'

From sketching castles and chapels to exploring culture and geography, cartographers wield charcoal and parchment to map every realm, measuring the land one step at a time. The girl had traveled countless paths alongside her cartographer grandfather, learning that staying grounded was the true calling of their craft.

Yet why, when faced with magnificent castles, did her mind wander not to blueprints and stonework, but to the graceful figures who once danced through the grand halls? And when confronted with desolate ruins, why did her mind linger not on timelines or treaties, but on the nameless souls buried beneath, erased from memory? Was a cartographer meant to be tethered only to what could be seen and measured? Did the stories she uncovered—the whispered legends, the forbidden secrets, the hidden tales—truly count for nothing?

The girl steeled herself for distant shores. Perhaps history need not follow a set course, and perhaps within time's relentless currents the unexpected truly awaits discovery. This time, she would complete her pilgrimage on her own terms.""

751419238.m_KeyValue:
""_$$To ride into battle, one must have cause. Mine—past, present, and forever—is the same._$$

Loyalty courses through the veins of the Aegis bloodline, a creed Valora lives to perfection. As the old master's fiercest knight, she rides alone into battle, raises her Vassals, and secures the family's glory. Though the old master is gone, her devotion remains unbroken. To her, the Bathory legacy is sacred—and only those of the rightful bloodline may carry it forward.""

""In that battle, my weapon shattered.

As I faltered, struggling against the tide of enemies, a spear suddenly materialized in my grasp. The moment I laid eyes upon it, I felt its eager anticipation—it yearned to fight alongside me.

774282097.m_KeyValue: "Quinn smiles gracefully as she cuts in. _$$Perhaps you didn't hear me clearly. Allow me to repeat myself: Would you be so kind as to begin performing Mario and Juliet this very moment?_$$"

774282098.m_KeyValue: "_$$You... don't remember me?_$$ The blue-haired girl stumbles back in disbelief. _$$Wait—did you just say 'Baphomet'?!_$$"

774282099.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Hey! My lady! I didn't do anything!_$$ Sirene raises her voice with indignant flair as massive shadowy hands burst from her cloak, flailing in her defense.""

774282100.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Valora, Julius... I was right after all. Here I am again, back in Bathory Castle from 600 years past._$$""

774282101.m_KeyValue: ""Sirene saunters toward the castle with theatrical dismay. _$$I heard they're also performing 'Here, ye! Here, ye! Tis Silver Bright and Crimson Red' afterward..._$$""

774282103.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Now then, what delicious quarry has wandered into my web today..._$$ The petite figure prowls with predatory grace, then stops abruptly. _$$Curious... your scent... it echoes the Young Lady's..._$$""

774282110.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn hurries over and grabs her hand with both of hers. _$$Please, Agnes—won't you play Mario for us? If anyone can bring him to life, I know it's you!_$$""

774282111.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, and ranked second among the _$$Seven Must-See Plays of a Lifetime_$$ is _$$Here, ye! Here, ye! Tis Silver Bright and Crimson Red_$$... with _$$Ten Thousand Kisses_$$ claiming third place.""

774348660.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, in the very moment all eyes turned to the opened door, the guard vanished without a trace, catching Noah and Van Helsing completely by surprise.""

774348661.m_KeyValue: ""When the Ancestors entered the vault, they were shocked to find only one survivor among their food.'""

774348662.m_KeyValue: ""As the three stood before the guard, they resembled children who were caught red-handed.""

774349616.m_KeyValue: ""The tiny flame—barely the size of a bean—flickered and fought to survive, straining not to be devoured by the void of darkness around it. In the deathly silence of the great hall, only the sound of faint crackling hiss of fire could be heard.""

774349617.m_KeyValue: ""'He refused to be swallowed by the river of time. He sought eternal life.' Empousa picked up the thread of the tale, clearly no stranger to it herself.""

774349618.m_KeyValue: ""'Even if you're in a hurry, Lady Empousa…' Bella gave a small shake of her arm, trying to loosen the grip. '…Could you please not grab both of my right hands?'""

774349619.m_KeyValue: ""'Let's set that aside for now...' Bella smoothly sidestepped the accusation, her tone returning to business. 'Shouldn't we focus on fixing the complete darkness first?'""

774349622.m_KeyValue: "Ami froze mid-sentence. 'Hm?' She gave the air a sudden sniff. 'Huh? That’s... sea breeze? What’s it doing all the way out here...?'"

774349623.m_KeyValue: ""Before Lorelei could finish, the lights around them abruptly went out—no, it wasn't just the room. The entirety of Bathory Castle had plunged into pitch darkness. A power outage, in a place like this!""

774349628.m_KeyValue: ""Before she even finished her sentence, Lorelei snatched the Raog meat right out of Ami's mouth, causing the girl to snap at the air and let out a disgruntled whimper.""

774349629.m_KeyValue: "Huh? What’s going on now? Why has the story suddenly taken such a strange turn?!"

775338531.m_KeyValue: "You dare stand before the Lord without bowing?"

775338533.m_KeyValue: "Why do you always use such strange words to describe people?"

775338534.m_KeyValue: ""Yet you spread that black paste across her body, and she woke.""

778080317.m_KeyValue: ""Every successor who bore his title followed in his footsteps, carrying the roots of all medicine forward.""

778080318.m_KeyValue: ""Something wrong? You look uneasy. If you're tired, we can head in and rest.""

778080319.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Ressa... but this time, I have no choice but to break my promise.""

778080321.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. Though sixty-six years have passed, it felt like mere days while I slept.""

778083519.m_KeyValue: "The next strike shall put an end to your sins."

778085676.m_KeyValue: ""He tamed the proud lion, rode the wild-hearted camel, slew the coyote pack—now he claims the highest glory.""

778085682.m_KeyValue: ""'Aeon granted me life, yet withheld the hope to live on; Astolfo offered me shelter, yet abandoned me for my poverty; my scythe no longer reaps grain, but the heads of nobles.'""

778085715.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to guard the prisoners.""

778085716.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer clutching a pitchfork who seems to recognize Noah, though his attitude is far from friendly.""

778085717.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to defend the castle.""

778085718.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to repel the intruders.""

780681528.m_KeyValue: ""You think I don't know that!? Ever since that red moon rose, the desert...""

782654383.m_KeyValue: ""I give you my word—I seek only to retrieve something I left behind. Once found, I'll depart at once and trouble no one.""

783026332.m_KeyValue: ""The Church: Reach a Potency Rating of 150,000.""

784143279.m_KeyValue:
""Hati didn't find Clive. Instead, she was once again protected by that mysterious person.

Perhaps it was revenge for the deaths of those alchemists that led to Hati being targeted. When I found her, she had only minor scratches, but on the alchemists' bodies, I saw familiar fatal wounds.

Unlike before, however, the being protecting Hati left words written in blood on the ground: _$$Don't look for me._$$""

784143562.m_KeyValue: ""Since the El Dorado affair, Van Helsing has been receiving more and more requests from the Church—cases steeped in mystery, impossible to unravel by ordinary means. He accepts them all, not merely out of duty, but because these cases genuinely intrigue him.""

784143651.m_KeyValue: ""An ancient wooden ship model, its rotting timbers endlessly replaced to preserve its original form. Carved into the base are the words: 'What truly defines a person - their physical form, or their soul?' Did the one who asked ever find their answer?""

784143810.m_KeyValue: ""One day aboard the El Dorado, Ami began hearing mysterious calls—an inescapable mental interference that tormented her for a long time. Only when the El Dorado sank and she plunged into the sea did she realize: those calls were the Calamity's mental corruption. Now these calls have returned within the castle. Could the Calamity be rising again? I should warn Ami...""

784462644.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps I should be more direct—I've been viewing your past through the perspective of that earring."

784568431.m_KeyValue: ""It's a three-tier complex below ground. This yard lies on the first level, alongside the guards' quarters and Fanny's interrogation hall.""

784568432.m_KeyValue: "Yard time's over. Back to your cells—now."

784568433.m_KeyValue: ""Let me properly introduce you to Ironfist Gaol—my nightly domain of toil. Each evening I walk these corridors, checking on every soul within these walls.""

784568434.m_KeyValue: ""(Down the left passage—third level, the deepest circle. Still no sign of Henry.)""

786139109.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia seeks to speak again, but the villagers are already gone.""

786139110.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia freezes, as her hands curl into fists. The words die in her throat, and silence claims her completely.""

786139112.m_KeyValue: ""The villagers shake their heads, their wry smiles filled with resignation.""

786139113.m_KeyValue: ""Without them, you and I wouldn't be torn apart like this.""

786434514.m_KeyValue: "Remarkable. I've never encountered water that resists my analysis."

786434515.m_KeyValue: "Why does he bear such a resemblance to that rumored Bell Ringer? Surely it's just my imagination..."

786434516.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose this is divine retribution. Had they not insisted on secretive alchemy, none of this would have come to pass.""

788507784.m_KeyValue: ""When taking fatal DMG, blocks that DMG and all subsequent DMG for 0.5 sec, then removes Parasol Shelter. Cannot be dispelled.""

788841773.m_KeyValue: ""Trying to provoke me, are you? Hah! You'll regret this dearly.""

788842796.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be troubled, for it's human nature to favor those who echo their sentiments.""

788847152.m_KeyValue: ""I'll keep you in my prayers. For everything else, you're on your own.""

788848307.m_KeyValue: "May you find your way back from the path of Loss."

788849330.m_KeyValue: ""Okay, I'll leave it up to you.""

790221889.m_KeyValue: ""Strike your weapon here, and let the creations of sand return to dust.""

790221896.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be scared. Stand behind me, I'll protect you.""

790221897.m_KeyValue: "This must be the Church's scheme. Both the crown and our sudden arrival in this desert."

790221900.m_KeyValue: "Aiona! Ami! Run! These monsters... they turn everything they touch into sand..."

790221902.m_KeyValue: ""<alpha=#FF>But I can still protect you, Ami...""

790221903.m_KeyValue: "Goldland taught me two things. First: protect your companions."

790221928.m_KeyValue: ""As long as human desires and conflicts exist, the Flames of War will never be extinguished...""

790221930.m_KeyValue: ""But through your eyes, I saw my father again, my friends, and Minexus's moon...""

790221931.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we're all here! Aiona, come join us!""

790221961.m_KeyValue: "I've always worried that I couldn't be as exceptional as my former 'self.'"

790221962.m_KeyValue: ""I am the vessel for these eyes, a puppet of fate.""

790221963.m_KeyValue: ""You... all of you, you've poured all your power into these eyes. That's why you said I'm the last hope.""

790221967.m_KeyValue: ""Get yer high quality cotton and linens! Wash 'em, soak 'em, bask 'em in the sun!""

790221994.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize, Lady Empousa. I'm a bit tired from using my eyes for so long to track the carriage carrying our 'target.'""

792051853.m_KeyValue: ""Here, you may select the area you wish to journey to. Difficulty will vary slightly.""

795216857.m_KeyValue: "Naturally. The crew wouldn't have noticed—because the 'tool' wasn't left behind. Because that's..."

795216858.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, what is that supposed to mean!?""

795216860.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Because of some information I didn't know, I actually fell behind that oaf?""

795216861.m_KeyValue: ""While the first two mistakes narrowed our suspicions, the third mistake will serve as the most telling evidence.""

795216862.m_KeyValue: ""Little Van Helsing, if you can't explain yourself properly, you won't even need the Captain to deal with you... As First Mate of this ship, I won't forgive such insolence!""

795216864.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, lifeless eyes! You're really just going to stand there and take that? Tell him you have evidence!""

795216866.m_KeyValue: ""This is why William went to such lengths to stage Aaron's death. Even if the Captain covered for him, the Church's guards were still aboard.""

795216889.m_KeyValue: "Third Mate William… and Captain Goldland... They haven't been in here?"

795216890.m_KeyValue: ""No time for questions! Everyone! To the deck, now!""

795216892.m_KeyValue: "The culprit isn't among the people you see here."

795217145.m_KeyValue: "Take them below deck and lock them up. I'll handle this myself."

795217146.m_KeyValue: "Heh. Don't address me by my family name. I'm just a humble fortune teller now—free to live as I please."

795217153.m_KeyValue: "That's if Cain's intel is even accurate to begin with."

795217154.m_KeyValue: ""From your perspective, Starfall Valley wasn't even our first encounter. Why didn't you tell me anything?""

795217155.m_KeyValue: ""A child, yes—but also a man. A Gravekeeper. A father who will never regret the choice he made.""

795217156.m_KeyValue: "My apologies. I did advise Miss Dalcarlo not to interrupt your... private moment."

795217157.m_KeyValue: ""As she said, you may call me Dalcarlo. I was invited aboard by Goldland himself—the true Captain of this ship. You could say I dabble in the art of divination.""

795217158.m_KeyValue: ""It's the lowest-numbered among the twenty-two Major Arcana, yet also the most distinct.""

795217159.m_KeyValue: "That explains your pale face and thin frame. Better be careful not to get blown away once the storm hits."

795217160.m_KeyValue: "Invitation? Do you mean the letter the white-haired Elder mentioned they'd be sending me?"

795217185.m_KeyValue: "Are you seriously casting shade right now?! Come help already!"

795217186.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... So annoying! Talking to yourself nonstop! You haven't even introduced yourself!"

795217187.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you have long been free from the Church's oversight, a lady of Bathory should still strive to speak with grace.""

795217188.m_KeyValue: ""I can't make out the words, but ever since we boarded… they've been whispering, over and over… Ugh—""

795217191.m_KeyValue: "You—! You only became a Bell Ringer's student because of your family connections. Stop letting it go to your head!"

795217192.m_KeyValue: ""What's the matter, our lovely guest, Sir Van Helsing? Do you happen to know this rude young lady?""

795217217.m_KeyValue: "So you've encountered stowaways too? You must've dealt with them easily."

795217218.m_KeyValue: "What did he do to you? Especially Hati—she looks badly..."

795217219.m_KeyValue: "We need to pick up the pace. Let's start collecting today."

795217221.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare take that commanding tone with me!"

795217222.m_KeyValue: ""Highly likely! This is bad—real bad. We need to find another place to hide, fast.""

795217223.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't that right, 'Sir' Van Helsing, Eighth of the Silver Cross?""

795217224.m_KeyValue: "You're not seriously implying that Bloodborn like you faced a Bell Ringer and lived to tell the tale?"

795217246.m_KeyValue: ""If it's just ordinary wine, I'll pass.""

795217249.m_KeyValue: "What?! I'm not even seasick! Why do I have to go?! I'll end up having to take care of her again!"

795217252.m_KeyValue: "Something's been bothering me... How do you know Cain? And why invite him aboard?"

795217253.m_KeyValue: ""Ha. Look who's talking. Pot, meet kettle.""

795217254.m_KeyValue: "What do you know?! My team's been guarding this ship for years—we have history with Captain Goldland! But Van Helsing..."

795217255.m_KeyValue: ""That only makes them rarer guests! My dear brother, you must never forget our creed—""

795217256.m_KeyValue: "This escort duty was originally his assignment. I joined on short notice because it aligned with my objectives."

795217277.m_KeyValue: ""That's just a ventilation panel. It connects to the deck, but it can't be opened. And it's way too high for anyone to reach anyway.""

795217278.m_KeyValue: "That dutiful sailor—the one who follows the rules to the letter."

795217282.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami. You were the first to find him. Please tell us exactly what you saw."

795217283.m_KeyValue: ""Not everyone’s like you, Ami. Always thinking about food...""

795217284.m_KeyValue: ""Haha! Did I embarrass you, Little Ami?""

795217285.m_KeyValue: ""That's when the ship suddenly lurched! I rushed over to the crew quarters to check—and by the time I arrived, this is what I saw.""

795217286.m_KeyValue: ""What am I, your personal seismograph? Don't think I missed that little jab, Silver-haired.""

795217287.m_KeyValue: "From what Bob's saying... William doesn't sound like much of a sailor."

795217288.m_KeyValue: ""The rest of you, with me. Something's happening aboard this ship. No one wanders off alone. Everyone stays where I can see them.""

795217314.m_KeyValue: "...Your understanding of feelings seems to come entirely from what the crew taught you."

795217315.m_KeyValue: ""If they hurt me, it's fine. If they hurt you... it would be a disaster.""

795217316.m_KeyValue: "That's Sailor Marlow—he's in charge of inspecting the cabins right now."

795217317.m_KeyValue: "...Then maybe it wasn't a 'person' pulling at all."

795217318.m_KeyValue: ""The second 'door' inside the guest room is this ventilation panel, and the rust on the rope matches the panel's corrosion.""

795217319.m_KeyValue: ""It's a little too big, but the weight feels about right.""

795217320.m_KeyValue: "This bed's too big. I can't get the rope tied around it."

795217345.m_KeyValue: "This is what happens when you move around."

795217347.m_KeyValue: "Contaminated food. Everyone's always so careless about hygiene. They don't have my constitution—I never get stomachaches."

795217350.m_KeyValue: ""Marlow, you shouldn't do this. The Captain will be mad if you break the door.""

795217351.m_KeyValue: "Let's seal the deal with this dark bread. We each take a bite. Instant accomplices."

795217352.m_KeyValue: "'Somewhere else'... He must've been taken to the guest room next door."

798288593.m_KeyValue: "These mass-produced war machines specialize in precision bow attacks."

798288594.m_KeyValue: "These mass-produced war machines wield intimidatingly large hammers."

798571464.m_KeyValue: ""Not only that one time. Every time they dragged me to interrogation, I heard Henry's voice after descending and turning left.""

798571467.m_KeyValue: ""You blunder recklessly, yet move as if you know every stone… and it thrills me.""

803428877.m_KeyValue: ""On this continent now under the Church's dominion, the Bloodborn, under the Bathorys, are steadily declining.""

803428878.m_KeyValue: ""Mortals embrace faith out of their fear of death, then present offerings to curry favor within their beliefs.""

810714866.m_KeyValue: "Lorelei? Don't even mention that wretched woman! How dare she free all those little slaves behind Joyce's back!"
