810714870.m_KeyValue: ""Since Ami is already here, it seems your deal has failed.""

810714891.m_KeyValue: "We got this from someone who speaks in a way we couldn't understand. They wanted us to deliver it to you."

810714896.m_KeyValue: ""Stay focused... I'll lend you my strength too, aim here—""

810714897.m_KeyValue: ""But that's fine. Do you know why Bella No. 13 is Joyce's masterpiece? Even with just one arm and a head remaining, she would fight on, for Joyce!""

810714898.m_KeyValue: "Well... Joyce will have to show everyone Joyce's masterpiece—"

810714900.m_KeyValue: ""As long as I live on in your memories, I'll never truly be gone.""

810714901.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's I who's eleven years late. Please forgive me, Lorelei.""

810714902.m_KeyValue: "Resurrecting humans as Bloodborn depends on memories stored in blood. But her memories reside in an entirely different vessel..."

810714922.m_KeyValue: ""What I sell isn't mere clothing—it's a philosophy. Clothing is the shackle of existence. Wealth, the chain of freedom. True liberation is the only design worthy of Sapphire Isle.""

810714923.m_KeyValue: "What?! There's actually one decent soul among ten thousand rich folk?"

810714932.m_KeyValue: "It's real! The deal the puppet mentioned is real!"

810714933.m_KeyValue: ""One of the former stewards left us something called a sunscreen potion. When applied, it shields us from the sun's searing heat temporarily.""

810714934.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, haven't you still chosen to be his friend, even though he's a Bloodborn?""

810714960.m_KeyValue: "Clovis had never seen waves that high..."

810714961.m_KeyValue: ""Grabbing a stick for balance, Bella limped toward the exit, hopping on one leg. She knew where to find allies who would help her uncover the truth.""

810714963.m_KeyValue: ""'Pay the price, and they'll be yours.'""

810714964.m_KeyValue: "Like a fish flailing on a market stall."

810714966.m_KeyValue: ""Before they could clean the blood from her body, Hallon returned to the basement.""

810714967.m_KeyValue: "The moon had risen quietly above the treetops."

812664214.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Empousa once believed you stood with her, before stepping into this place.""

812664215.m_KeyValue: "Is this some kind of jest?! I don't care what twisted bloodline you serve or what rules you follow!"

812664216.m_KeyValue: "Because... she wants to bring Mother back. So this... all of this... was for that."

812664217.m_KeyValue: "She was waiting for us. But this time..."

812664218.m_KeyValue: "Enough with the games! Show yourself if you have something to say!"

812665234.m_KeyValue: ""I’m sorry… Under Cain's assault, I can't hold the realm link much longer...""

812665235.m_KeyValue: "Plague snuffs out the ember of humankind. Famine awakens its primal cravings."

812665236.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, my silver-haired friend. If only you'd agreed to walk with me from the start... if only you'd grasped the truth earlier... no...""

812665237.m_KeyValue: ""You're starting to see. This is a confined space, so you assume you're Noah Nevernight.""

812665239.m_KeyValue: "Then tell me... when do you think a person truly dies?"

812665240.m_KeyValue: ""You're sharp, my silver-haired friend. Sharper than I was at your age... but you've lived too short.""

812665241.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it was more of an experience I had. The only difference is that this version of me remembers more than you do.""

812665242.m_KeyValue: "Not yours alone. Ours. We created it together."

813955870.m_KeyValue: "That makes me sound weak. I can transform too. I'll protect you. You go ahead."

813955871.m_KeyValue: ""Seth… the Saint, right? Now I get it.""

813955872.m_KeyValue: "I thought the tale would be difficult to grasp... Yet Ami has explained it more clearly than I ever could."

813955873.m_KeyValue: ""I was moving too fast to notice earlier, but aren't those the same paintings all over the walls?""

813956890.m_KeyValue: ""Yet here you are, planning something so reckless. That anxious girl... has grown too bold.""

813956893.m_KeyValue: ""That night, I went to Noah alone. Before Lamia or the others could reach him.""

813956894.m_KeyValue: ""You made it this far, ready for a fight to the death—yet you're still fretting over someone else?""

813956895.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't you say it yourself? That the closer one gets to Aeon, the clearer it becomes. The divine powers are just people, hiding truths they don't want uncovered.""

813956896.m_KeyValue: "To think Albrecht still remembers me so fondly... even going so far as to prepare 'holy water' for me. As expected of my nemesis."

813956897.m_KeyValue: "Then let's see if you truly are immortal when I pierce through the source of your memory!"

814810649.m_KeyValue: "So you traveled all the way to this era just to recruit one member?"

814978484.m_KeyValue: ""Starting right here, in Asta—just as they did in mine.""

814978485.m_KeyValue: "Then… are all our worlds bound to the same fate?"

814978487.m_KeyValue: ""Long before I arrived, they were already lying in wait.""

814978488.m_KeyValue: ""Alchemists created them. At first, they were nothing more than laborers—metal shells made to serve.""

814978489.m_KeyValue: ""So what, all this started because she brought those metal scraps here.""

814978490.m_KeyValue: "That's why they're so terrifying. They don't bleed. They don't stop."

814978491.m_KeyValue: "Who created them? And why? I've never seen any future like this in my visions."

814978498.m_KeyValue: "And you came here just to warn us?"

814978499.m_KeyValue: ""There's no point in us escaping, right? They'll continue tearing this place apart!""

814980668.m_KeyValue: "You're… the other me. From the Other Side."

814980669.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps you are the other me."

814980670.m_KeyValue: ""Well then, how did you get here?""

814980671.m_KeyValue: "Our worlds are clearly at different stages of development. So how do you know what's going to happen in mine?"

814980672.m_KeyValue: "If you're truly me… you won't beat around the bush. Those two answers may well be one and the same."

814980673.m_KeyValue: "Noah! There you are—What are you doing all the way out here?"

814981685.m_KeyValue: "No… I haven't had the chance to."

814981686.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—how does she know who we are? Noah, have you been talking about us?""

814981688.m_KeyValue: "She's you… from the Other Side? She certainly speaks as if she knows us."

814981689.m_KeyValue: "And this… is Stella. She's from the Other Side—another world's Noah."

814981690.m_KeyValue: ""That's Regina, a Gravekeeper from the Paracelsus family. She helped me back on Sunset Isle.""

814981691.m_KeyValue: "Wait—so she's who? You're who? Who’s with who? And who even am I!?"

814982844.m_KeyValue: "Full force? I was just following your lead."

814982846.m_KeyValue: "—especially those bottles strapped to their backs. Is that what's powering them?"

814982847.m_KeyValue: "You didn't even know what they were… and still went at them full force? What if you set off another explosion?"

814982848.m_KeyValue: "Are these constructs going to bring danger to Asta?"

814982849.m_KeyValue: "Why tell me this? Who are you?"

814982850.m_KeyValue: "Stop getting in my way. Leave with your companions—now."

814982851.m_KeyValue: "So this is what you meant by 'leave with them'?"

814983868.m_KeyValue: "Uhh... you're right. That one's on me."

814983869.m_KeyValue: "Not nearly as rude as someone who attacks first and asks questions later!"

814983870.m_KeyValue: ""What do you mean 'didn't actually try'... Wait, Noah? That insufferable silver-haired menace?!""

814983871.m_KeyValue: ""Forget it. She didn't actually try to fight us. More importantly, we need to hurry up and find Noah.""

814983874.m_KeyValue: ""Listen, whoever's with him right now is extremely dangerous!""

814983875.m_KeyValue: "He really does have knack for acquainting himself with strange women."

814985020.m_KeyValue: "Just in case… follow her. Quietly. And whatever you do—don't let yourselves be seen."

814985024.m_KeyValue: "Then tread carefully. We cannot know what enemies await you in that place."

814985025.m_KeyValue: "I doubt I'll find anyone over there as difficult as you."

814985026.m_KeyValue: "That is precisely what troubles me. The possibility that somewhere in that realm... another version of me may already be observing."

814986038.m_KeyValue: "Let's see here… huh? When did I even stock something like this?"

814986039.m_KeyValue: "I'd like to see this one. What's your asking price?"

814986045.m_KeyValue: "This one looks nice. I'll take it."

814986046.m_KeyValue: ""If anything catches your eye, feel free to take your pick...""

814986047.m_KeyValue: ""With the Harvest Festival in full swing, traders from across the continent are hawking their rarest wares!""

814986048.m_KeyValue: "Oi—I heard every word of that little plan of yours."

814986049.m_KeyValue: "Hard to believe folks dressed so plainly could be nobility… I might just make a killing today."

814986050.m_KeyValue: "Apologies. Our lady hasn't spent much time outside the manor. She's… unfamiliar with how this works."

814986051.m_KeyValue: "What? Didn't you just say I could pick...?"

814987194.m_KeyValue: "That's because our family is... rather special."

814987195.m_KeyValue: ""And you're so beautiful! So brave, so strong!""

814987196.m_KeyValue: "…You must be talking about my granddaughter."

814987197.m_KeyValue: "You can't be serious! You look so young—how could you possibly have a granddaughter?!"

814987198.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of Vice-Commander to Lord Albrecht, Bell Ringer No. III!""

814987199.m_KeyValue: "Albrecht? There's no way I'd serve as that arrogant cur's vice-commander!"

814987200.m_KeyValue: ""Those things don't look anything like spiders… In fact, even calling them 'monsters' feels generous...""

814987202.m_KeyValue: ""It really is her! With her here, we don't have to worry about being eaten by those spiders!""

814988220.m_KeyValue: "Everything. There is no form of 'water' in this world I do not comprehend. Therefore..."

814988221.m_KeyValue: "I see... But what does that have to do with what we were just talking about?"

814988222.m_KeyValue: "You… and those creatures… You must have originated from the Other Side. A world beyond our current knowledge."

814988223.m_KeyValue: "Therefore what? How does this explain where I came from?"

814988224.m_KeyValue: "What? What do they have to do with where I came from? And why are you tearing them apart?"

814988225.m_KeyValue: "It seems they carry the secret of your resurrection."

814988226.m_KeyValue: "A new expression of 'water' that has eluded even my understanding."

814988227.m_KeyValue: "These vials contain the energy that animates them—"

816001189.m_KeyValue: ""The opposite cell lay shrouded in silence. Noah's brow furrowed, and just as he drew breath to call again, familiar footsteps echoed through the corridor.""

816001191.m_KeyValue: ""The first dream: a poet of humble birth, reborn in the twin flames of Eternal Fire and Holy Flame. He thought this new radiance would crown him the sun itself.""

816001192.m_KeyValue: "Are you mocking me because I too have no past?!"

816613942.m_KeyValue: ""You could say that. A figure was there, washing laundry. But when I rushed in, it vanished.""

816685684.m_KeyValue: ""Flavor enhancement isn't exactly an Alchemist's forte, but next time I'll be sure to add more sugar for you.""

816730147.m_KeyValue: ""No... This time it's really me, and I've... truly returned?""

816791443.m_KeyValue: "So what's your plan to fix this mess?"

816974136.m_KeyValue: "You can see the moon from there. Try recalling it again."

817292845.m_KeyValue: ""When the moment comes, I only ask this: see with your own eyes, judge with your own heart. The choice will always be yours, Noah.""

817292846.m_KeyValue: ""And that is the greatest hindrance. The moment we step outside our cells, they bind our eyes with cloth.""

818205566.m_KeyValue: "The Third Tenet of the Bathory family is the 'Prohibition of Unsanctioned Creation of Progeny.' Vassals must obtain an Elder's consent to form blood contracts with outsiders. What are your thoughts on this matter?"

818205663.m_KeyValue: ""Some vassals are very curious about the alchemical research Cain has been conducting in secret, and they hope he could share some of his findings with everyone. What are your thoughts on this matter?""

818205830.m_KeyValue: ""The recent wave of acid rain has severely damaged the castle's Observatory, forcing us to cancel our nightly stargazing ceremony. Do you think this will have a significant impact?""

818205896.m_KeyValue: ""Recently, our castle has seen an increase in vassals recreated through alchemy. We need to discuss whether to grant them the same rights as our regular vassals.""

818205962.m_KeyValue: "A vassal returning from travels has mentioned encountering a mysterious island in the Sea of Medimar. The island's characteristics bear a striking resemblance to the 'Other Side' described in our family's historical records."

818205993.m_KeyValue: ""The Church has recently resumed salvaging 'Future Artifacts' from the sea. A vassal has suggested that we could try this as well, to enrich our collection in the Hall of Opulence. What do you think about this?""

818206028.m_KeyValue: ""A vassal who traveled to the Alita family returned with an album of secret alchemical techniques, but even our family's senior alchemist cannot decipher the formulas depicted within. Should we proceed with further research?""

818206059.m_KeyValue: "Cain has reported that many vassals have been secretly using the castle's alchemical facilities. I'm considering granting permission for the use of these facilities. What are your thoughts on this?"

818206125.m_KeyValue: ""Recently, the Church has been mining meteor craters day and night at the Howling Peninsula, yet these 'meteors' appear no different from ordinary stones. What are your thoughts on whether we should investigate the Church's true motives?""

818491570.m_KeyValue: ""Such an enormous skeleton sparks curiosity about the giant beast that once roamed here before the Meteor fell upon Starfall Valley. Yet, the mighty fade, and what remains is now the warm nest for the Rat King.""

818491571.m_KeyValue: ""Are the slaves who fought alongside Van Helsing truly sirens? Somehow, they seem different from the monsters in his nightmares...""

818491572.m_KeyValue: "They say bloodthirsty sirens dwell on Sapphire Isle. Could it really be true?"

818491573.m_KeyValue: "They say bloodthirsty sirens dwell on Sapphire Isle. Could it really be true?"

821101592.m_KeyValue: "The construct stirred once more in my hands—then fell still."

821101593.m_KeyValue: ""And when you return, we'll watch them—together.""

821101600.m_KeyValue: "It's so blurry... I can only make out a few points of light."

821101604.m_KeyValue: "That was the firelight from exploding constructs—not fireworks."

821720283.m_KeyValue: "The eve before Calamity fractured the world."

821720349.m_KeyValue: ""The day of sea fall, the day of rebirth.""

821720481.m_KeyValue: "The day fireworks danced across the skies of Sapphire Isle."

823022195.m_KeyValue: ""Clutching the hope of seeing her again, I drift into sleep, wondering if she too finds solace in dreams...""

823033737.m_KeyValue: "Even our passionate hero has quite the temper."

823165935.m_KeyValue: ""We'll meet atop the mountain. The way up won't be easy, but I'll be waiting.""

823673460.m_KeyValue: ""Right now, we need to find someone nearby and ask what's going on.""

823728351.m_KeyValue: ""It's been many days, and no one has come to claim them.""

823728352.m_KeyValue: ""Some time ago, I prepared the remains of an unidentified child.""

823728356.m_KeyValue: "And… they wouldn't want too many people to see them like that."

823728358.m_KeyValue: "However… there is something I might need your help with."

823728359.m_KeyValue: "So many have died in this war… I couldn't bear to leave them like that."

823728360.m_KeyValue: "Actually... I've been tending to the bodies of fallen soldiers."

823728361.m_KeyValue: "Noah... this isn't something you should be doing."

824842468.m_KeyValue: "I was fighting while she just stood there complaining. Does that count?"

824842470.m_KeyValue: "Who have you fought alongside the longest?"

824842472.m_KeyValue: ""Pardon the question, but—aren't emotions considered a burden for Ascendants in battle?""

825063468.m_KeyValue: "Still dwelling on that? You came away unscathed."

825063469.m_KeyValue: "At last... your signal. I feared something terrible had happened."

826917217.m_KeyValue: ""I merely did what their _$$god_$$ did—I made divine proclamations on their behalf, relieving them of thought and guilt. Naturally, they followed me.""

827094718.m_KeyValue: ""But I'm curious—if you knew the future and chose a different path, would that future change?""

827218399.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I've already checked for her. It was just a bit of paint.""

827218400.m_KeyValue: "Your warning is timely. I'll need to go through all the other letters that child has handled."

827218403.m_KeyValue: "Eh? How do you know about her injury?"

827218404.m_KeyValue: "Did she… actually end up including our conversation in the letter after all?"

827218406.m_KeyValue: "I didn't expect you to be so observant."

827218407.m_KeyValue: "Well... even the endearing ones need a bit of guidance when they make mistakes."

827218408.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, there are three stacks of ancient scores waiting to be transcribed in the attic. Perfect for helping Darcias… clear her mind. A thoughtful arrangement, wouldn't you say, Noah?""

827218409.m_KeyValue: ""(Such gentle words, yet they send a chill down my spine...)""

827218410.m_KeyValue: "Has Darcias recovered yet? Please give her my regards."

828366577.m_KeyValue: "A moving island...? Or perhaps the island itself... is alive?"

828366578.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it wasn't meant literally. It could be describing an island capable of movement."

828366585.m_KeyValue: ""If we keep reading at this pace, we may not even get a chance to appear in our own story.""

828366586.m_KeyValue: ""And because it's so thorough, there are dozens of volumes. Are you sure you want to read through all of them here?""

828366588.m_KeyValue: "Let's head to the upper level and rejoin the others."

828366589.m_KeyValue: ""_$$But rather than an island, it more closely resembled an enormous ship..._$$""

828366590.m_KeyValue: "_$$The island home of the Landis family was known as the 'Pillars of Hercules.'_$$"

828366591.m_KeyValue: ""Even with branch families and all the residents of their territory, no ship could possibly carry so many people...""

828366592.m_KeyValue: ""Before their disappearance, the Landis family was one of the twelve families under the Church protection.""

828367601.m_KeyValue: ""I spent the last of my fortune to restore it, and gave it a name worthy of its fate—The El Dorado.""

828367602.m_KeyValue: ""This day forward, it shall carry our dreams, set sail, and never sink...""

828367609.m_KeyValue: ""Then my dream—no, humanity's dream—of voyaging into the deep is no longer a fantasy.""

828367610.m_KeyValue: ""I learned much from the Landis people—of the ocean, of navigation.""

828367611.m_KeyValue: ""Aboard their great vessel, I discovered by embedding two jewels on opposite ends of the helm, they could sail to any destination within the span of a single storm.""

828367612.m_KeyValue: ""One jewel was blue, mournful—like the one in my possession. The other was crimson—deep and unfathomable.""

828367613.m_KeyValue: ""If I can find the second gem, I too shall command this miraculous gift. And I shall become the greatest adventurer the sea has ever known.""

828367614.m_KeyValue: "I must tell William! We who carry this jewel are chosen by the sea. We were meant to embark upon a legendary odyssey."

828367615.m_KeyValue: ""In the years that followed, I slowly gathered a fleet, piecing together every rumor tied to the lost Landis ship.""

828367616.m_KeyValue: ""In Sapphire Isle, my perseverance bore fruit: I acquired the wreckage of a ship built by the Landis people.""

828368755.m_KeyValue: "Wait... your card can be used for fire!?"

828368756.m_KeyValue: ""My apologies, I forgot the Empress fears the dark.""

828368761.m_KeyValue: "So what would make it whole? Devouring that jellyfish girl? What makes her so special?"

828368762.m_KeyValue: "If it becomes whole... the consequences will be devastating."

828368763.m_KeyValue: ""With half its power restored, Famine can already draw every Blood Beast aboard into its will resonance.""

828368764.m_KeyValue: "Followers? They aren't just regular Blood Beasts?"

828368765.m_KeyValue: "Blending into the environment to protect myself is instinct."

828368766.m_KeyValue: "You've shifted back to your beast form!! Don't go creeping around in the dark like that!"

828368767.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever the reason, we absolutely cannot allow her to be devoured... meow.""

828368768.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it has something to do with Miss Ami's unknown origins?"

828369779.m_KeyValue: "I was prepared that each voyage might be both the dearest and the last of my life."

828369780.m_KeyValue: ""The Eyes of the Divine Body once held by the Alita family vanished with their host, but I endured the vast frozen plains and wind that cut through bone.""

828369785.m_KeyValue: "That tree has long since sunk beneath the sea. And two fruits alone are not enough to seal Famine."

828369786.m_KeyValue: ""As despair took hold, I remembered the dream I had all those years ago...""

828369787.m_KeyValue: "There was hope. The two gems Ami and I possessed are fruits of the Right Hand of the Divine Body once guarded by the Landis family."

828369788.m_KeyValue: "But the true Right Hand was the golden tree that upheld their island—the very pillar that gave name to the Pillars of Hercules."

828369789.m_KeyValue: "I never told the crew the truth behind how we traveled through the storm. They simply believed that El Dorado was the fastest ship in the world."

828369790.m_KeyValue: ""Only Ami, who lent me the jewel before each departure... I could never tell whether she was naive, for not once did she ask a question.""

828369791.m_KeyValue: ""By embedding the two jewels into either side of the helm, one could sail anywhere—so long as they passed through the storm that churned like a vortex of time itself.""

828369792.m_KeyValue: "To prevent William from growing suspicious—and awakening Famine before I was ready—I used exploration as a pretense to visit each family guarding a Divine Body."

828370933.m_KeyValue: ""How tragic. That's the difference between you and us. You bar the path of what you fear, while I pursue what I revere.""

828370934.m_KeyValue: "You won't let me through? Then I take it you fear what I carry—a fruit of the Divine Body."

828370937.m_KeyValue: "That night… was the first time in a year that the nightmares left me alone."

828370938.m_KeyValue: "I never knew she could draw like that. I watched her work from sunset to starlight."

828370939.m_KeyValue: ""Even from here, I can feel the overwhelming pressure... So this is what it means to face a Calamity...""

828370940.m_KeyValue: "Ranna of the Famine... A name I knew only from history. The nightmare whispered of by countless souls."

828370941.m_KeyValue: ""Even now—knowing what he's done, knowing what he's become... I've spent this entire year lacking the courage to face him.""

828370942.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't William who changed... I had been wrong the entire time."

828370943.m_KeyValue: ""She didn't answer. Instead, she asked for a pen. She sat quietly at the bow and began sketching every crew member—face by face, name by name.""

828370944.m_KeyValue: "I wonder… does Ami see me as a selfish Captain? A poor excuse for family?"

828371957.m_KeyValue: ""At last, I no longer need to worry about endangering Ami—the Hermit I was meant to protect.""

828371958.m_KeyValue: "She's... she's so strong! Even stronger than Uncle Gadric!"

828371961.m_KeyValue: ""He has both the power and the reason to protect this ship. And if I'm wrong... at the very least, he will preserve my story.""

828371962.m_KeyValue: ""The third letter I sent to elder Bella Slade of Bathory Castle. The Puppet Association has long been my trusted partner, and the Bathorys—like the Landis—are a reclusive family.""

828371963.m_KeyValue: ""If both I and this ship were to vanish, that would be the safest place for Ami to begin a new life. A life of true freedom.""

828371964.m_KeyValue: ""But Bella recommended another—Jacintha Dalcarlo, undisputedly the strongest of the Bathory Elders.""

828371965.m_KeyValue: "I want William to receive a fair trial. The punishment he deserves. For he sold his soul to demons."

828371966.m_KeyValue: "And yet... I want him to live—because he is still my family."

828371967.m_KeyValue: ""The second letter went to the alchemist Cain Lamboza. He aided my search for the Divine Bodies time and time again, yet asked for nothing in return.""

828371968.m_KeyValue: "I know he has long taken interest in the El Dorado—and in my adventures aboard her."

828373112.m_KeyValue: ""And yet the Church... The Church has lied to us for generations. They sealed away our Ancestors using those cursed Divine Bodies, twisting our true gods into monsters.""

828373113.m_KeyValue: "Lady Ranna was one of the original thirteen Moonblessed. The source of the twelve great families across the continent."

828373115.m_KeyValue: "Hahahahahaha! Never have I met a descendant so bold. You'd dare speak to me this way? How amusing."

828373116.m_KeyValue: "Why should you devour me... when I could devour you?"

828373117.m_KeyValue: "Very good... worthy of being my child... Hm? What did you say? You refuse? But you've learned of your lineage—this is your destiny!"

828373119.m_KeyValue: "Now that you know our blood is the same... Become one with me. Let us return to our original form."

828373120.m_KeyValue: ""That alone may prove you're truly Ranna's descendant. Such calm, such clarity.""

828373143.m_KeyValue: "She's not just any whelp. She might be our last hope."

828373145.m_KeyValue: "Could they have... jumped into the sea together?"

828373146.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care who you are, whelp! I'm not in the mood for your nonsense!""

828373147.m_KeyValue: "No! They've found me... there's no helping it now..."

828373148.m_KeyValue: "What about that silver-haired one and the maid who almost caught me? I can't hear their heartbeats on the ship anymore..."

828373150.m_KeyValue: "Ah! You're that child I saw in the kitchen!"

828373151.m_KeyValue: "So close… I nearly defeated the Calamity… and this is where it ends?"

828373152.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Everyone's already here... Did I arrive at a bad time?"

831780716.m_KeyValue: ""We're getting closer to Empousa, I can feel it.""

831780747.m_KeyValue: "This is my first time fighting with a warrior like Jestel. She's quite reliable."

831780848.m_KeyValue: ""Blood Vassals are minions created by the Bloodborn using Black Blood, so they can indeed be considered our kind.""

831780914.m_KeyValue: "I don't know what you're talking about..."

832489225.m_KeyValue:
""Compared to his foster father, Uncle Gadric, Clive's close friend, was more like a real father to Clive Jr. He would often climb onto Gadric's shoulders and gaze across the Lupine Forest together, hearing about Uncle Gadric's adventures. In these tales, he could imagine himself just being as free and brave.
There’s another secret, known only to those involved, and myself. When Clive Jr. was still young enough to speak without fear, he once asked Gadric if he could take him away. Whether Gadric sensed the unease and resentment hidden behind those words, he only patted the boy's head in silent comfort.""

832489318.m_KeyValue:
""April 3rd, 1337. Clear. I, Kristoph Goldland, Captain of the greatest ship in history—the El Dorado—is set to embark on her maiden voyage on this momentous day! One can scarcely imagine the splendor of the inaugural ceremony, but it was all worth it. This merchant vessel shall amass great wealth anew, and our first destination will be—the domain of the Landis! This affluent family will bring us our first great fortune.
—Excerpt from the Captain's Log of the El Dorado""

832489384.m_KeyValue:
""Those who knew them could never understand why Clive treated his two children so differently. Though the adopted son Clive Jr. bore a striking resemblance to him, Clive kept his distance from this mirror image. They barely exchanged words—yet his demeanor held no aversion, only detachment.
It was only after I uncovered the truth that I understood: the detachment was a mask for guilt... guilt over his own younger self.""

832489473.m_KeyValue:
""The place that never saw sunset has been claimed by the sea, and yet the darkness that once imprisoned this isle now glows before me, vibrant and alive.

If this resurrection has nothing to do with her longing, then how did she reclaim life itself?

Regina once spoke of her past with Albrecht—colleagues bound by their knowledge of Alchemy's deepest mysteries.

Blood carries memory in its crimson depths. Perhaps Albrecht drew upon Regina's essence to grant her new life within The Exodus.

I wrote seeking answers, but his reply was simply a blank parchment and silence.""

832489632.m_KeyValue:
""After that less-than-successful attempt at written conversation, Stella never reached out to me again. I still saw her often around the castle—like a newborn cub, she regarded this strange world with equal parts curiosity and caution. I tried to approach her, but whenever our eyes met, she would pause for a heartbeat… then quickly turn and leave.

I asked Regina about it. She told me that in a few days, the home-leave granted by Captain Ami would end. After that, they would return to their own world, board the El Dorado, and set off on a new adventure.

…Perhaps I should be the one to seek her out.""

833973508.m_KeyValue: "Tap Vassal to assign as an Observer"

835443759.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Strong. The carrier stops and remains unable to cast Ultimate, Active Skills, Basic Attacks, or move during the effect.""

836292218.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I wake up, as long as the other Letitia remains, my wings won't be of any use.""

836292225.m_KeyValue: "Then who sealed you upon that floating isle? Your memories are far too chaotic and fragmented—I couldn't see that part."

836292226.m_KeyValue: "Just how many centuries have you endured?"

836292228.m_KeyValue: "Does our struggle and self-loathing hold any meaning?"

836292229.m_KeyValue: "But I never imagined I'd meet my end at the hands of a... exhibitionist."

836293248.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina cut the exchange short and moved to the other side of the corpse-heap, crouching to examine the remains.""

836293249.m_KeyValue: "It was they who ambushed the fleeing townsfolk."

836293251.m_KeyValue: ""...Seraphina, is this how you always pick fights in the Church?""

836293254.m_KeyValue: ""Selena, how far are we from the Black Mist?""

836293255.m_KeyValue: "Never have I witnessed such a sight... Could some distant volcano have erupted?"

836462524.m_KeyValue: ""Upon reflection, such a duel would prove meaningless—neither of us would find peace in it.""

836637337.m_KeyValue: ""Traveling merchants from distant lands gather at this crossroads before setting forth once more. Their camel bells chime a melodious farewell as they carry precious cargo—goods, gold, and trade secrets—toward unknown horizons.""

837276055.m_KeyValue: "Can a hero find redemption by plunging into this paradox without past or future? This question has no answer."

837276056.m_KeyValue: ""Now... take my body, my consciousness, my soul, my everything...""

837276063.m_KeyValue: ""It feels like a part of our memory has been cut out, and we suddenly ended up in this desert.""

837276064.m_KeyValue: "It takes thirty years for bones to weather into dust."

837276065.m_KeyValue: ""I picked up some navigation skills from Goldland, but here... I can't tell the time or direction...""

837276066.m_KeyValue: "Watch out! There's a monster behind you."

837276067.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, I'll take care of them—""

837276068.m_KeyValue: ""<alpha=#FF>Snap out of it, Aiona! More monsters are coming. Run!""

837276070.m_KeyValue: ""...Don't worry about me, I'm an immortal Bloodborn...""

837276095.m_KeyValue: ""Every time a Calamity breaks its seal and disaster strikes, everyone gathers here. But why are there so many versions of you—of me... and so many old friends?""

837276096.m_KeyValue: "Only when the predestined destruction is shattered... can all timelines regain their freedom..."

837276097.m_KeyValue: "Prevent the calamity... Can I really do it?"

837276098.m_KeyValue: ""So, don't worry about me. Go to the future that awaits you...""

837276099.m_KeyValue: "Why... how could you do this to me?"

837276127.m_KeyValue: ""Return to my timeline, prevent the calamity, break the cycle, and save all timelines.""

837276129.m_KeyValue: ""All the past timelines, the Aionas in those timelines, the companions and memories, will be devoured by it, forever losing their future.""

837276130.m_KeyValue: ""(The attacks of 'Time' feel familiar, like the power of my eyes.)""

837276133.m_KeyValue:
""The palace of the gods sat high in the clouds, their wrath like mighty thunder;
The condemned one, Sisyphus, cheating Death with his cleverness;""

837276134.m_KeyValue: ""Are you alright, young lady? You must have passed out.""

837276162.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry. Our target—that legendary 'Silver-haired' heretic—will be in the carriage that's about to pass through here, right?""

837583879.m_KeyValue: ""I cannot dismiss that possibility. We are, after all, bound by the same essence.""

837583881.m_KeyValue: ""They would also sacrifice themselves, for the sake of their kind.""

837583882.m_KeyValue: ""Nightmarish Letitia seeks to blast them all, but her every move is countered by that of another.""

837583883.m_KeyValue: "Don't your... certain things get in the way and throw off your balance in the air?"

837584903.m_KeyValue: ""With vision so obscured, ascending is pointless.""

837584905.m_KeyValue: "They were twisted beyond recognition by the Black Blood. They begged me to end their torment."

837584906.m_KeyValue: ""If you speak truthfully, then accept their thanks and forge yourself sharper—do not wither as you are now.""

837584907.m_KeyValue: "Far more than I anticipated... Take me to them."

837584909.m_KeyValue: "I was swept here by turbulence. Was that your doing?"

837584910.m_KeyValue: ""When she looks again, the mysterious girl is gone without a trace.""

837611642.m_KeyValue: "Is something troubling you? You can confide in me."

837611673.m_KeyValue: ""Please don't look into my eyes, at least... not right now.""

837614841.m_KeyValue: "Do you wish to glimpse the secrets of time through me?"

837620338.m_KeyValue: ""Kid, come dance to my newly composed tune.""

837620369.m_KeyValue: ""There's no treasure hidden in my hair, you know. Except your own hand, of course.""

837622512.m_KeyValue: ""From atop 'The Tower', all I can see is destruction... A vision of the apocalypse.""

837623378.m_KeyValue: ""This is not a garlic stalk, it's used to detect enemies.""

837623537.m_KeyValue: ""Hey there, what have you been up to lately?""

837625552.m_KeyValue: ""All things are given order by rules. This is not a constraint, but true freedom.""

837625711.m_KeyValue: ""May life be blessed, may humanity flourish, and may order be restored.""

840421440.m_KeyValue: "Observe more Constellations and Stars in the Observatory to increase the occurrence of higher-rarity Missions."

841965829.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, Hilda's letter made her intentions clear—she planned to leave. That's how Reese II knew she hadn't taken her own life.""

842475621.m_KeyValue: "Maybe next time. I’ll tell you when the time comes."

842475622.m_KeyValue: ""With your curiosity, I doubt you'll return the sketchbook until you've seen every page.""

842475623.m_KeyValue: "Speaking of which—it looks like the last page of the sketchbook was torn out. What was drawn there?"

842475624.m_KeyValue: ""But when I don't clean properly, he scolds me too… That cold side of him still shows up at times.""

842475625.m_KeyValue: ""So Goldland really was protecting you, after all.""

842509929.m_KeyValue: ""Major Arcana Card No. 11. Dalcarlo's Divination: _$$Wading through the dark, truth is gradually revealed._$$""

844838698.m_KeyValue: "That thing will drag you to an early grave—"

844838700.m_KeyValue: "I see. Did he leave anything behind?"

845073846.m_KeyValue: ""Cross mountains and streams, through emerald woods and golden wheat.""

845388628.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know from which direction they'll strike the seal, but I will stop them!""

845388629.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Never show mercy to an enemy, no matter the bond you share._$$ That was your first lesson.""

845388630.m_KeyValue: "I never expected our meeting would be under these circumstances."

845389650.m_KeyValue: "So this is what had you so distracted mid-battle. This little trick was your plan all along?"

845389652.m_KeyValue: "I once believed Lady Empousa might understand my ideals."

845389655.m_KeyValue: "Cidhall? He's here too? Why would both of them...!?"

849195451.m_KeyValue: "I never said I was conducting alchemical experiments."

849195452.m_KeyValue: "I couldn't care less about how it tastes. Shouldn't you explain why you just drank what was supposed to be alchemical material?"

849195457.m_KeyValue: ""The concentrated flavor of wild blackcurrants, with a remarkably weighty acidity...""

849195458.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, this familiar taste... it's been so long.""

849195461.m_KeyValue: ""Before sealing the cask, they added a small amount of Limine's own blood. Though Bloodborn blood typically tastes bitter, when mixed with the wine, it created an unexpectedly distinct flavor profile.""

849195462.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, this is the Bloodborn Covenant, a private wine blend of the Bathory family from when Limine was still around. It's made from a mixture of Sangiovese and Black Moon grapes.""

849195464.m_KeyValue: "Wait! Why did you just drink it?"

849795841.m_KeyValue: "Basic ATK inflicts 1 stack of Continuous DMG (Affliction) for {0} sec on units hit."

850483044.m_KeyValue: "What connection do they have to the memories I'm trying to recover?"

850483045.m_KeyValue: ""Finding the Moonblessed would serve multiple purposes: advancing the family's revival, fulfilling Lady Empousa's aspirations, and...""

850483079.m_KeyValue: "What are you two doing? Are we going or not!"

852480943.m_KeyValue: "Set the pointers to the position indicated in the hint."

853085235.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet's treacherous rise, Ganelon's fall from grace, even the young master in whom I placed such faith...""

853085238.m_KeyValue: ""But... no matter how many echoes of the past I find, this world has become something else entirely.""

853085240.m_KeyValue: "So much has transpired in the shadow of my slumber."

853085241.m_KeyValue: ""Valora halted, her gaze drawn upward to the starlit tapestry above.""

853085243.m_KeyValue: ""But... for me, there's something comforting in that constancy.""

853085244.m_KeyValue: ""And now, there is one more thing that stirs recognition within me.""

853085245.m_KeyValue: ""At the Observatory, I once said, 'All of this feels foreign to me; only the eternal stars above still whisper of home.'""

854681485.m_KeyValue: ""The cruel blood rose, truly fitting for a Bloodborn.""

855117111.m_KeyValue: "That was our pact before we came to Astolfo. And I will let no one stand in its way."

855117114.m_KeyValue: "Father… you fail to see. This barren desert cannot withstand an upheaval."

856037066.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how many more surprises this place has in store for us."

856408766.m_KeyValue: "Then I shall see to it you are given the grandest thousandth match of all. Perform well."

856559741.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, the castle remained untouched. The calamity I feared never came.""

857858892.m_KeyValue: "No matter. I don't care who you were—You stand now as pawns of the Apocalypse."

857858893.m_KeyValue: ""And you, leader of the Chamber of War, should be ending conflict. Yet here you are—relishing it.""

857858896.m_KeyValue: ""Even then, I wondered where the base of that tower led. Who would've thought… the opposite end of the continent.""

857858897.m_KeyValue: "Then am I right to assume—Dracula is the source of all Black Blood?"

857858898.m_KeyValue: "Didn't those things get burned to ash already?"

857858899.m_KeyValue: "We were chasing after a Moonblessed—now you're telling me Mother is here too?! Why didn't I know any of this?"

857858900.m_KeyValue: "What's strange is why you're tailing us."

857858901.m_KeyValue: ""If you'd prefer a friendly duel instead, I wouldn't mind.""

857862100.m_KeyValue: "Looks like there's no time to find other Vice-Commanders—we need to find Acappella immediately."

857862101.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm with the Choir. Just passing through.""

858058861.m_KeyValue: ""Nonsense! The 'Black Blood' is Aeon's divine punishment for heretics, members of the Church can't be...""

858058862.m_KeyValue: ""We don't need to kill her, do we? She's just following orders, and her sense of justice.""

858058864.m_KeyValue: ""Oh great Aeon, is this a test? Why did you subject us to such a cruel ordeal?""

858461871.m_KeyValue: "They've ruined my gown... How do you propose to remedy this?"

858461904.m_KeyValue: "I sense a most fervent gaze upon me."

858462234.m_KeyValue: "Such exquisite attire is hardly suited for the battlefield."

858599176.m_KeyValue: "More spirits will manifest the further Threads of Fate progresses."

858602377.m_KeyValue: ""That bastard knew that <style=""Highlight"">my specialty is dealing with large numbers of enemies</style>, so he wanted to torment me with them.""

858809383.m_KeyValue: "Today's Meeting has already been held. Please return tomorrow."

858809482.m_KeyValue: "Redeem successful. Please check your in-game mail."

858809483.m_KeyValue: "<style="Highlight">Affinity</style> limit reached. <style="Positive">Spirit Siphon</style> to increase limit."

859060390.m_KeyValue: "She's alive...? That's impossible! Where is she?"

859060391.m_KeyValue: "You've forgotten what happened? No wonder. That tragedy... it was too much for a child to shoulder."

859060394.m_KeyValue: ""So you walk beside the Bell Ringer now... Good. Like your father, you carry grand ideals—and boundless potential.""

859060395.m_KeyValue: "It's over... everything's ruined. And it's all Averdin's fault!"

859060397.m_KeyValue: "Damn it—what did you just bite into?!"

859060424.m_KeyValue: "Is she... Ami from the wanted poster?"

859060426.m_KeyValue: ""From what they're saying, it seems they've found Van Helsing. Let's follow them and see.""

859060427.m_KeyValue: "Ami has fallen into slumber due to the Master's schemes. I must gather all the Siren's Tears to awaken her."

859060428.m_KeyValue: "If you wish to serve under me… I might consider it."

859060678.m_KeyValue: ""Let this be your very first lesson about this cruel, cruel world!""

859060686.m_KeyValue: ""A new Sage has risen, the Mistbound Terror has been caught, and Lord Thoreau's ordered extra patrols. Tonight's festivities are cleared to last 'til dawn!""

859060688.m_KeyValue: "That settles it! I'll craft a new line that truly embodies the spirit of Sapphire Isle!"

859060689.m_KeyValue: ""And what, pray tell, is Robin von Quinn's most treasured possession?""

859060690.m_KeyValue: "Only commoners waste time on such nonsense! We’re leaving. Now!"

859060691.m_KeyValue: ""Surely, one can grasp that most mysterious thing called love... by slaying wicked dragons, conquering uncivilized barbarians, and unmasking the schemes of evil wizards!""

859060692.m_KeyValue: "To think... I would face my nemesis here and now."

859060713.m_KeyValue: ""With this seal, we can forge a letter requesting an audience with Thoreau—along with orders to transfer the remaining captives.""

859060720.m_KeyValue: ""They're fairly common flowers by the coast. When in bloom, they float across the water in clusters. Truly a beautiful sight.""

859060721.m_KeyValue: ""Curious about these flowers? For just thirty Soli, you can hire Yakov—Sapphire Isle's most knowledgeable guide—to dig up the truth!""

859060722.m_KeyValue: "She hasn't returned yet? Or... did she leave again?"

859060724.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—isn't this the Siren's Tear? The mark of a Sage's status and rank? If I could sell it on the black market, I could clear all my debts!""

859060752.m_KeyValue: "If anyone's an outsider... I suppose that would be me."

859060756.m_KeyValue: "Could Little Bella be a reaper?! She keeps cutting people's _$$threads of life_$$!"

859060757.m_KeyValue: "He was one of the Sages—he must've had one on him..."

859060783.m_KeyValue: "What important business could he possibly have without me? Wait... am I not his companion?!"

859060786.m_KeyValue: "They say you can get anything from him—if you're willing to pay his price."

859060787.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Listen here! A proper actor never refuses a lady's request—that's day-one etiquette for any respectable performer!"

859060789.m_KeyValue: "Lady Selena! We searched the auction house but found no one by the name Van Helsing."

859060811.m_KeyValue: ""With this motion, it makes an _$$ahh_$$ sound.""

859060814.m_KeyValue: "This is clearly our device—one that uses Siren's Tears to produce crimson mist. Anyone caught in the hallucinations shouldn't even be able to see it..."

859060816.m_KeyValue: "And this stone... it's already helped me recall fragments of the promise. It's time to return it. He needs it far more than I do."

859060817.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, that peculiar someone happened to be Sage Alexa—The same Sage who fined my stall thirteen times.""

859060818.m_KeyValue: "Me? I'm Joyce—the famous and beloved mascot of Sapphire Isle!"

859060819.m_KeyValue: "Wow! There are actually things in this world that money can't buy? What are they? What are they?"

859060821.m_KeyValue: "Outside Lord Hallon's office! That person said he was one of only two survivors of the tsunami eleven years ago. That he would keep Lord Hallon constantly on guard!"

859060845.m_KeyValue: ""Debts must be paid, and promises must be kept—no matter what.""

859060846.m_KeyValue: ""That's fine. If you do decide to snitch, I'll be sure to tell them all about your heroic exploits. How you helped us thoroughly defeat the Sages.""

859060847.m_KeyValue: ""Then this is part of your promise too, isn't it?""

859060848.m_KeyValue: "Then why is Miss Ami on the wanted poster?"

859060849.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm not mistaken, there must be a connection between those invisible _$$threads_$$... and the Siren's Tear.""

859060850.m_KeyValue: "Disgraceful. If anyone deserves a fate worse than a demon's in hell—it's you."

859060852.m_KeyValue: "Then we won't write it that way."

859060853.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Viktor Thoreau, Miss Alexa, and Miss Alexis. All fell by her hand... or rather, by the blade of Mr. Nevernight.""

859060878.m_KeyValue: ""If it weren't for you lot, that damn prisoner would never have escaped!""

859060882.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Isn't that Noah from the wanted poster? He's walked right into our hands—seize him!"

859060883.m_KeyValue: ""I know what you want to ask, Miss Bella. But not everything is as it seems.""

859060884.m_KeyValue: "Polished railings... tasteless flooring... and—torture devices? Either her taste has taken a strange turn... or my memories of her are still incomplete."

859060885.m_KeyValue: "As for the tsunami... There's a memorial garden dedicated to the victims of the 1342 disaster. It's in the southwest corner of the isle."

859150553.m_KeyValue: "Life is more fragile than you think—yet far braver than you'd ever believe."

859150556.m_KeyValue: ""Well said. Life is a precious miracle—cherish all life, and stay away from all calamities.""

859153754.m_KeyValue: "Or are you worried about what the fire guy might do if he defeats the thunder woman?"

859153755.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, is your battle with Joan over? And that thunder just now... what was it?""

860054484.m_KeyValue: ""Carrying the pride of the Ganelon family, Hati lingers in shadow, like a lotus veiled in darkness, waiting to bloom.""

860057687.m_KeyValue:
""Please keep your shiny things, wallet, and soul safe!
If they vanish, it's none's falut.
Meow? You saw me take them? Cheeky to blame a cat for that.""

860326580.m_KeyValue: ""Creates a Green Grotto in a select circle, lasting for {0} sec. When the Green Grotto is created, it knocks back nearby enemies outside its area. Enemies who re-enter the area have their Movement Speed reduced by {3}.""

861985839.m_KeyValue: ""No death is without regret, only cold oblivion.""

861985870.m_KeyValue: "It takes considerable resolve to touch the embodiment of death."

861988879.m_KeyValue: "And just what do you think you're doing?"

861994566.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, no, it's just... this is a little sudden.""

861996740.m_KeyValue: "My body has been feeling a bit stiff lately... Could it be because I haven't moved in a while?"

861997734.m_KeyValue: "There's still a gap between knowledge and real battle."

861998883.m_KeyValue: "You've certainly caused me quite a bit of trouble."

861999749.m_KeyValue: "Pain reveals our true colors… don't you agree?"

861999908.m_KeyValue: "Our struggle for power never ends. Only death can shatter the illusion."

862001923.m_KeyValue: ""The world is constantly being renewed, and destroyed.""

862002082.m_KeyValue: "Let us honor the sacrifices that led us here."

863370644.m_KeyValue: ""All right, all right, just a bit of fun. Now then—let us return our focus to the present.""

863922231.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona once told Empousa that her ritual tool was damaged during a Church mission. That mission had left not just a thin crack in her tool but also an invisible fracture in the meticulously planned life her family had laid out for her—a life she had followed step by step. Someday, she said, that crack would spread, destroying the last warmth of her past.""

864347011.m_KeyValue: ""For someone who claims she wasn't there, you seem remarkably well informed.""

864347012.m_KeyValue: "I mistrust both kindness without reason and cruelty without cause. This isn't about her—it's my principle."

864347013.m_KeyValue: ""Behold—the sacred chimes of Aeon's divine bells, a holy blessing poured upon the faithful!""

864465802.m_KeyValue:
""Little Bella No. 13 enters a charging state. After a period, she unleashes scorching flames, dealing massive M. DMG to all enemies.
While charging, DMG Taken (non-CRIT DMG) is reduced by {1}. Dealing sufficient DMG will interrupt this skill and inflict Weakened. Once charging is finished, a candle will be lit, with each candle increasing this skill's DMG by {2} on its next cast.""

864952759.m_KeyValue: "But… there has been no trial. How could the charge be lifted…?"

869036657.m_KeyValue: ""Can two who long for each other… live on as a shadow of that bond? Perhaps that, too, defies death.""

869039666.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we're not one and the same… but our hearts still sing as one."

869039825.m_KeyValue: "The past I wish to forget… is a memory I cannot forsake."

869045322.m_KeyValue: "Does this mean I'm a grown-up now?"

869045353.m_KeyValue: "I won't let you down... I absolutely won't!"

869048362.m_KeyValue: ""Henceforth, I shall fight and perish for your sake.""

869050536.m_KeyValue: "The show is about to begin… shall we walk into it together?"

869050695.m_KeyValue: "How beautiful... the El Dorado never disappoints."

869051844.m_KeyValue: "Let us begin constructing a paradise of flesh and blood."

869051875.m_KeyValue: "You shan't escape my grasp. Not until I have the world in my hands."

869490349.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, grants all allies placed on this tile 1000 Special Energy.""

870632260.m_KeyValue: ""Or should I make you part of my mantle, becoming my eternal Vassal?""

870632261.m_KeyValue: "Hehehe... Should I put a collar on you and make you sit obediently at my feet?"

870632264.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha... Looks like we'll be trapped here together forever!"

870632265.m_KeyValue: ""Oh my, what's happening here? Why did the tomb door close?""

870632268.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Cat got your tongue in front of your master?"

870632270.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. You'll see how tall I am when you're crawling and whimpering at my feet."

870632271.m_KeyValue: ""Sirene, you're... much shorter than I expected.""

870773815.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain <link=""Tips_ID;6""><#508499><u>Rushes</u></color></link> into battle, dealing <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (P. DMG) to the first enemy hit and marking them as the target. Gains Horn Dance for {1} sec.""

871285109.m_KeyValue: ""Much better, now that I've taken the medicine. I should've taken a proper rest right from the beginning...""

871318870.m_KeyValue: ""She said my writing was as scattered as my speech, so she offered to refine it.""

871390868.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's this very meticulousness that has her fixate too much on the details."

873540535.m_KeyValue: "Please think of me as your _$$birthday fairy godparent._$$"

873540536.m_KeyValue: ""I never imagined that the address I wrote on a whim would actually exist—and even more surprising, that the reply would bring an answer to my confusion.""

873540540.m_KeyValue: ""Somewhere in this world—be it in the past, present, or future—there must be many others like me who wish _$$you_$$ well, too.""

873540541.m_KeyValue: "I see... Thank you for your reply."

873540542.m_KeyValue: ""Not just at celebrations, but in all events in life, we are our own protagonists!""

873540544.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps I'm afraid to know the answer."

873540545.m_KeyValue: ""No matter what others think, I, a distant stranger, sincerely wish you well.""

873540546.m_KeyValue: "Believe this: you are the protagonist of your own world!"

874005817.m_KeyValue: "Deals True DMG equal to {1} of Max HP every {0} sec to enemies on burning tiles."

874005819.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, Vassals placed on this central tile gain All DMG Reduction (Minor), lasting for {0} sec, and immediately gain <color=#c33131>{1}</color> point(s) of Energy.""

875432663.m_KeyValue: "Seeking the gifts of the Threads of Fate through the cycles."

876762717.m_KeyValue: "I have one final favor to ask of you. This request is a matter of life and death to me. It may prove equally vital to Noah."

877226212.m_KeyValue: ""Amidst a myriad of possibilities, she struggled to piece together a cohesive narrative. Yet, a distinct warmth radiated from the object, unmistakable in its emotional resonance.""

877226213.m_KeyValue: ""To her companions' astonishment, Aiona lifted the amber-encased eye from the table. She attempted to invoke her power, seeking glimpses of the object's history.""

877226215.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain seemed unconvinced, his brow furrowed in concentration as he tried to recall where he had encountered the name 'Leonardo Ptolemy' before.""

877226216.m_KeyValue: ""'Indeed. Perhaps the cartographer's longing allowed the eye's owner to live on in his life, in a way.'""

877226217.m_KeyValue: ""'In fact, this could well be the origin of the name 'Eye of God'.'""

877226218.m_KeyValue: ""'I'm afraid my ability can't reveal anything more at the moment. However, this eye was carefully preserved in amber. Whoever did this must have really treasured it.'""

877255992.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know if I like it, but I don't dislike this anticipation.""

877255998.m_KeyValue: ""I appreciate the sentiment, but I'm afraid it fails to pique my interest.""

877256000.m_KeyValue: "How unexpected to find myself an invitee. I shall savor this evening."

877256001.m_KeyValue:
""Self: I'm sorry.
Puppet: She's actually thanking you!""

879422593.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, everyone... I can't bring you food anymore...""

879422596.m_KeyValue: "No! That's not it! Joan... she's protecting the world—making sure it follows the right order—"

879422597.m_KeyValue: "Me? Here? Heh... It's been ages since someone asked something so delightfully foolish."

879997303.m_KeyValue: ""So this was Hati's plan? To call me out, so you could speak with me before the Awakening power fades away.""

879997304.m_KeyValue: ""She's a serious child—stubborn, too. If she learns the truth, it might shake her to her core.""

879997305.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... as long as your heart beats and memories flow, we will always be with you.""

879997307.m_KeyValue: "I guess I won't be able to join Sheila and the others in their rest just yet—"

880044370.m_KeyValue: "I guess no one told you. How else do you think the legends of vampire bats and werewolves came about?"

880044373.m_KeyValue: "That's impossible! I've never heard of such a thing!"

880044435.m_KeyValue: "We only know the town's in big trouble. Having a local with us could be beneficial."

880045362.m_KeyValue: "Another monster like that eyebrow-less arsonist? You've got to be kidding me. Why do we keep running into these freaks..."

880045397.m_KeyValue: ""That stupid wolf, that wild girl, she's running so fast! She's doing it on purpose, isn't she?""

880474448.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Strong. Displace. Target is pulled forward and unable to cast Ultimate, Special (Active), Basic ATK, or move during the effect.""

880474449.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Strong. The carrier is interrupted and remains unable to cast Ultimate, Special (Active), Basic ATK, or move during the effect.""

880570468.m_KeyValue: ""You were told it was a silhouette, so why'd you pick the black cat?! And what's with the smug little smirk?!""

880664472.m_KeyValue: "Are you still thinking about what she said?"

880664474.m_KeyValue: ""Like that cat from earlier, it seems to have disappeared.""

880664503.m_KeyValue: "Appearing together is too much of a coincidence—it's like they're just there to fill space."

880664504.m_KeyValue: "Yeah... These monsters and that Tarot woman..."

880664536.m_KeyValue: ""It's fine to be confident, but you need to consider your own strength as well.""

880664538.m_KeyValue: "I didn't expect you to be so capable."

880665527.m_KeyValue: "I hope you can complete the next trial just as well."

880665530.m_KeyValue: ""Well done, you did not disappoint me.""

880665559.m_KeyValue: ""I take that back, this hunk of metal is impossible to talk to!""

880665561.m_KeyValue: "...How are you more optimistic than me at a time like this?"

880665562.m_KeyValue: "Maybe this is his way of showing goodwill?"

880665625.m_KeyValue: ""And now, let me see what you're made of.""

880673186.m_KeyValue: ""But one thing's for sure, we have to get rid of them if we want to get out of this place.""

880673247.m_KeyValue: ""I thought this would be quick, but they're tougher than expected.""

880673248.m_KeyValue: "Let's focus on the ones in front of us for now."

880675263.m_KeyValue: "Why are those things from before inside these creatures?"

880675265.m_KeyValue: "We need to figure out how to deal with this."

880675296.m_KeyValue: "A big one appeared. Is it the leader?"

880675300.m_KeyValue: "She seems to enjoy talking to the puppet."

880676289.m_KeyValue: "It dripped slime all over the floor too."

880676385.m_KeyValue: ""Clean yourself up first, then I'll tell you.""

880676386.m_KeyValue: "Whoa! I-I almost slipped... Why are you so far away?"

880676448.m_KeyValue: "It's a different color than the others..."

880677540.m_KeyValue: "These guys look really heavy. How can they fly?"

880677541.m_KeyValue: "Why do you always notice the weird things..."

880677571.m_KeyValue: ""If you're done observing, could you come here and help me?""

880677572.m_KeyValue: "Their wings are made of stone. There must be something else keeping them in the air."

880677606.m_KeyValue: ""The shadow... That's it, there's something wrong with the shadow.""

880678596.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine, but it seems we're no match for her.""

880678627.m_KeyValue: "Would anyone really pay money for that kind of thing?"

880678692.m_KeyValue: "Not unless you give us the card."

880679619.m_KeyValue: ""These suits of armor are on fire, but they're cold to the touch...""

880679652.m_KeyValue: "Just a little more... Can you manage?"

880679654.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not scared anymore... Ugh, it's still so high...""

880679716.m_KeyValue: "Hold on... let me... let me catch my breath..."

880680644.m_KeyValue: ""79, do you still have strength left?""

880680645.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry about me. They're tough, but I can still manage.""

880680646.m_KeyValue: "Then I'm counting on you to watch my back."

880680741.m_KeyValue: "I just want to get this pointless farce over with."

880680742.m_KeyValue: "Finally decided to get your hands dirty?"

880680803.m_KeyValue: "They're... a lot tougher than what we encountered earlier!"

880714249.m_KeyValue: "Don’t let him waste his energy here."

881727423.m_KeyValue: "Infiltrate failed. Enemy alert level now at 100%."

882584873.m_KeyValue: "Because humans are just like the wind."

883372951.m_KeyValue: "What about those agents the Church sent?"

883516691.m_KeyValue: "I copied all of these from those knightly novels."

884348781.m_KeyValue: ""Plants a Seed of Calamity on the field. Once charged up, the seed explodes, dealing massive M. DMG to all enemies. When Awakened, the seed continuously deals weak M. DMG to nearby enemies.""

884638040.m_KeyValue: ""Hehe! As long as you're somewhere in the wind, we'll always meet again.""

884638041.m_KeyValue: "Come race me! We'll see who reaches the crater first."

884638046.m_KeyValue: "I risked my life jumping after you."

884638047.m_KeyValue: ""Very well, then. Go on and chase after that precious ending.""

884638051.m_KeyValue: "She parts her lips and drives her fangs into the tender flesh on his neck."

884638052.m_KeyValue: "Your companions would be delighted to know."

884638053.m_KeyValue: ""No, wait, I... said I was done with those.""

884639070.m_KeyValue: "These memories... why must they plague my dreams again?"

884639072.m_KeyValue: "Please... let me look at them again..."

884639073.m_KeyValue: ""Truth or lie, your cowardice disgraces the sacred duty of a Church-forged weapon.""

884639074.m_KeyValue: "Are you survivors from outside the disaster area?"

884639076.m_KeyValue: ""Your attire may lack dignity, but your skill is undeniable.""

887841522.m_KeyValue: "You are... Domitian and Flavius. You serve at the Lord's side."

887841525.m_KeyValue: "It's not just you—they'll take everyone from the Capitolus Arena. Can you even keep everyone safe?"

890086992.m_KeyValue: "You'll be receiving Missions and Tasks in the castle. Try to complete as many as you can."

890097090.m_KeyValue: ""Phantoms will always drop Past Relics, regardless of their strength.""

890097092.m_KeyValue: ""Next, select Nefertari's Unique Relic—the sealed _$$Bow of Pyre_$$—and drag it to your Inventory.""

890097093.m_KeyValue: ""Now, take this bag while you're at it. It's nothing rare—you'll find more in the future.""

890098115.m_KeyValue: ""Excuse me, but I've just remembered something that would make the perfect gift to celebrate your rebirth—""

890098116.m_KeyValue: "These are notes I obtained from a cartographer friend. They will guide you to discover lost items during your journey."

890098117.m_KeyValue: ""Through its guidance, you may uncover treasures left by those who came before, or perhaps a story or two worth remembering.""

890098118.m_KeyValue: ""So, we just need to follow the clues to find the hidden location in this 'puzzle,' right?""

890098119.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. Try tapping on places you find suspicious. You may come across something unexpected..."
