""Clear Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II Fragment 7 to randomly obtain equipment from the following. 
<alpha=#80>Time erodes the husks of monsters, but the legacy of battle echoes eternally.""

890242272.m_KeyValue: "No Exorcise Spirit records. Unable to perform Quick Exorcise."

890242304.m_KeyValue: "Upgrade available after reaching Blood Transfusion LV. {0}."

890296531.m_KeyValue: "Let's finish this before old man Baphomet has to get his hands dirty."

890297555.m_KeyValue: "Let's go. We have to rescue Empousa."

890298709.m_KeyValue: "I never thought you would defy the family's tenets."

890299732.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) Looks like you are ready."

890300622.m_KeyValue: ""...Well, if you don't think that way, it's like you're denying that you're a real 'life' yourself, isn't it?""

890300625.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, you know where the other brazier is, lead the way!""

890301646.m_KeyValue: ""You seem to have quite an injury, are you alright?""

890548627.m_KeyValue: ""Quick, fight off the tentacle, or more will come!""

891320353.m_KeyValue: ""To help you adjust to your new role, I've compiled the _$$Ten Essential Duties of a Bloodborn Elder._$$""

891321477.m_KeyValue: ""Behold, a treasure chest awaits just beyond. Are you ready to embrace the challenge?""

891321508.m_KeyValue: "It's time to invoke the power of the 'Chariot' and deal with this sleeping guard."

891321675.m_KeyValue: ""Hope I didn’t keep you waiting, Patchen. The key’s ours now.""

891321706.m_KeyValue: "The chest is locked. It seems the 'Wheel of Fortune' has one more trial."

891323488.m_KeyValue: "Be diligent about upgrading your Vassal skills. It will greatly help in battle!"

891323523.m_KeyValue: ""Before we proceed, there's something I need to give you.""

891323554.m_KeyValue: ""We've been on this journey for a while now, Noah. Know that having like-minded Vassals by your side makes everything much easier.""

891323589.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, we have finally gained a foothold.""

891323620.m_KeyValue: "Truth's Odyssey is the main Raid for obtaining Skill enhancement materials."

891323853.m_KeyValue: ""Though the family remains in a state of disarray, the many facilities built during its golden era are still accessible in the castle.""

891324612.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, we've been trudging forever! My legs are about ready to fall off. I'm getting jealous of those bums back at the castle, sleeping in and sipping their hot wine.""

891326755.m_KeyValue: "This tower is overcomplicated! Why all the divergence? Which path should we take?"

891326790.m_KeyValue: ""We successfully broke free from the prison and completed the first phase of the fated covenant. Let's go back and check how we've been compensated, Noah.""

891529964.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's time I uncovered who Sirene truly is."

891529972.m_KeyValue: "Little Noah does have a sense of humor."

891529973.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. Your room will be perfectly safe."

891529974.m_KeyValue: ""I'll keep an eye on you, and I won't let anyone lay a hand on you. After all—""

891529975.m_KeyValue: "I absolutely hate it when people touch what's mine."

891529977.m_KeyValue: "Your eyes must be getting tired from all that watching."

891529979.m_KeyValue: ""No one answers, yet I can't shake the feeling that I'm being watched.""

891690482.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Why is my Bloodsoul resonating with you, an ordinary person?""

891892864.m_KeyValue: ""Not much. Just a golden lance, and it's absurdly heavy.""

891892866.m_KeyValue: ""You may have helped us just now, but I still don't know why you chose to intervene.""

892258073.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG equal to a percentage of their Max HP per sec, while boosting DMG dealt by {0}. This effect lasts until the end of the battle.""

892689628.m_KeyValue: ""As promised, I've come to return your sketchbook—complete this time.""

892689629.m_KeyValue: ""In fact, your Captain already gave you the answer.""

892689630.m_KeyValue: ""No matter where the ship sails, as long as you're not alone on the journey—that is what freedom truly means.""

893184522.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since the Blood Moon engulfed the sun, this desert's become a wasteland.""

893734445.m_KeyValue: "So the Bathorys were the fourth. And yet not a single Vice-Commander detected your movements..."

893734446.m_KeyValue: "Just as I was told—fierce and fiery. A most spirited small guest indeed."

893734447.m_KeyValue: ""So this is what lies within the sealed area... It feels like a twisted union—part Bathory, part Church.""

893734449.m_KeyValue: ""I can't say why, but something about this place feels... very off-putting.""

893734450.m_KeyValue: "Go on ahead. I'll hold them off."

893734451.m_KeyValue: ""What's even stranger is—where is she? If she lost, did she just vanish?""

893734452.m_KeyValue: "Wait—him? That man with the sinister eyebrows?"

893735468.m_KeyValue: "Save your strength—what good is reaching me if you're already on death's doorstep?"

893735471.m_KeyValue: "I won't abandon you! We'll leave together! I swear we will find a new life!"

893735473.m_KeyValue: ""Cain! Please spare my sister—spare Empousa! Let me become the sacrifice, let me serve as _$$Mother's vessel_$$!""

893735474.m_KeyValue: ""It is the memory etched into the veins of all _$$sisters,_$$ Empousa—""

893735475.m_KeyValue: "Who have only one reason to exist..."

893735476.m_KeyValue: "I should be the one asking that! Why are you here... Did you arrive with Jacintha and Cain?"

893735477.m_KeyValue: ""Then you went on to help him _$$find himself,_$$ but you were really following Cain's orders to gather the Moonblessed!""

895778745.m_KeyValue: ""Fanny was born and raised in Ironfist Gaol. Whatever she knows of the outside world, she's stolen from the memories of others.""

895778746.m_KeyValue: "The right place? I believe you've already found it."

895778747.m_KeyValue: "Yes—strike again! Your puppet of mine begs for torment! Let me find meaning in this sacred affliction—!"

895778748.m_KeyValue: ""You two, halt! Beyond this point lies the Warden's chamber of interrogation. None may pass!""

895779769.m_KeyValue: "So this is how we meet again in this place."

895779770.m_KeyValue: "(Coughing) Each reunion comes swifter than the last."

895779772.m_KeyValue: ""Chains rattle… the stench of rust and decay clings to the air. Another prison, then.""

895779773.m_KeyValue: "Most impressive. Now… let us see what strength remains once my shackles have claimed you."

895779774.m_KeyValue: ""Her pride stung, Fanny lashed out, boot cracking against the iron bars of the neighboring cell.""

895779775.m_KeyValue: "You turned your back on the Tempus Church. You defected to the Black Blood. Across the continent you are hunted as the Silver-haired Heretic… Bearing sins so grave—why do you not confess?!"

895779776.m_KeyValue: "You are the one who is truly imprisoned."

896820652.m_KeyValue: ""I've heard they use a unique alchemy to sustain the Long Night. If we can stop the ritual, the night might finally end.""

896820653.m_KeyValue: ""Once the night ends, both sides will lose their power to fight. Maybe then, their hatred will yield. This is the only way to stop them.""

896820655.m_KeyValue: "But the castle is too vast to search for the ritual site. If only Cain were here…"

896820656.m_KeyValue: ""A steward must answer when called. Unfortunately, with Lady Quinn in the dungeon then, I regret that I was unable to assist.""

896820657.m_KeyValue: "How terrifying! No one was here just now—how did you appear out of nowhere?"

896820658.m_KeyValue: ""Regarding the ritual site you seek, we can discuss it as we walk. This will ensure none of your precious time is lost.""

896820659.m_KeyValue: ""After such a wearying journey, my lady, I have readied fresh attire for your comfort.""

896820660.m_KeyValue: "I never would have imagined that you were truly a lady."

896820661.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for your thoughtfulness, Cain the steward.""

896830380.m_KeyValue: "You've been drinking it?! Doesn't Mouret have the Moontide Canal?"

896830381.m_KeyValue: ""Daylight's been getting shorter, and Ganelon's stretch of the river has almost dried up. This underground spring is all we've got left...""

896830388.m_KeyValue: "I-It's all Mr. James's fault for not stopping me! I was only trying to protect him!"

896830389.m_KeyValue: "Protect me? You ran faster than a rabbit! These old bones nearly fell apart chasing you!"

896830390.m_KeyValue: "But seriously—why come to the forbidden grounds of all places? That's just asking to get infected by the Plague!"

896830391.m_KeyValue: "Forbidden grounds... Plague... You mean this place? The Ashen Garden?"

896830393.m_KeyValue: ""In my time, this cave is one of the Twelve Forbidden Grounds of the continent—known as The Blackroot Hollow. You have no idea how dangerous it is!""

896830394.m_KeyValue: "I only found out about it by sneaking a peek at my grandfather's diary."

896830395.m_KeyValue: "Wait... we've been drinking water from here all this time... Isn't that basically slow suicide?"

896831534.m_KeyValue: "This is... an old score I need to settle."

896832558.m_KeyValue: ""It's a long trek through the caves. Are you sure you want to delay your search for the young hero, Agnes?""

896832559.m_KeyValue: "When I stumble on a historical mystery this big... I have to see it through!"

896832564.m_KeyValue: ""Instead, he went to the trouble of recruiting Johannes... and keeping the infected alive.""

896832565.m_KeyValue: ""Ezareth also said that once the patients mutated, they can be left alone. That sounds more like he wants them to stay that way.""

896832566.m_KeyValue: "We all know contracting the plague is a death sentence. Accelerating it helps no one... Unless... he's trying to sacrifice a few to save the rest?"

896832567.m_KeyValue: ""That doesn't hold up. These patients were already isolated in the caves. If he wanted to protect the healthy, he would've fortified the town.""

896832568.m_KeyValue: "Do you know where we might find this Lord Ezareth?"

896832569.m_KeyValue: ""During the war, he stationed himself near the edge of town to monitor the frontlines.""

896832571.m_KeyValue: ""I have a theory, but I need more evidence.""

896833720.m_KeyValue: "A curse? No way! It was incredible!"

896833721.m_KeyValue: "They called it a curse. Said this strange Blood magic would bring ruin upon the Baphomet line."

896833722.m_KeyValue: ""You're the one who brought me here, to seek out my mother. I should be the one thanking you.""

896833723.m_KeyValue: ""Inside that barrier, everything went silent... like the whole world held its breath. I've never felt so at peace.""

896834736.m_KeyValue: ""See, Quinn? I told you my dad would know what to do!""

896834740.m_KeyValue: "They said I looked like I was from the north… which means Mother wasn't a native of Mouret. She came here from her homeland."

896834741.m_KeyValue: ""The Crowleys are affiliated with Ganelon and typically reside beyond the northern reaches of the Lupine Forest. That said, your mother was among those who came to Mouret on official duty. After all, Mouret was once a key stronghold under Ganelon.""

896834742.m_KeyValue: "Agnes and I are actually headed to find Ezareth Crowley. He's from the same clan and used to be quite close with Elonora."

896834743.m_KeyValue: "He may know something. Why don't you come with us?"

896834744.m_KeyValue: ""Right! If the Cartographer hadn't reminded me, I would've completely forgotten!""

896834745.m_KeyValue: ""Father... Quinn's mother—she's the envoy you mentioned before, Elonora? Do you know where she is now?""

896834746.m_KeyValue: "Elonora... Elonora Crowley? That famed envoy from Mouret? I believe she disappeared after the great battle twenty years ago."

896834747.m_KeyValue: "So that's why they kept calling me a Crowley witch… My mother came from the Crowley family."

896835890.m_KeyValue: "So it's true. Your beloved sister was nothing but a pawn from the start."

896835891.m_KeyValue: "Only then... could her death serve... its greatest purpose..."

896835892.m_KeyValue: "I merely... ensured it appeared... at the right moment..."

896835893.m_KeyValue: ""O-Of course it was real... it had to be, to make it convincing...""

896835894.m_KeyValue: "This letter... it bears the Wolfsbane mark... This truly was my mother's!"

896835895.m_KeyValue: "Your father's bloodstained debt in Ganelon remains unpaid—and now you dare add to it?"

896835896.m_KeyValue: ""A child raised by monsters, ungrateful to the last... I generously let you see my sister's keepsake, and this is the thanks I get?""

896835898.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally, you don't care about facts. All you needed was a tragic tale to stir hearts. But this clay... it's the fatal flaw that unravels your lie.""

896835899.m_KeyValue: "Reasoning with a villain like you is a waste of breath. The only justice now... is to shut you up for good."

896836914.m_KeyValue: "Ah! My leg! That cursed arrow… And my fields—the harvest is still waiting. Who will care for my family now?"

896836915.m_KeyValue: "Father... Mother... where are you? It's so dark... it hurts so much... I'm scared..."

896836916.m_KeyValue: "My child! My little Tom! He was only five... Why? Why did you destroy our house? He was so young..."

896836917.m_KeyValue: "I don't want to die...but I don't want to kill either... I'm just a miller's apprentice! Why must I wield a sword? I can barely hold it steady!"

896836918.m_KeyValue: ""The faces are a blur now. But the screams... those screams... they haunt me still, as if they've carved themselves into my soul. Even after all these years, I hear them as clearly as the day they shattered my world.""

896836919.m_KeyValue: ""Conrad... Conrad! Open your eyes! Don't leave me and the children... Please, I'm begging you, wake up!""

896836920.m_KeyValue: "Leave everything here to Father and me!"

896836921.m_KeyValue: ""On our way to the castle, we passed through a war zone. It was the first time I witnessed the horrors of war with my own eyes.""

896836922.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to harm these villagers, you'll have to get through me first!""

896836923.m_KeyValue: ""Hurry along, Quinn. Time waits for no one. And you, Cartographer, keep her safe.""

896965693.m_KeyValue: "Every rumor speaks of Bathory's downfall. The castle should have been deserted long ago."

897070392.m_KeyValue: ""So... you've returned to my side, Noah.""

897070393.m_KeyValue: "Yet none would dream… that we might stand as one."

897070400.m_KeyValue: ""The key, she stands before us now.""

897070401.m_KeyValue: ""If I were to leap, the exquisite agony of my body breaking might grant me bliss beyond imagination… like the taste of your blood.""

897070402.m_KeyValue: ""They crowned me Warden, made me recite the Sanctus, as if those words could fill my hollow heart. But I know the truth—I am nothing but a shell, a marionette that speaks when pulled by strings.""

897070403.m_KeyValue: ""And no matter how savage the torment, by dawn the prisoners' wounds are gone, as if they had never bled at all.""

897070406.m_KeyValue: "I'll send you out. It was always part of my power. Escaping this place… will not be difficult."

897071424.m_KeyValue: "And you—fresh off the cart and already trying to bolt! Fasten those shackles tight!"

897071425.m_KeyValue: ""And, perhaps, my own intent as well… You have felt it already—Fanny's methods are beneath all dignity.""

897071426.m_KeyValue: "Which fool sounded that alarm? Do you all have a death wish? Yard time is over. Crawl back into your cages. Now!"

897071452.m_KeyValue: "There is a difference between brawling and dueling."

901000076.m_KeyValue: ""A nameless letter quietly waits on the desk, unopened.""

903613908.m_KeyValue: ""But... you hardly honored your promise to come alone that night, did you?""

903772932.m_KeyValue: "Hehe... I tremble to imagine how lively it'll be under my cloak tonight."

903772963.m_KeyValue: ""Gargoyles are carved from stone. We have no souls, and we do not die.""

903773029.m_KeyValue: ""I never believed it. Yet here we are, father and daughter, facing off against each other.""

904197215.m_KeyValue: "New Event [On Wind and Wing] Starts on <color=#81BAF5>10/23</color>"

904197410.m_KeyValue: "Reset Altar of Invocation according to recommended lineup."

905388408.m_KeyValue: ""Next time you go out, let us know first.""

906112464.m_KeyValue: "I've always said she wouldn't be a companion who'd stay with us till the end."

906113550.m_KeyValue: ""You can do it, Aiona! Aim for their heads!""

906113552.m_KeyValue: "These two aren't even fighting having a heated debate..."

906113553.m_KeyValue: ""When Ganelons fight, we aim for the heart!""

906648319.m_KeyValue: "An enhanced detector with a slightly different performance focus than Type I."

908977582.m_KeyValue: ""Next time you're causing trouble out there, I'll descend from the heavens for our fateful duel.""

908977585.m_KeyValue: "Now I know why our plot was exposed."

908977586.m_KeyValue: ""(Remaining silent, watching as Acappella's _$$brilliant plan_$$ unfolds)""

908977587.m_KeyValue: "So what we need is a plot twist!"

908977588.m_KeyValue: ""Because it's the same tired plot every time—you leave an opening, and I fail to catch you. The pattern is just too cliché.""

908977590.m_KeyValue: "I'm starting to think you're methodically plotting to murder me."

908977591.m_KeyValue: "It's not me killing you—it's you who's planning to strike me down."

908977592.m_KeyValue: ""You're clever, but you've got it backwards.""

""After evening prayers, Tris would lift the organ cover and teach the children to feel the lingering vibration of the pipes against their palms. 'There's an old legend about this organ,' she would say. 'Every melody played here will eventually find its destined singer.'
Sometimes, her fingertips would brush against the amber-like remains on the pipes—toffee candies hidden by children in the choir, forever sealing small memories in the fading light.""

913011254.m_KeyValue: "The level of the Vassals placed in the Transfusion Slots will be set to the same as the Transfusion Level."

913011444.m_KeyValue: "Unleash DMG during the exorcism to achieve higher scores!"

914337570.m_KeyValue: ""Haven't you noticed? Ever since we entered this prison, our wounds have been healing mysteriously come nightfall.""

914337571.m_KeyValue: ""The Church's blades shriek through the air, cutting Genevieve down again and again.""

918346035.m_KeyValue: "This desert can't go on forever... can it?"

918346037.m_KeyValue: "Wait! Did you forget what he said? Do you want to turn into sand too?!"

918346066.m_KeyValue: "What's with the monsters here!? It keeps getting worse..."

918346069.m_KeyValue: "You're bleeding... Stop talking... Let me patch you up..."

918346332.m_KeyValue: ""The eyes have been moistened... All preparations are done... Wait, is she regaining consciousness. What should we do?""

918346334.m_KeyValue: ""I am not just a vessel for the eyes, nor am I a puppet for the family!""

918346363.m_KeyValue:
""Their lands, blessed with eternal spring, where streams through verdant meadows flow;
Its people, prosperous and content, to the Church their loyalty show;""

918346365.m_KeyValue: "The bandages are still here... Have I returned?"

918346369.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, Lady Aiona isn't here either... Let's search over there!""

918346397.m_KeyValue: "They're armed assassins sent here to kill us!"

918346427.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>That voice... Are you the masked person from the desert?"

918346430.m_KeyValue: "I still have to save my Father. I must return to the castle immediately. Please!"

918346431.m_KeyValue: "Father... I need to go back and find Father!"

918346462.m_KeyValue: ""Tsk... So you think you know everything, little lady?""

918346465.m_KeyValue: "'Aiona... Fulfill... the duty of the Alita family...'"

918346496.m_KeyValue: ""The lord is not here, my lady. You shouldn't speak too much; your eyes need time to recover. Please rest for now.""

918346529.m_KeyValue: "Don't act rashly! Our power is being suppressed."

919133675.m_KeyValue: ""Stella, don't just stand there—get over here! We're nearly out of ammunition. We can't hold them off much longer!""

919133679.m_KeyValue: "It rends space itself. Its capacity for survival far exceeds those crude constructs."

919133680.m_KeyValue: "The next assault will come swiftly—we must prepare..."

919133682.m_KeyValue: "None of your attacks even grazed it?"

919133684.m_KeyValue: "We don't have time for small talk right now."

919134601.m_KeyValue: "Your laughter echoes all the way out here."

919134602.m_KeyValue: "Have you discovered a way to resist the Long Night?"

919134605.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Dumb wolf! Who said you could run off on your own?!"

919134606.m_KeyValue: ""...Thank you, Aiona. Come, let's join them—""

919134608.m_KeyValue: "Heh... Now this is a fascinating entry."

919134609.m_KeyValue: "You still haven't told us what really happened over there!"

919134610.m_KeyValue: ""I believe what Noah meant is this: To us, it was but one night. To them… it was long enough to cross into a new era.""

919134611.m_KeyValue: "Hurry up! They're about to light the bonfire!"

919134612.m_KeyValue: "I heard anyone nearby might get picked to help!"

919134698.m_KeyValue: ""Then, before our world bears its own poisoned fruit... Let me be the one to wither the seed and sever its bloom.""

919134701.m_KeyValue: "It doesn't change the truth. It came because of me."

919134702.m_KeyValue: "Even if Albrecht is right... Even if opening a passage to another World in a Bottle was fated to happen—"

919134703.m_KeyValue: "This 'hand' that rends fate... grew from seeds I sowed. Let me be the one to uproot them."

919134704.m_KeyValue: "It shattered the world I knew... and left me with nothing but myself."

919134705.m_KeyValue: "Fine! But don't expect me to bail you out when it all goes wrong—"

919134706.m_KeyValue: "I swear... I've no idea why I'm going along with this lunacy."

919134707.m_KeyValue: ""No matter. We're close enough. Come with me. Let us meet this Mastermind face to face. After all, our world is next on its list.""

919134708.m_KeyValue: "Impact's shaken the El Dorado. We're starting to lose speed."

919179309.m_KeyValue: "You were so secretive back then... but now I’m not even sure I want to know."

919248206.m_KeyValue: "A priest warped by the Black Blood. The defilement of their sacred scriptures has transformed their spells into twisted curses."

919248207.m_KeyValue: ""A knight grotesquely twisted by the influence of Black Blood. Devoid of faith, their swordsmanship is now tempered by pure insanity.""

919248216.m_KeyValue: "An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. Its exaggerated spine implies a body terribly distorted."

919248218.m_KeyValue: "Slaves of House Carrelle who will stop at nothing to claim a _$$surname_$$ for themselves."

919248219.m_KeyValue: ""An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. This creature has lost all semblance of its original form, becoming a monstrous beast.""

919248221.m_KeyValue: "An assassin attempting to infiltrate the Alita castle and kill the lord."

919292618.m_KeyValue: ""Gains All DEF Up based on lost HP. The more HP lost, the greater the All DEF increased.""

919394791.m_KeyValue: "This song was written just for you—it's unique."

920331012.m_KeyValue: "How can you spurn the mercy that's been offered..."

920332035.m_KeyValue: "It is time for the people of this world to wake up and witness the truth."

920565931.m_KeyValue: "I need no such thing. I already command the strongest Legion."

920565933.m_KeyValue: "Enough wavering. You've never loved anything but battle. Those so-called companions and friends? Shackles that drag you down."

920565935.m_KeyValue: "I saw you in the stands. Who are you?"

920565936.m_KeyValue: "Every opponent I've faced thus far has been dull."

920565937.m_KeyValue: "Then… might even wilder dreams be born as truth?"

920565938.m_KeyValue: ""(sighing) Well, with the great tree watching, Joyce can't slack off any longer. Best seal this dangerous power before it consumes her.""

920565939.m_KeyValue: "Is she chosen by the Saint? Run!"

920565940.m_KeyValue: "My thousandth battle… and I have triumphed."

921097293.m_KeyValue: ""Father announced that I am _$$the most gifted heir, a once-in-a-century qualified one._$$ His eyes brimmed with expectation.""

921723282.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! You, the greatest of sinners in the eyes of those mortals, dare speak so arrogantly of my sins?""

921734405.m_KeyValue: ""After all, like your sister, there are plenty to replace you...""

922779537.m_KeyValue: "Because I'd rather spend time alone with you."

923307718.m_KeyValue: "Looks like I succeeded. My mission was to keep you occupied."

923307720.m_KeyValue: "So… you'll let us leave? Even Aiona?"

923307721.m_KeyValue: "...It's coming from the sealed area. The Divine Body's seal… it's been broken."

923307724.m_KeyValue: ""All you need to know is this: Like you, I am simply one of many forms life may take.""

923307725.m_KeyValue: "Now that I’ve been honest with them... Will you grant me one request?"

923307726.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, so Aiona's over forty? That makes her ancient! No wonder she always wears a veil.""

923307727.m_KeyValue: "You aren't lying. But you haven't told them everything. There's something more you're looking for in the Bathory."

923816884.m_KeyValue: "I confess my previous correspondence was imprudent. I disregarded the precarious circumstances facing the Bathory and pressed you with questions better left unasked."

925479686.m_KeyValue: "You contacted the Church and brought them here? Why didn't you tell me about this before?"

925479687.m_KeyValue: "No way... How do I keep getting lost on my own doorstep?"

925479688.m_KeyValue: "That's right! I've also heard that each of the Church's twelve Bell Ringers possesses a unique ability that specifically counters Black Blood!"

925479689.m_KeyValue: "Could it be Death that I encountered on the cliff? And their presence at both ends..."

925479691.m_KeyValue: ""What do you mean? I'm never been mistaken about a person! You're Noah, plain and simple! Even if you started acting like a completely different person...""

925479718.m_KeyValue: "Of course! Everyone on the island knows that phantoms can only manifest from those we've shared wonderful memories with..."

925479719.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, when you were talking about your grandmother, you asked if I was a phantom or a real, living person, right?""

925479720.m_KeyValue: ""No... While I have no memories of the past, my experiences with Empousa and the others since my rebirth must be real...""

925479721.m_KeyValue: ""—The chant of my family's forbidden ritual! It turns the invoker into a 'sacrifice,' reducing them to nothing but ashes!""

925479722.m_KeyValue: "Noah? I'm glad you're okay... And the person you brought with you..."

925479744.m_KeyValue: "I am indeed angry at you for leaving the Church on your own without consulting me; but I'm also angry at myself..."

925479745.m_KeyValue: ""You're different from Darcias. You're not a cold weapon; you have your own thoughts, your own emotions...""

925479750.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, tell me, how much do you really know?""

925479751.m_KeyValue: ""Save your excuses for your master, Albrecht, that old fossil.""

925479754.m_KeyValue: "Wow... so Darcias is that skilled too..."

925479755.m_KeyValue: "Acappella... I know you still have many questions... but these... could they be Death's... minions? They..."

925479756.m_KeyValue: "Let's be wildly generous and say you actually learned Death's weakness from that old woman. What difference would it even make?!"

925479757.m_KeyValue: ""If you didn't do it, then why did you just happen to secretly leave the Church on the exact same day Death escaped? And why...""

925479777.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, this brat! She can clearly hear us, but only listens when it's about her!""

925479782.m_KeyValue: ""From that moment, the 'shades of longing' created by the Head of the Divine Body became the sole inhabitants of the island. Not a single living being remained.""

925479783.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, Darcias... You've been treating me like my grandmother... I guess that means I'm very similar to her... That makes me happy.""

925479784.m_KeyValue: "That's right. Your use of Covenant not only defeated Famine but also destroyed the ship."

925479785.m_KeyValue: ""If the Divine Body rejects all outsiders to this island... could it be that Noah is, in fact, not an outsider?""

925479786.m_KeyValue: ""I will. But in return, you must promise not to open that coffin before I come back.""

925479788.m_KeyValue: "There's also a worst-case scenario... Could he be..."

925479789.m_KeyValue: ""I trust you, Acappella, but you've only met him once. How do you plan to find him?""

925479811.m_KeyValue: "...I should be used to it by now... having no one by my side..."

925479815.m_KeyValue: "B-But... everyone was just saying... I'm not a child anymore! I'm the last Gravekeeper of the Paracelsuses!"

925479818.m_KeyValue: ""I hate to admit it, but you're right. We've left this world long ago, hahaha!""

925479819.m_KeyValue: ""Our methods are no different than those of the Bloodborn. We preserve the self, 'thoughts,' through the ceaseless transference of memories into new vessels.""

925479820.m_KeyValue: ""Well... Grandmother didn't say... but she did say that if Death ever escaped, it would definitely...""

925479821.m_KeyValue: ""Haha! That's right, I'm your grandmother's grandfather!""

925479843.m_KeyValue: "That bastard Albrecht... how could he be so heartless towards you!"

925479846.m_KeyValue: ""How ironic... Something our family only realized after generations of struggle, so casually stated by an 'outsider.'""

925479847.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... so that's why we went to live with the Church..."

925479849.m_KeyValue: ""But he must have just returned to this island. While he's weakened, it's our chance to send him back to the 'abyss.' But protecting Piera takes priority!""

925479850.m_KeyValue: ""But why... why is my mind filled with... fear, despair, and uncertainty... of death... of being alone... of my duty...""

925479851.m_KeyValue: "But... I'm also... a bit angry at you. I was ready to say farewell..."

925479853.m_KeyValue: "How could anyone in this world wish for their grandchild to sacrifice their life for a duty they themselves had fled from?"

925479881.m_KeyValue: "I... I feel myself slipping... The ritual is... almost done..."

925479882.m_KeyValue: "I finally understand... Someone as weak and pathetic as me... being born into this family... this must be my destiny."

927528615.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Weak. The carrier stops casting all skills, sets the caster as target, and is unable to cast Ultimate or Special (Active) during the effect. When the effect ends, the carrier will resume attacking their prior target.""

927666012.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, now's not the time to argue about right and wrong!""

927666013.m_KeyValue: ""That's not important right now. If we don't leave, it'll be too late!""

927666014.m_KeyValue: "Are you all alright? Have you seen my father?"

927666016.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry to keep you waiting, my old friend.""

927666017.m_KeyValue: "From what I've heard... Mr. Clive betrayed the Church and released the Black Blood demon sealed in the forbidden grounds. That's why this place..."

927666045.m_KeyValue: ""Since then, your life has been sustained by your oath. You've persevered all this time to protect Hati.""

927666046.m_KeyValue: ""I remember you loved these flowers, even though they're poisonous to you...""

927666311.m_KeyValue: "Bad predicament? You called for help because you were about to be eaten."

927666312.m_KeyValue: ""This is where your journey ends, kind travelers. No... perhaps I should call you vampires.""

927666341.m_KeyValue: ""Come, my worthy adversary! Our fated duel begins!""

927666342.m_KeyValue: ""...I guess that won't work, huh? And here I thought we could resolve this without fighting...""

927666343.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Is this how you treat those who saved your life? What kind of knight are you?"

927666345.m_KeyValue: ""...Ah yes, I must find Hati right away!""

927666372.m_KeyValue: "Cain said there were four Moonblessed left. Have all the clues really converged here?"

927666374.m_KeyValue: "You're the most relaxed one here... And I'm surprised you eat normal food."

927666375.m_KeyValue: ""Our home lies beyond the sea of stars, on the other side of that distant moon.""

927666376.m_KeyValue: ""We are indeed members of the Bathory family, but we only came to Lupine Forest to find someone.""

927666377.m_KeyValue: ""Wait a second, I know that look... Quick, get away!""

927666378.m_KeyValue: "You look like you've seen a ghost."

927666379.m_KeyValue: ""Get out of here, now! I'll hold them off!""

927666405.m_KeyValue: ""He... he's an old friend of my father's. But for some reason, today he kept trying to stop us from going back to help Father. He even tried to stop me by force...""

927666408.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, stupid wolf! If you can't bring yourself to fight people you know, step aside. Leave the Black Blood enemies to us!""

927666409.m_KeyValue: "How could this happen? We just escaped from the Church's soldiers together! What's happening?"

927666410.m_KeyValue: ""Your skin tone is different from theirs, and so is your build. I remember the Ganelon people being naturally tall and robust.""

927666411.m_KeyValue: ""In conflict, there are no true winners. Only varying degrees of harm suffered.""

927666436.m_KeyValue: "You helped me and Clive. I'm truly grateful. We're going to go find Father now. This is where we part ways."

927666440.m_KeyValue: "Why should we tell you? It's none of your business."

927666442.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare talk about my father like that!"

927666471.m_KeyValue: ""So it can't save their lives, but will allow them to die with more dignity—is that what you mean?""

927666472.m_KeyValue: "These soldiers have also been infected with the Black Blood disease."

927666473.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm just trying to understand his words—'Bringing him to the Ashen Garden is our family's destiny.'""

927666474.m_KeyValue: ""He might be able to... No, he definitely can help us solve the current crisis in town!""

927666475.m_KeyValue: ""I've always wanted to be a strong Gravekeeper like Father, so I've pestered him with questions about many things, including the possibility of forbidden grounds existing.""

927666500.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Ganelon is here too? With him by your side, perhaps it'll be fine...""

927666502.m_KeyValue: "That outfit... So you are from the Church!"

927666504.m_KeyValue: ""But it's okay. Even if Father only cares for sister, that's fine, because for me...""

927666505.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, and the Ganelon Gravekeeper gets their own Moonlight Sword too! It's really cool!""

927666506.m_KeyValue: "You've been flying the whole time. Have you really got the nerve to complain about being tired?"

927666507.m_KeyValue: "Find someone... Ah! He's Father's best friend. He must be coming to help Father!"

929379764.m_KeyValue: "The sacred forbidden fruit is bitter and hard to swallow."

929379795.m_KeyValue: ""Who am I in your eyes, truly?""

929382804.m_KeyValue:
""Puppet: How about I give you a discount?
Self: Don't tell anyone.""

929388460.m_KeyValue: "Is this a blessing or a curse?"

929388491.m_KeyValue: "I can sense that I'm one step closer to understanding my 'true self'."

929392839.m_KeyValue: "Mutual understanding is an experience I've never had before. I will deeply contemplate its meaning."

929395013.m_KeyValue: "Truly? My identity... It does not concern you?"

929398022.m_KeyValue: "I must live up to these expectations."

929398181.m_KeyValue: "Is this part of my job too?"

929794813.m_KeyValue: ""Then so be it. My dear prisoner, I shall wait for your answer. One that satisfies me.""

929794816.m_KeyValue: "Fanny. She may know where the true exit lies."

929852520.m_KeyValue: "You have activated a new Team Blood Bond: Desecrater!"

932484371.m_KeyValue: "Loses a small amount of HP every 2 sec and cannot use Ultimate."

932637849.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) My apologies. Did I wake you?"

932637856.m_KeyValue: "History is but the culmination of countless coincidences interwoven."

932637858.m_KeyValue: "But echoes of what has already transpired."

932637859.m_KeyValue: ""Prophecies are not tales of what's to come,""

932638872.m_KeyValue: ""Now, now, <style=""Highlight"">Noah Nevernight</style>, the silver-haired one, I'm just doing my job. The Church expects me to interrogate an extreme heretic like you very thoroughly.""

932638873.m_KeyValue: "So let's cut the formalities. What I really want to know is—"

932638881.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human?""

932638883.m_KeyValue: ""Don't feel like answering? Or perhaps, you believe it's neither?""

932638884.m_KeyValue: ""Then tell me, when do you think a person truly dies?""

932638887.m_KeyValue: "Did you really drag me here just to ask these questions?"

932640027.m_KeyValue: ""The shining knights of the Church, now just food for the rats in this forsaken valley... how ironic.""

932640032.m_KeyValue: "But where did that man with the sinister eyebrows go? Did he fall to his death?"

932640033.m_KeyValue: ""Thank goodness this carriage held together, even after falling from such a height.""

932640036.m_KeyValue: ""I made a promise to <style=""Highlight"">Ressa</style>... I will return, no matter what...""

932640037.m_KeyValue: "I... can't die in a place like this. I made... a promise..."

932640038.m_KeyValue: ""Argh! Damn, why is it acting up now...""

932640039.m_KeyValue: "Luckily the rain stopped. Now is my chance to escape while the path is visible."

932642204.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, has Starfall Valley always been covered by this bloodlike mist?""

932642208.m_KeyValue: "I'm indebted to the Bathory family for accepting me when I had nowhere to go. I'm still learning the full extent of my powers."

932642209.m_KeyValue: "I'm really tempted to sink my 'mundane' fangs into your neck right now!"

932642212.m_KeyValue: ""She temporarily reversed the flow of time back there, didn't she? Do all members of your family possess such incredible power?""

932642214.m_KeyValue: "I see. I guess some only have mundane powers like turning into a bat."

932642215.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona arrived only a few years ago, and she also holds a special place within our family.""

932643229.m_KeyValue: ""I see. No one can hurt me, and I won't be forgotten there...""

932643232.m_KeyValue: ""If the Blood Beast devours you, it could lead to a cataclysmic evolution. You two must be careful!""

932643234.m_KeyValue: "Is it trying to talk to us?"

932643237.m_KeyValue: "Just now... I heard cries of sorrow... but also something calling to me..."

932643238.m_KeyValue: "You heard it too? Like a myriad of echoing thoughts... that's the Black Blood yearning for all life to be one..."

932643239.m_KeyValue: "Both of you are exceptional Moonblessed with unique Black Blood."

932644382.m_KeyValue: ""...I'll go with you, but let them live.""

932644383.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, she's always been following in my shadow. What would she see if she was to stand beside me?""

932644384.m_KeyValue: "What about Setti? What was her crime? She was your subordinate! She looked up to you!"

932644385.m_KeyValue: ""All your suffering will be cleansed in fire. As for breaking that promise, I will go atone on your behalf.""

932644386.m_KeyValue: ""I admire your willpower, but you cannot resist the Black Blood much longer. Let me help you.""

932644387.m_KeyValue: ""It's such a shame, my silver-haired friend. Even if you are a special type with a unique heart...""

932644388.m_KeyValue: ""This is the power of a Bell Ringer, the Church's strongest...""

932644389.m_KeyValue: "Can a human really wield this kind of power? It's like trying to fight fire itself."

932645408.m_KeyValue: ""The great heretic, Noah Nevernight, ""The Silver Demon,"" defied destiny and desecrated the world's natural order. He was burned at the stake in the autumn of 1353.""

932645411.m_KeyValue: ""May you find peace adrift in the river of time, and find solace in God's embrace.""

932645415.m_KeyValue: "No matter what... you will live on."

932895612.m_KeyValue: ""I deliberately exposed my whereabouts to the lady of the Bathory family, and allowed her to take your blood, granting you new life.""

932895614.m_KeyValue: "I imagine the letter's contents are related to your promise."

932895615.m_KeyValue: ""And now, just like before, you're quietly waiting for the opportunity to start the war.""

939130120.m_KeyValue: "The bottom of the valley reeks of decay. Is this really where that heretic is hiding?"

939451190.m_KeyValue: ""First Mate of the dirigible the El Dorado, working alongside Captain Ami Landis to coordinate the duties and tasks of all crew members and sailors.""

939451191.m_KeyValue: ""A sailor succumbed to the influence of Black Blood. With sanity long abandoned, there's nothing holding back the manifestation of their brutal nature.""

939451192.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood has transformed William into a beast driven purely by desire. Timidity and self-doubt are stripped away. Ranna is beckoning to him — and there, where the claws of fear can never reach, lies only the promise of eternal peace.""

939451193.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood has transformed William into a beast driven purely by desire. Timidity and self-doubt are stripped away. Ranna is beckoning to him — and there, where the claws of fear can never reach, lies only the promise of eternal peace.""

939451194.m_KeyValue: ""The perfect embodiment of the Calamity _$$Famine._$$ Through the might of the Divine Body, Ami and the Blood Beast combine to become one formidable entity.""

939743795.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it’s only when we've grown that we see—but the ones who stayed by our side were the real treasures."

941228527.m_KeyValue: ""I need a favor from you. I'm sure our _$$hero_$$ Noah won't refuse me, right?""

941406028.m_KeyValue: "I hope this motivates her to achieve her dream of becoming a good doctor."

""As I pen these words, I know this letter shall never find its answer.

The century-long blood feud between Ganelon and the Bathory clan has at last fallen silent after that terrible plague, and this once-thriving peninsula now embraces an unforeseen desolation. I wander through the skeletal remains of Mouret, where no living soul stirs beneath the pallid sky—only endless fields of Wolfsbane bloom in wild abandon.""

944125619.m_KeyValue: "Lately I grow weary; my fighting spirit wanes by degrees."

944992377.m_KeyValue:
""'Hurried traveler... why not slow your steps and hear a tale or two? Seven stories await—each woven around the Church's enigmatic figure, Bell Ringer Agares Brennholt.'
Brennholt... the one who cast me into the flames. Fitting, then, that he became the start of this frantic odyssey.

The aged voice pressed on:
'One cradle built from bone and breath, a corpse gave life, then slept in death.
Two hearts beat in cursed accord, his flesh—the curse he can't afford.'

1031628705.m_KeyValue: ""Why are you yelling at me? Weren't you the one who said they weren't here? Plus, you said there's no trace of them in the cave now.""

1031628706.m_KeyValue: "How can you get lost in your family's own property?"

1031628707.m_KeyValue: ""But my brother isn't one of your people! He's a child of the Lupine Forest, a brave Ganelon warrior like my father!""

1031628708.m_KeyValue: "What's with that sad look? It is because you came here twenty years ago?"

1031628709.m_KeyValue: ""The Calamity in Lupine Forest—Sheila, the Seed of Plague. Its fate is also sealed there.""

1031628710.m_KeyValue: "Then follow me. We need to get to the deepest part. You'll understand once there..."

1031628737.m_KeyValue: "You entered such a dangerous place and you don't even know who you're looking for?"

1031628738.m_KeyValue: ""Are you saying that because we're originally from different eras, the terms used are also different?""

1031628739.m_KeyValue: ""To be honest, I just met him today. Why do you ask?""

1031628740.m_KeyValue: ""...Is it a trap? But right now, we have no other choice!""

1031628741.m_KeyValue: ""...There's no time. Aiona, help me. We must save Clive at all costs!""

1031628742.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, don't tell me you're planning to...""

1031628970.m_KeyValue: ""Humans run frantically to escape the boundaries of life and death, only to find their own feet have led them back to the starting point—completing the circle.""

1031629001.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps he never really cared. He was more focused on seeing your future."

1031629004.m_KeyValue: "What are sister and the others doing to father's grave?!"

1031629006.m_KeyValue: ""You mean... a special person or something? That's slightly less absurd, but I still don't get what you're after.""

1031629007.m_KeyValue: ""I ended up here while following clues to find my homeland, and your father also hoped that you would find your homeland.""

1031629008.m_KeyValue: "And all these strange mushrooms... they seem to be flickering... like they're giving off some kind of signal..."

1031629034.m_KeyValue: ""You might think the choice is yours, but that is merely what the god you rejected wants you to believe.""

1031629035.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... and Clive, they... they suddenly vanished right before my eyes!""

1031629036.m_KeyValue: ""...Crows? Ugh, I have a bad feeling about this...""

1031629066.m_KeyValue: ""Friedrich, Gilrain, since this person hasn't shown any symptoms of mutation, perhaps we should...""

1031629068.m_KeyValue: "What's even more tragic is that this poor soul has no idea of the consequences he will face."

1031629094.m_KeyValue: "I don't have time to waste here with you. I must find Clive. If he leaves this cave with those werewolves..."

1031629097.m_KeyValue: "For whose sake did we come here to collect these disgusting mushrooms?! And now you turn your back on the mission over some self-righteous fit?"

1031629099.m_KeyValue: "I just want to find my sister. I just want answers—who are we really? I must know."

1031629100.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps you misunderstood her kindness, but it is we who are her companions.""

1031629101.m_KeyValue: ""N-Noah, am I going to die? Will I... like Father...""

1031629104.m_KeyValue: ""Not able to live, not able to die. This is the inevitable tragedy once infected with Black Blood.""

1031629125.m_KeyValue: ""When this happens, it means the Black Blood has eroded his will, and then...""

1031629126.m_KeyValue: ""However, these spores can't be used directly. Once they mature into fully-grown mushrooms, they become highly explosive.""

1031629129.m_KeyValue: ""If just one of the sources were to get out, it would become a world-ending calamity. That's why they're called the Seeds of Calamity.""

1031629130.m_KeyValue: "Hold your breath and throw them at Gilrain and Friedrich's feet."

1031629131.m_KeyValue: "The Church tasked us to work together to strengthen the bonds between our families. Any internal discord is a desecration of our duty."

1031629132.m_KeyValue: "I only know it's a power equal to the Calamities; something that only those strong enough to become a Bell Ringer can master."

1031629133.m_KeyValue: "Good because it's none of your concern. What you need to do is come back to the Church with us."

1031629134.m_KeyValue: "I think he should at least know the reason for his suffering here."

1031629135.m_KeyValue: ""Even this guy is more focused on the mission than you, Aiona.""

1031629136.m_KeyValue: ""Not only are we not part of the Church, we're also heirs of the twelve families in charge of protecting the Divine Body, like the Ganelons that you claim were being deceived by the Church.""

1031629166.m_KeyValue: "How was I supposed to know that! She looks no older than me..."

1031629167.m_KeyValue: "I'll tear your wings to shreds and drag you with me!"

1031629168.m_KeyValue: ""Nah, it can't be. It's too lame!""

1031629195.m_KeyValue: "We are born into this world to seize the present."

1031629197.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona... You asked earlier why a lamb was born here, right?""

1031629198.m_KeyValue: "But it was raised by the werewolves here to be food..."

1031629199.m_KeyValue: ""It just came into this world. It's curious about everything around it, but also afraid...""

1032232265.m_KeyValue: "I guess I underestimated her a bit."

1033130571.m_KeyValue: "Participate in the First Supper to get 160 summons and SSR Vassal Bella & Starry-Eyed Aiona!"

1034234458.m_KeyValue: "A puppet? No wonder Empousa would say something like that..."

1034234459.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, and as promised, we're not enemies this time.""

1034234460.m_KeyValue: ""To bring you back, she exposed herself and the family to our most dangerous adversary...""

1035069525.m_KeyValue: ""But the storm has thrown us off course. If we want to reach Sunset Isle safely, someone needs to take the helm.""

1035069526.m_KeyValue: "Even the so-called culprit we just pulled down... He's turning too!"

1035069528.m_KeyValue: ""No. I will not allow it. You will not desecrate my brother's body, even if it is the only way to stop him...""

1035069555.m_KeyValue: "Why are so many Blood Beasts gathered here of all places?!"

1035069556.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... Since when am I friends with him...? Forget it..."

1035069557.m_KeyValue: ""With power like that, why did you spare him? If anyone deserved to face your metamorphosis, it's William!""

1035069558.m_KeyValue: ""But after such meticulous planning, even roping Jones in as an accomplice... Why would he seek death before I could confront him?""

1035069559.m_KeyValue: ""He said, 'Poisoning the whole ship would mean killing everyone… Why would anyone do that?'""

1035069561.m_KeyValue: ""From here on, this is pure conjecture: Aaron, Jones, and William may have been working together from the very beginning.""

1035069562.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Why do you ignore me and talk about things I don't understand?"

1035069587.m_KeyValue: "But the strangest part is... you feel oddly familiar."

1035069588.m_KeyValue: "Let me take a closer look… wait—what's inside these things…"

1035069589.m_KeyValue: "That voice… it's so faint… almost like a child's. Wait—don't tell me this place is used as a prison?"

1035069590.m_KeyValue: "No sign of anyone either… Maybe I was just hearing things from being dizzy."

1035069619.m_KeyValue: ""So you do want me dead, after all.""

1035069620.m_KeyValue: "They cannot be killed unless their bodies are fully destroyed—or their memories erased."

1035069621.m_KeyValue: "Is it just me? Or do you sound almost...happy?"

1035069622.m_KeyValue: ""No… if you truly possess such a gift, then it answers something I've long struggled to understand...""

1035069623.m_KeyValue: "Noah… don't tell me you're planning to..."

1035069625.m_KeyValue: "Wait. What was that sound? Something shattered... and it came from below."

1035069626.m_KeyValue: ""No, the noise was too clean—like glass or metal breaking. Which makes me wonder… perhaps this blueprint is incomplete.""

1035069648.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps now is not the best time to interrupt, but I should tell you—there is still one place you can go…""

1035069651.m_KeyValue: ""Spare me your sanctimony! On this ship, everyone cared about my brother—about you—even that girl, Ami! But never me.""

1035069652.m_KeyValue: "Did you know they were twins from the start?"

1035069653.m_KeyValue: ""And the Divine Body on Sunset Isle, unclaimed by any guardian bloodline, was the perfect target for a seafarer like Goldland to investigate.""

1035069654.m_KeyValue: "There are cruelties born of man that even beasts would recoil from."

1035069655.m_KeyValue: ""Shortly after you left, he claimed he wouldn't let you take all the glory for yourself. So he went after you, eager to prove his worth.""

1035069657.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me—why, as his kin, were you so insistent that I burn his corpse?""

1035069658.m_KeyValue: "You were even afraid of Jones's courage—his will to face his own guilt. That is why you killed him. And hid his body there."

1035069683.m_KeyValue: "But he's definitely there—at the far end of the corridor."

1035069684.m_KeyValue: ""You know the enemy is just ahead—so why are you shouting? What, hoping to give him time to prepare?""

1035069685.m_KeyValue: "Let Aiona deal with her. I'll go drag that dumb wolf back myself!"

1035069687.m_KeyValue: ""First Mate Bob is gravely wounded, Third Mate William turned traitor, and even the Captain… is dead...""

1035069688.m_KeyValue: ""I hate raw fish! And whether you're naming your food or devouring your own pets—either way, it's unnatural!""

1035069689.m_KeyValue: ""It may not be a perfect comparison, but I say this because I recently met someone who made a similarly extraordinary choice between two lives...""

1035069690.m_KeyValue: "Now… let me take you away. We'll return to that homeland you always dreamed of… Huh?"

1035069717.m_KeyValue: "I don't need your praise. I don't need anyone's approval anymore."

1035069718.m_KeyValue: "She wants me to bring you to her! She'll reward me!"

1035069720.m_KeyValue: "Famine—one of the four Calamities acknowledged by the Church."

1035069721.m_KeyValue: "A Blood Beast that devours its own kind… Is it like the Pestilence sealed in the forbidden grounds? A monster that draws power from bottomless hunger?"

1035684414.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'expanding alchemy research to combat 'emerging' factions'?"

1035686592.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'allowing vassals to attend meetings in transformed states'?"

1035689663.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'raising taxes to address our financial strain in the latter half of the year'?"

1040135218.m_KeyValue: ""The ""Wheel of Fate"" truly loves to toy with mortals. We barely speak of ""future Artifacts,"" and here comes the Sanctus sailing toward us.""

1041291983.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Piera, do you remember what you said before?""

1044545233.m_KeyValue: "Would Noah be willing to accompany me on a sketching expedition?"

1044545234.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, my eyes could use a rest anyway.""

1044545237.m_KeyValue: ""Within moments, Letitia appeared at the door.""

1044545238.m_KeyValue: "It seems I can _$$catch a ride_$$ now."

1120785756.m_KeyValue: ""Stop there! The escapees, I presume? You won't pass me!""

1120785757.m_KeyValue: ""She built the gaol inside the realm's turbulence itself, with time as the barrier. Time that unravels all things.""

1128688716.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limited Challenge Stages: Waning Moon Trial
<style=""InfoText"">Clear Waning Moon Trial stages for generous rewards.
• New stages open periodically.
• Entering a stage consumes challenge attempts, which reset daily at 04:00 AM.
• Clear required stages to unlock the next challenge.
• Use Quick Clear on stages already cleared. This consumes challenge attempts.
• First Clear Rewards are only available once. For each successive clear, Clear Rewards are awarded instead.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Strong Vassals
<style=""InfoText"">Deploy Strong Vassals in Waning Moon Trials for extra bonuses.""

1128688717.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limited Event Feature: Memory Shards
<style=""InfoText"">• Discover items belonging to lost souls along the Twilight Path.
• Use these items to unlock their Memory Shards.
• Reading Memory Shards increases Remembrance and provides progress rewards.
• Each shard has a specific resonance period. Wait patiently for the right moment.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Recollection Mode
<style=""InfoText"">When reading Memory Shards, be sure to choose the correct time and location. Making correct choices activates the shard, and unveils its story.""

1128688720.m_KeyValue:
""Ritual Chamber enhances Vassals' base attributes across the board. Ritual level will be capped by Transfusion Level.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Awakening Ritual
<style=""InfoText"">Upgrade Awakening Ritual to boost all Vassals' attributes.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Faction Ritual
<style=""InfoText"">Upgrade Faction Ritual to boost faction Vassal attributes.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Ritual
<style=""InfoText"">Upgrade Equipment Ritual to boost attributes of Vassals wearing that equipment.""

1128688721.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Clan Hunt
<style=""InfoText"">Challenge bosses together with Clan Members.
Each round of Clan Hunt allows players to take on 5 different bosses simultaneously. Defeating them all advances you to the next round.
Boss levels will increase on select rounds, raising the difficulty.
Monsters DMG modifiers may vary across different stages.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Daily Hunt Attempts
<style=""InfoText"">Each Clan Member has 3 hunt attempts per day.
If other Clan Members defeat the boss while you are in battle, your attempt will not be consumed.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Boss Battle
<style=""InfoText"">Each Vassal of a Clan Member can only participate in one boss battle per day.
DMG dealt to the same boss by Clan Members is shared across the Clan.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ DMG Settlement
<style=""InfoText"">Non-summons cannot be defeated in battle, and DMG dealt to them accumulates towards the Total DMG for the current boss.
After battle, DMG dealt to bosses accumulates towards the Total DMG for the current Clan Hunt.
If DMG dealt exceeds the boss's remaining HP, only the HP is counted.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Ranking and Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">When Clan Members defeat a boss, rewards will be sent to all members via mail.
At the end of the Hunt Season, Clan rankings will be determined based on the Total DMG dealt by all members during this Clan Hunt.
Final Clan Hunt rewards will be sent via mail based on rankings.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Mock Hunt
<style=""InfoText"">You may enter a Mock Hunt with your boss of choice, which will not affect the actual boss.
Mock Hunt will not consume daily battle attempts.
Vassals in Mock Hunt are permitted multiple uses.""

1128688722.m_KeyValue:
""Future Artifacts are an advanced way to enhance a Vassal's combat abilities. Only by equipping a suitable Artifact for a Vassal can their combat potential be maximized.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equip Artifact
<style=""InfoText"">Each Vassal can equip only 1 Artifact, which provides the following effects:
• Enhances the 4 basic attributes.
• Provides up to 3 additional passive skills.
Each Artifact has a specific limit on the number of Vassals who can equip it, but Artifacts can be unequipped.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Artifact Development
<style=""InfoText"">Artifacts can be leveled up, which gives the following effects:
• Enhances basic attributes.
• Unlocks or upgrades an Artifact's passive skills.
• Increases the number of Vassals who can equip the Artifact.""

1128688723.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Twilight Path
<style=""InfoText"">Clear Twilight Path to earn Moonlit Reverie.
• The event consists of Normal and Nightmare modes.
• Nightmare mode will unlock after a period of time, but Normal mode must be cleared first.
• Stages consume attempts, which replenish daily at 04:00. 5 free Attempts are provided daily, and players may purchase Scarlet Cords in the Moondream Journey Shop for extra attempts.
• Use Imbued Vassals to increase Extra Rewards drop rate. At 100%, Extra Rewards are guaranteed to drop.
• Some stages are repeatable. After your first clear, use Quick Clear to obtain rewards by consuming attempts or tickets.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Newborn Trial
<style=""InfoText"">Complete Newborn Trial tasks for Moonlit Reverie.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Moondream Journey
<style=""InfoText"">The shop Moondream Journey is open during the event.
• Spend Moon Tears to buy Scarlet Cords for Twilight Path.
• Use Moonlit Reverie to exchange for Embrace materials and items.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Memory Shards
<style=""InfoText"">• Discover items belonging to various souls on Twilight Path.
• Use these items to activate the Memory Shard of each soul.
• Reading Memory Shards increases Nostalgia and provides progress rewards.
• Each shard has a specific activation period. Wait patiently for the right moment.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Revival Record
<style=""InfoText"">Exciting time-limited sign-in rewards are available during the event.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Waning Moon Trial
<style=""InfoText"">Clear Waning Moon Trial for generous rewards.
• New stages open periodically.
• Entering a stage consumes challenge attempts, which reset daily at 04:00.
• Clear required stages to unlock the next challenge.
• Use Quick Clear on stages already cleared. This consumes challenge attempts.
• First Clearance Rewards are only available once. For each successive clear, Clearance Rewards are awarded.""
