1132400113.m_KeyValue: ""No need for formalities. If you're asking about that shape-shifting 'ghost,' I haven't seen them in some time. What surprises me more is that you still haven't caught them.""

1132438350.m_KeyValue: "Did you truly questioned her? Or did you say _$$You're now a prime suspect. Better spill the beans._$$"

1132615851.m_KeyValue: ""Do tell. You've got me losing sleep now, too.""

1133326904.m_KeyValue: ""Clear [Sapphire Isle] <color=#a65f30>N 1-12</color>: Sword of Honor, Slayer of Sirens""

1133762599.m_KeyValue: "Let's all agree to welcome in more Vassals."

1134310676.m_KeyValue: "He fought with its fury—clouds of dust swallowing his foes."

1134310677.m_KeyValue: "Then I will honor the name you gave me."

1134310678.m_KeyValue: "Then will you keep your promise to me—and stay?"

1134310679.m_KeyValue: ""Is this truly the present you've chosen, Noah?""

1134310681.m_KeyValue: ""Still, I've been waiting to cross blades with you, Brennholt. Let's see what you're truly made of!""

1134313880.m_KeyValue: ""A stalemate... This is not good. I'm pressed for time, while you only intended to stall me all along.""

1134313881.m_KeyValue: "The time for idle talk is over."

1135066951.m_KeyValue: "Collect memory fragments across the map for lost treasure."

1135965715.m_KeyValue: ""You are the Piera I know, so of course I believe you.""

1135965716.m_KeyValue: "Death... was that much stronger than a Bell Ringer?"

1135965717.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we failed... but not everyone died.""

1135965719.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... and I overheard the teacher saying that Death would likely return here... As the last Gravekeeper of the Paracelsus family, it is my duty...""

1135965720.m_KeyValue: "Piera! Don't answer its call! Don't let it tamper with your memories!"

1135965721.m_KeyValue: "Its voice... I think it's directly communicating with my mind. Noah... c-can you hear it too?"

1135965723.m_KeyValue: "You're a pitiful excuse for something called Death. The Calamities I've faced before were far more formidable."

1135965747.m_KeyValue: ""If I hadn't acted quickly... But never mind that, you should go find your companions!""

1135965748.m_KeyValue: ""Um, well... isn't the village at the base of the mountain? Shouldn't we be heading the other way?""

1135965749.m_KeyValue: "So the wild boars on the island... are the natives who have succumbed to Black Blood?"

1135965750.m_KeyValue: ""Sora... You're not giving up like this, are you? Losing to that Noah Nevernight...""

1135965751.m_KeyValue: "There may be even more tragedies along the way. We can't afford to waste time here."

1135966010.m_KeyValue: ""May Noah find the true path home, no longer ensnared by the web of false memories.""

1135966011.m_KeyValue: "...Empousa? It couldn't be. Such a bestial transformation would surely offend her sense of aesthetics."

1135966042.m_KeyValue: "It's much better now. I should be able to walk..."

1135966043.m_KeyValue: "Well... I guess they don't see it that way anymore."

1135966045.m_KeyValue: "Along with that chaotic dream... this place feels almost like... the 'afterlife.'"

1135966075.m_KeyValue: ""Um, I don't have many friends, and I rarely talk to other people... I'm really sorry...""

1135966076.m_KeyValue: ""Um, my name is P-Piera Paracelsus... You can just call me Piera.""

1135966077.m_KeyValue: ""They told me Sunset Isle was the ancestral home of our family, the Paracelsuses... This is my first time here.""

1135966080.m_KeyValue: "Getting back to what I wanted to ask—have you seen anyone else since you've been here?"

1135966106.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, maybe this island really is our home after all.""

1135966107.m_KeyValue: "Was it... people who vanish into thin air?"

1135966112.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me what I did, why you hate me so much. Did I really live on this island?""

1135966113.m_KeyValue: ""It's all your fault! Dr. Ressa abandoned us because of you, and now look what's become of this island.""

1135966138.m_KeyValue: "Shush! I'm trying to connect the pieces."

1135966142.m_KeyValue: "It's always 'Saint this' and 'Saint that.' That old hag didn't assign you Vice-Commanders to us for our safety..."

1135966143.m_KeyValue: ""Do you really buy that? Oh, Darcias, you really do believe everything you're told.""

1135966144.m_KeyValue: "How could the Saint not know about this?"

1135966173.m_KeyValue: "Even if she is... an illusion... created from my longing."

1135966174.m_KeyValue: "You suddenly started talking to yourself... and then drew your sword out of nowhere..."

1135966175.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what you're talking about! I don't remember any of you, I don't... I don't even remember who Ressa was...""

1135966176.m_KeyValue: ""My grandmother was the one who raised me, and I miss her so much... I just want to talk to her again, even if it's just an illusion from my longing.""

1135966177.m_KeyValue: ""I did have that thought at first, which is why I didn't respond when the islanders greeted me along the way.""

1135966202.m_KeyValue: "...But those were wild boars. What possible longing could I have for them?"

1135966203.m_KeyValue: ""So even if someone told me that the never-setting sun here was the Divine Body, I wouldn't find it surprising.""

1135966204.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... Noah, you're not just a phantom, right? You're a real, living person, right?""

1135966206.m_KeyValue: ""The reason my companions and I came to Sunset Isle was to find the Calamity—or as we call it, the 'Moonblessed.'""

1135966207.m_KeyValue: ""After hearing your words, I realized... how I'm the complete opposite of you... It's so frustrating...""

1136171184.m_KeyValue: "What are you trying to say? You're clearly—"

1136171186.m_KeyValue: ""Correct. She wasn't part of the original plan. The acceptable one... Lamia, I believe her name was.""

1136171188.m_KeyValue: "One rings at dusk—a sacred rite yearning for the fall of night."

1136394586.m_KeyValue: "Unable to switch accounts. The third-party account (e.g. Facebook) is not bound to any game profile."

1136583548.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, did you just say... Moonfall?""

1136583550.m_KeyValue: "...What exactly do you mean by vessels?"

1136583551.m_KeyValue: "'Tis because you're here... My ambition to see the Bathorys rise to greatness once more has been ignited!"

1136583582.m_KeyValue: ""The other three elders were annoying enough, but this one is really getting on my nerves!""

1136583583.m_KeyValue: ""And when these two cards depicting your future are combined, that is what you desire—""

1136583584.m_KeyValue: "Because I want us to tell each other our names after we've escaped together."

1136583845.m_KeyValue: ""That day draws near, does it not? After all, 15 was starved to die just yesterday...""

1136583846.m_KeyValue: "At least to believe is better than waiting to wither away."

1136583847.m_KeyValue: "Then it's my turn to ask... Why should I escape with you?"

1136583908.m_KeyValue: ""Oh right, I almost forgot we need to get all seven cards to activate the Astrolabe apparatus.""

1136583911.m_KeyValue: ""...I have to say, your pessimism on this matter is really quite irritating.""

1136583943.m_KeyValue: ""As for the remaining 90 million, you can repay it slowly as my friends and valued customers.""

1136583947.m_KeyValue: "It's useless trying to communicate with her. We should leave."

1136583977.m_KeyValue: ""From beginning to end, you and I might just have been someone's pawns to toy with...""

1136584007.m_KeyValue: "So... does this mean we've passed through here?"

1136584008.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, don't bother. I won't remember some useless numbers.""

1136584009.m_KeyValue: "I... I'm sorry. I'll hold him off here. You go first!"

1136584010.m_KeyValue: ""I've never had companions, nor will I ever.""

1136584040.m_KeyValue: ""We can't go back now, unless... we can restart this massive platform?""

1136584041.m_KeyValue: ""Because you're exactly the person I imagined you to be. And now that you're growing, I know I've had an influence on you, which is... truly wonderful.""

1136584043.m_KeyValue: ""That voice, where is it coming from... Ah!""

1137461816.m_KeyValue: "But I'm definitely not with those things."

1137461817.m_KeyValue: "No... they haven't turned into beasts. They've become Bloodborn."

1137461819.m_KeyValue: "We've followed you since before you bore the Bell Ringer's title. And we still remember what you told us!"

1137461820.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Agares, the survivors have regrouped and are on standby.""

1137462843.m_KeyValue: ""You tell me. You're the one who barged in, shouting for answers.""

1137462844.m_KeyValue: "That's fine. We don't need you alive to be of use..."

1138771370.m_KeyValue: ""And heroes... they should protect everyone, shouldn't they?""

1138771371.m_KeyValue: "Weren't you just accusing me—a Bloodborn tainted by Black Blood—might harm you?"

1138771373.m_KeyValue: ""We still don't know the ritual's true purpose, the lance's full power, or what that dark one even is.""

1139004859.m_KeyValue: ""Watch the battlefield, position your characters tactically, and protect the boy from harm.""

1139507136.m_KeyValue: "No. This is the time. Fanny's anger is only a mask. The real her—"

1139507137.m_KeyValue: "Sweet Alice… only fourteen. I always 'cherished' you as my little sister. Curse you—why did you run when the strike came? Was my lash too soft to teach you obedience?"

1139507138.m_KeyValue: "Pain cuts deeper than fleeting pleasure. You need no more punishments to fill that hollow within your soul."

1139507140.m_KeyValue: "What… what is all of this? Are these… fragments of your past?"

1140611663.m_KeyValue: ""Theophane summons black and white shields to block all incoming damage and enters a charging state. After charging completes, he pulls up a stone pillar and strikes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (P. DMG) to all enemies except himself. If both shields survive, they resonate with the shockwave to deal another <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (<link=""Tips_ID;4""><#508499><u>True DMG</u></color></link>) to all enemies except himself. Breaking both shields will trigger this skill early.""

1140787071.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes... it is only by veiling our eyes that we glimpse the deeper truths, especially where you are concerned.""

1140787104.m_KeyValue: ""Even without removing this veil, I have already committed every detail of you to memory—through senses far more intimate than sight.""

1140787137.m_KeyValue: "You'll find I'm nothing like your usual encounters."

1140787170.m_KeyValue: ""If you wish to close this distance between us, then do as you desire... Come, let nothing remain between us.""

1140787269.m_KeyValue: "Hm? Does this particular spot capture your interest?"

1140787302.m_KeyValue: ""Careful now... if you become entangled, you may never find your way out. I'm referring to my hair, of course.""

1140908565.m_KeyValue: "Seven Sages are using a large number of 'special' slaves to produce this 'Siren's Tear' in order to control more and more people."

1140908567.m_KeyValue: ""I'm worried that if the Church's soldiers find the Black Blood slaves, they'll either purge them or report it to the Church. Either way, things will spiral out of control.""

1140908568.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, a reason they won't be able to refuse.""

1140908570.m_KeyValue: ""There are many Church members at the auction venue. Lord Thoreau has ordered you to find a way to delay them. Now, move.""

1140908598.m_KeyValue: ""Oh Isaac, please don't say that. You're breaking my heart.""

1140908599.m_KeyValue: "You seem quite eager to send me away... Don't tell me you plan to continue those experiments from back then."

1140908601.m_KeyValue: "Lord Thoreau ordered us to evacuate the slaves at once!"

1140908623.m_KeyValue: "'It's those monsters from the sea! They brought the Plague!'"

1140908624.m_KeyValue: ""(Noah, is all of this... part of your plan?)""

1140908629.m_KeyValue: ""I must admit, when I nominated Miss Ami, I had not verified her identity.""

1140908631.m_KeyValue: ""Though it may be unsettling, she used the myths of the Mistbound Terror and the siren to eliminate those who posed a threat to her.""

1140908633.m_KeyValue: "We already have a plan to rescue those slaves."

1140908634.m_KeyValue: "I already know the answers to these questions—"

1140908635.m_KeyValue: ""All evidence shows you are the Mistbound Terror, Miss Lorelei.""

1140908636.m_KeyValue: "But... Ami did fake her identity. What if this is also part of her deception?"

1142369472.m_KeyValue: ""Fleeing? But the climate here is favorable, and the rains are abundant.""

1142369473.m_KeyValue: ""They cry with gratitude for each drop of rain, yet panic and flee at the first sign of thunder.""

1142369475.m_KeyValue: "They trusted you completely—their precious 'White Witch' and her divine prophecy. So they set out to find that promised land you showed them..."

1142369476.m_KeyValue: "But can you stop these wretches from tearing each other apart?"

1142379486.m_KeyValue:
""Even dressed like a maid, she commands the room as the castle's true heir.
Every cup of tea she offers carries the scarlet legacy of the Bathory.""

1142408080.m_KeyValue: ""Randomly selects 3 enemies, dealing massive P. DMG to each target.""

1142596474.m_KeyValue: "Deals DMG equal to {1} of Max HP every {0} sec."

1143216880.m_KeyValue: "Then let us see if your spear can taste my blood."

1143216881.m_KeyValue: ""The night wind sweeps through the trees. Before the cold reaches me, there's a deadly chill that feels almost hellish.""

1144310841.m_KeyValue: ""Birth is not the beginning, death not the end.""

1144310872.m_KeyValue: "The joy of a long life lies in rediscovering oneself time and again."

1144313881.m_KeyValue: "Really? You better not be lying... Liars have to swallow a thousand arrows."

1144319568.m_KeyValue: "Is it time to take the next step?"

1144321711.m_KeyValue: "My legs have grown even more nimble."

1144322577.m_KeyValue: "Having you by my side puts me at ease."

1144323885.m_KeyValue: ""You call me the 'Beguiler,' yet offer something so irresistible?""

1144323916.m_KeyValue: ""Once, someone tried to fly toward the sun. Can you guess what befell them?""

1144324751.m_KeyValue: "From these wounds flows all that you've given me."

1144324910.m_KeyValue: "Ah… I bathe in the radiance of the divine."

1144326059.m_KeyValue: ""With this power, I shall slay our enemies more efficiently.""

1144326925.m_KeyValue: "Come closer. Let me feel the warmth of your presence."

1145037906.m_KeyValue: "Major Arcana Card No. 11. Dalcarlo's Divination: _$$Justice radiates where universal principle and holy faith convene._$$"

1145239514.m_KeyValue: ""If anything deserves scrutiny, it is not Noah, but the Divine Body! The one commanding dreamfeeders to attack villages and devour both the living and their longing!""

1145239515.m_KeyValue: "He merely possesses great power. That is no crime—he has done no wrong!"

1145239516.m_KeyValue: "Because truth is not the same as principle."

1145239517.m_KeyValue: ""As I said before, knowing the truth does not always grant the power to change it.""

1145239519.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to say this: The _$$justice_$$ the Church proclaims... is not always right."

1145239520.m_KeyValue: "I will save as many lives as I can. And I will stand against every unjust death in this world."

1145239521.m_KeyValue: ""Whether I stood as the Saint's guard, or crossed into the Other Side after leaving the Church, my conviction has never wavered.""

1145239522.m_KeyValue: ""Now that I think about it, you were the naive fool who once believed death could be cured. Who even dared to imagine it might be kind.""

1145239523.m_KeyValue: ""My colleague, Yggdrasill, once told me he entrusted his medical texts to a warrior. One who lacked knowledge but bore a heart filled with compassion.""

1145240539.m_KeyValue: "Something's falling from the sky... is it snow?"

1145240540.m_KeyValue: "No... this scent... salt! Her salt crystals?"

1145240541.m_KeyValue: "Forget the salt—look! The crack in the sky is getting wider—"

1145240545.m_KeyValue: "Am I dreaming... the sky is breaking apart?"

1145240546.m_KeyValue: ""The unmoving sun has vanished… and now, the sky is shrouded in darkness.""

1145240547.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder few ever found Sunset Isle. That false sky—it served as a veil, hiding the island from the world.""

1145249242.m_KeyValue: "Oh right! Everyone in the village always talks about you—and Mother and Father always praise you too!"

1145249243.m_KeyValue: "Oh? What do they say about me?"

1145249250.m_KeyValue: "So you got separated from your mother again."

1145249251.m_KeyValue: "Is it because I'm a bad child… that Mother and Father don't want me anymore?"

1145249252.m_KeyValue: "That's not true at all. Eleanor is a very good girl who just got a little lost."

1145249253.m_KeyValue: ""Your parents must be so worried. Come, I'll help you find them.""

1145249254.m_KeyValue: "Do you know where Mother and Father are?"

1145249255.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... Ah! They're searching for you at the Painter's Bluff."

1145249256.m_KeyValue: "Wow! You're amazing! You can see all the way up the cliff from down here!"

1145249257.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph! Don't forget, I'm the all-knowing Dr. Ressa.""

1145250397.m_KeyValue: ""You're right. Of all the warriors I've seen, none fight better than you.""

1145250402.m_KeyValue: "Ressa! Look! Mother's favorite flowers are growing over there! Can I go pick some?"

1145250404.m_KeyValue: ""I see... You're Eleanor, aren't you? The child searching for her family?""

1145250405.m_KeyValue: ""I-I'm sorry! Please don't blame Ressa—I got lost, and she's helping me find my parents.""

1145250406.m_KeyValue: ""With me here, there's nothing to worry about.""

1145250407.m_KeyValue: ""But if we keep her in the dark, won't it become dangerous over time?""

1145250408.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell her about her parents. She's not ready."

1145250409.m_KeyValue: "Go ahead. But stay where I can see you."

1145251420.m_KeyValue: "They were the island's Defenders—keepers of balance."

1145251421.m_KeyValue: "Now... they've turned on us. Which can only mean... The balance has already shattered."

1145251426.m_KeyValue: ""Don't push yourself, your wounds are worse than you think.""

1145251427.m_KeyValue: ""I'll notify them right away! Dr. Ressa, please take care of Piera and Sora!""

1145251428.m_KeyValue: "Black mist rising from the blessed grounds... just like it did in my homeland..."

1145251429.m_KeyValue: "Should I warn the others? Tell everyone to stay away?"

1145251430.m_KeyValue: "This is bad. Could things really be heading in the direction I feared they would?"

1145251431.m_KeyValue: ""The dreamfeeders were here long before us. After we arrived, they began to feed on the longing that appeared now and then.""

1145251432.m_KeyValue: ""...There's no time to waste, I must get to Piera!""

1145252574.m_KeyValue: "Born upon this island to serve a mission. Born into this world to die for faith. Is that truly what's right?"

1145252575.m_KeyValue: "Deceived? Then perhaps life and death were never truths to begin with—just a grand illusion reversed."

1145252578.m_KeyValue: ""Life and death, right and wrong, past and future... Who decides what any of it means?""

1145252579.m_KeyValue: "Is this what you meant yesterday? When you said you'd move forward?"

1145252580.m_KeyValue: "Do you truly believe this is what Eleanor would have wanted? You've been deceived—by death itself!"

1145252581.m_KeyValue: ""When we lost Eleanor, we believed death marked the end. But if it lets us be with those we love... Isn't death also a kind of rebirth?""

1145252582.m_KeyValue: ""This isn't the time for heroics. They can't be killed by ordinary methods—and if even a drop of Black Blood enters your wounds, there's no saving you.""

1145252584.m_KeyValue: "There are many of them... but their Black Blood can't harm me. Wait... You are—"

1145253598.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. The Black Blood disease spreads through blood contact. Those it infects soon lose their minds, becoming little more than beasts.""

1145253599.m_KeyValue: ""The island's small, with scattered homes. That's why it hasn't gone out of control like it did in my homeland.""

1145253602.m_KeyValue: "...you and I are the only outsiders here. Shouldn't we support each other?"

1145253603.m_KeyValue: ""Support each other, hmm? Then why have I ended up with all the chores and potion work?""

1145253604.m_KeyValue: ""Because I'm protecting you in return—especially since you can't fight. And with the crisis looming, that's no small task.""

1145253605.m_KeyValue: "The crisis... you mean the Black Blood?"

1145253606.m_KeyValue: "I can't even stay mad at you anymore... Noah!"

1145253607.m_KeyValue: "I can manage this myself. Or do you still suspect I'll bring harm to the island?"

1145253608.m_KeyValue: ""At first, yes—I was wary of your past. But after all this time, I've come to trust you. You're not a bad person. And...""

1145254752.m_KeyValue: "There are too many of them... I can handle the fight—but not while protecting you both!"

1145254756.m_KeyValue: "The dreamfeeders are reacting more violently to the Black Blood..."

1145254757.m_KeyValue: "Then who can I blame?! Myself? For being useless?"

1145254758.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Jason. Noah happened to be at the blessed grounds—he's not the cause of the Black Blood outbreak.""

1145254759.m_KeyValue: ""If it weren't for you, Sora—he would never have turned out like this!""

1145254760.m_KeyValue: "Shut your trap! No one asked for your opinion!"

1145254761.m_KeyValue: "You should leave. He's terrified he might harm you in this state."

1145255776.m_KeyValue: ""Your hands... they are truly warm, Noah.""

1145255779.m_KeyValue: ""Now that Noah has returned, can he guide us to the Other Side?""

1145255782.m_KeyValue: "Feed on you... Do you mean the dreamfeeder?"

1145255783.m_KeyValue: "He said it was an even bigger and more powerful enemy!"

1145255784.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, I... don't remember anything like that.""

1145255785.m_KeyValue: ""That's right! He stopped everyone, saying bad people would feed on us if we went further.""

1146703565.m_KeyValue: ""Even so, the search for the child's family never ceased.""

1146809324.m_KeyValue: ""Tris, I spoke with Elder Bella about the organ, but I'm afraid it might be difficult to fulfill your request.""

1146819623.m_KeyValue: "He wouldn't be injured by a few Blood Beasts."

1147427760.m_KeyValue: "Baphomet the Soulless... Clive Ganelon the Gravekeeper..."

1149341832.m_KeyValue:
""Constantine gripped the ice-chilled blade and approached the sink.
In the flickering candlelight, the unconscious siren no longer seemed monstrous. This was his final living specimen. Tomorrow, he would have Hallon fetch new materials.
The obsidian knife parted the scales, cutting through the hide-like fishtail. The sinewy gray-blue muscles twitched, causing the grotesque fins to strike the blade with a high-pitched, mournful ring.
Like a fish flailing on a market stall.
Constantine's cuts were precise, measured—blood was never his pursuit. And yet, today, a strange unease festered within him.
That unease deepened the moment the basement door burst open.
'Quick! Help Bella! She collapsed during her birthday banquet!'""

1149932089.m_KeyValue: "The bell hasn't rung yet. Stay sharp. This watch is not to be taken lightly."

1149932090.m_KeyValue: "Kenneth reporting in. Here for the shift change. Appreciate your hard work."

1149935288.m_KeyValue: "Of course not with our current numbers."

1149935289.m_KeyValue: ""Take this earring. One for you, one for me. If anyone dares to bully you, just tell them you're under my protection.""

1150866691.m_KeyValue: ""Captain Goldland, blaming William now won't change anything. We need to find a way...""

1150866692.m_KeyValue: ""Silence! You're just an outsider. Fine, we'll settle this later. Why did you choose to act now, of all times—with that Silver Cross Van Helsing aboard?""

1150866693.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, he looked like nothing but a pampered noble who inherited his title. Why would I be afraid of him?""

1150866694.m_KeyValue: ""You think you're smarter than him? He's already seen through everything! If I hadn't cleared the evidence you left on the deck, you'd have been exposed long ago!""

1150866695.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. Even if he is that capable, he couldn't possibly anticipate my contingency plan. Just wait a little longer...""

1150866696.m_KeyValue: "Always so pleased with your petty schemes—that's why you'll never amount to anything! Bob won't be able to stall him for long. Van Helsing will be here any moment."

1150866697.m_KeyValue: "What!? Van Helsing's already onto us!? Those footsteps outside...!?"

1150866699.m_KeyValue: "I told you to keep quiet! And now that you're the only witness left... I have no choice but to silence you permanently."

1150876146.m_KeyValue: "Take them to the Captain's quarters. Captain Goldland will question them personally."

1150880838.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly, it was cut deliberately. Which means...""

1150880839.m_KeyValue: "You must have also seen the biggest flaw with this murder weapon. There are rust stains at the end..."

1150880842.m_KeyValue: "Then I must also seek out the answers I can find. At least until I uncover the truth about my own life."

1150880843.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps this proves... He is one of the few who truly knows who they are. He believes the answer he received long ago is the truth of his life."

1150880844.m_KeyValue: "You noticed it too—the rope used to strangle Second Mate Aaron."

1150880845.m_KeyValue: ""At times like these, what we need is a new clue. Something to open a new door in this dark labyrinth of truth.""

1150880846.m_KeyValue: ""Don't lose yourself in the question, Silver-haired. Perhaps 'being human' is the answer itself. Each person is an answer the world has dreamed up.""

1150880847.m_KeyValue: "Haven't you ever wondered? Whether the 'you' today is truly the same as the 'you' from yesterday? Whether the person you think you are... is really you?"

1150880848.m_KeyValue: "I just met someone... someone who had been waiting for me for twenty years. But I couldn't give him a new answer. Nor could I help him find a new path."

1150880849.m_KeyValue: ""Every soul you meet, every story you live, is a collision of answers, creating new ones, transforming into new lives.""

1151269398.m_KeyValue: ""If there is no reply after the first letter is sent, issue the following reminder.""

1151361628.m_KeyValue: "I didn't think there was still room to grow."

1151361659.m_KeyValue: "What is it? Need a little coddling?"

1151364668.m_KeyValue: "I'd nearly forgotten… what it feels like to be understood."

1151370324.m_KeyValue: ""If there's anything I can do... No, please let me help you!""

1151370355.m_KeyValue: "Could you... let me feel your warmth again?"

1151373364.m_KeyValue: ""You... have known all along, haven't you? That this is an unbreakable cycle.""

1151373523.m_KeyValue: ""Clive Ganelon, Gravekeeper of the Forbidden Grounds.""

1151375538.m_KeyValue: "Like the silk? I'll send a set your way."

1151375697.m_KeyValue: ""Impress me, and I may consider allowing you aboard the El Dorado.""

1151376846.m_KeyValue: ""As the first to dare approach me, perhaps I should grant you a reward... How about some human blood?""

1151376877.m_KeyValue: ""Humans, gods, the Church... nothing more than pieces of flesh destined to rot away.""

1152582390.m_KeyValue: "A channeled spell with a long cast time. Interruption cancels any effects."

1152603089.m_KeyValue: "Who is this person that can take on my form?"

1152694562.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor 070 in Tower of Purification."

1153191790.m_KeyValue: "The Black Blood is highly contagious. This isn't your fault."

1155197680.m_KeyValue: ""I refuse to accept that Lorelei is gone forever. If we offer more blood to the Siren's Tear, perhaps...""

1155474035.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, such royal alliances are but common stratagems in the game of thrones. Surely, it was naught but coincidence!""

1155474037.m_KeyValue: ""'I don't believe in divine guidance, only in the wisdom of my own heart. Yet, perhaps it truly is fate's design that brings us together in this moment.'""

1155474038.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, our benevolent witch was quick to console the young girl whose childhood illusions had just been shattered.""

1155995172.m_KeyValue:
""A painting hangs in the corridor outside the Ancestral Vault, its subject a shattered spear. The canvas is stained with brownish marks, yet it has never been entrusted to skilled artisans for restoration.

When I asked Elder Dalcaro about its origins, she explained that it was created during the bloodiest battle in Bloodborn history, meant to honor Julius, who fell in that conflict. But when I pressed her for more details, she abruptly fell silent, as though bound by an unseen command.""

1155995331.m_KeyValue:
""Deep in the wardrobe hang twenty-nine identical cloaks.
Yet lately, one of them feels… different. Perhaps it's only my imagination.
No matter how I scour my memory, I cannot recall where this particular cloak came from. Maybe that only proves how utterly unremarkable it is. Or perhaps… it was never mine to begin with. Perhaps someone else placed it there.
No—that's impossible. Isn't it?""

1155995362.m_KeyValue:
""When speaking of Letitia's gentleness and kindness, one cannot ignore her initiative in reaching out to human society.

From Letitia's perspective, human civilization emerged in what seemed but an _$$instant._$$ Yet these spirited little beings brought change to the world, which, however small, was something that had never existed before.

Thus, Letitia began to mirror their form and behavior, quickly becoming entranced in doing so.

In her own words: _$$Only through humanity can the stories of the natural world be told._$$""

1159580994.m_KeyValue: ""Ooh, is it something fun to play with?""

1159580995.m_KeyValue: "That's so considerate of you. You have my gratitude."

1159581003.m_KeyValue: ""I'll accept it for now. This, too, is part of the rules""

1162692893.m_KeyValue: ""The Sun is its father, the moon its mother, the wind hath carried it in its belly, the earth is its nurse.""

1162692895.m_KeyValue: "That was the glorious path ahead for the Pontos."

1162692924.m_KeyValue: ""Today, the goddess of fortune smiles upon us once again.""

1162692925.m_KeyValue: "Black bag... Do we have a black bag among our supplies?"

1162692927.m_KeyValue: "Why are you giving this to me?"

1162693189.m_KeyValue: "Umm... We once found our stolen luggage through divination. It turned out the thief had hidden it in a windmill."

1162693191.m_KeyValue: "I'm sure nothing bad will happen. That stuff about 'past sins' and 'endless pain' just sound scary."

1162693222.m_KeyValue: "We're likely to run into those beasts along the way back to camp. If you're still carrying the log..."

1162693254.m_KeyValue: "Let's get out of here before more show up."

1162693290.m_KeyValue: "Sigh... That was just the doctor's empty words to comfort her..."

1162693316.m_KeyValue: "A landlubber's life may be peaceful... but we don't care..."

1162693322.m_KeyValue: "Who's going to believe you at this point?!"

1162693323.m_KeyValue: "If you can't do it... then get back."

1162693350.m_KeyValue: "Then let's set off towards the prophesied treasure."

1162693351.m_KeyValue: "Sailors always stick together in times of crisis."

1162693354.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I drew a card, what then? Am I even a real mystic? I can't see the connections between those images, I'm just...""

1162693355.m_KeyValue: ""Esmeralda said that the fate of the Pontos... the fate of everyone on board, was revealed in this incomplete Tarot spread.""

1162693384.m_KeyValue: ""Everything you see is your deepest fear, what you're afraid of but can't forget, what you hate but keep recalling. You can't break free, and finally, like sinking into a swamp, the more you struggle, the deeper you fall, until you plunge into the silent Abyss—""

1162693387.m_KeyValue: "Take the herbs to town... Let everyone eat them..."

1163083390.m_KeyValue: "Who left a hammer lying around? That's hardly up to safety code for the isle."

1163157810.m_KeyValue: ""Please, I need your help! If anyone discovers I clogged the fountain, they'll fine me a fortune!""

1163157811.m_KeyValue: "You saw the notice? Thank the heavens! I was starting to panic thinking I'd never manage this mess on my own!"

1163157812.m_KeyValue: ""I still can't tell what's going on inside there... which means I'll have to dismantle you, just to be safe.""

1164987744.m_KeyValue: "(I heard she's been spending day and night at the arena. Perhaps I should write to ask how she's doing.)"

1165097723.m_KeyValue: ""(Two candlesticks sat upon the desk—one old, one new.)""

1165203482.m_KeyValue: "So you're the new master the Bathory have chosen?"

1166945192.m_KeyValue: ""Before the devices activate, get the one who saved you off the Isle..""

1166945193.m_KeyValue: "It's not me... It must be you two."

1166945194.m_KeyValue: ""He doesn't seem particularly sociable, yet there's something captivating about him.""

1166945195.m_KeyValue: "You like the Adventures of Ginokio too?! Wait—I still can't let my guard down around you!"

1166945197.m_KeyValue: ""Damn, we couldn't get Miss Ami out before they arrived.""

1166945198.m_KeyValue: "I can welcome you to my home too."

1166945199.m_KeyValue: "What are you waiting for? Help me get Miss Ami out of here!"

1166945224.m_KeyValue: "Joyce? What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be at the auction house?"

1166945225.m_KeyValue: ""Joyce loves it when Lord Isaac praises Joyce like that! Please, give Joyce more praise!""

1166945226.m_KeyValue: "Help you? Why would he hand over those Siren's Tears?"

1166945227.m_KeyValue: "They haven't adapted to their new bodies yet... Joyce's precious puppets are suffering so much... (sobbing)"

1166945228.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Isaac, rest assured. I'm coming down for you now!""

1166945229.m_KeyValue: ""What I failed to achieve eleven years ago, I will finish today, no matter the cost.""

1166945230.m_KeyValue: ""In keeping with my promise to Lorelei and Miss Ami, I shall dismantle every last one.""

1166945257.m_KeyValue: ""I see, you must have seen that 'string' again!""

1166945258.m_KeyValue: ""No, Ami, the new Sage, holds one. So there should be eight in total.""

1166945259.m_KeyValue: ""Things are bad, what Joyce must do is—""

1166945260.m_KeyValue: ""You haven't been honest with me either, have you? Or was coming to this ship part of your vacation plans all along?""

1166945261.m_KeyValue: ""The harp, the sunlight on the waves, the dream of being the continent's greatest musician—none of it was my dream. What I ever wanted was to live it all with you.""

1166945263.m_KeyValue: ""All this time, they were helping humans...""

1166945282.m_KeyValue: "I came to talk about the money I owe…"

1166945283.m_KeyValue: "You must've had too much fun playing with Dalcarlo and caught one."

1166945288.m_KeyValue: "It's quite a long story... Miss Ami will tell you all about it."

1166945289.m_KeyValue: "Hesitation in the face of the Black Blood will only bring tragedy in the future."

1166945290.m_KeyValue: "Is this man out of his mind?"

1166945292.m_KeyValue: "That sharp-tongued girl? Adored by the residents? Has the sun here scrambled my senses?"

1166945294.m_KeyValue: "I might owe about ten times that much... Sir..."

1166945295.m_KeyValue: ""In any deal, trust is everything—you should know that. Working both sides comes with a price.""

1166945321.m_KeyValue: "'A win-win deal! Joyce really is a genius!'"

1166945324.m_KeyValue: ""An argument erupted at once, escalating from plea to fury to despair, until someone knocked over the reagent shelf. Glass vials shattered like wine glasses from Bella's celebration.""

1166945325.m_KeyValue: ""In the flickering candlelight, the unconscious siren no longer seemed monstrous. This was his final living specimen. Tomorrow, he would have Hallon fetch new materials.""

1166945326.m_KeyValue: ""She looked around. Her left leg was missing, but the bandages were clean and tight. In the water tank beside her floated siren corpses, their bodies mutilated beyond recognition.""

1166945327.m_KeyValue: "Constantine's research was incomplete. Unproven. But there was no time left."

1167666900.m_KeyValue: ""You were right, silver-haired! To think that well-off Miss Lorelei would turn out to be such a dangerous person...""

1167666902.m_KeyValue: "Let's meet at the inn after we search the auction house."

1167666903.m_KeyValue: "The Church soldiers uncovered many suspicious items in her office!"

1167670214.m_KeyValue: "We'll present this evidence to Mr. Van Helsing."

1167721543.m_KeyValue:

1177316287.m_KeyValue: ""Then, the quiet was shattered by Empousa's sudden cry of excitement.""

1177316288.m_KeyValue: ""Brushing the dust from its lid, Aiona opened the box with care and examined the pages within.""

1177316289.m_KeyValue: "'Our luck's been awful. How many nights has it been now?'"

1177316290.m_KeyValue: ""'Come on, don't dwell on it too much, Aiona.'""

1177316291.m_KeyValue: ""'The Church believes the earth lies at the center of the universe. For them, a belief like hers would be heresy… something they could never allow.'""

1177316293.m_KeyValue: ""'Which is likely why she hid her notes in so many places… She couldn't risk being discovered, but she also couldn't bring herself to abandon the study of the stars.'""

1177316294.m_KeyValue: ""'But the entire thing's mirrored. You can only tell if you hold it to the light and look from the back. Even so, the marked location is still right here…'""

1177317375.m_KeyValue: ""'Truly astounding… For an entire year, at the same time each day, they came here to record the moon's appearance.'""

1177317376.m_KeyValue: ""'There must be more pages. If we keep searching, we might find an explanation for why the moon looks like this.'""

1177317377.m_KeyValue: ""'All the observations were made here, so we figured there might be missing pages left behind.'""

1177317378.m_KeyValue: ""The approaching footsteps disrupted the silence, drawing the attention of the pensive youth. At last, he lifted his head from deep contemplation.""

1177317381.m_KeyValue: ""'And yet, it's beautiful all the same.'""

1177317382.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa suddenly cut in, 'What I want to know is—if he went to all this trouble, does that mean the moon really does look the way he recorded it?'""

1177331953.m_KeyValue: "Smarter than I gave you credit for."

1177490404.m_KeyValue: ""'The 1,863rd Grand Assembly for introspection and review regarding matters of glory, faith, power, and fidelity, and the centennial outlook for the Bathory family's Moon Ascension Initiative has come to a perfect conclusion!'""

1177528613.m_KeyValue: "You're not even going to say 'Prep Cook'?"

1177528639.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't overthink it!' Selena flitted about in excitement, her oversized octopus headpiece bobbing wildly with each step. In the pitch-black corridor, its movements appeared disturbingly lifelike.""

1177528645.m_KeyValue: ""Now then, let us return our focus to the present.""

1177529729.m_KeyValue: ""'That elder still lives to this day, wandering the halls of this very castle.'""

1177529730.m_KeyValue: "Cain smiled bitterly. 'It's for the best. There's no need for them to know the real horror story. The truth will only lead them deeper into the abyss.'"

1177529731.m_KeyValue: "The portrait erupted into another bout of devious laughter. 'But my previous words were quite serious!'"

1177529732.m_KeyValue: ""'Isn't that just like looking in a mirror?' Empousa blurted out, before regretting her words.""

1177529733.m_KeyValue: ""It is as though an unseen force is at work, systematically dismantling our meticulously constructed view of the world, leaving in its wake an atmosphere of dread.""

1177529734.m_KeyValue: "Empousa's indignant voice cut through the air: 'This is all your fault! I'm stuck here cleaning because of you!'"

1177561312.m_KeyValue: "'So all we need to do is capture children from the major families?' Gilrain's eyes widened in shock."

1177561315.m_KeyValue: ""'It's the 'Bull'... the Cidhall family!' Bella exclaimed eagerly, turning to Gilrain. 'As expected of Elder Gilrain's family!'""

1177561316.m_KeyValue: "'Why do we keep changing the location of the Elder meeting?' Gilrain grumbled before the meeting even began. 'What's wrong with the old location? Getting bored?'"

1177561317.m_KeyValue: ""'So, one could say that the Griffith and Roland families stand on equal footing.'""

1177561318.m_KeyValue: ""'Indeed,' Baphomet declared with a note of pride in his voice. 'After all, you stand unique among the current elders—the only one from another family, and the only true Bloodborn among us.'""

1177566623.m_KeyValue: "_$$That's Lady Quinn's magnum opus! You said that in front of her?!_$$"

1177566638.m_KeyValue: "Wait a minute—this is just Quinn's personal theater watchlist!"

1177633187.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, unable to let go of the story, yelled out, 'What happened to that girl? Was she devoured by you or given the Embrace?'""

1177633188.m_KeyValue: ""It was a tenacious young girl who had managed to survive by any means necessary. Some of the Ancestors even suspected she wasn't actually an important figure at all, but an impostor.'""

1177633190.m_KeyValue: ""As Selena and Van Helsing secretly entered the Bathory family's Ancestral Vault, they could never have imagined what awaited them.""

1177634143.m_KeyValue: ""The candlelight danced over their faces, casting them in shifting shadows. In that trembling glow, tension, fear, helplessness—and something harder to name—played across their expressions.""

1177634144.m_KeyValue: ""'So he sealed himself inside a dark chamber… and froze the entire room with a rare alchemical process.' At this point, Empousa shivered—whether from fear or memory, even she couldn't tell.""

1177634145.m_KeyValue: ""'Both your…? What are you talking about? My left hand's on you, and my right is holding onto Lorelei...' She froze mid-sentence.""

1177634146.m_KeyValue: ""As Bella's words faded, everyone—excluding Ami, of course—fell into silence. They needed a clear-headed, decisive leader to guide them out of the darkness.""

1177634147.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, Miss Lorelei?' Bella leaned in and took the log from Empousa's hand. 'Now that's someone worth paying attention to. I'd suggest you give her a proper welcome, Lady Empousa.'""

1177634148.m_KeyValue: ""A few days later, at the gates of Bathory Castle...""

1177634149.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't tell me Cain's finally grown a conscience and decided to cook the young ladies of Bathory some seafood?' Driven by instinct, Ami spun on her heel and followed the trail of the ocean's fragrance.""

1177634150.m_KeyValue: "'Ah! What happened to the lights?! Don't tell me… it's… it's—!"

1177634155.m_KeyValue: ""Taking the flint from Bella, Lorelei struck a spark and set fire to the exquisite sashimi. 'Three, two, one… voilà.'""

1177634156.m_KeyValue: ""Bella turned her head at Lorelei's words, half her face swallowed by shadow—her expression unreadable. '...That day, in the end, you vanished beneath the sea.'""

1194955854.m_KeyValue: "All that talk about weapons to defeat everyone—it was just your ploy to lure me into escaping."

1194955855.m_KeyValue: "I laughed at her foolishness—how could wind be any different?"

1195336380.m_KeyValue: ""Faced with the unexpected, your choices now will impact the following battles.""

1198148319.m_KeyValue: "Privacy Data Encryption Failed. Please check your network connection and restart the game."

1198501384.m_KeyValue: "What is difficult to achieve with human hands... can sometimes be accomplished by other means."

1198501385.m_KeyValue: "That's not true! I would never harm my family!"

1198501386.m_KeyValue: ""It was merely a logical deduction. But since you've confirmed it, Captain Goldland, I know my hypothesis is correct.""

1198501387.m_KeyValue: "It's clear if you look at the ship's cross-section."

1198501388.m_KeyValue: ""True... If we hadn't rushed over, he would've had time to retrieve the rope without anyone noticing.""

1198501391.m_KeyValue: "He must have been trying to protect his brother."

1198501393.m_KeyValue: "...Ah! But Aaron wouldn't have willingly put his own head into it!"

1198501416.m_KeyValue: "Don't let what's past slow us down. We're one step away from the truth..."

1198501417.m_KeyValue: "One last question. Before questioning those two ladies on deck—you left your post for a short time."

1198501418.m_KeyValue: ""According to our planned course, we were supposed to hit the storm belt tonight.""

1198501419.m_KeyValue: ""One possibility... Someone was already infected before boarding, perhaps at that port where the Plague had broken out.""

1198501672.m_KeyValue: ""For a vintage from the Carrelle Estate, 500,000 Soli is hardly unreasonable.""

1198501673.m_KeyValue: "You've got to be kidding me. What sort of people are sneaking aboard today?!"

1198501680.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, what is this? That gilded peacock went completely overboard with the decorations.""

1198501681.m_KeyValue: ""Still, no sunlight means we're free to enjoy the breeze on deck without passing out in the oven below. Right, dumb wolf...?""

1198501682.m_KeyValue: "But I see 'choice' differently. I don't believe in 'the decree of the past.'"

1198501683.m_KeyValue: "Even I... If only I had said a proper farewell. Come to think of it..."

1198501684.m_KeyValue: "You're the girl who guided us before we boarded. So... your name is Ami."

1198501685.m_KeyValue: "Forgive me. But I'd rather keep the 'Wheel of Fortune' in my own hands."

1198501686.m_KeyValue: "I never offered to guide you. Please don't shift the conversation just to avoid an awkward silence."

1198501687.m_KeyValue: ""No, No... I-I meant the tear-like markings on her face.""

1198501712.m_KeyValue: "Oh no—First Mate Bob gets upset very easily..."

1198501713.m_KeyValue: ""As for the Bathory family, though they were purged for 'heresy' over a decade ago, records suggest they possessed forbidden arts of 'resurrection.'""

1198501714.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Why are you taking his side?! Look at those lifeless eyes—he's definitely not someone we can trust!"

1198501719.m_KeyValue: "They're just out cold… What's with the tears and theatrics?"

1198501744.m_KeyValue: ""Are you kidding? Without Bob here, we don't stand a chance against them!""

1198501745.m_KeyValue: "I've never met anyone who could deflect my bullets with just a sword."

1198501747.m_KeyValue: "This isn't my manifest... it looks more like an invitation."

1198501748.m_KeyValue: "Bob? Van Helsing? When did you get here? We couldn't find either of you earlier!"

1198501750.m_KeyValue: "Y-You mean those legendary monsters that suck blood from your neck until you're nothing but a husk?!"

1198501751.m_KeyValue: ""They're the Church's most elite heretic hunters. Usually tasked with investigations, assassinations, and other... high-risk operations.""

1198501772.m_KeyValue: "This weather… these tremors... Feels just like the day before the tsunami... Damn it..."

1198501773.m_KeyValue: "Ami... She's the girl we met on deck—the one with the tear markings."

1198501776.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, escort the seasick lady and Mr. Jones to the rest area. William, lower the sails and take the helm. As for the remaining guests—I'll attend to them myself.""

1198501777.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. William is the Captain's younger brother. And yet, he chose me—a complete outsider—as his First Mate. I am... deeply grateful!""

1198501778.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier, you spoke of Sunset Isle with such gravity. It's likely your destination as well. Until then...""

1198501781.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Goldland was just an obscure merchant a few years ago. His rise to maritime adventurer? That was thanks to the Church's support."

1198501782.m_KeyValue: ""Ohhh! There they go again! Little William, can you feel it? That sweet tension in the air!""

1198501783.m_KeyValue: ""Hang in there! They're just some grunts under that lifeless eyes. Take them out quick, and you can go back to resting!""

1198501804.m_KeyValue: ""It means he neither returned to the deck, nor stayed in the kitchen. He could only have gone down to the storage rooms. Or straight into this cabin where the murder occurred.""

1198501805.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly, the door between the kitchen and storage room is normally locked! Only the Captain and the assigned kitchen manager have the keys!""

1198501809.m_KeyValue: "It seems the Captain isn't quite as polished and gentle as he looks."

1198501810.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. And not long after that, we had that dispute over being accused as stowaways.""

1198501811.m_KeyValue: "Then he never returned to the deck. Captain Goldland—do you have a map of this area?"

1198501812.m_KeyValue: "Outrageous! Who would pull such a malicious prank?!"

1198501813.m_KeyValue: ""Well, judging by the result, you certainly brute-forced the knot open.""

1198501814.m_KeyValue: "You posted me at the upper wheelhouse! It takes time to get down here! The sailors who came with me can vouch for that."

1198501815.m_KeyValue: "Did that heavy object fall on one of the guests!?"

1198501840.m_KeyValue: "Aaron? He never really talked to anyone. He just snuck around the ship doing his own thing."

1198501841.m_KeyValue: "Bob said people make excuses when they're too shy to admit they like someone."

1198501842.m_KeyValue: ""Strange. Those suspected carriers didn't follow us, but there's a trace of Black Blood here too...""

1198501843.m_KeyValue: ""Given your habits, that hardly counts as strange. I meant the violent shaking—caused by that.""

1198501846.m_KeyValue: ""Then why don't I tie you up, then?""

1198501847.m_KeyValue: "No one's dead. I was conducting an experiment. Trying to verify a theory of mine."

1198501872.m_KeyValue: "Your blood? What does it taste like?"

1198501877.m_KeyValue: "Ami... come out... I know... you're in the kitchen..."

1198501878.m_KeyValue: "A-Ami? Didn't you just visit the kitchen not long ago?"

1198501879.m_KeyValue: ""If you're not worried about it, it can't be important.""

1199071759.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A veil worn by Ressa resembling that of a typical clergywoman, yet it holds a deeper meaning for her.
She ceaselessly smooths, folds, and tucks the edges into her white cap until the Bell of Tempus tolls.""

1199071761.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Ressa's cherished promise ring, seemingly worn for ages.
The tiny silver ring worn on the middle finger silently declares love, yet by dawn, it becomes a shackle.""

1199071762.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> The shawl worn by Ressa Ambolia. It accompanied her over the long days and nights of separation, as she awaited someone's return.
Moonlight, gentle yet somewhat duplicitous, bathes her as she leans against the window, shedding tears, just as scripted.""

1199071764.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Ressa's cherished memories, strung together by countless moments of happiness.
In the end, the happiness they defended so vigorously was merely a ruse of fate, designed to trap them in the present.""

1199071792.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A crown that embodies Joan's resolve.
War is the lifeblood of civilization. Flowing through the corridors of history, it is unstoppable, nay inevitable.""

1199071793.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> A blood-stained suit of armor worn by Joan.
Leaning against the wall, the homeland lay behind her in ruins; gazing into the distance, the future lay before her in doubt.""

1199071794.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Joan's signet ring, shaped like twin-peaks and engraved with the words _$$May Astolfo remain prosperous._$$
She leads all the lost souls unable to return home to the Motherland of nigh. _$$Through utter despair, hope springs anew._$$""

1199071795.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Joan's immortal past.
_$$Though yesterday has vanished and tomorrow is already known, how ought one navigate today?_$$""

1199072152.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The rusty amulet of Baphomet, the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
_$$Ashes beget ashes, and dust begets dust. Alas, life is but an anomaly, and all living memory perishes._$$""

1199072155.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The dark iron helmet of Baphomet the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
Blood represents the gravity of memory, while souls are as free as the blue sky. It's not that they are grander, just less attached.""

1199072157.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> The dark iron ring of Baphomet the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
_$$Once again, I find myself at your mercy. Perhaps this time, I should try finding credence in that distant prophecy?_$$""

1199072158.m_KeyValue:

_$$I gave up my body in pursuit of immortality, only to realize that the soul also ages._$$""

1199072188.m_KeyValue:

1201618989.m_KeyValue: "Two of them arrived at the same time."

1201618991.m_KeyValue: "But that's not our concern right now. Someone's approaching."

1201620013.m_KeyValue: ""Pudding, you taste amazing... Let's stay together forever...""

1201620014.m_KeyValue: "It was Dalcarlo. That woman jumped us out of nowhere!"

1201620015.m_KeyValue: ""Weren't you the one who taught the young lady, Aiona?""

1201855990.m_KeyValue: "They discovered us so quickly… Fanny must have informants shadowing our every move."

1201855992.m_KeyValue: "Hold them off first—we'll find the stairs after!"

1202191424.m_KeyValue: ""These resurgent demons hail from the Other Side, temporarily manifesting in the mortal realm during periods of invasion. Like a spectre, they haunt the land of Minexus.""

1203017817.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, what's wrong with her? She was just all fired up, and now...""

1203017949.m_KeyValue: ""For this battle, I will temporarily grant you energy to demonstrate the power of Blood Moon.""

1205393696.m_KeyValue: ""Since you won't return, you shall help me solve Cain's puzzle instead.""

1205434409.m_KeyValue: "W-What are you suddenly saying such strange things for?!"

1205434410.m_KeyValue: "I'd rather completely forget everything that happened at the orphanage."

1205434412.m_KeyValue: "This vile Bloodborn needs no trial. I shall execute them on the spot."

1205434413.m_KeyValue: "Since when did you become so skilled?!"

1205434414.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, I have a fugitive to catch. I don't have time for this.""

1205503675.m_KeyValue: ""(The envelope bore a dignified, timeworn elegance—its design once common in ages past.)""

1206735566.m_KeyValue: "I Want to Become the Drama Queen!"

1207708618.m_KeyValue: "The wooden one who wanted to regain emotions had three companions."

1207708619.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you brought me here."

1207708622.m_KeyValue: "It's where she killed my father and then adopted me."

1207708623.m_KeyValue: "Here's the paint you asked for—along with the book you left with me."

1208145012.m_KeyValue: "But... they're too strong. We don't stand a chance."

1208145017.m_KeyValue: ""Every record I could consult agrees—no Scourge, no Gravekeeper in this area.""

1208145018.m_KeyValue: "You've traveled so far; you must be weary. Why not let us—"

1208145019.m_KeyValue: ""As promised, Seraphina and Noah are placed in a dry, clean cell.""

1208145020.m_KeyValue: ""Since the everlasting darkness began, Scourges across the world grow restless.""

1208145021.m_KeyValue: "Seraphina dismantles the cell's lock and slides the bolt free."

1208145022.m_KeyValue: "The clash of steel draws a band of armored soldiers."

1208145023.m_KeyValue: ""Had you not abandoned me out there, I'd be warming myself by the fire with a bowl of soup by now!""

1208145024.m_KeyValue: ""Regardless, she will remain in my cell.""

1210486227.m_KeyValue: ""She never foresaw her dream for Sunset Isle unraveling, nor the day when Death would at last escape its cage.""

1211704766.m_KeyValue: "Victory's fruits possess a flavor all their own."

1211704797.m_KeyValue: "Speak not; simply feel the tranquility of this moment..."

1211707965.m_KeyValue:
""Self: Did we overdo it? 
Puppet: Oh my, it seems they're out completely!""

1211713493.m_KeyValue: "Who am I? The place where I belong... is it by your side?"

1211715636.m_KeyValue: "Defeating opponents of this caliber is hardly worth bragging about."

1211715667.m_KeyValue: "Do you have that much free time?"

1211717841.m_KeyValue: ""If you have some free time, come train with me.""

1211718676.m_KeyValue: ""Defending isn't just about self-perservation, it's also about creating opportunities to strike back... Don't you agree?""

1211719984.m_KeyValue: "What joy is there to be found in such things?"

1211720850.m_KeyValue: "Is there anything I can help you with?"

1211721009.m_KeyValue: ""Tis the right time, according to fate.""

1211723024.m_KeyValue: "Please step aside. The broom can't navigate corners on its own."

1211723183.m_KeyValue: "Tidying up rooms is still more of a challenge."

1212639126.m_KeyValue: ""The Church, honoring his valor, bestowed the divine mandate to rule Astolfo. Such is the tale of our rise. But why speak of it now?""

1213541082.m_KeyValue: ""In the Holy War of ages past, they gave all they had for their bloodline... only to be lost to the river of time.""

1213541179.m_KeyValue: ""Same rules as before, right? If a siren shows up, just whack it!""

1213999360.m_KeyValue: "Impossible! Lord Hallon explicitly ordered us to erase all traces at the auction house!"

1213999361.m_KeyValue: "You don't seem like someone with a trace of hostility or killing intent… So you couldn't possibly be the one who took Miss Ami from the silver-haired."

1213999362.m_KeyValue: ""Let us do what we believe is right, Lorelei.""

1213999363.m_KeyValue: "It's unsettling... You make it sound like we're surrounded by undying puppets..."

1213999364.m_KeyValue: "Fine! The priority now is to follow my lead and rescue Miss Ami—"

1213999365.m_KeyValue: ""And then, you'll be the most famous singer on the continent—and I'll be a renowned clavichord player.""

1213999366.m_KeyValue: ""Follow the wind's breath, as shadows trace the mark.""

1213999391.m_KeyValue: ""After dawn, when the Master tells me my daughter's whereabouts, I won't need them anymore.""

1213999393.m_KeyValue: ""Those behind you, I suppose they're your puppets?""

1213999394.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no, from now on Lord Isaac will call Joyce—Master!""

1213999395.m_KeyValue: "You expect me to trust you for mere words?"

1213999396.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, is this the person you need to defeat to fulfill your promise to Lorelei?""

1213999397.m_KeyValue: "Everyone in Sapphire Isle shall become Joyce's puppets!"

1213999398.m_KeyValue: "Go to the Isle! Get some fri—"

1213999418.m_KeyValue: "Now we have all of the Siren's Tears."

1213999423.m_KeyValue: ""Bella No. 13, you are useless! You can't be down already—Rise again!""

1213999424.m_KeyValue: "This one is undying... Could this be the perfect life form that the Master has been seeking?"

1213999426.m_KeyValue: ""Clap! Clap! The resounding applause of the puppet army, celebrating their glorious victory!""

1213999428.m_KeyValue: ""I remember being killed by a Blood Beast, and you saved me, didn't you?""

1213999429.m_KeyValue: "Look... these glows are lifting... just like Tidewisps unfurling..."

1213999430.m_KeyValue: ""No, Bella chose her own fate. She was never merely a hollow puppet, tethered by strings.""

1213999455.m_KeyValue: ""I drew him like this in my diary and wrote, 'Captain is evil.' He changed 'evil' to 'family.' Ugh, that man is so difficult...""

1213999456.m_KeyValue: "That daze has faded away at last."

1213999457.m_KeyValue: "Those who come here are overwhelmed by uncontrollable joy in their hallucinations."

1213999458.m_KeyValue: ""She paid ahead of time, so of course, I provided the service.""

1213999459.m_KeyValue: "But Ami has become a Sage now... am I even worthy of her anymore?"

1213999460.m_KeyValue: ""What?! And I was already picturing us in swimsuits, basking in sunlight and swimming by the shore.""

1213999461.m_KeyValue: ""Also, he told me about your [BEEP] has [BEEP][BEEP]. Is that true?""

1213999484.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei nodded. Bella once said that to humans, a trade was as sacred as a siren's oath.""

1213999487.m_KeyValue: "That's what Clovis told Isaac. The moon hung cold and pale overhead. Would morning ever come?"

1213999488.m_KeyValue: "'Joyce has received payment. And Joyce always upholds a deal!'"

1213999489.m_KeyValue: "If only he had the strength… the courage… he might've stopped it all."

1213999490.m_KeyValue: ""'One last request... If you find my nephew, Isaac... If there's any hope left for him...'""

1213999491.m_KeyValue: "'Quick! Help Bella! She collapsed during her birthday banquet!'"

1213999492.m_KeyValue: ""As the finest merchant, the price I demand will always far exceed the value of these goods.""

1213999493.m_KeyValue: "'What are those reagents in your lab? Why has the Isle turned into this? What are we supposed to do?!'"

1215380913.m_KeyValue: ""Yggdrasill... Among the Bell Ringers, he's as old as the Saint—perhaps older than the Church itself.""

1215380915.m_KeyValue: ""So what, we're just going to run away every time we see a Bell Ringer?""

1215380916.m_KeyValue: "Y-you're kidding! They regenerate faster than normal Blood Beasts?!"

1215384115.m_KeyValue: "I have a bad feeling about this..."

1215384116.m_KeyValue: ""We could barely handle one just now, and now there are so many of them...""

1217240397.m_KeyValue: "Why are you here of all places..."

1217240399.m_KeyValue: "Are these the children in the painting? Fighting like that… it's not right."

1217240400.m_KeyValue: ""I've heard a tale like this before, hidden within the Saint's scripture.""

1217241420.m_KeyValue: "Because... I know what he would do—if he were the one standing here."

1217241421.m_KeyValue: ""Don't you have someone you trust... Mass, maybe?""

1217241422.m_KeyValue: ""Impressive... You wield not just Death, but Plague and Famine as well...""

1217241423.m_KeyValue: "Looks like Lamia knows more than you do."

1218095176.m_KeyValue: ""If I join, I won't have to help with your tasks as well, will I?""

1218263012.m_KeyValue: "What? The whole world? From those pathetic metal scraps?"

1218263014.m_KeyValue: "You were their target all this time?"

1218263016.m_KeyValue: "So the danger… is from these spiders?"

1218263017.m_KeyValue: ""No, no. I meant… she is in danger.""

1218263025.m_KeyValue: ""They're tough for sure. But even if a thousand more show up, I'll knock them out!""

1218263026.m_KeyValue: ""They just keep coming. No matter how many we destroy, more take their place—""

1218265187.m_KeyValue: "Let me introduce myself. I am Noah Nevernight."

1218265195.m_KeyValue: "This is the first time I've ever felt this way."

1218265196.m_KeyValue: "Don't overthink it. It's the resonance between us... _$$Noahs._$$"

1218265200.m_KeyValue: ""We'll talk after. Once they're dealt with, I want to know why you came here.""

1218265201.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't just a feeling then. You and I—"

1218265202.m_KeyValue: ""Different weapons, but our movements, the way we think… So this is what it means to share the name 'Noah.'""

1218266213.m_KeyValue: ""Before you say anything to me, let's deal with them first...""

1218266215.m_KeyValue: "How do you know this granny’s granddaughter? Seriously—how many odd people do you know?"

1218266218.m_KeyValue: ""The last I remember, she was struck down by Death and then…""

1218266225.m_KeyValue: ""So who are you, and who is she?""

1218266226.m_KeyValue: ""You're someone's grandmother, and the one you're looking for is behind Noah.""

1218267365.m_KeyValue: "And what are you supposed to be? Let go—I need to stop them."

1218267366.m_KeyValue: "Can we talk now? Those constructs weren't ordinary—"

1218267372.m_KeyValue: "An explosion—there's been an explosion! Over by the plaza!"

1218267373.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me… But if I heard correctly, just now… You were speaking to me?""

1218267375.m_KeyValue: ""You know what they are, don't you?""

1218267377.m_KeyValue: "Those constructs we saw at the vendor stalls... Are these the same ones? Did they cause the blast?"

1218267378.m_KeyValue: "...So the time flow truly differs between our sides. They've already evolved this far?"

1218268395.m_KeyValue: "I'm so sorry! I saw her holding the bottle and assumed you were the attackers..."

1218268396.m_KeyValue: "They might be the ones behind the explosion—seize them!"

1218268397.m_KeyValue: "...There's someone more reckless than that dumb wolf."

1218268398.m_KeyValue: "You were caught in the blast too? And you're actually investigating the cause?"

1218268399.m_KeyValue: ""That voice, that face... you're Vice-Commander Piera of Bell Ringer Albrecht, aren't you?""

1218268401.m_KeyValue: ""Piera is my granddaughter! We may look alike, but we're generations apart, I assure you.""

1218269544.m_KeyValue: ""You misunderstand me. I seek hope. Not to bring ruin to another world, as we once did our own.""

1218269547.m_KeyValue: "You shall serve as envoy of this crumbling world. Sent to explore the higher-dimensional realm that watches us from beyond."

1218269548.m_KeyValue: "The future of our search for sanctuary now rests with you… Our 'star.'"

1218269550.m_KeyValue: ""Take my constructs with you. When the moment of truth arrives, they will be… useful.""

1218269553.m_KeyValue: "These creatures… slathered in some viscous compound. Is this your grand culmination? Utterly grotesque."

1218269554.m_KeyValue: "Aside from your failure to appreciate the sublime beauty of my designs… You are acceptable."

1218270565.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! Look at me—I'm clearly a merchant!"

1218270571.m_KeyValue: "This is the Garden of Asta. One of the grandest cities on the Northern Continent."

1218270572.m_KeyValue: "What are you mumbling about? Didn't we agree to come here together?"

1218270575.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? Me? Are you speaking to me?"

1218270576.m_KeyValue: "Hold on a second—did I just hear someone mention alchemy?"

1218270577.m_KeyValue: "Asta is also one of the few places where alchemy is freely studied. In fact… it is the birthplace of modern alchemy itself."

1218270578.m_KeyValue: "We arrived just in time for the Harvest Festival. Lady Empousa wouldn't dream of missing such a celebration—not now when the sun no longer burns her."

1218271721.m_KeyValue: ""So lively, with cries for help and every— Wait, someone's actually in trouble!?!""

1218271723.m_KeyValue: "Is this the realm of the dead? It's far livelier than I ever imagined."

1218271725.m_KeyValue: "I remember saying farewell to Noah and the others... at the blessed grounds on Sunset Isle just moments ago..."

1218271726.m_KeyValue: "I should've faded completely into longing by now..."

1218271729.m_KeyValue: ""If I can forge an Other Side that contains another 'me'... And if that version, in all certainty, will repeat this process anew…""

1218271730.m_KeyValue: "Then what of the world I now inhabit? Could it be that it was not shaped by divine hands at all? But by yet another version of myself? So this is the pattern…"

1218272743.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we ought to ask these curious spiders who arrived with you."

1218272747.m_KeyValue: "That is precisely what I intend to find out."

1218272748.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me you used one of your bizarre methods to bring me back."

1218272750.m_KeyValue: ""In my memory, you did die. And yet, I was not the one who returned you to this world.""

1218272752.m_KeyValue: "He wants you two to leave. We need to speak… alone."

1218272753.m_KeyValue: ""Well, we're alone now. What did you want to say, you alchemy-addled fool?""

1219274735.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The stylish cap worn by Isaac Van Helsing. On the pursuit of justice, it shielded him from the elements.
Though the damp winds may tousle his hair, they are incapable of extinguishing the youthful sparkle in his eyes.""

1219274737.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Van Helsing's wrist guard, stained with blood.

1219274738.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> The pauldrons worn by Van Helsing. Its bold design accentuates the wearer's personality.

Renouncing himself to embrace death, his sole hope is to leave a trace of himself somewhere in the future.""

1219274770.m_KeyValue:
