1219285717.m_KeyValue: ""(What is this… dozens of vials of blood, each a different shade, each marked with a name and date. She is no Bloodborn—so why hoard human blood? Unless…)""

1219285718.m_KeyValue: ""Each pawn believed their choices were their own, yet their fate had been written the moment the first piece fell.""

1219285720.m_KeyValue: "Then let me ask you—do you truly enjoy being Warden so much? Everyone here dreams of escape. Do you not?"

1219655918.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Defeat as many Pale Bloodwolves as possible.</style>
When a Pale Bloodwolf appears, it summons multiple Red Wolves. <style=""Highlight"">Defeating the Pale Bloodwolf also takes out all Red Wolves</style>.
<style=""Highlight"">Use the Illustrious Moon Seal in with _$$Synergy: Windchaser_$$ Vassals to significantly boost team abilities.</style>
Top Picks: Letitia, Seraphina, Van Helsing, Ressa""

1220014673.m_KeyValue: "I have no interest in the weak. Do with them as you please."

1220014674.m_KeyValue: ""I can only say, I'm sorry, truly...""

1220258663.m_KeyValue: "You can see fire and unfulfilled desires there. Try recalling it again."

1221012635.m_KeyValue: "What... What does that vile creature plan to do?!"

1221012636.m_KeyValue: "This Blood Beast seems to be the culmination of a flesh fusion in this valley. How many lives has this giant consumed?"

1221012637.m_KeyValue: "It's been drawn to the strong scent of your Black Blood; its insatiable 'appetite' has been whetted."

1221012638.m_KeyValue: ""Be mindful not to expose your wounds, and never let it touch your blood!""

1221012639.m_KeyValue: "This thing's too tough. We can't keep this up..."

1221183117.m_KeyValue: ""Then you'll be mighty, mighty, mightier than any human soul!""

1221183118.m_KeyValue: ""Ah—but that sounds terribly blasphemous, doesn't it? Oh well!""

1221183119.m_KeyValue: ""Ahem. Very well, very well. To business, then.""

1221183122.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina jerks backward, shoving Noah's chest to force him away.""

1221555181.m_KeyValue:
""Attention Lord,
The Season has ended. Congratulations on achieving Rank {ReplaceArenaScoreRank} on the Crucible Point Rank! Here are your Season Settlement Rewards, please claim them.""

1221727797.m_KeyValue: "That is not your concern. The current Warden will find her proper place."

1221727798.m_KeyValue: ""Heh... you were right, Fanny. Escape is never impossible—but such chances must be seized with one’s own hands, no matter the cost.""

1221727799.m_KeyValue: ""Precisely. Wear it, approach the silver-armored soldiers, tell them your intent. Recite the holy scriptures to them. Do you understand?""

1221727800.m_KeyValue: "But if I become Warden... what happens to the one who serves now? Where will she go?"

1221978537.m_KeyValue: "I can't just sit here and wait for death... I need to find a way out. If only I had something sharp..."

1221978539.m_KeyValue: ""What sets humans apart from animals is our use of 'tools,' but even animals know how to work together...""

1221978541.m_KeyValue: ""If the sirens take us away, we won't have to endure any more pain.""

1221978568.m_KeyValue: "Would you like us to safeguard your 'token of proof' for the selection?"

1221978569.m_KeyValue: ""It can only be father, it will only ever be father.""

1221978570.m_KeyValue: "You should have let him take over your business sooner."

1221978571.m_KeyValue: "Master’s judgment was right about you. You really are a good person."

1221978573.m_KeyValue: "What if I treat the audience to a special Joyce dance performance?"

1221978833.m_KeyValue: "Was it the lamb doll prize that kept Miss Aiona from leaving? I can still drink..."

1221978835.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, well, when it comes to money, he might be just as broke as I am… but if my master were here, he'd surely find a way.""

1221978836.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Savich, while your shirt is indeed one of a kind, the auction house recently acquired a batch of gold-threaded brocade. Perhaps you'd consider having a new one tailored from it?""

1221978838.m_KeyValue: "...He never told me about this! I must verify this with Master Van Helsing myself..."

1221978858.m_KeyValue: "You won't get away this time! Stop them!"

1221978864.m_KeyValue: ""Seven nobles decided to rebuild it, investing their wealth and effort to restore the isle to its former glory, making it what it is today. The isle's residents came to call them the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages.""

1221978865.m_KeyValue: ""The sun is quite intense here at the isle. Before heading into the water, be sure to apply the isle's exclusive sunscreen.""

1221978866.m_KeyValue: "Lady Ami's prepared 'attire' is truly a masterpiece."

1221978867.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... why the hesitation? I'm quite skilled at seeing beyond appearances—"

1221978868.m_KeyValue: ""This statue was salvaged by fishermen from the bay not long ago. Though it appears expensive, it's merely gold-plated. The appraiser named it 'Those Whom the Gods Would Destroy.'""

1221978869.m_KeyValue: ""Finally sobered up? Congratulations, we've reached the Return to the Moon final challenge—facing the siren.""

1221978871.m_KeyValue: "Well... um... this is a device developed for the Seven Sages Association's city promotion efforts... would you like to give it a try?"

1221978899.m_KeyValue: ""What could be so important at this hour... Let me just stabilize my vital signs first, then I'll go.""

1221978925.m_KeyValue: "<color=#c6ae80>Soli... Soli and even more Soli... being rich is such a bore.</color>"

1221978928.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed... this Mistbound Terror appears at night as well, hunting travelers on the island. It drains their blood and dismembers them. Several lone visitors have already disappeared mysteriously.""

1221978929.m_KeyValue: "This is getting more and more interesting."

1221978930.m_KeyValue: "But it's not entirely out of the question."

1221978932.m_KeyValue: ""The crispy Stargazer's Delight mingles with the ocean's freshness, while aged cheese stretches into beautiful, viscous arcs. The fish head soup with flatbread and canned shark are equally delightful, making it impossible to choose. I'll have another serving of both—""

1221978933.m_KeyValue: ""Silver-haired man? Ah, you must mean... the one with Miss Ami—Uhh... Oh, Mr. Nevernight!""

1221978934.m_KeyValue: "See? Now give us back our boss!"

1221978935.m_KeyValue: "All because he was trying to help me..."

1221978961.m_KeyValue: ""The victims remember the happiest moments of their lives before they drown, and with a blissful smile, they become stuck forever in the past...""

1221978965.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, hard to believe how prosperous it's become, isn't it?""

1221978966.m_KeyValue: "That place... who's in charge of it now?"

1221978967.m_KeyValue: "But everyone who knew I was the lord's son should be dead by now..."

1221978991.m_KeyValue: "Sapphire Isle is quite dangerous at night. What brings you wandering to the auction house?"

1221978992.m_KeyValue: ""This is bad, really bad! I just defeated many monsters—they might be people infected with Black Blood! We need to report this—""

1221978993.m_KeyValue: "The 'Mistbound Terror' only targets people who threaten the Seven Sages... Could they be working for them?"

1221978994.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps all 'swords' just look similar by nature."

1221978995.m_KeyValue: "All the important stuff has been burned... only some useless scraps of paper left."

1221978997.m_KeyValue: "Many of the Sapphire Isle Auction House’s goods are shipped by sea—and those pirates are notorious for raiding their vessels."

1221978999.m_KeyValue: "So that fanatic has really got you completely brainwashed..."

1221979024.m_KeyValue: ""We have money, land, and slaves. We could achieve great things together.""

1221979025.m_KeyValue: ""Greed knows no bounds, especially for the wealthy.""

1221979026.m_KeyValue: ""I've only heard about them, oh, a dozen times or so a day since I got here.""

1221979028.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, do we share such an instant connection?""

1221979030.m_KeyValue: "I can call them for you. Who are you looking for?"

1223223914.m_KeyValue: ""Werewolves within 3 meters will focus their attacks on the target for 15 sec. If the target dies while afflicted with Beast Plague, they will turn into a Werewolf.""

1224627080.m_KeyValue: ""'It must be because of the Misty Lodge,' Hati declared with absolute certainty. 'After building the lodge, they dug holes and filled them with hot spring water to attract customers!'""

1224627081.m_KeyValue: ""'Wouldn’t it be the other way around? They’d build the lodge after finding the hot springs, right?'""

1224627082.m_KeyValue: ""'You just don’t understand, Noah,' Hati said, shaking her head knowingly. 'In Mouret, I saw it with my own eyes—people cutting down trees into stumps just to wait for rabbits to run into them!'""

1225004810.m_KeyValue: "The day she was left at the monastery gate."

1225004876.m_KeyValue: "The day the sun met the horizon."

1225005008.m_KeyValue: ""The Kalends of November, the day of martyrs.""

1225005039.m_KeyValue: ""The Nones of January, when the sky smoldered with flame.""

1225030500.m_KeyValue: "Does the Church just recruit anything with two legs?"

1226318453.m_KeyValue: "Are you asking me? I don't know."

1226318454.m_KeyValue: "But why? Why would she take Death back instead of destroying him?"

1226318461.m_KeyValue: "That was not a request. It was an order."

1226318462.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... My Lady. But I haven't finished what I'm here for..."

1226318463.m_KeyValue: "I knew where you were long before you thought to flee."

1226318464.m_KeyValue: "If you hoped to delay me by hiding on Sunset Isle... You've misjudged."

1226318465.m_KeyValue: "So... you did hold me in such high regard after all?"

1226318467.m_KeyValue: "She can hear you when you call her that."

1226318468.m_KeyValue: ""That old woman... how dare she! Our Commander sacrificed herself, and she doesn't even care!""

1226319486.m_KeyValue: "I can't catch my breath all of a sudden... It's so... uncomfortable..."

1226319487.m_KeyValue: ""It's not just affecting Hati... I'm feeling it too, albeit to a lesser degree.""

1226319488.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... because of that black mist? Why does it feel so familiar..."

1226320631.m_KeyValue: ""Thibault. The most inscrutable of all Bell Ringers. Though a healer, she can make kings kneel with but a glance.""

1226320632.m_KeyValue: ""(sighing)... Withdraw your power. If the test subject is damaged, you will bear the consequences.""

1226320637.m_KeyValue: "I overheard a guard once say: He succeeded in refining a potion from a rare fungus... One that could suppress the Black Blood's effects."

1226320638.m_KeyValue: ""Each day, Albrecht drew material from us. To fuel his Black Blood research.""

1226320640.m_KeyValue: ""As my third student, you've mastered theory. Let us see how you perform in practice.""

1226320643.m_KeyValue: "I believe I made myself clear that no one is to enter without my permission."

1226321167.m_KeyValue: ""Her blade whistles past me, its edge grazing my ear as it shears away a lock of hair.""

1226321169.m_KeyValue: ""She straightens, her stance dissolving, the will to strike vanishing as quickly as it came.""

1226321262.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, I hope you're prepared to fight with everything you have.""

1226321663.m_KeyValue: ""Come, show me just how strong your resolve is!""

1226322809.m_KeyValue: ""And this time, don't throw the blade away again.""

1226322813.m_KeyValue: ""We can't match her head-on, we need to find another way...""

1226322814.m_KeyValue: ""This is bad… If this keeps up, the Bell Ringer's going to wipe us out sooner or later!""

1226322816.m_KeyValue: "Wait… this black mist... Is it about to explode?!"

1226322817.m_KeyValue: ""You're wrong. It wasn't you who chose me, but I who chose you.""

1226322818.m_KeyValue: ""So, you're ready... to accept this power.""

1226322819.m_KeyValue: ""But, I hadn’t thought you so well-loved.""

1226323841.m_KeyValue: ""Now that your memories are back, is there any reason for you to stay on Sunset Isle?""

1226323842.m_KeyValue: "There's still one thing I must resolve."

1226323843.m_KeyValue: "The anomaly within the Divine Body... I believe you can all sense it to some extent."

1226323844.m_KeyValue: "Unless I destroy it... None of us will ever leave this place."

1226324987.m_KeyValue: ""If I can't even save my friends with this power, then I have no right to wield it.""

1226324989.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I've prepared for this, I don't know if I can really wield this power.""

1226324990.m_KeyValue: "Escape to where? The Divine Body will probably destroy the whole island before we can get away."

1226324991.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe this is a little late, but we must leave this place immediately.""

1226324993.m_KeyValue: "Even the Bell Ringers probably couldn't damage it..."

1226324994.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body is essentially the remains of a god. It's not something that normal weapons can even scratch."

1226324995.m_KeyValue: "Is there no way to stop it?"

1226324996.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body... I think it's trying to blow up early!"

1228347996.m_KeyValue: ""There's a ventilation shaft that connects to the outside, right?""

1229828325.m_KeyValue: ""Well...? You've been eager for this, haven't you?""

1231878714.m_KeyValue:
""Exquisitely cooked fresh seafood with colorful vegetables, served to Kingdom Vassals. Fancy meal, moderately heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Its complexity of flavor is always impressive.""

1231878715.m_KeyValue:
""Exquisitely cooked fresh seafood with colorful vegetables, served to Kingdom Vassals. Luxury meal, greatly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>A testament to the abundant resources and sophisticated food culture among the kingdoms on the Minexus continent.""

1231878717.m_KeyValue:
""Exquisitely cooked fresh seafood, served to Kingdom Vassals. Simple meal, slightly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Good ingredients often only require the simplest cooking methods.""

1233487032.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of a Ganelon, you've inherited the family's inability to think quite well.""

1234089236.m_KeyValue: ""I spent the first half of my life on this island, and I've seen my share of 'longing'...""

1234089237.m_KeyValue: "Are you... no longer attached to this place?"

1234089240.m_KeyValue: "It seems the 'longing' between us has also fulfilled its purpose."

1234089242.m_KeyValue: "My Piera... you've already grown so much."

1234089243.m_KeyValue: "But grandmother... you haven't seen me grow up yet!"

1234089244.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps your mentor wanted to show you through their own actions what your predecessors may have proven: that life cannot truly overcome Death..."

1234089245.m_KeyValue: "Nor been able to defeat Death together."

""Objectively speaking, Acappella is a perfect listener. Her hypersensitive ears allow her to assess someone's psychological state through the subtle changes in their pulse and breathing.

It was this gift that helped her survive a harsh childhood without parents.

But who listens to the inner voice of this prodigy?""

1267206576.m_KeyValue:
""Unlike other families, the Paracelsus bloodline has always been led by young faces.

As Piera grew, the ever-tightening intervals between family gravestones became clear markers on the dial of her life. All of it seems bound to some vague and unshakable destiny.

Piera does not fear death itself—but the thought of fading into oblivion, of being slowly forgotten after death, often sends a chill through her soul.""

1267206669.m_KeyValue:
""However, these are just others' accounts of Gadric. What impressed me most was the water skin-like bag he always carried.

I've often wondered how much it could hold, as I'd seen Gadric pull out nuts to feed squirrels, oranges for Aiona's lamb, candies for Hati and Clive Jr., and finally, some jerky for me. He said it was an improved version of regular jerky—a snack even the Bloodborn would find tasty.""

1267206700.m_KeyValue:
""Esmeralda... The diviner mentioned that name too. What connection could there be between them?

Sneaking into the room of the black cat—the elder—a shelf come into view, holding not treasures, but relics: shells emitting an iridescent glow, shining otoliths, and leaves marked with cat paws... all so ancient that a single touch might reduce them to dust. And there, among the collection, rests the Star card.

The diviner once said that each tarot card whispers the truth about fate. Then why do her cards keep appearing near the black cat?""

1267206758.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa loved spending time with Aiona. She said they connected instantly—Empousa, having grown up without a mother, found a motherly gentleness in Aiona. She often clung to her, lamenting her cold childhood: no bedtime lullabies, no warm embraces, no comfort when she fell. Aiona always consoled her patiently, though a quiet, familiar loneliness seemed to linger in Aiona's own eyes.""

1268237290.m_KeyValue: ""Stay back, stay back— please, I'm begging you... Ahhhhh!""

1268498041.m_KeyValue: ""We witness the blaze of life burning bright, until time turns it all to ashes. All eyes are drawn to the crimson flame in his right hand— A symbol of his title as the Second Bell Ringer, an honor bestowed by the Saint herself after he emerged from behind Carrelle's towering walls as chancellor. Under his command, the Inquisition rains divine punishment upon heretics and nonbelievers without end. This facade sows the seeds of fear and reverence, blinding all to the azure flame in his left hand— The power inherited from Black Blood when he was reborn from the Heart of the Divine Body as _$$War_$$ of the Apocalypse. The ghosts he awakens prepare tirelessly for their final campaign against the Church. He craves war—an instinct woven into his bloodline. The crimson flame, once a symbol of order, has become his tool to dismantle the old world. Yet he despises this war—an emotion born of his own will. The azure flame, once a mark of chaos, has become his means to forge a new order. 'Lord Agares, is there no other way to forge a new order?' Perhaps there is. But if peace is what we seek, war remains the swiftest path.""

1268498231.m_KeyValue: ""Former Bell Ringer No. X—an Ascendant from a batch that retained the most memory and humanity. That's why the Church called her the 'Last Mercy.' In the evening, as hymns drift through the rose window, gently soothing the wandering, tormented souls on the streets, she is no longer a blade wielded by the Church, but simply 'Tris,' as the children call her.""

1268498258.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">We recommend experiencing the [Love and Lust] story before reading this Vassal Journal</style>

_$$Accept the pain I give you, and thus break free from your true bonds._$$

As the most brutal and merciless warden in Ironfist's dark history, Fanny's temperament burns with capricious fury. A master of restraint, torment, and interrogation, she wields every conceivable method of coercion to force Heretics into Repentance.

Yet toward those prisoners who capture her favor, she has never withheld her tenderness—though such affection proves as fragile as morning frost, ready to shatter at the slightest provocation. Should a prisoner dare attempt escape or defy her will, they would be granted the privilege of witnessing the most exquisite cruelties this world has to offer.

This twisted, consuming passion could only manifest as restless Phantasms haunting the prison corridors, until that one prisoner appeared—the one who would finally bear witness to the vulnerable heart beating beneath her armor of steel.""

1268498413.m_KeyValue: ""There is no death without regret, only forgetting without mercy. Before gaining immortality, he yearned for life's continuation; after attaining it, he longed to recover lost memories. Perhaps guided by moonlight, or bound by a promise worn thin by time, he finally embarked on his journey back to the island. Yet when he finally arrived, everything he once yearned for had been forgotten, and everyone he once stood beside had departed. Only the phantom of remembrance lingered on the beach, weaving one last reunion between the living and the departed. At the island's center lay the source of these illusions: the prison that had held him for a hundred years. As fate's chains tightened once more, could he use his memories as a blade to protect their promise? Like countless times before, he could not break his word.""

1284791186.m_KeyValue: ""_$$How someone treats their promises determines the color of their soul._$$ Despite how you may seem, I believe you're someone who honors their word.""

1284791187.m_KeyValue: ""Quoting my own words back to me—how like you. But knowing the kind of man you are, you didn't come all this way just for a reward, did you?""

1284791189.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't expect you to actually come to me, my silver-haired friend. Aren't you afraid I might go back on my word... and have you executed again?""

1284791190.m_KeyValue: ""_$$One cradle built from bone and breath, a corpse gave life, then slept in death._$$""

1284791191.m_KeyValue: ""You remember the first _$$tale,_$$ don't you? I was born among corpses on the battlefield, then taken in by a slave owner and raised in that manor.""

1284791192.m_KeyValue: "Brennholt. Everyone at that manor you sent me to bears that family name."

1284791193.m_KeyValue: "It's hard to imagine someone of your standing caring about a place so remote... Unless it's your hometown."

1284791196.m_KeyValue: ""All of us there were given the name Brennholt. We were slaves... but even so, we shared something close to peace.""

1284791197.m_KeyValue: "You mean all of you were slaves… and all called Brennholt?"

1285386954.m_KeyValue: "Interesting choice. Is there a matter you need me to handle?"

1285392200.m_KeyValue: ""Puppet: Make sure to invite Miss Bella to our next meeting as well, okay?""

1285398209.m_KeyValue: "A fine choice. I presume you're also one of the Moonblessed."

1285399230.m_KeyValue: "You can rest assured that this matter is in good hands."

1285401408.m_KeyValue: "I didn't know you were such a visionary."

1285402301.m_KeyValue: "Thanks for the recognition! Is there anything you need me to do?"

1285404479.m_KeyValue: "It would be an honor to assist you."

1285405500.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, are you trying to win my favor...?""

1285869401.m_KeyValue: ""One filled with hope, with kindness, with...""

1287622418.m_KeyValue: ""The barnacle controls its host to approach the target, then Self-Destructs, dealing massive P. DMG to enemies within a 2-meter radius.""

1287631127.m_KeyValue: "Deals M. DMG to enemies ahead in a cone."

1287631132.m_KeyValue: ""After {0} Basic ATKs, fires a plasma projectile at the farthest enemy, dealing M. DMG to enemies in a circle around the target and applying {1} stacks of Induction.""

1287633305.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak M. DMG to enemies in a circle around the target."

1287634327.m_KeyValue: ""Launches a flying sickle forward, dealing moderate P. DMG to enemies in its path.""

1287634330.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak P. DMG to the target."

1287634334.m_KeyValue:
""Talent: <link=""Tips_ID;10""><#508499><u>Effective Range</u></color></link>.
Has {3} base Lifesteal. When HP falls below {0} for the first time, increases Lifesteal Rate by {1} and gains ATK SPD UP for {2} sec.""

1287636504.m_KeyValue: ""Upon death, applies Sleep to enemies within range, lasting {0} sec.""

1287636508.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak P. DMG to the target."

1287636509.m_KeyValue: ""Throws the weapon at the farthest enemy, dealing weak P. DMG every sec to enemies in a circle.""

1287695139.m_KeyValue: "No reply came. Perhaps he had gone to seek out the rest of the tales on his own."

1287695141.m_KeyValue: ""That said, where exactly did you come across these tales? They're even numbered like some twisted nursery rhyme. There must be more. What else have they been saying about me?""

1287695142.m_KeyValue: "Each one costs a drink. We'll continue next time. If we meet again."

1287695143.m_KeyValue: ""No one remembers their own birth, do they? Even I only heard that story through rumors. Who knows if it's true?""

1287695144.m_KeyValue: ""I'll admit I'm not quite like ordinary men. As for whether I truly have two hearts... well, maybe you'll have to come hear for yourself.""

1287695145.m_KeyValue: "Is this how you treat your _$$friends_$$? Because you were _$$born from a corpse_$$?"

1287695146.m_KeyValue: "And your ruthlessness as an inquisitor... Does that come from having _$$two hearts_$$?"

1287953464.m_KeyValue: "Little Bella No. 13 removes Control effects from her Prototypes and commands them to deal moderate M. DMG to enemies ahead."

1287953466.m_KeyValue:
""Little Bella No. 13 is immune to Control, ATK SPD Down, and DMG Dealt Down effects.
When the battle begins, Little Bella No. 13 summons two Prototypes to assist in battle. Prototypes share HP with Little Bella No. 13, and will periodically light the _$$candles_$$ on Little Bella No. 13's arms in sequence.""

1287953468.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella No. 13 creates a _$$Stage,_$$ allowing her to control enemies with her psychic power and inflict Dollish Nightmare on 2 enemies. Units can break free from Dollish Nightmare using purify or movement skills. After breaking free a certain number of times, Little Bella No. 13 will suffer psychic backlash and enter a weakened state.""

1287953469.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak M. DMG to the target."

1288871433.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know about elegant, but the rest does seem to fit...""

1288871434.m_KeyValue: ""The stories say the Bloodborn are beautiful and elegant creatures, with silver hair, crimson eyes, and the ability to transform into animals. But they can't bear the sunlight...""

1288956958.m_KeyValue: "I may not be there in person—but you are. We can work through letters."

1288956969.m_KeyValue: ""But if you're not coming, perhaps I should decline...""

1288956970.m_KeyValue: "It's an invitation to investigate a mysterious incident at Duke Reese's castle—scheduled for the day after tomorrow."

1289595605.m_KeyValue: "As Tears Fade Into the Sunset Rewards"

1291126051.m_KeyValue: ""When its maw yawns wide, the sound is not a beast's roar but the panicked clamor of multitudes—until the dream itself is swallowed whole.""

1291126053.m_KeyValue: ""The whole city's abuzz—whispers say she may not only gain status, but be granted a new family name.""

1291126054.m_KeyValue: "It's something really cold that melts into water."

1291866187.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you say you had a plan? Everyone in the castle says you've been spending all your time in the library lately."

1291937929.m_KeyValue: ""Even within this reenactment of memory, Genevieve would struggle to find a better way to break the deadlock.""

1292321920.m_KeyValue: ""As I was about to sleep, faint singing drifted through the window from outside.""

1292560192.m_KeyValue:
""Launches a <style=""Highlight"">3.5</style>-meter strike against the largest group of enemies on the battlefield, dealing <style=""Highlight"">150%</style> ATK (M. DMG) and inflicting <style=""Highlight"">2</style> stack(s) of Burn on enemies hit, lasting for <style=""Highlight"">8</style> sec.
*Burn: Deals 50% ATK <link=""Tips_ID;4""><#508499><u>(True DMG)</u></color></link> every 4 sec.""

1292744058.m_KeyValue: ""When you're ready, follow me to the Hall of the Elders.""

1293833154.m_KeyValue: "Getting ambushed by all these werewolves and having to take care of Clive is a real handful."

1293836324.m_KeyValue: ""Though we've arrived in Mouret, we may still return to the Twilight Citadel at any time for a brief rest.""

1294067802.m_KeyValue: ""There was an outbreak of Black Blood in my town. Most of the people became infected, including me. They all suffered the same fate as those soldiers.""

1294068825.m_KeyValue: "But I don't think to disappear means to be forgotten."

1294068826.m_KeyValue: "The report said the carriage was attacked before it veered off the cliff. Was it this bat demon?!"

1294606004.m_KeyValue: ""Oh dear... as expected, the iron law of 'Justice' has locked the door.""

1294606233.m_KeyValue: "The key’s with that sleepyhead over there. Take him out quickly."

1294608015.m_KeyValue: ""Materials for Skill Enhancements can be obtained from [Timeworn Mausoleum]. Take a look, if that sounds enticing.""

1294608050.m_KeyValue: "Lady Empousa prepared a set of Equipment for you and your Vassals while you were asleep."

1294608081.m_KeyValue: "It looks like they have something to say."

1294608116.m_KeyValue: ""To help you adapt to the Black Blood coursing through your body, I took the liberty of making some preparations.""

1294608147.m_KeyValue: ""You shall venture into secret zones fraught with peril across the continent, enduring the trials in search of enlightenment and truth.""

1294608380.m_KeyValue: ""As you progress, you will be able to access more areas and unlock powerful features that will greatly assist both you and your Vassals.""

1294609139.m_KeyValue: "Jess and Setti aren't just lounging at the castle. They're there to oversee crucial family affairs."

1294611282.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you the heir here? How come you don't even know your way around your own castle?"

1294814491.m_KeyValue: "Thanks for the warning. I'll level up my room's security."

1294814492.m_KeyValue: "Can’t have you sneaking more strange things into my closet."

1294814501.m_KeyValue: ""I've never bothered with formalities before, but for you, little Noah, I'll make an exception.""

1294814504.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. Though you're welcome to call me Master, if you prefer.""

1294814505.m_KeyValue: "Stop forcing your name into people's minds."

1294814506.m_KeyValue: ""If you're this upset over a little teasing, you'll never survive what's coming.""

1295170564.m_KeyValue: "Repel the infected Church Soldiers and Priests."

1295974155.m_KeyValue: ""Moonlight spilled through the window, casting soft patterns across the floor. Ami stood in the light, quiet and still—as if waiting for someone.""

1295974156.m_KeyValue: "And I couldn't leave like they did... Was it because my treasure had always been on the ship?"

1295974157.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather—from the moment you stepped aboard, you had already become their treasure.""

1297751757.m_KeyValue: ""Targets the area with the most enemies, dealing <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (M. DMG) to all enemies in a circle.""

1300105179.m_KeyValue: ""I failed to stop Ganelon's advance. But their lord is dead, and the remnants of his force are already beginning to fall apart.""

1300105180.m_KeyValue: ""Useful, but only just... That sly old fox ensured his trap was sprung before death. Their forces, alongside the mutated werewolves, have already crossed the border to start the war.""

1300105181.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Peace? Nothing but a pitiful veil the defeated pull over their cowardice. You claim to understand my hatred, but what do you know? The weak exist to be crushed, and those who retreat invite their own ruin!""

1300105182.m_KeyValue: ""But Father… even with her final breath, Mother prayed for peace between our clans. You loved her once. Surely… you remember what she stood for.""

1300105184.m_KeyValue: "I'll go on ahead—the situation won't wait. Join me after you two had your family talk."

1300105185.m_KeyValue: ""I spared your life only because of that trace of Crowley blood in you. For supply and shield, 'it'll make do.'""

1300105186.m_KeyValue: ""Just think about it—if I had truly loved your mother, would you be in your current situation?""

1300105187.m_KeyValue: "Precisely. Now... fulfill your role. This is your final chance—go and die on the battlefield."

1300105188.m_KeyValue: ""So that time in the arena, when I won and you called me over, patted my head and said, 'it'll make do'... that's what you meant...""

1300106203.m_KeyValue: "You're urging us to destroy your family's most important ritual and expose your kin to daylight? Why would a steward turn against his own people?"

1300106204.m_KeyValue: ""The Bloodborn isn't that weak. When the Long Night fades, daylight is nothing more than a trivial hindrance to us.""

1300106205.m_KeyValue: "The old master sought to invoke the Long Night to give the Bloodborn more freedom to move. It was understandable."

1300106206.m_KeyValue: ""After his passing, the Long Night became a weapon wielded by some elders to fulfill their selfish ambitions. Victory holds meaning, but stripped of dignity and honor, it descends into nothing more than savagery.""

1300106207.m_KeyValue: "Besides... it's not yet the time for the Bathory to claim its place in history through such means."

1300106208.m_KeyValue: ""I can't fully explain it, but there's a hint of mockery toward your father.""

1300106209.m_KeyValue: ""I have no right to interfere in family matters, but if this is your wish, my lady, I will do my utmost to help.""

1300106210.m_KeyValue: ""Ultimately, you need to find the ritual site yourself. As a steward, I can only offer answers and point you toward possible paths.""

1300106211.m_KeyValue: ""As every second passes, more innocent lives are lost. Please, don't let my presence stop you—go now and save whoever can still be saved.""

1300106212.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it… Quinn, don't you see? Cain is using your kindness and your desperation to serve his own twisted ends!""

1300114907.m_KeyValue: "At last... I've been waiting for you...!"

1300114915.m_KeyValue: "I read Grandfather's journal. There's a Divine Body hidden in the cave at Lupine Forest—it can cross realms."

1300114919.m_KeyValue: ""Damp, dark, stone walls dripping with moisture... This has to be the cave in Lupine Forest. Location confirmed.""

1300114920.m_KeyValue: "The fungi are still in their primitive state... unchanged in size. All signs match the conditions from 600 years ago."

1300114921.m_KeyValue: "Ha! Not bad at all. First temporal landing—spot on! Just what you'd expect from the future greatest cartographer in all of Minexus."

1300114922.m_KeyValue: "Now then... time to track down the 'young hero' and earn that license!"

1300116061.m_KeyValue: ""And where there's a glimmer... it can light the way home! You said her name was Elonora, right? I think... I think my father once mentioned someone by that name!""

1300116062.m_KeyValue: ""That alone means everything to me. Like a glimmer of light cutting through the dark—brief, but unbearably precious.""

1300116067.m_KeyValue: "That word feels... so distant from my life. Almost foreign."

1300116069.m_KeyValue: ""In our culture, Wolfsbane stands for protection. This is her way of keeping you safe!""

1300116070.m_KeyValue: ""According to Mr. Cain, it was done by my mother. He said she was from the Lupine Forest.""

1300116071.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright. You've done nothing wrong. Because of you, I now know its name... its meaning... that it hails from the Lupine Forest... and that it bears healing properties.""

1300116072.m_KeyValue: ""Y-you never met your mother...? I'm sorry! I didn't know, I didn't mean to—""

1300116073.m_KeyValue: "Because I've never met her. 'Elonora'—that name... and this little flower... That's all I have. That's all I have ever known of her."

1300116074.m_KeyValue: "But it a gift from your mother... Why do you sound... so sad?"

1300117085.m_KeyValue: ""So because we lacked clean water, you poisoned the very people you lived among?""

1300117086.m_KeyValue: "Careful... He's dangerous and he craves the power that comes with Black Blood..."

1300117092.m_KeyValue: ""Leila treated you like her own son. These villagers trusted you, never wronged you... Why, Johannes? Why would you do this?""

1300117093.m_KeyValue: ""You cared for Leila when she was sick. She died so suddenly... in such pain... Tell me, was it because you withheld her Wolfsbane?!""

1300117095.m_KeyValue: "You all say you're kind. But what has your kindness given us? Not even a sip of clean water!"

1300117096.m_KeyValue: "Look at the Bathorys! What's wrong with joining the Bloodborn? At least they were—"

1300117098.m_KeyValue: "I never accepted that old fraud Leila as my godmother! A Ganelon Gravekeeper? Guarding the border under Church orders? What a load of crap!"

1300118239.m_KeyValue: ""A witch! She's a witch! The last time I saw magic that twisted, it came from the Crowleys up north!""

1300118240.m_KeyValue: ""Before scheming to snatch him, did you truly fail to notice someone else standing behind him?""

1300118245.m_KeyValue: ""My, my. Not only do you lack judgment, it seems you also lack sight.""

1300118246.m_KeyValue: "That girl... something's wrong with her. Her eyes... they're glowing..."

1300118247.m_KeyValue: ""S-So... If he comes back, everything we've planned... will fall apart!""

1300118248.m_KeyValue: "Didn't Lord Ezareth say... that boy went missing in Bathory territory? That's our perfect pretext to act!"

1300118250.m_KeyValue: "Then what are you gawking at?! Grab him and bring him to Lord Ezareth!"

1300119263.m_KeyValue: ""I—I'm not… not gracious or thoughtful… I'm Agnes, by the way.""

1300119264.m_KeyValue: "But you… you're a Bloodborn. Why are you in Ganelon territory? And your clothes—they're unmistakably Bathory."

1300119268.m_KeyValue: ""(coughing) No, there's no need to apologize. Given the circumstances, your response was more than reasonable.""

1300119269.m_KeyValue: "If a stranger had approached me in the dark—especially after what you've been through—I might've reacted even more harshly."

1300119270.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for your understanding. You're so gracious and thoughtful."

1300119271.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie and I were chased all the way here. When this young lady appeared, I thought she was one of them… so I lashed out without thinking.""

1300119272.m_KeyValue: "(The books say Bloodborn have pale skin and fangs. I imagined monsters… but she's… beautiful.)"

1300119273.m_KeyValue: ""(She may seem kind, but most Bloodborn are masters at deceiving. Agnes, don't be fooled. She must be dangerous. You can't let her go…)""

1300120417.m_KeyValue: "I said you could see it. I never said I'd give it to you. It's all I have left of Elonora. I won't part with it."

1300120418.m_KeyValue: "What are you doing? Let me go!"

1300120419.m_KeyValue: "James can vouch for this—it was her favorite case. There's no doubt."

1300120420.m_KeyValue: "Fetch her case—the one she always carried."

1300120421.m_KeyValue: "Just because someone died in another territory—does that mean the people there were the ones who did it? Where's your proof?"

1300120422.m_KeyValue: ""If only she had stayed in Mouret... But no, she wanted to be an envoy. Had she not... she'd still be alive today...""

1300120423.m_KeyValue: ""I sent for her many times. The Bathorys agreed, then stalled. And before long, we received word. She was assassinated.""

1300120424.m_KeyValue: ""I was the fool who arranged her marriage into that cursed house. I thought... if she wed a Bathory, it might bring peace between us. Instead, I sent her to her death.""

1300120426.m_KeyValue: "But yes. Nora is dead. Slain by the Bathory."

1300121441.m_KeyValue: ""Now, at last, I have found the answer to my question—she showed me the meaning of her life through her pursuit.""

1300121442.m_KeyValue: "Before I find my own path... I want to complete the journey she began."

1300121443.m_KeyValue: "What kept me going through that darkness... was my longing for a mother I had never met..."

1300121444.m_KeyValue: ""If only Mother were here, could she tell me the true meaning of life?""

1300121445.m_KeyValue: "Wishing for my safety… that was her heart as a mother. But striving for peace—that was her conviction as a person."

1300121446.m_KeyValue: ""During my days in the dungeon, I would often sleep for days on end, sometimes wishing... I'd never wake up again...""

1300121447.m_KeyValue: ""Seeing all this, I think of Mother and the sacrifice she made. Peace between our families was her lifelong wish, and she gave everything for it. I think... I have to try.""

1300121448.m_KeyValue: "Look at the letter again. Your mother sealed her power into that little flower—doesn't that say everything about her true wish? That you live in peace and without fear."

1300121450.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, have you truly thought this through? If we return now… that rusty armor will show you no mercy!""

1300354919.m_KeyValue: ""Go forth, collide with it. Ashes of Time—the pale bird of judgment.""

1300354920.m_KeyValue: ""Of countless fates, every one casts us as foes.""

1300354927.m_KeyValue: "Don't you see? There is no key. No escape. This is where it all ends."

1300354928.m_KeyValue: ""I've never felt this before… The sky is so near I could almost touch it, yet it's so far that I... can't grasp it.""

1300354929.m_KeyValue: ""The Codex Sanctus were my fairy tales, the torture rack my only toys.""

1300354930.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since we arrived, hunger, thirst—all such needs—have vanished.""

1300354932.m_KeyValue: "I have chosen. My prisoners—seek your freedom within my flesh."

1300354933.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we should leave this place while the rift is still open."

1300355951.m_KeyValue: ""Yard time's thirty minutes—no more! Keep still, keep quiet! You know well enough what the Warden does to those who step out of line!""

1300355952.m_KeyValue: ""Last night's little hint served well. We must remain here a while longer, and sparing you needless torment is my duty.""

1300355953.m_KeyValue: "ALERT—Ironfist Gaol has suffered a sudden breach—deploy all defenses at once."

1300355954.m_KeyValue: "You mean the locked oak cabinet behind the rack."

1300961698.m_KeyValue: "Ryan gives Noah's shoulder a perfunctory pat before turning to bark orders."

1302798032.m_KeyValue: ""Unnecessary. On the contrary, I shall grant her far greater power—baptize her in our purest doctrine.""

1302798033.m_KeyValue: "For what Silver Blood craves above all is precisely such an unburdened vessel."

1302798035.m_KeyValue: "Prisoner No. 681 has escaped without authorization. Subject confirmed deceased. Cause: new Warden Fanny permitted the prisoner's flight. Requesting orders—shall wardenship be revoked and disciplinary measures enacted?"

1303041614.m_KeyValue: ""Noah was overwhelmed with questions, unsure where to begin. After a pause, he managed to ask, '...Does possessing this Seafood Tycoon Pearl guarantee victory in the competition?'""

1304284603.m_KeyValue: "A letter from the future... could something like this even work?"

1307391269.m_KeyValue: "I don't want to cleave your chest and watch the light die in your eyes."

1307391270.m_KeyValue: "Would you trade your legs for them?"

1307391272.m_KeyValue: "But I won't let them. I won't die by their hands on some mission."

1307391273.m_KeyValue: "Don't talk—I swear my heart's about to explode."

1307391274.m_KeyValue: "Noah! What are you up to now?"

1307391276.m_KeyValue: "I've no patience for this. I'm leaving."

1308672935.m_KeyValue: "But you're seriously incredible! You took down all those alchemists on your own!"

1308706696.m_KeyValue: ""Because you're the only one I trust. And since I'm the last Moonblessed, you're counting on me to recover your memories, aren't you?""

1308757707.m_KeyValue: ""Noah was confused, 'Still don't know where you got that idea…'""

1313605059.m_KeyValue:
""Clear Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II Fragment 3 to randomly obtain equipment from the following. 
<alpha=#80>Time erodes the husks of monsters, but the legacy of battle echoes eternally.""

1315465034.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa's flippant justification was: 'Well, everyone's been very bored lately.'""

1315465035.m_KeyValue: ""Truth be told, Empousa had been battling a bout of boredom lately and had secretly been devouring books about the stars.""

1315465037.m_KeyValue: ""'Empousa suggested we all stargaze together.' Though in truth, her proposal was for a more... intimate gathering.""

1316295971.m_KeyValue: ""Now, select your Vassals and give it a try.""

1317587405.m_KeyValue: ""During rituals, Vassals offer precious resources as a tribute of their loyalty and reverence.""

1317587436.m_KeyValue: "Eliminate the souls first to truly suppress Baphomet's power."

1317587529.m_KeyValue: ""We are warriors, and we must fulfill our duty! We shall protect her!""

1317587595.m_KeyValue: "The Cluster Brain? It seems that defeating her is the key to winning this battle."

1317622097.m_KeyValue: ""I never meant to worry you. Come now, don't look at me like that—I'm perfectly fine.""

1317622098.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, go! I'll hold them off. Ahhh—!!!""

1318009416.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'reducing the severity of punishments for violating the Third Tenet: Unsanctioned Creation of Progeny'?"

1318011594.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'allocating funds to procure wool tapestries with superior light-blocking properties for curtains'?"

1318014665.m_KeyValue: "What are your views on 'imposing price controls to a certain degree on the shop'?"

1320646986.m_KeyValue: "This cannot be considered their final battle—surely you understand this?"

1320646988.m_KeyValue: "Even if those you're about to face are the very comrades who once fell beneath your blade?"

1320648012.m_KeyValue: "Is this truly what a world should be—one where time itself has yet to draw its first breath?"

1321630561.m_KeyValue: ""The power of these monsters is 'sandification', we're not sure if it's contagious, but...""

1321630562.m_KeyValue: "These vile creatures are actually born from the sand?!"

1321630564.m_KeyValue: "What's going on? How can there be assassins on our lands?!"

1321630593.m_KeyValue: "We don't have time to look for it!"

1321630595.m_KeyValue: ""No... you're a tempting demon, I won't succumb to you...""

1321630596.m_KeyValue: ""Wake up... Wake up, Gilrain... Wake up...""

1321630857.m_KeyValue: ""Please call me Sandra, my lady. After you completed the ritual, the lord—your Father—sent me to look after you.""

1321630860.m_KeyValue: ""I must ask Father about my eyes. Call for him—he'll come, I'm sure of it.""

1321630862.m_KeyValue: "Is this... some kind of Blood Beast?"

1321630889.m_KeyValue: "Have the assassins already infiltrated the castle? Father! Is Father alright?!"

1321630890.m_KeyValue: "My family was attacked?! When did this happen?"

1321630891.m_KeyValue: "Then you absolutely must try some! It's our local specialty."

1321630892.m_KeyValue: "...I'll take off the bandages and see for myself."

1321630922.m_KeyValue: "But how? Even Black Blood can't spread this fast..."

1321630924.m_KeyValue: "Since they're suspicious individuals... let's throw them in the dungeon and interrogate them thoroughly."

1321630959.m_KeyValue: ""Here again... Too late, it's already too late...""

1321630960.m_KeyValue: ""I will become a worthy vessel. Ancestors of the Alita family, let me return to the past once more!""

1321630989.m_KeyValue: ""I have lots and lots and lots of time to find all of you, one by one.""

1321630991.m_KeyValue: ""There isn't much time... however, the Alita family owes you nothing.""

1321631022.m_KeyValue: "This place... Is this where all the answers lie?"

1321631024.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I don't do it myself, you won't last much longer.""

1321631055.m_KeyValue: ""It feels like a part of my memory has been cut out, and we suddenly ended up here.""

1321631056.m_KeyValue: "Rushing in now would be futile. We need to find a way to restore our power first!"

""Darcias once had a happy home—parents who told her bedtime stories.

_$$It's time for bed now._$$

_$$But I haven't heard the ending! What happened to the wooden one?_$$

_$$You'll find out tomorrow night._$$

But she never heard the ending. Her father, consumed by Black Blood, killed her mother before falling to Tris's blade.

She thought the sword would turn on her next—but instead, those hands held hers with a gentleness she didn't expect.

Young Darcias bit her lip, holding back tears. She didn't understand why her mother had died, why her father had become a monster, or where she would go from here.

She understood nothing—only the weight of sorrow.""

As he spoke, he lifted his face—no longer an old man, but me. Silver hair. Crimson eyes. He went on, in a voice that mirrored mine: 'Five decrees to break the throne, his vow of vengeance sealed in stone. 'Six wings fell with fire and blade, his fate in slaughter darkly laid.' I still couldn't grasp the full meaning behind his tale and I asked: 'Why did you take my form?' 'Ask Agares. He'll give you the answer—and make sure he pays for the wine.'""

1467041147.m_KeyValue: ""Then... then let them all disappear... please, let me be innocent again...""

1467041149.m_KeyValue: "I... I can still feel my mother's warm hands... hear Father's tales of myths and heroes... taste the merchant's sweet caramel... But none of that matters anymore."

1467041151.m_KeyValue: "I understand. I will become what this prison demands of me."

1467041152.m_KeyValue: ""Fanny, ninety days of purification have stripped you of human frailty. Now you shall be sanctified, and rise as the perfect Warden.""

1467041160.m_KeyValue: ""From that day forth, the girl who longed for her parents, who wept for fallen birds, who smiled at the taste of caramel—died. What remained was a perfect Warden: without compassion, without weakness, without humanity.""

1467041161.m_KeyValue: "This way... I can never make another mistake..."

1473438034.m_KeyValue: "Please. Your true form is fine too."

1473438037.m_KeyValue: ""Cruel, but necessary for a new age to begin.""

1473627585.m_KeyValue: "The suspect now requires an explanation from the one who captured him."

1473627591.m_KeyValue: ""Though it doesn't quite match your requirements, consider it done.""

1473627593.m_KeyValue: "Do whatever you want—just don’t hurt anyone."

1474741704.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps it's not about obvious measures like strength, but something deeper?""

1474741705.m_KeyValue: ""That's why I've been training relentlessly in the arena, until no opponent could match me anymore.""

1474741707.m_KeyValue: "You've got brains—no wonder Empousa took an interest in you."
