1488904149.m_KeyValue: ""The key was discovered by the heirs of the three major families, who were then young apprentices in the Church. Little did they know how their destinies would unfold, or the twists that awaited them.""

1488904150.m_KeyValue: ""'You're not scared, are you?' Gilrain smirked as he strode past his friend without looking back. 'It's just a twig.'""

1488904151.m_KeyValue: ""'Click.' As the sound of the turning lock echoed and faded, a cabin—isolated from both the world and time—unveiled itself before the trio.""

1488904152.m_KeyValue: ""The three of them sat before the fireplace, poring over the cabin's notes in the flickering light.""

1488904153.m_KeyValue: "'It appears this Nikola is no longer alive.'"

1488904154.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, but what exactly feels amiss? At times, one must tread carefully, mustn't they? After all, fate rarely offers a warning before we arrive at a crucial crossroads.""

1488907413.m_KeyValue: ""'It's rude to stare, meow...' With a casual flick of its tail, the scattered Tarot cards were swept cleanly back into a neat stack—How it managed that was anyone's guess.""

1488907414.m_KeyValue: ""With one hand gripping the crystal ball and the other casually dragging her inverted spear, Joan strode forward at an unhurried pace. The spear's tip scraped against the ground, causing a shrill sound of friction. Now and then, silver sparks arced from it, crackling through brittle leaves in her path.""

1488907415.m_KeyValue: ""A flick of the paw—A custom-made Tarot deck, a slightly worn crystal ball, and a matching velvet mat all flew neatly onto the long table nearby. 'There. Good enough, meow…'""

1488907416.m_KeyValue: ""With a fluid sweep of her lance, she unleashed a crackle of silver lightning that sliced through the thorny brush ahead. 'Nothing stands in the path of my lightning.'""

1488907417.m_KeyValue: ""As if she'd foreseen this outcome from the start, Joan reached out and picked up the crystal ball. 'Then we'll be taking this as our spoils of war.'""

1488907418.m_KeyValue: ""'So the Bell Ringer's card is The Death and my card is The Lovers... quite unexpected, meow.'""

1488907419.m_KeyValue: ""'I'll go first. In case it's a trap.' Without further comment, Theophane flipped over the card before him. The High Priestess.""

1488907424.m_KeyValue: ""Meanwhile, at the foot of the hill...""

1488973846.m_KeyValue: "'And besides... wasn't <style=Highlight>Jack</style> the name of the food you had for dinner last night?'"

1488973847.m_KeyValue: ""'But!' Ami waved her hand, cutting Goldland off mid-sentence. 'Among the <style=Highlight>Eight Great Delicacies</style> of Minexus, I still haven't tasted the <style=Highlight>Comet Mushrooms</style> that flourish in Starfall Valley!'""

1488973848.m_KeyValue: ""'Basically, what Captain Ami is trying to say is that the El Dorado's food supplies are running low, so we'll need to venture to Starfall Valley to restock...'""

1488973849.m_KeyValue: "'And then we can finally taste the Comet Mushrooms—one of the Eight Great Delicacies of Minexus!' Ami clapped her hands in pure delight. 'So what are we waiting for? Let's go!'"

1488973850.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, I know!' Regina excitedly interrupted Stella. 'We just need everyone to stop eating and that'll solve the problem!'""

1488973851.m_KeyValue: ""'Ha! Now that's the Stella I know and love!' Regina sprang to her feet, practically glowing with excitement. 'I knew you'd never give up!'""

1488973852.m_KeyValue: ""'It's all thanks to your decisive leadership, captain!' Stella replied modestly to Ami. 'Since I've successfully convinced everyone to head to Starfall Valley as we agreed...'""

1488974934.m_KeyValue: ""'The Carrelle family crest,' Agares muttered while crouching down. He ran his fingers across the gravestone, tracing the weathered grooves with the pads of his fingertips.""

1488974935.m_KeyValue: ""'Mm... what is it? I can't tell...' Without breaking composure, Noah took a subtle step back. 'More importantly... when's the last time you had a bath?'""

1488974936.m_KeyValue: ""Noticing Noah's puzzled expression, Agares pulled out a small folding spade from who-knows-where. 'We're digging up whatever's under!'""

1488974937.m_KeyValue: "'Oh...?' Even someone as averse to trouble as Twin Agares couldn't ignore that. A flicker of competitive fire lit in his eyes. 'Then let's put it to the test.'"

1488974938.m_KeyValue: "Someone else was here?! To think they went unnoticed by both Noah and Agares… Just who are they?!"

1488974939.m_KeyValue: ""'Heh. As expected of Noah Nevernight.' Moments later, a familiar voice echoed from within the mist. That belonged to none other than...""

1488974940.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, now that you mention it... that did happen! Twin Agares ties the score in a flash! It's neck and neck, and the match is heating up!""

1488974942.m_KeyValue: "'I think... it's a special kind of meteorite. Planted here by _$$that person_$$ to protect the Carrelle family.'"

1488976021.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella made a gesture of Covenant with her hands clasped together, trying to appear solemn. She would have... if not for her feet resting on a gravestone.""

1488976022.m_KeyValue: "'Step back! Your breathing is too loud—I'm trying to locate people by their heartbeats.'"

1488976027.m_KeyValue: "The new friend here seemed rather displeased with this title."

1488976028.m_KeyValue: "'You can speak? But how are you still alive?'"

1488976032.m_KeyValue: ""If one had to call it a cake... well, it was certainly something only Acappella could have created.""

1489047893.m_KeyValue: ""Clive paled. At that time, his birth parents were still alive, and he hadn't yet been adopted by his current father.""

1489047897.m_KeyValue: ""Hati craned her neck to gaze at the towering watchtower. Atop it stood a vigilant clan member, eyes fixed intently on the distant lands of the Bathorys.""

1489047898.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, as if by some inexplicable twist of fate, Gadric suddenly lost his footing. With a startled 'Ow,' he tumbled to the ground just inches from the water.""

1489047899.m_KeyValue: ""'I think I just tripped over my own foot,' Gadric said, once again attempting to scratch his head through his helmet in embarrassment.""

1489047900.m_KeyValue: ""Clive suddenly bristled with anger. With a dismissive 'Hmph,' he turned and strode towards the Fangtooth Tower. His father was just a stranger to him, and Clive couldn't care less about the man's strength.""

1489051160.m_KeyValue: ""'Atop the tower's summit, the moons blushed crimson one by one, then faded, and finally vanished. Meanwhile, the bodies of fallen Bloodborn accumulated, blanketing the pinnacle in a grim shroud.'""

1489051161.m_KeyValue: "'That's impossible!' Hati cried out. 'The Ganelons are the epitome of loyalty!'"

1489051162.m_KeyValue: ""'Heh heh,' Hati chuckled nervously, her discomfort evident.""

1489051164.m_KeyValue: ""As she stood alone atop the tower, swinging a borrowed greatsword, it suddenly dawned on her—she simply didn't possess her brother's natural talent for swordsmanship.""

1489077301.m_KeyValue: "Hold on! This plot twist is real?! Even thi bard doesn't know of such things!"

1489077304.m_KeyValue: ""'In any case, precious few souls dwell in <color=#bc544b>yyf</color>.' She turns toward Stella, who remains silent. 'The most renowned among them, naturally, is...'""

1489077308.m_KeyValue: ""'And since it is Empousa who brings Noah from Sunset Isle to Bathory Castle, his feelings toward her...'""

1489077310.m_KeyValue: "<size=-10><alpha=#88>...Why don't you just ask Noah directly?</alpha></size>"

1489079477.m_KeyValue: ""'Since there are no books here, we should take our leave,' said Piera. The eldest in the group was always aware of the dangers at stake.""

1489079478.m_KeyValue: ""'Look at these ruins around you. Faith collapsed here long ago,' Cain retorted. 'How can one blaspheme against what no longer exists?'""

1489079479.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, the senior disciple with the most battlefield experience, had already pinpointed the source of the strange feeling. 'Over there! Everyone, be on guard!'""

1489079480.m_KeyValue: ""But the Crescent Garden proved a bitter disappointment. The church lay in ruins, its crumbling walls suffocated by an unyielding embrace of rose vines.""

1489079483.m_KeyValue: ""'With no one from his family to support him, he became both an apostate and a betrayer of his family.'""

1489079484.m_KeyValue: ""'His wish was granted. He had a son who grew at an astonishing rate, becoming the most formidable warrior the land had ever seen.'""

1489080438.m_KeyValue: "'Yeah… there it is again. That dreadful little tingle—that's the feeling of someone talking behind our backs.'"

1489080439.m_KeyValue: ""At this very moment, Darcias was back at the Church, undergoing a full analysis of the mushroom's composition. The culprit, of course, had already forgotten the whole thing.""

1489080440.m_KeyValue: ""'Doesn't it look familiar?' With a quick motion, Thibault reached forward, drawing the others' attention to her hand. 'It resembles…'""

1489080441.m_KeyValue: ""So… the suited, numbered cards represent figures from each faction, while the others—those without suits or numbers—represent different abilities?""

1489080442.m_KeyValue: "'Tch… pulling something that troublesome right out the gate… Did that last move already cost me 500 life points?'"

1489080443.m_KeyValue: ""This deck of mine is better suited for attrition. Laying down key effects early on is crucial for controlling the pace… and I must admit, I don't mind this style of play.'""

1489080444.m_KeyValue: ""'But it's a gamble. A Covenant amplifies offensive power dramatically—but at the cost of resources. If she overextends, it could open her up to a counterattack.'""

1489080445.m_KeyValue: ""...Wahahaha! Agares, you'd better go get that back checked—this match is mine!' Acappella swept her gaze around the battlefield with a grin. 'Summon servant—Darcias!'""

1489080446.m_KeyValue: ""'Still, that weird deck was kind of fun. Let's bring it back to the Church for further study.' As she spoke, Acappella bent down to pick up the deck, which only Bell Ringers could see.""

1489118677.m_KeyValue: ""_$$The usable fleece that falls is no larger than your palm..._$$ Aiona cradled the precious bundle in her cupped hands, her voice reverent. _$$This is 'soft gold'—one of nature's rarest textile treasures!_$$""

1489118678.m_KeyValue: ""He rubbed the wool between his palms, twisting it into a tight, compact bundle._$$…For combat purposes, this is extra weight I don't need. If, by any chance, you find it useful…_$$""

1489118679.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Gilrain, don't be rash! Match my rhythm and we strike together._$$""

1489118680.m_KeyValue: "'Though I suspected they would not recognize me so easily...' Aiona murmured under her breath. '...But perhaps that's for the best. I'm not ready to face them yet.'"

1489118681.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain laughed coldly. _$$Friedrich, haven't you noticed? Aiona's dressed for spring._$$""

1489118682.m_KeyValue: ""Yet for our protagonist, soon to enter this tale, that day carries even more meaning—it is her nineteenth birthday.""

1489118684.m_KeyValue: ""But judging by Aiona's words, what she's wearing today isn't Friedrich's dress either. So what exactly is it?""

1489118689.m_KeyValue: "It was Friedrich who broke the silence. _$$Where is our task target 'Joyce Gadric'?_$$"

1489118690.m_KeyValue: ""Even as she spoke, the world around them had already surrendered to perfect stillness—a manifestation of the terrible, near-invincibility that Aiona had wrested from the jaws of countless ordeals.""

1489119767.m_KeyValue: ""Edina gazed sorrowfully at the butterfly in her palm. Her master extended a branch to offer her a cup of tea, but all he received was a roll of the eyes from his disciple.""

1489119768.m_KeyValue: ""Edina gently raised the butterfly with broken wings again: 'Master, how do you suppose it managed to fly to this area?'""

1489119769.m_KeyValue: ""'Initially, the foreman harbored no lofty ideals; he simply needed the money and had no choice but to accept this job.'""

1489119770.m_KeyValue: ""'But just as they began their journey, they were struck by a massive blizzard. Suddenly, they faced a grim reality: pressing on meant almost certain death for everyone in those merciless snowy plains.'""

1489119771.m_KeyValue: ""Edina cupped her hands, sheltering and warming the delicate creature within, while scanning the snow-blanketed slopes for suitable plants.""

1489119772.m_KeyValue: ""'Even if we heal it, it cannot escape this snowy plain. The outcome of death is unchangeable.'""

1489151349.m_KeyValue: ""'Indeed we did, but the Wolf Family's Harvest Festival was more like a sporting event. I always took first place in the running races. Clive Jr., though, would insist he'd beat me when he grew up.'""

1489151350.m_KeyValue: ""With eyes closed, the girls could almost hear the creaking of a ship's mast. Only upon opening their eyes did the illusion dissolve, revealing the true source: the turning of the windmill's blades.""

1489151353.m_KeyValue: ""'I-I couldn't care less about the history of you stupid wolves!' Empousa stammered, her cheeks flushed with a mix of embarrassment and defiance.""

1489151354.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, you dumb mutt, don't tell me you brought the wrong key?' Empousa's sharp words instantly shattered the melancholy that had been welling up in Hati's heart.""

1489151355.m_KeyValue: ""'Based on my understanding, fabricating such a story wouldn't benefit anyone. At most, it would only serve to strain relations between the Ganelon family, the Church, and other families.'""

1489151356.m_KeyValue: ""'Why?' Empousa exclaimed, even more astonished than Hati had been when her father first recounted this tale. 'Was this before the Bathorys began their research into immortality?'""

1489156661.m_KeyValue: "But when would the skies rumble with thunder once more?"

1489156663.m_KeyValue: "'Found it.' Hati pranced back like a cat while trying to brush the grime off her newfound treasure."

1489156664.m_KeyValue: ""Hati lowered her head, hugging the gloves. 'It's because my father said everyone's first pair of boxing gloves should be thrown into the sky, to send a challenge to the highest power.'""

1489156665.m_KeyValue: ""'Looks like rain's on its way,' Ressa observed, voicing the unwelcome truth no one wanted to hear. On the bright side, they had managed to complete the harvest just in time.""

1489156666.m_KeyValue: ""'To erect this new tower, he not only spent vast fortunes but also poured every ounce of his ingenuity into its design. The tower soared to unprecedented heights.'""

1489156667.m_KeyValue: ""'Why won't she hang out with us?' Empousa grumbled, contemplating ways to drag Ami out of the Bathory castle.""

1489156668.m_KeyValue: ""'I want to climb to the top of the mill tonight,' Hati revealed. 'There's something I need to find up there.'""

1489223221.m_KeyValue: ""'Wow, so this is what a hot spring feels like... My fatigue just melted away! This hot spring is incredible!'""

1489223222.m_KeyValue: ""'Why don't we flip a coin?' Ami chimed in eagerly, already holding one up.""

1489223224.m_KeyValue: "'So you're preaching about fairness while planning to pull rank as the Bell Ringer (Beast) to overrule us?'"

1489223225.m_KeyValue: "'Looks like there's only one way to settle this. We'll draw lots to decide who goes first.' Ami rummaged through her bag and pulled out a coin."

1489223227.m_KeyValue: ""'Hm? Could he be here of all places...' Noah mused as he dispersed the thin mist, revealing a peculiar sight—someone else was already in the very pool where Hati had fallen!""

1489223228.m_KeyValue: ""'At times like this, I find myself missing the crowded warmth of company,' Noah mused, raising a hand toward the glowing moon above, as if to grasp it. 'Perhaps sharing a hot spring with everyone wouldn't be so bad after all.'""

1489224181.m_KeyValue: "What a masterful setup. As expected of one of the most skilled bards in all of Minexus!"

1489224182.m_KeyValue: ""'Mercury can't melt human flesh...' Nicole turned the empty helmet over in her hands, as if weighing a new thought. '...but that only applies if what's beneath the armor is human.'""

1489224183.m_KeyValue: ""'Does that really sound plausible?' Nicole followed behind at a measured pace, her gaze narrowing into the mist where the voice had come from.""

1489224184.m_KeyValue: ""'That's impossible...' She scanned their surroundings, eyes searching through the mist-laced forest. 'If he'd done anything, the mist would've caught it.'""

1489224185.m_KeyValue: ""Before Gadric could finish, a sudden splash echoed through the steam. A new figure appeared in the spring beside him—could this be the _$$unexpected guest_$$ he was just about to mention?""

1489224186.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, if you're asking about that...' Gadric let out a quiet sigh of relief. Clearly, being overheard talking to himself just now had unsettled him more than the idea of exposing his face.""

1489224187.m_KeyValue: ""'Huh? Where did he go...' Nicole stood up in the hot spring, turning to scan the mist for any sign of Gadric. Droplets slid down her body, vanishing into the thick mist.""

1489224188.m_KeyValue: ""'N-No... something's wrong... I can't...' Before he could finish, his vision blurred. Darkness swallowed the edges of his vision... and then everything.""

1489224193.m_KeyValue: "'Who knows. Maybe this thing holds a clue.' Darcias picked up the alchemical device..."

1489224194.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on. With the excess weeds cleared by Halfway to the Underworld, a second, strangely familiar figure was revealed crouching in the vegetable patch. Is that... another Gadric?""

1489295101.m_KeyValue: ""Ignoring the chatter of the other three, Goldland plonked himself down right where he stood. 'My magnificent golden body is upside down like a topsy-turvy turnip! This is absolutely, positively not beautiful! I simply cannot tolerate such an affront to aesthetics!'""

1489295102.m_KeyValue: ""Suddenly, the breeze fell silent. In that split second, one man seized his moment to act!""

1489295103.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing lapsed into silence. After a moment, he picked up the golden fishing rod and walked away, but not before leaving them with one last declaration: 'Never underestimate a man's determination!'""

1489295105.m_KeyValue: ""'...Wait, what? I'm paying rent? But I'm Empousa's...' Noah trailed off, then frowned. 'Hold on, why is Bella collecting rent anyway? Isn't this Bathory's castle?'""

1489295106.m_KeyValue: "'The competition is utterly irrelevant! The pearl that the Church seeks is hidden in this very fishing village. That's why I'm really here! And if my guess is correct—'"

1489295107.m_KeyValue: "Cain was about to agree when he caught Noah's subtle movement. 'Sure thing—wait a second. Hand over that Seafood Tycoon Pearl you're hiding first!'"

1489295108.m_KeyValue: "'Power without effort? Such a convenient thing doesn't exist in this world.' Noah's stern gaze made the others look away in shame."

1489297271.m_KeyValue: "'Ladies and gentlemen!' Acappella threw her hands up excitedly. 'Let the first-ever Sandy Fish-skin Ball Championship begin!'"

1489297272.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh my, this is getting interesting!' Acappella clapped her hands and turned to Lamia excitedly. 'I'm finally starting to look forward to this game.'""

1489297277.m_KeyValue: ""'Save your excuses!' Lamia violently waved her hand to cut off Tris. 'If it weren't for the Church, the Bathory family wouldn't have...' Her voice trailed off.""

1489297278.m_KeyValue: "'Huh? I didn't do anything!' Empousa jumped out. 'Don't let her size fool you—she's a genuine Bell Ringer from the Church!'"

1489297279.m_KeyValue: ""'Tch, look who's dawdling now...' Lamia followed Empousa toward the castle gates. 'But... what's the point of going to that wretched fishing village anyway?'""

1489297280.m_KeyValue: ""Before she could finish her thought, Acappella's voice suddenly rang out from behind her. 'My, my, what gossip is our Commander spreading now?'""

1489297281.m_KeyValue: ""'So it should be something like this...' Empousa took the fish-skin ball from Acappella, tossed it into the air, and as it fell, she hit it upward. 'One...'""

1489297282.m_KeyValue: ""'The first rule is simple: you score a point by landing the ball in the opponent's court. If it goes out of bounds, the point goes to the other team.'""

1489297283.m_KeyValue: "'Ta-da! It's done—a ball made of fish skin!' Acappella took the ball from Tris's hands and gave it a test bounce into the air."

1489300413.m_KeyValue: ""'You really don't let things go, do you?'""

1489300414.m_KeyValue: "'A race needs a prize. How about… the winner gets to ask the loser one question?'"

1489300415.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, sometimes a man does just want to watch the sea.""

1489300416.m_KeyValue: "An unexpected voice cut off Noah's communion with the sea."

1489300417.m_KeyValue: ""'I feel the same, though I'd enjoy it more if I won next time.'""

1489300419.m_KeyValue: ""And right out the gate, Agares surged ahead—pulling half a body's length in front of Noah!""

1489300420.m_KeyValue: "'Huh? And just where did you come from?'"

1489302585.m_KeyValue: "'Ah...!' Lamia immediately picked up the parchment. 'This is...'"

1489302589.m_KeyValue: ""With a sweep of her hands, Empousa commanded crimson flowers to surge across the court toward the opposite side of the net, spreading like a red carpet. 'Now, go—!'""

1489302591.m_KeyValue: ""'You might not be so lucky next time.' Though Tris delivered these words with a smile, they sent chills down everyone's spine.""

1489302592.m_KeyValue: ""Unusually, Lamia didn't argue back. '...Let's not dwell on this. There are more pressing matters at hand.'""

1489302593.m_KeyValue: ""As if by chance, the moment the seabird landed, a fierce look sparked in the eyes of those standing on either side of the nets—the unmistakable stance of those ready for competition.""

1489302594.m_KeyValue: ""'So... what shall we do about this, Acappella?' Tris turned to Acappella with a smile, seemingly unconcerned about the rapidly approaching fish-skin ball.""

1489302595.m_KeyValue: ""Tris nodded with a smile before lightning suddenly crackled across her body. She leaped gracefully—and in a flash, accompanied by rolling thunder, she vanished from where she stood.""

1489302596.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Lamia struck, Acappella extended one hand toward the ball, fingers positioned like a gun. 'Now bounce back!'""

1490754692.m_KeyValue: "Could there be more to this than just the contest? Hati's mind raced with speculation."

1490754693.m_KeyValue: ""'He didn't tell you anything about it?' Gadric asked, his chewing coming to an abrupt halt.""

1490754694.m_KeyValue: ""'Could it be that our father won?' Hati reasoned that since he mentioned it in front of them, the chances of her father winning must be quite high.""

1492196076.m_KeyValue: ""The village's best doctor claimed she had found a way to fight against Death, and needed everyone's help, but—""

1492196077.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother said that since ancient times, our family has resided on this isolated island alongside the Calamity known as Death.""

1492196078.m_KeyValue: "That's all I know... The story from 66 years ago that my grandmother told me..."

1492196079.m_KeyValue: ""But that was from 66 years ago... It's not surprising that you haven't heard about it, Noah...""

1492196080.m_KeyValue: ""The terrifying appearance, the inescapable whispers... just like the previous 'Calamities' I've encountered...""

1492196082.m_KeyValue: "I told you these tricks won't work against... Wha?!"

1492196083.m_KeyValue: "Think of happy thoughts! Remember your grandmother!"

1492196107.m_KeyValue: ""What's going on... Piera, why'd you hit me?""

1492196108.m_KeyValue: "I have. One of them said she was heading to the village and would wait for you there."

1492196110.m_KeyValue: "Piera... you contacted the Church? When did you...?"

1492196111.m_KeyValue: ""...Hah, look at you now... What a sorry sight...""

1492196372.m_KeyValue: "Seems I was right. They all bear markings on their bodies—some kind of symbol."

1492196402.m_KeyValue: "But they were trying to kill us moments ago."

1492196404.m_KeyValue: "...'The location of the next Moonblessed and the home of the silver-haired heretic lie toward the sunset.' That's what Cain said."

1492196409.m_KeyValue: "Those crabs have the advantage on this coastal terrain. Let's head inland first. There's also something I want to check on the way."

1492196437.m_KeyValue: "I'm just... used to being alone. I don't know what to say..."

1492196441.m_KeyValue: "Then that figure I saw... was it my imagination?"

1492196466.m_KeyValue: "She appeared... not long after you left..."

1492196467.m_KeyValue: ""Hah... Hahaha... Oh, you'll remember eventually. You'll remember everything.""

1492196469.m_KeyValue: ""If we get separated again, this gesture will be our way of telling it's the real us.""

1492196472.m_KeyValue: ""You doomed us all! You should be the one rotting in the ground, Noah Nevernight!""

1492196498.m_KeyValue: "I thought they were just wild beasts."

1492196499.m_KeyValue: ""Look, if you come across creatures like the ones we just dispatched, don't waste your time on them.""

1492196504.m_KeyValue: ""For the past 66 years, Death has been sealed beneath the cathedral. It's impossible for him to escape on his own.""

1492196505.m_KeyValue: ""That is the will of Aeon, perhaps?""

1492196532.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, I need to know—what exactly is inside that coffin you're carrying?""

1492196533.m_KeyValue: ""But that's not necessarily a bad thing, right, Noah? It means you've come to the right place... This is your 'homeland'—""

1492196534.m_KeyValue: ""How utterly despicable, Nevernight. You think you can wash away all your sins just by pretending to not remember?""

1492196535.m_KeyValue: "'Behind every frightful specter lies a soul that someone else misses dearly.'"

1492196536.m_KeyValue: ""O-Oh, I see... Noah, you're... really perceptive, aren't you...""

1492196560.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it's just one of many theories. I have no means to prove it though.""

1492196562.m_KeyValue: "We're being attacked by Blood Beasts. You can't see them?"

1492196563.m_KeyValue: ""Memories? But I don't have any memories of them. Wait, does that mean...""

1492196564.m_KeyValue: ""I want so badly to tell Grandmother, to tell everyone on the island... 'I'm Piera... I've come home today...'""

1492196565.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, are you... the type to get hung up on these philosophical questions?""

1492196566.m_KeyValue: ""It seems you've met the Gravekeepers from other families... haven't you, Noah...?""

1492196567.m_KeyValue: ""No, that's also one of the reasons. I nearly lost my life, and more importantly, I lost all my memories...""

1492196569.m_KeyValue: "That's because I've experienced this type of phenomenon twice before."

1492813908.m_KeyValue: "Only I remain absolutely loyal to the Bathory family!"

1492813910.m_KeyValue: ""The promised home on the far side of the moon, or the descent of the Blood Moon? Which dream is the real one?""

1492813940.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, I actually have a name. When I first awoke, I gave myself a beautiful name...""

1492813941.m_KeyValue: ""I merely said these cards aren't what you're looking for. I never said it wasn't in my possession, did I?""

1492813942.m_KeyValue: ""The reversed 'Moon'... unease and deception. As if you're flying towards the dream you seek—the far side of the moon. Beautiful, but is it truly real?""

1492813943.m_KeyValue: "I've thought it through. Now is not the time."

1492814204.m_KeyValue: ""No past, no future, not even a name. We are the forgotten ones, known only by a number.""

1492814205.m_KeyValue: "I'm No. 66! You got both digits wrong! And who are you calling a fool?!"

1492814206.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, you can't fool me. You remembered that No. 18 escaped three days ago, and you deliberately misnumbered No. 34, who was the first to die...""

1492814207.m_KeyValue: "Why are you getting all fired up? Remember our goal is to get out of here."

1492814237.m_KeyValue: "And with that prophetic image on the card... It feels like someone's watching our every move."

1492814239.m_KeyValue: "Is it it bad to say that it's fortunate we didn't team up with her?"

1492814268.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how they will surprise us next. I can't wait."

1492814270.m_KeyValue: ""But aren't you curious? There are so many things you don't know about yourself, waiting to be discovered.""

1492814300.m_KeyValue: ""You have a point. Okay, two friends... I will count that as 10 million Soli. Take this card and be on your way.""

1492814301.m_KeyValue: "Kill me instead! Don't you dare harm her!"

1492814303.m_KeyValue: ""Shame... In the end, only one can remain. Or perhaps, none at all.""

1492814305.m_KeyValue: ""How do you distinguish between humans and puppets, if I may ask?""

1492814306.m_KeyValue: ""I may look cute, but I'm also an Elder of the Bathory family.""

1492814336.m_KeyValue: ""You're right. So I've been thinking, even if we manage to escape, will it really change anything?""

1492814337.m_KeyValue: "I... I don't want to face the unknown alone. Even if it's a lie... even if it's for just a moment... could you... could you continue to walk with me?"

1492814338.m_KeyValue: ""If... if I die, you must live on, for both of us...""

1492814369.m_KeyValue: "My name. Didn't you ask for my name?"

1492814370.m_KeyValue: "Are you willing to die in her place?"

1492814371.m_KeyValue: "Are you one of that puppet's companions?"

1492814400.m_KeyValue: "I was just thinking how wonderful it is to be on this journey with you!"

1492814402.m_KeyValue: ""And there are some unsettling figures here—first puppets, then statues, and now armored suits?""

1492814403.m_KeyValue: "The gate stands open. I await you here."

1494029702.m_KeyValue: "Can you see it? The wine in my hand... a toast to this foolish world."

1494029768.m_KeyValue: ""Come, taste the bitterness of this forbidden fruit.""

1494032808.m_KeyValue: "Self: It's time for me to repay you."

1494032901.m_KeyValue: "Puppet: It's common sense to wear gloves when handling valuables!"

1494032967.m_KeyValue:
""Puppet: Sorry, we only have one item in stock.
Real self: And that's death.""

1494038398.m_KeyValue: "Is this... some kind of ritual to establish a connection of memories?"

1494038495.m_KeyValue: ""I see, so this is the true power of blood.""

1494040448.m_KeyValue: "...Do I need to personally teach you a lesson about manners?"

1494042746.m_KeyValue: "Are you interested in archery? I can teach you."

1494042843.m_KeyValue: ""With the power of focus, I shall not fear even the most numerous foes.""

1494043647.m_KeyValue: ""The purpose of a defender is to exhaust the attacker's strength, while your purpose is to crush the enemy.""

1494043678.m_KeyValue: "I entrust my life to my shield!"

1494043837.m_KeyValue: "I shall stand here and repel any foe that dares approach."

1494044796.m_KeyValue: "You truly have no fear of idle gossip."

1494045945.m_KeyValue: "This is not the time for games."

1494046011.m_KeyValue: ""Guide the stars of the past, bathe in the moonlight of yesteryear.""

1494047995.m_KeyValue: "Is this how you greet people back home?"

1494048026.m_KeyValue: "So you need me to protect you after all?"

1494098949.m_KeyValue: ""'On second thought, forget it,' Empousa said, waving her hand dismissively. 'I couldn't care less about all that war stuff anyway.'""

1494098950.m_KeyValue: ""'Tell us! Tell us!' Hati suddenly leaned in, then realized this matter wasn't as glorious as Empousa had made it out to be.""

1494098951.m_KeyValue: "Jestel let out a heavy sigh. 'But the Ganelon family is no more. We can't allow that chapter of history to simply fade into oblivion.'"

1494574266.m_KeyValue: "The Blackblood Tree will execute any character whose HP falls below 30%."

1495382973.m_KeyValue: ""This could affect her entire year. If possible, I'd rather not trouble her over something like this.""

1495382974.m_KeyValue: "Now let's see if you can change such a small thing after knowing this _$$future_$$ in advance."

1495382977.m_KeyValue: "I'll have to thank Mary for that. I remember her—she lives in the village outside the castle."

1495382978.m_KeyValue: "Her apples are some of the sweetest blood substitutes for the Bloodborn."

1495382979.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm not mistaken, Cain also uses her grapes to make wine.""

1495382980.m_KeyValue: ""Over the next few days, she was so devoted to taking care of your injuries that she missed the perfect timing for the grape harvest.""

1496419660.m_KeyValue: ""One of the Bloodborn's surviving elders, also the youngest one. He seems to have some connection to the Cidhall family.""

1496419687.m_KeyValue: ""Clive's son, and sibling to Hati, currently traversing his defiant phase.""

1496569023.m_KeyValue: ""'You're always caught up with matters on the Isle, yet you never make time for yourself.'""

1496569028.m_KeyValue: "'I want to... tend to your wounds.'"

1496640927.m_KeyValue: "Upgrading skill levels also increases a Vassal's Blood Power."

1496640993.m_KeyValue: "Collect all memory fragments to receive rewards."

1500709018.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, Acappella can now start a new life with the other children in the choir.""

1500709019.m_KeyValue: "Acappella's adoption papers... the Church approved it?"

1500709020.m_KeyValue: ""The choir takes these children in, and as the Commander, I naturally bear the responsibility of raising them.""

1500709021.m_KeyValue: "You truly meant it when you called them 'children.'"

1500709022.m_KeyValue: ""At Tris's invitation, I attended the hymn recital at the church. Acappella, that young girl, proved to be truly gifted—her performance was met with thunderous applause.""

1500709025.m_KeyValue: ""After the performance, Tris approached me with a smile, her eyes sparkling with joy.""

1500709030.m_KeyValue: ""As I executed more heretics, I came to realize that most of their children were innocent... A child shouldn't suffer for their parents' sins.""

1500709031.m_KeyValue: "It all began with a moment of mercy during a heretic's execution—that's when I brought Anna back with me."

1501939771.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that this Celestial God has powerful talons and wings. During the fall of the celestial realm, they single-handedly rescued Gods trapped in the Nether Void and bravely vanquished any form of threat, thus becoming the scout and guardian of the celestial realm in one fell swoop. Those under the protection of this Celestial God are endowed with a fearless spirit.""

1502129001.m_KeyValue: "Joan's power is spiraling out of control. There's so much more I need to prepare now."

""Wait a minute, isn't this ledger showing up around me too frequently to be coincidence? Well, let me see what's written inside this time, anyway:

1510933912.m_KeyValue:
""For a long time after, no song came from the Siren's Tear. Then one day, I accidentally spilled wine on it—the pooled surface shimmered with a vision:

A maiden held a letter from the north, pressed close to her heart.

It spoke of the biting chill of those distant lands, so unlike the warm summers of Sapphire Isle; Of dry mornings with wind carrying grains of sand; Of being well—her moments of awakening growing longer.

She had read the letter countless times, clinging to it through long days of captivity and pain, holding fast to the hope of reunion.""

1510933970.m_KeyValue:
""What was it Quinn had said? A way to walk in sunlight?

The last time I felt the sun on my skin, I needed Sapphire Isle's alchemical shield just to survive it.

Though the Bloodborn were granted eternity, the light cast us out. The sun turned us into ghosts on our own land.

For me, maybe it doesn't matter anymore. But to many of our kind, sunlight is the one thing they still long for.

Quinn knew that. And that's what makes her promise so dangerous.""

1510934036.m_KeyValue:
""My hunger for life compels me to drag this shattered frame forward, endlessly seeking herbs that might break my curse. My defiance of death forces these weary eyes to remain vigilant, endlessly battling the poison that seeps through my consciousness.

They all believe this dying child has surrendered his sanity to madness. But I can no longer spare thought for their stares and whispers—this disease wages war against the soul that is rightfully mine.

I feel the exquisite agony of ripped sinew, I taste the invisible hands, suffocating my throat... The hourglass empties. Time bleeds.

But yield I will not.""

1510934284.m_KeyValue:
""The world knows the 'Manor of Eternal Flame' as an intricate web of deception spun by Carrelle royalty. Yet only today, inhabiting the knight's form within Genevieve's memories, do I truly witness the genesis of this grand conspiracy.

The princess's day unfolds like an endless battlefield—dawn breaks with equestrian drills, midday is spent on tactical studies, and twilight brings political lessons. Every merciless hour of this regimen serves one sacred purpose: the salvation of Carrelle lands devoured by the flames of war.

In political class, the atmosphere thickens to a suffocating weight as the bishop delivers his calculated torment: 'Your Highness, envision the borders erupting in warfare. Would you levy crushing taxes upon your people to fund our armies, condemning millions to starvation? Or would you empty the royal granaries to feed the masses while watching the Kingdom crumble to ash? As future Lord, what is your choice?'

The realization strikes like lightning—this is Carrelle family's merciless probe of its heir. I surge to my feet, steel singing as my blade finds the bishop's throat, declaring his crimes of 'defiance against the sovereign and sedition among the people.' Death has never touched him so intimately. His face drains to bone-white terror.

'Enough.' Genevieve's touch guides my sword aside with gentle authority, her gaze turning toward the bishop with eyes that dance with dark amusement: 'Sir, the burden you and Father bear is not lost on me. In these precarious times, we all must navigate our own treacherous paths and impossible choices.'

In that crystalline moment, I glimpse the mastermind's satisfaction as she watches her carefully placed pieces align upon the board.""

""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Dusk Castle
<style=""InfoText"">The night deepens as the moon cries resoundingly. As the castle stands alone, it lies forever within the moon's embrace.
• From here you may enter rooms with varying functions.
• Some rooms have been sealed for ages and need to be unlocked with a key, which can be obtained by advancing Threads of Fate.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Observatory
<style=""InfoText"">The arrangement and movements of the stars are no mere coincidence; they signify cycles of cause and effect on the continent.
• Utilize Prophecy Inscriptions to unlock constellations and observe their Stars for bonuses.
• Advance Threads of Fate to uncover clues about Prophecy Inscriptions and explore the map to locate them.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hall of Honor
<style=""InfoText"">Your honor transforms into blessings for the future.
• Complete Achievements to earn Medals of Prestige. Accumulate these medals to upgrade your Hall of Honor Level.
• Upgrading the Hall unlocks honorary statues and rewards, some of which provide permanent bonuses.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Ritual Chamber
<style=""InfoText"">This ancient soul-alchemy ritual sacrifices souls of similar quality to extract potent Ancestral Power from them.
• The Ritual Chamber can enhance Vassals' attributes universally.
• All Ritual level caps are limited by Bloodline Transfusion Levels.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Moonlight Tribute
<style=""InfoText"">Moonlight Tribute is an essential ritual that the Bathory family must observe.
• For every 5 stages cleared in Normal Mode or Hard Mode in Threads of Fate, Moonlight Faith increases by 1 level. As Moonlight Faith increases, so do Tribute yields.
• You can perform a limited number of Extra Sermons each day. Through Extra Sermon, you will immediately gain basic resources and random item rewards equal to 2 hours of ritual time.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Wilderness Expedition
<style=""InfoText"">Most Bloodborn follow the tenet of Secrecy, but should they truly wish to restore their past glory, Lords must dispatch Vassals to explore the continent for lost treasures.
• Different expeditions require Vassals of different factions and rarities.
• Higher-star expeditions require longer completion times and higher-rarity Vassals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Starlit Memoir
<style=""InfoText"">On moonlit nights, Vassals venture outside the castle walls and play in the surrounding areas. It is here where little stories often unfold.
• Each story requires Candles to access. Candles represent the number of stories available this week.
• Earn a reward for completing each Memoir.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Council Chamber
<style=""InfoText"">The ancient castle is a place of intrigue, where Lords gather with their confidants to discuss topics such as internal affairs, diplomatic plans, or personal matters.
• Every day, Lords will randomly receive topics of discussion. Lords can choose which topics to discuss based on their own preferences.
• Each Vassal that participates in the meeting gains Affinity.""

1531973250.m_KeyValue:
""Duke it out with other Lords in Best-of-3 matches.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Season
<style=""InfoText"">• A season consists of both an Engagement and Armistice period. The Engagement period lasts for 13 days, while the Armistice lasts for 1 day.
• If you initiate an attack and win, you will switch rankings with your opponent. If you are attacked and fail to defend, you will also switch rankings with your opponent.
• At the end of each season, the Etched Keystone (Crucible Points) will be reset.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Challenge</style>
<style=""InfoText"">• Select an opponent you want to challenge from the Opponent List.
• You will only be matched against higher-ranking players.
• You have 2 free challenge attempts per day.
• Once your free attempts are used up, you may use Crucible Passes to engage in more battles.
• A challenge consists of a Preparation Phase and a Battle Phase.
• If you quit or time out during the Preparation Phase, the challenge will end and no attempts will be consumed.
• If you time out during the Battle Phase, it will be considered a failure (each of the 3 battles is independently timed).

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Defense Team
<style=""InfoText"">Tap _$$Edit Team_$$ to deploy your lineup. When challenged by other Lords, your Defense Team will defend your glory. You must build 3 teams, ensuring that each team contains 5 Vassals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Offense Team
<style=""InfoText"">You may build your Offense Team after selecting an opponent and entering battle.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Winning Conditions
<style=""InfoText"">The team that eliminates the other team first wins. Should the two teams be eliminated at the same time, the attacker wins. If you time out during the Battle Phase, it will be considered a failure (each of the 3 battles is independently timed).

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Winning the battle earns you rewards.
• After a season ends, season ranking rewards will be issued via Mail.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hourly Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Hourly idle rewards vary based on your rank; the higher the rank, the greater the rewards, with a maximum of 24 hours of idle earnings.
• Idle rewards also include Points, so achieving a higher rank can help you earn more Points, allowing you to secure a top spot on the Point Rank!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Battle
<style=""InfoText"">• When Quick Battle is enabled, battle results will be displayed directly.
• Use the Replay function to watch the battle again (may not be 100% accurate).""

1531973253.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Truth's Odyssey
<style=""InfoText"">• Set off on a journey to solve various contingencies and discover the wonders of enlightenment.
• All progress in this mode will reset daily at a specified time.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Embark
<style=""InfoText"">• Choose your preferred difficulty and Chamber.
• Chambers will be gradually unlocked by clearing [Threads of Fate].
• Each Chamber contains 3 difficulties. A new difficulty unlocks upon a successful challenge of the previous one.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※Chambers
<style=""InfoText"">• Each difficulty consists of multiple stages.
• For each stage, you can choose random or fixed Elements.
• These include Wind Elements, Earth Elements, Aether Elements, Water Elements, etc.
• After clearing all stages in one difficulty, you may claim rewards and proceed to the next.
• Clearance Rewards may only be obtained once per day.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Wind Elements
<style=""InfoText"">• Divided into three tiers: Wind Element I, Wind Element II, and Fire Element.
• Upon completing, you will gain Catalyst rewards.
• The higher the difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining High-Grade Catalysts.
• Vassals will not recover HP after each challenge.
• Enemy units also cannot recover HP should the stage remain incomplete.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Catalysts
<style=""InfoText"">• Provide special effects for Vassals participating in battle.
• However, Catalysts only apply to eligible targets.
• Catalysts are divided into four Grades: N, R, SR, and SSR. The strength of the effect increases with the Grade.
• The strength of Catalysts also increases with their Aspect Level.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Catalyst Aspects
<style=""InfoText"">• The Aspect Level will increase based on the number of Catalysts of the same Aspect type held.
• Catalysts are divided into 4 Aspects: Triangle, Diamond, Circle, and Square. Each Catalyst belongs to one of these Aspects.
• Catalyst Aspect Levels:
• LV1: Base state
• LV2: Hold 3 of the same Aspect type
• LV3: Hold 4 of the same Aspect type
• LV4: Hold 6 of the same Aspect type
• LV5: Hold 8 of the same Aspect type

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Aether Elements
<style=""InfoText"">• Triggers various Wonders, each providing different effects based on your selection.
• Effects will impact the status of Vassals and their Catalysts.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Water Elements
<style=""InfoText"">• You can choose to restore Vassal HP or revive Vassals.
• You must choose between restoration or revival.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※Stop
<style=""InfoText"">• You may end the Odyssey manually, or end through completion after clearing the final area.
• After the Odyssey ends, all progress will be reset.
• You can end the Odyssey at any time and come back to challenge it.""

1533535696.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood has transformed William into a beast driven purely by desire. Timidity and self-doubt are stripped away. Ranna is beckoning to him — and there, where the claws of fear can never reach, lies only the promise of eternal peace.""

1536551097.m_KeyValue: "Can you guess which words of yours made me change my mind?"

1536556346.m_KeyValue: ""Bella: Alright, I shall trust your judgment this time.""

1536558260.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, since they're saying you're one of the Moonblessed, I suppose I'll trust you this time!""

1536561459.m_KeyValue: ""Fine, I guess you have a point there.""

1536562352.m_KeyValue: "Is it still possible to change my mind?"

1536563373.m_KeyValue: ""I must admit, your argument has finally convinced me.""

1536565551.m_KeyValue: "It's nothing. I just wanted to see your smile."

1536568622.m_KeyValue: ""Upon consideration, your choice is indeed the more prudent course of action.""

1537089614.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the crabs and wild boars encroaching from behind."

1537600496.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. Though Black Blood failed to fully corrupt their mind, it also failed to grant them a powerful body. Bearing the blood of the Astolfo sages, killing is their sole meaning of existence.""

1537600504.m_KeyValue: ""Elite Knights who guard Sunset Isle. Unfortunately they have already began to crystallize. However, they hold fast to their posts, carrying out the orders of the Church in the last moments of their lives.""

1537600505.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us wisdom to endure the winter nights.'""

1537600506.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us grace to dwell alongside all living things.'""

1537600507.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. The Black Blood has twisted their flesh, leaving a thin, bat-like tail as a grim reminder.""

1537600508.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. Corrupted by Black Blood, their pale form barely recalls the past. Devoid of thought, they fight on—for blood, for their masters.""

1537600509.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn, their form warped by Black Blood. Devoid of thought, they stand guard with the only mercy from their masters—a beast-bone shield.""

1537600510.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. Body twisted, mind consumed by blood and flesh. Devoid of thought, their master's commands are everything—except, perhaps, the bone stiletto in their hand.""

1537600511.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. This Blood Beast forsakes their old form to submit to Black Blood. The glory of the Astolfo family is their sole anchor to sanity, driving them forward, even toward death.""

1537600562.m_KeyValue: ""The Full Moon burns the Black Blood within their bodies, muscles swelling like lava bursting from rock. They bite at their own flesh, seeking only to end the agony of being consumed by Black Blood.""

1537600563.m_KeyValue: ""Ganelon soldiers never question right from wrong, but simply obey orders out of habit. It is this blind compliance that makes them part of evil's plan.""

1537600568.m_KeyValue: ""A spirit reborn as an exquisite doll, her innocence steeped in blood. Beneath her mantle, hundreds of hands writhe in secret—her collection curated to preserve 'family harmony.' She is the queen of puppets, Sirene.""

1537600569.m_KeyValue: ""A peasant residing in Mouret. Invaders turned him into a raging monster, and the blood-covered scythe in hand is a testament to his brutality.""

1537600570.m_KeyValue: ""A schemer cloaked in a commander's mantle, twisting his kin into instruments of war with plague. With a cold smile, he cleanses the blood upon his late sister's relic, murmuring: 'The worth of death lies in stoking the fires of hatred.' This serpent of Ganelon shall one day devour his own homeland.""

1537600571.m_KeyValue: ""When stone wings shielded the girl one final time, shackles dissolved into drifting petals. Even as his spirit faded, his purpose endured—he fought, he stood firm, he protected. He is Michelangelo.""

1537600572.m_KeyValue: ""A shadow crouched in the cave's depths, using twisted claws to dig out underground springs. After pushing the last half-bowl of water to a child, it sank completely into the abyss.""

1537600573.m_KeyValue: ""Their claws rake against the stone walls, the protective amulet from home hanging around the neck. Festering flesh weeps Black Blood, and in the eyes lingers a desperate glimmer of pleading.""

1537600574.m_KeyValue: "A hunter residing in Mouret. Their archery skills retain deadly precision against the invaders."

1537600575.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer from Mouret, who even without any proper weapon, still grips a pitchfork with unwavering resolve, sworn to defend this land until the final breath.""

1537600592.m_KeyValue: ""The current Gravekeeper of the Ganelon lineage, he lost his sanity and underwent mutation due to the spread of the Black Blood. He awaits in silence for the designated one's arrival.""

1537600593.m_KeyValue: ""The eldest of the Bathory family, and armor to the arrogant and cruel Bloodborn. Despite his proud demeanor, he isn't immune to the ravages of time.""

1537600600.m_KeyValue: "The Heretic Hunters of the Church who stare death in the face. They know well that even their baptism before the crusade could not change their inevitable fate. Their chainmail clangs like a bell rung at their own funeral."

1537600601.m_KeyValue: ""The Heretic Hunters of the Church who stare death in the face. They know well that even their baptism before the crusade could not change their inevitable fate. Their choice is both a solemn vow, and a final tribute to their faith.""

1537600602.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to guard the prisoners.""

1537600603.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer residing near the Lupine Forest, stripped of their sanity yet retaining an unyielding devotion to safeguard their domain.""

1537600604.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to defend the castle.""

1537600605.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to repel the intruders.""

1537600607.m_KeyValue: "Jestel seems to know this person very well."

1537600667.m_KeyValue: ""One of many Spirit Bone Towers preserved in a salt coffin that are indestructible due to a fusion of blood and bones from the Paracelsus family. Like a massive piece of amber, the salt coffin perfectly preserves the remains within, seemingly rendering null the passage of time.""

1539868075.m_KeyValue: ""While I bear you no ill will, I am not here to answer your questions.""

1539868078.m_KeyValue: "Watch out! Those suits of armor are coming for us."

1539868107.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong, 79? Don't tell me you're thinking about going back again.""

1539868109.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, what a clever choice. As a reward, I'll do a Tarot reading for you—""

1539868110.m_KeyValue: "I just saw in you the image of a past friend. I remember she also gave herself a name..."

1539868111.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! Think about it. If we really made it to the far side of the moon, what would you say when the people there ask for your name?""

1539868371.m_KeyValue: ""'The more I chase, the further it gets from me.'""

1539868372.m_KeyValue: "There's nothing to be happy about... What's the point of living like this?"

1539868373.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, she's too reckless. Going with her... it's basically asking for death.""

1539868374.m_KeyValue: "I guess you'll do. Not like we have many options..."

1539868404.m_KeyValue: "This shape... it seems to match those grooves we saw."

1539868405.m_KeyValue: ""Look here, there are seven grooves. What could they represent?""

1539868435.m_KeyValue: ""I shouldn't have dismissed your ideas. I failed to realize that it could be your dream, too.""

1539868437.m_KeyValue: ""Well, we haven't found those two little puppets... might as well talk about something.""

1539868467.m_KeyValue: ""...that card, and a way out... as friends.""

1539868471.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, don't think we'll forget you're a puppet just because you hid them away!""

1539868472.m_KeyValue: ""Welcome to the stage I've prepared for you, foolish child, and naughty child.""

1539868503.m_KeyValue: "What are you talking about? We just found the second card!"

1539868505.m_KeyValue: "I can't shake the feeling that these statues are being manipulated by someone using the shadows."

1539868506.m_KeyValue: ""C'mon, let's go! I'm curious to see what we'll face next.""

1539868535.m_KeyValue: "But I lack her overzealous curiosity for these trials. I'm just doing my job here."

1539868536.m_KeyValue: "Forget it! We're escaping together. I'm not leaving you behind!"

1539868538.m_KeyValue: ""But we still have to push forward, right?""

1539868567.m_KeyValue: ""You used to always hide away, quiet and emotionless. But now...""

1539868569.m_KeyValue: "So this must be the abyss he mentioned?"

1539868570.m_KeyValue: ""This time, perhaps some souls will persevere to the depths below, and grant this old warrior an unexpected delight.""

1540746342.m_KeyValue: ""This time, there'll be no superiors to get in the way.""

1540746343.m_KeyValue: "So the report was true. A Bell Ringer's Vice-Commander is locked in a brutal fight."

1540746346.m_KeyValue: ""No, Lord Agares. Following you is our freedom!""

1540746347.m_KeyValue: ""I heard it—the heartbeats of my kin, the resonance of blood born of Dracula.""

1540747368.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing?! Don't tell me Bob couldn't even slow him down..."

1540747370.m_KeyValue: "What have I become… Who am I?"

1540747371.m_KeyValue: "He's more than his title. You won't be able to handle him."

1541571922.m_KeyValue: ""If Sirene has Dark Intentions, she will only use her Special and releases an additional shadowed spirit at a random enemy for each stack of Festering Desire she has.""

1541571923.m_KeyValue: ""Julius's Ultimate: Final strike now hits enemies in a line. After completing an Ultimate, if 3 stacks of 'Phantasm' are present, next Ultimate costs 2 less Bloodsoul.""

1542686034.m_KeyValue: ""A throwing knife left at the convergence of realms. In the endless war, of the weapons modified by Julius, even his blades were stained red with blood. In another life, does he feel but a trace of fatigue from this never-ending slaughter?""

1542686035.m_KeyValue: ""A Blood-Smeared Cloak, left at the convergence of realms. The scorch marks and bloodstains on the cloak tell tales of a brutal Holy War. In that place where she stands undefeated on the battlefield, does she ever long for peace?""

1542686036.m_KeyValue: ""An ritual artifact left at the convergence of realms. This ancient wooden totem harbors the tempest's might, able to destroy all things. In that life, when she claimed the continent as the Scourge, throngs would kneel with this totem in hand, pleading for her protection.""

1542686037.m_KeyValue: ""A wing made of silver, left at the convergence of realms. Complex alchemical markings adorn these wings, every feather sharp enough to cut. In that life, might she don these forged wings and ascend, step by step, to the pinnacle of the Church?""

1542791663.m_KeyValue: "Enough. I care nothing for the 'real' her."

1542791664.m_KeyValue: ""My apologies for disturbing your devotions, Warden.""

1542791665.m_KeyValue: "This is what you have always longed for."

1542791666.m_KeyValue: ""In my 'execution grounds,' I command the 'ignition point' of all things...""

1542791667.m_KeyValue: "They are proof that I once lived."

1542859250.m_KeyValue: ""A Blood-Smeared Cloak, left at the convergence of realms. The scorch marks and bloodstains on the cloak tell tales of a brutal Holy War. In that place where she stands undefeated on the battlefield, does she ever long for peace?""

1542859251.m_KeyValue: ""A throwing knife left at the convergence of realms. In the endless war, of the weapons modified by Julius, even his blades were stained red with blood. In another life, does he feel but a trace of fatigue from this never-ending slaughter?""

1542859252.m_KeyValue: ""A wing made of silver, left at the convergence of realms. Complex alchemical markings adorn these wings, every feather sharp enough to cut. In that life, might she don these forged wings and ascend, step by step, to the pinnacle of the Church?""

1542859253.m_KeyValue: ""A ritual artifact left at the convergence of realms. This ancient wooden totem harbors the tempest's might, able to destroy all things. In that life, when she claimed the continent as the Scourge, throngs would kneel with this totem in hand, pleading for her protection.""

1544083318.m_KeyValue: "It seems your 'comfort work' with the Warden last night proved profitable."

1544083320.m_KeyValue: ""This wing holds the worst of them—the truly dangerous. They could riot without warning. Yet curiously, it’s the quietest place in the prison.""

1544083321.m_KeyValue: ""So there it is—my life, laid bare. What do you make of it, my favorite prisoner? Hmm? What's with the silence? You're not one to startle so easily.""

1544193094.m_KeyValue: ""No, there are more important matters that need your attention, Aiona.""

1544193095.m_KeyValue: "I believe they'll definitely move the slaves near the auction house by then."

1544193097.m_KeyValue: ""Right... after all, he's the one who failed to look after his own disciple.""

1544193124.m_KeyValue: "Why can't I remember... anything from my past? My head hurts..."

1544193126.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose you haven't had a proper look around, right? Come—let me show you. Think of it as a little vacation.""

1544193150.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't be afraid, Averdin said he would protect us.'""

1544193157.m_KeyValue: ""Relying on me is convenient, isn’t it? But Miss Ami also needs someone in her corner.""

1544193158.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Lorelei knows where the Mistbound Terror is? Please, you have to tell us!""

1544193159.m_KeyValue: "It’s Lord Thoreau! He's overseeing the selection himself!"

1544193160.m_KeyValue: ""I can help you with your plan, but I need to know the answer.""

1544193161.m_KeyValue: ""And besides, if you were the one who did the killing, why investigate the so-called culprit? And why leave those sketches behind in your office?""

1544193162.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami should become the Eighth Sage!"

1544193163.m_KeyValue: "Guards! Escort Mr. Roland and me out of here."

1545410430.m_KeyValue: "θ-Blood Variant. Counters α-Blood Variant enemies (DMG +30% ); countered by β-Blood Variant enemies (DMG -20%)."

1545410431.m_KeyValue: "β-Blood Variant. Counters θ-Blood Variant enemies (DMG +30% ); countered by α-Blood Variant enemies (DMG -20%)."

1545410432.m_KeyValue: "α-Blood Variant. Counters β-Blood Variant enemies (DMG +30% ); countered by θ-Blood Variant enemies (DMG -20%)."

1545653996.m_KeyValue: ""Travel westward. Beyond lies another plain—though it lacks the gentle climate of these lands, it will serve to shelter you all.""

1545653998.m_KeyValue: "Oh my... Have I drifted off again...?"

1545653999.m_KeyValue: ""Forget the farmland—If we don't leave now, well... we'll be lucky to escape with our lives!""

1545654000.m_KeyValue: "The creatures in this valley alone who seek survival outnumber the stars themselves. Shall you tend to each and every one?"

1545654003.m_KeyValue: ""You never saw them afterwards, did you?""

1545949401.m_KeyValue: ""Under closer examination, I can see countless particles suspended inside...""

1545949402.m_KeyValue: ""Well, the notice on the bulletin board is clear enough—""

1545949403.m_KeyValue: ""Still, it's a blessing in disguise for the rest of us—the water runs pure again. Those wretches showed no reverence for water, the very wellspring of existence!""

1546501406.m_KeyValue: ""We have both been shaped by ritual, born into circumstances beyond our choosing.""

1546501407.m_KeyValue: ""Against his swift thrust, my legs feel leaden. Even pushing myself to the limit, I barely escape his opening strike.""

1546501408.m_KeyValue: ""He lifts his spear, the tip pointing straight at my brow.""

1546817157.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how Cain is doing with the ship preparations..."

1546817160.m_KeyValue: "The Church's ship has reached the target waters. Time to act."

1548524043.m_KeyValue: ""This is the Land of No Return... A moment of absolute stillness, conjured by my Covenant, beyond the reach of time. No breath, no sound, no interference.""

1548524045.m_KeyValue: "There’s no need to worry. Even the Saint cannot hear us within the Land of No Return."

1548524047.m_KeyValue: ""Time is frozen, but only for a breath. Listen closely.""

1548524049.m_KeyValue: "And I know this as well. The eternity given to the Bell Ringers is nothing but a curse. Every choice we make is already inscribed in the will of Aeon."

1548524050.m_KeyValue: ""I know the claim. That the Divine Body is the seal that protects the world, and the Black Blood is the Calamity that destroys it. But that's not the truth.""

1548534930.m_KeyValue: "Oh—Doctor Ressa! That flower you were carrying earlier… was it from a secret admirer?"

1548534931.m_KeyValue: ""Don't frighten them, Piera. The guards already have enough to bear.""

1548534932.m_KeyValue: "Good. Because ordinary folk who meddle in the passage rites might find themselves stalked by spirits... Ones that never let go..."

1548534933.m_KeyValue: "Return... Return home... Return to where it all began..."

1548538129.m_KeyValue: "The Church. I'm going to the Church!"

1548538131.m_KeyValue: "So it exists... even beyond this island?"

1548538133.m_KeyValue: ""Leave the island? Since our ancestors settled here, no one's ever left Sunset Isle.""

1548538134.m_KeyValue: "There is a way! Just as Dr. Ressa once reached this place."

1548538135.m_KeyValue: "But only the Paracelsus main family knows the method. I'm sorry for keeping it from you."

1548538136.m_KeyValue: "Forget that! Who are you even going to find? Who else can save us!?"

1548540303.m_KeyValue: ""By this, you have cast doubt upon Aeon's eternity and betrayed the sacred truth of the Church.""

1548540304.m_KeyValue: "Is it heresy to seek one's own path rather than blindly follow doctrines?"

1548540305.m_KeyValue: ""Even through these years of silence, you remain the indomitable clergy, Ressa Ambolia.""

1548540306.m_KeyValue: ""Yet your words just now reveal a grave sin. The Church upholds the order of time, and still, you leave the Church in search of eternity...""

1548540307.m_KeyValue: "I was wondering why the dreamfeeders grew so restless. A Bell Ringer has arrived on this island… Tris Tepes. That explains it."

1548540308.m_KeyValue: "I wondered as well—how anyone on this remote island could have bested my choristers."

1548540309.m_KeyValue: "If there was never an enemy... then did the eternity I crossed to the Other Side for ever truly exist?"

1548540310.m_KeyValue: "For eternity... So this is why you left the Church of your own accord?"

1548540311.m_KeyValue: "You always do this—shattering everything I've come to believe in over these three years on the island."

1548540312.m_KeyValue: "If _$$Death_$$ is not the enemy of life... then who is?"

1549988092.m_KeyValue: "Piera seemed to have been struggling with her illness for several more days."

1550088548.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes, you make me question my own beliefs.""

1550090722.m_KeyValue: "I have so many happy memories after meeting you..."

1550091557.m_KeyValue: "I'd love to keep you trapped in my mantle forever... Haha! Are you scared?"

1550093731.m_KeyValue: "I usually operate alone… but it seems we have potential."

1550093851.m_KeyValue: ""(I consulted Elder Bella about the organ. There are several available, but none in stock that meets Tris's requirement for 'perfect G minor resonance.')""

1550712287.m_KeyValue: ""In just these two days, I've faced two tragic souls.""

1552626359.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Are you the Mysterious Merchant I heard about?_$$
Lorelei stepped into the dark room—empty, at first glance. From behind the curtain, a low voice drifted forth, warning her that every piece of merchandise came with a price.
_$$As the finest merchant, the price I demand will always far exceed the value of these goods._$$
Lorelei nodded without a flicker of doubt. She was eight years old then, clutching three luminous pearls and seventy-five Soli saved from her stepfather. She was ready to give everything she had—no, more than that—for something others called impossible:
_$$I want my friend to stop being sick._$$
_$$So that one day… she might become the greatest musician who ever lived._$$""

1554144870.m_KeyValue: "The Last Summer on Sapphire Isle Redemption"

1554144875.m_KeyValue: "As Tears Fade Into the Sunset Redemption"

1554151217.m_KeyValue: ""Go, Captain. Teach William a lesson he won't forget. As for the others... leave them to me.""

1554151218.m_KeyValue: ""First Mate Bob, you're siding with sin and sentiment—shall I take this as your betrayal to our doctrine of truth?""

1554151219.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps one day, little Van Helsing, you will come to understand just how merciless the truth we once upheld truly is.""

1554151220.m_KeyValue: "But it is emotion that makes us human—without it..."

1554151221.m_KeyValue: "...what difference would there be between us and the Black Blood beasts we once hunted?"

1554151222.m_KeyValue: "Hey! What's....? This guy's aura is completely different from when he was picking fights earlier!"

1554151223.m_KeyValue: "And that weapon he just drew... it's a Future Artifact!"

1554151224.m_KeyValue: "Huh? The same kind lifeless eyes carries around? That oaf has something that dangerous too?"

1554151225.m_KeyValue: ""After all, First Mate Bob was once a Hunter of the Church. Or perhaps I should say...""

1554151226.m_KeyValue: "Former Eighth of the Silver Cross—Robert Lawrence."

1554165336.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... someone else has been murdered?"

1554165337.m_KeyValue: "Why's Captain Peacock so agitated? Did he drop one of his treasure chests?"

1563083723.m_KeyValue: ""The moment her words fall, the hall erupts into clamor.""

1563083724.m_KeyValue: ""Following the survivors, Seraphina is led to a castle perched on the cliff's edge.""

1564375378.m_KeyValue: "How did you come to be here as well?"

1564375379.m_KeyValue: ""If you wish to avoid a thorough thrashing, state your purpose here.""

1564375380.m_KeyValue: ""If you will not speak plainly, I have no objection to settling this by force.""

1564375384.m_KeyValue: "So you seek your enjoyments? Very well."

1565977422.m_KeyValue: ""She's right, I saw with my own eyes how the Tarot guided us to find the cochineal.""

1565977452.m_KeyValue: "They seem to have caught the scent of food and are in hot pursuit!"

1565977453.m_KeyValue: "I see! We need to wait for the bell!"

1565977716.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, was it something exciting? Were you being chased? Or ran into the wrong crowd?""

1565977718.m_KeyValue: "That's amazing! Do these mysterious phrases just come to you? What do they sound like when they appear? Is it a male cat or a female cat?"

1565977719.m_KeyValue: "There are more and more Blood Beasts. This isn't working... We need to get out of here."

1565977749.m_KeyValue: ""Is this... cypress? Hmm, it's a fine material for building ships. Wait, you mean...""

1565977782.m_KeyValue: "Strong and sturdy... an excellent base for a dugout canoe!"

1565977815.m_KeyValue: "The great Pontos II will set sail another day!"

1565977817.m_KeyValue: ""Shoot, Mother is looking for me. She won't let me come out to play with you. She says I'll get infected... I have to go now!""

1565977818.m_KeyValue: "Tomorrow? You still think there's going to be a tomorrow?"

1565977843.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes, I am the one Esmeralda spoke of. I will perform the final divination.""

1565977878.m_KeyValue: "Are you here looking for treasure as well?"

1565977880.m_KeyValue: "That cowardly 'Fool' has forgotten everything she taught her!"

1565977881.m_KeyValue: ""Esmeralda said that only a mystic who truly masters the power of the Tarot can draw the final card, bringing new hope to the incomplete spread...""

1565977911.m_KeyValue: ""Are you not? If not, why is this scene appearing before your eyes?""

1565977912.m_KeyValue: ""Silly cat, don't be sad. It's time to save everyone.""

1568881732.m_KeyValue: ""'Most people in this world are cunning. I wonder, did he perhaps conceal certain truths when recruiting workers?'""

1568881734.m_KeyValue: ""'But plants do not deceive. In this vast snowy expanse, lies will inevitably be scattered by the relentless winds.'""

1568881735.m_KeyValue: ""'While evil does exist in this world, I firmly believe that the majority are good at heart. Just like plants... some are poisonous while others can cure ailments.'""

1569574283.m_KeyValue: ""It fits heavy equipment, offering outstanding survival.""

1569919255.m_KeyValue: ""Since we cannot forestall a collapse, we must forge an existence that transgresses the bounds of history.""

1569919256.m_KeyValue: "That is precisely why I had you observe the other worlds—"

1569919257.m_KeyValue: ""If that's the case, how can you be sure this _$$world_$$ won't collapse at some predetermined moment, just like the previous ones?""

1569919258.m_KeyValue: ""Though history is riddled with countless coincidences, they all converge toward inevitable outcomes—be it my appearance, or the demise of others.""

1569919259.m_KeyValue: ""Inside here, you are able to glimpse your former self, no?""

1569919260.m_KeyValue: "Treasure it well. It represents my most perfect creation to date—the only place where observation won't get interrupted."

1569919261.m_KeyValue: ""You see, that was but one component required in my search. I never claimed it was the ultimate prize.""

1569919262.m_KeyValue: ""Inside the bottle, another world is contained, not the Aurum Perfectum you spoke of earlier.""

1572179102.m_KeyValue: "I've known since the beginning. Secretly saving Noah... seeking the Moonblessed who still believed in freedom..."

1572179103.m_KeyValue: ""I won't deny we share certain goals. But to say I serve them? No, no... that's not quite right.""

1572180120.m_KeyValue: ""I won't let you stop me again, Co—""

1572180121.m_KeyValue: "This is going to call for a lot of food after..."

1572180124.m_KeyValue: ""Leaving? But in every previous case, I only left when I died.""

1572180125.m_KeyValue: ""After a journey through memory, do you still define the present as _$$reality_$$?""

1572180126.m_KeyValue: ""Because of memory. Without others' memories, we cannot view the world from an omniscient mind.""

1572180127.m_KeyValue: ""When the memory vanishes? Be it our own, or the memories others hold of us.""

1572180129.m_KeyValue: "I possess no such power. I merely uncovered the truth."

1573117551.m_KeyValue: "I found your records in the family records. Quinn Baphomet—marked as a fugitive who harmed the clan."

1573117560.m_KeyValue: "So you stand with Father as well."

1573117561.m_KeyValue: "I had hoped you would be different from the others."

1573117562.m_KeyValue: "I see. Father has spoken to you."

1573117564.m_KeyValue: "What father? Is this just another lie to throw me off the scent?"

1573117565.m_KeyValue: "I thought you'd be different from them."

1573488655.m_KeyValue: ""Surely you don't expect me to track down the camp, clear out the monsters, and let you enjoy the fruits of my labor?""

1573488656.m_KeyValue: "Then it's simple. I'll head there and get rid of them."

1573488657.m_KeyValue: ""Without warmth, that large one will never wake.""

1573488658.m_KeyValue: "Is there any way we can save him?"

1574185140.m_KeyValue: "Yet none would dream… that we might stand as one."

1574185141.m_KeyValue: "Another troublesome affair… though not beyond reach."

1574185142.m_KeyValue: ""Mass Carrelle... No, I should call her by her true name—Genevieve Carrelle. An old companion of mine, a fugitive trapped in a temporal prison. Like you, she carries the same hunger to reach the end.""

1574185143.m_KeyValue: "The cruel irony: no common means will ever free you both from that temporal prison."

1574185144.m_KeyValue: "Genevieve entrusted this dagger to me before she vanished. She promised that within its steel lay all the answers I sought."

1574185145.m_KeyValue: ""It appears to be nothing more than an ordinary dagger, always worn around Genevieve's neck—yet she insists it belongs to me... How peculiar.""

1574185146.m_KeyValue: "Wait... the dagger—it's heating up... What's happening? Time itself is rewinding."

1574185147.m_KeyValue: ""Of countless fates, every one casts us as foes.""

1574185152.m_KeyValue: ""Since it's a temporal prison, it must follow the cycle of time. She can begin from the end, and I from the start. When our paths cross, the escape will be complete.""

1574185153.m_KeyValue: ""But at the beginning, all is unknown. Are you truly so certain you'll place your trust in a stranger who approaches without cause?""

1574646922.m_KeyValue: ""The Lupine Forest remained as peaceful as ever, even as everyone packed their belongings and prepared to set out.""

1574780312.m_KeyValue: "He... he came out of Colossus Max... and took Alene away..."

1575905453.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! Who do you think I am... Wait, why am I even taking orders from you!?""
