1577639264.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami who just checked in is from a branch of the wealthy Roland family. Please take extra care when attending to them."

1578006552.m_KeyValue: ""A junior monk of the Tempus Church, tasked with meting out punishment to those deviating from the Church's precepts. Their methods are notoriously brutal, often surpassing those deployed against heretics.""

1580600814.m_KeyValue: ""Without another word, Empousa dragged the other two out the door and made straight for Eye of God.""

1580600815.m_KeyValue: ""To my astonishment, I discovered that all we had been taught about it… was wrong.""

1580600816.m_KeyValue: ""'Aiona's studied astronomy since she was a child. When it comes to stargazing, few can match her.'""

1580600817.m_KeyValue: "Aiona let out a troubled sigh. 'There's been no real progress.'"

1580600818.m_KeyValue: ""'You could carry on her work. As long as someone continues her research, she won't be forgotten.'""

1580600820.m_KeyValue: ""Taking the previous journal pages in hand, Empousa began her own investigation.""

1580600821.m_KeyValue: "'Here—this looks like a letter from the author's friend.'"

1580601902.m_KeyValue: ""'_$$This is a calculated and theorized trajectory of the moon's movement. It may not be entirely precise, but I shall continue refining it._$$'""

1580601903.m_KeyValue: ""It was a densely packed entry, meticulously charting the moon's shifting phases over the course of a year.""

1580601904.m_KeyValue: "'This? Seriously? That's hideous!' Empousa gave a look of disgust."

1580771790.m_KeyValue: ""Genevieve's lines don't just leave her lips—they flow naturally, as if part of her very soul.""

1580771791.m_KeyValue: ""Mass stiffens at the words second lead. 'Quinn, I know you're the director and all,' she steps closer, 'but you don't have to remind me I'm the <style=""Highlight"">second lead</style> all the time!'""

1580771792.m_KeyValue: ""'Then seek them out! I, Genevieve, the <style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style>, leave them all in <color=#728c69>that place</color>.'""

1580771793.m_KeyValue: ""'Enough about mythical beasts.' Quinn twirls her parasol, letting the elegant canopy shimmer brilliantly.""

1580771794.m_KeyValue: ""'Because right now, you're... not quite <style=""Highlight"">perfect</style> yet. You're merely an ordinary <color=#728c69>Metamorph Dragon</color>.' Genevieve wiggles her finger teasingly.""

1580771796.m_KeyValue: ""Well, let's call it a close call that ended without major incident—for now, at least.""

1580771797.m_KeyValue: ""'If you desire it, go and find it! I, Genevieve, the <style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style>, left it all in...'""

1580773966.m_KeyValue: ""'...Tch, if we start fighting in front of this con artist, who knows when we'll be forced to buy things we'd never need,' Gilrain grumbled, his brows furrowed.""

1580773967.m_KeyValue: ""As his laugh erupted like thunder, he swung his axe to point at Gilrain. 'I see now... your true objective in joining the Bathory family was me all along!'""

1580773968.m_KeyValue: ""The absence of memories is one of Gilrain's deepest sorrows. Whether due to an unspeakable secret or a necessary sacrifice, he has lost all recollection of his former human life.""

1580773969.m_KeyValue: ""If he truly is just an empty shell without a soul... how does he differ from the shattered, stained piles of armor strewn across any battlefield? Can we still view 'him' as an existence? And perhaps more importantly—""

1580773973.m_KeyValue: ""Now, now, we did say the cat's background would be 'a complete mystery,' right? So naturally, its real name must be kept a secret.""

1580774926.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey Gilrain, looks like you're not feeling too well. But I've got just the thing—the latest product from the Puppet Association!'""

1580774927.m_KeyValue: ""He may be one of the four great elders, but it was just a cat after all! For the Grand Elder to be frolicking with a cat during a meeting—how undignified!""

1580774928.m_KeyValue: ""It wasn't until Bella solemnly interjected that everyone was jolted back to the reality: 'Well... while I couldn't quite grasp everything that was said, it seems the old-timer is suggesting that today's meeting has come to an end.'""

1580774929.m_KeyValue: ""Bella followed in Gilrain's wake, her mind already racing with ideas about which wares to peddle.""

1580774930.m_KeyValue: ""With a respectful nod to Baphomet, Gilrain and Bella stepped out of the way. Taking the lead, Baphomet walked with his back to the others, a faint smile playing across his aged visage—""

1580813140.m_KeyValue: "How did you even manage to fall like that?"

1580813166.m_KeyValue: ""'Waaah?!' Selena gasped in awe at the intricate mechanism, eyes wide as saucers as she peered into the narrow gap.""

1580813167.m_KeyValue: "Selena confidently shook off Bella's (four) hands. 'Hurry up! Silver-haired's waiting for us!'"

1580813168.m_KeyValue: "'I never imagined Selena would love grilled octopus so much.' The sun was already slipping into the sea as they stepped out of the Infernal Kitchen."

1580813169.m_KeyValue: ""Selena placed her hands on the doll-like beauty's cheeks, pulling the corners of her mouth outward, then squishing them back in. 'Th-this is... is... the Breath of Life!'""

1580813170.m_KeyValue: "'He probably just needed to wipe his hands.'"

1580813171.m_KeyValue: ""After a moment, Selena's tone wavered. 'F-Fine! I swear I'll pay you, Bella! Even if I haven't a single Soli to my name right now... (sobbing)!'""

1580813172.m_KeyValue: ""'About that first destination...' Bella glanced over her shoulder. 'According to the plan, we were to sail south from the Harbor of Soughs and reach the Dekatres Archipelago in two days.'""

1580813173.m_KeyValue: ""'If your body temperature's too low, then... then we'll have no choice but to rely on... h-human... w-warmth...' At that, Selena's face flushed red—though whether it was the blazing sun or something else entirely, no one could say.""

1580813178.m_KeyValue: ""Avoiding Selena's eyes, Bella turned her head slightly—and with two of her free hands, began performing her own version of the 'Breath of Life' on Selena's face. '...All right, then. Master Cook... Selena.'""

1580813179.m_KeyValue: ""'Dream Recipe?!' Selena perked up instantly, twisting upright with octopus-like agility to snatch the parchment.""

1580814258.m_KeyValue: ""'Fine! This is neither a product of alchemy nor any known magic in this world. It is something... unknown,' Cain unwillingly admitted.""

1580814259.m_KeyValue: ""'Within them, you will see the ideal version of yourself, and be mesmerized with self-adoration. But soon, horrifying things will begin to unfold.'""

1580814260.m_KeyValue: ""A chilling, otherworldly laugh emanated from the portrait. 'What makes you think I wouldn't?'""

1580814261.m_KeyValue: ""Cain replied with a smirk, 'Taking time to appreciate the fine arts after work is a way to discover new inspirations.'""

1580845842.m_KeyValue: ""A hush fell over the group. They began to fidget and cast their eyes about, clearly disinterested in the topic. After all, they had rehashed similar issues countless times before.""

1580845843.m_KeyValue: ""'What business is it of ours, and what blood conflicts do other families get into?' Gilrain scoffed. 'Do we even have the power to stick our noses in?'""

1580845844.m_KeyValue: ""'Now, now, let's all calm down. A good merchant never wants to drive away a potential customer.'""

1580845845.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet explains, 'The ancestral blood of the Roland family, the Horse, is equally elusive. They bury their dead wherever they please across the great plains.'""

1580851150.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Yes, my lady!_$$ With a flourish of her cloak and several distinct thuds, two bewildered figures tumble onto the garden grass.""

1580851151.m_KeyValue: ""_$$'Deny thy father and refuse thy name; or if thou wilt not, be but sworn my love, and I'll no longer be a Ganelon.'_$$""

1580851152.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Ganelon... an attack? Oh my, what a curious notion!_$$ Quinn blinks, then lets out a soft, amused laugh. _$$There's no Ganelon anywhere near these lands! Only dear Mother's peaceful Crowley Village!_$$""

1580851153.m_KeyValue: ""Before Agnes can react, Quinn grabs her hand and pulls her along. _$$Mario and Juliet is about to begin! We'll miss the opening!_$$""

1580851154.m_KeyValue: ""_$$...Mario and Juliet is premiering in the neighboring town. You'd better hurry out if you don't want to miss it, you know?_$$""

1580851155.m_KeyValue: ""With a delicate clearing of her throat, the young lady lifts the hem of her gown with practiced grace, executing a flawless sequence of nods, bows, and curtsies that flows like a choreographed dance. _$$It is my honor to make your acquaintance. I am—_$$""

1580851156.m_KeyValue: ""The girl murmurs as she sweeps off the crude robe that shrouds her form in one fluid motion. Her water-blue tresses tumble down to her waist like a silken waterfall, their ethereal glow seeming to pierce the veil of night itself.""

1580851157.m_KeyValue: "But her words are swallowed by silence—as though the Bathory family had never possessed a Young Lady at all."

1580851164.m_KeyValue: "_$$...Then what... what should I swear by?_$$ She has no idea what comes next. And yet the words just slip out."

1580917715.m_KeyValue: ""Inevitably, a battle erupted. No one knows how many Ancestors perished—perhaps even more than during the Crimson Inquisition. Quite the irony, wouldn't you say?'""

1580917716.m_KeyValue: ""Isaac asked urgently, 'Did any of those Ancestors leave the vault? And what became of the prisoners?'""

1580917717.m_KeyValue: ""'Should we kill him?' Selena whispered, her eyes on the drowsy guard as she quietly drew her crossbow.""

1580918670.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, Empousa, and Lorelei were standing in a circle in the room. Which means, of course, to Lorelei's right… was the one holding the candle on page 47—Bella.""

1580918671.m_KeyValue: ""'Bella? What… what are you waiting for? Hurry up and find another candle!' Trying her best to stay composed, Empousa reached blindly toward Bella in the darkness.""

1580918673.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah...!' Ami's presence suddenly sparked a realization. 'Ami, do you remember the path you took to get in here? Can you lead us out?'""

1580918674.m_KeyValue: "'And...' Bella turned to Empousa with a meaningful glance. 'I used your name when I made that deal.'"

1580918677.m_KeyValue: "'Bella! You can’t just go spouting nonsense like that and worry our guest!'"

1583199242.m_KeyValue: ""No coin, no purchase! Out—out of my sight!""

1583199243.m_KeyValue: ""With that half-beast form of yours, you can still speak the language of humans?""

1584194456.m_KeyValue: "_$$The High Priestess_$$ can return any unit to their position at the beginning of the current round."

1585038605.m_KeyValue: "None of us ever saw him again. Everything we heard came only through Noah and Gilrain."

1585941025.m_KeyValue: "Then show me how much you've grown."

1585941026.m_KeyValue: ""Foolish child, now you understand the danger. This path was never safe.""

1585941027.m_KeyValue: "I chose to bear that weight alone. So you wouldn't have to. You're now Bell Ringer No. X."

1585941028.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps… we were beasts to begin with."

1585941030.m_KeyValue: "You're still a child. The road I've chosen is far too dangerous."

1586432104.m_KeyValue: ""Because humans have limited understanding of the world, so they try to explain the incomprehensible through faith?""

1587882497.m_KeyValue: ""Just endure it. Once you're well-done, the heat won't bother you anymore.""

1587882498.m_KeyValue: "You think this is a grill!? I need water!"

1587882499.m_KeyValue: ""Fish... always in such a rush. Unlike us, right?""

1587883648.m_KeyValue: "It seems even my reading speed has become a liability."

1587883649.m_KeyValue: ""A pity. He was a fine Captain. But in the end, his need to play the 'good brother' doomed him.""

1587883650.m_KeyValue: "Now I understand why Jones so readily accepted when I volunteered to take over security for this voyage."

1587883654.m_KeyValue: "I suppose I'll have to experience what it's like to be a murderer."

1587883655.m_KeyValue: "Blood Beasts have gathered in both the upper and lower corridors. Which way should I go...?"

1587884666.m_KeyValue: ""We kept our vow. We guarded the Divine Body and offered our sacrifices. Yet year after year, our home kept sinking.""

1587884667.m_KeyValue: "It was Ranna—our great mistress—whose whispers led us to salvation! She showed us the truth: we could cut down the Divine Body and use its sacred wood to build a great vessel that would carry us to a new homeland!"

1587884672.m_KeyValue: "You're not merely a Landis survivor... are you..."

1587884673.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. He is the descendant of countless Landis people."

1587884675.m_KeyValue: ""And you... that masked witch. Even cloaked as you are, you can't hide the stench of the Divine Body on you...""

1587884676.m_KeyValue: ""Through the resonance of Black Blood, their memories merged—and those memories now live on in survivors like him.""

1587884677.m_KeyValue: "It's Aeon's fault. That shameless false god who poisoned the world with her lies about order!"

1587884678.m_KeyValue: "What's that supposed to mean? That's creepy... Are you saying he's not just one person?"

1587884679.m_KeyValue: ""It's collective memory. When the Landis family sank beneath the sea, most perished. But they had already turned to Famine's Black Blood.""

1587885820.m_KeyValue: "I've grown too old… too old to love any crew or ship but this one."

1587885821.m_KeyValue: "These old hands can't use the metamorphosis anymore... But they still remember what it means to fire one last shot."

1587885824.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, the courage you've loaded into this ship… I'll carry it.""

1587885825.m_KeyValue: "Stop wasting time reflecting and move! I'm almost out of ammunition!"

1587885826.m_KeyValue: "But you're not the only one keeping secrets. I never told you about my final measure either."

1587885827.m_KeyValue: "How cruel of you. You've gone and reminded me what it felt like to be young. To be like you."

1587885828.m_KeyValue: "What are you waiting for? Your job isn't to fight them off! It's to break through and face the big one!"

1587885829.m_KeyValue: ""Bob's weapons are too old. Even with the metamorphosis, they'll only stagger Famine's minions, not stop them...""

1587885830.m_KeyValue: ""Compared to Bob, I still have a long way to go.""

1587885831.m_KeyValue: "That's it! I don't need to destroy these tentacles. I just need to strike while they flinch!"

1587886845.m_KeyValue: "At this rate... I won't have the strength left to face Famine."

1587886848.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. I can't even imagine what Noah would look like in a panic."

1587886849.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it's our dependable little Fool, or Justice, who seems to have foreseen all of this...""

1587886850.m_KeyValue: "They've already taken the main stage. So? Are we just going to stand around here?"

1587886852.m_KeyValue: "Sounds of battle... coming from the upper deck."

1587886853.m_KeyValue: "Of course! That lifeless eyes said he'd meet Noah on deck! They must be fighting Famine right now!"

1587886854.m_KeyValue: "Noah! We haven't seen him in so long... Is he really up there? I hope he's okay..."

1587886855.m_KeyValue: "What are you worried about?! It's Noah! No danger's going to bring him down."

1587887999.m_KeyValue: ""As punishment for reading my diary, you'll be restricted to only two afternoon tea sessions per day for the next three days!""

1587888002.m_KeyValue: "Oh! I think we've found something! Although it looks like..."

1587888003.m_KeyValue: "But that was all before you met us."

1587888004.m_KeyValue: "So I've always been alone. I am nothing. I have nothing..."

1587888005.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't a dream. It wasn't someone else's memory. It was my own."

1587888007.m_KeyValue: ""Just like Landis sinking beneath the waves, you'll descend into the lightless deep. Alone. Sinking... endlessly... deeper...""

1588510822.m_KeyValue: ""You really are a little princess, aren't you...""

1590712333.m_KeyValue:
""Hati has disappeared.

While searching for her, I learned that many alchemists were gathering in Mouret, seeking mushrooms rumored to cure the Black Blood disease. But if they reopened the sealed grounds, the Black Blood would spread once again.

Yet when I arrived at the forbidden area, besides the dead alchemists on the ground, there was another figure—

Hati, whom I hadn't seen in a long time, unconscious among the flowers outside the forbidden grounds.""

1590712616.m_KeyValue: ""An old invitation bearing both my name and Van Helsing's? It summoned us to Duke Reese's castle, where an unsolved case awaited…""

1590712705.m_KeyValue:
""They say Baphomet was not always as we know him now. Few recall the knight who once raised the banner of Holy War for his family, nor the day he sealed himself within a tower where light could never reach, lost to countless forbidden experiments. He could not—would not—lay down his hammer. He swore to reclaim the 'life' devoured by regret and hatred.

When the fires of the last battle faded, armor lay scattered, and all deeds and misdeeds crumbled to dust. In the end, the flame of a soul proved fragile—snuffed out by the whisper of the night wind.""

1590712864.m_KeyValue: ""This conch shell used to lie by Ami's pillow aboard the El Dorado—a birthday gift from years past. Now in the castle, its ocean sounds take her back to the ship where she lived for so long.""

1590717428.m_KeyValue: "Yes. From here we go northeast through <color=#D63536>Starfall Valley</color>. There's a secluded wharf where we can find a boat to <color=#D63536>cross the sea</color>."

1590997937.m_KeyValue: ""That only leaves the people from Mouret... Wait, could it be their spirits protecting me?""

1591031698.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, is that your excuse for not finding the earring?""

1591295735.m_KeyValue: "Don't lose focus! I'm just not used to this new body yet."

1592004112.m_KeyValue:
""Clive was always absent, and Hati took on the role of parent. If Gadric was the father figure in this family, then Hati was the real mother, with Clive Jr. always affectionately by her side.
Hati's talent for sewing developed while raising Clive Jr. After all, in a household of a distant father and a willful child, someone had to be the glue holding things together. Yet even with all Hati's efforts, there remained an unmistakable distance between Clive and Clive Jr.""

1592004205.m_KeyValue:
""February 3rd, 1339. Weather... Who knows—I've been trapped in my cabin, tormented by that little monster. It's all because Ami's nurse fell ill, leaving me with this monumental mess. The destructive power of a child this age is truly terrifying. For some reason, she's been crying all night, every night. Heavens, pray for that nurse's swift recovery. I'm nearing my wits' end. And William has sneaked away again, right when it's his turn to take over. Good grief!
But, I must admit, when she quiets down on the rare occasion, she resembles a little angel. As expected of the pure Landis bloodline. I hope she grows up well...
—Excerpt from the Captain's Log of the El Dorado""

1592004271.m_KeyValue:
""I'm grateful that I still remembered to keep my promise to Clive—even though I had 'forgotten,' and the promise was only fulfilled on Clive's final day.
I managed to meet him before he was fully corrupted by the Black Blood. Just as the story had played out before, the cycle repeated, leading everything to its end.
He had carried such a heavy burden, and still, he pressed on. The one who once saw me as a hero... proved to be the true hero.""

1592004360.m_KeyValue:
""Last night, Regina confided that her leave was drawing to a close. Soon she would return to the Other Side, rejoining the El Dorado for a new journey across uncharted waters.

I asked if she wished to see Piera before departing.

She considered this for a long moment, then gently declined.

Her love for Piera runs deeper than oceans. It is precisely because of this love that she refuses to subject Piera to another painful farewell—not when she has finally stepped free from the shadows of yesterday.

In truth, they both deserve their own luminous futures.

Before taking leave, she promised to bring me something special upon next reunion.""

1596293568.m_KeyValue: ""To my silver-haired friend, always eager to catch my attention: You interrupted me last time. So, will you finally tell me who's been wandering around spreading my _$$tales_$$?""

1597392898.m_KeyValue: ""When you didn't take the bait, she dropped the topic entirely.""

1597392899.m_KeyValue: ""She feared broaching the subject too directly might offend you, so she dropped a subtle hint to gauge your reaction.""

1597392900.m_KeyValue: ""Whether you're dealing with humans or Bloodborn, it's a common social skill.""

1597392903.m_KeyValue: ""For me, this stirs memories from a distant age.""

1597392905.m_KeyValue: "I believe I've found your missing saddle."

Lunar Halo: Once HP falls below 60%, Lunar Halo will restore {0} of Aiona's Max HP to the bearer, then disappear.""

1597790039.m_KeyValue: ""Do you even need to ask? It's our protagonist, of course!""

1598240380.m_KeyValue: ""It's a survival rule etched into my very bones. Even with the game over, my eyes remain fixed on my _$$opponent,_$$ terrified that a moment's lapse could spell eternal doom.""

1598240381.m_KeyValue: ""As she frantically chased after the fluttering ornament, we unknowingly strayed far from the castle, arriving at the tree No. 66 had mentioned.""

1598240382.m_KeyValue: "What she truly wanted to give me... was freedom."

1598620907.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, the moon is in a crescent shape, signaling the appearance of the Starfall Valley Odyssey Gate. Allow me to accompany you there.""

1600123425.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how many times the cycle repeats, you were always by my side...""

1601480716.m_KeyValue: "So it was Reese II behind the ghost story all along."

1601480717.m_KeyValue: "Didn't expect you to make it here."

1601785912.m_KeyValue: "What Mr. Van Helsing means is that any suspicious activity would have easily drawn the attention of the crew patrolling the deck at the time."

1601785913.m_KeyValue: ""Huh. Listening to all this, the 'murderer' must have been quite smart.""

1601785914.m_KeyValue: ""The other end was wound around the helm inside the crew quarters, directly opposite the cabin.""

1601785915.m_KeyValue: "His second mistake? The knot tied to the helm wasn't even a proper sailor's knot."

1601785916.m_KeyValue: "Hmph. The one Van Helsing wants to accuse is William—my good-for-nothing little brother."

1601785918.m_KeyValue: "I suspect Captain Goldland's confidence comes from having disposed of the rope at sea the moment he discovered it."

1601785919.m_KeyValue: ""The one guarding the deck entrance to the guest cabins, who briefly left his post...""

1601785920.m_KeyValue: "That's why none of us ever suspected William at the time..."

1601785945.m_KeyValue: "No... they weren't even here when we first arrived. They weren't like this before..."

1601785946.m_KeyValue: ""But… if you do this, everyone aboard will die... Must it truly come to this?""

1601785947.m_KeyValue: "How long was I out? At least I'm feeling better... Right!"

1601786199.m_KeyValue: "Third Mate William! These two may be stowaways—boarded without invitations. How should we handle them?"

1601786200.m_KeyValue: ""May the 'Chariot's' voyage reach its destination without fail, Captain Kristoph Goldland.""

1601786207.m_KeyValue: "Because Noah's 'homeland' seems to lie on a legendary island..."

1601786208.m_KeyValue: ""Are you still thinking about that day... when we first met in the forbidden grounds, twenty years ago?""

1601786210.m_KeyValue: ""Well now… I didn't expect anyone else to be admiring this storm-kissed seascape—dangerous, but quite captivating.""

1601786211.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, little Ami and her 'ambitions,' already laid bare before strangers. But perhaps it’s that candor that makes her so... endearing.""

1601786213.m_KeyValue: ""There are some sweets in the kitchen. Would you two like some? That way, no one will notice I've been sneaking a few for myself.""

1601786239.m_KeyValue: "Wait! I do have an invitation—just not on me right now! And I'm not a stowaway!"

1601786240.m_KeyValue: "As for your earlier accusation—I did not spy you. I deduced it."

1601786241.m_KeyValue: ""Still, sitting still will only ease the symptoms for a time. You should find the ship's doctor quickly. A remedy of honey and spirits would serve her well.""

1601786242.m_KeyValue: "Are you delirious? It's just the two of us here. Who else could you be talking to?"

1601786245.m_KeyValue: ""'Captain' Van Helsing, what are you doing here? Being assigned as temporary squad leader doesn't give you the right to act on your own!""

1601786271.m_KeyValue: "Bob! These two were just caught on deck—without invitations!"

1601786272.m_KeyValue: "You know about Future Artifacts? That's top-level intel—even within the Church..."

1601786273.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. If more Elders keep getting taken out by someone like that silver-haired one, we'll have fewer and fewer fat lambs to feast on. At this rate...""

1601786274.m_KeyValue: "That scoundrel?! What's his invitation doing here?"

1601786275.m_KeyValue: "The Captain is expecting him. And those stowaways are coming with me."

1601786276.m_KeyValue: "Wait! They're talking about the stowaways now... That's not good."

1601786278.m_KeyValue: "Hmph! We've fought enemies far stronger than you!"

1601786300.m_KeyValue: ""I appreciate the gesture, but let the crew dine first. They've endured enough in this weather.""

1601786303.m_KeyValue: "Can't you see how unwell she is? Or did you not understand what I just said?"

1601786304.m_KeyValue: "As expected of the magnanimous Captain Goldland! Now that's a true sailor's spirit!"

1601786305.m_KeyValue: ""If you truly had wings strong enough to cross the sea, you wouldn't have risked boarding a ship in the first place.""

1601786306.m_KeyValue: ""'There are no eternal friends, only eternal profits.' Such is the way among merchants.""

1601786307.m_KeyValue: "B-But Mr. Van Helsing said we can't harm them before a proper interrogation..."

1601786308.m_KeyValue: "How dare you speak of Captain Goldland with such contempt?! He's a generous man with grand ambitions—he treats every crew member like family!"

1601786309.m_KeyValue: "...my guests. Welcome aboard the El Dorado."

1601786310.m_KeyValue: ""If you're referring to Jones, they're just ordinary knights. Their conflict is none of your concern.""

1601786331.m_KeyValue: ""No, it doesn't. This cabin only has one door, facing the kitchen. The other three sides are solid walls—no windows at all.""

1601786332.m_KeyValue: ""The other one's with me. I always volunteer for kitchen duty, so Jack—the one in charge today—was nice enough to lend it to me.""

1601786335.m_KeyValue: "What? Aaron? Why would anyone—who would kill him..."

1601786337.m_KeyValue: ""He had his back to me when I walked in. As soon as he noticed me, he left.""

1601786338.m_KeyValue: ""Impressive, isn't it?! Little Ami drew that! She's so talented! Remarkable, right?!""

1601786339.m_KeyValue: ""Have you found the problem, Bob? What exactly happened here?""

1601786341.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be too hard on yourself, William. This wasn't your fault. Someone sabotaged the rudder with that rope.""

1601786342.m_KeyValue: ""Bob... He's always reliable when the crew needs him, but when it comes to Ami, he gets far too anxious and impulsive.""

1601786367.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of that, I remember something. After I bumped into him...""

1601786368.m_KeyValue: ""If it were Van Helsing here instead of you, I'd protect him the same way.""

1601786369.m_KeyValue: "You can't beat them? Marlow and the others aren't even fighters—they're weak."

1601786370.m_KeyValue: "Not much strength... but pretty fast on his feet."

1601786371.m_KeyValue: ""Then maybe it wasn't one person? With your strength, you'd need at least a hundred!""

1601786372.m_KeyValue: ""Because if not, you're still the only one who could have done it.""

1601786374.m_KeyValue: "I believe Aaron's death is tied to that second tremor and sound."

1601786399.m_KeyValue: "I'm counting on you to lead the way."

1601786400.m_KeyValue: "This is terrible! What are we going to do?"

1601786401.m_KeyValue: "You forgot? Octo is the octopus I just ate."

1601786402.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it... How many sailors ate this?! At this rate, this ship will end up like Mouret...""

1601786405.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Aaron. As a fellow snack thief, I won't tell anyone you were here.""

1602481062.m_KeyValue: ""Located around the deck, cannons may be adjusted to target enemies and deal significant DMG to units in range.""

1602481063.m_KeyValue: "The cabin barrier which obstructs the movement of passengers. It is unbreakable and cannot be destroyed."

1602481064.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the Werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG every sec but gaining DMG UP. This effect lasts until the end of the round.""

1602481065.m_KeyValue: "Crabs will continuously emerge from the cave. Prioritize destroying the cave."

1602481066.m_KeyValue: "Deals AoE DMG. Keep out of its way."

1602481067.m_KeyValue: ""An ancient nameless statue on the island. Upon defeat, deals DMG and inflicts Stun to nearby enemies.""

1603486948.m_KeyValue: ""'Tch, you call this fulfilling the curse?' Empousa scoffed, clearly unsatisfied.""

1603486949.m_KeyValue: "'Could there still be a way to ensure the curse is never fulfilled?' Ami's words plunged both listeners into deep contemplation."

1603486951.m_KeyValue: "'I never imagined the curse would actually come true after all these years.'"

1604588830.m_KeyValue: ""If the stars fall and the sun fades to oblivion, does time still matter?""

1605140517.m_KeyValue: "This tremor's lasting longer than usual… Wait—footsteps? How can there be footsteps…?"

1605140519.m_KeyValue: ""…If only I hadn't done those wretched things… I wouldn't be rotting here, haunted by every echo in these cursed walls…""

1605140520.m_KeyValue: ""When they took me to Fanny before, there was no turn here. But now—""

1608596568.m_KeyValue: "Chamber already cleared. Please come back after reset."

1608678223.m_KeyValue: "Still hanging around that boring one? I really don't understand why you all flock to her."

1608718934.m_KeyValue: "The girl's endless chatter echoed through their secret hideout."

1608718937.m_KeyValue: "Did you never build a secret hideout as a kid?"

1608718939.m_KeyValue: ""Hey... would you at least listen to what I, the Bell Ringer, have to say?""

1608788202.m_KeyValue: ""(Beneath the wavering candlelight, a letter lay waiting.)""

1609195229.m_KeyValue: "What's happening to me? Is my darker nature about to break through the seal?"

1609195230.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia has sent no new letters, leaving me uncertain how to address her concerns.""

1609195237.m_KeyValue: "It’s kind of embarrassing to talk about..."

1609195238.m_KeyValue: "I have a weakness for love stories."

1609195239.m_KeyValue: ""Of course. Love is eternal, after all.""

1609195240.m_KeyValue: ""Stories about two hearts finding their way, moving from strangers to lovers, then finally coming together... there's something so deeply moving about them...""

1609195241.m_KeyValue: "But those rival characters always leave me feeling uneasy."

1609195242.m_KeyValue: "Those characters always make me think about all the others who surround Noah..."

1609195244.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! No, no! Forgive me—that came out all wrong.""

1609203044.m_KeyValue: ""'Some suspect it was murder. They believe the lightning rod was deliberately sabotaged. Plus, the new head of the family never saw eye to eye with the deceased.'""

1609203046.m_KeyValue: ""'It's not something I can control. Whenever there's thunder, that story instantly comes to mind,' Empousa said, her body trembling slightly as if reliving the recent storm.""

1609203047.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, if that's the case, you shouldn't have to fear thunder anymore,' Ressa reasoned.""

1610422959.m_KeyValue: "This is the future you've bestowed upon me."

1610422990.m_KeyValue: ""From this day forward, I shall no longer support you from behind, but walk beside you as an equal.""

1610425999.m_KeyValue: "It seems you have freed me from the shackles of time."

1610426158.m_KeyValue: "I hope to find at least a modicum of enjoyment in this..."

1610431655.m_KeyValue: ""The hymns of the temple, a requiem for the departed.""

1610431686.m_KeyValue: ""Oh dear, don't make me fall in love with this feeling, little one...""

1610433860.m_KeyValue: "Is it a 'lover' you desire... or is it me?"

1610434695.m_KeyValue: ""In the past, I could only sigh helplessly in the face of death. But now... I will protect everyone.""

1610434854.m_KeyValue: "It seems I need to get a bit more serious."

1610436869.m_KeyValue: "If walking alongside you is the preordained future... I am willing to embrace it."

1610437028.m_KeyValue: ""Thus, I may bestow blessings upon the people.""

1610438177.m_KeyValue: "Such warmth... I can't... I have to keep moving."

1610438208.m_KeyValue: "So this is what it feels like to… walk with someone."

1610993145.m_KeyValue: "But I haven't decided what to paint yet."

1610993147.m_KeyValue: ""I just thought that if I read this book over and over, maybe I could remember them?""

1610993148.m_KeyValue: ""My father, infected by Black Blood, killed my mother. Then Tris ended his life.""

1610993149.m_KeyValue: ""Don't let her hear you say that, or I'll be paying off another strange debt.""

1612600121.m_KeyValue: "But perhaps we should start by having you mount Ludgard."

1612600126.m_KeyValue: ""Prove yourself worthy of the Bathory name, and you'll have my loyalty.""

1612600127.m_KeyValue: "I noticed the metal saddle I had retrieved for her was already secured in place."

1612600128.m_KeyValue: "Valora approached Ludgard and swung herself into the saddle."

1612600129.m_KeyValue: ""Well, as a relic of the old world, I'm honored that you still see the gold in me.""

1612600130.m_KeyValue: ""Choose your own world, rather than letting the world choose you.""

1612903083.m_KeyValue: ""Tertius Baphomet is immune to Control, ATK SPD Down, and DMG Dealt Down effects. Tertius Baphomet periodically summons a Shield Spirit or Blade Spirit to assist in battle.""

1613101550.m_KeyValue: "Time-limited reward for achieving Rank 1 in Crucible (Group Stage) seasonal rankings."

1613101553.m_KeyValue: "Time-limited reward for achieving Rank 1 in Gauntlet seasonal rankings."

1613770754.m_KeyValue: ""At last, the souls end their vigil, returning to the quiet embrace of eternity. Until the wheel turns again.""

1614631998.m_KeyValue: ""Behold! With thunderous applause and roaring cheers, we welcome the long-absent legend of these sands—the undefeated myth, now approaching her 999th triumph—Joan!""

1616047446.m_KeyValue: ""Within each faction, you can select five Vassals for the ritual.""

1616825609.m_KeyValue: ""Permit me a proper introduction. Before you lie the former Elders of the Bathory family, long consigned to eternal slumber.""

1617283887.m_KeyValue: ""I have a confidential letter here, signed by Lord Hallon himself.""

1617283889.m_KeyValue: ""I don't believe you. Speak the truth, or this will be the end of you.""

1617283890.m_KeyValue: "But to strike at two targets at once..."

1617283891.m_KeyValue: ""Today, we shall make Sapphire Isle into an elysium.""

1617283919.m_KeyValue: ""I should never let my guard down. I suspected they might be the Master behind it all, but how could an ordinary 'human' move so fast?""

1617283921.m_KeyValue: "Don't look at me when you say that."

1617283922.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Isaac, I've finally found you! I'm coming to save you!""

1617283923.m_KeyValue: ""I remember now... The promise I wanted to keep was to set sail on a great ship with Lorelei, to help her people find their homeland.""

1617283924.m_KeyValue: ""The devices which the sirens asked me to dismantle—were they tools of their suffering, or the fetters that held them captive within the Isle?""

1617283925.m_KeyValue: "They're no longer heading to another location. I suppose all the devices have been dismantled."

1617283950.m_KeyValue: "As expected... Joyce should have used Bella No. 14 instead..."

1617283951.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, what's happening? Why are you glowing?""

1617283952.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, we're still missing one Siren's Tear.""

1617283953.m_KeyValue: "Could someone have sabotaged Joyce's Elysium devices?! And the only one who knew about all the devices was that wretched Lorelei..."

1617283954.m_KeyValue: "So you just didn't want to do it with us?"

1617283955.m_KeyValue: ""You've done your part, so now it's my turn. To save you.""

1617283957.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, you've arrived. The devices Joyce tried to activate just failed—was that your doing?""

1617283976.m_KeyValue: ""That tradition… you just made it up, didn't you.""

1617283977.m_KeyValue: "No clothes…? To think there's another soul out there who shares my ideals!"

1617283982.m_KeyValue: ""I just went to see Lord Hallon, but the guards said... all the Sages were killed last night... Is that even possible?""

1617283983.m_KeyValue: ""Please, Sir, don't do this! We may not know everything, but it wasn't the sirens who caused the disaster—it was the humans who experimented on them.""

1617283985.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, the person who made the reservation insisted that this gift be given to you, even if everything else was skipped.""

1617283986.m_KeyValue: "Where's Ami? Why isn't she with you?"

1617283987.m_KeyValue: ""It's nothing, Lady Empousa. You must be mistaken.""

1617283988.m_KeyValue: "It's just that... I accidentally got myself into a lot of debt here."

1617283989.m_KeyValue: ""It seems I'll have to contact the Bell Ringer, Albrecht.""

1617284014.m_KeyValue: ""But with a snap of their fingers, the Bell Ringer summoned a flood from the heavens, drowning homes and fleeing villagers alike.""

1617284015.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh dear, oh dear. Half the body’s been eaten. Tragic… And the other half? Tainted with Black Blood... Such a pity…'""

1617284016.m_KeyValue: ""Even as the Blood Beast tore into him, even when his hands could no longer feel, he kept his grip on the dagger.""

1617284017.m_KeyValue: "Run! Get Bella from the basement and leave now!"

1617284019.m_KeyValue: "'So that one day… she might become the greatest musician who ever lived.'"

1617284020.m_KeyValue: ""She remembered her illness flaring again, being carried to bed by servants, and then...""

1617284021.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, the moon looms vast, round, and brilliant.""

1617373779.m_KeyValue: "Just how badly do you want to be captain..."

1617373780.m_KeyValue: "Wait—what?! We'd stand a better chance together! Why are you running off now?!"

1617373781.m_KeyValue: "So the four Moonblessed Cain spoke of... They correspond to the Four Calamities?"

1617373782.m_KeyValue: ""When he took me from the Church, his aim was to use the blood of the Calamity to awaken the final Scourge.""

1617373783.m_KeyValue: ""One in the castle on Howling Peninsula, the other here in Starfall Valley. These two places have always been connected.""

1617373784.m_KeyValue: "She was the Bathory's new dawn—born in sunlight to serve as their Gravekeeper. But her black wings eclipsed the light..."

1617373785.m_KeyValue: "There was a theory that the world was round."

1617373786.m_KeyValue: ""If I had to guess, the carriage that took Noah headed that way.""

1617373787.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for escorting us this far."

1617376987.m_KeyValue: "I didn't receive any order to kill the Church's soldiers."

1617376988.m_KeyValue: "Sir Gadric... forgive us. It's all because of our weakness."

1617456763.m_KeyValue: "Defend the Rift. Don't let more than <#A65F30>10</color> phantoms escape."

1617456796.m_KeyValue: "Defend the Rift. Don't let more than <#A65F30>10</color> phantoms escape."

1617456829.m_KeyValue: "Defend the Rift. Don't let more than <#A65F30>10</color> phantoms escape."

1617473746.m_KeyValue: ""While this auncient one draws breath, ne'er shall victory be ceded!""

1617473777.m_KeyValue: "Shall I help you shed the shackles of the flesh as well...?"

1617476786.m_KeyValue: "Being handsy is not a desirable quality."

1617484647.m_KeyValue: "Let's hope your death isn't too unsightly."

1617485482.m_KeyValue: "Oh you wanna train together? I'm afraid I don't have the time at the moment."

1617485641.m_KeyValue: ""Before the face of justice, what chance do evil and intrigue stand?""

1617486790.m_KeyValue: "It's not enough... I've yet to reach my limit!"

1617486821.m_KeyValue: ""Only bitterness and regret remain, buried deep in my memories.""

1617487656.m_KeyValue: ""From the moment one steps onto the battlefield, the Lord shows no favoritism to anyone.""

1617488964.m_KeyValue: "Bury them well and let nature embrace their souls."

1617488995.m_KeyValue: "This form marks the humanity I've forsaken."

1617573748.m_KeyValue: "Liar! You're distorting the truth to absolve yourself of guilt!"

1617573749.m_KeyValue: "How can this guy still retain himself at this stage of the disease... Maybe the prophecy was..."

1618114063.m_KeyValue: "The residual blood on this sword can serve as a catalyst for awakening memories..."

1618117264.m_KeyValue: "Who... who would do such a thing! How could they treat them like this!"

1618324368.m_KeyValue: "Configuration currently not supported on your device."

1618324369.m_KeyValue: "Countdown ended. This round will not count."

1618575277.m_KeyValue: ""In this new order, sentiment means nothing. What matters now is leverage. Transaction.""

1618575279.m_KeyValue: "As luck would have it... Those two years are precisely what I've lost from memory."

1618575280.m_KeyValue: "Has it only been eleven years...? It feels like a lifetime ago..."

1618575281.m_KeyValue: "So this... is the truth of what happened back then."

1618575282.m_KeyValue: ""Hallon brought her to the lab, demanded I try the incomplete treatment. I had no choice. It was our only hope.""

1618575284.m_KeyValue: "Your hatred is deserved. That's why I'm telling you everything. To lighten the weight on my conscience… and to let you know..."

1618575310.m_KeyValue: "Strange fragments of memory... began to surface in my mind…"

1618575311.m_KeyValue: "My eyes... they're getting wet... something is falling…"

1618575313.m_KeyValue: ""Stop lazing around, we need to go catch him right now!""

1618575314.m_KeyValue: "(sighing) I think I'll just go back to sleep..."

1618575315.m_KeyValue: "Thanks. So you really did kill Constantine."

1618575316.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Isaac, Joyce wasn't stalking you at all!""

1618575317.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps. Once we defeat him, we'll know.""

1618575318.m_KeyValue: ""At first, I never meant to do evil. Everything I did was for her... I just wanted to keep her by my side...""

1618575566.m_KeyValue: "Something just flew out of the pocket..."

1618575574.m_KeyValue: "Of course! Catherine's makeup is flawless—you're the perfect Ginokio!"

1618575575.m_KeyValue: ""In interactive theater, improvisation is everything, Bella. Just follow my narration and act along!""

1618575576.m_KeyValue: "It means the course of the tale is shaped by every member of the audience!"

1618575577.m_KeyValue: ""If we're talking about a puppet, surely what she wants most... is to become a real person!""

1618575578.m_KeyValue: "W-what utter nonsense are you spouting?! How dare you suggest I’d entertain such thoughts! Teach him a lesson!"

1618575579.m_KeyValue: "How did that get approved?! I didn't write that!"

1618575580.m_KeyValue: "Take this book... You've earned it—by strength alone..."

1618575600.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami collapsed after touching the Siren's Tear... then Mr. Thoreau forced his way in and took her."

1618575605.m_KeyValue: "I can't recall anything after I fell ill... not even signing a contract with you."

1618575606.m_KeyValue: "Before they were removed—where did the flowers used to bloom?"

1618575607.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella, money is the least important thing in life. A promise between friends? Far more valuable.""

1618575609.m_KeyValue: "We forced the other Sages to acknowledge her status through public pressure at the election. They’re unlikely to fully trust her now."

1618575611.m_KeyValue: "Yeah! Why did Alexa suddenly come after us? What earth-shattering thing did Little Bella do in the past?"

1618575612.m_KeyValue: ""See, Little Bella? Someone on the Isle does remember you!""

1618575637.m_KeyValue: "Oh my. I thought Miss Ami had urgent business with me. But it's just her servant."

1618575638.m_KeyValue: ""These two are terrifying. I told you, Little Bella—we should've left sooner.""

1618575640.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing's offer is... most compelling."

1618575643.m_KeyValue: "If you still had Goldland's memories... You'd never have let Ami fall into danger like this."

1618575644.m_KeyValue: "When I cut the thread... It felt like all my strength drained out of me."

1618575670.m_KeyValue: "I... I need to meet with a friend."

1618575675.m_KeyValue: "You bear the Bell Ringer's token. To see the token is to stand before the Bell Ringer."

1618575676.m_KeyValue: ""I don't need anything expensive. Actually, I already know what I want.""

1618575697.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, I did faint by the roadside when I woke up... And what you described sounds exactly like what I experienced.""

1618575701.m_KeyValue: "But... Lord Constantine has been awfully busy with something lately. Joyce hasn't seen him in quite some time..."

1618575702.m_KeyValue: "I have to tell Alexa about this!"

1618575703.m_KeyValue: "It's stronger... more aggressive than anything from Constantine's experiments. Is someone trying to turn every human on the Isle into their puppet?"

1618575704.m_KeyValue: "Little Bella... you really shouldn't be so brutally honest with people you've only just met..."

1618575706.m_KeyValue: ""Well... you see, Sapphire Isle hides a tremendous secret...""

1618575707.m_KeyValue: ""...And yet, if such a thing did exist—I might buy it too.""

1618575708.m_KeyValue: "First—I have no interest in becoming the heir to any territory."

1618575732.m_KeyValue: ""Fine, Little Bella—I promise. No snitching. But I really can't take another step right now.""

1618575733.m_KeyValue: ""The road ahead... you'll have to walk it alone, Little Bella. This is as far as I go.""

1618575735.m_KeyValue: "That man over there... isn't that the one from the poster?!"

1618575736.m_KeyValue: "The promised place... it's just over there."

1618575737.m_KeyValue: ""The Bell Ringer...? Truly, Mr. Van Helsing—your connections are enviable. I understand.""

1618575739.m_KeyValue: "T-This can't be... I'm the only one left?"

1618575763.m_KeyValue: "He devoured Mother… he devoured everyone… He's a monster..."

1618575765.m_KeyValue: "No one saw Constantine leave the prison. If he's still there... then why hasn't he been found?"

1618575767.m_KeyValue: "Why would you go to such lengths to find him?"

1618575768.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine spent nearly half of every month inside the prison, devoting himself to siren experimentation.""

1618575769.m_KeyValue: "1353...? Eleven years later? Then I haven't been asleep for just a month... It's been eleven years...?"

1618575770.m_KeyValue: "Take the middle door marked with the Tidewisp marker."

1618575772.m_KeyValue: ""Even by continental standards, these are remarkably novel ideas. No wonder the place is flooded with tourists.""

1622570243.m_KeyValue: ""Mere insomnia, Warden. Surely even prisoners are allowed their nightmares.""

1622570244.m_KeyValue: ""(Fanny's still busy with those Church weapons. Good. From here to the interrogation chamber: left to the corridor's end, then right.)""

1622570245.m_KeyValue: ""You call that a nightmare? To be saved by faith's fire, to taste bliss upon the path to the sublime, and at last to ascend in holy brilliance, become one with the creator of all… That is a dream to be envied.""

1622570246.m_KeyValue: ""So I see through you as well. If faith were enough, you would not need to steal the memories of others.""

1622570247.m_KeyValue: ""She preys on clever, desperate men like you. She tempts them with hope, then grinds them beneath her feet to pave her own escape.""

1623543190.m_KeyValue: "You can see a sea of stars from there. Try recalling it again."

1623861898.m_KeyValue: "And what did you find in that cabinet to make you so sure?"

1623861899.m_KeyValue: ""For example: in one minute, this prison will be struck by a force strong enough to shake its very foundations. I call it 'The Comet's Fall'.""

1623861900.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me—could a mere puppet stand so serene, even reveling in the moment, while a force threatens to tear this prison down to its foundations?""

1624550758.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Camel Centaurs attacking the camp with Ottavia's aid."

1625263063.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, is that all the strength you can muster with that whip?""

1625263065.m_KeyValue: "Stop making that disgusting noise! Behave or else!"

1625263097.m_KeyValue: "I've left that matter to my son."

1625263099.m_KeyValue: ""Ooh—if Joyce had a bag of gold, then… then I could replace my head with pure gold!""

1625263100.m_KeyValue: ""Th-th-the last candidate’s token of proof hasn’t arrived yet, so what if… what if…""

1625263101.m_KeyValue: ""What a ridiculous title… but honestly, it suits him quite well.""

1625263360.m_KeyValue: "Was it the scorching summer sun that left the Bloodborn lightheaded? Or the heady warmth of the breeze that left them utterly intoxicated?"

1625263366.m_KeyValue: ""This will reduce the debt by a lot, right? Maybe it's not so...""

1625263386.m_KeyValue: "One million! Do I hear any higher bids?"

1625263391.m_KeyValue: ""Eleven years ago, Sapphire Isle was just a poor fishing village—until a tsunami turned it into a dead land, haunted only by crows and wild wolves.""

1625263392.m_KeyValue: ""So cold... Noah, let's go play in the water!""

1625263394.m_KeyValue: "Maybe... possibly... it's a bit... different from her usual style."

1625263395.m_KeyValue: "Isn't that... the statue from the Captain's room?"

1625263397.m_KeyValue: ""I almost forgot... Please accept this reward, the 'Siren Slayer's Sword of Honor.' You've earned it.""

1625263425.m_KeyValue: ""Close your eyes, and I'll tell you a bedtime story.""

1625263426.m_KeyValue: "The Captain wants to see you. You should head to his study right away."

1625263452.m_KeyValue: "The wealthy... are there really no good ones among them...?"

1625263455.m_KeyValue: "That sounds similar to the siren Miss Lorelei mentioned..."

1625263458.m_KeyValue: "I also had a... strange dream last night."

1625263459.m_KeyValue: ""Rest assured, Mr. Thoreau's security team will see to the safety of every guest.""

1625263460.m_KeyValue: "Where's the silver-haired man who stayed here yesterday?"

1625263461.m_KeyValue: "This is the sacred token of Master Albrecht!"

1625263462.m_KeyValue: "That Noah... He got involved with such dangerous people..."

1625263488.m_KeyValue: ""They use their singing to mesmerize people, making them walk into the sea...""

1625263491.m_KeyValue: "When did fate begin weaving its entanglements? What tragedy do these weaving hands desire?"

1625263492.m_KeyValue: "You mean the one that got hit by a tsunami?"

1625263493.m_KeyValue: ""After Father's death... I should have 'inherited' ownership of Sapphire Isle. But I've been running away for all these years, and now...""

1625263494.m_KeyValue: "Who did this... Was it the one who runs the Isle?"

1625263520.m_KeyValue: ""The first victim was a pirate who robbed the Trading Company's ships, the second was their business competitor, and the third was blackmailing the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages—assuming that's true.""

1625263521.m_KeyValue: ""This sword... it looks like yours, silver-haired? And also kind of like that 'Siren Slayer's Sword of Honor.'""

1625263522.m_KeyValue: ""If that's the case, Master Van Helsing must be in grave danger...""

1625263523.m_KeyValue: "There appears to be a bird in the victim's tattoo as well."

1625263524.m_KeyValue: "This tattoo... it belongs to a pirate crew that operates near Sapphire Isle."

1625263526.m_KeyValue: "Master Van Helsing has taught me many things that money cannot buy."

1625263549.m_KeyValue: ""Eavesdropping is quite unbecoming behavior, young lady.""

1625263551.m_KeyValue: ""You're from the Roland family—wealthy, bold, and well-connected with the Church.""

1625263552.m_KeyValue: ""As you said, my master is wealthy and well-connected with the Church, so why should we cooperate with you?""

1625263553.m_KeyValue: "I am unsure whether Miss Ami knows enough about the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages."

1625263555.m_KeyValue: ""Though I have never seen his face before, no one would dare impersonate one of Sapphire Isle's renowned Seven Sages.""

1625263558.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, so you've already met Mr. Thoreau?""

1626508441.m_KeyValue: "Increases DMG by {0} for Basic ATK while losing {1} of Max HP with each Basic ATK."

1627801251.m_KeyValue: "Receives Healing equal to {0} of Albrecht's Max HP once every {1} sec."

1628289337.m_KeyValue: "The first battle between the Bathory and the Ganelon."

1628289500.m_KeyValue: "During a certain autumn festival held by the family."

1628289535.m_KeyValue: ""The Kalends of August, the day of harvest.""

1628315543.m_KeyValue: "Would a cat under the care of the lavish Matriarch even bother with my meager peace offering?"

1628459283.m_KeyValue: "How could you possibly suggest taking a vacation right now!"

1628799546.m_KeyValue: "Try stroking the key back and forth to awaken it."

1629602980.m_KeyValue: "I believe you've inherited Tris's nobility. And I believe Noah carries a strength that rivals any of us."

1629602981.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you afraid we'll kill him? Or toss him into the sea on the way?"

1629602988.m_KeyValue: ""You sure ask a lot of questions. Bell Ringers aren't miracle workers, you know! If you want to stay behind and rot with the Black Blood, that's your choice!""

1629602989.m_KeyValue: ""The true enemy... You mean Death? Even the Bell Ringer can't stop him? Ressa... Does that mean Jason, Sora... they can't be saved?""

1629602990.m_KeyValue: ""Homeland isn't always a place. Sometimes it's the memories we share with family, with those we love... with those we long for.""

1629602991.m_KeyValue: "Even so... to leave the homeland we've known all our lives..."

1629602992.m_KeyValue: "I'm sure you have your ways of leaving this place."

1629602993.m_KeyValue: "That's what someone dear to me just reminded me of."

1629602994.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll entrust Noah to your care."

1629602995.m_KeyValue: "Naturally. We'll be transporting the black cocoon as well."

1629605164.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it strange? Why did you awaken in that carriage? And why did I allow the Bathorys to take your blood... for resurrection?"

1629605166.m_KeyValue: "Lest you forget—I'm the one who helped you escape the Church."

1629605170.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, the sealed area in Starfall Valley. That's where I'll be waiting.""

1629605171.m_KeyValue: ""If you want answers, then find me in the sealed area...""

1629605693.m_KeyValue: "I thought this was supposed to be a warm-up."

1629605787.m_KeyValue: "Did you feel a spark of thrill in that battle?"

1629605790.m_KeyValue: "You're taking this far more seriously now."

1629605792.m_KeyValue: "Repeat the same moves too often and your opponent will find a way to counter them."

1629609516.m_KeyValue: ""Hate to say this, but we're not out of the woods yet.""

1629609517.m_KeyValue: "You did it. Noah! You really stopped the Divine Body!"

1629609520.m_KeyValue: "I won't let it... end like this!"

1629609523.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I become Death, I am still Noah... Nevernight!""

1631915499.m_KeyValue: ""A rough-skinned newt possessed by Famine. It summons young newts that Self-Destruct near enemies—eliminate them first. When it burrows, watch out for vortex coils.""

1631915564.m_KeyValue: "A junior monk of the Tempus Church. Enemies tainted by the Black Blood are set aflame under their candlestick."

1631915565.m_KeyValue: ""A Divine Body that sealed the Calamity _$$Death,_$$ and the one closest to Aeon's own Will. Assassins and melee units are recommended.""

1631915572.m_KeyValue: ""A creature infected with Black Blood, now transformed into a beast. At low HP, its ATK SPD and DMG will increase.""

1631915594.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious siren from Sapphire Isle, its Special gains power based on the DMG it takes while charging. Interrupt when possible.""

1631915595.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious siren from Sapphire Isle, it throws spinning thorns that deal continuous DMG to nearby targets. Stay away from the spinning thorns.""

1631915596.m_KeyValue: "A choir musician deals high DMG with their lute while increasing allies' damage output. Prioritize eliminating them."

1631915600.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious siren from Sapphire Isle, it summons Healing bubbles that continuously restore HP. Focus on destroying the bubbles first.""

<alpha=#80>Violent yet elegant.""

1635163242.m_KeyValue:
""Slightly roasted tender steak with aromatic blood essence. Served to Bloodborn Vassals. Luxury meal, greatly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Only Bloodborn Elders can afford such luxury.""

1635163244.m_KeyValue:
""Slightly roasted tender steak, served to Bloodborn Vassals. Simple meal, slightly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Ask for no more than a simple meal during a rough journey.""

1637369529.m_KeyValue: "The remains of these nightmares didn't disappear... they've crystallized into fragments. Is this... salt?"

1637370497.m_KeyValue: "That guy with silver hair?! He's on this island as well?"

1637370503.m_KeyValue: ""This is about your family's duty and finding yourself. In the end, you must face it alone.""

1637370504.m_KeyValue: ""After losing your temper, you're back to acting like a Bell Ringer.""

1637370505.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, are you saying... you'll help me fight against Death? That's wonderful! With you by my side...""

1637370506.m_KeyValue: "Don't get your hopes up. Albrecht must have told you that the Bell Ringers are not allowed to interfere too much with the 'predetermined future'..."

1637370507.m_KeyValue: "Noah! I almost forgot he was knocked off the cliff by Death's minions! I have to save him!"

1637370508.m_KeyValue: "...Did you just say Noah? It couldn't be..."

1637370509.m_KeyValue: ""...I understand now. I've made my decision. I used to believe I was all alone, that no one needed me...""

1637370510.m_KeyValue: ""But in truth, Grandmother and you, Acappella, have always been protecting me. As well as Master, and even Noah, whom I just met today...""

1637371585.m_KeyValue: ""Are we sure about this? We're helping Isaac again, even though he's running with the Bloodborn now.""

1637371586.m_KeyValue: ""Albrecht's dim-witted disciple should be able to put two and two together by now. I've dropped enough hints, after all.""

1637371592.m_KeyValue: ""—Hmm, you've got a point, Darcias. If we help out this Van-whatever kid, Albrecht will owe me another one.""

1637371593.m_KeyValue: "Lady Acappella... did you just imply Noah's presence on this island as well?"

1637371594.m_KeyValue: "Did she say silver hair?! So she's looking for Noah too?"

1637371595.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you tell us in the first place."

1637371596.m_KeyValue: "—Their weak point is located just above the center of their chest. Target that spot and strike!"

1637371597.m_KeyValue: ""—Listen up, I'll only say this once: those minions are all smoke and mirrors. They're actually very weak...""

1637371598.m_KeyValue: "And this has nothing to do with Master Albrecht. Stop trying to use me to get to him all the time!"

1637373763.m_KeyValue: "...He said grandmother regretted betraying the family's heritage; regretted running away from her duty."

1637373764.m_KeyValue: "R-Regret? That Albrecht was always spouting nonsense!"

1637373767.m_KeyValue: ""In his eyes, Grandmother was... smart, brave, and bold... He always spoke well of her, but there was one thing that would always make him sad...""

1637373768.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, what kind of person was your grandmother, according to your master?""

1637373769.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... He said grandmother was always putting on a courageous smile, but deep down she was full of regret.""

1637373770.m_KeyValue: "That bastard is capable of feeling sadness? Hmph!"

1637373772.m_KeyValue: ""It may not be my place to say this, but I believe Piera's master wanted her to choose her own path in life.""

1637373773.m_KeyValue: "Piera told me that her master would always tell her stories about her grandmother... about you..."

1637373774.m_KeyValue: "You're wrong! You don't know anything about that madman! His eyes see nothing but his work and evolution!"

1637448211.m_KeyValue: "I see... they're more honest than I thought."

1637553970.m_KeyValue: "I asked Anna to write that letter. It seems she wrote the wrong address."

1638937483.m_KeyValue: ""Where is the Tempus Church now, when the world cries out for salvation? Where are these so-called protectors of the living?""

1638937484.m_KeyValue: ""—been consumed? Fed to the Church's divine order, like good little fuel?""

1639058686.m_KeyValue:
""A parting gift from Stella to Noah before her departure.

These alchemical war machines once pushed the world to the brink of destruction under the Mastermind's control.

But this little construct has been tenderly disarmed—its power core removed, its frame reduced to a harmless size.

No longer a weapon, it now serves a far gentler role: not as a tool of war, but as a companion.""

1639557276.m_KeyValue: "I don't even know who my 'true self' is right now."

1639558235.m_KeyValue: ""Do you really think I, the noble Lady Bathory, would be interested in some poor, backwater region up north?""

1639559289.m_KeyValue: "But why is the Black Blood Disease in town? Is this why the Church attacked?"

1639559323.m_KeyValue: ""Surprised, aren't you? She's not as weak as we thought.""

1639560314.m_KeyValue: ""Are you kidding me? If it's forbidden grounds, how could I possibly take outsiders there?""

1639560315.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, the 'forbidden grounds' are just a legend. In the whole town, perhaps only my father knows if such a place really exists.""

1639560316.m_KeyValue: "That's perfect then. We can go to town together to help your father and ask him about it."

1642861273.m_KeyValue: "I didn't think the Black Blood in our bodies could play such a crucial role."

1642861278.m_KeyValue: ""I recall the war you speak of... At the time I was here, guiding the villagers toward a new life, and they... they...""

1642861279.m_KeyValue: ""When she manifested, I was terrified—afraid that I would become like her, afraid that the world would burn because of who I was, so I...""

1642861280.m_KeyValue: ""We cannot completely prevent the Tempest from breaking the seal, but...""

1642861281.m_KeyValue: ""I witnessed... Seraphina's entire life, every moment leading to this.""

1642861285.m_KeyValue: "Hush. Do try to enjoy the scenery."

1642862302.m_KeyValue: "What are you doing?! Don't go off alone!"

1642862303.m_KeyValue: ""We are still half a day's journey from the area fully engulfed by the Black Mist. If they are surfacing here, it means...""

1642862304.m_KeyValue: "These corpses will yield nothing of worth."

1642862305.m_KeyValue: ""When challenging others, you should at least consider the occasion...""

1642862308.m_KeyValue: "Seraphina... Of all the companions fate could assign me..."

1644152928.m_KeyValue: "And how would you like me to do that?"

1644152933.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, I nearly just had my wings torn off... aren't you concerned about me?""

1644152935.m_KeyValue: "The mess is mine to clean up!"

1644152936.m_KeyValue: "I'm not going on any more 'missions' with you."

1644152937.m_KeyValue: "Are you okay? Does it hurt badly?"

""I was clutched in his burning palm as flames crept up his wrist. Such a familiar sensation—just like that winter when the Carrelle family's princess secretly brought ointment to soothe his whip wounds. Only this time, there were no cool fingers to ease the scorching heat.

The Brennholt title was not just a reward—it was also a tool to maintain the heartbeat of the Divine Body and suppress the Apocalypse _$$War._$$ When Agares won his arena battle and received this surname, he was destined to become a sacrifice for the Divine Body.

As the flames tore through his flesh, I seemed to glimpse their true nature: it wasn't the heat of the Divine Body I felt, but the burning of countless vows to survive. Within each vow, a different face flickered—his, the princess's, and the countless Brennholts, long since turned to bleached bones.

Suddenly, the crackling of his charred skin jolted me from my thoughts. Only then did I realize—I was still in his grip. 'Some promises... not even fire can burn away.'""

1671782785.m_KeyValue:
""Fanny spoke of it lightly, but knowing the Church as I do, she must have endured severe punishment—all for allowing Genevieve and me to escape.

Would the same torments she once wielded be turned upon her own flesh?

Guilt engulfs me like a rising tide. I must see her again.""

1671782940.m_KeyValue:
""Most people have fantasized about having the power of precognition, and I'm no exception. So when I received that letter, alongside disbelief, there was also a hint of joy at seeing such a fantasy become reality. When imagination becomes real, when you can know what's going to happen in the future—such allure is hard to resist.

Beyond matters of life and death, even taking seriously the incident about breaking Cain's wine bottle could have prevented the later _$$debt collection._$$ So regardless of whether what that version of me said was true or false, I wanted to give it a try.""

1671902725.m_KeyValue:
""At some point, I became known as the accomplice of demons. Despite being a healer, people avoided me wherever I went, their eyes filled with fear.
'Raven Mask Demon'—that's what they called me. When I asked my colleagues why, they could only offer resigned looks:
'You always use the sacrifice of some to save others.'
Was that so wrong?
I've never understood why it was considered a mistake to let some die to ensure the survival of many others. I pondered this question in the lab, my vision blurring, my body heating, my limbs growing weak...
'Ahem—'
Was the dark red blood on the desk really from my own body?
It turned out I had been infected by the patients without even realizing it.
Should I also lock myself away and prevent others from getting infected?""

1682873894.m_KeyValue: ""'Could it be the garlic rotting inside your helmet?' Nicole chuckled, slowly approaching Gadric and moving to remove his helmet. 'Plants need proper ventilation, you know.'""

1683293790.m_KeyValue: "You're mistaken. I'm not your prisoner anymore."

1683331771.m_KeyValue: ""The castle harbors too many echoes of my former life, yet circumstances now bar me from ever crossing its threshold again.""

1684994573.m_KeyValue: "It's not that... I just realized... I might have done something bad."

1684994574.m_KeyValue: ""...I recall you saying the village was at the base of the mountain, but we've been subtly veering off the right path this whole time...""

1684994575.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. You see, the phantoms had already existed on the island, but they never harmed anyone. It was only after being corrupted by Death that they turned into these nightmares.""

1684994576.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer?! Are you saying a Bell Ringer has come to this island again? Just like what happened 66 years ago?"

1684994605.m_KeyValue: "That's ridiculous! Wouldn't we know if we were a phantom?"

1684994606.m_KeyValue: ""I don't remember dying... Do you, Noah?""

1684994607.m_KeyValue: ""Jason, Sora, and I, along with you and Dr. Ressa, have been living together on this island for many years now.""

1684994631.m_KeyValue: ""The resolve to challenge predetermined fate with a fragile form; the courage to pursue one's own will in the face of cruel reality, that is—""

1684994632.m_KeyValue: "Is it truly appropriate to speak of someone in such a manner when they're present?"

1684994637.m_KeyValue: "I haven't even said what your crime was. Aren't you getting ahead of yourself?"

1684994638.m_KeyValue: "You should understand this better than anyone else in this world. Yet you still did it... Why did it have to be you..."

1684994639.m_KeyValue: "You're not ready to use Covenant just yet."

1684994641.m_KeyValue: "Twenty-one. Never underestimate a Bell Ringer's sense of time."

1684994642.m_KeyValue: "Why do you have the same look in your eyes as that old woman? Why is everyone abandoning me?"

1684994643.m_KeyValue: ""What nonsense are you spouting! You're about to lose your life, and you're talking about duty?!""

1684994644.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't a Vice-Commander always with their Bell Ringer when on duty? ...Just like you, idiot.""

1684994663.m_KeyValue: "—A loud sound is coming from the easternmost part of the island."

1684994664.m_KeyValue: ""After inheriting the 'Air Manipulation' ability from the 10th Bell Ringer, she became even more adept at controlling the air to enhance her sound abilities.""

1684994669.m_KeyValue: "I don't get it. What are you two talking about?"

1684994670.m_KeyValue: "She's not the Piera from 66 years ago! She's the granddaughter of that old hag—of that person!"

1684994671.m_KeyValue: ""...You could say we were shipmates for a while, searching for Sunset Isle.""

1684994673.m_KeyValue: "Your heartbeat has calmed down. I can sense the courage you two give each other."

1684994674.m_KeyValue: ""And should that one-in-a-million scenario come to pass, I'll be compelled to act—with such extremity that no one around me will be safe.""

1684994675.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, they weren't completely destroyed... Rumor was that they managed to achieve some form of 'eternal life' and now live in seclusion, adhering to the First Tenet of Secrecy.""

1684994676.m_KeyValue: "No... what I mean is... Noah might be a Bloodborn... an enemy of the Church. I don't want you to harm him..."

1684994698.m_KeyValue: "Commander! She's... my friend! How can you speak of this so lightly..."

1684994701.m_KeyValue: ""We were going to spare you, as one of the family, but you know too much...""

1684994702.m_KeyValue: ""You must leave now, little Piera. You can't go any deeper.""

1684994705.m_KeyValue: ""Um... I think you might have me confused with someone else. My name is Piera, but... the Piera you know... is probably my grandmother?""

1684994706.m_KeyValue: "Thoughts come from oneself while longings involve others."

1684994707.m_KeyValue: ""Great ancestors... please hear me out. Death, who was sealed away 66 years ago by my grandmother and the Church, has broken free and returned.""

1684994708.m_KeyValue: ""It's also our shared memory of fighting against Death, coursing through our blood.""

1684994729.m_KeyValue: "Piera! Are you alright?! Are you hurt anywhere?"

1684994730.m_KeyValue: ""At the time, I still held onto my determination to destroy Death with my own hands, so I agreed. But little did I know...""

1684994733.m_KeyValue: "So that's why those former inhabitants of Sunset Isle became Death's followers... and turned into those monsters."

1684994734.m_KeyValue: ""No... no! Grandmother, you once told me... this isn't... isn't how we should 'live'!""

1684994735.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for understanding... Noah, I remember 66 years ago, you were the only one who understood my decision...""

1684994736.m_KeyValue: ""He gave you the salt stake that I had sealed away... if you really became a sacrifice, he'd be Death's accomplice!""

1684994737.m_KeyValue: ""This statue... it's beautiful, but also so... full of sorrow...""

1684994738.m_KeyValue: ""If Death hadn't escaped from the Church, I would have almost... fallen into a life that was never meant to be mine...""

1684994739.m_KeyValue: "It's time to end this... end this curse that has shackled us for generations..."

1684994740.m_KeyValue: ""I know... but I'm the family's last Gravekeeper. This is the duty you entrusted to me, Grandmother. I have to...""

1684994767.m_KeyValue: ""Geez, I've been waiting all this time...""

1684994768.m_KeyValue: ""This isn't who I am! And you, Piera... this can't be your destiny!""

1684994770.m_KeyValue: "While I can... still hold on... run Noah... the further... the better..."

1684994771.m_KeyValue: "Just hold on! I'm trying to remember! I have to stop the bleeding somehow!"

1685991648.m_KeyValue: "Seems like the light half is on his way here. You've outlived your purpose."

1685991651.m_KeyValue: ""I believed this place—this ruin—would give birth to a new order, one shaped by the free.""
