1687180899.m_KeyValue: ""He's what I've been chasing my whole life, and the one who led me out of my despair.""

1687180900.m_KeyValue: "Why is the Church targeting Mouret? Just because the Black Blood has spread here?"

1687180901.m_KeyValue: "That's a horrific thought you just blurted out!"

1687180902.m_KeyValue: "I... I can't bear to lose anyone else!"

1687180931.m_KeyValue: ""Now you're at your wit's end, having turned into this state yourself. My old friend... do you have any regrets?""

1687181196.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph! The north of Lupine Forest is overrun by a bunch of savage, smelly werewolves! How could we possibly have good relations with them?""

1687181197.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, Brave travelers! I shall remember this charitable deed in my heart...""

1687181198.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... fangs, long ears, and pale skin...""

1687181229.m_KeyValue: ""If you can block my attack, I'll leave you be. What do you say?""

1687181232.m_KeyValue: ""Very well, I'll wait here and see if you can forge a different path.""

1687181233.m_KeyValue: "This young lady speaks quite rudely! I am not one to break my promises!"

1687181259.m_KeyValue: ""The 'moon' is likely just a symbol. Before we set out, he mentioned that Mouret harbors a set of 'forbidden grounds.'""

1687181261.m_KeyValue: "I want to change that. I want to fight back. I want to know 'why.'"

1687181265.m_KeyValue: "We can't let these stinking bats push us around! Let's teach them a lesson!"

1687181266.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you call me a butcher? You're just a mangy wolf who believes everything you hear!"

1687181295.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, so the Ganelon family does have someone worth a second look after all.""

1687181296.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Lady Empousa. We can't just leave her behind now.""

1687181297.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, we haven't seen anyone else besides you and a knight with a garlic-shaped head.""

1687181298.m_KeyValue: ""So it's all true? Your betrayal of The Church, and the rumors about embracing the power of Black Blood?!""

1687181323.m_KeyValue: "Um... What I meant to say was..."

1687181327.m_KeyValue: ""But if you insist on following me, that's your choice...""

1687181328.m_KeyValue: "Leave them out of this. I'm the one you're after!"

1687181330.m_KeyValue: "What's with this kid? Why's he so attached to you?"

1687181358.m_KeyValue: ""That person over there just now, could it be...""

1687181359.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, I didn't know you were versed in medicine.""

1687181360.m_KeyValue: ""As I thought, it's not so easy to shake off these persistent bastards...""

1687181361.m_KeyValue: ""When we separated, he went north alone to draw away the Church. That direction is... Ah!""

1687181362.m_KeyValue: ""No, at least not the current me. But my past self... I'm not sure.""

1687181389.m_KeyValue: ""But don't be afraid, Hati. I'll protect you, just like when we were kids!""

1687181390.m_KeyValue: "But now's not the time for reminiscing."

1687181391.m_KeyValue: "The Church already has monsters like the Bell Ringers. Why do they need each family's Gravekeeper to guard anything?"

1687181392.m_KeyValue: "No way! I don't smell any hostility at all!"

1687181394.m_KeyValue: ""He doesn't want you to be the Gravekeeper, so I have to inherit the role...""

1687203152.m_KeyValue: "{1} of Barnacle No. 1 emerge from the cave after a while."

1687260395.m_KeyValue: "Is this some kind of new scam?"

1687283302.m_KeyValue: "This isn't suppose to happen! The ritual hasn't even—"

1687283305.m_KeyValue: ""And now, I've found a way to bring Joan back. So we can stand guard over this land—together—forever.""

1687404135.m_KeyValue: "The Aegis family's current plight isn't entirely her doing."

1691861444.m_KeyValue: ""Be very careful, though the Soulless is their leader, the most dangerous one is actually that white-haired....""

1691861445.m_KeyValue: ""Are you referring to me? Coming from you, it's an honor.""

1691861450.m_KeyValue: "How dare you speak of Jacintha like that!"

1691861451.m_KeyValue: ""You can't even tell Empousa and Lamia apart, yet you're judging a cat's beauty?""

1691861452.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, the lovely Jacintha caught a whiff of danger and ran off first—""

1691861454.m_KeyValue: "(sighing) As the newest elder... I suppose I should deal with it."

1691861455.m_KeyValue: "I don't know how strong they are... but we're all seasoned warriors too!"

1691861456.m_KeyValue: "Enough! Are you two waiting for me to do everything myself?!"

1691861457.m_KeyValue: "Eh? But this new 'silver-haired' lad looks like he could become a lucrative customer. I'd hate to kill a potential client."

1691862599.m_KeyValue: ""Shh! Keep your voice down, or we'll attract the guards!""

1691862602.m_KeyValue: ""You're... the fabled shepherd of the Moonblessed, Aiona Alita!""

1691862604.m_KeyValue: "I am a faithful follower of the Moonblessed! Please take me with you! I will surely be of help!"

1691862605.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, uh... this warrior with the booming voice is...""

1691862606.m_KeyValue: ""I swear, if I ever make it out alive, I will have my revenge!""

1691862607.m_KeyValue: "That demon has hated flesh ever since. Unfortunately my clansmen were natural-born warriors with strong builds..."

1692410499.m_KeyValue: ""Then here's to you, the warmonger who claims to be a peace advocate.""

1692410501.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps that's why she took the earring... In her eyes, I'm gradually becoming another Carrelle.""

1692410502.m_KeyValue: "Why would I want to get involved in something this complicated?"

1694410578.m_KeyValue: ""The Lord is dead, slain! The city's in chaos—everyone says Cornelius has seized the throne!""

1694410579.m_KeyValue: "Do you remember our days in the arena? Please… be as you were then."

1694410580.m_KeyValue: "No way! Joan and I are both abandoned orphans—we only have each other. I won't accept some false kin who appears out of nowhere!"

1695150714.m_KeyValue: "Ami has been spending an unusual amount of time in the library lately. I should ask her what's going on."

1695222456.m_KeyValue: ""Carrelle sacrifices slaves as 'firewood,' casting them into the blazing heart of the Divine Body—a tragedy written in fate.""

1695702236.m_KeyValue: ""We can’t see her through this crowd! Quickly, let's push to the front!""

1695822185.m_KeyValue: ""But the people in these stories are always fighting, or harboring suspicions and hurting each other. The protagonist's journey is never smooth sailing...""

1697050117.m_KeyValue: ""What choice do I have? My Knights barely listen to me as it is, and now they're hearing I devoured my own siblings. The way they look at me grows more suspicious by the day.""

1697088354.m_KeyValue: "The Duke lies gravely ill. The servants are silent—too silent—and the air hangs thick with decay. There's a suffocating sense of death."

1697265855.m_KeyValue: "Then I'd guess you're an _$$Ancient One_$$—someone who lived through that legendary battle."

1697352331.m_KeyValue: ""Either way, you've saved my life, and I'll repay that debt for sure.""

1697353353.m_KeyValue: ""Black uniform, silver hair... it's him! The heretic that escaped, Noah Nevernight!""

1697616905.m_KeyValue: "You have to rub it... just... the right... way."

1697890531.m_KeyValue: ""Eh? The chest is locked too? Well, well, seems the Church's enforcers have actually gotten smarter.""

1698455124.m_KeyValue: "Repel the Church's elite forces sweeping through the village."

1698897172.m_KeyValue: "I take it you're never giving my sketchbook back."

1698966084.m_KeyValue: "The Calamity _$$Plague_$$ was sealed by the Ganelon family for generations and is now believed to be the root cause of the Black Blood pandemic afflicting the continent."

1699753573.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. That lance is the key they've been searching for."

1699753575.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if she fought beside you. This is our last refuge, and I won't have her join us.""

1703215326.m_KeyValue:
""Despite her branch-family origins, Setti rose swiftly through the Church—first as an exceptionally appointed hunter, then as Vice-Commander under Bell Ringer Agares within just a few short years.

As one of the Carrelle, she held deep reverence for the legendary figure who bore their name.

In Agares's frequent absence, Setti journeyed across the continent, spreading the Church's gospel and salvation to all.

With each step, her faith deepened, and her confidence grew. She came to believe her arrows could pierce through all shadows and injustice.""

1703215450.m_KeyValue:
""Empousa brings moonlight and serenity, but at the cost of a farewell forever to the sun. Before sunset, the light rejects us, and we hide in corners forgotten by the sun. After sunset, the moon appears, and we roam in dreams woven by its light.

Meeting Hati was like encountering another sun. This little wolf, who races through the forest with joy, yields to nothing the fates dare offer. Where she goes, warmth follows.""

1703215485.m_KeyValue:
""I can sense that Aiona has witnessed farewells between life and death far beyond imagination.

When time flows in reverse, most things can be restored. But fate, with cruel precision, cast life itself beyond time's reach—denying Aiona any chance to intervene. Faced with the infinite stream of time, the sliver she can bend with her delicate fingers is as feeble as silt upon a riverbed.

And the void growing within her year after year has become a hollow so vast, not even eons could ever mend it.""

1703215543.m_KeyValue:
""Jess brought the black shield and followed her parents' footsteps, pushing open the castle gates.

Behind them lay not the heroes of Aegis, but the remains of the deceived.

The bloodthirsty armor appraised her like a butcher sizing up a calf.

'These are your kin.'

Helplessly, she watched as her brethren fell into the Abyss, their dark pupils questioning her.

Is that shield in your hands a weapon to protect your family, or merely a shelter for a coward?

She dare not stand on high ground, fearing the vengeful spirits gazing up at her.""

1703215640.m_KeyValue:
""I remember Cain saying that he had originally meant for Lamia to go to Starfall Valley that night.

Empousa happened to overhear his conversation with Lamia, and that's why she arrived there first.

At first, I thought it was just typical rivalry between heirs, until Aiona revealed another side of the story—

That night, Empousa passed by the study, expecting to hear them discuss the usual topics like Alchemy or prophecies.

Until the word _$$dangerous_$$ caught her ear, and she heard Cain ordering Lamia to rescue a silver-haired man alone.

Fearing she might lose another sister, she immediately picked some scarlet flowers from the castle's back garden and, under cover of night, silently left the city disguised as a flower girl.""

1703215857.m_KeyValue: ""The Puppet Association near the castle is well known in the area and has built a loyal customer base—one of whom happens to be our current debtor: Mr. Derek, the shopkeep from Verse & Valor. The debt collection went unusually smoothly. But what truly caught my attention was something he mentioned in passing: Elder Bella has been regularly ordering books on philosophical discourse from his shop. Titles such as Existence Precedes Essence, Cogito, ergo sum, and Becoming Yourself.""

1703534747.m_KeyValue: "Who are you...? Why would a letter come from the castle?"

1703639446.m_KeyValue: "I believe we've found our path to the end."

1703639447.m_KeyValue: ""Mass Carrelle... No, I should call her by her true name—Genevieve Carrelle. An old companion of mine, a fugitive trapped in a temporal prison. Like you, she carries the same hunger to reach the end.""

1703639455.m_KeyValue: "Warning: Discipline protocol in progress. Remain still. Cease all unnecessary actions."

1703639456.m_KeyValue: ""But cages are all I have ever known. The door stands open, yet I dare not step through.""

1703639457.m_KeyValue: ""No—worse. It's a void, severed from existence by a power beyond reason.""

1703639458.m_KeyValue: ""Then let me set you free, Fanny.""

1703639460.m_KeyValue: "Can't you hear them? The people here... they're still calling out to me."

1703639461.m_KeyValue: ""At the very least, she is no longer the Fanny we knew. Now she holds the power to seek her freedom.""

1703640478.m_KeyValue: ""Seeking the way out? This may not be that mad Fanny's ward, yet Aeon's gaze is everywhere. Do not think escape so easily won.""

1703640479.m_KeyValue: "Are you being grateful? Or do you actually enjoy this?"

1703640480.m_KeyValue: "Those weapons that fell from the sky… they bore the Church's seal. So this truly is their ground."

1703640481.m_KeyValue: "Whatever it conceals—even if not the Church's most guarded secret—must surely betray her weakness."

1703640506.m_KeyValue: "I don't recall there being any bad blood between us."

1704246226.m_KeyValue: "Ryan suddenly calls one of the soldiers trailing Seraphina aside."

1706082557.m_KeyValue: ""Your very existence reminds me of my shame—I, once a master of Alchemy, now rotting here, humiliated day after day.""

1706082558.m_KeyValue: ""Since you first drew breath within these walls, here you shall also breathe your last. From this moment on, I have no daughter... and you, no father.""

1706082559.m_KeyValue: "Wh-what do you mean? Aren't we going to the outside world together?"

1706082560.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Fanny... but I never meant to take you with me. You should never have been born. Raised in this cesspit, you're nothing but a puppet of doctrine—unfit to set foot beyond these walls.""

1706082561.m_KeyValue: ""The man tore the keys from the girl's hand, trembling as he forced them toward the lock.""

1706082562.m_KeyValue: "Heh... you're overthinking it. There's no need for farewells. You can stay here forever."

1706082569.m_KeyValue: "The man thrust open the heavy door and hurled himself headlong into the blazing light beyond."

1706461738.m_KeyValue: ""Though the linework still bears traces of inexperience, the precision of detail and the masterful capture of atmosphere stand out...""

1706461739.m_KeyValue: "The survey maps from the castle—they've finally arrived!"

1706461740.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you wouldn't happen to be some sort of secret cartographic prodigy, would you?""

1706461741.m_KeyValue: "To create such artistry in so perilous a place..."

1706461742.m_KeyValue: ""So, does that mean I can call it quits on the survey?""

1708197603.m_KeyValue: ""A phantom of longing corrupted by _$$Death,_$$ now completely devoid of sanity. For some unknown reason, it doesn't vanish upon defeat like other phantoms.""

1708960779.m_KeyValue: "Do you also experience this feeling of being watched from places hard to comprehend?"

1708960845.m_KeyValue: ""Cycles entwined, all consumed and laid to rest.""

1708960876.m_KeyValue: "I should no longer run from my true self."

1708963885.m_KeyValue: ""Even someone like me... I will follow... No, pursue you for life!""

1708969475.m_KeyValue: "Are you practicing? It's more effective to set the reward and punishment first."

1708969572.m_KeyValue: ""Classical, romantic, realistic, fantasy... I've collected so many dreamscapes.""

1708971525.m_KeyValue: ""Next time, remember to buy a ticket first.""

1708971715.m_KeyValue: "I shall dedicate the finale of life's symphony to this dance."

1708971746.m_KeyValue: "These legs can carry me to even greater distances."

1708972740.m_KeyValue: "Listen to the seedlings breaking through the soil."

1708973823.m_KeyValue: "Admiration is the furthest cry from understanding. You have my regrets."

1708973920.m_KeyValue: ""We witness the blaze of life burning bright, until time turns it all to ashes.""

1708975873.m_KeyValue: ""What do you expect from this cold, lifeless body?""

1708976094.m_KeyValue: "The feeling deep within my mind... so strange."

1708976929.m_KeyValue: "To gain something... something else must be given."

1708977022.m_KeyValue: "Humans cannot resist the will of the gods."

1709470347.m_KeyValue: "Fine by me! Let's finish them all off in one go!"

1709564601.m_KeyValue: "Shall we go make some new memories?"

1709564602.m_KeyValue: ""Two figures walk side by side, slowly surrendering themselves to the embrace of shadow.""

1709564603.m_KeyValue: "But when I saw that child's remains... I felt afraid again."

1709564604.m_KeyValue: "There are things that must be done while I still can."

1709564605.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, you're the one who said you wanted to see me.""

1791143592.m_KeyValue: ""I get it... sort of. If they're here but not in the 'present' here, then are they here or not...""

1791143593.m_KeyValue: ""Scent? I guess you really are a wolf, even though you don't look like the others at all.""

1791143594.m_KeyValue: "You said these disgusting things were the seeds of Plague?"

1791143595.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, he was there too. Twenty years ago, Noah and I fought side by side to save him from succumbing to the Black Blood disease.""

1791143597.m_KeyValue: ""I've heard her say that before. I think it means don't try to change fate, or you'll just be dragged along with it. But I don't really get it either.""

1791143624.m_KeyValue: ""...The hidden moon, could it be referring to something they've concealed in this forbidden land?""

1791143625.m_KeyValue: "The 'me' you know—the me from twenty years later. Am I any different from the weak and insecure person I am now?"

1791143626.m_KeyValue: "I see. You really are the type of person who takes promises very seriously..."

1791143627.m_KeyValue: "That's why Clive could see their memories just now. And these carriers... can also glimpse into Clive's memories!"

1791143628.m_KeyValue: ""No, he hasn't given up fighting the Black Blood yet.""

1791143629.m_KeyValue: "N-Noah... D-Don't come any closer...! G-Go away...!"

1791143888.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, have you ever considered that your real home wasn't in Mouret?""

1791143889.m_KeyValue: ""Hati... It's not the gods who determine our fate, but ourselves.""

1791143890.m_KeyValue: ""Even if what you're saying is true, what could be Father's reason?""

1791143891.m_KeyValue: "You still wish to lead the way for them and raise the curtain to your own tragedy?"

1791143892.m_KeyValue: "Just what are you trying to find in the forbidden grounds?"

1791143893.m_KeyValue: ""As for my previous identity, the only clue I have is finding the four legendary Moonblessed.""

1791143894.m_KeyValue: ""That's why I'm going in myself, no matter the danger.""

1791143895.m_KeyValue: "Wh-what's wrong with you all of a sudden?"

1791143922.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, didn't that garlic head say he would take care of everything? Why is the Church still on our tail?""

1791143923.m_KeyValue: "Clive? He was with you? But where's Noah? Why isn't he with you?"

1791143952.m_KeyValue: "What did they say? The water was contaminated... with Black Blood? But... but..."

1791143954.m_KeyValue: "Water? Where did you get water from?"

1791143955.m_KeyValue: ""This should be our first meeting, I believe.""

1791143958.m_KeyValue: ""It matters not to me. Why don't you explain it to Gilrain, who proposed we work together in the first place...""

1791143959.m_KeyValue: "I'm fine. It's just… we've already entered the forbidden grounds. Let's go find the other two."

1791143984.m_KeyValue: "The Aiona I know would never do such a thing."

1791143986.m_KeyValue: "And where are you going? We never said you could leave."

1791143987.m_KeyValue: "I don't know. I don't understand. All these voices... telling me things I can't comprehend."

1791143988.m_KeyValue: "You say you know how to control the Black Blood?"

1791143989.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain, why did you attack?! He's only a child!""

1791143990.m_KeyValue: ""No, that's not true! They're not Blood Beasts, they're people! They're all people of Mouret, my companions!""

1791144012.m_KeyValue: "That's why I understand Clive's pain better than anyone. I have to bring him back... back to Hati's side!"

1791144013.m_KeyValue: ""They are not poisonous, but they would explode…""

1791144016.m_KeyValue: ""You're very worried about that child, aren't you?""

1791144018.m_KeyValue: ""Despite their young age, they've become the leaders of their families and gained the Church's favor. Now they are competing for the Bell Ringer position left by Lord Roland, the 'King of Light'...""

1791144019.m_KeyValue: "It seems someone triggered those mushrooms. Could it be..."

1791144020.m_KeyValue: ""It seems that even though the Black Blood has not affected you, you can still be suppressed by the Divine Body.""

1791144021.m_KeyValue: ""Therefore, the Divine Body can be said to be the most powerful counteractant to the Black Blood. Because of your...""

1791144023.m_KeyValue: "Cidhall... I feel like I've heard that name before..."

1791144053.m_KeyValue: "But isn't your Ganelon family crest a dumb wolf's head?"

1791144054.m_KeyValue: "Aiona... How did you know about the terrain here?"

1791144055.m_KeyValue: ""Easy for you to say, you can fly! Just you wait, you stinking bat!""

1791144085.m_KeyValue: ""Have you also pondered that question? 'If humans are destined to die, why are they born in the first place?'""

1791144086.m_KeyValue: "Is that the type of life you're after? A quiet paradise..."

1791144087.m_KeyValue: ""For now, the sources of the Black Blood is still sealed by the Divine Bodies. The number of infected is still manageable. Not to mention, we still have Doctor Thibault.""

1794584410.m_KeyValue: "Who else could've done it? The whole crew's lost their minds!"

1794584411.m_KeyValue: "That's where Captain Peacock gave his speech before we set sail... Why would William choose that place to hang himself?"

1794584412.m_KeyValue: ""The helm is just above us in the aftcastle. If we want to take the wheel, we'll have to fight our way up there.""

1794584413.m_KeyValue: "Wait... Why'd they suddenly stop chasing us? They're not following us in?"

1794584415.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. Van Helsing, have you forgotten your original duty was to protect me?""

1794584435.m_KeyValue: ""If something gets in your way, just kick it aside!""

1794584442.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't it you who said Noah might be in trouble on the other side of the ship?"

1794584443.m_KeyValue: "If you don't want that day to be today—stay away from me."

1794584444.m_KeyValue: "Now that I think on it… the very first to speak of destroying the infected crew's bodies was Captain Goldland himself."

1794584445.m_KeyValue: "True… we never saw anyone leave that cabin. Perhaps there's a passage only the Captain knows about?"

1794584446.m_KeyValue: ""The first was in the cabin, when we discovered Aaron's body. William's immediate reaction was to ask why Aaron had been murdered.""

1794584447.m_KeyValue: "Jones's reaction makes me suspect he knew about the poisoning—perhaps he was even directly involved."

1794584448.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm… and after that, William used the helm to kill Aaron, but we've already gone over that part. Let's move on.""

1794584449.m_KeyValue: "...Wait! Something's not right. I remember Joseph skipped his meal because of a conversation he had while delivering wine to Goldland. But I distinctly recall..."

1794584475.m_KeyValue: ""They look terrifying, but they're all bark and no bite!""

1794584476.m_KeyValue: ""Forget it! One of the Ganelon family mottos says: 'When the weak call for help, never stand idle!'""

1794584506.m_KeyValue: ""Then I won't allow it. I must protect this place—its food, its sanctity. They shall not have it.""

1794584508.m_KeyValue: ""Like the tale of Octo the squid, who became Captain by pretending to be an octopus?""

1794584509.m_KeyValue: "Your unusual appetite—far stronger than what one would consider natural—closely mirrors the ravenous hunger that afflicts those infected with Black Blood."

1794584510.m_KeyValue: ""Just as he did, on the other side.""

1794584512.m_KeyValue: "And what you remembered nearly matches what I saw that day."

1794584513.m_KeyValue: ""That would be the Captain's research chamber. Ordinary crew aren't permitted inside. Lately, it's been William entering and leaving the most.""

1794584534.m_KeyValue: ""To protect the El Dorado until the very end—that, I can still do. And as for setting William straight… I leave that to all of you.""

1794584535.m_KeyValue: "Your venom no longer wounds me! I never needed them."

1794584538.m_KeyValue: ""He must have uncovered what I was doing with Jones in secret… He's heading there to stop me again—to stand in my way, as always!""

1794584539.m_KeyValue: ""All of this… was truly your doing? William… at the very least, tell me the Captain wasn't—""

1794584540.m_KeyValue: "He treats strangers like family—how could he abandon his own blood when it truly mattered? He never meant to blame you..."

1794584541.m_KeyValue: ""So there truly is a Divine Body on Sunset Isle... If they always appear in pairs, then Cain's intelligence was right! There must be a Moonblessed on that island too.""

1794584542.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to speak plainly. I have no sympathy for those who scorn themselves and long to become someone else."

1794584543.m_KeyValue: ""I was rather hoping the object of your devotion was the sea, not... something stranger.""

1794584544.m_KeyValue: "Not everyone's a coward like you. So terrified of a threat that you'd rather eliminate it."

1794584545.m_KeyValue: ""I, Isaac Van Helsing, Eighth of the Silver Cross, hereby commence inquisitorial judgment upon you—Captain Goldland.""

1794584570.m_KeyValue: "Then why does jellyfish girl still look half-dead? Didn't we already finish off those monsters?"

1794584571.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa, you and Aiona take Ami and head back the way we came. Find Hati and regroup.""

1794584574.m_KeyValue: ""That is Miss Ami, an apprentice aboard this vessel. She's likely mourning and just doesn't know how to show it. ...Why ""jellyfish""?""

1794584575.m_KeyValue: "You're impressive. To deduce that someone had laced the food with Black Blood at William's behest without ever stepping foot in the kitchen. That was no small feat."

1794584576.m_KeyValue: "It doesn't matter... no one's death matters..."

1794584577.m_KeyValue: "Come out now. No one will ever take you to that wretched place again—that accursed Sunset Isle."

1794584604.m_KeyValue: ""Yes… this power... The one that swallows islands, overturns seas… I felt it in your blood before…""

1794584605.m_KeyValue: ""William, I've seen your research records. If you had committed yourself to alchemy, you would've been exceptional.""

1794584607.m_KeyValue: "This is no exaggeration. It's written in the Church's chronicles. The former Bell Ringer No. X fell to one of the Calamities."

1794584608.m_KeyValue: "She may be older than the world itself."

1794584609.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, after all of it… she left me too. Just like the rest. Was I nothing but a jest… from the start?""

1796329235.m_KeyValue: "As expected of the Fool chosen by destiny."

1796472975.m_KeyValue: "You finally realized you sent the wrong things?"

1797434965.m_KeyValue:
""Moonblessed:
 It's been a hundred days since your resurrection. My apologies, but such brief periods hold little meaning to me.
 Watching Empousa prepare gifts for you, however, I, as your steward, felt obliged to extend my courtesy.""

1797434967.m_KeyValue:
""Dear Esteemed Guest of the Bathorys,
Have you heard of Sapphire Isle? Once ruined by the tsunami, it was rebuilt by the hands of the Seven Sages. The tides carried away a heavy past, and from its ruins, a new brilliance has risen.
Let the warm breeze lift your fatigue, and let fine wine lull your senses. At our well-loved auction house, for but a modest price, anything your heart desires may be yours. Countless travelers arrive with hope, and depart with joy.
Now, as high summer draws near and the days grow ever warmer, I extend to you my most sincere invitation. Enclosed is a small token of my regard. I await your arrival and may your time here be nothing short of perfect.""

1798847449.m_KeyValue: "I received a letter from Acappella. She said you've been unusually warm toward her these days."

1798919447.m_KeyValue: ""How odd. Sir Gadric was quite certain when he gave me the address, assuring me that the organ could be purchased through the local merchant association.""

1799722596.m_KeyValue: ""Most Ganelon soldiers come from humble families and possess unwavering loyalty to their commander. This blind trust makes them fearless on the battlefield, charging without hesitation even when facing the most formidable enemies.""

1799722597.m_KeyValue: ""Astolfo flourished from barren sands, a lone pearl on the desert's breast. To shield it from the consuming dunes, we recite prayers for its eternal preservation with our lives.""

1799722600.m_KeyValue: ""Clergy of the Tempus Church who guards heretics and criminals. Their blessed arrows mercilessly pin sinners to the walls—yet sometimes, those very arrows strike their former companions.""

1799722632.m_KeyValue: "A moon-shaped egg with a Plague Hatchling inside. Witnessing its hatching would forever alter your understanding of _$$giving birth._$$"

1815028464.m_KeyValue: "As expected of two who've already obtained five cards. You saved me the trouble of having to explain."

1815028466.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps I should graciously hand over the card I've been safekeeping to you, without wounding your pride too much. That would be for the best, wouldn't it?""

1815028467.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps everyone is being manipulated by some higher power—though you might prefer to call it 'fate.'"

1815028469.m_KeyValue: "66... Don't do this to yourself. These memories... We don't even know what's real and what's fake."

1815028496.m_KeyValue: ""Look, our destination is just ahead. We're almost there!""

1815028523.m_KeyValue: ""I don't understand what you mean by that. Everyone here has their own hopes and dreams, and that's why we're sisters.""

1815028529.m_KeyValue: "So those things outside came from here..."

1815028530.m_KeyValue: ""This is quite troublesome. If you die, it'll take an enormous amount of time to screen for another suitable vessel.""

1845217214.m_KeyValue: ""A dark, bitter liquid that keeps one alert through the night. Would likely fetch a good price among night watchmen and ascetics.""

1845260993.m_KeyValue: ""Note that there are different types of mechanisms. Some only activate while standing on them, and deactivate as soon as you step off.""

1846704272.m_KeyValue: ""It seems no one could resist the wealth and treasures of the sea. Wouldn't you agree, Lady Dalcarlo?""

1846704273.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather, those who see through a ""Magician's"" tricks must always pay a small price.""

1846704307.m_KeyValue: "I'll join you once I've stabilized the ship."

1846704338.m_KeyValue: ""It seems in this voyage, we are not just the ""Hermit,"" but also the ""Death.""""

1850563512.m_KeyValue: "Am I going to be wanted now?"

1850674401.m_KeyValue: "Yes! Isn't your wish to escape with me?"

1850675418.m_KeyValue: ""Well, they're both from the Bathory family.""

1850675421.m_KeyValue: "Do you think there might be some connection between them?"

1850675514.m_KeyValue: "...Why are you always so perceptive about the strangest things?"

1850675515.m_KeyValue: "See! They even talk the same way!"

1850675516.m_KeyValue: ""Ladies, this game has gone on long enough.""

1850677458.m_KeyValue: ""Come, join us... and leave behind your troubles.""

1850677459.m_KeyValue: "Why are you telling me all this..."

1850677472.m_KeyValue: ""The more I chase, the further it gets from me, until it disappears without a trace.""

1850677473.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of the Astrolabe's projection, it can recreate me so accurately.""

1850677562.m_KeyValue: "A caged bird should not yearn for the sky."

1850677564.m_KeyValue: "But even a caged bird yearns for something."

1850677569.m_KeyValue: "Every feather of this caged bird has long been etched with the radiance of freedom!"

1850677627.m_KeyValue: ""Come, join us... and leave the pain behind.""

1850677628.m_KeyValue: ""Our true home lies on the far side of the moon, yet none has ever seen it.""

1853417792.m_KeyValue: "That chilling silver hair and those inscrutable crimson eyes..."

1855442553.m_KeyValue: "You yearn to break free from the shackles of flesh and journey to the other side where souls dwell... Such an ideal is both romantic and admirable."

1855442561.m_KeyValue: ""You might not care, but perhaps your Moonblessed friend would be interested?""

1855442563.m_KeyValue: "I've been hearing things about you from a friend these past few days."

1855442566.m_KeyValue: "Learning that such a gentle faction as the Moonblessed has emerged among the Bloodborn brings me such pleasant surprise."

1855442567.m_KeyValue: "My understanding remains rooted in an era when the Bloodborn sought to transform the entire continent into their feeding ground."

1855656692.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia, in the end, you chose to save yourself.""

1855656693.m_KeyValue: "We're dead if we don't get out of here!"

1855656694.m_KeyValue: "Hey! What are you two whispering about down there?!"

1855656695.m_KeyValue: "No wonder I have never ceased to believe in the goodness that dwells within humanity's heart."

1855656696.m_KeyValue: "No wonder I hold life so sacred."

1855656697.m_KeyValue: "You chose hope. I simply shared a story that 'should have existed.'"

1855656704.m_KeyValue: ""Come on, Letitia. It's time to face yourself. I'll be right here with you.""

1856516191.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, I think I've been experiencing hallucinations lately... or perhaps, auditory ones?""

1856587933.m_KeyValue: ""(With all paths seemingly closed to me, I could conceive of only one way to shatter the chains of that endless temporal prison: an alliance with Agares.)""

1858932600.m_KeyValue: "Impossible. Holding back would sully the sacred duel."

1858932601.m_KeyValue: "Prepare your blade for tomorrow night. Meet me at our usual ground."

1858932609.m_KeyValue: ""You usually skip the quips and get straight to blows, don't you?""

1858932610.m_KeyValue: "Usually. But trading barbs with you stokes the blood in my veins."

1858932611.m_KeyValue: "Your fighting spirit makes its mark even on the reports at the front."

1858932613.m_KeyValue: "I can't tell whether you prefer dishing it or receiving it."

1858932614.m_KeyValue: "Both striking and being struck are part of combat—endurance training is just as vital."

1858932615.m_KeyValue: "Then simply stand still and let me claim victory—would that be easier?"

1861104350.m_KeyValue: "No... You... You're the demon sealed in the Divine Body..."

1861104352.m_KeyValue: "Who are you? Death's errand boy? Sent by Aeon to drag me across?"

1861104353.m_KeyValue: "Fire... is this what freedom feels like? So hot it sears the soul."

1861104354.m_KeyValue: ""You've met her? No, no. You're delusional. I've seen your type before.""

1861104355.m_KeyValue: "Who said you could whisper?! Your lives belong to Carrelle now! Show your gratitude!"

1862031645.m_KeyValue: "Sapphire Isle's Mascot; All-Purpose Mysterious Merchant; The Master; Aspiring Fifth of the Four Knights"

1862031647.m_KeyValue: "Owner of the Yakov Troupe; Pioneer of Interactive Theater; Loyal Puppeteer of Bella No. 1"

1862031648.m_KeyValue: "Elder of the Bathory Family; Cat Burglar; Enthusiast of Magical Creatures"

1862031653.m_KeyValue: ""Bell Ringer No. III; Purifier of the Black Blood Outbreak in Sapphire Isle, 1342""

1862031654.m_KeyValue: "A Descendant of the Once-Great Roland Family"

1862410705.m_KeyValue: ""Hasan, did they attack the camp while I was gone?""

1862410707.m_KeyValue: "Gone so long... we were certain you'd died out there."

1862410708.m_KeyValue: ""Moran, stop kicking it! Do you know how hard I worked to haul that thing back!?""

1862561007.m_KeyValue: "Can Miss Bella be a proper guide?"

1862561008.m_KeyValue: "I can never resist diving into the things I like right away either! Thinking about it now... my friend is so much more patient than I am."

1862561009.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, where do you hide your keepsakes?""

1862561012.m_KeyValue: ""Next time, I'll take you to explore that hidden reef!""

1862951371.m_KeyValue: "Unlocks the _$$Contest Winner_$$ avatar frame. Can be changed in Profile."

1864252291.m_KeyValue: "Stay here and keep yourselves entertained with these _$$imitations._$$"

1864252292.m_KeyValue: ""Real or fake, whether you win or we do—it no longer matters. The seeds of chaos have already been sown... in all four directions.""

1864252293.m_KeyValue: ""In this land, where the Black Blood once ran rampant... the Church fractured and turned on itself, while faith across the continent crumbled into dust.""

1864252294.m_KeyValue: "Pavana of Astolfo? They were assigned to guard the southernmost Divine Body. Have they turned against us too...!?"

1864253315.m_KeyValue: ""In my memory, the real Cain intervened during the battle with Lamia.""

1864253317.m_KeyValue: "Don't lose focus! I'm just not used to this new body yet."

1864253318.m_KeyValue: ""He might've said something like that, but none of us had any idea what he meant.""

1866297610.m_KeyValue: ""Is it the same for you? When you first felt the tremors, you seemed far more composed than you do now.""

1866297611.m_KeyValue: "It sounds as if you harbor something even more 'interesting.'"

1866297613.m_KeyValue: ""She was waiting in my cell when we returned, as if she already knew what we're planning.""

1866297614.m_KeyValue: ""And that is the problem. The moment the comet's impact ends, she'll send someone for you at once.""

1866416393.m_KeyValue: ""Lately, there've been a lot of people sent by the Church snooping around the forbidden grounds. The alchemists must have told them about me.""

1866450154.m_KeyValue: "Care to tell me what makes you so certain?"

1867691615.m_KeyValue: ""'Why not put in some real effort and source your ingredients from the market in the neighboring town? And speaking of which, what kind of life have Empousa and the others been living? It's hard to believe they've never even tasted seafood.'""

1867691618.m_KeyValue: "Cain gave an elegant butler's bow and smiled lazily. 'I'm planning to introduce a new cuisine for tonight's dinner. The Bathory ladies have yet to experience the delights of seafood.'"

1867868289.m_KeyValue: "Nightmarish Letitia materialized behind Seraphina without warning."

1867868290.m_KeyValue: ""Standing at the precipice and peering into the abyss below, tendrils of Black Mist seep from the island's accursed soil, cascading toward the distant continent.""

1867868291.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina crouches beside the fallen figure, studying it with careful intensity.""

1867868294.m_KeyValue: "The suffocating Black Mist swallows her once again."

1868203872.m_KeyValue: "The timing is indeed propitious. You may proceed."

1868207073.m_KeyValue: "It aligns closely with our predetermined course."

1869276980.m_KeyValue: ""The castle curtains show signs of being gnawed by rats, occasionally allowing sunlight to penetrate. 1892188676.m_KeyValue: ""Finally, Aiona of the Alita family, masters of time itself. In a future beyond Aiona's vision, the fateful crossroads loom ever closer.""

1892188677.m_KeyValue: ""The three proceeded in silence through the mist. What sounded like the wailing of the dead emanated from the birch trees around them. The mist swirled like caressing shadows, enveloping them in a dreamlike state.""

1892188678.m_KeyValue: ""'This place must have belonged to a scholar,' Friedrich observed as he gently brushed away years of dust.""

1892188679.m_KeyValue: ""Predictably, Gilrain just rolled his eyes at Friedrich. But a moment later, he suddenly stood up.""

1892188680.m_KeyValue: ""'Father once spoke of a group of cartographers who crossed the continent, determined to map the world by the steps of their own feet,' recalled Friedrich as he took on a solemn expression.""

1892191940.m_KeyValue: ""As she spoke, she placed the crystal ball onto the cushion laid across the table. Whether it was her influence or something else… faint streaks of lightning began to flicker within the crystal's core.""

1892191941.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't intervene. This is my war.' With that, she halted before the tent, spear gripped firm, gaze locked onto the shadowy interior beyond the flap.""

1892191943.m_KeyValue: "—or so claimed a suspicious flyer stuck to an even more suspicious travel tent."

1892191944.m_KeyValue: ""At some point, the black cat lounging on the cushion had vanished without a trace... Then, from the far end of the tent, a silhouette emerged.""

1892191945.m_KeyValue: "'Death is numbered thirteen. Lovers is only six. The outcome is clear.'"

1892191946.m_KeyValue: ""Knew you Bell Ringers wouldn't know anything about Tarot. There are now rules meow.' A flick of its tail, 'intepret it however you want, as long as your reading turns out accurate meow.'""

1892191947.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, come on! Why does the cat look so shaken!? And throwing in a half-hearted _$$meow_$$ now just feels sarcastic! There's no way that wasn't mockery, right?""

1892191951.m_KeyValue: "'The mission is complete. Why wouldn't we leave?' Joan shot Theophane a glance. 'Don't tell me you've already forgotten why we came to Eye of God.'"

1892258372.m_KeyValue: ""At this, Ami's brow furrowed. 'I am no mere <style=Highlight>captain</style>—a title so dreadfully unimpressive.'""

1892258373.m_KeyValue: ""'Mm... huh?' Lost in fond memories of her vacation, Stella responded absentmindedly before suddenly snapping back to reality. 'What's wrong with Starfall Valley?'""

1892258374.m_KeyValue: ""'Ami, you...' Goldland's tone gentled at her words, and his gaze grew tender with compassion. 'When I found you on that shoreline all those years ago—'""

1892258375.m_KeyValue: ""While nodding vigorously in agreement with Stella, Ami whispered under her breath, 'Blast... why couldn't I have thought of that excuse earlier...'""

1892258376.m_KeyValue: "What is this 'Hehe!' supposed to mean? You think you can just get away without any explanation?"

1892258377.m_KeyValue: ""For some inexplicable reason, upon hearing those words, Regina immediately settled herself obediently onto the deck and fell silent.""

1892258378.m_KeyValue: "So you've only been an official crew member for one day?"

1892258407.m_KeyValue: "Why is this the same as page 17?"

1892259460.m_KeyValue: ""Noah followed Agares further in, his eyes scanning the overgrowth, noting the scattered gravestones along the path. 'A lot of these seem to belong to the Carrelle family...'""

1892259461.m_KeyValue: ""'Come now, no need to skulk around like some shy stray.' Without so much as a glance back, Agares waved a hand behind him and continued walking. As if expecting Noah to follow.""

1892259462.m_KeyValue: ""'Come on now, what's with that look...' Agares raised the black, unidentifiable stone in his hand and gestured toward Noah. 'The smell's coming from this.'""

1892259463.m_KeyValue: ""Agares never finished his sentence. At that moment, his spade struck something solid with a sharp clang—the unmistakable ring of metal against metal.""

1892259464.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, the two men stood unfazed by the chill, for they were agents of flame. In the name of the Bell Ringer, a battle unlike any other was about to begin!""

1892259465.m_KeyValue: ""That's right! The one struck by the black, unidentified stone Agares had just thrown... was none other than _$$Agares_$$!""

1892259466.m_KeyValue: ""'You're... Mass.' Noah glanced around, only to find the other Agares had vanished. 'Who's the other one?'""

1892259467.m_KeyValue: "*Note: This scene may be mildly unsettling. Sensitive viewers are advised not to let their imaginations run too wild."

1892259469.m_KeyValue: ""Mass left her words hanging, rising to her feet and gazing off into the distance—lost in her memories. Noah wisely chose not to press further.""

1892260548.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, she could hear heartbeats. And yes, she was just that exceptional.""

1892260549.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, this is the <style=""Highlight"">Wailing Crypts</style> of the Bathory family!! If you truly read the air!""

1892260550.m_KeyValue: ""'I can hear you, you know.' Darcias murmured, as she slid the key into the stone door's groove.""

1892260551.m_KeyValue: "'I never knew a Covenant could be used like that...'"

1892260553.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, that one from before must be their lead singer.'""

1892260555.m_KeyValue: "'But today should be a day off!' Darcias pulled at Acappella's hat."

1892260559.m_KeyValue: ""'Uh, the 'cake' won't be necessary.' Darcias put away the 'cake,' crushing Acappella's dream of becoming a top chef.""

1892315160.m_KeyValue: ""Stay out of any Guards' line of sight during the heist. Being spotted will greatly increase their Alert level, and units will be sent to capture you.""

1892332420.m_KeyValue: ""'But as soon as we began the duel, I knew I'd made a mistake. We were in a forest, and your father, knowing I wouldn't harm small animals, quickly gained the upper hand.'""

1892332424.m_KeyValue: ""Clive brandished his short sword and lunged at Gadric, who merely sidestepped the attack with surprising grace for such a rotund figure.""

1892332425.m_KeyValue: ""Gadric found himself sprawled upon the slippery rocks, absently scratching his equally smooth helmet.""

1892332426.m_KeyValue: ""'The First Knight?' Uncle Gadric mused, looking up at the boy.""

1892332427.m_KeyValue: ""Hati unlocked the door at the base of the tower and retrieved a basket. Inside lay a hearty loaf of dark bread, a wedge of cheese, a cured ham, and a flask of wine.""

1892335687.m_KeyValue: ""'In the aftermath, it took the victorious army another month to erect a smaller Fangtooth Tower on the original site. This very tower endures to this day, standing as a silent witness to history.'""

1892335688.m_KeyValue: ""'The Aegis warriors hid behind massive shields, waiting for nightfall. They were determined to prevent anyone from escaping the tower.'""

1892335689.m_KeyValue: ""'You know about it too!' Empousa exclaimed, her face lighting up with delight.""

1892335690.m_KeyValue: ""'Yes, I've heard that too,' Empousa nodded. 'But unlike you, we can't control the wolf packs in Lupine Forest. This tower can only function as an early warning system at best.'""

1892335691.m_KeyValue: ""'This is my family's domain,' Empousa declared imperiously. 'As a guest, shouldn't you show some respect to your hosts?'""

1892361828.m_KeyValue: "As her soft murmurs flow over the audience <size=-10><alpha=#88>(Though only Stella is present)</size></alpha=#ff> visions unfurl before Stella's eyes <color=#daa520>yellowed</color> parchment opening to reveal the eternal cycles of Minexus—"

1892361829.m_KeyValue: ""...At the very least, tell us your name! To lurk in the shadows is cowardice!""

1892361830.m_KeyValue: ""'I remember... it is a year of plenty. Across Sunset Isle, the folk are busy harvesting wheat <size=-10><alpha=#88>(or perhaps some other crop)</alpha></size>. But Noah alone—he reaps something far more precious: a baby girl.'""

1892361831.m_KeyValue: ""'And yet...' She tilts her head, her finger resting on her chin. 'That <style=""Highlight"">Other Side</style> leaves behind almost no proof of its existence.'""

1892361832.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia shakes her head. 'Actually, it's quite the opposite.'""

1892361833.m_KeyValue: ""As if she has expected Stella to take the bait, Letitia smiles warmly once more, her eyes narrowing into gentle crescents. 'Now, who could it be... Why don't you hazard a guess, little Stella?'""

1892361835.m_KeyValue: ""Having said this, Letitia ignores that irksome voice entirely and turns her gaze back to Stella. 'Noah's feelings toward Empousa are indeed quite extraordinary...'""

1892361837.m_KeyValue: "I declare once again—Stella was never Noah's daughter! The <color=#bc544b>Seven Great Mysteries of yyf</color> never existed! (bows and exits)"

1892364004.m_KeyValue: "'The goddess's repeated treachery against the Bathory family left them with no choice but to seek an alliance with Dracula.'"

1892364005.m_KeyValue: ""'We're leaving,' Piera cut in firmly. 'Our only purpose here is to find useful texts. Whatever he's doing is irrelevant to our mission.'""

1892364006.m_KeyValue: "'To use the power of time manipulation in a sacred place of the Church is utter blasphemy!' Isaac's shock quickly gave way to a surge of righteous fury."

1892364007.m_KeyValue: ""Nicole, the middle disciple, offered a contrasting view. 'Many of the Church's texts are safeguarded by special measures. They wouldn't succumb to decay so easily.'""

1892364010.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, as they departed Crescent Garden, they all found themselves pondering whether their master's true purpose in bringing them here was truly in pursuit of truth.""

1892364011.m_KeyValue: "'He was ready for the battlefield before he could even utter his first word.'"

1892364964.m_KeyValue: "'Sure am. What were you saying again?'"

1892364965.m_KeyValue: ""'Fine, fine! I'll come out—just stop tugging on my receiver!'""

1892364966.m_KeyValue: ""Thibault halted and turned toward the direction Acappella had pointed. 'Over there, you say…'""

1892364967.m_KeyValue: ""Aside from the Church's crest, there are three other distinct suits. Structurally, they do resemble Tarot cards.'""

1892364968.m_KeyValue: "'A treasure etched with the dreams of the entire continent… then how about Pocket Dreams?'"

1892364969.m_KeyValue: ""Agares held a (Bell Ringer–only) card between his index and middle finger. 'So… it's finally my turn. In that case, I—'""

1892364970.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, fine—if that's how it's gonna be…' Acappella drew a card from the top of the deck (Bell Ringer–only). 'Perfect timing! Alright, I'm playing this one!'""

1892364971.m_KeyValue: "That man… was he finally getting serious? Of course—becoming a Bell Ringer was never about luck."

1892364973.m_KeyValue: "...Wait. Everyone can see the cards now!? What—what is going on!?"

1892403204.m_KeyValue: ""After a moment, Gilrain turned toward Friedrich, who had fallen into deep contemplation. _$$Who is she?_$$ he asked. _$$Do you know this woman, Friedrich?_$$""

1892403205.m_KeyValue: ""Friedrich extended a bundle of lamb fleece toward him, only to withdraw when Gilrain made no move to accept it. With a shrug, he tossed it casually over his shoulder—""

1892403206.m_KeyValue: "His white blade cut through the snow like a banshee's scream—then came a sharp tear as it caught fabric and sliced through the edge of Joyce Gadric's cloak."

1892403207.m_KeyValue: ""Friedrich at his side raised his longsword in a commanding salute to the heavens, _$$Joyce Gadric! Savor your last moment—for the next shall be your curtain call!_$$""

1892403208.m_KeyValue: "Why does Gilrain know that dress so well? Because..."

1892403209.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain's chestplate has been cracked and battered for years, yet he stubbornly refuses to repair it, and no one knows why.""

1892403210.m_KeyValue: ""The mysterious figure approached through wind and snow, words whispering like secrets before vanishing into the storm.""

1892403211.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Pudway pure cotton corset with matching sleeves, Moonflower silk fishtail skirt adorned with tasseled ribbons, and an Erland tie-dyed silk shawl to complete the look... That should cover everything._$$""

1892403216.m_KeyValue: ""A thousand thoughts whirled inside her, yet what came out of her mouth was oddly simple:""

1892403217.m_KeyValue: ""Just as she was about to leave, she stopped once more.""

1892404294.m_KeyValue: ""'They were hit by another blizzard, but this time, he chose to leave the safety of the waystation behind. It was as if he was gambling with his very life, plunging into the howling storm towards his goal.'""

1892404295.m_KeyValue: ""'The eggs swiftly hatch into larvae, which voraciously feed to amass energy. They promptly pupate before emerging as fleeting adult butterflies, ready to continue their odyssey across the unforgiving snowy plains.'""

1892404296.m_KeyValue: ""Yggdrasill's branches and leaves stirred gently, as if contemplating the question with profound consideration.""

1892404297.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I see. Edina just plucked a leaf from her master's branch and dropped it into some boiling water.""

1892404298.m_KeyValue: "'The life force a plant can absorb from the frozen earth is limited. Even restoring the life of a butterfly's could cost a shrub its life.'"

1892404299.m_KeyValue: ""'Master, have you heard the tale of the one who built this waystation?' Edina inquired after lighting the furnace.""

1892435876.m_KeyValue: "Hati glanced up at the windmill. 'The route goes from this windmill to the town gate and then back again!'"

1892435877.m_KeyValue: ""'The Ganelon family is extinct,' Hati replied, her bitter smile tinged with irony. 'How could there be any wolf packs left?'""

1892435880.m_KeyValue: ""'Desperate, the Ganelon family sought aid from major families across the continent, even appealing to the Church. But all turned them away, citing various reasons.'""

1892435881.m_KeyValue: ""'Does it really matter?' Ami's voice called from behind them. She had been wandering through the wheat fields, which explained her delayed arrival.""

1892435882.m_KeyValue: ""'I believe it's because the Ganelon family, having learned farming, expanded Mouret and increased its population. This led to them becoming a major force in the subsequent 'Crimson Inquisition'.'""

1892435883.m_KeyValue: ""Hati said, with evident reluctance, 'According to the explanation given by the Bathory family head at that time, they were concerned that if the Ganelon family became too weak, the Church might turn its attention directly to the Bathory family.'""

1892441190.m_KeyValue: "'Is that... a boxing glove?' Ressa recognized the object before Hati could explain."

1892441191.m_KeyValue: ""'Because father was lying. There's no such tradition in our family. I've been feigning ignorance this whole time, but now...'""

1892441192.m_KeyValue: ""'I didn't think a Bloodborn would be afraid of lightning,' Ressa said with a gentle, comforting smile.""

1892441193.m_KeyValue: ""'Curiously, the structure itself remained untouched, standing resolute for decades before it was finally dismantled.'""

1892441194.m_KeyValue: ""To protect farmers within the Bathory territory from wolf attacks during the harvest, Hati had been making daily trips to Mouret.""

1892441195.m_KeyValue: "'How hard is it?' Ressa asked with concern."

1892507748.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, Agares’s back had never been a problem—it was just an excuse he made up to get out of work.""

1892507749.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Noah was about to reveal story-changing truth again, a wild brown bear wandered by, casually dragging a trembling squirrel, and stepped into the hot spring...""

1892507750.m_KeyValue: ""'—and create the ultimate fatigue-relieving hot spring, this tiny sacrifice is completely worth it.'""

1892507751.m_KeyValue: ""'Isn't it a little too convenient that these sticks just happened to be here, and they're exactly three long and one short?'""

1892507752.m_KeyValue: ""'If it lands on either heads or tails, then I get to go first!'""

1892507753.m_KeyValue: ""'...Well, we should respect the proper order. Since Agares is already using the spring, we should look for another—'""

1892507754.m_KeyValue: "'This isn't something Noah can fix just by dropping to his knees and apologizing.'"

1892507755.m_KeyValue: ""'I get that good hot springs are... ugh... usually hidden away, but how much longer until we... urp—!'""

1892508708.m_KeyValue: ""But before we unveil the final answer, let's pause the tale for just a moment... and hear from our esteemed audience—What do you think lies beneath Gadric’s armor?""

1892508709.m_KeyValue: "'Or perhaps...' Nicole leaned in to peer inside the hollow shell of armor. '...the real question is whether Gadric ever had a body at all.'"

1892508710.m_KeyValue: ""'Obviously, to make him think we fell for this painfully obvious trap.'""

1892508711.m_KeyValue: ""Both Darcias and Nicole instinctively looked up—And in the next instant, the truth struck them.""

1892508712.m_KeyValue: "'Hmm? Why'd you stop?' Darcias looked at him expressionlessly. 'Don't mind me. Carry on.'"

1892508714.m_KeyValue: ""Take the infamous Church carriage incident—after a noble family's coach plunged off a cliff, the culprit, a young lady of high standing, confidently claimed she did it to save the man fated to become her Vassal.""

1892508715.m_KeyValue: ""As if in response to her voice, faint ripples spread across the surface. Then with a splash, Gadric's body rose from the depths.""

1892508720.m_KeyValue: ""Gadric, who was tending the garden, straightened up and gazed in the direction of Ethereal Springs. 'Ah, looks like another set of armor got scrapped.'""

1892508721.m_KeyValue: "So this was all Acappella's trap from the start... But seriously... Should a Bell Ringer really be spending their whole day doing stuff like this?"

1892579628.m_KeyValue: ""'Very well, let's use this interlude to clarify the competition rules,' Van Helsing glanced around. 'The competition will be team-based. The objective is simple: the team that catches the most fish within the time limit wins.'""

1892579629.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh? So this is...' Another elegant voice chimed in, barely concealing their curiosity and excitement.""

1892579630.m_KeyValue: ""'Why, you ask, did he have access to so much seafood? The answer is simple: smuggling, of course!'""

1892579631.m_KeyValue: "'That's the essence of teamwork. He fishes while I block. Using the rules to our advantage is part of the game. Blame your lack of competition experience!'"

1892579632.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing burst out of a dilapidated shack nearby, drawn by the commotion. As the dust began to settle, an utterly bizarre scene unfolded before him—one that would be seared into his memory for the rest of his days.""

1892579633.m_KeyValue: ""'...The Seafood Tycoon Pearl?' After hearing this mystical term from Cain, Noah could no longer contain his curiosity. 'Is this how Goldland dominated the seafood market?'""

1892579635.m_KeyValue: ""Seeing that everyone had settled down, Noah calmly addressed them, his tone measured and guiding. 'Let's end this foolishness and do something worthwhile.'""

1892581799.m_KeyValue: ""Before Empousa could finish, Tris's hand whipped through the air. A silver needle, crackling with lightning, shot past Empousa's face, slicing off a strand of her hair.""

1892581804.m_KeyValue: ""As tensions rose between the two sides... Tris suddenly stepped forward, positioning herself between the opposing groups with an outstretched hand.""

1892581805.m_KeyValue: "'...Why are you making such a big deal out of this?' Empousa covered her face in exasperation. 'Why do I have to deal with these people...'"

1892581806.m_KeyValue: ""'Shh, be quiet!' Sensing something, Lamia held out an arm to stop Empousa. The sisters quickly ducked into the shadows, staying on high alert.""

1892581807.m_KeyValue: ""The golden-haired woman smiled as she watched Acappella's figure enter the cabin, then turned her gaze back to where the sea met the sky. '...I hope no storm is brewing.'""

1892581809.m_KeyValue: "Eh?! The whole game is decided by a single point? That seems risky... Or does Tris have some secret winning strategy up her sleeve?"

1892581811.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph, is this really the best that the Church's weapon and Bell Ringer can come up with?' Empousa shook her head lightly, mocking Tris's suggestion.""

1892584940.m_KeyValue: "It's best to keep distance from people who have a few screws loose. Noah made a point by putting some distance between them."

1892584941.m_KeyValue: ""A heated, high-stakes race is about to begin.""

1892584942.m_KeyValue: "'To sink beneath the sea… it's a wonderful experience.'"

1892584943.m_KeyValue: ""So much for Noah's hard-earned peace and quiet. Someone had come uninvited. Someone who bore fire, yet willingly approached the sea. Who could it possibly be—""

1892584944.m_KeyValue: "'It's not just the sea. Isn't that true for people too? Maybe all we can do… is learn to live with that complexity.'"

1892584946.m_KeyValue: ""To avoid them, Noah dove beneath the surface—Now only Agares could be seen above the water.""

1892584947.m_KeyValue: ""With the moonlight at their backs, the three walked toward the shore, the seawater trailing from their bodies leaving paths in the sand.""

1892587112.m_KeyValue: "'38 million Soli?!' Lamia covered her mouth in disbelief. 'And it says... whoever holds this note becomes the new creditor!'"

1892587113.m_KeyValue: ""'...Finally, the villagers must throw you off a 99-meter cliff into the sea and back... 99 times... for a thorough baptism by the ocean.'""

1892587116.m_KeyValue: ""'I told you...' Lamia reacted instantly, using a servant as a springboard to leap up. Before the ball could fall completely, she raised both hands—""

1892587117.m_KeyValue: ""Tris intercepted the speeding fish-skin ball with perfect precision—or rather, it was as if the ball itself had eagerly rushed to meet her fist.""

1892587118.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh my, what are we going to do about this? It's quite a pickle.' Somehow, Acappella had already freed herself from Empousa's binding vines through unknown means.""

1892587119.m_KeyValue: ""And now, the fish is dead, its skin made into a ball for sport. So... following the phenomenon described, shouldn't the net be destined to break? Doesn't that make sense?""

1892587120.m_KeyValue: ""Stopping a short distance behind Empousa, Lamia gathered herself before throwing the fish-skin ball high into the sky—""

1892587121.m_KeyValue: "'Since when are Bell Ringers above the rules!'"

1892587122.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph, so much for being some fancy ex-commander of whatever.' Though Empousa spoke dismissively, her stance remained alert. 'Now watch this—Harvest Season!'""

1892587123.m_KeyValue: ""'Tch...' At that same moment, Lamia recognized the predicament. She immediately withdrew her foot, spinning gracefully in the air to disperse her momentum before landing elegantly.""

1892751001.m_KeyValue: ""I'll accept it for now. This, too, is part of the rules.""

1892756688.m_KeyValue: ""Ooh, is it something fun to play with?""

1892759697.m_KeyValue: "That's so considerate of you. You have my gratitude."

1892759856.m_KeyValue: ""Pray, let no innocent creatures be caught in the fray...""

1895480601.m_KeyValue: "Paracelsus... the Calamity that our family has sealed for generations..."

1895480602.m_KeyValue: "Noah... are you not going to ask anymore? Do you believe me?"

1895480603.m_KeyValue: "Yes... that Bell Ringer ended up sacrificing herself during the battle against Death..."

1895480604.m_KeyValue: "Hold on a second! You just said there are no living people on this island now. That means your family's struggles..."

1895480605.m_KeyValue: "N-No... it's not that... it's... it's Death. It..."

1895480607.m_KeyValue: "We both have to live on. We'll meet again someday... I know we will."

1895480610.m_KeyValue: ""For some reason, this thing's contamination doesn't seem to affect me. But in terms of raw fighting ability...""

1895480634.m_KeyValue: "Of course... That explains why another one appeared out of nowhere."

1895480635.m_KeyValue: "You can thank me later. Right now we need to get to the village!"

1895480636.m_KeyValue: "Damn it! Damn the Black Blood! Why does it keep tormenting us?!"

1895480637.m_KeyValue: ""Sora isn't a...! He's a living, breathing person!""

1895480638.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, are you listening? The Black Blood disease on the island has spiraled beyond you and the doctor's control.""

1895480898.m_KeyValue: "I wonder what happened to Empousa and the others on the ship... Hm?"

1895480932.m_KeyValue: ""And apart from those Black Blood crabs, I haven't seen any other living creatures.""

1895480962.m_KeyValue: "But since this was also your family's origins... Is there any chance you've heard someone mention me?"

1895480963.m_KeyValue: "Just call me Noah. By the way..."

1895480964.m_KeyValue: "I've never actually lived here. Most of what I know I heard from my family."

1895480967.m_KeyValue: ""Nevernight... Wow, your name is just like the legend! So you really are from here!""

1895480993.m_KeyValue: ""She said... Welcome back to the home of the sunset, to the... 'resting place of memories.'""

1895480994.m_KeyValue: "...Sorry. I just had a really strange encounter. It's still messing with my head."

1895480997.m_KeyValue: "It is you! The young man who's always with Dr. Ressa!"

1895480998.m_KeyValue: ""I've been meaning to ask, why have you been carrying that coffin this whole time?""

1895480999.m_KeyValue: ""Give back everything you took from us, Noah Nevernight!""

1895481000.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) I don't want to die... I don't... want to die alone... You're coming with me!"

1895481029.m_KeyValue: ""I do not know the answer to that, but the Saint said...""

1895481030.m_KeyValue: "Orders are orders. He escaped some days ago and they tasked us with recapturing him."

1895481031.m_KeyValue: "But if there's really a traitor in league with the Calamity among the twelve Bell Ringers... I can't even fathom the catastrophe it would bring."

1895481061.m_KeyValue: "Noah... are you alright? You look terribly pale..."

1895481062.m_KeyValue: ""You brought death upon us, you turned us into these... abominations.""

1895481064.m_KeyValue: "Noah... you don't think I'm just making this up... do you?"

1895481089.m_KeyValue: "And what each person sees is based on who they long for and those that long for them."

1895481090.m_KeyValue: ""The Divine Bodies I've encountered before didn't have any set forms. One turned out to be an entire cave, while another was a golden tree shaped like a ship's keel.""

1895481092.m_KeyValue: ""Where to begin... Ah, yes. My grandmother told me that up until 66 years ago... all members of our family were still living on this island...""

1895481093.m_KeyValue: "You've been so open with me. I shouldn't keep this from you either. The truth is..."

1895481094.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, what's wrong? Why are you crying...?""

1895481095.m_KeyValue: "I believe you. But that doesn't mean you haven't heard about this place... Perhaps from relatives who once lived here?"

1895481096.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... As you deduced, the Paracelsus family has been the 'Gravekeepers' of Sunset Isle for generations.""

1895686073.m_KeyValue: "And you expect me to nod along while lives are thrown away for your hollow fantasy of returning to the moon?"

1895686074.m_KeyValue: "As expected of you. Naive. Stubborn. And strong enough to see it through."

1895686075.m_KeyValue: ""We—the children of Dracula—are awakening. And together, we shall return... to the Other Side.""

1896716374.m_KeyValue: "So our method of 'invading' that world... is to squeeze ourselves into this bottle?"

1896716375.m_KeyValue: "Your world has been here from the start."

1896716376.m_KeyValue: "So this is what Aiona meant by something that could change the world…?"

1896716377.m_KeyValue: ""I realize this may be… difficult for the ignorant to grasp, but this bottle holds the entirety of Miss Death's world.""

1896716379.m_KeyValue: "Let's see whether you're fit to be the key pieces in the stratagem I've begun to design."

1896716380.m_KeyValue: "Seriously? We cleared out all those metal scraps just so you could grab a bottle?"

1896716381.m_KeyValue: ""So bold—to pursue all the way here, certain in the belief that you cannot be erased or destroyed.""

1896716382.m_KeyValue: "Very well. Allow me a moment to prepare. I leave the battlefield to you—consider it your first trial."

1896717399.m_KeyValue: "I honestly don't know if I have any right to ask this—to pull you into a crisis that doesn't even belong to your world."

1896717400.m_KeyValue: "Once we return... can we truly save the world?"

1896717401.m_KeyValue: "I asked for a single line—what I got was three questions."

1896717402.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it was my arrival that awakened them in the first place..."

1896717403.m_KeyValue: ""As the 'wedge,' you make it easy to trace your point of entry.""

1896717404.m_KeyValue: "Even though I'm from there... I never learned how to return."

1896717405.m_KeyValue: "...Shouldn't we declare something suitably dramatic before departure?"

1896719576.m_KeyValue: "A pleasure to make your acquaintance. The other me... did he not come?"

1896719578.m_KeyValue: ""Their power source is water… and as it happens, every drop of water in this world answers to me.""

1896719579.m_KeyValue: "What—?! Why did they all just blow up on their own?!"

1896719580.m_KeyValue: "There are always fools who cling to the notion of salvation. Covenant—!"

1896719581.m_KeyValue: "The most fascinating trait of humanity is that no matter how grim the hour..."

1896922143.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, catch me a big fish from the depths where Landis sank.""

1896976703.m_KeyValue: "I want to know if that's true."

1896976704.m_KeyValue: ""At this rate, I'll be buried beside this garlic...""

1896976706.m_KeyValue: "For Lord Agares! For the freedom of will!"

1896976707.m_KeyValue: ""Well... since our allies from the Kingdom are here, your mission is complete.""

1896977730.m_KeyValue: "But Van Helsing is the Eighth of the Silver Cross... Can we really take him down?"

1896994605.m_KeyValue: ""The Gate of Ritual, not yet opened.""

1898286257.m_KeyValue: "Wait. Could that have been his plan from the very beginning?"

1898286258.m_KeyValue: "Tsk. You don't look like someone with only thirty percent left."

1898399630.m_KeyValue: ""In return, I'll share with you the secret of walking in sunlight.""

1898505389.m_KeyValue: "What happened last time... I bear some blame as well."

1898863124.m_KeyValue: ""'What an incredible ability! Come on, tell us what you've seen!'""

1898863125.m_KeyValue: ""Moments later, Aiona returned to the fireplace, her expression serene. 'The true owner of this place,' she said, her voice as calm as a still pond, 'is not Leonardo Ptolemy.'""

1898863126.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona approached the manuscripts once more, invoking her ability. The text fragments swirled and danced, breaking apart and reforming, as they transported her consciousness back through time.""

1898863128.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain pondered for a moment, then asked, 'So, did Nikola steal Leonardo's identity to gain greater fame?'""

1898863129.m_KeyValue: ""'I couldn't see how Nikola's story ended, but Leonardo Ptolemy has most likely passed away. He was a remarkable painter.'""

1898863130.m_KeyValue: ""'Hold on, wasn't he supposed to be dead?'""

1898863131.m_KeyValue: "'The one who built this place was Nikola.'"

1898863134.m_KeyValue: ""'I agree with Friedrich. In the story I saw, they made a promise to explore the world together.'""

1898863135.m_KeyValue: "'I don't think he needed to use Leonardo's name to succeed. These maps are exceptionally well-made.' Friedrich leaned in to examine the map his companion was holding."

1899798779.m_KeyValue: ""What truly defines a person - their physical form, or their soul?""

1899801788.m_KeyValue: ""Rest assured, no dust will settle on my head.""

1899801947.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure it's alright to be wandering around when there's still so much work to be done?"

1899809618.m_KeyValue: ""My wish is simple: let the wicked die as they deserve, and the good meet their end with grace. Nothing more.""

1899809649.m_KeyValue: "Chivalrous? You flatter me. I simply cannot stand injustice."

1899810643.m_KeyValue: "Setting the chaotic world right... That is my life's purpose!"

1899811792.m_KeyValue: "Don't come too close. I don't want you to get hurt."

1899811823.m_KeyValue: "Don't move. I'm... afraid I might lose control."

1899812658.m_KeyValue: ""When humanity is tainted by evil, the Lord shall bring punishment through the fires of war.""

1899812817.m_KeyValue: ""This time, I hope you can fight by my side until the very end.""

1899813966.m_KeyValue: ""Come closer, and let me whisper nature's secrets to you.""

1899813997.m_KeyValue: "Humans... such despicable creatures. Become my sustenance."

1903570358.m_KeyValue: ""Recently, whenever I bring the shell close, I can hear that voice.""

1903642100.m_KeyValue: ""You could say I harbor certain... reservations about him. We do share the same ultimate goals, but I envision another possibility—one where tragedy is forestalled at its very genesis.""

""'Pay the price, and they'll be yours.'
Hallon believed the words in that mysterious letter. He could no longer save the Isle or its people. All he could trade for was the safety of a precious few.
The rest—infected or not—would be nothing more than drops in the ocean. That was the Bell Ringer's flawless form of purification.
'One last request... If you find my nephew, Isaac... If there's any hope left for him...'
Albrecht neither nodded nor shook his head. Hallon couldn't read his expression.
It had taken all his courage to make a deal with the Bell Ringer—under the guise of establishing liquid metal currency. He fled with Constantine in tow.
Run! Get Bella from the basement and leave now!
He didn't know that what awaited him… was his daughter's lifeless body.""

1910016330.m_KeyValue: ""This is a secluded castle that belongs to the Bathory family, and the home of Lady Empousa and myself.""

1910016331.m_KeyValue: ""The essence of life lies in memory, and blood is the vessel that carries memories. The Embrace is the ritual of reliving life by extracting the memories contained within the blood.""

1910016332.m_KeyValue: ""There is... a surge of warmth... rushing through my chest... My mind feels clearer now, and my body is more agile.""

1910016333.m_KeyValue: ""That last one wouldn't happen to be me, would it? Well, that's just mean.""
