1910087053.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Clive... Father... For always accepting me, even when I could not face who I truly am.""

1910087054.m_KeyValue: ""I've returned. To our homeland, and to the memories we shared.""

1910087055.m_KeyValue: "Sorry to keep you waiting—my other self."

1910087057.m_KeyValue: "I'm proof that you once lived... so lend me your strength!"

1910087058.m_KeyValue: "Could Aiona be right... Is she going to transform into one of those furry giant wolves?"

1910087059.m_KeyValue: ""The flea brain is fighting some monster... Wait, is she about to 'mutate'!?""

1910088076.m_KeyValue: "Who's at the helm?! The ship's gone completely off course—at this rate we'll be swallowed by the whirlpool!"

1910088077.m_KeyValue: "I won't let the El Dorado become just another legend lost beneath the waves like Landis!"

1910088080.m_KeyValue: "What in—?! A Blood Beast?! That sailor at the helm—is he the one steering the ship?!"

1910088081.m_KeyValue: "...Is that the sailor young Van Helsing mentioned?"

1910088082.m_KeyValue: ""No time to think—rescue first, helm second!""

1910088084.m_KeyValue: ""That won't be necessary, First Mate Bob.""

1910088085.m_KeyValue: "The greatest help you could offer me... is to die."

1910096788.m_KeyValue: "I just ate... and yet I'm still..."

1910096790.m_KeyValue: "Food... It's all mine... I have to survive..."

1910096792.m_KeyValue: "I am Famine! I am the strongest of the Black Blood...! ...No..."

1910096793.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm not! I'm not Famine at all...!""

1910096794.m_KeyValue: "I'm Hati! A warrior of Ganelon! I won't... let you control me!"

1910096795.m_KeyValue: "This thing that suddenly latched onto my neck—it's your fault I'm in such a bad mood!"

1910097934.m_KeyValue: "They're not even strong—just annoying! Did they come here just to cut us off?!"

1910097935.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, I knew it! There's always someone who shows up to interrupt at exactly the wrong moment! Can't I hear the full story just once?!""

1910097940.m_KeyValue: "We have to... seal her away... Before she regains her strength—Before she's had her fill... Or else..."

1910097941.m_KeyValue: "See? She's just babbling because she's dizzy. She doesn't even look old enough to know what happened forty years ago."

1910097942.m_KeyValue: "No... we can't let this go on. She'll devour us all... just like she devoured that entire island—forty-four years ago..."

1910097943.m_KeyValue: "Huh? But neither that dumb wolf nor this jellyfish girl looks infected. And why can't I hear anything?"

1910097944.m_KeyValue: "Only Noah and I were present that day... We're the only ones who know the truth. She's actually—"

1910097945.m_KeyValue: "That dumb wolf's just a survivor from our archenemy's family. What other identity could she possibly have?"

1910097946.m_KeyValue: "I believe they're both hearing the whispers. It might be connected to Miss Hati's true identity..."

1910097947.m_KeyValue: "I think you're the one who's hungry. Why don't we take you to the kitchen first?"

1910098959.m_KeyValue: "Aw... A dream forever out of reach—this illusion of human kinship is merely a snare devised by that sanctimonious Aeon."

1910098964.m_KeyValue: ""I did not! I promised I'd take you next time, didn't I?""

1910098966.m_KeyValue: "Wait a second. This is... Mouret? I was on a ship... How did I end up back here? And..."

1910098967.m_KeyValue: ""A ship? Ugh, you went to the ocean without me again, didn't you?""

1910098968.m_KeyValue: "Shut up! This has nothing to do with you—and my name's not Sheila!"

1910098969.m_KeyValue: ""Who are you talking to, sis? Why are you just standing there?""

1910100112.m_KeyValue: ""A fine Captain entrusted his dream of adventure to this vessel. In the end, because of one spoiled little brother, he lost all his Strength.""

1910100113.m_KeyValue: ""What a mess this place has become… Even a cat can't help but sigh, meow…""

1910100116.m_KeyValue: ""So you're looking for more than one person, meow. Naturally, I foresaw this in the future.""

1910100117.m_KeyValue: "Miss Hati is also in the lounge ahead. We can pick her up along the way."

1910100118.m_KeyValue: ""The infection's spreading fast. When we descended, this floor was still secure...""

1910100119.m_KeyValue: "Oh? And these strays were in your so-called future too?"

1910100121.m_KeyValue: "What's with the sudden shift in tone? You're not even saying _$$meow_$$..."

1910100122.m_KeyValue: ""To the future, the path does not matter—only the outcome, meow.""

1910100123.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure she went this way? There's no sign of her at all."

1910101137.m_KeyValue: "Octo is the octopus I ate today."

1910101141.m_KeyValue: "Enough. This is the mindscape born of Black Blood resonance..."

1910101142.m_KeyValue: "It seems I must guide you from the beginning—help you remember who you truly are."

1910101145.m_KeyValue: "Wait—there's another one?! Who are you supposed to be?!"

1910101146.m_KeyValue: "Why are there strangers showing up in my head?!"

1910101147.m_KeyValue: "That's my question! Why are you—who clearly aren't food—inside my head?"

1910102290.m_KeyValue: "They're heading up... Huh? Now there's two of them?"

1910102293.m_KeyValue: "This Captain's already dead. The Black Blood's controlling him?"

1910102295.m_KeyValue: "This body... has no memory of you. What exactly are you?"

1910103314.m_KeyValue: ""Come back, Sheila. Return to your true homeland.""

1910103317.m_KeyValue: ""Just know that where your loved ones dwell, where your thoughts return... that is where you truly belong.""

1910103318.m_KeyValue: ""Aeon deceived his faithful, branding Black Blood as a disease that devours the will.""

1910103319.m_KeyValue: "But is he not the same—splitting our once-unified consciousness into a thousand curses of flesh and blood?"

1910103320.m_KeyValue: "Why do you believe that world of life and death—defined by a false god—is real?"

1910103321.m_KeyValue: ""And why do you call this world of your own making, where all your desires are fulfilled, false?""

1910103323.m_KeyValue: "No! This is not real! You're not the real Clive!"

1910395725.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare disturb my friend's rest!"

1910395726.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what you're up to, you headscarf bear, but if it's a fight you want, take it outside.""

1910395729.m_KeyValue: "Caught you red-handed! You were trying to phase through the wall!"

1910395731.m_KeyValue: ""I challenge you, Bloodborn of Bathory! In my authority as First Mate of the El Dorado, I hereby issue my challenge!""

1910395732.m_KeyValue: "What are you even talking about? What's with the agression..."

1910395734.m_KeyValue: ""You're severely underestimating Van Helsing's intelligence! He's genuinely skilled at this sort of thing, and soon...""

1910395735.m_KeyValue: "Should I transform and sneak into the next room..."

1910395736.m_KeyValue: "Who is he talking to...? Why isn't the other person saying anything?"

1910756527.m_KeyValue: "Tch... I'll be straight with you—you're not paying me nearly enough to die for you again."

1910756529.m_KeyValue: "He left? The whole desert's frozen solid—where in the world could he have gone...?"

1910784285.m_KeyValue: ""This survey bears profound significance—it enriches our cultural legacy, safeguards this era's treasures, and ensures the transmission of wisdom to generations unborn.""

1911251828.m_KeyValue: "Enemy Effect: Immune to displacement and will not move."

1912117976.m_KeyValue: ""You're not far off. To be precise, they are the ghosts that have haunted me for a long time.""

1914218280.m_KeyValue:
""Hmm? Who left their ledger here again...

'I can't believe I met Silver-haired, Master Van Helsing's dear friend, here at the bay! Brandy wasn't lying after all! Surely it won't be long before I find Master Van Helsing and come to his rescue in his hour of need! The graceful and beautiful Lorelei even gave me a golden spatula—it must be worth quite a sum! Miss Lorelei is the best! Today's debt: 187,320,000 Soli. Hardworking as I am, I will pay off these debts in no time!'

No amount of hard work could possibly pay off that kind of debt.""

1914218404.m_KeyValue:
""Through the fractured sea of time, Aiona drifted between the tides of past and future. Once, I asked how many cycles she had endured. She only shook her head in silence. Perhaps even she no longer remembers.

At last, she seized that single wave. She succeeded though the cost was trauma etched deep by countless, agonizing returns.

Along that endless journey, she left so much behind. Companions. Family. Feelings. All she carried was her obsession to break the cycle.

Even now, she remains ever watchful, as though still wandering that sunless desert.

I sent her an hourglass, hoping she would understand that no hand will come to turn it again. Be it time, or the sands within, everything has finally come to rest.""

1914218439.m_KeyValue:
""The broken Siren's Tear lay on the table, its luster dulled by the passage of time. From deep within, it stirred a whisper of song.

A young girl stood at the weathered bow of a ship, softly humming to the moon.

By the time she was born, the Pillars of Hercules had long since vanished beneath the waves. Her people had become wanderers, adrift on the sea. Her mother had told her, that they were like fish, and the currents chose their path.

She had not yet learned to turn her tentacles into legs, nor to speak the language of humans. But her song carried a quiet yearning—what lay beyond the waters, on those distant, unknown shores?""

1914218563.m_KeyValue:
""I feel life hemorrhaging from my flesh, and thought crystallizing within my skull.

This body feels like a god-given cage for my disobedience—lungs that cannot draw breath, legs that cannot bear weight, a tongue that cannot form words... Like some primordial curse, this torment devours my soul with each passing day. They speak of an unknown _$$disease,_$$ seared into my marrow from my very first breath.

My future stretches before me like a funeral shroud, yet I know that within death's maw, I can still seize that _$$answer_$$ which will grant me deliverance.""

1914218594.m_KeyValue:
""The young cartographer's scheduled survey is set for tomorrow.

Yet I can already picture it—knowing her stubborn spirit, even if the castle gates were firmly locked, she would find a way to climb in through the windows.

After careful consideration, there is only one way to prevent her entry—I must complete the survey myself, before she gets the chance.

Determined to walk the cartographer's path before she could, I made my first stop at the back garden of the castle.

This place had long since been transformed into an alchemical garden by that enigmatic steward.

As I stepped inside, the subtle smile gracing Cain's lips whispered of something out of the ordinary.

Agnes, that young girl, had already arrived and completed her initial survey.

The survey was set for tomorrow, but she'd already made her move. 

Fortunately, the first survey location was Cain's territory. Well-versed in the art of concealment, he should be able to leave no trace.

But if the survey goes any deeper, Bathory's well-hidden secrets may be laid bare. I must stop her before that happens.""

1914218652.m_KeyValue:
""Bearing this saddle, I made my way back to Bathory Castle.

What forgotten time lay buried beneath that veil of rust? As one who had lost all memory of my own past, I found myself consumed by curiosity.

I talked to both Empousa and Jestel, hoping they might shed light on this mystery.

Empousa declared she knew nothing of its origins, while Jestel revealed that such intricate patterns were exceedingly rare, even within the Aegis family.

Throughout the family's long history, only one ancestor had earned the right to bear such markings—the great Valora Aegis herself.""

1914240532.m_KeyValue: "Lord Ezareth continuously deals strong DMG to a single target after <color=#D63536>Channeling</color>. Timely heals or DMG mitigation is recommended. Summoned soldiers also provide Lord Ezareth with additional buff effects while on the field. Prioritize eliminating them."

1914240564.m_KeyValue: "A spectral entity capable of marking and assaulting enemies from afar. It's advised to steer clear of its attack range."

1914240565.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer from Lupine Forest. Attacks in melee range with their pitchfork, dealing powerful AoE DMG.""

1914240566.m_KeyValue: ""A junior warrior of the Silver Cross armed with flails, their sweeping melee attacks deal fatal damage to targets.""

1914240567.m_KeyValue: ""A squad leader of the Silver Cross, skilled with shields and strong durability.""

1914240570.m_KeyValue: ""A melee Defender spirit armed with a sturdy shield, boasting remarkable DEF.""

1914240571.m_KeyValue: ""A basic melee spirit, and combat veteran demonstrating an even distribution of attributes.""

1914240575.m_KeyValue: ""The eldest of the Bathory family. Wielding a titanic axe, he smites anyone who dare oppose him, consuming lives indiscriminately to sustain his waning essence.""

1914240596.m_KeyValue: ""A sorcerer with antlers, holding ice flowers, who continuously heals other units. Recommended to interrupt.""

1914240597.m_KeyValue: "A Bloodborn Vassal that launche a scythe forward to cutting through enemies along the path. Prioritize eliminating them."

1914240598.m_KeyValue: ""A creature that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Land CRIT Hits to shatter its crystal, reducing its DEF.""

1914240599.m_KeyValue: ""A wizard with antlers, wielding a staff, who can deal AoE DMG to enemies. Recommended to dodge or prioritize eliminating them.""

1914240600.m_KeyValue: "A Bloodborn servant who wields a blade to deal DMG to all enemies they face. Keep a loose formation."

1914240601.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. This Blood Beast charges forward into battle. It's recommended to dodge or block their ATK swiftly.""

1914240602.m_KeyValue: "A Bloodborn Vassal who heals other allies upon <color=#D63536>channeling</color>. Prioritize eliminating them."

1914240603.m_KeyValue: ""A Bloodborn servant who blocks all ATK with the shield bestowed by their master. While <color=#D63536>channeling</color>, resonates with other Bloodborn to increase their DEF. Interrupt when possible.""

1914240606.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. This Blood Beast deals continuous DMG in a circle after <color=#D63536>channeling</color>. Interrupt when possible.""

1914988922.m_KeyValue: "'That's far from mere superstition! There's a documented case of someone's wish being granted by a shooting star.'"

1914988923.m_KeyValue: ""'What a load of nonsense!' Empousa scoffed, her disdain for such starry-eyed notions palpable.""

1914988924.m_KeyValue: "'But didn't he also claim that he didn't believe stars could foretell the future?'"

1914988925.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, but it was a disaster. The marriage alliance between the Berde and Yegar Kingdoms became a threat to the kingdom in the west.'""

1914988927.m_KeyValue: ""'I've made my choice. I must revive my family. I have my own mission, so I'm staying here,' Jestel declared, finally at peace with her decision.""

1916981379.m_KeyValue: ""Not only that, but deliberately letting me discover your secrets.""

1917318064.m_KeyValue: "...Then why did you send the letter?"

1917318065.m_KeyValue: "Haven't decided yet. Let me think about it."

1917318068.m_KeyValue: "I need your help with those techniques of yours."

1917318070.m_KeyValue: "But I'm still curious how you plan to screw me over."

1917318071.m_KeyValue: "I have a rather bad feeling about this."

1917318072.m_KeyValue: "Enough! Let's get to the real matter at hand."

1917318075.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you Bloodborn particularly good at playing hide and seek?"

1917432500.m_KeyValue: "I was bracing myself for you to burst through the gates and confront me."

1918432184.m_KeyValue: "The Moonfall Games—that's where I first met my so-called _$$sisters._$$"

1918432185.m_KeyValue: "Let's start here and end this ridiculous game."

1918432186.m_KeyValue: ""Ha! If you want to dress up this deal as something noble, be my guest.""

1918432187.m_KeyValue: ""First, we need to identify your previous shortcomings, or rather, what you've failed to achieve. Shall we start by examining your shared experiences?""

1918492258.m_KeyValue: ""You're not one of the scouting drones the El Dorado sent to search for Noah, are you?""

1918492259.m_KeyValue: ""The Formless's forces will be here any moment. This area isn't safe—get out of sight, quickly.""

1918492261.m_KeyValue: "It's blue... one of ours. Modified by our Albrecht. What are you doing here in the forest?"

1918492268.m_KeyValue: ""You're trying to tell me something, aren't you? I'm sorry—but I still can't understand what you mean.""

1918494430.m_KeyValue: ""When Black Blood spreads far enough, its victims merge into one consciousness. They vanish into the swarm, becoming a single, mindless purpose.""

1918494431.m_KeyValue: "You don't just know it—you've lived it."

1918494438.m_KeyValue: ""But together, under the Mastermind's command, their flawless coordination could bring ruin to entire worlds.""

1918494439.m_KeyValue: "You truly believe there's a Mastermind behind it all?"

1918494440.m_KeyValue: ""According to Stella, it controls every construct. If we defeat it, the threat to both worlds ends.""

1918494441.m_KeyValue: ""Do you really believe that? That some supreme will exists—pulling every string, logically controlling everything?""

1918494442.m_KeyValue: "Every question you ask makes it harder to see you as just another Bell Ringer."

1918494443.m_KeyValue: "You want me to say there's no will. No Mastermind."

1918494444.m_KeyValue: "That most people simply crave affirmation... and lose themselves trying to meet others' expectations."

1918495454.m_KeyValue: ""And as her crew, we carry out her will.""

1918495455.m_KeyValue: "Captain's orders are clear—we wait. This is our homeland too."

1918495456.m_KeyValue: "...I think we should have bread for dinner tonight."

1918495457.m_KeyValue: ""There's our Captain Ami, deep in thought as always!""

1918495460.m_KeyValue: ""This is my homeland. If there's even the faintest glimmer of hope, I won't let it go.""

1918495461.m_KeyValue: ""Stella, don't throw your life away! There are too many of them.""

1918495468.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. I won't let anything happen to this ship."

1918496608.m_KeyValue: "And what makes you so certain it was your doing?"

1918496609.m_KeyValue: "The version of me here has already confirmed it—he's pursuing the exact same research."

1918496614.m_KeyValue: "I wonder if 'Death' might buy me the time I need to work through this puzzle."

1918496615.m_KeyValue: ""Take too long, and I may simply leave you behind—""

1918496616.m_KeyValue: "Too bad the constructs outside won't wait for you to enjoy your 'pursuit.'"

1918496618.m_KeyValue: ""Still, this was worthwhile. Most of my theories hold true—""

1918496619.m_KeyValue: ""I created this world, yes, but its growth now exceeds my design.""

1918496620.m_KeyValue: "Hmm… so that was my conclusion after all."

1918496621.m_KeyValue: "Any later and I'd have fled to avoid your charming little monsters."

1918497631.m_KeyValue: "So I was right. You came here to indulge your curiosity."

1918497638.m_KeyValue: ""So you're telling me the passage between our worlds could be hidden anywhere—in forests, oceans, cities we pass by without a glance...""

1918497639.m_KeyValue: ""But universes are more elusive. Their link to the outer world lies not at the rim, but within.""

1918497640.m_KeyValue: "Wouldn't you like to know how I discovered such an insignificant point of contact?"

1918497641.m_KeyValue: "or perhaps... inside that very clock tower."

1918497642.m_KeyValue: "I do know how to close it. But it seems... an accident occurred."

1918497643.m_KeyValue: "I'm more curious why you never tried to seal it—even after locating it."

1918497644.m_KeyValue: "It appears to move freely between both worlds without using the passage—and that's the mystery I intend to unravel."

1918498786.m_KeyValue: "It's the Formless! It's slicing through space—it's about to manifest—!"

1918498792.m_KeyValue: ""Now that we know each other's names, we're all companions!""

1918498794.m_KeyValue: "The one who won't meet my gaze and hasn't stopped eating."

1918498795.m_KeyValue: "This one's Brad… gulp... smells amazing. Want a bite?"

1918498796.m_KeyValue: "No. I just want to know who you are."

1918498797.m_KeyValue: ""Me? I'm the world's last hope, captain of the legendary Ultimate El Dorado, and the greatest adventurer alive—""

1918499808.m_KeyValue: "Little Stella... You really are something else!"

1918499809.m_KeyValue: ""The deck should be clear of constructs now. Still, you may want to check inside the ship—some might have slipped through.""

1918499814.m_KeyValue: ""Hey! Less chatter, more action! They're boarding through the Gates!""

1918499815.m_KeyValue: ""Little Regina, did you see the rifts torn open by the Formless? Those are Gates—pathways between worlds.""

1918499817.m_KeyValue: ""Return to port. If we can't close the Gates, we're wasting our time here.""

1918499819.m_KeyValue: "No one knows those constructs better than I do."

1918499820.m_KeyValue: "Can you take them all on your own?"

1918499821.m_KeyValue: "I'll handle them. Keep the ship moving."

1918500967.m_KeyValue: "The El Dorado's flying speed has its limitations. You were the only one we could save."

1918500968.m_KeyValue: "Forget that! Did you see anyone else—was anyone else with me?"

1918500969.m_KeyValue: "Two more fell. That who you're talking about?"

1918500970.m_KeyValue: ""El... Dorado? Such a fancy name… Wait—if I'm still alive, that means we actually made it to Stella's homeland!?""

1918500973.m_KeyValue: ""Lucky for you, the El Dorado broke your fall.""

1918501987.m_KeyValue: ""And yet... that's exactly how much time I need. Tell me, who do you think sent that 'star' to beg for my help?""

1918501991.m_KeyValue: ""For ordinary mortals? Ten years, give or take.""

1918501992.m_KeyValue: "We may not have ten days. This world is falling apart around us."

1918501993.m_KeyValue: "But for a genius like myself? Ten days."

1918501994.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you use Covenant during the fight? Like before—when you bailed us out."

1918501997.m_KeyValue: ""I tried. It's useless. The water here... its structure is completely alien. Until I understand how it's composed, I can't manipulate this world's 'water.'""

1919314076.m_KeyValue: "My apologies. We cannot know if those returning from beyond have been exposed to Black Blood."

1919314083.m_KeyValue: ""If I were you, I would not announce such tidings aloud.""

1919314084.m_KeyValue: "Survivor? Look at her armor—does she seem one who needs rescuing?"

1919314087.m_KeyValue: ""Following his eyes, Seraphina sees Ryan approaching, several soldiers at his back.""

1919314088.m_KeyValue: "What's the commotion? Have you forgotten your training?"

1920916389.m_KeyValue: ""They must have left by now, right? The herbs in the bag should temporarily suppress the Blood Beast... Now, it's my turn to deal with you.""

1920916420.m_KeyValue: "Quickly bring the herbs... to save everyone..."

1920916421.m_KeyValue: ""'I don't want to die vomiting all my blood, hideous and in pain... Goodbye, everyone.'""

1920916423.m_KeyValue: "But I always mess things up... I can't pass fate's test..."

1920916425.m_KeyValue: ""Like all my captured prey, you'll become a puppet of the Black Blood—the true threat your companions will have to face.""

1920916426.m_KeyValue: ""Y-yes... We've defeated Blood Beasts before, this time we'll also...""

1920916427.m_KeyValue: ""You forced your way into my mind through the Black Blood—but within the Hive Mind, I glimpsed your secrets as well.""

1920916453.m_KeyValue: ""Was it you who woke me? I told you to run, didn't I, silly cat...""

1920916455.m_KeyValue: "What's the diving limit for humans? 100 meters? 200 meters?"

1920916458.m_KeyValue: ""Before I leave, I can grant you one last wish!""

1922061493.m_KeyValue: ""Easy, Aiona. You've already left that desert behind.""

1922061495.m_KeyValue: "But all I remember… is the yellow sand."

1922207779.m_KeyValue: "Could this be the power of 'The Sun'?"

1922207780.m_KeyValue: "The glory of the whole world and thereby all obscurity shall fly from you."

1922208075.m_KeyValue: ""Aunt Julia says you can do divination, is that true?""

1922208076.m_KeyValue: "But you said you were able to find your luggage through divination. Is it because I didn't give you treats?"

1922208077.m_KeyValue: ""The final 'Judgment' descends, where past sins are settled, undisputable, and no one is spared.""

1922208078.m_KeyValue: ""Hurry and defeat them! After all—these are your memories, not some blissful dreamland.""

1922208109.m_KeyValue: "Let's save that poor little thing first."

1922208141.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... that's indeed an option. Men, let's chop down this tree!""

1922208175.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright, I've thought of a sturdier way to secure the mast.""

1922208178.m_KeyValue: ""She'll be fine, she will definitely be fine...""

1922208207.m_KeyValue: ""If only I were a cat too—If we were all cats, we could swim away from here, couldn't we?""

1922208208.m_KeyValue: ""She adopted you to inherit her role as the next mystic of the Pontos, to break that prophecy, but you can't even pick up the Tarot cards!""

1922208209.m_KeyValue: "I see the spirit of the deceased has descended once again... He must have given you final guidance."

1922208210.m_KeyValue: "The gifts of fate come at a price. It was my cowardice and hesitation that delayed its revelation..."

1922208237.m_KeyValue: "I'm going to listen to fate's final advice."

1922208238.m_KeyValue: ""There's nothing to apologize for. We all abandoned our stable lives to follow the Captain we admired, drifting around at sea.""

1922208239.m_KeyValue: "In the distant new land—milk and honey flow everywhere—"

1922208240.m_KeyValue: "Shh—Spoken words have the power to become reality."

1922208241.m_KeyValue: ""Her righteous light would blind the windmill, her inspiring words would make it ashamed to see the light of day!""

1922208242.m_KeyValue: "The future shown in the reading is sealed... unless I can draw the final card."

1922598277.m_KeyValue: "Miss Lorelei! We have new prizes at our stall. Would you like to try your luck?"

1922656492.m_KeyValue: "You need to download {size} of necessary resources before entering your territory. Start downloading now?"

1922672697.m_KeyValue: "We'll need more clues. Judging by where it vanished and where this part turned up... I'd say it headed east toward the other side of town."

1923878837.m_KeyValue: ""Since this is your territory, and I come seeking your protection, I thought it only right to introduce myself.""

1924420976.m_KeyValue: "Someone awaits you. Tap to meet beneath the moon."

1924938790.m_KeyValue:
""Current situation aboard the El Dorado—
Van Helsing tracks William, who is disguised as Goldland, to the third deck.""

1924938793.m_KeyValue:
""Territory of the Ganelon family, once a place where the wolves thrived.
Since the spread of the plague, no living being remains. The emotions and memories of those who once lived here have formed into a collective consciousness, lingering in the forest pine.""

1925212840.m_KeyValue: ""I'm still the warden here, after all.""

1925891258.m_KeyValue: "Just a little more... and it would've been a flawless work of art."

1925891259.m_KeyValue: ""Now that Sapphire Isle has grown so vibrant... would you like it better, Bella?""

1925891264.m_KeyValue: "Such sad memory fragments... I can't bear to look... I don't like this..."

1925891265.m_KeyValue: ""To Dalcarlo, helping me search for treasures was probably just a passing whim.""

1925891266.m_KeyValue: "I told her about the most extraordinary creatures. The ones you can only find in Sapphire Isle."

1925891267.m_KeyValue: "Such a precious item... What did Little Bella No. 1 trade Dalcarlo to get this?"

1925891268.m_KeyValue: ""You said Sapphire Isle was nothing but a dreary fishing village, lacking music, invention, or the fashion you longed for.""

1925891269.m_KeyValue: ""...It's been eleven years since you left. In your diary, you wrote that I was a dull father who did not care about your interests, your life, your growth.""

1925891270.m_KeyValue: "Did Bella catch a cold too? Why is there liquid running down her face?"

1927735274.m_KeyValue: ""Greetings, Noah. It's been a while since I received your letter. What have you been keeping yourself busy with?""

1928409462.m_KeyValue: ""Don't underestimate me! When I made up my mind to protect that stinky bat, I felt it—my whole body surged with strength. Maybe, from the very beginning...""

1928409463.m_KeyValue: "She needs me... as a vessel for her resurrection."

1928409464.m_KeyValue: "...I'd like to know that myself. Jacintha—whose side are you really on!?"

1928409465.m_KeyValue: "Spare me the flattery and drop that form!"

1928410480.m_KeyValue: "W-Why is there another one?! She looks exactly the same!"

1928410482.m_KeyValue: ""Is he some kind of bard, here to cheer us on?""

1928410484.m_KeyValue: "—the coachman... the one Empousa is about to attack!?"

1928410485.m_KeyValue: ""I only pray Albrecht can stall him, even briefly...""

1928410486.m_KeyValue: ""And if there are others like me, then they too become us—and together, we live on, as one and the same.""

1928410488.m_KeyValue: "Was that your doing? How did you obtain such power...? Or does it belong to that strangely dressed woman at your side?"

1928410489.m_KeyValue: ""Because Aeon is me, is you, is everyone—and all that exists?""

1930219042.m_KeyValue: ""Coupled with my mother's determination to protect us, I doubt its defenses can be easily breached!""

1930219209.m_KeyValue: "This... this is Baphomet's hunting ground where he toys with his prey!"

1930219372.m_KeyValue: ""First of all, she's not my sister! And secondly, don't you dare order me around!""

1930877282.m_KeyValue: ""I'll miss the town, everyone I know here, and those who are no longer with us.""

1931093020.m_KeyValue: ""So, what is it Letitia wants to discuss?""

1931283420.m_KeyValue: "Fragments of a girl named Bella. Pieces of personality—stripped away."

1931283421.m_KeyValue: "Can we truly return to being just merchant and customer?"

1931283422.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Derek mentioned you're well-read in philosophy."

1932430931.m_KeyValue: ""It's a curse written in blood—the body withers, organs decay from within, and neither ancient remedies nor modern medicine can cure it.""

1933049163.m_KeyValue:
"'Acting is believing!'

1933049164.m_KeyValue: "Your computer flashes a message: 'Do you have the courage to tread the path ahead?'"

1934615831.m_KeyValue:
""I'd never spoken directly to Cidhall. I gathered those fragmented memories myself.
Even though I'd won so many times, he had never acknowledged me because I was not the one they sought after.
This thought came and went in my mind, vanishing just as quickly as it had appeared.
I was mad with jealousy.""

1934615861.m_KeyValue: "We were all prisoners wrestling with fate."

1934615893.m_KeyValue:
""I'm not necessarily averse to conflict. I've killed before.
Took out a few of _$$them._$$""

1934615894.m_KeyValue:
""The person I saved was quite wary of me, her language abilities lacking.
I felt disappointed, for in her soul fragment, she hadn't resembled this lifeless state.""

1934615927.m_KeyValue: "I was also angry with myself for not being chosen."

1934615960.m_KeyValue:
""I wanted to live on, but I feared my own self,
nor was I able to face down my demons.""

1934615993.m_KeyValue:
""I lay beneath the crumbling statue, my body convulsing.
I hunger insatiably, craving without end; I slay all, yet I yearn for more.
But the more I thirst, the emptier I become.""

1934616026.m_KeyValue:
""The sensation could hardly be more distinct than it is right now. As I muse on this thought,
a sharp blade suddenly tears through my chest. I turn around—
It's ""her."" No... could it be ""her""? Or perhaps, it is ""her""...""

1934935492.m_KeyValue: "Endless apologies—aren't you a little too gentle for your own good?"

1934935493.m_KeyValue: "(coughing)... What little strength remains... is fading..."

1934935494.m_KeyValue: "No… I cannot keep running... All of this... is because of me…"

1934935497.m_KeyValue: ""As for how you came into contact… I have a hypothesis, but I will not leap to conclusions.""

1936846845.m_KeyValue: "Why is everything shaking? Is there an earthquake? Are you getting attacked by constructs again?"

1936846846.m_KeyValue: ""After Stella's reply, I gently cupped the construct in my hands, staring into its emerald eyes.""

1936846848.m_KeyValue: ""No, it doesn't only carry sound—I can see your world through the construct's eyes...""

1936846850.m_KeyValue: ""And as if it sensed her unease, the construct squirmed faintly in my grip.""

1936846851.m_KeyValue: ""I couldn't read her expression through the construct's polished eyes, but her voice held a tremor—light, but unmistakable.""

1936846852.m_KeyValue: ""Wait... Noah? You're awfully close, aren't you?""

1937491736.m_KeyValue: "Meow? Are you bringing me new catnip?"

1937525497.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, I found the Wolfsbane you asked for.""

1937741235.m_KeyValue: "I've... I've decided to try writing stories myself!"

1938137947.m_KeyValue: "Did you cut yourself? Or bump into something?"

1938137948.m_KeyValue: ""Joan and I faced the same thing once, wandering the desert.""

1938969167.m_KeyValue: "There's a small manor in eastern Carrelle territory that's been suffering repeated raids by bandits. I'd like you to drive them off and help the people there."

1939079146.m_KeyValue: ""What I experienced transcended mere memories. I could smell the earthen scent hanging in the air, feel the dampness seeping through torrential rain. It was more like... living it all over again.""

1939184905.m_KeyValue: "So we just need to move your coffin into the bedroom?"

1939429602.m_KeyValue: "Who are you? Why have you been following me?"

1939886414.m_KeyValue: ""Amidst the journey of recovering your memories and pursuing your dreams, don't forget to check the collections in the territory regularly.""

1939895959.m_KeyValue: "Clear [Sapphire Isle] <color=#a65f30>N 1-8</color>: It Was All A Dream"

1940110139.m_KeyValue: ""Humans shall pay the price for their actions. When the night mist rises, they will all become prey for the Mistbound Terror.""

1940328355.m_KeyValue: ""Like the ancient arenas, this is a place for blood, sweat, and honor. Build your lineup, train your Vassals well, and test your might against rival Lords.""

1940331556.m_KeyValue: ""While you were away, our territory has accumulated a fair bit of resources.""

1940331653.m_KeyValue: ""There are many tortured souls here, victims of Baphomet. Miss Aiona, we can revive these warriors!""

1940538395.m_KeyValue: "Please select 2 pieces of Equipment for Salvage."

1940879728.m_KeyValue: "How?! With Joan standing guard—how did Agares reach the sealed area?!"

1940879730.m_KeyValue: ""The more I cursed death, the more I came to understand it. I wanted to run from you—and find you again.""

1940879731.m_KeyValue: ""When I accepted the Silver Blood Ritual, I let go. The pain of crossing to the Other Side… The comfort of living by your side… All of it was replaced by a single purpose.""

1940879732.m_KeyValue: ""There you go again, saying strange things.""

1940879733.m_KeyValue: ""We can build a new reality—return to an ordinary life, just like before...""

1940879735.m_KeyValue: "Thibault. Would you allow me a moment alone with this child? There are things I must say to her."

1940882932.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, it burns! Want to know why you lost? Though you probably can't hear me anymore, I'll be kind enough to tell you.""

1940882934.m_KeyValue: ""This is truly awe-inspiring! To witness the legendary Covenant of the Goddess of War for the first time—and in a battle against me, no less?""

1940882935.m_KeyValue: ""Limine Bathory, the _$$Everlasting Night._$$ Once we have you, we'll be halfway to achieving our long-cherished wish.""

1940885090.m_KeyValue: ""Astolfo flourished from barren sands, a lone pearl on the desert's breast. To shield it from the consuming dunes, we guard its master with our lives.""

1940885096.m_KeyValue: ""A peasant residing in Mouret. Invaders turned him into a raging monster, and the blood-covered scythe in hand is a testament to his brutality.""

1940885101.m_KeyValue: ""'Aeon granted me life, yet withheld the hope to live on; Astolfo offered me shelter, yet abandoned me for my poverty; my arrows fly not for beasts, but for the eyes of slavers.'""

1940885102.m_KeyValue: ""'Aeon granted me life, yet withheld the hope to live on; Astolfo offered me shelter, yet abandoned me for my poverty; my pitchfork no longer shifts the harvest, but pierces the hearts of the rich.'""

1940885119.m_KeyValue:
"The manifestation of the Calamity _$$Famine_$$ in Hati's Spirit Realm.
It attempts to merge with Hati to reclaim its power."

1940885127.m_KeyValue: "The Heretic Hunters of the Church who stare death in the face. They know well that even their baptism before the crusade could not change their inevitable fate. Their chainmail clangs like a bell rung at their own funeral."

1940885129.m_KeyValue: ""Spirit vessels used by Baphomet for his flesh experiments. Though they are quite damaged, they still retain some energy.""

1940885130.m_KeyValue: "An assassin attempting to infiltrate the Alita castle and kill the lord."

1940885194.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps the most distinctive Spirit Bone Tower, it is clearly a prized piece of work. The tower is meticulously constructed from the skulls of the Paracelsus family, and silently displays the obsessive nature of its creators.""

1941812257.m_KeyValue: ""When HP falls below {0}, charges forward and knocks back all enemies. Also summons multiple Plague Nests before disappearing from the Battlefield. After a period of time, returns to the Battlefield by emerging from the ground.""

1942171385.m_KeyValue: ""Even if the Saint begins to doubt you because of me... As long as you remain useful, she will protect you.""

1942171387.m_KeyValue: ""Why do you think animals are unaffected by Black Blood? Yet humans lose themselves to it, becoming beasts?""

1942171388.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if you truly believe this, or if you've simply lost your mind. All I know is this: You, Tris Tepes, are now an enemy of the Church. A heretic I must vanquish!""

1942171389.m_KeyValue: "No... that's not what I wanted to ask."

1942171390.m_KeyValue: "...you would've received the memories of every Bell Ringer before you. And the memory of history itself."

1942189287.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, this armor... these patterns... I've seen them before.""

1943480940.m_KeyValue: "So close! You were so close to sounding like a person!"

1943480941.m_KeyValue: ""If you'd gotten yourself hurt, I'd be the one left picking up the pieces.""

1943976310.m_KeyValue: ""A lot of fish have been mysteriously disappearing from the kitchen lately. You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?""

1944030869.m_KeyValue: "I wasn't working for that silver-haired. We fought side by side only because circumstances left us no choice."

1944030870.m_KeyValue: ""So, are you an agent of the Silver Cross, or companion to the silver-haired one?""

1944030871.m_KeyValue: "That weapon... You're Isaac Van Helsing of the Silver Cross!"

1944030872.m_KeyValue: "Stay back! Run while you still can—before the monsters reach us! Go!"

1944030873.m_KeyValue: ""Come now, could you at least let me finish my heroic line?""

1944030874.m_KeyValue: ""I heard it at time's end, the toll of the bell returning to zero.""

1944031897.m_KeyValue: ""What's that supposed to mean? Aren't you my brother Kris? Or should I call you Captain Goldland, seeing as we're still on the ship.""

1944031898.m_KeyValue: ""That's why we need your help, Kris... no, Captain Goldland.""

1945453797.m_KeyValue: ""Since the castle still holds meaning for you, you're welcome to visit. I see no harm in it.""

1945559556.m_KeyValue: ""If you're looking for a fight, you could just ask directly.""

1946076190.m_KeyValue: "I heard the comet strike left several laborers gravely wounded—three died where they fell."

1946076191.m_KeyValue: ""In the stifling gloom, a scatter of candles cast their trembling light. Fanny knelt before the instruments of torment, her fingers gliding across them as if they were holy relics. Under her breath she whispered the names of the dead.""

1946076192.m_KeyValue: ""As Warden, you were molded into Discipline itself—tormenting them was your sacred charge. But as a human soul, you hungered for connection, for warmth. Punishment became your only bridge to reach them.""

1946076193.m_KeyValue: ""Warden, I can give you what you crave.""

1946076194.m_KeyValue: ""What have you done to everyone?! Ressa, Aiona, and Empousa!""

1947367845.m_KeyValue: ""The other two levels hold only cells. From the stairwells we climb for the yard time and questioning, I'd place our cells on the third basement.""

1947367846.m_KeyValue: "You again! Looking to get yourself killed?!"

1947367847.m_KeyValue: "(Left from the yard. Straight for fifty-six steps to the stairwell. Down one flight—second level.)"

1947367848.m_KeyValue: "(...Just as Genevieve said—a chatterbox. Perfect. All three positions confirmed.)"

1947477619.m_KeyValue: ""However, during our investigation, Selena and I discovered that Mr. Thoreau is likely putting up a front—he has done many questionable things in secret.""

1947477621.m_KeyValue: ""If it was an eating contest, I'd be more confident.""

1947477622.m_KeyValue: "—They might even be connected to the people of Landis..."

1947477624.m_KeyValue: ""Once everything is done, I'll find a way to regroup with you all.""

1947477653.m_KeyValue: ""All I could do was return to the ruined Sapphire Isle, take up your father's legacy, and rebuild it into the thriving place you see today.""

1947477654.m_KeyValue: "What your father went through... could very well be your fate."

1947477678.m_KeyValue: "Then let us lay it all bare beneath the summer sun."

1947477683.m_KeyValue: "Oh? This is quite unexpected. Could it be that... Miss Ami is a fraud?"

1947477685.m_KeyValue: "I knew it—the guests staying at our inn must have gone missing..."

1947477688.m_KeyValue: "The olive branch at the crime scene suggests Viktor Thoreau cloaking violence beneath the guise of peace; the scepter and Pisces imply that one of the Seven Sages usurped Van Helsing's rightful lands; and the scales with the blindfold... a symbol of you enforcing order through bloodshed."

1948516401.m_KeyValue: "Place in a locked Inventory slot to unlock slot."

1948518579.m_KeyValue: "Place in a locked Inventory slot to unlock slot."

1948938523.m_KeyValue: "I don't know how we can ever repay you...!"

1948938525.m_KeyValue: ""Have you come to ask about the weather? As for rainfall, this month should bring...""

1948938526.m_KeyValue: ""I've heard this war involves Bloodborn and the Church. Someone like you, skilled in sorcery—if they catch you, the consequences would be dire, I say.""

1948938527.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia, together we are the Tempest that creates and destroys life—not servants to these lesser forms.""

1948938529.m_KeyValue: ""That man who kneeled in gratitude—they took everything from him. His money, his family, all of it.""

1949233928.m_KeyValue: "The food matches my data perfectly—no significant anomalies detected here."

1949233930.m_KeyValue: "High time you had a taste of this filth yourselves."

1949698034.m_KeyValue: ""Three years new, three years old, and three years of mending worn holes; the wood caskets in the Timeworn Mausoleum endure, generation after generation.""

1949700212.m_KeyValue: ""Three years new, three years old, and three years of mending worn holes; the wood caskets in the Timeworn Mausoleum endure, generation after generation.""

1952523928.m_KeyValue: "I never mentioned their gender. Seems you gave yourself away."

1953378378.m_KeyValue: "Please don't say that. Elder Bella mentioned a retired instrument maker who might be able to craft one to order. I can inquire about that for you."

1953996814.m_KeyValue: ""And these swords, with which we clashed, shall be my monuments to your memory.""

1957838452.m_KeyValue: "(A wax-sealed letter and talk of an official survey? This has all the hallmarks of an elaborate new scam. Best to ignore it entirely.)"

1959151444.m_KeyValue: "Quickly moves towards selected target or direction. Cannot be targeted during this effect."

1959172143.m_KeyValue: ""I thought, after all these years, they might have laid their hatred to rest. I didn't expect them to return like this.""

1960277506.m_KeyValue: ""At last, kind and brave souls have come to my aid!""

1960280707.m_KeyValue: "What a bother... Never thought I'd see the day I'd be buying time for a Ganelon."

1961088108.m_KeyValue: ""A sailor fully mutated by Black Blood. The infectious Calamity _$$Famine_$$ has rendered it a living embodiment of _$$devourance,_$$ its monstrous maw serving as a testament to this concept.""

1961370877.m_KeyValue: "Alert the Warden at once! The silver-haired heretic and his red-haired accomplice have broken out! Their whereabouts are unknown!"

1961370878.m_KeyValue: ""If you're planning a breakout, step one is opening the door.""

1961370879.m_KeyValue: "Wait! You're not taking me with you!?"

1961370880.m_KeyValue: ""Now left, straight for thirty-six paces. You'll smell incense, and the floor—see how the stone tiles rise and sink under countless feet.""

1961370881.m_KeyValue: "Why… why did you run off with that woman the moment my back was turned?"

1962980398.m_KeyValue:
"Actions can't keep up with thoughts—that's just how it is.
We'll leave it at that."

1962980427.m_KeyValue: ""Having moved too slowly, it's as if nothing happened when you arrive. World's unsolved mysteries +1.""

1964035546.m_KeyValue: "I was just about to write you when your letter arrived."

1964284789.m_KeyValue: ""(She'll return to her world, where new trials await.)""

1966171193.m_KeyValue: "Deals <style="Highlight">{0}</style> increased DMG to enemies under debuff or Control effects."

1966368254.m_KeyValue: "He has his own affairs to tend to."

1966368256.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, the mutation has not advanced too far—subduing it is manageable.""

1967659898.m_KeyValue: "Tch. Most likely they're here on a purge—to cut down potential threats."

1967659899.m_KeyValue: ""If guilt gnaws at you, then go down and share their fate. Die in the smoke, or turn into a monster.""

1967659904.m_KeyValue: "What else do you need to know?"

1967659910.m_KeyValue: "And what concern is that of yours?"

1973604139.m_KeyValue: "Hmph! What's so great about the strongest? We have the Bathory's strongest fighter on our side—Elder Jacintha!"

1973604140.m_KeyValue: "You're not worthy to be my opponent."

1973604141.m_KeyValue: "What?! But he's a Bell Ringer—how could he be a Moonblessed?!"

1973604145.m_KeyValue: ""Even though Mr. Lifeless Eyes left the ship, it still feels like he's around… Guess that means everyone liked him more than they let on.""

1973604146.m_KeyValue: "But why's she sealed here? Isn't the Bathory estate across the sea?"

1973604148.m_KeyValue: ""That the fourth Moonblessed, the Calamity called War, is here?""
