1974237139.m_KeyValue: "It's another Siren's Tear... the one Lorelei slipped into my hand back then."

1974237140.m_KeyValue: "Wait... something on me is resonating with it..."

1974241263.m_KeyValue: ""I've already seen it, no need to waste more time.""

1974241265.m_KeyValue: ""Now, let's carefully examine this area. <style=""Highlight"">Tap on anything unusual</style> to uncover clues. Tap the <style=""Highlight"">Notice</style> in the top-right corner whenever you need guidance.""

1974805637.m_KeyValue: ""If you want her location, then tell us the formula for Siren's Tear.""

1974805638.m_KeyValue: "Which is why I must face it now—as the man I've become."

1974805639.m_KeyValue: "You call that saving people? You used those inhumane methods..."

1974805640.m_KeyValue: "I can't save my sister... But I can still save her child!"

1974805641.m_KeyValue: ""Unlike me. I'm nothing but a corpse, shuffling forward on borrowed time, driven by regret.""

1974805642.m_KeyValue: "If he hadn't followed me—If he hadn't stopped me—She was his niece too! Why couldn't he sacrifice those damn sirens?!"

1974805644.m_KeyValue: "I created the first Siren's Tear. It's what the Master desires above all else. And I'll never let hand it over..."

1974805669.m_KeyValue: ""It may be hard to believe, but when we met, I carried another Siren's Tear—given to me by Miss Lorelei, once a Sage herself.""

1974805670.m_KeyValue: ""Debts must be paid, and promises must be kept—no matter what. Noah, you will fulfill your promise to Lorelei, won't you?""

1974805671.m_KeyValue: ""So she must be the companion Noah's been looking for, the one kidnapped by the Master...""

1974805672.m_KeyValue: ""I also heard that before he escaped, he killed Lord Constantine!""

1974805673.m_KeyValue: ""We found him! Quick, take him to Lord Hallon for our reward—""

1974805674.m_KeyValue: "Ami... was she that maid on the ship?"

1974805675.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, Selena, who serves under you, seemed to follow you here and has been searching for you ever since.""

1974805676.m_KeyValue: "Stop thinking—you're not built for it. Just take us to Hallon already."

1974805677.m_KeyValue: ""Why must you be like your father, haunting me like a nightmare with your cursed sense of justice?""

1974805933.m_KeyValue: ""It's the perfect moment for the Yakov Troupe to shine—spirited acts, clever lines, and a script that bends with the wind!""

1974805934.m_KeyValue: ""Ladies and gentlemen, gather round! The grandest interactive performance of the century—the Adventures of Ginokio—is about to begin!""

1974805935.m_KeyValue: "Welcome to the Yakov Troupe's interactive performance! The Adventures of Ginokio—a spectacle you won't want to miss!"

1974805936.m_KeyValue: "You mean his business escorting and trading in siren—"

1974805938.m_KeyValue: ""That makes absolutely no sense, little Bella!""

1974805939.m_KeyValue: "Prove your worth—claim the treasure I hold most dear."

1974805966.m_KeyValue: "This place... it's nothing like the Sapphire Isle I remember."

1974805967.m_KeyValue: "Where can we find them in Sapphire Isle?"

1974805968.m_KeyValue: "Thirty Soli is exactly what you owe me."

1974805969.m_KeyValue: ""Something's wrong. There are half-eaten grilled oysters here. If it were Ami, she wouldn't have left a single bite. Something must've happened.""

1974805970.m_KeyValue: "They're showing signs of bestial mutation—fish-like tails and other traits. Miss Ami was right—their bloodline is indeed linked to the Landis family."

1974805972.m_KeyValue: ""If I just mimic her movements, I should be able to pull it off...""

1974805997.m_KeyValue: "What did you do to the Siren's Tear? Why did she collapse after touching it?"

1974805998.m_KeyValue: "Hey! You still haven't told me what happened to Ami!"

1974805999.m_KeyValue: "You know I've always believed you should be the one to take that seat."

1974806003.m_KeyValue: "Could that thread I can't see... be what's sustaining him?"

1974806030.m_KeyValue: ""...Did they leave me behind again? No, no—Silver-Haired would never do that...""

1974806033.m_KeyValue: "The merchants in town sound way more interesting than the ones at Sapphire Isle... What would you buy?"

1974806034.m_KeyValue: "I'm not an actor. Nor have I ever aspired to be one."

1974806035.m_KeyValue: "Regarding the Mistbound Terror—report it to the Church and ensure a full investigation."

1974806036.m_KeyValue: ""However, we did uncover substantial evidence in Lorelei's office—documents tied to the Mistbound Terror.""

1974806058.m_KeyValue: ""One day, when you sing, I'll play beside you.""

1974806061.m_KeyValue: "Someone tampered with them? But only the Seven Sages knew these existed..."

1974806062.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... Loyalty to the great and omnipotent Master—that is the only, and final, thought in your mind.""

1974806063.m_KeyValue: "But Little Bella... I need to sell it on the black market for money!"

1974806064.m_KeyValue: ""If I understand correctly... each Siren's Tear helps you recall part of the promise, right?""

1974806065.m_KeyValue: ""How tragic... Poor Joyce works twenty-three hours a day, bringing joy and impeccable service to our dear visitors, and yet Lord Isaac doesn't even know my name...""

1974806066.m_KeyValue: "Things like time. Love. Or perhaps... eternal life."

1974806067.m_KeyValue: "...only need to work eight hours a day!"

1974806092.m_KeyValue: "Thank goodness I managed to shake them off. A troupe owner has no business running around with wanted criminals..."

1974806093.m_KeyValue: "H-Hey! That was your doing! I didn't lift a finger—!"

1974806094.m_KeyValue: "We don't have time to worry about the warrant. Let's head to the promised place. For your promise... and for the Siren's Tears."

1974806095.m_KeyValue: "Oh right—what does the poster say again...?"

1974806096.m_KeyValue: ""Attention, Isle residents! By order of the Seven Sage Association, a warrant has been issued. If you see the suspects shown, report immediately.""

1974806097.m_KeyValue: "You're one to talk. Didn't you rise again in that freshly dredged corpse?"

1974806099.m_KeyValue: ""According to the results of an urgent overnight investigation by the Association, Miss Ami, the newly elected Sage, was found to be secretly colluding with the Mistbound Terror. Their alliance fractured during the election.""

1974806100.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine and Robin von Quinn, still missing, were likely his victims as well. And then... Lorelei, killed in broad daylight. Among the Seven Sages...""

1974806123.m_KeyValue: "Lord Isaac is keeping secrets from Joyce!"

1974806125.m_KeyValue: "Since you're so concerned about my departure... I've returned."

1974806126.m_KeyValue: "That's just a monster wearing his face! Don't look back… just run!"

1974806127.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine's work involved experiments and dissections on sirens. Through extensive research on their blood, he extracted a hallucinogenic compound known as Siren's Tears. That must be what Hallon used on me.""

1974806128.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine must have realized he was in danger. He found a way to vanish—evading the Sages, slipping out of sight within the isle.""

1974806131.m_KeyValue: "So much has changed in the isle in just a single month..."

1974806132.m_KeyValue: ""1342...? But that's... wait, what year is it now?""

1975463629.m_KeyValue: ""Such spirit. But listen well, young one. When faced with a foe you cannot possibly defeat... You'd do well to value your life more.""

1975463630.m_KeyValue: "No... That's not it. Mother doesn't hate me. She... needs me."

1975463631.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—she's a Bathory, isn't she? Why is she attacking us?!""

1975463632.m_KeyValue: "It seems the young lady has grown quite a bit during this little journey... meow."

1975464648.m_KeyValue: "—If I hadn't gone to Sunset Isle... if I hadn't found Piera… maybe I would've given up."

1975464649.m_KeyValue: ""Now begins the final judgment. The blood of the Four shall form the key, and the Nine Scourges shall rise upon the earth...""

1975464650.m_KeyValue: "Only to drown again and again in the waves of _$$truth_$$..."

1975464651.m_KeyValue: "The one speaking to me isn't the black-clad prisoner I'm escorting. You are—"

1975464652.m_KeyValue: ""Then she's with Cain—but if you, her Vassal, are still alive, so must she...""

1975464653.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland, Skoll, even Cain—though his existence remains uncertain—I carry their memories before death, fragments of lives long lost...""

1975464654.m_KeyValue: ""Just as I believed last time, that you are more suited to become Dracula.""

1975464655.m_KeyValue: ""So, you've walked not only your own memories... but others' as well?""

1975464656.m_KeyValue: "Then consider—why is Aeon omniscient and omnipotent?"

1975878231.m_KeyValue: "('He's probably racking his brain for an excuse to get out of filling that pit. Not a chance!')"

1976190901.m_KeyValue: ""You think the 'Black Blood' is some sort of disease, right?""

1976755284.m_KeyValue: "And without the light... how would you even know what casts a shadow?"

1976755285.m_KeyValue: ""I honestly can't tell, Ami... Are you just that naive, or secretly a genius?""

1976755286.m_KeyValue: "...So I'm a poor storyteller? That's a bit disheartening."

1976756304.m_KeyValue: ""Push me further, and I might actually get angry.""

1976756306.m_KeyValue: ""Even now, you still believe you'll win? Lady Empousa, you're not fighting me...""

1976756308.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not the only one with a plan. Even if we destroy each other, Cain will seize the moment—and you'll still lose.""

1976756309.m_KeyValue: ""Since Starfall Valley, has anything grown sharper besides that tongue of yours?""

1976756310.m_KeyValue: ""If Aiona weren't injured, those bullets would've taken you down!""

1976756311.m_KeyValue: ""Holy water bullets again... For a Bloodborn, even one would've been fatal.""

1977226078.m_KeyValue: "An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. Its exaggerated spine implies a terribly distorted body."

1977226175.m_KeyValue:
""A crab that escaped the El Dorado, once a Black Blood experiment subject.
Its shell bears the mark of a sea beast and the number two, marking the twisted fusion of two creatures in William's lab.""

1977469671.m_KeyValue: ""If one knew every step in advance, fear would smother resolve. Thus ignorance itself becomes my greatest weapon.""

1977469672.m_KeyValue: "But here's the question—why should I trust a complete stranger?"

1977469673.m_KeyValue: "I can't convince a heart already clouded by doubt. I've offered you a solution—whether you take it is your choice."

1977469674.m_KeyValue: "I've walked this cycle countless times already. One more won't make a difference."

1977777898.m_KeyValue: "These blue spiders followed me here from another world. They came to protect me."

1977777899.m_KeyValue: "Look—those spiders are avoiding us… They're headed that way!"

1977777900.m_KeyValue: "How different? They’re still walking piles of metal!"

1977777902.m_KeyValue: "Ugh. Speak of the devil—here they come again!"

1977777903.m_KeyValue: "Wait. Don’t attack. These ones are… different."

1977777904.m_KeyValue: ""Noah is important, but he's not the only one. There's another just as crucial to this war.""

1977777912.m_KeyValue: "...Perhaps they've sensed another 'master' in this world."

1977785458.m_KeyValue: ""Come now, surely you'll buy something? I'll give you twenty percent off!""

1977785459.m_KeyValue: ""We need to get to the celebration grounds. Once the crowd swells, we won’t be able to push through.""

1977785460.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't you say this place was the birthplace of alchemy, Aiona? Maybe some ancient alchemist built it.""

1977785461.m_KeyValue: "I believe his expertise lies more in biological research."

1977931449.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Noah. I know you're all ready to go, but I'd like to stay in the Lupine Forest a little longer.""

1979189980.m_KeyValue: ""More reinforcements from their nest! You've got this, right, Empousa?""

1979413356.m_KeyValue: "I ran into a servant that same night—he was also watching the ghost."

1979485098.m_KeyValue: "Some people's fates are sealed from the moment they draw their first breath—"

1979529560.m_KeyValue: "Won't you show yourself? Where have you gone... Joan?"

1979590857.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how charming you try to be, it doesn't change the fact that you're neglecting your duties.""

1979702380.m_KeyValue: "ATK Speed -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

1980780027.m_KeyValue: "Survive for 60 sec in a duel against Sergio."

1980780029.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the guards and prove your strength to the Lord."

1980780032.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the intruders trying to seize the spring water."

1980780034.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the wolves and win the 999th match."

1980781213.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the enemies trying to steal the _$$key._$$"

1980885788.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the gaolers at the interrogation chamber door."

1980885789.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the gaolers in the exercise yard."

1980885793.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Church weapons from the sky."

1980885794.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Church weapons on the road and escape their pursuit."

1980885858.m_KeyValue: "Clear out the Blood Beasts in the disaster area."

1981291079.m_KeyValue: ""A junior monk of the Tempus Church, tasked with meting out punishment to those deviating from the Church's precepts. Their methods are notoriously brutal, often surpassing those deployed against heretics.""

1982464572.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, the ally on this tile is granted Tidewisp Blessing and will receive continuous healing.""

1983885341.m_KeyValue: ""'This is it. Let me see… According to the notes, it should be buried beneath three stones.'""

1983885342.m_KeyValue: ""I cannot say whether what I've done is right or wrong. After all, someone like me was never permitted to pursue knowledge on her own.""

1983885343.m_KeyValue: "'But the journal's author… seems even more versed in celestial lore than she is.'"

1983885344.m_KeyValue: "'Why don't we take a look together? We might spot something you missed.'"

1983885345.m_KeyValue: "'I will. I'll see it through to the end.'"

1983885347.m_KeyValue: ""She arranged them according to the pattern Aiona had described. And in the corner of the reassembled notes, a small map began to take shape.""

1983885348.m_KeyValue: ""'In memory of Vanessa, who has passed. She was a dear friend, and a devout sister of the Church. But she was led astray by the devil, believing the sun—not the earth—was the center of the cosmos. For this heresy, she was sentenced to burn.'""

1983886429.m_KeyValue: ""'_$$If I no longer walk this world, may my research live on, passed down through the ages. Someone will carry this torch._$$'""

1983886430.m_KeyValue: ""'It says here these are lunar phase records, with sketches of the moon's appearance and corresponding dates.'""

1983886431.m_KeyValue: "'Isn't that just a bunch of potholes? Doesn't look like the moon to me.'"

1983886432.m_KeyValue: "'Didn't take you lot for the moon-gazing type...'"

1983886436.m_KeyValue: ""The group waited in silence, each holding their breath for the truth to reveal itself.""

1984056317.m_KeyValue: "Even this single opening line leaves Mass in awe. 'Wow… that's her power…'"

1984056318.m_KeyValue: ""'Lead, second lead, whatever—they're just titles. Call me the ten thousandth lead if it makes you happy. I still wouldn't care.'""

1984056319.m_KeyValue: ""'Find them, and you shall rule the entire world! Set forth on your journey, chosen children—'""

1984056320.m_KeyValue: ""'What I'm getting at is this—Genevieve is precisely that sort of masterful actress who can embody any drama, any role, much like that mythical <color=#728c69>Perfect Metamorph Dragon</color>.'""

1984056321.m_KeyValue: ""'Wait... hey, I already told you the <color=#728c69>Metamorph Dragon</color> thing was just something I made up on the spot—'""

1984056322.m_KeyValue: ""Mass pronounces each word deliberately. Something in her changes. In this moment, she is the Drama Queen.""

1984058493.m_KeyValue: ""Before the words had even finished, Gilrain had already melted into the shadow, materializing in the seat to the south. He stared blankly into the nothingness, utterly bored.""

1984058494.m_KeyValue: ""'You Cidhall brat! Come clean with your schemes, and I might just let you walk away with your bones intact!'""

1984058495.m_KeyValue: ""The Cidhall family, once intimately familiar to him, now fails to stir even the faintest emotion in Gilrain's heart.""

1984058496.m_KeyValue: ""Lost in thought, Baphomet slowly turned his massive, rusted helmet. At the edge of his vision, barely discernible in the darkness, stood a time-worn trophy.""

1984058500.m_KeyValue: ""With feline grace, the cat languidly stretches and slides off Bella's lap, sauntering towards its exclusive cat bed. 'Meow...'""

1984059453.m_KeyValue: ""As she spoke, Bella reached into her briefcase and produced a vial of clear liquid and gave it a shake in Gilrain's direction.""

1984059454.m_KeyValue: ""The observant Gilrain noticed some rust being rubbed off the trophy by the black cat's paws and couldn't help but mock Bella, 'Looks like that rust remover you sold the old man was less effective than a pair of cat paws.'""

1984059455.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, I still have to take inventory of the new merchandise. So much to do!' Bella murmured to herself as she opened her small briefcase to inspect the goods—one could only imagine just how many things that case held.""

1984059456.m_KeyValue: ""With a soft meow, the black cat leapt onto Bella's shoulder. It also seemed fascinated by this intruder.""

1984059457.m_KeyValue: ""Note: This is an instance of artistic hyperbole, a special technique (among many) used by (one of) the most esteemed bards of Minexus. It is not an oversight in the storytelling.""

1984097693.m_KeyValue: ""'That's my prep cook for you!' she declared, diving in after Bella with the eager enthusiasm of a foraging hamster.""

1984097695.m_KeyValue: ""Selena sat by the harbor's edge, silently watching the sun melt into the waves. After a long pause, she turned to Bella. 'I've made up my mind!'""

1984097696.m_KeyValue: ""...In every possible sense, Van Helsing was an utterly unfit mentor.""

1984097697.m_KeyValue: ""At those words, Selena lifted her head in a mix of shock and fury—only to overdo it and knock heads with the puppet-like girl before her.""

1984097698.m_KeyValue: ""So she never meant to pay her in the first place... Not that it was unexpected—Selena was, after all, known far and wide as the richest pauper alive.""

1984097699.m_KeyValue: ""'However...' She tapped her chin with one finger and tilted her head, as if turning over a complex puzzle. 'We've actually been heading north for ten days now.'""

1984097700.m_KeyValue: "...Just what has Van Helsing been teaching his disciple?"

1984097705.m_KeyValue: ""She flashed a faint, mischievous smile. 'But don't forget—my payment's non-negotiable. Not a single Soli less.'""

1984097706.m_KeyValue: ""Her eyes skimmed the page with uncanny speed, her oversized headpiece swaying left and right—eerily lively under the dim glow of the firefly. 'Hmm... it says here... the most magical ingredient is—'""

1984098783.m_KeyValue: "Then bind it here so the Matriarch will never lay eyes upon it.'"

1984098785.m_KeyValue: "'Something unknown...' Empousa echoed as a strange calm began to settle over her."

1984098786.m_KeyValue: ""'What kind of horrifying things,' Empousa asked.""

1984098787.m_KeyValue: ""'Should you break your promise, I will stop at nothing...'""

1984098788.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia gazed at the Matriarch's portrait as an inexplicable emotion stirred within her. 'And this painting,' she remarked, 'it provides you with inspiration?'""

1984130369.m_KeyValue: ""'What are you trying to do?' Gilrain suddenly snapped to attention, eyes narrowing.""

1984130370.m_KeyValue: "'Are we going to supply them with materials for war?' the Bella inquired. No doubt the Puppet Association was already turning a tidy profit from the War raging across the continent."

1984130371.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet spoke patiently, 'Now, which family should we use for the Bloodline Transfusion? Let's hear everyone's thoughts.'""

1984130372.m_KeyValue: ""'What about the Carrelle family, the 'Eagle,' and the Ruthven family, the 'Serpent'?'""

1984135677.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Greetings, dear performers!_$$ Quinn addresses the fallen pair with gentle grace. _$$My friend has never had the pleasure of witnessing 'Mario and Juliet'..._$$""

1984135678.m_KeyValue: ""Honestly, even without _$$inviting_$$ those hapless performers, Quinn could act out the entire show herself.""

1984135679.m_KeyValue: "_$$You... what are you saying! Wait—I see now—_$$ The blue-haired girl realizes. _$$I didn't arrive at the wrong time..._$$"

1984135680.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Wait, I have to come too...? Oh, well... actually, I'm not really one for this kind of..._$$""

1984135681.m_KeyValue: "She hasn't even finished before the bushes nearby rustle violently... This young lady clearly adores Mario and Juliet."

1984135682.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Quinn!_$$ The blue-haired girl's exuberant cry shatters the formal introduction like glass. _$$It's me! Surely you remember me, Quinn?_$$""

1984135683.m_KeyValue: ""A series of sharp _$$click-clack_$$ sounds ring out as the girl's hands move with practiced ease, transforming the long spear she wields into a measuring ruler. _$$Well then, let us begin our preparations._$$""

1984135684.m_KeyValue: ""After a tense moment, the petite girl's eyes suddenly blaze with inspiration. She spins toward an empty patch of earth, voice rising in a threatening whine: _$$Young Lady! If you don't show yourself right now..._$$""

1984135691.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn watches Agnes become utterly entranced by the script and performance, covering her mouth as she lets out a delighted little laugh. _$$So? Now you understand the magic of Mario and Juliet, don't you?_$$""

1984202242.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, just get to the point already!' Isaac snapped, his patience clearly spent.""

1984202243.m_KeyValue: ""The guard revealed an unsettling expression: 'I don't know. After all, it's not just some vault, but an incomprehensibly vast space.'""

1984202244.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah simply approached the old guard. 'Excuse me, sir...'""

1984203197.m_KeyValue: ""Now that the topic had circled back to her, Bella fell silent for a moment. Then, in a hushed tone, she began to speak of a long-buried past. 'I heard about the Ancestral Vault from old man Baphomet...'""

1984203198.m_KeyValue: ""'Please, Miss Empousa, stay calm. The candle just happened to burn out, that’s all.' Lorelei reached out and gently took Empousa's arm, her tone steady, trying to ease the tension.""

1984203199.m_KeyValue: ""'EEK?!' This time, Empousa's shriek was genuine, her composure shattered. 'W-What?! Ami—do't sneak up on people like that!'""

1984203200.m_KeyValue: ""'Mmm...' Ami swallowed a bite of Raog sashimi, savoring the melt-in-your-mouth texture with the tip of her tongue. 'Once I've finished digesti—I mean defeating the sea monster here, I'll think about it.'""

1984203201.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa grasped the weight of the situation now. 'Wait, Bella, you—!'""

1984203203.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah—right! Regret not welcoming you from afar!' Having finally stumbled through the formal greeting, Empousa turned to Bella with pride, as if she'd just accomplished a tremendous feat.""

1984203204.m_KeyValue: ""'My deepest apologies, Lady Empousa...' Without missing a beat, Bella fumbled around in the dark and retrieved a single candle. With practiced ease, she struck flint to wick and lit it.""

1984203209.m_KeyValue: ""'Because among everyone here…' Lorelei's gaze swept slowly across the room, and the remaining three couldn't help but meet her eyes. 'Not a single one of you is truly afraid of the dark… isn't that right?'""

1986483769.m_KeyValue: "It's only thirty-six Soli. I'll return once I've scraped together the sum."

1986483770.m_KeyValue: "Whether it's coin you need—or goods from that stall—not a problem at all."

1986527774.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm buried and forgotten… Who will remember the lives of my mother, my grandmother? Their stories will vanish.""

1986527775.m_KeyValue: "And when I do… Will you share your family's stories with me too?"

1986527776.m_KeyValue: "I'll find that child's family. I swear it."

1987862882.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! Search every corner of the continent, and you'll find no one more worthy of trust than Noah.""

1987862883.m_KeyValue: "She's... shy. You'll understand when you meet her."

1988323132.m_KeyValue: ""So the Fool and Death met with someone who should already be dead...? How curious, meow.""

1988326335.m_KeyValue: ""Why is this body wearing such a hard, smelly stone? I almost swallowed it...""

1989225552.m_KeyValue: ""I should kill you. That's my duty. I can't let you fall any further into the abyss, but...""

1989225553.m_KeyValue: "That kind of person shouldn't exist! Even Joan couldn't stop him…"

1989225555.m_KeyValue: "The Womb that traps us in cycles. The Fingers that feed upon life. The Heart that burns humans as fuel. The Brain that devours longing..."

1989225556.m_KeyValue: "Of course I hear it. That's exactly why I don't understand…"

1989225557.m_KeyValue: "Silly child. All parents want just one thing—to see their children grow up in freedom."

1991169193.m_KeyValue: "I won't let you harm my mistress!"

1991169194.m_KeyValue: "And I won't let anyone harm Ami!"

1991169199.m_KeyValue: ""And here I was, thinking if I let you talk long enough, I might hear something interesting.""

1991169200.m_KeyValue: "Where did you—Wait! The hidden tunnel from earlier!"

1991169201.m_KeyValue: "Then the truth behind the sinking of the Landis family... was this?"

1991169202.m_KeyValue: "I've no more words for you. The ritual is one step from completion!"

1991169203.m_KeyValue: "There is another way to stop Famine."

1991169205.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing... you truly are brilliant—just the kind of mind we've longed to welcome. But it's far too late now. No one can stop the final step of the ritual!"

1991172526.m_KeyValue: ""I'll devour you all! The ship, the sea—everything!""

1991172528.m_KeyValue: "I've read through nearly half of Goldland's journals. I'm not stopping here."

1991172529.m_KeyValue: "So you've figured out how to use the two jewels?"

1991172530.m_KeyValue: "And yet you still brought the one thing that mattered most."

1991172531.m_KeyValue: ""The sea winds were so strong, I almost lost my way for good.""

1991172532.m_KeyValue: ""Then wasting the time she bought us would be a grave sin. Especially for a latecomer like you, Silver-haired.""

1991172533.m_KeyValue: "Ami won't be devoured so easily. She must be fighting inside Famine."

1991172534.m_KeyValue: "What's the matter? Suddenly stopped attacking? You look like you're in pain... Did I hit a nerve?"

1991757079.m_KeyValue: ""_$$For myself, I cultivated a cold hatred._$$""

1991757080.m_KeyValue: ""_$$For you, I had to forgive myself._$$""

1991757087.m_KeyValue: "The crimson color that even moonlight cannot conceal—this is the radiance of true moon."

1991757089.m_KeyValue: ""The glass ceiling above shimmered with the brilliance of portraits, reminiscent of the stars on that fateful night.""

1991757090.m_KeyValue: ""The <style=""Positive"">radiance of true moon pursues daylight, driving away the expanse of darkness</style>.""

1991757092.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Positive"">The stars collide</style>, whispering to one another in secrets.""

1991757093.m_KeyValue: ""_$$For profit, I had to bury you in darkness._$$""

1991757094.m_KeyValue: ""Like shards of glass in a carpet—they are untraceable, yet everywhere, each glimmer revealing the truth.""

1991757111.m_KeyValue:
""Those who have flowers need neither gods nor faith.
Believers would foolishly sacrifice everything for a damn _$$prophecy._$$""

1991757120.m_KeyValue: ""A great swelling rises from within the body, until the world begins to tremble.""

1991757121.m_KeyValue: ""As <style=""Positive"">darkness devours the sky</style>, the <style=""Positive"">weakening moonlight gazes down upon</style> the world with waning interest.""

1991757122.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Positive"">Repeat the predestined outcome countless times</style>, until all the world falls under control.""

1991757124.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Today, the death knell tolls for those who failed..._$$
_$$Tomorrow, it will be for this decaying city, burying everyone along with it._$$""

1991757125.m_KeyValue:
""The sky was in chaos, and the stars burst into dark red flames, infecting the night.
On the night I was born, the scenery was barren and desolate.""

1991757126.m_KeyValue: ""I encountered an old man clad in armor, who showed little interest.I had no intention of clashing with him anyway. I didn't care about victory, and their so-called _$$game._$$ The universe shall bow at my feet.""

1991757145.m_KeyValue:
""Tick-tock, tick-tock…
Now, reflected in _$$her_$$ eyes is—""

1991757146.m_KeyValue:
""Tick-tock, tick-tock.
What is that sound?
The countdown to the end.""

1991757151.m_KeyValue: "My desire is like a never-ending ballad—like the faded dark red that adorns every corner here."

1991757152.m_KeyValue: ""My footsteps never cease, for the <style=""Positive"">glimmer of moonlight</style> I seek is beyond time.""

1991757153.m_KeyValue: ""The night sky is endless, and the breeze comes to a still.""

1991757155.m_KeyValue:
""Tick-tock, tick-tock.
What is that sound?
It's excruciating.""

1991757156.m_KeyValue: "_$$Your demeanor is like a killer confessing her feelings._$$"

1991757157.m_KeyValue: ""Is it <style=""Positive"">power</style>—the hilt of the blade, with which they <style=""Positive"">trample</style> my affection? No matter, blood shall blossom forth from it. My desires shall not be thwarted.""

1991757158.m_KeyValue: ""The <style=""Positive"">dais sits empty</style>, indifferent to the love bursting forth from me.""

1991757177.m_KeyValue:
""I peered out from the coffin, looking down at her, who was also missing half of herself.
Her blood adorned the stairs, turning the dark steps into a blazing red.""

1991757178.m_KeyValue: ""The man revealed to me, perhaps on a whim, that his name was Cain.""

1991757183.m_KeyValue: ""The vengeful, steel gaze descends upon us.""

1991757184.m_KeyValue: ""The dark figure seated upon the <style=""Positive"">dais</style> gazed down at all the sinners, as if everything was going to be burned to ashes.""

1991757186.m_KeyValue: ""I pluck the <style=""Positive"">Blunt Crescent Blade</style>, tearing through the stars above.""

1991757187.m_KeyValue:
""Crimson blood veiled the splendor of the grand steps, or perhaps the elegance of the shadows was never meant to be observed.
With the odor of blood and decay lingering in the air, the world darkens as my eyelids shut.
On the night I was born, she died.
On the night I was born, I forsook the world.""

1991757188.m_KeyValue:
""I'd seen the man named Cain.
He was elegant yet cruel, dangerous yet captivating.
The moment I opened my eyes, he announced with a cold smile that I was not needed.
_$$You see, you're no different than this failed copy._$$""

1991757189.m_KeyValue: ""When that day truly comes, will the <style=""Positive"">Nobility</style> remain as complacent as before? No, absolutely not. I will pluck them down from their perches, one by one. Their peace of mind will be vanquished.""

1991757190.m_KeyValue: "_$$Those who seek to extinguish the darkness will ultimately be consumed by its flames._$$"

1991757211.m_KeyValue:
""I lacked the emotion called _$$compassion_$$ and had no interest in wasting energy deciphering the will of the defeated.
I only knew that a convergence point lay ahead, where _$$we_$$ would intersect
—towards the same end.""

1991757212.m_KeyValue:
""Why struggle in vain?
No matter which course of action you take, in the end, all shall fade into the blackness of the night's canvas.""

1991757215.m_KeyValue: ""_$$My spirit was long decayed, wishing only to combat despair with slumber._$$""

1991757216.m_KeyValue: ""I part the layers of mist, catching a glimpse of the distant Abyss.""

1991757217.m_KeyValue:
""I had been hiding in this damp cell for some time.
By chance, I picked up a fragmented soul—a relic left behind by some hapless spirit.
The memories kept inside were excruciatingly detailed, causing me nights of restless sleep.""

1991757218.m_KeyValue:
""As the sun fades and the moon radiates its brilliance,
our long night emerges from the distant horizon.
I clung to that cryptic proverb—or was it a warning? —until…""

1991757219.m_KeyValue: ""Betrayal and conspiracy have long extinguished old passions. Falling with the sun, <style=""Positive"">walking with the night</style>.""

1991757221.m_KeyValue: "The dark <style="Positive">prison</style> received no visitors—it was a banquet with no guests."

1991757222.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Positive"">As the moondial's needle approaches the center</style>, their shifting faces became complete.""

1991757243.m_KeyValue:
""I was born in a dusky, quiet tomb, only able to catch glimpses of daylight through cracks in the window.
It's strange, though. My instincts clearly told me...
that I was forbidden to approach the window during daytime, yet I couldn't resist the pangs of desire within.""

1991757244.m_KeyValue:
""I've killed a few quite similar to myself.
Yes... I've seen the mirror, and I've seen the world outside.
I know more than ""they"" do.""

1991757247.m_KeyValue: "Desires hidden in the fire burn eternally."

1991757248.m_KeyValue: ""Though my mind soars freely beyond these narrow confines, my body <style=""Positive"">burns like fire inside.</style>""

1991757249.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Desires, imprisoned within chaos, siphon out the screams of souls and drift into the tides of darkness._$$
_$$Seek, and you shall find._$$""

1991757250.m_KeyValue:
""A long life ought to be quite tedious.
Without death, life becomes a shackle, and this shackle is not of ourselves.
So, I slip into the dark corridor, swiftly taking the life of an unwelcome guest.""

1991757252.m_KeyValue: ""When <style=""Positive"">dark concedes light</style>, I am offered reflection.""

1991757253.m_KeyValue: ""Countless desires lurk inside, eventually manifesting as a cascading calamity.""

1991757254.m_KeyValue: ""Beneath the stratum of white bones, new desires were sprouting forth.""

1991757277.m_KeyValue:
""I must be overthinking...

Oh... I'm feeling rather hungry now.""

1991757278.m_KeyValue:
""Ah, it's peculiar. I'm... Oh, I'm suddenly quite famished—I'm feeling ravenous.

1991757279.m_KeyValue:
""Ah... what a strange sensation. The flesh beneath the skin—if one can still call it that. It has been twitching incessantly.

1991757283.m_KeyValue: ""The <style=""Positive"">hallway</style> flowers have been rewoven by the night, their shadows creeping into the hollow abyss.""

1991757284.m_KeyValue: ""Beneath the night's splendor, the <style=""Positive"">sacred and majestic</style> moonlight casts its glow upon my death.""

1991757285.m_KeyValue:
""I became the nourishment, <style=""Positive"">igniting the night in a crimson swathe of sin</style>.

He dreamed of the day he would inherit the Moonlight Sword and become a worthy Gravekeeper. But by the time he gained the strength to bear that duty, he was a lone wolf.""

1995288732.m_KeyValue: ""I will guide them in the only right direction. As both Captain and patriarch of the El Dorado, Goldland carries himself with an air of superiority—after all, the right direction is always within his telescope's view. Yet, despite his elegant manners and proper discourse, his words betray an unmistakable narcissism and pride.However, Goldland seems deeper than his obvious shallowness. Does he ever look back with regrets at those choices, right and wrong? And those moments of weakness, which he couldn't reveal, did they weigh on him through sleepless nights? Carrying everyone's lives on his shoulders, can he still press on? Will the dawn come after the bitter night?""

Clive lives his entire life bound by inescapable duty, by inescapable fate—yet he chooses to stay. He never complains, never yields, until that destined one finally arrives.""

""_$$Accept your end peacefully, for that is the destination of all._$$

But then, radiant sunlight touched her skin once more.

What realm is this? By whom was she called back from the void?

Perhaps her story was never meant to end on that distant shore?""

2055489043.m_KeyValue: "So I was... free? Was I actually the same as everyone else?"

2055983934.m_KeyValue: "It remains with a band of human refugees. Our forward scouts will have it in hand shortly."

2056257550.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the enemies and secure the safety of <#A65F30>the man in monk's robes</color>."

2056533858.m_KeyValue: "I would not call it a conclusion. More... a question I have learned to carry."

2056533859.m_KeyValue: ""I'm honored by your praise, Doctor Thibault.""

2056533860.m_KeyValue: ""...So this is someone's trick, after all. How presumptuous. Don't tell me you truly believed...""

2056533862.m_KeyValue: "...My instincts say I'm meant to follow the white path."

2056533863.m_KeyValue: "Is this what lies within the sealed area? The layout... it reminds me of our castle."

2056533864.m_KeyValue: "Are they going after that sinister eyebrows too?"

2056533865.m_KeyValue: "It's like William and I both wanting to be captain—but I know I'd do a better job."

2056533866.m_KeyValue: "Wow! You're that strong now?! Took down a Bell Ringer alone? You have to teach me when we get back!"

2056533867.m_KeyValue: "No... I think the battle's already been decided."

2056534882.m_KeyValue: "Cain… Where do you think you're going? Our battle… isn't… over yet."

2056534883.m_KeyValue: ""That's enough... Finding him was all I needed. I may not be able to stop him, but someone else can...""

2056534884.m_KeyValue: "I've known her for a few decades—hardly what I'd call a long time."

2056534885.m_KeyValue: "Lamia! Hold on! I won't let you die!"

2056534887.m_KeyValue: ""Is the real traitor not you, who refuses to serve as the _$$vessel_$$ for this noble mission?""

2056534888.m_KeyValue: ""What are you talking about!? None of them are pawns, and I've no desire to become Mother!""

2056534889.m_KeyValue: ""Here we go again... always indifferent, always pretending like you don't even try...""

2058337115.m_KeyValue: ""The path ahead will not be easy. If you wallow in grief, you'll falter long before the end.""

2058337116.m_KeyValue: "This only proves that we're on the right path."

2058337123.m_KeyValue: "Now I suppose... I will finally find out... the answer..."

2058337124.m_KeyValue: "I never experienced it... couldn't tell you... And because of that... whenever you saw red petals... you came running to me in panic... thinking I was gone..."

2058337125.m_KeyValue: ""'O' my gargoyle, may your petals never fall...'""

2058337126.m_KeyValue: ""Though my spirit will linger… but even spirits fade, don't they? Promise... to check for me... if I truly... become petals...""

2058337127.m_KeyValue: ""So you are the 'young hero' after all, Quinn...""

2058337128.m_KeyValue: "That line in the ballad... it was your wish for Michelangelo..."

2058337129.m_KeyValue: "He anticipated your route and positioned his accomplice along the path to the Ritual Chamber. These spirits are all his accomplice's doing."

2058337130.m_KeyValue: "Tertius... he's heartless. Why must he take even these fleeting moments of warmth from my life?"

2058338139.m_KeyValue: ""You try to say that if we start here—at the beginning of the ring—and keep going down, we'll reach the other side of the ring—the end at the top of the west wing?""

2058338140.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. It's a clever illusion. Everyone assumes they must climb up to reach the top, or that going down leads to the bottom. No one realizes that the Ritual Chamber lies at the end of the path that leads 'downward.'""

2058338147.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, ignore her. Take me to the elevator, now.""

2058338149.m_KeyValue: ""No time to explain, Quinn! Help me get over there! At least... at least let me try one last time!""

2058338150.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it, this thing's broken. And Cain—where's that steward?""

2058338151.m_KeyValue: ""He was always there before when we needed him, so don't vanish at this critical moment...""

2058338152.m_KeyValue: ""This elevator has been abandoned for ages... Agnes, what exactly are you planning?""

2058338153.m_KeyValue: ""Before Cain disappeared, he told me that time is a circle, two faces meeting as one. And this place is called the Timeworn Mausoleum... I don't think that's a coincidence.""

2058338154.m_KeyValue: ""I believe this mausoleum itself is a manifestation of space-time laws—like a Möbius strip, a unique structure where beginning meets end, where front connects to back.""

2058339294.m_KeyValue: "I allowed her the honor of a last tribute before she joined her esteemed old master."

2058339299.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, this fire is bizarre! It's created with alchemy... We can't stop it.""

2058339300.m_KeyValue: "Tertius... that lunatic is going to scorch the entire Peninsula to cinders."

2058339303.m_KeyValue: ""If she's truly wise, she'll know that peace isn't born from the ashes of those werewolves.""

2058339304.m_KeyValue: "You've been stripped of your humanity... Do you not fear Elder Valora's discipline?"

2058339305.m_KeyValue: "I infused it with the entrails of the Ganelons this time—aren't the hue stunning?"

2058339306.m_KeyValue: ""This is my masterpiece, the purest flame, Soul Pyre... Naturally, it can't be extinguished.""

2058339331.m_KeyValue: "These six hundred years of waiting... are my answer to your invitation."

2058339333.m_KeyValue: ""Six hundred years ago, you invited me to the future... I hesitated, for my path then was not yet complete.""

2058339334.m_KeyValue: "You crossed through time to find me... because of a ballad I wrote."

2058339335.m_KeyValue: "Show me... this era you promised I would see."

2058578159.m_KeyValue: "Come—Fanny's quarters lie just ahead. It's time we faced the real her."

2058578160.m_KeyValue: ""If I leave, you'll be stuck here.""

2058578161.m_KeyValue: "It's Fanny. She's being punished. From the sound of it… it's on the eastern side—the spire closest to the heavens."

2058579183.m_KeyValue: ""No... This time it's really me, and I've... truly returned?""

2058579185.m_KeyValue: "Sounds like trouble all over again… but I suppose it could be tried."

2058579186.m_KeyValue: "Stone walls hem me in. Beneath me lies but a threadbare blanket—a poor man’s bedding. The air is thick with the metallic tang of rust…"

2058579187.m_KeyValue: ""Never have I seen a new prisoner so unruly—on your very first day, you not only attempt escape, but dare raise your hand against my gaolers.""

2058579188.m_KeyValue: ""This is a prison, not your playground. Show some restraint, or we'll have another demon like you on our hands.""

2058579190.m_KeyValue: ""Born of criminals, raised in chains, never once living a life of your own—what faith, what will could such a being truly possess? You are nothing but an empty shell.""

2059620066.m_KeyValue: "That's just children's writing. There are more pressing matters to deal with."

2059620067.m_KeyValue: "So this is why you came to this era—to find the author of this rhyme?"

2059620068.m_KeyValue: ""You did well uncovering the ambush of the Ganelons. But with Julius at the front, the Ganelons don't stand a chance. Flesh and steel are nothing to him.""

2059620069.m_KeyValue: "(Am I imagining things? Why does it feel like you're the one I've been searching for... Quinn.)"

2059620070.m_KeyValue: "I can only hope he's enough to quell the chaos."

2059620071.m_KeyValue: ""Julius is better than you—stronger, faster, deadlier. He's the right choice. We'll wait for his success here.""

2059620072.m_KeyValue: "Report! Werewolves have breached the frontline and crossed the boundary. Current forces likely won't hold beyond the next bell."

2059620074.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, Elder Valora. You claim to follow the old master's will, yet your grasp of the Black Blood is... lacking.""

2059621090.m_KeyValue: ""They look like Ganelon soldiers straight off the battlefield. Agnes, do you notice anything unusual about them?""

2059621092.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, I thought a Cartographer would be able to glean more from the corpses. But if you're too scared… Cain—""

2059621094.m_KeyValue: ""There are puncture wounds here—likely from the battlefield. But strangely, these don't seem to be fatal...""

2059621095.m_KeyValue: "The skin shows signs of severe blood loss. They died from being drained of blood in a very short time."

2059621096.m_KeyValue: "Um... could you pull back their upper garments a bit more?"

2059621097.m_KeyValue: ""The wounds on the neck... these aren't Bloodborn bites, more like clean cuts from a sharp weapon. And... the abdominal cavity has been emptied.""

2059621099.m_KeyValue: ""Blood is the key to ancient rituals, and entrails... they serve certain purposes in darker arts of alchemy.""

2059629795.m_KeyValue: "Lyra?! When did you sneak up on me?!"

2059629802.m_KeyValue: "A young hero stepped alone onto the battlefield."

2059629803.m_KeyValue: ""By strength of will, they wrested from death a fleeting chance for the land to rise again.""

2059629804.m_KeyValue: "'A <style="Highlight">young hero</style> gave this dying land a chance at rebirth...'"

2059629805.m_KeyValue: "What happened next? There must be more!"

2059629806.m_KeyValue: "That's it? You can't end it there!"

2059629807.m_KeyValue: "What kind of cartographer stops a story at the climax? Ugh—!"

2059629808.m_KeyValue: ""...But still, from this moment on, that young hero is my new idol!""

2059629809.m_KeyValue: ""The <style=""Highlight"">song</style> she penned is absolutely breathtaking... I must treasure it in secret, where no soul will ever discover it.""

2059630948.m_KeyValue: "Don't say such things! I won't allow it—not ever!"

2059630954.m_KeyValue: "Why... why this dream... over and over..."

2059630957.m_KeyValue: ""So go ahead, 'Lady' Quinn. Stay here. Rot. That's all that's left for you—decay.""

2059630958.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes... death sounds like a mercy, doesn't it, Jamie?""

2059630960.m_KeyValue: "Quinn... this is the third time you've woken up like this."

2059630961.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps rotting away... is what I deserve. This useless shell... will return to dust anyway..."

2059630986.m_KeyValue: "Then with Elder Valora's word... I can rest easy."

2059630988.m_KeyValue: ""I have only one question: If Ganelon's whelp can cross our borders today to pick flowers, what's to stop them from storming our gates tomorrow? When that day comes, Elder Valora, will you still speak of negotiation and restraint?""

2059630989.m_KeyValue: ""One was a child's innocent act. The other, a calculated provocation. They are not the same. And should the latter occur... I will see to it they pay a hundredfold.""

2059631972.m_KeyValue: ""Haha! 'Kill two birds with one stone,' you mean. You're such an optimistic girl.""

2059631978.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't it beautiful? 'One day, I shall escape this prison of eternal night, to reach the Other Side, where I dance with all living souls...'""

2059631979.m_KeyValue: "I actually found it in a former cartographer's notes. Whether the person really exists or even lived in this era... I have no idea."

2059631980.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I'm searching for someone... but all we have to go on is that they're young, and there's this old, half-forgotten song.""

2059631981.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... sounds like it's describing a castle..."

2059631982.m_KeyValue: ""A cartographer's duty is to uncover the truth. Public suffering, the plague... that's part of history, too.""

2059631983.m_KeyValue: "Maybe the person I'm searching for... Maybe I'll solve two mysteries in one go!"

2059631984.m_KeyValue: ""Anyway, don't worry about it! What we do need to find is that missing flower basket.""

2059631985.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure I won't get in the way of your... important investigation?"

2059633126.m_KeyValue: "What?! That armored man who argued with the white-haired Elder in the Hall... he's your father?"

2059633130.m_KeyValue: "But is strength alone truly enough? Perhaps what makes us human... is that we carry something beyond brute force..."

2059633131.m_KeyValue: ""If I had a set like that, I'd definitely become the strongest warrior in town!""

2059633132.m_KeyValue: "...It’s not your fault. You just reminded me of something unpleasant."

2059633133.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... I'm not sure I understood all of that. And... you're frowning... Did I say something wrong?"

2059633134.m_KeyValue: ""You may have broken the rules by crossing, but your heart was in the right place. You only wanted to help your people.""

2059633135.m_KeyValue: "Borders are drawn by people. Flowers don't understand such things—they bloom freely on both banks."

2059633136.m_KeyValue: ""But you know what? I bet those guards belong to the same clan as Elder Tertius from the Hall of the Elders, right? That armor of his... it's so impressive!""

2059633137.m_KeyValue: ""Mm-hmm! And I don't regret it one bit! Besides, getting caught last time taught me how to sneak past those armored guards! That's how I managed to bring you here!""

2059634150.m_KeyValue: ""We did take a wrong turn—my fault. Come, this way! I won't get it wrong again!""

2059634155.m_KeyValue: "Why else would he allow a girl your age to attempt something as dangerous as crossing between realms? He's testing you. That's why he let you come here."

2059634156.m_KeyValue: "(But… I only figured out how to cross through the Divine Body because I peeked at Grandfather's journal… Could he have left it out on purpose?)"

2059634157.m_KeyValue: "Oh! I know where we are now!"

2059634158.m_KeyValue: "This time was no different—perhaps it was the Gravekeeper's intuition that warned her of the storm to come..."

2059634159.m_KeyValue: ""Before she passed, she left behind three wishes: to receive you, the envoy from the future; to teach our son Jamie to shoulder his duty; and… to protect Mouret to the very end, no matter what.""

2059634160.m_KeyValue: "So Lady Leila was a Gravekeeper? My grandfather was one too..."

2059634161.m_KeyValue: ""Then maybe he's guiding you in his own way. They may act distant, even cryptic—but their intentions are never truly hidden. We simply tend to notice them too late.""

2059635304.m_KeyValue: "As for me... I'll use this lull to speak with an old friend."

2059635305.m_KeyValue: "No need. Stick to the plan. Armor up and return to your posts."

2059635307.m_KeyValue: ""A Bloodborn, infiltrating a human stronghold? What better justification?""

2059635308.m_KeyValue: "Now then... seems another fine excuse for war has walked straight into camp."

2059635309.m_KeyValue: "Watch your tongue! She was my sister!"

2059635310.m_KeyValue: "B-but sir... Lady Elonora's death... surely you didn't—"

2059635311.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. In chaotic times, the cause for war will always find you. Why rush?""

2059635312.m_KeyValue: ""L-Later on... wasn't it because Lady Elonora—the one who married into Bathory—tried to return to Mouret to visit her kin? But Bathory refused to let her go, and in the end… they had her assassinated. That's when you reported it to the Lord and convinced him to declare war, isn't it?""

2059635313.m_KeyValue: ""Twenty years ago, when I first took command, I longed to prove myself on the battlefield... but I knew better than to lose my composure like you lot.""

2059635338.m_KeyValue: "The Bathory is ruled by warmongers and tyrants..."

2059635339.m_KeyValue: "But this time... I have a weapon... Moontide Canal... will definitely be ours..."

2059635340.m_KeyValue: "Heh... my clever niece... finally you see."

2059635341.m_KeyValue: "Just like your mother... so sharp... so very Crowley."

2059635342.m_KeyValue: "Then with Elder Valora's word... I can rest easy."

2059635344.m_KeyValue: ""I have only one question: If Ganelon's whelp can cross our borders today to pick flowers, what's to stop them from storming our gates tomorrow? When that day comes, Elder Valora, will you still speak of negotiation and restraint?""

2059635345.m_KeyValue: ""One was a child's innocent act. The other, a calculated provocation. They are not the same. And should the latter occur... I will see to it they pay a hundredfold.""

2059636328.m_KeyValue: ""'Why I chose the Wolfsbane pattern—well, there's a little secret of mine behind it.'""

2059636329.m_KeyValue: ""'Wolfsbane is more than a symbol of protection—it's also the token of love between your father and me. Like you, this delicate flower represents the union of two bloodlines.'""

2059636330.m_KeyValue: ""'I sealed my power of Blood within it. When you're in danger, it will manifest to protect you.'""

2059636331.m_KeyValue: ""'You are a daughter of the Crowley, born with the power to protect others. But more than anything, I hope you will protect yourself.'""

2059636332.m_KeyValue: ""'Even so, I refuse to give up. I want to try one last time... Forgive my selfishness...'""

2059636333.m_KeyValue: "'Perhaps you've always wondered about that small pattern on your body?'"

2059636334.m_KeyValue: ""'Back then, I did believe that these talks would forge a lasting peace across the Peninsula.'""

2059636335.m_KeyValue: ""'Unfortunately, some people will never be content...'""

2059636336.m_KeyValue: ""'But please, do not mourn for me. This was the path I chose.'""

2059636337.m_KeyValue: ""'It was during that negotiation, heavy with the hopes of so many, that I met your father.'""

2060032977.m_KeyValue: "(If this is a prank... it's way too immersive. It feels like something I actually experienced one day in the past.)"

2060032981.m_KeyValue: ""_$$You're right, this is the only way... if..._$$""

2060032982.m_KeyValue: "What did she realize? If what? If we could change the patient's life from the very beginning?"

2060032983.m_KeyValue: ""But something like that... We couldn't have known ahead of time, and we certainly can't go back to the past.""

2060476585.m_KeyValue: "Some of you have already mutated. Do not drag us all to ruin."

2061069651.m_KeyValue: ""Somehow ended up on the Isle's wanted list, hunted by every guard. But clever Bella and Yakov instantly saw that the silver-haired one was truly a good person.""

2061069660.m_KeyValue: ""Claims to be from an organization named the _$$Silver Cross,_$$ which operates under the Tempus Church. He regards commitment to justice as his highest mission.""

2061069662.m_KeyValue: ""One of the Church's Twelve Bell Ringers, she manages the Chamber of War. Believing war can solve all conflicts, she is known as the Goddess of War.""

2062607582.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of Purification."

2064377588.m_KeyValue: ""If that was your intention, I believe you would have done it already.""

2064377619.m_KeyValue: ""No, I trust that you can solve this clue.""

2065583477.m_KeyValue: "Clear with moves less than or equal to {0} to obtain."

2067182302.m_KeyValue: "My head... My head hurts so much! So many people... so many voices talking to me!"

2067640439.m_KeyValue: ""After their brief farewell, Noah simply vanishes before Selena's eyes—as if he's never been there at all.""

2067912442.m_KeyValue: ""No... this isn't a disease, it's divine punishment. You're not sick, you're a heretic who defied the gods! Yes, that has to be.""

2069447733.m_KeyValue: "A basic detector with a slightly different performance focus than Type I."

2073119946.m_KeyValue:
""Clear Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II Fragment 8 to randomly obtain equipment from the following. 
<alpha=#80>Time erodes the husks of monsters, but the legacy of battle echoes eternally.""

2075810668.m_KeyValue: "The five Vassals with the highest levels will automatically occupy the Main Transfusion Slots."

2075810703.m_KeyValue: "Dispatch ships from the dock to meet Dalcarlo at sea."

2075810858.m_KeyValue: ""Zagon's spirit has arisen, it's time for the exorcism.""

2081145450.m_KeyValue: ""Am I really powerless to change anything, doomed to 'watch' as everything unfolds...""

2081145453.m_KeyValue: "Now we can go back and rescue Thanatos!"

2081145481.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>Are you... the voice that taught me how to fight?"

2081145483.m_KeyValue: "You're finally awake... I hate to admit it..."

2081145484.m_KeyValue: "It's all my fault... I wasn't strong enough... I wasn't brave enough... That's why I couldn't..."

2081145485.m_KeyValue: ""They've scattered, now's our chance to bust out!""

2081145747.m_KeyValue: "This is the ritual... But that was weeks ago. Am I hallucinating? Or..."

2081145748.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since the ritual was completed—no, since the ritual began—everyone has been repeating 'eyes passed down since the dawn of time' and 'family's duty' over and over...""

2081145777.m_KeyValue: ""Make way, young lady. Mr. Brigges is telling stories in front of the tavern!""

2081145778.m_KeyValue: "I'll go check out the market and see where I am."

2081145783.m_KeyValue: ""My lady, where are you? The lord and the elders are ready for the rit—I mean, that matter. They're all waiting for you—""

2081145841.m_KeyValue: ""It's me, my lady. Is something wrong?""

2081145846.m_KeyValue: "What time is it? What are we doing here?"

2081145847.m_KeyValue: ""No, I have to go back further... just a bit more!""

2081145879.m_KeyValue: "Death is of little consequence. The most important thing is 'that matter'..."

2081145910.m_KeyValue: ""Please head inside, my lady. The lord is already waiting for you. I will summon the other elders.""

2081145943.m_KeyValue: ""No need to search. Look, a certain 'person' has already come to us.""

2081237031.m_KeyValue: ""No, you must believe that there is no wrong in justice!""

2081240232.m_KeyValue: ""What are you doing here, you stupid wolf?!""

2081978723.m_KeyValue: "So you didn't tear it out yourself?"

2082047635.m_KeyValue: ""A hunter armed with a crossbow, seemingly in recognition of Noah—but not in a friendly way.""

2082092032.m_KeyValue: ""Gains All DEF Up based on lost HP. The more HP lost, the greater the All DEF increased.""

2082974755.m_KeyValue: ""<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>, the Plague Nest bursts upon completion, producing two Plague Spawnlings.""

2084522696.m_KeyValue: ""As someone who has ascended my existence as a 'Soul,' I am merely liberating lesser beings from their mortal coils. So you see, I have been misunderstood.""

2084522697.m_KeyValue: ""I... I can also smell that nauseating stench of rotting metal, it's him...""

2084533818.m_KeyValue: "He's a cunning man who's always a step ahead of us. Let's wait and see how things unfold."

2086578317.m_KeyValue: ""One fateful day, a cryptic letter arrives.""

2086616298.m_KeyValue: "A familiar envelope catches your eye. You recognize it immediately as correspondence from the enigmatic Q."

2088279101.m_KeyValue: ""Don't give me that look... E-Everyone loses their bearings at some point, right?""

2088279102.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I've only just learned how to use it. Once I fully master its secrets, I'll rid this island of all the nightmares.""

2088279105.m_KeyValue: ""Wh-what are you saying?! If you're not Noah, then who are you?! And if I'm not Piera, then who do you think I am?!""

2088279132.m_KeyValue: "Maybe you're really not the Noah I knew... How could you be so cold and doubt me!"

2088279133.m_KeyValue: ""I'm saying, now that I think about it, aren't I more likely to be the longings of the dead?""

2088279158.m_KeyValue: ""So, do we report back and say we never saw her on the island?""

2088279159.m_KeyValue: ""Although you're very timid and weak, likely incapable of accomplishing anything on your own...""

2088279164.m_KeyValue: "I watched you grow up! I don't want you to die! Don't you understand? I'm asking you one last time..."

2088279165.m_KeyValue: "Who knows? That old geezer always acts like nothing ever concerns him. No one knows if he cares about anything. However..."

2088279166.m_KeyValue: ""You're even more annoying than them! I would never get lost on this pebble of an island, unlike that old hag!""

2088279167.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother... taught me to have determination. Noah... put his trust in me. Standing against you, I am no longer alone...""

2088279168.m_KeyValue: ""Meanwhile, I... I can't even handle one on my own...""

2088279169.m_KeyValue: ""I'll count to thirty, and if these vexing vermin are still alive...""

2088279170.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Acappella. The fact that you're saying all this... it means you've believed in my innocence all along, doesn't it?""

2088279171.m_KeyValue: ""Because... I knew... I knew that Death escaped, and I also knew it would return here...""

2088279190.m_KeyValue: "—Indeed. It seems they've been trapped by Death's minions. What incompetence."

2088279191.m_KeyValue: "—Absolutely not. Why would I help you? You've got a bunch of heretics with you."

2088279196.m_KeyValue: ""The question is... if Noah... if he's actually from here, then... when was he born?""

2088279198.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, that silver-haired guy wasn't on the deck when all this went down, was he?""

2088279199.m_KeyValue: ""If memory serves, he said even without his memories, he was somehow certain that this island was his homeland...""

2088279201.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that the Divine Body on Sunset Isle creates phantoms of the deceased, blurring the boundary between life and death. These seem to be those phantoms.""

2088279202.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's nothing. Anyway, you mentioned he fell off a cliff, right? Even if he's a Bloodborn, he's not truly immortal. Shouldn't you go save him?""

2088279203.m_KeyValue: "I can hear every living heartbeat on this island! How do you think I managed to find you?"

2088279225.m_KeyValue: "But my ancestors who lost their way... have given me clarity..."

2088279228.m_KeyValue: "How do you think we could stand before you when we should have perished long ago?"

2088279229.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Then if we kill you, there won't be any pesky Gravekeepers left to threaten Lord Death's revival?""

2088279230.m_KeyValue: "I've learned a lot from the Church... from my master. But he's never told me what I should believe."

2088279232.m_KeyValue: "But if that's true... how am I able to see all of you?"

2088279233.m_KeyValue: ""You, in contrast, perpetuate the longing's 'self' by passing it to your progeny.""

2088279234.m_KeyValue: ""I see. That wasn't very helpful of her, leaving out part of the story like that.""

2088279235.m_KeyValue: "Eh? But you look much younger than the elderly gentleman... Ah... sorry."

2088279256.m_KeyValue: "So he chose me because you two worked together..."

2088279257.m_KeyValue: "Master... he only told me stories about you... Coming back to the island and stealing the 'salt coffin'... those were my decisions..."

2088279261.m_KeyValue: "Exchanging the Calamity and Divine Body to the Church for the safety of the family?"

2088279262.m_KeyValue: ""Very likely. As I recall... 66 years ago, on the day the Calamity of Death broke out, I witnessed a similar sight!""

2088279264.m_KeyValue: "Only to finally choose to follow Death? If even they could never succeed..."

2088279265.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... what was the Other Side like... the world you used to tell me about?"

2088279267.m_KeyValue: ""When I was just a girl even younger than you, I had already witnessed too many loved ones become sacrifices to seal Death away. And what did it achieve?""

2088279296.m_KeyValue: "Noah... I'm really happy to have met you..."

2088279297.m_KeyValue: "In that coffin... is Grandmother's research... and the remains of my people..."

2088279299.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... I was distracted... didn't notice them... It's all my fault."

2089650709.m_KeyValue: "A basic CPU that handles common environmental changes."

2089722421.m_KeyValue: ""'Perhaps he could trade something else to reclaim his son's swiftly ebbing time,' Isaac proposed, an idea that seemed remarkably pragmatic.""

2089722422.m_KeyValue: ""'He possesses wealth, status, lands, and health, but how could any of these compare to a warrior blessed with Invincibility by the goddess herself?'""

2089823113.m_KeyValue: "Please position me behind you. My Talent is called Silver Omen. It grants a Shield to an ally in front of me at the start of the battle."

2089823114.m_KeyValue: "This beast is more savage than anything I've ever encountered. Is the scent of my Black Blood sending it into a frenzy?"

2089823115.m_KeyValue: ""Oh blessed Moonlight, let the sufferer forget their pain and rewind to their previous state.""

2090465426.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to run, go ahead. I'm not leaving without Father.""

2090465431.m_KeyValue: "It's precisely because I know his character that I'm urging you to leave."

2090465458.m_KeyValue: "I just thought you might feel lonely when the day you've waited so long for finally arrives. So I came to keep you company..."

2090465459.m_KeyValue: ""Old friend, the moment you can forgive yourself is almost here. Until then, rest well.""

2090465724.m_KeyValue: "Help! Is there any kind and gentle soul out there?!"

2090465725.m_KeyValue: ""We should've minded our business and let these 'innocent pups' eat you, you garlic head!""

2090465756.m_KeyValue: ""From what you said, you should have more pressing matters yourself. Surely that's more urgent than fighting some strangers.""

2090465757.m_KeyValue: ""How about this... You all wait here, and once my business is done, I'll come back to take you to the Church...""

2090465759.m_KeyValue: "Please keep what just happened a secret."

2090465760.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! You're giving me too much credit. I gave it everything I had!"

2090465761.m_KeyValue: ""You're a worthy opponent, my silver-haired friend.""

2090465786.m_KeyValue: "He told me... where the next Moonblessed might be."

2090465787.m_KeyValue: "You don't have to worry about us. Hati. We're just slowing you down..."

2090465788.m_KeyValue: ""It's all Cain's fault, always being so cryptic. What does he mean by 'the moon hidden by evil wolves'?""

2090465790.m_KeyValue: "We heard you talking to the villagers."

2090465791.m_KeyValue: "W-What are you doing? Wake up! We're family!"

2090465792.m_KeyValue: ""Huh?! Fangs, long ears, and pale skin... It's those damn vampires from the south!""

2090465793.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, drop the act already. In Ganelon territory, even children know that the Bathorys are nothing but butchers!""

2090465819.m_KeyValue: ""Wrong direction... Of course! If you didn't see Clive on your way here, he must have turned back towards town!""

2090465822.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Can't you set your feelings aside for once? They're not the people you used to know anymore..."

2090465823.m_KeyValue: ""They've been infected by the Black Blood. They're rapidly losing themselves, driven only by the urge to assimilate all flesh before them...""

2090465824.m_KeyValue: "So that's what you're most concerned about!"

2090465825.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, you dumb wolf! It's not over yet!""

2090465850.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, but as I said before, apart from my father, I doubt anyone in town knows if the forbidden grounds actually exist...""

2090465854.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa, this is no time for squabbling. We should be working together to reach Mouret as quickly as possible.""

2090465855.m_KeyValue: "Scent! Are you some kind of beast?"

2090465856.m_KeyValue: "My father never spread the Black Blood!"

2090465857.m_KeyValue: "Where... am I? Am I still alive?"

2090465885.m_KeyValue: "But... I don't hate Wolfsbane. It's Hati and father's favorite flower."

2090465887.m_KeyValue: "Huh? What? Am I the only one who didn't get that?"

2090465888.m_KeyValue: ""I know... Father is incredibly strong, but he's not invincible. That's why I worry, why I came back on my own...""

2090465889.m_KeyValue: ""Literally speaking, that seems to be correct.""

2090465914.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't expect a Bell Ringer and her Vice-Commander to show up as well. You understand what this means, right? When the Church deploys a Bell Ringer...""

2090465918.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize for interrupting this touching sibling moment, but who is this Gravekeeper you mentioned?""

2090465919.m_KeyValue: "Not yet. But Father says I'll have my own Moonlight Sword sooner or later..."

2090465920.m_KeyValue: "The Ashen Garden is further north of town. You should be able to reach it after crossing a few more bridges."

2090465921.m_KeyValue: "Then he should have come to help us by now. That weirdo must have some other plan..."

2090544922.m_KeyValue: "I'm so relieved that your address hasn't changed."

2090688662.m_KeyValue: "Jestel is a newer knight. We speak from time to time."

2093252912.m_KeyValue: ""Your plan demonstrates admirable thoroughness. My discernment, as ever, proves impeccable.""

2093255847.m_KeyValue: ""Haha, so you've finally accepted your role as a servant!""

2093258918.m_KeyValue: ""As I thought, we had the same idea.""

2093259939.m_KeyValue: "I'll never believe in kindness that doesn't come with a price."

2093261096.m_KeyValue: "Offering advice is work too. We can discuss the implementation next time."

2093262117.m_KeyValue: "As expected of you! Leave the rest to me!"

2093263010.m_KeyValue: ""Great, I'm glad you feel the same.""

2093265188.m_KeyValue: ""No need for thanks, I'm simply acting according to my duty.""

2093266209.m_KeyValue: "Shall I proceed with immediate execution of the task?"

2094871453.m_KeyValue: "Clear [The Black Mist] <color=#a65f30>H 1-6</color>: Gold Clouds and Glooming Shadow"

2095145977.m_KeyValue: ""Don't get distracted! Find a chance to escape, as long as you take his blood, there's a chance to revive him!""

2095147134.m_KeyValue: ""Take her with us, she may know Baphomet's weakness.""

2096575446.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, making the best use of your team's skills will go a long way.""

2096575448.m_KeyValue: "I will deal DMG to the first enemy in front of me as soon as I enter battle."

2096575449.m_KeyValue: ""When you put me in the field, the ground will show the effects of my Talent.""

2098506983.m_KeyValue: "Forgive me for leaving the Divine Body's forbidden grounds so abruptly. There are things I couldn't say in the presence of those guards."

2098986762.m_KeyValue: "She means to face that many wolves alone? This is..."

2100144106.m_KeyValue: ""As much as I'd like Jestel to rest, the situation doesn't allow it.""

2100145129.m_KeyValue: ""Though it all occurred in a single day, to me it felt like a lifetime...""

2100151135.m_KeyValue: "So that's it... One of the elders is trying to seize control of the Bathory family."

2100154203.m_KeyValue: ""Just light the other brazier mechanism, and you can activate the central elevator of this prison tower.""

2100154204.m_KeyValue: ""Good, I can feel it, your anger—that's the best seasoning for your beautiful body...""

2100155227.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona and the others said that if we don't rescue you, I may never be able to truly learn how to suppress the Black Blood on my own. And also...""

2100334644.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I do take pride in being the second most idle Bell Ringer. As the saying goes: the less you give, the less you get, but you gain plenty of rest.""

2100372881.m_KeyValue: ""A noble estate, a dying patriarch, a young heir... This must be an inheritance dispute—or a hidden woman.""

2100444623.m_KeyValue: "But those people from the past—boys and civilians alike—they seemed somehow different from those I meet today."

2100550382.m_KeyValue: "Should I praise your cleverness? Or punish your insolence?"

2100636855.m_KeyValue: "He was the reason I joined the Church... I've... I've worked so hard for all these years to become his second-in-command!"

2100636856.m_KeyValue: ""So, what crime did you commit? You don't seem like a bad person, and you look rather weak...""

2100637879.m_KeyValue: ""But for us Moonblessed, daylight is the real danger.""

2100637880.m_KeyValue: "Really? I think the color suits him."

2101175058.m_KeyValue: "Though putting a sleepyhead in charge of the key shows they've only gotten a tiny bit smarter."

2101935804.m_KeyValue: "This bastard! It's... It's trying to consume me as well?!"

2102250500.m_KeyValue:
""An Alita knight lost to the sand.
The knight perished long ago, yet mutters endlessly under the sand's sway.""

2102250501.m_KeyValue: ""Coming from the shattered world, powered by vast amounts of Aqua Vitae. They command the actions of all constructs. Yet their hidden visage seems to whisper of a past long vanished.""

2102250508.m_KeyValue: "These war machines mass-produced by the Tempus Church use spells which slowly cripple the enemy to death."

2102250509.m_KeyValue:
""Silver-haired Agares.
A story from when he was still a slave of House Carrelle, bound by a promise to _$$live on._$$""

2102250510.m_KeyValue: "God teaches us to love and keep faith—I love those who pay my wages and stay faithful to every deal sealed by Soli."

2102250511.m_KeyValue: ""For the right price, guarding someone is just another job... or is it?""

2102250512.m_KeyValue:
""A monster rises with the dawn of time, dissolving into sand upon death. Mindless yet relentless, it fights on.
It rings the bell of copper, a sound declaring something yet to come.""

2102250513.m_KeyValue:
""A monster rises with the dawn of time, dissolving into sand upon death. Mindless yet relentless, it fights on.
It brandishes its dagger, attacking with frenzied precision.""

2102250514.m_KeyValue:
""A monster rises with the dawn of time, dissolving into sand upon death. Mindless yet relentless, it fights on.
Within its hourglass, the sands fall endlessly, tumbling forever into eternity.""

2102250515.m_KeyValue:
""A Phoenix forged by the will of time, it consumed the flames of war, only to become them.
As long as humanity clings to conflict, the flames will never die.
Again and again, it is reborn in fire.""

2102250597.m_KeyValue: ""The second mate of the _$$El Dorado,_$$ familiar with the art of combat at sea. <color=#D63536>He capitalizes on the ship's sway to nimbly evade incoming attacks</color>.""

2102250604.m_KeyValue: ""When his crimes can no longer be concealed, the Black Blood merchant sheds all pretense. He will prove to the world that he is no mere shadow of Goldland—but the true master of the El Dorado. And his name is William Goldland.""

2102250605.m_KeyValue: ""A sailor succumbed to the influence of Black Blood. With sanity long abandoned, there's nothing holding back the manifestation of their brutal nature.""

2102250606.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood has transformed William into a beast driven purely by desire. Timidity and self-doubt are stripped away. Ranna is beckoning to him — and there, where the claws of fear can never reach, lies only the promise of eternal peace.""

2102250608.m_KeyValue: ""The perfect embodiment of the Calamity _$$Famine._$$ Through the might of the Divine Body, Ami and the Blood Beast combine to become one formidable entity.""

2102250610.m_KeyValue: ""The head chef of the _$$El Dorado,_$$ responsible for meal preparations. Proficient with a pair of meat cleavers, he serves up a course of combat expertise.""

2102250611.m_KeyValue: "The Calamity "Plague" was sealed by the Ganelon family for generations and is believed to be the root cause of the Black Blood pandemic afflicting the continent."

Rather than maintaining the unstable nature of mutual assistance, he preferred to maintain complete control over the entire family.""

2107336038.m_KeyValue: ""Webs left at the convergence of realms. Its eerie light was spun into illusions by the _$$magician_$$ Pavana. In another life, would this master of illusions have known she too was caught in the weave of fate?""

2107336039.m_KeyValue: ""Fungi left at the convergence of realms. This radiant colony was carefully nurtured by Edina, the _$$fungal researcher._$$ In another life, would she ever wonder harmony between humanity and the wild as she wielded nature's power?""

2107336040.m_KeyValue: ""Blades left at the convergence of realms. Once, they were the lethal instruments of the _$$merciless blade_$$ Nicole. In another life, would she still crave to dance beneath the moonlight, even stripped of dreams and humanity?""

2107336041.m_KeyValue: ""Shackles left at the convergence of realms. The blood-corroded rust signifies the mercy once bestowed by the divine. In another life, after comprehending the divine prophecy, does she still seek to know pain?""

2107336042.m_KeyValue: ""A chariot left at the convergence of realms. Radiating golden brilliance, it was the vessel of Agares as the _$$light bearer,_$$ bestowing light and warmth. In another life, would he yearn for mortal pleasures as he traversed from sky to earth?""

2107336043.m_KeyValue: ""A plaguemask left at the convergence of realms. This precious relic was kept safe in a cabinet by _$$the town doctor_$$ Thibault. In another life, where the plague never came, would she have found new meaning in the quiet practice of medicine?""

2107336044.m_KeyValue: ""A spear left at the convergence of realms. Wrapped in bandages, this weapon bears witness to the countless triumphs over the Calamity by Tris, _$$the Bell Ringer of Glory._$$ In another life, returning in triumph, would she live without regret?""

2107336046.m_KeyValue: ""A halberd left at the convergence of realms. Carrying the aura of sin, it belonged to Noah, the _$$phantom Death,_$$ who was consumed by the Calamity. In another life, burdened by the curse, would he finally break free from the chain of fate?""

2107487297.m_KeyValue: ""I'll find their family, I swear it. They won't be forgotten.""
