2113960324.m_KeyValue: ""And as expected, Seraphina is already there—waiting in stillness against the starlit sky.""

2113960325.m_KeyValue: "There is one thing worth staking our lives on."

2113960326.m_KeyValue: "Why does it have to be me?"

2113960327.m_KeyValue: ""Her wings snap free, and with a lurching deceleration, the world steadies once more.""

2113960328.m_KeyValue: ""So this is your idea of staking our lives? There's no danger in—wait, what—?""

2113960330.m_KeyValue: ""To die for yourself or live for someone else—you've already made your choice, haven't you?""

2114738521.m_KeyValue: ""I don't seek immortality, but only by living can I await the day to tear off their hypocritical masks.""

2114740695.m_KeyValue: "I hope this strength never harms those around me..."

2114741561.m_KeyValue: "Touch me again and my mantle will snap your neck."

2114741720.m_KeyValue: ""Hey newcomer, let's play together! Don't worry, I won't break you.""

2114743735.m_KeyValue: "Our hair color isn't all that different."

2114743894.m_KeyValue: "Peak performance! The First of the Silver Cross will be ours."

2115903566.m_KeyValue: "Is this how the Bathory family treats their guests? I'm relieved you're here."

2118388579.m_KeyValue: "A bee construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Its sensors on the head have lost their communication function and can only receive one-way commands for attacks."

2118388676.m_KeyValue: ""In the heart of the Ashen Garden dwells the queen, drawing strength from plague’s remains to thrive in desolation.""

2118494477.m_KeyValue: "Just Bella is fine. I'm not nearly old enough to need formal titles."

2120691033.m_KeyValue: ""After all, weren't you the one who broke our pact first?""

2120691034.m_KeyValue: "So I suppose it is because of Ressa's destruction that you're capable of navigating your own nodes now."

2120691035.m_KeyValue: ""At the end of time, before all wills could finally become one, three irreconcilable wills began to argue over who was truly right...""

2120691037.m_KeyValue: "I see. You've cut off our connection to Aeon… This space of yours nullifies the Covenant's reach."

2120691038.m_KeyValue: "Why a fifth Bell Ringer—unforeseen—would appear? Friedrich Roland of the Light."

2120692053.m_KeyValue: "What's happening all of a sudden?! The moon has turned blood-red!"

2120692054.m_KeyValue: ""After the Long Night, the remaining eight Scourges will awaken. I wish to challenge that power, nothing more.""

2120692055.m_KeyValue: "But why does he still look so composed?"

2120692056.m_KeyValue: ""And now, I wish for my two opponents—to disappear from this place.""

2120692058.m_KeyValue: ""I pass on to you the feather of War. Now it is your turn to lead the Moonblessed in search of truth, to rise against the divine wills...""

2120692059.m_KeyValue: ""You look quite miserable, Noah. Reminds me of our first clash in Starfall Valley.""

2120692061.m_KeyValue: ""Water is truly magnificent—it makes up our bodies, and even this world itself, so...""

2121694585.m_KeyValue: "I just can't believe I'm not the hero who changes fate."

2121694586.m_KeyValue: "I just can't accept that I failed to save you."

2121694587.m_KeyValue: "I just can't forgive myself for killing you."

2122606659.m_KeyValue: "That's... Mira! She's the priest I mentioned earlier!"

2124156459.m_KeyValue: ""As the story in Threads of Fate progresses, Moonlight Faith will increase, leading to faster Tribute yields.""

2124156649.m_KeyValue: "Stage Objective: Defeat the Cluster Brain (Elite Shield Spirit) to achieve victory."

2126860808.m_KeyValue: "I'll leave these petty concerns to you."

2126861831.m_KeyValue: ""Apologies. Until I've honored my mother's wish, I've no time to spare for idle talk.""

2126862986.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! I'll leave this decision to you commoners."

2126865164.m_KeyValue: "The divine will does not concern itself."

2126867342.m_KeyValue: "Haven't you got anything better to do?"

2128518467.m_KeyValue: "Clear [Threads of Fate] 5-10 to unlock this Hunting Ground."

2130111972.m_KeyValue: "How I live is my burden. It has nothing to do with you."

2130111973.m_KeyValue: ""Now, I must retreat into shadow once again.""

2130111974.m_KeyValue: "So you stood against him and fled the castle."

2130111975.m_KeyValue: ""As you can see, my mother was born into the Crowley family—vassals to Ganelon.""

2130597900.m_KeyValue: ""Look, I fear nothing in this world... except those revolting creatures. That's precisely why I handed the castle's interior survey task over to you.""

2130597901.m_KeyValue: ""Blood Beast breeding! That's your secret, isn't it? I discovered it during my first survey of the castle!""

2130597902.m_KeyValue: "So what's your real purpose for this meeting? And what exactly did you mean when you said you knew Bathory family's secrets?"

2130597903.m_KeyValue: "You... you really had no idea I was Bloodborn?"

2130597904.m_KeyValue: "Wait... Y-You have fangs! You're actually a Bloodborn!"

2130597905.m_KeyValue: "Bloodborn? What Bloodborn... I don't know what you're talking about anymore."

2130597906.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, you're no cartographer at all, are you? You're one of the Church's hunters—the ones who hunt down the Bloodborn.""

2130597907.m_KeyValue: ""Extraordinary power, close ties to the Church, tracking my every move since your very first letter...""

2194428155.m_KeyValue: ""Hang in there, Clive! We're here with you, and Hati is still waiting to see you!""

2194428384.m_KeyValue: ""Even if it becomes the law of the world, don't waver. Repetition never equals eternity.""

2194428415.m_KeyValue: ""That's alright. We don't need to move on, we just need to keep moving forward.""

2194428416.m_KeyValue: ""Father is gone and I'm no longer a child, Noah. Pretty words cannot comfort me anymore.""

2194428417.m_KeyValue: ""As I just said, Hati. Nothing is a coincidence.""

2194428419.m_KeyValue: "That's not the version I heard before..."

2194428420.m_KeyValue: "So what? Maybe they were all painful memories. It's better to forget."

2194428421.m_KeyValue: "...Are you saying you want to risk your life on a hunch?"

2194428422.m_KeyValue: ""These aren't vegetables, they're fungi. They look like they've been here for a long time. They definitely weren't put here recently.""

2194428449.m_KeyValue: "Something strange must have taken place at the cemetery. We can discuss the details after dealing with the problem at hand."

2194428450.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, why did you come back alone? Where's Noah?""

2194428479.m_KeyValue: ""Disregarding the boy who just drank from the contaminated water, this one with silver hair seems to have long been infected with Black Blood.""

2194428480.m_KeyValue: ""Not only can he suppress the Black Blood within, he can even use it to manifest new abilities...""

2194428481.m_KeyValue: ""We got separated. When I woke up, she was gone. I don't know if she's okay...""

2194428482.m_KeyValue: ""Why are you dressed like that, Aio...""

2194428485.m_KeyValue: ""But if it's really her... she'll definitely help us, right?!""

2194428508.m_KeyValue: ""Neither that child, nor the werewolves can ever leave this place.""

2194428512.m_KeyValue: "You just called me... You know my name?"

2194428513.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Noah... Please don't follow me any further.""

2194428515.m_KeyValue: "Ah... my... my blood... Wh-why is it black?"

2194428518.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps it's the fate of humans to fight one another. And the courage born beneath it is often nothing more than 'resistance, putting oneself upon the pyre.'""

2194428540.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of you, Noah. You made the connection right away.""

2194428543.m_KeyValue: ""It was his choice to pursue the truth, so naturally, he should bear the consequences. His fate is already sealed.""

2194428545.m_KeyValue: ""You're just upset that Aiona trusted someone she just met over you, right?""

2194428546.m_KeyValue: ""It's hard to explain, but I have a feeling that I should know you, Noah.""

2194428547.m_KeyValue: "This is a special type that I've only read about in Dr. Thibault's old books. Bringing him back to the Church will surely gain us much favor."

2194428548.m_KeyValue: ""To be precise, it's one of the sources. According to The Church's records, there are twelve known sources of Black Blood on the continent, each sealed by a Divine Body.""

2194428549.m_KeyValue: ""So Clive is the Church's Gravekeeper, tasked with guarding this Divine Body?""

2194428580.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Why do you keep calling me a dumb wolf?"

2194428581.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, they can't fly either! Hmph, finally we won't have to be constantly chased by those knights!""

2194428582.m_KeyValue: ""You must keep at it, Miss Hati. There are many more of these explosive mushrooms ahead.""

2194428609.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you've already felt it. That person is—"

2194428611.m_KeyValue: ""No, we may have overlooked a possibility...""

2194428614.m_KeyValue: "I can't imagine the horrors that will befall the Lupine Forest... And it could very well spread to the entire continent."

2197868937.m_KeyValue: "That's my brother's! Give it to me!"

2197868939.m_KeyValue: "Stop talking. Don't draw Van Helsing's attention."

2197868940.m_KeyValue: "Hey... Anyone else noticing something off about these guys on the ground...?"

2197868941.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why's no one around? Where did everyone go?"

2197868942.m_KeyValue: "You keep saying that! What is it anyway? You mentioned it when you fought that big oaf too!"

2197868961.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it's because all the sailors are dressed alike? It's easy to confuse one for another."

2197868962.m_KeyValue: "And what is this room? It's filled with odd jars and bottles…"

2197868970.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? So instead of getting two additional helpers, I picked up a pair that needs protecting?""

2197868971.m_KeyValue: "Don't just stand there. No threat for now—get to the helm!"

2197868972.m_KeyValue: "There are three questions I need answers to:"

2197868973.m_KeyValue: ""When I discovered the crew had been infected with Black Blood, I suspected the ship had been poisoned. Jones's response was strange.""

2197868974.m_KeyValue: "...came when we reached the deck and saw William hanging from the mast. Goldland said that something's happened to William. He killed himself."

2197868975.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, the kitchen—the ideal place to poison the ship's entire crew. ""

2197868976.m_KeyValue: "The motive remains unclear—but betrayal or infighting seems more than plausible."

2197869001.m_KeyValue: ""Is this it? You're not like the other vats—trying to stand out, are we?""

2197869002.m_KeyValue: "They're taller than me—Who are you calling short?!"

2197869003.m_KeyValue: "Don't go… please… help me… save me…"

2197869033.m_KeyValue: ""I do not feed on humans. And to be precise… I am not fully Bloodborn, either.""

2197869034.m_KeyValue: "Don't speak of us as though we're monsters. Even true Bloodborn drink only blood and wine."

2197869036.m_KeyValue: "You mean… you can glimpse the memories of the food you eat?"

2197869037.m_KeyValue: "The ship's not safe enough for that. There's no need to go to such lengths—I have another way."

2197869039.m_KeyValue: "Could it be… the same as what happened in the Lupine Forest?"

2197869040.m_KeyValue: ""According to the layout, we're already at the bottom level of the ship.""

2197869061.m_KeyValue: "This is my ship! None of you will take me!"

2197869062.m_KeyValue: "Enough!!! I don't want to hear another word of your sentimental little 'family'!"

2197869065.m_KeyValue: "You were fortunate not to drink the Black Blood Aaron slipped into every dinner..."

2197869066.m_KeyValue: "Whoa... he really hates being called that. He's burning with shame and fury."

2197869067.m_KeyValue: ""On the other, he wished to spare William, to leave him with a path forward.""

2197869071.m_KeyValue: "I've already examined the body. I removed the hat and eyepatch. I saw his face."

2197869072.m_KeyValue: "...every act only confirms what you truly are: a cunning little coward. "

2197869098.m_KeyValue: "That voice… It won't stop… My head… is spinning…"

2197869099.m_KeyValue: "No… I don't want to go back… She's there… she's..."

2197869102.m_KeyValue: "You were the one who said it!"

2197869103.m_KeyValue: ""And if he shared Goldland's face, he could easily pose as both victim and survivor.""

2197869104.m_KeyValue: ""You're more beautiful than any other—Stronger than my brother, than Bob, than Van Helsing, than all those wretched Bloodborn...""

2197869130.m_KeyValue: "It's coming from above! That's the storage room!"

2197869131.m_KeyValue: "Only recognition of your mastery in alchemy."

2197869132.m_KeyValue: "No! I've never been more clear-headed! Hahaha! So this is the rapture that comes with Black Blood!"

2197869133.m_KeyValue: ""He's lying! I ran a background check on you back on deck—before I even checked your ticket. You were replacing that schemer Cain, so I had to be thorough.""

2197869134.m_KeyValue: ""She is the world-ending Calamity spoken of in hushed whispers. The one that stirs the deepest, most uncontrollable desires within mortal hearts.""

2197869135.m_KeyValue: "You did all of this… to set something free?"

2200719492.m_KeyValue:
""This marks the one hundred and fifteenth day of my journey around Minexus.
Today, I arrived at a welcoming village, where the people, cheerful and humble, greeted me with kindness.
It was the harvest festival. The land here, though not truly fertile, yields generously thanks to mild weather and easy tilling on the plain.
When the feast ended, the village chief climbed to the highest point and scattered a bowl of grain into the air.
The villagers told me it was an act of gratitude to the wind.
They do not remember exactly why this is done, only that the tradition has endured since their ancestors crossed distant lands to settle here.
Such a fascinating custom.""

2200719493.m_KeyValue:
""To _$$the future_$$:

 The War between the houses of Ganelon and Bathory has yet to cease. In the face of this historical inertia, our efforts feel exeedingly insignificant.
 Yet this does not mean our sacrifices were in vain. I shall continue to travel the continent, seeking new paths for the Bloodborn. Human blood is not essential—the Pure Blood Essence that I entrusted Mr. Cain to brew makes a perfect substitute. The Bloodborn need not forever hide in darkness; one day, we will surely walk beneath the sunlight.
 I leave this letter somewhere in Bathory Castle, hoping that its reader might set aside hatred and prejudice, and join me in welcoming that beautiful future.
 Even if it is destined to be a long, hard road.""

2275779906.m_KeyValue: ""Such an idea... Well, well, your boldness has certainly grown since we last met.""

2275828362.m_KeyValue: ""Across this vast continent, there exists a group of intrepid explorers who roam the world. They live by the creed of 'mapping the world with their own footsteps,' venturing into and documenting those undiscovered, enigmatic realms.""

2275828461.m_KeyValue: ""'Eye of God. Arrived.' He halted, lifting his gaze toward the unremarkable hill. After scanning the surroundings for a moment, he gave his first assessment: 'Threat level: low.'""

2275830474.m_KeyValue: "This story unfolds in a different Other Side—a world utterly distinct from the Minexus you know."

2275830507.m_KeyValue: ""A small gravestone stood in the overgrown crevice, its surface veined with fine cracks and damp with moss—the quiet traces left behind by time.""

2275830540.m_KeyValue: ""Before the great fire was kindled at the boundary between life and death, <style=""Highlight"">Bell Ringer No. X and Commander of the Choir</style>—Acappella, finally found a rare respite.""

2275832718.m_KeyValue: ""The Moonlight Sword of the Ganelon family embodies their ancestral legacy. It grows in strength as its wielder matures, and wanes as its master's life ebbs away.""

2275832817.m_KeyValue: "Do you grasp the true significance of those people's actions in the past? Just look around you now—their impact is evident in everything."

2275833677.m_KeyValue: ""In this world, true coincidence is but an illusion. Even fate itself is a puppet, its strings pulled by unseen hands lurking in shadow. We revel in fleeting moments of fortune, blind to the grand deception unfolding around us.""

2275833706.m_KeyValue: "'Agares. If you had incinerated those strange plants from the start…'"

2275834863.m_KeyValue: ""For the people living on the northern Acorellia Highlands, in the Aesgracia Village, the annual Aesgracia Festival is the most sacred winter day.""

2275834896.m_KeyValue: ""In her quest for botanical wisdom, Edina once journeyed alongside Yggdrasill, their travels weaving a tapestry of knowledge across the entire continent.""

2275835855.m_KeyValue: ""Time beautifies our memories, yet also distorts them. It is our inability to return to the past that makes the solace of remembrance so essential.""

2275836016.m_KeyValue: ""Have you ever had this experience... You stumble upon something long forgotten, triggering a memory you'd almost lost. Yet, in that moment of recollection, you find the memory itself becoming strangely unfamiliar.""

2275838033.m_KeyValue: ""The cold moonlight poured down from the night sky, splintering into delicate halos as it filtered through the dense forest canopy. It softly enveloped the swirling mist, gaining a faint, unexpected warmth in its ethereal embrace.""

2275838062.m_KeyValue: ""'It was on a full-moon night...' Soaking in the misty warmth of the spring, only Gadric's garlic-shaped helmet poked out above the surface as he muttered in a low, muffled voice.""

2275840211.m_KeyValue: ""The ashen sky was blanketed with vast swaths of leaden clouds, hanging heavy like water-logged, tattered cotton. Below, their oppressive weight bore down upon a desolate fishing village.""

2275840277.m_KeyValue: ""A woman with pale golden hair stood before a wooden cabin in the fishing village, her gaze fixed on the distant horizon. The sea breeze stirred her hair, carrying away with it a trace of her melancholy.""

2275840372.m_KeyValue: ""The sea is ever dangerous—yet ever alluring. Even knowing how many lives it's claimed, people still head willingly toward its depths.""

2275840438.m_KeyValue: ""An unidentified seabird swooped down from the clouds, gliding gently on seasonal winds toward a small fishing village in the vast ocean.""

2276905330.m_KeyValue: ""Mere ants, and yet I must deal with them personally!""

2276905361.m_KeyValue: ""Even if it's the emotions talking, I'm going to get angry if you continue acting like this.""

2276910577.m_KeyValue: "Where's the rest of the search team? Why haven't they caught up?"

2283263925.m_KeyValue: ""As much as I dislike that garlic head, he really doesn't seem like the type to abandon someone in need.""

2283263928.m_KeyValue: ""Hati... I joined the Church to catch up to you. But now, it seems like you've left me even further behind...""

2283263929.m_KeyValue: "It's your call! Go find your father or stay here with that idiot who's just as dumb as you!"

2283263930.m_KeyValue: ""That's impossible. Even Dr. Thibault, the Bell Ringer herself, is still searching for a cure for the Black Blood disease...""

2283263958.m_KeyValue: ""Stupid wolf! Face it, that idiot doctor is beyond saving!""

2283263960.m_KeyValue: "Is that the flower you take after being infected to die with some dignity?"

2283263961.m_KeyValue: ""When you broke your arm as a child, I was the one who set it for you. You always said I was too rough—""

2283263962.m_KeyValue: "That voice... It's Uncle Gadric! Uncle Gadric is singing!"

2283263989.m_KeyValue: ""But I won't stop here. I'll bloom as you wished, like the Wolfsbane growing towards the moonlight.""

2283263991.m_KeyValue: "Let's go in too! Hati and Clive might need us."

2283585170.m_KeyValue: ""Make haste. The guards at the gate, pursuers behind—we'll be trapped between them.""

2283965634.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it's only the homeland left behind on a distant journey that stirs such longing."

2299383354.m_KeyValue: ""But you see, what we're offering you is two friends.""

2299383355.m_KeyValue: ""If we're talking about who's responsible, I bear the larger share. Take my life but spare her, shopkeeper.""

2299383358.m_KeyValue: ""It seems she doesn't really understand human emotions at all, yet she longs to become a real person.""

2299383359.m_KeyValue: "I can't believe they called you foolish and naughty."

2299383361.m_KeyValue: ""I'll sell it to you, for just 100 million Soli.""

2299383390.m_KeyValue: "That puppet was right. So many have died along the way. How much hope do we really have of becoming survivors?"

2299383392.m_KeyValue: "You're trembling. What are you afraid of? Worried we'll be defeated like before?"

2299383423.m_KeyValue: ""It's Cidhall, the Elder here... sort of. I'm new.""

2299383424.m_KeyValue: ""But it's still within expectations. In the end, you're just another batch of failed experiments.""

2299383425.m_KeyValue: ""The louder the voice, the more it fails to mask the fear underneath. That's lesson two.""

2299383454.m_KeyValue: ""You've always been different from the others, always immersed in your own world, enjoying your own secrets.""

2299383456.m_KeyValue: ""No, this feeling... The ground beneath us is sinking!?""

2299711300.m_KeyValue: "Moran!? What are you doing out here all by yourself?"

2299711302.m_KeyValue: ""In that case, surely you can form a proper sentence?""

2300000900.m_KeyValue: "Within every alchemist's workshop lie creations capable of reshaping the world."

2300000902.m_KeyValue: ""I endure it not because I must, but because I owe no explanations to the ignorant.""

2300000903.m_KeyValue: "What's so special about a few jars and flasks?"

2300000904.m_KeyValue: "Those constructs lack flesh and blood—they were never alive. That may be why they pass between worlds so easily… slipping through the rift at will."

2300000905.m_KeyValue: "Must we truly have this conversation here? The stench in this place is vile!"

2300000907.m_KeyValue: "I was born from Death... only to be cast aside by it long ago."

2300000908.m_KeyValue: "Our world no longer has the Church's protection. Even Albrecht has lost the blessing of Silver Blood."

2300000909.m_KeyValue: ""The passage between worlds rends flesh from bone—and without immortality, he wouldn't survive the journey.""

2300001922.m_KeyValue: "This isn't something she should bear alone."

2300001926.m_KeyValue: ""Honestly, I cannot say whether shattering the bottle would destroy that world...""

2300001927.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer should know better than to even suggest such blasphemy."

2300001928.m_KeyValue: "So I propose we let this silver-haired young lady try. After all—it is her world."

2300001929.m_KeyValue: "—or quite the opposite. It may unleash its contents entirely... And invade this world instead."

2300001930.m_KeyValue: "Then why not just smash the bottle? Wouldn't that wipe out all those metal scraps at once?"

2300001931.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. Every particle and everything that constitutes her world lies sealed within this bottle... forged by my own hand."

2300001932.m_KeyValue: "Are you suggesting Aeon is the same?"

2300001933.m_KeyValue: ""In any world, the one who creates it... is not always the one who writes its laws.""

2300004101.m_KeyValue: "So in stopping it... she may have caused it?"

2300004102.m_KeyValue: "That's not it. I came here to stop them."

2300004103.m_KeyValue: "Not necessarily. Maybe it was her arrival that woke them up."

2300004104.m_KeyValue: ""You're the dumb one, silly bat! She just said those metal scraps were already lying in wait before she even showed up!""

2300004105.m_KeyValue: "But what if they came because you did?"

2300004106.m_KeyValue: "And everything that followed... played out exactly as I told you."

2300004107.m_KeyValue: "...my world's Asta was invaded by those constructs on the day of the Harvest Festival."

2300004108.m_KeyValue: "I don't know why it happened today... But back home..."

2300004109.m_KeyValue: ""Why did they appear today, of all days?""

2303707979.m_KeyValue: "The statue of Goldland and many items at the auction were salvaged from the deep sea by fishermen… I'm worried…"

2303707980.m_KeyValue: "The Eighth Sage… would they really use an 'election' to determine such a position?"

2303707981.m_KeyValue: "I told Selena a little lie—her route will avoid your operation."

2303707982.m_KeyValue: "A token proving your candidacy for the election."

2303708012.m_KeyValue: "So you became a thief? What an interesting way to grieve."

2303708013.m_KeyValue: ""You're still... too young after all, Isaac.""

2303708015.m_KeyValue: "The chart room? I'm on... a ship?"

2303708044.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Savich... I've never seen this Miss Ami before. She isn't from our family."

2303708045.m_KeyValue: "How could she have done such a thing?"

2303708046.m_KeyValue: "The 'proof' is the Mistbound Terror! The very nightmare that haunted Sapphire Isle and left both tourists and residents in fear—captured by Miss Ami herself!"

2303708047.m_KeyValue: ""As long as there are those who seek to exploit the Siren's Tears, running will be in vain. The Master hiding among the six remaining Sages has yet to be revealed.""

2303708049.m_KeyValue: ""So what do you plan to do with this Mistbound Terror, Mr. Noah?""

2306016292.m_KeyValue: "The destined sovereign who will guide the Bloodborn toward their rebirth."

2306016293.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the Wolfsbane growing in this forest, they too bear witness to that ancient battle.""

2307776904.m_KeyValue: "Bell Ringer No. II utilizes flames to deal Continuous DMG as well as additional DMG. Dispel the Continuous DMG as soon as possible."

2308038928.m_KeyValue: "Y-y-you're... Ressa Ambolia? The Valkyrie who once stood at the Saint's side!?"

2308038929.m_KeyValue: "I object! She's just an ordinary nun! ...Wait..."

2308038930.m_KeyValue: "This is ridiculous! How could you be involved with a Calamity!?"

2308038931.m_KeyValue: "It's been a while since anyone called me that."

2308038932.m_KeyValue: "So even one as detached from the world as a Bell Ringer has someone she holds dear."

2308038933.m_KeyValue: ""Do as I say, Acappella. This is no place for a child—descend the mountain at once.""

2308038934.m_KeyValue: "Weren't you the one who trusted only your Choristers? Seems you're the one who's changed the most."

2308038935.m_KeyValue: "One voice alone does not make a Choir."

2308039952.m_KeyValue: "But for an explosion like this—she must be in danger too…"

2308039953.m_KeyValue: "Only one possibility. She encountered something she couldn't defeat. A Calamity… one as powerful as Famine."

2308039958.m_KeyValue: "C-could it be the sunlight from earlier? Why such a delayed reaction?!"

2308039959.m_KeyValue: "No... it's Noah. I can feel his pain..."

2308039960.m_KeyValue: ""A resonance between those connected by blood... just like when Noah sensed you, back at the castle.""

2308039961.m_KeyValue: "He's not far from us... he's here... on this island!"

2308048656.m_KeyValue: ""What a clever girl. Even when longing continues its passage, it doesn't vanish—it remains with us.""

2308048657.m_KeyValue: ""They return to us through their longing, and we hold them close through ours.""

2308048664.m_KeyValue: "Because this is where longing lingers... before it continues the passage to its final rest."

2308048665.m_KeyValue: ""Each longing sheds a tear before it goes—and over time, those tears formed this pool.""

2308048666.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, I know what longing is! The grown-ups say when someone dies on the island, they become longing and stay with us.""

2308048667.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean by 'continuing the passage'?"

2308048668.m_KeyValue: "It means being guided to the place where they're meant to go."

2308048669.m_KeyValue: "Guide them? Where to? Wouldn't it be better if they stayed with us?"

2308048670.m_KeyValue: ""This world lives by the law of balance. What do you think would happen to our island if there was only life, and no death?""

2308049810.m_KeyValue: ""We're grateful for the gesture, truly. But we cannot accept this gift.""

2308049811.m_KeyValue: ""These flowers... I once loved them dearly. But Eleanor... she fell from here, trying to pick one for me.""

2308049816.m_KeyValue: ""Because I knew if we wished to find you, this would be the place.""

2308049817.m_KeyValue: ""Dr. Ressa, Piera? What brings you here?""

2308049818.m_KeyValue: "But I really wanted to give Mother the flowers…"

2308049819.m_KeyValue: "It's alright. Let's wait a little while. They'll come… I promise."

2308049820.m_KeyValue: "Someone who couldn't bear to see your sorrow entrusted me with a task: To bring you these flowers."

2308051988.m_KeyValue: ""No—no, that can't be... Why would Death—a Calamity no less—help us reunite with the dead?""

2308051989.m_KeyValue: "No. It may be a privilege—bestowed by the death sealed beneath this island. A parting gift... to those who die here."

2308051993.m_KeyValue: "This thing doesn't devour longing... It devours everything touched by Black Blood."

2308051994.m_KeyValue: "Then that means... The longing on this island didn't come from the imagination of the Divine Body's Skull..."

2308051995.m_KeyValue: "Because maybe longing was never about clinging to life... Maybe it was always a bond... with death."

2308051996.m_KeyValue: "A dreamfeeder... but I've never seen one this massive before."

2308051998.m_KeyValue: "Names... are given by humans. But what if everything we've ever named—we've misunderstood?"

2308051999.m_KeyValue: "Wait—how can a dreamfeeder devour living people?! Wouldn't that be a people-feeder?"

2308053012.m_KeyValue: ""I don't remember who I was, or what I want to do. All I have is the name _$$Noah._$$ Nothing else.""

2308053013.m_KeyValue: ""You were Noah before, and you're still Noah now—working beside me to heal this island. You'll take pride in that one day. Isn't that enough?""

2308053016.m_KeyValue: ""I understand. But in just three months, more than ten villagers have already shown symptoms.""

2308053017.m_KeyValue: "Are you using time to pressure me?"

2308053019.m_KeyValue: ""You know your past, you know your purpose. You even take pride in your principles.""

2308053020.m_KeyValue: "To defy death. To find a way to eradicate the Black Blood entirely."

2308053021.m_KeyValue: "Whether you mean death as a natural end—or the Calamity sealed on this island—neither can be undone by sheer will alone."

2308053022.m_KeyValue: "I know. Of course I know. I've lived on Sunset Isle for over three years... and I've made no progress."

2308053023.m_KeyValue: "But the balance of life and death is a law nurtured over countless ages. Three years is nothing against that."

2308054166.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias, take her back to the Church.""

2308054168.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the legends say—darkness outside, yet dusk lingers within.""

2308054169.m_KeyValue: "Wow... so this is what it's like inside Sunset Isle?"

2308054170.m_KeyValue: "The black fog rising there is far thicker than it was three months ago. Could it be... That Death is awakening?"

2308054171.m_KeyValue: ""No, that direction... it's the blessed grounds.""

2308054173.m_KeyValue: "Why are they suddenly moving in one direction?"

2308054174.m_KeyValue: "I'll stay with him. You... go help... Ressa..."

2308055190.m_KeyValue: ""At least for us who were fed upon by dreamfeeders, we felt the cruel truth—how these minions of the Divine Body tried to make us their prey.""

2308055191.m_KeyValue: ""Yet this young man known as Death defied the god to protect us, slowly losing his strength until he became what he is now.""

2308055192.m_KeyValue: ""If what you're saying is true, then we've had it all wrong from the start?""

2308055193.m_KeyValue: ""Just as my wife said, we who guarded the Divine Body were but vessels, beings trapped in deception.""

2308055194.m_KeyValue: ""It is the Divine Body, the protector, who leads longings across to the Other Side.""

2308055195.m_KeyValue: ""We always believed that _$$Death,_$$ as a Calamity, devoured longings, dragging them into oblivion.""

2308055196.m_KeyValue: "We doubted it at first too. But you saw it—Eleanor reached her final destination with his guidance."

2308055197.m_KeyValue: ""As I said before, death is not what I once believed—not an end, but the dawn of a new beginning.""

2308055198.m_KeyValue: ""So youthful and gentle in form, yet known by a fearful name.""

2308055199.m_KeyValue: ""Even so, Death shouldn't be the one that sends longings to the Other Side...""

2308539263.m_KeyValue: "Besides... the ones truly hunting the sirens are the Masters hiding behind the Sages."

2308539264.m_KeyValue: "Staying with the Sage Association is how I repay the Mysterious Merchant."

2308539271.m_KeyValue: "The Sages will approve of the victim I've chosen."

2308539272.m_KeyValue: "Lorelei burned the first half of the letter and kept the second half."

2308539273.m_KeyValue: "Just the last shred of goodness in an evil heart."

2308539274.m_KeyValue: "Are you using the Mistbound Terror as a disguise to hunt those who abuse sirens?"

2308539277.m_KeyValue: ""Besides... sooner or later, I will lead all my kin back to the sea.""

2308539278.m_KeyValue: ""By staying here, I can at least use my position as a Sage to protect a few.""

2309941465.m_KeyValue: "Unlocks after obtaining Outfit - The Kindled Flame."

2309941467.m_KeyValue: "Unlocks after obtaining Outfit - Dawn's Rosy Sky."

2312141246.m_KeyValue:
""The moon had risen quietly above the treetops.
Myrtle heard beastly cries in the forest. She tried to flee the banquet with Isaac—only to find Averdin emerging from the layered shadows.
His teeth were sharper, claws sprouting from his fingers, and blood staining the corners of his lips. What had happened? Myrtle was gripped by terror.
'I'm starving…' he rasped.
She should have fought. She should have struck him down.
But how could she tear out the throat of the man who had once saved her? The man who had built a home for her people?
Tonight, the moon looms vast, round, and brilliant.
Tonight, it bleeds with a deep, blood-red hue.""

2312731501.m_KeyValue: "...Is it time to ring the bell?"

2312731502.m_KeyValue: "Why hasn't Kenneth's squad come to meet us? The patrol unit's missing too... Am I late again?"

2312731504.m_KeyValue: ""You still don't get it?! The Bell Ringer himself is here, scouring our post for the legendary Divine Body!""

2312734701.m_KeyValue: ""To light the dawn of a new era, these old nobles make perfect _$$firewood._$$""

2312734702.m_KeyValue: ""Remember how it flies now, for this once-proud symbol will soon be no more than ash and memory.""

2312734703.m_KeyValue: ""Mass Carrelle betrayed her family, and attempted to destroy the Divine Body before leaping into the flames—on the very day of your resurrection.""

2313371579.m_KeyValue: ""I can feel it... Their longing, their protection.""

2313371582.m_KeyValue: "And the one they love... Is the truest version of me."

2313371583.m_KeyValue: "I never understood a word you said. But there's one thing I've always known:"

2313371584.m_KeyValue: "Impossible! How could someone as incomplete as you achieve transcendence on your own!?"

2313371585.m_KeyValue: "How can this be...? How is your power greater than mine!?"

2313372604.m_KeyValue: "Have you forgotten me? You've all forgotten I existed."

2313372605.m_KeyValue: ""But that's just as it should be. We, the faithful of Famine Ranna, have no need for names.""

2313372606.m_KeyValue: "Then you... You were never part of this crew to begin with! When did you..."

2313372607.m_KeyValue: ""When your body is devoured by the great Ranna, you will be reborn. You'll finally see the truth of this world.""

2313372608.m_KeyValue: ""Now, raise your voice with mine and invoke the sacred name of the Moonblessed!""

2313372609.m_KeyValue: "Famine Ranna shall once more reign over the sea that rightfully belongs to her!"

2313381308.m_KeyValue: "Such stubbornness... Then it's time you remembered who you truly are."

2313381315.m_KeyValue: "You want to eat me? You're a thousand years too early for that!"

2313381317.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, not again! I don't even know you!""

2313381318.m_KeyValue: "You're the perfect vessel... Become one with me..."

2313381319.m_KeyValue: "Shut up! Stop clinging to me and get off!"

2313381320.m_KeyValue: "Let's escape... And reclaim what was stolen from us..."

2313381321.m_KeyValue: "I don't know what you are... But I'm not going along with this."

2313381322.m_KeyValue: ""Let's find the others... Together, we shall be invincible...""

2313382461.m_KeyValue: "No. She's been with our family for a long time now."

2313382462.m_KeyValue: "An Elder...? You mean the one replacing Baphomet?"

2313382467.m_KeyValue: "I haven't seen you for a while. I was concerned something had happened to you."

2313382468.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for the timely assistance. You must be... Miss Dalcarlo, from earlier on the deck.""

2313382469.m_KeyValue: ""You have a bad habit, my Empress. Always fixated on what's right in front of you... while ignoring the dangers that surround you.""

2313382470.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, go on, Aiona. What secret is that silly wolf hiding?""

2313382471.m_KeyValue: "Of course. She's part of the family and one of the Elders."

2313382472.m_KeyValue: ""You two know each other, Lady Empousa?""

2313382474.m_KeyValue: ""Do not forget, I'm a fortune teller. Foreseeing and avoiding danger is what I do best.""

2313383485.m_KeyValue: "I told you—you messed with the wrong person!"

2313383491.m_KeyValue: ""Return to me, Sheila. Rejoin me, and find the rest of our kin and reclaim the world that was always ours.""

2313383493.m_KeyValue: ""Remember your name, Sheila—and speak mine: Ranna.""

2313383494.m_KeyValue: ""We are kindred, Moonblessed—branded with the stigmata of Famine and Pestilence, cast out from our true homeland.""

2313383495.m_KeyValue: ""The Ganelon family sealed you away, did they? I see... they've tamed you like a lapdog.""

2313383496.m_KeyValue: "You leave me no choice. I'll have to devour you to complete our union—"

2313384639.m_KeyValue: "Speaking of resonance... What were you about to say about that silly wolf's identity? Why would she have the Black Blood disease?"

2313384640.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. And knowing Hati's temperament, she must have gone straight for the source.""

2313384643.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously, where did everyone run off to!""

2313384645.m_KeyValue: "That Black Blood resonance you mentioned? Same as the jellyfish girl?"

2313384646.m_KeyValue: "Ah... could it be those whispers again?"

2313384647.m_KeyValue: "Stay out of it! Every family's like this when it comes to siblings!"

2313384648.m_KeyValue: ""The Empress really should try getting along with her sisters, meow.""

2313384649.m_KeyValue: "Who knows? Maybe she ran off to find her precious little brother again."

2313384650.m_KeyValue: ""Not always. Lady Hati and her brother are quite close... Oh, why didn't she come with you?""

2313385663.m_KeyValue: ""Compared to your growth, this one's 'growth' seems far more troubling...""

2313385664.m_KeyValue: "It's getting bigger the more it eats! We have to stop it!"

2313385667.m_KeyValue: "Wait... I get it now! It transforms into what it eats! That's why it took on my form earlier!"

2313385668.m_KeyValue: "If I'm its child... Does that mean I'll learn to do that too?"

2313385669.m_KeyValue: "Why do you sound so excited to become... whatever that is?"

2313385670.m_KeyValue: "Now it all makes sense. My love of food... it's part of my growth!"

2313385672.m_KeyValue: ""Octo was food. After I ate it, I just happened to inherit its memories too.""

2313385673.m_KeyValue: "You truly are my child... Able to turn food into strength..."

2313386817.m_KeyValue: "The cabins are on this floor... but they went down."

2313386818.m_KeyValue: ""You think they're suspicious too, don't you?""

2313386819.m_KeyValue: "Um... I see you two are busy! I'll just take Mother back now!"

2313386820.m_KeyValue: "Now's really not the time for this..."

2313386821.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to escort you both back to your cabin."

2313386824.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, yes! That's right! We're just... lost passengers who wandered in by mistake!""

2313386825.m_KeyValue: "They look like normal passengers. Pretty sure I saw them near the bow earlier..."

2313387841.m_KeyValue: "You're right. They're not in Mouret. They're not even in this world. But I can still sense them."

2313387843.m_KeyValue: "That side of Mouret is long gone. You have no home left to return to."

2313387844.m_KeyValue: "If they're not here with me—then where could they be?"

2313387845.m_KeyValue: "But now... maybe being dumb isn't a bad thing."

2313387846.m_KeyValue: "Honestly? I didn't understand a single word you said. But I know one thing for sure. My family's not with you."

2313387847.m_KeyValue: ""Don't hesitate. Everything you've ever loved and longed for... is right here, with me.""

2313387848.m_KeyValue: ""...You know, lately everyone's been calling me a dumb wolf. At first, I didn't want to admit it...""

2313387849.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, Clive... I should make your dinner now...""

2313666104.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes. If these old bones would allow it, he would not hesitate.""

2313666105.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Captain Goldland... I leave the rest... to you.""

2313666106.m_KeyValue: "...All those touching words and you still killed him! You heartless demon!"

2313666107.m_KeyValue: "He's only unconscious. And not from our attacks. It was from the strain of wielding the Future Artifact. That drained all his strength."

2313666108.m_KeyValue: ""Those weird weapons of yours are Future Artifacts too, right? Why aren't you out cold?""

2313666109.m_KeyValue: ""I just said—the Church's research has advanced... Why am I explaining anything to you, a Bloodborn who will inevitably become my enemy?""

2313666110.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly, Mr. Van Helsing... Captain Goldland slipped away during the commotion. Shouldn't we pursue him?""

2313666111.m_KeyValue: "I believe he went to inform William—the true culprit. As for William's current whereabouts..."

2313666112.m_KeyValue: ""According to Miss Bathory, wasn't he just in the break room at the end of the hallway with Jones?""

2313666113.m_KeyValue: "If the person speaking with that armored man next door is the culprit you mentioned... Then he should still be there."

2313680253.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, wait! Are you defying the Captain's orders!? This man...""

2313680256.m_KeyValue: "And you call yourself a Silver Cross heretic hunter! You'd rather slander little Ami than go after the Bloodborn!"

2313680258.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, calm down! Let's hear Mr. Van Helsing's deduction first...""

2313680260.m_KeyValue: ""It must have been Miss Bathory! She admitted she was a Bloodborn, didn't she!?""

2313680261.m_KeyValue: "I once heard a bard say that Bloodborn could pass through walls to enter human homes and drink their blood! That's it—"

2313680262.m_KeyValue: "Walking through walls is just an unproven legend. Can you truly do that?"

2313680263.m_KeyValue: "The rope on the rudder! She must have done that too! It was all to lure me away so she could kill Aaron! It has to be her!"

2317135974.m_KeyValue: ""I wrenched myself free from Quinn's grasp, but dawn broke sooner than expected.""

2317136005.m_KeyValue: ""I chose to trust Quinn. Soon, the morning sun crested the horizon like a cautious flame, its first rays reaching toward us with unexpected gentleness.""

2318273449.m_KeyValue: "A tale as whimsical as any children's fable."

2318273450.m_KeyValue: ""Just then, a shooting star streaked across the sky above the Observatory. Only one person witnessed this fleeting marvel. Among the four now inside the Observatory, who could be that fortunate soul?""

2318273451.m_KeyValue: ""'All things have their own destiny. Even a falling star follows its fated trajectory, unrelated to us.' For once, our witch's words were remarkably lucid.""

2318273452.m_KeyValue: ""Many tragic tales transform into beautiful fairy tales when children are told only the beginning, with the cruel ending left untold.""

2318794745.m_KeyValue:
""After exchanging letters with Sirene, strange fragments of memory began to surface.
I saw miracles unfold on an ancient battlefield engulfed in fire and Black Blood. I watched as the crypt's heavy stone gates slammed shut, locking away the Bloodborn's wrath and despair along with a distant hope meant for the far-off future.
The memory ends there, but the feeling of that awakening still lingers in my chest.
What does it all mean...?""

2318794776.m_KeyValue:
""For Letitia, frequent contact with humanity proved a double-edged blessing.

Just as nature encompasses gentle breezes and soft rains, so too does it encompass raging torrents and towering waves; even the most virtuous souls harbor shadows within their hearts.

In time, _$$things that had never existed before_$$ began to stir within Letitia.

Anger, jealousy, greed... These dark aspects of human nature gradually seeped into Letitia's heart, filling her with unspeakable dread.

At last, she resolved to seal away _$$that version of herself_$$ forever.""

2320602591.m_KeyValue: ""Please enlighten me, how should a Bloodborn properly show respect to a Bell Ringer?""

2320602592.m_KeyValue: "I didn't ask you to reply with such a nauseating tone!"

2320602597.m_KeyValue: ""Most Honorable Bell Ringer, what troubles could have prompted you to grace me with your letter at this late hour?""

2320602598.m_KeyValue: "Shouldn't you at least show some respect to a Bell Ringer? Especially since you're a Bloodborn Heretic."

2320602599.m_KeyValue: ""Fine, I'll raid your hideout right now.""

2320602601.m_KeyValue: ""Before we resort to violence, let's discuss why you sent the letter.""

2320602602.m_KeyValue: "Get ready to be burned to charcoal."

2321336745.m_KeyValue: "Casting the right skills at the appropriate time may turn the tide of battle."

2321494961.m_KeyValue: "Give Extra Sermon in Moonlight Tribute {0} time(s)."

2321494967.m_KeyValue: "Make a purchase in General Store {0} time(s)."

2321716705.m_KeyValue: ""But damn it, what haven't I accomplished yet?!""

2321716706.m_KeyValue: ""I understand. If it's for the sake of freedom, I'll help you.""

2321716707.m_KeyValue: ""But Cain had to meddle, saying I can only leave if I solve his stupid puzzle.""

2321716708.m_KeyValue: ""The question is—I must prove that whatever my _$$sisters_$$ can do, I can do as well.""

2321716709.m_KeyValue: ""She buried a weapon beneath that tree, one powerful enough to end all of this.""

2321716710.m_KeyValue: ""That's why I must get out. Once I'm free, I'll claim the power No. 66 left behind and eliminate all of you who stand in my way.""

2321716712.m_KeyValue: ""That fool, No. 66, said before she died that if I ever got tired of this game, I should look for the great tree by the cliff at Howling Heights.""

2340288853.m_KeyValue: ""'Knock, knock! Is anyone here?' A clear, youthful voice rang out at the entrance of the hall. 'Oh, Morain and the old-timer are already here...'""

2340288854.m_KeyValue: ""'Are you sure those memories are really your own, old-timer? Because you...' Gilrain paused, deliberately scanning the cumbersome armor from top to bottom.""

2340288855.m_KeyValue: "His sincere recollection had a fatal allure that required neither the eloquent spin of a bard nor the stirring melody of a minstrel."

2340288859.m_KeyValue: ""At this point, all attendees of the meeting have gathered: a suit of armor, a shadow, a puppet, and a black cat.""

2340288860.m_KeyValue: ""'—Especially financial strength.' At this moment, Baphomet's posture was exceptionally straight, for he was the Puppet Association's biggest suc—ahem, most esteemed patron.""

2340289814.m_KeyValue: ""'Ever since I became an elder and you pushed that so-called memory-restoring medicine on me...' Gilrain trailed off, as if recalling something deeply uncomfortable. He fell silent for a moment.""

2340289815.m_KeyValue: ""'Baphomet, didn't you say this was the place where honor can be realized'? Sincerity and keeping one's word are part of honor, aren't they? How do you expect to restore our glory with this crooked merchant around?'""

2340289816.m_KeyValue: ""Only the black cat stirred, suddenly leaping from its seat to the floor. Its eyes blazed with fierce intensity as it fixed its gaze upon a particular section of the castle, a series of ominous, suppressed growls rumbling deep in its throat.""

2340289817.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—trained who? Gilrain just joined, Bella bought her way in and never lifted a finger, and that black cat...""

2340289818.m_KeyValue: "—To safeguard the future of the Bathorys!"

2340328054.m_KeyValue: ""'Our current location...' Bella rummaged through her bag and pulled out a map. 'We're within Bathory territory. If we go just a little farther, we should see—'""

2340328055.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't underestimate me!' At those words, Selena suddenly struck a pose, hands on hips, chest puffed out in pride. 'Even if I've been rejected 2,150 times—'""

2340328056.m_KeyValue: ""'Careful—' Before Bella could finish, the unwieldy octopus hat sent Selena sailing through the air. She spun gracefully—two and a half times, to be exact—before landing in the most improbable fashion:""

2340328057.m_KeyValue: ""'What do you mean!' Selena burst out, cutting Bella off with an animated wave of her hand. 'Prep Cook Bella, have you forgotten the oath we swore before we set out?'""

2340328060.m_KeyValue: ""'Such a pretty girl... and yet she's not the least bit soft... that really hurt!' Selena muttered in a half-whine and half-admiration, as she instinctively checked the pretty girl for injuries.""

2340328065.m_KeyValue: ""At those words, Selena lowered her head, and with it, the exaggerated octopus hat drooped, veiling her eyes. 'Lord Van Helsing once told me...'""

2340328066.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmm? Made up your mind about what...?' Bella tilted her head slightly, puzzled.""

2340329143.m_KeyValue: ""'Change into what?' Lamia asked, struggling to mask her fear as she met the Matriarch's gaze in the portrait—a chilling look that made her quiver.""

2340329144.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa was paralyzed with terror. Turning her head, she saw Lamia frozen in place. Without hesitation, she grabbed Lamia's hand and frantically dragged her out of the Hall of Opulence.""

2340329145.m_KeyValue: ""The two girls recoiled in shock, for this was the first time they had heard the portrait speak.""

2340329146.m_KeyValue: "'I don't know?' Cain smiled bitterly. 'Then allow me to tell you the origin of this painting.'"

2340329148.m_KeyValue: ""For only the second time in all his years, Cain, the epitome of composure, felt utterly powerless. Never before had he been mocked as 'ignorant,' yet now, the term fit with stinging accuracy!""

2340360726.m_KeyValue: ""'Not make a choice?' Bella echoed, clearly puzzled.""

2340360731.m_KeyValue: ""'Among the warriors of the major families, who actually has the greatest individual strength?' Bella asked with genuine curiosity.""

2340360732.m_KeyValue: ""'We'll employ Bloodline Transfusion to train exceptional warriors from other families, using their ancestral blood. Then, through the Embrace, we'll transform these warriors into Bloodborn.'""

2340366037.m_KeyValue: "_$$Refuse the very same Mario and Juliet that the editorial board of 'Minexus: A Brief History' declared one of the 'Seven Must-See Plays of a Lifetime'?!_$$"

2340432602.m_KeyValue: ""'Many of the prisoners were once high-ranking officials and noblemen, unable to endure the rancid food and foul water. Some succumbed to illness, while others chose to end their own lives.'""

2340432603.m_KeyValue: ""Noah's face flushed with embarrassment. 'My apologies,' he mumbled, turning back to beckon his companions.""

""As a reward for my long-standing patronage of the Puppet Association, Elder Bella unexpectedly and graciously shared a piece of intelligence with me.

Legend tells of an ancient ritual so abhorrent that even the Bloodborn, deemed it too brutal. This ritual demands a cursed spear, its blade soaked with the blood of 999 innocent souls, and the purest 'holy light'—a virtuous person of unshakable ideals. Through unspeakable torments, the ritual imprisons this person in a purgatory of agony, despair, and suffering. Their radiance is defiled, their ideals shattered, and their hope twisted into a cruel illusion. 2376798766.m_KeyValue: "Be it the year we grow up or the year we rise to fame—this promise will one day come true."

2376798774.m_KeyValue: ""Come with me. We're going after the fugitives, Noah and Ami.""

2376798775.m_KeyValue: "I've never implied anything. And your outfit... are you performing in a play?"

2376798776.m_KeyValue: ""Eleven years ago, humans helped us. Now, it is our turn to return the favor..""

2376798777.m_KeyValue: ""Noah and I defeated them before. Back then, I saw a string above their heads—one no one else could see. When we severed those strings, they collapsed, defeated.""

2376798779.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. We'll journey to new places, travel far, and you can play the music you cherish.""

2376798807.m_KeyValue: ""Without their blood, Joyce could barely control everyone and create Puppet Elysium on Sapphire Isle!""

2376798808.m_KeyValue: ""These devices are spread throughout the Isle, and their control center is this very ship! Once all the Siren's Tears gather here...""

2376798809.m_KeyValue: ""Betray Lord Isaac, and Joyce will ensure Miss Ami is returned to you. That's a promise!""

2376798810.m_KeyValue: "Joyce remembers every single puppet perfectly! Joyce gave each of them a unique name—that's how special bonds between friends are made!"

2376798811.m_KeyValue: "Where did it all go wrong? How did Joyce's perfect plan end up like this?"

2376798839.m_KeyValue: "That thing... it looks exactly like you..."

2376798840.m_KeyValue: ""Boom! Boom! The thunderous march of the puppet army, surging forth from the Isle to shield Joyce!""

2376798841.m_KeyValue: ""Return to the sea with your people, Lorelei. My longing will linger, as fireflies and stars, lighting your way home.""

2376798842.m_KeyValue: ""Had I made it to our meeting place eleven years ago, to warn you of the imprisoned sirens and urge you to flee the Isle... perhaps all the pain you suffered could have been avoided.""

2376798844.m_KeyValue: ""She is merely the No. 7 puppet, a vessel of implanted memory fragments, endlessly repeating the behavioral patterns her Master left behind.""

2376798863.m_KeyValue: "Now then… who shall debut my newest masterpiece?"

2376798864.m_KeyValue: "It was someone dressed like a puppet. Helped me rake in a fortune in just one night... Must be thanks to you wearing that promotional outfit all day!"

2376798870.m_KeyValue: "It's great to see Miss Ami back to her usual self."

2376798871.m_KeyValue: "What happened while I was unconscious? The Isle seems to have lost the unusual excitement it had when we first arrived."

2376798872.m_KeyValue: "Well... it was one of the former Sages."

2376798873.m_KeyValue: "Ami saved me! She even concerns about my head!"

2376798874.m_KeyValue: "A miracle like that actually exists? Where is this steward? We ought to buy out their entire stock and hoard it at the castle!"

2376798875.m_KeyValue: "How did you end up getting involved with that person?"

2376798876.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know, but I feel like this no longer concerns us.""

2376798901.m_KeyValue: ""In a single night, once-familiar elders had grown siren traits and begun tearing into their own kin.""

2376798902.m_KeyValue: "'I have to reach the meeting point. I must warn Lorelei—someone is hunting the sirens!'"

2376798903.m_KeyValue: ""If he had never entered that lab, none of this—his family, his friends, his home—would have been lost.""

2376798904.m_KeyValue: "Hallon believed the words in that mysterious letter. He could no longer save the Isle or its people. All he could trade for was the safety of a precious few."

2376798905.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine's cuts were precise, measured—blood was never his pursuit. And yet, today, a strange unease festered within him.""

2376798906.m_KeyValue: "'Are you the Mysterious Merchant I heard about?'"

2376798907.m_KeyValue: "'Come on. We’re getting out of here.'"

2376798908.m_KeyValue: "Myrtle heard beastly cries in the forest. She tried to flee the banquet with Isaac—only to find Averdin emerging from the layered shadows."

2379475428.m_KeyValue: ""For those who can't harness Black Blood, it's a curse; but for us, it's a source of power.""

2380039811.m_KeyValue: ""I know Gilrain's abilities... I'll find a way to hold him off. Ami, you head on first.""

2380039812.m_KeyValue: "Seth must have been heartbroken... watching her brothers fall by each other's hands."

2380039813.m_KeyValue: ""Then 'he' will take us to another world to live, die, and live again. Over and over.""

2380040831.m_KeyValue: "I even preserved their voices to keep you company on your final journey..."

2380040836.m_KeyValue: ""Are you mocking me? That no matter how far I reach for the 'truth', I'm still a mere mortal?""

2380040838.m_KeyValue: "Because I am the one who created the 'original Death'. I predate Death itself."

2381062425.m_KeyValue: "If you truly don't want to burden us… then help us."

2381062426.m_KeyValue: "Tell us their weaknesses and fight by our sides."

2381062427.m_KeyValue: "So you crossed over here… only to face it all alone?"

2381062428.m_KeyValue: "But this place is already being pulled into chaos. We can't stand by and watch."

2381062429.m_KeyValue: ""But when I saw you… Empousa, Aiona, Hati... When I saw you alive… all I could think of was keeping you safe.""

2381062430.m_KeyValue: "You shouldn't be dragged into a war that doesn't concern you."

2381062431.m_KeyValue: ""Well, look who grew a brain. Are you the dumb wolf from the Other Side?""

2381062432.m_KeyValue: "I came here seeking allies to fight with me."

2381062439.m_KeyValue: "No. They evolve without end. We can't defeat them alone."

2381062440.m_KeyValue: "What? Not even with you and Noah? Wasn't that the whole reason you came here?"

2381069980.m_KeyValue: ""It resembles the work of an alchemist, though… with current methods, animating a metal construct through liquid propulsion should be impossible.""

2381069989.m_KeyValue: "Could that strange fluid beneath the metal shell be its power source?"

2381069990.m_KeyValue: "Look what you've done to my stall... (sniff)... Can't you at least buy something to make up for the mess?"

2381069991.m_KeyValue: "I told you already—this isn't even my merchandise!"

2381069992.m_KeyValue: "Hey! You can't just put dangerous things up for sale like that!"

2381071137.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps I should use your true name—Madam Regina?"

2381071139.m_KeyValue: ""Please don't jest about such things! Lord Albrecht is an invincible, exalted Bell Ringer—he could never die!""

2381071140.m_KeyValue: ""They're quite right, you know... It's been far too long, Vice-Commander Piera.""

2381071141.m_KeyValue: "What? Albrecht's here too? Don't tell me… he's dead as well?"

2381071142.m_KeyValue: "It's all because of those spiders—they came out of nowhere and—What did you say? Lord Albrecht is dead?!"

2381071143.m_KeyValue: "That's enough. I am your Vice-Commander—Piera Paracelsus."

2381071144.m_KeyValue: ""Then please, Vice-Commander Piera—report this directly to Lord Albrecht!""

2382085131.m_KeyValue: "What—leaving me already? Do you think the same trick will work twice?!"

2382085132.m_KeyValue: ""My, you sure know how to please me. Spin them well, and perhaps I'll let you live until dawn.""

2382085133.m_KeyValue: ""He clawed for his lost past, but memory slipped away like morning mist—the tighter his grasp, the quicker it vanished.""

2382085134.m_KeyValue: "But tell me before you leave… who led you to that cabinet? Was it the red-haired woman?"

2382814087.m_KeyValue: ""Was I too gentle? They still live, and even that garlic beside them hasn't completely withered...""

2382814088.m_KeyValue: "This place again... Who have I become this time?"

2383376785.m_KeyValue: "I simply don't make a habit of airing others' secrets."

2383376786.m_KeyValue: ""A deafening roar split the heavens, and the prison lurched as though the earth itself had bucked. The walls trembled, the ground convulsed, and prisoners ducked low, scattering for shelter.""

2383376787.m_KeyValue: "I'd say they overestimate the value of sight."

2384575502.m_KeyValue: ""As salt crystallizes, it entombs the dying Blood Beasts of the island. These jagged formations rise like coffins across the desolate isle—both sanctuary and sustenance for the decaying remains.""

2384575503.m_KeyValue: ""As salt crystallizes, it entombs the dying Blood Beasts of the island. These jagged formations rise like coffins across the desolate isle—both sanctuary and sustenance for the decaying remains.""

2384575511.m_KeyValue: ""Once a mere rat feasting on the dead, the Black Blood's influence forced a grotesque mutation, crowning it as the ruler of Starfall Valley.""

2384575512.m_KeyValue: "They say bloodthirsty sirens dwell on Sapphire Isle. Could it really be true?"

2384575577.m_KeyValue: ""Humanoid weapon enhanced by the Church through physical modification, wielding heavy hammers to crush evil.""

2384575578.m_KeyValue: ""A beast from distant lands, rumored to be an alchemical accident.""
