2384575581.m_KeyValue: ""Silver Blood forged her into the immortal embodiment of Ironfist Gaol. When darkness falls, she leads prisoners who violate time into the interrogation chambers, conducting judgment in the name of scriptures. Yet only she knows that she is the one truly imprisoned by eternity.""

2384575598.m_KeyValue: "A humanoid creature encountered in the Ashen Garden. Their partial mutation reveals the chilling truth behind the catastrophe in Mouret Town."

2384575606.m_KeyValue: ""A junior monk of the Tempus Church, tasked with meting out punishment to those deviating from the Church's precepts. Their methods are notoriously brutal, often surpassing those deployed against heretics.""

2384575607.m_KeyValue: ""A Divine Body guarded by the Paracelsus for generations. Its true form and whereabouts a mystery, as is the Sunset Isle itself. Yet all Gravekeepers believe that for a thousand years, it has sealed the Calamity _$$Death._$$ It's the Divine Body closest to Aeon's own will.""

2384575672.m_KeyValue: ""With the fall of the former ruler Zagon, a vicious rat-like Blood Beast swiftly seized power, becoming the new sovereign of Starfall Valley. Though it still bears traces of Zagon, years of mineral corrosion have eroded all remnants of its former grandeur.""

2384777950.m_KeyValue: "Don't forget 'that person' was the one who put him here. It won't look good if he dies on us."

2384777953.m_KeyValue: "But how should I communicate with them..."

2384777954.m_KeyValue: "A hole... What's inside? You're trying to escape?!"

2384777955.m_KeyValue: ""Come, join us beneath the waves. Let the sea be our burial ground...""

2384777982.m_KeyValue: ""Really now… We all agreed to come here for a vacation, yet somehow, it still turned into a mission…""

2384777983.m_KeyValue: "<color=#be79a6>Everyone has seen the evidence of that woman's betrayal.</color>"

2384777985.m_KeyValue: ""Keep an eye out for 'dark, damp places where no light reaches.'""

2384777986.m_KeyValue: ""The beautiful, kind, and lovely Miss Ami—""

2384778246.m_KeyValue: "It's such a shame Empousa and Hati aren't here..."

2384778247.m_KeyValue: ""That anticipation of finding family, that thirst for truth, somehow—""

2384778249.m_KeyValue: ""How dare you…! You're mocking me, aren't you?! Guards, teach her a lesson!""

2384778250.m_KeyValue: ""Since it's your request, I suppose I can take a look.""

2384778251.m_KeyValue: ""I won't reveal my identity to a <style=""Highlight"">Bloodborn</style>, even if you just helped me...""

2384778252.m_KeyValue: "It's a long story... but I can't tell you right now!"

2384778272.m_KeyValue: "I think there might be some misunderstanding between you two."

2384778273.m_KeyValue: "So this is how an 'auction' works as a way of trading..."

2384778278.m_KeyValue: ""However, even the seemingly perfect Sapphire Isle has its dark rumors...""

2384778279.m_KeyValue: ""Show this custom Isle coin, then you'll have free access to all facilities and stalls here.""

2384778280.m_KeyValue: "This is—a gift from family. I'm not sure about its craftsmanship either."

2384778282.m_KeyValue: ""Um, well, the figure on the statue looks pretty impressive.""

2384778283.m_KeyValue: ""We were having so much fun, I completely forgot to ask about the auction... Come to think of it, what is this 'auction' anyway?""

2384778284.m_KeyValue: ""It incorporates 'proximity-based vibration feedback,' 'surface groove information storage,' and—""

2384778285.m_KeyValue: ""The mysterious legends are one of Sapphire Isle's selling points, you know. The isle has many places with little touches like this.""

2384778310.m_KeyValue: "The incense burned out... Where did Aiona and Ami go?"

2384778312.m_KeyValue: "It's nothing... it's just that you've never told me bedtime stories before..."

2384778313.m_KeyValue: ""Hey Ami, that's the kitchen, not the Captain's study.""

2384778342.m_KeyValue: "And... this Mistbound Terror sounds like the figure I saw in my dream last night..."

2384778343.m_KeyValue: "I told Master I'd keep an eye on you... Are you both alright?"

2384778344.m_KeyValue: ""There are rumors that the latest victim was investigating something on the Isle, and going around asking strange questions...""

2384778345.m_KeyValue: "It's just... it's been a long time since I've recalled those memories."

2384778346.m_KeyValue: ""As a matter of fact, it was Michel Savich who went missing yesterday after some several minor conflicts with you.""

2384778348.m_KeyValue: "Why trouble a Bell Ringer over such a trivial matter?"

2384778349.m_KeyValue: ""Food loses its flavor and spoils if not eaten, clothes fade and lose their luster if not worn, and money, if not spent—though I suppose I don't have much money to begin with...""

2384778374.m_KeyValue: "Something's wrong... I... have no strength at all... I can't feel my legs..."

2384778378.m_KeyValue: "How can I escape from this place?"

2384778379.m_KeyValue: "Why don't you join us on vacation? We could revisit some old memories."

2384778380.m_KeyValue: "Is this a test from Master Van Helsing?"

2384778406.m_KeyValue: "In my dream last night... I also saw monsters with unique appearances that vanished after being defeated."

2384778407.m_KeyValue: "That's possible. But the way the 'Mistbound Terror' went to such lengths to leave those marks at the scene... I feel there must be more to it..."

2384778408.m_KeyValue: ""I've uncovered your secret—all seven of you—about those slaves imprisoned in dark, damp places where no light reaches. If you don't want me to tell everyone, leave the money in the basket outside the Black Ram Tavern.""

2384778409.m_KeyValue: ""It can't be anything important. Silver-haired, you read it.""

2384778410.m_KeyValue: "This victim has bite marks on their neck too..."

2384778411.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, I conducted a thorough investigation. I'm not here on vacation.""

2384778412.m_KeyValue: "You... you stepped on me! I never should have brought you along..."

2384778413.m_KeyValue: ""I want to know about the travelers who disappeared in the isle, and the 'Mistbound Terror.'""

2384778436.m_KeyValue: ""No! From the very beginning, it was Noah who claimed to be Master Van Helsing's friend. Perhaps he had already seen through you... I'm the only one who fell for your lies!""

2384778437.m_KeyValue: "The Siren's Tear? Where did they go?!"

2384778439.m_KeyValue: ""Not just in Sapphire Isle, but across all of Minexus.""

2384778440.m_KeyValue: ""You rebuilt a ruined Isle, bringing prosperity and wealth to this place. A truly remarkable achievement.""

2384778441.m_KeyValue: "Those people... you got rid of all of them?"

2384778442.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, and since what we need to discuss is rather private, I suggest everyone else take their leave.""

2384778443.m_KeyValue: "I thought that sculpture... had artistic value."

2384810832.m_KeyValue: "Purchase <color=#F0CB9A>[Bundle Name]</color> to obtain the following rewards."

2384810833.m_KeyValue: "Purchase <color=#F0CB9A>[Bundle Name]</color> to obtain the following rewards."

2387185541.m_KeyValue: "I placed the construct gently on my shoulder. And together—with Stella—we watched the fireworks bloom across the divide between worlds."

2387804356.m_KeyValue: "A night at the dock when ravens shadowed the sky."

2387804453.m_KeyValue: "The season lillies go in full bloom."

2387804519.m_KeyValue: "The day of being adopted by Tris."

2388356582.m_KeyValue: ""Ami, I found your missing drawing. Shall we meet at the castle? I’ll return the sketchbook—complete this time.""

2388356584.m_KeyValue: ""(Now that I think about it, that mutated enemy was clutching this drawing… Even in death, they wouldn't let it go.)""

2388356585.m_KeyValue: ""(Goldland, Bob, Aaron, William… and all the sailors.)""

2388356586.m_KeyValue: "(So the missing page showed everyone gathered aboard the El Dorado.)"

2388356587.m_KeyValue: ""By the coast, Ami's lost sketchbook was reclaimed from a mutated enemy.""

2388356588.m_KeyValue: "Keeping silent? I suppose I’ll see for myself once I find it."

2388356590.m_KeyValue: "Then maybe you could start by telling me what the drawing was?"

2389120580.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, are you unwell? You're worse than before.""

2389120674.m_KeyValue: ""Without another word, Seraphina leaves the arena.""

2389120676.m_KeyValue: "…Then perhaps we should settle this with combat."

2389120678.m_KeyValue: ""I just arrived. The winds were favorable today, so I flew a little faster than usual.""

2391147409.m_KeyValue: "He would never abandon his companions to face peril alone."

2391147410.m_KeyValue: ""Selena leans close to the skylight and lets out a long, lilting whistle.""

2391290179.m_KeyValue: ""The Bloodborn have their own tenets, just as pirates have their own code. Please read them carefully.""

2391290180.m_KeyValue: "Let's see what's written on the next page."

2391290181.m_KeyValue: "Be careful! The traps on this ship are even more cunning than tricks from 'The Devil.'"

2391290182.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry though, I've left hints in every stage. Feel free to check them when you lose your way.""

2393001158.m_KeyValue: ""Thus, to escape the burden of thinking and the responsibility it brings, humans created gods to bear the weight of their thoughts.""

2394450518.m_KeyValue: "They're here too. And they've brought some new friends."

2394450519.m_KeyValue: "The noise—it's coming from the storage room."

2394450526.m_KeyValue: "It's true that each of the twelve families guards a Divine Body within their territory."

2394450527.m_KeyValue: "Or... under the supernatural influence of a Divine Body."

2394450529.m_KeyValue: "But their supernatural nature is not something outsiders like you should be privy to..."

2394450530.m_KeyValue: "Then I might need a moment to consider..."

2394450531.m_KeyValue: "And what if I told you I didn't just hear about it—I experienced it myself?"

2394450533.m_KeyValue: ""Whether to force the truth out of you, or keep searching Goldland's journals for the answer.""

2394451542.m_KeyValue: ""Was that my imagination... Did that fish barrel just move? The fish must be fresh, but more importantly...""

2394451543.m_KeyValue: "A blue jewel? It feels like I've seen it somewhere before..."

2394451551.m_KeyValue: ""When I came down here with Ami, this floor was in far better shape. The Blood Beasts must have torn through after we left.""

2394451552.m_KeyValue: ""The stairs have collapsed, and the fire's spreading fast... Van Helsing was right—we should have taken the other route.""

2394451553.m_KeyValue: "Still... I can't get that tentacle out of my head. The one that dragged William's body—it must've reached down from this storage room."

2394451554.m_KeyValue: ""Let's search quickly for any clues, then regroup with the others.""

2394451555.m_KeyValue: ""Of course it wouldn't be that simple, would it?""

2394451556.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll let my blade do the talking."

2394451557.m_KeyValue: "They're closing in from every direction... Why are they avoiding that spot?"

2394452696.m_KeyValue: ""I promised we wouldn't let Famine devour that girl. That was my agreement with the Captain, meow.""

2394452702.m_KeyValue: "I feel... weak. Lightheaded... like when I first boarded..."

2394452705.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the fate that awaits this Chariot, 'burning' is its final mission.""

2394452706.m_KeyValue: ""Calamity-level Black Blood leaves mortals no choice. You'd better be careful, meow.""

2394452707.m_KeyValue: "Whoa... That walking suit of armor has joined the followers?"

2394452708.m_KeyValue: "I'm certain. That's why they're stationed here—to guard this place."

2394452709.m_KeyValue: "Are we even going the right way? You're sure you saw that weird sailor lead people into the captain's quarters?"

2394453720.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, Jacintha, you're supposed to be strong! Why did you charge in first without saving that jellyfish girl?""

2394453721.m_KeyValue: "Ending Famine in its incomplete state wouldn't be difficult. But ensuring The Hermit's survival would be... Especially since she's already halfway merged..."

2394453726.m_KeyValue: ""Strangely, as time passed, I found myself thinking less of whether the Divine Bodies remained, and more of what wonders might await us at the next shore.""

2394453727.m_KeyValue: ""Behold! The howling tempest! The surging waves! A breathtaking vista, gifted to us by the sea itself!""

2394453728.m_KeyValue: ""The Heart once kept by the Carrelle family was destroyed in a great fire, yet I stood among blooming fields in eternal spring.""

2394453729.m_KeyValue: ""Next, we set course for the Howling Peninsula, where the Womb is guarded by the Ganelon family, and the Wings by the Bathorys.""

2394453730.m_KeyValue: ""Let him go! Ami, are you alright?!""

2394453731.m_KeyValue: "No one shall interfere with our great mistress's rebirth."

2394453732.m_KeyValue: ""Look upon these carved windowpanes, this crest of the sirens—treasures left to us by our noble bloodline!""

2394453733.m_KeyValue: "What an honor it is... to have such a worthy audience bear witness to the glorious rebirth of our mistress—Ranna!"

2394454874.m_KeyValue: "You're not the only one with a 'final measure.'"

2394454875.m_KeyValue: "Your final moment is still a long way off."

2394454878.m_KeyValue: "The physical toll is too great. No one's ever survived using it twice in one day."

2394454879.m_KeyValue: "Do I use the metamorphosis again? I was saving it for Famine."

2394454880.m_KeyValue: "But if there's no other choice... Then you'll be my final measure."

2394454881.m_KeyValue: "Now I understand why they call it by its other name. Whether I use it or not... death waits on both sides."

2394454882.m_KeyValue: "Out of my way—I'm not here for you! It's your master I'm after!"

2394454883.m_KeyValue: ""You may bring thousands to their knees again and again... But so long as adventurers still draw breath, there'll always be one who rises to meet you.""

2394454884.m_KeyValue: "We're out of ammunition… and they just keep coming. There's no time left to hesitate."

2394454885.m_KeyValue: "As expected from a Calamity's servant… their regeneration is relentless."

2394455898.m_KeyValue: ""That voice... It sounds like Miss Ami, but how...?""

2394455899.m_KeyValue: "The Landis ritual has completed. Famine has devoured Ami—and now it's whole."

2394455902.m_KeyValue: "Even if you're really cool and strong... stealing's still wrong!"

2394455903.m_KeyValue: "What else do you want from this ship? Gems? That golden statue? The helm?"

2394455904.m_KeyValue: "...This isn't the time to talk about that."

2394455906.m_KeyValue: ""So Jacintha, you were here to protect that jellyfish girl from the start—because of a deal!?""

2394455907.m_KeyValue: "Bella made the deal with Goldland. I simply benefited from it. But as for the kitten..."

2394455908.m_KeyValue: "What I truly desire? I won't trade for it. I'll steal it."

2394455909.m_KeyValue: "Ah... So all those cat burglar sightings in the castle were..."

2394457052.m_KeyValue: "You knew all along?! Why didn't you act? Why didn't you try to change anything?!"

2394457053.m_KeyValue: "So I've known about everything you mentioned for quite some time."

2394457054.m_KeyValue: "I found the Captain's diary. And after a few conversations with Jack... I confirmed it all."

2394457055.m_KeyValue: ""Apparently, I'm the only one on this ship who remembers his name. That seemed strange, so I started digging.""

2394457057.m_KeyValue: "I've known Jack for a long time. I know he wouldn't lie."

2394457058.m_KeyValue: "No need to explain all that. Ami's still young—barely fifty. She's only just met you all. No wonder she can't accept what you're saying."

2394457059.m_KeyValue: ""Eh? That's your question...? Well, that's, uh...""

2394457060.m_KeyValue: ""I don't understand. If there were thirteen Moonblessed, why are there only twelve great families?""

2394457061.m_KeyValue: "Of course you don't! None of us did at first! The Church feared the power of the Ancestors—so they named them Calamities. They made us turn our blades against our own kind."

2394457086.m_KeyValue: "She's one of the Church's Bell Ringers. No. X: Acappella."

2394457090.m_KeyValue: ""But since you're about to blow, how about I help you cool off?""

2394457091.m_KeyValue: ""The hymns of the temple, a requiem for the departed.""

2394457093.m_KeyValue: ""You're the one who wrecked my barrel back in the kitchen! Looking at you now, all beaten and bloated with rage… I can't even stay mad.""

2395467487.m_KeyValue: ""Then we are comrades on the same front, right?""

2395467488.m_KeyValue: "I want to become the new god."

2395467495.m_KeyValue: ""The people of Sapphire Isle are kind, but they're all so dull.""

2395467496.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it truly is an option worth considering."

2395467497.m_KeyValue: ""One look at Uncle Rudolf's expression tells me whether he's pretending everything's fine after arguing with his wife, or genuinely happy about a good catch.""

2395467498.m_KeyValue: "One look at Father's morning expression tells me if he had salted cod with bread for breakfast or secretly drank an extra beer."

2395467499.m_KeyValue: "But I don't want this world to see through me."

2395467500.m_KeyValue: ""Dull people have strings attached to them—even without someone pulling those strings, you can easily see what they'll do and how their future will unfold.""

2395467501.m_KeyValue: "I too want to win the game against the gods."

2395467502.m_KeyValue: ""I refuse to accept that my life, future, and death are all foreseen by someone who calls themselves god.""

2396963098.m_KeyValue: ""Among the scattered papers, I found a refund slip from the pharmacy.""

2396996859.m_KeyValue: ""In my mailbox, I found a worn, unfamiliar book—apparently once a well-known folktale.""

2397068857.m_KeyValue:
""Dear Sir/Madam,

I trust this letter finds you well. I'm writing to seek your assistance in procuring an organ for the Church choir. The instrument must be capable of perfectly rendering pieces in G minor. Should you know of such an instrument's whereabouts, I would be most grateful if you could inform me of its value.

This matter is of utmost importance, and I earnestly seek your aid. Your favorable response would be met with profound gratitude.

I await your reply with sincere anticipation.

Yours faithfully, Anna""

2397281387.m_KeyValue:
""When I entered Hati's room, the sight before me stirred something deep within—

The walls, floor, blankets, and table... every surface that could hold ink was covered with her messages of greetings and gratitude.

_$$Why... are you here?_$$

Facing her unease, I concealed my concern and calmly asked about her reasons for doing this.

Perhaps due to her continuous use of Homecoming, she looked terribly worn, but I could see her usual stubbornness in her eyes: _$$I'm waiting for his response!_$$""

2397281670.m_KeyValue: ""As for the castle staff—this wasn't the kindly cook of fairy tales. Among the servants, she’s known for her bitter tongue and love of gossip. After Hilda's falling out with Duke Reese II, the cook tried to arrange a marriage between Hilda and her own son, the village butcher. When Hilda refused, the woman turned vindictive, spreading malicious rumors. If Hilda truly took her own life, then this woman surely played a part. I've decided to investigate further.""

2397281918.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland once told me of a place bathed in golden sunlight, where trade flourished and the people of Landis warmly welcomed every visitor to their island. It was during one of these adventures that Goldland formed a friendship with the Landis people. Yet beneath this prosperity, the Landis people harbored a secret worry—the rising sea levels loomed over their family like a storm cloud that would never dissipate.""

2398550508.m_KeyValue: ""I turned to find a corpse by the desk—a well-dressed body, its face frozen in a gruesome expression.""

2398573166.m_KeyValue:
""It was a rainy night, the Lupine Forest drenched in a downpour unseen for decades. Clive Jr. was born into such an unsettling night, where conspiracy and chaos shattered the happy, complete family he might have had.
The roar of thunder drowned out his feeble cries. But by some fortune, he met Clive. Clive Jr. once told me that, though the memory was faint, he still recalled an embrace—
one that reeked of blood, cold and hard, much like the role Clive would play in his life for many years to come.""

2398573259.m_KeyValue: ""The well-preserved ship's log chronicles every day of sailing since the El Dorado first set sail. Whether major events or minor occurrences, as long as it happened aboard the ship, Goldland recorded it all... or did he?""

2398573325.m_KeyValue:
""I've heard much about the profound bond between Clive and Gadric. But only after seeing the full shape of their story did I realize—that what they shared was more than mere friendship; it was something far more intricate.
This explains Clive's extraordinary trust in Gadric. And Gadric never once betrayed that trust—even after Clive transformed into a beast.""

2398573414.m_KeyValue:
""Seeing Piera again left me breathless. I had believed her lost forever to the Sunset Isle—that our last farewell would truly be final. Yet here she stands before me. Who has given her form this time?

Though I understand nothing of how it came to pass, Piera radiates a joy I never dared imagine possible.

For her, every moment beyond Sunset Isle is a gift stolen from time itself.

But now that her mission has ended, perhaps I should call her by her true name.

Regina.""

2400053633.m_KeyValue: "Can he truly revive the Bathory family with such a 'body'?"

2401313536.m_KeyValue: "Though his expression was undiscernable—for he had none—Baphomet's joy was evident from the tone of his words."

2401313537.m_KeyValue: "'I'm pleased you've noticed such details. It shows you hold our past meetings in high regard.'"

2401313538.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain glanced around. 'Why aren't we meeting in the usual place?'"

2401313543.m_KeyValue: ""'...Uh, the last meeting was outdoors. That's kind of hard to miss—anyone with eyes would remember'—but eyes was precisely something Baphomet did not have.""

2401527700.m_KeyValue: ""When applied, deals {1} ATK (P. DMG) to a random target within {0} meters. After reaching {2} stack(s), converts into {4} sec of Paralysis.""

2402376159.m_KeyValue: ""Well, that's no different from being killed.""

2402376160.m_KeyValue: "There is a way... but we'd have to return to the Sealed Altar."

2402376165.m_KeyValue: "And the Blood Servants on the island...?"

2402376166.m_KeyValue: "There is no such division. All things unfold as they must."

2402376167.m_KeyValue: "You have... so many memories... my head is bursting..."

2402376170.m_KeyValue: ""So I just keep fighting, battle after battle, thinking 'maybe one day a strong foe can put me out of my misery.'""

2402376171.m_KeyValue: "I can hardly remember... has the sky ever been this blue?"

2402376172.m_KeyValue: ""I despise what I've become—cowardly, weak, useless...""

2402377190.m_KeyValue: "Those tracks... no mortal could have left such marks."

2402377192.m_KeyValue: ""But as an external member of the Silver Cross, you are certainly in a position to do so.""

2402377195.m_KeyValue: "Our objective is clear: completely eradicate all mutated. Restraint is no longer required."

2402377196.m_KeyValue: ""Before them, a wall of black mist rises to the sky, stretching without end like an ancient barrier no mortal gaze can pierce.""

2402402725.m_KeyValue: "You've already surrendered the very key to your torment and ecstasy."

2402721278.m_KeyValue: ""A city that once basked in splendor, its prosperity celebrated in countless verses. Yet after a mysterious catastrophe, all wealth and glory crumbled to dust. Even now, travelers passing through the ruins can still hear echoes of those forgotten songs drifting through the crumbling stones.""

2403359996.m_KeyValue: "Even such a narrative should have faded into oblivion."

2403359997.m_KeyValue: ""In this long and endless time, I am willing to give up my body, consciousness, soul, everything.""

2403360005.m_KeyValue: ""In this long and endless time, I'm willing to sacrifice my body, consciousness, soul, and everything to become—""

2403360006.m_KeyValue: ""A mirage is just an illusion, Lady Empousa. It can't create a tangible object.""

2403360007.m_KeyValue: "I don't wanna start a pointless argument. Let's get away from these monsters first."

2403360036.m_KeyValue: ""The Church has departed... while the others remain in the void, consumed by time...""

2403360039.m_KeyValue: "Are you going to leave by yourself again?"

2403360068.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... I, we, all believe in you...""

2403360069.m_KeyValue: "You are 'Aiona'... Aiona Alita... that is your name..."

2403360070.m_KeyValue: ""But you forgot, you are me, and I am you.""

2403360074.m_KeyValue: ""Today we recite this poem here, to spread his name across the world...""

2403360075.m_KeyValue: ""What a strange thing to ask. Did you hit your head? Of course we're in Minexus. This is Plankrich, an island city belonging to the Carrelle family of the Church. Were you not born on this continent?""

2404463321.m_KeyValue: ""There appears to be little of scholarly interest here. Still, prudence demands a more thorough examination.""

2406931113.m_KeyValue: "I-it hurts…! Please… gentler… punish me slow… nghhh… (heavy panting)"

2407866835.m_KeyValue: ""To truly love one's fate and embrace oneself, that is the greatest courage of all.""

2407869844.m_KeyValue: "No one has ever been this kind to me... Thank you for giving me a place to return to."

2407870003.m_KeyValue: "Have I earned the right to live?"

2407877674.m_KeyValue: ""As a slave to music, I can finally dance without end.""

2407877705.m_KeyValue: "In the future... I wish to show you the dance steps hidden deep within my memories."

2407878540.m_KeyValue: "I never thought I'd care for someone else like this..."

2407879848.m_KeyValue: ""Well, there goes my excuse for slacking off...""

2407879879.m_KeyValue: ""I never imagined it would be you by my side... No, I'm glad it is you.""

2407880714.m_KeyValue: "This devotion could bring the world to ruin. And it's all yours to take."

2407880873.m_KeyValue: "Hush… feel my presence with your body."

2407882022.m_KeyValue: "My body seems to be growing restless..."

2407882053.m_KeyValue: "This strange impulse in my heart... What could it be?"

2407882888.m_KeyValue: ""Promise me you'll stay safe, okay? I couldn't bear to see your wounds.""

2408049770.m_KeyValue: ""Making his father spend the rest of his life bedridden, living each day in constant fear of revenge... I must say, this method...""

2408049771.m_KeyValue: "Again? I came to find the letter—ran into the supposedly bedridden Duke entering the study."

2410922639.m_KeyValue: "So the silver-haired thief did leave it behind..."

2410922641.m_KeyValue: "That's enough. I don't even know who you are. Why should I tell you anything?"

2411472569.m_KeyValue: "The bone serpent...!? Then Ruthven is one of the traitors?! Then the last must be..."

2411472570.m_KeyValue: "Determination. Honor. All wiped clean by your beloved Church."

2411472571.m_KeyValue: ""How pitiful—you've lost your mind, your will. Now you're nothing more than a puppet, dancing on the Church's strings.""

2411472572.m_KeyValue: "Is it really safe to leave Theophane alone against that many?"

2411473591.m_KeyValue: "I told you—your tricks won't work on me."

2411473593.m_KeyValue: "That life shouldn't end in oblivion—but return to its source. To be embraced again by _$$Mother._$$"

2411473594.m_KeyValue: "Why keep such power hidden? What a waste."

2411473595.m_KeyValue: "Are we really the first ones here?"

2411853521.m_KeyValue: ""Once Channeling is complete, the Crystal deals strong DMG to all enemies and unleashes a circular wave of ice blades, dealing P. DMG to any enemy hit. Destroying the Frost Crystal will interrupt this attack.""

DMG) to enemies in a circle.""

2413784538.m_KeyValue:
""Talent: <link=""Tips_ID;10""><#508499><u>Effective Range</u></color></link>.
<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>. Upon completion, sprays acid forward, dealing <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (P. DMG) to enemies in a straight line.""

Valora gains immunity to all control effects and <link=""Tips_ID;6""><#508499><u>rushes</u></color></link> toward the farthest or selected enemy on Ludgard, dealing <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (P. Each rush during her Ultimate leaves Hellfire on the ground for {8} sec, dealing <style=""Highlight"">{9}</style> ATK (P. DMG) to enemies within range once every 1.5 sec.""

2415860162.m_KeyValue: "Is someone trying to accelerate the disease...?"

2415860164.m_KeyValue: ""To understand why, we first need to figure out how.""

2415860165.m_KeyValue: ""Wolfsbane's the only thing keeping them alive, right? Don't you think its sudden disappearance is a little too convenient?""

2415860167.m_KeyValue: "We can't be sure yet. But the infected will eventually need it."

2415860168.m_KeyValue: "Let's search the area. The truth might be right under our feet."

2415861308.m_KeyValue: ""It is my sworn duty. She holds remarkable promise. Given time, she will become a leader worthy of guiding this house.""

2415861309.m_KeyValue: ""Cain, see to the young lady's education. More effort is required.""

2415861314.m_KeyValue: ""Should the Long Night one day falter… the young lady will be of age. When that time comes, she'll be the one to decide.""

2415861315.m_KeyValue: "These rituals are but poison to slake our thirst. What the Bloodborn seek is eternal night—not this fleeting shroud that may not survive the dawn."

2415861316.m_KeyValue: "Should our butler of questionable origins continue to fail... then human sacrifice will be our only recourse."

2415861317.m_KeyValue: ""Half a year? Since the Long Night descended, both the Howling Peninsula and the Lupine Forest have withered.""

2415861318.m_KeyValue: ""I've just acquired some exquisite new Vassals. Shall I offer them up for your amusement, Elders?""

2415861319.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, come now. Are we really throwing the family into chaos over one little commoner from Ganelon?""

2415861320.m_KeyValue: "I've said it before. Only those of true Bathory blood may inherit the family's crown. None but Limine is worthy."

2415861321.m_KeyValue: ""The young lady again... The old master is dead. And you, Valora, you now hold the reins of authority. Why not claim the mantle yourself? Surely... no one would dare object.""

2415865664.m_KeyValue: ""They were doomed, rotting away like worms. I gave them meaning! I gave them a glorious end... For Ganelon!""

2415865665.m_KeyValue: "Why must you paint me a villain?"

2415865666.m_KeyValue: ""Why? (coughing) You claimed to fight for us... But in the end, you sacrificed your own... turned them into beasts!""

2415865667.m_KeyValue: "I thought the tales were just stories... that Ganelon blood awakened only to defend our land..."

2415865668.m_KeyValue: "He used Johannes and the infected... to build himself an army. To win his vile war."

2415865669.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight’s full moon, those coincidental mutations... Ezareth meant to weaponize the Ganelon blood.""

2415865670.m_KeyValue: ""James, you wouldn't know... but when exposed to the full moon, the Ganelon bloodline can trigger a violent frenzy. It's said to awaken incredible strength.""

2415865672.m_KeyValue: "I didn't want to believe anyone could do this... Not to their own people."

2416566985.m_KeyValue: ""To be precise, they are connected to restoring the power of the Bathorys and the Bloodborn.""

2416566986.m_KeyValue: ""Help me reclaim my memories, so I may discover who I truly am.""

2418380340.m_KeyValue: "Found a pearl in an oyster! Lucky work day!"

2419169175.m_KeyValue: ""I have been sleeping through countless ages—so long that I am now but a forgotten name in history, dusty and neglected.""

2419169176.m_KeyValue: "...Yet perhaps this resolve of mine serves no purpose at all."

2419169179.m_KeyValue: "I know you have become Bathory's new master."

2419169180.m_KeyValue: ""Valora turned to face me directly, her gaze piercing through me with an overwhelming, suffocating presence.""

2419169181.m_KeyValue: ""Loss and loneliness—for the first time, I glimpsed these shadows dwelling within Valora's heart.""

2419169182.m_KeyValue: ""I do not acknowledge you as my master. We may become companions, if you will it—but my loyalty is not yours to claim.""

2419169183.m_KeyValue: ""In the time since my awakening, I have come to understand the essence of the great upheavals that have swept across this continent.""

2419169184.m_KeyValue: "A true knight transcends the crude brutality of mere weapon-wielding."

2420092556.m_KeyValue: "Which means the Church must have eradicated the Bloodborn entirely."

2420092557.m_KeyValue: ""Since the Holy War ended, no reports have surfaced of Bloodborn hunting humans in the Howling Peninsula.""

2420092564.m_KeyValue: "...The Hall of the Elders still endures?"

2420092565.m_KeyValue: "Wait... the letter was addressed to the old master's private post."

2420092567.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me… you're the new master of House Bathory?"

2420092568.m_KeyValue: ""Merely an old friend, long wandering in exile. Pay me no mind.""

2420092570.m_KeyValue: "It's just... I never expected a reply."

2421017395.m_KeyValue: "Increase Affinity gained by Vassals invited to the Council Chamber."

2421017396.m_KeyValue: "Increase Affinity gained by Vassals invited to the Council Chamber."

2421017397.m_KeyValue: "Wilderness Expedition: Number of destinations increased to 5."

2422121007.m_KeyValue: "At least the Church didn't mention anything else."

2422122030.m_KeyValue: "Something's wrong... I think this place is about to collapse!"

2422492707.m_KeyValue: ""You spoke of a thousand victories—you meant those in the arena, yes?""

2422492708.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps such tales are not without foundation."

2422643682.m_KeyValue: "The delicate verse she left behind was the only trace of her nocturnal visit."

2423582604.m_KeyValue: ""Three nights from now, at the stroke of midnight—Lupine Forest.""

2423582612.m_KeyValue: "Risking your life in combat—that's what makes it a duel."

2423582613.m_KeyValue: ""Of late, there are no foes in the Silver Cross worth risking my life for. It maddens me.""

2423582614.m_KeyValue: "I don't think I'm worth risking your life on."

2423582616.m_KeyValue: "You're a Bloodborn and your skills in battle are worthy. I would risk my life for such an opponent."

2423582617.m_KeyValue: "I have no wish to die for this."

2423582618.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it is I who will meet my end."

2423582619.m_KeyValue: ""Regardless, your reply tells me you've accepted my challenge.""

2423942833.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer... the Church's strongest combatant! I can't believe I get to fight one!"

2423942835.m_KeyValue: "The most improbable answer may be the right one. And I suspect Noah thinks the same."

2423942836.m_KeyValue: ""Sheila of Pestilence, Ranna of Famine, and... Noah of Death.""

2423942837.m_KeyValue: "But saying they’re connected doesn't explain how. What exactly connects them?"

2423942839.m_KeyValue: "It'll take time to craft a new deck—but we have other methods."

2423942840.m_KeyValue: "It happened before you came to exist."

2423942841.m_KeyValue: ""Before we set off, I heard the Church had reinforced Starfall Valley.""

2423946042.m_KeyValue: ""The Choir... outwardly performing the most sacred duties, while secretly engaging in unspeakable acts...""

2424142802.m_KeyValue: "When did the Church start employing undead soldiers?"

2424893258.m_KeyValue: "Upgrade Hall of Honor to unlock Quick Expedition."

2424893423.m_KeyValue: "Redeem failed. Please check the code and try again."

2425144331.m_KeyValue: ""He's long since mastered the art of resurrection. And he wants you to know, that girl from eleven years ago… she's still alive.""

2425144332.m_KeyValue: "I lost not just my father that day. I lost my past too."

2425144333.m_KeyValue: ""I stumbled upon a discovery. Siren blood could ease the pain caused by the disease. After that, Hallon began helping me imprison them...""

2425144334.m_KeyValue: "So it is hereditary after all... My daughter..."

2425144335.m_KeyValue: "Master Albrecht saved me. He gave me back my 'life.'"

2425144336.m_KeyValue: ""What do we do now? If this continues, what will become of the isle?""

2425144338.m_KeyValue: "So this... is a siren's song. Beautiful..."

2425144363.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps… it was to give herself the chance to do it."

2425144364.m_KeyValue: ""You're going to find the Master behind it all, aren't you? Then I shall head to the meeting place.""

2425144365.m_KeyValue: "Do you still sing those soothing songs? Or perhaps your life has been hollowed of music and forgotten dreams..."

2425144366.m_KeyValue: "But he just attacked a prison guard and escaped one more time!"

2425144367.m_KeyValue: ""The remaining three Siren's Tears, the meeting place, and the Master behind it all... It seems all answers converge here.""

2425144370.m_KeyValue: "Joyce understands now! You must be the enemy of Lord Isaac's enemy... which means lo—"

2425144371.m_KeyValue: "It is time for you to face the long awaited judgment for your past deeds."

2425144619.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, yes, but that's what the contract says. Little Bella, do remember to read the fine print next time, hmm?""

2425144627.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying? The day's barely begun—no time for long faces!"

2425144628.m_KeyValue: "Let's make you the finest actor in all of Sapphire Isle! Isn't that the dream you've always had?"

2425144629.m_KeyValue: "The pinnacle of fashion... is to abandon the very idea of clothing itself. Looks like everything I've designed for my customers has been far too conservative..."

2425144630.m_KeyValue: "Then maybe... Ginokio's deepest desire is to defeat Robin von Quinn and claim his most precious treasure!"

2425144631.m_KeyValue: "Hmph. A foolish tale of love—how could I possibly enjoy such drivel?"

2425144633.m_KeyValue: ""Waves crash upon jagged stone, the waters dark with menace.""

2425144634.m_KeyValue: "Don't clean me up! I'll leave on my own!"

2425144654.m_KeyValue: ""No, Aiona. Her people still need someone to get them out.""

2425144659.m_KeyValue: "I never expected to hear such words from you."

2425144663.m_KeyValue: "Let’s regroup with Ami and discuss our next move. I arranged to meet her at the inn."

2425144664.m_KeyValue: "They no longer understand human speech... Their transformation has already progressed this far..."

2425144666.m_KeyValue: "Now that you have power—your duty is clear! Protect the weak... like me!"

2425144691.m_KeyValue: ""Now, I have far more important matters to address. You may take your leave, Miss Ami's... servant.""

2425144692.m_KeyValue: "You're that puppet merchant from the castle... why are you here?"

2425144693.m_KeyValue: ""How can Miss Ami be an outsider, when she's already been chosen as the next Sage?""

2425144694.m_KeyValue: "A gentleman in rather... unusual attire just delivered a letter."

2425144697.m_KeyValue: "Strange... There's no blood in his body. How is he still alive?"

2425144698.m_KeyValue: ""Regardless... thanks to you, I know now. To save Ami, I'll need to gather every Siren's Tear.""

2425144724.m_KeyValue: "Said he’d be busy tonight—told me to let anyone looking for him or Miss Ami know to return tomorrow."

2425144727.m_KeyValue: "Have you heard the rumor? There's a mysterious merchant in town."

2425144728.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, but I need it urgently. I can't...""

2425144729.m_KeyValue: ""Did you just give us new orders, my Lady? We're not sure we understood...""

2425144730.m_KeyValue: ""It's vow, not vial. That's how you say it.""

2425144751.m_KeyValue: ""There are no guards with her—quick, let's teach her a less—No, I mean... let's liberate the Siren's Tear she's holding!""

2425144752.m_KeyValue: "That's alright. I memorized how the musician played it."

2425144757.m_KeyValue: "We didn't actually defeat Noah. He held back."

2425144758.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier, someone attacked me for no reason—so I acted in self-defense.""

2425144760.m_KeyValue: ""The answer is simple. Sapphire Isle, as it stands, is ruled by the Seven Sages—wealthy beyond measure. If your story holds any truth, this Master must possess a kind of commodity that wealth alone cannot buy.""

2425144761.m_KeyValue: "If you overthrow the Master and claim your rightful place—Then maybe..."

2425144762.m_KeyValue: "Where did you overhear that I'm the heir to Sapphire Isle?"

2425144786.m_KeyValue: "I enjoyed working with you too. And I'll remember everything you've said."

2425144787.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, you've got it all wrong! How could I ever do such a thing? We've been through so much—we're friends now, aren't we? I mean, it’s not every day you get to befriend someone worth five million Soli...""

2425144788.m_KeyValue: "The one I need to awaken with the seven Siren's Tears... is Ami. She's the other person on that wanted poster. Whoever issued that warrant is trying to stop me from doing so."

2425144789.m_KeyValue: ""And for her heroism, Miss Ami was unanimously chosen as the new Sage! Such a thrilling tale... it will be the plot of my next play!""

2425144791.m_KeyValue: "This path of transformation... Far more tempting than becoming one of the Bloodborn."

2425144793.m_KeyValue: ""No! If word spreads that so many of the Seven Sages have been struck down, it will cause panic!""

2425144819.m_KeyValue: "...It seems someone else has been sneaking around the ship."

2425144820.m_KeyValue: ""Father… what's happening to you? Why… why do you have a fish tail too? Please wake up, Father!""

2425144822.m_KeyValue: "The text ends abruptly—likely an abandoned cry for help. Its author may not have survived."

2425144823.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei... I don't recall any singer by that name. But, today—that name...""

2425144825.m_KeyValue: "Looks like she redecorated while I was sick."

2425144826.m_KeyValue: "I've never heard of any 'Seven Sages.' And I don't remember a tsunami..."

2425234494.m_KeyValue: "It's not the beasts speaking. Someone behind them is sustaining them."

2425234496.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you could, you still wouldn't be able to defeat her.""

2425234497.m_KeyValue: "The Blood Beasts we encountered in Starfall Valley..."

2425237696.m_KeyValue: "Looks like things are getting more interesting around the sealed area."

2430005924.m_KeyValue:
""In a way, all Bell Ringers are lonely. But only Acappella refuses to accept this fact—and she herself hasn't even realized it.

Duty, service, faith, discipline... These chains that bind Acappella may often leave her restless, but the constant push and pull with these constraints has become her way of maintaining her sense of self.

Finally, through all this noise, I heard Acappella's most genuine inner voice for the first time—Play with me.""

2430005990.m_KeyValue:
""An alchemist once shared more about Piera's lineage with me.

Though the Paracelsus family had long suffered misfortune, they were never on the brink of extinction. That is, until 66 years ago, when a terrible calamity struck their homeland—an isolated island, by most accounts.

The calamity claimed over half the family, and those who escaped perished one by one after leaving the island. Their names faded, lost to time.

For Piera, then, homeland is nothing more than a distant idea—an echo of a place that no longer exists.""

2430006114.m_KeyValue:
""Only one card remains missing from the diviner's tarot deck. Caught in the heavy iron door of the castle basement is something that looks like the Devil card—

Try to pull it out!

Drat, the door won't budge.

It seems the card can't be retrieved unless the door is open.

What secrets could lie behind this heavy door?

Amid uneasy speculation, a whisper seeps through the cracks, resonating like the voice of an ancient god:

'Open... it...'

'Face... me...'

That voice... It's the lure of the Black Blood! Grab the tarot and run!

Surely, it's a demon—a creature of insatiable lust for blood, consuming life.""

2431036698.m_KeyValue: ""…What is it you want? Have you come only to torment me, to watch me fall into madness?""

2431036700.m_KeyValue: ""Fret not, fret not—the trial will come. Joyce simply wished to share the result ahead of time… a little secret between us.""

2431036703.m_KeyValue: ""So! How about it? Will you walk the path to its bitter end, for the sake of the dead who gave their lives?""

2431036704.m_KeyValue: "The Black Blood in your body is out of control. I had no choice but to act."

2431297645.m_KeyValue:
""After some investigation, I learned that Tris was once a Bell Ringer of the Church, tasked with executing heretics. But believing that children should not be burdened with the sins of their parents, she brought the children of heretics into the choir, giving them a new life.
Anna, the elderly woman with antiquated handwriting, was one of those Tris brought to the Church when she first became a Bell Ringer. Time has left its traces on Anna's face, yet left Tris untouched. To Tris, even though Anna's hair has turned gray, she remains the same little girl who once enjoyed her meal so much she got food stains on her face.""

2431418635.m_KeyValue:
""Nicole Flamel was a renowned ballerina from East Boulevard, but during the infamous 'Libation Day' siege, her legs became trapped under a collapsed building. She was rescued in time, but her mangled legs had to be amputated. Unable to ever dance again, Flamel became increasingly depressed. Yet on the brink of despair, she encountered Albrecht the Crystal Sage, a Bell Ringer who told her he could let her dance again. Flamel regained her hope and voluntarily became Albrecht's test subject, as well as his apprentice.
She felt grateful towards her mentor, but their master-apprentice relationship revealed to her Albrecht's contempt for the world.
'I've seen your dance. It's beautiful and shouldn't be taken from this world, even if the world itself shall disappear.'
Though unable to agree with his stance, Flamel nonetheless carried out bounty missions for Albrecht as a way of repayment.""

2434884597.m_KeyValue: ""You stole something important from me, meow.""

2435028337.m_KeyValue: ""It's a good idea for me to carry out the survey instead—this way, she will also save time and effort.""

2435574290.m_KeyValue: "Deployed characters deal 50% more DMG to enemies inflicted with Black Blood."

2436178576.m_KeyValue: ""Take care, Acappella. Take care, Ressa. You're about to face a foe no one can overcome...""

2436178577.m_KeyValue: "But you'll always be in my heart."

2436716201.m_KeyValue: ""D-don't be ridiculous! If I get sealed, you'll be trapped in here too...!""

2436716202.m_KeyValue: ""The sealing ritual I learned has its limitations, but it'll be enough to keep you sleeping for a good hundred years.""

2436716205.m_KeyValue: "There's no way your ancestors kept you asleep in the Ancestral Vault for over three centuries with just a few herbs."

2436716208.m_KeyValue: "So I turned to ancient texts and learned sealing arts that don't belong to this era."

2436716211.m_KeyValue: "Please don't mind me. I'm just helping you fall asleep a little faster."

2436969852.m_KeyValue: ""Fires a Heavy Shell in a select area, dealing massive P. DMG to enemies within range.""

2436969853.m_KeyValue: ""Fires a projectile at the furthest enemy, dealing weak P. DMG to enemies in a 1.5-meter radius.""

2437288393.m_KeyValue: "Make a purchase in the General Store 1 time."

2437369050.m_KeyValue: ""But don't worry, I will, once everything is settled.""

2437375808.m_KeyValue: "Now... the last thing I can do... I said I'd cover your retreat..."

2437375809.m_KeyValue: ""Even without Aeon's blessing, we still have a chance to break through their encirclement with our skills.""

2437375810.m_KeyValue: "This time... I will protect you all."

2437375842.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain! What's wrong? D-did I do this? I..."

2437375843.m_KeyValue: "I should have protected everyone... Thane... Friedrich... Gilrain..."

2437376104.m_KeyValue: "What about the doctor and the elders? Why is it just you here?"

2437376105.m_KeyValue: "My eyes are in so much pain... Is anyone there?"

2437376106.m_KeyValue: "These eyes—passed down since the dawn of time—carry more than sight... they carry burden."

2437376107.m_KeyValue: ""My lady, please, you must rest. Your eyes carry the family's duty; we cannot risk anything going wrong.""

2437376108.m_KeyValue: ""At the dawn of time, the eyes did not exist...""

2437376136.m_KeyValue: "Nothing suspicious... Will they infiltrate after nightfall?"

2437376137.m_KeyValue: "The once formidable lord; now his whereabouts are unknown to all."

2437376139.m_KeyValue: "This isn't our lands? Why did Father send me here?"

2437376171.m_KeyValue: ""My lady, as you know, 'that matter' is of great importance. We must hurry to complete the preparations...""

2437376204.m_KeyValue: "You're about to undergo the ritual. The lord is waiting for you. I'll go call the other elders."

2437376205.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? Do you know where we are?"

2437376236.m_KeyValue: "Today is 'predestined' to be the day of the Alita family's—"

2437376237.m_KeyValue: "Where am I? What did I have to do... I remember... killer..."

2437376238.m_KeyValue: ""You've broken my family's taboo. Even if my family ceases to exist, I'll make sure you pay with your life.""

2437376269.m_KeyValue: "What are the answers to all this?"

2437376270.m_KeyValue: "How do I use the power of my eyes? How do I save everyone... What am I supposed to do?"

2437376271.m_KeyValue: ""The Alitas were once known for their glory, now their splendor has turned to dust in a single night;""

2437376302.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, stop giving me that 'I see right through you' look.""

2437474809.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you could try delivering the letters yourself."

2437762165.m_KeyValue: "Puppet: What Miss Bella means is that she's on board!"

2438413062.m_KeyValue: ""After binding, you can log in to Silver and Blood mobile via phone.""

2440089758.m_KeyValue: "Deals True DMG equal to {1} of Max HP every {0} sec to enemies on burning tiles."

2442751015.m_KeyValue: ""Given the wide age range of our audience, we've made sure this tale remains suitable for everyone.""

2442808677.m_KeyValue: "Fanny? The message is broken. I can't hear you clearly."

2442846658.m_KeyValue: ""If you're willing to listen, please write back.""

2442932887.m_KeyValue: "Pay attention to your Bloodsouls and adapt your formation and tactics for each stage's victory condition."

2442932888.m_KeyValue: "Keep an eye on the remaining time."

2442932889.m_KeyValue: "Use Nexus Coins to reset a character's level and get back the level up materials spent on them."

2443862948.m_KeyValue: "'No amount of your flattery will reach the Matriarch's ears.'"

2443862951.m_KeyValue: "'And what if they did?' The painting on the wall suddenly interjected."

2445479719.m_KeyValue: ""When receiving DMG, loses Shield Strength instead of HP. When receiving True DMG or Piercing DMG, loses Shield Strength equal to 200% of DMG taken. Shield cannot exceed 200% of Max HP.""

2445506535.m_KeyValue: ""Companions of the past, of the present, and of all tomorrows.""

2445506536.m_KeyValue: "But don't worry. I can bring her back."

2445506538.m_KeyValue: ""Aren't we all just discarded pieces, left behind by Joan to rot in this forsaken desert?""

2446081244.m_KeyValue: ""As twins sealed within the _$$Womb_$$ of the Divine Body, we faced a cruel choice—the Black Blood was running dry, and only one of us could survive.""

2446081245.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Father, Uncle Gadric, Clive Jr.... and you, Sheila._$$""

2446081246.m_KeyValue: ""_$$If I may... from now on, let me..._$$""

2446081247.m_KeyValue: "I… don't really understand what you mean."

2446127219.m_KeyValue: "Should've brought Jestel and Setti along. At least they talk like normal people."

2446127221.m_KeyValue: ""What, am I the only one with free time? Just to be clear, I didn't come along because I was worried about this guy... Huh?""

2446127222.m_KeyValue: ""It can't be helped. We just lost an elder, so they have their hands full...""

2446129306.m_KeyValue: ""Just surrender quietly, brat. Don't become a traitor like your father, Clive Ganelon.""

2446558389.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Strong. Displace. Target is pushed back and unable to cast Ultimate, Special (Active), Basic ATK, or move during the effect.""

2446775282.m_KeyValue: ""A month later, I received another letter from that mysterious address.""

2446919022.m_KeyValue: ""Feuler delivered an antiquated letter, its surface adorned with intricate patterns that mirror those etched upon the saddle.""

2447590600.m_KeyValue: "And I still remember it all. Their screams. The stench of burning flesh."

2447590601.m_KeyValue: "They say you never eat cooked meat... I see now—that wasn't just a rumor."

2447590602.m_KeyValue: "As for why they also chose the name _$$Brennholt_$$... perhaps they simply don't know the story behind it."

2447590603.m_KeyValue: "All my old companions—and their families—were burned. I was the only one who survived."

2447590604.m_KeyValue: ""And yet here you stand. The flames took your life, but not your will. Just like me.""

2447590605.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what your resurrection felt like. But when I awoke, the pain—searing, like the torments of hell—never left me. Not to this day.""

2447590606.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Two hearts beat in cursed accord, his flesh—the curse he can't afford._$$ Was your survival... tied to the Heart?""

2447590607.m_KeyValue: ""When I was thrown into that great furnace, I must have died—just as you did, when I set you alight.""

2447590610.m_KeyValue: ""To think the Church's most revered and feared Bell Ringer, the Poet of Flame, had been burned.""

2447590611.m_KeyValue: ""To be honest, I still have no idea if it was the Heart or the fire itself that brought me back. When I opened my eyes, the heart was already gone.""

2448668814.m_KeyValue: ""A brilliant light erupts forth as Letitia raises a resplendent, egg-shaped crystal into the air.""

2448668815.m_KeyValue: "Warm lips claim the words that linger unspoken on Noah's tongue."

2450432722.m_KeyValue: ""Once charged up, deals massive M. DMG to enemies in a straight line. When Awakened, increases both skill range and DMG dealt.""

2450721981.m_KeyValue: "Then let Noah go forth now to fulfill his destiny."

2450721982.m_KeyValue: "Alright... I'll take it easy and wait for you."

2450721990.m_KeyValue: "He gave his life so I could land that shot."

2450721991.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, Letitia! He said he's fine. No need to get all touchy-feely.""

2450723011.m_KeyValue: "The pain... it has been long since I suffered such a fall."

2450723015.m_KeyValue: "You're the outsider here. We've been trapped in this place for three months."

2450723018.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me... I—I must leave, before she finds me.""

2450752878.m_KeyValue:
""Little Bella No. 13 enters a charging state. After a period, she unleashes scorching flames that deal massive M. DMG to all enemies.
While charging, Little Bella No. 13 absorbs the flames from the candles on her arms. Each flame increases the DMG of her scorching flames.""

2453925465.m_KeyValue: ""The desert night sheds its searing veil, and upon a bed gone cold, the girl drifts into wintered dreams.""

2453925466.m_KeyValue: ""We must first escape tonight's capture—get everyone out, Joan.""

2453925467.m_KeyValue: "Did you hear? They say the Lord himself will preside over Joan’s thousandth match in a few days."

2453925468.m_KeyValue: "Let her be. I hear the Lord's found a snow-white leopard for the thousandth match."

2455121334.m_KeyValue: "I never expected a little wolf to sing like that."

2455337072.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, I mean... all stories have something frightening about them.""

2456201497.m_KeyValue:
""Clear Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II Fragment 4 to randomly obtain equipment from the following. 
<alpha=#80>Time erodes the husks of monsters, but the legacy of battle echoes eternally.""

2456375490.m_KeyValue: "This single day I've spent with you all... It is my entire life thus far."

2456381496.m_KeyValue: "...That's why I said you outsiders know nothing."

2456384563.m_KeyValue: ""I see, so you call them all Lamia? You still want to play your 'sister game'? Do you think they are all real lives?""

2456385588.m_KeyValue: ""We've become connected through blood ties. When you suffer from the torment, I cannot remain unaffected.""

2456632537.m_KeyValue: "You can return to previous battles to challenge these undead creatures. And your courage will be honored with abundant rewards upon clearing the stage."

2457397899.m_KeyValue: "What I fear is knowing I will lose something and being powerless to stop it..."

2457397996.m_KeyValue: "I can clearly see the path before me."

2457401098.m_KeyValue: ""Time has no end, only the solitude of eternity.""

2457406595.m_KeyValue: ""Don't let me get used to this warmth. After all, only the earth can perceive the traces left by the wind.""

2457406692.m_KeyValue: ""You're not expecting me to grow taller, are you?""

2457408645.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, a Tarot spread I can't decipher... How intriguing. What is your name?""

2457408866.m_KeyValue: "It seems I've drawn the 'Strength' card. So be it."

2457409701.m_KeyValue: ""Is it just my imagination, or did I sense something?""

2457409794.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you water it, it won't grow.""

2457411844.m_KeyValue: ""Disrupting order is unforgivable, but if it's you, perhaps you can show me a different future.""

2457412993.m_KeyValue: "You seem to... always give me unexpected warmth."

2457976808.m_KeyValue: ""You're a strange one... You're a Bloodborn too, yet you turn your blade against your own kin?""

2458342014.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG equal to a percentage of their Max HP per sec, while boosting DMG dealt by {0}. This effect lasts until the end of the battle.""

2458773570.m_KeyValue: "You thought you were trapped aboard the ship—but you never noticed that the ship itself sails across the open sea."

2458773571.m_KeyValue: "Noah… I think I know what I want to do now."

2459818385.m_KeyValue: "So you have changed after all. The man who once believed nothing existed beyond his own mind... Now dares to seek the answers of others."

2459818386.m_KeyValue: ""The Saint foretold four noble houses would betray the Church... That they would gather here, with the traitor Agares, to awaken the Long Night.""

2459818387.m_KeyValue: "...A domain fashioned by mortals could bind a Bell Ringer?"

2459818389.m_KeyValue: ""What? You two are always joined at the hip, and now you want to split up?""

2459818390.m_KeyValue: "Yet the murals and carvings have all been replaced. This is the Church's style."

2459818391.m_KeyValue: "They're heading for the sealed area—but it looks like they plan to take us down first."

2459818393.m_KeyValue: "No... I didn't win. Agares appeared and broke up the fight."

2459818394.m_KeyValue: "...A golden spear? Whose weapon is this?"

2459819409.m_KeyValue: ""First Seth's Left Hand, now her Right. One after another, you keep sending your protégés to stand in my way. What a meddlesome little sister.""

2459819411.m_KeyValue: ""Second, I've dealt with thousands upon thousands of _$$copies,_$$ just like her. If I had to feel something for each of them...""

2459819413.m_KeyValue: ""I can't help but care for you, can't help but trust you; I can't help but... hope to see you forge your own path in life.""

2459819414.m_KeyValue: ""I... can't believe it... Resurrecting _$$Mother_$$ was never about our family. It's exactly what Lamia said, isn't it? The Blood Moon...""

2459819415.m_KeyValue: ""At this point, I can't tell if you're having me on, or if you've just lost it.""

2459819416.m_KeyValue: "And yet always ahead of me... what does that make the ones who barely survived the game..."

2459819418.m_KeyValue: ""That's why you rushed to find the first Moonblessed before I did—the Silver-haired one, the _$$Seed of Death._$$""

2461862686.m_KeyValue: ""To break free from the temporal loop that has bound us, to let time flow forward again. But that has nothing to do with what I asked.""

2461862688.m_KeyValue: "This is the moment to rescue her. She'll finally see who her true captors are."

2461862689.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—these are the Warden's keys. She was here, then left. For one so cautious, she'd never abandon something this vital.""

2461863710.m_KeyValue: "I wouldn't bother if I were you."

2461863711.m_KeyValue: "You and I are not so different. We both carry unfinished burdens. Yet you… have let 'truth' bind your hands and fetter your stride."

2461863712.m_KeyValue: "Everyone here seeks a way to flee. Are you truly the only one who does not?"

2461863713.m_KeyValue: ""For now, I must turn my thoughts to escape. Only then may I seek the answers I need.""

2461863714.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm… I must say, you're the fairest of all who have come this month.""

2461863715.m_KeyValue: "Speak one lie and a gentle stroke on your head will have these forked points pierce your tender flesh and bleed you crimson."

2461863716.m_KeyValue: ""Interesting. When you speak of the divine, your eyes are vacant—like lines recited from another's script.""

2461863717.m_KeyValue: ""Let me look at you more closely… conspiring with Bathory, setting the plague loose upon the Lupine Forest, sending the El Dorado to the depths, letting Sunset Isle burn, watching Starfall Valley collapse into ruin…""

2462435620.m_KeyValue:
""The energy concealed within the Artifact can hugely enhance the combat abilities of Vassals.
<alpha=#80>Forged in black iron, its heat clings to the skin, like the heartbeat of sin itself. Sparks ignite the powder within, and the abyss answers with a roar.""

2462904593.m_KeyValue: "Daylight growing shorter... I feel like I've read about phenomena like this before... Maybe in ancient records?"

2462904594.m_KeyValue: "The moonlight at night... fuels this war."

2462904595.m_KeyValue: ""Bloodletting, the <style=""Highlight"">Long Night</style>…. I see now. Is this the other option you mentioned?""

2462904596.m_KeyValue: ""Back in the Hall of the Elders, didn't they mention something called the <style=""Highlight"">Bloodletting</style> ? Could that be the cause, Quinn?""

2462904597.m_KeyValue: ""I've read countless verses praising daylight in the old poetry collections. To walk beneath the sun's rays, I asked Mr. Cain to craft this umbrella for me.""

2462904598.m_KeyValue: "I've always heard the Divine Body guarded by the Bathory family was sealed beneath the castle... What if the Calamity they sealed is this Long Night?"

2462904599.m_KeyValue: ""So that's why the townsfolk say daylight’s grown short... It's the Calamity's doing. Without the sun, even the forest turns against us.""

2462904600.m_KeyValue: ""I once thought the sun existed only in poetry—that darkness was simply the way of the world… Until, one day, I overheard the elders conspiring to prolong the night. Only then did I realize… it was my family that ensured it would never end.""

2462904601.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. It's not my father nor Ezareth's will that we need to stop… It's this Long Night."

2462904602.m_KeyValue: ""If the Long Night ends, the werewolves will lose their powers, unable to fight. And the Bloodborn, terrified of sunlight, will be forced to retreat as the darkness fades.""

2462914321.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, Agnes! They're not Blood Beasts, they're just villagers!!""

2462914322.m_KeyValue: "I-I'm so sorry! I didn't realize you were from Mouret..."

2462914329.m_KeyValue: "Then I have critical news to share!"

2462914330.m_KeyValue: ""M-Mister, wait—shh! Don't say a word! And whatever you do... don't look behind you! Move slowly. Very slowly. Over here...""

2462914331.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, why do you look so pale?""

2462914335.m_KeyValue: "(Oh no. I was so full of myself. Am I seriously going to die during my first survey?)"

2462914336.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. James! If I fall here, please, please tell the Cartographers' Association Chairman, 600 years from now—His granddaughter gave her life in service of the cartographers!""

2462915475.m_KeyValue: "I don't want you to return... But if the day ever comes—remember our signal. I'll be watching from the shadows."

2462915476.m_KeyValue: ""Listen to me, child. Keep walking forward. Don't look back.""

2462915481.m_KeyValue: "That's not important. The Four Elders are meeting in the Hall of the Elders. The main entrance is barely guarded—this is your chance to escape."

2462915482.m_KeyValue: "How did you even get past the dungeon guards?"

2462915483.m_KeyValue: ""Michelangelo, now is not the time for jokes.""

2462915484.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, lad! Your true strength has finally awakened! How does it feel?""

2462915486.m_KeyValue: "You've always wanted to find your mother. Now you have a guide. Go. Head to the Lupine Forest."

2462915487.m_KeyValue: "The Quinn I know wouldn't hesitate like this."

2462915488.m_KeyValue: ""Escape...? No, I... I can't. If I run, Father will take it out on you... you'll—""

2462916500.m_KeyValue: "If Lord Ezareth truly ordered them to be turned overnight... What's his aim?"

2462916505.m_KeyValue: ""He said if we obeyed, we could reclaim what's left of the Moontide Canal. I only did what he told me...""

2462916506.m_KeyValue: ""So he told you to withhold the Wolfsbane, and give the patients tainted, boiled-down water?""

2462916507.m_KeyValue: ""I swear I'm telling the truth! He heard I was tending patients and approached me. Said if I followed his orders, I'd get access to clean water.""

2462916508.m_KeyValue: ""After the Moontide Canal dried up, we were drinking from caves and mud pits. I just... I just wanted a clean sip...""

2462916509.m_KeyValue: "They... they've already mutated... It's too late..."

2462916510.m_KeyValue: "Maybe I didn't hit you hard enough earlier."

2462916511.m_KeyValue: "Yes... He said that once the patients mutated... We wouldn't have to worry about them anymore..."

2462916512.m_KeyValue: "Take that medicine you've been hiding. Give it to the patients—now."

2462917653.m_KeyValue: ""I never imagined this <style=""Highlight"">strange magic</style> would have any place on the battlefield. Back then, it was only ever a reason for others to mock me.""

2462917654.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks for saving me back there! If it weren't for your magic, they would've caught me for sure.""

2462917657.m_KeyValue: ""Then we have to tell Father right away! Perfect timing, he might know something about your mother too!""

2462917658.m_KeyValue: ""That's merely my suspicion. With Elder Valora in command, Bathory and Ganelon have maintained a surface peace these past two years… aside from your little accidental border crossing.""

2462917661.m_KeyValue: "Yes. And those strange timber frames and towers you saw in town..."

2462917664.m_KeyValue: "I've seen structures like those in the war frescoes back at the castle—chevaux-de-frise and arrow towers. They're fortifications raised only when war is at the gates."

2462918677.m_KeyValue: ""(Oh no, they’re all staring. Say something! Don't clam up!)""

2462918678.m_KeyValue: ""You're from Bathory, yet you claim no ill intent... Then what are you doing here, in the Lupine Forest?""

2462918681.m_KeyValue: "Those robes... I've seen them illustrated in ancient texts. They belong to an order known as the Cartographers."

2462918682.m_KeyValue: ""The records say this subsect doesn't just chart terrain, they measure time and chronicle history in their own way.""

2462918683.m_KeyValue: "Oh! So that's why you carry that giant ruler—it's for making maps!"

2462918684.m_KeyValue: ""(Not only is she beautiful… she's smart, too. How could someone so perfect...?)""

2462918685.m_KeyValue: "But who are you? And why are you with Father? Wait—don't tell me… you're the envoy from the future he spoke of?!"

2462918686.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie, that's no way to speak to a guest who's come all this way.""

2462918687.m_KeyValue: ""When Father said we'd be meeting an envoy from the future, I imagined someone impressive, mysterious, maybe even a little awe-inspiring. But… she doesn't seem impressive at all. More like… hmm… an old relic!""

2462918688.m_KeyValue: "You brat! Who are you calling an old relic?! I'll have you know I'm a certified Cartographer from 600 years in the future!"

2462919831.m_KeyValue: "Enough of this drivel—seize the girl for spreading lies!"

2462919832.m_KeyValue: ""Look at how the clay's embedded in the torn fibers—it was ground in during a struggle, not picked up by accident. If she died in Bathory lands… why would her things bear soil found only here?""

2462919833.m_KeyValue: ""Why would soldiers carrying her belongings go out of their way to rest deep in the Lupine Forest? This kind of clay is thick, distinctive—found only in one specific area!""

2462919834.m_KeyValue: "Clay? That proves nothing. Perhaps the soldiers who handled her belongings brushed against it while passing through."

2462919835.m_KeyValue: "And that particular clay... it's found only in one place: a chamber deep in the Lupine Forest. There's nothing like it in Bathory territory."

2462919836.m_KeyValue: ""You said Elonora died in Bathory lands, but this case is stained with red clay.""

2462919838.m_KeyValue: ""You just won't hold your tongue, will you? Guards—take her.""

2462919839.m_KeyValue: "You handed over your most cherished sister in marriage? It makes no sense. Unless... the marriage itself was part of your scheme all along."

2462919840.m_KeyValue: ""You contradict yourself from the start. You loathe the Bathorys, and yet…""

2462920855.m_KeyValue: "Your parents are ruthless enough. Do you have to make things even worse?"

2462920856.m_KeyValue: ""You're exploiting these infected villagers as weapons, and yet you dare to speak of ruthlessness?""

2462920857.m_KeyValue: ""You're right, you're right. We still have hopes. We still have the 'weapons'...""

2462920859.m_KeyValue: "Don't listen to them... The only way we can win this battle is to release the werewolves in the caves."

2462920860.m_KeyValue: ""They are the 'weapons' forged by Lord Ezareth. With their power, we stand a chance of victory and of avenging your brother.""

2462920861.m_KeyValue: "I'm going with you... to Bathory Castle from 600 years ago. It's also part of the survey."

2462920863.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn... Quinn, stop talking. I have a feeling you're about to say something I really don't want to hear. Please, stop.""

2462920864.m_KeyValue: "Impossible. I won't let you run off alone again."

2463154333.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me, how do you intend to end it this time?""

2463154334.m_KeyValue: "Another troublesome affair… though not beyond reach."

2463154341.m_KeyValue: ""Shall I take that as your confession, Noah?""

2463154342.m_KeyValue: ""But I can't. I'm bound to these walls, so even death remains a mercy beyond my reach.""

2463154343.m_KeyValue: ""Until you, my dear prisoner. Even knowing you act only to escape, you were the first to truly see me—to strip away the mask, to pierce through my facade.""

2463154344.m_KeyValue: ""Rather than a prison, it is an island cut adrift beyond time itself.""

2463154345.m_KeyValue: "That… that was a memory buried inside her power?!"

2463154346.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, Noah, how did you get a sword...""

2463155365.m_KeyValue: ""(So this is the recreation yard. By all logic, it should be rife with schemes of escape… yet the guards are few. Why?)""

2463155366.m_KeyValue: ""Prison rags upon my back, shackles at my ankles… I hardly expect to find much dignity in a place like this.""

2463155367.m_KeyValue: "Blindfolded figures are driven in single file into the prison's depths."

2463155368.m_KeyValue: ""The rest of the room lies strewn with documents, drawers and cupboards left open—yet that cabinet alone is bound fast with double iron locks. Such excess speaks too loudly to be coincidence.""

2463155393.m_KeyValue: "This is not about hate—I simply no longer feel the urge to fight."

2463542910.m_KeyValue: ""No pain, no gain, but I'll gladly take the latter.""

2463542912.m_KeyValue: "Is this the appropriate time to express gratitude?"

2463542913.m_KeyValue: "Speak. What do you want to gain?"

2463542916.m_KeyValue: "You've even chosen a style I like. How thoughtful of you."

2463542918.m_KeyValue: "I can feel the sincerity in your heart."

2471472349.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks for helping me out earlier! If it weren't for you, who knows how long I would've been lying there!""

2471506110.m_KeyValue: ""You know I've been waiting for your reply, right? It's been so long—have you still not found the earring's trace in the memories of my blood?""

2471553276.m_KeyValue: ""Lately, I've been busy with work at the castle.""

2475061526.m_KeyValue: "Are you speechless in the face of my brilliant scheming?"

2475061529.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, I think I'm about to make history.""

2475061530.m_KeyValue: "I'm curious—how do you think that will play out?"

2475061531.m_KeyValue: ""I'll deliberately leave an opening, and you'll seize that chance to strike me down.""

2475061532.m_KeyValue: ""Then I can finally slip away from Darcias and those stubborn old folks at the Church, and have some peace and quiet for once.""

2475061533.m_KeyValue: "The next step is for you to take me hostage."

2478351622.m_KeyValue:
""'Would you like to hear the story of Agares Brennholt, the usurper chancellor of the Carrelle family?'
'Reborn in flames, he led the once-enslaved to overthrow the Carrelle family and forge a new order upon their ancestral lands.'

'He loves war—for it shatters decaying shackles, letting a new world rise from the ruins. He hates war—for it scorches the soil of peace, drowning freedom in the blood of innocents.'

She reached out to remove me, and at last I saw her face behind the mask: 'He is both the Apocalypse embodying _$$War_$$ and the Church's Bell Ringer. But someone like him... would he still remember the promise he once made?'""

2478351839.m_KeyValue: "I've sent Fanny the wine Cain promised to share with me. Blood isn't the only liquid that brings pleasure. I pray this bottle will grant her peaceful slumber."

2478351994.m_KeyValue: ""Was this attempt a failure, or perhaps a success? Following that Noah's warning, I did avoid falling off the cliff during battle, so when we took a different path after the fight, I didn't notice anything wrong. It was a path he hadn't taken before, so naturally he couldn't have known what would happen—Empousa, Hati, and I ended up falling at a different spot. In the end, we had to limp back to the castle supporting each other. The good news is we saw a beautiful group of fireflies on the way, and we didn't disturb Aunt Mary. Perhaps this could be considered a success in its own way?""

2478468162.m_KeyValue: ""'That place now stands barren,' the Baphomet intoned, his words heavy with disappointment.""

2478468164.m_KeyValue: ""'It's quite straightforward,' Gilrain explained, stating what everyone already knew. 'We've been consistently using the Matriarch's bloodline for the transfusions. We have long reached its limit.'""

2478468165.m_KeyValue: ""To transcend this limitation, we must seek out an older Ancestor,' Bella posited. She then added, 'Have we thoroughly searched the Ancestral Vault? I've heard whispers of strange sounds emanating from there recently.'""

2478468167.m_KeyValue: ""'Our presence here stems from the fact that Bloodline Transfusion has long been our primary means of nurturing powerful vessels. However, it appears we've now reached the very limits of this method.'""

2478699255.m_KeyValue: "Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit I"

2479095195.m_KeyValue: "The Fusion Level is dependent on the lowest level Vassal of the five in the Main Transfusion Slots."

2479095385.m_KeyValue: "Each spirit has a substantial amount of HP."

2480421511.m_KeyValue: "I only acted that way to see the worry in your eyes. It's so rare to have you care for me like this."

2480421512.m_KeyValue: ""*Cough, cough*—Noah—don't look back—you have to make it out alive—""

2483446406.m_KeyValue: "I was afraid you wouldn't step through that door."

2483446407.m_KeyValue: ""Torches sparsely line the corridor walls in rows, their flames devoured by shadow long before reaching the stone floor below.""

2483447427.m_KeyValue: ""Before that moment arrives, let us hear a tale of 'hope and courage.'""

2484429976.m_KeyValue: "Aeon won't abandon his followers. Let's rest for a bit and think of a solution."

2484429978.m_KeyValue: "But how can we just leave him..."

2484430007.m_KeyValue: ""We can't handle this one, Aiona! Don't engage it head-on!""

2484430010.m_KeyValue: ""Don't interrupt me... How was my speech... Better than... Friedrich's, right...""

2484430012.m_KeyValue: ""Take away my body, my consciousness, my soul, my everything...""

2484430273.m_KeyValue: ""Continue the extraction. Once she's lost consciousness, begin the rite.""

2484430274.m_KeyValue: ""Sandra, where's my father? I need to see him.""

2484430276.m_KeyValue: "I don't know this place. Is this the future... or some far away land?"

2484430304.m_KeyValue:
""But fate's cruel hand struck at midnight, as the moon behind thick clouds did hide;
The guards on their rounds in the manor found their heads pierced, hanging to the side;""

2484430305.m_KeyValue: "It's juice made from almonds. You've never tried it? You must be from the north."

2484430335.m_KeyValue: ""Please head inside, my lady. The lord is already waiting for you. I will summon the other elders.""

2484430337.m_KeyValue: "No need to say a word. I know you're here to assassinate the Alita family."

2484430403.m_KeyValue: ""If you're so capable, why don't you go find them yourself?""

2484430404.m_KeyValue: "He didn't turn to sand... or into a monster..."

2484430437.m_KeyValue: "Your eyes carry the family's duty; we cannot risk anything going wrong."

2484430469.m_KeyValue: "I don't know... But I do know there's no desert near Starfall Valley."

2484430470.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I can't use my Revert ability.""
