""Attention Lord,
You have achieved Rank 1 {Num} times in Blood Moon Rising - Blood Hunt Reward. Please collect your Special Rewards below!""

2485217616.m_KeyValue: "Only you can cross between worlds—as Death incarnate."

2485217617.m_KeyValue: "Exactly! We'll hold these constructs off—go find Albrecht!"

2485217619.m_KeyValue: ""Stella, go! You have more important matters to deal with!""

2485217623.m_KeyValue: "Wait—stop! Those things are the Formless's constructs! You can't fight them—come back!"

2485217625.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... I can't understand what you're trying to say."

2485218542.m_KeyValue: ""Well... truth is, I never really belonged to that world either. One day I just woke up there.""

2485218543.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, we make a great team, don't we? How about it? We stick together. Keep adventuring.""

2485218548.m_KeyValue: "Where else would I be but waiting for you?"

2485218551.m_KeyValue: ""Just as you said, tend these new seeds. Help them grow. Maybe that's what I was meant to do.""

2485218553.m_KeyValue: ""Come, time for our own Harvest Festival—""

2485218638.m_KeyValue: "And the one chosen to light the flame... was none other than Stella."

2485218639.m_KeyValue: ""On that day, the Asta Harvest Festival held its bonfire ceremony at that very bell tower.""

2485218642.m_KeyValue: ""Now, then... care to guess why that day, of all days?""

2485218643.m_KeyValue: "And just how would you know that? Did that memory tell you?"

2485218645.m_KeyValue: ""You old fool! If you already know, then say it!""

2485218646.m_KeyValue: "So you're saying the reason she crossed into our world—and we into hers—"

2485218647.m_KeyValue: "The true joy of alchemy lies in combining wholly unlike elements... and observing the reactions that emerge between them."

2485218648.m_KeyValue: "If I had to guess... the Formless breached this world during the Harvest Festival nineteen years ago."

2485218649.m_KeyValue: "—is because I somehow reacted with the bell tower?"

2485263250.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, that missing page was left behind on the El Dorado. I was hoping you could help me find it.""

2485332148.m_KeyValue: ""A knight grotesquely twisted by the influence of Black Blood. Devoid of faith, their swordsmanship is now tempered by pure insanity.""

2485332159.m_KeyValue: "Slaves of House Carrelle who will stop at nothing to claim a _$$surname_$$ for themselves."

2485332160.m_KeyValue: ""An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. This creature has lost all semblance of its original form, becoming a monstrous beast.""

2485332162.m_KeyValue: "An assassin attempting to infiltrate the Alita castle and kill the lord."

2486480804.m_KeyValue: "A hero with a versatile attack style who can destroy many enemies using various methods."

2486480805.m_KeyValue: ""Deals consistent, strong DMG to a single target or targets in a small area.""

2486649872.m_KeyValue: ""Hehe—congratulations, Joan! You've passed the Bell Ringer's trial!""

2486649874.m_KeyValue: "I see... so that is 'such' a way."

2486649875.m_KeyValue: ""She would inherit my will, guard this desert, and protect all who call it home. Perhaps she is the one truly meant to be their master.""

2486649876.m_KeyValue: "Could this also be a miracle? Two divine signs in a single day..."

2486649878.m_KeyValue: "The cat goddess... the cat goddess truly walks among us!"

2487181234.m_KeyValue: "They spent a long time preparing an exquisite _$$ritual tool_$$ as a gift for me."

2487807222.m_KeyValue: ""The strong culling the weak, right and wrong being decided by the victors—I can understand your point of view.""

2487807223.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me, what sins have I committed? Who has the authority to judge me?""

2487818345.m_KeyValue: "...I don't understand what you two are thinking! Are you helping them rescue that Empousa?"

2488475067.m_KeyValue: "My suggestions are merely guidelines—you're free to follow your own judgment."

2488478268.m_KeyValue: ""Clearly, the meaning of knighthood is still lost on you.""

2488482624.m_KeyValue: ""I hope that one day, I can be as decisive as you...""

2489098879.m_KeyValue: ""That is, until I lost to another Bloodborn. For the first time, I felt like a frog in a well.""

2489105908.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, this appears to be merely a journal left behind by one of the elders.""

2489391659.m_KeyValue: "You're not Agares? Then who are you?"

2489391661.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, you must remember. The prophecy, inscribed in the Church's sacred texts:""

2489391662.m_KeyValue: "Then go. Face the fate you've chosen."

2489391663.m_KeyValue: "Those rats… they're merging into some kind of monster!?"

2489391665.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry. Lady Empousa… Hati, Ami… I've hidden things from all of you. Even if you hate me for it...""

2489391667.m_KeyValue: "Aiona… do you truly work for the Church? Or are you with the Bell Ringers?"

2489391668.m_KeyValue: "Aiona... are you still keeping secrets from us?"

2490319831.m_KeyValue: ""Swings tentacles to emit electric pulses that <link=""Tips_ID;1""><#508499><u>bounce</u></color></link> onto up to 3 enemies, dealing M. DMG to each unit hit.""

2490319836.m_KeyValue: ""After {0} Basic ATKs, deals moderate M. DMG to enemies in a straight line in front of the target.""

2491563627.m_KeyValue: "Did I send them to the other side of the island? No wonder we haven't seen any signs of rescue!"

2491563629.m_KeyValue: "So things that have been corrupted by Black Blood are weak to salt..."

2491563632.m_KeyValue: "It looks like we have mistaken one another from the start."

2491563659.m_KeyValue: "I believe neither of us has been the subject of someone else's longing."

2491563661.m_KeyValue: "Am I just a phantom of the deceased? Who am I really?"

2491563662.m_KeyValue: "It's the blessed grounds... at the top of the mountain! We must hurry! Someone is reciting—"

2491563685.m_KeyValue: ""So, Acappella... you knew what I'd choose all along, didn't you? Yet you kept testing me...""

2491563686.m_KeyValue: ""That old man may be a bit of a scoundrel, but he doesn't make meaningless choices. You have your own worth.""

2491563692.m_KeyValue: ""No... I didn't... Acappella, listen to me, I can explain!""

2491563693.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, what a pain. These minions of Death can barely string two words together, yet they won't shut up.""

2491563695.m_KeyValue: ""Couldn't live up to your own boast, huh? Get ready for a scolding when we're back at the Church.""

2491563696.m_KeyValue: ""Plus, there are always plenty of 'new friends' eager to meet you.""

2491563697.m_KeyValue: "You think you can really handle Death? That's a 'Calamity'! What could a pathetic excuse for a Vice-Commander like you possibly do?!"

2491563698.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, are you saying I'm a suspect too?!""

2491563717.m_KeyValue: ""—There are four noisy people, accompanied by some eerie whispers of Death's minions.""

2491563718.m_KeyValue: "—Hahahaha! This is something you mortals could never master in your pathetic lifetimes. You might as well bow down and worship me!"

2491563723.m_KeyValue: ""In that great battle, we sealed Death at the cost of losing our commander, then brought the survivors from the island back to the Church.""

2491563724.m_KeyValue: ""I simply assumed because you have the same name. I apologize, Piera.""

2491563725.m_KeyValue: ""Hey Darcias, the ship went down pretty fast after I took out that Famine, didn't it?""

2491563726.m_KeyValue: "But how did Noah reach these shores? Could there be a way even a Bell Ringer doesn't know about?"

2491563727.m_KeyValue: "Acappella... will you promise... to help Noah escape?"

2491563728.m_KeyValue: ""Come on, we've been at this for 66 years now. Stop talking nonsense and let's focus on finding him first—""

2491563729.m_KeyValue: ""If he's really connected to the Bathorys, or any Bloodborn who follow the Calamities, it would explain everything.""

2491563730.m_KeyValue: "Maybe he knew the old hag... I mean your grandmother. Or perhaps he even knew the commander. Maybe we even know each other."

2491563752.m_KeyValue: "You expect me to... just do nothing? To let her march off to her death alone...?"

2491563755.m_KeyValue: "You're the spitting image of that self-righteous Piera. Just looking at you is..."

2491563756.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, this place was never meant for a child like you in the first place.""

2491563759.m_KeyValue: "But... but I don't remember ever meeting you... Are you all... phantoms?"

2491563760.m_KeyValue: ""The Bloodborn, who proclaim themselves immortal, embody this truth; as do the Bell Ringers who have transcended the shackles of time.""

2491563762.m_KeyValue: "So that means... you're all... my ancestors?"

2491563783.m_KeyValue: ""Those 'salt-transformed' minions of Death we saw on the way... you defeated them using what was in this coffin, didn't you?""

2491563784.m_KeyValue: "It shortens their lifespan... Is that why Piera became so weakened after using it twice?"

2491563787.m_KeyValue: ""Spending one's whole life fighting something, sacrificing everything... All their effort, just to become part of the enemy.""

2491563788.m_KeyValue: ""Although I couldn't refute our family's views, I absolutely refuse to accept such methods! And so I contacted the Church.""

2491563789.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, though I remember his appearance was somewhat different back then, I can recognize that insufferable way of talking anywhere.""

2491563790.m_KeyValue: "Their leader looks just like Death's true form!"

2491563791.m_KeyValue: ""And now I gaze at the same place as you, and what lies within... could it be Death, returning home?""

2491563792.m_KeyValue: "Noah... I'd glad to have met you in my final moments..."

2491563823.m_KeyValue: "But... as one of the Paracelsus bloodline... I will become its weakness!"

2491563824.m_KeyValue: "Please... I can't control it... for long... (coughing)"

2491563825.m_KeyValue: "The servants of Death can't hurt me. I'm getting you down this mountain! You're going to be okay!"

2493749953.m_KeyValue: "The Black Blood has already broken out in Mouret. No one can stop the purge now."

2493749954.m_KeyValue: ""No, it is important. Are you speaking as my childhood friend or a member of the Church?""

2493749958.m_KeyValue: "Skoll! You know Father would never do such a thing!"

2493749985.m_KeyValue: ""Don't misunderstand, old friend. I'm not here to fight you this time.""

2493749986.m_KeyValue: ""I know you have no regrets, but you must be exhausted...""

2493749987.m_KeyValue: ""But as long as that child—Hati—likes them, you'd plant a whole garden for her, wouldn't you?""

2493750218.m_KeyValue: "Hah! Still think you can underestimate me?"

2493750252.m_KeyValue: ""Well you see, young lady, I am a pacifist. I simply can't bring myself to harm these innocent pups.""

2493750283.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, but we have our own urgent matters to attend to.""

2493750284.m_KeyValue: ""I know you helped me, but as a heretic hunter for the Church, I must uphold my duties.""

2493750286.m_KeyValue: "Let's part ways here. I must hurry to town to fulfill another promise."

2493750287.m_KeyValue: ""From the start, he wasn't taking this seriously.""

2493750288.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright?! Are you hurt anywhere?"

2493750313.m_KeyValue: "Cain? You saw him? I knew he wasn't dead! What did he tell you?!"

2493750314.m_KeyValue: ""Hang in there, everyone! Once we're out of the forest, we'll find somewhere safe.""

2493750315.m_KeyValue: "We've been on the move since entering the forest. It's time we rest and organize the limited clues we have."

2493750316.m_KeyValue: "So you want to reach the moon because it's home."

2493750319.m_KeyValue: "There... They look like people from the Bathorys!"

2493750320.m_KeyValue: ""Hey! You're the ones who attacked us, you know! Don't act like you're the hero and I'm the villain here!""

2493750346.m_KeyValue: ""If it weren't for some wolves suddenly appearing, we couldn't have shaken him off... Oh no, could he have taken my little brother, Clive?!""

2493750351.m_KeyValue: "Who are you calling short?! My father said I'm just a late bloomer. I'll definitely grow taller and stronger!"

2493750352.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's time for our generation to put an end to this hatred... Hm?"

2493750377.m_KeyValue: "Hold on! You think a simple 'thank you' is enough? Don't you owe us something? Tell us where the forbidden grounds are."

2493750381.m_KeyValue: ""Then why should I take you? Mouret is my home, so it's none of your business either.""

2493750382.m_KeyValue: ""I smell the rusty scent of Church Knights... They're still in town, and... they're coming closer.""

2493750383.m_KeyValue: ""The Church gave him the 'Moonlight Sword' to fight the Black Blood, but instead he spread the Black Blood disease in town. It's the worst betrayal!""

2493750412.m_KeyValue: ""Wolfsbane, deadly to those who are have become beasts... A fitting name.""

2493750415.m_KeyValue: ""But our most urgent task now isn't going to the Ashen Garden, it's finding Father! He stayed behind alone... He needs us!""

2493750441.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, it can't be fine. Before setting out, our troops thought this was just a routine Black Blood cleansing mission, but...""

2493750443.m_KeyValue: "I couldn't sense any hostility from him at all. This seems complicated!"

2493750445.m_KeyValue: ""Protecting you, sis, is the most important thing!""

2493750447.m_KeyValue: ""What's the matter, dumb wolf? If you're jealous, why don't you fly too!""

2493750448.m_KeyValue: ""Uncle Gadric is super strong! With him and Noah teaming up, we don't have to fear anyone from The Church!""

2493923822.m_KeyValue: "The Redeem Code does not belong to the account."

2494863595.m_KeyValue: "'Are you truly prepared? What if the moon turns out to be nothing like we imagined?'"

2494863596.m_KeyValue: "'The moon doesn't owe it to us to match our imagination.'"

2494863597.m_KeyValue: ""'And besides, it's still home. Don't tell me you're getting cold feet now!'""

2498722826.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">Dracula</style>, the first <style=""Highlight"">Bloodborn</style>. I'm sure you've heard this name before.""

2498722827.m_KeyValue: "I didn't expect an Inquisitor from the Church to believe in the tall tales of the <style="Highlight">Bloodborn</style>. But what does any of this have to do with me?"

2498722828.m_KeyValue: ""The connection lies in <style=""Highlight"">the method I just mentioned</style>. The flesh cannot resist the erosion of time, hence his method of achieving immortality was—""

2498726146.m_KeyValue: ""Look, it's raining again... It's all because of your dilly-dallying.""

2498726150.m_KeyValue: "So these people were all laborers who died in the past? But..."

2498726151.m_KeyValue: ""No, I mean, why is it only the armor that's left? Where is the, um, rest?""

2498726152.m_KeyValue: ""This was a dangerous land, naturally they came wearing armor.""

2498726153.m_KeyValue: ""So that's why it's called Starfall Valley... But, this mist... It's almost like the land itself is bleeding.""

2498726154.m_KeyValue: ""Well, long ago, a massive meteorite fell from the sky and created this scarred ravine.""

2498726155.m_KeyValue: ""We're hated due to our nature, but aren't humans the real parasites on the land?""

2498726156.m_KeyValue: ""The Church once dispatched scores of laborers here to mine the meteorite. These days, the valley is filled with this bloody mist, like a wound that can't heal.""

2498727169.m_KeyValue: ""What happened, my silver-haired friend? I leave you for one moment and look at the mess you got yourself into.""

2498727170.m_KeyValue: ""I heard you promised that nun that you'll live on and return to your homeland, no matter what.""

2498727173.m_KeyValue: "Oh that won't do. A man must keep his promises."

2498727174.m_KeyValue: ""Well, well, well, what do we have here? I came for the heretic, but found a little bonus—""

2498727175.m_KeyValue: ""Atone for your sins and become ash, 'Rat King of Starfall Valley.'""

2498727178.m_KeyValue: "My memories seem to be... slipping away from my mind..."

2498727180.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry I can't keep my promise, Ressa...""

2498728324.m_KeyValue: ""I won't let you die, and I won't allow you to turn into one of those monsters.""

2498728325.m_KeyValue: ""Don't forget, I carry the Black Blood—the memories I hold will not be lost with my body's demise.""

2498728326.m_KeyValue: "How are you going to remember me when you're dead?!"

2498728327.m_KeyValue: ""As long as we remember each other, that is proof of our existence.""

2498728328.m_KeyValue: ""Remember what I said when we first met? Even if I die, at least I've lived. You really did save me.""

2498728329.m_KeyValue: "Then... why did we go through all this?! What was the point of it all?!"

2498728330.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry. There's nothing more we can do. I can't see any possibility of us defeating that man."

2498728331.m_KeyValue: ""Are you really giving up? Come on, Aiona, think of something!""

2498979553.m_KeyValue: "Because you were the strength I needed all along."

2498979555.m_KeyValue: "But at least I got this earring back... and a letter she left for me."

2498979556.m_KeyValue: ""After your resurrection, instead of overthrowing the Carrelle family immediately, you liberated other slaves and gathered allies who shared your cause, waiting for the perfect moment.""

2554099431.m_KeyValue: "Silence! Don't call me that again! I'm not a coward!"

2554099462.m_KeyValue: "You have my respect as well. You didn't so much as flinch when you heard that William had used his twin identity to impersonate Goldland."

2554099493.m_KeyValue: "I haven't eliminated all our enemies yet. But once I deal with you two..."

2554099494.m_KeyValue: "I've encountered both a Calamity and a Bell Ringer recently. The Calamity was still immature. But the despair the Bell Ringer instilled in me was far greater…"

2554099495.m_KeyValue: ""She is the embodiment of beauty, the weight of ruin, and more wicked than the darkest nightmare.""

2555987862.m_KeyValue: ""After completing the survey, I had Feuler deliver the survey maps to Agnes.""

2556595200.m_KeyValue: ""Isaac shot Noah an icy glare. 'Don't forget, in our eyes, most Bloodborn are far from innocent.' With a swift gesture to Selena, he fired his crossbow at the guard.""

2556595201.m_KeyValue: ""In a flash, Noah's sword cut through the air, cleaving the bolt in two. 'I said no.' Now that's our protagonist in action!""

2556595205.m_KeyValue: ""'No.' Noah whispered firmly. 'If we kill him, it'll alert others that someone entered the vault.'""

2556595206.m_KeyValue: ""'He's just some random Bloodborn,' Van Helsing scoffed. 'His death will be forgotten just like this place.'""

2556595207.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah remained adamant: 'No. We're here to investigate the vault, not to kill indiscriminately.'""

2588165726.m_KeyValue: ""The Tower situated at the base of Bathory Castle was reportedly constructed to seal a mysterious temporal rift. To maintain the Tower's structural integrity, the family has expended countless artisans over hundreds of years for maintenance. Perhaps due to prolonged erosion by the temporal rift, the once-abstract laws of time and space have manifested in tangible form.""

2588165727.m_KeyValue:
""Legend states that every stone gargoyle originates from the same ancient primordial boulder, their hierarchical ranks determined by the order in which they were cleaved from the mother stone.

Once separated from this stone, skilled artisans would carve them into distinct forms and adorn them with varied colors and patterns. Yet despite their countless external differences, these gargoyles share a single thread of consciousness—they are united in thought and purpose, working in perfect harmony to fulfill their sacred duty of guarding the castle and protecting the young Vassals who have yet to reach maturity.""

2588165729.m_KeyValue:
""Several withered Wolfsbane petals and a diary written in elegant script reveal the identity of its owner.

The entry reads: I have lived for hundreds of years and witnessed far too many joys and sorrows. The light that once burned in my heart from love, victory, and peace has gradually dimmed with the passage of time. Whenever this happens, I think of you—knowing that you exist somewhere in the future, living and breathing—and I find the strength to endure it all. Your existence means everything to me.""

2588774678.m_KeyValue: ""But with the Roland family and the Cidhalls intervening, no faction dared lay hands on it.""

2588774680.m_KeyValue: ""Over a decade ago, the Alita family suffered a calamity—a massacre that wiped them out.""

2588774681.m_KeyValue: ""To this day, no one knows exactly what happened. For a long time, this place remained an empty land, claimed by no one.""

2588774682.m_KeyValue: ""So despite the fall of the Alitas, the people here have lived in peace—self-governed, untouched.""

2588774684.m_KeyValue: ""Later, the Church handed control to the Carrelles.""

2588774685.m_KeyValue: ""But after an internal upheaval, they lacked the strength to govern the land.""

2588774688.m_KeyValue: ""Even without the family, my homeland remains at peace.""

2597712646.m_KeyValue: "But they couldn't have just vanished! There must be another explanation!"

2597712647.m_KeyValue: ""What's going on? We finally made our way through those explosive mushrooms, but it's like we've been going around in circles.""

2597712648.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, the Alita family has the power to manipulate time as both our faith and weapon.""

2597712649.m_KeyValue: ""I wouldn't have believed it before I set foot in this place. After all, it's been twenty years.""

2597712650.m_KeyValue: ""I can only guarantee that you will witness the fate of each and every one of them with your own eyes: Noah, Clive, and our true enemy...""

2597712651.m_KeyValue: "Yeah! Tell me how to bring them back!"

2597712679.m_KeyValue: "So there's a possibility that the Moonblessed I'm searching for is this Calamity sealed by The Church."

2597712680.m_KeyValue: ""But that child... what is he to you, Noah?""

2597712681.m_KeyValue: ""Something seems off. They were moving silently before, but now they're deliberately howling to reveal their location...""

2597712682.m_KeyValue: "This is bad... He's showing signs of turning!"

2597712683.m_KeyValue: "Is that my blood can resist the transformation!"

2597712911.m_KeyValue: "I've looked through many lives and observed countless choices. Yet the results are surprisingly consistent—nothingness."

2597712942.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, do you think father truly found peace in the end?""

2597712943.m_KeyValue: "Your father wouldn't want to see you giving up on yourself."

2597712945.m_KeyValue: "I don't understand... Father and Noah... Why... Why did it turn out like this?"

2597712946.m_KeyValue: "We can't stop here. We have to keep moving."

2597712947.m_KeyValue: ""To be precise, I'm looking for the 'Moonblessed.'""

2597712948.m_KeyValue: "We were led all the way here by your father."

2597712949.m_KeyValue: "What is this place? How can there be such a huge space here? Where does it go?"

2597712975.m_KeyValue: "The stage and actors of the Ashen Garden are set. Will you drift with the tide or turn against the current..."

2597712976.m_KeyValue: "I had to knock some sense into you! Now tell me what happened to Noah!"

2597712977.m_KeyValue: "What the hell's taking them so long?"

2597713006.m_KeyValue: "The condemned need not know such things."

2597713007.m_KeyValue: "I see... So you're one of those Special Types capable of suppressing the Black Blood in your body?"

2597713009.m_KeyValue: "So much tragedy in this world are the result of small acts of ignorance and carelessness."

2597713012.m_KeyValue: ""Letting emotions cloud your judgment has always been your weakness, Aiona. It's the reason the Alita family has yet to appoint you as its head.""

2597713035.m_KeyValue: ""You, on the other hand, are different. A special type who can control the Black Blood within.""

2597713038.m_KeyValue: ""And that is precisely why we were chosen to lead our families, while she has yet to be selected to this day.""

2597713040.m_KeyValue: "And Noah... I'm sorry. It's not that I don't trust you. I just..."

2597713041.m_KeyValue: ""Hey... you two haven't forgotten about us, have you?""

2597713042.m_KeyValue: ""I'm mending the wound, but Gilrain's blade went very deep. For a child like him, the process will likely be excruciating.""

2597713043.m_KeyValue: "It hurts... it hurts so much... Noah..."

2597713045.m_KeyValue: ""Only a lingering thought remains, their bodies have completely turned into filthy beasts...""

2597713066.m_KeyValue: "It's using Hive Mind! The Black Blood gradually links the minds of infected hosts with similar thoughts and bloodlines."

2597713067.m_KeyValue: "We only need the spores from them. The Church wants to research their natural suppressive properties against the Black Blood."

2597713070.m_KeyValue: "He's in danger? The reason why the Black Blood needs to be sealed with Divine Bodies is because..."

2597713073.m_KeyValue: "Covenant? He shouted something like that when we fought. What exactly is..."

2597713074.m_KeyValue: "Divine Body...? I've never heard of such a thing."

2597713076.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine. If your mission was to retrieve those spores, don't waste them on me.""

2597713107.m_KeyValue: ""We're Bloodborn. Our bodies don't age like you, idiot.""

2597713108.m_KeyValue: ""I can simply fly over them. Oh, right, some of us aren't so capable.""

2597713136.m_KeyValue: ""But someone made me realize that I shouldn't be fixated on the past, or fear that inevitable end called the future.""

2597713138.m_KeyValue: ""...you're from the future? You might think I'm a strange person to even come to that conclusion, but actually...""

2597713139.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps this lamb is just like the lambs out there."

2597713140.m_KeyValue: ""This little thing was so scared a moment ago, but now it has completely let its guard down. You really are something.""

2597713141.m_KeyValue: ""For humans, the final stage of the Black Blood disease is transforming into a beast-like state. But for animals, they are already beasts, aren't they?""

2603509819.m_KeyValue: "Let's meet at the castle tonight. I'll give you the Wolfsbane then."

2603509821.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, it was only later that I understood his hopes for me.""

2606775939.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be so reckless, you stupid wolf!""

2610629179.m_KeyValue: "Sometimes inspiration isn't found in words alone."

2613380144.m_KeyValue: ""In that split second as Nightmarish Letitia's turned towards Noah, Ryan struck—his blade drawn, lunging forward.""

2613380145.m_KeyValue: ""I am her, and she is me...""

2613380146.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you should steer clear from investigative work."

2613380147.m_KeyValue: "That should be the last of them."

2613380148.m_KeyValue: "I've merely balanced out the Black Blood inside you. That's all."

""Sealed with the secrets of a legendary Warrior. High-quality material used for upgrading Warrior Skills.
<alpha=#80>Having emerged triumphantly from eight decisive holy wars, the Church no longer had to worry about its collapse. Upon his retirement, the Church clandestinely sealed this warrior's legacy, shrouding him in secrecy for eternity.""

2617062429.m_KeyValue:
""Sealed with the secrets of a legendary Defender. High-quality material used for upgrading Defender Skills.
<alpha=#80>That was the last time she set up a tent to shelter her people from the ravages of time. There were no secrets kept from the Tempus Church, alas the tent was eventually confiscated by Bell Ringers, and so it was that her silent guardianship became doomed to obscurity.""

2617062430.m_KeyValue:
""Sealed with the secrets of a legendary Assassin. High-quality material used for upgrading Assassin Skills.
<alpha=#80>Once the hidden blade of the Astolfo family, she became exiled by way of an internal power struggle. Forty years later, she returned under a moonless sky, channeling her humiliation into a bloodbath, exacting retribution upon all those who had betrayed her.""

2617062431.m_KeyValue:
""Sealed with the secrets of a legendary Sorcerer. High-quality material used for upgrading Sorcerer Skills.
<alpha=#80>She communed with the heavens, which presented her shooting stars that foretold of a cataclysm. Before she could make it to town, she passed in the mountains, leaving behind only a few pieces of her secrets.""

2617062432.m_KeyValue:
""Sealed with the secrets of a legendary Marksman. High-quality material used for upgrading Marksman Skills.
<alpha=#80>He soaked his bow in a vat of Black Blood for half a century, and the arrows became imbued with the eternal memory of the Black Blood Beast, relentlessly chasing their target until the ends of the earth.""

2617062434.m_KeyValue:
""Sealed with the secrets of a legendary Enchanter. High-quality material used for upgrading Enchanter Skills.
<alpha=#80>As the right hand of the Saint, she wove the Threads of Fate, with each strand portending a destiny. Yet in defiance of Church decrees, she clandestinely altered the needlework, thereby sparing the heretics from their assured doom.""

2621597520.m_KeyValue: ""The bad news is, while I'm not skilled in combat, you seem even less so.""

2621597521.m_KeyValue: ""Why make such a fuss? In this world, aren't we all being manipulated one way or another?""

2621597523.m_KeyValue: ""Noticed something amiss? You have no memory of naming yourself, yet you remember having a name.""

2621597552.m_KeyValue: "The reason the first card was inside the monster is that those girls... could only get this far before being devoured by that creature."

2621597554.m_KeyValue: ""No... you can't die. Please, I'm begging you, don't die!""

2621597577.m_KeyValue: ""Oh! As expected of a senior, I really want a name too!""

2621597582.m_KeyValue: "It's time to complete the final step."

2621597585.m_KeyValue: ""You can call me Cain. Before we activate the Astrolabe, I suspect you have many questions.""

2621597586.m_KeyValue: "Looks like the last one finally showed up. You've kept us waiting far too long."

2621597588.m_KeyValue: ""If I can go back, I'll be able to meet No. 66 again.""

2621597589.m_KeyValue: ""From beginning to end, we have always been... the same person.""

2622475524.m_KeyValue: "Seems we've underestimated what we're up against."

2622475526.m_KeyValue: "My condolences... I knew how close you two were. I shouldn't have asked."

2622476547.m_KeyValue: "And then alive again… Who will I become this time?"

2622476550.m_KeyValue: "Is it the will to live—or the urge to protect her...?"

2622531132.m_KeyValue: "What a nightmare! What brat left their toy here? Look at my shop!"

2623329776.m_KeyValue: "Is there a task that requires my attention? Or perhaps... you seek to unravel my mysteries?"

2623332975.m_KeyValue:
""Puppet: Come browse our shop, we have a wonderful selection!
Self: Cash only. No credit.""

2623338472.m_KeyValue: "Will I ever be free of the shackles of the past?"

2623338503.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, my head hurts a bit. I still tend to forget some important things.""

2623340646.m_KeyValue: "What took you so long? You lack the awareness befitting a Vassal of mine!"

2623340677.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, didn't I say not to bother me if there's nothing important?""

2623342820.m_KeyValue: "Unwavering focus is the key to striking every target."

2623342851.m_KeyValue: ""Hehe, shouldn't it be the other way around? I'm older than you, you know?""

2623343686.m_KeyValue: "Are you performing some kind of ritual?"

2623343845.m_KeyValue: ""I've been waiting for you. Come, let us begin!""

2623344994.m_KeyValue: "Do you also have things you cannot forget?"

2623345860.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps even beneath this mask is not the real me."

2623346019.m_KeyValue: ""If you become lost, follow the moonlight.""

2623348034.m_KeyValue: ""...Next time, I might accidentally spill hot tea on you. Do be careful.""

2623348193.m_KeyValue: "Welcome back. I've prepared your room for you."

2623767181.m_KeyValue: ""Is that so? And here I thought my disguise was flawless. No point keeping up appearances now, is there?""

2623768203.m_KeyValue: "Only to relive their destined end. But..."

2623768205.m_KeyValue: "Ugh… I really don't want to fight a potentially high-spending customer."

2625076732.m_KeyValue: "The key is illusion. Make them believe victory lies just within reach. That's when the prey lowers its guard."

2625076733.m_KeyValue: ""A true hunter doesn't just slay her quarry—you know how to capture them, too. Don't you?""

2625076734.m_KeyValue: "I was about to ask you—wasn't this left behind by that silver-haired traveler you've been pursuing?"

2625156460.m_KeyValue: "That doesn't answer my question. You've only explained what we share in common. But I still don't know why they resent you. Or why I've been dragged into this."

2625156461.m_KeyValue: ""Let's leave it at that. Since we finally have a lead on the source of these rumors, I don't have much time to waste.""

2625156462.m_KeyValue: ""If I’m understanding this correctly… You, a Grand Inquisitor who has sentenced countless heretics to the fire, have experienced something similar yourself?""

2625156463.m_KeyValue: "Ghosts are drawn to places and people who share their feelings. It's no different from the Black Blood disease and the beasts it spawns. You of all people should know that."

2625156464.m_KeyValue: "What I find more curious is... Why would a ghost so obsessed with you choose to take on my form in front of others?"

2625156465.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps you, I, and they... all died the same death. Consumed by flames.""

2625156466.m_KeyValue: ""There are too many phenomena in this world, things that not even a Saint or the divine, can explain.""

2625156467.m_KeyValue: "Take this for example: Why can _$$they_$$ shift their appearance at will? Those fanatical scholars in the Church would stop at nothing to obtain that kind of power."

2626978915.m_KeyValue: "But at the very least... I'll make sure he has time to say goodbye properly."

2627383175.m_KeyValue: "Were these people once nobles? How odd... What would nobles be doing here?"

2627383178.m_KeyValue: "It's difficult to fathom what purpose would drive someone to conceal an island above a volcano."

2627383181.m_KeyValue: "Tell me... do you use these to dance upon the winds?"

2630530874.m_KeyValue: ""I tried leaving a note for Julius by that painting, and sure enough—after just a few bell chimes—I received a reply.""

2631162342.m_KeyValue: ""I will protect your past here, and be here to bless you on your next journey—""

2631162343.m_KeyValue: "Why do you keep crying? What should I do..."

2631162344.m_KeyValue: ""He has always been by your side, ever since the day you were born...""

2631162345.m_KeyValue: ""It's my favorite flower. You too, huh...""

2631162346.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, that's right, I brought a Wolfsbane.""

2632349525.m_KeyValue: "If I ever get the chance... do you think I could leave Sapphire Isle one day and see the world outside?"

2632349527.m_KeyValue: "Oh! I almost forgot I can't write!"

2654995912.m_KeyValue: ""66 years ago, when the Black Blood disease ravaged this island, we fought many of their transformed kin...""

""Yakov told me that to celebrate Bella's recovery, he arranged for her to take part in a new interactive performance by the bay.

Bella, playing the Coffee Bean Princess, delivered such brutally honest commentary about the plot that it completely contradicted her character, yet somehow won unexpected praise from the audience.

Yakov was pleased that the performance had brought a long-absent smile to little Bella's face, but she declared it 'the dullest script' she had ever seen.""

2673733326.m_KeyValue:
""The Siren's Tear no longer responded to wine. I tried again and again, desperate to glimpse more of her hidden past.

Until one day, a drop of blood from my wounded hand spilled across its surface. And suddenly, I was pulled back to the old Sapphire Isle.

It was opening day at the auction house. Renowned merchants scoffed at the rules. Nobles turned up their noses and left. Only thugs remained, hungry for easy spoils.

Some smashed coral from the sea, then demanded 'compensation.' The young auctioneer stood trembling, encircled and helpless.

From behind the curtain, a red-haired woman stepped out with quiet grace. 'Leave the poor girl be. Perhaps I can offer compensation instead?'

Her face was entrancing, and her eyes flamed.

A ruffian sneered, lifted his sword to toy with her hair—but before anyone could blink, the man's hand had hit the floor. She stood there, faster than sight, calm and lethal.

'Who the [beep] are you?' the ruffian roared.

'Lorelei,' she replied. 'Acting manager of the Sapphire Isle auction house.' Blood spattered across her cheek—bright as her fiery hair. I reached out, trying to wipe it away, though I could only watch. 

And just for a second… it felt like she looked right at me.""

2673733450.m_KeyValue:
""It rained.

This was the first torrential downpour I had witnessed since my earliest memories. Clutching my disease-ridden shell, I sheltered inside the cave, watching the relentless deluge scour the earth clean. A bitter resentment gnawed at me—my life ebbed away with each passing moment, yet here I cowered, hiding from nature's fury.

When the tempest finally abated and I emerged unto the rain-soaked earth, a verdant flash stopped my heart: the tree trunk that should have withered to rot had somehow birthed fresh buds from its dying flesh...

—Resurrection. The answer I had sought lay hidden within that very storm. Or perhaps... within each seemingly insignificant droplet that fell from the weeping sky.""

2673733698.m_KeyValue:
""The Manor of Eternal Flame's magnificence defied every expectation—sprawling training halls, immaculate quarters, trial grounds bristling with weapons of every conceivable design... All of it a testament to the 'glorious future' promised to those desperate souls sold into bondage.

Yet beneath this grandeur, an unrelenting heat pulsed from the manor's depths, a constant reminder that the ever-beating heart lay buried far below.

It was then that understanding dawned: Genevieve had never betrayed her bloodline. When she and countless Brennholts were consumed by fire, their purpose was not to destroy the Divine Body, but to smother the Calamity 'Flames of War'—a karmic fire that burned a thousandfold more fierce than any earthly flame.

Now, on the eve of the sacrificial rite, I could feel the frenzy and wild vigor of the flames of Calamity with crystalline clarity. The Divine Body was spending its waning energy in desperate struggle, fighting to contain and suppress the very essence of Calamity writhing within its core. What stratagem had Genevieve prepared for this moment?

Firelight flickered across Genevieve's features as she drew an ancient wheel from the folds of her robes. Intricate patterns were carved deep into its bronze surface. If memory served, this was the sacred heirloom passed down through generations of the Alita family.""

2683638538.m_KeyValue: ""This tale is narrated by (one of) the most esteemed bards on Minexus. It's impossible for such a silly mistake to occur. Right, it would never occur, 'til the end of time.""

2683638539.m_KeyValue: ""...Uh, err, that was a hallucination. What's done is done, so—What? No, no, no, I wasn't getting mad that this tiny oversight was pointed out! That's just silly!""

2683638540.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? It jumped from the 1,861 to 1,862...? Wait, who the hell is actually reading the ludicrously long meeting names?""

2684017518.m_KeyValue: "I don't see any aspect of your performance that falls short of others."

2684789842.m_KeyValue: "I will. I'll give it my all to defeat you like this... I won't let down Father's final resolve—"

2686548452.m_KeyValue: "This is where I grew up! I won't let the Church have their way! I won't abandon my people who might not even be infected!"

2686548453.m_KeyValue: "No wonder he tried to stop me from returning to town. Did he know the Church was going to purge Mouret?"

2686548454.m_KeyValue: ""...Dr. Thibault once told us that a knight's duty is to fight, while our duty...""

2686548455.m_KeyValue: ""Since I didn't interrupt your little childhood reunion, in return, shouldn't you take us to the Ashen Garden now?""

2686548457.m_KeyValue: "Save your strength. There must be a way... I got it!"

2686548484.m_KeyValue: "No way! I can't just abandon you!"

2686548485.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... I need to stop here... and rest... But you have a long journey ahead,""

2686548486.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, if she can't accept reality, we'll be stuck here too.""

2686548488.m_KeyValue: ""More than losing his form and dignity, he feared losing the memories you shared.""

2686548489.m_KeyValue: "And he can even sing... Huh? Is someone really singing?"

2686548516.m_KeyValue: ""Despite that, you still hoped for me to leave Mouret and see the world for myself.""

2686548517.m_KeyValue: ""Since entering this misty forest, I've been enveloped in mysteries about myself. I'm uncertain if my past self had any connection to Mouret.""

2686548518.m_KeyValue: "You'll understand when you're older. That is... if you're willing to trust me now."

2686548519.m_KeyValue: ""Ha ha ha, indeed. Sometimes the long way around can be the shortcut, you know.""

2686548523.m_KeyValue: "Everything... So you mean you're willing to spare those two children?! Thank you so much!"

2686869696.m_KeyValue: ""But at least this time, we chose well.""

2686869697.m_KeyValue: "All the more reason we should deal with this quickly—"

2689733929.m_KeyValue: "This is the first time I've heard you speak so softly. Are you really..."

2689734061.m_KeyValue: ""They're armor inhabited by lost souls, remnants of Baphomet's experiments. Leave them to me!""

2689734096.m_KeyValue: "Baphomet... 'the Soulless'? As in the Elder? He did all this?!"

2689734259.m_KeyValue: "This bat... it's... here to help us?! Aren't they supposed to be on the same side?"

2690191806.m_KeyValue: "We shall release them from their torment."

2690194846.m_KeyValue: ""Is this a bounty? Strange, I haven't taken any jobs recently.""

2690200533.m_KeyValue: "Is this my reward for completing my task?"

2690202707.m_KeyValue: "What a gentle audience you are... Then I shall accept your gift."

2690203542.m_KeyValue: ""As a token of gratitude, I will mend your wounds next time.""

2690204850.m_KeyValue: "I guess I'll get a bit serious."

2690204881.m_KeyValue: ""What a hassle... Picking out a gift in return is no easy task, you know?""

2690205716.m_KeyValue: ""A new toy? Do tell me, what new games have you been fantasizing about?""

2690205875.m_KeyValue: ""Allow me to grant you, the sweetest death.""

2691302612.m_KeyValue: "Artifact Patrol are special units that patrol through the ship's cabin. Memorize their routes to avoid being spotted."

2692038461.m_KeyValue: ""In my opinion, we should keep the menu as it is. Let the younger generation taste the hardships we endured in our day!""

2692038527.m_KeyValue: ""This policy is essential to preserving our family's power. If everyone is granted the freedom to take the long sleep, what will happen when war breaks out and they all choose death out of fear? Such a dangerous precedent must not be set under any circumstances.""

2692038558.m_KeyValue: ""Now is absolutely not the time to be training spies. In my opinion, we'd best hold off on this for now.""

2692038624.m_KeyValue: ""Though the Bathory family is regaining its glory, we remain frail compared to the Kingdom and the Church. Only by prioritizing the family's benefit can we ensure our people thrive.""

2692038659.m_KeyValue: ""In my view, the evening gatherings must not be abolished. These young ones, they merely wish to laze about in their coffins.""

2692038690.m_KeyValue: "An untamed animal running wild in the castle could not only damage our antique furniture but also frighten our vassals. We absolutely cannot allow this! It's out of the question!"

2692038756.m_KeyValue: ""However, after all this time, most of the pages must have yellowed and wrinkled... Procuring new books isn't cheap. In my opinion, we should save our resources for now.""

2692038791.m_KeyValue: ""During the Holy War, we didn't even have houses. Who cared about curtains when we were sleeping in cellars? In my opinion, this expense is unnecessary.""

2692038888.m_KeyValue: ""What we need right now are practical skills and survival strategies. Instead of practicing singing, they should focus on perfecting techniques to precisely sever the major arteries of the Church's soldiers. Let's just forget about this.""

2693158718.m_KeyValue: "Hmph. That reaction tells me all I need. So it was you."

2693158723.m_KeyValue: ""Stop whining—I stepped in here with you, didn't I?""

2693158726.m_KeyValue: ""Then tell me, what sin has this 'exhibitionist' rescuer of yours committed?""

2693158727.m_KeyValue: "When you spoke of something worse—did you mean the Scourge?"

2693158728.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... my strength is... failing me."

2693158730.m_KeyValue: "That living weapon thinks of nothing but investigation and combat—she lacks human reason."

2693159781.m_KeyValue: "Losing Vassals will slow down the Bloodsoul Recovery."

2694450378.m_KeyValue: ""I expected you to have vanished by now—and yet here you stand, still within these very walls.""

2694450379.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina lowers the still-unconscious Selena from her shoulder, laying her gently upon the stone floor.""

2694450380.m_KeyValue: "Letitia turns her gaze to the window."

2694450385.m_KeyValue: "...that you would stoop to ally with that Dark Witch!"

2694772657.m_KeyValue:
""Leveling up is the most effective way to increase Vassals' base attributes, but it is subject to their level cap.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Level Up
<style=""InfoText"">Vassals start at LV. 1 and can be leveled up using certain materials. Besides this, Vassals can also be leveled up through the Bloodline Transfusion.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Level Limit
<style=""InfoText"">Vassal level-ups are subject to their own level cap and the following rules:
• Own 5 LV. 40 Vassals to increase level cap to 60.
• Own 5 LV. 60 Vassals to increase level cap to 80.
• Own 5 LV. 80 Vassals to increase level cap to 100.
• Own 5 LV. 100 Vassals to increase level cap to 120.
• Own 5 LV. 120 Vassals to increase level cap to 140.
• Own 5 LV. 140 Vassals to increase level cap to 160.
• Own 5 LV. 160 Vassals to increase level cap to 180.
• Own 5 LV. 180 Vassals to increase level cap to 200.
• Own 5 LV. 200 Vassals to remove level cap.""

2694772658.m_KeyValue:
""Equipment serves as an advanced way to enhance the abilities of Vassals. The higher the quality and level of the equipment, the more noticeable the enhancement effects.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Part
<style=""InfoText"">There are 4 parts that can be equipped: Head, Body, Amulet, and Ring. You may equip the parts only with its corresponding equipment.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Type
<style=""InfoText"">There are 3 types of equipment: Light, Medium, and Heavy. Vassals can only wear equipment that matches their equipment type.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Faction Bonus
<style=""InfoText"">Some special equipment enjoys faction bonuses. Such equipment can have its bonus stats (usually 25%) activated if worn by a Vassal of the right faction.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Enhancement 
<style=""InfoText"">High-quality equipment can be enhanced. The higher the enhancement level, the stronger the attributes provided. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Soul Echo 
<style=""InfoText"">Soul Echo can be performed with Soulstrike for equipment that meets the following requirements: 
• Belongs to Tier 9 and has faction bonuses.
• Equipped by Vassals of the right faction. 
• Enhanced to the max level. 
After Echo, the equipment is bound to the Vassal and gains the following effects: 
• Cannot be unequipped. 
• Provides more powerful attributes. 
• Gains up to 3 Blessings for a certain chance. Blessings can bring a very significant boost to Vassals. 
• Can be recast or refined later to change Blessing effects.""

2694772661.m_KeyValue:
""In the darkest recesses of the world, countless threads of fate have interwoven tightly. Hence, what is about to unfold is not the future, but an event that has already transpired.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Modes
<style=""InfoText"">Chose from Normal Mode and Hard Mode. Note that Hard Mode unlocks after progressing in Normal Mode. Also, enemies in Hard Mode are more formidable, so proceed with caution!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ EX Stage
<style=""InfoText"">EX Stages will appear once certain progress in a chapter has been made. Enemies in EX Stages are all extremely powerful, and units on both sides will be set to a certain LV.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Fated Ties
<style=""InfoText"">Could the items encountered along your journey have once been treasures cherished by a lost soul? Occasionally, the threads of fate intertwine briefly, only to quickly unravel once more.
• Clues may be revealed while progressing through certain chapters. Use these Clues to seek out hidden locations on the world map and discover lost items. 
• Some locations contain Lost Memories belonging to various individuals. By completing sets of Lost Memories, certain rewards will become available. View more details in [Fated Ties] — [Lost Memories].

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Clear
<style=""InfoText"">For Substages in Story Normal Mode, if your current Blood Power is higher than the stage's recommended Blood Power, you can use [Quick Clear] to complete the substage instantly.""

2694772662.m_KeyValue:
""Duke it out with other Lords for power and glory. If victorious, you will receive Marks of Bravery, which may be exchanged for rewards in the [Shop - Blood Shop].

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Fair Play
<style=""InfoText"">• All teams will be set to LV. 200.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Season
<style=""InfoText"">• A season consists of both an Engagement and Armistice period. The Engagement period lasts for 13 days, while the Armistice lasts for 1 day.
• Winning a battle grants you Points while losing one costs you Points. Your ranking is decided by your total Points.
• At the end of a season, your Points will be reset to around 1,000.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Challenge</style>
<style=""InfoText"">• Select an opponent you want to challenge from the Opponent List.
• You have 3 free challenges per day.
• When free attempts are used up, you may use Arena Pass to engage in more challenges. There is a daily purchase limit for Arena Pass.
• A challenge consists of a Preparation Phase and a Battle Phase.
• If you quit or time out during the Preparation Phase, the challenge will be canceled and no challenge attempts will be consumed.
• If you quit or time out during the Battle Phase, your challenge will be considered a failure, which will result in the consumption of your challenge attempt, thus Points will be settled accordingly.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Defense Team
<style=""InfoText"">Tap Edit Team to arrange your lineup. When challenged by other Lords, your Defense Team will take on the challenge and defend your glory.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Offense Team
<style=""InfoText"">You can edit your Offense Team after you select an opponent and enter the battle.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Winning Conditions
<style=""InfoText"">The team that defeats the other team first wins. If the two teams tie for victory, they both win. If the attacker quits or times out in the Battle Phase, their challenge will be considered a failure.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Achieving victory in the battle earns you Victory Rewards.
• Daily rank rewards will be issued via Mail every day.
• After a season ends, season rank rewards will be issued via Mail.""

2694772663.m_KeyValue:
""Send your loyal Vassals on hired missions! Mercenary Hunting Ground offers attractive Skill Upgrade materials.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Mercenary Hunting Ground
<style=""InfoText"">Earn rewards based on kills, up to 3 hunts per day. Please manage your hunts wisely!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Clear
<style=""InfoText"">Achieve a score in any hunt to unlock Quick Clear for that day (consumes hunt attempts). Rewards will be based on your best score of the day.""

2694772664.m_KeyValue:
""Transfuse with family blood, and inherit will of the strong. Bloodline Transfusion can help level up your Vassals and even raise their level cap.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Vassals
<style=""InfoText"">The 5 highest-level Vassals will automatically join the Transfusion.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Level
<style=""InfoText"">Transfusion Level will be limited to the lowest level of the 5 participating Vassals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Slot
<style=""InfoText"">Newly-added Vassals upgrade to the set Transfusion Level automatically. However, Vassals in Transfusion cannot be upgraded independently.
• In some cases, Transfusion Level can be higher than a Vassal's max level.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Bloodline Evolution
<style=""InfoText"">When Transfusion Level reaches LV. 200, you can evolve the Bloodline Transfusion. Once the Bloodline Transfusion is evolved, Transfusion Vassal levels cannot be reset.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Upgrade
<style=""InfoText"">When Transfusion Level is below LV. 200, you can use Transfusion Upgrade to conveniently synchronize and boost all Transfusion Vassals' levels.""

2694772665.m_KeyValue:
""Moonlight Tribute is essential to the Bathory family, and is a key source of basic enhancement materials.
<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Moonlight Faith
<style=""InfoText"">Every 5 clears in Threads of Fate (both Normal or Hard Mode) increases Moonlight Faith by 1, and Moonlight Faith increases Tribute gains.
<style=""InfoText"">Moonlight Tribute Earnings are capped at 24 hour intervals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Extra Sermon
<style=""InfoText"">Lords may perform Extra Sermons a limited number of times per day to gain basic resources and random item rewards equal to 2 hours of ritual time per Sermon.""

2694772666.m_KeyValue:
""This is where your loyal Vassals gather. To view specific rules about Vassal development, go to the development tab in Vassal details and tap the [!] icon in the top left corner.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Blood Power
<style=""InfoText"">Blood Power represents the overall combat ability of a Vassal. Developing Vassals can enhance their Blood Power rating, and you can develop Vassals through various means, including but not limited to: leveling up, skill enhancement, equipment development, Future Artifacts, Ritual Chamber, Affinity, etc.""

2694772667.m_KeyValue:
""Legend holds that each blade in the tomb has befallen a Blood Beast. As time passes, however, the blood shed transforms into dark spirits that linger below.
Take on these powerful spirits in the Tomb of the Fallen to obtain Equipment! 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Tomb of the Fallen
<style=""InfoText"">There are 4 major stages that unlock as you progress through Threads of Fate. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Exorcise Spirit
<style=""InfoText"">Use Exorcise attempts to take on spirits and earn rewards.
Exorcise attempts are shared between all stages and reset daily. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Spirit Fragments
<style=""InfoText""> Spirit Fragments represent the total DMG dealt to a spirit.
The higher the accumulated DMG dealt to a spirit, the more Fragments you'll receive, and thus the better the rewards.
As your Spirit Fragment count increases, spirits will grow stronger.
Spirit Fragments reset daily for each stage. Daily Spirit Fragment records are only recorded when fighting manually. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Battle
<style=""InfoText"">After manually fighting a spirit, you may use Quick Battle, which is based on the best attempt that day. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Trial Exorcism
<style=""InfoText"">You may practice on all unlocked stages.
Trial Exorcism does not consume daily attempts, but it does not count towards Spirit Fragments, nor does it provide rewards.""

2694772668.m_KeyValue:
""Towers and Abysses appear as opposing forces. Yet, as you climb upwards here, you eventually… plummet further into the depths. Advance in Infinite Abyss to earn Moon Tear and Faction Vassal Shards!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Infinite Abyss
<style=""InfoText"">Venture into the abyss to take down enemies. The farther you progress, the stronger the enemies you encounter. Infinite Abyss consists of the Tower of Purification and 4 Faction Abysses.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Tower of Purification
<style=""InfoText"">Accessible throughout the day, you may enter with all your Vassals and there are no faction restrictions.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Faction Abysses
<style=""InfoText"">These consist of Tower of Ancestry - Decay, Tower of the Church - Original Sin, Tower of the Bloodborn - Desire, and Tower of the Kingdom - Deception. Each corresponds to a faction, and is open for a limited time. Only faction Vassals can enter!""

""When the Blood Moon looms high, intruders prowl into the castle halls. Thus the hunt begins. Exterminate them before dawn's light.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hunting Hours
<style=""InfoText"">• During the event, 5 stages will open on different days, with 2 stages available each day. All stages will be open on Saturday and Sunday. Only open stages can be challenged. Please plan your Hunt accordingly.
• Available stages open at 05:00 daily and close at 04:00 the following day. Scores will be settled after the stage is closed.
• Entry closes 10 minutes before daily settlement. Ongoing challenges continue, but stages cleared after closing time won't be recorded.
• After all challenges end, the Review phase begins, during which challenges won't be available. Lords can collect unclaimed Rewards and view Rankings.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Stage Challenge
<style=""InfoText"">• Complete the objectives for each Stage to achieve a score.
• Stages can be challenged multiple times, but only your best score is recorded and ranked.
• Rewards can be claimed once you reach the required stage objectives.
• All Vassals are set to LV. 200 during the challenges, with individual progression bonuses remaining unaffected.
• Each stage provides multiple relevant Seals. You can select 2 Seals to assist your battle.
• In different stages, DMG increase or reduction attributes that monsters receive may be adjusted.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Leaderboard
<style=""InfoText"">• You'll be grouped with random players and ranked by your scores.
• Stage Rankings determine your points, which increase with your ranking.
• All Rankings display total scores across all stages. All Ranking Rewards are distributed once all challenges conclude.
• Stage Rankings update in real-time, while the All Rankings update daily at 04:00.""

""They are treasures that transcend dimensions—the crystallization of memories, but more importantly, items essential for exploring the Timeworn Mausoleum.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Relic Gallery
<style=""InfoText"">When attempting stages, you'll have the chance to collect Past Relics. For each new Relic collected, its entry in the Gallery will activate automatically. In the Gallery, you can look up information about Relics at any time.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Relic Types
<style=""InfoText"">The Gallery is divided into three sections:
• Unique Relics: View the effects of both Sealed and Activated Unique Relics. Here you can also learn which Basic Materia are needed to activate Sealed Relics.
• General Relics: View the effects of both Sealed and Activated Basic Relics. Here you can also learn which Basic Materia are needed to activate Sealed Relics.
• Basic Materia: View the detailed effects of various Basic Materia. These are crucial for activating more advanced Relics.""

2694772825.m_KeyValue:

2694772826.m_KeyValue:
