2694772827.m_KeyValue:
""As you gaze into the abyss below, countless souls from other realms gaze back. This mausoleum is both a graveyard for memories, and a cradle of nightmares.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Stages 
<style=""InfoText"">• The Timeworn Mausoleum has five floors, with three stages on each floor.
• Complete battle objectives to clear the current stage. 
• There are no attempt limits for any stage.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Mechanics 
<style=""InfoText"">The Timeworn Mausoleum features a tower defense mechanism. Inside the Mausoleum dwell a host of phantoms who constantly surge toward Rifts in a desperate bid for salvation. Certain rules apply:
• In battle, your Vassals will hold their position in front of the Rift and will not actively pursue enemies.
• Each Vassal can block a number of phantoms, and certain roles (such as Warrior, Defender, and Assassin) can block more phantoms.
• Some Vassal skills may function differently in the Timeworn Mausoleum.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limits 
<style=""InfoText"">When attempting stages in the Timeworn Mausoleum, the following restrictions apply:
• Your Vassal LV. will be a set value, which can be raised through the Talent Tree.
• Equipment will remain effective in the Timeworn Mausoleum.
• Future Artifacts will remain effective in the Timeworn Mausoleum.
• Vassal Skill LV. does not take effect in the Timeworn Mausoleum.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Inventory Management 
<style=""InfoText"">Past Relics will drop in the Timeworn Mausoleum. Players can place Relics in their Inventory to gain extra effects in battle:
• Inventory space is limited, be sure to organize your bags carefully as you may not be able to hold all items. 
• Past Relics come in 5 types: 
1. Unique Relics grant attribute bonuses and skill buffs for featured Vassals.
2. General Relics grant attribute bonuses for all deployed Vassals, with some offering skill buffs.
3. Sealed Relics are either Unique or General Relics with certain powers locked off. When placed in your Inventory, not all effects will be granted.
4. Basic Materia can activate Sealed Relics when placed together in your Inventory, granting the item's full potential.
5. Expansion Bags increase Inventory capacity.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• After completing a stage, rewards are calculated based on the number of Phantoms you eliminate. Your reward level increases with the number of Phantoms eliminated.
• Claim your rewards from the main menu after your reward level increases.
• Rewards can only be claimed once per day.""

2694772828.m_KeyValue: ""Initial Hand allows you to set up to 3 Ultimates that enter your hand at the start of the battle. Upon Victory, your hand will be saved until the lineup is changed.""

2697652832.m_KeyValue: ""I saw you in the stands—front row, third seat of the noble box.""

2697652835.m_KeyValue: "Joan will return to herself soon. I know she will."

2698757730.m_KeyValue: ""'Interestingly, this key, unearthed alongside the linen, bears a similar eye-shaped emblem. I can't help but wonder what they might lead to.'""

2698757731.m_KeyValue: ""A lake crowned the hill, its shape and color like an azure iris. It transformed the hill into a colossal eye fixed upon the heavens, its gaze eternal and unwavering.""

2698757733.m_KeyValue: ""'Looks like you've cracked it too,' Friedrich said, picking up one of the manuscripts and placing it next to the one in Gilrain's hand.""

2698757734.m_KeyValue: ""If you could see Gilrain's expression right now, it would undoubtedly be a sight to behold.""

2698760994.m_KeyValue: ""The way it was said—so casual, so unconcerned—you'd think the cat was talking about something else entirely.""

2698760995.m_KeyValue: ""—Wait. Upon closer inspection, that was just Theophane, calmly walking ahead to lift the flap.""

2698760996.m_KeyValue: ""'...Meow? Staring at me won't help, meow... Zzz...'""

2698760997.m_KeyValue: ""A breeze rustled the travel tent, lifting the flap just enough to reveal a black kitten curled in a nest, eyes half-lidded in a lazy doze. 'Mmh... they're here, meow.'""

2698760998.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, yes. This morning's reading said I'd encounter a woman with the initial J, atop a mountain with a lake, sometime this afternoon…'""

2698760999.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, I know. Lovers is a pair, so it ought to be doubled. But even then, it only reaches twelve. Still less than thirteen. Which makes this my victory.'""

2698761000.m_KeyValue: ""...Sure, there might be no rules, but you can't just do whatever you want! Where's the dignity of the Church in all this, Vice-Commander!?""

2698761001.m_KeyValue: ""With a flick of its left paw, three Tarot cards flew cleanly from the top of the deck, landing face-down on the table before the two people—and itself. 'Why, by whose reading turns out more accurate, of course, meow.'""

2698761005.m_KeyValue: ""'But why was it given to us?' Theophane hesitated. 'I mean, we didn't exactly win that match...'""

2698827426.m_KeyValue: ""As if to match the grandeur of her proclamation, Ami strode forward across the deck, grabbed a piece of grilled squid that had mysteriously appeared, and bit into it triumphantly.""

2698827427.m_KeyValue: "So this is the real reason Ami wanted to go to Starfall Valley..."

2698827428.m_KeyValue: ""These two aren't talking about the same thing, are they？""

2698827429.m_KeyValue: ""'Keep going, Stella. I'm all ears.' Ami pointedly ignored Goldland's interjection.""

2698827430.m_KeyValue: "'Uhm... well...' Regina fidgeted nervously. 'I think I heard Albrecht mention once that the <style=Highlight>Minexus Restoration System Y</style> is somewhere in Starfall Valley...'"

2698827431.m_KeyValue: ""'For we are the last remnants of humanity in this world, and the El Dorado is our final warship!'""

2698827432.m_KeyValue: ""A gentle breeze swept past Ami from behind, lifting her dress in a soft, rustling whisper.""

2698828514.m_KeyValue: """"Ah... you're right.' Agares stopped and turned to face Noah. 'Tell me. Why do you think that is?'""

2698828515.m_KeyValue: ""'Fair point...' Agares paused, as if something had just occurred to him and turned to face Noah. 'How about this? You'll be my next Vice-Commander. What do you say?'""

2698828516.m_KeyValue: "'The stench is too strong for something that's been sitting underground for ages.'"

2698828517.m_KeyValue: ""('So he's found something... That means he won't ask me to help, right?')""

2698828518.m_KeyValue: "W-What? Has the real one already been revealed just like that?!"

2698828519.m_KeyValue: ""'I'm in a sour mood right now, dear imposter.' Twin Agares raised a hand and flames sparked to life in his palm, radiating blistering heat.""

2698828520.m_KeyValue: "Noah remained noncommittal. 'Even so... why did you take Agares's form?'"

2698828521.m_KeyValue: "'The real Agares has never done that.' Noah took several steps forward. 'Unless... neither of you is the real one.'"

2698828523.m_KeyValue: "'...they fuse into a burning sun—like the man who constantly sets himself ablaze.' Mass gave a bitter smile and shook her head. 'But it's all just an illusion.'"

2698829602.m_KeyValue: ""Suddenly, Darcias pinned Acappella against a gravestone. As she drew closer, it became impossible to tell whether the encroaching cold came from the graveyard or Darcias.""

2698829604.m_KeyValue: ""'Seems broken. Won't open.' After a few whimpers, the stone door stopped shaking.""

2698829605.m_KeyValue: ""The air grew colder in the space between their frozen gazes. Had the silence shown emotion, it surely would have exclaimed, 'This is a graveyard!'""

2698829606.m_KeyValue: ""(clearing throat) As a tale by the greatest bard of Minexus, it’s flawless, of course. I definitely did not get carried away and added a few lines on the spot. (clearing throat again)""

2698829607.m_KeyValue: ""'And this is a heated showdown between two lead singers!' Acappella placed her hands on her hips, her eyes blazing with determination.""

2698901474.m_KeyValue: "Hati could vividly picture the scene: the Garlic knight not only had to fend off their father but also block any attack that might harm the animals or even a tree."

2698901475.m_KeyValue: ""'However, I believe that in warriors' contests, utilizing the environment is crucial. So in that match with your father, if we had seen it through to the end, he probably would have won.'""

2698901478.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, however, pressed on, his battle cries echoing with each wild swing of his short sword. The fire of youth had clearly ignited his temper.""

2698901479.m_KeyValue: ""'Looks like I need to hit the road, or I'll start rusting away,' Gadric said, catching Hati by surprise.""

2698901480.m_KeyValue: ""'But... but...' Clive stammered, his convictions visibly shaken.""

2698901481.m_KeyValue: "Gadric settled himself on the stone steps and began to savor his lunch."

2698904741.m_KeyValue: ""'There is,' Empousa unexpectedly provided the answer. 'They ensured that this Fangtooth Tower stands tall and unshaken to this very day!'""

2698904742.m_KeyValue: ""'Later, the attackers tried setting fires at the base of the tower, but even this failed to drive out the stalwart Ganelon defenders.'""

2698904743.m_KeyValue: ""'What do you mean it's not?' Empousa put her hands on her hips. 'We Bathorys successfully repelled the enemy, thanks to the intel we got from Fangtooth Tower!'""

2698904744.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey Hati, I've heard the sunset here is beautiful. Is it true?' Empousa asked.""

2698904745.m_KeyValue: ""'All the land on the Howling Peninsula was forcibly occupied by your family,' Empousa shouted, hands on her hips. 'I've told you to read more, you dim-witted wolf!'""

2698930882.m_KeyValue: "Unmoved by the noisy protests <size=-10><alpha=#88>(?)</size><alpha=#ff> Letitia continues her tale. 'On a certain Other Side... the continent we know is not called <style="Highlight">Minexus</style>...'"

2698930884.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia still pays no attention to that incessant voice<size=-10><alpha=#88>(?)</alpha></size><alpha=#ff>. 'This infant is you, little Stella.'""

2698930885.m_KeyValue: ""'The seven most renowned legends are known to <style=""Highlight"">Other Side enthusiasts</style> as the <color=#bc544b>Seven Great Mysteries of yyf</color>, with the foremost among them being—'""

2698930886.m_KeyValue: ""'By contrast, Bathory Castle—though it reigns as the continent's heart, the paramount nexus of commerce, culture, passage, history, and revelry...'""

2698930887.m_KeyValue: ""'But Ressa lacks the time. As Sunset Isle's sole licensed physician, she keeps a grueling schedule of house calls and endless duties.'""

2698930888.m_KeyValue:
""
<align=""center""><b>'Everything that will happen must happen, because it has transpired.""

2698933058.m_KeyValue: ""'The Bathory family's loyalty was once unquestionable. When the goddess commanded them to cede a portion of their lands to their despised rivals, the Ganelon family, they obeyed, surrendering territory to those contemptible mongrels.'""

2698933059.m_KeyValue: "'We seek texts or treatises concerning the art of alchemy.'"

2698933060.m_KeyValue: ""Under the moonlight, they came upon an even more out-of-place metal instrument. Even the moonlight twisted and coiled around it, as if being inexorably drawn into its otherworldly form.""

2698933061.m_KeyValue: ""'Let's go,' Piera decided. 'No point wasting time here. We'll go in and see for ourselves.'""

2698933065.m_KeyValue: ""Cain's mockery left the three deeply unsettled—each silently praying it wasn't true, for if it were, their faith would crumble to dust the moment they stepped out of the church.""

2698934018.m_KeyValue: ""And someone who spends all day chasing after fun has no right to judge them, do they?""

2698934019.m_KeyValue: ""'Acappella. If I'm not mistaken, weren't you supposed to be out gathering herbs with Darcias today?'""

2698934020.m_KeyValue: "—Why did both of them fall for it!?"

2698934021.m_KeyValue: "'And this sword-and-shield symbol likely represents the Gravekeeper.'"

2698934023.m_KeyValue: ""What? Skip? What does that even mean—skip what!? You think dropping a cryptic, cool-sounding line gets you off the hook!? Explain the rules, Bell Ringer!""

2698934024.m_KeyValue: "Note: A 'Slap' may be a bit exaggerated."

2698934025.m_KeyValue: ""'He's sacrificing six cards at once… Such a massive cost—could it be…' Thibault's voice was lower than usual, as if she already foresaw the coming storm of molten fury.""

2698934026.m_KeyValue: ""'Blegh… ptooey!' Acappella grimaced in utter disgust, glaring at Darcias with venom in her eyes. 'Dar—cias! What was that for—'""

2698972258.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Consider her attire,_$$ Friedrich continued, his analytical mind at work. _$$To venture forth so lightly dressed on winter's most bitter day—she must possess a constitution impervious to cold. And her presence here in Aesgracia Village suggests she—_$$""

2698972259.m_KeyValue: ""<s><alpha=#88>The paragons</s><alpha=#FF> Gilrain and Friedrich wheeled toward the voice, their eyes falling upon a silhouette both achingly familiar and impossibly strange—it was...""

2698972261.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps it was the ripple of temporal forces that stirred some distant soul—or perhaps mere coincidence. After all, every tale owes something to chance.""

2698972263.m_KeyValue: ""At these words, Friedrich glanced at Gilrain's bare chest. Catching the look, Gilrain thrust his torso forward defiantly and shot back a challenging glare. _$$Gilrain, you underestimate winter's bite._$$""

2698972265.m_KeyValue: ""_$$...Ah._$$ Gilrain adopted a studied indifference and turned to Friedrich. _$$Well then, shall we? Tasks await._$$""

2698972270.m_KeyValue: ""Epilogue: Due to another Aiona eliminating _$$Joyce Gadric_$$ ahead of schedule, the task was deemed incomplete. Once again, Gilrain watched first place in the assessment slip away.""

2698972271.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Oh no… this was my favorite._$$ The other Aiona turned and smiled, looking back at the version of herself who was struggling with all her might. _$$Funny thing. This shawl was made right here._$$""

2698973348.m_KeyValue: ""'That contract was to fulfill a promise. At a friend's grave, he swore a solemn vow—to erect a haven for travelers against nature's fury.'""

2698973349.m_KeyValue: ""'An intriguing tale, indeed. I perceive the message you aim to convey.'""

2698973350.m_KeyValue: ""'Is this pitiful grass huddling together for warmth, or a deception woven by oleanders blooming in a parched riverbed?'""

2698973351.m_KeyValue: ""'In fact, they did something that everyone considered foolish, even cowardly—they built a simple waystation right where they were, merely 3 miles from Iron City.'""

2698973352.m_KeyValue: ""'Be careful not to startle the little one in your hands,' Yggdrasill said, his words reflecting the boundless patience he had for his pupil.""

2698973353.m_KeyValue: ""'Would you permit me to share his story with you?' Edina asked, sitting upright in her chair, hands folded neatly on her lap.""

2699004930.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, that's cheating!' Hati cried out, dashing after her. To her surprise, Ami had already beaten her to it.""

2699004931.m_KeyValue: ""The windmill's creaking seemed to intensify, its cacophony growing so fierce it raised doubts about its structural integrity. It was as if the old mill was desperately pleading for one last chance to serve before being destroyed by the merciless march of time.""

2699004934.m_KeyValue: ""'They clearly had no concept of financial planning,' Empousa scoffed, her voice dripping with disdain and unwarranted superiority.""

2699004935.m_KeyValue: ""'Stop showing off knowledge you've picked up from books,' Hati called out Empousa. 'Cleaning a mill requires a lot of water and is usually done after the harvest season. It's not something that happens frequently.'""

2699004936.m_KeyValue: "'Yes. Legend has it that the Bathory family head who spearheaded the effort to aid Ganelon vehemently cursed the Ganelon family before he was killed.'"

2699004937.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa exclaimed eagerly, 'And wasn't that a perfect opportunity to bring the Ganelon family over to the Bloodborn side?'""

2699010244.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa sighed. 'Don't tell me you didn't like them back then, so you tossed them on the roof, and now you're regretting it and coming to find them?'""

2699010245.m_KeyValue: ""Hati sat on the roof, clutching the gloves and gazing up at the full moon as it emerged from the dispersing dark clouds.""

2699010246.m_KeyValue: "Hati interjected: 'I recall reading in the family records that a Bathory ancestor was killed after being struck by lightning. Perhaps that explains Empousa's fear.'"

2699010247.m_KeyValue: ""'Say, Empousa, I was thinking... Could it be that you're afraid of lightning because it can suddenly light up the sky like the sun?'""

2699010248.m_KeyValue: ""Now the mill's windmill no longer spun idly. Its interlocking gears drove the millstone, steadily grinding out sack after sack of easily storable flour.""

2699010249.m_KeyValue: ""On the mill's final night of operation, Hati used a wrench to disengage the gears connecting the windmill to the mechanism below. However, she deliberately left the switch that locked the windmill's rotation in place.""

2699076802.m_KeyValue: ""—But seeing the complex expressions of hard-fought victory on everyone's faces, Noah paused, thought for a moment, and decided to keep those words to himself.""

2699076804.m_KeyValue: ""'On second thought, explaining would be too much work.' Before even starting, Agares quickly abandoned the idea and turned toward the hot spring.""

2699076805.m_KeyValue: "—And there was his characteristic sigh of resignation."

2699076807.m_KeyValue: ""'Now now, let's not go around calling people sources of contamination,' Agares said with a resigned shake of his head. 'And if we're talking about the Plague, wouldn't that be you?'""

2699076808.m_KeyValue: ""'Ow ow ow...' Hati winced as she struggled to climb out of the pool. 'The mist here is so dense—even our hometown, Mouret, can't compare...'""

2699076809.m_KeyValue: ""'I told you not to force yourself to come along,' Noah said, gently patting Hati's back. 'We've only just set sail, so there's still time to turn back if you want.'""

2699077762.m_KeyValue: "...Never mind! Your opinions don't matter! Let’s refocus our gaze on the scene at hand!"

2699077763.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no... That can't be true! Because...""

2699077764.m_KeyValue: "'Gadric won’t escape this time. I’m more curious how far he'll go.'"

2699077765.m_KeyValue: "'—isn't a full-moon night!' Nicole's pupils contracted. 'Which means… he never said that line tonight!'"

2699077766.m_KeyValue: ""'Acappella vanished early this morning. Probably off chasing her next thrill.' She raised an arm and examined it briefly, as if checking her own vitals.""

2699077767.m_KeyValue: ""'Gadric...' Nicole flicked droplets from her hair, '...once told Edina that he wore the helmet because, like plants, he didn't need to eat.'""

2699077768.m_KeyValue: ""(All right, we've driven him into the deep end. Now we wait.)""

2699077769.m_KeyValue: ""Nicole smiled and raised a single finger. Droplets slowly beaded at the tip. 'With this, of course.'""

2699077774.m_KeyValue: ""'Weeding's no fun at all. How did that garlic-head even put up with this?' The so-called Gadric grumbled a few complaints, then raised a hand in a familiar gesture...""

2699148682.m_KeyValue: ""After an eternity of anticipation, the last grain of sand finally trickled through. The (ostensibly) 'solid gold' (but secretly hollow) Statue of Goldland triumphantly flipped over and stood erect, its arms outstretched as if to embrace the heavens!""

2699148683.m_KeyValue: ""Interestingly, judging by its weight, that sculpture was clearly hollow and merely gold-plated... The reasoning behind this peculiar design? Well... that's another sad story altogether.""

2699148684.m_KeyValue: ""'Exactly! Goldland amassed enormous profits through seafood smuggling, throwing the entire Minexus seafood market into chaos. Every family on the continent has reached their breaking point with him.'""

2699148685.m_KeyValue: ""'Hah, I know what you're thinking: that I alone can't defeat both of you.' Van Helsing said, all the while scanning his two opponents, watching for any sudden moves to pursue Goldland.""

2699148686.m_KeyValue: ""In a flash, Van Helsing grasped the truth: The real Seafood Tycoon Pearl had never been in that dilapidated shack—it had been here in the square all along! The recent explosion had caused it to transfer directly into Noah's body!""

2699148687.m_KeyValue: ""Before Noah could finish speaking, a nimble figure suddenly sprang out from the side, lunging fiercely at Cain!""

2699148689.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, I never saw this coming. I was on the brink of making a grave error. As always, Silver-haired one, your insight puts me to shame.'""

2699150853.m_KeyValue: ""'Em-Empousa?!' After quickly checking Empousa was unharmed, Lamia turned to face Tris. 'You bastard! Looking to start a war with the Bathory? I don't care if you're from some choir—'""

2699150858.m_KeyValue: ""'A contest...?' Lamia crossed her arms, eyeing Tris suspiciously. 'You're not planning to use this as a cover for something else, are you?'""

2699150859.m_KeyValue: "Her words brought an immediate silence—she had clearly struck a chord; everyone present obviously had more important matters to attend to."

2699150860.m_KeyValue: ""'Should be around here somewhere, Commander.' Acappella casually flipped open a nearby wooden box. 'Though... I wonder what you plan to do with 'that thing' once we find it?'""

2699150861.m_KeyValue: ""'If you keep dragging your feet, I'm leaving without you, you dummy Empousa!'""

2699150863.m_KeyValue: "'Not if I can help it!' Acappella pointed at Lamia with a finger-gun gesture. 'Just so we're clear—I won't go easy on you like the Commander does.'"

2699150864.m_KeyValue: "'Wh-what's the big deal? That doesn't seem so difficult!'"

2699153994.m_KeyValue: ""Agares slicked his hair back with a sweep of his hand, then paused, eyes glinting with some fresh mischief.""

2699153996.m_KeyValue: ""…Wait, when did he get so philosophical?""

2699153997.m_KeyValue: ""Still reeling from the sheer audacity, Noah finally spoke. 'You're the one who pushed me in.'""

2699154000.m_KeyValue: ""The finish line drew near… but suddenly, chaos erupted in the water—""

2699154001.m_KeyValue: "Noah slipped out from under his arm without a word."

2699156166.m_KeyValue: "'Could this be what Cain meant by something that could enhance our family's power...!'"

2699156167.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella stood there stunned, her mouth opening and closing as words failed her.""

2699156170.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, hey...' Acappella made a token attempt to twist free, then protested halfheartedly when she realized she couldn't move. 'Isn't this against the rules?'""

2699156171.m_KeyValue: ""Before Empousa could finish her words, the fish-skin ball crashed into the fishing net with thunderous force, creating a massive depression in the net that seemed ready to tear it apart.""

2699156172.m_KeyValue: ""'Acappella, a Bell Ringer shouldn't say such things.' Tris walked toward the torn net. 'The Bathory ladies have won this match—after all, I did break the rules.'""

2699156173.m_KeyValue: "Empousa unconsciously clenched her fists at her sides. 'Something that could enhance our family's power... Could it really be hidden in such an unremarkable fishing village?'"

2699156174.m_KeyValue: ""'Come forth, my servants—Scarlet Vassal Dance!' Before Lamia could finish speaking, four Scarlet Bats appeared, swirling around her.""

2699156175.m_KeyValue: ""'While the rules don't explicitly forbid using our abilities, still...' Tris pondered with her chin in hand, completely unfazed by the fish-skin ball that Acappella had just sent skyward.""

2699156176.m_KeyValue: ""'Go forth, my servants!' Four Scarlet Bats heeded the command and intercepted the ball's trajectory, their wings beating in unison to create a whirlwind that might slow its advance.""

2699156177.m_KeyValue: ""'Ugh! You're so annoying!' Empousa exploded, hands on her hips as she stomped her foot. 'Standing there gloating with that fake sweetness...'""

2699410421.m_KeyValue: "Clear [A Familiar Spark] <color=#a65f30>N 2-11</color>: Clouds on the Horizon"

2699889061.m_KeyValue: "Survive the siege of the Nightmares for 60 sec."

2700394617.m_KeyValue: ""And he healed with its grace—nurturing herbs, mending flesh, tilling life from soil.""

2700394618.m_KeyValue: "And prove I will never be bound by darkness again."

2700394619.m_KeyValue: ""Your power is far too dangerous. That's why the Saint chose to seal you alongside the equally dangerous Divine Body, Brain. Only eternal, beautiful dreams… can contain the Death that cannot die.""

2700394620.m_KeyValue: "And what about you? Have you found it yet? The future you've searched for all your life—Where no life will ever face death again?"

2700394621.m_KeyValue: ""It's been a while… or perhaps only a moment for you, Noah Nevernight. The one who died.""

2700394622.m_KeyValue: "This is... Sunset Isle? I'm back here again."

2700397820.m_KeyValue: ""Although the impostor can only move at less than half your speed, it was enough for me to make it here.""

2700397821.m_KeyValue: ""If anyone should be worried, it's me—I came here with the resolve to kill you.""

2700397822.m_KeyValue: ""Now, with no one standing between us, let's have an all-out battle—just me and your true self.""

2701704175.m_KeyValue: "What!? They're back on their feet already!?"

2702049656.m_KeyValue: ""If you say your secret is not related to the Calamity, that's enough for me.""

2702049657.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother said that at the time, the faithful across the entire continent were in a state of panic... People saw that the Church's Bell Ringers, who had always seemed invincible, could still be...""

2702049658.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother said she remembers that day vividly. 66 years ago, during a fierce thunderstorm, when the sun was completely shrouded by dark clouds...""

2702049660.m_KeyValue: ""Shortly after I arrived here, I met those crab friends... and you, Noah...""

2702049661.m_KeyValue: "No... I don't... I... I can't hear the other voices!"

2702049662.m_KeyValue: "I can. I'm actually getting used to this by now."

2702049689.m_KeyValue: "I got the directions wrong again? I'm so embarrassed!"

2702049690.m_KeyValue: "It's all our fault... If only we had believed the doctor's diagnosis sooner... if only I had sought help from the Church in time..."

2702049692.m_KeyValue: "But I want to see if they will..."

2702049951.m_KeyValue: ""I will wait for you, always... Noah.""

2702049984.m_KeyValue: ""Seeing them like this, I can't help but feel sorry for them.""

2702049985.m_KeyValue: "I... I'm okay... It's just... I fell and hurt my leg when I got startled. Ow..."

2702049986.m_KeyValue: "Maybe I actually drowned at sea? That would explain a few things. Is there a place where the sun never sets... Wait..."

2702050015.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, stay close to me. Let's take care of these guys first... I still have a lot of questions for you.""

2702050016.m_KeyValue: ""No, it was just wishful thinking on my part. I should've known it wouldn't be that—Huh?""

2702050017.m_KeyValue: "Piera... There's no need to be so nervous. Are you not used to talking to strangers?"

2702050021.m_KeyValue: ""N-No... Besides those crabs, you're the first soul I've seen.""

2702050047.m_KeyValue: ""There are people who recognize us here, but also secrets that are beyond our understanding.""

2702050048.m_KeyValue: "You saw them too?! Do you know who they are?! Did they hurt you?"

2702050051.m_KeyValue: "This is no time for jokes. Where's the doctor? You two were inseparable!"

2702050053.m_KeyValue: "What is my connection to Ressa? What did I do to this island?"

2702050084.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying he did not escape?"

2702050085.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, this is why I can't stand that old hag. She acts like she knows everything, but never lifts a finger...""

2702050086.m_KeyValue: "How peculiar. Blood Beasts don't just vanish upon death."

2702050114.m_KeyValue: ""A homeland where the sun never sets, a lonely isle of the dead's longing—'Sunset Isle' is where I'll find the next 'Moonblessed' connected to my memories...""

2702050115.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry for scaring you. It's probably because I've encountered all these people who seem to know me, yet I can't recognize them. My memories are all jumbled up.""

2702050116.m_KeyValue: ""No, you just don't want to remember—you're terrified to face what you've done to all of us.""

2702050117.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, do you remember what I always used to say?""

2702050118.m_KeyValue: ""But you, on the other hand, seem genuinely unaware of their existence.""

2702050143.m_KeyValue: ""Um... actually... instead of longing, perhaps memories might be more accurate?""

2702050144.m_KeyValue: ""The sun as the Divine Body? Noah, that's... very romantic...""

2702050145.m_KeyValue: ""I sure hope so. At least, I feel like I'm alive. But come to think of it, how should we define being 'alive'...""

2702050146.m_KeyValue: "Wh-what's going on!? Is... is something there?"

2702050147.m_KeyValue: ""...Oh. So you didn't come because this is your hometown, Noah?""

2702050148.m_KeyValue: ""I know who I am, I know where I'm from, I know my duty—I haven't forgotten anything...""

2702050149.m_KeyValue: ""It's your first time here too, but you've already figured out this island...""

2702050150.m_KeyValue: "Please forgive me if my pronunciation is off."

2702255125.m_KeyValue: ""Do you even know who I am now? Who I was, before?""

2702255126.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, Captain Goldland. Everything rests on your decision.""

2702255127.m_KeyValue: ""With the present of the four Apocalyptic Moonblessed, Limine will become the fifth blood.""

2702255128.m_KeyValue: "You and Cain both treat lives as pawns for your schemes."

2702255129.m_KeyValue: "The other at midnight—a final summons to unite all blood."

2702255130.m_KeyValue: "Your hatred for those who burned you surely outweighs your hatred for those who brought you back."

2702667489.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since we woke up, there's been this voice in our heads telling us to go to the far side of the moon...""

2702667490.m_KeyValue: ""Good, you didn't keep this old soul waiting for too long. But my weapon... is thirsting for blood...""

2702667491.m_KeyValue: "It is your destiny; your one and only future."

2702667522.m_KeyValue: ""'The Lovers' - connection, trust, believing in each other, moving forward together. This card depicts your present.""

2702667523.m_KeyValue: ""Now hold on. Don't you want to know more from me? Like which one is the fifth card you need, how to leave this place, or that place you're trying to reach—""

2702667525.m_KeyValue: ""To symbolize breaking free from our past lives, bound by numbers, and embracing a new future.""

2702667785.m_KeyValue: "'They say our true home lies on the far side of the moon.'"

2702667786.m_KeyValue: "Only two of us are left now. Me and that dreary No. 79."

2702667787.m_KeyValue: ""So, what do you say? Even if it's just pretending to play along... Want to escape with me?""

2702667788.m_KeyValue: "Heh... I knew I wasn't wrong about you."

2702667818.m_KeyValue: "There's an image on it. I think it's depicting our battle with that monster..."

2702667819.m_KeyValue: "They were pointing at this in their final moments... could it be the key to our escape?"

2702667851.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, what do you think is on the far side of the moon?""

2702667881.m_KeyValue: "I don't quite understand... but it seems fun. I would also like to have... friends."

2702667882.m_KeyValue: "They may not make much sense... but their strength is undeniable. There's nothing we can do."

2702667884.m_KeyValue: "Huh? So... I miscalculated? Does that mean the two of us are only worth one-tenth of that card?"

2702667886.m_KeyValue: ""I think that big, adorable puppet just ran this way?""

2702667888.m_KeyValue: "We can't leave just yet. Look at what she's holding..."

2702667948.m_KeyValue: ""If you're not afraid of the path leading to a darker abyss, then press on—candidate vessels.""

2702667952.m_KeyValue: "Is anyone really here in this darkness?"

2702667981.m_KeyValue: ""...If it starts up again, we'd have to ride it all the way back up, right? That might be worse than dying...""

2702667982.m_KeyValue: "66... Let's go meet whoever is waiting for us."

2702667983.m_KeyValue: ""Whoa, it's so dark here... Is this what Cidhall was talking about?""

2703491197.m_KeyValue: ""Pretty good, but I'll need you to catch one more fish before I can call it a complete success.""

2703545757.m_KeyValue: "They say all Bell Ringer Vice-Commanders are immortal Ascendants. Is it true?"

2703545758.m_KeyValue: "Even Gadric...? So this is Agares’s work. How many aces is he still hiding?"

2703545761.m_KeyValue: "Earlier than expected... just like tonight's Blood Moon."

2703546784.m_KeyValue: "...Is this a glimpse into Goldland's past?"

2704855311.m_KeyValue: "Alene said Colossus Max is the legendary hero—the guardian of the desert."

2704855312.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you afraid I'll take this chance to strike you down?"

2704855314.m_KeyValue: ""That dark one clearly failed to drag you to Twin Peaks, so now he's resorting to bait and deception.""

2705591077.m_KeyValue: ""She's dealing with the aftermath now. We should wait, Noah. This is no time to provoke her.""

2705591078.m_KeyValue: ""Marcus… behold your cherished instrument of torment. How many times have you cried your daughter's name beneath its bite? At last, you shall be reunited.""

2705591079.m_KeyValue: ""Now they have abandoned you, and you taste the bitter draught of separation.""

2705591080.m_KeyValue: ""The air grew thick with the sharp tang of blood, rich and intoxicating. Fanny's pupils dilated into dark pools as her knees buckled. Slowly she sank, her tongue trembling forward as though compelled by some primal, irresistible force.""

2705591081.m_KeyValue: ""At long last, it's time to awaken you, my first and final... the dream of 'returning home to the moon.'""

2706992506.m_KeyValue: ""Thoreau showed us the 'Siren's Tear'—a substance that can create illusions, and possibly even control them.""

2706992507.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you seem to be... hiding something from Selena.""

2706992509.m_KeyValue: "Would the Church's soldiers really go to the auction house without a proper reason?"

2706992510.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid there are more slaves imprisoned in the sewers…"

2706992538.m_KeyValue: "They are monsters mutated by the Black Blood. It is my duty to kill them..."

2706992539.m_KeyValue: "...who stole my father's land and doing all these 'good deeds'. Can you even sleep peacefully?"

2706992540.m_KeyValue: "Your father would be so proud to see you becoming a Bell Ringer."

2706992565.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, step forward and claim the honor that is rightfully yours.""

2706992570.m_KeyValue: "Told you! Miss Lorelei will never be a ruthless killer!"

2706992571.m_KeyValue: ""You sought my backing, Michel. And now that I brought a Roland elder to stand with Miss Ami, will you still act so bold?""

2706992575.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, that's more than just one question.""

2706992576.m_KeyValue: "You! Why? This isn't what we agreed on—"

2706992577.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami was right! She caught the Mistbound Terror!"

2708453410.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia gazes toward the village nestled at the valley's end, where the familiar tendrils of smoke are absent. Instead, she watches as villagers hurriedly load their worldly possessions onto old carts.""

2708453413.m_KeyValue: "The farmland could sustain at least three more generations. Why would you abandon—"

2708453414.m_KeyValue: "I fail to comprehend what could possibly inspire pity for such base and selfish beings."

2708453417.m_KeyValue: "You saw what happened—yet you couldn't even sever their nooses."

2709300820.m_KeyValue: ""These flowers were trampled and burned in the flames of war. They hate what war brings, yet they do not shrink from resistance.""

2709300821.m_KeyValue: ""Julius raises his spear and charges forward with fluid precision. No wasted motion, no hesitation.""

2709300822.m_KeyValue: ""A metal spear drags across the sandy ground, emitting a low, resonant clang.""

2711121847.m_KeyValue: "Major Arcana Card No. 11. Dalcarlo's Divination: _$$Justice radiates where universal principle and holy faith convene._$$"

2711323455.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa, you must understand the meaning when a Bell Ringer is given the order of elimination—""

2711323457.m_KeyValue: "Then you must also know under what circumstances the Saint would assign a Bell Ringer to carry out such a merciless order."

2711323458.m_KeyValue: ""—To eliminate, at any cost, all beings potentially controlled by the Black Blood in the target area.""

2711323459.m_KeyValue: ""If you know all this, why are you still taking his side?""

2711323460.m_KeyValue: ""—When the Ancestral Black Blood breaks the Divine Body's seal, it may stir a _$$Calamity_$$ capable of plaguing the entire continent.""

2711323461.m_KeyValue: ""But in these past three months, I've seen the truth with my own eyes. He's a kind young man who works without rest to gather herbs, prepare medicine, and tend to the sick.""

2711323462.m_KeyValue: ""I know. Noah is likely Death itself—the one the Church calls the seed of Calamity, the demon sealed within the Divine Body, the very source of Black Blood.""

2711323463.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps from the very beginning, we were misled by those names the Church branded him with... _$$Calamity _$$... _$$Death_$$... Noah...""

2711323464.m_KeyValue: ""And today, I learned he is the guide—long misunderstood by legend—who guides the longing to the Other Side.""

2711324480.m_KeyValue: "Looks like we've shaken off those minions for now."

2711324481.m_KeyValue: ""What is with this island? It's crawling with strange enemies, we've been running forever, and the sun still hasn't set!""

2711324482.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly… Lady Empousa, are you all right?""

2711324483.m_KeyValue: "Why wouldn't I be? Oh! Now that you mention it..."

2711324484.m_KeyValue: ""We've been running under sunlight this whole time, and I'm not burning?""

2711324485.m_KeyValue: ""Could it be... you've overcome your weakness to sunlight, you silly bat!""

2711324486.m_KeyValue: "Seems like I'm the type who grows stronger without even realizing it!"

2711324487.m_KeyValue: "No... something's not right about this sun."

2711324488.m_KeyValue: ""Hey... it hasn't moved. Since we arrived, it's just there—motionless over the mountains.""

2711333183.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong, Eleanor? Have you been crying?""

2711333184.m_KeyValue: ""… I wanted to pick flowers for Mother to make her happy, but… I kept walking and walking… and ended up all alone...""

2711333193.m_KeyValue: ""O revered Aeon, though I have long departed from the lands under your protection, I still believe...""

2711333194.m_KeyValue: ""...That in your infinite mercy, you can still hear my voice and answer my humble prayers...""

2711333195.m_KeyValue: ""May our path forward be bathed in the light, unhindered by shadow. May both sides...""

2711333197.m_KeyValue: "Sorry... Did I interrupt your—what's it called—prayer?"

2711333198.m_KeyValue: "You didn't interrupt anything. I'd just finished."

2711334337.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you... but that doesn't answer my question. You left without a word. As your escort, I should have noticed.""

2711334338.m_KeyValue: ""You've finally inherited the role? My congratulations, Piera.""

2711334343.m_KeyValue: "Even you? That makes me feel better."

2711334344.m_KeyValue: ""When I first came here three years ago, I got lost quite a few times too.""

2711334345.m_KeyValue: ""I feel I've walked this path so many times before, but I can't remember... How strange.""

2711334347.m_KeyValue: "Ahem! It's Piera! a name worthy of the Gravekeepers."

2711334349.m_KeyValue: "Dr. Ressa? What are you doing here?"

2711334350.m_KeyValue: "Mother and Father always say I'm silly... Sometimes I get scared they won't want me anymore."

2711335361.m_KeyValue: "Jason? You're hurt. Let me tend to you first."

2711335362.m_KeyValue: "It's nothing. I tripped while running. Piera and Sora are in danger! Please go to the blessed grounds now!"

2711335367.m_KeyValue: "Did that couple truly let go of Eleanor?"

2711335368.m_KeyValue: "They claimed they would move on... but their eyes were hollow."

2711335371.m_KeyValue: "I must visit them as soon as possible..."

2711335373.m_KeyValue: ""Not drawn toward life, but consumed by death's eternity...""

2711335374.m_KeyValue: "It's exactly how my people looked... Just before my home fell."

2711336515.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, stay with Sora. Do not let those things get close.""

2711336519.m_KeyValue: "They... they were human just moments ago. How did they turn into this..."

2711336520.m_KeyValue: "Just a little longer. Jason's gone to fetch Ressa. She'll come. She will!"

2711336523.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... I didn't think they'd be so relentless!"

2711336525.m_KeyValue: "Don't be foolish. I'm not leaving you behind!"

2711337539.m_KeyValue: ""Well, well, look who's learned how to tease people now.""

2711337543.m_KeyValue: ""When I first found you, you couldn't even speak. Now you know how to gather herbs and how much to use in each dose.""

2711337545.m_KeyValue: "I don't believe it. It took me ages to learn how to identify herbs and memorize recipes."

2711337546.m_KeyValue: "And you still get them wrong all the time."

2711337549.m_KeyValue: ""Sage, chamomile, and thyme... hmm, if it's something to calm the mind, we'll need mint as well.""

2711337550.m_KeyValue: "Sora's share is ready. Now I need rosemary and hops for Eustace."

2711338697.m_KeyValue: ""As long as I'm here, I won't let you leave this world in regret.""

2711338699.m_KeyValue: "Re... ssa... you came... to see me..."

2711338700.m_KeyValue: "What kind of doctor would I be if I couldn't even face my patient?"

2711338701.m_KeyValue: "Dr. Ressa... about Sora... You should prepare yourselves."

2711339719.m_KeyValue: "Eleanor? Haven't I led you through the passage already?"

2711339720.m_KeyValue: ""Yes! After I bid you farewell, I reached a place of warmth and light. But someone bade me not go further and to return to this side…""

2711339721.m_KeyValue: "Are they trapped here because the awakening of _$$Death_$$ has blocked the passage?"

2711339723.m_KeyValue: "These are the longings I've sent to the blessed grounds over the past three months. Why are they still lingering..."

2711339724.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I recall you saying that means helping longings with their final departure from this world, sending them to the Other Side, where they belong.""

2711793352.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that this Celestial God bore the responsibility of nurturing and caring for the celestial realm. They secluded themself in a corner of the celestial realm, sacrificing the freedom to roam, instead mating with powerful Celestial Gods to give birth to offspring, tirelessly working for the realm's prosperity and longevity. Those inspired by this Celestial God will gain the ability to communicate with all things.""

2712893265.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose I was being too idealistic. Still, I'm truly grateful for your help, Noah.""

2715425773.m_KeyValue:
""Averdin had never known this basement existed beneath his brother's residence.
Labeled vials lined the shelves. Inside jars, dark gray tissue floated. As Averdin stepped closer, he saw slender fingers webbed with translucent skin.
'Averdin, why are you here...'
'What have you done?! We promised to give the sirens a home—and you did all this behind my back?'
An argument erupted at once, escalating from plea to fury to despair, until someone knocked over the reagent shelf. Glass vials shattered like wine glasses from Bella's celebration.
A shard sliced across Averdin's hand. It burned.""

""Alone, he pressed on toward the light, leaving all behind.
His resolve never faltered, yet when he reached the top, he found his own radiance had waned, as faint as a <color=#a65f30>crescent moon</color>.""

2716096704.m_KeyValue:
""Carrying the weight of her family's name, she journeyed with two dear friends.
They were the brightest stars on the continent.
Until she glimpsed a future where choices had to be made.
<color=#a65f30>The new moon</color> marked both an ending and a beginning.""

2716096705.m_KeyValue:
""All his life, he pursued the sun.
A distant flame to yearn for, yet never to face.
His story began in the shadowed depths of night, beneath the fading light of a <color=#a65f30>waning moon</color>.""

2716096706.m_KeyValue:
""He perished in flames, only to be reborn from death's embrace.
With fractured memories, he seeks his true self and the Moonblessed.
When the Moonblessed reunite, the <color=#a65f30>full moon</color> shall rise for the Bloodborn once more.""

2716096707.m_KeyValue:
""This is the dawn of time, and its end.
In the endless void of oblivion, a hero remembered by none fights a futile battle, over and over.
Still, she holds to the belief that the <color=#a65f30>eclipse</color> will one day break into dawn.""

2716297271.m_KeyValue: ""Sealed within a Salt Coffin, it gains a Shield equal to {0} HP and recovers {1} HP per sec. Once the Shield is destroyed or HP is fully restored, it gains the ability to move.""

2716585384.m_KeyValue: ""It might be unthinkable to mortals, but we are called the Bloodborn precisely because we possess the coveted secret to immortality...""

2716585385.m_KeyValue: ""(sighing) Even though these Pure Blood Essences are from my personal stash... Here, take them.""

2716585386.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa is in grave danger. We must move quickly—prepare yourself, then let's go.""

2716950631.m_KeyValue: ""...After all, only the dead stay silent.""

2716963447.m_KeyValue: "I thought as much. I've already brought some from the kitchen."

2716963448.m_KeyValue: "Then off with you. Four glasses of red wine will suffice for now."

2716963451.m_KeyValue: ""William has arranged for the crew to take their meals on deck in turns. We're just waiting on you, Captain.""

2716963453.m_KeyValue: ""Ah… once again, you've seen through me, sir.""

2716963454.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, don't pin it all on me. You're always in motion—surely, you haven't eaten either.""

2716964779.m_KeyValue: "I see. What a waste. All that pointless talk for nothing. I'm leaving."

2716964780.m_KeyValue: "Sorry to disappoint you. We don't actually possess that kind of ability."

2716964783.m_KeyValue: "Though the ceiling is a little high for me."

2716964784.m_KeyValue: ""After all that complicated talk, are you finally going to pass through walls?""

2716964785.m_KeyValue: "You two looked like you were about to demonstrate going through walls. I stayed to secretly learn it."

2716964787.m_KeyValue: "Then perhaps we need to overturn our assumption. That the killer strangled Aaron inside this cabin."

2716964788.m_KeyValue: "The rope must have been much longer."

2716964789.m_KeyValue: "And in this windowless cabin... this rope could lead us to a new 'door'..."

2716964790.m_KeyValue: ""Because theoretically, with a rope long enough, the killer could have murdered Aaron from somewhere else entirely.""

2721358493.m_KeyValue: "Each gear slot corresponds to a body part."

2721557976.m_KeyValue: ""'Maybe... we should make a wish too, if we see another shooting star,' Noah suggested hesitantly.""

2721557978.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, that reminds me! I recently read about that shooting star from 400 years ago in a book: The Red-Haired King found it and used it to forge the Magic Blade!'""

2721557979.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, at least the prince and princess were buried together in the same tomb, united for eternity.' Perhaps Aiona's comforting skills could use a bit of refinement.""

2722079113.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Be the hunter—or be the prey. There is no third path._$$

He is the quiet shadow in the Hall of Elders. The power struggles within the family, the clashes beyond its walls—these are but hollow echoes to him. His heart beats for the battlefield alone. To fight as a group is cowardice; victory requires neither schemes nor strategy. He needs no army, only his halberd and his resolve. Beneath the moonlight, he is the hunter, and his prey can only whisper prayers for mercy.""

2722079206.m_KeyValue:
""'When you lose, just lie still—there's no shame in it.'

As a weapon of the Church, Seraphina has undergone countless alterations, and that exceptional Silver Blood Ritual scoured away nearly all trace of her humanity.

Though she is ranked third in the Silver Cross, she remains dissatisfied with her rank. Even she cannot explain the origin of her relentless fixation on becoming the strongest, nor discern where such hunger will one day lead her.""

2722079272.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Scream a little louder, or I'll keep you trapped in my mantle forever._$$
For most of the Bloodborn, Sirene's name had long sunk into the depths of forgotten memory, fading with each passing generation.
But the moment the silver-haired sinner stepped through the gates of Bathory Castle, a few idle murmurs from deep within stirred—enough to make her insolent descendants recall the fear etched into their blood.""

2722079303.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Life and hope are the most precious things in the world._$$

The exact moment Letitia's consciousness first stirred remains lost in time. Perhaps she walked this realm from the primordial ages, when molten rock had yet to cool into the foundations of the earth.

Yet the Letitia of today bears little resemblance to the ancient force one might expect.

To those who know her, she appears as nothing more—and nothing less—than a soul of boundless gentleness and compassion.

All of this, it seems, traces back to a single, fateful _$$seal_$$...

_$$Life and hope are the most precious things in the world._$$""

2725883131.m_KeyValue: ""Rest assured, I will see you placed in the cleanest quarters available. The door will not be barred, and your rations will not be withheld.""

2725883137.m_KeyValue: "But didn't Captain Ryan say even half a month would not see us through the Black Mist? They'd been gone only three days and—"

2725883138.m_KeyValue: "You use the castle as sanctuary—resourceful enough."

2725883139.m_KeyValue: "Why are you alone? Where are the rest?"

2725883140.m_KeyValue: ""Let me think... You would not happen to be the legendary 'Silver-haired Noah,' would you?""

2726187950.m_KeyValue: ""'Cain, I have to say, your words are truly revolting.'""

2726187953.m_KeyValue: ""'See, Cain?' The painting on the wall suddenly spoke. 'Even these children have noticed your abnormal behavior.'""

2728776834.m_KeyValue: "...She's been in that position for so long... I hope nothing went wrong..."

2728776836.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight's 'Moon' has lost its radiance. When tomorrow's 'Sun' is at its peak, accompanied by three bell tolls, we shall set sail from the east, moving towards the rising sun.""

2728776865.m_KeyValue: ""But we are brave sailors! Sailors who never give up in the face of nature's trickery! If Death is our destined end, we shall die at sea, not on this mediocre island!""

2728776866.m_KeyValue: "'Death's curse falls into the black bag.'"

2728776868.m_KeyValue: ""Inside is the divination for the Pontos II. When you encounter difficulties, open it and take a look.""

2728777130.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder you're so afraid of water! Well, not what I was expecting... Do you have any other interesting stories with divination?""

2728777131.m_KeyValue: "It's okay if you don't want to talk about it. Can't we try it just for fun? I want to see what it's all about."

2728777133.m_KeyValue: ""Problems with the cargo, running into a storm, being stranded on a deserted island, and now Blood Beasts appearing out of nowhere... This journey has been nothing but bad luck.""

2728777162.m_KeyValue: ""You mischievous little guy, are you hurt?""

2728777163.m_KeyValue: "But... how are the two of us going to cut down this big old thing and bring it back to camp?"

2728777164.m_KeyValue: ""...Is what I want to say, but...""

2728777195.m_KeyValue: "It seems the Blood Beasts have set their eyes on the talented mystic of the Pontos."

2728777196.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, now let's haul this back to the camp!""

2728777229.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone, muster your strength and paddle hard!""

2728777230.m_KeyValue: "Now let's get the Pontos II into the water!"

2728777231.m_KeyValue: "How could this be?! Didn't they say... didn't they say she could hold on until tomorrow?!"

2728777232.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone's already seen the end of the story, right?""

2728777257.m_KeyValue: "The sea's waves may toss us... but we don't care..."

2728777261.m_KeyValue: "Today is the day we board the great Pontos II!"

2728777263.m_KeyValue: "I will perform the final divination and lead everyone off this island."

2728777264.m_KeyValue: ""He... he is still the Captain, do we really... really have to...""

2728777291.m_KeyValue: "The voice also told me that the paint needed to create the sacred Tarot cards are just ahead."

2728777293.m_KeyValue: "I will draw the last card. I promised Ernest... I can do it."

2728777294.m_KeyValue: ""Stay here and wait for me to come back. Don't wander off, don't interact with other cats. Remember that, my mischievous little 'Star.'""

2728777325.m_KeyValue: ""My trick? I'm just a poor ghost without even a form, how could I have such power?""

2728883392.m_KeyValue: "Cannot be targeted by enemies (can take AoE DMG)."

2729241751.m_KeyValue: "Here's the culprit—this metal part is blocking the outlet."

2729241752.m_KeyValue: "I'd barely opened my doors this morning when some little creature came barreling through and turned everything into absolute chaos—"

2729244024.m_KeyValue: ""(Valora retrieved the saddle at the appointed time, precise to the second.)""

2730750356.m_KeyValue: "Memory: As Tears Fade Into the Sunset"

2731071685.m_KeyValue: "I hear you've made the arena your home lately. It seems you've found a way to solve the puzzle."

2731181664.m_KeyValue: ""(Beneath the twin flames, a letter awaited.)""

2731507844.m_KeyValue:
""Current situation aboard the El Dorado—
To escape the sailors' attack, Noah and Ami head to the storage on the third deck; meanwhile, an intense conflict breaks out between Bob and Van Helsing's group.""

2731507846.m_KeyValue:
""At the crossroads between the Plane of the Living and the Other Side, phantasmal remnants of Aeon still linger. 
If destiny on the Living Plane is a preconceived notion, perhaps the Other Side, with its promise of infinite possibilities, is actual reality.""

2731507847.m_KeyValue:
""Legend has it that when all the _$$Moonblessed_$$ gather, they will be able to return to their distant homeland—The Moon.
They hold their own philosophies, be it meek or radical, all in pursuit of their dream of returning home.""

2732373697.m_KeyValue: ""It fits light equipment, offering outstanding attack.""

2733029133.m_KeyValue: ""No, we can't just leave like this.""

2733029134.m_KeyValue: "Seems the disguise failed... in that case—"

2733029135.m_KeyValue: ""Since you're with the silver-haired one, he must have already spoken of me. I am his most capable assistant and the foremost disciple of the Church's Silver Cross Van Helsing—Selena, the Deadly Arrow.""

2733029136.m_KeyValue: ""I am indeed here to rescue Ami. And from your question, I'd say you are too, aren't you?""

2733029138.m_KeyValue: "Strange... they've been resurrected... and their strings have been restored as well..."

2733029166.m_KeyValue: ""So, this is the Master Lorelei has been seeking all this time?""

2733029167.m_KeyValue: "Did Joyce ever mention that the Siren's Tears needed to be handed over to Joyce?"

2733029168.m_KeyValue: "Fighting is bad! Why don't we make a deal with Joyce instead?"

2733029169.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Bella No. 7, you're back! Joyce thought you were gone forever!""

2733029170.m_KeyValue: ""Bella No. 7, don't look at Joyce as your enemy... it makes Joyce so sad...""

2733029171.m_KeyValue: ""Now that all the Siren's Tears are gathered here, Joyce can transform even more puppets!""

2733029172.m_KeyValue: "Fries aren't important—Prioritize Master Joyce... Protect Master Joyce!"

2733029197.m_KeyValue: "Her life is draining... Such is the sorrowful fate of artificial life."

2733029198.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, why are you getting even colder?""

2733029199.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... that silver-haired servant is utterly useless! Why can't he work as tirelessly as Joyce does?"

2733029200.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, where you think you can run now?""

2733029201.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, right! I almost forgot to give this to you.""

2733029202.m_KeyValue: ""I feel the same way... So please, stay. I'll find the way—""

2733029204.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, there's one more thing. If the puppet holds Bella's memory fragments from her life, could we bring her back?""

2733029223.m_KeyValue: ""No need for that, Selena. Someone's already paid off all your debts.""

2733029230.m_KeyValue: "I know that if it were your friend—the silver-haired one—he would definitely grant freedom to the sirens."

2733029231.m_KeyValue: "Someone has already booked the ultra-grand celebration package for the new Sage's appointment."

2733029232.m_KeyValue: ""A grotesquely carved wooden monster, its back marked with the words 'Captain is Family'—but family is not a title to be taken; it is a bond that must be acknowledged by all.""

2733029233.m_KeyValue: "Oh—right! Since when did none of you fear the sunlight anymore?"

2733029234.m_KeyValue: "The costumes from that interactive performance were utterly profound! They've sparked my latest vision: a fabric-free summer collection."

2733029235.m_KeyValue: ""I'll go talk to the owner, maybe... there's another way!""

2733029236.m_KeyValue: "And I have no patience for people who lack a sense of timing."

2733029262.m_KeyValue: "'Before leaving… there's still time to wrap up one last transaction through Hallon!'"

2733029263.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei counted the stars as they faded, one by one, until golden light broke in the east.""

2733029264.m_KeyValue: ""If they had never come, the Isle would never have descended into this nightmare.""

2733029265.m_KeyValue: "A shard sliced across Averdin's hand. It burned."

2733029266.m_KeyValue: ""The obsidian knife parted the scales, cutting through the hide-like fishtail. The sinewy gray-blue muscles twitched, causing the grotesque fins to strike the blade with a high-pitched, mournful ring.""

2733029267.m_KeyValue: "'Was I kidnapped? Them too? Who would do this…?'"

2733029268.m_KeyValue: ""He stared at Bella on the operating table, one leg already lost. This was the best he could do.""

2733749456.m_KeyValue: ""Wow, it fell and transformed into a flower petal.""

2733754146.m_KeyValue: "That curly-headed boy had dreams like that...?"

2733754149.m_KeyValue: ""When we grow up, you'll be the most famous singer on the continent—and I'll be a renowned clavichord player.""

2733754150.m_KeyValue: ""Very well. From now on, we'll meet there.""

2733754151.m_KeyValue: "My brother once said his dream was to become the most righteous tailor on the continent."

2733754153.m_KeyValue: ""When we practice, let's do it in that old ship by the shore.""

2733754155.m_KeyValue: "I found a safe path. Just follow the <style="Highlight">Tidewisp markers</style> and avoid the damaged areas."

2733754156.m_KeyValue: "That ship's too old. It might be dangerous."

2733756313.m_KeyValue: "Even after eleven years... the promised markers still guide the way."

2734960181.m_KeyValue: ""By the looks of it, those soldiers will be affected too, not just us.""

2734978515.m_KeyValue: "_$$Who in this world is truly in the right?_$$ ...such a heavy thing to consider."

2734978516.m_KeyValue: "From the beginning... I was no one. Only a vessel. For Mother. For Limine Bathory."

2734978518.m_KeyValue: "You say you have plans—but whose side are you truly on?"

2734978519.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't this the best? You're the one who chose this path. Hopefully, we'll regroup with the others soon enough.""

2734979534.m_KeyValue: "Go after him! I won't allow that stupid bat to die by his hands!"

2734979535.m_KeyValue: "No way! I'll defeat every last one of you!"

2734979538.m_KeyValue: ""But I remember this carriage—when it fell, no one died...""

2734979539.m_KeyValue: "Is she... your companion? Another version of you?"

2734979540.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human? Was that your test for your companions?""

2734979541.m_KeyValue: ""And yet you, a Bell Ringer sworn to the Saint, see Aeon—the Church's one true god—as your enemy?""

2734979542.m_KeyValue: "Of all people to see after returning to my body... it had to be you?"

2734979543.m_KeyValue: ""Or that you never became them at all. From the very beginning, you were them. Perhaps... you were everyone.""

2735916964.m_KeyValue: ""(Yet if she had already reclaimed what she sought and fulfilled her purpose, what compelled her to risk this dangerous meeting?)""

2735916965.m_KeyValue: ""(His account vindicated her completely—three centuries past, Elder Baphomet's sole daughter had indeed vanished from these halls under circumstances that remain shrouded in mystery.)""

2735916972.m_KeyValue: "So your hostility toward me... it wasn't born from father's shadow after all."

2735916974.m_KeyValue: ""Now that the misunderstandings have been laid to rest, Noah... might we finally meet?""

2735916975.m_KeyValue: "How much has shifted within these walls during my years of exile..."

2735916976.m_KeyValue: "This time... can we both honor our promises?"

2735916977.m_KeyValue: "I will share with you the secret of how to _$$walk in the sunlight._$$"

2735916978.m_KeyValue: ""(After our exchange, I sought out Cain immediately, determined to scrutinize every claim Quinn had made.)""

2736270172.m_KeyValue: "My blade takes no pleasure in bloodshed. My ears abhor the sound of screaming..."

2736270173.m_KeyValue: ""No, this is the fate of all conscious life...""

2736270174.m_KeyValue: ""On the Other Side, 'he' will weave the 'preordained history' into new time, and from it, forge worlds that repeat.""

2736271193.m_KeyValue: ""I'd be forgotten. Just like the moon is the sun's dream; and when the dawn comes, the dream will be forgotten.""

2736271194.m_KeyValue: ""To remain this calm, even now... As expected of Silver-haired's master.""

2736271195.m_KeyValue: "...Perhaps you're right. Maybe I've had them all along... this companion by my side."

2736271196.m_KeyValue: "I truly despise fighting in this hideous form... but against you..."

2736271197.m_KeyValue: "Because you can resurrect with that... memory transference ritual?"

2736271198.m_KeyValue: "I haven't saved Lamia yet. We haven't found our true homeland. And I still haven't... with Noah..."

2736288066.m_KeyValue: "He's been hiding inside the Colossus Max this entire time!"

2736288067.m_KeyValue: "What is that dark figure even talking about...? None of it makes sense..."

2736288068.m_KeyValue: ""No point delaying. The sooner we test this, the sooner we know if it'll work.""

2736288070.m_KeyValue: "That can't be right! We stockpiled enough wood to supply hundreds."

2736288071.m_KeyValue: "Now you're suddenly saying we should roast that big lump of metal over a bonfire?"

2736288072.m_KeyValue: "I fear that final blow drained all of his stored energy."

2736472318.m_KeyValue: "Fabric shifts against skin. Heat. The sound of restraint unraveling."

2736472320.m_KeyValue: "Now tell me. Did they break you?"

2736472321.m_KeyValue: "Why don't you find out for yourself?"

2736472323.m_KeyValue: ""My hand brushes through her loosened hair. She leans forward without warning, pressing me down.""

2736472325.m_KeyValue: "I slipped out on my own. It's been too long... I wanted to see you."

2736472333.m_KeyValue: "Those little tricks aren't enough to scar me."

2737446336.m_KeyValue: ""In these past few days, everything, including my home, has ceased to exist.""

2737579727.m_KeyValue: "This is... more complicated than I expected."

2737662074.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... my existence predates the very words we speak, you know.""

2737852473.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no... what do I do now?! Her silence is terrifying! Silver-haired friend, say something!""

2737852474.m_KeyValue: ""That's right! If we collect them all, we can awaken the complete Bella! And redeem her life from Joyce!""

2737852475.m_KeyValue: "And if I choose to continue living as I am?"

2738315490.m_KeyValue: "Do you know what most become here? They break or sink into lifeless despair. But you… you study me."

2738315491.m_KeyValue: "Such obedience. You didn't even need my escort. You crept in here all on your own to wait for punishment?"

2738315492.m_KeyValue: "But this next dream… this one should satisfy me."

2738315493.m_KeyValue: ""Why should I? You uncovered my secret, and the thought of it thrills me. Do you know how long it's been since anyone truly saw through me?""

2738444157.m_KeyValue: "The road ahead won't be easy. More Vassals will be needed to aid you in battles to come."

2738506033.m_KeyValue: ""Well, now. We haven't seen a visitor here in ages, living ones at that.""

2738506034.m_KeyValue: ""Since the dark-skinned lady here seems intrigued, please follow me.""

2738506035.m_KeyValue: "Was this place not abandoned? Why is there a strange man inside?"

2738506036.m_KeyValue: ""Your presence warms me, but alas, you tread on forbidden grounds—Perhaps you'd do well to reconsider.""

2738506037.m_KeyValue: ""—Augustine. Those who know the name are among the family's most trusted... I can sense that your curiosity has led you here. Well, come then—You may enter freely, at your own will.""

2738506038.m_KeyValue: "I seem to recall him as well. He became keeper after the building was renovated long ago. His name was Augi-something..."

2738999985.m_KeyValue: "I want to see what kind of future awaits that boy."

2739105744.m_KeyValue: ""Please, spare me the lines ripped straight from a romance drama.""

2739478707.m_KeyValue: "I can't stand by and watch them suffer like this..."

2740296005.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Bloodborn and Black Blood carriers."

2743400228.m_KeyValue: "'Come on! Eye of God belongs to the Bathory family—I'd know it anywhere.'"

2743400229.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, I found myself drawn instead to the shifting path of the moon, to the hidden patterns among the stars.""

2743400231.m_KeyValue: ""The stars shifted, time passed, and still, Aiona's research showed little progress.""

2743400232.m_KeyValue: ""'Even within the Alita family, it's rare to see an astronomer of such natural brilliance.'""

2743400234.m_KeyValue: "'I wonder where the last of the pages could be…'"

2743400235.m_KeyValue: "They found the remaining pages without incident."

2743401316.m_KeyValue: "'Though this one doesn't look like another lunar phase record.' Noah carefully took the final page in hand."

2743401317.m_KeyValue: "'Got something! This looks like the last record—let me take a look…'"

2743401318.m_KeyValue: ""Amid the quiet of the observatory, the sounds of a 'treasure hunt' echoed in every corner.""

2743401319.m_KeyValue: ""'If you can be here, why can't we?!'""

2743415894.m_KeyValue: ""There are too many eyes and ears in a place like this. If word of our true identities spreads, it could invite trouble.""

2743415899.m_KeyValue: ""Even back in Bathory lands, it's never this crowded.""

2743415900.m_KeyValue: "You're not just Ganelon's representative. You're also part of the Bathorys!"

2743415901.m_KeyValue: "Silly wolf! Stop gawking like some country bumpkin."

2743415902.m_KeyValue: "Look at all the people out at night!"

2743415903.m_KeyValue: "It's not often we get a chance like this—let's enjoy the festival while we can."

2743415905.m_KeyValue: "Who are you calling a stinky bat?!"

2743415906.m_KeyValue: "Just Blood Servants... and a stinky bat flapping everywhere."

2743571204.m_KeyValue: ""'Alright, alright...' Genevieve smiles and waves, then walks slowly to center stage. When she opens her eyes again, her expression has completely changed.""

2743571206.m_KeyValue: ""The grim-faced soldiers force Genevieve to her knees and demand her final words. She allows herself the faintest smile, raises her head, and draws a deep breath—""

2743571207.m_KeyValue: ""'According to Minexus: A Brief History, 8th Edition, the <color=#728c69>Perfect Metamorph Dragon</color> was already classified as endangered some 150 years ago—'""

2743571208.m_KeyValue: ""Genevieve smiles. 'Rest assured, I won't say some cliché line like <style=""Highlight"">I'm taking back what's mine.</style>'""

2743571209.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, here we go again...' Quinn shakes her head in resignation. 'I shouldn't have told you this ten years ago. You wouldn't have gotten yourself so lost.'""

2743571210.m_KeyValue: "'It was worth every ounce of effort I expended to drag the <style="Highlight">Drama Queen</style> Genevieve out of the <style="Highlight">[New Prison Name] Prison</style> and grant her this brief respite!'"

2743573380.m_KeyValue: ""Note: At the Puppet Association's request, we include their promotional list for discounted items. The list reads: 'Our store's motto is: If a wealthy customer and a Bell Ringer fall into the river at the same time—'""

2743573381.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain stared at Baphomet with a half-smile. Those eyes seemed to pierce through the ancient armor, probing the secrets hidden within.""

2743573382.m_KeyValue: ""The cruel words hung in the air, as if freezing the very atmosphere... This verbal assault landed with nothing short of a fatal blow!""

2743573383.m_KeyValue: ""A deep, hoarse sound emanated from Baphomet's armor as it shifted: 'To think that I, in my twilight years, should find myself reduced to such a state. I, who was once feared throughout the realm as the 'Soulless'—""

2743573387.m_KeyValue: ""'Of all the creatures in the world, why did it have to be a cat? Don't they realize just how many people are allergic to cats?'""

2743574340.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet adopts the bearing of a seasoned Grand Elder, imparting wisdom to his juniors with paternal gravitas.""

2743574341.m_KeyValue: ""Until it spotted a rusted trophy and trotted over. Like a lion toying with its prey, the cat curiously batted at the trophy with its paws.""

2743574342.m_KeyValue: ""The other three elders snapped their attention to Baphomet—now the most venerable and influential figure within the family. He gazed across the gathering, then slowly began to speak—""

2743574343.m_KeyValue: ""'Sigh, as the newest elder, I guess I will handle this intrusion,' Gilrain shrugged resignedly as he conjured a scythe and dragged it out of the room.""

2743612580.m_KeyValue: ""'Something... is calling to me...' Out of nowhere, a glimmer appeared, fluttering around Bella in lazy spirals before landing atop the wick of a candle embedded in the stone wall.""

2743612581.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah... well, that's just how silver-haired is!' Selena nodded knowingly. 'Lord Van Helsing said silver-haired love sneaking around in the dead of night, doing who-knows-what.'""

2743612582.m_KeyValue: ""With a gentle smile, she took Selena's hand. Her radiant expression seemed to soften even the unforgiving blaze of the midsummer sun.""

2743612583.m_KeyValue: ""'T-t-too close!' Selena's face flushed bright red—like a thoroughly roasted octopus. In that dazed instant, her thoughts drifted back to several months ago...""

2743612584.m_KeyValue: "'Why can't you give up that ridiculous octopus?'"

2743612585.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph. Already trying to wriggle out of your duties...' Selena glared at Bella, clearly displeased.""

2743612586.m_KeyValue: "'Lost? That's nothing to worry about!' Selena showed no hint of distress at the news. 'We'll journey across the whole of Minexus... and uncover ingredients of legend!'"

2743612587.m_KeyValue: ""A firefly appeared from nowhere, spiraled gently around the girl, then disappeared into the streets. Selena never noticed.""

2743612592.m_KeyValue: ""She took Bella's hand. 'So... will you help me make this dream come true, Prep Cook Bella?'""

2743612593.m_KeyValue: ""Bella looked up at her call, following the direction of Selena's outstretched finger—though she still kept Selena pinned beneath her. 'Is that... parchment?'""

2743613670.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph,' the portrait spoke again. 'I must concede, you meddlesome creatures have achieved some competent attempts at understanding matters beyond your comprehension.'""

2743613672.m_KeyValue: ""'That's right,' Cain affirmed. 'It's merely an art piece created through alchemy.'""

2743613673.m_KeyValue: ""'I don't understand a word you're saying, Cain!' Lamia bursted out.""

2743613674.m_KeyValue: ""'Of course I remember,' came a reply from the painting. Cain, it seemed, hadn't been talking to himself after all. The portrait—none other than that of Limine Bathory, the Matriarch herself—had spoken.""

2743613675.m_KeyValue: ""As for what Lamia did that angered the elders—that's another tale for another time. After all, every story has its bounds.""

2743645253.m_KeyValue: ""Thus, a grand Bloodline Transfusion scheme, entangling all existing families, was about to be realized. However, fate intervened when Noah and his allies struck down the plan's mastermind, narrowly escaping catastrophe.""

2743645256.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet was sinking into despair, realizing that this meeting was likely to end on Bella's relentless prattle.""

2743645257.m_KeyValue: ""Just then, with a meow, the black cat—predictably the last elder to arrive—leapt onto its seat and promptly dozed off.""

2743645258.m_KeyValue: "'You're just bitter because Friedrich beat you for the Bell Ringer position!' Bella ruthlessly exposed Gilrain's true motives. 'That's why you're trying so hard to belittle the Roland family!'"

2743645259.m_KeyValue: "'There's a girl from the Ganelon family who's rumored to possess considerable power.'"

2743650564.m_KeyValue: "_$$I want you to witness the magnificence of this theatrical masterpiece! I want to share with you the very emotion that once moved my soul!_$$"

2743650565.m_KeyValue: ""At the mention of theater, Quinn lights up instantly. She claps her hands in delighted anticipation. _$$Why, that immortal line, of course—_$$""

2743650566.m_KeyValue: ""_$$What...? What?!_$$ The blue-haired girl reels, her voice cracking with shock. _$$This isn't right. What about the war between Bathory and Ganelon?_$$""

2743650567.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes steps forward with graceful confidence, extending her hand in greeting. _$$It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Agnes. Quinn Crowley Baphomet... what a truly beautiful name you have!_$$""

2743650568.m_KeyValue: ""_$$...What's a shame?_$$ Whether the blue-haired girl is genuinely oblivious or deliberately playing along, she rises to the bait nonetheless.""

2743650569.m_KeyValue: ""Her voice is filled with anticipation, like a mischievous child about to sneak out for a grand adventure.""

2743650571.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Noooo—!_$$ The petite girl spins toward the nearby shadows, face blazing with humiliation. _$$Young Lady! Stop mocking me this instant!_$$""
