2780083307.m_KeyValue: ""Run as you will, and my arrows follow like fate.""

2780083332.m_KeyValue: ""Eleven years... I thought she was dead all this time. Let me see her once, then I'll submit to whatever fate you choose for me.""

2780083333.m_KeyValue: "So Lord Hallon can rest easy and become a 'boring' father."

2780083334.m_KeyValue: ""Correct! Joyce has already replaced all the Sages with puppets, except for Lord Constantine, who's still in hiding, and the ever-troublesome Lord Hallon...""

2780083335.m_KeyValue: "This smoke... has turned the crew and guards into string puppets."

2780083336.m_KeyValue: ""Puppets, bring Miss Ami here at once!""

2780083359.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine's office houses all his research records. Hidden within them, there must be a way to purge the influence of Siren's Tear from Ami.""

2780083364.m_KeyValue: ""Oh! Oh! Bella No. 13! You're burning up! You must be getting stronger! Quick, use your fire punch on them—""

2780083365.m_KeyValue: "Looks formidable... Could it have any weaknesses?"

2780083367.m_KeyValue: ""In truth, none of these sounds ever echo… Sapphire Isle remains lost in its sweet delusion, awaiting the break of dawn.""

2780083368.m_KeyValue: "Oh no! Did we make it in time?"

2780083369.m_KeyValue: ""I made a deal with the Master, hoping to save you, but I never imagined that would mean turning you into a puppet. I was told you were being treated...""

2780083391.m_KeyValue: "Completely bald. Not wearing a single stitch of clothing. She didn't seem... particularly respectable."

2780083397.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier, you called that glimmering object a Siren's Tear. But what are sirens? Are they truly here?""

2780083398.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder this place has risen to fame as a popular resort, despite lacking the support of any major families.""

2780083400.m_KeyValue: "I need to talk to Father right away and have him prepare a token of gratitude!"

2780083402.m_KeyValue: ""Sir, why aren't you saying anything? Ah, this is bad, Sir! I forgot something very important!""

2780083403.m_KeyValue: ""The appointed time has come and gone, yet the Master hasn't brought Michel, nor provided any updates on the Puppet Elysium...""

2780083425.m_KeyValue: ""'Keep this pact with you. When the time comes to fulfill it, you'll receive a letter.'""

2780083428.m_KeyValue: ""Far across the ink-black sea, a silhouette rose with the sun.""

2780083431.m_KeyValue: "Albrecht neither nodded nor shook his head. Hallon couldn't read his expression."

2780083432.m_KeyValue: "Averdin had never known this basement existed beneath his brother's residence."

2780083433.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei nodded without a flicker of doubt. She was eight years old then, clutching three luminous pearls and seventy-five Soli saved from her stepfather. She was ready to give everything she had—no, more than that—for something others called impossible:""

2780083434.m_KeyValue: "Constantine crumpled to the floor. It was over. His homeland would soon become a breeding ground for the Black Blood."

2780083435.m_KeyValue: "She should have fought. She should have struck him down."

2780913477.m_KeyValue: ""Here, the spirits of powerful enemies you've faced before will manifest again. Defeat them to earn rewards.""

2780916678.m_KeyValue: "Baphomet the Soulless? He did all this?"

2780930305.m_KeyValue: "ATK Speed -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

2780931363.m_KeyValue: "ATK Speed +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

2781035807.m_KeyValue: ""CRIT Rate +{0}, CRIT DMG Up +{1}. Stacks up to {2} time(s).""

2781035810.m_KeyValue: ""Upon the carrier's death, all are converted into an equal number of Feathers of War for Seraphina.""

2781278276.m_KeyValue: "Tap the Open button to open the chest."

2781623297.m_KeyValue: "Your Vassals are now available for Skill Upgrade."

2781954531.m_KeyValue: "Clan name can be changed after establishment."

2782759955.m_KeyValue: "But what if I told you... that the Black Blood can grant you power beyond human limits?"

2783324338.m_KeyValue: ""But the truth is... you didn't stop. You lost your way. You've become something monstrous, Gilrain.""

2783324339.m_KeyValue: "—Perhaps because one from the Bathory line once took part in that story."

2783324340.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. A final clash between three wills who could not become one. And so, they destroyed each other before the unification.""

2783324341.m_KeyValue: "They look more like rocks than kids. How can you tell?"

2783325358.m_KeyValue: "So? Aiona can't reach this place anymore. And that brat's bullets can't even pierce the air."

2783325360.m_KeyValue: "I know. I've always known. This is our fate—mine and Lamia's. A burden we were born to bear."

2783325361.m_KeyValue: "What's the point of saying all this now?"

2783325362.m_KeyValue: ""How enviable… this trust, these bonds. Is that the privilege of humans who still dare to dream of the future?""

2783325365.m_KeyValue: ""It's... no use... If this goes on, everyone... will die...""

2785369657.m_KeyValue: ""The clash of iron rings through the air as Noah is bound once more. Yet this time, Fanny's hands tremble with fevered urgency.""

2785369658.m_KeyValue: "(The locked cabinet behind the rack of instruments—there it is.)"

2785369659.m_KeyValue: "A puppetmaster longed to stage a deicide pantomime. He wrote his script and lured four pawns into the game."

2785369660.m_KeyValue: ""The blood in that cabinet. You drink the prisoners' blood to glimpse their memories, to live their lives. Am I wrong?""

2785369661.m_KeyValue: ""But you, Noah—you are a prisoner I will not lose. Stay away from her.""

2785739859.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Defeat as many mechanical constructs as possible.</style>
The Pilot Bee will lead a construct swarm. Vassals that can deal high single-target DMG are recommended. Use the <style=""Highlight"">Unstable Force</style> Seal to quickly clear out the regular constructs.
Top Picks: Letitia, Transcendent Hati, Agnes, Darcias""

2786153320.m_KeyValue: "This is the privilege you gave me."

2786306479.m_KeyValue: ""Hall of the Elders, where memories live.""

2786342604.m_KeyValue: ""Neglecting fate, yet unable to fulfill desire. Try recalling it again.""

2786661312.m_KeyValue: ""Her favorite trick. Whenever someone nears an inconvenient truth, that paper appears—right on cue.""

2786661313.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, I know your nature. You won't trust easily, no matter what I say. And that's exactly what she's counting on.""

2786661314.m_KeyValue: ""If this truly marks the prison's 'weakness', then why does the Warden greet it as though it were a grand festival?""

2787267057.m_KeyValue: ""No, no! If you become nothing but broken steel, your fallen companions will weep from beyond the grave!""

2787267058.m_KeyValue: ""Without burden, without companions, without grief. Only battle, endless battle, glorious battle! Is that not the dream your comrades so longed for?""

2787267059.m_KeyValue: ""In any case, your suspicion of heresy is cleared! Rejoice—applause, applause!""

2787267060.m_KeyValue: ""Tell Joyce—deep in your heart, don't you wish to be found guilty?""

2787267063.m_KeyValue: ""Her hand flies to her throat, and crimson wells beneath her fingers, running downward in a thin, dark rivulet.""

2787449600.m_KeyValue: "The following Vassals grant a higher chance of Extra Rewards upon clearing stages."

2787811734.m_KeyValue: ""As long as Father and Mother are with me, anywhere feels like home. But... if your hearts truly yearn for freedom, then I'll follow you!""

2787811735.m_KeyValue: ""Then perhaps the time has come, Fanny. Seek out the silver-armored guards. Tell them you wish to become the Warden of this place.""

2787811736.m_KeyValue: ""I love this place, and everyone in it. Each has their own quiet corner to study the scriptures. We're blessed with time in the courtyard each day to breath in fresh air. And sometimes, the kind merchant slips me sweet caramel when the guards aren't looking.""

2787811737.m_KeyValue: ""Scriptures, scriptures, scriptures... Haha... Sweet Fanny, still the lamb among wolves.""

2787811738.m_KeyValue: ""These are matters far beyond you, child. Of course you wouldn't understand.""

2787811739.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I've never stepped outside these walls, I don't believe this place is 'hell.' The scriptures say hell is for the truly damned, a place of torment. But Ironfist Gaol feels like sanctuary to me—and the people here are kind.""

2787811740.m_KeyValue: ""Even if escape were possible, heretics like me—who dared to pursue forbidden Alchemy—would be hunted down and dragged back into this hell.""

2787811741.m_KeyValue: ""Father, I don't understand... what is this 'land that once belonged to truth'? Why do you say we've been forgotten, and trapped here?""

2787811748.m_KeyValue: ""Once you hold that mantle... I—no, we—will have our chance to escape.""

2787811749.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you made me wear this strange uniform today... You want me to become the Warden."

2788062479.m_KeyValue: "They seem to be trying to communicate with me too. This sound... probably means the guards are not here?"

2788062480.m_KeyValue: ""If I could get the prisoners by the door to warn me about guard movements, it would make things much easier.""

2788062481.m_KeyValue: "You take us for fools?! What is it?"

2788062482.m_KeyValue: ""Are you afraid... Isaac, do you yearn for it?""

2788062509.m_KeyValue: "No need. My subordinates will bring the token over later."

2788062511.m_KeyValue: ""Let’s hope this time, I won’t have to clean up after him.""

2788062513.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, alright… let’s see what our final candidate has in store for us!""

2788062515.m_KeyValue: "'You' what? Turing to your father again?"

2788062773.m_KeyValue: ""Five more barrels of wine, a basket of bread, thirty grilled mussels, twenty grilled oysters, twenty grilled scallops—""

2788062774.m_KeyValue: "Was it the all-you-can-eat snacks that kept Miss Ami lingering about? Five more grilled squid—"

2788062778.m_KeyValue: ""You're not from around here, are you?""

2788062779.m_KeyValue: "Why are you looking for Isaac? Did you get separated?"

2788062800.m_KeyValue: "Sold for one million! Now fill Joyce's body with lots and lots of shiny coins!"

2788062805.m_KeyValue: "That grandiose title is too much praise. We simply wanted to build our ideal city-state."

2788062807.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I can't even see any seams. How was this made?""

2788062810.m_KeyValue: "Return to the... I remember we were supposed to help Miss Ami find something at the auction—"

2788062811.m_KeyValue: ""Don't underestimate this 'Sword of Honor for Slaying Sirens', it was made using a rare future Artifact that the Association rewarded me with.""

2788062812.m_KeyValue: "Did the Seven Sage Association have the stall owners make these?"

2788062840.m_KeyValue: "Vital signs... what is she talking about?"

2788062866.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#c6ae80>Besides Soli, there's nothing left in my life anymore.</color>""

2788062869.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps the legend of the Siren was created to cover up this Mistbound Terror's existence."

2788062872.m_KeyValue: "Just some old memories. They have nothing to do with this Mistbound Terror."

2788062874.m_KeyValue: "I haven't seen them today... I heard someone went missing this morning. I hope they weren't caught up in it."

2788062876.m_KeyValue: ""I only 'borrowed' this token from Master Albrecht to help Master Van Helsing, but to think I might have to use it now...""

2788062906.m_KeyValue: ""I remember Albrecht had a task there. Come to think of it, wasn't that when he saved you?""

2788062932.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize, my sleeping schedule differs from most people's. I thought I'd pass the time with a walk, and found myself here before I knew it.""

2788062933.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, where are their bodies? They're gone?!""

2788062934.m_KeyValue: "It's possible that... he's one of the Seven Sages!"

2788062937.m_KeyValue: "But... why would a pirate have a tattoo of a dove?!"

2788062938.m_KeyValue: "You seem to know a lot about the Isle."

2788062940.m_KeyValue: ""Well, what information do you want this time?""

2788062963.m_KeyValue: "I knew it! You're in league with those rich people!"

2788062964.m_KeyValue: "What did you see in the Siren's Tear?"

2788062966.m_KeyValue: "I believe we can build a new utopia together."

2788062967.m_KeyValue: "Excellent. Then you must also know what we have accomplished."

2788062968.m_KeyValue: "No need to hold back. Please speak your mind."

2788062969.m_KeyValue: ""If that's the case, our 'negotiation' will surely be a pleasant one.""

2788062970.m_KeyValue: "I heard that you spent a fortune at yesterday's auction on a gilded statue."

2788062972.m_KeyValue: ""Thoreau... You mean Viktor Thoreau, one of the Seven Sages? The keeper of order who was called the 'Peace Bearer from the Olive Leaf' after suppressing the uprising in the Olive Leaf slums?""

2788927953.m_KeyValue: ""The Bathory family's observatory, designed to peer beyond the Moon's horizon. Unexpectedly, though perhaps not accidentally, patterns and fluctuations in the stars were discovered through this device, hinting at cosmic cycles of cause and effect. Heeding these signs seem to promise great success with minimal effort.""

2791088751.m_KeyValue: "The day when Tidewisps begin to bloom."

2791088949.m_KeyValue: ""The Ides of April, when green grass grows.""

2791114441.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, I'm just a healer. I've never experienced anything like this...""

1.7 Other consequences (if any) arising from Account termination.

2.Before you apply or continue to apply for termination of your Account, in order to protect your Account security and related rights and interests, you should check first and ensure that the Account you apply for termination has met the following conditions in the meantime, which include but are not limited to:

2.1 The Account is legally owned and accessed by yourself and complies with the provisions on Account in the Terms of Service and relevant applicable rules.

2.2 The Account is in in safe and normal operation status: there is no risk of being blocked or stolen; there have been no banning or frozen records in the past 14 days; there have been no sensitive operations such as device replacement, password replacement, and Account switching in the past 14 days.

2.3 The in-Game property in the Account has been settled or properly handled, including but not limited to tickets, diamonds, battle points, items, subscription benefits, etc. In addition, there are no outstanding refunds, payables or orders:including but not limited to recharged diamonds, bundles, subscriptions, etc.

2.4 There are no disputes in this Account: including complaint, being complained, investigations by state agencies, arbitration, litigation, and other disputes.

2.5 Other conditions (if any) officially announced by VIZTA.

You may first try to handle the above problems by yourself. If you are unable to handle the problem or have any doubts in the process, please contact customer service for assistance.

3. Account termination process:
3.1 You may terminate your Account on the relevant function setting page according to the termination process and operation guidelines provided by official channels.

3.2 After you click ""Confirm to Terminate"", VIZTA will review your Account and inform you of the result afterward. In order to further protect your legitimate rights and interests, we have the right to verify whether you meet the termination conditions stipulated in Article 2 hereof as appropriate, and comprehensively judge whether your Account meets the termination conditions according to the security status of your Account and your use of the relevant products and services. In order to protect your Account security and property rights, we have the right to conduct identity authentication for the termination application, so as to determine that you are the authorized user of the Account (e.g. email authentication, etc.). If it is found that the Account does not meet the termination conditions after comprehensive judgment, or if the identity authentication fails, your termination may fail, please contact customer service for assistance.

2792402394.m_KeyValue: "And I still don't remember what happened in all that time."

2792402395.m_KeyValue: "But... sixty-six years have passed since the battle with the Bell Ringer—since I parted ways with Ressa..."

2792402404.m_KeyValue: ""Lies a world that belongs to us, and us alone.""

2792402405.m_KeyValue: "Your heart. Your mind. In your blood. In the deepest corridors of memory..."

2792402406.m_KeyValue: "Then what I just saw... those past events... They weren't dreams. They were memories returning to me."

2792402407.m_KeyValue: ""And I've been waiting here for you, Noah Nevernight... For far longer than you know.""

2792402408.m_KeyValue: "My presence here is proof that you've always known who you are. Death."

2792402409.m_KeyValue: "How can you reclaim what was never truly lost? You never forgot. You simply had no need to remember."

2792403418.m_KeyValue: ""As a Bell Ringer's Vice-Commander and an Ascendant, she wouldn't be permitted to leave without authorization from the Church.""

2792403419.m_KeyValue: "Finding Piera on Sunset Isle isn't just a matter of Church protocol. It's about answering some questions I've had."

2792403427.m_KeyValue: "There are even more traces of crystals around us..."

2792403428.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we're getting closer to where Piera is channeling her power."

2792403429.m_KeyValue: "I still can't believe that she could transform the entire island like this."

2792403430.m_KeyValue: "I've been wondering why those creatures were also covered in crystals."

2792403431.m_KeyValue: ""Piera and I were both disciples of Master Albrecht, and the very first lesson we learned was how to control our own power. But the current situation seems like...""

2792403433.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, don't tell me you boarded the El Dorado just to find Piera on Sunset Isle?""

2792404572.m_KeyValue: "But in my memory… it was Agares who took me away."

2792404573.m_KeyValue: "You were sealed by Bell Ringer Tris and taken away from Sunset Isle... What you see now is the memory you lost."

2792404578.m_KeyValue: ""Of course not. If it weren't for you, Dr. Ressa, who would have treated our wounds and illnesses?""

2792404579.m_KeyValue: "Piera... do you hate me? For lacking the resolve to kill Noah... even knowing he is Death?"

2792404580.m_KeyValue: ""Dr. Ressa, the one named Darcias has already evacuated the residents. Shouldn't we return to the Church as well?""

2792404582.m_KeyValue: ""Dr. Ressa, let's take Noah and leave this place together!""

2792404584.m_KeyValue: ""If you're not leaving now, find your own way off Sunset Isle!""

2792404585.m_KeyValue: ""And besides, even without his memories, Noah helped us many times. Even if he is Death...""

2792405107.m_KeyValue: "We've never sparred before. How would you know I'm worse than before?"

2792405205.m_KeyValue: ""On the ground beneath the tree, Noah notices the faint, repeated tracks—evidence of Seraphina's restless pacing as she waited.""

2792405206.m_KeyValue: ""I mirror Seraphina's movements, preparing my body with deliberate care.""

2792405596.m_KeyValue: "He's not alone. The concentration of crystals in the area is high—they're Piera's salt crystals. There was an explosion here."

2792405597.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying... are you saying the one you're looking for is trapped inside that thing—with Noah?"

2792405602.m_KeyValue: ""_$$He is Death, veiled in shadow, who leads all life to its appointed end. He is Rebirth, crowned in light, who calls what withers to rise anew._$$""

2792405603.m_KeyValue: "The Moonblessed Death we seek... Could that be the source of the black mist?"

2792405606.m_KeyValue: "But this thing... Just a fraction of its pressure... It’s stronger than that giant we faced on the ship!"

2792405607.m_KeyValue: "Is Noah... really inside that... all by himself?"

2792405608.m_KeyValue: "You damn bat... Don't tell me you think Noah is in there?!"

2792405609.m_KeyValue: ""I'm certain of it... I can feel Noah's pain, he's trapped in there!""

2792406750.m_KeyValue: "Her existence serves to remind you of the warmth you once experienced as a human."

2792406751.m_KeyValue: "This person is a testament to your friendship."

2792406754.m_KeyValue: "But I don't get it. What purpose does this serve you?"

2792406755.m_KeyValue: ""Using those phantoms of Jason, Sora, and Piera's grandmother, you led me step by step into the depths of my memories in order to awaken my past self.""

2792406757.m_KeyValue: ""Don't forget, Noah... From the beginning, you and I were one and the same.""

2792406758.m_KeyValue: ""It appears that you, in your current state, have lost your power.""

2792406760.m_KeyValue: ""Since my arrival on this island, you were the one who used nightmares to force me to recall my past.""

2792406761.m_KeyValue: "It's still more than enough to deal with you."

2792407774.m_KeyValue: "Because I am not the one you need to fight."

2792407775.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it… Then who? If not you, who am I supposed to hate...?""

2792407778.m_KeyValue: "How unfortunate. I don't have time for you right now."

2792407780.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you hear me!? I told you to stop!"

2792407781.m_KeyValue: ""Why… Even after becoming a Bell Ringer, why am I still powerless against Death?!""

2792407783.m_KeyValue: "And right now... I'm not your enemy."

2792407784.m_KeyValue: "Silence! I must complete Commander Tris's unfinished mission and seal you here!"

2792407785.m_KeyValue: "Otherwise... I'll never break free from that day's shadow!"

2792408928.m_KeyValue: ""You guys get out of here when you get the chance, don't worry—""

2792408929.m_KeyValue: ""When I received Death's memories, I also learned about the Divine Body's weakness.""

2792408932.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah, how are you planning to destroy the Divine Body?""

2792408933.m_KeyValue: ""Having lost all means of resistance, its only option is to detonate its core, trapping me on Sunset Isle forever.""

2792408934.m_KeyValue: "It’s sensed that I've awakened Death's power. That's why those creatures went berserk before."

2792408936.m_KeyValue: "So it finally shows itself... Is this the true form of the Divine Body on Sunset Isle?"

2793122173.m_KeyValue: "Special offer <color=#DEA11F>Choose 1 of 3</color>. Available for 2 hours only."

2794431936.m_KeyValue: ""Through all our trials, Noah has proven himself far more steadfast than I once believed.""

2794431937.m_KeyValue: ""She told me once I entered the castle, I could call her from any opening to the outside.""

2800171005.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, the truth is far more somber. They are but 'restless spirits,' forever caught in the turbulent struggle between Death and the Divine Body, unable to find peace.""

2800171006.m_KeyValue: ""Rumors from beyond the island, as well as the islanders themselves, claim that these shades formed from memories of longing are a blessing from the Divine Body upon Sunset Isle.""

2800173187.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying... you've been my pride and joy since the day you were born."

His technique represented a crystallization of wisdom far beyond the limitations of his era.""

2805660686.m_KeyValue: "Ridiculous—is that silver-haired fool really jumping down to die alongside them?"

2805660687.m_KeyValue: "Argh. Just a slip of the tongue!"

2805660692.m_KeyValue: "Black Blood... Such tragedies have become disturbingly common."

2805660693.m_KeyValue: "Sometimes I helped children chase their kites into the sky; other times I fanned flames that consumed entire cities..."

2805660694.m_KeyValue: "I glimpsed it in your memories... You refused the other Letitia's proposal?"

2805660696.m_KeyValue: "But can the 'humans' I've come to know truly embrace every facet of themselves?"

2805660698.m_KeyValue: ""Regret, self-loathing... none of it matters anymore.""

2805661716.m_KeyValue: ""These tracks run in opposite directions, their spacing jagged and uneven... Hmm...""

2805661717.m_KeyValue: "At least allow me to catch my breath!"

2805661718.m_KeyValue: "These villagers and soldiers do not seem to have fought one another..."

2805661719.m_KeyValue: "Ambush remains the surest path to victory."

2805661722.m_KeyValue: "Wait—must you deviate from the plan at every turn?!"

2806644523.m_KeyValue: ""But because of the persistence of a fool, these hopeless words remain preserved here.""

2806644524.m_KeyValue: ""To become the vessel for the 'Eyes' of the Alita family, to become the puppet that opposes time.""

2806644531.m_KeyValue: ""You're not... thinking of asking these guys for directions, are you?!""

2806644532.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, it's identical to the Temporal Veil I'm wearing...""

2806644534.m_KeyValue: "How much longer do we have to walk in this desert... I feel like my blood's about to evaporate..."

2806644536.m_KeyValue: "I think... I've regained my power to fight."

2806644563.m_KeyValue: "Are those sand monsters and that phoenix the 'Time' that is consuming you?"

2806644565.m_KeyValue: ""But I can fight with you. Your father, Empousa, Friedrich, and Gilrain... you have none of them by your side. Fighting alone is a lonely thing.""

2806644566.m_KeyValue: "Abandoning your friends is a shameful and cowardly act. Do you want to bring disgrace upon your family with your actions?"

2806644567.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona... you've defeated me, but you can't defeat...""

2806644595.m_KeyValue: ""No matter what lies ahead, you've already created a miracle today...""

2806644597.m_KeyValue: ""You want to save me and my companions, and I...""

2806644598.m_KeyValue: ""The Temporal Veil... No, you must not touch it...""

2807747848.m_KeyValue: "These barrels... are they meant for water and provisions?"

2808063013.m_KeyValue: ""A winged creature from the depths of the sealed area, corrupted by Black Blood. It appears to have been driven from the darkness by some force. Covered in dry blood spots, it generates powerful Sound Waves with each flap of its wings.""

2808063014.m_KeyValue: ""Master Vendor, thank you for creating us! But why call us sirens? Must we endure this torment for our home?""

2808063015.m_KeyValue: ""Master Vendor, thank you for creating us! But why call us sirens? Must we endure this torment for our home?""

2808063109.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its tissue is fully exposed, and it emits dreadful spiked orbs.""

2808063115.m_KeyValue: ""A creature that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Its giant body sparkles with reflected light, and a gust of dry air follows its every swing.""

2808063116.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its squiggling body struggles to maintain control over its energy orbs.""

2814758123.m_KeyValue: "No matter how many times I try to outrun this fate..."

2817852016.m_KeyValue: ""A keen observation. What stands before us is not a true soldier, but a spirit.""

2817852017.m_KeyValue: ""This soldier looks familiar, like one of the corpses we found earlier.""

2817853026.m_KeyValue: ""Elder Sirene, drop the act... I know it's you.""

2817853027.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, a new friend with hair like a wolf tail? Adorable.""

2817853039.m_KeyValue: ""You coward! If you've got any guts, come out and face me!""

2817853040.m_KeyValue: ""Don't yell at me. You started it, harming my precious 'playmates' that I worked so hard to collect...""

2817853041.m_KeyValue: ""A strong Ganelon soldier, a gargoyle rich with stories... They are rare to find. How are you going to compensate me?""

2817854187.m_KeyValue: ""How ironic that the origin of the Long Night, the one nurturing all evil, has such a radiant disguise...""

2817854188.m_KeyValue: "So this is the Bloodletting...? Looks solid. I wonder if it's really as fragile as Cain said—easily destroyed."

2817854191.m_KeyValue: ""Father, Father! I stopped those soldiers, only mutated villagers are all that remain!""

2817854219.m_KeyValue: "It's been three days and nights... why won't she wake up?"

2817854223.m_KeyValue: "Quinn? I'm Lyra! Don't you recognize me?"

2817854224.m_KeyValue: "Let her sleep... The scars from crossing realms never show on the flesh."

2819318913.m_KeyValue: "Units under Control effects take reduced DMG."

2820051570.m_KeyValue: "I do believe this is a 'eureka' moment between us."

2820055662.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for bringing a moment of joy to this long and wearisome life."

2823377094.m_KeyValue: "Unless… you're not who you claim to be."

2823377098.m_KeyValue: ""I was indeed once bound to the Bathory, yet unlike the others, I am not sustained by human blood.""

2838260853.m_KeyValue: "Only by breaking free from the gravity of our past can we soar towards the starry sea of our future."

2838260884.m_KeyValue: ""Is the silver-white a symbol of decay, or of emptiness?""

2838263893.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, you'd best watch your back at night!""

2838264052.m_KeyValue: "Oh... Wh-What a coincidence... running into you here..."

2838271723.m_KeyValue: "I've devised a new dance step. Would you care to be my first audience?"

2838271754.m_KeyValue: "Interrupting someone's thoughts is not very polite."

2838272748.m_KeyValue: "Would you accompany me to the herb garden?"

2838273897.m_KeyValue: ""Accursed by flame, condemned to burn until the end of days.""

2838273928.m_KeyValue: "Ah... I have already drifted off to sleep. All I utter now is but sleep talk."

2838274922.m_KeyValue: ""The pain you bring is sweet, like honey.""

2838276937.m_KeyValue: ""I don't mind revealing my true face, but it's better for both of us if I don't.""

2838277096.m_KeyValue: "Do you need me to examine you?"

2838312864.m_KeyValue: ""To safeguard Bathory's secrets, I must prevent Agnes from conducting her survey.""

2838920202.m_KeyValue: ""'And who's to say that after the Embrace, the girl would share her master's aversion to blood?' The guard's words were tinged with bitterness.""

2838920207.m_KeyValue: ""It seems the recent disturbances in the Ancestral Vault were likely caused by this traitorous Ancestor,' Noah deduced.""

2838920208.m_KeyValue: ""'That's very possible,' the guard agreed. 'While the girl is unlikely to have lived this long, the traitor may return.'""

2838920209.m_KeyValue: "'But why didn't he turn her into a vampire through the Embrace?' Selena asked innocently. 'Then they could have been together forever.'"

2839676763.m_KeyValue: "Take a moment to recover. One final trial awaits."

2839677786.m_KeyValue: ""And when that hour comes, what future will you bring forth from the life you guard so closely?""

2840000729.m_KeyValue: "A promise...? You're just making things up."

2840000734.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, it's not really _$$teasing_$$ if I don't leave you wanting more… hehehe...""

2840000735.m_KeyValue: ""Well then, since you made that promise, I suppose I'll let you wake up over there.""

2840000737.m_KeyValue: "The moment you put on that mantle… you stepped into my dream."

2840000738.m_KeyValue: ""My, my... So focused on me that those little details slipped right past you.""

2850203549.m_KeyValue: "Did the great Bathory elders and generals of ages past also keep flocks of little birds?"

2850456070.m_KeyValue: ""The Church: Reach a Potency Rating of 26,000.""

2850460426.m_KeyValue: ""The Church: Reach a Potency Rating of 66,000.""

2850462604.m_KeyValue: ""The Church: Reach a Potency Rating of 46,000.""

2850875127.m_KeyValue: ""As a representative of the Bathory family, you must have heard of the Carrelles? Once one of the twelve noble clans, like your own. They were tasked with guarding the Heart of the Divine Body.""

2850875129.m_KeyValue: ""Looking back, I never questioned it at the time. I thought it meant we were a family. Until the eldest son of the Carrelle family came and chose the strongest among us...""

2850875130.m_KeyValue: ""Judging by your tone, he wasn't simply picking out slaves for labor in the city, was he?""

2850875131.m_KeyValue: ""How ironic. We thought we were slaves who, despite our hardships, still owned our lives...""

2850875132.m_KeyValue: ""But in Lord Carrelle's eyes, we weren't even human. Our true purpose had always been to become the firewood that keeps the Heart beating.""

2850875133.m_KeyValue: "The Heart must keep beating. And each pulse requires a living soul burned to ash to keep it going."

2850875134.m_KeyValue: "So that's why he chose the strongest..."

2850875137.m_KeyValue: "The people living in that manor now... Are they the descendants of your former companions?"

2850875138.m_KeyValue: "Should I say you have a kind and naive side too? That place was rebuilt to house war orphans like myself."

2851953342.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia draws closer, his hands rising to cradle Noah's face with infinite tenderness.""

2853655638.m_KeyValue: ""Pardon my indifference, but an observer should not intervene too much.""

2853658839.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we should weigh our options more carefully."

2854648952.m_KeyValue: "Why does it feel like the floor is still shaking?"

2854648953.m_KeyValue: "Let's go back to the central elevator at the tower's core and make Baphomet pay for this!"

2854648957.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, it really is you! I'm so glad you're okay and have grown so much.""

2854648958.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong, Jestel? Won't you come give mommy a hug?""

2854648959.m_KeyValue: ""You don't need to be afraid anymore, because mommy has changed and can protect you and your brother now.""

2854657664.m_KeyValue: "Is that all the blood Lady Empousa managed to bring back?"

2854657665.m_KeyValue: "Looks like you had a long dream."

2854657666.m_KeyValue: ""The memories are incomplete. It might be difficult to create the body, unless...""

2854657667.m_KeyValue: "It was a life-or-death situation! Can he still be resurrected?"

2854657669.m_KeyValue: ""It's because of his obsession with 'living,' that he could walk out of that abyss on his own.""

2854659841.m_KeyValue: ""Out of this vile lot, you're the first one I want to tear apart!""

2854659842.m_KeyValue: ""You wretched witch, you're the one who took Empousa on this 'Moonblessed' charade. I know you're up to something!""

2854659843.m_KeyValue: "She is Lady Lamia... you can think of her as Empousa's sister."

2854660858.m_KeyValue: ""And what of it? Legends, prophecies... What do they matter to us? Cain, you're a clever one, you should understand...""

2854660859.m_KeyValue: ""As long as I remain, this family will be the greatest among the Bloodborn.""

2854660864.m_KeyValue: ""He's got silver hair like you, Gilrain. He must be the other Moonblessed foretold in the prophecy.""

2854660865.m_KeyValue: "It seems so. I think his name was Noah or something? But I heard he was executed by a 'Bell Ringer.' Did Cain revive him?"

2854660866.m_KeyValue: "The old-timer must be getting senile. She's the maid who plays the Moonblessed game with Empousa."

2854660867.m_KeyValue: ""I recall... her name is something like Aiona, isn't it?""

2854660868.m_KeyValue: ""Revive the family? By your words, are you implying the Bathory family has fallen?""

2854660869.m_KeyValue: "That's not what I meant. But all Bloodborn must have heard the legend: the Moonblessed will lead us back to our <style="Highlight">promised home</style>."

2854660870.m_KeyValue: ""I also wish to plead for the young lady, bringing back the Moonblessed from the prophecy is for the dream of reviving our family, she shouldn't...""

2854660871.m_KeyValue: ""Silence! You have long lost the trust of the Council of Elders, Cain.""

2854662012.m_KeyValue: "Aiona and the others did seem to say so."

2854662013.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, wait, wait... did you just mean you're also one of the Moonblessed?!""

2854662016.m_KeyValue: ""No, I just realized you were looking for me to help you find that promised home. It sounds far-fetched, yet strangely romantic.""

2854662018.m_KeyValue: "I said you guys were quite romantic..."

2854662020.m_KeyValue: "What is this 'promised home' you speak of?"

2854662021.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, I bet you see the legend of the promised home as a joke too, just like all the other Bloodborn.""

2854662023.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that when all the Moonblessed are gathered, we will finally be able to 'Ascend' to our promised home, the moon.""

2854663036.m_KeyValue: "You little runt! How dare you become Lady Empousa's..."

2854663037.m_KeyValue: "But you say you're also a Moonblessed... Miss Empousa must have had no choice but to do it for the prophecy..."

2854663041.m_KeyValue: ""From just now, my chest has been feeling hotter and hotter... This might be proof that we're getting closer to her.""

2854663042.m_KeyValue: "Y-You... Why do you share a blood resonance with Lady Empousa?!"

2854663043.m_KeyValue: "Because Noah has already become Lady Empousa's first blood vassal."

2854663044.m_KeyValue: ""To get out, we go towards the east elevator.""

2854663045.m_KeyValue: ""But before that, we have to go rescue Empousa first.""

2854663046.m_KeyValue: "Empousa?! You mean... the lady of the Bathory family?"

2854663047.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you say so earlier! You know she's the original Moonblessed!"

2854664190.m_KeyValue: ""If something happened to you, I, I...""

2854664191.m_KeyValue: ""I risked my life to bring you back, and Aiona and the others managed to revive... But you put yourself on a silver platter for the elders.""

2854664192.m_KeyValue: "...You fool! Why did you come to rescue me?"

2854664193.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, this is the second time you've called me an idiot, so it must really be you.""

2854664198.m_KeyValue: "More gentle than the last time I heard it."

2854665216.m_KeyValue: "People who look just like Lady Empousa... there are several of them?"

2854665217.m_KeyValue: "What the hell is going on here?!"

2854665219.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong with you? Are you here to help me too?"

2854665220.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, that's what her name seemed to be.""

2854665222.m_KeyValue: ""I have the same feeling... By the way, we encountered your 'sister' while coming to rescue you...""

2857209990.m_KeyValue: ""I remember… a promise left unfulfilled, bound to that name.""

2857209993.m_KeyValue: ""You've turned cold again, just as when you last lost control. Indifferent to the weak who stand beside you.""

2857209994.m_KeyValue: ""A family name? Can't eat it, can't trade it at market. What good is that?""

2857209995.m_KeyValue: ""I wish it could snow here in Astolfo. Then we'd never thirst again, right?""

2857950128.m_KeyValue: ""You're not eating the library books, are you?""

2858021870.m_KeyValue: ""But when she produced that Anachronometer before the Divine Body, curiosity stirs...""

2858644133.m_KeyValue: "Deals <style="Highlight">30%</style> increased DMG to targets inflicted with Burn."

2859849531.m_KeyValue: ""To my silver-haired friend, who may have been swayed by those rumors about me: I was planning to spend a quiet holiday at Ellington Bay, but this matter keeps nagging at me. Why not just tell me who's been spreading them?""

2859887768.m_KeyValue: "I've arrived at the castle. Something feels… off."

2859959510.m_KeyValue: "Your silence has stretched on for quite some time—I take it you've encountered something rather fascinating."

2860065269.m_KeyValue: "I _$$saw_$$ memories that don't belong to me."

2860152766.m_KeyValue: ""Just like I don't believe death will erase one's existence. Someone will always remember them... Like your singing, I will definitely remember it.""

2860152767.m_KeyValue: "Watch your tongue! You are in the graces of Empousa."

2860689945.m_KeyValue: "The key is within reach. Let's take a break."

2860691991.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks for all the assistance, by the way... I'm still getting the hang of it all.""

2860692022.m_KeyValue: ""Here, we can learn about a Vassal's past, as well as present. We can also explore the unique memories you've created together.""

2860693080.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, well at least someone is doing something for once.""

2861254505.m_KeyValue: "Repel the Church's elite forces sweeping through the village."

2863065139.m_KeyValue: ""I was thinking, maybe you'd leave me with something.""

2863166945.m_KeyValue: ""The Three Vows of Knighthood—protect the weak, stand against the strong, and serve the bloodline for all time.""

2863166976.m_KeyValue: ""Loyalty begins with a vow… but perhaps, it does not end there.""

2863169985.m_KeyValue: ""To love is to be vulnerable. I never wished for it, and yet…""

2863170144.m_KeyValue: "Clear the field. This game is set to my design."

2863175641.m_KeyValue: ""You've arrived, ender of cycles. This is where time itself comes to rest.""

2863175672.m_KeyValue: "A touch like this… reminds me I'm still alive."

2863177815.m_KeyValue: "Well then... I suppose we can chart the flow of time itself?"

2863177846.m_KeyValue: ""You're quite fond of head pats, aren't you? ...Could this be some sort of ceremonial ""ritual"" among the Bloodborn?""

2863178681.m_KeyValue: ""I've found human emotion far more complex than any alchemic formula. While Alchemy adheres to the principle of equivalent exchange, emotion can create something out of nothing.""

2863178840.m_KeyValue: "I do believe this qualifies as an equivalent exchange."

2863179989.m_KeyValue: ""I am Selena the Deadly Arrow, chief assistant to Silver-haired and first disciple of Lord Van Helsing!""

2863180020.m_KeyValue: ""That's your idea of encouragement, Silver-haired? It's... quite unique.""

2863180855.m_KeyValue: ""Might I rest in the warmth of your palm, just for a moment?""

2863183188.m_KeyValue: "Allow me to be your guide… through a most 'delightful' holiday in Sapphire Isle."

2863185203.m_KeyValue: ""Bella: Father said I was very sick… and even so, you still want to play with me?""

2863185362.m_KeyValue:
""Bella: I've been waiting for you. Let's go together this time.
Yakov: Don't forget me! I'm coming too!""

2866014740.m_KeyValue: ""I never thought we would meet like this, but perhaps this is the only way I can break free from who I once was. The Black Blood disease is divine punishment, and only devotion to god brings salvation—this was Setti's first lesson in the Church. Her exceptional performance led to her selection as Vice-Commander under Bell Ringer Agares. Her arrows, which had never missed after countless hours of practice, would one day pierce through the vicissitudes of fate itself.""

2866014833.m_KeyValue: ""Habits can be terrifying. I've thought about leaving my overprotective guardian, but I've never dared to take the first step. Though she appeared to work dutifully as a maid aboard the El Dorado, most described her as cold, incompetent, and emotionally absent. In truth, she was the last surviving member of the Landis family—a lineage that had long since vanished beneath the waves. Captain Goldland had kept her aboard as a living symbol of that bloodline, a relic to be preserved. Because of this, her life had been like the sea's surface—calm in appearance, yet adrift in uncertainty. She longed for freedom, but her homeland had already sunk into legend. Without roots, where could she return? She wanted to belong here, yet this great ship was never her dream to begin with. And without knowing how to raise the sails, where could she hope to go? The cage that confined her was never locked. But neither had she grown the wings to escape it.""

2866014864.m_KeyValue: ""Will I ever be free of the shackles of the past? Noah was killed in flames, only to awaken inside a coffin. He had been revived as a Bloodborn, left only with his shattered memories. He cannot remember who he truly was—save for that promise to 'return alive.' Perhaps by finding those known as the Moonblessed, he can recall his lost memories. Yet perhaps, only by returning to that 'home' deep inside his heart, can he remember his former self.""

2866014899.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps even beneath this mask is not the real me. No one knows where Aiona came from, nor why one of the Bloodborn was granted refuge by the Bathory family. Perhaps it is because she shares their longing to return to the moon—or perhaps they simply covet her command over time...""

2866014957.m_KeyValue: ""Without someone to protect, a shield loses its purpose. When Jestel was a child, she often fell asleep in tears, listening to tales of returning to the moon. Back then, she couldn't grasp why her father devoted half his life to the so-called black shield, even if it meant leaving her behind to pursue this mysterious cause at Bathory Castle alongside her mother. 'Every story needs a hero to make the last stand, to shield everyone from harm.' Only when she was strong enough to wield her father's shield did she realize the weight of these words. Whether hope or legacy, it all resided within that shield. However, upon following her parents to Castle Bathory, Jestel uncovered the 'story' was nothing but a facade of false hope. The lingering dream from her childhood transformed into a living nightmare, where she witnessed her kin broken and scattered, their faces forever etched with the pain of some cruel experiments. Though she still stands with her father's shield, she finds herself tormented by the prospect of unattainable revenge.""

2866015054.m_KeyValue: ""The moon is but a dream of the sun, and thus we were forgotten by the light. Born of darkness, yet imprisoned by it. To Empousa, a Bloodborn's immortality is not a gift but a curse—daylight exists as an unreachable shore. The Bloodborn took her freedom, while her position as the Bathory family heir stripped away her identity. She seeks a key—one that would free her from this cage called 'Empousa'...""

2866015112.m_KeyValue: ""Mortals embrace faith out of their fear of death, then present offerings to curry favor with their beliefs. A peculiar atheist—not one who denies the existence of gods, but who questions 'where the line between god and man truly lies' and 'why gods cannot worship men.' From the moment he stepped into the Bathory Castle, he immersed himself in his work. This was more than just a mad experiment; it was a meticulously planned transaction, a long-harbored wish buried deep within his soul. Yet he knew well that this mission could not be accomplished alone. Gradually, those who coveted immortality, thirsted for power, and sought truth... various souls unknowingly entered this chess game called the Demon Banquet. Little did they know they were offering themselves as puppets in a game of gods.""

2866015271.m_KeyValue: ""Bella: Are you here to buy something? Puppet: Or to become the merchandise? The most unique yet purest among the Bathory's Elders—a puppet fixated on money while remaining indifferent to worldly affairs. Yet behind her tired sales pitch, emotions that seem uncharacteristic of her occasionally slip through. 'Time to wake up'— Which identity should she greet the world with today? A puppet indifferent to mortal emotions, a ruthless merchant selling her wares, an Elder of the Bathory family... or perhaps, a pitiful girl waiting to save enough money to buy back her own life?""

2866334161.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know your connection to Bathory, but this place clearly holds memories for you.""

2866438860.m_KeyValue: "It seems… a 'friend' has come from the end of time."

2866438861.m_KeyValue: ""Since it's a temporal prison, it must follow the cycle of time. She can begin at the end; we'll meet at the beginning, and only then will the escape be complete.""

2866438869.m_KeyValue: ""If I could wash them all away, would I be worthy then? Worthy enough that you would choose to stay...?""

2866438870.m_KeyValue: ""So kill me. As you said, this prison is part of me. End me, and you will be free.""

2866438871.m_KeyValue: "They bound you here to sustain this prison. You are its beating heart."

2866438873.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it be you or us… we are all birds, trapped within the same cage.""

2866438874.m_KeyValue: "I had hoped to hear more of your story… but that will have to wait for another time."

2866439892.m_KeyValue: ""You are the one in the neighboring cell. Last night, you exposed Fanny's weakness on purpose.""

2866439893.m_KeyValue: ""Before you rush to prove how well you know me, ought you not explain those figures in the shadows, northeast corner?""

2866439894.m_KeyValue: ""Those confined here, for the most part, defied their ordained fate and were cast out by the Timeline itself. You labored so hard to shatter the cycle—this is the price such defiance demands.""

2867045639.m_KeyValue: "The patrol that escorted Miss Seraphina—you'll spend three days in confinement as well."

2870191043.m_KeyValue: "But why are you interested in Alchemy? Or perhaps... in me?"

2870368544.m_KeyValue: ""So, to my past self, if you are reading this letter, there's something I need to tell you.""

2873475210.m_KeyValue: "Just as you cannot drive steel through my heart."

2873475213.m_KeyValue: "I want to choose my last battle—to choose the last face I see before I stop breathing."

2873475216.m_KeyValue: ""The two walk side by side, vanishing swiftly into the endless forest.""

2874756876.m_KeyValue: ""If those alchemists hadn't barged into the sealed area, I wouldn't have had to leave in such a hurry.""

2874790637.m_KeyValue: "Why did you ask me to help find your earring? You even gave me your blood."

2878009364.m_KeyValue: "(This may be more serious than I thought. I should write to Elder Bella directly to confirm.)"

2878258607.m_KeyValue: "(I assumed she wouldn't reply until each one had been thoroughly read.)"

2883671536.m_KeyValue: "Let's take the leader down and win this for Jestel and the victims!"

2883706039.m_KeyValue: ""You've always wondered why I've fought so desperately to get you out of here, haven't you?""

2885834814.m_KeyValue: ""That bridge will always be waiting for you. Cross it when you're ready, over the river of sorrow and into a new life. We'll all be here waiting.""

2885834816.m_KeyValue: ""But if you look closer at the details, the future isn't all sorrow. Though three cups have fallen, two still stand. If you just turn around, you'll see—you haven’t lost everything.""

2885834818.m_KeyValue: ""I thought I had let go, but maybe I haven't.""

2885834819.m_KeyValue: ""If I join you in this card, you won't have to be alone anymore.""

2885834821.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we could add another person to this card."

2885834823.m_KeyValue: ""Let me see... The Five of Cups, upright, shows a figure gazing down at three spilled cups, with a river ahead and a bridge fading into the distance.""

2886730927.m_KeyValue: "They have already claimed their glory on the battlefield. You are their..."

2886730934.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose this counts as seeing each other one last time, doesn't it?""

2886731954.m_KeyValue: ""The deadly Black Mist creeps silently through the valleys, the Black Blood disease trailing it like a shadow.""

2887714503.m_KeyValue: "This time it's a Blood Beast overlord..."

2887714504.m_KeyValue: "My power... the power of my eyes..."

2887714534.m_KeyValue: "I need it to use my eye's power to fight. I must find it!"

2887714537.m_KeyValue: ""No! No, no, no, don't go... I shouldn't have touched you...""

2887714538.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>I don't want to see them disappear anymore... I must protect them... I have to protect them..."

2887714799.m_KeyValue: "Can I take off the bandages and look outside?"

2887714801.m_KeyValue: ""My lady, the most important thing is for you to rest and let your eyes recover.""

2887714802.m_KeyValue: ""If... if I didn't have these eyes, would you all stop acting so strange?""

2887714803.m_KeyValue: "These monsters keep emerging from the desert..."

2887714830.m_KeyValue: ""No...No, I can't waste any time... I must find those assassins.""

2887714831.m_KeyValue: ""It was on a moonless, black night, not long ago, at the month's start;""

2887714833.m_KeyValue: "Looks like the same room I was in before..."

2887714863.m_KeyValue: "This can't be real... Perhaps... it's a dream?"

2887714865.m_KeyValue: "No! They were planning to assassinate the family today. We must search the estate immediately for their accomplices!"

2887714898.m_KeyValue: ""Zoe, what time is it? What are we doing here?""

2887714900.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, my lady. If you don't go in soon, you'll be late for the ritual.""

2887714930.m_KeyValue: ""How naive. I could just tell you, for what we're going to do, no one can stop us.""

2887714931.m_KeyValue: ""If we can't find the lord, let's make him come to us...""

2887714932.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I don't do it myself, you won't last much longer, so why not make yourself useful one last time?""

2887714965.m_KeyValue: "This isn't it either... Have to keep searching..."

2887714996.m_KeyValue: "Could this be the true power of Black Blood..."

2887714997.m_KeyValue: "Wait for me… I'll come back for you!"

2888502143.m_KeyValue: "It's all right. I'll handle it—at least allow me to fulfill my final duty."

2888502146.m_KeyValue: "You've stepped forward... Are you planning to help me hold them off?"

2888502147.m_KeyValue: "The Formless must sense my strength fading—so they've gathered their constructs to finish me."

2888502152.m_KeyValue: "I'll figure it out later. Stay behind me—I'll handle this."

2888503069.m_KeyValue: ""Even so, new seeds have taken root here. That's what matters.""

2888503073.m_KeyValue: "If I hadn't been the one to light that bonfire... Would any of this have happened?"

2888503074.m_KeyValue: ""History is inevitability, stitched from countless chance events. Even without you, fate may have found a second Stella. Or a third.""

2888503075.m_KeyValue: "Had you not come today... I might have become the next anchor to open that door."

2888503076.m_KeyValue: ""I've been thinking too... If only another 'Noah' had warned us, nineteen years ago. But thoughts like that—what good are they now?""

2888503080.m_KeyValue: ""I know this sounds strange... but the flames from those exploding constructs... they remind me of the fireworks that lit up the sky over Asta, nineteen years ago.""

2888503165.m_KeyValue: "What? I thought it was the bell tower!"

2888503166.m_KeyValue: "Simple. Because you—Stella Noah—have been the anchor linking our two worlds from the very beginning."

2888503169.m_KeyValue: ""Would you hear my answer? As long as memory and knowledge persist, he cannot truly die.""

2888503170.m_KeyValue: "Why are you pointing at your head?"

2888503171.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, hold on—you're losing me... You still haven't explained why the Formless keeps chasing Stella.""

2888503172.m_KeyValue: "Isn't that how human civilization carries on?"

2888503173.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. But tell me—when do you think a person truly dies?"

2888503174.m_KeyValue: ""But after I left... he died, didn't he?""

2888503175.m_KeyValue: "He never left. He's been here all along—"

2888503176.m_KeyValue: ""He asked me the same thing, just before I departed. Then... could it be that you're—""

2888505346.m_KeyValue: "That place... Is that where Aiona and the others died?"

2888505349.m_KeyValue: "...You want me to come with you?"

2888505351.m_KeyValue: ""Why are you still following me? Now's your chance—while the Formless rests, get to safety.""

2888547777.m_KeyValue: "Why would I tear out one of my own drawings?"

2888616689.m_KeyValue: "Slaves of House Carrelle who will stop at nothing to claim a _$$surname_$$ for themselves."

2888763259.m_KeyValue: "How about trying to become a Bloodborn instead of a human?"

2889934402.m_KeyValue: ""If my power could be divided into a hundred parts, I would gladly give one to Pavana.""

2889934403.m_KeyValue: "Where's Joan? She was right here… how could she vanish without a trace?"

2889934404.m_KeyValue: "Come with us to the Tempus Church. There lies your destiny—your ultimate destination."

2889934405.m_KeyValue: "Could the desert's ancient myths be true?"

2889934408.m_KeyValue: "It has starved so long—it will relish every morsel of your flesh…"

2891226058.m_KeyValue: "Never did I dream I would die rebelling against a Lord. And that is already the finest end I could ask for."

2891226059.m_KeyValue: "Desert! Scorching heat! And passionate beauties in flowing skirts!"

2891226061.m_KeyValue: "Joan's already charged in! She'll bring us victory—I know she will…"

2891226062.m_KeyValue: "Don't question my memory. That's exactly how he looks."

2891226063.m_KeyValue: "Day 90... We've returned to the capital again."

2891614809.m_KeyValue: "Perform Spirit Siphon with any Vassal {0} time(s)."

2892383406.m_KeyValue: ""He was so frail, yet that cold silver hair and those inscrutable crimson eyes...""

2892390435.m_KeyValue: ""Still, it's good to stay alert—there are mysteries lurking in every corner of this abandoned castle, waiting to be discovered. Who knows? Next time you might find something truly valuable.""

2892391589.m_KeyValue: "And of course to Miss Alita as well."

2892644678.m_KeyValue: ""Amusing... since when does tattered armor need sleep? Save your barbs, traitor. I will teach you a hard lesson myself!""

2892676189.m_KeyValue: "Can you endure the grief—of farewells from which there is no return?"

2892676190.m_KeyValue: ""From the start, he never intended to let me leave.""

2892676191.m_KeyValue: ""How very kind of you, blue-skinned elder!""

2892676192.m_KeyValue: "Because every Divine Body holds power beyond human control. They have never been humanity's friends."

2892676193.m_KeyValue: ""Agreed. She'd have made a great captain on the El Dorado—second only to me, of course.""

2892676195.m_KeyValue: ""So you've hidden this from them. Afraid, are you? Afraid of letting them see who you truly are?""

2892720464.m_KeyValue: "Piera's Bond. Greatly increases CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG for all allies right away."

2892954168.m_KeyValue: "Which is why I believe Letitia possesses the courage of a legendary hero."

2892954176.m_KeyValue: ""Though if the protagonist just forgave them because of those struggles... that would be pretty frustrating, wouldn't it?""

2892954177.m_KeyValue: ""But then again, I've probably done similar things myself... Haha.""

2892954178.m_KeyValue: ""If I were the protagonist, the whole story would probably fall apart.""

2892954181.m_KeyValue: "Don't flatter me. I know how weak I am."

2892954182.m_KeyValue: "I can't even face my own darkness."

2892954183.m_KeyValue: "To completely sever ties with your own shadow—that's something most people could never accomplish."

2894848154.m_KeyValue: "The people from the Church—how many of them were there?"

2894848155.m_KeyValue: ""No, I was just thinking how you remind me of my other companions. I suppose I can see where you're coming from.""

2894848156.m_KeyValue: ""Even though the salt weakened the nightmares, you're actually...""

2894848159.m_KeyValue: ""Living on Sunset Isle, you should know better than me...""

2894848186.m_KeyValue: ""To be honest, ever since I woke up on this island, I've been experiencing a sense of surreal confusion...""

2894848187.m_KeyValue: ""What?! But you're the one who told me about her today, when we first met...""

2894848188.m_KeyValue: "It's coming from the village! Did something happen there?!"

2894848189.m_KeyValue: "...That forbidden ritual should have been forgotten ages ago. No one but me should know about it. Who... who could it be?!"

2894848212.m_KeyValue: ""For now, let's concentrate on how we can help Piera with the time we have left on the island.""

2894848213.m_KeyValue: ""You... you're just making me more confused! Everyone else is like some myth or superhuman, while I'm just... a useless nobody...""

2894848219.m_KeyValue: "Ah! Does this mean we'll finally see him without that annoying grin? I'm getting more excited by the second!"

2894848220.m_KeyValue: ""How did I know you were here? And why would I come after you personally just for leaving the Church without permission, right?""

2894848221.m_KeyValue: "Even though Master said I can't fully control this power... if I use it with this..."

2894848222.m_KeyValue: "Well... my teacher never really talks about... what he does as the Bell Ringer..."

2894848224.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean 'that's enough'?! I can hear your heartbeat—you're terrified!"

2894848225.m_KeyValue: ""I... I just know! I know... Death will return. I know how to deal with it, and I also know...""

2894848244.m_KeyValue: "It's pointless. She's likely far away from here."

2894848245.m_KeyValue: "—Just ignore them. Let's focus on tracking down the one with silver hair."

2894848250.m_KeyValue: "Do you really think he looks that old?"

2894848251.m_KeyValue: "Bathory? I think grandmother mentioned them... Are they also Gravekeepers of the Divine Body like my family?"

2894848252.m_KeyValue: "Then he must have made it to the island by himself... but was it before or after the ship went down?"

2894848254.m_KeyValue: "I fear I can't keep my promise."

2894848255.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, quit slacking off! I've already taken out three of these things!""

2894848256.m_KeyValue: ""Leave it to me, then. I can track him down.""

2894848257.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella... thank you. I know you can read hearts, so you can already tell... of my fear... and apprehension...""

2894848282.m_KeyValue: "Why do you think this island is the only place in the world with these phantoms?"

2894848283.m_KeyValue: ""Naive child, there's so much you've yet to understand.""

2894848285.m_KeyValue: ""...Acappella, even though you warned me not to open it before you returned...""

2894848286.m_KeyValue: "Eh? You're all Gravekeepers...? Then all of you are from the Paracelsus family?"

2894848287.m_KeyValue: "Death stands as the ultimate testament to your defiance against fate. I hope you will remember this always."

2894848288.m_KeyValue: ""So that's why you braved the perils to come here alone, carrying such a heavy burden.""

2894848289.m_KeyValue: ""Little Piera, it's wonderful to see you all grown up. You look just like your grandmother at that age.""

2894848311.m_KeyValue: ""By not stopping you, he was putting you in danger!""

2894848314.m_KeyValue: ""Ironic indeed... Death took your lives, yet granted you this 'eternity' in return.""

2894848315.m_KeyValue: ""At that time... more and more family members began to convert to Death's faith. The Divine Body no longer responded to us, and no one even knew where on the island it was.""

2894848316.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be afraid, I'm here with you. We'll face this together, so throw away that relic 'salt stake'... Did that bastard Albrecht give it to you?""

2894848317.m_KeyValue: "It seems we managed to defeat Death before he could recover his power."

2894848319.m_KeyValue: ""I won't, right? This ritual will erase Death along with this island... from this world!""

2894848320.m_KeyValue: ""Have you forgotten everything I taught you, you foolish girl!""

2894848321.m_KeyValue: ""Compared to our short, mortal lives, Death is truly 'eternal.'""

2894848351.m_KeyValue: "It's my fault... I can only... rely on the power of my ancestors... (coughing)"

2894848352.m_KeyValue: "The ritual... you only... interrupted it... but... only the last step remains..."

2894848353.m_KeyValue: "Don't talk. Save your strength. I'm going to heal you..."

2937519928.m_KeyValue: ""Is the true protagonist of this celebration really _$$me,_$$ or is it that heir and qualified one who bears all the gazes?""

2938022932.m_KeyValue: ""As for that person's current whereabouts, you probably know better than I do—after all, only one person could be this close to you.""

2938022933.m_KeyValue: ""Now that you mention it, I might actually know someone like that... Perfect timing, it's been a while since I've had a proper chat with her.""

2938022937.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it was when you were the chancellor or later when you became the Bell Ringer, that princess never left your side.""

2938022938.m_KeyValue: "Don't you think that's a rather frightening thing to say?"

2938022939.m_KeyValue: ""The memories I saw belong neither to you nor the earring, but to the princess of the Carrelle family.""

2938022940.m_KeyValue: ""If that were true, she would have had no reason to stay hidden when I launched my war against the Carrelle family.""

2938022941.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps she had the same intentions as you from the beginning."

2938022942.m_KeyValue: ""Through the war, you buried the Carrelle family in ruins and built a new order on top of it—exactly what the Carrelle princess intended to do.""

2938692410.m_KeyValue: ""A pity I've cast aside my humanity... but for you, I suppose I'll make an exception.""

2938692441.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, this feeling... it's as if I've been transported back to the past. Thank you for allowing me to experience life once more.""

2938692476.m_KeyValue: ""I am a servant of God, why do my hands tremble...?""

2938692507.m_KeyValue: ""How did you know I… Wait, I should prepare something too…""

2938692573.m_KeyValue: "Your insistence leaves me no choice but to accept."

2938757920.m_KeyValue: "Shoulder to shoulder? We're standing miles apart."

2938757922.m_KeyValue: "Is this the true power of blood?"

2940069097.m_KeyValue: ""After ruling out strength and ideals, there's only one thing I failed to achieve—obtaining you.""

2940069098.m_KeyValue: ""These letters we've exchanged and these pieces of jewelry should be sufficient proof that I've _$$obtained you,_$$ shouldn't they?""

2940069099.m_KeyValue: ""You probably don't know yet, do you? She never got approval from the Hall of the Elders to find you in Starfall Valley—she ran away on her own.""

2940069100.m_KeyValue: ""I don't understand, what do you think Cain wants to test between you two?""

2941544064.m_KeyValue: ""To take the name ""Thibault"" is to mask the past beneath a facade. Though Ressa once swore to sacrifice everything, what choice must she make when Noah stands between her and the path to progress and redemption?""

2941544073.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious fortune teller who emerged on the El Dorado. Shrouded in enigma and intrigue, she refers to others by the faces of Tarot cards.""

2941544075.m_KeyValue: ""As the Third Mate of the El Dorado, William holds a position of leadership, yet remains somewhat estranged from the rest of the crew. Meanwhile, his relationship with Captain Goldland is also... rather unusual.""

2941544076.m_KeyValue: ""Past regrets become lessons for today. This time, things will be different...""

2941544077.m_KeyValue: "Sunset Isle resident and long-time friend of Noah and Ressa. Formerly a subject in the Church's Ascension Experiments."
