2946823193.m_KeyValue: ""This wretch comes for you once more. Stand, and face your end!""

2946823194.m_KeyValue: "Silver Cross... it seems I misjudged you."

2946823195.m_KeyValue: "Here we go again—Do you fancy yourself some kind of expert on us?"

2947188453.m_KeyValue: ""I recall fragments... the gentle caress of moonlight, the sweet fragrance of Wolfsbane, and...""

2947188454.m_KeyValue: ""And pain... the searing agony of eyes torn from their sockets, tongue ripped from my throat. They carved into my flesh with white-hot iron, pierced me with needles...""

2947188455.m_KeyValue: ""Blood surges from my throat, yet a weapon knows neither pain nor surrender. I will endure, I will embrace silence, I will remain bound to this place day after day, I will—""

2947188456.m_KeyValue: ""(His handwriting devolved with each reply, growing wild and erratic, marred by senseless scratches across the parchment.)""

2947291023.m_KeyValue: "This thing's power is beyond anything I've faced..."

2947291024.m_KeyValue: "Ah—wait! We were supposed to be analyzing the ritual. When did I start talking to myself?"

2947291025.m_KeyValue: ""With the Blood Moon rising and the eternal night settling in, we needed firewood, candles.""

2947291026.m_KeyValue: "You said someone doesn't want him to speak—what do you mean by that?"

2948582679.m_KeyValue: "You held them off alone? How long was I unconscious?"

2949004598.m_KeyValue:
""Attention Lord,
You have unclaimed rewards in Crescent Moon Pact, please be sure to claim them.""

2949004599.m_KeyValue:
""Attention Lord,
Your storage limit has been reached. Please find the surplus items attached to this letter and claim them.""

2949225514.m_KeyValue: ""A winged creature from the depths of the sealed area, corrupted by Black Blood. Driven by an unknown force, it strikes the ground with great force, generating Shockwaves that ripple through the environment.""

2949225602.m_KeyValue: ""An outgrowth of an infected rough-skinned newt. Now autonomous, this creature retains the will of its former self, spraying toxins upon death in attempt to take its enemies down with it.""

2949225603.m_KeyValue: ""The Blood Beast encountered on the El Dorado is a rare amphibious creature. The toxins it releases, amplified by Black Blood corruption, are particularly terrifying.""

2949225610.m_KeyValue: ""A crab common to Sunset Isle. Seemingly infected with Black Blood, it has lost its vision and now repels approaching creatures by spraying toxin.""

2949225611.m_KeyValue: ""A crab common to Sunset Isle. Seemingly infected with Black Blood, it now swings its pincers wildly as if to shred anything standing before it.""

2949225612.m_KeyValue: "A common wild boar on Sunset Isle. It is a hypersomniac and will enter a frenzy when awakened."

2949225613.m_KeyValue: ""A common tusked wild boar on Sunset Isle. With a fiery temper and poor eyesight, it charges indiscriminately when provoked.""

2949225614.m_KeyValue: ""A common tusked wild boar on Sunset Isle. With a fiery temper and poor eyesight, it charges indiscriminately when provoked. Its body, fully crystallized with salt, is exceptionally tough.""

2949225615.m_KeyValue: "A tusked wild boar infected with Black Blood. It charges indiscriminately when provoked."

2949225616.m_KeyValue: ""A phantom of longing corrupted by _$$Death,_$$ now completely devoid of sanity. For some unknown reason, it doesn't vanish upon defeat like other phantoms.""

2949225617.m_KeyValue: ""A phantom of longing corrupted by _$$Death,_$$ now completely devoid of sanity. For some unknown reason, it doesn't vanish upon defeat like other phantoms.""

2949323718.m_KeyValue: "A soft blush bloomed across Letitia's cheeks as she glanced away."

2949323721.m_KeyValue: "All those romantic twists and turns in stories... they're just not for me."

2949323722.m_KeyValue: "Human society... truly a marvel to behold."

2949323723.m_KeyValue: "Days of poring over countless stories and texts have finally taken their toll on me."

2949352947.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps when they are forgotten by the world."

2949632700.m_KeyValue: "Curse us? Sounds like your so-called god is the real demon."

2949632701.m_KeyValue: "Those were lies to lure you in!"

2950000609.m_KeyValue: ""Hatches will produce Black Blood Mutant Sailors in battle, and are relatively weak.""

2951002947.m_KeyValue: "This wouldn't happen to be the last remaining blood of the Matriarch? The security was incredibly tight. I had to knock out quite a few guards to get it."

2951180448.m_KeyValue: "You mean something that would change my future and your past?"

2951840303.m_KeyValue: "'Down thirty drinks to win an exquisite Acorellia Highlands goat toy.' What an odd promotion."

2952964435.m_KeyValue: "Behold an Undiscovered Artifact. Enter [Dutchman's Revenge] to obtain it."

2953943006.m_KeyValue: ""And I thought you were about to say something profound, but what came out was more nonsense.""

2953943008.m_KeyValue: "The sheer number of insects tells me we're not far from the core of the Ashen Garden."

2953943009.m_KeyValue: "This is ridiculous! This is no time to tell lies!"

2953943011.m_KeyValue: ""Fine. I trust you, Aiona. Lead the way.""

2953943038.m_KeyValue: "The Seed of Calamity? I heard they were a group of alchemists who used the power of Black Blood to rebel against the Church."

2953943039.m_KeyValue: ""As long as the person before my eyes is still that kind 'Aiona,' you are you, the one I trust most.""

2953943042.m_KeyValue: "If this continues... you'll all die here!"

2953943043.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, this is the only way... you must drink my blood.""

2953943305.m_KeyValue: "I never imagined we would end up in a place like this..."

2953943307.m_KeyValue: ""Even though Father never spoke about the forbidden grounds, I grew up in Mouret and have never heard anything about any Moonblessed.""

2953943308.m_KeyValue: "Geez... Just what was Father trying to tell me?!"

2953943336.m_KeyValue: ""How do you seem to know so much... Whatever, follow me!""

2953943337.m_KeyValue: "Snap out of it and make some sense!"

2953943366.m_KeyValue: ""I... I'm not going to die, right?""

2953943367.m_KeyValue: ""You would go against me... against the Light, for the sake of a stranger you just met?""

2953943368.m_KeyValue: "You drank the water from this cave?!"

2953943369.m_KeyValue: ""How unfortunate, to say your last goodbye right after meeting.""

2953943398.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you're not that Aiona, deep down I know you're a trustworthy companion.""

2953943399.m_KeyValue: ""Moreover, you gave the precious spores we just collected to a runt beyond saving. Did you forget our mission?""

2953943400.m_KeyValue: "He's already infected with Black Blood and shares the same bloodline as those filthy werewolves. We merely allowed him to return to where he belongs."

2953943404.m_KeyValue: "You're wrong! You can't mock our efforts. Mouret won't be destroyed just like this..."

2953943426.m_KeyValue: "These werewolves have lived in the cave for a long time. They're more familiar with these mushrooms than we are."

2953943427.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, what kind of person do you want to become?""

2953943430.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what this Calamity is capable of, but Clive is only a child—a child who just lost his father.""

2953943431.m_KeyValue: ""Over some random kid, she's siding with a special type that she just met?""

2953943432.m_KeyValue: "Not yet... But the Church elders and the lords of the kingdom firmly believe that one of them will become the youngest Bell Ringer in history."

2953943434.m_KeyValue: "We have no reason to tell an outsider like you..."

2953943435.m_KeyValue: "The spores I gave you were collected from within the Divine Body. They can suppress the onset of Black Blood to a degree."

2953943436.m_KeyValue: "Their honor and duty were fabricated by the Church from the very beginning. They were destined to be your sacrifices all along!"

2953943437.m_KeyValue: "He'll be sealed by the Divine Body and trapped in this cave. If this cave contains one of the sources of Black Blood..."

2953943467.m_KeyValue: "Family crest... hearing that here... I can't help but be reminded of that time..."

2953943468.m_KeyValue: "You came to the lands of the werewolves? And even entered their forbidden grounds? Then you..."

2953943469.m_KeyValue: "We mustn't let our guard down. Those special mushrooms also grow here."

2953943500.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, Noah, didn't you know? The Black Blood only infects humans. Animals can be carriers of the disease, but it won't have any adverse effects on them.""

2954686044.m_KeyValue: "The most important thing to focus on is evading the dangers of the day."

2954686046.m_KeyValue: ""A winding path lies ahead. Will you take it, or bypass it and go straight?""

2954686047.m_KeyValue:
"'I'm the No. 1 Steering Spider!'
Reach the next destination even faster!"

2954686076.m_KeyValue:
""Misleading opponents is also a competitive strategy.
Faced with a dead end, the two spiders reassess their relationship.""

2954686077.m_KeyValue:
"You encounter spiders moving in the opposite direction.
You question yourself—should you be following them?"

2954686079.m_KeyValue: "The spider that stuck to its path spotted the other spider at the supply point—the one that turned back earlier had caught up."

2955548055.m_KeyValue: ""Siren's Tears applies Siren's Song to nearby units once per sec. Each stack of Siren's Song inflicts ATK SPD Down on enemies, and Sleep when it reaches 2 stacks. Each stack grants ATK SPD UP to allies and removes their status effects when it reaches 2 stacks.""

2955939158.m_KeyValue: ""Now, alter the flow of time and face our destiny.""

2957383824.m_KeyValue: ""No! This is your doing, Van Helsing! Had you not pressed him so hard, he'd never have chosen death!""

2957383825.m_KeyValue: ""It's a dead knot, no way to untie it... We'll have to cut it with a sword!""

2957383826.m_KeyValue: ""No, no—who even are you? When did you even show up!?""

2957383827.m_KeyValue: "Fall back and fight! Head for the Captain's quarters!"

2957383829.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing! I'll take the helm! Please cover me while I head up!"

2957383848.m_KeyValue: "Matching uniforms… brothers… the hat… and a veiled plea for me to destroy his flesh… Could it be... Oh no!!"

2957383849.m_KeyValue: "Come... come quickly... I'm waiting for you... my fellow Moonblessed..."

2957383856.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you say you had some final form? What are you waiting for—use it!"

2957383857.m_KeyValue: ""Because perhaps one day, not far from now, I'll use it to kill you.""

2957383858.m_KeyValue: ""No. I will not allow it. You will not desecrate my brother's body, even if it is the only way to stop him...""

2957383859.m_KeyValue: ""When Bob stopped us, Goldland was clearly heading toward Jones's quarters, but when we arrived, only Jones was there.""

2957383860.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe Mr. Jones just thought… On a sealed vessel like this, even one case of infection could doom everyone?""

2957383861.m_KeyValue: "I must understand why William was infected with Black Blood."

2957383862.m_KeyValue: ""Then Jones struck him unconscious in the guest cabin and slipped the rope he had prepared around his neck, waiting for the right moment.""

2957383863.m_KeyValue: ""What about Aiona and me? And you, and that big oaf, and the dutiful sailor from earlier? None of us are infected either!""

2957383890.m_KeyValue: "Help me… my kin… I'm right below…"

2957383920.m_KeyValue: ""It seems you were right, Noah. Once they reach this state, all that remains is hunger.""

2957383921.m_KeyValue: ""You've carried the Black Blood for some time now. And without knowing it, you've learned to live with it. Just as the Bloodborn do.""

2957383922.m_KeyValue: "I see... there's a stockpile of ingredients here. And they all look fresh."

2957383924.m_KeyValue: ""I only sensed that you hold this place dear, that you truly wish to protect this 'sanctuary.'""

2957383926.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, isn't it? I've lived on this ship for over ten years, yet somehow you seem to know more about it than I do.""

2957383927.m_KeyValue: "I examined the floor when I first grew suspicious. There's no hidden hatch that I could find."

2957383948.m_KeyValue: ""First Mate Bob, allow me to tend to your wounds—""

2957383949.m_KeyValue: "I haven't lost. I haven't lost. I haven't! It's only because I stood alone—while you all turned against me..."

2957383952.m_KeyValue: ""Kris... even my brother, always preaching about how the crew is family, yet treated me—his own blood—as dead weight...""

2957383953.m_KeyValue: "I had assumed killing his brother and taking his place was a sudden act—but it may have been planned from the beginning. He may have simply been waiting for the moment to strike."

2957383954.m_KeyValue: ""That is exactly why you're a fool! You know he scolded you, hit you, threatened to throw you overboard! And yet he never once... never once would have...""

2957383955.m_KeyValue: ""That part remained unclear—until now. But from what I overheard just before entering, and from William's own mention of the Divine Body… I've found my answer.""

2957383956.m_KeyValue: "Is that what your brother used to tell you?"

2957383957.m_KeyValue: ""Now, all that remains is to stop this vessel from reaching Sunset Isle—where the Divine Body lies hidden...""

2957383959.m_KeyValue: "Back then I was bickering with the walking tin can over his sense of taste—and now this place is his grave. Wait! You're—!"

2957383984.m_KeyValue: "Something is clearly amiss with Ami. Look after her. As for Blood Beasts of this level—"

2957383985.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it too late to realize this? There can't be many left alive aboard this ship. And if she's not strong…"

2957383986.m_KeyValue: "We'll look after Ami. And we will find Hati. Leave this to us."

2957383990.m_KeyValue: "That remains to be seen. Let's find out whether the answers we carry in our minds are the same. Starting with..."

2957383991.m_KeyValue: ""Don't test me like this… Come out, my goddess...""

2957384018.m_KeyValue: "Enough of your sanctimonious talk… You coward. You couldn't even bring yourself to face the sea."

2957384019.m_KeyValue: ""Don't look at me with those eyes, Van Helsing. I don't need your pity.""

2957384020.m_KeyValue: ""Shut your trap, Van Helsing! You keep ruining everything... Wait...""

2957384021.m_KeyValue: ""You of the Silver Cross ought to know better than anyone. No matter how skilled you are, you're still mere mortals. And a Calamity? They are legends for a reason! They have slain even Bell Ringers.""

2957384023.m_KeyValue: ""To free her, I killed all who might've discovered her. Including my brother.""

2957588999.m_KeyValue: ""<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>. While channeling, continuously deals moderate M. DMG to random enemies.""

2957828663.m_KeyValue: ""(Did something like this happen between Ressa and me? To be honest, I don't remember...)""

2960234379.m_KeyValue:
""Noah,

Are you available? I need to see you as soon as possible.
Recently, the Silver Cross has encountered a troublesome case. Selena and I have been running everywhere, yet we can't find a single clue—the case remains a tangled mess.
Considering our excellent cooperation in the Reese's case, I thought I should send you an invitation.
Also, even though we've been busy all day, Selena insisted I send this letter today.
She says it's a meaningful day and mentioned she hasn't had cake in ages—she's certain you'll bring cake with you.
Though today is my birthday, but I believe the case is our top priority.
However, Selena's been working hard lately, do bring her a cake—I'll cover the expense.
A small one. I don't like eating too much.""

2960234380.m_KeyValue:
""Noah,
Halfway through my seventh meal, you crossed my mind.
Miss Empousa took my plate while I was lost in thought, insisting I save room for birthday cake.
My appetite demands justice.
The castle is grand, but the food is dreadful. No seafood, no delicacies—only bats. Perhaps you could make me lord of this place so I can restore its culinary dignity.
I wanted to share birthday cake with you.
But when I sought you in your room, you were gone.
I'll entrust this note to Polly. I can only hope by the time it reaches you, the cake won't be half gone.
I'll wait for you in my room. If you're late, you can still polish the plate clean.
—And that has nothing to do with me, truly. You may ask Polly about it.
Ah, there is cream on the note!
How am I still starving after the cake… Oh, looks like you're on the menu?""

2961613102.m_KeyValue: "Many days had passed since I promised Piera I'd find the child's relatives."

2961718861.m_KeyValue: ""After the previous two, on the third day I received another letter from Tris.""

2962521937.m_KeyValue: ""As salt crystallizes, it entombs the dying Blood Beasts of the island. These jagged formations rise like coffins across the desolate isle—both sanctuary and sustenance for the decaying remains.""

2962521944.m_KeyValue: ""Priests who guard Sunset Isle. Unfortunately they have already began to crystallize. Though good at healing injuries through prayer, they <color=#D63536>lack the means to protect themselves.</color>""

2962521946.m_KeyValue: ""A phantom of longing corrupted by _$$Death,_$$ now completely devoid of sanity. For some unknown reason, it doesn't vanish upon defeat like other phantoms.""

2962521947.m_KeyValue: ""Merely the avatar of Calamity _$$Death_,$$ its presence and power fall short of the true Calamity, a pale imitation, a hollow display.""

2962521948.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. The medal behind them echoes their gallantry as an Astolfo warrior. Even now, they wield the sickle against any enemies before them.""

2962521949.m_KeyValue: "Are these eerie tentacles crawling out from the cracks in the deck merely Blood Beasts… or a glimpse of the Calamity _$$Famine_$$ itself?"

2962521950.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its hardened shell appears capable of deflecting most attacks.""

2962521951.m_KeyValue: ""As salt crystallizes, it entombs the dying Blood Beasts of the island. These jagged formations rise like coffins across the desolate isle—both sanctuary and sustenance for the decaying remains.""

2962522003.m_KeyValue: ""Prisoners confined within the depths of Ironfist Gaol. Their hands bear the seared marks of branding irons, shattering the dexterity they once took such pride in. Perhaps when they next grasp a coin, the joy they once felt will transform into agony.""

2962522008.m_KeyValue: ""Forgetting hunger and fatigue, the cleric kneels to provide final aid to the dying warrior. Though she knows hope is slim, she battles death for every life, even as this conflict slowly drains her own strength.""

2962522009.m_KeyValue: ""Clergy of the Tempus Church who wields the staff of punishment, sparing neither heretic nor criminal. Yet after countless acts of cruelty, they too find themselves prisoners—trapped within the very gaol they uphold.""

2962522010.m_KeyValue: ""Most Ganelon soldiers come from humble families and possess unwavering loyalty to their commander. This blind trust makes them fearless on the battlefield, charging without hesitation even when facing the most formidable enemies.""

2962522011.m_KeyValue: ""With trembling hands, Sorcerer Crowley raises his staff high, knowing each spell cast erodes his soul, yet he continues to draw power from the Abyss to protect the village behind him, even as he gradually succumbs to monstrosity through this dark pact.""

2962522013.m_KeyValue: ""Knights sent to the prison by order of the Tempus Church, who answer to the warden and lead the other gaolers. Their armor and blades are well polished to reflect the moon, the one thing that lights their way back to the Church.""

2962522014.m_KeyValue: ""Clergy of the Tempus Church who guards heretics and criminals. Their blessed arrows mercilessly pin sinners to the walls—yet sometimes, those very arrows strike their former companions.""

2962522015.m_KeyValue: "Clergy of the Tempus Church whose prayers reach out to criminals and fellow clerics. Maybe this is the sole means to cleanse one's soul—within this cage of perpetual sin."

2962522033.m_KeyValue: ""An outgrowth of Sheila the Firstborn and the carrier of the Calamity _$$Plague,_$$ exist only to find hosts and spread the Calamity.""

2962522040.m_KeyValue: ""Gravekeeper for the Ganelon family, he lost his sanity and underwent mutation due to the spread of the Black Blood. He now awaits in silence for the chosen one's arrival.""

2962522046.m_KeyValue: "A moon-shaped egg with a Plague Hatchling inside. Witnessing its hatching would forever alter your understanding of _$$giving birth._$$"

2962522047.m_KeyValue: ""An outgrowth of Sheila the Firstborn and the carrier of the Calamity _$$Plague,_$$ exist only to find hosts and spread the Calamity.""

2965607174.m_KeyValue: "Just look at what we've achieved in mere days—so many impossibilities realized through our bond."

2965607175.m_KeyValue: "How did you discover that the Calamity could be reversed?"

2965607176.m_KeyValue: ""Mass is the amalgamation of my will with the wills of all the enslaved after death. A spirit of wills should not exist in this world—yet since it does, there must be purpose in its existence.""

2965607177.m_KeyValue: ""I believe it persists because it carries a singular, unfulfilled obsession—to undo the tragedy that befell Carrelle.""

2965607179.m_KeyValue: ""Blinding flames seared the air, forcing eyes shut. Slaves were driven into a grim procession, pushed into the fire as the acrid stench of burning flesh choked the air.""

2965607180.m_KeyValue: "I never imagined your solution would be to walk into the flames once more."

2965607181.m_KeyValue: ""From the moment I first chose you, I knew with absolute certainty—together, we would bring this tragedy to an end.""

2965607186.m_KeyValue: ""If I hadn't experienced _$$Death_$$ myself, I might never have believed such a possibility—""

2965607187.m_KeyValue: ""Enduring endless suffering, reaching the very end of time, then wielding millennia of accumulated anguish as fuel to bend the laws of time and space and restore chaotic energy to order.""

2965963541.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet's enthusiastic declaration rang out in the Hall of Honor, touching everyone present.""

2965963542.m_KeyValue: ""Though our Matriarch is sealed away, the Bathory family endures. As long as we elders pass down the Bathory spirit, our lineage shall persist! Our resurgence is on the horizon!'""

2966342520.m_KeyValue: "Clinging to hope when you know there's no escape isn't an ideal—it's pure foolishness."

2966452499.m_KeyValue: "I wanted to share that feeling with you."

""Humans are food.
That was the first thing my sister told me when I arrived in the territory. Her voice was unfeeling, as I stood at the edge of the bustling crowd.
They looked like me. Moved like me. I couldn't understand how she saw them as nothing more than prey.
But then a girl approached. She carried flowers and a scent—not of petals, but something irresistible.
It struck a chord somewhere primal. My doubts trembled.
'Can you feel it? This is food.'
Then my sister placed the little girl's hand into mine, her crimson eyes shimmering with ravenous hunger.
Perhaps it was an invitation—to blood. She handed me a dagger, the Bathory crest gleaming on it. 'She is yours now.'
And just like that, she vanished, leaving me alone with the girl. The girl held out a flower. 'Lord asked me to give you these.'
'Why?'
'It's for your birthday... You must really love flowers, miss?'
Do I? I don't know.
But at that moment, the fragrance of blossoms masked the thirst in my chest...""

3054617287.m_KeyValue: ""We all know how bad-tempered Elder Bella's little puppets can be... If we impose price controls, they might just pack up and leave. What'll we do then?""

3054617384.m_KeyValue: "Sounds like an impartial and highly professional organization. I say we let them survey our territory! They might help us learn more about our family history. I'm all for it!"

3054617551.m_KeyValue: ""Not only is this place surrounded by mountains on three sides, but there's also a river on the east side flowing towards The Howling Peninsula. Anyone traveling by water must pass through here. It's a perfect haven.""

3054617617.m_KeyValue: ""Let me speak up for the person in question! The one sending letters is an old acquaintance from before they joined the Bloodborn. Although an outsider, they bear no ill will towards the Bloodborn.""

3054617648.m_KeyValue: ""To restore our family’s glory and conquer the continent, our Vassals must venture forth and gain worldly knowledge. We need only ensure they exercise discretion in their affairs.""

3054617683.m_KeyValue: ""Word on the street is that this Bloodborn faction differs greatly from the Bathory—they live among humans, with similar eating habits and lifestyles.""

3054617714.m_KeyValue: ""Absolutely support it! From major decisions like the power to execute vassals and the right to use high-level Alchemy, to minor ones like daily menu planning and choosing the castle's furniture style... the elders want to control everything!""

3054617749.m_KeyValue: ""Raising taxes can only solve our immediate needs. In the long run, it's not a good solution and will inevitably cause discontent among vassals and believers. It's time we explore new ways to earn Soli and acquire resources!""

3054617780.m_KeyValue: "These Ganelon people have lost their families and leaders. They're in a precarious situation where they could be purged by the Church at any moment. Now is precisely when they need protection."

3054617846.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, this is a good opportunity. Although they've made it clear they have no intention of getting involved in the conflict between the Bloodborn and the Church, they're quite generous in other aspects.""

3054714414.m_KeyValue: ""As sharp as ever. While this isn't entirely unrelated to _$$them,_$$ I'm reaching out for another reason. There's a matter I can't attend to personally, and I was hoping you might lend a hand.""

3054752651.m_KeyValue: ""It was civil. And besides, I learned those tactics from you.""

3054824393.m_KeyValue: "I figured out what's causing the pain in my stomach."

3054930152.m_KeyValue: ""Hehehe... Only you, dear Noah, would dare speak to me like that.""

3054988091.m_KeyValue: ""'Cease this pointless deliberation. My eyes shall light the way. Mind your steps and follow me closely.' With these imperious words, the Roland heir strode away, his customary arrogance trailing in his wake.""

3054988092.m_KeyValue: ""'Would you rather it be called one-eyed hill?' Friedrich jested while attempting to bump shoulders with his stern companion. But Gilrain, in anticipation, nimbly stepped out of the way.""

3054988093.m_KeyValue: ""To Friedrich, however, his companion's tone seemed more resigned than angry.""

3054988094.m_KeyValue: ""'How interesting. When pieced together, they reveal a hidden message.'""

3054988095.m_KeyValue: ""'So this cabin was built by the cartographer, Leonardo Ptolemy? Probably to study this Eye of God.'""

3054991354.m_KeyValue: ""'Where's the shopkeeper?' Joan glanced around the dim tent interior, but saw no sign of anyone else. Her brows drew together—clearly unimpressed by a fortune-telling tent run by a single cat.""

3054991356.m_KeyValue: ""But seriously, why did it have to end every sentence with meow? Where had it learned that annoying habit!?""

3054991358.m_KeyValue: ""'I knew Bell Ringers don't play by the rules…' The cat froze mid-groom, clearly taken aback. 'But this is the first time I've ever seen it in action, meow...'""

3054991359.m_KeyValue: ""'Theophane, stand down.' Joan raised a hand to stop him. 'I believe I said this was my war. You don't need to force your hand.'""

3054991360.m_KeyValue: ""Joan hesitated for only a moment before lifting her chin, a confident smile playing at her lips. 'Interesting. No matter the kind of war, I don't lose. I accept your challenge.'""

3054991361.m_KeyValue: ""'...then I might be willing to share a little information.' Having said its piece, the cat paid no further heed to the Bell Ringer and her Vice-Commander. Instead, it resumed licking its paw, as though entirely disinterested in doing business.""

3054991364.m_KeyValue: ""Joan turned the crystal ball over in her hand. 'Because it reeks of Silver Blood. For the Bloodborn, it's the most potent poison.'""

3054991365.m_KeyValue: ""…Wait, hold on. Divination is that precise? That’s not divination, that’s a prophecy!""

3055057787.m_KeyValue: ""Ami fixed Goldland with a menacing glare, shoved the rest of the grilled squid into her mouth in one go, and while furiously chewing, delivered her threat: 'Mmph… this mmph!'""

3055057789.m_KeyValue: ""'Mm... huh?' Still lost in fond memories of her vacation, Stella responded absentmindedly before suddenly snapping back to reality. 'What's wrong with gourmets?'""

3055057790.m_KeyValue: ""'Those buzzing beetles and creeping spiders, you mean?' Regina appeared beside them as if from thin air. 'I did overhear <style=Highlight>that guy</style> mention something useful...'""

3055057791.m_KeyValue: ""'Heh...' Goldland shrugged with a smirk, turning toward the camera with a mocking expression. 'Looks like you've run out of stories to tell, huh… some third-rate bard.'""

3055057792.m_KeyValue: ""'If we turn our backs and flee, who will stand as this world's shield?' Stella's gaze burned as it swept across each face. 'Perhaps after countless eons, reinforcements from another Other Side might come...'""

3055058874.m_KeyValue: ""'Touché. Come now, we've got to unwind every now and then...' Agares waved his hand with a laugh. 'Or... we might end up as one of the Ascendants.'""

3055058876.m_KeyValue: "('Wait... we have to fill it back in? Ugh. Guess I'll need to find an excuse.')"

3055058877.m_KeyValue: "Surely Agares and Goldland couldn't be more different... right?"

3055058878.m_KeyValue: ""The tiny flame left Twin Agares's palm and caught the wind. In an instant, it swelled into a roaring blaze—ready to engulf Agares whole.""

3055058879.m_KeyValue: ""'Then... this meteorite-looking thing you're holding, what is it?' For the third time, Noah edged another step back.""

3055058880.m_KeyValue: ""Both _$$Agares_$$ froze, startled expressions spreading across their faces. Now that they've been exposed, what will they do?""

3055058881.m_KeyValue: ""He... he's got a point. Given Agares's personality, it really is hard to imagine him initiating something like that. One point to Agares!""

3055058882.m_KeyValue: "Noah gave a slight nod. 'So you're the same. The past you cling to still runs through your blood.'"

3055058883.m_KeyValue: ""Mass knelt slowly, running her fingers once more across the weathered surface of the gravestone. '...he hasn't been back in a long time. Maybe he never will. So I came in his place.'""

3055059962.m_KeyValue: ""After all, Bell Ringer No. X has absolute control over the 'Air'—this is her domain.""

3055059966.m_KeyValue: ""Well, the Church's machine has become this remarkable—even capable of expressing sorrow.""

3055059969.m_KeyValue: "'Objective eliminated.' A flash of light was all that remained. Darcias had already struck down the enemy before the blade could even be glimpsed."

3055059972.m_KeyValue: ""'Since when?' A fire seemed to burn in Acappella's eyes. 'Of course it's when the static arises again, that's... the new chapter of life!'""

3055059973.m_KeyValue:
""'KHHK SHHK HHKH SHHK
KHKH SHHK HHKH SHHK'
It started writhing—oh, I mean dancing.""

3055114574.m_KeyValue: ""Secret passages will instantly transport you, like a portal.""

3055131834.m_KeyValue: ""'Curious about the outcome of my last duel with your father?' Gadric asked suddenly, a slight smirk playing on his lips.""

3055131835.m_KeyValue: ""'Suddenly, someone rushed in to stop us,' Gadric said, pouring himself another glass of wine.""

3055131836.m_KeyValue: "'No. She returned east five years ago and reportedly fell in battle.'"

3055131839.m_KeyValue: "But Clive was deaf to any counsel. His mind was fixated on one goal: to land even just a hit."

3055131840.m_KeyValue: ""'Uncle Gadric, did you really just fall by accident?' Clive finally asked the question that had been on both siblings' minds.""

3055131841.m_KeyValue: ""'There are many types of warriors in this world—those who fight on land, at sea, and from afar. This title of the kingdom's First Knight is nothing but empty words.'""

3055135101.m_KeyValue: ""'In response, the Bathory family launched a massive assault on the tower. This time, their forces included numerous Bloodborn, who could transform into bats and fly directly up the tower.'""

3055135102.m_KeyValue: ""'In the stories passed down through generations in the Aegis family, the Church was merely using the Ganelon family as pawns to trap the Bathory family on The Howling Peninsula.'""

3055135103.m_KeyValue: ""'In fact, the tower is mentioned countless times in the castle's archives and various historical records. It has been destroyed at least thirteen times throughout its history.'""

3055135104.m_KeyValue: ""'How many years can your puny memory even span, you dumb wolf!' Empousa exclaimed, exasperated by the futility of reasoning with her.""

3055161242.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, my dear little Stella—or should I say... little Noah?' As Stella approaches, Letitia clasps her palms together in rapture, her face radiant with joy.""

3055161244.m_KeyValue: "'Even if these so-called <color=#bc544b>Seven Great Mysteries of yyf</color> are real... they have nothing to do with me.'"

3055161246.m_KeyValue: ""'Yet Sunset Isle has no sunset. And so Dr. Ressa works without pause, never once returning home to Noah.'""

3055161247.m_KeyValue: ""In matters of reason, Stella truly resembles Noah.""

3055161248.m_KeyValue: ""'Relax! This Noah isn't the <style=""Highlight"">Minexus</style> Noah! And besides, didn't I hide the crucial details with underscores?'""

3055161249.m_KeyValue: ""'...suffers from suffocating quarters, where one must share space with peculiar armor, puppets, wandering creatures, and flamboyant residents. Most importantly...'""

3055161251.m_KeyValue: ""'The future...' Stella's eyes widen with sudden realization. 'You mean I will meet <color=#bc544b>her</color> someday, don't you?'""

3055163418.m_KeyValue: "'Those belong to the Church!' Isaac exclaimed vehemently."

3055163419.m_KeyValue: ""The black-haired man turned to face them. 'Curiosity is the crucible of growth for the youth, but it can also bring a premature end.'""

3055163420.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, their master had provided them with an old map of the church from its time. Although the building was now unrecognizable, the map at least helped them locate the library's position.""

3055163424.m_KeyValue: ""'Yet, as he prayed, his son had already aged to become as old as him.'""

3055163425.m_KeyValue: ""'Perhaps the reward was bestowed in ways beyond their perception,' Nicole advocated for the goddess.""

3055164379.m_KeyValue: ""'At least this time it's not _$$my back hurts_$$ again. But the mission's already over—no more excuses to slack off, right?'""

3055164380.m_KeyValue: "'Let's do something fun!' She looked expectantly at the other two Bell Ringers—"

3055164381.m_KeyValue: ""'Right, right… That's the one. Hmm… I've seen it in a divination shop before… What was it called again…?' Agares stepped forward, equally invested in the invisible mystery.""

3055164382.m_KeyValue: ""'In any case, there are twelve cards for each of the four suits—forty-eight total. Then there are the rest: cards with no suit and no number. Altogether, that brings the full deck to ninety-six.'""

3055164383.m_KeyValue: ""…Wait, what!? That has nothing to do with paths or stones!""

3055164384.m_KeyValue: ""'By skipping the action phase, Agares loses one-eighth of his maximum life, but avoids triggering Silvershade Requiem's counterattack—a cautious yet calculated choice.'""

3055164386.m_KeyValue: ""Up until now, the battle had been a chaotic free-for-all—But in this moment, Acappella and Thibault exchanged a glance, and without a word, a silent alliance was formed.""

3055164387.m_KeyValue: ""Having also recovered after eating the mushroom, Agares wore a drained expression. 'Ugh… What were we even doing just now…? This is bad. My stomach's killing me. I need a hot spring…'""

3055202618.m_KeyValue: ""_$$—And certainly don't go casting lamb fleece to the winds!_$$ The woman who bore Aiona's likeness deftly caught the wool midair with ease, cradling it gently in both hands and stroking it with reverence.""

3055202619.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Friedrich, what are you doing...?_$$ Despite his violent shivering—from the bitter cold cutting through where his chestplate should have been—Gilrain couldn't help but question his companion's peculiar actions.""

3055202620.m_KeyValue: ""_$$What's happening... what are they doing...?_$$Staring in horror at the impending clash, she shouted instinctively, _$$Cov—Covenant—!_$$""

3055202621.m_KeyValue: ""Now now, dear audience, let us not upstage the tale with untimely chatter.""

3055202622.m_KeyValue: "_$$Enough!_$$ Gilrain cut him off with a sharp gesture. His bare chest rose and fell with barely contained anger. Friedrich's words always hit deeper than they should."

3055202624.m_KeyValue: ""The two exchanged a meaningful glance—a silent understanding earned through decades of shared trials. Without another word, they strode purposefully toward Aesgracia Village, leaving Aiona alone, the chill wind tugging at her dress.""

3055202625.m_KeyValue: ""His gaze mixed tenderness, pity, and a hint of mischief. _$$What Aiona is wearing isn't a robe from the Crimson Spider Hills at all. It's a gown woven from Eastdale cotton._$$""

3055202630.m_KeyValue: ""As she spoke, a flicker of thought crossed her eyes. She pulled out a dagger, then slashed down along the tear. The once-flowing shawl split into two.""

3055202631.m_KeyValue: ""The veil touched the ground, and with it came the truth: a face of ethereal beauty, identical in every feature to the Aiona now frozen in place.""

3055203706.m_KeyValue: ""'This butterfly, with its broken wings, may well be oblivious to the terror of death.'""

3055203708.m_KeyValue: "'But they did not fulfill their original task.'"

3055203709.m_KeyValue: ""'Master, I truly believe that goodness prevails in this world. Just as the foreman emerged from the tent, ready to face his end alone, some of the workers who had departed earlier returned.'""

3055203710.m_KeyValue: ""Legend tells that long ago, these snowy plains were even colder than they are now. Travelers heading north often froze to death before reaching Iron City. No ordinary person could endure such bitter cold.""

3055203711.m_KeyValue: ""Finally, Edina, after being interrupted several times, couldn't help but blurt out in a childish tone, 'Master, do you even want to hear this story anymore?'""

3055203713.m_KeyValue: "'Why do you insist on saving it?' The Master's eyes remained utterly devoid of emotion."

3055235290.m_KeyValue: ""'That decision lies with the Elders. At present, they are inclined to avoid conflict with the Church, so it's unlikely they will expand into Mouret for the time being. However, I cannot speak for future intentions.'""

3055235291.m_KeyValue: ""'No,' Hati said with a bitter smile. 'He cursed the Ganelon family, saying that one day they would be unable to harvest their crops.'""

3055235294.m_KeyValue: ""Hati glanced up at the idle gears above, powered by the windmill. 'Of course we can eat it. The bread is mostly dark, but it's quite tasty. After all, this is the only mill in all of Mouret town.'""

3055235296.m_KeyValue: ""'To ensure the Ganelon family wouldn't face starvation in the following winter, the Bathory family even joined in the farming efforts.'""

3055235297.m_KeyValue: ""'But then, someone arrived with sacks of flour and taught the Ganelon family how to bake black bread.'""

3055240604.m_KeyValue: ""'Or maybe you were traumatized by a past event that you have blocked from your memories,' Ressa added.""

3055240605.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa clenched her fists and shouted, 'Then why in the world did you throw them onto the mill roof?!'""

3055240606.m_KeyValue: ""As Ressa and Empousa prepared to ascend to the roof, they were met with an unpleasant surprise: the ladder was broken.""

3055240607.m_KeyValue: ""'It happened during one of the castle's expansions,' Empousa's now calm voice replied. 'That particular individual was consumed by an insatiable obsession to reach the moon, which manifested in relentlessly expanding the castle up toward the sky.'""

3055240609.m_KeyValue: ""'Sounds like a minor thing from the way you're talking,' Ressa replied.""

3055307162.m_KeyValue: "(sighing) '... Guess we're down to our last option.'"

3055307163.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey! You can’t hog the hot spring all to yourself!' Hati shouted, dashing over. 'Let’s settle this with a race to the hot spring!'""

3055307164.m_KeyValue: ""'As you might have guessed, it’s just a dormant volcano...'""

3055307165.m_KeyValue: "'Hold on—this type of coin... A special minting technique is used to make the heads side heavier than the tails! That's not fair!'"

3055307166.m_KeyValue: "'There's no need to complicate things—there're still—'"

3055307167.m_KeyValue: ""'My, my. I specifically planted a sapling by this spring three years ago to keep it private, yet here you all are...'""

3055307168.m_KeyValue: ""Soon after, they disembarked at Ethereal Springs, embarking on their journey to discover the fabled hot spring.""

3055308122.m_KeyValue: "'Oh... mercury poisoning?' Darcias took just one-eighth of a breath to piece it all together."

3055308124.m_KeyValue: ""'It was on a full-moon night...' A familiar voice echoed from the distance, but the thick mist made it impossible to see who was speaking.""

3055308125.m_KeyValue: ""Moments later, the swirling mist began to dissipate. Before Darcias and Nicole stood a patch of empty ground. And Gadric's voice... was gone.""

3055308127.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, this mission was entirely self-assigned, which, in a way, meant she had already become a rather capable Vice-Commander. As for why she went to such lengths...""

3055308128.m_KeyValue: ""'Ahahahahaha!' The laughter grew louder, as if he'd just heard the funniest joke in the world.""

3055308129.m_KeyValue: "It looked like the two of them were clearly up to something. Things were starting to get interesting..."

3055308134.m_KeyValue: ""'But once he gets serious, he's surprisingly troublesome.' With a wry smile, she shook her head. 'Come on. We're not getting anything else tonight.'""

3055308135.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, what? He can form a Covenant? That's a power reserved for Bell Ringers and only the most elite combatants.""

3055379042.m_KeyValue: ""'—the one and only Kristoph Goldland!' Admiring the masterpiece in his palm, Goldland declared with unbridled enthusiasm, 'For us merchants, time is not merely precious—it is the very essence of gold itself!'""

3055379044.m_KeyValue: ""A ray of sunlight broke through the clouds and mist, enveloping Van Helsing in a golden glow. In this moment, he stood as the veritable incarnation of wisdom and strategy.""

3055379045.m_KeyValue: ""'Begins now!' The words had barely left his mouth before Goldland took off like a shot, his boisterous laughter echoing behind him. 'Ha ha ha ha! Van Helsing, stop them!'""

3055379046.m_KeyValue: ""The thin mist was dispersed by the gust of wind from the figure's movement, revealing none other than Goldland himself. 'Cain, I never expected you to uncover Lord Goldland's secret.'""

3055379047.m_KeyValue: "Noah felt a chill down his spine. He and Ami had once profited from selling overpriced seafood to Friedrich... Could this be the real reason the Church was targeting him?"

3055379048.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah... It's all coming back to me now. Those grueling days, huddled together on that rickety little boat... How could I have strayed so far from my original purpose?'""

3055379049.m_KeyValue: ""This realization flashed through Van Helsing's mind like lightning. In the very next heartbeat, he sprang into action, lunging forward and wrapping his arms around Noah's waist, forcefully yanking him backward!""

3055381212.m_KeyValue: ""Tris clapped her hands and said with a smile, 'Now, now, it's just a friendly match. Let's not spoil the mood. After all, we might not see each other again after this, right?'""

3055381213.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, of course it's...' Empousa suddenly realized something. 'Ah!'""

3055381218.m_KeyValue: ""'Tris, former commander of the Church choir.' Tris gave a slight nod. 'So, young ladies of Bathory, I assume you're also here for 'that thing'?'""

3055381219.m_KeyValue: ""'Going by their aura, they must be from the Bathory family.' The golden-haired woman turned to Acappella. 'Acappella, you sensed it too, didn't you?'""

3055381220.m_KeyValue: "'Ugh... why do we have to go to some backwater fishing village...' Empousa muttered under her breath. 'And with Lamia of all people—'"

3055381222.m_KeyValue: "'Then... let's say you can only touch the ball three times after it reaches your court.' Tris held up three fingers. 'Touch it a fourth time and you lose the point.'"

3055381223.m_KeyValue: "'Ah...!' Empousa finally realized. 'Then the force keeping the sand from falling in is...'"

3055381224.m_KeyValue: "Tris set up the fishing net vertically. 'This net will serve as the boundary between our two teams.'"

3055381225.m_KeyValue: "'Appreciate it?' Empousa's brow furrowed. 'The Bathory family needs no charity from the Church!'"

3055384354.m_KeyValue: ""Noah hesitated, then sighed. 'I just wanted to watch the sea, not take a dip in it.'""

3055384355.m_KeyValue: ""Noah gave him a long, bewildered stare, as if unsure whether he heard Agares correctly.""

3055384357.m_KeyValue: ""'The sea isn't all allure. It's not just the pale blue you see from here—the depths are black like tar, thick enough to drown out the loudest screams.'""

3055384358.m_KeyValue: "Augustine thought for a moment. 'Did you enjoy yourselves today?'"

3055386526.m_KeyValue: ""'...Hmm?' Empousa lifted her head, and right at that moment, the seabird lowered its beak and pecked her nose tip with a light tap.""

3055386527.m_KeyValue: ""Back at the small wooden cabin where Tris was staying, Acappella curiously asked her, 'Commander, are you sure it's alright to let them have that debt note?'""

3055386530.m_KeyValue: ""'Stop spacing out, you dummy Empousa... the ball's falling!' Lamia anxiously watched the fish-skin ball plummeting from above. 'Servants, intercept that ball!'""

3055386531.m_KeyValue: ""Finally giving up her struggle, Acappella shrugged helplessly. 'Commander, I'm completely powerless here. It's all up to you now!'""

3055386532.m_KeyValue: "—Could all of this have been within Tris's calculations?"

3055386533.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa and Lamia stood motionless, at a loss for words—they finally realized they had been led by the nose from the very beginning...""

3055386535.m_KeyValue: ""'Take this! One! Strike! Victory!' High in the air, Lamia swung her leg in a full arc and kicked with tremendous force, sending the fish-skin ball rocketing toward the opposite court like a cannon shot, creating sonic booms in its wake.""

3055386536.m_KeyValue: "'You!' Empousa stomped her foot in anger. 'The Church is full of condescending bastards! What's so special about the Covenant?! Go ahead and use it—'"

3055386537.m_KeyValue: ""The ball landed on the vine netting, sinking down in a deep arc, losing all its speed just as it was about to touch the ground, then bouncing back up high after a brief moment—""

3055609379.m_KeyValue: ""Corresponding with you has sparked a rare interest in me, but I must attend to my experiments now. Let's continue this discussion another time.""

3055609384.m_KeyValue: "So you believe humans are foolish and gods are powerless?"

3055609385.m_KeyValue: ""Therefore, god is not an inherent existence, but a human creation.""

3058280475.m_KeyValue: ""I truly don't know who you are, or what you want me to return. But let me make one thing clear...""

3058280477.m_KeyValue: ""From my observations, you have occasionally interacted with 'people' that I can't see. But these interactions seemed to be genuine.""

3058280478.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, are you sure we're going the right way?""

3058280501.m_KeyValue: ""However, I have a strong feeling that the sealed Calamity is very close to us.""

3058280504.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body on this island can awaken memories that I can't remember?"

3058280505.m_KeyValue: ""I remember my family's duty... I've learned so much from the Church's teachers... I've grown up, I'm no longer that timid child who cried at everything, and yet...""

3058280506.m_KeyValue: ""...That's not what I meant to discuss with you... I just thought, rather than being sad about the lonely past...""

3058280507.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we've been through a lot together. They're all precious companions to me now.""

3058280508.m_KeyValue: "I don't remember who I am or where I'm from. At first... I wasn't even sure if I wanted to find the answers."

3058280509.m_KeyValue: "Why are you... suddenly asking me about that? What did the people you saw say to you?"

3058897849.m_KeyValue: ""You don't look like someone without ambition. In fact, from where I'm standing, they look like they're about to burst into flames.""

3058897850.m_KeyValue: ""In order to revive the Bathory family, you shall directly influence the success of the Moonfall.""

3058897851.m_KeyValue: ""You're definitely overthinking it, but that's what sets you apart from the rest of us.""

3058897852.m_KeyValue: "It's yours by right. This key was always meant for worthy vessels. Consider it a reward for pleasantly surprising this old man."

3058897881.m_KeyValue: "Can you tell me? I want to call you by your name."

3058897882.m_KeyValue: ""In fact, quite the opposite. The Astrolabe apparatus and the 'Prophecy Cards' are all of my creation.""

3058897883.m_KeyValue: "The reversed 'Lovers' implies you'll soon face new choices. The moment to choose between your emotions and your dreams may not be far off."

3058898145.m_KeyValue: "How long will these days continue? Perhaps until we're all dead...?"

3058898146.m_KeyValue: ""The moon is in the sky, and nobody has ever seen its far side. I can't understand people who believe there's a 'homeland' there...""

3058898147.m_KeyValue: ""You actually remember everyone, don't you? Their numbers, their fates, everything.""

3058898148.m_KeyValue: ""The path is clear now. Let's go, we need to save our strength for whatever lies ahead.""

3058898180.m_KeyValue: "Let's put that aside for now. What's intriguing is the direction she and the others are pointing at—"

3058898211.m_KeyValue: "There's also the possibility that the past we can't remember simply doesn't exist."

3058898212.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe it wants us to follow it. After all, it doesn't seem to be the owner of the second card.""

3058898241.m_KeyValue: ""Great! Friendship really is the most precious treasure, huh?""

3058898242.m_KeyValue: "Are you two arguing or bonding? Is this what they call 'friendship'? Or... or 'love'?"

3058898246.m_KeyValue: ""Bella has always thought of herself as human, you know.""

3058898248.m_KeyValue: "Bargain my foot! That's way too many zeros! Where would we even get that kind of money?"

3058898277.m_KeyValue: ""The far side of the moon could just be a lie they told us. Even if we somehow escaped, we might just end up in an even bigger cage.""

3058898278.m_KeyValue: "Are these... stone statues from the castle?"

3058898311.m_KeyValue: ""79, get out of the way! Didn't we agree not to do this?""

3058898312.m_KeyValue: "Companion? What a nostalgic yet unpleasant word."

3058898341.m_KeyValue: "Why are you so happy about it?"

3058898343.m_KeyValue: ""Vessels without masters, welcome to your trial.""

3059516817.m_KeyValue: "Not necessarily—there may still be other survivors out there besides us."

3059516819.m_KeyValue: "Do you even need to ask? Of course she'll bring us. Any shot at turning the tide is worth the risk..."

3059794018.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... I don't have enough strength left..."

3061466910.m_KeyValue: ""Not quite. After all, this isn't your first time falling off a cliff, is it? Though it'll hurt.""

3061466911.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, Aunt Mary found you quickly and immediately went to get Aiona.""

3061466914.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, a week from now, you'll face a battle.""

3061466915.m_KeyValue: "So soon... Will it be a battle I'm destined to lose?"

3061466916.m_KeyValue: ""No, you won. But your triumph turned to tragedy when you fell from a cliff after your victory.""

3061466917.m_KeyValue: "Is this where my life comes to an end?"

3061466920.m_KeyValue: "That would be a future even I cannot predict."

3061466921.m_KeyValue: ""In that case, let's start with something small.""

3066792961.m_KeyValue: "You are the one who should be thanked for discovering a talent like Acappella."

3066792962.m_KeyValue: ""So today, you are not just a guest invited by a Bell Ringer. It's also a gesture of gratitude, from the choir and the Church, to you.""

3066792963.m_KeyValue: ""The Silver Blood keeps me from aging, while some of them have already entered their later years. Yet in my eyes, they are still children—in need of my care.""

3066792964.m_KeyValue: ""Then came Darcias, Acappella, and others. Decades have passed. Now, over forty children call this place home.""

3066792965.m_KeyValue: "I've indeed never met a Bell Ringer like you—one who adopts orphans and even welcomes a Bloodborn into the Church."

3066792966.m_KeyValue: ""Being a Bell Ringer is my divine duty, but the choir... it's my haven in this cruel world.""

3066792971.m_KeyValue: "Actually... this was another reason I invited you here."

3066792972.m_KeyValue: "You seem to take particular notice of Acappella."

3067871393.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, can you promise me something? When this is all over, will you come with me to lay lots of Wolfsbane on Father's grave?""

3068212946.m_KeyValue: ""That girl's forever dreaming of winning in the games, as you once did. She has not grasped how merciless they truly are.""

3070957930.m_KeyValue: ""And this time, rose again with Dracula's blood. Wings born from flame.""

3077017694.m_KeyValue:
""Left at the inn, this seems to be the final page of her ledger:

'At last, I found Master Van Helsing, and Silver-haired's companion was safely rescued. Everything seems to have reached a perfect conclusion—even my debts have been cleared thanks to someone's help. Bella, whom I just met, gave me a beautiful seashell bracelet right away. She's the second kindest person to me in Sapphire Isle after Silver-haired! Today I've finally paid off all my debts and even have some extra income. But... if I save up another 200 or 300 million Soli, could I help Bella get a new body to stand again? Yet, as Master Van Helsing said, many things are priceless...'""

3077017787.m_KeyValue:
""In Bella's secret spot, I also found a notebook.

Inside, Bella had documented her studies of the ocean's tidal patterns, the moon's waxing and waning cycles, and the daily routines of life in Sapphire Isle... After uncovering all these patterns, Bella left her own assessment—dull.

It seems she expended every effort to understand this world, determined to uncover all its secrets.""

3077017818.m_KeyValue:
""From her most recent letter, Aiona's mood seems lighter. Her memories now hold clearer glimpses of her companions, no longer is she swallowed by the void. And yet, the sorrow of countless farewells still lingers. I find myself quietly troubled.

But just last night, I saw her in the castle greenhouse, tending to the Wolfsbane with Empousa and Hati at her side.

I had underestimated her. She has reclaimed what she once cast away. The shadows of yesterday can no longer slow her steps toward tomorrow.

Trusting she will not be burdened by her family's past, I placed the ceremonial relic of the Alitas within her chamber.""

3077017853.m_KeyValue:
""The vision vanished without warning. In desperation, I drenched the Siren's Tear in every kind of liquor I had—At last, another glimpse.

Behind the prison bars, a masked guard slipped the maiden an envelope, saying: _$$From the Mysterious Merchant._$$

Could it be from her friend? Could that all-purpose Merchant truly deliver letters even into the depths of Hallon's prison?

For a moment, hope bloomed in her chest—

No. It was a command from the Master. A cruel snare, meant to make her a puppet. To force a choice between betraying her family or her friends. Throw it away. Tear it up.

But I could only stand outside the Siren's Tear, watching helplessly as it all unfolded.""

3077017911.m_KeyValue:
""Through the name _$$Quinn,_$$ I swiftly traced a young woman in the family records—one who walked these halls three centuries past: Quinn Baphomet.

Curiously, her name was scratched out. No connections to the bloodline. Just a warning scrawled beside it in red: Traitor. Condemned for kinslaying and betraying the clan. A final decree remained: should her whereabouts surface, capture and execute without mercy.

A killer of her own blood. No wonder she never dared set foot near the castle.

Yet here she lurks, watching from the shadows with patient eyes...

But if she wants to approach the castle, I can use that to my advantage. Lure her in. Flush her out.""

3077018008.m_KeyValue:
""Soon three packages arrived from Agnes, delivered with the same breathless urgency that defines her nature.

Package One: Several sketches with chaotic handwriting yet remarkable spatial intuition.
<style=""Highlight"">Undoubtedly Agnes's handiwork, sent as cartographic reference material.</style>Package Two: A survey manual marking locations such as the Underground Sepulcher, where blood servants gather; the Ancestral Vault, where primordial Bloodborn lie in slumber; and the Alchemical Tower, where copies are forged.
<style=""Highlight"">Why is it that all these places are so eerie and ominous?</style>

Package Three: A parcel marked 'cartographic instruments.' Upon opening, it contained nothing but a stack of well-worn storybooks.
<style=""Highlight"">Surely the wrong package?</style>

Despite the ominous survey locations and the lack of proper tools, I relied on Agnes's drawings to complete the mapping task. With that, the survey should reach its conclusion.""

3077018066.m_KeyValue:
""I made arrangements with Valora to collect the saddle.

The Bathory had awakened several elders from the Ancestral Vault, and Valora was among them.

Our previous letter marked my first communication with her. Before our meeting, perhaps I should learn more about her.

From the Cartographer's survey notes, I discovered that she had been gravely wounded in a bitter battle.

Strangely, however, despite her standing as both general and knight of the Bathory, the family's records concerning her remain frustratingly vague. I have combed through every chronicle, yet cannot piece together an idea about her. Even the crucial reason for her slumber remains shrouded in mystery, leaving only the words 'gravely wounded.'

When I asked Cain, he merely smiled and offered nothing.""

3077788336.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel eagerly crossed her fingers like a child: 'Quick, make a wish! Even though I'm the last of the Aegis line, I still hope there's a chance for our family to be reborn!'""

3077788339.m_KeyValue: ""'Actually, many ancient texts warn that shooting stars bring disaster!' Empousa declared with merciless glee!""

3077788341.m_KeyValue: ""'I'm going to search for that falling star we just witnessed! Who knows, I might be able to forge something extraordinary from it.'""

3080117487.m_KeyValue: ""Feuler delivered the last letter, panting heavily.""

3081291668.m_KeyValue: ""I think I believe it now—when hearts truly connect, even language becomes unnecessary.""

3081291670.m_KeyValue: "Empousa... our Empousa—the one we lost. She used to..."

3081291671.m_KeyValue: "She always had a 'friend' just like you. And she'd always respond when it beeped—just like this."

3081291673.m_KeyValue: "I think I'm finally starting to understand you."

3081291675.m_KeyValue: ""'Stella, run'... That's what you're trying to say, right?""

3081291682.m_KeyValue: ""I can even understand the Formless now... It wants to eliminate me, doesn't it?""

3081291683.m_KeyValue: "I'll draw it away. You go the other way—or stay hidden until it's safe."

3081294868.m_KeyValue: "This started because of me—maybe all of it started with me."

3081294869.m_KeyValue: "That's why. Because we're companions... I can't lose you..."

3081294870.m_KeyValue: ""What are you talking about?! We're companions now, aren't we?""

3081294871.m_KeyValue: "Like I said—you're just an outsider who got dragged into this."

3081294872.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? You're going in alone?"

3081294873.m_KeyValue: "Find Ami and the others. I'll hold them off."

3081294874.m_KeyValue: "This isn't working! We can't keep waiting for your friends. We need another way out—now!"

3081294875.m_KeyValue: ""Tch... These pests hit like hammers, and they just keep coming!""

3081294882.m_KeyValue: "And that's exactly why we're here—to fight them with you!"

3081294883.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how far I run, they follow... like shadows I can't shake.""

3081299228.m_KeyValue: "I'm adrift in an ocean of the unknown."

3081299229.m_KeyValue: "Shh—keep your voice down. This place... I've never seen anything like it."

3081299231.m_KeyValue: "You don't know? It was that Bell Ringer..."

3081300380.m_KeyValue: "Stella? Come here! It's fine—these people are friends."

3081300381.m_KeyValue: "She's far too trusting for her own good."

3081300382.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, if you mean her—she's right over there.""

3081300385.m_KeyValue: "At least they haven't seen me yet. I just need to reach Regina—but I can't be spotted..."

3081300386.m_KeyValue: "Wait—a dirigible?! No wonder I couldn't hear any waves... We're in the sky!"

3081300387.m_KeyValue: ""Captain Ami, we picked up four signals. One was this young lady, and two we couldn't reach in time... So where's the fourth?""

3081312503.m_KeyValue: "P. DMG Taken -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

3083631410.m_KeyValue: "I fear we may be acting with undue haste."

3083634345.m_KeyValue: ""Not happening! If you've got a problem, then fight me!""

3083636523.m_KeyValue: "Might I suggest we give this matter further consideration?"

3083638437.m_KeyValue: ""Once, I would have agreed without hesitation...""

3083638440.m_KeyValue: "But now... the decisions before us are far more nuanced."

3083640615.m_KeyValue: "Let the river of fate carve its own path."

3083715802.m_KeyValue: "Oh no... Seems I'm not dead yet..."

3083715834.m_KeyValue: "I hope there's still some meat on the belly when we get there..."

3083715837.m_KeyValue: ""Don't rely on the Tarot. Love this world, feel this world, that's a power greater than it...""

3083715838.m_KeyValue: ""Afraid that you're the so-called harbinger of disaster, afraid that your fate is controlled by some mysterious force, afraid that you can't actually change anything.""

3083715866.m_KeyValue: ""You want to be a hero? You're a cat! You couldn't even save your fellow cats, and now you want to save humans?""

3083715868.m_KeyValue: "Your limbs have gone limp. You think you're talking to me? This is just your last hallucination before death."

3083715869.m_KeyValue: ""If you think I can't do it, then just watch me fail. Why waste words?""

3083715871.m_KeyValue: "Someone's swimming toward us... is that Jacintha? It really is her!"

3083715872.m_KeyValue: ""You only have one chance, seize it, kitty!""

3083715873.m_KeyValue: ""The hero has saved the world! The warrior has slain the dragon! Now, there's just one tiny, itsy-bitsy problem—how will someone so terrified of water make it back to land?""

3085397691.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? There's a note under the carpet."

3089832979.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Hati. Sir Gadric must have his reasons... Anyway, let's get out of here first, then we can talk.""

3089832981.m_KeyValue: "His blood is black... Have you been in contact with the infected?!"

3089832982.m_KeyValue: "He's your father's friend and a Knight of the Church. His oath constrains his position. He must be troubled by this too."

3089832983.m_KeyValue: "The 'Black Blood' is a carrier of chaotic merged memories. The invasion and overwriting of memories don't discriminate when choosing a host."

3089832984.m_KeyValue: "I never thought the Black Blood... would take effect so quickly..."

3089833013.m_KeyValue: ""She keeps calling us stupid, and you're taking her side?""

3089833014.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, you stupid wolf! Don't get so close! Aren't you afraid of getting infected?""

3089833015.m_KeyValue: ""He probably wanted to give Hati his last bunch of Wolfsbane... Clive, keep it for her for now.""

3089833016.m_KeyValue: ""But you returned to your homeland, and you were with us until the very end. Your life was anything but empty.""

3089833044.m_KeyValue: ""Clive mentioned it, but I still don't fully understand...""

3089833050.m_KeyValue: ""That's just like you... Well, let's head back to the Church and make our report.""

3090534688.m_KeyValue: "Though only fragments remain... I can sense the longing hidden within them."

3093018456.m_KeyValue: "Jestel... you should leave it to us this time."

3093018588.m_KeyValue: ""So, as I said, it's all because of this loudmouth redhead, causing us unnecessary trouble!""

3093018623.m_KeyValue: ""What a blunder, I was so engrossed in talking to Lady Empousa that I didn't notice—!""

3093018689.m_KeyValue: ""Don't let your guard down, the bats are still swarming in!""

3093018786.m_KeyValue: "But I'm curious to see if the rumors about the silver-haired Noah Nevernight are true."

3093810085.m_KeyValue: "Twin Peaks? How can you possibly know she's there?"

3094082834.m_KeyValue: "It's a private matter. Come with me."

3094082835.m_KeyValue: "So Yakov told me all this on purpose… So that I'll help find the other fragments."

3094082836.m_KeyValue: "Oh my! Yakov can practically smell the sweet scent of romance in the air!"

3095969482.m_KeyValue: "Many have fallen before me. You won't be the exception."

3095969513.m_KeyValue: ""Spare me the riddles. If you have something to say, say it.""

3095971687.m_KeyValue: ""Oh my, this is too... Can I really have it?""

3095972522.m_KeyValue: "You thought this junk would impress me?"

3095972615.m_KeyValue: "Will I ever meet any interesting Vassals?"

3095972681.m_KeyValue: "So this is the new Vassal candidate? Would anyone mind if I break them?"

3095974696.m_KeyValue: "Useless for combat... but I'll keep it. Thanks."

3097276770.m_KeyValue: "See? You can handle it after all."

""The moon has two faces:
One born of darkness, and the other shining with radiant light.""

3097415245.m_KeyValue:
""Cid once said that humans are composed of a myriad of contradictory emotions.
Self-destruction was the inherent nature of all living beings. It was _$$we_$$ who were incomplete creations.""

3097415275.m_KeyValue:
""They had never aspired to become gods.
Blasphemy or ridicule was enough.""

3097415307.m_KeyValue: ""If anything could motivate me to live, it would be _$$her._$$""

3097415308.m_KeyValue: "My focus on her was purely coincidental."

3097415338.m_KeyValue: ""Under the somber moonlight, I collapsed before a puppet-like figure.""

3097415341.m_KeyValue: ""On the night the world abandoned me, I too had abandoned it in kind.""

3097415374.m_KeyValue: "Nor do I wish to live on in vain."

3097415407.m_KeyValue:
""The light fragmented through the window lattice and shimmered onto the mirror, resembling a sparkling lake.
I've seen lakes glisten under the sun's rays, but only from afar, through thick latticework...
Those shimmering sparkles felt like flaming arrows, igniting my my flesh as they pierced through the window.""

3097415408.m_KeyValue:
""_$$I lie in the inferno, trading life for death._$$
_$$Alas, my name shall be whispered by the gods._$$""

3097415439.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Even without a pilgrim soul, one can still return home through death._$$""

3097415440.m_KeyValue:
""The emptiness returns... and the wounds on my body throb with pain once more.
They were left by the prey I nearly drained, not long ago.""

3097734906.m_KeyValue: ""Ah yes. Had you not spoken, I might have forgotten entirely.""

3097734912.m_KeyValue: ""Enough pretense… (coughing) I could believe the Silver Cross would slaughter us all to halt the plague, but I never imagined…""

3098057352.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Inventory
<style=""InfoText"">This is where your items are stored.
• Consumables: Under this tab, you'll find all consumables you own. You can view information about these consumables at any time and use them to strengthen your Lineup.
• Materials: Under this tab, you'll find all materials you own. You can view information and quantities of these materials at any time, but they can only be used in their respective systems.
• Equipment: Under this tab, you'll find all Equipment you own. You can view information about this Equipment at any time, and you can fortify or dismantle it.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Fortification
<style=""InfoText"">There are 4 types of Equipment Fortification:
• Enhancement: Use Soli and Smelting Ore to Enhance Equipment.
1-Enhancing Equipment grants attribute improvements.
2-Other items besides Smelting Ore can also be used for enhancement.
• Echo: Faction Equipment that has reached Tier9 Rarity, LV.5 Enhancement, and is currently equipped can use Soulstrike to perform Echo.
1-Echoed Equipment grants significant improvements, while unlocking both Reforge and Refining.
2-Echoed Equipment cannot be unequipped.
• Reforge: Use Soulstrike to Reforge the Echo Blessing on Equipment.
1-Reforging will randomly modify the type of Echo Blessings.
2-Blessings may strengthen or weaken after reforging Equipment. Use with caution.
• Refining: Use Soulstrike to Refine the Echo Blessing on Equipment.
1-Refining will randomly modify the value of Echo Blessings without changing their types.
2-You can lock individual Echo Blessings. Locked Blessings won't change their value, but the cost of Refining increases, consuming more Soulstrike.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Dismantling
<style=""InfoText"">You can Dismantle Equipment you don't need into Smelting Ore.
• When dismantling, the enhancement level of your selected Equipment will be calculated into Smelting Ore.""

3103684437.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. Though Black Blood failed to fully corrupt their mind, it also failed to grant them a powerful body. Bearing the blood of the Astolfo sages, killing is their sole meaning of existence.""

3103684445.m_KeyValue: ""Elite Knights who guard Sunset Isle. Unfortunately they have already began to crystallize. However, they hold fast to their posts, carrying out the orders of the Church in the last moments of their lives.""

3103684446.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us wisdom to endure the winter nights.'""

3103684447.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us grace to dwell alongside all living things.'""

3103684448.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. The Black Blood has twisted their flesh, leaving a thin, bat-like tail as a grim reminder.""

3103684449.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. Corrupted by Black Blood, their pale form barely recalls the past. Devoid of thought, they fight on—for blood, for their masters.""

3103684450.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn, their form warped by Black Blood. Devoid of thought, they stand guard with the only mercy from their masters—a beast-bone shield.""

3103684451.m_KeyValue: ""A human transformed by the Embrace of the Bloodborn. Body twisted, mind consumed by blood and flesh. Devoid of thought, their master's commands are everything—except, perhaps, the bone stiletto in their hand.""

3103684452.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. This Blood Beast forsakes their old form to submit to Black Blood. The glory of the Astolfo family is their sole anchor to sanity, driving them forward, even toward death.""

3103684503.m_KeyValue: ""The Full Moon burns the Black Blood within their bodies, muscles swelling like lava bursting from rock. They bite at their own flesh, seeking only to end the agony of being consumed by Black Blood.""

3103684510.m_KeyValue: ""A peasant residing in Mouret. Invaders turned him into a raging monster, and the blood-covered scythe in hand is a testament to his brutality.""

3103684513.m_KeyValue: ""A shadow crouched in the cave's depths, using twisted claws to dig out underground springs. After pushing the last half-bowl of water to a child, it sank completely into the abyss.""

3103684514.m_KeyValue: ""Their claws rake against the stone walls, the protective amulet from home hanging around the neck. Festering flesh weeps Black Blood, and in the eyes lingers a desperate glimmer of pleading.""

3103684515.m_KeyValue: "A hunter residing in Mouret. Their archery skills retain deadly precision against the invaders."

3103684516.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer from Mouret, who even without any proper weapon, still grips a pitchfork with unwavering resolve, sworn to defend this land until the final breath.""

3103684533.m_KeyValue: ""The current Gravekeeper of the Ganelon lineage, he lost his sanity and underwent mutation due to the spread of the Black Blood. He awaits in silence for the designated one's arrival.""

3103684534.m_KeyValue: ""The eldest of the Bathory family, and armor to the arrogant and cruel Bloodborn. Despite his proud demeanor, he isn't immune to the ravages of time.""

3103684541.m_KeyValue: "The Heretic Hunters of the Church who stare death in the face. They know well that even their baptism before the crusade could not change their inevitable fate. Their chainmail clangs like a bell rung at their own funeral."

3103684542.m_KeyValue: ""The Heretic Hunters of the Church who stare death in the face. They know well that even their baptism before the crusade could not change their inevitable fate. Their choice is both a solemn vow, and a final tribute to their faith.""

3103684543.m_KeyValue: ""Byproduct of Baphomet's flesh intercision experiments, carrying the remnants of his victims' Spirits. They dutifully execute their order to guard the prisoners.""
