3106775724.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, could you help me with something?""

3106830283.m_KeyValue: "So you want to finish our fight from Sunset Isle."

3106830284.m_KeyValue: "Won't even live to see it sprout."

3106830286.m_KeyValue: "Then follow me... and bear witness to the end."

3106830287.m_KeyValue: ""As promised—you are free to return. From this day forward, no chains, no commands. You are your own.""

3106831312.m_KeyValue: "He looked like nothing but a pampered noble who inherited his title. Why would I be afraid of him?"

3106847466.m_KeyValue: ""I rushed to the Carrelle's forbidden grounds, only to witness slaves facing death with unwavering resolve—what exactly is Genevieve's method to break the deadlock?""

3108253211.m_KeyValue: "Why not use her desire to visit the castle and lure her into the open?"

3108358970.m_KeyValue: ""The memory of such cowardice haunts me. I lie awake, restless with shame.""

3108875604.m_KeyValue: ""Sharp, desperate knocks echoed through the wall—Genevieve's signal.""

3108875607.m_KeyValue: "Why are you cutting your own wrist? Are you punishing yourself—willingly?"

3108875608.m_KeyValue: ""...You still haven't answered me, Noah. If I disappear, would you remember me?""

3108875609.m_KeyValue: "The drawer... why is it open? A map of the prison… I knew it. You still mean to escape."

3110027711.m_KeyValue: ""It‘s more likely that, for some reason, they can’t show themselves.""

3110061472.m_KeyValue: ""Without her, I probably wouldn't have had the resolve to win that duel.""

3110167259.m_KeyValue: "Save the wit for the day we're free. Fanny could summon me at any moment. Describe those three informants quickly."

3110167260.m_KeyValue: ""No need—I'm here. What is it, my favorite prisoner?""

3110167261.m_KeyValue: ""Despair, most likely. When hope dies, so does the will to fight. What remains is waiting for... death.""

3110167262.m_KeyValue: ""I was only wondering—if you've suspected me all along, why share so much?""

3110277033.m_KeyValue: "It was precisely because I had complete faith in you that I worked with Lady Empousa to save you back then."

3110277034.m_KeyValue: ""If Noah's plan is right, then this must be the most suspicious spot…""

3110277035.m_KeyValue: ""What preparations are needed to make this 'token'? Please, let me help.""

3110277036.m_KeyValue: "I was thinking the same thing. Thoreau hinted that whoever becomes the Eighth Sage the day after tomorrow will gain access to those slaves."

3110277037.m_KeyValue: "These slaves have already transformed… and these aquatic features… could it be…"

3110277038.m_KeyValue: "We'll leave that for Isaac to deal with."

3110277065.m_KeyValue: "Their words? Whose words? I can't recall..."

3110277069.m_KeyValue: "What's happening? What's with all the commotion?"

3110277092.m_KeyValue: "Only by becoming the Eighth Sage... can I bring this to an end."

3110277097.m_KeyValue: ""Are you saying that Mr. Roland, and all the guards of House Roland behind him, are frauds I conjured up as well?""

3110277098.m_KeyValue: ""That's enough, Michel. Ours is not a house that boasts through borrowed honor.""

3110277101.m_KeyValue: ""Those too foolish wouldn't survive to see the plan's end, while those too clever—like you, would never stop asking questions...""

3110277102.m_KeyValue: "You could call it... a peculiar interest of mine."

3110277103.m_KeyValue: "Attendants of Miss Ami slew the siren! Slew the Mistbound Terror!"

3111737937.m_KeyValue: ""Once you've made your home there, I shall visit from time to time.""

3111737938.m_KeyValue: ""Though we dream, I recall what transpired. These memories... they are real.""

3111737943.m_KeyValue: ""The soldiers came to tax their grain and gold, so the villagers raised their pitchforks, to defend all that they had...""

3112069165.m_KeyValue: "To align oneself with the currents of fate is the truest path."

3112075699.m_KeyValue: "This should be the right course of action... um... right? I'm... not sure..."

3112076722.m_KeyValue: "I feel something calling from the depths of my memories..."

3112585347.m_KeyValue: "But you can choose to wield that power to defy fate."

3112585348.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, he doesn't press his advantage with a second strike.""

3114607982.m_KeyValue: "No fair! The Commander's stronger than any of them! If only we weren't so useless..."

3114607985.m_KeyValue: "You've done well. I'm the one who failed—I underestimated the bond between them. Leave the rest to me. This is my duty... as your Commander."

3114607986.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Acappella. I've always seen you as a child… But I won't be there to watch you grow.""

3114607987.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Darcias. You've stayed by my side longer than anyone. Just this once... let me be selfish.""

3114607988.m_KeyValue: "There are only two things in this world that can counter a Calamity..."

3114607991.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body... And the Silver Blood of a Bell Ringer."

3114609007.m_KeyValue: ""She fulfilled her duty as a Gravekeeper. She gave her life to deny the enemy escape. Just as I once did, sixty-six years ago.""

3114609009.m_KeyValue: ""I'm nothing more than a longing now. Sunset Isle is no more... and soon, so will I.""

3114609010.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Darcias and I... We've been through so much together, and I never got the chance to tell you everything...""

3114609011.m_KeyValue: ""I'm glad you never strayed from the path you chose, Acappella. It's been a joy watching over you, helping you grow...""

3114609012.m_KeyValue: "Do you remember the first song you wrote for me? I wove it into the most beautiful sheet music."

3114609014.m_KeyValue: "Sing it for me... It's the last gift I prepared for you."

3114617718.m_KeyValue: ""Wow! You scared them off just like that! Ressa, you're amazing!""

3114617719.m_KeyValue: ""I'm all grown up now, but when I was your age, I wasn't half as brave as you are.""

3114617720.m_KeyValue: ""When I grow up, will I be as strong as you?""

3114618870.m_KeyValue: "I wonder if the ritual went well... It's rare to see Ressa this serious."

3114618871.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Ressa... For staying with me—until I finally found them.""

3114618873.m_KeyValue: "I understand! I won't cry. If Mother and Father knew I'd left tears in the Mourning Hollow... it would only bring them more pain."

3114618874.m_KeyValue: "Why all the sneaking? Don't tell me you two were trying to spy on the ritual?"

3114618875.m_KeyValue: "Re- I mean Dr. Ressa! Have you completed the ritual?"

3114618876.m_KeyValue: "This is getting serious. Should we sneak a peek?"

3114618877.m_KeyValue: "You mean Dr. Ressa! Though you're right... even Piera looks troubled."

3114622066.m_KeyValue: ""She asked me not to tell anyone, but... she left the island days ago.""

3114622067.m_KeyValue: "His body's begun to mutate... We can't hold out like this. I must leave the island and find help."

3114622070.m_KeyValue: "Sora... Sora's becoming less and less human!"

3114622072.m_KeyValue: "These recipes still can't hold back the Black Blood..."

3114622073.m_KeyValue: "Does Piera know? We haven't seen her for days."

3114622075.m_KeyValue: "That scared the life out of me... I thought I was done for..."

3114622076.m_KeyValue: ""Jason, why did you come here alone? I told you to stay and watch over Sora.""

3114622077.m_KeyValue: "That's why I came to find you..."

3114623223.m_KeyValue: "And take my place as Bell Ringer No. X."

3114623224.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella's musical gift is beyond question. In time, she'll succeed me...""

3114623226.m_KeyValue: "To shape seven voices into a chorus of battle—only our Commander could do that!"

3114623228.m_KeyValue: "No need to worry. I have a way. Covenant."

3114623229.m_KeyValue: "ARGHHH—! I should have pressed her for clearer directions back then!"

3114624244.m_KeyValue: "But now I'm not quite sure who you really are."

3114624245.m_KeyValue: ""You are _$$Death_$$ itself, sealed upon this island, yet known to the longings as the god who guides them to the Other Side...""

3114624246.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I can no longer sense their echoes.""

3114624247.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, those intruders in white couldn't interfere. I knew I could trust you, Ressa.""

3114624248.m_KeyValue: ""Things were different back then… Anyway, I've got a few scores of my own to settle with them.""

3114624249.m_KeyValue: ""Eleanor, her parents, and the others have safely crossed to the Other Side, where new lives now await them.""

3114624250.m_KeyValue: "Yet I remain uncertain about who you are..."

3116105794.m_KeyValue: "I'm not sure I follow... Can't the Church provide it?"

3116177792.m_KeyValue: "If you found a pearl buried in the sand… what would you do with it?"

3116796228.m_KeyValue: "They are both scars etched in my memory and proof of how far I've come..."

3117479746.m_KeyValue: "When are we finally going to get out of this hellhole..."

3117745143.m_KeyValue: ""Then be sure you can satisfy me when the time comes. Or else, I'll make you pay.""

3117745148.m_KeyValue: "Then you'd have to flee with me into the shadows."

3117745151.m_KeyValue: ""They couldn't find anything to incriminate me, so some pulled back.""

3117745153.m_KeyValue: ""The moment they discover I'm still in contact with you, they'll have all the justification they need to strip away my position as Warden.""

3117745154.m_KeyValue: "But if that happens... wouldn't we be able to stay together forever?"

3120235158.m_KeyValue: "What?! This oaf was from the Church too? And not just any grunt—he held a major rank!?"

3120235159.m_KeyValue: ""By the time I joined the Silver Cross, that rank was already vacant. But there were many rumors about where Robert, the former Eighth, had disappeared to.""

3120235160.m_KeyValue: ""Who would have thought—the man who once despised the sea would become a sailor, and even rise to First Mate of the El Dorado, the very ship he was once tasked to investigate!""

3120235161.m_KeyValue: ""I won't explain anything—because as I said, you are not yet capable of understanding.""

3120235162.m_KeyValue: ""Among all the Silver Cross throughout history, you were the brightest. You were too skilled at finding the 'truth,' which made you firmly believe that 'truth' is absolute law.""

3120235163.m_KeyValue: ""Only a fool like me, left behind by truth itself, could see the true darkness behind it.""

3120235164.m_KeyValue: ""Those who hold a rank in the Silver Cross are all masters of Future Artifacts. Even long after retirement, they far surpass ordinary men—he is no common opponent.""

3120235165.m_KeyValue: ""Come forth, truth hunter, witch, and Bloodborn... The Silver Cross Hunter you see before you no longer fights for so-called truth.""

3120235166.m_KeyValue: ""I am Bob, First Mate of the El Dorado! I fight for my people!""

3120249306.m_KeyValue: ""According to Joe, Jones did briefly leave his post—but that was before the bell rang.""

3120249307.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? Why couldn't it have been Jones? Didn't he leave his post earlier?"

3120249310.m_KeyValue: "Exactly! Are you covering for one of your own!?"

3120249311.m_KeyValue: "But you also said former captain Jones had the opportunity to enter the guest cabin. Why couldn't it have been him?"

3120249312.m_KeyValue: "How ironic. The only one thinking along the right lines... is you—my Heretic enemy."

3120249314.m_KeyValue: ""As I said, my deduction is based on the premise that Aaron was strangled here in this guest room. It's what brings us closest to the truth.""

3120249315.m_KeyValue: ""So... you did it?! Little Ami! I'll... Wait, what? You're saying Ami did it?""

3120249316.m_KeyValue: "The motive is what we must investigate next."

3120249317.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no, no! Little Van Helsing, you must be wrong somewhere! How could Little Ami possibly be a murderer?""

3120637866.m_KeyValue: "Feuler's wings flutter as it delivers a letter bearing a wax seal."

3121245209.m_KeyValue: ""After such a long time,' Noah speculated, 'that Ancestor must have withered away in the cellar. After all, without sustenance, even a Bloodborn cannot survive for so long.'""

3121245210.m_KeyValue: ""'Unless someone has been tossing 'food' into the cellar,' Isaac interjected.""

3121245211.m_KeyValue: ""'Indeed,' the guard affirmed, his gaze fixed on the two young men. 'While the battle has seemingly ended, it rages on in secret. Even now, prisoners of war are occasionally cast into the depths of this cellar.'""

3121385156.m_KeyValue: ""Still keeping your heart from me, even now?""

3121385321.m_KeyValue: ""So, got our next mark in mind?""

3121385387.m_KeyValue: "You seem awfully interested in my secrets."

3121385420.m_KeyValue: "All this treasure... You do know how to please a lady."

3121385453.m_KeyValue: "The one piece missing from my collection."

3121385486.m_KeyValue: "You're not giving it to me? Am I not your most precious treasure?"

3121385519.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? Where was I? That's for me to know."

3121385552.m_KeyValue: ""All I need in this life of crime, is you.""

3121950858.m_KeyValue: "A type of DMG that is neither Physical nor Magic. Requires 200% Shield Strength to resist."

3122063030.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor 030 in Tower of Purification."

3122488564.m_KeyValue: "I don't know myself. I can't put it into words in a letter."

3122488571.m_KeyValue: "That's how duel letters are written in those novels."

3122488572.m_KeyValue: "I never would've expected you to read such novels."

3122488573.m_KeyValue: ""Well, the characters are always fighting and dueling each other. There's never a dull moment.""

3122488574.m_KeyValue: "But now you're backing down from another bout with me?"

3122488576.m_KeyValue: "Is it because I wasn't taking it seriously enough?"

3122505114.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? First time hearing about Raog sashimi? Well then, we absolutely must give it a proper introduction!""

3123076920.m_KeyValue: "I swear they wanted to eat me."

3123080121.m_KeyValue: "For now... let's help her say her final goodbyes."

3124071954.m_KeyValue:
""Bella's condition continued to improve, and she sent over a new piece of sheet music. I asked Acappella to perform it, and the music stirred distant yet warm memories. Though I couldn't clearly see their form, I could feel the 'longing' within—it was a song about my homeland.

Bella said it was the most unique song, written just for me. She seems to have an almost obsessive distinction between what is 'dull' and what is 'unique.'""

3124072144.m_KeyValue:
""I heard the water breathing—a resonance more profound than life itself. They enveloped me from all quarters, mingling with the crimson tide in my veins, drawing me toward an unfathomable depth.

I witnessed water's true form—configurations with weight greater than whole worlds. They crystallized before my eyes, filling the hollow spaces within my flesh, guiding me toward a distant place.

As if stirring from some fevered dream, I found myself standing once more in that chamber lined with bottles and phials, the air thick with unspeakable fragrances—the place that was once my sanctuary, and now my laboratory of metamorphosis:

Let the experiments begin...""

3124072233.m_KeyValue:
""The more I conversed with Valora, the more I came to admire her.

On the battlefield, she charged alongside Ludgard, facing formidable enemies with unwavering courage.

In the Hall of the Elders, she chose to serve as advisor to the young master, maintaining her unwavering loyalty to the Bathory. Even when her loyalty caused Baphomet's resentment, she never once regretted it.

When friction frequently arose between the Bathory and the Ganelon, she wielded compassion to preserve the fragile peace.

Valora possesses every quality a knight should embody.

Therefore, she deserves the treatment a knight has earned.""

3124072392.m_KeyValue:
""In that moment, I could not fathom what method Genevieve would employ to quell the Calamity.

The following dawn brought with it an eerie echo of history—a vast procession of slaves trudging toward the forbidden grounds of the Divine Body, Genevieve walking silently at the rear of the line.

Dread clawed at my chest. I lunged forward, seizing one of the slaves by the shoulder, desperate to warn him—this was no trial leading to liberation, and they were marching to their deaths as sacrificial offerings.

The slave turned slowly, and in his gaze I found not terror, but a resolve unlike anything I had ever witnessed—the transcendent serenity that belongs only to those who embrace their fate willingly. 'I know.' he said simply.

He spoke of his willingness to become a sacrifice, for Princess Genevieve would guide them all to shatter the cursed destiny of the Carrelle family. Not in this age, but in the time yet to come.

At last, comprehension flooded through me. I understood Genevieve's gambit to break the deadlock.

I understood why she had bidden me wait in this place—the 'Queen' would lead all her 'pawns' to flow against the current of a fated future, reshaping the present.""

Yet, etched within its lines is the seeker's unyielding resolve. No matter the world, he stands with absolute confidence, destined to command the essence of all things.""

3128972953.m_KeyValue: ""A drafting ruler left at the convergence of realms. Those beautiful yet naive ideals were ultimately destroyed by the curse in the family bloodline. In another life, where she maps the canvas of history, does she still recall that reckless adventure?""

3128972954.m_KeyValue: ""A parasol left at the convergence of realms. No longer the neglected child—Quinn is the pride of the Bathorys. In another life, where she marched with her family into Mouret, does she still recall the Wolfsbane once tattooed on her body?""

3128972955.m_KeyValue: ""A noble's crossbow, left at the convergence of realms. The bow is exquisite, carved with lavish yet impractical decorations and patterns. More a display of wealth than a weapon. In that place where she became nobility, can she still recall her days of impoverishment?""

3128972956.m_KeyValue: ""The blood of a siren, left at the convergence of realms. Sirens gathered around her, collecting every drop that she shed. Her tears ran black, filled with longing for home. In that place where Sapphire Isle sank beneath the waves, for whom do her tears fall?""

3128972958.m_KeyValue: ""A conch shell, left at the convergence of realms. The beautiful shell bears the marks of time and tide. In that place where she became a puppet, can she still recall the promise they made on the beach?""

3134792374.m_KeyValue: ""The first twelve alchemists consumed the blood of _$$Abel the Martyr_$$ and mastered the secret of _$$Rebirth._$$ The price, however, was to experience life rooted in the cycle of _$$truth,_$$ with each life playing out the same.""

3135978024.m_KeyValue: "ATK SPD -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

3136003200.m_KeyValue: "They all arrive at the same conclusion."

3136003201.m_KeyValue: ""Beyond the boundaries of time, countless copies of Noah and Albrecht may exist, yet no matter who—""

3136003203.m_KeyValue: "Would you care to hear what they think?"

3136003204.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps at this very moment, our other selves contemplate these same questions.""

3136003205.m_KeyValue: "The same spirit... so that's what you meant."

3138263042.m_KeyValue: "These children are the future of those who have none. Let us not bind them to the cycle of sorrow their elders could not escape..."

3138263043.m_KeyValue: ""Somewhere along the way, I almost forgot. Forgot who I really was...""

3138263044.m_KeyValue: ""I have only ever served one lady. And I already told you who that was, when we were outside.""

3138263045.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no, Lady Empousa... this is no mere flattery. Even your mind has grown sharper.""

3138263046.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, bat—don't you think this is a little too easy? We haven't seen a single enemy so far...""

3138264062.m_KeyValue: "We are all me—the souls reborn from Carrelle's Divine Body. But we are also you. Join us. Let Calamity and the Divine Body become one again."

3138264063.m_KeyValue: "Guess it's my turn to help too."

3138264064.m_KeyValue: ""The First Scourge, Long Night, must be mine. I won't let Cain take her.""

3138264065.m_KeyValue: "Precisely. You understand. You're about to die."

3138264066.m_KeyValue: "Told you. He's not ready to accept the truth."

3138264067.m_KeyValue: "It seems the you that stands here has seen much—just as I once did."

3138264068.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. That is what Aeon did to us. Erased our memories so only they would endure. Only they would remain eternal."

3138264069.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human?""

3140025589.m_KeyValue:
""A crab that escaped the El Dorado, once a Black Blood experiement subject.
Its shell bears the mark of a sea beast and the number zero. Only the bottle it clutches offers solace from its former torment.""

3140269081.m_KeyValue: "That black dagger I entrusted to you holds every answer you seek—the truth behind why I chose to help you."

3140269083.m_KeyValue: "Wait—at least tell me who sent you to help me."

3140269084.m_KeyValue: ""Hehe... you haven't figured it out yet, have you?""

3140269086.m_KeyValue: ""The rift in the temporal currents is closing… Ironfist is crumbling... Noah, did we finally succeed this time?""

3140269087.m_KeyValue: "This time? Has this scene unfolded before?"

3140269088.m_KeyValue: "No time for explanations now. Do you feel it? Our consciousness is slipping away from these vessels... We'll return to the original timeline soon. Until we meet again in Minexus."

3140269094.m_KeyValue: ""It's been several days since I left Ironfist and returned to this familiar timeline, yet Genevieve's origins remain shrouded in mystery.""

3140864252.m_KeyValue: "So... we did the right thing by accident."

3140864254.m_KeyValue: "You Bloodborn can slaughter your own without so much as flinching."

3141716353.m_KeyValue: ""Is someone there…? Please, I just need... a hand.""

3141989394.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you're wounded! Before the Black Blood spreads further, allow me use my Revert ability and mend your injuries.""

3142212770.m_KeyValue: ""I conducted an investigation at Duke Reese's castle, but the servants are highly vigilant and little was discovered.""

3142284512.m_KeyValue: "The new reagent proves remarkably potent—it draws you completely into that forgotten chapter of the past."

3142390271.m_KeyValue: ""Dear Noah, are you ready to take responsibility?""

3142501794.m_KeyValue: "ATK Speed +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

3142501823.m_KeyValue: "ATK Speed -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

3143723193.m_KeyValue: ""So... there's one more thing, could I ask you a favor?""

3143723199.m_KeyValue: "No need to dwell on such trivial matters."

3143723201.m_KeyValue: "Your father might prefer if you got along well with this 'potential business partner'..."

3143723202.m_KeyValue: "Good thing little Michel isn't as shrewd as his father."

3143723203.m_KeyValue: ""Even though we've just met, you remind me of my 'family' who always took care of me.""

3143723204.m_KeyValue: "This voice... Why does it sound so familiar?"

3143723205.m_KeyValue: ""Tch... I'll let it slide this time, but don't let me catch you again!""

3143728636.m_KeyValue: ""Offer up your most precious possession, win the respect of all residents, win the eighth Siren's Tear, and take your place as the Eighth Sage.""

3143728637.m_KeyValue: ""In two days, we will hold a ceremony to select the Eighth Sage at the auction house. This is your invitation, Miss Ami.""

3143728638.m_KeyValue: "I never said anything of the sort."

3143728639.m_KeyValue: ""Are you saying that if I disagree, you'll continue to shape my 'reality'?""

3143728640.m_KeyValue: ""'Dreams' are defined by humans, and is 'reality' any different?""

3143728643.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, would you like to be part of this 'plan' for the future?""

3143728644.m_KeyValue: ""With this in our possession, the future we have planned will inevitably become reality.""

3145515578.m_KeyValue: ""Control: Strong. The carrier is interrupted and remains unable to cast Ultimate, Special (Active), Basic ATK, or move during the effect.""

3146684755.m_KeyValue: "'The rest of the journal must be hidden there. Let's go!'"

3146684756.m_KeyValue: "So I gave myself wholly to the study of the moon."

3146684757.m_KeyValue: ""'Even you, heir to the Alita family, have no clue?'""

3146684758.m_KeyValue: ""Dragging Noah behind her, Empousa stepped into Aiona's room with concern. 'Aiona, how's the research coming along?'""

3146684761.m_KeyValue: "'Looks like I'll have to do it. No one's better at treasure hunts than me.'"

3146684762.m_KeyValue: "'Why do these notes look scorched? Were they burned?'"

3146685843.m_KeyValue: ""'Look—there's a note from the author: _$$After more than three years, I've finally brought this preliminary star-gazing journal to a close._$$'""

3146685844.m_KeyValue: ""The group gathered around Empousa, eyes fixed on the page in her hands.""

3146685845.m_KeyValue: ""'Is this… the moon?' Aiona held up a page from the journal, showing a page of black scribbles.""

3146685846.m_KeyValue: ""'We came to observe the moon,' Aiona explained gently.""

3146685849.m_KeyValue: ""'Next time you're moon-gazing, invite us too.'""

3146855731.m_KeyValue: ""'Where... am I...? Why is it so cold? The flames rage all around me, their fury consuming everything in sight, yet from the very depths of my soul I feel nothing but this endless, bone-deep chill...'""

3146855732.m_KeyValue: ""'Cut—!' Quinn snaps open her delicate parasol. 'Mass... focus on your lines. Your turn isn't up yet. Remember, you’re the <style=""Highlight"">second lead</style>!'""

3146855733.m_KeyValue: ""'Riches, talent, glory... once, I possessed it all!' Genevieve's eyes sweep across the crowd. 'Do you crave my fortune? Do you covet my artistry? If you desire them...'""

3146855734.m_KeyValue: "'Oh... that Brief History of Minexus? I just made that up on a whim. Please don't take it seriously—no such creature has ever existed on Minexus.'"

3146855735.m_KeyValue: "Genevieve shrugs. 'I'm just an artist. I don't want this stage to be ruined. That's all.'"

3146855736.m_KeyValue: ""'—As a <color=#728c69>Perfect Metamorph Dragon</color>, the key is to adapt to any stage. Right now, I'm not merely <style=""Highlight"">playing</style> the Drama Queen, but rather...'""

3146855737.m_KeyValue: "...Should this be called the noble spirit of sacrificing oneself for art?"

3146855738.m_KeyValue: ""'Not enough!' Genevieve stops and whispers into Mass's ears, '<style=""Highlight"">Riches, talent, glory... once, I possessed it all! Do you crave my fortune? Do you covet my artistry?</style>'""

3146857907.m_KeyValue: ""...Hmm, looks like the second half of that sentence is on some other promotional material.""

3146857908.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet paused, then snapped his gaze from the trophy to Gilrain. 'Gilrain Cidhall... Ha Ha Hahahaha!'""

3146857909.m_KeyValue: "As expected of the man known as the 'Soulless'—his words are lack any warmth."

3146857910.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on a second... It's a bit late to be asking this, but why is he called the Soulless? Wasn't this character supposed to be a soul that lost his physical body and is now attached to armor?""

3146857914.m_KeyValue: ""And last but not least... a warm welcome to our final attendee—whose seat is to the west, but who's currently sprawled to the north—the enigmatic and very cute black cat!""

3146858867.m_KeyValue: ""'A-Achoo!' Instead of a dignified response, Gilrain's ill-timed sneeze shatters the solemn atmosphere. His worsening cat allergy, it seems, has chosen a most inopportune moment to manifest.""

3146858868.m_KeyValue: ""As the trophy rolled back and forth between the cat's paws, Baphomet considered intervening, but was unwilling to lower himself to do so—""

3146858869.m_KeyValue: ""A deathly hush descended upon the scene, each person ruminating on Baphomet's words. Even the black cat quietly padded back to its seat, its eyes blinking with an expression that seemed to teeter between comprehension and bewilderment...""

3146858870.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey Gilrain, do be gentle, won't you? I have a hunch this intruder could become a big-time customer! And the silver hair... could it be the one Cain mentioned?'""

3146858871.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet paused for a moment, then hefted his axe and lumbered forward as two spectral flames flickered to life within the void of his helmet. Through these flames, Gilrain and Bella seemed to glimpse something...""

3146897107.m_KeyValue: ""With a faint hiss, the candle flared to life, and at once came the clatter-clack of hidden mechanisms. The wall split open, revealing a narrow passage—just wide enough for one person to pass through.""

3146897108.m_KeyValue: "Seriously... what on earth has Van Helsing been teaching her?"

3146897109.m_KeyValue: ""Led by that hand, with the wind brushing her cheeks, Selena was guided toward the Infernal Kitchen—where she would spend one of the most blissful days of her summer.""

3146897110.m_KeyValue: ""Several months ago, at the Harbor of Soughs...""

3146897111.m_KeyValue: "'Because Lord Van Helsing once said...' Selena clenched her fists at her sides. 'Th-this outfit suits me—and he even patted my head... so gently...'"

3146897112.m_KeyValue: ""Bella offered no reply, meeting her gaze with a perfectly blank stare.""

3146897113.m_KeyValue: ""'That's the very purpose of our travels!' she declared, thrusting a finger forward with fiery conviction. 'Which is why we chose the Dekatres Archipelago, south of the Harbor of Soughs, as our first destination.'""

3146897114.m_KeyValue: ""'Hang in there! Whatever you do, don't fall asleep!' Selena clutched the girl's hand tighter as they ran beneath the blazing sun. 'Lord Van Helsing told me about cases like this...'""

3146897119.m_KeyValue: ""Bella gave no reply. But somewhere in that narrow, flickering space, fireflies rose like spirits from the dark—dancing softly around the two of them. And in the shifting light, something intangible seemed to bloom in the air.""

3146897120.m_KeyValue: ""From nowhere, a firefly emerged, circling lazily around Bella before drifting down to land upon the parchment. Its soft glow lit the surface and revealed a single line, written in bold—""

3146898197.m_KeyValue: ""Cain continued to explain, 'Put simply, it involves summoning the Matriarch's portrait through certain means, at a location far from her presence.'""

3146898199.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh? And will you claim that I'm also one of your creations, O illustrious Grand Alchemist?' The Matriarch's visage taunted.""

3146898200.m_KeyValue: ""'People often look at mirrors hoping to see the person they imagine themselves to be, only to be disappointed. But not when looking at these portraits.'""

3146898201.m_KeyValue: ""'The foretold day draws near,' Cain continued, his voice heavy with concern. 'Will you really disappear?'""

3146898202.m_KeyValue: "Lamia was the first to spot Cain and wasted no time in calling him out. 'Cain! Why are you loitering here instead of attending to your duties?'"

3146929783.m_KeyValue: "'Enough!' Baphomet cut in sharply. 'What I want to discuss is how we can create more powerful vessels to counter the growing strength of other powerful families.'"

3146929784.m_KeyValue: ""'Let us commence our monthly Elder meeting,' Baphomet, in his capacity as Chief Elder, declared. 'Our agenda today concerns the recent Blood conflicts among other families.'""

3146929785.m_KeyValue: ""'That's right,' Gilrain declared, laying bare his true feelings. 'If anyone's to be compared to the Lion, it should be us, the Bull. The Horse doesn't even deserve to be mentioned in the same breath!'""

3146929786.m_KeyValue: ""'However, obtaining their ancestral blood would likely require venturing into the forbidden grounds, and that Gravekeeper Clive Ganelon is no pushover.'""

3146935091.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Sirene, use your cloak at once to fetch—ah, I mean, kindly invite—the theater troupe from the neighboring town!_$$""

3146935092.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn clears her throat with a delicate _$$*Ahem*..._$$ before closing her eyes, losing herself entirely in the theatrical world— _$$'Mario, Mario, wherefore art thou Mario?'_$$""

3146935093.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I remember... six hundred years ago, Ganelon was preparing to launch a surprise attack...?_$$ The blue-haired girl's eyes widen. _$$And your mother was also..._$$""

3146935094.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Your name sounds lovely too!_$$ Quinn clasps Agnes's hand warmly, her mouth opening to continue, until her eyes catch Sirene, who's still lurking nearby. _$$Oh, no..._$$""

3146935095.m_KeyValue: ""Though this unexpected interjection isn't part of her carefully laid scheme, Sirene smoothly adapts, weaving the interruption into her theatrical performance to draw out the young lady: _$$The young lady's favorite stage play..._$$""

3146935096.m_KeyValue: "The young lady's excitement propels her toward Sirene—all memory of her earlier attempt to trip the woman forgotten—only for propriety to halt her mid-stride when she notices the strangers gathered nearby. Such unguarded enthusiasm hardly befits someone of her station."

3146935097.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Ah...!_$$ With a soft gasp, a graceful silhouette materializes from the air in one of Bathory Castle's shadowed gardens. _$$No matter how many times I visit this place, I simply cannot grow accustomed to its unsettling aura..._$$""

3146935098.m_KeyValue: "_$$Young Lady?_$$ The blue-haired girl's gaze drifts toward the castle's spires. _$$The Young Lady of the Bathory family... could it possibly be..._$$"

3146935105.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Ah! Please, do not swear by the moon... The moon is fickle and ever-changing, waxing and waning with each passing month—and perhaps your love might prove just as inconstant..._$$""

3147001656.m_KeyValue: ""However, as in many clichéd tales, one Ancestor fell for the girl. He soon noticed some of his fellow Ancestrals struggling more and more to suppress their growing hunger.""

3147001657.m_KeyValue: ""It's said that during the Crimson Inquisition, several Ancestors with unique Blood Powers hid in the vault, along with some prisoners of war.'""

3147001658.m_KeyValue: ""Upon infiltrating, however, they found that guarding the vault's entrance was neither a powerful seal nor a terrifying monster—but an elderly man with a large key ring dangling from his waist.""

3147002611.m_KeyValue: ""To help set the mood more vividly, we should clarify their positions:""

3147002612.m_KeyValue: ""Darkness consumed the room. Even though all three had faced far worse before… In that moment, a quiet, inexplicable dread began to stir in each of their hearts.""

3147002613.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever had been lurking in the darkness loosened its grip on Bella's arm. But no one was foolish enough to believe it had left. That overwhelming presence, driven by an obsession so dense it nearly took form, still pressed down upon them...""

3147002614.m_KeyValue: ""Fresh cuts of Raog can be prepared in a variety of ways, though the most celebrated are the Raog Belly Sashimi and the Glasflare Fin Soup served at the Infernal Kitchen of Harbor of Soughs.""

3147002616.m_KeyValue: ""'…Rest assured, Lady Empousa. This is for the sake of…'""

3147002617.m_KeyValue: ""'Right—gracing our humble estate. We, uh… regret not seeing you off properly…'""

3147002618.m_KeyValue: ""'The Bathory ancestors left behind... certain inexplicable remnants. Strange occurrences like this are, unfortunately, not uncommon here.'""

3147002623.m_KeyValue: ""'So… this was all your doing, wasn't it?' Lorelei fixed Bella with a half-smile, half-glare. 'I'm guessing… there'll be even more theatrical horrors waiting in the Ancestral Vault?'""

3147002624.m_KeyValue: ""Well—depending on how you looked at it, maybe that's what you'd call a fair exchange.""

3149283184.m_KeyValue: "Wait! We're not here for your life."

3150278397.m_KeyValue: ""_$$The High Priestess_$$ can immobilize enemies, who lose their vision and cannot move in the following round.""

3151122546.m_KeyValue: "What? Why is he dead again? He literally just handed us clues—and ship tickets!"

3152024966.m_KeyValue: ""Return to the Church, Acappella. If you cannot walk this path with me, then live.""

3152024967.m_KeyValue: ""We've both made our choice, Acappella. So now… we walk forward.""

3152024968.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying?! Have you gone mad?!"

3152024970.m_KeyValue: "And you've proven yourself more than worthy as my successor—beyond what I ever imagined."

3152024971.m_KeyValue: ""Had you inherited your position through traditional means. Then, like me...""

3152083484.m_KeyValue: ""While the shell exists, P. DMG Taken -{0}""

3152516045.m_KeyValue: "Why do you think humans believe in god?"

3153968608.m_KeyValue: "Landis... doesn't belong here anymore. Go back... return to where everyone is waiting."

3153968613.m_KeyValue: "Let your foolish—but delectable—blood become our offering for Ranna's glorious rebirth!"

3153968614.m_KeyValue: "You've lost! And just your luck—we're not exactly short on heavy hitters today."

3153968615.m_KeyValue: "Sounds more like she preyed on your desperation and tricked you into destroying the Divine Body... just so she could escape."

3153968616.m_KeyValue: "Your understanding is far too shallow. We won't waste time trying to bring you to our side."

3153968617.m_KeyValue: ""It's no use... Even if you kill us, we'll always remain with our mistress. And she will create new vessels to carry us forward.""

3153968619.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa, parading around in borrowed plumes does little to impress.""

3153969770.m_KeyValue: ""So come, Captain... Let's share a drink—just like we used to.""

3153970793.m_KeyValue: ""Still not here... Silver-haired, we need you...""

3153971939.m_KeyValue: "They came from my memories. They're my family."

3153971940.m_KeyValue: "They're not in my memories... They're not of my bloodline!"

3153971941.m_KeyValue: "No... this isn't right! I didn't summon these creatures—where did they come from?!"

3153971943.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why am I here too? Am I supposed to say something?"

3153971944.m_KeyValue: ""Marlow, Joseph... If only I'd finished the food in the kitchen faster... maybe you wouldn't have—""

3153971945.m_KeyValue: "Or the toughest... But we'll always be the ones standing between you and danger."

3153971946.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, you're surrounded by a crew that may not be the brightest, or the most articulate...""

3153971947.m_KeyValue: "That's true... The Captain does make everyone take turns on watch. No one's allowed to rest."

3153971948.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you fall into the sea again, someone will be there to pull you out. Don't forget—you've got a whole ship full of sailors behind you.""

3154776615.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the enemies of _$$Phantoms in the Woods._$$"

3156303924.m_KeyValue: "We still have a long journey ahead."

3156303955.m_KeyValue: ""Patience. Await the opportune moment, and success will come naturally.""

3156306964.m_KeyValue: "I hope my presence doesn't make you uncomfortable."

3156312651.m_KeyValue: "Doing something even more boring than boredom itself... I suppose that's a form of amusement too."

3156314794.m_KeyValue: ""With 'The Chariot' in hand, victory is inevitable.""

3156314825.m_KeyValue: "Perfect timing. Why don't you keep me company for a spell? I'll be sure to... properly compensate you."

3156315660.m_KeyValue: "You want to know what's beneath the armor? I'm afraid it might startle you."

3156315819.m_KeyValue: ""If I cannot secure a victory of this caliber, I would not dare call myself a Knight.""

3156317834.m_KeyValue: ""Life is so fragile, so delicate that even the gentlest touch can cause it to wither.""

3156317993.m_KeyValue: "This is the requiem bestowed upon you."

3156319142.m_KeyValue: "I-I still have a long way to go…"

3156319173.m_KeyValue: "I was born to bear my family's hopes... but what are mine?"

3156796646.m_KeyValue:
""They say Baphomet once wore indestructible armor, forged by the former head of his family. Yet none could have foreseen it would be shattered by his own blood. His daughter, born under a curse, was prophesied to end him. Against all odds, the hardened old knight softened, raising her in the dungeon, believing he could seal the curse by sealing away the skylight.

That was until that night, when the girl drove her blade through his breastplate. Since then, he has changed his armor often—but mortal steel cannot withstand the rust of years, and his heart has aged with it.""

3157081878.m_KeyValue: ""Besides Clive and Gadric, who else knows you?""

3157379676.m_KeyValue: ""I promised to help, and I will stay by your side until we rescue her!""

3158065395.m_KeyValue: "The thick scent of blood hung in the air. Blood always followed her—was that why they called her the Mistbound Terror?"

3158088460.m_KeyValue:
""After learning Stella's wish, I extended an invitation to Aiona and the rest.

They accepted without hesitation, and we agreed to meet at the dining hall.

Perhaps it was disbelief—or the quiet fear that often comes with returning home—but the radiant joy Stella had shown upon first meeting Asta was nowhere to be seen. She appeared reserved, even a little shy.

Thankfully, Empousa and Hati were there to soften the silence. With warm smiles, they took her hands in theirs and gently coaxed out the emotions she'd kept hidden.

At last, her guarded walls gave way. Aiona pulled her into a quiet embrace, letting her tears fall freely onto flowing robes.

I rose without a word and stepped to the dining hall's entrance—keeping watch to ensure this long-awaited reunion would remain undisturbed.

Let this beautiful moment belong to her, and her alone.""

3164136258.m_KeyValue:
""After falling from the cliff of Starfall Valley, I was rescued by Aiona and Empousa. By the campfire that night, Aiona handed me a small lamb craft and told me there was still a future worth pursuing. Only now do I understand why she felt so strangely familiar, why she stayed by my side as I searched for my identity.

That night, in the flickering firelight, she said: _$$I will witness your future, just as you once accompanied me._$$""

3164324320.m_KeyValue: ""Until that day, when I was about to leave and several bats suddenly appeared before me.""

3164324321.m_KeyValue: ""If you were constantly compared to your _$$sister_$$ from birth, knowing that only by surpassing her could you survive, you'd develop the same instinct.""

3164324322.m_KeyValue: ""A sudden evening breeze swept in, carrying the hair ornament I had given to Lamia into the night sky.""

3164324323.m_KeyValue: "What she wanted to give me wasn't a weapon..."

3166207335.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain... Perhaps it's because of your blessing... that I could keep moving forward..."

3166207432.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how many times I've been through this, I will always save you.""

3167869852.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. So after all that, you simply circled back to proving that Aaron was still killed inside the guest cabin.""

3167869854.m_KeyValue: "Lady Empousa seems to be developing a competitive streak... even in this peculiar situation."

3167869856.m_KeyValue: ""I will make you see the truth. As I said, William made three fatal mistakes that exposed him as the culprit.""

3167869857.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing, a word of caution. I know who you're about to accuse, but without sufficient evidence, I won't accept it.""

3167869858.m_KeyValue: ""No. I don't have any physical evidence—whatever we might have found, I believe the Captain has already destroyed.""

3167869859.m_KeyValue: "What!? There shouldn't be any more evidence! The rope on the deck was already..."

3167869860.m_KeyValue: "It was a clever plan. But what he never expected was..."

3167869885.m_KeyValue: "William came by earlier. We had a lot to talk about. Both constantly stepped on by people who can't stand us."

3167869886.m_KeyValue: "Now that's a first... seeing you this flustered. Where's all that elegance now?"

3167869887.m_KeyValue: "What?! How can there be a Black Blood infection at sea?! I'm saying this now—it has nothing to do with me!"

3167869888.m_KeyValue: ""For now, it's contained. The Black Blood hasn't fully overtaken their bodies yet.""

3167870140.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I've been holding onto it. Though… we've been traveling nonstop—I haven't had a chance to open it.""

3167870149.m_KeyValue: ""This ship, the El Dorado, was commissioned at great cost by Goldland—a merchant who fancies himself an explorer—in his search for lost isles.""

3167870150.m_KeyValue: "Every 'present' we live through is a miracle wrought from countless past 'choices.'"

3167870151.m_KeyValue: "What mattered to him wasn't whether he could escape the vortex of history—but whether Hati could leave it behind... and keep walking her own path."

3167870152.m_KeyValue: ""Still, if this is the sort of relationship you'd rather keep unseen, the guest cabins offer far better privacy.""

3167870153.m_KeyValue: "Then it seems this voyage promises enough turmoil to warrant a fortune teller aboard."

3167870154.m_KeyValue: ""I see 'The High Priestess' is well-versed in tarot. 'The Fool' often knows nothing, yet holds limitless potential...""

3167870155.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, I should deliver dinner to the Captain before it arrives. I won't be showing you two to your cabins.""

3167870180.m_KeyValue: ""You're right. I have been rude. Please allow me to introduce myself, albeit belatedly. I am Van...""

3167870181.m_KeyValue: "How do you know that—have you been spying on us?!"

3167870182.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Stay with me! What do I do…"

3167870185.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer's student? Just who are you?"

3167870187.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, we're so sorry… We were too weak... We couldn't even avenge you…""

3167870206.m_KeyValue: ""There's a small barrel over here. Hide in it, and no one will ever find you.""

3167870216.m_KeyValue: "...That depends on how you define 'still alive.'"

3167870219.m_KeyValue: ""A Silver Cross member—one of the top ten, no less! The Captain clearly didn't bring just anyone aboard.""

3167870240.m_KeyValue: "I'll pass as well. I don't partake in anything that clouds the mind."

3167870241.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of Jones... It seems he's been repeatedly disrespectful regarding the guard arrangements. Given our long-standing dealings, allow me to offer my sincere apologies.""

3167870244.m_KeyValue: ""Weren't you supposed to be watching them, Jones?""

3167870245.m_KeyValue: ""The sea is fair: no matter how noble or mighty you are, its waves will engulf your arrogance.""

3167870246.m_KeyValue: ""He never mentioned me? Back when we were still a small association, he'd regularly purchase cosmetics and special mirrors from me.""

3167870247.m_KeyValue: ""As Captain, I sincerely apologize for the discourtesy shown by William and the others.""

3167870248.m_KeyValue: "He just strolls in on the back of his connections and snatches command of the security detail! Unforgivable!"

3167870250.m_KeyValue: "You're quite open about having a 'purpose' of your own."

3167870251.m_KeyValue: "Why's it so noisy... Is it mealtime already?"

3167870273.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, just so you know, the crew quarters, where I just fixed the rudder entanglement, are right behind the farthest wall.""

3167870276.m_KeyValue: "What's happening on this ship? And what's going on here now?"

3167870277.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing is in charge of ship security for this voyage. The Silver Cross specializes in handling matters like this. Leave it to him."

3167870278.m_KeyValue: ""Me? I was in the kitchen next door, preparing some food. Then I heard something heavy crash to the ground over here, so I came to check.""

3167870281.m_KeyValue: "Untie that knot immediately. We need to resume sailing—we can't let the guests grow uneasy."

3167870282.m_KeyValue: "But yes—the vibration was different. More like something heavy crashing to the floor... And it came from just behind that wall."

3167870283.m_KeyValue: "Ha! William? He's never cared for the sea or being a sailor since he was a boy. Always preferred tinkering with strange contraptions. Good thing he's the Captain's brother..."

3167870308.m_KeyValue: "Maybe because I grew up on this ship. I've never been to anywhere else. I only know these people."

3167870309.m_KeyValue: "Are you being protective because you like me?"

3167870310.m_KeyValue: ""If this is about the damaged floor, I can explain...""

3167870311.m_KeyValue: "To think Silver-haired would share her naive... Wait. I get it now."

3167870312.m_KeyValue: ""If Van Helsing can lift this box—about the weight of an adult—from the deck, it'll prove...""

3167870340.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why did you knock away Blake?"

3167870341.m_KeyValue: "They suddenly started staring at me! So much for your promise that we'd never be found in here."

3167870342.m_KeyValue: ""Whether you call him Marlow or Jack, he's no longer the person you knew.""

3167870343.m_KeyValue: "Could it be...! I was wondering why the sailors got infected... If the food was contaminated with Black Blood..."

3167870344.m_KeyValue: "Are they about to do something... 'dangerously forbidden'?"

3167870345.m_KeyValue: "Of course. How else would I know who to thank for keeping me fed? Want a tentacle? It's from Octo."

3167870347.m_KeyValue: ""Ah... that's not necessary, I'm... already full...""

3168128842.m_KeyValue:
""Synergized Vassals gain Synergy DMG +{2}, Synergy DMG Reduction +{6}, and {4} of Letitia's Windwing stacks.
Windwing: +{7} CRIT Rate, +{8} Dodge. Stacks up to {9} times.""

3168159816.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I'm here for you. But first, you need to take that step.""

3168159817.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Noah. I'll do my best.""

3168159818.m_KeyValue: ""Since we've left our homes behind, why don't we focus on creating a new one here together?""

3168159820.m_KeyValue: "It's just a jumbled mess in my mind."

3168159821.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, as far as I'm concerned, home is wherever I feel at ease.""

3168159824.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah, do you ever feel homesick?""

3168159825.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes... After all, home usually carries pleasant memories.""

3168565005.m_KeyValue: "Flames in the cabin. Enemies will take DMG over time if standing in the flames."

3169115480.m_KeyValue: "Maybe Father wouldn't have died then... And Sis wouldn't be so heartbroken... It's all because I'm too weak—"

3170672771.m_KeyValue: ""'Tell me, in places yet untouched by cartographers, could greater fascinations await?'""

3170720673.m_KeyValue:
""Attention Lord,
You acheived Top {SoloRaidRank} in Prophecy Unbound. Please claim your rewards.""

3171295153.m_KeyValue: "I need only for you to take two steps closer and place your trust in me... I will take the field myself and return the Calamity to silence."

3171295160.m_KeyValue: "What do you need me to do?"

3171295161.m_KeyValue: ""Alone, this would indeed be nothing more than wishful thinking. But everything has changed now.""

3171295162.m_KeyValue: ""All I need is your trust, and your willingness to wait here—to wait as I break through the shackles of time and space and return from that battle I was meant to die in.""

3171295163.m_KeyValue: "The truth is... I don't need you to shoulder any burden for me."

3171295166.m_KeyValue: "The purpose of 'castling' is to move the King to an absolutely safe position while unleashing the Rook's full combat potential."

3171295167.m_KeyValue: ""Move the 'King' two squares toward the 'Rook,' then move that 'Rook' over the 'King' to the square beside it?""

3171653530.m_KeyValue: ""'How exactly do you plan to deliver justice with a pearl? Are you implying all the criminals are... what, fish?'""

3171653533.m_KeyValue: ""'To obtain the pearl's power and deliver justice to all evildoers across Minexus, of course!'""

3172386285.m_KeyValue: ""I realize it's hard to adjust to this change, but Pure Blood Essence is vital for restoring your strength, so that you may <style=""Highlight"">live</style>.""

3172386286.m_KeyValue: ""Daily, Weekly, as well as Story Tasks each have their own objectives. Completing milestone achievements also grants rewards.""
