3174083386.m_KeyValue: "There's another reason... I didn't want to hear the story from the future—it felt like a harsh prophecy."

3174083387.m_KeyValue: ""Since birth, I was prophesied as the 'cursed one' for my bloodline. Those memories… still ache too deeply.""

3174083394.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps watching you struggle to defy fate… reminded me of who I once was."

3174083395.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, you asked me about the ballad earlier...""

3174083397.m_KeyValue: "You were right... the matters at hand are far more important than my naive plans."

3174083398.m_KeyValue: "Do you want to know why I kept denying that I wrote that ballad?"

3174083400.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I wrote it... but it was just a child's fantasy. I don't deserve the title of 'hero' you speak of.""

3174083401.m_KeyValue: ""The hero of your destiny was never meant to be someone else... but you yourself, Agnes.""

3174084540.m_KeyValue: "What is this? Love? It's disgusting! Making me sick...!"

3174084541.m_KeyValue: ""Trust me, his flame will quench... Go now!""

3174084546.m_KeyValue: ""The flames... they ignite from within him. With his state now, I can see it more clearly.""

3174084547.m_KeyValue: "He's the source of this great fire."

3174084549.m_KeyValue: "Leave? What about you... He can survive this fire... but you'll get killed!"

3174084551.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie, get Da Vinci here and take Agnes to the cave. She can return home from there.""

3174084553.m_KeyValue: ""The source of this fire is inside him. If we destroy it, the blaze will cease!""

3174672496.m_KeyValue:
""I hear the voice at the end of time—
Like the ancient strings at the dawn of the world,
Like the soft murmur of all living things.
The river flows from that far shore,
On this side, it nurtures will, memory, and civilization;
On the Other Side, it nurtures the sun, stars, and moon.
Aeon takes my hand as we sail on the river,
On the left, the clamor of iron forges and silhouettes of travelers,
On the right, the loneliness of home and the morning stars of the night.
I shall Embark from this shore,
Taking Aeon's hand, to journey towards the Other Side.""

3174680509.m_KeyValue: ""After obtaining the final reward, you can continue exploring for remaining rewards.""

3174802877.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, our game of cat and mouse is officially over.""

3174802878.m_KeyValue: ""Usually, heads that know this many secrets go _$$BANG!_$$ and get blown off.""

3174802879.m_KeyValue: "You're too slow. I'll have to knock you all out and make a run for it."

3174802881.m_KeyValue: ""Unforgivable heretic of the Bloodborn, prepare to face judgment.""

3175279170.m_KeyValue: "I've traveled to every corner of the world... somehow reading about them just isn't the same. There's no mystery left."

3175279171.m_KeyValue: ""So, what sort of stories catch your interest, Letitia?""

3175279179.m_KeyValue: ""Yet they crave stories filled with turmoil and upheaval, even those that end in tragedy...""

3175279180.m_KeyValue: "The human mind is a labyrinth of contradictions."

3175279181.m_KeyValue: ""What kinds of stories do you like, Letitia?""

3175279182.m_KeyValue: "Me? I... feel a little shy saying it."

3175279185.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I'm actually the inspiration behind some of those myths myself... Reading about them feels a bit too grandiose, you know?""

3176081873.m_KeyValue: "—The true reason for your "incompleteness" is that neither you nor Lady Empousa possess enough power."

3176081874.m_KeyValue: ""While the Church controls the mortals through faith, we Bloodborn can show them how they can defy 'death'—even attain 'immortality.'""

3177077086.m_KeyValue: "But there are others in the Choir too. Like Anna. Like—"

3177077088.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you came to me. You hoped I could help you feel again."

3177077089.m_KeyValue: "My parents' faces blurred. Their voices grew faint. The bedtime stories they told me scattered into fragments."

3177077090.m_KeyValue: ""According to the dictionary, your behavior would be described as unusual.""

3177199096.m_KeyValue: "You now have full command. Lead us to victory!"

3177932222.m_KeyValue: ""Come on, it'll be fine! Let's go do something fun.""

3177933245.m_KeyValue: "Such matters are of no concern to me."

3177935423.m_KeyValue: "Is it really necessary to obsess over such trivial matters?"

3177936578.m_KeyValue: "Life is fleeting. Shall we turn our minds to more important matters?"

3177938756.m_KeyValue: ""Kid, don't rope me in unless it's vital. I'd rather catch some more shut-eye.""

3178079771.m_KeyValue: "Set the pointers to the position indicated in the hint."

3178684070.m_KeyValue: "I could almost see them thundering across the battlefield."

3178684071.m_KeyValue: ""At its master's command, Ludgard broke into a run.""

3179713768.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'purchasing the blood stain cleaner invented by the Church'?"

3179716967.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'adhering to family-first policy in all matters'?"

3179720038.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'continuing to uphold the principle of the First Tenet of Secrecy'?"

3179854695.m_KeyValue: ""He sacrificed his corporeal form for the House of Bathory, only to have his spirit expunged by the Silver-Haired one. Upon absolution, though laden with regret, his mind no longer suffered.""

3179958523.m_KeyValue: "Tap [Claim All] to complete all Main Tasks for this stage."

3180715939.m_KeyValue: ""Wait... the slave we're meant to ambush—that's Joan, isn't it?""

3180715941.m_KeyValue: "Joan's 999th match is about to begin. Where in the world is Pavana?"

3180715942.m_KeyValue: ""Keep her from today's match. Better yet, see she never sets foot in Astolfo again.""

3181965154.m_KeyValue: "This Artifact has been equipped by the maximum number of Vassals. Select an equipped Vassal to switch."

3182131387.m_KeyValue: ""After selection, you'll have a higher chance of obtaining these Vassals during the Embrace ritual.""

3182158569.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive my tardiness, and my silence upon arrival.""

3182426443.m_KeyValue: "I know you want to change the future—that's why I sent you this letter."

3183367827.m_KeyValue: "The Master has installed devices throughout the Isle that will turn everyone into puppets."

3183367829.m_KeyValue: "Here I thought the silver-haired one was like me—someone I could trust. How did he end up so popular and sociable?"

3183367830.m_KeyValue: ""I'm Ginokio, and I never tell lies.""

3183367831.m_KeyValue: ""Ahem! Don't forget that I am the silver-haired one's most capable assistant and the foremost disciple of the Church's Silver Cross Van Helsing—Selena, the Deadly Arrow.""

3183367832.m_KeyValue: ""No matter what, we will always be Master's first and most cherished children.""

3183367833.m_KeyValue: ""And as we sail, we'll help you and your kin find your home beneath the waves.""

3183367834.m_KeyValue: ""I've always wanted to say something cool like Master Albrecht—and today, I did!""

3183367859.m_KeyValue: "Joyce knows where Lord Hallon's daughter is."

3183367860.m_KeyValue: "Ta-da! Joyce and Joyce's puppets are no ordinary humans!"

3183367861.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to the silver-haired one, Joyce's servant! A simple trap was all it took, and you fell for it, helping Joyce collect every last one of the Siren's Tears!""

3183367863.m_KeyValue: "I don't need saving. I'm not in any danger."

3183367864.m_KeyValue: ""So this's an enemy to both Lorelei and myself. Noah, I'll fight alongside you.""

3183367865.m_KeyValue: ""I cannot comprehend their language, nor can I fathom their thoughts. But their eyes speak volumes—these devices must be destroyed.""

3183367866.m_KeyValue: "The situation with the siren appears to be resolved. It is time I joined Noah."

3183367891.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, you win! That's amazing! Please teach me how—""

3183367892.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine, Selena. Please lend me your hand one more time.""

3183367894.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't that vile woman supposed to be dead?! Curses! Joyce has been deceived! She must have faked her death!"

3183367896.m_KeyValue: ""You already did, Lorelei. That's why, after eleven years, destiny has guided us back to each other.""

3183367897.m_KeyValue: "You said when the promised place filled with blooming Tidewisps—"

3183367898.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I dismantled many devices alongside the sirens, but... I always believed they did it to reclaim their freedom.""

3183367917.m_KeyValue: "Well… not entirely! The owner is actually a really good person!"

3183367918.m_KeyValue: ""Strange... Yakov, can you catch a cold too?""

3183367923.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't the Mistbound Terror already dead? Is the Isle still safe? What happened last night?"

3183367924.m_KeyValue: "Besides... the sirens probably won't return to land again."

3183367925.m_KeyValue: ""Congratulations to Sage Ami, graced with valor! Congratulations to Sage Ami, endowed with wisdom!""

3183367926.m_KeyValue: ""She said, 'It was salvaged along with some gaudy statue.’""

3183367927.m_KeyValue: "She's become quite popular with the locals—they've all gathered around to hear her stories."

3183367928.m_KeyValue: ""If you're after swimsuits, try that stall over there.""

3183367930.m_KeyValue: ""No need to search for me, I'm already here.""

3183367955.m_KeyValue: "'No… The Church… they've come to purge us…'"

3183367956.m_KeyValue: ""'But now Joyce has the answer! If we turn little Bella into a puppet, she'll never be sick again!'""

3183367957.m_KeyValue: "To destroy all that is evil. To crush its seed before it spreads."

3183367958.m_KeyValue: "He didn't know that what awaited him… was his daughter's lifeless body."

3183367959.m_KeyValue: "'What have you done?! We promised to give the sirens a home—and you did all this behind my back?'"

3183367960.m_KeyValue: "Constantine gripped the ice-chilled blade and approached the sink."

3183367962.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, it bleeds with a deep, blood-red hue.""

3183457720.m_KeyValue: ""Then I'm Hati, Pestilence—though I haven't fully mastered that power yet.""

3183457722.m_KeyValue: "Sheila of Pestilence. Ranna of Famine. And I… who am Death. That means only War remains."

3183457723.m_KeyValue: "No wonder it felt strange at the time—he just let Aiona and me leave..."

3183457724.m_KeyValue: "Connected? But there's an entire ocean between them!"

3183457725.m_KeyValue: ""...and she turned her back on Aeon's truth. Thus, she became heir to Dracula's bloodline.""

3183457726.m_KeyValue: "You still believe in stuff like that? You're more of a Heretic than the Heretics themselves…"

3183457727.m_KeyValue: "That direction… it leads to the Blood Moon Seal. So the threads converge after all."

3183457728.m_KeyValue: ""We owe it to Ami's friend. Without them, we wouldn't have landed safely.""

3183457729.m_KeyValue: ""I said it before—once we're past that sea, we're enemies again.""

3183460928.m_KeyValue: "Sir Gadric... we're so sorry... we couldn't avenge you..."

3183460929.m_KeyValue: "But it was your sacrifice that made us realize how meaningless this conflict truly is!"

3183657690.m_KeyValue: ""How naive! Not finishing your enemy, and even letting your guard down!""

3184076956.m_KeyValue: ""Do you even need to ask? It's our protagonist, of course!""

3184408013.m_KeyValue: "You need a key to open this chest!"

3184408145.m_KeyValue: "Upgrade [Hall of Honor] to unlock Quick Dispatch."

3184408304.m_KeyValue: ""After <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style>, collect all other memory fragments to obtain Memento <style=""Highlight"">Torn Pages</style> and enter.""

3184408305.m_KeyValue: "Unlocks when Vassal Fanny reaches Spirit Siphon Tier {0}."

3184659219.m_KeyValue: ""Then again, it's been eleven years. We're not who we were back then.""

3184659220.m_KeyValue: "And not long after… he married one of them. Do you remember? You have a siren sister. Her name is Lorelei."

3184659221.m_KeyValue: "What ails my wife?! How could she have... faded so quickly?"

3184659222.m_KeyValue: ""My mind was numb. Hallon pulled me away and we left the isle. Not long after, the Church dispatched the Bell Ringer. And a tidal wave came—'cleansing' the isle completely.""

3184659225.m_KeyValue: "I'm not like you. I don't need comfort. Only the truth."

3184659250.m_KeyValue: "Miss Lorelei asked me to aid her with a plan—to free her imprisoned kin."

3184659251.m_KeyValue: ""I believe in Lorelei's plan, in the allies she chose, and in her strength... she won't die so easily.""

3184659253.m_KeyValue: "Seems like there's been a lot of terrible lately..."

3184659254.m_KeyValue: ""And he even killed Constantine, one of the Seven Sages?""

3184659255.m_KeyValue: "I'm deeply honored to be part of your dreams."

3184659256.m_KeyValue: "It seems we'll be working together again… for now."

3184659257.m_KeyValue: ""I'm Joyce! Joyce got a name! And this handsome silver-haired man... he must work for that extravagant lady, Ami!""

3184659259.m_KeyValue: ""I still have one deal to complete. I'm waiting—for the result, for 'him' to grant me one last glimpse of my daughter.""

3184659506.m_KeyValue: "I still haven't secured the permit for outdoor performances on the Isle—"

3184659516.m_KeyValue: "W-what is happening? Why is someone dressed like that suddenly shouting in the middle of the street...?"

3184659517.m_KeyValue: ""Let's see... you there—what do you think Ginokio wished for most, after coming to life?""

3184659546.m_KeyValue: ""Listen closely—debts must be repaid, and promises must be kept. That's the first rule of being a proper actor!""

3184659548.m_KeyValue: ""To uncover the mystery of these petals, first stop—let's ask the flower vendor.""

3184659550.m_KeyValue: ""As long as Ami insists her actions at the election were an attempt to seize Lorelei’s position, she can still pass as a ruthless opportunist.""

3184659551.m_KeyValue: "Everyone held at the auction house has been rescued."

3184659578.m_KeyValue: "I beg your pardon... what did you say?"

3184659579.m_KeyValue: ""Anyone who acts without saying a word is just plain strange, Little Bella. Let's steer clear of people like that.""

3184659581.m_KeyValue: "I've poured years into Sapphire Isle... I won't allow anyone to tear it apart."

3184659584.m_KeyValue: "I saw it... she resonated with the Siren's Tear..."

3184659585.m_KeyValue: "The demeanor and appearance... they're subtly different. Could she be the same..."

3184659611.m_KeyValue: ""Owner, where's the silver-haired guest who was staying here?""

3184659615.m_KeyValue: "Ah! So that's what stirred Little Bella's memory—the fragment of her promise with a friend?"

3184659616.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! But Master Van Helsing is so much stronger than I am. If I ever did become one, then he would surely...""

3184659617.m_KeyValue: ""Then on your birthday, I'll bring you a _$$pearl_$$—bigger than the one you wanted, and one you'll love even more.""

3184659639.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you mean that large, elegant one?""

3184659642.m_KeyValue: "This isn't... I understand. Return to your posts—I'll handle it from here."

3184659643.m_KeyValue: "What more is there for your mind to ponder?"

3184659645.m_KeyValue: "I have another one. You should take it too."

3184659646.m_KeyValue: "As expected of Lord Isaac—the true heir of Sapphire Isle!"

3184659647.m_KeyValue: "Actually... there's a rumor whispered among the Seven Sages. That a mysterious... Master is pulling the strings behind everything on the Isle!"

3184659648.m_KeyValue: ""Possibly. But if they truly exist... What are they after? What's worth orchestrating all this—here, on the Isle?""

3184659649.m_KeyValue: "Your mind and will shall be paralyzed forever! Isn't that enough for you to get moving?"

3184659672.m_KeyValue: ""Come, Jacintha. Most beautiful... and most graceful of all.""

3184659673.m_KeyValue: ""This is where we part, Little Bella... It's been a real pleasure working with you today.""

3184659674.m_KeyValue: ""I won't hold it against you—Little Bella, Silver-Haired Boy.""

3184659675.m_KeyValue: "Little Bella! You shouldn't trust strangers so easily!"

3184659677.m_KeyValue: "Before we go... I have one more question."

3184659678.m_KeyValue: ""So it's true... The Master really does possess the means to grant eternal life. Then he'll keep his promise as well, won't he?""

3184659679.m_KeyValue: ""This is a moment that decides the Isle's fate, Lord Hallon. Where is the resolve and clarity you once showed?""

3184659680.m_KeyValue: ""If we allow him to continue moving freely through the Isle, everything you've built... could collapse in an instant.""

3184659681.m_KeyValue: "Any shift in the Isle has already fallen within your expectations."

3184659704.m_KeyValue: "You finally remember. But… the truth may not be so simple."

3184659706.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Isaac, did you find anything? Do you know where Lord Constantine is?""

3184659707.m_KeyValue: "They're Black Blood creatures. Twisted beyond recognition. They could barely string a coherent sentence. Why do I care what they think?"

3184659709.m_KeyValue: "Last week's experiment log was completed by his assistant. Only routine data is recorded."

3184659710.m_KeyValue: "What about Father? Uncle? Those who took care of me? And..."

3184659711.m_KeyValue: "Take the green door in the middle."

3184659712.m_KeyValue: ""And it was your chosen meeting spot. If you hadn't brought me here, no one would've ever noticed it.""

3184659713.m_KeyValue: ""But that was eleven years ago. After a tsunami struck, the Seven Sages funded its reconstruction... And turned the Isle into a coastal paradise.""

3185492984.m_KeyValue: ""After reaching Spirit Siphon Tier 3 with the Vassal, unlocks an interactive feature.""

3188188079.m_KeyValue: "Fires an arrow in a straight line that will eliminate the first unit hit and ignite all torches along its path."

3189024386.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Deal as much DMG as possible to the Inquisitors within the time limit. No score will be recorded if the entire team dies.</style>
Use the Seal <style=""Highlight"">Bloodmoon Shadow</style> and deploy high ATK SPD Vassals to deal higher DMG more easily.
Top Picks: Julius, Timeless Aiona, Gilrain, Acappella""

3189520970.m_KeyValue:
""Many wandering bards roam the continent of Minexus, sharing tales both romantic and dramatic. Among these, none is more beloved or widely spread than 'The Garlic Knight':

Gadric, known as the Garlic Knight, serves as Vice-Commander to Bell Ringer Thibault. He traveled across the civilized lands as a Bloodborn hunter, renowned for his honesty, integrity, and selflessness, refusing to harm any living being except the Bloodborn.""

3189521001.m_KeyValue:
""A tarot deck rests in my room—worn, yet always cherished by the diviner. The cards still hum with the blessing of her gentle, adoptive mother, Esmeralda.

Esmeralda, the fortune teller who once guided sailors through storm-wracked straits, steered them away from marauding pirates, and led the Pontos to its next destined seer.

But something feels... off. Aren't some cards missing? I have to retrieve them—before the diviner notices.""

3189627131.m_KeyValue: "That place is damp and dark. Try recalling it again."

3189945840.m_KeyValue: "It comes at regular intervals. It is this prison's greatest weakness—and our best chance to escape."

3189945841.m_KeyValue: ""You've only revealed the timing of our escape. Unless I'm gravely mistaken, you're still holding back the most vital pieces—our path and our destination.""

3190551586.m_KeyValue: ""Mmm… not bad at all, not bad at all!""

3190551590.m_KeyValue: ""The first sight to greet her is Noah's face, mere inches away.""

3190551591.m_KeyValue: ""A bone-chilling scream rips through the dungeon’s entrance, shattering their exchange.""

3191347004.m_KeyValue: "Wretched mute... Get out of my sight!"

3191347005.m_KeyValue: "More wounds... Did the jailer pay me a visit while I was unconscious?"

3191347006.m_KeyValue: "Seems the prisoners make that 'momu' sound right before a guard enters... Could it mean 'someone's coming'?"

3191347007.m_KeyValue: "Forgetting something? Didn't 'that person' tell you that one needs utensils to eat?"

3191347009.m_KeyValue: ""Learning another language through guesses, trials, and repetition—God destroyed the Tower, yet humans will rebuild it with their own hands, brick by brick.""

3191347036.m_KeyValue: ""To think Joyce gets to be the host! Joyce’s heart is racing, and cheeks are feeling so warm!""

3191347037.m_KeyValue: "Come get your own luggage! Stop dumping everything on me!"

3191347038.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#8f9abf>The more beautifully a flower blooms, the more poignant its withering.</color>""

3191347039.m_KeyValue: ""First, position yourself with the Church soldiers outside the auction house.""

3191347041.m_KeyValue: ""You see? Money should be invested in developing places like Sapphire Isle, not wasted on tasteless statues!""

3191347042.m_KeyValue: ""A waste of space who only knows how to spend his father’s money should try for titles like Wandering Sea Louse, Netted Crab, or Whale Barnacle instead.""

3191347043.m_KeyValue: ""But above all, stop the Church’s soldiers.""

3191347300.m_KeyValue: "I can still drink... for the grand prize!"

3191347302.m_KeyValue: ""A basket of bread, thirty grilled mussels, twenty grilled oysters, and twenty grilled scallops coming right up! Ugh, this smells so good, I want a taste too...""

3191347303.m_KeyValue: ""You want me to pay for the clothes… right? Sorry, but ever since I got here, I've been drowning in debt—I don't even have a single Soli to spare…""

3191347304.m_KeyValue: "Is that all you've got? Even this squid put up more of a fight."

3191347305.m_KeyValue: "If you are not pressed for time."

3191347306.m_KeyValue: "Don't be so guarded. I know your master Van Helsing—we've been through a lot together."

3191347307.m_KeyValue: "You can wear our store's promotional outfit during your stay at the Isle!"

3191347326.m_KeyValue: "Just one million? Who's so poor that they'd make such a fuss over someone spending one million?"

3191347327.m_KeyValue: "O-one million! That's... that would take me 572 years to earn!"

3191347332.m_KeyValue: "The servant just mentioned her name. Couldn't you figure out who she was?"

3191347333.m_KeyValue: "This... can this even be considered clothing? Do I really have to wear something this revealing?"

3191347334.m_KeyValue: "Something that would suit this young lady..."

3191347338.m_KeyValue: "What was it you wanted to ask just now?"

3191347364.m_KeyValue: "None of us want to deal with another kitchen fire in the middle of the night..."

3191347367.m_KeyValue: "On a distant hillside lived a happy flock of little lambs..."

3191347392.m_KeyValue: "<color=#a7675c>I care not for such trivialities. The votes from this meeting are in.</color>"

3191347393.m_KeyValue: ""Why not? She's beautiful, kind, passionate, and wealthy.""

3191347396.m_KeyValue: "Oh right! Last night at the bar... I heard something interesting."

3191347397.m_KeyValue: "So this is the 'business partner' the Seven Sages wanted to introduce to me?"

3191347398.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone's been having strange dreams, but what's more suspicious is that I saw similar scenes in my dream before you even told me about this Mistbound Terror...""

3191347399.m_KeyValue: "...Someone who had been brutally murdered. And then I was chased by a siren-like monster. The whole thing was a blur."

3191347400.m_KeyValue: "Calm down. Sapphire Isle would never permit something as vile as a “disappearance” to happen."

3191347401.m_KeyValue: "What if Master Van Helsing is also... Huh? Where did that Noah go?!"

3191347402.m_KeyValue: "Why would a Bell Ringer come to a place like this?! Do you think we're stupid?!"

3191347403.m_KeyValue: "Don’t worry. I’ll gather the other members of the Seven Sages for a meeting to discuss our response."

3191347429.m_KeyValue: ""They grab people who are alone on the beach, and wait for the tide to slowly drown their prey...""

3191347433.m_KeyValue: "He's a Bell Ringer now. The distance between us keeps growing."

3191347434.m_KeyValue: ""Also, as a member of the Church, we value transparency in the light. Stop following me in secret.""

3191347435.m_KeyValue: ""At least after he concealed his tracks, disguised himself as a traveler, and returned to his homeland only to be drugged by a drink—his destination was this—""

3191347458.m_KeyValue: ""Understood. Next time I want to take a walk, I'll invite Miss Lorelei to join me.""

3191347459.m_KeyValue: "Ah! Could it be... those monsters were the 'Mistbound Terror'? But I didn't see who they killed this time..."

3191347462.m_KeyValue: "Anyway that's not important just read it Silver-haired!"

3191347463.m_KeyValue: "That's it! Master Van Helsing's family crest has two fish and a staff! I heard his family originally made their fortune from fishing."

3191347464.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, are those... bite marks under the olive branch?""

3191347466.m_KeyValue: "It's not about money. But there is a place where you might find the clues you're looking for."

3191347467.m_KeyValue: "...Sell me one more piece of information. I'll pay back what I owe you someday."

3191347490.m_KeyValue: "It is a tear. A dream. A whisper. A song."

3191347491.m_KeyValue: "Master Van Helsing taught me that there is only one way to deal with heretics..."

3191347492.m_KeyValue: ""I, on behalf of the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages, would like to invite you to become the next star to illuminate our isle.""

3191347493.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, if Miss Ami finds them repulsive, we have dedicated staff to manage the slaves.""

3191347495.m_KeyValue: ""And some less noble acts, like your suppression of the slum uprising...""

3191347496.m_KeyValue: "Is this some kind of prank? Did you hire all these people to play along?"

3191347498.m_KeyValue: ""I was following the trending style of Leonardo Ptolemy, who's famous across the continent.""

3191347499.m_KeyValue: ""You make a fair point, Miss Ami. I should dress more appropriately to meet my 'guest.'""

3192212480.m_KeyValue: ""At his zenith, Dracula devised a technique to consummate the Bloodborn around the world, sharing his blood with vassals to make them as formidable as himself. When the Bathory family took power, they found that this technique worked not just for Bloodborn, but any young person, granting them the ability to transfuse blood from their ancestors. Perhaps… all life shares a common origin, after all?""

3192399308.m_KeyValue: "Monsters... The new Lord has sent many monsters to capture us!"

3194373278.m_KeyValue: ""The Ides of April, when green grass grows.""

3194373410.m_KeyValue: "The morning when fierce winds carried a dirge."

3194373476.m_KeyValue: ""Brought to life in a casket. Autumn, 1353.""

3194399484.m_KeyValue: ""You've uncovered that as well? Poking around in a cat's secrets isn't very noble, you know.""

3194543224.m_KeyValue: "Every single day here is fresh and joyful to me!"

3194883487.m_KeyValue: "The key seems to have awakened! Tap the keyhole again to try unlocking!"

3195686929.m_KeyValue: "There's enough land within the Church's territories. Houses too. Acappella will help you. Try to get along with her."

3195686930.m_KeyValue: "But once we're gone... where could we possibly settle?"

3195686932.m_KeyValue: "Don't think I didn't hear that! And stop making promises on my behalf!"

3195689634.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina's strikes come in a storm, leaving me no room to breathe. I can do little more than hold my guard.""

3195689635.m_KeyValue: "I half-expected you to not turn up."

3195689636.m_KeyValue: ""Without another word, Seraphina lifts from the ground, gliding over the treetops until she vanishes into the night.""

3195689728.m_KeyValue: "A shadow of unease flickers across her face."

3195689730.m_KeyValue: ""As for meals, the Church issues us our rations on schedule. Weapons like us have no need to bother with food.""

3195689732.m_KeyValue: "But Seraphina is already waiting beneath the tree."

3195689733.m_KeyValue: ""Tactically speaking, keeping you anxious about my next move would raise my chances of victory—""

3195693455.m_KeyValue: ""I don't think I'll return to see you again, Commander.""

3195693457.m_KeyValue: "The Saint's final order still stands: Eliminate the traitor among the Bell Ringers. Let’s go…"

3195693458.m_KeyValue: "Do you really think that silver-haired fool believes you're nothing more than a longing left behind on Sunset Isle?"

3195693461.m_KeyValue: "I'm just here to return something. Thought I'd lend a hand while I'm at it."

3195693462.m_KeyValue: "Elder Jacintha? How did you get here?"

3195693463.m_KeyValue: "Rest assured. Someone will come to take you home."

3195693464.m_KeyValue: "It's too late! We'll never make it in time!"

3197999542.m_KeyValue: ""Continuously recovers HP while inside its crystal tomb. Upon the destruction of the tomb, they will be re-awakened and join the battle. Prioritize destroying the tomb to prevent its recovery.""

3198164915.m_KeyValue: "Perform Spirit Siphon to increase the level cap."

3201247182.m_KeyValue:
""A fragrant pot of Earl Grey tea served to Vassals. Fancy meal, moderately heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>When the clock strikes four, everything stops for tea.""

3201247183.m_KeyValue:
""A pot of exotic fruit-infused tea paired with delicious snacks served to Vassals. Luxury meal, greatly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>First goes the tea, followed by the milk, then stir from twelve to six. When with friends, feel free to forego the formalities.""

3201247185.m_KeyValue:
""A bland pot of green tea served to Vassals. Simple meal, slightly heightens Affinity.
<alpha=#80>Remember, it's not the tea that matters, but the companionship.""

3201351710.m_KeyValue: ""Gains a Shield equal to <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> of the caster's Max HP for {1} sec. Deals P. DMG equal to {2} of M. DEF to enemies in a 2.5 meter radius around the target, as well as dealing additional P. DMG to the target, equal to {3} Shield Strength. DMG cannot exceed {4} of the caster's current M. DEF.""

3203637911.m_KeyValue: "This child... always so careless. It seems someone needs a little scolding."

3205021422.m_KeyValue: "You heartless wretch... How could you twist your own kin into such abominations..."

3205021423.m_KeyValue: "Do you know what happens when pale and dark clouds converge at the sky's zenith?"

3205640990.m_KeyValue: ""If the commander finds out I let vampires go, I'll be punished. You have my gratitude!""

3205643098.m_KeyValue: "He must have snuck back because he was too worried about Father and didn't want to leave him alone... I have to get back to Mouret right away to help them!"

3208945213.m_KeyValue: "Ugh! I'm on my own again! This mission has been nothing but trouble."

3208945214.m_KeyValue: ""Black Blood can link the consciousness of carriers, forming what's known as the Hive Mind.""

3208945219.m_KeyValue: "My companions fell to such horrors too."

3208945222.m_KeyValue: ""Somehow, our consciousness has become intertwined. I don't understand why.""

3208945225.m_KeyValue: "Does Miss Seraphina also... hate who she's become?"

3208946243.m_KeyValue: ""Without warning, Seraphina takes to the air and vanishes into the forest's depths.""

3208946244.m_KeyValue: "So feeble... I had thought foes within these disaster-stricken area would offer greater resistance."

3208946246.m_KeyValue: ""Had the First not interfered, I would have secured my fortieth consecutive triumph.""

3208946249.m_KeyValue: "Follow the plan. I've got no objections."

3208946250.m_KeyValue: ""Swept away by the gale, Seraphina is hurled into the roiling depths of the Black Mist.""

3210236874.m_KeyValue: ""Letitia collapses to her knees, spent, her vacant gaze fixed upon the ground.""

3210236875.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, who leapt from the island for Seraphina—he was such a soul. Ryan, who charged at you—he was such a soul. And I, too, shall follow in their footsteps.""

3210236876.m_KeyValue: "H-How... How is this possible? How dare you interfere...?"

3210236878.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I hope you still remember how to flap your wings when the time comes.""

3210236880.m_KeyValue: ""Survivors emerge from the ancient castle in a steady stream, their eyes wide with wonder as they take in the world around them.""

3210236881.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, why not seal her alongside the other?""

3210237898.m_KeyValue: "Judgment will be rendered in fifteen days. Whether you are hailed as hero or damned as traitor—the Church will decide."

3210237900.m_KeyValue: ""The torches mounted on the walls wage their desperate battle to snuff out the suffocating darkness of the prison, their flickering light binding Seraphina's shadow to the weeping stones of her cell.""

3210237901.m_KeyValue: "Your claims will require examination of the dead."

3210237904.m_KeyValue: "Please—be careful. Do not let their Black Blood touch you."

3211032375.m_KeyValue: "Have you heard? The nobles' alchemy workshop —it's said to have exploded!"

3211347637.m_KeyValue: ""Bell Ringer No. X, who knows every corner of Sunset Isle like the back of her hand. Rumor has it she has come for the sacred mission entrusted by the Saint—to seal the Calamity.""

3212357017.m_KeyValue: ""Ironic, isn't it? Though I chase the light, the armor I wear is so cold...""

3212357176.m_KeyValue: "Those who dread the dark cannot fathom the Light."

3212362704.m_KeyValue: "I don't recall giving you permission to speak to me so casually."

3212367887.m_KeyValue: ""Light begets shadow, but the shadow holds no allegiance.""

3212368046.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, is that the best you can do?""

3212370220.m_KeyValue: "Even the light can be shrouded by shadows."

3212372235.m_KeyValue: "Every day we live is unique and irreplaceable. Cherish the present moment."

3212372394.m_KeyValue: "This victory belongs to all of us."

3214636221.m_KeyValue: ""Are you two living together now? Is she bullying you again? You know, it's okay to feel sad. You don't have to act tough.""

3214851959.m_KeyValue: "Conflict is what gives stories their power."

3214855769.m_KeyValue: ""The difference, however, is that he chose this path for himself...""

3215889353.m_KeyValue: ""What... what did you say...? This is... too... too... too high, let me... calm down first.""

3215890376.m_KeyValue: ""To be honest, at first I was just a Black Blood patient trying to escape and survive.""

3215890377.m_KeyValue: "Does that count as an instability factor? Shall I eliminate him?"

3215895359.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Is the old-timer thinking of using the silver-hair as a new test subject?"

3215896382.m_KeyValue: ""Ahahaha! You know nothing, you pretentious woman! There are those among the elders who have long wanted Empousa gone. They won't let this chance slip away.""

3215896383.m_KeyValue: ""But even when I was human, I knew to repay kindness.""

3215899450.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't expect... you'd be the calmest one, despite only becoming one of us Bloodborn today.""

3215899451.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it! It must have been Baphomet's doing! Only he, only he would do such a thing, he treated us the same way back then—""

3216079891.m_KeyValue: "Do you always speak so bluntly when prodding at another's wounds?"

3216189870.m_KeyValue: ""Though only eight years old, the boy understood what others could not—if he wished to survive, he would have to create a miracle.""

3216295629.m_KeyValue: "Heheh. You look so adorable when you're desperate. Should I put a collar on you?"

3217110305.m_KeyValue: ""Fires an electric current from its tail, dealing P. DMG to the target.""

3217110308.m_KeyValue:
""Talent: <link=""Tips_ID;10""><#508499><u>Effective Range</u></color></link>. Activates after every {1} Basic ATKs.
<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>. Upon completion, deals P. DMG multiple times to random enemies.""

3217115686.m_KeyValue: "Deals weak M. DMG to the target."

3217115687.m_KeyValue: ""Triggers every {0} Basic ATKs. Blows a bubble that moves toward the target, deals M. DMG upon hitting. The bubble can be destroyed, recovering {2} Bloodsoul when broken.""

3218041624.m_KeyValue: "You mean the other families are already here?"

3218041626.m_KeyValue: "She may already be inside the sealed area."

3218042647.m_KeyValue: "This power of yours... has no hold on me."

3218042648.m_KeyValue: "I think I just went somewhere... weird. Good thing I made it back!"

3218042649.m_KeyValue: ""You look pale, Lady Empousa. What happened?""

3218042650.m_KeyValue: "Because what comes next isn't about to happen. It has happened."

3218202479.m_KeyValue: ""Skilled in striking from afar, this sailor commences self-healing once their HP is low. As the battle unfolds, they swiftly mark targets and deal DMG. It's advised to steer clear of their attack range.""

3218202480.m_KeyValue: ""Proficient in melee combat, this sailor wields a hatchet with deadly precision. Once their HP is low, they commence self-healing. Concentrate fire to eliminate them quickly.""

3218202481.m_KeyValue: "This bat flies forward with blistering speed. Warriors or Defenders are ideal for blocking its swift onslaught."

3218202483.m_KeyValue: ""A formidable soldier of the Silver Cross. Their weighty hammer possesses the ability to strike through targets, impacting enemies positioned behind.""

3218202484.m_KeyValue: ""A bestial creature using blood magic. Their attacks bounce between enemies, and when their <color=#D63536>chant is complete</color>, they deal high DMG to the farthest enemy.""

3218202485.m_KeyValue: "An immensely powerful creature. Its wide-reaching sweeps impacts all enemies in range. It is recommended to counter them with Defenders."

3218202489.m_KeyValue: ""An infected first mate carrying explosives. When their <color=#D63536>chant is complete</color>, they throw a bomb dealing high DMG to surrounding enemies. Interrupt when possible.""

3218202490.m_KeyValue: ""Infected Head Chef excels at dashing attacks. It is recommended to stay out of their attack range, or counter them with Defenders.""

3218202515.m_KeyValue: ""A guard maintaining order on the Isle, they unleash a flurry of flying knives after several Basic ATKs. Mind your positioning.""

3218202516.m_KeyValue: ""A guard maintaining order on the Isle, they have sequential charging skills, each triggering the next. Interrupt their charges.""

3218202518.m_KeyValue: ""A guard maintaining order on the Isle, their Basic ATK creates mist clouds by throwing drinks. Their Special ignites these clouds, dealing damage to units in the mist. Interrupt their charge.""

3218202522.m_KeyValue: "Bob's hook pulls Vassals close to deal strong DMG. Break the hook quickly."

3218288456.m_KeyValue: "But you still asked me to help find the missing page."

3218288458.m_KeyValue: "You'll have to see for yourself... if you manage to find it again."

3218783347.m_KeyValue: "How did they find us? We were so well-hidden before..."

3219333272.m_KeyValue: "Life and eternity are contradictions by nature."

3219333274.m_KeyValue: "What is this place? I know I stepped through the sealed gate... so why am I here?"

3219333281.m_KeyValue: "But if there was a fight... where is everyone?"

3219334297.m_KeyValue: ""Then let me help. Together, we can stop him!""

3219334298.m_KeyValue: ""Cain, you demon! After all the time she spent with you, you truly feel nothing for her at all?""

3219334299.m_KeyValue: ""Just like my dear sister, in that regard… But hear this: when you have the power to change something and choose not to act—""

3219334300.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa... I hate you, I truly do...""

3219334301.m_KeyValue: ""Cain, I... I should have known you were a traitor!""

3219334302.m_KeyValue: "The Elders and Cain will surely select you as the heiress for your _$$great achievements_$$—You'll become the next Mother!"

3219334303.m_KeyValue: "...Don't tell me you've spent so much time with those creatures that you've started thinking like a human?"

3219334305.m_KeyValue: "This memory has existed in our minds since birth."

3221136537.m_KeyValue: ""Remember this: Time is a circle, two faces meeting as one. The beginning is also the end. Therefore—""

3221136538.m_KeyValue: ""Listen. As a cartographer, you have a unique insight into the structures of time and space.""

3221136540.m_KeyValue: """"Therefore"" what? I hate your riddles—at least explain before you go!""

3221137561.m_KeyValue: ""I just came to this era on a whim, behind Grandpa's back. I wanted to see if the stories in those records were true...""

3221137562.m_KeyValue: "And now... I've been involved in this story with no way out..."

3221137563.m_KeyValue: ""A cartographer's principle is to 'record without intervention.' Yet here I am, having recorded nothing while completely intervening in the timeline...""

3221137564.m_KeyValue: "I'm not here to survey at all. I'm just an ordinary person who tries to stop innocent people from dying..."

3221137565.m_KeyValue: "You finished? Save your breath now—you can continue in the elevator."

3221138708.m_KeyValue: "Your death… will set history back on its rightful course!"

3221138713.m_KeyValue: "And you won't find the source of this fire..."

3221138714.m_KeyValue: "Just... the chestplate... It won't be the end of me..."

3221138715.m_KeyValue: ""The truest tragedies are wrought by human malice. And today, Father… I will extinguish this evil for all!""

3221138717.m_KeyValue: "You are the unpredictable force from the future. I nearly forgot what Johannes once told me about."

3221138719.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, please, go to the future with me. If we can...""

3221138720.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... this fire is erupting from the fabric of space itself—I can't trace its source at all..."

3221377573.m_KeyValue: "I had never thought of it that way before…"

3221377575.m_KeyValue: "That someone reached her first—took hold of her before we could."

3221377576.m_KeyValue: "So you see it too—that yearning for the world beyond…"

3221378598.m_KeyValue: ""If you have known this was a cycle, have you never sought to break it?""

3221378599.m_KeyValue: ""Of countless fates, every one casts us as foes.""

3221378601.m_KeyValue: ""The lock yields swiftly to his hand, yet its defeat rouses some unseen alarm.""

3221378602.m_KeyValue: "Quiet—some of us still seek what little rest this pit allows."

3221378604.m_KeyValue: "Enough to know this: your reaction when that woman struck your nerve."

3222419480.m_KeyValue: "Seize her! Take her straight to the dungeon!"

3222419481.m_KeyValue: ""How convenient. I was just thinking of crushing the Ganelon swarm before dealing with you, my treacherous fool... but you've saved me the trouble.""

3222419482.m_KeyValue: "Stay back! None of you will lay a hand on her!"

3222419484.m_KeyValue: ""I have no time for your little games. Let's go, Valora. The rest of you, proceed—""

3222419485.m_KeyValue: "And you've got some feral stray from the Ganelon to guard you... Are you flaunting your betrayal now?"

3222419486.m_KeyValue: "Lord Ezareth of the Ganelon has fallen by my blade. And... I've discovered my mother's whereabouts."

3222419488.m_KeyValue: "I killed him just as you were mobilizing your forces."

3222420504.m_KeyValue: ""But this ritual is insatiable, demanding a perpetual offer of blood to uphold its power.""

3222420505.m_KeyValue: "So that's what the argument between Elder Valora and Father was about…"

3222420506.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Quinn, you're truly perceptive—to piece together this family's hidden truths from the faintest words.""

3222420507.m_KeyValue: "Elder Valora's attempt to sustain the ritual with animal blood is merely a succession of the old master's will."

3222420508.m_KeyValue: "But Elder Tertius... he desires living humans. This stems from both personal grudges and—greater ambitions."

3222420509.m_KeyValue: "How could a mere steward hold such intimate knowledge of the family's most guarded alchemical rituals?"

3222420510.m_KeyValue: "Cain is more than a steward—he used to be the old master's most trusted alchemist."

3222420511.m_KeyValue: "That still fails to explain how you can possibly harness the power of the Calamity merely through alchemy."

3222420512.m_KeyValue: "Harness the Calamity? You give me far too much credit."

3222420513.m_KeyValue: ""The ritual is fragile, fed by fresh blood. So frail that even a child's blow could shatter it—let alone when faced with formidable challengers like you.""

3222429208.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes—your books... you didn't even bring your survey tools... No, this is bad...""

3222429209.m_KeyValue: "At least tell me—where are you going?!"

3222429216.m_KeyValue: "You know full well—only licensed cartographers are permitted to conduct temporal surveys."

3222429219.m_KeyValue: "'Only licensed cartographers are permitted to conduct temporal surveys.' How could anyone not investigate after hearing that?"

3222429221.m_KeyValue: ""You've been eyeing that mapping ruler for weeks, haven't you?""

3222429222.m_KeyValue: ""My allowance is in the second drawer, left side. Use as much as you need.""

3222429223.m_KeyValue: ""I'll be gone for two days—cover for me with Grandfather, please?""

3222430362.m_KeyValue: "But... why is Wolfsbane... marked on your body?"

3222430363.m_KeyValue: "I gather it every day—I'd never mistake it. There's nothing else around here that looks like this."

3222430368.m_KeyValue: "That's right! Wolfsbane is a flower—and one of the most-used medicinal plants in the Lupine Forest!"

3222430369.m_KeyValue: "So the herb you were gathering... was a flower?"

3222430370.m_KeyValue: "You once said... you were caught crossing the border while collecting herbs."

3222430371.m_KeyValue: ""When I was little and had a toothache, Mother would grind it into powder for me. She said it helped with the pain. Maybe it works for headaches too. Here—try it.""

3222430375.m_KeyValue: "Three heart-shaped petals... nearly identical in size... I've seen it before... somewhere..."

3222431386.m_KeyValue: "Johannes... Explain yourself. What is this _$$better cure_$$ you mentioned?"

3222431392.m_KeyValue: "Because... well... we've found a better cure!"

3222431393.m_KeyValue: "Oh? And where is this better cure? Can I see it?"

3222431394.m_KeyValue: "Wait! No! You... you can’t give them that!"

3222431395.m_KeyValue: "Why not? Isn't this the medicine used to treat the plague?"

3222431397.m_KeyValue: ""James, come out! Johannes told me to give contaminated water to the patients and he's hiding their medicine!""

3222431398.m_KeyValue: "Stop asking so many questions! I'll bring it later. Just sit here and watch them."

3222431399.m_KeyValue: "Make sure they drink from this bucket. Got it?"

3222432541.m_KeyValue: "Even if Aeon's holy child descended right now—"

3222432545.m_KeyValue: "Lord Ezareth's orders: we reach the site before the full moon peaks. Now move!"

3222432546.m_KeyValue: "S-Sir! That boy... I think he's James's son—Jamie!"

3222432547.m_KeyValue: ""Oh? Trying to die young, are you?""

3222432549.m_KeyValue: ""Strange... I've only been gone a few days, but things in town feel... off.""

3222432550.m_KeyValue: "Out of the way! This is no place for children!"

3222432551.m_KeyValue: ""Hey—wait, mister! Where are you going with that pitchfork?! That path leads near Bathory territory—it's dangerous over there!""

3222433564.m_KeyValue: "You've been trying so hard to stay strong. I forgot you're still just a child."

3222433568.m_KeyValue: ""Don't tell me the town's out of Wolfsbane again…? It's alright, son. I'll find a way.""

3222433569.m_KeyValue: ""N-no, I was captured… then hunted down… If it weren't for Quinn, I—I'd be dead by now… (sobbing)""

3222433570.m_KeyValue: ""Captured…? Hunted down? Take your time, son. I'm here now.""

3222433574.m_KeyValue: "Wait… Jamie?! What in Aeon's name are you doing here?!"

3222434718.m_KeyValue: "She has my sister's beauty and sharp wit."

3222434719.m_KeyValue: "The mark she left on me... it feels like a final farewell."

3222434720.m_KeyValue: "James said she was a renowned envoy. Someone of her stature would be known if she still lived. But she vanished without a trace."

3222434722.m_KeyValue: "Now that's a curious question. You shouldn't know anything about Nora. So why assume she's dead?"

3222434723.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Ezareth, I've come to ask about Elonora Crowley. Is she... still alive?""

3222434724.m_KeyValue: ""Hey—wait, I never said I wouldn't! There's no way I'm letting you face him alone.""

3222434725.m_KeyValue: ""I know. But he may be the only one who holds answers. You don't need to follow, if you'd rather not.""

3222434726.m_KeyValue: "Do we really have to talk to that old snake? Just hearing his voice makes me ill..."

3222434727.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie, take your father aside. Let him rest—I'll handle this.""

3222435742.m_KeyValue: "But your brother has already died in this war... Do you want more people to share his fate? They might have a brother waiting for them to return home too..."

3222435743.m_KeyValue: "Even... even if we retreat... those Bloodborn won't spare us..."

3222435745.m_KeyValue: "You're young... you didn't see the horrors of twenty years ago. I don't blame you for being drawn to Ezareth."

3222435746.m_KeyValue: ""If... If you hadn't hoarded the lower part of the Moontide Canal, the Ganelons wouldn't have been driven to desperation for water...""

3222435747.m_KeyValue: "Then Lord Ezareth wouldn't have started the war... and my brother would still be alive..."

3222435748.m_KeyValue: "Th-there's another one with pale skin and red eyes—a Bathory Bloodborn!"

3222435749.m_KeyValue: "It's all because of you... this is what became of us..."

3222435750.m_KeyValue: "I can't leave him to the Bloodborn! His remains will be—"

3222435751.m_KeyValue: "Think about it—going now is suicide. We've lost too many already. We're no match for them."

3223869065.m_KeyValue: ""One of the Sapphire Isle Sages, responsible for expanding the Isle's influence and drawing more merchants to trade. Known as the Herald of Paradise.""

3223869066.m_KeyValue: ""After Ami fused with the Calamity _$$Famine,_$$ she became the true ruler of the deep sea. This marks her new form's first venture onto land.""

3223869074.m_KeyValue: ""Claims to be from an organization named the _$$Silver Cross,_$$ which operates under the Tempus Church. He regards commitment to justice as his highest mission.""

3223869076.m_KeyValue: ""One of the Church's Twelve Bell Ringers, she manages the Chamber of War. Believing war can solve all conflicts, she is known as the Goddess of War.""

3229214034.m_KeyValue: "Note: Only Tier 3 and above Equipment can be enhanced."

3230439852.m_KeyValue: "Wait... how am I supposed to get back to the surface?"

3230439853.m_KeyValue: ""The Scourge has been sealed once more, and you were instrumental in that victory.""

3235331594.m_KeyValue: ""Still, I'd say most of the time, he's just the same arrogant, self-absorbed Captain we all knew.""

3235331595.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. Sometimes he'd be so thoughtful, and other times... distant, like a stranger.""

3235331596.m_KeyValue: "Because his attitude toward you would suddenly turn cold... then warm again?"

3235579913.m_KeyValue: "Is she crazy? Doesn't she care about getting hurt?"

3235841466.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Avatar of Calamitous Death as quickly as possible."

3235841467.m_KeyValue: "Hunt down more monsters to gain higher Hunting Points."

3235841475.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the monsters in the Nightmare without delay."

3235841476.m_KeyValue: "Deal as much DMG to enemies as possible."

3235841477.m_KeyValue: "Defeat as many Blood Servants as possible."

3235841480.m_KeyValue: "Defeat the Plague Queen as quickly as possible."

3236057090.m_KeyValue: ""Use <#A65F30>Fanny</color>, feel her power, and defeat all enemies.""

3236057091.m_KeyValue: ""Use <#A65F30>Genevieve</color>, witness her loyalty, and defeat all enemies.""

3236057097.m_KeyValue: "Try to use <#A65F30>Sirene</color> and defeat all enemies."

3236078553.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Earn 1 Hunting Point for each enemy unit defeated. Aim to achieve the highest Hunting Points possible.</style>
Use the <style=""Highlight"">Thick Skin</style> Seal with <style=""Highlight"">Vassals who excel in CRIT Hits</style> to earn more Hunting Points.
Top Picks: Letitia, Seraphina, Van Helsing, Thibault""

3236574978.m_KeyValue:
""The carefully stored hymn robe and sheet music bear witness to the turning point in Acappella's life. She's complained to me about many boring things, but never about singing.

Perhaps only when she's softly singing hymns does the world quiet down to listen to her voice.

Now, my ears too are filled with Acappella's thoughts and worries.

Somewhere along the way, this shared cacophony has gradually been brightened by a young girl's cheerful laughter.""

3236575044.m_KeyValue:
""A mysterious coffin—its contents unknown.

Scrawled across its surface are the names of the Paracelsus family's departed, each one carrying the weight of a young girl's unending longing for her kin.

Despite the sorrowful rumors, this family has not yet been forgotten by the world. For now, it remains deeply engraved in one girl's heart.

And I, too, shall follow the path of her longing—to witness the winding traces they once left behind in this world.""

3236575226.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa remembers the day Aiona suddenly agreed to forge a new ritual tool. She said a mysterious friend had encouraged her. Empousa was overjoyed. That day, Aiona handed her damaged tool to Empousa. She said something strange: _$$The tool had no reason to carry my longing for the past or my defiance of the future._$$ Under the clear sky, she decided it was time to start anew.""

3237866699.m_KeyValue:
""It was after some investigation that I discovered Darcias was also an orphan taken in by Tris. Many years ago, on a moonlit night, Tris was ordered to execute a man condemned as a heretic. At the execution grounds stood a short-haired girl, clutching a curved blade—her father's final memento. When the man died, the little girl bit her lip until it bled, yet shed not a single tear.
Later, the same hands, that had pierced the sword through her father's chest under the moon, taught her to wield the blade he left behind. She was shaped into a great warrior. Those hands would wash away the bloodstains for her after each battle, as if trying to ease the scar left by that night at the execution grounds.""

3241453651.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. Joyce's client is none other than the legendary black cat elder. So, do you have enough Soli to make amends for your theft?""

3241597391.m_KeyValue: "All that surveying must be exhausting. Perhaps you'd like to take a moment's rest?"

3242442501.m_KeyValue: "It hasn't disappeared—it's merely waiting for the next winter's chill."

3242442503.m_KeyValue: ""When it drifts to where it belongs, it will become snow once again.""

3242442504.m_KeyValue: ""Once you've recovered, let's make this our second destination on our journey together.""

3242442505.m_KeyValue: "This is the 'most unique sight' I've ever seen."

3243551870.m_KeyValue: ""I'd say that's a fair call, all things considered.""

3243554048.m_KeyValue: "I've never quite belonged in the castle... so take it as you will."

3243557249.m_KeyValue: ""If this path leads to greater strength, then you have my support.""

3243558404.m_KeyValue: ""It must be done, in this way.""

3243559427.m_KeyValue: "Ah... the pain... is a sign from the divine will!"

3243938104.m_KeyValue: ""It's been days since the pharmacy refund slip arrived, and still no word from Piera.""

3243971865.m_KeyValue:
""Lord Noah,

I hope this letter finds you in good health.
Please accept my sincerest apologies for any discourtesy during our recent encounter.
If you would be so kind as to overlook my prior conduct, I wish to make a humble request.

Yours faithfully,
Darcias""

3244043863.m_KeyValue:
""Greetings,

I am writing to relay the Commander's exact words:

The hymn recital is approaching, and we will need an organ capable of perfectly rendering pieces in G minor. The price is negotiable.

<s>Heaven, is that blood on you? Come here, remove your armor so I can check. Still taking notes? You don’t need to include every word in the letter. Oh, you sweet little perfectionist.</s>

Sincerely,
Darcias""

3244846938.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us unshakable might.'""

3244846939.m_KeyValue: ""'Adhering to ancient and forbidden beliefs, we seek protection from the formidable wild deer, that it may grant us speed of forest wind.'""

3244846946.m_KeyValue: ""Crows that soar above Starfall Valley. After being infected with Black Blood outside the sealed area, the explosive power of their crystalline form reached its limit. Upon death, crystal shards explode from their bodies in a wide swath.""

3244846947.m_KeyValue: ""A spider construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Originally designed to help humans navigate, its sensor has become the most lethal of weapons.""

3244846948.m_KeyValue: ""A spider construct powered by Aqua Vitae. The electricity emitted from its sensors was meant to provide convenience to the city, but now serves as the very cause of its desolation.""

3244846949.m_KeyValue: ""A spider construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Originally designed to clean the streets, it now sees all living beings as targets to be eliminated.""

3244846950.m_KeyValue: "A bee construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Its sensors on the head have lost their communication function and can only receive one-way commands for attacks."

3244846951.m_KeyValue: ""A bee construct powered by Aqua Vitae. Its luminescent components were originally created to provide lights, but have somehow become harbingers of death.""

3244847005.m_KeyValue: ""The Mouret boy cowering behind the Bloodborn girl, clutching tightly to a flower basket fragrant with herbs. He stares at Agnes like a frightened animal, his pants stained with mud, his young face a mixture of fear and defiance.""

3244847012.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious colossus that hunts Colossus Max through the frozen deserts during the Long Night, seemingly burdened with an inescapable mission.""

3244847034.m_KeyValue: "A priest warped by the Black Blood. The defilement of their sacred scriptures has transformed their spells into twisted curses."

3244847035.m_KeyValue: ""A knight grotesquely twisted under the influence of Black Blood. Devoid of faith, their swordsmanship is now tempered by pure insanity.""

3244847044.m_KeyValue: "An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. Its exaggerated spine implies a body terribly distorted."

3244847046.m_KeyValue: ""A peasant residing near the Lupine Forest. The Black Blood infection stripped away their sanity, leaving only a blood-covered scythe as a testament to their madness.""

3244847047.m_KeyValue: ""An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. This creature has lost all semblance of its original form, becoming a monstrous beast.""

3244847048.m_KeyValue: ""A hunter residing near the Lupine Forest. Despite their infection with Black Blood, their archery skills retain a deadly precision.""

3244847049.m_KeyValue: ""A hunter residing near the Lupine Forest. Despite their infection with Black Blood, their archery skills retain a deadly precision.""

3245774169.m_KeyValue: ""<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>, the Plague Nest bursts upon completion, producing two Plague Spawnlings.""

3247322109.m_KeyValue: "Allow me to verify for myself whether the legend of the Moonblessed is mere talk!"

3247322111.m_KeyValue: ""Before Baphomet occupied it, what was its original purpose?""

3247333232.m_KeyValue: ""This is perhaps what they often say—to deceive the enemy, one must first deceive their own.""

3247415522.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't that too severe? Preserving progeny is crucial for the family's revival. Why don't we reduce the severity of punishments? For instance, we could remove 'Exile' and 'Execution' as options.""

3247415619.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, why doesn't Cain ever collaborate with other alchemists in his research?""

3247415786.m_KeyValue: ""The Observatory holds special significance for our family. It was established to observe the Other Side of the Moon. From the changes in the stars, we can read many omens. We should repair it as soon as possible. We mustn't delay such important matters!""

3247415852.m_KeyValue: ""A vassal's worthiness of our respect should not be determined by their origin, but by their actions within our castle.""

3247415918.m_KeyValue: ""I remember that description of the 'Other Side'! 'Time in the Other Side flows parallel to our reality, its space intertwines with our own. The secret of 'eternal life' may be hidden within.'""

3247415949.m_KeyValue: ""They say these 'Future Artifacts' don't belong to this era, but for some reason, they were misplaced on this continent. Hmm... there must be more to this story!""

3247415984.m_KeyValue: ""I've noticed that even the alchemical ingredients they use are quite unusual. Things like mistletoe, beryl...""

3247416015.m_KeyValue: "It's definitely worth a try! Alchemy can not only enhance our Blood power but also create various everyday items!"

3247416081.m_KeyValue: ""These meteor fragments look completely unremarkable, and according to our family's senior alchemist, they cannot be refined into anything useful.""

3249377731.m_KeyValue: ""Rather, it is you... who cannot forget the taste of my blood.""

3249415712.m_KeyValue: "It brings me comfort to know that the Bathory bloodline now serves under new leadership—someone wise enough to leave old ways behind and lead with a clearer vision."

3249516230.m_KeyValue: "Th-thank you… I didn't think… it'd feel like this…"

3251078514.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong? Hey, look, I won't think any less of you because of this little 'flaw.'""

3251078515.m_KeyValue: "Odd... we should have reached it by now. The village wasn't this far away."

3251078517.m_KeyValue: ""After hearing our plea, the Church took it very seriously. They even sent a Bell Ringer to handle the matter.""

3251078519.m_KeyValue: ""What's that supposed to mean? Sure, we're just a tiny village on some far-flung island, but I'm still the Captain of the Guard, you know!""

3251078546.m_KeyValue: "What? One of us is a phantom?"

3251078547.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah, for someone to become a phantom, doesn't that mean they've died?""

3251078549.m_KeyValue: "'The blood before us is the guidance left by our forebears; the shadow behind us is the resolve set for our descendants...'"

3251078550.m_KeyValue: "...In the name of Paracelsuses... I offer forth this life as sacrifice to the legacy...'"

3251078572.m_KeyValue: ""Even when afraid, you didn't back down; knowing you could die, you never even considered giving up. You possess something we don't...""

3251078573.m_KeyValue: ""They possess an innate battle instinct and are devoid of fear—in essence, they are perfect war machines.""

3251078578.m_KeyValue: ""No, it was all my doing! Master had absolutely nothing to do with this!""

3251078579.m_KeyValue: "...Is to deal with traitors who blaspheme against the Church and its mission."

3251078580.m_KeyValue: "I would strongly advise against opening that coffin."

3251078581.m_KeyValue: "Noah... I must go... go and save him!"

3251078583.m_KeyValue: "A mere child who just turned twenty right under my nose... Why... Why are you suddenly taller than me? Why..."

3251078584.m_KeyValue: "The last Gravekeeper of the Paracelsus family. This is my destiny and duty."

3251078585.m_KeyValue: "But didn't you say that only Bell Ringers have access to that part of the cathedral?"

3251078605.m_KeyValue: "Acappella was born with hearing far beyond that of normal humans."

3251078610.m_KeyValue: ""You've figured it out too, haven't you, Piera?""

3251078611.m_KeyValue: ""I'm a Bell Ringer, and you're a 'weapon' that can just swap to a new body, idiot. As for Piera...""

3251078612.m_KeyValue: ""Silver hair... You know Noah too, Acappella?""

3251078613.m_KeyValue: "The 'Head'... Does that mean the Church... knows the appearance and whereabouts of every Divine Body?"

3251078614.m_KeyValue: "It was his presence... he gave me the strength to face my destiny."

3251078615.m_KeyValue: ""Should the true identity of this Noah align with my fears, it would be too much for that child.""

3251078616.m_KeyValue: ""But the Bathorys turned to the Calamity in their obsession for 'eternal life.' As a result, they were destroyed by the Church.""

3251078617.m_KeyValue: ""I told you, I won't stand in your way, nor will I take part in your mission. But for everything else, I can help.""

3251078639.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, what burden must a girl bear to willingly sacrifice her life and tap into the uncontrollable power of the Covenant?""

3251078643.m_KeyValue: "We can fulfill the shared wish of countless generations of Gravekeepers. Death... we can..."

3251078644.m_KeyValue: "Noah... our agreed-upon gesture... was it also fated?"

3251078645.m_KeyValue: ""No, not one Gravekeeper on this island has ever laid eyes upon the true form of the Divine Body. It was Death, long portrayed as our enemy, who was actually—""

3251078646.m_KeyValue: ""Piera! It's you! You're little Piera, right? Hahaha!""

3251078647.m_KeyValue: "People are made up of their 'thoughts' and 'longings.'"

3251078648.m_KeyValue: ""So Piera, what brings you back here this time? Don't tell me you just came to see me?""

3251078649.m_KeyValue: ""The Gravekeepers are our family's heroes, chosen by the Divine Body to battle against the Calamity across generations. And what's passed down isn't just knowledge and power...""

3251078670.m_KeyValue: ""It's all thanks to you, Piera. I didn't know you could use Covenant... I've only seen the Church's elite use it before.""

3251078671.m_KeyValue: ""He said he could modify my salt stake to serve as a medium that would allow ordinary people to master the Covenant, unleashing the true power of this 'perfect form.'""

3251078674.m_KeyValue: "We stand no chance... Life cannot triumph over Death."

3251078676.m_KeyValue: ""I don't think your judgment was wrong. Without outside intervention, Death's dominion over Sunset Isle would likely have been even worse.""

3251078677.m_KeyValue: ""I entrusted you to him, only for him to teach you this forbidden ritual! And even more infuriating...""

3251078678.m_KeyValue: "The 'blessed grounds'... a forbidden place I'd only heard of in scary stories..."

3251078679.m_KeyValue: "Twenty years of living a normal life... that's enough... I should be content with that."

3251078680.m_KeyValue: "The shadow behind us is determination to protect our descendants..."

3251078681.m_KeyValue: "Do you understand what you're doing? This forbidden ritual requires a 'living sacrifice.'"

3251078708.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you promise me we'd meet back at the village no matter what?"

3251078709.m_KeyValue: ""Why... Ever since I set foot on these 'blessed grounds,' the pain and anger inside feel like they're about to pour out...""

3251078711.m_KeyValue: "When I... die... the ritual... will... complete... The entire island will be..."

3252075589.m_KeyValue: "And since you reject eternal life offered by the endless night... Farewell."

3252075590.m_KeyValue: ""Joan will return, forged in absolute loyalty. She'll never abandon us again.""

3252075591.m_KeyValue: "W-What are you saying? How could Joan...?"

3252450123.m_KeyValue: "An enhanced CPU built for harsh conditions."

3252650298.m_KeyValue: "It seems you attacked us in the depths of the forbidden grounds to protect Hati before she was even born."

3252650299.m_KeyValue: ""_$$To be honest, I used to feel so frustrated. Finally gaining power only to discover that those I wanted to protect were already gone._$$""

3252650300.m_KeyValue: "It seems you have already delivered my message to him."

3252650301.m_KeyValue: "_$$The chains_$$... So that's what it meant?"

3253264840.m_KeyValue: ""We grew up together, and I'll never be able to face Mr. Clive if anything happens to you.""

3253264843.m_KeyValue: ""And I've heard enough. If you're scared, you're free to leave. We need to find Father and rescue the townspeople.""

3253264845.m_KeyValue: ""Damn... How did things end up like this? Father, please be safe...""

3253264873.m_KeyValue: ""Allowing those whose minds have been completely consumed by the Black Blood to return to eternal sleep shouldn't go against my pacifist principles, right?""

3253264874.m_KeyValue: ""When Hati was little, you always sang her this nursery rhyme. Even I know it now, though I'm a bit off-key.""

3253265137.m_KeyValue: "Every path in Lupine Forest looks the same. Can we really find the Ganelon residence without getting lost?"

3253265138.m_KeyValue: "What is this? A pack of wolves attacking... a guy dressed like a garlic?"

3253265139.m_KeyValue: ""I'm looking for someone. I can't waste time here, I must find Hati!""

3253265170.m_KeyValue: "We don't need to explain anything to you. I'll ask one time: Are you going to get out of the way or not?"

3253265173.m_KeyValue: "...And who's that commander he spoke of? I hope we don't run into any more weirdos."

3253265200.m_KeyValue: "'Hidden in the moon by the wicked wolf.'"

3253265201.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Where'd he go? Wasn't he right beside me just now?"

3253265204.m_KeyValue: ""You said the Church attacked your town, which means we're both being targeted by them.""

3253265206.m_KeyValue: "Did they just call her Hati? Could she be the one Gadric is looking for?"

3253265207.m_KeyValue: ""Listen, you! Do you just believe everything you hear? Can't you use that tiny brain of yours to think for yourself?""

3253265236.m_KeyValue: ""But you're in pain, aren't you? Your body no longer belongs to you, and worse, you can't remember the people you cherish...""

3253265237.m_KeyValue: ""Stupid wolves will be stupid wolves. Believing everything the Church says, refusing to face reality even now.""

3253265239.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously, don't you know that those infected with Black Blood are hard to kill? You need to stay on your toes!""

3253265269.m_KeyValue: "It's that wretched girl who just fled with a group of people!"

3253265270.m_KeyValue: "Clive? What... what have you done to him?!"

3253265271.m_KeyValue: ""Sis, who are these people? Are they your friends?""

3253265299.m_KeyValue: "Father often said he hoped I could live like Wolfsbane..."

3253265300.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, if that stuff really worked, the Black Blood disease would've been wiped out by now.""

3253265301.m_KeyValue: ""So... Father is probably at these forbidden grounds, or rather—""

3253265302.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps those two things aren't mutually exclusive."

3253265303.m_KeyValue: ""One day, a man named Noah will come to Mouret. Bringing him to the Ashen Garden is our family's destiny.""

3253265328.m_KeyValue: "Yes! We're all in grave danger if we stay here!"

3253265331.m_KeyValue: "So you didn't recognize me at first? Is it because of this robe?"

3253265332.m_KeyValue: ""The Church appoints a Gravekeeper for each of the twelve families, chosen from the most formidable members of each bloodline.""

3253265333.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Big bro Noah, are you... are you giving me your sword?""

3253265335.m_KeyValue: "Forget about Gadric... Why does Father keep so many secrets from me?"

3253344336.m_KeyValue: "Eh? Having a birthday once a year... isn't that perfectly normal?"

3253488076.m_KeyValue: "I can hear the displeasure and mockery in your voice."

3254159654.m_KeyValue: "Consider this tale the price of a drink. What I want to know is the _$$seventh tale_$$ of Bell Ringer Agares Brennholt."

3254159655.m_KeyValue: "The price of a drink... Those words remind me of someone dear—the Second Princess of Carrelle. The one who died with me in the fire."

3254159656.m_KeyValue: "We're getting off track. Why don't we try interpreting the _$$five decrees_$$ and _$$six wings_$$ together..."

3254159657.m_KeyValue: "Hm? What's this? You're in the mood to buy me a drink?"

3254159658.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Seven drops of blood to stir what's yet ahead, and death shall be the place he makes his bed._$$""

3254159660.m_KeyValue: "She was quite the drinker... Tell me—among those _$$ghosts_$$ who told you stories about me... Was she one of them?"
