3254841744.m_KeyValue: ""You have always been able to see the world through my eyes. Now, at last, I can see yours as well.""

3254841841.m_KeyValue: "Growth is the process of discovering oneself."

3254844850.m_KeyValue: "You're using your precious resources on me? Hmm..."

3254844943.m_KeyValue: ""Don't tug on my scarf... Ah, it's coming loose! Waahhh...""

3254850440.m_KeyValue: "For my next reward... I'd like to fall asleep together and dream."

3254852490.m_KeyValue: ""If this were the end of my life, I would still want to use all my strength... to offer you one last dance.""

3254853639.m_KeyValue: "So this is how the plants feel when I touch them..."

3254854788.m_KeyValue: ""The gods are merely tools to reach the future. And as tools, there must be someone to wield them.""

3254854885.m_KeyValue: ""Phew, this fiery passion is getting intense!""

3254855689.m_KeyValue: "My hair... my cheek... will you continue...?"

3254856838.m_KeyValue: ""I can't remember who I am, but... I don't think I belong to the Church.""

3254857987.m_KeyValue: "The sensation of your touch... I shall engrave it deeply in my heart."

3257001776.m_KeyValue: ""When HP falls below {0}%, enters an Awakened state and enhances all Special effects.""

3257945385.m_KeyValue: "How dare a mere servant of that insolent Empousa raise her voice against me!"

3257945386.m_KeyValue: ""From the very beginning, they never intended to engage with us as equals. Is this hubris also one of your tenets?""

3257945391.m_KeyValue: ""Not only has she violated the Third Tenet by using her blood to create another Bloodborn, she has also broken the First Tenet of Secrecy!""

3257945392.m_KeyValue: "Exposing herself and the family to the Bell Ringers! This sin can only be atoned by death!"

3257945393.m_KeyValue: ""However, the fact remains that our sworn enemies—the Church's Bell Ringers—are closing in, an imminent threat we must prepare for.""

3257945394.m_KeyValue: "Then all the more reason to punish Empousa!"

3257945395.m_KeyValue: "Her body...? What do you intend for the young lady?!"

3257945397.m_KeyValue: ""Though I'm no genius, that armored man so eager to kill Empousa must be the traitor Cain mentioned.""

3257946539.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet lost his physical body after being defeated by an ancient Bloodborn, and has since relied on anchoring his soul to various armor.""

3257946540.m_KeyValue: ""I heard another elder say that Baphomet experimented on living flesh, could it be that...""

3257946545.m_KeyValue: ""I am also the last surviving member of the Aegis family, who were tortured and killed in Baphomet's experiments.""

3257946546.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel Aegis, a warrior aspiring to follow the Moonblessed and ascend to the promised home.""

3257946547.m_KeyValue: "But that elder in black armor dismissed it as mere nonsense and imprisoned me here."

3257946548.m_KeyValue: ""You... you know Aiona, Aiona Alita!? She's...""

3257946549.m_KeyValue: "Do you have a grudge against him too?"

3257946550.m_KeyValue: ""Black armor... You mean that demon, Baphomet?!""

3257947571.m_KeyValue: ""Anyway, with my connection to Empousa and your familiarity with the route, we should be able to easily find the cell where she's kept.""

3257948718.m_KeyValue: ""But it was a good time for Jestel to interrupt, there are more important things to do...""

3257948720.m_KeyValue: "This noisy redhead really can't read the atmosphere..."

3257948721.m_KeyValue: "Following the Moonblessed to find the promised home has been my childhood dream!"

3257948722.m_KeyValue: "Lady Empousa! I am Jestel from the Aegis family. It is my great honor to serve the Moonblessed!"

3257948723.m_KeyValue: "C-Connection? What connection are you talking about?"

3257948724.m_KeyValue: "But our connection... There's no way I could let you face it all alone."

3257948725.m_KeyValue: ""You don't get it at all! In this family, anyone could be my replacement...""

3257948726.m_KeyValue: ""Would have wasted all that effort, you big idiot!""

3257949747.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa, be careful! They are not Lamia!""

3257949749.m_KeyValue: ""How could this be... they are not 'complete' yet, why, who let them out?!""

3260494519.m_KeyValue: "And what has that to do with me?"

3260494521.m_KeyValue: ""You're sharp in some ways, but in others, you're still just a child.""

3260494522.m_KeyValue: "Because—children shouldn't ask so many questions. Sleep."

3261306397.m_KeyValue: "I assumed you and Miss Alita were quite close. Surely you must know what the wheel can do?"

3261690388.m_KeyValue: ""No worries, I just heard singing coming from Empousa's room, but it didn't sound like her voice, so I sent Feuler to ask about it.""

3261786176.m_KeyValue: ""And facing her now—the prized wolves of the Decimus Arena! Blood-drunk beasts clad in iron, bred only for slaughter.""

3261786177.m_KeyValue: ""How wonderful and yet, why does my heart not soar as I thought it would?""

3261906126.m_KeyValue: ""I've been reading mythology, tragedies, comedies... all at Noah's recommendation.""

3262432837.m_KeyValue: ""Increases Bloodsoul Recovery by {0} and M. DMG by {1}, stacking up to {2}. Cannot be dispelled.""

3263134058.m_KeyValue: "That's what happens when your authority was never solid to begin with."

3263244037.m_KeyValue: "Establishing contact with entities from the past marks the first phase of observation. It appears you're now one step closer to the _$$reward_$$ I have prepared for you."

3263436269.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be fooled by his laid-back attitude. I'll have you know he's one of the twelve <style=""Highlight"">Bell Ringers</style>, the highest-ranking members of the Church.""

3263436270.m_KeyValue: "Thank you. You're very skilled at treating wounds."

3263436272.m_KeyValue: ""I hope the next time we cross paths, it won't be as enemies.""

3263437293.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">The moon is but a dream of the sun</style>, and thus we were forgotten by the light—""

3263437294.m_KeyValue: ""Ha! Look at the pathetic state the <style=""Highlight"">Black Blood</style> has left him in. After we capture him, maybe they'll make us Bell Ringers!""

3263977607.m_KeyValue: "Expeditions reset daily. Remember to claim your Mission Rewards and dispatch Vassals for a new round of expeditions each day."

3264727925.m_KeyValue: ""If we survive all of this, I'll be more than happy to learn how to control the Black Blood from you.""

3264727927.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) Let's cross the bridge first, then worry about the rest.""

3264728948.m_KeyValue: ""The soldiers are blocking the way, but I can't go back... Have to find someplace to hide!""

3264981113.m_KeyValue: ""So, Ami—you wanted to be a cook and a sailor?""

3265049914.m_KeyValue:
""From shifting sands emerges the Shade of Empousa, luring Aiona toward the edge of time.
'Aiona, come with us!'""

3265050024.m_KeyValue: ""A sailor with a machete in hand, seemingly in recognition of Noah—but not in a friendly way.""

3265050025.m_KeyValue: "The Calamity _$$Plague_$$ was sealed by the Ganelon family for generations and is now believed to be the root cause of the Black Blood pandemic afflicting the continent."

3266509616.m_KeyValue: "Timed Event - Far Side of the Moon"

3266581784.m_KeyValue: ""All Bloodborn, no matter how young, stand to gain powerful abilities by transfusing their blood with that of the ancients.""

3269004674.m_KeyValue:
""The energy concealed within the Artifact hugely enhances the capabilities of Vassals.
<alpha=#80>A small metal dial with circular scales and two needles marking the cycle of day and night. Only Ancestral Nobles and esteemed Church members could possess such a gadget in ancient times.""

3269299267.m_KeyValue:
""Faced with comrades infected by the Black Blood, Setti raised her bow, only to lower it again.

If the Black Blood was divine punishment for the unfaithful, why had it taken those most devout?

Why had Agares, so long withdrawn, returned now and decided to oversee the interrogation?

In that instant, I saw Setti's fingers tremble on the bowstring—then steady once more.

_$$Forgive me. I will grant you release._$$

_$$And I swear, my arrows will uncover the truth._$$

She let us live, bearing a blood debt that was never hers. Then turned her back to confront the Church's deceit and the secrets shrouding Agares—

Even knowing the path ahead led only into unending darkness.""

3269299360.m_KeyValue:
""With Goldland's silent approval, Ami is allowed access to most rooms aboard the El Dorado. Even so, she still longs for the day she can set foot on land.
Perhaps that's why she drew this image—a small bird in a cage. Now that the bird has been set free, will it miss the cage it once called home? I have no idea.""

3269299391.m_KeyValue:
""A bloodbath, a murder, a sin—before boarding the ship, I never imagined it would come to this.

Perhaps the wicked maid, the prideful Captain, or the ship's uncanny air were all signs, and it was doomed to be an ill-fated voyage.

We are all seekers of our true selves. And perhaps the El Dorado will carry us to the Other Side, where answers await.""

3269299426.m_KeyValue:
""While her story is expected to end perfectly with a return to the moon, the beginning of Aiona's story is marred with ink. She rarely speaks of her origins, yet in the fragments she offers, there is a quiet discomfort whenever the word parents arises.

_$$My parents gave me this mortal form—and with it, they forged my fate. It is a past and a future I cannot escape._$$

Some say Aiona's mother did not possess a human form.""

3269299484.m_KeyValue:
""Turning a blind eye to her kin? It's fine, just biding time. Ending her mother's life? It's fine, it was mercy.

As long as she could exact revenge on Baphomet, anything would be worth it—but she couldn't even land a single punch.

Perhaps... Jess was just a coward.

She raised her shield in the name of protection, yet protected no one; her patient endurance for revenge was merely an excuse to stay alive.

The coward no longer raises her shield. She sits by the window, repeatedly caressing a tiny shield.""

3269299581.m_KeyValue:
""The rest of the story is likely familiar to all.

She descended like an arrow loosed from its bow. Like Death's bat servant, she landed at the coachman's neck.

_$$The moon is but a dream of the sun, and thus we were forgotten by the light._$$

She was beautiful as she sang at the cliff's edge, yet her song etched an eternal question in the hearts of those who heard.

When someone vanishes, are they erased from the world? I'm not certain, but I know I will remember her from tonight.

My answer seemed to move her. Before the stake, she sank her fangs into my neck and took my blood.

My vision turned scarlet, just like the flowers in her basket. I wonder if my answer helped resolve her doubts.""

3269299639.m_KeyValue:
""Everyone desires immortality, yet when life extends beyond a certain point, it becomes more of a curse than a blessing. Thus, for someone like Cain who has lived far too long, learning new things became a sort of game to pass the time.
After joining the Church, Alchemy became his new passion. Whether he joined the Church to learn Alchemy or learned Alchemy after joining the Church remains a mystery. Regardless, it is an undeniable fact that he studied the forbidden art of Alchemy while holding a religious position, which resulted in this Alchemy Handbook.""

3269618688.m_KeyValue: ""The castle stands well. It's quieter now, but under the guidance of the Hall of the Elders, order remains.""

3269723387.m_KeyValue: "Oh? I never thought this carriage would truly come to a halt. Now… who could have managed such a feat?"

3269723388.m_KeyValue: "The cruel irony: no common means will ever free you both from that temporal prison."

3269723395.m_KeyValue: ""Come with us, Fanny. Leave this place behind. Genevieve, now!""

3269723396.m_KeyValue: ""Ahhh—!!! Pain... more pain... only through agony can I forget my sins, even for a moment...""

3269723397.m_KeyValue: ""If a bird abandons its cage, then what becomes of the cage?""

3269723398.m_KeyValue: ""Yet you sense all that unfolds within these walls—our whispered plots, the guards' movements, the prisoners' routines...""

3269723399.m_KeyValue: "What—what's happening?! Why is the whole place shaking like this?!"

3269723401.m_KeyValue: ""But it matters not—one day, I'll catch up to you. I'll find my way back to your side.""

3269724419.m_KeyValue: ""This is a prison, not your playground. Show some restraint, or we'll have another demon like you on our hands.""

3269724420.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, yes—I nearly forgot. You are the man purified by holy flame upon the pyre, countless times. To you, ordinary pain must serve as nothing more than a needle prick.""

3269724421.m_KeyValue: ""Now you see. This is the Tempus Church's Ironfist Gaol, governed entirely by its 'laws' and 'weapons'.""

3269724422.m_KeyValue: ""I know you won't waver, Noah. All the same, be cautious with that girl—her fixation on you is dangerous.""

3270213982.m_KeyValue: ""A ticket to nowhere. Who will it choose, and what lies ahead?""

3270213983.m_KeyValue: "What do you want to buy? A warden... then that alone isn't enough. Blood—Joyce needs more blood."

3270213984.m_KeyValue: ""Joyce loves generous customers, but trust is something even Joyce can't buy.""

3270213985.m_KeyValue: ""Shiny things are Joyce's favorite. What to trade them for? Food, water, or perhaps... a chance to escape.""

3270213988.m_KeyValue: ""Only one ticket, only one chance. Who will you free from this cage?""

3270213989.m_KeyValue: ""A prisoner claims this ticket hails from a grand, golden vessel.""

3270330167.m_KeyValue: "What unsettles Noah most is Ryan's gaze settling on him and Seraphina."

3272545672.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I'm terrified of those things in the castle... if you won't agree, I'll find the courage to survey it myself!""

3272545679.m_KeyValue: "Missing out is the norm in life."

3272545680.m_KeyValue: "You're a talent that can't be missed."

3272545681.m_KeyValue: ""We're not finished here yet, Lord. Keep moving!""

3272545682.m_KeyValue: "North of the castle lies a village called Elfriede."

3272545685.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare try that 'read but don't reply' trick on me—I know exactly where your castle is."

3272653099.m_KeyValue: "An advanced chassis with a slightly different performance focus compared to Type I."

3273653071.m_KeyValue: "(How can Feuler suddenly detect the sender's location? And this _$$past self_$$... is that referring to me? Is he really my future self?)"

3276759738.m_KeyValue: ""The mountain path winds treacherously upward, each ledge threatening to crumble beneath my steps.""

3276759739.m_KeyValue: "That's enough. Forget I ever said it."

3276759740.m_KeyValue: "You can see it yourself—this face that doesn't smile or cry."

3276759742.m_KeyValue: "The ground hurtles toward me as gravity claims me."

3276759744.m_KeyValue: "I only acted because I thought you'd splatter into a bloody mess…"

3276759746.m_KeyValue: ""And from that moment, they remain bound for life, sworn to their destined foe until death lays claim to them both.""

3279071303.m_KeyValue: "Support 'Freedom to Go Into the Long Sleep'"

3279110629.m_KeyValue: "I must go. Those wretched pests have returned."

3279747836.m_KeyValue: "An old warhorse passed down from the former head of Aegis. She said it would carry me toward the family's future."

3279747902.m_KeyValue: ""In the name of the Aegis, eliminate the enemy!""

3279750942.m_KeyValue: "Shall I remind you of your next move?"

3279751035.m_KeyValue: ""Clearly, you require instruction in noble conduct.""

3279756532.m_KeyValue: "This is the duty of the Alitas… and my fate to bear."

3279756598.m_KeyValue: ""The past, without end, becomes this moment. And the future, without limit, begins from here.""

3279756629.m_KeyValue: "As I am now… can I truly withstand the erosion of time?"

3279758772.m_KeyValue: "I shall traverse every realm beneath my stride!"

3279758803.m_KeyValue: "Everyone here seems to have such fascinating ‘stories.’"

3279759638.m_KeyValue: ""Even in silence, you continue to yield unexpected variables. A most fascinating discovery.""

3279759731.m_KeyValue: "You desire to partake in my experiments?"

3279760946.m_KeyValue: ""Wind guides, shadow strikes, and my arrows won't fall behind.""

3279760977.m_KeyValue: "Feels like my cooking's almost as sharp as my assassinations!"

3279761812.m_KeyValue: "Is this... a new ritual of the Hall of the Elders?"

3279761971.m_KeyValue: ""Where my heart leads, there lies my home.""

3279763986.m_KeyValue: "Come closer. Don't be afraid of how I look."

3279764079.m_KeyValue: "Few have touched the blade of the Mistbound Terror… None of them still draw breath."

3279766129.m_KeyValue: "Bella: If you don't hold tightly to what you cherish… time will wear it away."

3279766160.m_KeyValue: "Bella: So this is what growing up feels like…"

3279766319.m_KeyValue: "Bella: Take my thoughts with you… and keep walking forward."

3283490447.m_KeyValue: ""I have no underlings. Those who fight beside me are companions—bound not by orders, but by shared will.""

3283490448.m_KeyValue: ""We're merely telling stories, Doctor. And what are stories without a little imagination?""

3283490449.m_KeyValue: "And to think the two of you were bound so closely... Good thing that little dream has ended."

3283490450.m_KeyValue: "You claimed there are few in this world who surpass you—and that Saint Seth was one such soul."

3283490451.m_KeyValue: ""I must commend you… Miss Ressa, the Saint's Left Hand, and Noah, the Greatest Calamity—your balance of poise and precision is admirable.""

3283490452.m_KeyValue: "Mind your own business! Whatever's between me and the Commander—I'll settle it myself!"

3283491467.m_KeyValue: ""Please rest assured, I have already prepared an entire Kingdom's population to serve as both your sustenance and servants...""

3283491468.m_KeyValue: "I care nothing for the immortality and beauty you desire. Being Bloodborn or human makes no difference to me."

3283491469.m_KeyValue: "You think you can trap three Bell Ringers? Ressa and Yggdrasill could break your spatial prison without breaking a sweat!"

3283491470.m_KeyValue: "Are you underestimating me?! What's happening... what's happening to Starfall Valley?!"

3283491471.m_KeyValue: "Now that's the answer I was looking for—"

3283491472.m_KeyValue: ""Do you see it... life burns, and time turns to ash.""

3283491473.m_KeyValue: "I feel no relief... no warmth... there's nothing here. I can't feel anything at all."

3283491474.m_KeyValue: ""—If I disappear, would you remember me?""

3283491475.m_KeyValue: "Just ignore Lifeless Eyes. He's the type who jumps at any chance to show off his useless knowledge."

3283491476.m_KeyValue: "As long as blood flows through their veins—regardless of its color—it is all water. And..."

3285406073.m_KeyValue: "Let me use my Ultimate. I can precisely lock onto a single target."

3292254677.m_KeyValue: ""Every compromise of his principles, every betrayal of his own conscience in building that manor—it was all for the family he left behind in the kingdom.""

3292254678.m_KeyValue: ""He raised me, and I know him better than anyone else ever could—there is no pure evil in his heart. The Manor of Eternal Flame... it was nothing more than a task forced upon him by his superiors.""

3292254685.m_KeyValue: ""You must understand—normally, knights can only wait outside the chapel doors, never permitted to set foot inside. That's why I brought you along.""

3292254686.m_KeyValue: "You mean... you want to use threats to get close to him? What are you planning?"

3292254687.m_KeyValue: ""I've considered this possibility, of course... but it's far from the best solution.""

3292254688.m_KeyValue: ""If that bishop is the mastermind behind the Manor of Eternal Flame, why not just eliminate him?""

3292254689.m_KeyValue: ""Right now, our best option is to seize control of the Manor of Eternal Flame ourselves. Only then can we stop this tragedy at its very beginning.""

3292254690.m_KeyValue: ""Killing him would only delay the Manor of Eternal Flame's construction. The seeds of catastrophe have already taken root in the hearts of those who hold power—sooner or later, someone else will rise to rebuild it.""

3292254691.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to your blade's menace, that bishop revealed his inner weakness through fear after I sent you away.""

3292254692.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying you've already seized control of the Manor of Eternal Flame?"

3293397315.m_KeyValue: ""I'd like you to meet my grandfather, Clive—he's the president of the Cartographers' Association.""

3293397316.m_KeyValue: "I had this drafting ruler custom-made based on mine. It's yours."

3293397317.m_KeyValue: ""Precisely! Cartographers shoulder the sacred duty of chronicling the ages, journeying across worlds and through time itself. We require more than exceptional skill—we must possess unshakeable character that can weather any trial.""

3293397318.m_KeyValue: "Why does that sound suspiciously like Agnes's three great virtues?"

3293397319.m_KeyValue: ""What matters most is that during my carefully designed second assessment, you embodied the three cardinal virtues of every cartographer—integrity, wisdom, and honesty.""

3293397320.m_KeyValue: ""Yet none of that truly matters. When I first became a cartographer, I lacked those very same qualities.""

3293397321.m_KeyValue: ""During that castle survey, you displayed the rare qualities of a true cartographer—meticulous attention to detail, exceptional artistry, and formidable power.""

3293397328.m_KeyValue: ""You just said... that you don't come from this era, that you came specifically from another timeline to conduct surveys.""

3293397329.m_KeyValue: "The Cartographers' Association has only about a dozen members total. It's invitation-only—most people can't even qualify for the assessment."

3293750288.m_KeyValue: ""A letter arrived from an unknown sender, addressed to _$$The Stranger from Afar._$$""

3294510586.m_KeyValue: "I must... reach her side at once..."

3294510587.m_KeyValue: "You? Alone? You could not even reach me."

3294510588.m_KeyValue: ""Very well, wretched slave. I accept your challenge. Let me grant you the mercy of death.""

3294510589.m_KeyValue: ""How should I draw the new Lord? Joan, have you seen him before?""

3294510590.m_KeyValue: ""Together we agreed: Joan must lead us back to the capital, to overthrow the wicked new Lord.""

3295483896.m_KeyValue: "We discovered some special elite enemies in the tower we just explored. Let's challenge them to obtain more valuable equipment."

3295483931.m_KeyValue: "The tower left by The Soulless now belongs to you."

3295667932.m_KeyValue: "He cut off the power to the elevator!"

3295667933.m_KeyValue: "What is this old coot going on about!?"

3295757264.m_KeyValue: ""If you can't handle it, just hide somewhere.""

3295867217.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps the old-timer just wants to possess Empousa?"

3295929205.m_KeyValue: "You call me a traitor? Interesting... I wonder what Limine would think if she heard this."

3295960715.m_KeyValue: "They too are living beings. They feel fatigue. They feel fear. You have won."

3295960716.m_KeyValue: "This force… it's even stronger than that sea monster on the ship… Stronger than when Noah awakened… It's crawling beneath my skin—"

3295960717.m_KeyValue: "Your companions believe in you—Just as you believe in them. That is worth something. But—"

3295960719.m_KeyValue: "Hmph. I never imagined someone like you existed in the Church. Then again… you don't even look human. What are you?"

3295960720.m_KeyValue: ""I know how much you despise lies and deception, Sir Yggdrasill.""

3295960721.m_KeyValue: "What!? This strange old man was Aiona's mentor?"

3295960722.m_KeyValue: "But please believe me. I joined the Bathory because I truly believe in your dream—returning to the moon."

3296238704.m_KeyValue: "I hope my words can bring her comfort."

3297252374.m_KeyValue: ""From this day forth, you are granted the surname Brennholt. You are now Agares Brennholt.""

3297252375.m_KeyValue: ""The first time I died, I was a nameless slave, unworthy of life.""

3297252376.m_KeyValue: "Anyone else? No? Then the victory's mine!"

3297252377.m_KeyValue: "Then let my fists show you what this world is really like!"

3313046454.m_KeyValue: ""Don't underestimate this old hand, Van Helsing…""

3313046457.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, lifeless eyes! Are you going after him or not? Why are you muttering to yourself like some brooding poet?""

3313046459.m_KeyValue: "On closer inspection… this statue isn't made of real gold."

3313046460.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. Figures. This ship may dazzle on the outside, but beneath the surface—it's all ornament and rot.""

3313046461.m_KeyValue: "Likely the one beneath the golden statue of Goldland. It's been moved."

3313046462.m_KeyValue: "Hah… as expected of young Van Helsing. You saw through it at a glance."

3313046463.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm right, it should lead down to the quarters where Jones used to stay.""

3313046464.m_KeyValue: ""At last, every piece falls into place... I'm sorry, Jones. If only I had seen it sooner...""

Unlike other golems, it wanders endlessly, seeking.""

3315991655.m_KeyValue: ""How long has it been? If I don't return soon, they'll start to worry...""

3316464739.m_KeyValue:
""Noah:
 Today is my birthday. They say the birthday person gets all the luck.
And it must be true, because I saw a beautiful owl while practicing archery in the forest near the castle.
Although I can never go back, I still see the owl as a symbol of my family's honor.
It's funny to think back to when we first met, pointing swords at one another. Now, we're companions who have gone through countless adventures together.
Do you remember that wooden carving you gave me? To be honest, Noah, it looked nothing like the real thing.
Come to the forest tonight. I'll show you how beautiful a real owl can be.""

3316464740.m_KeyValue:
""I understand now—this is the truth of the world, the truth we've always sought!
Blood... memory... alchemy... the Church has always tried to keep us in ignorance, but it doesn't matter!
I've finally grasped the key to enlightenment, and I must pen it down!
Even if they come for me, I must...
(The notes show signs of burning and lacerating. All the pages that follow are missing.)""

3316464741.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, Thank you. Without all of you, I might have remained asleep forever, sealed within that little puppet. Tell Miss Ami that I believe she will make a fine Sage. Tell Miss Aiona that I'm grateful for her gentleness and kindness. Tell Miss Selena that I wish we could've watched The Adventures of Ginokio together one more time. While I slept, Sapphire Isle became a place I no longer recognized. But after meeting all of you, I came to love what it's become. If fate allowed, I would've gladly gone on another journey with you. But there's a promise I must keep. Lorelei is still waiting for me. They say a letter lets you glimpse someone's truest thoughts. So if you've read this far... I suppose you know this is my last letter. The money enclosed should be enough to buy a few Tidewisp seeds. Please plant them by the sea for me. That's my last request.""

3317283310.m_KeyValue: "Huh? It feels like there's a voice... replying to me...."

3317843462.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose… it's still related to that child, in a way.""

3327100688.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) My memories? But where must I go..."

3327100689.m_KeyValue: "But you can't remember where that home is. Did it truly exist? Or perhaps..."

3327100690.m_KeyValue: ""The origin of life was a mistake, thus memories are destined to fade into nothingness. My life was short, yet long, filled with mistakes but not regrets...""

3327100691.m_KeyValue: "You... Have you also questioned your existence? And whether it holds any meaning."

3328112266.m_KeyValue: ""Does it hurt? Don't worry, your suffering is about to end.""

3329331074.m_KeyValue: ""(After hearing Aiona's wish to return home, I began discussing the journey's details with her.)""

3329617653.m_KeyValue: "Infuses Thunder Blade with Electric Essence to enhance skill power. Breaking the Thunder Blade will temporarily grant Electric Essence."

3330544614.m_KeyValue: ""I gathered the Four Calamities, just as the prophecy ordained. I awakened the Long Night—first of the Nine Scourges—to merge with you all...""

3330544615.m_KeyValue: ""You possess overwhelming force. But in the end, your focus faltered.""

3330544616.m_KeyValue: ""They were the beginning, and they will be the end: Seth, Abel… and Cain.""

3330544617.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I acknowledge your strength… You may well be one of the few who could rival the Saint.""

3330544619.m_KeyValue: "I do not believe this Friedrich is real… yet the Gilrain who faces him—he is no illusion."

3330545635.m_KeyValue: "Such a simple man... Too simple to be interesting."

3330545636.m_KeyValue: ""Because from the start, his only goal was to delay us for a moment—""

3330545637.m_KeyValue: ""...I'm sorry, Noah. We were so close, but it seems... we've lost.""

3330545639.m_KeyValue: ""You want me to devour you, to take your memories?""

3330545640.m_KeyValue: ""To think that you, who bears the name of _$$Death,_$$ would fear death itself.""

3330545642.m_KeyValue: "I've always believed that Albrecht—my mentor and the Bell Ringer who commands water—is the greatest Bell Ringer of all."

3331836270.m_KeyValue: ""You're not the only one who's changed. We all have our paths. And we've been walking them, with or without you.""

3331836271.m_KeyValue: "You know you can't beat Noah on your own. That's why you’re counting on them to harm his allies."

3331836272.m_KeyValue: "Then perhaps this will interest you. The other two Elders have already arrived..."

3331836273.m_KeyValue: ""That night—when you crushed me like an insect, even at the height of my power... is not something I'll ever forget!""

3331836274.m_KeyValue: ""Silver hair, crimson eyes... cold, yet burning with might. How I have longed for this day—Noah Nevernight!""

3332086150.m_KeyValue:

To celebrate your first day in the game, we want to give you a special gift! We are honored to accompany you in your forthcoming journey.""

3332086181.m_KeyValue:

Your verification code is {code}. It will expire in 5 minutes. Please proceed without delay.""

3332238256.m_KeyValue: "Your sketches of the El Dorado helped us uncover the ship's mysteries before. I didn't realize you'd drawn so many... interesting stories as well."

3332453738.m_KeyValue: ""Just mix the powder with water, and you'll see 'ice.'""

3333966908.m_KeyValue: "Log in for <color=#FFF7C1>5</color> days after the purchase to claim all rewards."

3335797955.m_KeyValue: "Accept your end with peace. It's where we all return."

3335797986.m_KeyValue: "Your form grows ever clearer in my memory."

3335800995.m_KeyValue: "I feel emotion stirring within me. Is this what it means to have companions?"

3335801154.m_KeyValue: "Will dawn break in the Other Side?"

3335806682.m_KeyValue: "Please don't be so kind to me..."

3335809691.m_KeyValue: "So this is what lies within your heart..."

3335811865.m_KeyValue: ""Speak, then. What reward do you seek from me?""

3335812024.m_KeyValue: ""Captivated by my valiant prowess on the battlefield, are you?""

3335813204.m_KeyValue: "Do you wish to offer your blood to me?"

3336701337.m_KeyValue: ""My <color=#D63536>Special</color> is ready, but I must hold back. I don't wish to kill anyone.""

3336701338.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry you ended up like this, but... I made a promise to live on and return home!""

3337885059.m_KeyValue: ""You may store items here, but note that stored items take no effect.""

3338533693.m_KeyValue: ""The young think far too simplistically. Allow me to speak on behalf of the Elders: Though the family shows signs of rising prominence, we must remain cautious and maintain a prudent distance from the Kingdom and the Church.""

3338533759.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, hold on. I've learned that this chamber is located at the border between the Ganelon and Carrelle territories. Although its position is secluded, there's still a risk of it being seized.""

3338533790.m_KeyValue: ""The elders rack their brains night after night for the future of our family. And now, they're expected to let a bunch of brats decide how well-done their steaks should be and how soft their beds are...""

3338533825.m_KeyValue: ""Developing trade routes takes time and resources, but that's a matter for later. The family is at a crucial stage of revival. Castle repairs, cultivating vassals, the 'Return to the Moon' project... everything requires Soli.""

3338533856.m_KeyValue: ""The young are quick to judge what they scarcely understand. Though the First Tenet of Secrecy was indeed established during the Bathory's decline, its true purpose is to ensure the utmost preservation of our bloodline.""

3338533891.m_KeyValue: ""How naive! Since the Holy War, the Church has all but eradicated Black Blood from the continent. The Bloodborn barely survived—another Bloodborn faction’s existence is impossible.""

3338533922.m_KeyValue: "No intention of getting involved? What a joke! I've never seen such cowardly Bloodborn! Bathory would never stoop so low as to ally with such a conservative and weak faction!"

3338533988.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on! Bathory Castle is no refuge for strays! As the Lord himself said, the Bathory and Ganelon families have been sworn enemies for generations—how could we possibly take their descendants as our Vassals?""

3338534023.m_KeyValue: ""I was the first to object when the Elder Baphomet decided to purchase armor from her. Now look where we are—not only are prices soaring, but the Puppet Association has monopolized all business in the castle. In my opinion, it's high time we take measures to regulate this situation.""

3338534120.m_KeyValue: ""We must remain vigilant. The cartographers may claim neutrality, but persistent rumors suggest that several of its members frequently accept missions from the Church, operating in their service.""

3339162011.m_KeyValue: "A ranged creature mutated by Black Blood. Their blood orbs can penetrate targets. Keep your formation spread out."

3339735395.m_KeyValue: "Progress will not be saved. Do you wish to exit?"

3339965553.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, but I must go on ahead.""

3339965554.m_KeyValue: ""When I had to choose between my father and mother, I decided to walk my mother's path to the very end.""

3339965555.m_KeyValue: ""Years ago, she was given to my father in marriage, a gesture of peace between our houses.""

3341307467.m_KeyValue: "No further replies. It seemed he had left for now."

3341564752.m_KeyValue: "Do not believe their lies! They want to break your spirit!"

3341564753.m_KeyValue: ""The chosen one must be 'her.' Joyce, I shall go with you.""

3341564754.m_KeyValue: "I was a slave in the arena. I won my first victory with nothing but these hands!"

3341564755.m_KeyValue: "The slave Joan has fallen! The rest of you—lay down your arms!"

3341564756.m_KeyValue: ""They say the Saint has turned her will against the new Lord—that this is divine punishment. With no more water, even common folk now flee.""

3341564757.m_KeyValue: ""Someone once told me: a master's worth lies in protecting those who follow. Without followers, there is no master.""

3341976871.m_KeyValue: "Useless for combat... but I'll keep it. Thanks."

3341976902.m_KeyValue: ""Please, no more. I fear I might grow accustomed to such warmth.""

3341976937.m_KeyValue: ""For a commoner, you have quite the discerning eye.""

3341976968.m_KeyValue: "I never thought I'd care about anything other than battle."

3341977003.m_KeyValue: ""A new toy? Do tell me, what new games have you been fantasizing about?""

3341977034.m_KeyValue: ""I should not accept this, but... Please allow me to briefly set aside my divine duties and relish this moment of tranquility.""

3341977069.m_KeyValue: "How did you know? Just leave it there. I will enjoy it thoroughly."

3341977100.m_KeyValue: ""This is... well, I'm not sure what to say. But thanks!""

3343504227.m_KeyValue: ""Cannot be purified. Permanent effect. When reaching {0} stacks, effect disappears, inflicting Sleep on the carrier for {1} sec.""

3344306541.m_KeyValue: ""Huh. What a surprise. Brennholt... the name of the estate we came from. It just means 'firewood,' doesn’t it?""

3344306544.m_KeyValue: "So I won. Not that it means anything."

3344828600.m_KeyValue: ""A black kitten found by Dalcarlo, beloved by the Pontos crew. In it, Dalcarlo seemingly sees herself...""

3344828602.m_KeyValue: ""Following Joan, a foreign woman rose as the head of the Astolfo family. The sandy land of the southern continent she rules over appears to have long harbored a quiet betrayal against the Church.""

3344828604.m_KeyValue: "A nun who runs a small church on Sunset Isle with Nevernight. She is among his most trusted and beloved."

3352303138.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! Oh, don't worry... I'm just a little sensitive there...""

3352608245.m_KeyValue: ""My fingers interlaced upon her bared soul. That endless, all-consuming kiss unveiled every chapter of our story.""

3352608247.m_KeyValue: "It's my own fault. I shouldn't have gone three days without sleep."

3352608248.m_KeyValue: ""No, no—I already understand the tale that must be told.""

3352608249.m_KeyValue: ""After being out in the sun all day, my skin and stamina are starting to feel it.""

3352608250.m_KeyValue: "I'm fine... just need to... rest for a moment... then I'll..."

3352917225.m_KeyValue: ""While I appreciate your concern for my soul, I think the latter might yield a higher chance of survival.""

3352917227.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, I don't think sending someone off a cliff counts as 'saving' them...""

3354576851.m_KeyValue:
""A Baphomet member who ascended to elder in his youth. The purple Soul Pyre and blade he wields manifest his boundless ambition.
He will prove he is no lackey, no brute, no inferior—the throne of the Lord of the Bloodborn shall be his.""

3355554154.m_KeyValue: ""Since you've noticed something unusual, little one, could you give me some clues?""

3355554155.m_KeyValue: ""Happy birthday, Miss Lorelei! To the Isle's most graceful, brilliant, and sweet-voiced lady!""

3355554156.m_KeyValue: ""In support of the Seven Sage Association's effort to promote the Isle, I've designed two new attractions.""

3355554157.m_KeyValue: ""Well, if it isn't Miss Lorelei! Are you in search of anything particular to purchase?""

3355554158.m_KeyValue: ""If I remember correctly, your troupe doesn't have a permit for outdoor performances yet.""

3356248963.m_KeyValue: ""Alert level above 50%. Proceed with caution, like the _$$Hermit._$$""

3356539438.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa, Aiona, and I will distract them. You go and rescue him.""

3357227533.m_KeyValue: "You have any clue what she's talking about?"

3357227534.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, other than the spot where they disappeared, I haven't caught my brother's scent at all.""

3357227535.m_KeyValue: ""They are seeds of 'Plague'... As I thought, even after twenty years, it's still seeping into the Lupine Forest.""

3357227536.m_KeyValue: "Th-that's impossible! Then what about Clive? My little brother?!"

3357227537.m_KeyValue: ""There is more than one Seed of Calamity. Before the Church named them the Calamities and sealed them away, they called themselves...""

3357227538.m_KeyValue: ""What does that even mean? No wonder you're always speaking in riddles, it runs in the family!""

3357227565.m_KeyValue: "But what does the moon hidden by the wicked wolf mean? The wolf must be referring to the Ganelon family."

3357227566.m_KeyValue: ""I dare not ask what the world will be like in twenty years, nor what I will be doing then. But I can't help wondering...""

3357227567.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly, I promised someone that I would look after Clive.""

3357227568.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I got it! The Hive Mind connects the minds of all Black Blood carriers who share the same bloodline.""

3357227569.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, he's already turned. There's nothing we can do...""

3357227570.m_KeyValue: ""But right now, I must protect their past and your future!""

3357227829.m_KeyValue: "Where can I go? Where should I go?"

3357227830.m_KeyValue: "But why my father? Why the people of Mouret? Why am I the one left behind? Which rotten god have I angered to deserve this?"

3357227831.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps your father is guiding our way."

3357227832.m_KeyValue: ""Even though you're already deeply mired in this cursed fate, even though you're already covered in wounds from the family bonds that have shackled you your whole life...""

3357227833.m_KeyValue: ""I was about to ask why you're so eager to help me, but naturally you have your own motives.""

3357227834.m_KeyValue: "This homeland thing again? I'm surprised you care this much about a promise."

3357227835.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't you say that it's not the gods who decide our fates, but ourselves?""

3357227863.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, just as I thought. Seeing crows is always an ill omen!""

3357227864.m_KeyValue: "What... What do I do? Clive... My little brother is missing..."

3357227893.m_KeyValue: ""According to the Church's records, there have indeed been cases of people retaining their humanity after being infected with Black Blood, but that information was never made public.""

3357227894.m_KeyValue: ""This special type could very well become a threat in the future. Rather than taking him alive, we must execute him immediately.""

3357227895.m_KeyValue: "Are you okay now? Do you want some water?"

3357227899.m_KeyValue: ""No, this is indeed my first time meeting them. Please believe me, it's just...""

3357227925.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, I was worried that you might refuse to give him the spores. I'm with the people who tried to kill you, after all. What if it was poison?""

3357227929.m_KeyValue: ""Save your strength. Aiona will heal the wound. As for the Black Blood, I'll teach you how to control it.""

3357227930.m_KeyValue: "A child managed to survive my attack? Is this the resilience of the Black Blood?"

3357227931.m_KeyValue: "What nonsense is this kid suddenly spouting? They're nothing but Blood Beasts now!"

3357227932.m_KeyValue: "They're... the people who lived in Mouret?"

3357227953.m_KeyValue: ""I've experienced it, or rather I'm constantly fighting against it.""

3357227954.m_KeyValue: "We needed to do something and I couldn't think of anything else at the time."

3357227957.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, when the time comes, I'll be sure to drag you down with me.""

3357227958.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, what are you trying to do—""

3357227959.m_KeyValue: ""Knowing them, they'll catch up soon. Those two are... quite exceptional.""

3357227962.m_KeyValue: "You two are disclosing too much information!"

3357227963.m_KeyValue: "But the Gravekeeper shouldn't be named Clive. I've never heard that name before. Did they recently appoint a new one?"

3357227964.m_KeyValue: "And why are you introducing me? Leave me out of this."

3357227995.m_KeyValue: "We've finally shaken off those annoying knights."

3357227996.m_KeyValue: "Can't you run any faster? I thought wolves were really fast. Are you sure you're not just some stray your family picked up?"

3357228026.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, the concept of being born only to die applies not just to them, but to us as well, doesn't it?""

3357228027.m_KeyValue: ""If the water in this cave hadn't been contaminated by the Black Blood, we could live a peaceful life here.""

3357228028.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, the current situation is not as dire as you think.""

3357767853.m_KeyValue: ""You'll encounter many events during your adventure, some of which require making choices. These events take varying amounts of time, and your Mechanical Spider risks taking damage.""

3357970571.m_KeyValue: "Doing the bare minimum while still getting the job done—that's the spider way."

3357970573.m_KeyValue: ""A winding path lies ahead. Will you take it, or bypass it and go straight?""

3357970574.m_KeyValue:
"'I'm the No. 1 Steering Spider!'
Reach the next destination even faster!"

3357970603.m_KeyValue:
""Misleading opponents is also a competitive strategy.
Faced with a dead end, the two spiders reassess their relationship.""

3357970604.m_KeyValue:
"You encounter spiders moving in the opposite direction.
You question yourself—should you be following them?"

3357970606.m_KeyValue: "The spider that stuck to its path spotted the other spider at the supply point—the one that turned back earlier had caught up."

3358396880.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, who are you? Do you remember your name at least?""

3358396882.m_KeyValue: "Looks like there weren't enough memories in the blood. Other foreign memories also seemed to have gotten mixed in."

3358832582.m_KeyValue: ""Siren's Tears applies Siren's Song to nearby units once per sec. Each stack of Siren's Song inflicts ATK SPD Down on enemies, and Sleep when it reaches 2 stacks. Each stack grants ATK SPD UP to allies and removes their status effects when it reaches 2 stacks.""

3359364982.m_KeyValue: "Inhabited by a Lost Maiden. Will summon another Lost Maiden upon death."

3360668351.m_KeyValue: "I've been meaning to ask—why are you so sure it was suicide?"

3360668352.m_KeyValue: "Be careful with him! That's... that's my brother!"

3360668353.m_KeyValue: "Hey! That's not fair! I'm Jack! I've been here the whole time! I just didn't want to interrupt your conversation!"

3360668354.m_KeyValue: "We might be able to use the narrow hallways there to avoid getting swarmed!"

3360668355.m_KeyValue: "There's a staircase going down... maybe it leads to the dining room?"

3360668356.m_KeyValue: "Seems to me that you—a sailor—have more courage than your supposed crew-loving Captain."

3360668375.m_KeyValue: "What? What is it?! What's going on?!"

3360668376.m_KeyValue: "I don't know who you are or what kind of price you'll demand. But my family motto is:"

3360668383.m_KeyValue: ""I've been meaning to ask—if I'm supposed to cover Jacob while he steers, then why did you come along?""

3360668384.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, that lifeless eyes just pulled off a pompous performance and turned those weapons into a bow?""

3360668385.m_KeyValue: "...more like a reminder. A silent urging… that putting an end to William's body was the right thing to do."

3360668386.m_KeyValue: "How did Goldland leave? And was William ever there to begin with?"

3360668387.m_KeyValue: "That's one possibility. But what troubles me are the coincidences. This is the third suspicious answer I've heard today."

3360668388.m_KeyValue: ""Just now, when you saw William's corpse stir, you seemed startled and found it strange. I've been meaning to ask—what was strange about it?""

3360668389.m_KeyValue: "That explains why he left his post on the deck for a brief moment… It didn't take long—but that was all he needed!"

3360668390.m_KeyValue: "I never eat food prepared by others. As for Bob and James—they were likely too busy to eat."

3360668416.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I weren't here to rescue you, looks like these things wouldn't let me walk away. Fine by me—time to teach them a lesson!""

3360668417.m_KeyValue: "What do I do…? Who knows what kind of danger is down under… can I handle it alone?"

3360668447.m_KeyValue: ""The true purpose of the Black Blood remains unclear. But it drives its hosts to absorb all flesh, all thought—until nothing remains but hunger. That is its clearest symptom.""

3360668448.m_KeyValue: "So when you claimed the Bloodborn are not demons… you were trying to soothe me? Afraid I would reject what I am?"

3360668449.m_KeyValue: "They're not just food—each one carries a story worth savoring."

3360668450.m_KeyValue: "Wait… what if I've misunderstood this from the start?"

3360668451.m_KeyValue: "I know nothing of any hidden door. Only that I broke through this wall…"

3360668453.m_KeyValue: "Because I once glimpsed the ship's layout in Aaron's cabin—shortly before he was murdered."

3360668454.m_KeyValue: "If there's no passage downward—then what lies behind that wall? The one that's noticeably thicker than the others?"

3360668475.m_KeyValue: ""No—don't waste your strength on me. If the Captain still lives, then he would want only two things:""

3360668476.m_KeyValue: "You once had an entire ship of companions. It was you who betrayed them."

3360668479.m_KeyValue: "Is that what you truly believe? Why do you think the Captain was only strict with you? Why do you think he insisted on sailing to the dangerous Sunset Isle this time?!"

3360668480.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing, you wretched bastard! Stop speaking like you're the only one with a mind in this room—and don't you dare look at me with that scornful gaze!""

3360668482.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body… He spoke of it?"

3360668483.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing… I've been meaning to say this for a long time. I despise your habit of always speaking in riddles."

3360668484.m_KeyValue: ""Then at last, we may be together. Never to part again.""

3360668485.m_KeyValue: "Tch… You old fool. Still breathing? I was certain Van Helsing had already dealt with you."

3360668486.m_KeyValue: "My only mistake… was underestimating the cruelty a coward can unleash when he refuses to face who he truly is."

3360668511.m_KeyValue: "Silver-haired and I are more than enough."

3360668512.m_KeyValue: ""Don't curse her! The dumb wolf may be dense, but she can definitely handle a few infected sailors! Though...""

3360668513.m_KeyValue: ""Let's go, silver-haired. It's time to let this whirlpool of insecurity, jealousy, and greed...""

3360668515.m_KeyValue: "And who's this stinking jellyfish girl? So carefree… and always alone with Noah."

3360668516.m_KeyValue: "What?! What in the world is wrong with you?!"

3360668518.m_KeyValue: "You know what I've done—I killed my brother. I killed the crew. All for you."

3360668545.m_KeyValue: "Something's wrong. This rocking... It's not from the storm."

3360668546.m_KeyValue: "I was born this way. But that's beside the point."

3360668547.m_KeyValue: "Ranna hasn't abandoned me. She's testing me."

3360668548.m_KeyValue: "A Calamity can kill a Bell Ringer?"

3360668549.m_KeyValue: ""Harboring? She was here long before this ship was ever built... No, more than that...""

3360668550.m_KeyValue: ""To feed her, I turned every soul on this ship into flesh puppets, bound by Black Blood...""

3362413176.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps I forgot to introduce myself at the El Dorado—I am Jacintha Dalcarlo."

3362556916.m_KeyValue: ""I stayed up too late reading the night before I sent those packages... I was still half-asleep when I packaged everything, so I accidentally mixed them up.""

3363518906.m_KeyValue:
""Noah:
 My perception of time differs from mortals, alas counting days is not my habit... That said, I presume you would find this occasion worth commemorating.
 I know the joy of receiving blessings on special days. Today, I wish to convey that same happiness to you.""

3363518907.m_KeyValue: ""Silver-haired friend, How does it feel to reunite after so long? How could Death cannot bring the dead back to life? Yet great alchemy can achieve this feat. Don't be mistaken—I'm not here to cause trouble. On the path to finding the 'answer' in another world, we will still need each other's strength. Therefore, our partnership will continue. However, I look forward to the day we settle our score.""

3365806477.m_KeyValue: ""A vermin that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Born in unstable space, its hardened shell appears capable of deflecting most attacks.""

3365806538.m_KeyValue: ""With trembling hands, Sorcerer Crowley raises his staff high, knowing each spell cast erodes his soul, yet he continues to draw power from the Abyss to protect the village behind him, even as he gradually succumbs to monstrosity through this dark pact.""

3365806541.m_KeyValue: ""Clergy of the Tempus Church who guards heretics and criminals. Their blessed arrows mercilessly pin sinners to the walls—yet sometimes, those very arrows strike their former companions.""

3365806542.m_KeyValue: "Clergy of the Tempus Church whose prayers reach out to criminals and fellow clerics. Maybe this is the sole means to cleanse one's soul—within this cage of perpetual sin."

3365806567.m_KeyValue: ""Gravekeeper for the Ganelon family, he lost his sanity and underwent mutation due to the spread of the Black Blood. He now awaits in silence for the chosen one's arrival.""

3365806573.m_KeyValue: ""A moon-shaped egg, believed to signal a devastating plague. Its presence on the continent may mark the beginning of a nightmare.""

3370730457.m_KeyValue: "Is there really any point in fixating on such nonsense?"

3370731480.m_KeyValue: ""Whichever path you choose, all destinies converge upon the same inevitable end.""

3370732635.m_KeyValue: "Well... I don't really know much about that."

3370733658.m_KeyValue: "Neither do I! You make the call!"

3370734813.m_KeyValue: ""I have more pressing matters that require my contemplation. Do proceed without my input, if you would.""

3370735836.m_KeyValue: "Do you fuss over this trivial stuff every day? How utterly boring."

3370736991.m_KeyValue: "Are we seriously holding a meeting for something this trivial?"

3372644208.m_KeyValue: ""I just wanted to ask—when you drew that bird in a cage, was it because you felt trapped on the El Dorado?""

3372895030.m_KeyValue: ""So, it is you who brings the Scourge.""

3372895031.m_KeyValue: ""At that moment, Letitia—just a few steps away—suddenly spits blood, collapsing to her knees.""

3372895032.m_KeyValue: ""A woman materializes in the great hall—bearing Letitia's likeness, yet emanating a wholly different presence.""

3372895033.m_KeyValue: ""These chattering... babbling primates, they've scarcely learned to walk upright, yet you persist in your pitiful attempts to blend in.""

""'Thank you, Dr. Ressa.'
The elderly woman before me bowed repeatedly in her gratitude.
Though I've lost count of how many patients I've treated today, her smile still gave me a glimmer of strength.
For years, I've done my utmost to help these patients in remote villages.
'Why do you go to such lengths, Dr. Ressa?' the old woman asked before she left.
Why indeed...
Is it because of the horrors of war I've experienced, and the fear of death they instilled in me?
Or is it guilt over the lives taken, driving me to cherish it above all else?
I do not know. But now, all I want is to keep everyone as far from death as possible, no matter the toll it takes on me—
After all, only this makes me feel truly alive.""
