3458275882.m_KeyValue: ""Joan's fighting spirit felt as if it could take form—And in that very instant, the tent flap stirred without a breeze. Was this the power of a Bell Ringer? A will so intense it could bend the air around it?""

3458275883.m_KeyValue: ""The crystal ball spun with a gentle clink as it rolled off the edge… Thankfully, it landed in a patch of grass near the entrance without a scratch. Was that... planned?""

3458275884.m_KeyValue: ""And why suspicious (repeated twice, no less)? Because what kind of fortune-teller sets up shop in the middle of nowhere!?""

3458275885.m_KeyValue: ""It's Dalcarlo, of course! Who else in all of Minexus is known for her skill in Tarot divination?""

3458275887.m_KeyValue: ""Theophane picked up the card, studied it for a moment, then slapped it face-down on the table. '...Draw again,' he said, his voice low and firm with resolve.""

3458275888.m_KeyValue: "'Let's set that aside for now.' Joan waved her hand. 'You mentioned a contest in fortune-telling... How exactly do we determine who's better at that?'"

3458275892.m_KeyValue: ""'To recover the stolen ceremonial relic…' Halfway through his sentence, he paused, then frowned. 'Wait... The crystal ball?'""

3458342313.m_KeyValue: "'Listen well—I'll only say this once: I am... the <style=Highlight>captain</style> of this <color=#bc544b>Virgo-class</color> <color=#59788e>Warship</color> <color=#ffcc00>El Dorado</color>!'"

3458342314.m_KeyValue: ""'Tsk! As a member of this warship's crew, how dare you ignore your <style=Highlight>captain's</style> words!' Ami glared at Stella. 'As a punishment, you're going to Starfall Valley to gather dinner ingredients!'""

3458342315.m_KeyValue: "'As one of the last two gourmets remaining on Minexus...' Ami's fist clenched with fierce determination. 'I am bound by sacred duty to etch every delicacy of this world into my very soul!'"

3458342316.m_KeyValue: ""'You do realize I can still hear everything you're whispering over there, don't you?'""

3458342317.m_KeyValue: ""'It's... It's fine! We just need to find the <style=Highlight>Minexus Restoration System Y</style> first! El Dorado, let's go!'""

3458342318.m_KeyValue: ""'Back to the matter at hand...' Stella's voice cut through the silence, quiet yet steel-steady. 'Starfall Valley may be treacherous, but it's a destination we cannot avoid.'""

3458342319.m_KeyValue: ""'But Stella, your dedication to this ship is evident to all!' Ami turned and strode forward several steps, standing at the captain's position to look down on the crew.""

3458343401.m_KeyValue: ""Agares halted at those words, a fleeting trace of sorrow crossing his face—only to vanish the next instant.""

3458343402.m_KeyValue: "'Not many Bell Ringers have this much free time...' Noah let out a weary smile. 'No wonder you've gone through so many Vice-Commanders. They're not exactly fans of a leader who always shirks his duties.'"

3458343403.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh...? Ah, I see...' Noah took another small step back. 'So... whatever this is, it hasn't been buried long?'""

3458343404.m_KeyValue: ""Noah peered down into the pit from above, meeting Agares's gaze. As their eyes met, the same thought surfaced in their minds...""

3458343405.m_KeyValue: ""Agares chuckled and shook his head. 'The moment you said let's settle this, you'd already lost.'""

3458343406.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey now, that's my line.' Twin Agares lets out an exasperated sigh. 'Can't believe even my day off comes with this kind of trouble...'""

3458343407.m_KeyValue: ""At that question, Mass lowered her head slightly. 'Just a phantom shaped like Agares. A vessel for the countless lingering wills of the Carrelle family.'""

3458343408.m_KeyValue: "'You both spoke in third person when you were making your arguments.' Noah stared intently at the two identical men before him. 'Like you were talking about someone else.'"

3458343410.m_KeyValue: ""'...This meteorite seems to draw in the lingering souls of the nearby Carrelle dead.' Mass turned back. 'When these fragments, glimmering like firelies, gather together...'""

3458344489.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella even closed her eyes to focus on listening, but why did the distractions become even clearer?""

3458344491.m_KeyValue: ""The stone door, bearing the Badge of the Bathory family, rumbled deeply as the stenchy cold air escaped through the gap like desperate wraiths.""

3458344492.m_KeyValue: ""'Indeed, this isn't how a Covenant should be used. But on the bright side, I survived.'""

3458344493.m_KeyValue: ""'I don't know either, it just suddenly came to my head.'""

3458344496.m_KeyValue: "'I told you! Don't touch my receiver!'"

3458344499.m_KeyValue: ""'Aca-aca, pella-pella.' This time she added some dance moves to the rhythm.""

3458344500.m_KeyValue: ""'You're no fun at all! Let's go.' As Acappella turned to leave, she casually snapped her fingers, reducing the mud monster behind her to ashes in an instant.""

3458399101.m_KeyValue: ""Act carefully during the heist, avoiding direct confrontation with Artifact Guards unless necessary. Engaging in battle increases their Alert level, and defeat will result in immediate failure.""

3458416361.m_KeyValue: ""'I can't believe the old man would stoop to such tricks,' Clive thought. In his mind, that distant father had always been the embodiment of righteousness and loyalty.""

3458416362.m_KeyValue: "'Neither of us. Our contests always ended prematurely for various reasons. And I never had another chance to compete with your father.'"

3458416365.m_KeyValue: ""'Watch your opponent's rhythm,' Gadric instructed calmly, his movements fluid as he deftly dodged and retreated.""

3458416366.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, well,' he mused, 'it seems even the most seasoned warrior can falter. Fortunate this wasn't a real battle.' With Hati's aid, he sat up on the smooth rocks.""

3458416367.m_KeyValue: ""'I haven't even crossed swords with every knight, how could I possibly claim to be the first among them? Even if I've won once, I might lose the second time.'""

3458416368.m_KeyValue: ""Clive lent a hand, slicing the bread, cheese, and ham to prepare their meal.""

3458419628.m_KeyValue: ""'But...' Hati suddenly murmured, her voice barely audible, 'Was the sacrifice of those Ganelons truly meaningful?'""

3458419629.m_KeyValue: "'The Ganelons in the tower began firing arrows. Anyone who charged the entrance was either shot dead or cut down by a Ganelon defender at the doorway.'"

3458419630.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, of course. The Aegis family took part in that battle too. But it's not really something to be proud of, is it?'""

3458419631.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa and Jestel joined Hati at the edge. Together, the three stood silently, letting the salty sea breeze caress their faces as they watched the waves crash rhythmically against the distant shore.""

3458419632.m_KeyValue: ""'Your family's domain?' Hati scoffed, her anger barely contained. 'Fangtooth Tower belongs to the Ganelon family.'""

3458445769.m_KeyValue: " ...Those two lines clearly belong to the bard! I told you not to steal the stage and script!"

3458445770.m_KeyValue: "'Ah... Is a name really so vital? I hardly care myself. But since you seem so desperate to know... I suppose I could indulge you.'"

3458445771.m_KeyValue: ""The way you're saying it... did he find this infant, or did she fall from the sky?""

3458445772.m_KeyValue: ""'That is why, for many <style=""Highlight"">Other Side enthusiasts<color=#bc544b>, the realm of <color=#bc544b>yyf</color> becomes the cradle of legend.'""

3458445773.m_KeyValue: ""'Though Sunset Isle lies in distant obscurity, its vastness allows Noah to claim an entire manor for himself.'""

3458445774.m_KeyValue: ""'Ressa... she certainly has both proximity and motive, being so near to Noah. But...'""

3458445775.m_KeyValue:
"
<align="center"><b>'History is but the culmination of countless coincidences interwoven.'"

3458445776.m_KeyValue: ""'If Ressa's endless work leave Noah feeling <style=""Highlight"">__ and __</style> toward her, then Empousa's act of moving Noah's quarters leaves him feeling <color=#bc544b>__ and __</color> toward her.'""

3458447946.m_KeyValue: ""'A wise decision,' Cain nodded approvingly. 'If you're seeking specific texts, perhaps I can... guide your search.'""

3458447947.m_KeyValue: ""Undaunted by the overwhelming odds, the trio spread out with trained precision. Like young lions on the hunt, they silently stalked their formidable prey.""

3458447948.m_KeyValue: ""'Even with its proximity to the Bathory's castle,' Isaac persisted in his pessimism, 'this site couldn't have escaped the attention of clandestine looters.'""

3458447952.m_KeyValue: ""'The goddess, in her infinite wisdom, not only blessed the devout follower with a mighty warrior for a son, but also thoughtfully hastened his growth to adulthood.'""

3458448905.m_KeyValue: ""(One always wears a mask for who-knows-what reason, the other's constantly trying to slack off… How did they end up as Bell Ringers?)""

3458448906.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously… these are supposed to be the Church's top fighters? Where's the dignity of a Bell Ringer? If word got out that they spend their time playing hide-and-seek, how would the Church live it down?""

3458448907.m_KeyValue: ""Agares also stopped, glancing in the same direction. 'Oh…?'""

3458448908.m_KeyValue: ""'Ooh, look at this blood-red vertical eye… Doesn't it remind you of those Bloodborn?'""

3458448909.m_KeyValue: ""'Naming stuff's my specialty!' Acappella tilted her head, deep in thought. 'Since it was found under a rock on a quiet path, let's call it…'""

3458448910.m_KeyValue: ""He suddenly paused mid-sentence, then gave a soft chuckle. 'Heh. So that's what this is… a trap.' Shoulders lifting in resignation, he muttered, '…skip.'""

3458448911.m_KeyValue: ""With flair, Acappella raised the card (Bell Ringer–only) dramatically above her head—Then smacked it down to the ground with a 'Slap'!""

3458448912.m_KeyValue: ""'I offer six cards from my hand…' Crossing his arms before him, Agares clenched his fists. Between each pair of fingers, a card (Bell Ringer–only) gleamed faintly.""

3458448913.m_KeyValue: ""Before any of the three Bell Ringers could react, she swiftly tossed something their way—And with perfect aim, the objects landed straight into their mouths. Looking closer... they were those strange mushrooms from earlier.""

3458487145.m_KeyValue: ""Friedrich shook his head with an air of mystery, his pale golden hair catching the light as it danced in the swirling snow. _$$...Gilrain, when circumstances present themselves, one must learn to observe and deduce._$$""

3458487147.m_KeyValue: ""Startled, Joyce Gadric froze. Her hand reached for her face as her veil slipped away.""

3458487148.m_KeyValue: ""_$$We'll meet again... won't we?_$$ Even as the words fell from her lips, Aiona's dagger began to pulse with otherworldly energy—a beckoning from time's end, from the realm of the dead...""

3458487149.m_KeyValue: "_$$Oh... thank you for the gift... I truly adore that gown._$$"

3458487150.m_KeyValue: ""Some say it is poverty. Every coin saved from fixing armor goes toward his younger brother's education, fueling hopes that the boy might escape their humble origins.""

3458487151.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Something I carry within..._$$ Aiona repeated the cryptic message softly, fragmented memories flickering through her mind—familiar yet distant. _$$What could be the most precious thing...?_$$""

3458487152.m_KeyValue: ""Is she truly here for a task? Come to think of it, this outfit doesn't match the description <s><alpha=#88>the paragons</s><alpha=#FF> Gilrain and Friedrich gave earlier, does it?""

3458487158.m_KeyValue: ""_$$G-Got you…!_$$ Straining against the frozen world around her, Aiona summoned every last ounce of strength to grab hold of the torn edge of her other self's shawl.""

3458488235.m_KeyValue: ""'Was it for the money, or to fulfill that contract?' You've probably never seen a tree scratching its head with its own branches.""

3458488236.m_KeyValue: ""'This journey may span three or four generations to complete, with the plants along the way serving as vital waystations for their journey.'""

3458488237.m_KeyValue: ""'He lay in wait outside the prison gates for days, finally finding a few recently released inmates with nowhere else to turn.'""

3458488238.m_KeyValue: ""Yggdrasill accepted the tea from his disciple with his wounded branch, seemingly using this gesture to show his displeasure. Then again, it's not exactly easy to read emotions on a tree, is it?""

3458488239.m_KeyValue: ""'Then I'll find a big tree!' Edina exclaimed. Her hands trembled, the realization of her near mistake hitting her suddenly.""

3458488240.m_KeyValue: ""'I have no interest in human affairs,' Yggdrasill stated flatly. If not for his disciple, he wouldn't have set foot in this waystation at all.""

3458519817.m_KeyValue: ""Without warning, Empousa hitched up her skirt and darted off. 'The race is on!'""

3458519818.m_KeyValue: ""Wordlessly, Hati approached the edge of the wheat field. She reached out, grasping an ear of golden wheat. As she gently rubbed it between her fingers, brown grains slipped through the gaps.""

3458519821.m_KeyValue: ""'Couldn't they just buy food?' Ami asked, bewildered. Her experience observing Goldland doing business made this situation utterly incomprehensible.""

3458519822.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh Ami, of course you wouldn't understand, having spent your life at sea,' Empousa said with an air of superiority. 'A mill needs regular cleaning, otherwise it becomes a haven for rats and insects.'""

3458519823.m_KeyValue: ""'No wonder this isn't mentioned in the Bathory family records,' Empousa exclaimed. 'We inadvertently cultivated such a powerful enemy for ourselves—it's utterly humiliating!'""

3458519824.m_KeyValue: ""'But weren't the Ganelon family worried that the Bathory family might sabotage the flour?' Ami asked, though she already knew how it had turned out.""

3458525131.m_KeyValue: "'Yup' Hati beamed with joy. 'It's my very first pair of boxing gloves! Father made them for me using Clive's old clothes.'"

3458525132.m_KeyValue: "'Mouret is going to be completely abandoned. I should let this glove stay here with my other treasured one.'"

3458525133.m_KeyValue: ""'It's just... I've never been this close to lightning in the open before, and... and...'""

3458525134.m_KeyValue: ""'That's rather perplexing,' Ressa mused. 'Wouldn't an architect of such renown have incorporated safeguards against such disasters?'""

3458525135.m_KeyValue: ""This continued until all the wheat had been ground into flour and transported back to the Bathory lands. Empousa and Ressa, meanwhile, were there purely for the excitement.""

3458525136.m_KeyValue: ""'With three people, it's really quite straightforward,' Hati said, leaving the other two completely baffled.""

3458591689.m_KeyValue: "'I’ve been wanting to say this all along... There are hot springs all over this island. Couldn’t everyone just use a different one? What was the point of fighting over this?'"

3458591690.m_KeyValue: ""The bear submerged itself, leaving only its head above water. With practiced ease, it placed the still-trembling squirrel on its forehead like a compress, wearing an expression of pure bliss.""

3458591691.m_KeyValue: ""'Allow me to explain in detail...' Agares raised a finger, as if fully prepared to educate these amateurs on the fine art of crafting a proper hot spring.""

3458591692.m_KeyValue: "'What a hassle... no one's even listening to me.'"

3458591693.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, I get it—' Hati nodded along then froze. 'Wait...'""

3458591694.m_KeyValue: ""'This is awful! Did we get here too late? The legendary hot spring has been tainted!' Hati slumped her shoulders in frustration, radiating an aura of utter dejection.""

3458591695.m_KeyValue: ""'...Should I get down and apologize? Wait, why me?'""

3458591696.m_KeyValue: ""Hati dashed to the ship’s railing, vomiting before her words could even finish. It seemed that even after transforming from a clumsy wolf into a moth, she hadn’t shaken her predisposition to seasickness.""

3458592650.m_KeyValue: ""'An empty shell without flesh?' Darcias studied the cross-section of the helmet, answering idly, 'Like that elder from a certain noble house who passed away not long ago?'""

3458592651.m_KeyValue: ""Nicole flexed the legs she'd formed with mercury manipulation. 'With all this mist, it's like I've filled the area with eyes and copies of myself.'""

3458592653.m_KeyValue: "'Ah... what brings you here?' Gadric changed the subject. 'I don't see your Bell Ringer. It's rare for a Vice-Commander to appear alone.'"

3458592654.m_KeyValue: ""With a loud splash, a second _$$unexpected guest_$$ popped up from beneath the surface. Was she lying in wait this whole time?""

3458592655.m_KeyValue: ""Let’s hope she and her Vassal are getting along, and that a little cliff-diving hasn't driven a wedge between them.""

3458592656.m_KeyValue: ""'Just as you predicted.' Darcias circled the floating Gadric, scrutinizing him. 'But how did you pull it off? There's no way he'd drown that easily.'""

3458592661.m_KeyValue: ""'Ahahaha!' Gadric burst into hearty laughter, like a child after a successful prank. 'Darcias fell for another one!'""

3458663569.m_KeyValue: ""'As we agreed earlier, I'm with Goldland, while you, Silver-haired, are paired with Cain. Hmph, remember, you chose this pairing yourself, Silver-haired! So don't come fishing for excuses if you end up on the losing side!'""

3458663570.m_KeyValue: ""As the thin mist dissipated, the the object was revealed—a golden hourglass. What set this timepiece apart, however, was the intricate carving of a man upon its surface.""

3458663571.m_KeyValue: "Noah froze at this shocking revelation—'Smuggling seafood?'"

3458663573.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland had Noah by the head while Cain gripped his hands, each yanking in opposite directions. All the while, they were yelling 'Seafood Tycoon's Pearl!' at the top of their lungs.""

3458663574.m_KeyValue: ""'Precisely,' Cain said, raising the golden hourglass high. 'Now, chant with me: Come forth, Seafood Tycoon Pearl!'""

3458663575.m_KeyValue: ""...And thus, amidst a whirlwind of chaos, the Greatest Fishing Competition of the Minexus drew to its chaotic yet successful conclusion. We extend our heartfelt thanks to the Golden Goldland Statue for its unwavering support of this... memorable event.""

3458663576.m_KeyValue: ""The remaining three locked eyes, exchanging silent nods of understanding. Their hands—all six of them—curled into white-knuckled fists as their minds raced with visions of grand conquests and glorious empires. True warriors, after all, do not falter in the face of mere setbacks!""

3458665745.m_KeyValue: "'Surely we didn't all come here just to trade words?' Tris smiled as she swept her gaze across everyone present. 'Why don't we settle this with a proper contest? Let our abilities do the talking.'"

3458665746.m_KeyValue: ""'Now, now, let's not point fingers at each other.' The golden-haired woman clapped her hands to quiet everyone down. 'After all, none of us came here today to fight, did we?'""

3458665747.m_KeyValue: ""Moments later, Acappella and the golden-haired woman appeared in the distance, glancing around as if searching for something.""

3458665749.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph, dummy Empousa doesn't even realize she's been tricked.'""

3458665750.m_KeyValue: ""'One point...' Lamia pondered with her hand on her chin. 'Hmph, I get it. As long as we keep the ball from touching the ground, we can have multiple exchanges even in a single point.'""

3458665751.m_KeyValue: ""'It's the court boundaries, dummy Empousa.' Lamia stared intently at the lines Acappella had casually drawn. 'So this is the power of a Bell Ringer...'""

3458665752.m_KeyValue: ""Fishing does sound a bit dull, even if it was Commander's idea...' Acappella tilted her head in thought. 'Ah! I know—let's play ball!'""

3458668881.m_KeyValue: ""'Still… same dive or not, yours lacked my signature flair.'""

3458668882.m_KeyValue: ""Would it be the ever-fiery Agares who claimed victory? Or would Noah, the unchanging protagonist, seize first place once again? The answer lay just ahead.""

3458668883.m_KeyValue: ""'I swam with the little fish, drifted with the seaweed. My soul felt boundless—until it touched the shore of another.'""

3458668884.m_KeyValue: ""'My, my. You're looking pretty rough today, Noah.' Agares crouched lazily by the shore, his grin full of mischief.""

3458668885.m_KeyValue: ""Moonlight poured down, casting all three in soft silver. Their shadows stretched long across the sand—easy, unburdened.""

3458668887.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—Noah had resurfaced! He had caught up to Agares, and now the two were neck and neck!""

3458668888.m_KeyValue: ""Agares threw an arm over Noah's shoulder. 'Well now, Noah… who'd have thought that we'd both be the loser?'""

3458671053.m_KeyValue: ""'You mean...' Empousa turned to look at Lamia, who wore the same shocked expression. 'We're going to be rich...?'""

3458671054.m_KeyValue: ""'...Otherwise, even if you manage to collect the debt by force, the money will somehow get blown into the sea by a mysterious wind.""

3458671057.m_KeyValue: ""'...I don't need a dummy like Empousa to tell me that!' As she spoke, Lamia clasped her hands together and slammed them down with tremendous force! The ball shot toward the opposite court with a fierce whistle!""

3458671059.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, it doesn't matter anyway.' Acappella turned and walked away. 'The Commander probably did that on purpose anyway.'""

3458671060.m_KeyValue: ""'That thing Cain mentioned...' Lamia scanned the surroundings. 'It should be somewhere around here, right?'""

3458671061.m_KeyValue: ""'...Rules don't limit how we touch the ball,' Lamia said with a sly smile. ' Or hit it, which means—'""

3458671062.m_KeyValue: ""'The rules didn't say anything about using external forces, did they?' Acappella gently tapped upward, sending the fish-skin ball floating into the air. 'Commander—'""

3458671063.m_KeyValue: ""As soon as Empousa's words faded, a sea of crimson flowers burst forth from the ground. The blossoms grew rapidly, their vines intertwining to form an intricate net.""

3458671064.m_KeyValue: ""'So... that counts as one touch, doesn't it?' Acappella 'kindly' reminded the team across the net. 'Only two chances left! Better make them count!'""

3458925308.m_KeyValue: "Clear [A Familiar Spark] <color=#a65f30>H 2-2</color>: The End of the Road"

3461564542.m_KeyValue: "The truth is... even if we find the village... there likely won't be anyone there..."

3461564544.m_KeyValue: ""Because the Church suddenly arrived, as if they were already prepared for Death's awakening...""

3461564545.m_KeyValue: "Is it because the sealed Calamity is still cursing the family members that they want to completely eradicate... the Calamity itself?"

3461564546.m_KeyValue: "But I also saw those phantoms... So just who are they?"

3461564547.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, so that's why you said you were learning from the Church's teachers, you were actually born and raised in the Church's territories...""

3461564549.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, hide behind me! Run as soon as you get the chance!""

3461564551.m_KeyValue: "I won't let you lay a finger on her!"

3461564574.m_KeyValue: ""When the time comes, we'll return here together.""

3461564575.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, I can't believe you're still in one piece after falling from all the way up there!""

3461564577.m_KeyValue: "Where's Sora? Weren't you two looking for the doctor together? Where is he?!"

3461564838.m_KeyValue: ""May our path forward be bathed in the Light, unhindered by the shadow.""

3461564840.m_KeyValue: "The bad news... the El Dorado has most likely sunk..."

3461564870.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, my clothes are all dirty... Your clothes... they look very expensive...""

3461564871.m_KeyValue: ""I have a lot I'd like to ask you, but let's find somewhere safe first.""

3461564872.m_KeyValue: "But I still haven't seen another soul. If only someone could shed some light on all this... anyone would do—"

3461564873.m_KeyValue: "Am I even sure this is an island?"

3461564902.m_KeyValue: ""This island, where the next Moonblessed is supposed to be, and the location of my hometown, according to Cain...""

3461564903.m_KeyValue: "I was told that my hometown is on Sunset Isle."

3461564905.m_KeyValue: ""N-No, I wasn't. I came here to find my hometown...""

3461564934.m_KeyValue: "My grandmother passed away a long time ago. And..."

3461564937.m_KeyValue: "...Why did Noah choose that particular gesture?"

3461564938.m_KeyValue: "Dr. Ressa is our last hope... She's the only one who can save us from turning into those monsters!"

3461564939.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's my fault. I got caught up in the moment.""

3461564940.m_KeyValue: "This voice... why does it sound so familiar? So comforting..."

3461564967.m_KeyValue: ""Longings? But... if we can see them, does that mean we also have a longing for something on this island?""

3461564970.m_KeyValue: "Didn't I tell you to catch a boat back to the Church without me? Why are you still here?"

3461564972.m_KeyValue: ""And there lies the problem. Within the Church, only the Bell Ringers are allowed access to that place. So the traitor...""

3461564973.m_KeyValue: ""If he's been gone for days, why are we searching here?""

3461565000.m_KeyValue: "—'Gravekeeper' of the Divine Body on this island?"

3461565002.m_KeyValue: ""...You are Noah Nevernight, indeed. You haven't changed at all. So self-absorbed, so cold... and yet... so strong...""

3461565003.m_KeyValue: ""But you, Noah Nevernight, you stole her from us.""

3461565004.m_KeyValue: "S-Sorry... I promise I won't get scared. I won't cause you any trouble."

3461565005.m_KeyValue: "But you said your grandmother told you? I don't recall seeing anyone that could be your grandmother on the way here."

3461565030.m_KeyValue: ""Let me take care of these, then you can explain these rules to me!""

3461565031.m_KeyValue: ""Either way, for now we only know that the Divine Body on this island is causing these phantoms to materialize based on people's longings.""

3461565033.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you just said... you came to the island to find the Calamity, right? But you called it a Moonblessed?""

3461565034.m_KeyValue: ""The Gravekeeper's duty... naturally fell to me, the only one left...""

3461565035.m_KeyValue: ""It's because of my companions—the blurred figure in my memories who promised to wait for my return; and now, those by my side striving towards our common goal, the Moonblessed.""

3461565037.m_KeyValue: "I appreciate the concern. But it was the presence of a Divine Body that linked those two events."

3461770012.m_KeyValue: "Then let me—the heart of the Divine Body—show you what you truly are."

3461770014.m_KeyValue: "But Cain plans to use Empousa regardless. If he succeeds..."

3461770015.m_KeyValue: "And next time you want to negotiate... Come in person."

3461770016.m_KeyValue: ""Just days ago, in that broken carriage... I never imagined you would become the end of my journey.""

3462039791.m_KeyValue: ""What are your thoughts on 'collecting Future Artifacts highly sought after by various factions, despite significant risks'?""

3462041969.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on arranging for vassals to infiltrate the territories of other Kingdoms?"

3462045040.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'reducing the scope of authority of our elders'?"

3462182376.m_KeyValue: ""So, you don't intend to deal us another card?""

3462182377.m_KeyValue: "My mortal flesh has long since withered. This form is all that remains."

3462182379.m_KeyValue: "And here I thought we'd met a nice old man. Looks like we'll have to fight after all!"

3462182408.m_KeyValue: "We've already obtained four cards. We're more than halfway through this journey. Let's stay positive."

3462182409.m_KeyValue: ""I'm afraid none of these are the fifth card you're looking for, darlings.""

3462182410.m_KeyValue: ""My, my, this card... Is it what you expected? 'The Moon' in reverse—""

3462182411.m_KeyValue: ""Consider this card a gift and a word of advice from me. After all, the path ahead will undoubtedly be difficult.""

3462182412.m_KeyValue: ""You're right, but... I have no idea. What name should I give myself?""

3462182672.m_KeyValue: "'Perhaps a caged bird should never yearn for the starry sky.'"

3462182673.m_KeyValue: ""Of course it's boring, doing the same thing every day. But we can choose to escape, to leave this place behind.""

3462182674.m_KeyValue: "Then why me...? I haven't done anything of note."

3462182675.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously, why can't you just be honest?""

3462182704.m_KeyValue: "What the heck were those two... things?"

3462182705.m_KeyValue: "As I thought... this strange card is one of the keys to activate the Astrolabe."

3462182706.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps... keys to unlock a mechanism? Seven grooves, and the Astrolabe has seven rings...""

3462182707.m_KeyValue: ""Even if we count everyone who was imprisoned with us, there still weren't this many people, were there?""

3462182736.m_KeyValue: ""No, I shouldn't have tried to force my ideals on you, and even said you hated...""

3462182739.m_KeyValue: ""...Wait, why are there so many of them?!""

3462182769.m_KeyValue: ""You warned me, but I underestimated our situation. If we fail here, it's my fault alone...""

3462182771.m_KeyValue: "We've got the second card too. Let's get out of here before she changes her mind."

3462182772.m_KeyValue: "Don't be jealous just because I'm cute."

3462182774.m_KeyValue: ""Violence is prohibited in this store. If you have no money, please leave.""

3462182775.m_KeyValue: "I can part with it if you want."

3462182805.m_KeyValue: ""You can feel me, can't you? My body's warmth, my scent—they're real.""

3462182806.m_KeyValue: ""Like those puppets we encountered before, right?""

3462182836.m_KeyValue: ""'Die here in despair,' or 'Struggle to survive and chase that unreachable goal.'""

3462182837.m_KeyValue: "Are you done playing this game of friendship?"

3462182838.m_KeyValue: "This guy... Could he be some kind of monster?!"

3462182839.m_KeyValue: "Lesson one: respect the darkness and the unknown lurking within."

3462182868.m_KeyValue: "Is it... weird? Do you not like it?"

3462182870.m_KeyValue: "So it's literally an abyss? That's rather... disappointing."

3462800316.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I said we cannot halt their invasion. But what if…""

3462800317.m_KeyValue: "We turned the tide—by invading their world instead?"

3462800319.m_KeyValue: ""At last, someone who grasps the rhythm of my thought.""

3462800320.m_KeyValue: ""So after all that clever talk, we're still the ones left to figure things out?""

3462800322.m_KeyValue: ""What?! So even you don't have a solution, Four-Eyes?""

3462800323.m_KeyValue: "Got my hopes up for nothing. What a letdown..."

3462801336.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, when you're done, you'd better come back, got it?""

3462801337.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, Four-eyes said we can't cross over anyway.""

3462801340.m_KeyValue: "We'll deal with this! Noah—go! Take them to the bell tower!"

3462801341.m_KeyValue: "The hand that tore the sky! Why did it come here?!"

3462801342.m_KeyValue: ""Even if we tried to stop you, you'd still go, wouldn't you?""

3462801344.m_KeyValue: "Again!? What does it take to shake these pests off!?"

3462803514.m_KeyValue: "If I unleash Death's power now... it may take them with it—"

3462803515.m_KeyValue: ""They're getting in our way... But we can't just leave them… Ugh, what a mess!""

3462803516.m_KeyValue: "Why are civilians still outside?! Get indoors—hurry!"

3462803517.m_KeyValue: ""Aeon have mercy on us... Seth, protect...""

3462803518.m_KeyValue: "Someone help me—! I... I can't die here!"

3462803520.m_KeyValue: "'Mastermind'? You mean your world's equivalent of the Divine Body?"

3462803521.m_KeyValue: "I told you... they're endless. So long as the 'Mastermind' exists."

3462803522.m_KeyValue: "How many more are pouring through that rift?!"

3463060644.m_KeyValue: "I've heard that ranked Silver Cross members are second only to the Bell Ringers in power..."

3463060646.m_KeyValue: "I can't run... I have to kill this thing and get the message out!"

3463060648.m_KeyValue: ""My my, Cain is surprisingly dependable when he's our ally.""

3463061671.m_KeyValue: "He says nothing... That's as good as a yes."

3463061672.m_KeyValue: ""...After all, only the dead stay silent.""

3464370198.m_KeyValue: "And yet all this began the moment he handed you that lance without a single explanation..."

3464370199.m_KeyValue: "You're the one who refused to listen to reason!"

3464370200.m_KeyValue: "Let's be honest. You'll collapse halfway there."

3464947065.m_KeyValue: ""The blonde youth drifted off mid-sentence. His companion, however, laid wide awake, his mind a tempest of thoughts.""

3464947066.m_KeyValue: ""'Isn't it really romantic when you think about it? But, we should probably get some sleep.'""

3464947067.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain let out a derisive chuckle. 'Hah, there you go again, weaving your fanciful tales.'""

3464947068.m_KeyValue: "'I think this is about passing on an ideal. Nikola is using his dear friend Leonardo's name to document the world.'"

3465105964.m_KeyValue: "Put the blindfold on and follow me."

3465105965.m_KeyValue: "Dead bodies have no place in prison! Do you understand the punishment I face for these runaways who dared to die?"

3465105967.m_KeyValue: ""The life we shared… that quiet, ordinary time… It's a precious memory—one I'll carry always.""

3465788125.m_KeyValue: ""One of the maiden's copies, and bearer of the last pass to the outside realm for No. 66. Neither cruel destiny nor fight with her friend could deter her from 'escaping together.'""

3465979788.m_KeyValue: "Clear [Threads of Fate] <style="Clientmessage01">1-4</style> to unlock [Initial Ultimate Edit]."

3466401955.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel looked a bit disappointed. 'I suppose it could be... After all, I only heard it as a child.'""

3466401956.m_KeyValue: ""'No, it's actual history,' Empousa cut in abruptly, catching even Noah off guard.""

3466401958.m_KeyValue: "'It sounds like a fabricated beautiful fairy tale.'"

3468002552.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, <link=""Tips_ID;2""><#508499><u>Teleports</u></color></link> to the farthest enemy within range of the target, dealing massive P. DMG and marking them as the new target.""

3468002553.m_KeyValue: ""When HP Percentage falls below {0} for the first time, gains a Shield equal to {1} of Max HP. Casts Special again when their target dies.""

3468006905.m_KeyValue: ""Uses a gun to perform a Ranged attack, dealing weak P. DMG to the target.""

3468006908.m_KeyValue: ""Shoots an Anchor Hook at the farthest enemy, inflicting Stun and gradually reeling them in. When nearing close range, deals massive P. DMG and knocks them back. This skill can be interrupted by destroying the hook during the pull.""

3468010101.m_KeyValue:
""After battle begins, periodically summons {0} Worker Bees. Worker Bees are immobile, but deal P. DMG to random targets. When a Worker Bee dies, all remaining Worker Bees immediately restore their HP to {3}.
After {4} sec, the Formless absorbs all energy from the remaining Worker Bees on the field and deals P. DMG to all enemy targets. Each Worker Bee absorbed increases P. DMG dealt and restores {5} energy. If no Worker Bees are absorbed, the Formless gains Vulnerability for {6} sec.""

3468010102.m_KeyValue: ""Gathers electric clouds along the densest line of targets, then strikes that area, dealing P. DMG and inflicting Paralysis for {0} sec.""

3468010103.m_KeyValue:
""When a unit on the field has Paralysis, the Formless absorbs their electrical current to restore {0} Energy.
When its HP drops to {1}, its backup power is activated, granting {2} sec of Invincibility and instantly filling its Energy to maximum. Cannot be triggered while dormant.""

3468010104.m_KeyValue: ""The Formless swings its arm to strike the ground, dealing P. DMG to all targets and applying {0} stacks of Induction to targets hit.""

3468010105.m_KeyValue:
""When Energy reaches {0}, the Formless enters Cannon Mode for a duration, exposing its Energy Core while dealing P. DMG to all enemies. In Cannon Mode, it targets the enemy with the highest Max HP and fires plasma beams, dealing heavy P. DMG. Each shot consumes Energy and applies {2} stacks of Degradation to itself. When Energy reaches zero, the Formless leaves Cannon Mode and clears all Degradation.
If the Energy Core is destroyed during Cannon Mode, the Formless will enter dormancy due to Energy depletion, and all Degradation remains for {3} sec.""

3468010108.m_KeyValue: ""Swipes in a cone, dealing P. DMG.""

3468195302.m_KeyValue: ""DMG Reduction UP by {0}. Each CRIT Hit received reduces DMG Reduction by {1}, up to {2} times. When this limit is reached, becomes Stunned for {3} sec.""

3468195303.m_KeyValue: "ATK and DEF increased by {0}. Immune to status effects."

3468524481.m_KeyValue: "Complete challenges with Vassals at specific levels to earn abundant Extra Rewards."

3471155920.m_KeyValue: ""But no matter what you've become, you'll always be the hero to us.""

3472131468.m_KeyValue: ""I think I'm starting to understand how it feels to be dragged into these _$$rumors._$$ If I see him again, I'll be more careful.""

3472131470.m_KeyValue: "That old man? I thought there was something strange about him from the start. But why would he do this?"

3472131471.m_KeyValue: ""Ah... so the _$$storyteller_$$you met appeared as an old man? So they can alter not only their appearance, but even their age. Who could they be?""

3472131472.m_KeyValue: ""I've no idea why anyone would think that's me, but let me make one thing clear. I didn't know you before, nor did I have any interest in doing so.""

3472131473.m_KeyValue: "Of course I know you're not that kind of person. If I had to guess... someone went out of their way to take your form."

3474264470.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Julius - Spirit Siphon avatar."

3474264474.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Gilrain - Spirit Siphon avatar."

3474264475.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Baphomet - Spirit Siphon avatar."

3474264476.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Selena - Spirit Siphon avatar."

3474264477.m_KeyValue: "Obtain to unlock Dalcarlo - Spirit Siphon avatar."

3474940660.m_KeyValue:
""Bella awoke from unconsciousness, pain stabbing through every inch of her body.
She remembered her illness flaring again, being carried to bed by servants, and then...
'Where am I?'
She looked around. Her left leg was missing, but the bandages were clean and tight. In the water tank beside her floated siren corpses, their bodies mutilated beyond recognition.
'Was I kidnapped? Them too? Who would do this…?'
Grabbing a stick for balance, Bella limped toward the exit, hopping on one leg. She knew where to find allies who would help her uncover the truth.
'I have to reach the meeting point. I must warn Lorelei—someone is hunting the sirens!'
'I can still run...'""

3475530915.m_KeyValue: "Just someone who hopes you'll pretend none of this ever happened."

3475530916.m_KeyValue: "But the commander said they would wait for the full moon... and that night has yet to come—"

3475530917.m_KeyValue: "You remember when Lord Agares executed that silver-haired heretic here a few days ago? Where did he go after that?"

3475530918.m_KeyValue: "I see. Just the two of you… That makes it easier."

3475534116.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, the Carrelle family's thousand-year reign of bondage comes to an end.""

3475534117.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Agares, are you alright? Everyone is waiting for your orders.""

3475534118.m_KeyValue: ""Now, six days is all I need to reclaim everything I have lost.""

3476100271.m_KeyValue: "I... How did I get here? Who am I? My memory..."

3476100272.m_KeyValue: "This is a sample of Miss Setti's blood that we managed to bring back from Starfall Valley."

3476100273.m_KeyValue: ""It seems the <style=""Highlight"">Pure Blood Essence</style> worked quite well for Miss Setti. What will it be for you, Noah?""

3476100274.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Setti, please calm down. You've just awakened and your body is quite weak. We shall be explaining the situation to you in detail, alright?""

3476170993.m_KeyValue: "I always knew—Ganelon was never truly my name."

3476170995.m_KeyValue: ""Deep down, I've always known... I'm different. From my brother, from my father... from everyone in Ganelon.""

3476170996.m_KeyValue: "And I knew Mouret was never truly my home."

3476170997.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Your true homeland._$$ Back then, I never knew what he meant.""

3476170998.m_KeyValue: ""Father always told me, _$$One day, you must take that step... face your true self... and find..._$$""

3476170999.m_KeyValue: "A true homeland... is just as you said—where the ones I love and hold dear reside."

3476171000.m_KeyValue: "Thank you... Your name's Ranna? Your words helped me understand my father for the first time."

3476171002.m_KeyValue: "So I don't need to go anywhere. Because I never left my homeland."

3476172018.m_KeyValue: ""March – The sea, ever an unpredictable maiden, grew more temperamental this time of year.""

3476172019.m_KeyValue: "Our mission to recover the lost artifacts of the legendary Landis family had come to a complete halt."

3476172020.m_KeyValue: ""Until that day, when Bob—newly promoted to Second Mate—came to me, cradling a child in his arms.""

3476172021.m_KeyValue: ""He said they had pulled her from the sea. Could that be true? How could a girl, barely a year old, survive the ocean's depths?""

3476172022.m_KeyValue: ""Yet something about her brought the Landis family to mind—the very family we had been searching for, the ones who vanished with their island into the waves.""

3476172023.m_KeyValue: ""If they hadn't perished, but instead founded a kingdom beneath the sea... then this child might be the key to unlocking that mystery, to realizing our dream.""

3476172024.m_KeyValue: ""_$$We should give her a name,_$$ Bob said.""

3476172026.m_KeyValue: ""Ami—Ami Landis. She would be our helm, the one to steer us toward the truth behind the legend.""

3476180721.m_KeyValue: "Am I going to be eaten...? Or will I turn into one of them—devouring others...?"

3476180730.m_KeyValue: "Why is this happening? What's going on aboard the ship?"

3476180731.m_KeyValue: ""Just this morning, Bob praised me for working so hard...""

3476180732.m_KeyValue: "I even had my favorite smoked fish for dinner..."

3476180733.m_KeyValue: ""If I could just get some sleep, tomorrow would be another ordinary, happy day...""

3476180735.m_KeyValue: "All I did was slack off a little today... Is this my punishment...?"

3476180736.m_KeyValue: "Is it so wrong to just want to live a quiet life...?"

3476181875.m_KeyValue: "Then those whispers might be a resonance—a symptom of the Black Blood."

3476181876.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami has lived on this ship for years—she shouldn't be seasick. If Miss Hati heard the same voice..."

3476181881.m_KeyValue: "The source of the voice... Is it moving?"

3476181882.m_KeyValue: "No... something's wrong. The voice... it's getting closer. She's coming up here too—she's nearby..."

3476181883.m_KeyValue: ""We've left the lowest level—the one that caused you pain. Are you feeling any better now, Miss Ami?""

3476181885.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know if they're hearing the same thing, but that's what that dumb wolf said.""

3476181887.m_KeyValue: ""First that dumb wolf, and now her? Do all seasick people hear creepy whispers? What a pain...""

3476181888.m_KeyValue: "That voice... She's hungry... She wants to restore her power... She's searching for more food..."

3476182899.m_KeyValue: "That kick really hurt! Can you help me up?"

3476182905.m_KeyValue: "Huh...? When did it get so dark? Did someone blow out the candles?"

3476182906.m_KeyValue: "Where did that thing that tried to devour me go? Could it be waiting to ambush me from the shadows..."

3476182909.m_KeyValue: "Sis... We're just sparring. You didn't have to go all out..."

3476184053.m_KeyValue: ""I may not know where she is now, but I know exactly where she'll end up.""

3476184054.m_KeyValue: ""Never forget, the future is always a step ahead of the present.""

3476184057.m_KeyValue: ""Erm... Miss Dalcarlo, that's not what the compass is for either.""

3476184058.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to track someone, go ask the compass, meow.""

3476184059.m_KeyValue: "I will not allow anyone to mock the future! ...But you did remind me of something."

3476184060.m_KeyValue: "Why prattle on about the future? We'll be fish food before it ever comes. Especially you—you'd make a rather lovely bite."

3476184061.m_KeyValue: "She's got the brains of a jellyfish—doesn't even realize how dangerous it is to wander off alone right now!"

3476184063.m_KeyValue: ""Empress, you seem to misunderstand what I do meow. I see the future, not the present.""

3476184064.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, Jacintha, aren't you supposed to be a fortune-teller? Hurry up and tell us where she went!""

3476185077.m_KeyValue: "I have to go... I can't let her revive again..."

3476185078.m_KeyValue: "...Am I still too weak? I need to eat..."

3476185082.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, keep an eye on jellyfish girl. Leave these pests to me!""

3476185083.m_KeyValue: "You bear my blood... You are my kin..."

3476185088.m_KeyValue: "That voice... It's coming from the provisions room?"

3476186232.m_KeyValue: "Eh?! Well that's worse! What do we do now?!"

3476186235.m_KeyValue: "It's fine. I recognize that uniform. He's not with the crew."

3476186237.m_KeyValue: "I need more sustenance to restore my strength!"

3476186239.m_KeyValue: "They dare reject fusion with the ancestral Black Blood? They'll regret it soon enough."

3476187255.m_KeyValue: "I'm not falling for that trick again! This isn't Mouret!"

3476187256.m_KeyValue: ""And why are you so certain this world isn't real? Aren't your thoughts, your memories... all right here?""

3476187257.m_KeyValue: ""You dragged me into that mindscape thing again, didn't you?!""

3476187258.m_KeyValue: "Have you ever considered... that this might be the real world?"

3476187259.m_KeyValue: "What happened to you? You look hideous!"

3476187260.m_KeyValue: "Fool! Black Blood is our true form—this shape is proof that I've reclaimed my power."

3476187262.m_KeyValue: ""Now, Sheila... this is the perfect time to join me.""

3476187264.m_KeyValue: "Why's it so quiet... Is there nothing on the deck? Ami...?"

3478201917.m_KeyValue: ""From the sound of it, they're not among the living.""

3481072863.m_KeyValue: ""Alas, even if one's wish did come to fruition, it was but a twist of fate, a mere coincidence.""

3481072864.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, ever the pragmatist, stood at the Observatory's threshold, her face a canvas of utter bewilderment. 'Then what's the point of us being here?'""

3481072865.m_KeyValue: "Our faith in the protagonist remains unassailable!"

3481072868.m_KeyValue: ""Incidentally, there's also a legend that 400 years ago, a couple successfully escaped the war. Their descendants may still be thriving in some remote corner of the continent to this day...""

3481594000.m_KeyValue:
""All the strange occurrences began the moment I touched that painting. Perhaps the answers to this mystery lie there as well.

I scoured every corner for traces of Julius, but my search was fruitless. Only Van Helsing unearthed a tome from the Church's archives—a book titled _$$The Blood-Stained Hammer._$$ Its pages spoke in cryptic tones of a Bathory elder who fell during the Church's crusade against the heretics centuries ago. His spear, the text claimed, shattered in a desperate battle against the Bell Ringer. Afterward, the heretics were utterly defeated, their existence wiped away.""

3481594159.m_KeyValue:
""Sirene does have more hands than most—likely extensions of her will.
Just as she loathes introducing herself, she hates doing anything with her own hands. Rather than soil her skin with coarse objects or tire her muscles with effort, she'd much rather curl up in her cloak and let its hands do the work.
Come to think of it... how does she control so many at once?""

3481594190.m_KeyValue:
""I have gazed upon the stone door that binds Letitia's dark nature, and I have tasted the suffocating dread that heralds a Tempest. I know with absolute certainty that Letitia's choice was the only path.

Yet, having severed all negative emotions, Letitia's boundless compassion invariably became her greatest burden, blinding her to harsh truths in moments when decisive action was required.

Perhaps the dark side of human nature serves a purpose more vital than we dare admit.""

3483065320.m_KeyValue: "How curious... What is Yakov's real reason for drawing you into Association matters?"

3483402009.m_KeyValue: ""Now then, I'll have to think carefully about how to persuade you to help me.""

3483402012.m_KeyValue: "I'll be sure to write to you again soon."

3483402015.m_KeyValue: "I think we should return to a more rational discussion."

3483402016.m_KeyValue: "Very well. I'll pay you a personal visit then."

3484576197.m_KeyValue: "Come to think of it… this jungle looks like the one near Asta."

3484576198.m_KeyValue: ""If the El Dorado hadn't caught us, Regina and I might've landed near the 'anchor' in the bell tower Albrecht mentioned... I just hope I made the right call.""

3484576199.m_KeyValue: ""Still, this might be the only way to prove my theory.""

3484576200.m_KeyValue: ""If I really am the Formless's target, then Regina and Ami should be able to slip past the encirclement.""

3484576202.m_KeyValue: "(exhaling) I must've been scratched by the brush when I fell from the dirigible."

3484576210.m_KeyValue: "Its tone... it's different. Almost melodic—like it's singing?"

3484578371.m_KeyValue: "We hold the line. At least until Noah and the others return."

3484578372.m_KeyValue: ""It's rather ironic. Individually, these constructs pose no real threat to us.""

3484578380.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't today's celebration canceled because of those metal beasts? Why are there still fireworks?"

3484578381.m_KeyValue: "Those aren't fireworks. They're a message from another world."

3484578382.m_KeyValue: "Another world... you mean Noah and the others!?"

3484578384.m_KeyValue: ""Now that the hand has vanished, we must seize the moment to destroy what remains.""

3484578385.m_KeyValue: "So that Asta may one day see real fireworks again."

3484578386.m_KeyValue: ""I don't really get it, but... we just smash those metal creatures, right?""

3484579395.m_KeyValue: "You're all bark when it comes to pain."

3484579396.m_KeyValue: ""If it comes to that, I'll have to use metamorphosis...""

3484579397.m_KeyValue: ""I don't understand your faith in him. But the reality is, this ship won't survive another assault.""

3484579398.m_KeyValue: ""Please... just a little more time! If Noah got our message, he'll come—he'll bring Albrecht from our world!""

3484579399.m_KeyValue: "We sent every last drone to hunt down that Noah guy. And now what!?"

3484579400.m_KeyValue: "Damn it! We can't stay here—those constructs will swarm El Dorado if we don't move!"

3484579409.m_KeyValue: "I'll disembark and draw them away from the ship."

3484579410.m_KeyValue: "For my family—for everything I care about—I will do it!"

3484580549.m_KeyValue: "There are countless alchemical creations here you've never seen before."

3484580550.m_KeyValue: ""Mortals seek answers, yet forget the joy of the pursuit.""

3484580555.m_KeyValue: "So your true purpose here is to explore instead of saving the world?"

3484580556.m_KeyValue: "Glory and titles mean little to an alchemist."

3484580558.m_KeyValue: "I expected something advanced... but this exceeds even my projections."

3484580559.m_KeyValue: ""And here, within this sanctuary I have carved—Lies the 'key' every alchemist yearns to find.""

3484580560.m_KeyValue: ""That 'key' which transcends time itself, binding all knowledge into one.""

3484580561.m_KeyValue: "What drives us is truth. The hunger to comprehend the principle of truth."

3484580562.m_KeyValue: ""From the moment we first melt metal into liquid, we embrace the most primal alchemy. That simple act births all creation.""

3484581571.m_KeyValue: "People look at a bottle and assume all things pass through its mouth."

3484581572.m_KeyValue: ""So if you want to keep them from reaching our world, all you'd need to do is seal the bottle?""

3484581579.m_KeyValue: ""Initially, I sought merely to determine whether beings of higher dimensions dwelt beyond the boundaries of our reality.""

3484581581.m_KeyValue: "Can universes truly be created so easily?"

3484581582.m_KeyValue: ""I infused my 'water' into the vessel, and through patient, meticulous refinement, watched a fledgling universe take shape—one that now grows beyond its crystalline cradle.""

3484581583.m_KeyValue: "So you're not denying that you created this world?"

3484581584.m_KeyValue: "'Universe'—is a man-made word. And no... it's not easy."

3484581585.m_KeyValue: "I witnessed it firsthand—nothing but ruins left in the wake of creation."

3484581586.m_KeyValue: ""I admit, I had doubts about my calculations and was even startled by its progression. You see—""

3484582727.m_KeyValue: "But... where will that hand strike next?"

3484582728.m_KeyValue: ""...I already know your names and identities, and I believe you should have the same goal as I do. But her—""

3484582731.m_KeyValue: "Or rather that hand pursued Stella back to where it came from."

3484582732.m_KeyValue: ""If we eliminate these enemies, the city should be safe for now?""

3484582734.m_KeyValue: ""Finally, some good news! Let's clear them out—fast!""

3484582736.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, is it just me, or are there fewer of those metal creatures?""

3484582737.m_KeyValue: "It's likely connected to Noah and the others reaching the Other Side."

3484583750.m_KeyValue: ""I'd love to hear more, but it's getting closer!""

3484583755.m_KeyValue: "I've fought that thing for years—even followed it to the Other Side—and this is the first time I'm hearing what it's called."

3484583756.m_KeyValue: "It's a weapon the Mastermind uses to force its way into our world. It's controlling all those alchemical constructs."

3484583759.m_KeyValue: "It can reach the Other Sides because it exists outside time and space."

3484583760.m_KeyValue: "Time flows differently on each 'Other Side.' The fastest one—one day there equals seven years here."

3484583761.m_KeyValue: "I was only there for a day."

3484583762.m_KeyValue: "The Other Side? So that's where you're from. Explains why you dropped in out of nowhere."

3484584905.m_KeyValue: "Looks like we've got another mouth to feed."

3484584908.m_KeyValue: "Ugh… my head… feels like my body's been torn apart…"

3484584909.m_KeyValue: "We detected four signals before. Where are the others?"

3484584911.m_KeyValue: "A fall from that height should've killed her. Should we toss her over?"

3484584912.m_KeyValue: ""No, wait—she's breathing. We can still save her.""

3484584914.m_KeyValue: "That signal from earlier—it has to be her."

3484585931.m_KeyValue: "So this is Miss Death's homeland? Intriguing. I see contraptions I've never encountered before."

3484585932.m_KeyValue: ""So, you've made it here in one piece. I must admit—your descent was far more graceful than expected. But given... present circumstances, perhaps some mysteries are best left unanswered.""

3484585933.m_KeyValue: ""And yet the world teeters on the brink of ruination. Which is precisely why we've come, isn't it?""

3484585934.m_KeyValue: ""Given time, I'm sure you could recreate them yourself.""

3484585935.m_KeyValue: ""Even amid the devastation, you can still glimpse what Asta once was.""

3484585937.m_KeyValue: "Shattered pipes strewn across the ground... wreckage that looks like ships. Could they truly fly through the skies?"

3484585938.m_KeyValue: ""But though it's still Asta, everything has changed.""

3484597030.m_KeyValue: "M. DMG Taken -{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

3485398017.m_KeyValue: "A dungeon? This is your notion of hospitality?"

3485398018.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Didn't you just say we should talk in private?"

3485398023.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—the six missing were four civilians and two soldiers, armed with pitchforks and longswords, were they not?""

3485398024.m_KeyValue: ""A silver-haired youth steps from the crowd, his voice low with quiet warning.""

3485398025.m_KeyValue: "Captain Ryan! We found a survivor beyond the walls."

3485398026.m_KeyValue: "Good. Open the gates and hold the perimeter."

3485398027.m_KeyValue: "Your technique just now... no common Bloodborn could wield a blade so."

3485398028.m_KeyValue: "Noah cuts the exchange short and glances back over his shoulder."

3485398029.m_KeyValue: ""The soldiers behind them break formation in alarm, weapons raised.""

3485398030.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina's gaze roves over Noah, measuring him in silence.""

3487000329.m_KeyValue: "Are there annoying Blood Beasts in heaven too?"

3487000330.m_KeyValue: ""As expected, you really like the taste of blood in this body.""

3487000361.m_KeyValue: "Aunty Julia caught a big fish and is calling everyone to eat!"

3487000363.m_KeyValue: "You're right... it's all my fault... I shouldn't have done the divination. Mother warned me long ago..."

3487000364.m_KeyValue: "There's only one way to pass the test..."

3487000365.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's not that you're not relying on the power of the Tarot. You're too afraid... afraid that your divination will come true.""

3487000367.m_KeyValue: "Half of the sailors row at full speed towards the sails! The other half grab weapons and prepare for battle!"

3487000368.m_KeyValue: "Your weakness lies at the ocean's end..."

3487000394.m_KeyValue: ""I'm useless... Kitty... I couldn't save you, nor anyone else...""

3487000395.m_KeyValue: "Stop you? I don't need to do anything."

3487000396.m_KeyValue: ""How many disoriented wanderers have I caught in the deep sea, their lungs filled with water, unable to utter even their last words?""

3487058301.m_KeyValue: ""Spits out a Plague Hatchling at the nearest target, Binding them and inflicting Stun. The Plague Hatchling can be Eliminated, removing Stun from the target.""

3488291720.m_KeyValue: ""There were so many beasts this time, yet they were surprisingly weak.""

3488291721.m_KeyValue: "It ascends from the earth to the heaven and again it descends to the earth and receives the force of things superior and inferior. By this means you shall have—"

3488291752.m_KeyValue: ""Pack them separately, be prepared to discard them to lighten the load at any time.""

3488291753.m_KeyValue: "The tarot was right! We defeated so many beasts! Now we can finally set out!"

3488291754.m_KeyValue: "What about the Tarot card she gave us? Does it say where to find her?"

3488291755.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, life returns to dust, but death can have its own value.""

3488292016.m_KeyValue: ""What a downpour! Even the fish are coming up to the surface, let's go catch some!""

3488292017.m_KeyValue: "I... I can't perform divination for others..."

3488292018.m_KeyValue: ""'The Tower' stands at the center of the storm, its once solid foundation crumbling in tragedy;""

3488292019.m_KeyValue: ""What appeared? Slimy, vicious Blood Beasts that bring endless pain and torment, of course!""

3488292020.m_KeyValue: ""...The Tarot is not a power to be used lightly. We explore the limits of being 'human,' and only after that do we seek the blessing of the Tarot.""

3488292051.m_KeyValue: ""A giant, super fluffy version of yourself? Hehe, I can just imagine how cute you'd—""

3488292082.m_KeyValue: ""You mean this tree? ...Ah, to build a new boat?""

3488292116.m_KeyValue: "Captain... the mast was broken during the battle..."

3488292117.m_KeyValue: "Captain... while we were distracted those beasts ripped a hole in the ship..."

3488292119.m_KeyValue: ""The doctor gave her some medicine and said... if she could hold on until tomorrow, there's still hope for recovery...""

3488292149.m_KeyValue: "I don't believe in the fate you speak of! Are you the one Esmeralda said would bring hope? You're not!"

3488292150.m_KeyValue: "It's the Captain! The Captain is speaking!"

3488292151.m_KeyValue: "Why did you wait... wait until the Captain..."

3488292178.m_KeyValue: "What about you? Aren't you going back?"

3488292180.m_KeyValue: "The sealed door opens—ancient tales come to light—"

3488292182.m_KeyValue: "She'd keep fighting all the way to the Blood Beasts' lair! She'd find the mastermind behind it all—the evil windmill that wants to devour the entire world!"

3488292183.m_KeyValue: ""The cards reveal that the Pontos will ultimately fall to Death, and this calamity will continue to spread until it brings misfortune to the entire continent.""

3488682218.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, should I start with the 'Sapphire Isle Auction House' and its rare treasures? Or head straight to the legendary 'Sails of Glory'?""

3491022731.m_KeyValue:
""Current situation aboard the El Dorado—
Noah and others pursue William to the lowest deck.""

3491022734.m_KeyValue: "A name long-since sealed. Only a few remember the ebb and flow of time in those repetitive twenty years.Those who don't understand the mystery of cause and effect still call it the _$$Ganelon Forbidden Grounds._$$"

3491358896.m_KeyValue: ""'Once the promised flower withers, your father will no longer exist in this world...'""

3491975207.m_KeyValue: "To think I could be outwitted... What a brilliant little cat burglar."

3491975208.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, its most vital memory has been stolen.""

3491975210.m_KeyValue: "And so... that's how everything came to pass."

3491975211.m_KeyValue: ""At last, the wicked Joyce has fallen.""

3492979900.m_KeyValue: ""Allied Units: After battle begins, loses {0} of Max HP every {1} sec for the entire battle.""

3493819215.m_KeyValue: "I am searching for the way back to my homeland."

3494475068.m_KeyValue: "Fungal colony? I think I've heard alchemists mention that before."

3494493403.m_KeyValue: "The power my father taught me was the power to protect! Awaken—"

3494493404.m_KeyValue: "W-what?! What kind of mother does that?! What kind of family is this!?"

3494493405.m_KeyValue: "Is it that sinister eyebrows? Have you joined him? Or is it... Cain? Are you working with him now!?"

3494493406.m_KeyValue: "Miss Dalcarlo... You left so suddenly back there. I thought you'd abandoned us."

3494494422.m_KeyValue: ""What are you trying to do, Mr. Van Helsing…?""

3494494423.m_KeyValue: "What kind of bard would show up in a place like this?! He's clearly the enemy!"

3494494425.m_KeyValue: "Is this... the sealed area? Have I returned to reality?"

3494494426.m_KeyValue: "Just long enough for me to gather the Four and open the path—"

3494494427.m_KeyValue: "No. There is one case in which we do die—"

3494494428.m_KeyValue: "A long tale... and we've little time left. You'll be leaving soon."

3494494429.m_KeyValue: "How rude—both to her wardrobe and to your labeling of truth as an ability."

3494494430.m_KeyValue: "And if I take Aeon's place... then why should I not be omniscient and omnipotent?"

3494682019.m_KeyValue: "Only by bathing in the Light can one be reborn."

3494682178.m_KeyValue: "This will be the last time you face The Light."

3494687609.m_KeyValue: "The last person who disrespected me ended up in pieces."

3494687706.m_KeyValue: "Phew... At least that's somewhat of an improvement."

3494689659.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Aren't you getting a little too comfortable?"

3494689849.m_KeyValue: "This is what you get for messing with me!"

3494690715.m_KeyValue: "Oh? You wish to add more kindling to this undying flame?"

3494690808.m_KeyValue: "I found this spot first. Mind going somewhere else?"

3494690874.m_KeyValue: "Watch as time itself is set ablaze!"

3494691957.m_KeyValue: "I'll stop at nothing to exact my revenge."

3494692054.m_KeyValue: "This power is enough to cut through flames."

3494692858.m_KeyValue: "The feelings in my heart vanished long ago with the moonlight."

3494695063.m_KeyValue: ""The deeper the night, the thicker the shadows.""

3494695156.m_KeyValue: ""These shadows beneath your feet - were they born from you, or do you merely cling to their existence?""

3494697206.m_KeyValue: "Is there somewhere you'd like to go? Just tell me directly."

3494697237.m_KeyValue: "Let us tread the path illuminated by divine light."

3494697396.m_KeyValue: "Feel the scorching heat of the sun!"

3495802953.m_KeyValue: "Light's other half... 'the dusk remains'... It must mean the black and white Colossus Max..."

3495802954.m_KeyValue: "Seriously... is there anyone normal in this camp?"

3495802955.m_KeyValue: ""Whoa, whoa—don't get upset. I was jesting.""

3495892365.m_KeyValue: "With this power... perhaps I can defeat them!"

3495892396.m_KeyValue: ""No time to worry about that! Since Bloodsoul is a shared resource, allocate it to me so I can unleash my Ultimate!""

3496302983.m_KeyValue: "This armor was crafted by my father with the resolve to protect all of our family. It's incredibly sturdy."

3496303115.m_KeyValue: ""You're so pathetic, black-haired exhibitionist. Are these soulless soldiers really scaring you?""

3496303150.m_KeyValue: "Who... who would do such a thing! How could they treat them like this!"

3496303216.m_KeyValue: ""We can take shelter inside if we get through the corridor. You three go first, I'll cover you.""

3496303313.m_KeyValue: "I don't care about those pointless names. I just want to help your sister. Let us pass."

3496961223.m_KeyValue: ""That place must be in ruins now, and those Wolfsbane Clive planted for you...""

3497176961.m_KeyValue: "I apologize—I may have misunderstood your methods of acquiring knowledge."

3497367360.m_KeyValue: "What?! You figured out one of Yakov's brilliant schemes?"

3497367362.m_KeyValue: ""Only humans have wants, longings. Can a puppet really have a will of its own?""

3497538743.m_KeyValue: ""All allies receive Tarot's Favor, gaining {0} M. DMG Up and ATK SPD Up.""

3498443130.m_KeyValue: "...what exactly have I done to give you that impression?"

3498514872.m_KeyValue: ""His mother fell to the same affliction. When death claimed her, the child had barely taken his first steps in this world.""

3499955622.m_KeyValue: ""I had a strange dream last night, and the moment I awoke, Savich's man suddenly invited us here.""

3499958924.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me Goldland's a set of triplets..."

3500527452.m_KeyValue: "Blessed with a protective shield and well balanced in attributes. Excels in melee combat."

3500527453.m_KeyValue: "Blessed with a protective Shield. Deals AoE DMG to the target and surrounding units through Special. Spread out to reduce DMG taken or focus fire to eliminate them quickly."

3500527454.m_KeyValue: ""Blessed with a protective Shield. <color=#D63536>Upon channeling</color>, grants Shields to allies. Interrupt their skills in time.""

3500527485.m_KeyValue: ""An egg with a Plague Hatchling inside. It is weak, but births a Plague Hatchling after a while.""

3500527486.m_KeyValue: "Plague host. Its attacks slow enemies down."

3500527513.m_KeyValue: "A wandering nightmare. Proficient in melee combat with balanced attributes."

3500527514.m_KeyValue: ""An incarnation of the Calamity _$$Death,_$$ avoid getting too close when it charges up. Below certain HP, it plants a Seed of Calamity that Self-Destructs once charged up, dealing strong DMG to all enemies. Prioritize destroying the seed.""

3500527515.m_KeyValue: ""A creature that appeared following the island’s crystallization. Land CRIT Hits to shatter its crystal, reducing its DEF.""

3500527517.m_KeyValue: ""A creature that roams through unstable space, capable of reducing damage taken.""

3500527519.m_KeyValue: ""Part human, part camel. Once an paragon of valor, this Blood Beast still attacks with speed and strength.""

3500527520.m_KeyValue: ""Tentacles hidden beneath the deck can suddenly emerge, dealing strong AoE DMG. Stay alert and dodge!""

3500699769.m_KeyValue:
""And yet, how many of _$$their_$$ corpses must I trample over
Before I claim the crown of _$$hope_$$?""

3500699772.m_KeyValue:
""She looked incredulous.
The moment she fell, I could feel my heart breaking.
But I did not dwell on it any further; winning is all that matters.""

3500699803.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I was buried by fate's riddles, and in the end, I crowned myself king of my own city._$$""

3500699834.m_KeyValue:
""_$$Clinging stubbornly to the past while completely disregarding the person over there. Turns out you had never truly intended to cooperate._$$
She toyed with her long, delicate hair, now filled with regret and clearly losing interest in me.
_$$So that's how it was. The strange sensation I felt from you was merely an illusion. I suppose that it's time to deliver the fatal blow._$$""

3500699835.m_KeyValue:
""Now I found myself agreeing with the woman named Slade.
_$$A woman who has secrets is more charming._$$
I looked at the half of her face shrouded in shadow and felt it merging with the version of her from my memories.""

3500699868.m_KeyValue: "I was angry with those who were chosen."

3500699901.m_KeyValue:
""Miracles don't happen twice. Having barely escaped a massacre, death was close at my heels.
""She"" laughed maniacally, peeling my skin.
—_$$To think one could be so brazen and live this long! How your impudence fuels my rage!_$$""

3500699934.m_KeyValue:
""I stared at that familiar face,
The faces of _$$them,_$$ the ones who I killed, and _$$them,_$$ the ones who shall kill me.
Yes, mutual annihilation. That is our destiny, and our purpose.""

3500699967.m_KeyValue:
""I'm so hungry, the feeling of hunger even outweighs the pain.
Hiding in the shadows, gasping for breath, I start to long for the warmth soaked in blood from the very beginning of my existence.""

3501341874.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Impeachment Conditions
<style=""InfoText""> • Any Member can initiate an impeachment vote against a Clan Leader who has been offline for more than 7 days.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Voting
<style=""InfoText""> • Once an impeachment vote is initiated, all Clan Members can vote. After 24 hours, if supporters outnumber opponents, the impeachment passes.
• Each Member has only 1 vote per impeachment and the vote can not be changed.
• If all Members vote within 24 hours, the impeachment result is determined immediately.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Impeachment Results
<style=""InfoText""> • If successful, leadership transfers to a Member who has been active within the last 24 hours (Elders have priority; if candidates have equal roles within the clan, leadership goes to the member with higher Blood Power).
• If an impeachment vote failed, no new impeachment can be initiated for 24 hours.
• The same Member can only initiate an impeachment once every 48 hours.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Permission Restrictions
<style=""InfoText""> • During an impeachment vote, members cannot be removed; leadership cannot be transferred; the current Leader, potential successor, and impeachment initiator cannot leave the clan.""
