3648018053.m_KeyValue: ""Kristoph, Bob—are you two serious right now?!""

3648018056.m_KeyValue: ""With defenses that thick, there's no mistaking it—the Mastermind must be there.""

3648018057.m_KeyValue: ""Captain, have you lost your mind?! That path is crawling with constructs!""

3648018058.m_KeyValue: "We'll have our work cut out for us repairing the El Dorado after this..."

3648018061.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, great—here it comes. Since you two get along so well, why don't you go talk it down?!""

3648018063.m_KeyValue: "That is precisely my intention. Though I've never cared for waiting idly... I would rather take the initiative and seek it out myself."

3648131571.m_KeyValue: ""An unmistakably canid-like creature discovered in Lupine Forest. Summoned by the White Wolf, lean yet vicious toward intruders.""

3648131573.m_KeyValue: ""Once they were offerings to the divine, now they have kindled the signal fires of rebellion and change.""

3648131576.m_KeyValue: ""A hunter armed with a crossbow, seemingly in recognition of Noah—but not in a friendly way.""

3648175973.m_KeyValue: ""Gains All DEF Up based on lost HP. The more HP lost, the greater the All DEF increased.""

3648278146.m_KeyValue: "Is it because you're afraid of being forgotten?"

3649449286.m_KeyValue: ""Now, what kind of Legion shall it be? Cute? Charming? Or perhaps… like Joyce?""

3649449289.m_KeyValue: "Very well. I will go with you to the Church."

3649449292.m_KeyValue: "Is divine power truly capable of such feats?"

3649449293.m_KeyValue: "The power lingering within Eternity is still far too great for mortal souls to bear."

3649449294.m_KeyValue: "Th-that weapon in her hands… that's the spear from the square! The sacred relic left by the legendary Bell Ringer!"

3650617759.m_KeyValue: "Don't talk in riddles! I've known him just as long as you have!"

3652700239.m_KeyValue: "I'm writing again to offer my sincerest apologies."

3654363041.m_KeyValue: ""Well, you and the doctor have always been against involving the Church in the island's affairs. You wanted to handle things yourselves...""

3654363042.m_KeyValue: "Guess you've always been bad with directions..."

3654363043.m_KeyValue: ""Your salt seems to be working, but it doesn't look that effective.""

3654363044.m_KeyValue: ""No, these are not Death... They're phantoms of longing that it has corrupted.""

3654363046.m_KeyValue: ""The truth is, I'm not the Noah you think you know. And you... you're not the Piera I know either, right?""

3654363073.m_KeyValue: ""But before the Black Blood outbreak, very few people actually encountered them... It's not like we could ask them, 'Hey, do you know you're just a memory of someone's longing?'""

3654363075.m_KeyValue: ""No, I refuse to accept that I'm merely someone's memory of longing. But if I'm not a phantom, and neither are you, Piera, then...""

3654363076.m_KeyValue: "Looks like they're not going to let us go up without a fight."

3654363099.m_KeyValue: ""At this point, I'm powerless to alter the Inquisition's verdict against you, let alone influence whatever you intend to do next.""

3654363100.m_KeyValue: "Could it be that she... actually hates me?"

3654363106.m_KeyValue: "Does Master... suspect me as well? Was he.. disappointed?"

3654363107.m_KeyValue: ""Without following their loud racket, you'd still be lost, wandering the island.""

3654363108.m_KeyValue: "I am Piera... Piera Paracelsus... the last Gravekeeper of the Paracelsus family."

3654363109.m_KeyValue: "Dealing with Death's minions? It's nothing special."

3654363110.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias, I don't want to obliterate this entire island just yet, but I really need to vent my anger, so—""

3654363111.m_KeyValue: "Do you really think you'll come out of this unscathed? Can you escape the Church's penalty? How will you... even stay alive?"

3654363112.m_KeyValue: "...did you come straight back to Sunset Isle?! It lines up perfectly with our observation of Death's movements..."

3654363131.m_KeyValue: ""Four noisy people... I wonder, am I included in that count?""

3654363132.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella! I don't expect you to come help us, but could you at least tell us how to beat these minions?""

3654363137.m_KeyValue: ""I recall, but what does it have to do with Noah?""

3654363138.m_KeyValue: "What about the silver-haired guy? Why hasn't he aged? He's clearly not from the Church... so who exactly is he?"

3654363139.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, are you saying this is my fault? I made sure to evacuate all the survivors from the deck to the other side of the island!""

3654363142.m_KeyValue: ""What the hell are these things?! They're not ghosts, they're not Blood Beasts—they won't die, and more keep showing up!""

3654363144.m_KeyValue: "Did you forget that I'm the 10th Bell Ringer and commander of The Choir?"

3654363166.m_KeyValue: "I can face this alone... I already made up my mind long ago... If only I hadn't met him and the others today..."

3654363169.m_KeyValue: "How... How is this possible... The Gravekeepers... my ancestors became pawns of Death?"

3654363173.m_KeyValue: "You're also right about not being able to see the longing of people who don't exist in your memories."

3654363174.m_KeyValue: ""—A prison called 'divinity,' wrought from an insatiable obsession with 'immortality.'""

3654363197.m_KeyValue: "Because the salt stakes in the coffin were originally researched by Albrecht and I."

3654363198.m_KeyValue: ""No, Grandmother... it's not like that... you've misunderstood him...""

3654363201.m_KeyValue: ""Noah is right, from the moment we're born, death is inevitable. No matter how we struggle, we cannot change this.""

3654363202.m_KeyValue: ""Though I don't know why, the Church has always wanted the Divine Body to be watched by different families, so I gave up my duty as Gravekeeper...""

3654363203.m_KeyValue: "Is Death in there? Has he returned...? Is he... awakening?"

3654363204.m_KeyValue: "Please don't worry about me... I want to be... the Piera that can fight by your side!"

3654363205.m_KeyValue: ""My noble ancestors, the Gravekeepers of old... what torments did they endure over all those years...""

3654363206.m_KeyValue: "But then you came along and gave me a new curiosity for this world... and new hope for this life as Piera."

3654363237.m_KeyValue: "Don't ever say that. You're not weak. You're stronger than anyone I know."

3654363238.m_KeyValue: "I... used the salt crystals... stopped the bleeding... I can still... still hold out a bit longer..."

3655734650.m_KeyValue: "An advanced CPU with slightly different performance focus compared to Type I."

3656411970.m_KeyValue: "Control: Weak. The carrier stops and is unable to cast Ultimate or Special (Active) during the effect."

3656549372.m_KeyValue: ""Right now, only you can clear his name. If something happened to you, Mr. Clive will be branded a traitor for life.""

3656549702.m_KeyValue: "This garlic head... He's actually strong. Was he just playing us before?"

3656549728.m_KeyValue: "Don't say that! You're our friends! I won't let those knights from the Church hurt you!"

3656549729.m_KeyValue: ""—The moon guides our beliefs, grants us power, and at the same time...""

3656549731.m_KeyValue: ""While there has been a long-standing feud between the Bathorys and Ganelons, perhaps it's time we reassess our relationship.""

3656549732.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid they're... no longer the people you once knew."

3656549733.m_KeyValue: "Are they talking about me? This is the second time I've been insulted today!"

3656549734.m_KeyValue: "This child... truly a member of the Ganelon family..."

3656549760.m_KeyValue: ""If you're heading back to Mouret, perhaps you could take us with you?""

3656549763.m_KeyValue: ""They're friends I've known since childhood, and the people who watched me grow up. They will always be that to me.""

3656549764.m_KeyValue: "Black Blood... the Black Blood Disease?! How is that possible? I thought the Church had eradicated it!"

3656549765.m_KeyValue: ""Leaving aside the two points Empousa mentioned, what puzzles me most is... why haven't you been infected by the Black Blood?""

3656549791.m_KeyValue: ""And with Father missing, bringing you here is all I can do.""

3656549797.m_KeyValue: "Just as stubborn as your ungrateful brother—"

3656549798.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be silly! You're only 15, you've got your whole life ahead of you! Here, let me help you up.""

3656549826.m_KeyValue: ""They're beautiful and strong. No matter how windy or rainy, they always bloom toward the moon.""

3656549827.m_KeyValue: "It's a white flower that grows around Mouret. They say it can suppress Black Blood. Church doctors have come to gather it before..."

3656549828.m_KeyValue: ""He said 'bring'... Perhaps it means he will be there waiting for me, for a man named Noah.""

3656549829.m_KeyValue: ""But now that I've actually met you, Noah, I remember Father's prophecy. I feel like this is what I'm meant to do!""

3656549855.m_KeyValue: "It's a mission where the Church will not tolerate any mistakes."

3656549859.m_KeyValue: ""They guard the deceased in their graves, preventing lost souls from disturbing their eternal rest...""

3656549861.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, did your father ever mention how he and I met?""

3656549862.m_KeyValue: "No... I think he just got lost. It's that simple."

3658678168.m_KeyValue: "No… I wouldn't dare… but—the Church has sent their own."

3658678169.m_KeyValue: "We'll return the escapees to their cell at once!"

3658678171.m_KeyValue: "Why are you looking at the prison? Wait—you cannot mean—"

3660619486.m_KeyValue: "Be the hunter—or be the prey. There is no third path."

3660619517.m_KeyValue: ""I never liked fighting alongside others. Lately, though… I'm rethinking that.""

3660621691.m_KeyValue: "My skin is cold to the touch... I hope it doesn't put you off..."

3660622526.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. If I'd been as shameless as you back then, us Elders might've gotten along… and we wouldn't have lost the Holy War.""

3760512060.m_KeyValue: ""W-Well, it's also possible they've already escaped this cave!""

3760512061.m_KeyValue: "It's called the forbidden grounds for a reason! It's my first time here too! If Noah hadn't accidentally opened the way..."

3760512062.m_KeyValue: "That's something I couldn't make sense of until now. I believe this Ashen Garden is hiding a secret..."

3760512063.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, now I can say with certainty, I was here. Twenty years ago, in this very Ashen Garden, I met Noah for the first time. And that time, it was...""

3760512064.m_KeyValue: "Calamity? Plague? What does this calamity have to do with us?"

3760512065.m_KeyValue: "You can't talk out of this one! Just tell me how to bring them back!"

3760512092.m_KeyValue: "Know that even the Church's elite must obtain approval and form a team of at least three to enter the sealed area around a Divine Body."

3760512093.m_KeyValue: "It's possible. It seems the pieces of the puzzle are coming together..."

3760512094.m_KeyValue: "You seem to care a great deal for him. I thought you might be related or something."

3760512097.m_KeyValue: "Leave everything to me. Take this chance to escape."

3760512325.m_KeyValue: ""All things live and die, beginning from emptiness and returning to dust. Keep running, fleeing from those observers who toy with you...""

3760512356.m_KeyValue: ""That's easy for an outsider to say. But after all that's happened, I can't just walk away...""

3760512357.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps your father hasn't truly left you."

3760512358.m_KeyValue: "You can't be thinking of... That would disturb Father's rest! I can't do something so disrespectful!"

3760512359.m_KeyValue: "They went inside... Is that a secret passage?!"

3760512360.m_KeyValue: ""Our family motto has always been: 'If something gets in your way, just kick it aside!'""

3760512361.m_KeyValue: "I have no memories of my past. I don't even know who I am."

3760512362.m_KeyValue: "I don't think this is just a coincidence."

3760512363.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I don't think Father had anything to do with them. He hates vegetables.""

3760512390.m_KeyValue: "What!? What nonsense are you spouting? Looks like you need another smack..."

3760512420.m_KeyValue: "What now? Killing those tainted by Black Blood is simply granting them mercy."

3760512421.m_KeyValue: "We'll take him back with us. I'm sure the Church's researchers would be very interested in a special type!"

3760512422.m_KeyValue: "Clive... Why are you here? Where's Hati?"

3760512423.m_KeyValue: "There's no need to be so harsh. He's still just a child..."

3760512426.m_KeyValue: "That's Aiona? She seems so different from before..."

3760512454.m_KeyValue: "...What are you saying? You're Clive Ganelon's son! The hero who just sacrificed himself to protect your home!"

3760512456.m_KeyValue: ""No, I absolutely won't let that happen. I won't let Hati lose you both in one day.""

3760512457.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? Why do you know my abilities?"

3760512458.m_KeyValue: ""I hear them... farmers, woodcutters, hunters, fishermen... different voices, but all sharing the same love for each other and this town...""

3760512459.m_KeyValue: "You want a fight to the death?"

3760512480.m_KeyValue: "He will quickly lose his cognition and memories... and become one of 'them.' In other words..."

3760512481.m_KeyValue: ""So back there... you used your time manipulation to accelerate the growth of the spores in that bag, turning them into explosive mushrooms to hold off those two.""

3760512484.m_KeyValue: "Then I definitely can't let Clive reach this Calamity."

3760512486.m_KeyValue: "However... it is also my duty to teach Aiona that she must answer for her selfish actions—"

3760512487.m_KeyValue: "Then... why did you choose to help me? Aren't you allies?"

3760512488.m_KeyValue: ""Are you really taking him back for the Church's sake, Gilrain?""

3760512489.m_KeyValue: "You mean... there's a source of the Black Blood in this cave?"

3760512490.m_KeyValue: "So the forbidden grounds of the Ganelon family are actually where this so-called source of Black Blood is sealed..."

3760512491.m_KeyValue: ""I, Friedrich Roland, am the heir to the family that guards the Four Limbs of the Divine Body, and the most loyal ally of the High Priest.""

3760512521.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, that's why you dumb wolves are always trying to invade our lands... for the secret to immortality!""

3760512522.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, Lady Empousa reminded me. Perhaps we can use the terrain here to our advantage against the enemy.""

3760512523.m_KeyValue: "Why am I the only one dealing with this?!"

3760512550.m_KeyValue: "And the person who made you realize this is..."

3760512553.m_KeyValue: "Humans raise livestock for food as well."

3760512554.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose we're all the same. Intrigued by the unknown, yet also fear it.""

3760512555.m_KeyValue: ""However, I'm concerned that one day, the Black Blood here will flow out into the world...""

3763952911.m_KeyValue: ""Hey hey, am I seeing things? That lifeless eyes just pulled off a pompous performance and turned those weapons into a bow?""

3763952913.m_KeyValue: "Could it be that guilt finally caught up with him? Captain Peacock did speak with him first—likely gave him a lecture on family and honor..."

3763952914.m_KeyValue: "And? Isn't that just common sense? Of course everyone would die if the Black Blood spreads."

3763952915.m_KeyValue: "W-what?! This ship is completely insane! Are both brothers cold-blooded killers?"

3763952916.m_KeyValue: ""Aaron was likely tasked with poisoning the food in the kitchen. Afterward, Jones escorted him to the adjacent guest cabin.""

3763952917.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps Goldland was part of it from the very start. Only those involved would know to avoid the ship's food today."

3763952942.m_KeyValue: "How am I supposed to get you out of there?"

3763952944.m_KeyValue: "Father once spoke of wicked merchants who smuggled slaves across the sea to line their pockets."

3763952974.m_KeyValue: "No. Quite the opposite. The Black Blood will not bring your death. But…"

3763952975.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you said the Black Blood wouldn't kill me? Though becoming such a creature hardly seems any better."

3763952976.m_KeyValue: "Because this is my sanctuary—my sacred place aboard the El Dorado."

3763952977.m_KeyValue: "Octo isn't a squid. He's an octopus."

3763952978.m_KeyValue: ""Breaking through this wall may damage the storage chamber, but it remains the swiftest path forward.""

3763952980.m_KeyValue: ""What's so strange about hearing sounds from below? I've heard voices from below before, when I snuck in earlier.""

3763952981.m_KeyValue: "What if there's another layer beneath us—one hidden from the rest of the crew?"

3763953006.m_KeyValue: ""Raising sails, hauling lines, casting nets, loading cargo—you never once came to me. You cast me aside like I was worthless, incapable of doing anything!""

3763953007.m_KeyValue: "No… I only knew they were brothers. I thought William kept his face hidden simply because he was shy by nature…"

3763953008.m_KeyValue: "Spare me your smug little deduction game! That nonsense about my brother trying to save me—how laughable!"

3763953009.m_KeyValue: ""Ironically, this horrifying trade is not only real, but sanctioned by certain hands within the Church itself. That… is another reason I boarded this vessel.""

3763953010.m_KeyValue: "You knew full well he couldn't handle a Blood Beast that far gone. Why didn't you stop him?"

3763953012.m_KeyValue: "And stranger still… Why did the face hidden beneath look exactly like yours?"

3763953013.m_KeyValue: "Hey… don't tell me lifeless eyes was right all along. This…"

3763953038.m_KeyValue: "No… that's not the voice I meant… It's not his voice… it's… something else…"

3763953039.m_KeyValue: "No… I've had this gnawing feeling we've forgotten something—something both important and not. That dumb wolf…"

3763953040.m_KeyValue: ""No! Going alone now just gives him another isolated target. From this point forward, no matter what...""

3763953042.m_KeyValue: ""Ami… I know you're hurting. But at a time like this, we should...""

3763953043.m_KeyValue: ""Please, Lady Empousa, don't start a quarrel with her. She's just lost most of her companions because of William. Right now, we should be focusing on defeating our enemy.""

3763953044.m_KeyValue: "Ah yes. The friend who waited twenty years for your return. It seems they shaped your thinking more than you realize."

3763953071.m_KeyValue: "I want to leave... I want to be free... I want to go... home."

3763953072.m_KeyValue: "I have her. I'll become part of her—and together… we'll be free."

3763953073.m_KeyValue: "My goddess will surely embrace me again!"

3763953074.m_KeyValue: ""Regardless! The priority now is stabilizing the situation. Even if Famine is as powerful as he claims, no being is without weakness.""

3763953075.m_KeyValue: "What did you say?! Famine is on this ship?!"

3763953076.m_KeyValue: "I wonder… is there any link between this being and Ami?"

3763953077.m_KeyValue: "There's something wrong with him. His condition isn't normal."

""Isaac despised the sirens.
If they had never come, the Isle would never have descended into this nightmare.
Isaac despised his father.
If he had never entered that lab, none of this—his family, his friends, his home—would have been lost.
Isaac despised himself.
If only he had the strength… the courage… he might've stopped it all.
'Tell me. What will you do?'
Albrecht's voice lingered in his mind, but Isaac remained silent, fingers clenched tight around the dagger.
Even as the Blood Beast tore into him, even when his hands could no longer feel, he kept his grip on the dagger.
To destroy all that is evil. To crush its seed before it spreads.""

3793163848.m_KeyValue:
""Summer's dawn came early.
Lorelei counted the stars as they faded, one by one, until golden light broke in the east.
Soft footsteps rustled behind the curtain.
'You're back. Is Bella better?'
The Mysterious Merchant clapped, as if dismissing such a minor favor. 'The air here isn't good for her recovery. I'll take her northward, where it's cold. She'll write to you regularly.'
Lorelei nodded. Bella once said that to humans, a trade was as sacred as a siren's oath.
'Keep this pact with you. When the time comes to fulfill it, you'll receive a letter.'
'And don’t forget to check your mailbox. Our deal...'
'...isn't over yet.'""

Those inspired by this Celestial God will view hardships as a path of temperament, and atonement as necessary in the journey of self-cultivation.""

3830472823.m_KeyValue: "Praise the great Carrelle! We who bear the name Brennholt will fight to the death for our lord!"

3830690992.m_KeyValue: "Use the Regeneration Clock flexibly to clear obstacles. But be careful—the Regeneration Clock can only be used in the current timeline."

3830691058.m_KeyValue: ""My dear little Fool, you’ll be the one to stir up a bit of commotion and catch his attention.""

3830691089.m_KeyValue: ""Even in the same place, timelines leave quiet traces of change.""

3830693236.m_KeyValue: ""There are still a few towers nearby that aren't ready, but the main tower should be enough for you to explore, right?""

3830693302.m_KeyValue: "Don't underestimate the things these monsters can drop!"

3830694259.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, Noah. You have entrusted me with this authority, and I am deeply honored. However, each day brings important matters that require your personal judgment.""

3830696402.m_KeyValue: ""Every time you complete a trial, you will receive rewards. May you march forward and take on all challenges that face you!""

3830737759.m_KeyValue: ""After all these years, whenever I think back to my father's choice... I can't say I don't understand it.""

3830737794.m_KeyValue: "I made the same choice... Perhaps it's because we share the same blood that we should speak honestly with each other."

3831400116.m_KeyValue: "Former Lord of Sapphire Isle; Father of Isaac Van Helsing"

3831779173.m_KeyValue: "He left? In weather like this!? Where could he possibly be heading!?"

3831779175.m_KeyValue: "He's like the old tales speak of—the hero who watched over the desert."

3831779176.m_KeyValue: ""Our stores are already empty? Looks like we'll have to venture out again, storm or no.""

3831929475.m_KeyValue: "My friend and I have this little game—we hide secret scrolls behind wooden signs."

3831929476.m_KeyValue: "Such a nonchalant response... but it really fits the impression you give."

3831929477.m_KeyValue: "That's a good idea. I'll remember that."

3831929478.m_KeyValue: "Fainting in a wrong location can be quite dangerous."

3831929480.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, you'll be safe with me.""

3833070830.m_KeyValue: "Said something about you needing to take it somewhere... but I can't recall the rest."

3833070831.m_KeyValue: ""He said... Take this lance to Twin Peaks, and you'll understand everything.""

3833620761.m_KeyValue: "The Church's war machines!? How can you control them?"

3833621781.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't for nothing. At the very least… I now know what Cain's true power is."

3833621783.m_KeyValue: ""It's a hassle, but I am a new Elder after all... I suppose I should pitch in and do my part.""

3833621784.m_KeyValue: ""Because I've realized something. As long as the vessel doesn't die, the past can be changed!""

3833621786.m_KeyValue: "Different? I'd say the opportunity I've waited for has finally come."

3835411657.m_KeyValue: "The 'God of Death' is watching over us! Victory is ours!"

3835412747.m_KeyValue: "We can't let our guard down. Let's finish them once and for all!"

3835420369.m_KeyValue: "We must eliminate them all before they break into the camp."

3835420371.m_KeyValue: ""Moonlight illuminates the ambitions hidden in the darkness... Accept your 'judgment', Blood Beasts.""

3835422547.m_KeyValue: ""Sailors, take up your weapons with the same fervor as you do unfurling the sails!""

3835423633.m_KeyValue: "Then we must prioritize protecting the lady."

3835423634.m_KeyValue: ""Dalcarlo, these frenzied beasts seem to be coming straight for you!""

3835424726.m_KeyValue: "A true captain would not wish harm on others."

3835425780.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be so down, lad! Good things come to those who wait.""

3835425812.m_KeyValue: ""Since you've come with such enthusiasm, I might as well offer you as sacrifices to the sea god in place of the Pontos II, hahaha!""

3835425815.m_KeyValue: "A true captain would not wish harm on others."

3835426903.m_KeyValue: "Don't just charge in recklessly! Such a rude boar..."

3835427989.m_KeyValue: "Don't underestimate the power of mysticism. I'm just as strong as you when it comes to fighting."

3835666078.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight feels different—quieter, less chaotic than usual.""

3835666079.m_KeyValue: "But for you... it doesn't seem that way."

3835666080.m_KeyValue: ""I never thought a mere glimpse into that hollow, tormented past could so utterly ensnare the Warden.""

3835666081.m_KeyValue: "I warned you—running through these halls carries consequences."

3835666083.m_KeyValue: "It can also give rise to new possibilities."

3836497350.m_KeyValue: ""Once you've finished collecting the local specialties from Sapphire Isle, come to my room.""

3836497352.m_KeyValue: ""In a sense, Sapphire Isle is my hometown.""

3836497354.m_KeyValue: "Then Sapphire Isle doesn't count. The Black Blood disease turned it into a dead city long ago."

3836774961.m_KeyValue: ""Becomes immune to Control, ATK SPD Down, and DMG Dealt Down effects.""

3837195675.m_KeyValue: "We will dispatch a professional cartographer to conduct detailed on-site surveying and documentation."

3837195683.m_KeyValue: "I have some questions about this survey."

3837195684.m_KeyValue: "Sorry for the delay in replying—there have been many affairs in the territory lately."

3837195687.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, enough small talk. I have work to do.""

3837195688.m_KeyValue: ""Whether you reply or not, I'll be there on time. Regulations are regulations.""

3837195689.m_KeyValue: "The first survey location will be the back garden of Bathory Castle."

3837195690.m_KeyValue: ""The initial survey of Bathory territory shall commence at dusk, three days hence.""

3838859639.m_KeyValue: ""As always, you have my full support in matters like this.""

3838863995.m_KeyValue: "Enough hesitation. Let’s plan our next move."

3839941860.m_KeyValue:
""Soul Shards collected by the undertaker. Collect 50 of them to Embrace an SSR Church Vassal.
<alpha=#80>'All are born free, yet all are bound by the chains of order.'""

3839943776.m_KeyValue: "Done? I've got other matters to attend to."

3839944799.m_KeyValue: "I'm certain you have your own considerations in this matter."

3839945954.m_KeyValue: "This is but a mere speck among countless misconceptions."

3841582559.m_KeyValue: "How could it be? Were there really people living in this dangerous place before?"

3841582560.m_KeyValue: ""If that foolish wolf doesn't keep up, soon it'll just be the two of us.""

3841582561.m_KeyValue: ""Their duty could not allow the Black Blood to spread to the town, so they chose to lock themselves in the forbidden grounds.""

3841582564.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, were there this many bugs here twenty years ago?""

3841582591.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what type of person I will be twenty years from now, but I know I don't want to be alone anymore!""

3841582626.m_KeyValue: ""Without that Noah guy, you won't be able to handle the enemies in this ruined garden.""

3841582655.m_KeyValue: ""What's going on? We stopped the ritual, so why isn't Noah reacting at all...""

3841582656.m_KeyValue: "Never mind that. Have you noticed the Calamity seems a bit off?"

3841582657.m_KeyValue: ""Over there, it's Noah! Are they performing some kind of ritual on him?""

3841582687.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong with you? Don't be rash, we can still think of a way...""

3841582688.m_KeyValue: ""It's a ticket. 'Across the Sea of Medimar, chasing the legend of the setting sun. Welcome aboard the El Dorado!'""

3841582691.m_KeyValue: "He is indeed Sheila一the Plague. There's no mistake."

3841582692.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it right in front of you?"

3841582693.m_KeyValue: ""However, Cain did ask me to pass on a message to you.""

3841582694.m_KeyValue: ""I can't help but feel that if you were still alive, you might have made a worthy adversary.""

3841582716.m_KeyValue: ""Hehe, well, don't forget, you still have a promise with someone else too...""

3841582719.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, after all, we still have one last thing we must do.""

3841582720.m_KeyValue: ""All things require balance, like light and shadow. Once that balance is lost, either side can turn into a Calamity.""

3841582721.m_KeyValue: "Is that why you chose 'light'? You really are a damn prodigy. Just how far ahead of me do you want to get before you're satisfied?!"

3841582722.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? Don't you want to go back to our own time?"

3841582723.m_KeyValue: ""I made it thanks to you, Noah, and now I understand my duty.""

3841582724.m_KeyValue: "I began searching everywhere for you all... Until your blood found me and awakened me on the other side."

3841582725.m_KeyValue: "This can't be a coincidence. I know I'll never be able to see the sister I once knew..."

3841582726.m_KeyValue: "That's where our favorite place in town will be built—a bustling market."

3844397937.m_KeyValue: ""In life and beyond, let me be your guardian.""

3844406633.m_KeyValue: "When even my own existence begins to blur… thinking of you gives me the strength to go on."

3844408776.m_KeyValue: "That's what happens when you underestimate a cartographer!"

3844408807.m_KeyValue: ""I sense we've crossed paths in some distant era... but in which epoch, I wonder?""

3844409642.m_KeyValue: "It's been ages since I felt such... emotion."

3844409801.m_KeyValue: ""To reach a desired result, methodology is the key.""

3844410981.m_KeyValue: "Silver-haired! I saved the best batch of seafood just for you."

3844411816.m_KeyValue: "Are you also... a messenger from the future?"

3844413990.m_KeyValue: "I wonder... what kind of web should I weave to make you fall right into it?"

3844414083.m_KeyValue: "There's no going back... to my home beneath the waves..."

3844416164.m_KeyValue: ""Bella: I don't know why… but when I'm with you, I forget my sadness.""

3844722371.m_KeyValue: "Just don't come back as a crone next time."

3844722372.m_KeyValue: "Has no one ever told you what a sharp tongue you have?"

3844722373.m_KeyValue: "Don't forget to bring me something next time."

3853716604.m_KeyValue:
""New all-time high!
Though you've failed before, your success was inevitable.""

3853716630.m_KeyValue:
"Chasing butterflies.
Even mechanical spiders dream of sheep."

3853716632.m_KeyValue:
"Snowstorms and getting lost make a perfect match!
Right? Right!"

3853769353.m_KeyValue: "Come back soon. We'd be lost without your guide."

3854623670.m_KeyValue:

The processor issued a command, but the mechanical legs did not respond.""

3854623672.m_KeyValue:
"Less power equals less responsibility!
Mechanical spider is ready to pass the buck!"

""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
Afterwards, each sets off on their own journey, reeling from their wounds.""

3854623675.m_KeyValue:
"The chassis failed to withstand the acceleration once more.
A few more failures and that'll be it."

3855958131.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) What sorcery is this?! Why does the smoke flow back upon us?! Ugh—! (coughing)"

3855958132.m_KeyValue: ""That smoke—it was your doing, wasn't it?""

3855958137.m_KeyValue: "Is 'knowing' someone your excuse for dragging them into a cell?"

3855958138.m_KeyValue: "So Letitia's sudden arrival was the only reason you survived?"

3855958140.m_KeyValue: "Don't take it to heart—Seraphina probably just suffers from a... difficulty with names."

3855958141.m_KeyValue: "The people here call her the Dark Witch. It was she who unleashed this mist."

3855958142.m_KeyValue: ""Noah drops to his knees beside her, struggling to lift her frail form. At some unseen moment, a grayish smoke has begun seeping across the dungeon floor.""

3855958143.m_KeyValue: ""She 'rescued' me, then hurried to your side when you strayed into the mist.""

3855959195.m_KeyValue: "Interrupt enemies attempting to charge. Eliminate those charging first."

3857249792.m_KeyValue: "Did Seraphina trouble you while I lay unconscious?"

3857249795.m_KeyValue: "It's over now. Come—I shall take you to sanctuary where you may find rest…"

3857717491.m_KeyValue: ""Summons 2 <link=""Tips_ID;20080""><#508499><u>Joyce the Miser</u></color></link> and 3 <link=""Tips_ID;20081""><#508499><u>Animated Puppets</u></color></link> at a select location, who deal <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> of Bella's ATK (M. DMG) to all enemies in a circle, inflict Stun for 1 sec, and become the target(s). Joyce inherits {1} of Bella's base attributes and lasts for {2} sec. Only 2 Joyce can be present.""

3860888707.m_KeyValue: "Stories come in many different forms; that is just one type."

3860888711.m_KeyValue: "Noah shared a diverse collection of renowned stories from various genres with Letitia."

3860888712.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Noah! I'll read them carefully.""

3860888713.m_KeyValue: "Could I come talk with you sometime?"

3861283468.m_KeyValue: ""How have you been, my silver-haired friend? Forgive the delay, I've been quite occupied with work.""

3861393447.m_KeyValue: "Our journey through the past draws to its close. What secrets did you uncover in the man I once was?"

3861499206.m_KeyValue: "That sudden seriousness... I have a bad feeling about this."

3861948855.m_KeyValue: "Complete challenges and collect puzzles to unlock Memories."

3862209836.m_KeyValue: "Clear [A Familiar Spark] <color=#a65f30>H 2-7</color>: Where Will is Forged"

3865054539.m_KeyValue: ""Do you truly believe I'm just copying people? That anyone could do such a thing, you fool?""

3865054541.m_KeyValue: ""So, who did you choose to be your sacrifice? Not Empousa?""

3865054543.m_KeyValue: ""Children of Dracula's blood—do you hear it? Two tolls, ringing for you.""

3865466903.m_KeyValue: ""The thirst for power, for life, for knowledge... Those who cling to such things are merely driven by their own desires.""

3865466904.m_KeyValue: "Maybe this old guy's different from those two weirdos. Could he actually be... nice?"

3865466905.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe I'm overthinking it, but I can't shake the feeling that the future depicted by these cards is not what we're striving for...""

3865466906.m_KeyValue: ""My true form is not here. As long as my soul exists, I can never truly die.""

3865466935.m_KeyValue: ""I don't want to call you 66 anymore, and I don't want you to call me 79. I hope... we can have our own names.""

3865466936.m_KeyValue: "Are you implying that you're one of the elders too? But you don't have a card."

3865466938.m_KeyValue: ""That reminds me, she just mentioned a name. We didn't finish our conversation. You were about to tell me your name...""

3865466939.m_KeyValue: "Better leave it to 'Death.' That man always handles these things with such finesse."

3865467199.m_KeyValue: ""Since waking up one day, I've been locked up here with my 'sisters.'""

3865467200.m_KeyValue: ""...I envy you, 34. You still cling to hope for those fairy tale endings.""

3865467201.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what you're talking about. I'm not interested in the others, or this place, or the world outside.""

3865467202.m_KeyValue: "Are they immortal or something? This is getting interesting!"

3865467231.m_KeyValue: "'We follow'... Are you imitating how they talk?"

3865467232.m_KeyValue: ""It's nothing... I just find it too coincidental. Just as we were wondering how to activate the mechanism, that monster appeared with the card...""

3865467233.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, they must be hidden throughout the castle!""

3865467234.m_KeyValue: ""As expected, she didn't last very long.""

3865467263.m_KeyValue: "How interesting... How beautiful! So this is friendship!"

3865467265.m_KeyValue: ""You really are pessimistic, aren't you? Is it because you can't remember your past?""

3865467296.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Wait a second! Are you saying I'm dead weight?!"

3865467299.m_KeyValue: "What's a real person? Is it a more expensive version of a fake person?"

3865467300.m_KeyValue: "...Are you the puppet master? But you look like a puppet youself."

3865467301.m_KeyValue: "(panting) How... how can a puppet be so strong?"

3865467331.m_KeyValue: "Why do you always jump to the worst-case scenario?"

3865467332.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe we'll end up like those cold bodies on the ground, but at least... we'll be together.""

3865467366.m_KeyValue: ""However, I didn't expect that two would come at the same time.""

3865467395.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's this side of you that keeps drawing me closer."

3865467397.m_KeyValue: "Whoa! This place is way too high!"

3865467398.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of vessels capable of passing the three trials—and two at once, no less.""

3865795243.m_KeyValue: "So you fear the dark too... You're more human that you let on!"

3866084841.m_KeyValue: "So it really was your Albrecht—the one from your world—who sent you to warn us?"

3866084843.m_KeyValue: ""If I can reach Asta before it falls, I can still contact the other Albrecht.""

3866084844.m_KeyValue: "Even a single drop of 'water' may be enough to alter the course of history."

3866084845.m_KeyValue: "I cannot say for certain whether I'll reach the other side in one piece. But—"

3866084846.m_KeyValue: ""Rather than await a doomed present, I'd rather entrust everything to the unknown Other Side.""

3866084847.m_KeyValue: ""Asta was the beginning of our descent toward the end... and perhaps, it may yet become the place where salvation begins.""

3866084848.m_KeyValue: "All I have to do... is lie here—between the past and the future."

3866084850.m_KeyValue: ""According to Albrecht, this place—what was once a bell tower—now serves as a gateway to another world.""

3866085863.m_KeyValue: ""But you said her world exists inside the bottle, didn't you?""

3866085864.m_KeyValue: ""And now, through that same point... I shall 'invade' their world in return.""

3866085867.m_KeyValue: "So the bell tower Stella mentioned when she arrived..."

3866085868.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps Miss Death would have a better understanding."

3866085869.m_KeyValue: ""The me from her world used this very bell tower as an anchor—to drive her, the wedge, into ours.""

3866085871.m_KeyValue: "Then why bring us to this bell tower if we're meant to use this bottle?"

3866085873.m_KeyValue: "So what are you trying to do?"

3866085874.m_KeyValue: "How little you people understand what a ritual truly entails."

3866088041.m_KeyValue: "Now that you mention it... there were no sightings of alchemical constructs before we arrived in Asta."

3866088042.m_KeyValue: ""No, you dumb wolf! It's the Harvest Festival! Must every thought in your head be about fighting?""

3866088043.m_KeyValue: "Aren't we here to deal with those metal scraps..."

3866088044.m_KeyValue: ""Don't tell me you've already forgotten what we're here for, you silly wolf!""

3866088046.m_KeyValue: "But then those wretched metal beasts showed up and threw everything into chaos. Now the whole city's shut indoors..."

3866088047.m_KeyValue: ""Just a few hours ago, the streets were packed—see those bonfires? They were meant to blaze through the night.""

3866088048.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, don't remind me. Tonight was supposed to be the one time Asta feels lively.""

3866088049.m_KeyValue: "And to think they call Asta one of the liveliest cities on the continent? It's dead quiet! Not much more exciting than Mouret."

3866290611.m_KeyValue: "I've been using those fish for some experiments."

3866345171.m_KeyValue: ""...Rest well, Sir Gadric. I regret never crossing blades with you.""

3866345172.m_KeyValue: "Why are you the only ones here? Where's the Vice-Commander who was supposed to lead you?"

3866345173.m_KeyValue: "No... I don't want to be here... AHHH—!!"

3866345175.m_KeyValue: "Why are all of you here? Your orders were to delay the Church's reinforcements in Starfall Valley."

3866346198.m_KeyValue: "That's right! You said Van Helsing uncovered our plan. So what now?"

3866346199.m_KeyValue: "This body... it truly can't fight... So this is the helplessness that ordinary man feel?"

3867654725.m_KeyValue: "So let's send him to protect Alene."

3867654728.m_KeyValue: ""And if we keep letting them lead us by the nose, the consequences may be dire.""

After charging completes, he pulls up a stone pillar and strikes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> ATK (P. DMG) to all enemies except himself. Breaking both shields will trigger this skill early.""

3869495022.m_KeyValue: ""Theophane jumps and strikes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals heavy P. DMG to all units except himself.""

3869791920.m_KeyValue: "The strange dreams we've had since arriving at the bay—they must be the effects of this 'Siren's Tear.'"

3869791921.m_KeyValue: "The strange armored visitor today seemed to have misunderstood Ami's identity. They invited her to run for the position of Eighth Sage of Sapphire Isle."

3869791922.m_KeyValue: ""That's why you need to help them escape before the soldiers get to them, Aiona.""

3869791953.m_KeyValue: ""After that disaster, everyone was gone... and you vanished without a trace. You have no idea how it broke me.""

3869791978.m_KeyValue: "'Kill them! For the peace of Sapphire Isle!'"

3869791979.m_KeyValue: "The title of Sapphire Isle's Eighth Sage shall be bestowed upon one of unparalleled valor and wisdom—"

3869791984.m_KeyValue: "I never imagined such brazen deceit would thrive under the Church’s vigilant eye."

3869791985.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Bertram Roland, do come and meet this prodigious young heir of yours—so gifted, so generous with her wealth.""

3869791987.m_KeyValue: "Could the proof be Miss Lorelei's word?"

3869791988.m_KeyValue: "Letting them out of their cage won't guarantee freedom."

3869791989.m_KeyValue: ""Everything I saw, everything I experienced, was part of your plan.""

3869791991.m_KeyValue: ""You have one last thing to do now, little Bloodborn.""

3871252824.m_KeyValue: ""Master Letitia, we... we simply cannot take that chance.""

3871252825.m_KeyValue: ""How strange, I can't seem to recall the year. Did the Church and the Bloodborn exist at this time?""

3871252827.m_KeyValue: ""We're not traveling, my lord. We're fleeing.""

3871252829.m_KeyValue: ""Without them, the tragedies you just saw would not repeat themselves.""

3871252830.m_KeyValue: "Can't remember? Allow me to refresh your memory."

3871252831.m_KeyValue: ""You, the very essence of wind, can coax life from barren earth with your tender gales and soft rains.""

3871866789.m_KeyValue: ""A special type of DMG. When inflicted, it ignores a certain amount of P. DEF and M. DEF and deals 200% DMG to Shields. This DMG type is not affected by P. DMG and M. DMG related effects.""

3872100233.m_KeyValue: "Heh... It's quite amusing watching little Noah encounter him."

3872100234.m_KeyValue: "They remember the blood that stained this earth and the warriors who fell."

3872100235.m_KeyValue: ""Since you are not the king I have awaited, the blood upon my spear remains insufficient.""

3872100236.m_KeyValue: ""I wait among the ruins of that battlefield in my dreams. Now, this place has become a forest in full bloom.""

3873921261.m_KeyValue: "Major Arcana Card No. 11. Dalcarlo's Divination: _$$Justice radiates where universal principle and holy faith convene._$$"

3874122869.m_KeyValue: "Then it is unfortunate. You shall slumber forever. Alongside your _$$Seed of Hope._$$"

3874122870.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, I now believe that perhaps Death... is not evil.""

3874122871.m_KeyValue: "Two against two. Do you truly think that guarantees your victory?"

3874122875.m_KeyValue: "You're the one who got lost. I arrived just fine."

3874122876.m_KeyValue: ""How could you, Commander! Swapping places with your Chorister to teleport ahead, and leaving us stranded behind!""

3874122877.m_KeyValue: "You heard her. That was Tris who said you're weak—not me."

3874122878.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, stay out of this. You're not strong enough to face them.""

3874123893.m_KeyValue: "And I thought… I could finally walk freely beneath the sun… But the sunlight here wasn't real..."

3874123895.m_KeyValue: "Those white crystals falling from the sky… They must be the salt Mr. Van Helsing mentioned."

3874123896.m_KeyValue: "...This is Piera's doing. She's here. Somewhere on this island."

3874123897.m_KeyValue: ""Piera? Who's that? When you say it's her doing, do you mean the salt on the ground… or the sky exploding?""

3874123898.m_KeyValue: "I suspect both. Though I never thought she'd unleash something on this scale."

3874123899.m_KeyValue: "Wait—you're saying one person shattered the sky with salt?"

3874123900.m_KeyValue: "Whoa—another powerful name!? Who exactly is this Piera!?"

3874123901.m_KeyValue: "She's my senior. Vice-Commander to Bell Ringer Albrecht and..."

3874123902.m_KeyValue: "The reason I boarded the El Dorado to reach Sunset Isle."

3874132597.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Tell me—do you know why it's called the the Mourning Hollow?"

3874132605.m_KeyValue: "They say that Dr. Ressa can handle anything... except medicine!"

3874132606.m_KeyValue: "…So the one thing I want to be good at is the one thing I'm not. It's not as simple as I thought…"

3874132607.m_KeyValue: ""If I want to be a real doctor here, I've still got a lot to learn.""

3874132609.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we shouldn't keep your parents waiting. Shall we head to Painter's Bluff?""

3874132611.m_KeyValue: ""Not so fast, Eleanor! You'll get lost again if you run off alone.""

3874132612.m_KeyValue: ""No way! This is the Mourning Hollow, I know this place!""

3874133752.m_KeyValue: ""We've made it to Painter's Bluff. Thankfully, no more dreamfeeders crossed our path.""

3874133757.m_KeyValue: "It's not your imagination. There're too many longings left behind... and not enough to guide it."

3874133758.m_KeyValue: ""Is it my imagination? Lately, the dreamfeeders seem more restless than before.""

3874133761.m_KeyValue: "Stay back. You're safe there. Let us handle this."

3874133763.m_KeyValue: "I've only just become Gravekeeper. Couldn't this have waited for the next in line?"

3874134781.m_KeyValue: "If that's true... Then we may be standing at the brink of another catastrophic crisis..."

3874134784.m_KeyValue: "But between this island—formed from a Divine Body—and the Death sealed within it."

3874135929.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Eleanor... If only I'd seen through it sooner...""

3874135933.m_KeyValue: "It took her so long to call me _$$Father_$$..."

3874135934.m_KeyValue: "She'll be so happy. You were the first person she saw when she was born."

3874135937.m_KeyValue: "A world without Eleanor is not real..."

3874135938.m_KeyValue: "What if we—the so-called guardians of the Divine Body—were never chosen? What if we were merely vessels… And longing was the only thing that was truly ours?"

3874135939.m_KeyValue: "My love... it seems... I'll reunite with our daughter first..."

3874136953.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, remember this well: Resorting to that method would pull you into a darkness deeper than the Black Blood itself.""

3874136954.m_KeyValue: "Ressa... Do you remember why you left your homeland to come here?"

3874136957.m_KeyValue: "That method is absolutely out of the question!"

3874136958.m_KeyValue: "Is it really that hard? All you need to do is drink the crimson blood of others to dilute the Black Blood inside you..."

3874136959.m_KeyValue: "Don't suggest something that vile with a straight face."

3874136960.m_KeyValue: "Do you understand what it means to drink someone else's blood? Sacrificing others to save ourselves. That is never the path we should take."

3874136961.m_KeyValue: ""But it's already been three months. We need to find herbs—and formulas—fast, to suppress both the symptoms and the spread.""

3874136963.m_KeyValue: "One day... I will find the way."

3874136964.m_KeyValue: "Do we really need to wait for _$$one day_$$? I remember reading something in the medical book you kept—there was a method written clearly inside."

3874138108.m_KeyValue: "What kind of... fri...end... am I... if I can't even help you... in the end..."

3874138109.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) You said... You didn't want to... harm anyone..."

3874138113.m_KeyValue: "Sora? What are you trying to tell me?"

3874138114.m_KeyValue: "He's restrained—for now. Should we help Ressa?"

3874138116.m_KeyValue: ""Sora... You're not giving up like this, are you? Losing to that Noah...""

3874139131.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, he is Death—the god who delivers us from separation and sorrow.""

3874139133.m_KeyValue: ""That's why you emerged from the Phantom of Aeon, Noah... because all along, you were the guide—""

3874139134.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, he is the one who leads us to the Other Side.""

3874139135.m_KeyValue: ""Plucking wildflowers by the cliff for her mother, listening to tales spun by her father… And whenever she lost her way, Ressa, you would guide her back to the Painter's Bluff.""

3874139136.m_KeyValue: ""Usually, longings take the Phantom of Aeon's hand to go through the passage. But just now, it was your hand that Eleanor took, as she crossed to the Other Side...""

3874139137.m_KeyValue: ""So Eleanor has been guided? Noah, you really...""

3874139138.m_KeyValue: "What's happening? I think I saw this child's memories."

3874139139.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa, thank you! You found my parents and brought back Noah to guide us.""

3875702978.m_KeyValue: "Wipe that look off your face. It's the werewolves' blood."

3878225187.m_KeyValue:
""Constantine's research was incomplete. Unproven. But there was no time left.
He stared at Bella on the operating table, one leg already lost. This was the best he could do.
Before they could clean the blood from her body, Hallon returned to the basement.
'Come on. We’re getting out of here.'
After five long years, Constantine had finally returned to Sapphire Isle—only to find it reduced to a living hell.
'What are those reagents in your lab? Why has the Isle turned into this? What are we supposed to do?!'
Constantine crumpled to the floor. It was over. His homeland would soon become a breeding ground for the Black Blood.""

3878815442.m_KeyValue: "Who are you?! Why do you look like me?!"

3878815443.m_KeyValue: "...It's Kenneth. The others are dead too."

3878815444.m_KeyValue: "What are we even guarding? The mines in Starfall Valley have been deserted for years. Who'd bother attacking this place?"

3878815445.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, was just thinking you should've shown up by now. Finally, I can get some sleep.""

3878818644.m_KeyValue: ""What? You can't accept it just because you're a slave? Hmph! Well, when I become the head of the family, the first thing I'll do is abolish this whole slave system!""

3879750046.m_KeyValue: ""Because if anyone had left that room at the end of the hallway, we would have seen them. We've been fighting here the entire time!""

3879750047.m_KeyValue: "To think Lady Empousa would notice something like that..."

3879750048.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, so much for all that talk about 'observation and deduction' from lifeless eyes. It's not that difficult!""

3879750049.m_KeyValue: ""...If they're all still in that break room, it spares me the trouble of questioning them one by one. Let's go.""

3879750050.m_KeyValue: "It's time to confront the true culprit."

3879750051.m_KeyValue: "Do you realize how foolish you've been?"

3879750052.m_KeyValue: ""I don't understand, Kris... or should I call you Captain Goldland, since we're still on the ship?""

3879750053.m_KeyValue: "You of all should know that harming a 'family' member is a capital offense aboard this ship! You killed Aaron!"

3879750054.m_KeyValue: ""Family, family... It's sickening. We're the only two aboard who bear the Goldland name. I'm your real brother—not them!""

3879764193.m_KeyValue: "But those are things others have defined for you. When I ask myself this question... That's not the answer I'm searching for."

3879764194.m_KeyValue: ""As for me, Van Helsing is my name. Heretic hunter is my occupation. That is enough to answer who I am.""

3879764197.m_KeyValue: "What's this? Another soul trapped in the same tale... The price of power is losing your memory and self?"

3879764198.m_KeyValue: ""You are Van Helsing, a hunter of the Silver Cross, our enemy. But as for who I am... Even when we reach land, I might not remember.""

3879764199.m_KeyValue: "Sentimental fools always think they are unique. But who among us hasn't lost fragments of memory along the way?"

3879764200.m_KeyValue: ""A few days ago, I set out on a journey with no preparation—to find out 'who I am.' An answer I'm not even sure I want to know.""

3879764201.m_KeyValue: "I want to stay here. Look for any clues we may have overlooked—just like you."

3879764202.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you going after them? I won't stop you this time."

3879764203.m_KeyValue: ""But once we reach land, our weapons will remind us of our identities...""

3879764204.m_KeyValue: ""Just like me, huh... We do get along surprisingly well. But that's only because we're trapped together at sea. For now, we have no reason to draw our blades.""

3880152753.m_KeyValue: ""In the days that followed, a series of letters arrived in rapid succession, each bearing increasingly stern and insistent language.""

3881465745.m_KeyValue: "Purifies the most recently applied debuff or Control effect of the same type."

3881486444.m_KeyValue: "So you've finally realized it was me?"

3881577922.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor 085 in Tower of Purification."

3882075145.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... It's my fault everyone ended up like this. I'm so sorry-"

3884357390.m_KeyValue: ""'Eventually, they fell in love and married, uniting two Kingdoms that had once been sworn enemies.'""

3884357391.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, a shooting star!' Our protagonist's exclamation sounded just like that of an insignificant side character.""

3884357392.m_KeyValue: ""'So the notion that shooting stars bring misfortune is also unreliable. I'll entrust my sisters to Setti and embark on my journey without hesitation.' Naturally, Empousa's resolve wouldn't be shaken by a mere shooting star.""

3884357393.m_KeyValue: ""But Jestel knew the whole story. 'I don't like this tale at all,' she said firmly.""

3884878527.m_KeyValue:
""On a restless day, I passed the painting again and caught the faintest sound emanating from within.

Was it haunted? A trap? Unease gripped me as I drew closer, the clash of weapons and the scrape of armor resonating through my bones. The echoes swelled, forming vivid visions:

a battlefield cloaked in dust. In my hands, I held a blood-streaked spear. Behind me, the dead lay in countless numbers; before me, enemies surged like a ceaseless tide. A voice, calm yet brimming with fervor, whispered in my ears:

Go and claim our victory.

Was this a dream? Or had Sirene willed me to meet her fallen comrade-in-arms? The truth eluded me.""

3884878620.m_KeyValue:
""As a living weapon forged through the Church's most advanced designs, Seraphina's prowess in battle is second to none. Yet within the Silver Cross, her lone-wolf temperament and disruptive methods make her a perpetual thorn in others' side.

Where others long for reliable allies, Seraphina hungers only for formidable foes.""

3886349847.m_KeyValue: "Yakov told me to collect debts—to repay my debt."

3886599090.m_KeyValue: "I've walked the road of loss myself. I understand the weight it carries."

3891576247.m_KeyValue: ""Suffering will end, and tomorrow will be as bright and grand as the sun—""

3891576546.m_KeyValue: ""This is just a normal little town, after all—""

3891576578.m_KeyValue: ""What else can we do? The wreckage of the Pontos has already drifted who knows where. Although I said I'll rely on myself, right now we're... completely clueless.""

3891576609.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, Captain. The cat led me here to show us a way out.""

3891576610.m_KeyValue: ""The sea's waves may toss us, but WE DON'T CARE! Everyone get in tempo and... LIFT!""

3891576646.m_KeyValue: "A plague broke out in town... My cousin was infected."

3891576671.m_KeyValue: "The brave Captain... buried by the raging waves..."

3891576677.m_KeyValue: ""Cheer up, lad! Now is not the time to be disheartened!""

3891576705.m_KeyValue: "The paint you need is from these insects?"

3891576706.m_KeyValue: "How did you... uh... get guided here by fate?"

3891576707.m_KeyValue: ""On the ancient, lost island—sailors find treasure—""

3891576708.m_KeyValue: "I've heard of an herb that can treat the plague. Perhaps I can find it in the mountains."

3891576709.m_KeyValue: "I'm just a fraud pretending to be something I'm not..."

3891576710.m_KeyValue: ""But she never drew the final card, not even when she left us during that accident...""

3891576739.m_KeyValue: ""Becoming a ghost like me, with no home and no one who cares!""

3891576741.m_KeyValue: ""At a time like this, why are there still troublemakers showing up!""

3891576742.m_KeyValue: "So much blood... Did you encounter wolves? I'll go find a doctor!"

3892043438.m_KeyValue: ""(That evening, a letter arrived at my room.)""

3892241790.m_KeyValue: ""The blood-drinking seers achieved immortality, unearthing _$$Calamities_$$ in an attempt to restore their Ancestral glory, who reigned supreme over mankind in an era now lost to time. — Alas, mortals have been imprisoned in their flesh far too long; They've forgotten whom they serve. ""

3892241791.m_KeyValue: ""The heroes of the Church embark on their crusade, defending preordained History with unwavering faith and loyalty. — Time defines existence; Order bestows meaning upon us.""

3892241792.m_KeyValue: ""At time's end we gaze upon divinity, until life and death fade from memory. Only the sword of law hangs eternally overhead, reminding us of our unfulfilled destiny. — _$$Embracing the cycle of life and death, or preserving the repetition of order, what would be your choice?_$$""

3892241796.m_KeyValue: ""We are anomalies, bred from within Tempus itself; We are entities forbidden by History. Only the Ark, resting on the far side of the moon, can deliver us from this hellish vortex of Blood and Silver. _$$—In a world spun from order and chaos, all things persist without an end._$$""

3892241797.m_KeyValue: ""Our forebears drew strength from consuming the Divine Body, and received assurances for yielding to Tempus. Today, both have decayed into rotten curses, plaguing our realm. —_$$It is kill or be killed—Vae Victis!_$$ ""

3899087484.m_KeyValue: "Our wood reserves won't last more than three days."

3899271733.m_KeyValue: "You said you were looking forward to seeing me again. Now I'm here. Aren't you happy?"

3899271735.m_KeyValue: ""Fanny, whom I haven't seen in ages, lies on her side next to me, watching me with a spark of mischief in her eyes.""

3899271737.m_KeyValue: ""The bedroom looks the same as always, the sheets soft beneath me. And yet... something feels wrong.""

3900245750.m_KeyValue: "That was also where father and Uncle Gadric would practice their combat skill together."

3900447959.m_KeyValue: "If I had gained this strength sooner… could I have changed my family's fate?"

3900447990.m_KeyValue: "Did you mistake me for someone else?"

3900450999.m_KeyValue: "The Black Blood marked us both... but your silver runs a little paler."

3900456655.m_KeyValue: ""What do I need to do to get stronger... Ah! It's, it's nothing, just talking to myself...""

3900456686.m_KeyValue: ""If only I had more time, perhaps I could truly grow and mature.""

3900459695.m_KeyValue: ""I shall guard the forbidden grounds, for all eternity...""

3900459854.m_KeyValue: "I wield my blade to protect friends and kin."

3900461869.m_KeyValue: ""You desire a self-portrait of mine? Fret not, for I can indulge this trifling request of yours.""

3900462028.m_KeyValue: ""Don't dare avert your gaze. Miss my splendor, and you'll regret it dearly.""

3900463177.m_KeyValue: "May I have a taste of you?"

3900651887.m_KeyValue: "But—but everything I did was for Lady Bella's wish! Surely you wouldn't punish me... right?"

3900651888.m_KeyValue: "But Elder Bella is the most special one—the core!"

3900651889.m_KeyValue: "And if what I want is to reclaim my life?"

3901243342.m_KeyValue: "They look formidable. Let's find a way to hold them off."

3901504281.m_KeyValue: "These anchor points look solid. If only Setti were here..."

3902194936.m_KeyValue: ""If the stars fall and the sun fades to oblivion, does time still matter?""
