DMG to enemies in a rectangular, inflicting Bleed, lasting {1} sec. DMG increases with each time. The second hit Knockbacks enemies, and the third causing significant Knockback.""

3906199642.m_KeyValue: "'Look at this! This little map—doesn't it look like Eye of God?' She held up a page with barely contained glee."

3906199643.m_KeyValue: "'We've found it. This one… it reads like a personal account.' She cradled the yellowed pages gently in her hands."

3906199644.m_KeyValue: "'It's a shame I still haven't deciphered the formulas from that last set of notes…' Aiona sounded slightly frustrated."

3906199645.m_KeyValue: "'I have to uncover the history behind that journal.' She lifted her gaze to the sky."

3906199646.m_KeyValue: "'What about the rest of the pages?' Noah reached into the box and retrieved a half-burned journal."

3906199648.m_KeyValue: ""'Still, this journal seems incomplete. Some pages must have scattered…'""

3906199649.m_KeyValue: ""'If the whole layout is reversed, then the last pages should be hidden on the opposite side of this place.'""

3906200730.m_KeyValue: ""'Even among the Alita family, such meticulous documentation is rare,' Aiona remarked in admiration.""

3906200732.m_KeyValue: ""'If you're interested, Noah, why not help us search?'""

3906200737.m_KeyValue: "'I see no reason to believe he would fabricate it.'"

3906215307.m_KeyValue: ""And without my noticing, another celebration had already begun.""

3906215308.m_KeyValue: "The last time I stood here... Stella was at my side."

3906215313.m_KeyValue: ""As a gesture of farewell to the past, this year's festival moved the fireworks to a new location.""

3906215314.m_KeyValue: "The ceremony was over. The crowd that once surrounded the bell tower was already gone."

3906215315.m_KeyValue: ""I moved alone, the construct at my side, pushing against the tide of departing revelers.""

3906215317.m_KeyValue: ""I ascended the tower, step by step, until I reached its summit.""

3906215318.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, the bell tower remained—silent, enduring, keeping its eternal vigil.""

3906215319.m_KeyValue: ""Revelry and wine flowed freely, seeping into every corner of the city.""

3906215320.m_KeyValue: ""With the bell-ringing complete, the crowd moved on toward the festival's fireworks.""

3906370618.m_KeyValue: "'Hey! Who told you to drift off into your own little world? We're already behind schedule. Keep this up and we'll never finish on time.' Quinn shakes her head in exasperation."

3906370620.m_KeyValue: ""Genevieve, draped in prisoner's rags, is marched to the scaffold by stone-faced guards. The executioner's blade awaits... 'Heh, so this day has finally arrived...'""

3906370621.m_KeyValue: ""Blessed with the extraordinary ability to flawlessly transform its <style=""Highlight"">form</style> to match any environment, it rightfully earned the title <color=#728c69>Perfect Metamorph Dragon</color>.""

3906370622.m_KeyValue:
""<size=-10><alpha=#88>
...Wait, perhaps 'disappeared' isn't quite right—there doesn't seem to be any such backstory. Even bards improvise, it seems... blame the <style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style> for the confusion!""

3906370623.m_KeyValue: ""'Should be handled with extra care this time, shouldn't they?' Mass interrupts confidently. 'The <style=""Highlight"">Drama Queen</style> earned that title because...'<style=""Highlight""></style>""

3906370624.m_KeyValue:
"Mass freezes at her words—this must be significant. <size=-10><alpha=#88>

What kind of secret could it be... I'm absolutely dying to know!"

3906370625.m_KeyValue: ""Mass freezes, her breath catching at those words. She had imagined countless responses from Genevieve, but this answer—this unexpected offer—left her reeling.""

3906372794.m_KeyValue: ""As she spoke, the girl tilted her head and raised her four snall fists in a cheering gesture—yes, you read that right, 'four' fists. As for why she has four fists...""

3906372795.m_KeyValue: ""'I have weathered desolation, and been graced with the sight of the crimson moon looming over the world. Thus... none yearn more fervently than I to reclaim the days of yore, to reforge our lost glory!'""

3906372796.m_KeyValue: ""...Let is introduce the attendee sitting to the south, the one who forsook his entire past to join the Bathory family... Esteemed guests, please welcome the youngest of the Bathory Elders—Gilrain Cidhall!""

3906372797.m_KeyValue: ""Firstly, let us welcome the elder presiding over our assembly on the east side—the most venerable of the Bathory family, whose chilling armor strikes terror into the hearts of all who hear his name—Baphomet the Soulless!""

3906372801.m_KeyValue: ""As Bella spoke, she gently stroked a black cat that has suddenly appeared in her arms. The cat settled contently on her lap, occasionally letting out soft, joyful purrs.""

3906373755.m_KeyValue: ""'That potion...' Gilrain seemed to be restraining himself. 'It wasn't even clear! How was I supposed to—' He suddenly exploded, 'You can't see the bottom until you've drunk it all!' His eyes blazed with such fury they could have set the room ablaze.""

3906373756.m_KeyValue: ""He had always considered himself the pillar of the Bathory family. Now, with the family's prestige and power at its lowest, it was his inescapable duty to rise to the occasion and revive the their former glory.""

3906373757.m_KeyValue: "'What?! There's an intruder?! With silver hair?! The Bathory family hasn't seen this much brazen insolence in... how many centuries?!'"

3906373758.m_KeyValue: ""'Baphomet, I think it's your turn to take the stage—'""

3906373759.m_KeyValue: ""Epilogue: A soldier, severely punished by Baphomet for negligence in patrolling, harbored deep resentment. He sought help from a friend studying magic at the Church to place a curse on Baphomet...""

3906411994.m_KeyValue: ""'This place... why does it feel so familiar...?' Bella reached out to the ancient stone wall, fingertips brushing its rough surface as she moved forward slowly, sensing the chill that radiated from it.""

3906411995.m_KeyValue: ""'Silver-haired must be inside! Let's find him and play!' At the thought of Noah, Selena's mood visibly brightened. Before she even finished her sentence, she began skipping forward in delight.""

3906411996.m_KeyValue: "How has she managed to survive this long?!"

3906411997.m_KeyValue: ""The doll-like girl's rose-kissed hair slipped forward, its silken ends brushing against Selena's cheek, leaving a faint, ticklish sensation in their wake.""

3906411998.m_KeyValue: ""'Not again...' Selena was tossed out of yet another shop—her 2,150th rejection since she began her job hunt. The reason was always the same: she looked far too much like an octopus.""

3906411999.m_KeyValue: ""'Honestly! This is why I say you're still a million years away from managing anything on your own.' Selena shook her finger, wearing a look of stern, long-suffering disappointment.""

3906412000.m_KeyValue: "...This is the refined craft of a professional bard—so kindly refrain from expressing your admiration with raw eggs or fresh vegetables."

3906412001.m_KeyValue: ""'Cold cellar? Days?! That's dangerous! You'll get frostbite!' Without another word, Selena seized one of the girl's four hands and dashed toward the center of the street.""

3906412006.m_KeyValue: "'Now I understand. The food there... it wasn't just delicious.' She adjusted her ungainly hat with care. 'It brought back something I'd forgotten—someone irreplaceable.'"

3906413084.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa felt herself gasping for air, as if recalling something... writhing in the shadows. Struggling to breathe, she finally managed to ask, 'What about that portrait?'""

3906413085.m_KeyValue: ""'About our promise...,' Cain hesitantly brought up the subject they both knew should remain unspoken.""

3906413086.m_KeyValue: "'What is that thing?' Empousa cried out in terror."

3906413087.m_KeyValue: ""'Not quite. Mirrors often show us an unfamiliar face. This painting, however, offers a dynamic journey of self-discovery, one that's intimately tied to your imagination.'""

3906413088.m_KeyValue: ""The Hall of Opulence, one of the few dimly lit chambers in the Bathory castle, found Cain speaking softly to a portrait on the wall: 'Tell me, do you still remember the promise we made all those years ago?'""

3906413089.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia sneered with unbridled satisfaction, 'Oh, don't be so petty. You're just too dim-witted to realize you had a chance to escape.'""

3906444667.m_KeyValue: ""'Exactly,' Baphomet said, brimming with pride. A scheme meticulously crafted over countless years was finally coming to fruition.""

3906444670.m_KeyValue: ""'While the Cidhall family is undoubtedly powerful, Roland...' Baphomet persisted in his attempts to redirect the conversation.""

3906444671.m_KeyValue: ""'Naturally, we hold our meetings in locations that reflect the subject matter,' Baphomet patiently explained to the newcomer. 'This has been our custom since long before you joined the Bathory family.'""

3906444672.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, however, disagreed: 'The Griffiths may rule the ice plains, but they're no match for the Rolands and their warhorses. If I were betting, I'd put my money on the Rolands any day.'""

3906444673.m_KeyValue: ""'In that case, even if we can't call it a 'perfect being,' it should suffice to address our current predicament.'""

3906449978.m_KeyValue: ""...Wait, what? That <alpha=#88><s>suspicious-sounding</s><alpha=#FF> book was written by her?!""

3906449980.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Crowley is my mother's name. She may not have been born Bathory, but she and Father were struck by love at first sight! It was instant, passionate, and destined!_$$""

3906449981.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Here, there's no war between Bathory and Ganelon, no conspiracies from Lord Ezareth, no ruthless machinations from Baphomet..._$$ Her voice lowers. Her hair veils her face.""

3906449983.m_KeyValue: ""_$$You... you're not lying to me, are you, Sirene?_$$ A soft voice breaks through the garden. Nervous. Hopeful.""

3906449984.m_KeyValue: ""I knew our audience would question this! Well then, today we shall unravel the mystery that has puzzled so many for so long: Is 'Minexus: A Brief History' actually a legitimate published work?""

3906449985.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Hmph! Such brazen words from mere prey. Do you even know who I—Ahh—!_$$ The petite girl's arrogance shatters as she lurches forward, nearly face-planting. The cause, of course...""

3906516542.m_KeyValue: ""The guard's voice, now youthful, echoed from an unknown source: 'Neither. She left the Ancestral Vault unharmed, still a human. She likely returned to her family and became their heir.'""

3906516543.m_KeyValue: ""In such dire circumstances, the girl's background would have been irrelevant. The Ancestors must have turned on each other, fighting over the only remaining scrap of food! This explains why so many never emerged from the vault!'""

3906516545.m_KeyValue: ""Rumors of this mysterious chamber spread like wildfire within the Silver Cross. Van Helsing remained ever vigilant, dreading the possible return of a powerful Bloodborn Ancestor.""

3906517498.m_KeyValue: ""Being closest to the flame, Bella spoke first. 'At this point, perhaps we should just…' She paused again, turning slightly to her right, casting an inquiring look at the person beside her.""

3906517499.m_KeyValue: ""'A cold, suffocating darkness…' Lorelei murmured to herself. 'Not unlike the depths of the sea.'""

3906517500.m_KeyValue: ""Because if that were true… Then what—or rather, who—was holding Bella's other right hand?""

3906517501.m_KeyValue: ""Meanwhile, Ami was far too busy enjoying the so-called _$$scent of the sea_$$—a veritable mountain of food casually tossed out by Lorelei: grilled scallops, roasted oysters, steamed sea crab, and slabs of Raog sashimi... among others.""

3906517502.m_KeyValue: "'Doesn't matter to me—it's just another routine visit between old families. But you two know each other? I don't recall you ever mentioning this.'"

3906517503.m_KeyValue: ""'That should be the Bathory estate up ahead. Brings back memories... The last time I was here—' She trailed off, a half-smile playing on her lips as she glanced meaningfully into the distance.""

3906517504.m_KeyValue: ""Elsewhere in Bathory Castle, in a room near the Ancestral Vault...""

3906517505.m_KeyValue: ""'This isn't good, Lady Empousa—it must be the Ancestral Vault...'""

3906517510.m_KeyValue: ""As the saying goes, a single spark can ignite a wildfire. In the blink of an eye, the entire mountain of seafood had gone up in flames. Finally releasing the true _$$scent of the sea._$$""

3906517511.m_KeyValue: ""'That's...' Lorelei flinched, her outstretched hand froze in midair, then slowly drew back. 'It's not what you think. If you'd just let me explain—'""

3907506416.m_KeyValue: ""Is it just me, or has Joan seemed like another person since she woke?""

3908798070.m_KeyValue: ""Filth, the very ground is fouled by your presence! Away from my stall!""

3909793284.m_KeyValue: ""_$$The Fool's_$$ Illusion distracts nearby enemies, who will come to investigate in the following round.""

3910248198.m_KeyValue: "Dust. The power of the earth—passed down through every Bell Ringer No. XI."

3910248199.m_KeyValue: ""It is my duty to stop the four Calamities from gathering at the sealed area, Noah of Death.""

3910248200.m_KeyValue: "_$$Our home_$$—you never meant the cottage. You meant wherever we were together."

3910248201.m_KeyValue: "But memories remain in the past. And dreams… Dreams are only dreams because we must wake from them."

3910248202.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer who betrayed the Church. Another risen from death. All gathered to stand by a Calamity... Fascinating."

3910251401.m_KeyValue: "_$$I miscalculated... The power of both Silver Blood and Black Blood combined cannot fell you in one strike..._$$"

3910251403.m_KeyValue: "_$$Pawn_$$ and _$$order_$$ are such harsh words. Mass and I are accomplices bound by a common ideal."

3910253558.m_KeyValue: ""Beasts from Decimus Arena, starved, parched, long imprisoned. All that remains in their gaze is bloodlust.""

3910253587.m_KeyValue: ""The current Gravekeeper of the Ganelon lineage, he lost his sanity and underwent mutation due to the spread of the Black Blood. He awaits in silence for the designated one's arrival.""

3910253598.m_KeyValue: ""A farmer residing near the Lupine Forest, stripped of their sanity yet retaining an unyielding devotion to safeguard their domain.""

3912030932.m_KeyValue: ""...No need to thank me, though you haven't said it yet.""

3913483494.m_KeyValue: ""Ami's still alive, right!? We can still save her!?""

3913483495.m_KeyValue: ""Well then, little Justice... After all that setup, do you even know where the other jewel is?""

3913483500.m_KeyValue: "Have you lost it?! Are you really planning to kill Ami just to stop Famine!?"

3913483501.m_KeyValue: "So this is the fabled Justice they say never wavers?"

3913483502.m_KeyValue: ""Great Ranna, receive now the blood of your children—may your resurrection be complete!""

3913483504.m_KeyValue: ""According to Goldland's journals, after the Landis family sank, two Divine Body jewels still remained in the world. This red gem... is one of them.""

3913483505.m_KeyValue: "If we can combine them in a certain way—as the journals described—we may be able to suppress Famine. And maybe... save Ami."

3913483506.m_KeyValue: ""No... It seems Mr. Van Helsing was never aiming at Miss Ami at all, but rather...""

3913483507.m_KeyValue: "Wait—was that the red jewel from that jellyfish girl's necklace?"

3913486827.m_KeyValue: ""And these two gems... the fruits in its grasp. Back off, Silver-haired!""

3913486828.m_KeyValue: "So this helm was the ring from the Divine Body's right hand...?"

3913486829.m_KeyValue: ""Turn the golden wheel, follow where my heart leads...""

3913486831.m_KeyValue: ""Crimson to the north, azure to the south...""

3913486832.m_KeyValue: "She noticed it! the Divine Body that had sealed her away is now emanating power!"

3913486833.m_KeyValue: "That golden helm... it reeks of Divine Body... What are you planning!?"

3913486834.m_KeyValue: "Then I'm ready. Everything hinges on this moment."

3913486835.m_KeyValue: "There! I see Ami! She's trapped... in the abdomen!"

3916311161.m_KeyValue:
""Even after I drove away the alchemists surrounding her, Hati continued to lie there pretending to be unconscious.

_$$The one who protects you didn't appear._$$

_$$Maybe they knew you would save me, so they didn't come out._$$

_$$There could be other reasons. For instance, did you do anything special before you lost consciousness?_$$

Hati fell unusually silent. After a long while, she finally spoke again, her voice hoarser than ever:

_$$I used... the power of Homecoming._$$""

3916311444.m_KeyValue: ""Even before I reached the castle, its atmosphere weighed heavily. Festive decorations hung from the trees, but their presence felt hollow. The castle itself exuded a strange tension—enough to stifle any thought of celebration. Duke Reese, the master of the estate, remained unseen due to poor health. Only a grand portrait bore witness to the man he once was. His heir, Duke Reese II, received me with courtesy befitting his name—yet I could see the unease in his eyes. If Van Helsing were here, I'm certain he’d already be forming theories.""

3916311692.m_KeyValue: ""Ami isn't typically a curious person—quite the opposite, she tends to take a passive stance on most matters. That's why I'm surprised by her enthusiasm in investigating Landis and these strange sounds. Though she doesn't show it, she must still be curious about her origins.""

3916596765.m_KeyValue: ""It's the only explanation that makes sense... Wait, you're not just saying that to make me feel better, are you?""

3916736314.m_KeyValue: ""Skoll, in monk's robes, was a famed herbalist in his Timeline, locked here for brewing forbidden compounds. Any herbs I acquire, I pass to him for refinement. And also—""

3916736315.m_KeyValue: ""I see through your little schemes. But it matters little—from tonight onward, I'll share your cell through every dark hour. As for the interrogations, I'll entrust them to others.""

3916736316.m_KeyValue: ""This cell belongs to Thomas—a father condemned for forging coins to save his dying daughter. Every night at three, his weeping begins, lasting twenty minutes before silence returns until dawn. I've listened to his cries for seven years.""

3918533996.m_KeyValue: ""Each stack reduces CRIT Hit DMG Reduction by {1}, effective up to {2} times.""

3918602396.m_KeyValue: ""The fragrance of blossoms, the sound all around—it all feels so very real.""

3918602397.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, customers? Terribly sorry, but I'm afraid we're closed today.""

3918602398.m_KeyValue: "Dumping untreated waste... only an incompetent alchemist would make such novice mistakes."

3918602399.m_KeyValue: ""After the water source was purified, the soil also returned to its original state.""

3918737564.m_KeyValue: ""Because no matter how lowly their origin, all beasts ultimately yearn for 'The Light'.""

3918991120.m_KeyValue: "A summon that performs ranged Basic ATK in sync with Transcendent Noah. Only 5 can exist at the same time."

3918991124.m_KeyValue: "Purifies all debuffs and fully restores HP."

3922674848.m_KeyValue: ""If the Church doesn't have it, how could I?""

3922746846.m_KeyValue: "I'd find the perfect place for it."

DMG) to enemies in a cone (<style=""Highlight"">{2}</style> ATK for non-Boss units below {1} HP, and <style=""Highlight"">{4}</style> ATK for Boss units). 3923163114.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain's Ultimate can target any enemy on the field. Upon casting, Gilrain teleports behind the target and deals AoE DMG. If an enemy is eliminated, the skill can be cast again, and will target the farthest enemy. Each subsequent cast deals 20% less DMG, up to 3 additional times, upon which Gilrain returns to his original position. During his Ultimate, Gilrain deals 200% DMG to all enemies along his path. Up to 5 Shadowy Apparitions can be present, who will also cast his Ultimate from their position at the same time as Gilrain.""

DMG) to the farthest enemy in a circle around the target, then summons a<link=""Tips_ID;20140""><#508499><u>Shadowy Apparition</u></color></link> that inherits {2} of the caster's base attributes.""

3923215314.m_KeyValue: "I haven't seen fish this fresh since we left the El Dorado."

3923839207.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier, I thought what my _$$sister_$$ achieved that I couldn't was winning you over, and that sister I was comparing myself to was Empousa.""

3923839208.m_KeyValue: "How many spirits guard this gate? Am I supposed to face the entire Hall of the Elders alone?"

3923839209.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps... the escape itself was her gift to you?"

3923839210.m_KeyValue: ""It wasn't until that moment, when I ran out of the castle, that I realized how wrong I was.""

3926598711.m_KeyValue: ""Instantly receive <color=#ffd8a6>1,000 Moon Tear (Free)</color> upon purchase, for a total of up to <color=#ffd8a6>10,000 Moon Tear (Free)</color>.""

3927123060.m_KeyValue:
""The twelve Bell Ringers situated at the apex of the Tempus Church, baptized by divine Silver Blood, can rival or even surpass miracles with just their mortal form. The truth of Tempus is cyclical in nature. Much like a ring, it is both contradictory and unified; no thing nor self exists, only the eternal tolling of the bell remains.
—_$$With a stopped clock held in hand, they believe they can control time, yet the ticking of Tempus still echoes in their ears._$$""

3927123061.m_KeyValue:
""Elites secretly cultivated by the Church, specializing in enforcing another form of _$$justice,_$$ one in the shadows where the bright light of faith cannot reach. Tempus created twelve primary colors, serving as the only form of light; all other forms of color are destined to be consumed by the shadow of the cross.
—_$$Shadow is not the opposite of light, but rather its subordinate._$$""

3927123062.m_KeyValue:
""Humanoid weapons used by the Church who enhance their combat prowess through physical modifications. For the sake of victory, they have long since removed all unnecessary bodily functions, leaving only battle memories inside.
—_$$Form gives the spirit meaning, known as life, yet through this the spirit loses its original significance._$$""

3927123155.m_KeyValue:
""The romantic idealists of the Bloodborn who firmly believe the moon is their home to return to. Though the body is born of the earth, any mark left behind is insignificant, for only the bright moon above is the true resting place of the soul.
—_$$Awakening amid the sun's dream, we are children of the moon._$$""

3927123157.m_KeyValue:
""The moderate-conservatives of the Bloodborn who enjoy a hidden and reclusive lifestyle. The world mocks our faith, exiled by the sun; Yet, our fabled home is also a cage, imprisoning the light.
—_$$Fate is much like the moon, waxing and waning, but never fully fading away._$$""

3927123158.m_KeyValue:
""The extreme radicals of the Bloodborn who are proponents of clan supremacy. The crimson moon gazes coldly upon the world, observing the destruction of all life; Bathed in the scarlet moonlight, their bodies are branded with blood-colored markings.
—_$$Far away in a foreign land, nowhere is home, yet everywhere is home._$$""

3927123219.m_KeyValue:
""Drawing new blood from celestial meteorites, we shape our new exterior with unprecedented power. Tempus is merely a vessel, containing all life in endless cycles of rebirth. It is we who are the masters of this vessel.
—_$$Tempus is omnipresent, much like the ocean. All life can feel its flow, yet none can prevent its passing._$$""

3927123220.m_KeyValue:
""Though they imbibed Divine Blood, they refused to become enslaved by Black Blood. They are all strangers, unable to integrate into the world or feel the pulse of their own heartbeats. Their only wish is to return _$$home,_$$ to the Other Side, distant as it may be.
—_$$The exiles attempted to find a new place to call home. Yet when they finally gazed back, they realized they had long since left their homeland behind._$$""

3927123221.m_KeyValue: ""Inheriting Black Blood's most primal power, they became a Scourge. Though the sun's scorching blaze illuminates a future known as _$$hope,_$$ they lurk in the shadow of the silver moon, echoing a past known as _$$despair._$$ — People only remember the warmth of the blazing sun, forgetting that in this world, there still exists the chill of the moon.""

3927123255.m_KeyValue:
""The devout Church followers from each Kingdom. Their interlocked fingers radiate a warm glow— a blessing bestowed upon the chosen ones.
—_$$The pain of devotion is a double-edged sword granted to the spirit by God: Though one edge points towards non-believers, the other is pointed at oneself._$$""

3927123256.m_KeyValue:
""Rebels from each Kingdom who are dissatisfied with the Church's power. _$$God_$$ is merely a fool's delusion. The time has come, and the light of the morning star shall pierce through the decadent lies of the Divine.
—_$$When faith is lost, gods disappear; When faith is needed again, gods become tools to be exploited._$$""

3927123258.m_KeyValue:
""The powerful individuals from each Kingdom who guard the Divine Body relics day and night. Will endlessly guarding the remnants of fallen gods bring mortals closer to the Divine?
—_$$The weak worship the strong, and strong follow the stronger. This is how gods are born._$$""

3927955114.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The stylish cap worn by Isaac Van Helsing. On the pursuit of justice, it shielded him from the elements.
Though the damp winds may tousle his hair, they are incapable of extinguishing the youthful sparkle in his eyes.""

3927955116.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Van Helsing's wrist guard, stained with blood.
Even as the marsh envelops his figure, the young man draws his sword with swift alacrity, displaying not even a speck of hesitation.""

3927955117.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> The pauldrons worn by Van Helsing. Its bold design accentuates the wearer's personality.
At the time, he hadn't realized that pursuing one's vision demands bearing heavy responsibility.""

3927955119.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Van Helsing's vows echoed with resolve.
It wasn't until darkness consumed him that he realized: Only actions taken from a position of power are considered true justice.""

3927955147.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The feathered crown discarded by Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
Renouncing himself to embrace death, his sole hope is to leave a trace of himself somewhere in the future.""

3927955148.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> The torn garment of Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
The fervor which burned inside chest was not for the present, but for a future unbound from destiny.""

3927955149.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring.</style> A ring forged from the blood of Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
Blood and mind converged to birth a soul which could lead them forth. _$$This is faith; overbearing, yet ethereal._$$""

3927955150.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The amalgamation of deep despair and profound hope within Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
'Place down your sword, the future you seek is not elsewhere; it is right beneath your feet.'""

3927955507.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Amulet crafted from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blackblood Beast.
The Bell Ringer melted the beast's seemingly impregnable hide instantaneously with a terrible heat, bringing inspiration to the artisans.""

3927955510.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A leather helmet sewn from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blood Beast.
Perhaps an illusion? The visage revealed by this Blackblood Beast appears to be in agony, yet somehow gives the impression of a grin.""

3927955512.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> A ring crafted from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blackblood Beast.
The bone smith who crafted this became haunted for seven nights, by horrific cries wailing in the darkness.""

3927955513.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> A leather jacket sewn from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blackblood Beast.
The wing membranes connecting their limbs are durable, yet flexible. As Blood Beasts evolve towards a form capable of flight, one must wonder: Where are they headed?""

3927955538.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Sheila the Firstborn's figure dissipated, thus breaking her final set of wings. It contains the primal power of Plague.
_$$Facing the abyss, I leap forward, if only to fill the chasms blocking your path ahead._$$""

3927955543.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> Crafted from the iridescent wings of Sheila the Firstborn, it is imbued with the primal power of Plague.
A sheer veil masks her gaze, yet fails to conceal the icy tear streaming down her cheek.""

3927955544.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Armor</style> Crafted from the iridescent wings of Sheila the Firstborn, it is imbued with the primal power of Plague.
Silken scaly wings drape over your shoulders and gently brush against your skin, providing you with a faint sense of solace.""

3927955545.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Though Sheila the Firstborn's form has long since disintegrated, her icy ring still remains, imbued with the primal power of Plague.
The broken corpse marks the end of a cycle, while the ring heralds its dawn. _$$Abandoning the past shall lead to nowhere._$$""

3930456476.m_KeyValue: "These mass-produced war machines wield intimidatingly large hammers."

3930456563.m_KeyValue: ""A crab common to Sunset Isle. Seemingly infected with Black Blood, it excels at hurling coral and spraying toxin to knock back those who draw near. Its shell, crystallized with salt, is exceptionally hard.""

3930456564.m_KeyValue: ""A crab common to Sunset Isle. Seemingly infected with Black Blood, it now swings its pincers wildly as if to shred anything standing before it. Its shell, crystallized with salt, is exceptionally hard.""

3930456576.m_KeyValue: ""A sailor fully mutated by Black Blood. The infectious Calamity ""Famine"" has rendered it a living embodiment of ""devourance,"" its monstrous maw serving as a testament to this concept.""

3930739347.m_KeyValue: "There they are! Heading for the stairs!"

3930739349.m_KeyValue: "It seems I must trouble you a while longer—before I chain you back where you belong."

3931074779.m_KeyValue: ""These resurgent demons hail from the Other Side, temporarily manifesting in the mortal realm during periods of invasion. Like a spectre, they haunt the land of Minexus.""

3931901600.m_KeyValue: "Nothing will stop me from saving Miss Empousa!"

3931932694.m_KeyValue:
""I don't know what happened to Julius, who had been corresponding with me. I came to the painting at the entrance of the Ancestral Vault, but it showed no change. I tried speaking to the painting, but it gave no response.

In the many days that followed, I received no more letters from Julius. Yet around the castle, rumors began to spread—rumors of a spear that kills. Could this strange and ominous tale be tied to Julius's sudden disappearance?""

3931932787.m_KeyValue:
""In a sense, Seraphina has embraced humanity's eternal dream of flight—though the price has been grievous.

Whether it be the ruinous toll the ritual and modification have taken upon her lifespan, or the perilous combat missions she accepts, both stand as certain omens that her life will know no peaceful end.

Every bird is fated to fall.

If ruin is her destined end, then perhaps she yearns for that last battle—the one that will strip away all she has ever loved.

Perhaps I am beginning to truly grasp her hunger for victory, vast enough to eclipse all else...""

3931932853.m_KeyValue:
""The _$$Crimson Inquisition_$$—that's what the history books call the great battle I glimpsed.
Overwhelmed by the Church's Blood Power, the Bloodborn of that era had no choice but to seal away their Elders—those who carried strange and ancient powers—deep within the crypt.
A mantle, a lance, a warhorse, armor... In the fractured haze of memory, only faint silhouettes remain.
And in a mantle soaked with vengeful souls, I saw Sirene's sleeping face.
Was that the destination she had reserved for me...?""

3931932884.m_KeyValue:
""The wind-born treasure that harbors the fury of storms—known as Zephyr.

Whether across mountains or through valleys, within emerald forests or golden grain fields, wherever life takes root, infinite possibilities unfold.

And when all living beings yearn for the blessing of sweet rain, the name they whisper in reverence is none other than Letitia's.

At the dawn of time, I shared a fleeting moment with Letitia.

Then, neither of us could foresee what future the Zephyr she bore would bring forth, but now, all has been revealed.""

3934243290.m_KeyValue: "Reply! Right! Now! Or I'll blow you and your castle sky-high!"

3934616587.m_KeyValue: ""Furthermore, we have but a handful of alchemists in the castle. To assign them to study that worthless tome would be to neglect our 'real work'! We'd best set it aside for now.""

3934616653.m_KeyValue: ""In 1248, four vassals skilled in navigation were sent aboard the 'Dark Soul' to explore the southwestern Sea of Medimar in search of the 'Other Side.' They returned half a year later, with various degrees of damage to their bodily functions. If you ask me, we should forget about this whole idea!""

3934616750.m_KeyValue: ""If we allow vassals to use these facilities at will, not only might they violate our ancient family laws, they could even burn this ancient castle to the ground. In my view, it would be far more reassuring to keep the right of use firmly in our own hands.""

3934616882.m_KeyValue: ""Furthermore, he never used family funds for his research. What right do you have to criticize him? Continue with your research, old friend. That is your prerogative.""

3937028366.m_KeyValue: ""Silver-haired, why do you watch that captain so intently?""

3937028373.m_KeyValue: ""Now, now, little one—no need to bristle. We only wish to be kind.""

3937028375.m_KeyValue: "It is… complicated. Perhaps we should begin with the Black Mist."

3937028376.m_KeyValue: "I know of an enjoyment far more... entertaining."

3937028378.m_KeyValue: "What? How am I here? You've some nerve to ask!"

3942424371.m_KeyValue: ""So this is Sapphire Isle, the famed summer paradise?""

3942424437.m_KeyValue: "It's been a while. How are you getting along with your new Vassals?"

3942882714.m_KeyValue: ""You're free now. Quickly, get out of here!""

3942882715.m_KeyValue: ""No, they are now under Lord Hallon's command. He orders your immediate return to the ship.""

3942882716.m_KeyValue: "I'm only dressed like this because I owe a huge debt to some wine vendor... But this is not the point!"

3942882717.m_KeyValue: ""Hatred will become waves, devouring the future.""

3942882718.m_KeyValue: ""But somehow they've been resurrected, and the strings above them restored too.""

3942882720.m_KeyValue: "And more people will hear your beautiful songs!"

3942882746.m_KeyValue: "Take whatever you want. These things are nothing but false visions of my daughter."

3942882748.m_KeyValue: ""Good thing the silver-haired one helped Joyce kill her. Thank you, detective!""

3942882750.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Isaac or Miss Ami... who will it be, Lord Silver-haired?""

3942882751.m_KeyValue: "But how did Bella No. 7 wake up? Ugh! It must be that wicked woman Lorelei's doing! No wonder she was asking Joyce all those strange questions..."

3942882752.m_KeyValue: ""It's okay... Even though there were some mishaps, everything is still under control! Now that all the Siren's Tears are gathered here, Joyce can transform even more puppets—you stand no chance of victory!""

3942882753.m_KeyValue: "Everyone in Sapphire Isle shall become Joyce's puppets!"

3942882773.m_KeyValue: "No wonder Joyce's secret weapon failed to activate."

3942882778.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella, how could you turn Joyce's own power against Joyce? That's so cruel!""

3942882779.m_KeyValue: "Let's play! Joyce can keep this game going forever!"

3942882781.m_KeyValue: ""Clash! Clash! The fearless din of their weapons, striking with unyielding resolve!""

3942882782.m_KeyValue: ""Sing for me one last time, and I'll play along with you.""

3942882783.m_KeyValue: ""I'm the one who broke our promises... I promised to cure your illness, to let you play your cherished harp again, to sail with you under the sun, far beyond the Isle...""

3942882784.m_KeyValue: ""I knew it. You're no better than the Master. One day, I'll face you with my blade.""

3942882785.m_KeyValue: ""Without her master, she returns to her original state—still, void of life.""

3942882810.m_KeyValue: "He must have read my diary again."

3942882811.m_KeyValue: "The other person affected by the Siren's Tear has probably recovered as well."

3942882812.m_KeyValue: "The Seven Sage Association has placed devices throughout the Isle that release small amounts of the Siren's Tear."

3942882814.m_KeyValue: "She... she really does care about me!"

3942882816.m_KeyValue: ""He taught me many useful things. No wonder he can be your friend, Sir!""

3942882817.m_KeyValue: "Wait! I think we've lost something too..."

3942882839.m_KeyValue: ""The Mysterious Merchant clapped, as if dismissing such a minor favor. 'The air here isn't good for her recovery. I'll take her northward, where it's cold. She'll write to you regularly.'""

3942882842.m_KeyValue: ""'The Church will come. When they do, things will return to normal.'""

3942882845.m_KeyValue: "The rest—infected or not—would be nothing more than drops in the ocean. That was the Bell Ringer's flawless form of purification."

3942882846.m_KeyValue: "That unease deepened the moment the basement door burst open."

3942882847.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei stepped into the dark room—empty, at first glance. From behind the curtain, a low voice drifted forth, warning her that every piece of merchandise came with a price.""

3942882848.m_KeyValue: ""After five long years, Constantine had finally returned to Sapphire Isle—only to find it reduced to a living hell.""

3942882849.m_KeyValue: ""His teeth were sharper, claws sprouting from his fingers, and blood staining the corners of his lips. What had happened? Myrtle was gripped by terror.""

3943902956.m_KeyValue: ""The first time HP falls below {0}, releases lingering thoughts which form a barrier. For allies inside, DMG taken from outside the barrier is reduced by {1}. Lasts {2} sec.""

3943908335.m_KeyValue: ""<link=""Tips_ID;8""><#508499><u>Channels</u></color></link>. Upon completion, unleashes a torrent of sand and stone from above, dealing strong M. DMG to the target.""

3944157781.m_KeyValue: ""So diviners have such convenient pre-made predictions going around? If I learn this, could I set up my own stall and make some money?""

3944157782.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to set up a stall, you'll need to learn more than these.""

3944264270.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong with running? Staying alive is what matters."

3944264271.m_KeyValue: "It appears someone is healing them from afar."

3944267470.m_KeyValue: "Are you worried that the thunder woman will come after us if she defeats the fire guy?"

3944267471.m_KeyValue: "It seems I've arrived at just the right moment."

3945559369.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood aims to seize full control over you, turning you into its vessel. Its Bloodsoul slowly corrupts your mind while continuously strengthening your body.""

3946123754.m_KeyValue: "They didn't want to. But perhaps this is what humans..."

3946123755.m_KeyValue: ""At the end of time in every world, all wills will converge into one. Then 'he' will sail the ark to the Other Side.""

3946124774.m_KeyValue: "I used to think that was all I was worth. That outside my mission... outside being a vessel..."

3946124775.m_KeyValue: ""No! Lady Empousa, there must be another way!""

3946124777.m_KeyValue: ""Seems that by setting you on this path, I ended up forging a foe far stronger than I intended.""

3946124778.m_KeyValue: ""It's true. My nemesis may wound me, but I cannot die. And do you know why?""

3946124779.m_KeyValue: "Dumb Wolf... Lifeless Eyes... Aiona... Lamia... and... Noah..."

3947146367.m_KeyValue: "Her world is about to be annihilated and she faces it alone without companions to fight by her side."

3947146370.m_KeyValue: "And in that world—do we exist as well?"

3947146371.m_KeyValue: "Are we strong? Are we awesome? And why didn't they come with you?"

3947146373.m_KeyValue: "So those metal creatures you mentioned… they're from your world?"

3947146380.m_KeyValue: "(sniffling) Th-that's so sad... But... you've got us now!"

3947146381.m_KeyValue: "Hold on—didn't that old woman just say she was dangerous?"

3947148542.m_KeyValue: ""It's nice that you trust me so quickly, but you’re standing a little too close.""

3947148543.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry. I don't know why, but I feel drawn to you. As if there's something I need to understand.""

3947148553.m_KeyValue: "That's not blood. Those machines have never pulsed with life."

3947148554.m_KeyValue: ""A thick fog engulfed the sun back in my home, plunged everything into a black mire that devoured all light.""

3947148555.m_KeyValue: ""The air turned rank and bitter, poisoning every wellspring. Decay clung to everything and drained all life.""

3947148556.m_KeyValue: ""Our world is nothing like yours. Only a few of us remain, clinging to the remnants of a world long gone.""

3947149567.m_KeyValue: "And now another woman appears out of nowhere—acting like she knows me?"

3947149569.m_KeyValue: "Wait. Speaking of scent… Why are there two of you!?"

3947149570.m_KeyValue: ""Good thing I could track your scent. With this crowd, we never would've found you otherwise—""

3947149572.m_KeyValue: "You vanished without a word! Do you have any idea how long we've been searching for you!?"

3947149580.m_KeyValue: "I can't believe it's really you. How's Piera?"

3947150726.m_KeyValue: "The Harvest Celebration is about to begin. Even more people will be converging on the center of Asta."

3947150727.m_KeyValue: ""If there weren't so many people around, I'd transform and just fly over this whole mess.""

3947150729.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, looks like the whole city's moving in the same direction... We're never getting through this.""

3947150730.m_KeyValue: "Someone brushed past me just now... and whispered..."

3947150731.m_KeyValue: ""Stop dawdling! If we don't hurry, we'll miss the whole thing!""

3947150732.m_KeyValue: "Let's all move together. Don't get separated in the crowd."

3947150733.m_KeyValue: "Noah? What is it? You just stopped."

3947151750.m_KeyValue: ""First an explosion, now a pack of crazed metal beasts attacking us—""

3947151752.m_KeyValue: "Aiona—what are you doing? Why are you tearing those bottles off the spiders?"

3947151753.m_KeyValue: "Honestly! Where in blazes did Noah run off to? He's the one who told us not to split up!"

3947151754.m_KeyValue: "I saw it. The blast originated here."

3947151755.m_KeyValue: "I believe the fluid within them may be the cause of the explosion."

3947151756.m_KeyValue: ""It isn't water. It's an unstable synthetic compound… It's alchemy, after all.""

3947151757.m_KeyValue: "But it was just water—why would water explode?"

3947152898.m_KeyValue: "This is your ninth question. What final trial awaits me?"

3947152899.m_KeyValue: "For someone like you? It should be the simplest part—"

3947152904.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Then are you the type to define a person by their existence?"

3947152907.m_KeyValue: "Tell me... when do you think a person truly dies?"

3947152909.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps when they are forgotten by the world."

3947153920.m_KeyValue: "Says the stupid wolf who sobs over her wilted little flower like it's the end of the world."

3947153921.m_KeyValue: ""It's just daylight! You're acting like stepping outside is some grand miracle, you mangy bat.""

3947153930.m_KeyValue: ""…Perhaps this is the first time in ages Lady Empousa has ever danced in daylight, among so many joyful souls.""

3947153931.m_KeyValue: ""We finally won at Starfall Valley's sealed area and broke the curse. For the first time in centuries, the Bloodborn may walk beneath the sun.""

3947153932.m_KeyValue: ""Oi, noisy bat—what are you standing around for?! If we don’t move, we’ll miss the opening of the harvest festival!""

3947153933.m_KeyValue: "Noah! Are you even listening to me?"

3947155076.m_KeyValue: ""I shall savor the exquisite privilege of observation… Awaiting the inevitable day when The Exodus births another iteration of myself—who, in turn, shall craft his own Other Side. …Wait.""

3947155077.m_KeyValue: "Only now do I grasp this possibility—fascinating... and deeply disquieting."

3947155078.m_KeyValue: "Life and death shall unfold as I decree. The very cogs of reality shall obey my direction."

3947155079.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Aeon breathed life into the world that bore me, so too shall I ascend to become the god of The Exodus.""

3947155080.m_KeyValue: ""I see threads spun from time itself, drawing this Other Side into the present I occupy.""

3947155081.m_KeyValue: ""I hear wheels turned by blood, driving this Other Side toward the future I have envisioned.""

3947155082.m_KeyValue: ""—In this very moment, a new Other Side takes form within my grasp.""

3947155083.m_KeyValue: ""All life and history, faith and science, shall be reborn within this radiant new… world in a bottle of my design. It requires a name... Yes 'The Exodus'—a vessel for genesis, nurtured by my will.""

3947156098.m_KeyValue: ""Ah—of course! With us on guard, not a soul will overhear!""

3947156099.m_KeyValue: "I meant I would prefer no other ears."

3947156104.m_KeyValue: ""We're here to guard you, my lord!""

3947156106.m_KeyValue: "I never thought I'd find you here of all places."

3947156108.m_KeyValue: "To encounter you here—what an extraordinary honor!"

3948169073.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't you wish to hear my nightmares, Warden? These cursed visions haunt me night after night. I'm ready to share them with you.""

3948169074.m_KeyValue: ""A fool perished in fire, then awoke in the cold embrace of a coffin. The world he met was at once familiar and strange. He remembered nothing but one vow—to return alive.""

3948169075.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight's little dance has pleased me greatly. Here—take this. A personal invitation from the Warden. When the nightmares return, show it to the guards—they will deliver you straight to me.""

3948169076.m_KeyValue: "You do not understand… none can leave. This is the end."

3948898028.m_KeyValue: "What a pity. Perhaps it would be better if you died by that boring man's hand instead—"

3948898029.m_KeyValue: "So this is how we meet again in this place."

3949105893.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps the Prison is where memories belong."

3950659443.m_KeyValue: ""As salt crystallizes, it entombs the dying Blood Beasts of the island. These jagged formations rise like coffins across the desolate isle—both sanctuary and sustenance for the decaying remains.""

3950659451.m_KeyValue: ""At the Commander's call, a virtuous lutist steps onto the desolate isle. From their cherished lute flows a melody that cleanses the corruption of Black Blood and restores weary flesh.""

3950659452.m_KeyValue: ""Once a mere rat feasting on the dead, the Black Blood's influence forced a grotesque mutation, crowning it as the ruler of Starfall Valley.""

3950659453.m_KeyValue: "They say bloodthirsty sirens dwell on Sapphire Isle. Could it really be true?"
