4082217594.m_KeyValue: "And before the endless night of fate descends. The maiden has already made her silent vow:"

4082217599.m_KeyValue: "If I died and turned to bones too... Who would remember my mother? My grandmother? Anyone from our bloodline?"

4082306596.m_KeyValue: "Sounds like you're already starting to miss the people and the life you had on that ship."

4082306597.m_KeyValue: ""Second Mate Aaron said the same thing. Honestly, it sounds more like a villain's excuse than a grown-up's well-meaning lie.""

4082306598.m_KeyValue: "You sound just like First Mate Bob. Is that how all older people talk?"

4082306599.m_KeyValue: "There are some things children aren't allowed to do."

4082306600.m_KeyValue: "Adventure always carries both joy and danger."

4082306601.m_KeyValue: ""Yet every time they came back from shore, they looked so happy. Smiling, laughing… sailing off to the next port...""

4082306602.m_KeyValue: "The travelers who came aboard always told me stories about life on land—and all the delicious food there. But I never understood why everyone else on the ship kept saying the land was dangerous."

4083367852.m_KeyValue: "You'll have noticed a vial that accompanied this letter. Pour its contents into any basin and witness a memory from days long past."

4084140415.m_KeyValue: ""Heir to the Cidhall Family, who finds a confidant and competitor in Friedrich.""

4084140512.m_KeyValue: ""An enigmatic witch who stubbornly follows Noah, possessing the eerie ability to momentarily reverse time.""

4084140513.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa's butler. An enigmatic figure, forever donning a sly grin, his intentions as unpredictable as his actions.""

4084140514.m_KeyValue: ""Clive's adoptive daughter, not of the Ganelon bloodline, yet immune to the Black Blood.""

4084235075.m_KeyValue: "Allow this auncient one to enlighten thee on the nature of power."

4084238115.m_KeyValue: ""Since you prepared this for me, I'll accept it.""

4084245976.m_KeyValue: ""It's not exactly novel, but I can tell you put some thought into it. Thanks.""

4084248985.m_KeyValue: "Why are you giving this to me?"

4084250324.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for the things you have painstakingly prepared for me."

4085240191.m_KeyValue: "The chest is locked. It seems the 'Wheel of Fortune' has one more trial."

4085272034.m_KeyValue: "I will do everything in my power to protect everyone!"

4087862945.m_KeyValue: "Oh dear… how quickly my little secret was uncovered."

4088112188.m_KeyValue: ""Is there something you didn't understand? I may not know much myself, but I can always ask around.""

4088845961.m_KeyValue: ""You probably already know this, but I feel I should say it anyway.""

4090059501.m_KeyValue: ""You helped revive my silver-haired friend, led him to Famine and Plague. For that, I'm grateful.""

4090059502.m_KeyValue: ""It was Seth who tattled to god. Seized victory without a fight, and took the world as Aeon's agent.""

4090059503.m_KeyValue: "That is the true source of your power."

4090059504.m_KeyValue: "What you're implying is… you command time itself? As the Saint once did?"

4090059505.m_KeyValue: "Noah keeps running into powerful foes... yet you show no concern."

4090059506.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, I'm sure you're eager to see how it all plays out. After all, your beloved Commander has been drawn into this conflict.""

4090060521.m_KeyValue: ""Congratulations on your rebirth, my Master. The Blood Moon shall rise for you, and your wings shall forever eclipse the sun.""

4090060522.m_KeyValue: "Let us settle our score... next time."

4090060523.m_KeyValue: ""I must admit, four individuals have grown far beyond my calculations. But they've all... paid the price already.""

4090060524.m_KeyValue: ""In those brief moments, the outside world... has likely experienced several days already.""

4090060525.m_KeyValue: ""I won't forget her, I won't forget any of my companions, I won't forget the will of those who sacrificed themselves in this fight. So...""

4090060526.m_KeyValue: ""I thought after seeing countless futures, I would no longer hope for anything beyond what was preordained.""

4090060527.m_KeyValue: "Because I am Death... the stillness to which all life must return. Must I face this fate as well?"

4090060528.m_KeyValue: ""...The moon is the sun's dream. When she awakens, this dream will disappear, and our existence will be forgotten along with it.""

4090060529.m_KeyValue: "Don't you find this quite an interesting coincidence?"

4091351157.m_KeyValue: "Cain and the others plan to sacrifice her to awaken the Scourge—the Long Night herself: Limine Bathory!"

4091351158.m_KeyValue: "And you—only here because Lord Agares revived you with his flames."

4091351159.m_KeyValue: "Oh? So the castle rats followed us after all."

4091351161.m_KeyValue: ""What does life or death even mean to a suit of armor without flesh... Or a puppet, with four arms and two companions?""

4092543577.m_KeyValue: "Place in a locked Inventory slot to unlock slot."

4093524927.m_KeyValue: "Deploy Vassals from the Embrace until the Lineup is complete."

4093731608.m_KeyValue: ""Three years new, three years old, and three years of mending worn holes; the wood caskets in the Timeworn Mausoleum endure, generation after generation.""

4095076356.m_KeyValue: "I can't... I need to catch my breath..."

4097520931.m_KeyValue: ""...You ask me? I, I don't know.""

4097521954.m_KeyValue: ""Can we pick another one? I'm done with these worn-out, third-rate stories.""

4097524132.m_KeyValue: "Is this supposed to be some kind of joke?"

4097525287.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid this isn't my domain of expertise."

4097526310.m_KeyValue: "A tricky hand we've been dealt... Let's not play our cards too hastily."

4097527465.m_KeyValue: "Both sides have their merits and drawbacks. It's a real dilemma."

4097528488.m_KeyValue: "What's the hurry? Let me think for a moment."

4098355730.m_KeyValue: ""Care to join us, you two? The more the merrier.""

4098356658.m_KeyValue: "Not quite. But I did come across a rather curious tale. I think you'll find it most intriguing."

4098356659.m_KeyValue: "That strange construct with the bottles... Was that what you thought I might find intriguing?"

4098356660.m_KeyValue: "Each of those bottles holds a world entire."

4098356661.m_KeyValue: "And in every world... a story waiting to be told."

4098356746.m_KeyValue: "So this is where the Mastermind dwells? There's nothing here. Only emptiness."

4098356747.m_KeyValue: "Let's strike together and take back all that we've lost!"

4098356753.m_KeyValue: ""And of course, I haven't forgotten you either.""

4098356757.m_KeyValue: "—Come with me. Let's face the Enemy we were meant to confront."

4099787980.m_KeyValue: "Joyce—that rule-breaking thief—has been siphoning Joan's lightning for all these years."

4099787982.m_KeyValue: ""Joyce adores friends, but some souls are born with ice in their veins.""

4099787984.m_KeyValue: "We are Bell Ringers of the Tempus Church. You stand within a rift in time itself."

4099787985.m_KeyValue: ""Then Joyce has a genius idea—divide your power into a hundred fragments! Every enemy you meet would grow stronger. Perfect, isn't it?""

4099787986.m_KeyValue: ""Pavana, though this may sound harsh to say when you've only just awakened...""

4099787988.m_KeyValue: "Stand your ground! You are sworn soldiers of Astolfo—sworn to protect me!"

4099787989.m_KeyValue: "Strange… why should the number one thousand matter to me?"

4101491789.m_KeyValue: "Wow! This must be worth a fortune!"

4101491855.m_KeyValue: "The old me would have been thrilled... Thank you for reminding me of who I once was."

4101491890.m_KeyValue: ""Think carefully now. Once this leaves your hand, you will share my sin.""

4101491956.m_KeyValue: "It's regrettable that I can't offer you anything in return in this state."

4101491987.m_KeyValue: "This is one of my few indulgences outside of archery. You have my heartfelt gratitude."

4102236987.m_KeyValue: "And what of your human life? Are you really sure of who you are?"

4102529769.m_KeyValue: "Do you truly have the courage to witness each Scourge aroused by the final judgment? Do you truly understand what that means…?"

4102529770.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) As expected from the Chamber of War's leader. You must be one of the strongest Bell Ringers."

4102529771.m_KeyValue: ""You're a good per—I mean, you're a good tree.""

4102529772.m_KeyValue: "That’s right! We’ll send that smug old codger hiding in the back flying!"

4102529773.m_KeyValue: "We both come from the same family background! Why did you have to run off with those smelly bats!? You should've joined us!"

4102529775.m_KeyValue: "Aiona... is what that blue-skinned person said true?"

4102529776.m_KeyValue: ""Back at the Ganelon Forbidden Grounds, you mentioned your family had guarded a Divine Body for generations. But why call it your enemy?""

4109622608.m_KeyValue: "Then stand your ground. Don't you dare die cowering like a civilian."

4112025025.m_KeyValue: ""Master Vendor, thank you for creating us! But why call us sirens? Must we endure this torment for our home?""

4112025027.m_KeyValue: "A resident of Sunset Isle mutated by Black Blood. Seems to be an old acquaintance of Noah."

4112123132.m_KeyValue: "It contains our letters... and my feelings for Noah..."

4112123135.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, that's why I love this place.""

4112123136.m_KeyValue: "So vibrant... This is my first time setting foot in a city where so many souls dwell together..."

4112152361.m_KeyValue: "I suppose when the heart stops beating."

4112171601.m_KeyValue: ""As summer draws to a close, I bid farewell to Sapphire Isle. Before boarding the carriage, Bella and I made a promise to stay in touch.""

4112800021.m_KeyValue: ""Attack tipped-over powder kegs to make them roll and expand the terrain, or detonate other powder kegs.""

4112800023.m_KeyValue: ""Hatches will produce Black Blood Mutant Sailors in battle, and are relatively weak.""

4113693993.m_KeyValue: "No... not yet. Too many people are counting on me. I can't give up on the 'present' yet."

4114639717.m_KeyValue: "This tree looks like an ideal spot to hide things."

4116883436.m_KeyValue: ""Deals True DMG equal to {0} of the bearer's Max HP per sec. After {1} stacks, deals DMG to all allies within 3 meters of the bearer instead.""

4117061395.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Mira... May the wind bring you peace!""

4117061404.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, but I can't bring myself to hurt my former comrades, even in this state...""

4117061405.m_KeyValue: ""But if you need someone to cover you, leave it to me!""

4117061408.m_KeyValue: ""They were once Inquisition Knights, likely accompanied by priests well-versed in arcane rites. If you cross paths with them, be on guard against their ranged sorcery!""

4117911767.m_KeyValue: "This isn't the place to talk. Follow me to the family hall."

4118307664.m_KeyValue: ""Why do I feel like I've seen her somewhere before, and just now she...""

4120559066.m_KeyValue: "But my work is actually quite interesting."

4120559069.m_KeyValue: ""Though it may be boring at times, it's a responsibility I must face.""

4122071803.m_KeyValue: ""But just as Feuler departed, Swaney arrived with Agnes's letter to the study.""

4123033793.m_KeyValue:
""According to reports from the front, our cleanup squad sent to ※※※※※ was completely wiped out during our operation to eliminate the Black Blood.
We cannot rule out the possibility that ※※※※ is infected with Black Blood and is collaborating with the enemy.
We request a detailed investigation be conducted.

4123033794.m_KeyValue:
""To whom it may concern:

My name is Agnes, an apprentice Cartographer destined to become the greatest in Minexus!
Soon, I shall embark upon a cross-dimensional study. Your participation would add a splendid chapter to this grand voyage.
Compensation and job responsibilities may be discussed upon meeting.
As a gesture of goodwill, I've enclosed a small gift with this letter. Those interested should come on the night of the full moon to...
(The ink has dried and peeled off, making the handwriting illegible here. You suspect this might be some childish prank from the past.)""

4123852364.m_KeyValue: "We were never allowed near these ruins before... I never imagined they'd end up like this..."

4123852365.m_KeyValue: "I'm drained... but I can't fall here—not now..."

4123935411.m_KeyValue: "Miss Bella specially prepared this limited-time Mystery Gift for you!"

4124412516.m_KeyValue: "That's not why I wrote… It's something else."

4124446277.m_KeyValue: ""I've rediscovered a long-lost emotion. Show Acappella attention, watching her complain… it makes me smile.""

4124518275.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I'll make them some puddings to cheer them up right away. And I'll watch them eat every last bite. If that's not enough... they can join me for organ practice in the chapel until dawn. How does that sound?""

4125097005.m_KeyValue: ""Every 20 sec, Goldland transforms an ally into Maven of Wicked Blood.""

4126160120.m_KeyValue: ""You really can't do without me, hm?""

4126778551.m_KeyValue: ""They heard me... So, we really do have a choice.""

4126784557.m_KeyValue: "Very well. Let’s face what comes next together."

4126786735.m_KeyValue: "Save your gratitude. I'm merely adhering to my principles."

4126787756.m_KeyValue: "Not bad. It seems we’re cut from the same cloth."

4126791848.m_KeyValue: "Your insight is a rarity in these times."

4128151582.m_KeyValue: ""Get up, and come at me again!""

4128151583.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't supposed to end like this..."

4128406588.m_KeyValue: ""Genevieve stepped into the sea of flames, and fire erupted in a streak of azure light—the color of her eyes, her final trace upon this world.""

4128406589.m_KeyValue: ""Then came the vigil—a waiting as vast as eternity itself. Year upon year, the Divine Body's flames guttered and blazed anew, blazed and guttered, beating like some cosmic heart.""

4128406590.m_KeyValue: ""None could say where Genevieve and her people had gone, what ordeals they had endured, or why Noah had kept his long watch over the forbidden grounds.""

4128406591.m_KeyValue: "Until that day when Noah slowly lifted his gaze to the endless sea of eternal flame."

4128406592.m_KeyValue: ""You who are about to endure such suffering must find this far harder to bear than I, merely waiting here.""

4128406593.m_KeyValue: "This sword has been my companion through countless battles between life and death. I pray it will carve a path home for you and all the people of Carrelle."

4154249667.m_KeyValue:
""The region now known to the world as the Ganelon Forbidden Grounds bore a vastly different name in 1053—the _$$The Ashen Garden._$$ The Ganelons of that era regarded this place as a paradise on earth, and when Pestilence ravaged the land, people fled here en masse seeking sanctuary.

Yet the cruel irony lay in the fact that the very plague which claimed countless lives had its true source hidden deep within this _$$Ashen Garden_$$—namely in its underground river, seemingly placid on the surface, but turbulent beneath.""

4154249669.m_KeyValue:
""Clearly, the people of 1053 knew nothing about symptoms of mutation brought by the Black Blood disease.

Aside from the precious few who could harness the power of Black Blood for their own purposes, for the masses, once tainted by this cursed blood, they would embark upon a path of no return—over the following weeks, their minds would slowly erode and their humanity slowly fractured, bit by bit, until they devolved into creatures driven by bloodlust, gaining brute strength far beyond that of any ordinary mortal.

Even more disturbing was how humans of different bloodlines mutated in completely different fashions: Ganelons transformed into bloodthirsty wolves, and Bathorys metamorphosed into bats of the dark night, while the seafaring people of Landis would mutate into the most terrifying sea monsters of the deep.""

4154249670.m_KeyValue:
""The white flowers that now bloom only within Lupine Forest once grew in unprecedented abundance in 1053—these blossoms spread far and wide, even crossing the territorial boundaries between the great houses of Bathory and Ganelon.

These elegant little flowers were revered for their miraculous medicinal properties: they could both heal bodily wounds and dispel the spectre of plague. Thus, the local populace venerated them as symbols of protection. People had firmly believed this sea of pure white blossoms would shield their lands from disease and calamity, granting eternal peace.""

4154249671.m_KeyValue:
""Guided by the philosophy of _$$measuring the world with one's own feet,_$$ Cartographers scatter to every corner of the globe, traversing every realm and temporal node throughout history.

They survey the mysterious territories of continents still undiscovered, conducting research across cultural, civilizational, and archaeological boundaries. Each map bears the weight of history buried by time; each survey continues the legacy of human memory.""

4154249672.m_KeyValue:
""This ancient river, which has long since dried up in the current age, once flowed like a silver ribbon across the territories between the great houses of Bathory and Ganelon. In the era of abundant water and lush vegetation, it became the traditional boundary which both clans had respected for generations.

However, as the peninsula's ecosystem gradually withered, the once-flowing water began to dwindle, and this precious resource became as rare as nectar. The two great houses that once coexisted in harmony now turned their blades against each other over this sole remaining source of life, locked in a bitter struggle.""

4154249673.m_KeyValue:
""A new discovery from this survey—the house of Crowley.

This minor clan, vassals to the Duchy of Ganelon, had dwelt for generations in the northern regions of the Lupine Forest. The Crawleys possessed distinctive physical traits, namely red hair and pale skin. Due to their unique Blood Power, they are often misunderstood by Ganelons as outcasts who practice _$$witchcraft._$$

The women of Crawley possess even more distinctive Blood Powers, expending mental strength to negate physical harm. In other words, they are born with the miraculous power to protect others.""

4154249674.m_KeyValue:
""The year 1053 marked the beginning of the fateful entanglement between the houses of Bathory and Ganelon.

From territorial disputes over rivers and control of precious natural resources, to fundamental philosophical differences—the Bathorys cherished elegant and reserved aristocratic refinement, while the Ganelons upheld frank and forthright candor—even their long-guarded cultural heritage became kindling for the growing tensions between them.

This centuries-long feud grew ever more intense, like an unending tragedy. This persisted until 1353, when the great plague descended like death incarnate, and the hundred-year vendetta between the two clans finally reached its somber end beneath the shifting sands.""

4154249675.m_KeyValue:
""According to Cain, the mysterious Bloodletting ritual was meticulously formed to fulfill an old patriarch's cherished wish—to guide power from the _$$Long Night_$$ into the mortal realm. However, this ritual resembles an insatiable, bottomless abyss, requiring an endless stream of blood sacrifice to maintain its operation.

The truth of his words remains uncertain, but one thing is clear: the catastrophe that erupted in 1053 was but a minor prologue for the true descent of the Long Night.""

4154249676.m_KeyValue:
""This survey revealed that the house of Bathory's betrayal of the Church occurred much earlier than Cartographers once thought—even before 1053.

However, every house bears the sacred duty to obey the Church and guard the Divine Body. What impact might Bathory's heretical actions have on the Divine Body's sealing power? What unspeakable horrors lie hidden within the legendary Divine Body, sealed beneath the castle and piercing through the earth's core? Further investigation is required.""

4171037423.m_KeyValue: "Wait... all the villages share the surname _$$Brennholt_$$—same as Agares. Could this be... his hometown?"

4171037424.m_KeyValue: ""I should pay him a visit. He still owes me a reward, after all.""

4171037425.m_KeyValue: "The thugs were much easier to deal with than Agares. I quickly eliminated them all."

4171037426.m_KeyValue: ""But this manor is even more remote than I expected, and there aren't many people living here. Why would someone like Agares care so much about a place like this...""

4171037427.m_KeyValue: ""He's a man who keeps his promises, and the reward isn't bad. Besides, there might be answers there. Something that sheds light on the truth behind the rumors.""

4171037428.m_KeyValue: "Eastern Carrelle isn't far. I may as well take a look."

4171037429.m_KeyValue: "But I never agreed to help you."

4171037431.m_KeyValue: "Shouldn't that fall to the Church? They're the ones sworn to protect them."

4171037432.m_KeyValue: ""Any case, I'll leave it in your hands. Your reward will be ready when you return.""

4172299254.m_KeyValue: "Time to put those Bloodborn eyes to use. Check the study tonight."

4172299255.m_KeyValue: "They claim Hilda left a note—but it's locked in the family study."

4172859880.m_KeyValue: "But I can't... I can't watch anyone else fall before me—"

4174666729.m_KeyValue: ""Silence fell. He is preparing the reward, it seems.""

4174666730.m_KeyValue: "Your reward awaits. Come to my alchemical sanctum—I wish to bestow it upon you personally."

4174666737.m_KeyValue: ""The records you've provided have yielded fascinating conclusions: regardless of which reality we examine, every iteration of 'me' shares identical origins and experiences.""

4174666738.m_KeyValue: "—other worlds concealed beyond the veil of time itself. I'm pleased you've pieced it together."

4174666739.m_KeyValue: "And you sought my observations and records precisely because of what I am—Death."

4174666740.m_KeyValue: ""Not merely myself—all of history unfolds in endless repetition, mirroring our own experiences precisely. Yet time itself appears to flow far more swiftly in those realms than here.""

4174666741.m_KeyValue: ""After all, across every realm of existence, Death alone remains immutable.""

4174666742.m_KeyValue: ""Until success is achieved, no one can predict what mishaps may arise in the course of experimentation. Only Death holds the answers I require—""

4174666743.m_KeyValue: ""This isn't your first experiment of this nature, is it?""

4174666744.m_KeyValue: "It appears I've become your test subject without my knowledge."

4176196101.m_KeyValue: "(It's been a while since I received a letter from Lamia. I wonder if she's made any progress with the puzzle.)"

4176306080.m_KeyValue: ""(At dawn, I returned to my room.)""

4178156778.m_KeyValue: ""Oh? Dear Noah, are you learning to read your master's mind now?""

4178156786.m_KeyValue: ""I can only sleep soundly in a coffin, in a dark, damp crypt, completely sealed off from the world.""

4178156789.m_KeyValue: "I refuse to go back to that place."

4178156790.m_KeyValue: "I found an ancient tomb with a similar environment. I should be able to get a good rest there."

4187681529.m_KeyValue: ""Move forward, or... return to where it all began.""

4187681530.m_KeyValue: ""You are me, and I am you.""

4188015970.m_KeyValue: "Feeling better? Just leave everything to me..."

4188559464.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Am I the first to arrive?"

4188559465.m_KeyValue: "You're right. Every last one of them was once with the Inquisition."

4188559466.m_KeyValue: "Master Albrecht rarely travels. He's sent someone else in his place."

4188560488.m_KeyValue: ""But you returned to your homeland, and you were with us until the very end. Your life was anything but empty.""

4188560491.m_KeyValue: "You! Don't you know how fast the Black Blood disease spreads? Why did you..."

4189851119.m_KeyValue: "So many imitations deployed at once... I've no choice but to—"

4189851120.m_KeyValue: "Now it all adds up—the Saint anticipated this."

4189851121.m_KeyValue: ""Now, let us begin this tragic prelude of mutual slaughter!""

4189851122.m_KeyValue: "The Silver Cross uncovered House Astolfo's betrayal long ago. Just like the Bathorys before them."

4189852143.m_KeyValue: ""Insolence! Who do you think you are, mumbling in the Hall of the Elders?""

4189852144.m_KeyValue: "Nothing has changed... I keep becoming someone else for nothing."

4189852145.m_KeyValue: ""We can take shelter inside if we get through the corridor. You guys go first, I'll cover you.""

4189852146.m_KeyValue: "Are you two waiting for me to do everything myself?!"

4191160671.m_KeyValue: "Their strength is insufficient to reclaim the key."

4191160675.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. That lance is the key they've been searching for."

4191896439.m_KeyValue: ""Such trifles hold no meaning now. What I want... Will you grant me another drop of your blood, my captive?""

4191896441.m_KeyValue: ""We'll keep watch until the impact ends, so don't try anything.""

4191896442.m_KeyValue: ""—Or perhaps something else lurks beyond these walls, something that will keep us from ever truly escaping.""

4192015221.m_KeyValue: "Are you asking me to deliver a message for you?"

4193062856.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, but I can't make that promise.""

4193467116.m_KeyValue: "The Volcanic ridge bears no record of any Scourge."

4193467117.m_KeyValue: ""Once this is all finished, I'm looking forward to a proper bout with you.""

4193467118.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, when you said the castle was rising... do you mean to say we're actually flying?""

4193467119.m_KeyValue: "I never would have expected to encounter Blood Servants in a place like this."

4193467122.m_KeyValue: "Seraphina is consumed in a fit of agony."

4198955528.m_KeyValue: "I melted in the flames. Found nothing."

4205316731.m_KeyValue: "It seems Baphomet still regards me with caution."

4205316733.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally, the 'repay it in full measure and more' I spoke of has nothing to do with such trifling matters.""

4209080922.m_KeyValue: ""This sound reminded me of all my deeds, and it was the final thread that still tied her to me.""

4209080924.m_KeyValue: ""Your plan is to have me kill you, isn't it?""

4209080925.m_KeyValue: ""The dream feels real, doesn't it? That's why Hallon was obsessed with turning Sapphire Isle into a land of dreams, and why the Master desperately sought the formula for Siren's Tear.""

4212188491.m_KeyValue: "Tch. Just as I thought—gone without a trace."

4212188492.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) Curses... the poison surges after exertion…"

4212188497.m_KeyValue: ""Honestly, I nearly turned back and listed you among the fallen. That would've raised Lord Van Helsing's standing in the Silver Cross... but, ah, that’s beside the point.""

4212188498.m_KeyValue: "I fell after being caught in violent turbulence at high altitude near the Black Mist."

4212188499.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, I should have introduced myself sooner...""

4212188500.m_KeyValue: "Or is it because her chest and hips are larger?"

4212188502.m_KeyValue: "Letitia moves to stand in front of Seraphina."

4212188504.m_KeyValue: "I never meant to draw you into this—I'm so sorry…"

4212263848.m_KeyValue: ""It came to me today, and I want to raise it and watch it grow.""

4212263851.m_KeyValue: "The situation is far more dire than what the Church had told us. Friedrich and Gilrain... would they be willing to risk themselves for a little lamb..."

4212263852.m_KeyValue: ""But there are so many werewolves here, will we be able to get it out unharmed?""

4212263853.m_KeyValue: "Mm... I'll make it my birthday wish this year—to escape from here with the little lamb."

4212263854.m_KeyValue: ""We'll make it out of here, Aiona.""

4212263855.m_KeyValue: ""This little thing was so scared a moment ago, but now it has completely let its guard down. You really are something.""

4212263857.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose we're all the same. Intrigued by the unknown, yet also fear it.""

4212263858.m_KeyValue: ""It just came into this world. It's curious about everything around it, but also afraid...""

4216036397.m_KeyValue: "Is it the Fool's pure essence that wins the favor of fate?"

4216070158.m_KeyValue: ""Just like before, pure white wolfsbane thrives upon the ruined ground.""

4216285896.m_KeyValue: "What was it Letitia wanted to discuss...?"

4216516131.m_KeyValue: ""Defeat the little wolves quickly, or the Moon Sword will absorb them to reduce channeling time.""

4216520395.m_KeyValue: "Player has already joined a clan. Cannot invite."

4216520495.m_KeyValue: "Remember the punishment sequence and perform it on Fanny."

4217787504.m_KeyValue: ""The world knows them as 'Mapmakers', yet few have ever glimpsed their presence. This peculiar key, for instance, bears a design that seems to transcend the aesthetics of our mortal realm.""

4217787505.m_KeyValue: ""Suddenly, a snap beneath Friedrich's feet prompted him to look down.""

4217787506.m_KeyValue: ""As evening approached, the trio finally discovered the key's purpose—a small wooden cabin perched quietly atop the mountain, overlooking the serene lake to the south.""

4217787507.m_KeyValue: ""'I've noticed that eye pattern again on one of the manuscripts,' Aiona commented, even as she carefully retrieved the boiling water from the fire.""

4217787508.m_KeyValue: ""As Aiona read the cryptic note, a story long sealed by time began to unfold.""

4217787509.m_KeyValue: "Aiona stood up and paced around the room. 'I can't shake this feeling that something's off.'"

4217790768.m_KeyValue: ""Joan lowered her gaze and scrutinized the cat in silence. Her eyes, sharp as lightning, seemed to search for something beneath its fur.""

4217790769.m_KeyValue: "She turned it over thoughtfully. 'How curious…' A pause. Then her eyes sharpened. 'There's… a force inside this thing. Something unfamiliar.'"

4217790770.m_KeyValue: ""'Where'd I throw the Tarot deck... meow...' Its voice drifted out from the depths of the cabinet, sluggish and drowsy even at this distance.""

4217790771.m_KeyValue: ""'Of course,' Joan stepped past Theophane and entered the forest. 'This falls under the domain of the Bathory family. At least on the surface, they're still allies of the Church. And besides…'""

4217790772.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, seriously? That's it? Where did the fortune-telling showdown go? Wasn't divination supposed to be the whole point of this story?""

4217790773.m_KeyValue: ""Well… as cool as that dramatic tap had looked, she'd actually flipped two cards (laughs). It's hard to say if that was intentional... or if she didn't know her own strength.""

4217790774.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Joan reached out to turn over the face-down Tarot cards, Theophane moved to stop her.""

4217790775.m_KeyValue: ""Theophane nodded. As one of the most experienced Vice-Commanders in the Church, he had indeed noticed something unusual about the cat's behavior—""

4217790778.m_KeyValue: "'She wanted to get rid of it more than we wanted to reclaim it.'"

4217790779.m_KeyValue: ""'Death and Lovers, huh?' She picked up the cards, gently brushing her fingers across their surfaces. 'Bell Ringer and her Vice-Commander… Yet the bond between them feels heavy.'""

4217857200.m_KeyValue:
"Other Side ID: thankyouforsupporting-SAB-silverandblood-pleasecontinuetosupportus-202508

Other Side Time: Year 2589"

4217857201.m_KeyValue: "<style=Highlight>Note: Ami's original line was 'Just like this octopus Jack!'</style>—So how exactly does Goldland manage to decode this so-called Ami-speak anyway?"

4217857202.m_KeyValue: ""'Captain Ami... ever since our final confrontation with <style=Highlight>the Formless</style>, Starfall Valley has been swarming with rogue constructs. It's become one of the most treacherous places on the entire continent...'""

4217857203.m_KeyValue: ""'Jack, oh Jack... even you have abandoned me in the end...'""

4217857204.m_KeyValue: ""'So if we manage to get our hands on this <style=Highlight>Minexus Restoration System Y</style>, we'll actually be able to deal with those dangerous constructs in Starfall Valley...?'""

4217857205.m_KeyValue: ""'You don't need to think about it in such complicated terms.' Stella, who had remained silent since page 47, suddenly spoke and shattered the deathly silence, bringing hope to everyone—including the bard.""

4217857206.m_KeyValue: ""A thoughtful silence settled over everyone, as if they were savoring the weight of Stella's words.""

4217857207.m_KeyValue: ""'You did a wonderful job!' When the crew of the El Dorado was occupied with their duties, Captain Ami slipped away to find Stella in private.""

4217858288.m_KeyValue: ""'Let's set that aside for now...' Noah turned slightly, casting his gaze into the distance. 'This area's not far from the Bathory's territory. What brings a Bell Ringer all the way out here?'""

4217858289.m_KeyValue: ""Beneath the moonlight, a pair of hands parted the underbrush, revealing the base of the gravestone. A familiar symbol came into view...""

4217858290.m_KeyValue: ""Before long, Agares had swiftly unearthed the buried object and brushed off the dirt. Holding it in one hand, he leapt out of the pit. 'Here, have a look.'""

4217858291.m_KeyValue: ""Something seemed to click in Agares's mind. 'Hah... interesting hypothesis. Let's test it, shall we?'""

4217858292.m_KeyValue: ""'You think a flame like that is enough to pass for a Bell Ringer?' Agares blew lightly on the flame, snuffing it out with ease. 'Don't underestimate the Church.'""

4217858294.m_KeyValue: ""A veil of mist rolled in at just the right moment, hiding the two Agares. Through the thinning mist, something was beginning to change.""

4217858295.m_KeyValue: "'Not quite.' Twin Agares shook his head. 'Don't forget the beach. Agares was the one who suggested a swimming race.'"

4217858297.m_KeyValue: ""'I was skeptical at first, but...' Mass gestured toward the spot where the black stone had been thrown. 'After I dug that thing up—he appeared, didn't he?'""

4217859377.m_KeyValue: ""'What I mean is, there has to be a secret here, or someone's up to something!'""

4217859378.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, what a perfect moment to unwind and cast aside the burdens of duty.'""

4217859379.m_KeyValue: ""'Covenant—Halfway to the Underworld. Waltz of Silence.' The air stirred with Acappella's gestures, carrying both her and Darcias upward, their clothes fluttering in the wake.""

4217859380.m_KeyValue: "But why did she look so expectant? This Commander would likely lose her voice without entertainment for even a minute."

4217859386.m_KeyValue: ""The mud monster lead singer suddenly appeared before them, seemingly displeased by the commotion they were causing.""

4217859387.m_KeyValue: "Acappella pulled out a cake from her hat and held it up to Darcias's face."

4217913988.m_KeyValue: "You'll need a key to open chests. Defeat the Artifact Captain to obtain chest keys."

4217931248.m_KeyValue: "'Oh!' Hati exclaimed. 'I remember that. Clive wasn't my brother back then.'"

4217931249.m_KeyValue: ""'It was Anion, a female knight from the East. You've all met her before.'""

4217931250.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps, for those three, the outcomes of their contests were never what truly mattered.""

4217931252.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it was the very absence of the sword that led the young woman to recognize her own uniqueness."

4217931253.m_KeyValue: ""Gadric, in stark contrast, moved with perfect balance, as if he was still on solid ground. Hati surmised the duel was about to end any moment.""

4217931254.m_KeyValue: ""'Like maybe you wanted to teach us some grand lesson about being aware of our surroundings during battle, or you fell to avoid stepping on small fish and shrimp, or maybe...'""

4217931255.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't forget your father,' Gadric added. 'The warriors of the Ganelon family are not only formidable, but also unwavering in their loyalty.'""

4217934515.m_KeyValue: ""'Legend has it that on that fateful night, atop Fangtooth Tower, three moonlight greatswords sliced through the night like moons fallen to earth. The sight was so awe-inspiring that even some Bloodborn of the Lunar Sect hesitated to join the battle.'""

4217934516.m_KeyValue: ""'The two families were locked in a fierce rivalry on this peninsula for hundreds of years, until one day, a Ganelon betrayed the family.'""

4217934517.m_KeyValue: ""'You didn't actually understand a word I said, did you?' Empousa asked sarcastically, shooting Hati a withering look.""

4217934518.m_KeyValue: ""'Besides, the Ganelon family is no longer...' Jestel's words trailed off as realization dawned. Even with her usual lack of tact, she understood too late that this might wound Hati.""

4217934519.m_KeyValue: "Hati wasn't quite sure why she had returned to Fangtooth Tower. Perhaps it was to relive those cherished memories of practicing swordsmanship with her brother under Uncle Gadric's guidance."

4217960656.m_KeyValue: ""'...even if <style=""Highlight"">one of the others</style> happens to be your father?' Her lips curve into a knowing smile, her eyes curving into twin crescents of gentle mirth.""

4217960659.m_KeyValue: "That book hardly qualifies as an authoritative source."

4217960660.m_KeyValue: "'Why else do you think Ressa fled Sunset Isle? Why the secret mask? She was worked to the bone... The poor girl only needed to watch a sunset and finally rest.'"

4217960661.m_KeyValue: ""'I... I was only wondering, who is that baby girl's mother?'""

4217960663.m_KeyValue: ""'Surely no one could endure such squalid living conditions?' When she opens her eyes again, the weariness pooling within them threatens to spill over.""

4217962832.m_KeyValue: ""Isaac desperately wanted to affirm, but he couldn't bring himself to utter the lie.""

4217962833.m_KeyValue: "Isaac exclaimed with sharp accusation: 'How dare you conduct experiments with time in this sacred place? This is blasphemy against the goddess!'"

4217962834.m_KeyValue: "Nicole's eyes darted around. 'I can't shake the feeling that we're not alone here. There must be others.'"

4217962835.m_KeyValue: ""Inspired by tales from their master, Van Helsing, Piera, and Nicole embarked on a journey to the Crescent Garden, hoping to uncover the hidden truths of alchemy within its bounds.""

4217962838.m_KeyValue: ""'The goddess's devout follower finally lost his faith. He rampaged through this church, destroying everything he could and taking the life of every soul he met.'""

4217962839.m_KeyValue: ""'Countless were his prayers to the goddess, for a son of unrivaled valor to become her divine warrior, sworn to wage an eternal crusade against the Bloodborn.'""

4217963793.m_KeyValue: ""(…Wait, actually, maybe he really is old enough for his back to hurt. Ugh, the Bell Ringers these days are such a mess.)""

4217963794.m_KeyValue: ""For the record, just a while ago, Acappella had dragged Darcias along to trail these two Bell Ringers. Along the way, she spotted a strange mushroom… and, without a second thought, shoved it right into Darcias's mouth.""

4217963795.m_KeyValue: ""You're thinking of Tarot cards?' Thibault stepped in as well, pointing at the empty space with mock seriousness. 'But this isn't Tarot. Look at the suit symbol in the upper left corner of this one…'""

4217963796.m_KeyValue: ""'The cards without suits or numbers… they're inscribed with strange titles. Like… Endless Purgatory, for example.' Thibault cast a meaningful glance toward Agares.""

4217963797.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Wait—aren't they still making up the rules!? How is she even battling!? And more importantly, what card did she just play!? Am I the only one who can't see it!?""

4217963798.m_KeyValue: ""With a flick of her finger, the top card of the deck (Bell Ringer–only) flew neatly into her palm. 'Setting field effect: Unbound Sand Burial.'""

4217963799.m_KeyValue: ""Using a Covenant this early… It seems Acappella's aiming for a swift end.' Thibault paused, voice low with calculation.""

4217963801.m_KeyValue: "Ah! So all of that… was a hallucination caused by poisoning!? Those cards weren't even real!? What a scare—I really thought we'd seen the end of the bards forever—"

4218002032.m_KeyValue: ""With such intimate knowledge of lamb lore, this could only be Aiona herself (?).""

4218002034.m_KeyValue: ""_$$What are you muttering about? How dare you let your mind wander when facing me, Gilrain? Take this!_$$ Gilrain lunged forward with furious intent, his blade's gleaming edge racing toward Aiona as steel filled her vision.""

4218002035.m_KeyValue: "...Such a name?! Has the continent of Minexus run out of options?"

4218002036.m_KeyValue: ""But her attempt to calm things backfired. Instead of settling the dispute, her presence only made it worse.""

4218002037.m_KeyValue: ""It marks the coldest point of the season, and those who endure it are promised a prosperous year ahead.""

4218002038.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Aiona moved to catch up with <s><alpha=#88>the paragons</s><alpha=#FF> Gilrain and Friedrich, a shadowy figure appeared, blocking her path.""

4218002039.m_KeyValue: "What kind of background leads to someone receiving an entire wardrobe as gifts?"

4218002044.m_KeyValue: ""With that, Aiona began to fade back into the swirling wind and snow, her form growing ever more ethereal until she vanishes entirely... And as if on cue, time itself resumed its rhythm.""

4218002045.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona drifted toward her other self with unhurried grace, her dagger weaving intricate patterns through the air like silver petals on the wind. _$$...facing that 'Joyce Gadric' would be fatal._$$""

4218003120.m_KeyValue: ""Edina was about to say something when the butterfly in her palm suddenly stirred to life, its wings fluttering as it took flight towards a window—one that had mysteriously opened.""

4218003122.m_KeyValue: ""'For the next few years, they repeated this cycle of building and dismantling, over and over. But then, halfway through their journey, tragedy struck—one of the workers died.'""

4218003123.m_KeyValue: ""'Their graves lie behind this waystation, and to this day, their descendants maintain and stock it with provisions for passing travelers.'""

4218003124.m_KeyValue: ""'As for the one who built this waystation, his tale begins simply enough—someone offered him a fortune to construct this refuge.'""

4218003125.m_KeyValue: ""'With that settled, the group set out for the pre-selected site, carrying enough supplies and materials to build the waystation.'""

4218003126.m_KeyValue: ""As they traveled northward from the Eye of God, they planned to stop at Snowmelt Station upon approaching the vast snowy plains.""

4218003127.m_KeyValue: ""'You perceive it as fleeting because you're measuring an insect's life by human standards,' Yggdrasill said, his gaze already fixed northward.""

4218034704.m_KeyValue: ""'Hati, did you ever celebrate something like a Harvest Festival?' Empousa asked suddenly.""

4218034705.m_KeyValue: ""The ripe wheat stalks stood shoulder to shoulder, bowing their heads reluctantly only when the wind swept through, transforming the field into undulating waves of gold. Amidst this golden sea, the mill rose like a solitary ship on a vast ocean.""

4218034708.m_KeyValue: ""'Our ancestors were hunters, not farmers at all,' Hati said, noticing Empousa's surprise. 'Don't tell me you've never read about the Ganelon family's history in your books?'""

4218034709.m_KeyValue: ""Hati stared at the crude key in her hand, shocked by how much older and more rust-covered it was than in her memory. Would it still manage to open the wooden door before her? Or would it simply snap off in the keyhole?""

4218034710.m_KeyValue: ""'This story can't possibly be true, can it?' Empousa said with a pronounced pout. 'I wouldn't believe it even if my life depended on it. How could these two families ever have gotten along?'""

4218034711.m_KeyValue: "'And the only ones who came to the Ganelon family's aid in their hour of need were the Bathory family.'"

4218040018.m_KeyValue: ""Her eyes darted around before she suddenly dashed toward the roof's edge. The others froze, fearing she might jump, but instead, she snatched up a grimy looking object.""

4218040019.m_KeyValue: "'So you're scared of thunder too! And you've never dared to come up here for these gloves since then!' Empousa felt an inexplicable rage suddenly boiling inside her."

4218040020.m_KeyValue: ""As Hati got the roof after the other two, she gazed upward to see the full moon slowly disappearing behind a veil of ominous clouds.""

4218040021.m_KeyValue: ""'Yet his ambition remained unfulfilled. He yearned to construct an even loftier tower, a higher observatory, to bring himself ever closer to the moon's embrace.'""

4218040022.m_KeyValue: ""'You mean Ami?' Hati turned to answer the two girls behind her. 'She visited once before, but now she absolutely refuses to come back.'""

4218040023.m_KeyValue: ""'We can't just say yes to something when we don't know what we're getting into,' Ressa said firmly.""

4218106576.m_KeyValue: ""In the next moment, all three dashed forward and—splash, splash, splash—leaped into the hot spring one after another.""

4218106577.m_KeyValue: "'How can you have a race when you’re already standing by the hot spring?'"

4218106578.m_KeyValue: ""'And of course, it is I, Agares, who provides heat to this volcano every year.'""

4218106579.m_KeyValue: ""'Speaking of fairness, it's obvious that I should be the first one in the hot spring.'""

4218106580.m_KeyValue: ""Had they listened to him, perhaps the course of this story would have changed. But in this case, even Noah’s power to alter fate proved useless.""

4218106581.m_KeyValue: ""Who would have thought Agares was already at the age where he needed to mind his health? On that note, they say the hot springs here are excellent for relieving back pain...""

4218106582.m_KeyValue: ""Before Hati could finish her sentence, there was a splash as she lost her footing and tumbled into the water. A loud thud followed—she had collided with something. It was...""

4218106583.m_KeyValue: ""From deep within the thin mist came the soft splashing of water, punctuated by a deep voice murmuring to itself—""

4218107536.m_KeyValue: ""So that’s it…! The 'droplets' mentioned back on Page 18, Page 25, and Page 47—they were all foreshadowing mercury!""

4218107537.m_KeyValue: "'Of course not! That's clearly a decoy!'"

4218107538.m_KeyValue: ""'So you're telling me, in the midst of mercury poisoning, he somehow found a moment to secretly remove his armor, escape underwater, and then slip away without us noticing... and relocate?'""

4218107539.m_KeyValue: ""By all rights, Nicole should've been the first to notice something. Yet she stood in stunned silence, disbelief plain on her face. '...I didn't.'""

4218107540.m_KeyValue: ""'...Yes, a moon just like tonight. That unexpected guest—'""

4218107541.m_KeyValue: "Huh? That direct? Wasn't this supposed to be a secret mission?"

4218107542.m_KeyValue: ""But just as it seemed his helmet might finally come off and his secret exposed, Gadric’s laughter stopped cold. In an instant, he plunged beneath the water, leaving behind nothing but a trail of bubbles.""

4218107543.m_KeyValue: ""Though weighed down by bulky armor, Gadric moved nimbly through the water, dodging Darcias's strikes as he muttered to himself, 'Why does it feel like breathing's getting...'""

4218107548.m_KeyValue: "'So that voice... Gadric set it up in advance?' Nicole crouched to examine the device. 'But why go to all this trouble? What was he trying to pull?'"

4218107549.m_KeyValue: "...What?! That's Acappella's skill! Why would Gadric..."

4218178456.m_KeyValue: ""The proclamation died on Goldland's lips as a sudden realization struck him. He fell into an abrupt silence, his brow furrowing deeply as he fixed an intense gaze upon the hourglass now resting on the ground.""

4218178457.m_KeyValue: ""Through the thin mist, four men stood in a tense standoff in the village square. The sticky sea breeze tugged at their clothes and hair, yet failed to quench the fire burning in their eyes.""

4218178458.m_KeyValue: ""A golden fishing rod lay conspicuously on the ground—its tip adorned with an engraving of an excessively flamboyant man, head held high and arms outstretched. The identity of its owner was painfully obvious.""

4218178459.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing took up a fighting stance, eyeing the pair before him. 'My apologies, but I must keep you two here.'""

4218178460.m_KeyValue: ""Cain instantly grasped the situation. 'Nevernight, help me out! I'll have Bella slash your rent!'""

4218178461.m_KeyValue: ""'You really think I, the great Van Helsing, would lose my way?' Van Helsing muttered to himself as he rummaged through the house.""

4218178462.m_KeyValue: ""'...Hey Cain, mind getting me another room? This one doesn't have any windows—I can't even get a bit of moonlight. There's gotta be a half-decent empty room somewhere in this massive castle, right?'""

4218178463.m_KeyValue: ""'You guys... I've had it up to here!' In a flash, Noah seized the perfect moment and, with a powerful surge, broke free from their grasp. The three men clinging to him were suddenly sent sprawling in different directions.""

4218180626.m_KeyValue: ""'Since you're our guests, you can start first.' With that, Tris and Acappella took their positions on the other side of the net.""

4218180627.m_KeyValue: "'is your chance to attack. How else would the ball reach the opponent's court? How else would you score?'"

4218180632.m_KeyValue: "'The Church isn't quite what you imagine—'"

4218180633.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia stepped out from the shadows. 'Tch, we got caught because you couldn't mask your presence properly, Empousa. Useless dummy!'""

4218180634.m_KeyValue: ""'Alright, alright! Stop nagging already!' Empousa stormed out of the room and headed for the castle gates. 'Let's go before Cain gives us another lecture.'""

4218180635.m_KeyValue: ""'That child... still as playful as ever, I wonder? I hope it won't interfere with her duties... Though perhaps for her, play is what truly matters.'""

4218180636.m_KeyValue: ""'That won't do either. It would waste too much time.' Tris thought for a moment. 'How about this: no matter how you receive it, you must release the ball within a single breath after touching it.'""

4218180637.m_KeyValue: ""'Well then... We'll split into two teams: Acappella and I on one side, and the Bathory ladies on the other.'""

4218180638.m_KeyValue: ""Tris turned and picked up some semi-dried fish skin from nearby. She placed the pieces in her hands, using electrical current to heat and fuse them together, until finally—""

4218183769.m_KeyValue: ""He rubbed his chin—whatever he'd just thought of, it definitely wasn't anything good.""

4218183770.m_KeyValue: "'That's a huge misunderstanding. I just wanted to sit quietly and watch the sea.'"

4218183771.m_KeyValue: ""'So do you like the sea, or not?'""

4218183772.m_KeyValue: ""He smiled faintly, as if he already knew the answer. 'A very Noah response.'""

4218183775.m_KeyValue: ""Reaching forward, Augustine laid his hand upon the final rock. 'Ah… It's been a long time since I've entered the water. I'm a bit out of practice.'""

4218183801.m_KeyValue: "A rival who's both enemy and friend?"

4218185940.m_KeyValue: ""The startled seabird cried out and flew upward, frantically flapping its wings—scattering feathers everywhere and dropping a mysterious piece of parchment—""

4218185941.m_KeyValue: "'—Those who come to collect the debt must receive the Sea God's blessing.'"

4218185944.m_KeyValue: ""'If we could just stop her from using her skills—ah!' Empousa's eyes lit up with sudden inspiration. 'Lamia, I've got it!'""

4218185945.m_KeyValue: ""'Even without using the Covenant, this shouldn't be too challenging for a Bell Ringer, should it?' Tris smiled as she stared at Acappella, who looked like a child caught doing something wrong.""

4218185946.m_KeyValue: ""'Young ladies of the Bathory shouldn't be so willful.' Tris had turned around, still smiling. 'Your actions just now were a bit out of line. Consider that ball your punishment.'""

4218185947.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia turned to look at Empousa, who met her gaze in return. As their eyes met, an ineffable feeling began to sprout between the sisters.""

4218185948.m_KeyValue: ""The seabird circled once before choosing a sandy spot to descend. With a few beats of its wings, it perched steadily atop a pole used to secure fishing nets in the sand.""

4218185949.m_KeyValue: ""'There are rumors that the Bathory family seeks to rebel against and replace the Church... While such claims may be exaggerated, their power is certainly not to be underestimated.'""

4218185950.m_KeyValue: ""Lamia quickly cut Empousa off, then called across the net to confirm the new rule with her opponents, 'So it's settled then, Bell Ringer! No excuses when you lose!'""

4218185951.m_KeyValue: "'As if I'd let you pull the same move twice!'"

4218186111.m_KeyValue: "Why does she keep stomping her feet?"

4218894216.m_KeyValue: "Let's try to shake them off. We don't have time to deal with them now."

4239817232.m_KeyValue:
""Bella unveiled a new collection of wares, her puppet chattering away as it hawked gaudy trinkets at absurd prices.

Amid the clutter, I noticed a woolen toy. Its coat heavy with dust, its seams frayed by time.

It stirred a memory. A little lamb we encountered during my first meeting with Aiona.

I cleaned and mended the lamb with care, then placed the small companion in the hands of the Alita heir.

She held it in silence. Yet in that moment, I saw something I had never seen before—Aiona's lips, curved in the faintest smile.

_$$Noah, I want to go home._$$""

4239817267.m_KeyValue:
""At night, I dreamed I was once again aboard the great ship of Sapphire Isle.

Constantine wiped the blood from his blade, turning to her with practiced calm. 'These test subjects are no longer of use. Dispose of them.'

'You know best how to silence them... without those dreadful screams.'

The dying sirens glared at the woman, their fins rising stiff and sharp. Their cries pierced the air, shrill with fury.

Even without understanding their language, one could sense the hatred, the betrayal from the once-kin.

She gave no reply. One by one, she moved behind each captive, sliding her blade into the base of the skull—severing the spine, then angling upward to destroy the point where body and soul met.

Each siren fell silent as blood burst forth, consciousness vanishing in an instant. Their curses died mid-breath.

Siren blood ran darker than a human's, and it streaked across her cheek like a wound carved by guilt.

I offered her a handkerchief. She took it—but did not use it. 

'Why trouble yourself, little one?' she asked. 

'This blood carries sins long etched into my soul, a mark I can never wash away.'""

4239817325.m_KeyValue: ""As promised, I arrived at the castle's side entrance when midnight's bell tolled. Naturally, I had not come alone as agreed—my guards crouched hidden in shadow's embrace, awaiting their moment to strike. As night deepened its hold, I kept vigil upon the weathered stone steps. The moon sank behind twisted branches, yet she remained absent. Weariness crept through my bones until dreams claimed me. In that dream, a young woman with pale crimson hair approached through the mist. I jolted awake, scanning the emptiness around me—finding only night's breath stirring, carrying the haunting fragrance of Wolfsbane. Had Quinn been here? My hand moved instinctively to my pocket, fingers discovering an unfamiliar slip of paper. Unfolding it, I saw neat, elegant handwriting: Bat shadows gather thick, companions to the ghostly night The moon's child gazes longingly from this shore The voyage through the stars stretches on, the promised land still distant Don't linger in dreams—go, seek the far shore of the soul This was the verse Quinn had pledged to bestow upon me. She had indeed come—slipping past while I lay vulnerable in slumber. Fearing she might have infiltrated the castle, I rushed back to investigate. Strangely, every chamber remained undisturbed.""

4239817422.m_KeyValue:
""Elfriede is a village concealed deep within the forest's embrace.

It had been so long since I last roamed these lands that I failed to realize the territory was under nightly assault by bat swarms, leaving the villagers stricken with fear.

Clearly, these creatures were blood servants kept by the Vassals out in the wild. Since the arrival of winter forced most beasts into hibernation, the ravenous servants redirected their hunger toward this defenseless village.

Though time was pressing on the survey, saving lives took precedence. I used what remained of my medical knowledge to tend to the wounded. Once their conditions stabilized, I made my way back. Along the way, I recalled each wandering blood servant, escorting them back to the castle to return to the Vassal, accompanied by a cartload of Pure Blood Essence to soothe their terrible thirst.

Once the crisis passed, I let out a deep sigh of relief. However, an entire day had elapsed, causing the time-sensitive survey task to be marked as failed.

Just as I lifted my pen to write Agnes a letter explaining the circumstances, a sudden wave of bewilderment stirred within my heart. As those blood servants fluttered toward me, I distinctly heard a girl's piercing scream—a voice that carried something deeply unsettling.""

4239817480.m_KeyValue:
""At the Observatory, Valora gazed across the entire Bathory territory and recounted the history that Baphomet had erased.

Though I had already read the survey notes, I was still struck with shock by the historical details told firsthand by someone who had lived through them.

'But why arrange to meet at the Observatory?'

Hearing my question, Valora fell into silence for a moment before revealing her reasons.

'In the time I have slumbered, all things in this world have changed beyond recognition. All of this feels foreign to me; only the eternal stars above still whisper of home.'

Before departing the Observatory, I told Valora that I had once asked Cain about her past. She advised me to maintain a certain discipline of caution around Cain.""
