4262419051.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood has transformed William into a beast driven purely by desire. Timidity and self-doubt are stripped away. Ranna is beckoning to him — and there, where the claws of fear can never reach, lies only the promise of eternal peace.""

4263736776.m_KeyValue: "Where's Joan? Some well-dressed fellow is asking for her."

4264841671.m_KeyValue: ""'It appears to be directions—north from a burial ground, into a mist-shrouded birch forest...' Gilrain's eyes narrowed as he meticulously examined every detail.""

4264841672.m_KeyValue: ""'The Eye of God... I wonder why it's called that,' Gilrain mused, examining the linen cloth in his hands and pondering its author's intention.""

4264841673.m_KeyValue: ""As Gilrain's irritated shout rang out, several pages of manuscripts crumbled in Friedrich's hands.""

4264841674.m_KeyValue: ""'That's it! These two nearly identical symbols actually make a pair of eyes,' Aiona exclaimed once the symbols were placed together.""

4264841675.m_KeyValue: ""Friedrich's voice dropped to a lower tone, 'To be precise, I overheard it when he was discussing official matters.'""

4264844935.m_KeyValue: ""'But... if you manage to beat me in a reading...' With a wave of its paw, the floating Tarot cards descended slowly, landing in a tidy stack on the corner of the table.""

4264844936.m_KeyValue: ""'...meow?' The half-asleep black cat jolted upright, quickly wiping its face with a tiny paw. 'Welcome, honored guests!'""

4264844937.m_KeyValue: ""The ball didn't stop. It kept slowly rolling… until, with a quiet thud, it bumped into something—""

4264844938.m_KeyValue: ""No one's really surprised the cat can talk—After all, if you can't manage something that basic, you've got no business calling yourself a proper resident of Minexus.""

4264844939.m_KeyValue: ""'…and that if I challenged her to a Tarot duel and lost, I'd break the seal.' Jacintha stretched with a playful smile. 'That went better than expected.'""

4264844940.m_KeyValue: ""That calculating look of yours won't help! This is divination, not a game of who's-got-the-bigger-number! You're Joan, not Acappella!""

4264844941.m_KeyValue: ""'...Meow?!' For the second time, the cat rubbed its face in disbelief. 'Drawing a new card is fine, but that counts as a loss.'""

4264844942.m_KeyValue: ""This is bad. They've entered a battlefield completely unsuited to Bell Ringers. After all, none of them know the first thing about divination. Even Acappella—the most playful of the lot—only ever liked card games for the fun of it!""

4264844946.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, so you knew you didn't win?!""

4264911367.m_KeyValue: ""'As the captain of El Dorado, I hold absolute authority over our next destination! Not even you, Goldland, can defy me—or you'll face the consequences...'""

4264911368.m_KeyValue: "But what food could possibly be there? Isn't Starfall Valley known for its mineral deposits?"

4264911369.m_KeyValue: ""'And now, I stand but one step away from this glorious triumph! How could I possibly yield here? Don't you agree, Stella, the second of Minexus' last gourmets?'""

4264911370.m_KeyValue: ""'Still... Goldland has a point. Starfall Valley is genuinely treacherous right now.' Stella propped her chin on her hand, deep in thought. 'If only there were some way to neutralize those constructs...'""

4264911372.m_KeyValue: "What? Why are you only telling us this important detail now?"

4264911373.m_KeyValue: ""'As your captain, I declare...' Ami extended her hand toward the horizon—not merely pointing the way, but reaching toward that brilliant future itself.""

4264912455.m_KeyValue: "'That's like asking why Goldland keeps a life-sized statue of himself in his room...' Noah raised a hand to his forehead. 'Some things are better left unanswered.'"

4264912456.m_KeyValue: ""'If you told me that was just a trap to drag me back to the pyre, I might be more inclined to believe you.'""

4264912457.m_KeyValue: ""'Exactly! If I weren't holding it right now, I'd give you a standing ovation.'""

4264912458.m_KeyValue: ""('Heh. He probably thinks he's off the hook. When it's time to fill the pit, I'll make sure he does the heavy lifting.')""

4264912459.m_KeyValue: "'The real Agares would never suggest settling anything with a showdown. It's way too much trouble.'"

4264912460.m_KeyValue: ""'I apologize, but would you mind submitting to a trial by fire?' Before the words had fully left his lips, the flame in his hand surged towards the 'imposter.'""

4264912461.m_KeyValue: ""'Well, going around in the Bell Ringer's appearance makes things a lot more convenient, doesn't it?' Mass turned and took a few steps toward the gravestone. 'Besides, Agares...'""

4264912464.m_KeyValue: ""'That man wants to move forward, yet he can't let go of the past... like the final moment of darkness before dawn. Perhaps that's why the fragments chose his shape.'""

4264913543.m_KeyValue: "'So it's you—sneaking here at night to practice?'"

4264913545.m_KeyValue: ""'Bathory's stuff really doesn’t hold up. Just a few hundred years, and it’s already falling apart.' As she spoke, Acappella seemed to have a new idea.""

4264913546.m_KeyValue: "'Ah! I get it!' Acappella glanced around as if trying to read the air."

4264913547.m_KeyValue: ""At any rate, the mud monster fled into the forest. As the two pushed through the thick branches, they stumbled upon many mud monsters dancing around a bonfire.""

4264913548.m_KeyValue: ""'Since when have you been so keen on singing?' Darcias tilted her head, studying Acappella with a serious gaze.""

4264913549.m_KeyValue: ""The mud monster suddenly lunged at Acappella, who remained lying on the ground, seemingly humming something.""

4264913550.m_KeyValue: ""'You're acting strange today, very strange.' Darcias looked down at Acappella, and for a moment, there was a hint of sadness.""

4264913554.m_KeyValue: ""'Maybe for them, existing like this is another kind of cruelty.' Acappella glanced around at the desolate, gloomy surroundings.""

4264985415.m_KeyValue: ""'And then what happened?' Clive asked eagerly, noticing that Uncle Gadric had paused his story.""

4264985416.m_KeyValue: "'Does Ms. Anion still come back to challenge you nowadays?'"

4264985419.m_KeyValue: ""'Read your opponent's movements. Blind aggression only leaves you vulnerable,' Gadric advised patiently as he attempted to guide the young man back to the proper flow of battle.""

4264985420.m_KeyValue: ""Hati looked around for a fish or crab or other small critter—knowing Gadric, he probably lost his balance while trying to avoid stepping on one.""

4264985421.m_KeyValue: "Gadric's words continued to chip away at the foundations of the young man's already fragile worldview."

4264985422.m_KeyValue: "Ever wonder how a garlic knight dines? Especially with garlic sauce on the menu."

4264988683.m_KeyValue: ""'That night, the Bathory family began bombarding the tower with stone projectiles and gunpowder bombs, attempting to destroy it outright. But the tower proved incredibly resilient—three hours of relentless assault barely left a scratch.'""

4264988684.m_KeyValue: "'Would you like to hear how the Aegis family remembers that battle?'"

4264988685.m_KeyValue: ""Hati said with a bitter smile, 'I've heard about it too. Having lived on the land my whole life, I'm curious about a sunset over the sea.'""

4264988686.m_KeyValue: ""Hati's anger flared up. 'For as long as I can remember, this place has belonged to the Ganelon family!'""

4265014824.m_KeyValue: "'Letitia...? Could it truly be you? How are you even here...?'"

4265014825.m_KeyValue: "'...Do you expect me to believe such fairytales?' Stella shakes her head with cold indifference and moves as if to leave Letitia behind."

4265014827.m_KeyValue: ""Note: See Mario and Juliet. Ah, how's that? This time our bard claims victory, wouldn't you agree?""

4265014828.m_KeyValue: ""'The islanders honor nature's rhythms, rising with the sun and resting with its fall.'""

4265014829.m_KeyValue:
""
<align=""center"">'The answer you seek lies not in the <style=""Highlight"">past</style>, but in—'""

4265014830.m_KeyValue: "Hey! What's this dangerous territory you're wandering into? Such a setting never existed!"

4265016999.m_KeyValue: ""'The goddess promised them rewards for their sacrifice, yet not a single boon ever graced their hands.'""

4265017000.m_KeyValue: ""'Some of those books were taken by the Church, while I brought the rest back to the Bathory's castle,' Cain said, as his hair swayed despite there being no wind.""

4265017001.m_KeyValue: ""Before the instrument stood a black-haired man, with a subtle mockery exuding from the corner of his mouth.""

4265017002.m_KeyValue: ""The trio moved between ruined walls and rose bushes, using moonlight to find their footing while carefully avoiding the sharp thorns hidden along the stems.""

4265017006.m_KeyValue: ""'Once more, the goddess's devotee found himself kneeling in this very church, his prayers now a desperate plea to slow the relentless march of time for his son.'""

4265017959.m_KeyValue: "'…Hmm? Did you feel that? Feels like we're not alone out here.'"

4265017960.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't sweat the small stuff,' Acappella interrupted with a cheerful grin. Then, as if a thought struck her, she clapped her hands together. 'Ah! Since we're all gathering…'""

4265017961.m_KeyValue: ""'Mmhmm… just as I thought…' Acappella stared at the empty ground, studying it with exaggerated seriousness.""

4265017962.m_KeyValue: ""'And what about this huge orb thing? It's wrapped in two floating ribbons, and the middle looks like it's dripping something… Never seen anything like it!'""

4265017963.m_KeyValue: ""'Exactly! Which is why we're calling it… Battle Masters!' Acappella nodded proudly, looking very pleased with herself.""

4265017964.m_KeyValue: ""'A wise decision.' Thibault gave a slight nod. 'Silvershade Requiem is a card that combines offense and defense. If an enemy triggers its preset condition, it immediately retaliates.'""

4265017965.m_KeyValue: ""'Covenant—' Before the word even left her lips, the wind howled to life, scattering the clouds in reverse. The air itself twisted—as if something terrible was about to be born…""

4265017966.m_KeyValue: ""'This guy…' For once, Acappella dropped her usual playfulness, standing at full attention as if bracing for a finishing move.""

4265017967.m_KeyValue: "She suddenly paused. '...Ah. I see now… So that mushroom was an antidote.'"

4265056199.m_KeyValue: "_$$Then she must be our task target—_$$"

4265056202.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever the cause, in the final heartbeat before the three would clash in deadly combat, Aiona (the very Aiona who had been abandoned by <s><alpha=#88>the paragons</s><alpha=#FF> Gilrain and Friedrich) appeared at the edge of the chaos.""

4265056203.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Hah, you're the one who's completely lost, Gilrain._$$ Friedrich smiled with the kind of fondness reserved for a hopeless <s><alpha=#88>junior</s><alpha=#FF> younger brother.""

4265056204.m_KeyValue: "_$$Your careless attitude during the task cost you first place last year. Are you planning to make the same mistake again?_$$"

4265056205.m_KeyValue: ""But let's return to our story. Meanwhile, <s><alpha=#88>the paragons</s><alpha=#FF> Gilrain and Friedrich have already arrived in the village...""

4265056206.m_KeyValue: ""Before Gilrain could finish his, Friedrich gave a resolute nod. _$$Tasks come first._$$""

4265056211.m_KeyValue: "Will he ever get that chestplate repaired...?"

4265056212.m_KeyValue: "_$$From the cashmere of goats that roam the Acorellia Highlands. I received it as a gift on my nineteenth birthday._$$"

4265057289.m_KeyValue: ""'That friend had perished in a blizzard, at the very spot where the waystation was destined to rise.'""

4265057290.m_KeyValue: ""'Edina, you must understand: from the moment of birth, we tread inexorably towards death. A tree's rings are but measured steps on its journey to its end.'""

4265057291.m_KeyValue: ""At that time, Edina was still in her youth. The vast tapestry of the world had yet to unfurl before her eyes. The two possibilities her master described sometimes converged from the same horizon.""

4265057292.m_KeyValue: ""'Yet, that very waystation ensured their survival. After all, the whole purpose was to help people survive the treacherous journey across the plains.'""

4265057293.m_KeyValue: ""'Master, could you please heal it?' Edina asked hopefully, gently raising the butterfly towards Yggdrasill.""

4265057294.m_KeyValue: "'If you wish.' Yggdrasill thought he may as well consider it a simple bedtime story to pass the time."

4265088871.m_KeyValue: ""The three girls sprinted along the path cutting through the heart of the wheat field, their eyes fixed on Mouret's gate. The wind continued to blow across the land, carrying with it the eerie howls of wolves from the distant forest.""

4265088872.m_KeyValue: ""'Empousa, I believe I can offer temporary protection to those who come to harvest the wheat. However, can you assure me that the Bathory family's sphere of influence won't extend to this area?'""

4265088875.m_KeyValue: ""Hati continued, 'Just as the Ganelon family had resigned themselves to relocating the entire town, a heavy snowfall descended, as if determined to drive everyone into despair.'""

4265088876.m_KeyValue: ""'How could anyone possibly stomach bread made with flour from such a filthy place?' Empousa exclaimed, her cheeks flushing with indignation.""

4265088877.m_KeyValue: ""'A curse for the extinction of the entire Ganelon family?' Ami remarked with a wry smile. 'Well, it seems that curse has certainly come to fruition now.'""

4265088878.m_KeyValue: ""'But I think neither family truly wanted to be on the same side as the other,' Hati observed, much to her surprise finding agreement from both Empousa and Ami.""

4265094185.m_KeyValue: ""'Of course not,' Hati said, still beaming.' I've always cherished these gloves!'""

4265094186.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey Hati, I've been wondering—have you gotten over your fear of thunder since then?'""

4265094187.m_KeyValue: "'Could it have happened during the castle's construction?' Ressa mused. 'The Bathory castle stands impressively tall and is outfitted with an extensive array of lightning rods. Perhaps a lesson learned from that tragedy?'"

4265094188.m_KeyValue: "Empousa paused for a moment. 'Can that kind of stuff even happen?'"

4265094189.m_KeyValue: ""Hati glanced up at the mill and said, 'Would you all mind doing me a favor?'""

4265094190.m_KeyValue: "This was to eliminate any chance of being struck by the windmill as they climbed. But this action could potentially reduce the windmill's durability to the point where it could break before the next group came to take it over."

4265160745.m_KeyValue: "Whether it was because he found it too troublesome to explain or simply wanted to keep the hot spring to himself—or perhaps a bit of both."

4265160746.m_KeyValue: ""With a turn of his palm, Agares conjured a pale blue flame. Perhaps it was just imagination, but the distant volcano seemed to stir for a moment in response to the azure fire.""

4265160747.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, she had not caught on to the obvious trick...""

4265160748.m_KeyValue: ""'I see. So, what we really need to figure out now is who gets to use the hot spring first.'""

4265160749.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh...? The water’s so warm here!' Hati exclaimed, dipping her hand into the pool to test the temperature. 'This has to be the legendary Ethereal Spring!'""

4265160750.m_KeyValue: ""'D-Damn it...' Hati muttered, wiping her mouth as she clung to the railing. 'Uncle Gadric trained me to handle seasickness not too long ago. I won't give up!'""

4265161703.m_KeyValue: "Nicole gripped the helmet firmly and gave it a sharp tug upward. 'What?!'"

4265161704.m_KeyValue: ""Because that would mean duplicate character traits! And as the most professional bards (okay, maybe top three) in all of Minexus, of course I would never allow such redundancy!""

4265161705.m_KeyValue: ""'Gadric, you’re not hurt, are you? We’re here to help.' Darcias's words were innocent, but her arms swept through the mist with ruthless, slicing strikes.""

4265161706.m_KeyValue: ""'Gadric... was never here to begin with!' Realizing this, Nicole let out a long sigh. 'And here I thought he was just a comic relief...'""

4265161707.m_KeyValue: ""According to reliable intel, Darcias had actually snuck away from Acappella today for a secret mission! And that mission was... to coax Gadric into removing his helmet, just to catch a glimpse of his true face!""

4265161708.m_KeyValue: "'Ahahaha...' Gadric burst out laughing—like an overjoyed puppy who couldn't contain his glee."

4265161709.m_KeyValue: ""Upon hearing Nicole’s deliberately hushed whisper, Darcias gave the faintest nod and stopped her actions. Then, raising her voice: 'Target lost. Let’s head back.'""

4265161710.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! Those weren't ordinary water droplets—They were mercury! As the Vice-Commander and second disciple of Bell Ringer Albrecht, one of Nicole’s greatest abilities is her control over mercury itself.""

4265232623.m_KeyValue: ""'Splendid! Now everything is truly, impeccably ready.' Goldland reverently placed the golden hourglass on the ground and, with a grandiose flourish, once again proclaimed, 'The Greatest Fishing Competition in All of Minexus—'""

4265232624.m_KeyValue: ""The lifelike figure stood proudly atop the hourglass. His head was held high, arms spread wide in a pose of extravagant narcissism. As one's gaze lingered, the identity of this ostentatious figure became clear—it was none other than—""

4265232625.m_KeyValue: ""'This matter eventually caught the Church's attention, prompting them to issue their highest-level investigation order against him. They're using the Blood Beast investigation as a cover, while their real intention is to secretly take over Goldland's seafood empire.'""

4265232626.m_KeyValue: "'But I only need to hold you off until time runs out for our team to win!' Van Helsing looked down at the two opponents with pride. 'Strategy is just as much a part of strength as anything else.'"

4265232627.m_KeyValue: "'Seizing the Silver-haired one means controlling the seafood market—a power so great that even the Church fears it! My dream of ascending to society's upper echelons is finally within reach! How could I let such a golden opportunity slip away!'"

4265232628.m_KeyValue: ""Although Cain noticed immediately and deftly avoided the attack, the figure still managed to grab one end of the golden hourglass—the part with Goldland's head carved into it.""

4265232630.m_KeyValue: ""'You make a valid point. While Alchemy is my passion, my primary duty is that of the Bathory family's steward. I'm ashamed to admit I lost sight of that fundamental fact.'""

4265234794.m_KeyValue: ""'If the Commander truly wanted a fight, you wouldn't be standing here talking right now.'""

4265234799.m_KeyValue: ""'As if I'd bother with such complicated schemes.' Acappella shot Lamia a contemptuous glance. 'See, Commander? I told you they wouldn't appreciate it.'""

4265234800.m_KeyValue: "'And who might you be? You're acting like you know everything... Are you just putting on an act?'"

4265234801.m_KeyValue: "The golden-haired woman was about to answer when she suddenly turned toward where Empousa and Lamia were hiding. 'Would our guests care to show themselves?'"

4265234802.m_KeyValue: ""'Hey, watch how you talk to your sister! If anyone's a dummy, it's you, Lamia!' Empousa shot back while hastily changing clothes and gathering her things.""

4265234803.m_KeyValue: ""'Listen up.' Lamia snatched the fish-skin ball from Empousa. 'You can only touch the ball three times, so after you've used up all three touches, what state should the ball be in?'""

4265234804.m_KeyValue: "'You have a point though. Holding the ball too long would defeat the purpose of a quick match...'"

4265234805.m_KeyValue: ""'...And that's why you're a dummy.' Lamia pointed at the sand. 'with such a clear groove in the ground, wouldn't the sand collapse inward?'""

4265234806.m_KeyValue: ""'That's not a bad idea, Acappella.' Tris nodded at her with a smile. 'We can use these fishing nets as our net.'""

4265237935.m_KeyValue: "'Why don't we have a race? See who's the better swimmer.'"

4265237937.m_KeyValue: ""If you're so enthralled by the sea, why not just jump in? You won't feel its wonder just standing there.""

4265237938.m_KeyValue: ""'Now, now, don't say it like that, Noah. I just gave you a little encouragement.'""

4265237941.m_KeyValue: ""Behind them, a massive surge broke the surface. A figure cut through the waves—""

4265237942.m_KeyValue: ""'Augustine, do you have a question for us?'""

4265240108.m_KeyValue: "'Did you really think these debts have gone uncollected all these years by chance?'"

4265240111.m_KeyValue: ""'Hmph, the Bell Ringer is being so dramatic. This is just keeping you immobile for a while.' Empousa tightened her control over the vines around Acappella, showing no signs of letting up.""

4265240112.m_KeyValue: ""Yet the ball didn't break through. Instead, its tremendous momentum carried it straight to Empousa's face, stopping just inches from her nose, the net straining between them.""

4265240113.m_KeyValue: ""With these words, Tris gave a graceful bow, then turned and walked away with a flourish, quickly disappearing from the Bathory sisters' sight along with Acappella.""

4265240114.m_KeyValue: ""Just then, the unidentified seabird that had appeared on pages 1 and 24 glided down slowly from the sky once again, landing with a plop on Empousa's head.""

4265240115.m_KeyValue: ""The Scarlet Bats beat their wings violently, creating a whirlwind around Lamia. Using this gale force, she leaped skyward, soaring up to catch the fish-skin ball at its apex!""

4265240116.m_KeyValue: ""'Ah, I've got it!' Acappella clapped excitedly. 'Our side won't use the Covenant—that way, even the Bathory folks will have a chance to beat us!'""

4265240117.m_KeyValue: ""Their combined ultimate defense proved effective—the ball, which had been moving with the speed of thunder, was first controlled by the wind pressure, then further slowed down by the vine net...""

4265606285.m_KeyValue: ""The diviner’s hair carried the mysterious scent of burning incense. Her fingers, pale as moonlight, brushed my face with a warmth untouched by the cold moon.""

4266988734.m_KeyValue: ""Transfer Code is used to move your account to another device. Please keep it secure and confidential! Note that only unbound third-party accounts can use Transfer Code. If you have already bound a third-party account, please use the account login feature.""

4267933443.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, the plague of this era spreads only through tainted water. As long as we steer clear of the foul sources, we should remain unharmed.""

4268665552.m_KeyValue: "Can life be defined by something other than 'body' and 'soul'?"

4268751431.m_KeyValue: "It's been ages since a vessel last graced my presence."

4268751432.m_KeyValue: ""When the Blood Moon descends and the final moment arrives, you will understand...""

4268751433.m_KeyValue: ""I, Baphomet, in the name of the Bathory family, shall execute the trial upon these two vessel candidates before me!""

4268751462.m_KeyValue: "I never thought they'd keep cats in such a gloomy castle."

4268751464.m_KeyValue: "Forget it! We'll just defeat you and take the card from your deck!"

4268751465.m_KeyValue: "The fifth card... Did you intend to give it to us from the start?"

4268751466.m_KeyValue: ""...So, I should come up with a name too?""

4268751726.m_KeyValue: "'Yet no one has ever seen what it looks like.'"

4268751727.m_KeyValue: ""How long are you going to stay curled up in that corner, moping? You should be happy you've survived this long.""

4268751728.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you leave with No. 18 when she made her escape three days ago?"

4268751729.m_KeyValue: ""So, how about that? You can count on me!""

4268751759.m_KeyValue: "But it shows us being devoured by it. How unsettling."

4268751760.m_KeyValue: "...It does look like some kind of mechanism. Though I'm not sure if it can help us escape this castle."

4268751761.m_KeyValue: "For those who tried to escape before us... this is where their journey ended."

4268751790.m_KeyValue: "Huh? What are you saying all of a sudden?"

4268751792.m_KeyValue: "Why are you asking that all of a sudden?"

4268751822.m_KeyValue: ""You're a merchant, right? Let's make a deal. We'll be your friends in exchange for...""

4268751823.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize, Miss Slade. I'm the one at fault, please spare my friend.""

4268751825.m_KeyValue: ""Friendship shouldn't be measured by money. Isn't that what you taught me, my friends?""

4268751826.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no. How can a human have four hands?""

4268751828.m_KeyValue: ""But if we want that card, we only have one choice...""

4268751858.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, I... I think it's better if I go back to my cage after all.""

4268751860.m_KeyValue: ""Since you've said all that... I don't know how far we can go, but I'll accompany you.""

4268751861.m_KeyValue: ""Stop worrying so much. I won't let anything happen to you, and you won't let anything happen to me.""

4268751889.m_KeyValue: ""After all, the vessel we ultimately seek is one that fears not death, and can bear all sins and suffering.""

4268751890.m_KeyValue: ""Judging by where you came from, you must've passed that strange puppet, though I'm not sure how you managed that...""

4268751891.m_KeyValue: ""You've always dreamed of the outside world more than I have, so... at least you should make it out!""

4268751892.m_KeyValue: "Such a lack of vigilance. I'm amazed you've made it this far."

4268751893.m_KeyValue: ""Stay alert. If they can control statues with shadows, they can surely conceal themselves too.""

4268751924.m_KeyValue: ""And it seems the path ends here, with only a bottomless void below...""

4268751925.m_KeyValue: ""Even vessels need to be tempered, lest they become naught but discarded refuse.""

4269629698.m_KeyValue: "You may yet get your wish. Once he sprouts."

4269629699.m_KeyValue: "I came with Sir Gadric. He... he was killed. We were trying to get the message out..."

4269629700.m_KeyValue: "What do I do... what do I do...!?"

4269629701.m_KeyValue: "Then all the more reason you shouldn't follow me."

4269629702.m_KeyValue: "The Kingdom alliance resisting the Church has arrived and seized control of the battlefield. So we've come to support you."

4269630723.m_KeyValue: "Skoll! You have to hang in there!"

4269630725.m_KeyValue: "Then we silence him. He was never meant to walk these decks anyway."

4269630726.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure about this? He's the Captain of the El Dorado... and he's your..."

4269925455.m_KeyValue: "Though his expression was undiscernable—for he had none—Baphomet's joy was evident from the tone of his words."

4269925456.m_KeyValue: ""'It gladdens me to hear your curious question, for it shows the duty of an elder has taken root in your heart.'""

4269925457.m_KeyValue: "Bella opened her briefcase. 'What's the topic for this meeting?'"

4269925462.m_KeyValue: ""'What are you yapping about, old-timer? I just wanted to use this opportunity to do a big sale for all the stuff I've been hoarding!'""

4271052625.m_KeyValue: "Only through the family records did I uncover the truth—Quinn was a criminal who had brought harm to our clan."

4271581113.m_KeyValue: "ATK SPD +{0}. Does not stack with effects of the same type."

4271675018.m_KeyValue: ""Very well, do as you wish. You never heed my counsel anyway.""

4271675019.m_KeyValue: "How did you get in? There will be no interrogations tonight. I am… indisposed."

4271675020.m_KeyValue: "Have you come to gloat over my ruin? To see the mighty Warden toppled from her throne? Surely that is every prisoner's sweetest dream."

4271675021.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I almost forgot... You people of this era wouldn't know what an 'ignition point' is, would you? But know this...""

4271675022.m_KeyValue: ""So this is what it means to live… Not breath, not a heartbeat, but this—this shuddering blaze that sets my soul aflame.""

4271720647.m_KeyValue: "Maybe… she really does need the rest."

4271720648.m_KeyValue: "I waited for a long time. But no reply came."

4271720649.m_KeyValue: "But the refund is… quite substantial. How much did you buy?"

4271720651.m_KeyValue: ""Some medicine, a bit of rest, and I'll be right as rain.""

4272834759.m_KeyValue: "I just haven't read this particular story..."

4272834761.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, I've never heard of any of them.""

4272834762.m_KeyValue: "I see. So Noah can't read. How pitiful."

4272834764.m_KeyValue: "It's the main character from the book. Some versions avoided copyright by calling it the Iron Person or Stone Person—kind of like a certain rust-prone wanderer from that famous yellow-brick story."

4273076447.m_KeyValue: ""...Sorry. Since coming here, these recurring dreams have been clouding my thoughts.""

4273076448.m_KeyValue: "That settles tomorrow's plan! I'll head to the tavern and gather more information."

4273076449.m_KeyValue: "What do you need me to do?"

4273076450.m_KeyValue: "That's why I asked Selena to have the Church's soldiers create a distraction for the auction house guards on that day."

4273076452.m_KeyValue: "There are too many guards right now. Rushing in carelessly would only draw more attention…"

4273076480.m_KeyValue: ""As expected... I knew I'd find my answer here. So, it was you...""

4273076481.m_KeyValue: "And you can go back to the Church and continue with your dream of becoming a Bell Ringer after this."

4273076482.m_KeyValue: "Well... I can't quite remember what happened to my father."

4273076483.m_KeyValue: "The Church is searching the auction house... they say... it's by order of the Bell Ringer!"

4273076505.m_KeyValue: "'Sapphire Isle will become our second home. Let's rebuild it together with everyone.'"

4273076506.m_KeyValue: "The Eighth Sage of Sapphire Isle... may you lead this isle toward a brighter future."

4273076511.m_KeyValue: "The final candidate... is actually a fraud?"

4273076514.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, regarding your 'proof,' how much longer—""

4273076516.m_KeyValue: ""If the Seven Sages could use the Siren's Tears to induce hallucinations, how was I able to witness the murders of the Mistbound Terror at night?""

4273076517.m_KeyValue: "That's right! Miss Ami should be our Eighth Sage!"

4273076518.m_KeyValue: "Miss Lorelei is actually the 'Mistbound Terror'? And... and she's a monster!"

4274537352.m_KeyValue: "We were once a single soul. Is it so strange that I manifest in your dreams?"

4274537353.m_KeyValue: ""Sunlight gently bathes the countryside in golden warmth, and the soft breeze carries the fragrance of sweet wildflowers mingled with the promise of rain.""

4274537354.m_KeyValue: "This isn't about the weather—it's the civil war. This place is soon to become a battlefield."

4274537356.m_KeyValue: "Let the Tempest grant this world a chance at rebirth."

4274537357.m_KeyValue: ""Then, they collided head-on with the enemy Captain's flanking troops...""

4274764354.m_KeyValue: ""Increases All DMG Dealt and All DMG Taken, and reduces HP Recovery Rate and Shield Recovery Rate.""

4274830256.m_KeyValue: ""Tragically… it's never once been used. For as long as I can remember, daylight has been little more than a fleeting visitor.""

4274832756.m_KeyValue: "I'll need to find someone who can give me proper answers."

4274832757.m_KeyValue: "'Reserved for nobility—commoners need not concern themselves.'"

4274832758.m_KeyValue: "Oh? I hadn't expected to find an ordinary individual with such resolve."

4274940487.m_KeyValue: ""Phantoms who wander between rifts. Bound neither to past nor future, they are trapped in the infinity of time, forever cycling through perpetuating dimensions, unable to find their way home.""

4275210697.m_KeyValue: ""But in my eyes, she'll always be that new little girl to the choir, who couldn't resist sneaking a crumb of communion during mass.""

4275210698.m_KeyValue: ""How time flies... In the blink of an eye, more than sixty years have passed.""

4275210699.m_KeyValue: ""Still, I must thank you. May the beautiful melodies of the hymns bless your kind soul, always.""

4276097565.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you invite me to eat fish with you?"

4277235149.m_KeyValue: "Seeking the gifts of the Threads of Fate through the cycles."

4277407397.m_KeyValue: "Even before I set foot on this island... I knew I would meet you. I've been waiting for this moment... for a very long time."

4277407398.m_KeyValue: ""Today, Bell Ringer No. X, Tris Tepes, will cross blades with the Valkyrie… Then fall at Sunset Isle, sealed alongside Death, remembered only as a fading legend.""

4277407399.m_KeyValue: ""Let me be selfish—just this once. A rare chance, a moment unrepeatable.""

4277407400.m_KeyValue: "She's gifted beyond measure. She'll inherit my place soon enough. And when that day comes… she'll begin to see the truth for what it is."

4277407401.m_KeyValue: ""And what about that child? What will become of her? She’s the one you cherish most, isn't she?""

4277407403.m_KeyValue: "She'll learn what it means to understand everything—yet be powerless to choose. I wonder how she'll struggle against it... That's what I look forward to most."

4277407405.m_KeyValue: "I'd rather you call me a good opponent instead."

4277423658.m_KeyValue: ""He admits to being the Calamity _$$Death,_$$ so what will you do?""

4277423659.m_KeyValue: ""Whether in your heart you remain the clergy from days long past, or have become a healer battling mortality on this island.""

4277423660.m_KeyValue: "So you've come because the Saint sent you to bring me back for judgment?"

4277423661.m_KeyValue: ""No, I think her target... must be me. The one deemed a _$$Calamity,_$$ the one known as _$$Death._$$""

4277423662.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how many secrets you learned while serving as the Saint's guard."

4277423663.m_KeyValue: ""But in my years as a Bell Ringer, I learned that some secrets remain veiled not always because they're forbidden to share, but because even truth itself changes nothing.""

4277423664.m_KeyValue: ""Tris, have you ever considered that time may not be the key to eternity—but its greatest betrayal?""

4277423665.m_KeyValue: ""You Bell Ringers are not truly immortal, but forsaken by time.""

4277423666.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa, know this: no matter which Other Side it may be, the same Tempus Church watches over every flow of time.""

4277423667.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you cheat life and death, fleeing to the edge of space and time, you will ultimately face us.""

4277724974.m_KeyValue: "He witnessed the blossoming of your resolve. Let's offer this flower and allow him to return to peace."

4277877293.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that this Celestial God has extraordinary wisdom, often coming up with ingenious solutions to conflicts among Celestial Gods. Their wisdom lay not in foreseeing the future, but in understanding the present and exploring the correct position of each step taken. Those blessed by this Celestial God will receive its gift of wisdom, rendering them able to hastily formulate meticulous strategies to resolve crises.""

4279595642.m_KeyValue: "The warmth of their blood still clings to my hands..."

4280279160.m_KeyValue: ""The deeper we go, the more of these insects we encounter.""

4282669325.m_KeyValue: "Cain! Noah's memories are still a mess. Now is not the time for explanations."

4282669326.m_KeyValue: ""This is... Wait, you want us to drink this?""

4282669327.m_KeyValue: ""Let's head back to the chamber where we used the Embrace. From there, we can pass through the long corridor to reach the Hall of the Elders.""

4282880761.m_KeyValue: "Purchase Premium Pass to reach max level."

4283034572.m_KeyValue: ""You are determined to accuse William, even if it means dragging your own companion into this disgrace. Have you no regard for the Church's reputation?""

4283034573.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland, I understand your desire for dignity and grace. But their mistake... is standing between me and the 'truth.'""

4283034574.m_KeyValue: "Jones truly despises me—but I know that hatred stems from his pride in his duty."

4283034575.m_KeyValue: "I do not know how William persuaded him to become an accomplice."

4283034576.m_KeyValue: ""But I believe there is still a sense of justice left in him. If we question him, we can uncover the whole truth.""

4283034577.m_KeyValue: ""If you're talking about your walking armor subordinate, he's in the rest area at the end of this floor. I even overheard him talking to someone...""

4283034578.m_KeyValue: "...That must be our culprit. Perfect. Saves me the trouble of questioning everyone one by one. Let's go."

4283034579.m_KeyValue: ""Do not forget whose ship you stand upon. At sea, I am the law. I do not care if you are the Silver Cross, or even a student of the Bell Ringers—I will not allow you...""

4283034580.m_KeyValue: ""I won't allow harm to come to our family. Even if they have committed an unforgivable sin, punishment must come from the Captain.""

4283044372.m_KeyValue: ""So long as I don't tug on the whiskers of the Bell Ringers, those silver kittens aren't so frightening—including the one aboard your ship as we speak.""

4283044373.m_KeyValue: "A humble fortune teller… interested in charts detailing the locations of Future Artifacts? Even the Tempus Church has its eyes on those."

4283044374.m_KeyValue: "But I expect Lady Dalcaro to honor her end of the bargain once the chart's authenticity is confirmed."

4283044375.m_KeyValue: "No wonder the Puppet Association recommended you—you've got guts. Fine. I'll hand over the chart to the Future Artifacts."

4283044377.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, Captain. I'll be right back.""

4283048690.m_KeyValue: ""We've had so much happen today, we haven't even properly welcomed you aboard yet. Forgive our discourtesy, Lady Bathory.""

4283048691.m_KeyValue: ""Just keep an eye on your 'caring' crew, and make sure they don't keep delivering 'room service' one after another.""

4283048692.m_KeyValue: ""First the headscarf bear barges in causing trouble, and Aiona doesn't even lift a finger to help. Where's Noah when you need him? Nobody's worried about us at all...""

4283048693.m_KeyValue: "Because we all believe Bob is actually a kind and caring person."

4283048695.m_KeyValue: "Thank goodness none of you were hurt. It seems the misunderstanding has been cleared."

4283048696.m_KeyValue: "Your friend must be sleeping really soundly to not wake up from all this noise."

4283048697.m_KeyValue: "She's just exhausted. She needs time to recover."

4283048699.m_KeyValue: "Ah... I got a bit carried away. I didn't notice her. My apologies."

4283048720.m_KeyValue: ""What do you mean!? Stop playing games, little Van Helsing! Just tell us who it is!""

4283048721.m_KeyValue: ""My deduction thus far is based on the premise that: 'Second Mate Aaron was strangled to death in this guest room, and his killer was here as well.'""

4283048725.m_KeyValue: "Of course not. I was only teasing. How could I ever forget the name of one of my dear family members?"

4283048726.m_KeyValue: "Tell us! Who did it?! I must avenge Aaron right away!"

4283048727.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing. After all these questions... Do you know who did it?"

4283048728.m_KeyValue: ""If I remember correctly... It was former captain Jones. He left for the bathroom once, then stayed with us afterward.""

4283048729.m_KeyValue: "One last question. Who was assigned to guard the deck near the bow at that time?"

4283437280.m_KeyValue: "Collaborating with the cartographer's surveys stands as a sacred duty for all citizens of Minexus."

4284532146.m_KeyValue: "No Perennial Band to collect or send."

4284714672.m_KeyValue: ""Distinguished patron, unveil your surprise from Puppet Association.""

4284862449.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor 055 in Tower of Purification."

4284862541.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor 150 in Tower of Purification."

4287641917.m_KeyValue: ""'Hehe.' Empousa's lips curled into a self-satisfied smirk. Despite teasing the amnesiac protagonist, she felt not an ounce of remorse.""

4287641918.m_KeyValue: ""'Just there.' Well, that's our witch who always seems to have a glimpse of the future.""

4287641919.m_KeyValue: "That's truly nothing more than a legend."

4287641920.m_KeyValue: ""'However, the book mentions an alternative account.' Empousa, sensing the oppressive atmosphere, attempted to salvage the situation.""

4288131532.m_KeyValue: ""Regarding the Vassal development you mentioned earlier, I have prepared the necessary resources for you.""

4288131533.m_KeyValue: ""(coughing) Damn it, it feels like my body and spirit are being torn apart—what is...""

4289634374.m_KeyValue: ""First, the Puppet Association is not short-staffed.""

4289883617.m_KeyValue: "Yes... I've always wished for one more moment with them—to say all the things I never could."

<alpha=#80>The ancients once associated immortality with the crescent moon. As the crystals refined from Lunarite naturally form into a teardrop-shape, alchemists have named them 'Moon Tear.'""

4291967072.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive us, but we too, are simply trying to survive.""

4291967077.m_KeyValue: ""The heavy doors creak open, and a weary band of survivors files into the hall.""

4291967079.m_KeyValue: ""Within its vast hall stretch rows of makeshift beds and low tents, the foul air heavy enough to draw a grimace.""

4291967080.m_KeyValue: "The Silver Cross?! Then you serve the Church? Has the Church at last sent aid to deliver us from this place?"

4291967081.m_KeyValue: ""Those crimson eyes... that swordsmanship, haunting yet steeped in ancient strength... and that mantle...""

4291967082.m_KeyValue: ""First some wind-summoning exhibitionist, now a fugitive of the Church. Truly, what a day.""

4291967083.m_KeyValue: ""Seraphina turns her eyes upon Ryan. He ignores the clamor, brow furrowed, his gaze fixed on her with unyielding intensity.""

4291967084.m_KeyValue: ""So, will you stand with a Bloodborn for the greater good—or...?""

4293258726.m_KeyValue: "And none of us can say who will transform next. Do you truly believe they'll test each one with care?"

4293258732.m_KeyValue: "Get away! I'll leave on my own!"

4293258733.m_KeyValue: "Wait—how did the two of you end up together?!"

4293258734.m_KeyValue: "Do not answer a question with a question."

4293258735.m_KeyValue: ""I'm impressed— for one who lives by the blade, your memory serves you well.""

4293258738.m_KeyValue: "Very well. Saving survivors no longer concerns me."

4294860774.m_KeyValue: ""As the deceased foretold, the incomplete Tarot spread has found itself. The future is revealed within a small space, and what awaits us will be...""

4294860775.m_KeyValue: "All things have been and arose from one by the mediation of one: so all things have their birth from this one thing by adaptation."

4294860806.m_KeyValue: ""Once, we were abandoned by fate, endured raging storms, were stranded on a desolate island, and confronted beasts afflicted with a contagious disease.""

4294860807.m_KeyValue: ""Don't panic. Jacintha left a box and said when we encounter difficulties, we'll find the Tarot's revelations within.""

4294861070.m_KeyValue: ""How much longer do we have to stay here, mother?""

4294861071.m_KeyValue: "It was when I was just born. I was abandoned by the water. Mother found me through divination and adopted me."

4294861073.m_KeyValue: "Don't... don't put too much faith in my divination. This... might not be accurate..."

4294861074.m_KeyValue: "How can we leave? The Pontos was sunk in the storm. We're lucky to have drifted to this island."

4294861075.m_KeyValue: ""Before we entrust our fate to divination, don't forget that our hands can create miracles too!""

4294861104.m_KeyValue: ""Why didn't I think of that! Surely we can build something to get off this island! Thank you, kitty!""

4294861105.m_KeyValue: "Let's get rid of all the Blood Beasts on the island!"

4294861136.m_KeyValue: "Why were all the Blood Beasts going for Jacintha during the battle..."

4294861170.m_KeyValue: ""...Thanks to everyone's perseverance, the great Pontos II is ready for sail!""

4294861171.m_KeyValue: ""...Thanks to everyone's combined effort, the great Pontos II has been completed!""

4294861172.m_KeyValue: ""Where have you been? Something's happened to your cousin, come with me!""

4294861173.m_KeyValue: ""Just give up! There is no tomorrow, there is no hope! Failure and death are all that await, again and again.""

4294861203.m_KeyValue: ""The Captain got infected with the Black Blood Disease, killed Stanley in the middle of the night, and Ernest...""

4294861204.m_KeyValue: "I will pick up the Tarot cards."

4294861205.m_KeyValue: ""But before that, we must stop the 'Captain' from harming his former men...""

4294861232.m_KeyValue: "...That was indeed a voice from the deceased. We will eventually leave this lonely island and return to the embrace of the sea."

4294861233.m_KeyValue: "Too bad I found this place first. According to sailors' rules..."

4294861234.m_KeyValue: ""Kitty, I know what to do now.""

4294861236.m_KeyValue: ""Kitty, do you think I can draw the final card?""

4294861267.m_KeyValue: "Ouch... Good thing my head is tough..."

4294861269.m_KeyValue: ""Trembling body, fearful eyes, helpless sighs... Oh no, is the past about to repeat itself?""
